1CH.1.50.motu: Baal-hanana e mase, bena Hadad na e lohia, ia gabuna ai; ena hanua badana ladana na Pai. Adavana ladana na Mehetabel; ia na Matared natuna, tubuna na Mesahab.
1CH.1.50.english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

1CH.6.36.motu: Amasai na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Ioel natuna, Ioel na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Sefania natuna,
1CH.6.36.english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

1CH.16.30.motu: tanobada idoinai, ia vairanai ba heude-heude;
1CH.16.30.english: Tremble before him, all the earth.

1CH.9.29.motu: Ma haida edia ḡaukara na dubu kohudia bona ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai, bona flaoa namo-hereana, bona vine ranuna, bona dehoro, bona muramura mai bonadia, bona aniani mamidia ihanamodia muramuradia, inaridia.
1CH.9.29.english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

1CH.21.7.motu: A Dirava ese una kara na e badulaia, bena ia ese Israel e hahisia.
1CH.21.7.english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

1CH.8.35.motu: Mika natuna: Pitono, Melek, Tarea, Ahasa.
1CH.8.35.english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

1CH.1.10.motu: Kusu ese Nimrod e havaraia; ia na lohia tauna gini-gunana tanobada ai.
1CH.1.10.english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

1CH.26.19.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea bunu; idia na Kora taudia bona Merari garana.
1CH.26.19.english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

1CH.12.37.motu: Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana Ioridane sinavaina unukahana amo, tatau iboudiai na domaga-ta gerebu-rua, mai edia tuari ḡaudia iboudiai imadia ai.
1CH.12.37.english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

1CH.1.34.motu: Abraham ese Isaak e havaraia. Isaak natuna: Esau bona Israel.
1CH.1.34.english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

1CH.6.32.motu: Idia na hebou kalagana dubuna vairanai toma-diho anedia e abi ema bona Solomon ese Iehova ena dubu e haginia Ierusalem ai; bona toma-diho karadia e kara, ta ta ena nega ena nega ai.
1CH.6.32.english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

1CH.29.19.motu: Natugu Solomon danu ba ha-uraia, bena ia ese mai lalona idoinai emu haheḡani bona emu hahediba herevadia bona emu taravatu baine badinadia, iboudiai na anidia baine kara, bona ruma badana, kohuna na lau ese vada na heḡaeḡaelai ḡauna, na ia ese baine haginia.
1CH.29.19.english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

1CH.9.5.motu: Bona Silono taudia: Asaia, tau-guna, mai natuna hahidaosi ida.
1CH.9.5.english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

1CH.2.40.motu: Eleasa na Sisimai tamana; Sisimai na Salumu tamana;
1CH.2.40.english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

1CH.21.16.motu: Bena David na e gaga isi, Iehova ena aneru e itaia, tanobada bona guba padadiai gini, imana amo dare e veria lasi bona Ierusalem daenai e toia roro. Bena David bona hanua tau-badadia na puse dabuadia e hahedokilai bona tano ai e goru parapara.
1CH.21.16.english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem.

1CH.29.14.motu: A lau be daika, bona egu orea taudia be daidia, bena mai emai dala emai lalo-ura ai herahia baia heni? Badina be ḡau iboudiai na oiemu amo e maimu, bena oi sibomu emu ḡau ma vada a henimu lou.
1CH.29.14.english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

1CH.6.18.motu: Kohat natuna: Amram, Isahara, Heberon, Usiele.
1CH.6.18.english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

1CH.3.11.motu: ia natuna Ioram; ia natuna Ahasia; ia natuna Ioasa;
1CH.3.11.english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

1CH.9.30.motu: Ma haida, hahelaḡa taudia natudia, ese aniani mamidia ihanamodia muramuradia e bulo hegaeḡaeva.
1CH.9.30.english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

1CH.23.18.motu: Isahara natuna na Selomiti, tau lohia.
1CH.23.18.english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

1CH.24.16.motu: ihagwauta-taurahanitana na Petahia, iharuahuina na Iehesekele,
1CH.24.16.english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

1CH.29.22.motu: Bena una dina ai idia na Iehova vairanai e aniani bona e inuinu, mai moale badadia ida.
1CH.29.22.english: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

1CH.24.24.motu: Usiele natuna, Mika; Mika natuna, Samiri;
1CH.24.24.english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

1CH.9.22.motu: Ini iboudiai, raka-vareai ikoukoudia igimadia dainai e duanaidia taudia, na sinahu-rua gwauta-rua; edia uru ta ta ai ladadia e tore, edia hanua heḡereḡeredia ai. David bona mata-hanai tauna Samuel ese e haginidia, abidadama dagina ai.
1CH.9.22.english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

1CH.28.13.motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia orea, bona Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai; bona Iehova ena dubu lalona ḡaukaradia ḡaudia iboudiai,
1CH.28.13.english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

1CH.1.40.motu: Sobal natuna: Alian, Manahata, Ebal, Sefi, Onam. Sibeon natuna: Aia bona Ana.
1CH.1.40.english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

1CH.15.20.motu: Sekaria, Asiele, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Uni, Eliab, Maaseia bona Benaia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bae hatai, Alamoto dalana ai;
1CH.15.20.english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

1CH.18.14.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Israel idoinai e lohiaia, bona ia ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaorona ida.
1CH.18.14.english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

1CH.26.11.motu: ihararuana na Hilkia; ihatatoina na Tebalia; ihahahanina na Sekaria. Hosa natuna bona tadikakana iboudiai na gwauta-toi.
1CH.26.11.english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

1CH.12.15.motu: Tatau bini Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, hua gini-gunana lalonai, abata e lasiva negana ai; bena idia ese koura ai e nohova taudia iboudiai, laurabada kahana ai bona lahara kahana ai, e luludia karoho.
1CH.12.15.english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

1CH.27.20.motu: Efraim iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Hosea Asasia; Manase iduhu-kahana taudia ikwaradia na Ioel Pedaia;
1CH.27.20.english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

1CH.7.17.motu: Ulama natuna na Bedana. Unu na Gilead garana; Gilead na Makiri natuna, Makiri na Manase natuna.
1CH.7.17.english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

1CH.12.34.motu: Napatali amo tuari lohiadia daha-ta, mai edia tuari taudia gerebu-toi daha-hitu, mai kesidia bona mai iodia ida.
1CH.12.34.english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

1CH.17.24.motu: Bena oi ladamu baine gini, bona bae imodaia hanaihanai, baeto “Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na Israel taudia edia Dirava”; bona emu hesiai tauna David ena iduhu na oi vairarnu ai baine gini.
1CH.17.24.english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

1CH.16.24.motu: Tanobada besedia bogaragidiai ia hairaina ba gwauraia hedinarai,
1CH.16.24.english: Declare his glory among the nations,

1CH.3.20.motu: bona Hasuba, Ohele, Berekia, Hasadia, lusaba-hesede, tatau laima.
1CH.3.20.english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

1CH.23.4.motu: David eto, Idia bogaragidia amo gerebu-rua daha-hani na Iehova ena dubu gaukaradia bae kara, daha tauratoi na heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ai baela,
1CH.23.4.english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

1CH.7.7.motu: Bela natuna: Esbon, Usisi, Usiele, Ierimoto, Iri, Iaimaosi, iduhu kwaradia, tuari taudia mai goadadia. Edia uru ai ladadia e tore, iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-rua toi-ahui hani.
1CH.7.7.english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

1CH.5.15.motu: Ahi, Abdiele Guni natuna, na edia iduhu e lohiadia.
1CH.5.15.english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

1CH.15.8.motu: Elisafan garana amo: Semaia, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-rua.
1CH.15.8.english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

1CH.11.5.motu: Iebusu taudia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na iniseni ai basio raka vareai. Ḡau tamona, David ese Siona kohorona e abia; una na David ena hanua.
1CH.11.5.english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

1CH.26.18.motu: Lahara kahana dehena ai na tatau hahani dala ai bona rarua dehe ai.
1CH.26.18.english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

1CH.26.7.motu: Semaia natuna: Otni, Refaele, Obed, Elsabad; Elsabad tadikakana Elihu bona Semakia na mai dibadia momo taudia.
1CH.26.7.english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

1CH.8.17.motu: Elpala natuna: Sebadia, Mesulama, Hiski, Hebere,

1CH.6.10.motu: Iohanan na Asaria tamana; Solomon ese Ierusalem ai e haginia dubuna lalonai una Asaria ese hahelaḡa karadia e kara.
1CH.6.10.english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

1CH.21.6.motu: A ia ese Levi taudia bona Beniamina taudia na se duahidia, badina be hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani na Ioab lalona ese e dadaraia.
1CH.21.6.english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

1CH.21.24.motu: A King David ese Oronana e hamaoroa, eto, Lasi, a davana korikori ai baina hoia; oiemu ḡau na basina abia Iehova ena, bona davadia asina kara ḡaudia na basina hahelaḡadia.
1CH.21.24.english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

1CH.23.25.motu: Badina be David eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese maino na ena bese taudia vada e henidia, bona ia na Ierusalem ai e noho hanaihanaiamu;
1CH.23.25.english: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

1CH.24.3.motu: Bena Eleasara garana ta, ladana Sadok, bona Itamara garana ta, ladana Ahimelek, ese David e durua, edia iduhu taudia na orea ta ta lalodiai e haboudia bona edia ḡaukara e henidia.
1CH.24.3.english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

1CH.17.15.motu: Ini hereva iboudiai bona ina mata-hanai idoinai heḡereḡeredia ai, Natan ese David e hamaorolaia.
1CH.17.15.english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

1CH.15.17.motu: Taunabunai, Levi taudia ese Hemana Ioel e duanaia, varavarana ta Asaf Berekia ida; bona varavaradia Merari garana amo, Etana Kusaia;
1CH.15.17.english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

1CH.26.9.motu: Meselemia na mai natuna bona tadikakana, mai dibadia momo taudia, gwauta-taurahani.
1CH.26.9.english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

1CH.22.10.motu: Ia ese dubu auta baine haginia, lau ladagu ena. Ia na lau natugu ai bainela, bona lau na ia tamana ai bainala; bona ena pavapava teronona na Israel ai baina haginia ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.22.10.english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

1CH.5.5.motu: ia natuna na Mika; ia natuna na Re-aia; ia natuna na Baal.
1CH.5.5.english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

1CH.15.9.motu: Heberon garana amo: Eliele, tau lohia, mai varavarana taurahani-ahui.
1CH.15.9.english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

1CH.11.28.motu: Ira Ikese, Tekoa tauna; Abiesere, Anatoto tauna;
1CH.11.28.english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

1CH.7.37.motu: Besere, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Itiran, Bera.
1CH.7.37.english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

1CH.15.22.motu: Kenania, Levi taudia edia ane-abi igunalaina tauna, ese ane baine hakaua, badina be ia na mai dibana.
1CH.15.22.english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

1CH.18.17.motu: Benaia Iehoiada na Kerete bona Pelete taudia biagudia. David natuna mamaruanedia na heitatao taudia badadia, hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara lalonai.
1CH.18.17.english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

1CH.16.1.motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana e huaia vareai, David ese vada e haginia kalagana lalonai e atoa; bena ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia na Dirava vairanai e hahelaḡadia.
1CH.16.1.english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

1CH.23.8.motu: Ladan natuna na Iehiele, tau lohia, bona Setama bona Ioel, tatoiosi.
1CH.23.8.english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

1CH.6.55.motu: bena Heberon, Iuda tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, e henidia;
1CH.6.55.english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

1CH.6.66.motu: Kohat taudia edia iduhu haida na edia hanua e abidia, Efraim taudia edia tano amo.
1CH.6.66.english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

1CH.7.34.motu: Ia tadina Semere natuna: Roga, Iehuba, Aram.
1CH.7.34.english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

1CH.6.76.motu: Bona Napatali iduhuna amo: Kede, Galilea ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Hamon, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Kiriataimi, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.76.english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

1CH.2.51.motu: Salma (ia na Betelehem tamana); bona Harefe (ia na Bete-gadere tamana).
1CH.2.51.english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

1CH.6.23.motu: Asiri natuna na Elkana; Elkana natuna na Ebiasafa; Ebiasafa natuna na Asiri;
1CH.6.23.english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

1CH.13.10.motu: Bena Iehova ena badu na Usa latanai e kau; bena e rahua mase, imana na maua helaḡana e toi roro henia dainai; bena unuseni ai e mase, Dirava vairanai.
1CH.13.10.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

1CH.25.25.motu: Ihagwauta-taurahanina na Hanani, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.25.english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.22.8.motu: A Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto: Oi na rara momo vada o hahebubu, bona tuari babada o kara; dubu auta basio haginia lau ladagu ena, badina be rara momo na tano ai vada o hahebubu lau vairagu ai.
1CH.22.8.english: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

1CH.12.3.motu: Ginigunana na Ahiesere, bona ia murinai na Ioasa; raruosi Sema, tau Gibea, natuna. Idia muridiai na lesiele bona Pelet, Asamavete natuna raruosi; Beraka; Iehu, tau Anatoto;
1CH.12.3.english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

1CH.19.3.motu: A Amono lohiadia ese Hanunu e hereva henia, eto, Oi na o laloamu David ese tauhalo taudia na dekemu vada e siaidia mai dainai ia ese tamamu e matauraiamu a? David ese ena hesiai taudia dekemu ai vada e siaidia badina korikori be bae hetahu, bae hahedarere, bona tano bae hasinadoa, ani?
1CH.19.3.english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

1CH.6.8.motu: Ahitubu na Sadok tamana; Sadok na Ahimasa tamana;
1CH.6.8.english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

1CH.8.2.motu: ihahanina na Noha; iha-imana na Rafa.
1CH.8.2.english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

1CH.26.25.motu: Ia tadikakana: Eliesere ena amo, natuna Rehabia; ia natuna Iesaia; ia natuna Ioram; ia natuna Sikri; ia natuna Selomoto.
1CH.26.25.english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

1CH.21.18.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Gad e haḡania, ia ese David baine hamaoroa, David na bainela, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta baine larebaia, Oronana tau Iebusu ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai.
1CH.21.18.english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

1CH.23.13.motu: Amram natuna na Aaron bona Mose. Aaron na e atoa idau, helaḡa herea ḡaudia baine hahelaḡadia totona; ia bona ia garana ese muramura mai bonadia na Iehova vairanai bae gabu ela bona hanaihanai, bona ia isiaina bae lao heni bona hahenamo herevadia bae gwaurai ia ladana ai ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.23.13.english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

1CH.24.5.motu: Mari amo edia orea e hididia, iboudiai na heḡereḡere; badina be haida na gabu helaḡana itataona taudia bona haida na Dirava ena itatao taudia, Eleasara garana amo bona Itamara garana amo danu.
1CH.24.5.english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

1CH.25.23.motu: Ihagwauta-tauratoina na Hanania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.23.english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.29.18.motu: Iehova e, senemai Abraham bona Isaak bona Israel edia Dirava, ura bona lalo-hadai unuhetomadia na emu orea taudia lalodia ai ba hamiadia hanaihanai, bona lalodia ba ha-uradia, idia na oi mo bae haḡeremu.
1CH.29.18.english: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

1CH.3.12.motu: ia natuna Amasia; ia natuna Asaria; ia natuna Iotam;
1CH.3.12.english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

1CH.17.8.english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

1CH.1.44.english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

1CH.8.28.motu: Unu na iduhu kwaradia bona lohia taudia, edia uru lalodiai. Idia na Ierusalem ai e nohova.
1CH.8.28.english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

1CH.11.20.motu: Abisai, Ioab tadina, na hari toiahuiosi biagudia. Ia ese tatau sinahu-toi na ena io amo e aladia mase; bena ladana e dae, idia tatoiosi ida heḡereḡere.
1CH.11.20.english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

1CH.23.15.motu: Mose natuna na Geresom bona Eliesere.
1CH.23.15.english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

1CH.25.13.motu: Ihatauratoina na Bukia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.13.english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.6.56.motu: a hanua badana tanodia mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida na Kaleb Iefune e henia.
1CH.6.56.english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

1CH.16.18.english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan,

1CH.18.16.motu: Sadok Ahitubu bona Ahimelek Abiatara na hahelaḡa taudia; Savasa na toretore tauna;
1CH.18.16.english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

1CH.11.41.english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

1CH.8.10.motu: Ieusu, Sakia, Mirima. Natuna bunu; idia na iduhu kwaradia.
1CH.8.10.english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

1CH.27.1.motu: Israel taudia ladadia bini, iduhu kwaradia bona daha bona sinahu Iohiadia bona edia orea biagudia, hanua pavapavana isiaina e lao heniva, laḡani lalonai hua ta ta ai orea edia lao mai e ita taova; orea ta ta taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.1.english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.29.7.motu: Dirava ena dubu gaukaradia ikaralaidia totona e heni ḡaudia na gold talent daha-ima bona golddarikidia gerebu-ta, silver talent gerebu-ta, bronze talent gerebu-ta daha-taurahani, bona auri talent domaga-ta.
1CH.29.7.english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

1CH.3.10.motu: Solomon garana: Rehoboam; ia natuna Abia; ia natuna Asa; ia natuna Iehosafat;
1CH.3.10.english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

1CH.29.26.motu: David, Iese natuna, ese Israel idoinai unu e lohiaia toma.
1CH.29.26.english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

1CH.24.8.motu: ihatoina na Harimi, ihahanina na Seorimi,
1CH.24.8.english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

1CH.10.11.motu: A Iabese-gilead taudia iboudiai na Filistia taudia edia kara iboudiai Saulo enai haridia e kamonai,
1CH.10.11.english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

1CH.7.39.english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

1CH.17.9.motu: Egu bese Israel ena gabu baina duanai henia, bona baina hadaia, bena ena gabu korikori ai baine noho, basie hamarerea lou. Daḡedaḡe taudia ese basie habuaia lou, gunaguna e karava heḡereḡerena,
1CH.17.9.english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

1CH.20.5.motu: Bena Filistia taudia ida ma e tuari lou; una negana ai Elhanan lairi ese Lahami, Goliata tau Gata tadikakana, na e alaia mase. Una tau ena io auauna na dabua ihatuna tauna ena au na heto.
1CH.20.5.english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

1CH.6.51.motu: Abisua natuna na Buki, Buki natuna na Usisi, Usisi natuna na Serahia,
1CH.6.51.english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

1CH.25.10.motu: Ihatoina na Sakuru, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.10.english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.24.22.motu: Isihara taudia edia amo, Selomoto; Selomoto natuna edia amo, Iahata.
1CH.24.22.english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

1CH.26.29.motu: Isihara iduhuna amo, Kenania mai natuna ida e duanaidia, murimuri kahana ḡaukaradia bae kara, Israel ena; heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ai baela.
1CH.26.29.english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

1CH.5.20.motu: ituari-henidia ai hekaha e davaria. bena Hagara taudia mai bamodia ida na idia imadia ai e heato kau; badina be tuari lalonai idia ese Dirava e boi henia, bena ia ese edia noinoi e abia dae, idia ese ia e abidadama henia dainai.
1CH.5.20.english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

1CH.29.30.motu: ena lohia karadia, bona ena siahu, bona ienai bona Israel enai bona unu tano basileiadia iboudiai ediai e vara ḡaudia, sivaraidia danu.
1CH.29.30.english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

1CH.21.28.motu: Una negana ai David ese e itaia, Oronana tau Iebusu ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai Iehova ese vada e haere henia; bena ena boubou ḡaudia na e hahelaḡadia unuseni ai.
1CH.21.28.english: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

1CH.29.23.motu: Bena Solomon na Iehova ena terono ai e helai, tamana David gabuna ai e lohia; ena namo e habadaia e laova, bona Israel idoinai ese ia erena e kamonai.
1CH.29.23.english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

1CH.16.21.motu: una negana ai ta asine gwau maoro henia idia baine daḡedaḡe henidia;
1CH.16.21.english: He allowed no man to do them wrong.

1CH.6.69.motu: Aialono, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Gata-rimon, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.69.english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

1CH.1.11.motu: Aigupto ese e havaradia besedia bini: Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Napatuhim,
1CH.1.11.english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

1CH.7.5.motu: Idia varavaradia, Isakara ena iduhu iboudiai lalodiai, na tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-taurahani daha-hitu, edia uru ai ladadia e tore.
1CH.7.5.english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

1CH.7.11.motu: Unu iboudiai na Iediaele natuna, edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia, tuari taudia mai goadadia. Iboudiai na gerebu-ta daha-hitu sinahu-rua, heheḡaegae tuari totona.
1CH.7.11.english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

1CH.25.9.motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna tauna, Asaf enai, na Iosef. Iharuana na Gedalia, mai tadikakana bona natuna verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.9.english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

1CH.2.45.motu: Samai natuna na Maono, Maono na Bete-suru tamana
1CH.2.45.english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

1CH.1.51.english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

1CH.15.26.motu: Bena Dirava ese Levi taudia, hari Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na e durudia dainai, idia ese boromakau mamaruanedia hitu bona mamoe mamaruanedia hitu na e abidia, boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia.
1CH.15.26.english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

1CH.4.35.motu: Ioel; Iehu Iosibia, Seraia Asiele tubuna;
1CH.4.35.english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

1CH.28.8.motu: Taunabunai, harihari Israel taudia iboudiai, Iehova ena hegogo taudia vairadiai, bona eda Dirava ena kamonai ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani iboudiai ba badinadia bona ba tahudia, bena ina tano namona bavabia oiemu, bona ba rakatania, garana ahudia ai bainela ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.28.8.english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

1CH.11.10.motu: David ena goada taudia lohiadia bini. Idia ese e durua goadagoadava ena basileia lalonai, Israel idoinai ida, pavapava ai bae halaoa totona, Iehova ese Israel e herevalaia heḡereḡerena.
1CH.11.10.english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.

1CH.29.2.motu: Taunabunai, egu Dirava ena dubu kohudia vada na heḡaeḡaelai, egu goada heḡereḡerena: gold, gold gaudia edia; silver, silver ḡaudia edia; bronze, bronze ḡaudia edia; auri, auri ḡaudia edia; au, au ḡaudia edia; bona onuku nadidia, bona herahera nadidia haida, puku nadidia, oromadia idau-idau nadidia, dava-bada nadidia idau-idau, bona nadi hururu-hururudia.
1CH.29.2.english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

1CH.1.31.motu: Ieturu, Nafisi, Kedema. Ismael natuna bunu.
1CH.1.31.english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

1CH.17.14.motu: a egu ruma ai bona egu basileia ai baina hamomokania hanaihanai, bona iena terono baine gini ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.17.14.english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

1CH.28.9.motu: Bona oi, natugu Solomon e, tamamu ena Dirava enai ba manada, bona isiaina ba lao heni mai lalomu idoinai bona mai lalo-uramu idoinai; badina be Iehova ese taunimanima iboudiai lalodia e tahudiamu, bona lalo-hata bona lalo-hadai iboudiai na dibana. Boma tahua, vada ba davaria; a boma rakatania, ia ese baine negemu daure ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.28.9.english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

1CH.8.32.motu: bona Mikloto (ia na Simea tamana). Idia na varavaradia italaidia ai e nohova Ierusalem ai, tadikakadia ida.
1CH.8.32.english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

1CH.14.15.motu: Bena reḡe ta baka audia dondia ai ba kamonai, e kara tuari taudia e raka hanaimu na heheto, vada ba raka lasi, ba tuari henidia; badina be Dirava vada e raka lasi guna oi vairamu ai, Filistia edia tuari taudia irahu-masedia totona.
1CH.14.15.english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

1CH.5.7.motu: Ia varavarana, edia iduhu ta ta ai, edia uru ladadia e hagaudia heḡereḡerena: Ieiele, lohia tauna, bona Sekaria;
1CH.5.7.english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

1CH.23.9.motu: Simei natuna na Selomoto bona Hasiele bona Haran, tatoiosi. Idia na Ladan ena iduhu lohiadia.
1CH.23.9.english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

1CH.12.33.motu: Sebulun taudia na gerebu-ima, tuari manada taudia, edia tuari ḡaudia iboudiai na imadia ai, bona lalodia na tamona, David bae durua eto.
1CH.12.33.english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

1CH.4.25.motu: ia natuna na Salumu, ia natuna na Mibisam, ia natuna na Misirna.
1CH.4.25.english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

1CH.29.21.motu: Bena boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena; bona daba-rerena ai ḡole-oho bouboudia na e hahelaḡadia. Iehova ena, boromakau mamaruanedia daha-ta, bona mamoe natudia daha-ta; edia inuinu bouboudia danu e hahelaḡadia, bona boubou ḡaudia momo herea, Israel taudia iboudiai daidiai.
1CH.29.21.english: They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

1CH.11.45.motu: Iediaele Simri, bona ia tadina loha, tau Tisi;
1CH.11.45.english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

1CH.1.13.motu: Kanaan natuna bini: Sidono, tau-roboana, bona Het.
1CH.1.13.english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

1CH.9.10.english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

1CH.4.16.motu: Iehalelele natuna: Sifi, Sifaha, Tiria, Asarele.
1CH.4.16.english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

1CH.19.9.motu: Bena Amono taudia na e raka lasi, edia tuari ḡaudia e abidia, hanua raka-vareaina ai e gini heḡaeḡae. A hari pavapavana, ema taudia, na sibodia tano paka ai e noho.
1CH.19.9.english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

1CH.6.30.motu: Usa natuna na Simea; Simea natuna na Hagia, Hagia natuna na Asaia.
1CH.6.30.english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

1CH.11.46.motu: Eliele, Mahava tauna; Ieribai bona Iosavia, Elnama natuna raruosi; Itima, Moab tauna;
1CH.11.46.english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

1CH.6.6.motu: Usisi na Serahia tamana; Serahia na Meraioto tamana;
1CH.6.6.english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

1CH.5.24.motu: Tamadia edia iduhu kwaradia bini: Efere, Isi, Eliele, Asriel, Ieremia, Hodavia, bona Iahadiele, tuari taudia mai goadadia bona mai haridia, tamadia edia iduhu kwaradia.
1CH.5.24.english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

1CH.25.30.motu: Iharuahui-toina na Mahasioto, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.30.english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.2.49.motu: Ia ese Saafa danu e havaraia (ia na Madamana tamana), bona Seva (ia na Makabena bona Gibea tamadia). Kaleb natuna hahinena na Aksa.
1CH.2.49.english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

1CH.1.52.english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

1CH.5.22.motu: Hutuma bada e mase, badina be tuari na Dirava ena amo e vara. Bena edia gabu e noholaia ela bona e laohaidia idau gabu ai e hanohodia negana.
1CH.5.22.english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

1CH.2.46.motu: Efa na Kaleb ese e adavaia hahinena; una hahine ese Haran bona Mosa bona Gasese e havara henia. Haran na Gasese tamana.
1CH.2.46.english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

1CH.27.2.motu: Iasobeama, Sabdiele natuna, na orea gini-gunana e biaguava, hua gini-gunana ai; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.2.english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.7.31.motu: Beria natuna: Hebere bona Malkiel, Birisaiti tamana.
1CH.7.31.english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

1CH.9.32.motu: Bona varavaradia haida, Kohat iduhuna taudia, ese flaoa helaḡana igabuna e nariava, dina helagadia iboudiai e heḡaeḡaelaiava.
1CH.9.32.english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

1CH.4.42.motu: Bena idia haida, Simeon iduhu tataudia sinahu-ima, na Seiri ororona ela; ihakaudia taudia na Isi natuna hahaniosi, Pelatia bona Nearia bona Refaia bona Usiele.
1CH.4.42.english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

1CH.11.12.motu: Unu tatoiosi bogaragidiai, ia murinai na Eleasara; ia na Dodo, tau Ahohi, natuna.
1CH.11.12.english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

1CH.7.33.motu: Iaflete natuna: Pasaka, Bimihala, Asavata. Unu na laflete natuna.
1CH.7.33.english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

1CH.3.5.motu: Ini na Ierusalem ai e havaradia: Simea, Sobab, Natan, Solomon; ini hahaniosi na Batasua, Amiele natuna, bogana amo.
1CH.3.5.english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

1CH.4.36.motu: Elioenai; Iaakoba; Iesohaia; Asaia; Adiele; Iesimiele; Benaia;
1CH.4.36.english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

1CH.6.12.motu: Ahitubu na Sadok tamana; Sadok na Salumu tamana;
1CH.6.12.english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

1CH.3.23.motu: Nearia natuna: Elioenai, Hesekia, Asarikama, taudia tatoi.
1CH.3.23.english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

1CH.6.25.motu: Elkana natuna na Amasai bona Ahimoto;
1CH.6.25.english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

1CH.5.25.motu: A idia ese tamadia edia Dirava e kara havara henia, bona una tano taudia edia dirava e toma henidia diho, Dirava ese idia vairadiai vada e habuadia tari ḡaudia.
1CH.5.25.english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

1CH.19.12.motu: Ia eto, Suria taudia na egu ai bema goada herea, vada ba durugu; a Amono taudia na emu ai bema goada herea, lau ese baina vasi durumu.
1CH.19.12.english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

1CH.10.6.motu: Saulo na unu e mase toma, bona natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi bona ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ia ida e mase bou.
1CH.10.6.english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

1CH.2.20.motu: Huru na Uri tamana, bona Uri na Besalele tamana.
1CH.2.20.english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

1CH.11.23.motu: Aigupto tauna ta danu ia ese e alaia mase; una tau na tau bada-hereana, ena lata na kiubit ima. Una Aigupto tauna imana na mai iona; una io na dabua ihatuna tauna ena au na heto. A Benaia ese mai auna ida ia e lao henia, io na Aigupto tauna imana amo e dadihaia, bena sibona ena io amo e gwadaia mase.
1CH.11.23.english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

1CH.23.21.motu: Merari natuna na Mali bona Musi. Mali natuna na Eleasara bona Kisa.
1CH.23.21.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

1CH.23.3.motu: Levi taudia, laḡanidia toi-ahui vada e hanai taudia, na e duahidia, iboudiai na gerebu-toi daha-taurahani.
1CH.23.3.english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

1CH.1.42.motu: Esere natuna: Bilhan, Saavan, laakan. Dison natuna: Usu bona Aran.
1CH.1.42.english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

1CH.4.13.motu: Kena natuna na Otoniele bona Seraia; Otoniele natuna na Hatata bona Meonotai.
1CH.4.13.english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

1CH.29.29.motu: King David ena kara, matamana amo ela bona dokona, na mata-hanai tauna Samuel bona peroveta tauna Natan bona mata-hanai tauna Gad Sisigadia bukadia ai e hetore;
1CH.29.29.english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

1CH.10.13.motu: Taunabunai Saulo na e mase, asi ena momokani dainai; ia na Iehova enai se momokani, Iehova ena haheḡani se badinaia, bona rohe hahinena enai hahekau e tahua,
1CH.10.13.english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

1CH.12.28.motu: Sadok, tau eregabe, goada-herea tauna, bona tuari lohiadia ruahui-rua, ia tamana ena iduhu amo.
1CH.12.28.english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

1CH.17.13.motu: Lau na ia tamana ai bainala, bona ia na lau natugu ai bainela; egu hebogahisi na iena amo basina abia oho, e gunalaimu tauna ena amo na abia oho heḡereḡerena;
1CH.17.13.english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

1CH.17.26.motu: Iehova e, oi na Dirava, bona oi ese ina ḡau namona na emu hesiai tauna vada o gwaurai henia hamata;
1CH.17.26.english: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

1CH.6.34.motu: Samuel na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Eliele natuna, Eliele na Toa natuna,
1CH.6.34.english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

1CH.16.41.motu: Idia ida na Hemana bona ledutunu, bona e abidia hidi bona ladadia e hato taudia oredia. Eto, Iehova bae hanamoa, badina be ena hebogahisi e hesiriu hanaihanaimu.
1CH.16.41.english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;

1CH.9.44.motu: Asele natuna na tauratoi, ladadia bini: Asarikama, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, Hanana. Asele natuna bunu.
1CH.9.44.english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

1CH.23.20.motu: Usiele natuna na Mika, tau lohia; ihararuana na Isia.
1CH.23.20.english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

1CH.26.8.motu: Ini iboudiai na Obed-edom natuna, bona idia natudia bona tadikakadia, mai dibadia momo taudia, edia diba vada e heḡereḡere ḡaukara ikarana ai, iboudiai na tauratoi-ahui rua, Obed-edom garana amo.
1CH.26.8.english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

1CH.19.4.motu: Taunabunai, Hanunu ese David ena hesiai taudia e abidia, auki-huidia e nau, bona edia hahedoki e utudia kwadogi koekoedia ai; bena e siaidia oho. Bena idia na ela.
1CH.19.4.english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

1CH.22.18.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na umui ida ani? Ia ese maino vada e henimui kaha iboudiai ani? Badina be ina tano taudia na lau imagu ai vada e atodia, bona tano na vada e hagedaia tari, Iehova mai ena bese taudia ida vairadiai.
1CH.22.18.english: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

1CH.19.7.motu: Idia ese kariota gerebu-toi daha-rua bona Maaka pavapavana mai ena tuari oreana ida e vatudia; bena idia na ema, Medeba vairanai e taruha. Amono taudia danu edia hanua amo e haboudia, bena tuari ela.
1CH.19.7.english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

1CH.6.62.motu: Gereson taudia edia iduhu ta ta amo na hanua gwauta-toi e gwaurai henidia, Isakara bona Asere bona Napatali bona Manase (Basan ai) iduhudia amo.
1CH.6.62.english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

1CH.16.33.motu: Una negana ai uda audia na moale anedia bae abi
1CH.16.33.english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh,

1CH.12.23.motu: Tuari taudia edia orea ta ta e hagaudia ḡaudia bini; idia na David dekena ela, Heberon ai, Saulo ena basileia na ia bae henia eto, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
1CH.12.23.english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.

1CH.4.41.motu: Ini ladadia e hetore taudia na Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai ema, edia kalaga e habuadia tari, bona Meunimi taudia unuseni ai e davaridia danu e ha-oredia, ema bona ina dina; bena edia gabu e noholaia, badina be edia seri adia rei gabudia na unuseni ai.
1CH.4.41.english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

1CH.2.1.motu: Israel natuna bini: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Iuda, Isakara, Sebulun,
1CH.2.1.english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

1CH.12.32.motu: Isakara lohiadia na sinahu-rua, nega ihaerona mai dibadia bona Israel na ede baine karaia toma danu dibadia taudia; varavaradia iboudiai na idia edia siahu henunai.
1CH.12.32.english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

1CH.12.29.motu: Beniamina taudia, Saulo varavarana, na daha-toi; idia hutuma na ema bona hari Saulo ena iduhu enai e tao.
1CH.12.29.english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

1CH.9.38.motu: Mikloto na Simeama tamana. Idia na varavaradia italaidia ai e nohova Ierusalem ai, tadikakadia ida.
1CH.9.38.english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

1CH.2.16.motu: Taihudia na Seruia bona Abigail. Seruia natuna: Abisai, Ioab, Asahele, tatoi.
1CH.2.16.english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

1CH.10.7.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai koura ai e nohova ese tuari oreana e itaia vada e heau, bona Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida vada e mase; una negana ai idia ese edia hanua e rakatanidia, e heau. Bena Filistia taudia ema, unu hanua e noholaidia.
1CH.10.7.english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

1CH.16.23.motu: Tanobada idoinai, ane avabia, Iehova ena!
1CH.16.23.english: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth!

1CH.24.14.motu: ihagwauta-imana na Bilga, ihagwauta-tauratoina na Imere,
1CH.24.14.english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

1CH.6.5.motu: Abisua na Buki tamana; Buki na Usisi tamana,
1CH.6.5.english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

1CH.6.49.motu: A Aaron mai garana ida ese boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, ḡole-oho bouboudia ihaboulaina patana latanai bona muramura mai bonadia patana latanai, helaḡa-herea gabuna gaukaradia iboudiai daidiai bona Israel ena herohemaino ikarana totona, Dirava ena hesiai tauna Mose ena haheḡani iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
1CH.6.49.english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

1CH.25.19.motu: Ihagwauta-ruana na Hasabia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.19.english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.4.9.motu: Iabese ese kara maoromaoro ai tadikakana e hereadia; sinana ese ia ladana e hatoa Iabese, eto, Badina be hisi-ani ai na havaraia.
1CH.4.9.english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

1CH.21.1.motu: Satana ese Israel e inai henia, bena David e dibaḡania, Israel taudia baine hagaudia.
1CH.21.1.english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

1CH.8.7.motu: Naaman, Ahia, Gera (ladana ta Hegelama); ia na Usa bona Ahihud tamadia.
1CH.8.7.english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

1CH.8.3.english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

1CH.25.3.motu: Iedutunu ena amo: Iedutunu natuna Gedalia, Seri, Iesaia, Simei, Hasabia, Matitia, tauratoiosi. Tamadia Iedutunu ese e biagudia; una tau na Iehova ihanamona bona i'imodaina ai hatai-hatai ḡaudia amo e perovetava.
1CH.25.3.english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

1CH.23.10.motu: Simei natuna na lahata bona Sina bona Ieusu bona Beria. Unu hahaniosi na Simei natuna.
1CH.23.10.english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

1CH.2.27.motu: Ram, Ierahamele natuna roboana, natuna: Maasa, Iamin, Ekere.
1CH.2.27.english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

1CH.16.7.motu: Una dina ai David ese Asaf mai varavarana ida e duanaidia, Iehova ihanamolaina anedia bae abi matama.
1CH.16.7.english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

1CH.7.30.motu: Asere natuna: Imna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, bona taihudia Sera.
1CH.7.30.english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

1CH.11.25.motu: Ia na mai harina unu toiahuiosi bogaragidiai; ḡau tamona hari tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere. Bena David ese ia igimana oreana biaguna ai e halaoa.
1CH.11.25.english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

1CH.17.2.motu: Bena Natan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Lalomu ai e miamu ḡauna idoinai do ba karaia, badina be Dirava na oi ida.
1CH.17.2.english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

1CH.7.6.motu: Beniamina natuna: Bela, Bekere, Iediaele, tatoiosi.
1CH.7.6.english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

1CH.2.38.motu: Obed na Iehu tamana; Iehu na Asaria tamana;
1CH.2.38.english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

1CH.17.11.motu: Emu dina bae ore bena tubu tama dekedia baola negana ai oi ese o havaraia merona, oi natumu mamaruanedia ta, lau ese baina abia isi, bona ena basileia danu baina haginia.
1CH.17.11.english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

1CH.23.28.motu: Edia ḡaukara be Aaron garana bae durudia, Iehova ena dubu gaukaradia ikaradia ai: maḡu bona daiutu bae naridia, ḡau helaḡadia bae haḡoevadia, bona Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia idau-idau bae kara;
1CH.23.28.english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

1CH.23.7.motu: Gereson natuna na Ladan bona Simei.
1CH.23.7.english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

1CH.1.45.motu: Iobab e mase, bena bena Husam, Teman tanona tauna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
1CH.1.45.english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

1CH.1.7.motu: Ivan natuna: Elisa bona Tarasisi; bona Kitim besena bona Dodanim besena danu ia ese e havaradia.
1CH.1.7.english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

1CH.16.27.motu: Hemataurai bona heimodai na ia vairanai,
1CH.16.27.english: Honor and majesty are before him.

1CH.29.12.motu: Taḡa bona hemataurai e maimu daladia na oiemu amo; oi ese ḡau iboudiai o biagudiamu. Siahu bona goada na oi imamu ai; oi imamu ai na ḡau iboudiai ihabadadia bona ihagoadadia.
1CH.29.12.english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

1CH.3.24.motu: Elioenai natuna: Hodavia, Eliasibi, Pelaia, Akubu, Iohanan, Delaia, Anani, taudia hahitu.
1CH.3.24.english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

1CH.15.1.motu: David na ruma haida e haginidia ia sibona ena, David ena hanua ai; bona Dirava ena maua helaḡana gabuna e lailaia, bona kalagana e haginia.
1CH.15.1.english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

1CH.11.39.motu: Seleke, Amono tauna; Naharai, tau Beroto, Ioab Seruia ena kesi ihuana tauna;
1CH.11.39.english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

1CH.7.3.motu: Usisi natuna na Isirahia. Isirahia natuna: Mikael, Obadia, Ioel, Isihia; tatau laima, iboudiai na lohia taudia;
1CH.7.3.english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

1CH.4.19.motu: Hodia adavana, Nahama taihuna, natuna na Keila, tau Garama, bona Estemoa, tau Maakata, tamadia.
1CH.4.19.english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

1CH.9.36.motu: Natuna roboana na Abdon; ia murinai Suru, Kisa, Baal, Nere, Nadab,
1CH.9.36.english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

1CH.21.14.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese dai-hanai gorerena ta Israel latanai e siaia; bena Israel taudia gerebu-hitu e mase.
1CH.21.14.english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

1CH.6.47.motu: Semere na Mali natuna, Mali na Musi natuna, Musi na Merari natuna, Merari na Levi natuna.)
1CH.6.47.english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

1CH.6.57.motu: Aaron garana na roho-mauri hanuadia e henidia: Heberon; Libna, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Iatiri; Estemoa, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.57.english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

1CH.1.41.motu: Ana natuna: Dison. Dison natuna: Hamaran, Eseban, Itiran, Keran.
1CH.1.41.english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

1CH.2.50.english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

1CH.4.3.motu: Ini na Etam natuna: Iesrele, Isma, Idibasa; taihudia ladana na Haseleleponi.
1CH.4.3.english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

1CH.11.22.motu: Benaia Iehoiada na boga-auka tauna ta, Kabsele amo; ia na kara badadia ikaradia tauna. Ia ese Ariele natuna raruosi Moab amo na e aladia mase. Ia danu e hekei lao, leona ta na guri lalonai e alaia mase, snow e dihova dinana ai.
1CH.11.22.english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

1CH.1.17.motu: Sem natuna: Elam, Asuru, Afasad, Lud, Aram, Usu, Hulu, Getere, Mesek.
1CH.1.17.english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

1CH.24.19.motu: Ini ta ta na mai edia ḡaukara, Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareai negadia ai, Iehova, Israel Diravana ese senedia Aaron e haḡania bena Aaron ese taravadia e atu heḡereḡerena.
1CH.24.19.english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

1CH.25.2.motu: Asaf natuna edia amo: Sakuru, Iosef, Netania, Asarela. Idia na Asaf natuna, bona Asaf ese e biagudia. Hari Asaf na hanua pavapavana ena hahedua heḡereḡerena ai e perovetava.
1CH.25.2.english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

1CH.2.52.motu: Sobal, Kiriat-iearimi tamana, na mai ena bese haida danu: Haroe; Menuhoto besena kahana;
1CH.2.52.english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

1CH.15.4.motu: Bena David ese Aaron garana ona Levi taudia e haboudia.
1CH.15.4.english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

1CH.24.30.motu: Musi natuna: Mali, Edere, lerimoto. Levi garana bunu, edia iduhu ta ta ai.
1CH.24.30.english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

1CH.7.22.motu: Tamadia Efraim na taidia e tai, dina hoho; bena tadikakana ese ia tauna ihalona ema.
1CH.7.22.english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

1CH.2.34.motu: Hari Sesana natuna na hahinedia mo, asi natuna maruanena. A Sesana na mai ena hesiai tauna ta, Aigupto tauna, ladana na Iaraha.
1CH.2.34.english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

1CH.16.26.motu: Badina be bese idau-idau edia dirava na kaivakuku mo,
1CH.16.26.english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols,

1CH.19.8.motu: David e kamonai, bena ia ese Ioab, bona tuari taudia mai goadadia iboudiai na e siaidia lao.
1CH.19.8.english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

1CH.26.15.motu: Obed-edom na e duanaia, diho kahana ena, bona natuna na habou-habou rumana ena.
1CH.26.15.english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

1CH.4.8.motu: Koso na Anubu bona Sobeba tamadia, bona Aharahele, Harumu natuna, ena iduhu senena.
1CH.4.8.english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

1CH.29.5.motu: bona karakara ai ima-namo taudia edia ḡaukara iboudiai ikaralaidia gaudia, gold, gold ḡaudia edia, bona silver, silver ḡaudia edia. Daika na hari ina dina ai mai ura-kwalimuna ida sibona baine heato lasi Iehova enai?
1CH.29.5.english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

1CH.7.23.motu: Bena Efraim na adavana dekenai e vareai; bena hahine na e rogorogo, mero ta e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Beria, badina be dika na ena ruma latanai vada e kau.
1CH.7.23.english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

1CH.11.36.motu: Hefere, tau Mekerata; Ahia, tau Pelono;
1CH.11.36.english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

1CH.27.31.motu: Ini iboudiai na King David ena kohu ireḡudia.
1CH.27.31.english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

1CH.13.11.motu: Bena David na e badu, Iehova ese Usa e rahua mase dainai; bena una gabu ladana e hatoamu Perese-usa, ema bona harihari.
1CH.13.11.english: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

1CH.2.17.motu: Abigail ese Amasa e havaraia; Amasa tamana na letere, tau Ismael.
1CH.2.17.english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

1CH.9.34.motu: Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia bunu; idia na hegunalai taudia, edia uru ta ta ai; idia danu Ierusalem ai e nohova.
1CH.9.34.english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

1CH.9.18.motu: Guna idia na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou e gimaiava, mairiveina kahana ai. Levi taudia edia taruha ikoukouna igimana taudia bunu.
1CH.9.18.english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

1CH.27.14.motu: Ihagwauta-tana, hua ihagwauta-tana ena, na Benaia, tau Piratono, Efraim garana ta; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.14.english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.8.1.motu: Beniamina natuna roboana na Bela; iharuana na Asbel; ihatoina na Ahara;
1CH.8.1.english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

1CH.11.30.motu: Maharai, tau Netofa; Helede Baanaha, tau Netofa;
1CH.11.30.english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

1CH.12.35.motu: Dan taudia na gerebu-rua daha-taurahani sinahu-tauratoi, mai edia tuari ḡaudia ida.
1CH.12.35.english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

1CH.18.11.motu: unu ḡau danu King David ese e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena, vada e hadareredia besedia iboudiai edia amo e dadi silver-na bona gold-na ida. Besedia be Edom bona Moab bona Arnono bona Filistia bona Amalek taudia.
1CH.18.11.english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

1CH.28.11.motu: Bena David ese dubu raka-vareaina bona rumana, bona habou-habou daiutudia, bona atai daiutudia, bona laloma daiutudia, bona hebogahisi teronona daiutuna, ikaradia dalana e laloa hata ḡauna na ia natuna Solomon e henia;
1CH.28.11.english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

1CH.1.54.motu: Magdiel, Iram. Unu na Edom iduhulohiadia.
1CH.1.54.english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

1CH.26.31.motu: Heberon iduhuna lalona amo leria na Heberon iduhudia idau-idau iboudiai edia lohia. (David ena lohia laḡanina ihahari-ahuina ai hetahu e karaia, bena mai dibadia momo taudia haida na idia bogaragidiai e davaridia, lasere, Gilead hanuana ta, ai.)
1CH.26.31.english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

1CH.20.4.motu: Una murinai idia na Filistia taudia ida e tuan lou, Gesere ai. Bena Sibekai, tau Husata, ese Sipai, taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta, e alaia mase. Bena Filistia taudia na vada e darere.
1CH.20.4.english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

1CH.3.17.english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

1CH.14.1.motu: Hirama, Turo pavapavana, ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia; bona sida audia, bona nadi iḡaukaralaidia taudia, bona kamuta taudia, iena ruma auta bae haginia totona.
1CH.14.1.english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

1CH.16.2.motu: David ese ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia vaitani, bena ia ese taunimanima na Iehova ladana ai e hanamodia,
1CH.16.2.english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.

1CH.11.32.motu: Hurai, Gaasa sinavaidia amo; Abiele, Araba tauna;
1CH.11.32.english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

1CH.5.14.motu: Unu na Abihaili Huri natuna; Huri na Iaroa natuna, Iaroa na Gilead natuna, Gilead na Mikael natuna, Mikael na Iesisai natuna, Iesisai na lado natuna, Iado na Busu natuna.
1CH.5.14.english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

1CH.15.15.motu: Bena Levi taudia ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana na mai madunana ida paḡadia ai e huaia, Mose ese Iehova ena hereva amo e haḡanilaidia dalana heḡereḡerena ai.
1CH.15.15.english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.

1CH.22.11.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, Iehova ese baine bamomu, bona Iehova, emu Dirava, ena dubu do ba haginia vaitani, ia ese vada e herevalaimu heḡereḡerena.
1CH.22.11.english: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

1CH.24.28.motu: Mali ena amo: Eleasara; ia na asi natuna.
1CH.24.28.english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

1CH.11.47.motu: Eliele; Obed; bona Iaasiel, tau Mesoba.
1CH.11.47.english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

1CH.1.39.motu: Lotan natuna: Hori bona Homam. Lotan taihuna na Timna.
1CH.1.39.english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

1CH.7.32.motu: Hebere natuna: laflete, Somere, Hotama, bona taihudia Sua.
1CH.7.32.english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

1CH.4.29.english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

1CH.8.6.motu: Ehud natuna bini (idia na Geba taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, gabeai e laohaidia, Manahata ai e hanohodia):
1CH.8.6.english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

1CH.4.31.motu: Bete-makaboto, Hasara-susirni, Bete-biri, bona Saaraimi. Edia hanua badadia bunu, ela bona David e lohia negana.
1CH.4.31.english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

1CH.25.27.motu: Iharuahuina na Eliata, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.27.english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.25.24.motu: Ihagwauta-hituna na Iosobekasa, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.24.english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.12.40.motu: Bona noho hetabira taudia danu, ela bona Isakara bona Sebulun bona Napatali ese aniani ḡaudia e mailai, doniki bona kamelo bona hosi bona boromakau mamaruanedia dorudia ai: flaoa momo; suke manedia; vine huahuadia, e hakaukaudia ḡaudia, takodia; vine ranuna bona dehoro; boromakau mamaruanedia bona mamoe; badina be Israel tanona ai e moaleva dainai.
1CH.12.40.english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

1CH.2.41.motu: Salumu na Iekamia tamana; Iekamia na Elisama tamana.
1CH.2.41.english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

1CH.2.22.motu: Segubu na lairi tamana; hari lairi ena hanua na ruahui-toi Gilead tanona ai.
1CH.2.22.english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

1CH.9.26.motu: Badina be ikoukou igimadia taudia badadia hahaniosi na Levi taudia; idia ese Dirava ena dubu daiutudia bona kohudia e nariva.
1CH.9.26.english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

1CH.25.8.motu: Idia na mari e abi, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara iduanaidia totona. Maraḡidia bona badadia, hahediba taudia bona e hadibadia taudia, na e kara henidia negeregere.
1CH.25.8.english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

1CH.6.37.motu: Sefania na Tahata natuna, Tahata na Asiri natuna, Asiri na Ebiasafa natuna, Ebiasafa na Kora natuna.
1CH.6.37.english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

1CH.16.17.motu: Iakob enai e hamomokania, taravatu ai bainela,
1CH.16.17.english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute,

1CH.25.15.motu: Ihataurahanina na lesaia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.15.english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.9.33.motu: Unu na ane-abi taudia, Levi iduhudia ikwaradia taudia, dubu daiutudia ai e nohova, bona asi edia ḡaukara idauna ta, badina be dina hanuaboi e gaukarava.
1CH.9.33.english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

1CH.4.20.motu: Sirnono natuna: Amnon, Rina, Benhanana, Tilono. Isi natuna: Sohete bona Ben-sohete.
1CH.4.20.english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

1CH.9.43.motu: Mosa na Binea tamana; Binea natuna na Refaia; Refaia natuna na Eleasa; Eleasa natuna na Asele.
1CH.9.43.english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

1CH.11.19.motu: eto, Egu Dirava vairanai, unu baina kara toma na lalogu ai se heḡereḡeremu, lasi ona lasi vaitani. Ini tatau edia mauri rarana baina inu a? Badina be edia mauri inegedia asie laloa, bena e mailaia. Taunabunai, ia na inuna se ura. Ini kara be goada-herea taudia tatoiosi ese e kara.
1CH.11.19.english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

1CH.10.10.motu: Bena ena tuari dabuadia na edia dirava edia dubu ai e atodia, bona kwarana na edia dirava ta ladana Dagon ena dubu ai e kapaia kau.
1CH.10.10.english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

1CH.23.11.motu: Iahata na tau lohia, Sisa na ihararuana; a Ieusu bona Beria natudia mamaruanedia na dia hoho, una dainai idia na iduhu tamona mo e gwauraidia.
1CH.23.11.english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

1CH.27.17.motu: Levi iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Hasabia Kemuel; Aaron iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Sadok;
1CH.27.17.english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

1CH.23.30.motu: Daba iboudiai bae gini, Iehova bae hanamoa bona bae imodaia, bona adorahi ai danu,
1CH.23.30.english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

1CH.27.15.motu: Ihagwauta-ruana, hua ihagwauta-ruana ena, na Heledai, tau Netofa, Otoniele garana; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.15.english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.2.47.motu: Iahadai natuna: Regeme, Iotam, Gesana, Pelet, Efa, Saafa.
1CH.2.47.english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

1CH.8.18.english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

1CH.7.15.motu: Makiri ese ulato e abidia, Hupirn bona Supim bae adavadia. Ia taihuna ladana na Maaka. Iharuana ladana na Selofehad; Selofehad na mai natuna hahinedia.
1CH.7.15.english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

1CH.12.10.motu: ihahanina na Misimana; iha-imana na Ieremia;
1CH.12.10.english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

1CH.6.67.motu: Roho-mauri hanuadia na e henidia: Sekem, mai ena rei gabudia ida, Efraim ororodia ai; Gesere, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.67.english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

1CH.4.39.motu: Idia na e laolao ela bona Gedoro rakavareaina kourana mairiveina kahana ai, edia seri adia rei gabudia e tahudia.
1CH.4.39.english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

1CH.1.43.motu: Israel taudia do asi edia pavapava negadia ai na Edom tanona e lohiaiava pavapavadia bini. Bela Beoro, ena hanua badana ladana na Dinihaba.
1CH.1.43.english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

1CH.22.5.motu: Badina be David eto, Natugu Solomon na eregabe, bona ḡaukara ai do asine manada, bona namona be Iehova ena dubu hairaina baine herea dae vaitani; harina bona hairaina herevadia na tano idoidiai latadiai bae da'ania; una dainai lau ese baina heḡaeḡaelaia. Taunabunai, David na do se mase ai, ia ese dubu kohuna momo herea e habou guna.
1CH.22.5.english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

1CH.22.14.motu: Mai hekwarahi-badagu ida Iehova ena dubu kohudia vada na abi heḡaegae: gold talent domaga-ta, silver talent domagagwauta, bona auri labora-labora bona auri, asi ihahetohodia dalana badina be momo herea daidiai. Bona au bona nadi danu vada na abi heḡaeḡae. Ini latadiai ma haida bavato kau.
1CH.22.14.english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

1CH.6.43.motu: Simei na Iahata natuna, Iahata na Gereson natuna, Gereson na Levi natuna.)
1CH.6.43.english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

1CH.19.18.motu: Bena Suria taudia na Israel taudia vairadia amo e heau. Suria edia kariota daha-hitu taudia bona ae-raka taudia gerebu-hani David ese e aladia mase, bona Sofaka, edia tuari oreana biaguna, danu e alaia mase.
1CH.19.18.english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

1CH.7.1.motu: Isakara natuna: Tola, Pua, Iasub, Simron; tatau hahani.
1CH.7.1.english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

1CH.21.17.motu: Bena David ese Dirava e hereva henia, eto, Lau na haheḡani, taunimanima bae hagaudia nato, ani? Lau na vada na kara dika bona na kara havara; a ini mamoe na dahaka e karaia? Iehova egu Dirava e, na noimumu, oi imamu ese lau bona tamagu ena iduhu baine hadikamai, a dai-hanai gorerena na emu bese taudia latadiai basine mia.
1CH.21.17.english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

1CH.27.10.motu: Ihahituna, hua ihahituna ena, na Helese, tau Pelono Efraim garana ta; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.10.english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.27.24.motu: Ioab Seruia ese taunimanima iduahidia e matamaia, a se ha-orea; to ḡau tamona badu na Israel latanai e kau, una kara dainai, bona King David Sisigana bukana lalonai asie torea Iaunimanima na ede hohodia.
1CH.27.24.english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

1CH.17.19.motu: Iehova e, emu hesiai tauna bagunai bona sibomu emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai, ina kara hereana idoinai vada o karaia, bona ini kara badadia iboudiai vada o hahedinarai.
1CH.17.19.english: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

1CH.6.71.motu: Gereson taudia na Manase iduhu-kahana amo ini hanua e henidia: Golan, Basan ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Astaroto, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.71.english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

1CH.2.53.motu: bona Kiriata-iearimi iduhudia: Itiri bona Puti bona Sumata bona Misira besedia; idia edia amo Sorata bona Estaol besedia e vara.
