1CH.2.53.english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

1CH.25.7.motu: Idia bona tadikakadia Iehova ihanamolaina anedia iabidia e hadibalaidia taudia, iboudiai mai dibadia momo, na sinahu-rua taurahani-ahui taurahani.
1CH.25.7.english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

1CH.18.7.motu: Hadadesere ena hesiai taudia ese gold kesidia e abi ḡaudia na David ese Ierusalem e laohaidia.
1CH.18.7.english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

1CH.16.22.motu: Eto “Vada na horodia taudia basio daudia toho,

1CH.18.12.motu: Abisai, Seruia natuna, ese Edom taudia gerebu-ta sinahu-taurahani na Damena Kourana ai e aladia mase.
1CH.18.12.english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

1CH.6.19.motu: Merari natuna: Mali bona Musi. Levi taudia edia iduhu bini, tamadia heḡereḡeredia:
1CH.6.19.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

1CH.1.8.motu: Ham natuna: Kusu, Aigupto, Put, Kanaan. Kusu natuna: Seba, Havila, Sabata, Raama, Sabateka.
1CH.1.8.english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

1CH.7.10.motu: Iediaele natuna na Bilhan. Bilhan natuna; Ieusu, Beniamina, Ehud, Kenana, Setana, Tarasisi, Ahisahara.
1CH.7.10.english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

1CH.8.39.motu: Ia tadina Esek natuna bini: roboana na Ulama; iharuana na Ieusu; ihatoina na Elifelete.
1CH.8.39.english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

1CH.6.20.motu: Gereson natuna na Libni; Libni natuna na Iahata; Iahata natuna na Sima;
1CH.6.20.english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

1CH.4.34.english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

1CH.6.79.motu: Kedemoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Mefata, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.79.english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

1CH.2.39.motu: Asaria na Helese tamana; Helese na Eleasa tamana;
1CH.2.39.english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

1CH.29.25.motu: Bena Iehova ese Solomon harina e habadaia, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai, bona siahu herea-daena e henia; Israel pavapavana ta, ia e gunalaia taudia bogaragidia amo, na siahu unuhetomana asie henia.
1CH.29.25.english: Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

1CH.6.70.motu: Bona Manase iduhu-kahana amo: Anere, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Bileama, mai ena rei gabudia ida. Kohat taudia edia iduhu oredia edia gabu bunu.
1CH.6.70.english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

1CH.11.1.motu: Bena Israel idoinai na David dekenai e hebou, Heberon ai, eto, A itaia, ai na oi turiamu bona oi hidiomu.
1CH.11.1.english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

1CH.14.2.motu: Bena David lalona e parara, Iehova ese ia vada e haginia, Israel pavapavana, bona ena basileia danu vada e hadaea herea, ena orea taudia Israel bagudiai.
1CH.14.2.english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

1CH.26.30.motu: Heberon iduhuna amo, Hasabia mai tadikakana ida, mai dibadia momo taudia daha-ta sinahu-hitu, ese Israel tanona Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana e itaia taova, Iehova ena ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, bona hanua pavapavana isiaina ilao-henina danu.
1CH.26.30.english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

1CH.19.11.motu: A ena tuari taudia oredia na tadina Abisai e henia, baine biagudia, Amono taudia ituari-henidia baela.
1CH.19.11.english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

1CH.25.12.motu: Iha-imana na Netania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.12.english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.2.14.motu: ihahanina na Netanele, iha-imana na Radai,
1CH.2.14.english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

1CH.6.4.motu: Eleasara na Fineha tamana Fineha na Abisua tamana;
1CH.6.4.english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

1CH.4.17.motu: Esera natuna: Ietere, Merede, Efere, Ialono. Ini na Bitia natuna, (ia na Farao natuna hahinena Merede ese e adavaia); hahine na e gaba manoka, bena natuna e havaradia, Miriama bona Samai bona Isiba, Estemoa tamana.
1CH.4.17.english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

1CH.29.16.motu: Iehova e, ai emai Dirava, ini kohu momo ai ese vada a heḡaeḡaelai, dubu auta, oi ladamu helaḡana ena, ihaginina totona, na oi sibomu imamu amo bona oi sibomu emu ḡau.
1CH.29.16.english: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

1CH.24.23.motu: Heberon natuna: Ieria, tau lohia, ihararuana na Amaria, ihatatoina na Iahasiel, ihahahanina na lekameama.
1CH.24.23.english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

1CH.27.34.motu: Ahitofel gabuna na Iehoiada Benaia bona Abiatara ese e abia. Ioab na hanua pavapavana ena tuari oreana biaguna.
1CH.27.34.english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

1CH.3.2.motu: ihatoina na Absalom; ia sinana na Maaka, Talmai, Gesuru pavapavana natuna hahinena; ihahanina na Adonia; ia sinana na Hagiti;
1CH.3.2.english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

1CH.13.1.motu: David na daha lohiadia bona sinahu lohiadia bona hegunalai taudia iboudiai ida e henega bou.
1CH.13.1.english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

1CH.12.4.motu: Isimaia, Gibeon tauna, goada-herea tauna ta tatau toiahuiosi bogaragidiai bona toiahuiosi igunalaidia tauna ta; Ieremia; Iahasiel; Iohanan; Iosabad, tau Gedera;
1CH.12.4.english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

1CH.1.9.english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

1CH.9.4.motu: Ta be Utai, Amihud natuna; Amihud na Omri natuna, Omri na Imri natuna, Imri na Bani natuna; Bani na Perese Iuda garana ta.
1CH.9.4.english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

1CH.4.24.motu: Simeon natuna: Nemuele, Iamin, Iaribi, Sera, Saul;
1CH.4.24.english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

1CH.21.3.motu: A Ioab eto, Iehova ese ena bese na nega sinahu-ta amo baine habadaia. Egu lohia bona egu pavapava e, idia iboudiai na egu lohia ena hesiai taudia, ani? Dahaka dainai egu lohia ese ina ḡau e ura heniamu? Dahaka dainai ia ese Israel baine hakererea?
1CH.21.3.english: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

1CH.6.80.motu: Bona Gad iduhuna amo: Ramoto, Gilead ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Mahanaim, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.80.english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

1CH.23.2.motu: David ese Israel lohiadia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia iboudiai e haboudia.
1CH.23.2.english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

1CH.13.13.motu: Taunabunai David ese maua helaḡana na ena gabu, David ena hanua, se laohaia, to e heaulaia siri, Obed-edom, tau Gata, ena ruma e laohaia.
1CH.13.13.english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

1CH.4.21.motu: Sela Iuda natuna: Ere, Leka tamana, bona Laada, Maresa tamana. Ia be Bet-asabea dabua aukadia ikaradia taudia edia iduhu senedia danu.
1CH.4.21.english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

1CH.29.6.motu: Bena iduhu kwaradia ese edia herahia ḡaudia e heni, bona iduhu lohiadia bona daha bona sinahu lohiadia bona hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara itataona taudia danu.
1CH.29.6.english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

1CH.2.31.motu: Apairni natuna: Isi. Isi natuna na Sesana. Sesana natuna na Ahalai.
1CH.2.31.english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

1CH.3.13.motu: ia natuna Ahasa, ia natuna Hesekia; ia natuna Manase;
1CH.3.13.english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

1CH.16.11.motu: Iehova ba tahua, bona ena goada danu;

1CH.6.68.motu: Iokomeama, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Bete-horono, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.68.english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

1CH.21.5.motu: Bena Ioab ese taunimanima ihagaudia herevana na David e henia. Israel idoinai lalonai dare taudia na domaga gwauta-ta, bona Iuda lalonai dare taudia na domaga-hani gerebu-hitu.
1CH.21.5.english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

1CH.3.15.motu: Iosia natuna: roboana na Iohanan; iharuana Iehoiakim; ihatoina na Sedekia; ihahanina na Salumu.
1CH.3.15.english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

1CH.7.4.motu: bona idia ida, edia uru ta ta ai bona edia iduhu ta ta heḡereḡeredia ai na tuari oreadia, iboudiai na gerebu-toi daha-tauratoi; badina be adavadia bona natudia na hutuma.
1CH.7.4.english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

1CH.22.12.motu: Ḡau tamona, Iehova ese aonega bona lalo-parara baine henimu, bena Israel igunalaina tauna ai baine halaomu negana ai na Iehova, emu Dirava, ena taravatu do ba badinaia.
1CH.22.12.english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

1CH.15.23.motu: Berekia bona Elkana na maua helaḡana ena ikoukou igimana taudia ai baela.
1CH.15.23.english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

1CH.27.19.motu: Sebulun iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Isimaia Obadia; Napatali iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Ieremoto Asriel;
1CH.27.19.english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

1CH.12.6.motu: Elkana; Isia; Asarele; Ioesere bona Iasobeama, Kora taudia;
1CH.12.6.english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

1CH.14.12.motu: Edia kaivakuku diravadia na unuseni ai e rakatanidia; bena David na e haheḡani, bena e doudia.
1CH.14.12.english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

1CH.5.9.motu: Ia na mairiveina kahana ai danu e nohova, ela bona tano ḡaḡaena iraka-vareaina gabuna, Eufrate sinavaina inikahana ai; badina be edia boromakau vada e hutuma Gilead tanona ai.
1CH.5.9.english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

1CH.20.2.motu: Bena David ese edia hanua pavapavana ena havava ḡauna na kwarana amo e abia oho: metauna na gold talent ta, bona lalonai na mai herahera nadina herea-daena ta. Gauna na David kwarana ai e atoa kau. Bena hanua kohuna idau-idau na hanua lalona amo e hua lasi, kohu momo herea.
1CH.20.2.english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

1CH.15.25.motu: Taunabunai David bona Israel tau-badadia bona daha lohiadia na ela, mai moaledia ida Iehova ena taravatu mauana Obed-edom ena ruma amo bae daelaia totona.
1CH.15.25.english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

1CH.21.26.motu: Bena David ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta unuseni ai e larebaia, bona ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, bona Iehova e hahanea. Bena ia ese guba lahina amo e haere henia, ḡole-oho bouboudia patana latanai.
1CH.21.26.english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

1CH.26.28.motu: Bona mata-hanai tauna Samuel, bona Saulo Kisa, bona Abnere Nere, bona Ioab Seruia, ese e hahelaḡadia ḡaudia danu; herahia helaḡadia iboudiai na Selomoto mai tadikakana ida ese e nariva.
1CH.26.28.english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

1CH.15.16.motu: David ese danu Levi lohiadia na e haḡanidia, varavaradia haida bae duanaidia, ane bae abi, bona reḡereḡe ḡaudia idau-idau, hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia bona botabota ḡaudia, ihataidia bona ibotadia amo moale reḡedia bae hadae badabada.
1CH.15.16.english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

1CH.6.35.motu: Toa na Sufu natuna, Sufu na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Mahata natuna, Mahata na Amasai natuna,
1CH.6.35.english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

1CH.27.25.motu: Hanua pavapavana ena habou-habou rumadia itataodia na Asamavete, Adiele natuna; bona tano idoinai, hanua badadia bona maraḡidia bona kohorodia ai habou-habou rumadia itataodia na Ionatan, Usia natuna.
1CH.27.25.english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

1CH.28.19.motu: Ini iboudiai na Iehova imana ena toretore ḡaudia ese e hahedinaraidia ḡoeva, ḡaukara iboudiai na bae hekara e helalo hatalai heḡereḡerena.
1CH.28.19.english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

1CH.1.38.motu: Seiri natuna: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Esere, Disan.
1CH.1.38.english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

1CH.4.38.motu: Ini ladadia e hetore taudia be edia iduhu lohiadia, bona edia iduhu na e bada e laova.
1CH.4.38.english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

1CH.12.19.motu: David na Filistia taudia ida ema, Saulo bae tuari henia totona, negana ai Manase taudia haida na e hanai, David ena kaha ai. (Ḡau tamona, ia ese Filistia taudia se durudia, badina be Filistia lohiadia na e henega bou, bena e siaia oho, eto, Ia na biaguna Saulo dekena ma baine hanai negana ai, dika na kwaramai ai baine kau na garina.)
1CH.12.19.english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

1CH.11.18.motu: Bena hari goadaherea taudia tatoiosi na Filistia taudia edia taruha amo e tata uru, Betelehem ikoukou badibadinai guri e miamu ranuna e utua, bena e abia, David dekena e laohaia. A David ese inuna se ura; ia na e bubua diho Iehova ena;
1CH.11.18.english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

1CH.4.14.motu: Meonotai na Ofra tamana; Seraia na Ioab tamana. Ioab na Geharasimi taudia senedia; Geharasimi e gwauraidia badina be idia na ima karakara dibakana taudia.
1CH.4.14.english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

1CH.10.14.motu: a Iehova enai hahekau se tahua. Taunabunai, Iehova ese e alaia mase, bona basileia na David lese e henia.
1CH.10.14.english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

1CH.7.40.motu: Unu iboudiai na Asere taudia, edia iduhu kwaradia, e abidia dae taudia, tuari taudia mai goadadia, Iohia ikwaradia. Edia uru ai ladadia e tore, tuan lao totona; iboudiai na tatau gerebu-rua daha-tauratoi.
1CH.7.40.english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

1CH.6.46.motu: Hilkia na Amasi natuna, Amasi na Bani natuna, Bani na Semere natuna,
1CH.6.46.english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

1CH.6.65.motu: Bona Iuda bona Simeon bona Beniamina iduhudia amo ini ladadia vada e tore hanuadia na mari amo e henidia.
1CH.6.65.english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

1CH.14.17.motu: Bena David harina na tano iboudiai e piua rohoroho, bona Iehova ese ia garina igari-henina e havaraia, bese iboudiai ediai.
1CH.14.17.english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.

1CH.24.20.motu: Levi garana orena ai: Amram natuna edia amo, Subaele; Subaele natuna edia amo, Iehedeia.
1CH.24.20.english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

1CH.29.1.motu: David, hanua pavapavana, ese hebou taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Natugu Solomon sibona na Dirava ena abi-hidi tauna, to ia na eregabe, bona ḡaukara ai do asine manada; ḡaukara danu bada herea, badina be ina ruma badana na dia taunimanima edia, a Dirava Iehova ena.
1CH.29.1.english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

1CH.7.26.motu: Tahan natuna na Ladan; Ladan natuna na Amihud; Amihud natuna na Elisama;
1CH.7.26.english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

1CH.21.21.motu: David na Oronana dekena ela negana ai, Oronana na e roha lao, David e itaia; bena uit ikwadina gabuna amo e raka lasi, tano ai e goru diho, David e toma henia diho.
1CH.21.21.english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

1CH.29.10.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Iehova e hanamoa, hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai. David eto:
1CH.29.10.english: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

1CH.25.14.motu: Ihahituna na lesarela, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.14.english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.23.6.motu: Bena David ese orea ta ta ai e hididia, Levi natudia, Gereson bona Kohat bona Merari, besedia dodidiai.
1CH.23.6.english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH.6.13.motu: Salumu na Hilkia tamana; Hilkia na Asaria tamana;
1CH.6.13.english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

1CH.6.72.motu: Bona Isakara iduhuna amo: Kede, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Dabera, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.72.english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

1CH.26.17.motu: Laurabada kahana ai na tatau tauratoi, dina ta ta ai; mirigini kahana ai na hahani, dina ta ta ai; diho kahana ai danu hahani, dina ta ta ai; bona habou-habou rumana ai rarua rarua amo.
1CH.26.17.english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

1CH.4.18.motu: Bona adavana hane Heberu ese Ierede, Gedoro tamana, bona Hebere, Soko tamana, bona lekutiele, Sanoa tamana, e havaradia.
1CH.4.18.english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

1CH.16.42.motu: Hemana bona ledutunu na mai edia kibi bona mai edia botabota auridia, ane daidiai, bona Dirava ihanamolaina anedia iabidia idurulaina ḡaudia danu. Iedutunu natuna na e duanaidia, ikoukou bae gimadia.
1CH.16.42.english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

1CH.14.11.motu: Bena ia na Baal-perasimi ela; unuseni ai David ese e hadareredia. David eto, Dirava ese inaigu na lau imagu amo vada e haheḡiḡidia dobi, abata ese ḡau ta bema ḡiḡia dobi na heto. Una dainai una gabu ladana e hatoamu Baal-perasimi.
1CH.14.11.english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

1CH.15.19.motu: Ane-abi taudia Hemana bona Asaf bona Etana na aurilaboralabora botabota ḡaudia bae botadia;
1CH.15.19.english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

1CH.12.16.motu: Beniamina bona Iuda iduhudia taudia haida na David ena gabu aukana ema.
1CH.12.16.english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

1CH.27.9.motu: Ihatauratoina, hua ihatauratoina ena, na Ira, Ikese tau Tekoa natuna; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.9.english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.9.31.motu: Matitia, Levi tauna ta, Salumu tau Kora natuna roboana, ese ataga igabudia e nariava.
1CH.9.31.english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

1CH.1.36.motu: Elifasa natuna Teman, Omara, Sefi, Gatam, Kena, Timna, Amalek.
1CH.1.36.english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

1CH.11.6.motu: David eto, Daika ese Iebusu taudia baine hadareredia guna, ia na lohia bona tuari biaguna ai bainela. Bena Ioab Seruia na e dae guna; una dainai ia na lohia ai ela.
1CH.11.6.english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

1CH.21.25.motu: Taunabunai, David ese gold sekele sinahu-tauratoi e hahetohodia, Oronana e henia, una tano davana.
1CH.21.25.english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

1CH.27.26.motu: Biru taudia itataodia na Esri, Kelubu natuna;
1CH.27.26.english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

1CH.27.23.motu: David ese laḡani ruahui henuna taudia na se duahidia, badina be Iehova vada e gwau hamata, ia ese Israel baine hahutumaia, guba hisiudia hohodia na heto.
1CH.27.23.english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

1CH.16.13.english: you offspring of Israel his servant,

1CH.11.26.motu: Goada-herea taudia tuari oreadia lalodiai ladadia bini: Asahele, Ioab tadina; Elhanan Dodo, tau Betelehem;
1CH.11.26.english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

1CH.26.27.motu: Tuari ai e abi kohudia amo idia ese herahia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena dubu inanatalaina ḡaudia ai baela.
1CH.26.27.english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

1CH.7.24.motu: Ia natuna hahinena na Seera; una hahine ese Bete-horono, henu bona atai hanuadia, bona Usene-sera e haginidia.
1CH.7.24.english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

1CH.2.15.motu: ihatauratoina na Oseme, ihahituna na David.
1CH.2.15.english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

1CH.29.17.motu: Egu Dirava e, lau dibagu oi ese taunimanima lalodia o tohodiamu, bona kara maoromaoro o moalelaiamu; mai lalogu maoromaorona ida ini ḡau iboudiai vada na heni dudukau, bona harihari oiemu orea taudia hahidaosi iniseni ai nonoho vada na itadia, idia na edia herahia ḡaudia e henimu dudukaumu mai moaledia ida.
1CH.29.17.english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

1CH.6.78.motu: Bona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Ieriko ai, Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai, Ruben iduhuna amo: Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Iahasaha, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.78.english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

1CH.21.22.motu: David ese Oronana e hamaoroa, eto, Uit ikwadina gabuna tanona a henigu, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana na ia latanai baina larebaia totona. A henigu, bena davana korikori baina henimu, dai-hanai gorerena na taunimanima edia amo baine heabi oho helaoreana.
1CH.21.22.english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

1CH.11.3.motu: Taunabunai, Israel tau-badadia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, Heberon ai; bena David na idia ida e hegwauhamata heheni Heberon ai, Iehova vairanai. Bena idia ese David e horoa, Israel pavapavana, Iehova ena hereva Samuel ena amo heḡereḡerena.
1CH.11.3.english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.

1CH.4.11.motu: Kelubu, Suha tadina, na Mehin tamana; Mehiri na Esetono tamana;
1CH.4.11.english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

1CH.28.3.motu: A Dirava ese e hamaorogu, eto: Dubu auta basio haginia, lau ladagu ena, badina be oi na tuari tauna, bona taunimanima raradia vada o hahebubu.
1CH.28.3.english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

1CH.29.9.motu: Bena taunimanima na e moale, badina be vada e heni mai lalo-uradia ida; badina be idia ese mai lalodia idoidiai Iehova vada e henia dudukau. David, hanua pavapavana, danu e moale bada herea.
1CH.29.9.english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahweh; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

1CH.3.9.motu: Ini iboudiai na David natuna mamaruanedia; ma haida be e adavadia hahinedia natudia. Taihudia na Tamara.
1CH.3.9.english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

1CH.20.7.motu: Una tau ese Israel taudia e ḡonaḡonalaidia, bena Ionatan, David kakana Simea natuna, ese e alaia mase.
1CH.20.7.english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

1CH.25.5.motu: Unu iboudiai na Hemana, hanua pavapavana ena mata-hanai tauna, natuna. Una tau na Dirava ese vada e gwau henia hamata, i'imodaina baine habadaia; badina be Dirava ese Hemana na natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-hani bona natuna hahinedia tatoi e henia.
1CH.25.5.english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

1CH.6.31.motu: Maua helaḡana Iehova ena dubu ai e atoa murinai, David ese ini tatau e atodia, unuseni ai ane-abi gaukarana bae gunalaia.
1CH.6.31.english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

1CH.6.41.motu: Malkia na Eteni natuna, Eteni na Sera natuna, Sera na Adaia natuna,
1CH.6.41.english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

1CH.7.18.motu: Ia taihuna Hamolekete ese Isihod bona Abiesere bona Mahala e havaradia.
1CH.7.18.english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

1CH.24.21.motu: Rehabia enai: Rehabia natuna edia amo, Isihia, tau lohia.
1CH.24.21.english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

1CH.13.8.motu: David bona Israel idoinai na Dirava vairanai e moale hisi dae mai goadadia idoinai, mai anedia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia idau-idau bona tareko bona botabota auridia bona kibi reḡedia ida.
1CH.13.8.english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

1CH.9.8.motu: bona Ibneia Ierohama; bona Elaha (ia na Usisi natuna, Usisi na Mikri natuna); bona Mesulama (ia na Sefatia natuna, Sefatia na Reuele natuna, Reuele na Ibnia natuna);
1CH.9.8.english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

1CH.2.18.motu: Kaleb, Hesron natuna, ese natuna e havaradia, adavana Asuba enai bona lerioto enai. Asuba natuna bini: Iesere bona Sobab bona Aradono.
1CH.2.18.english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

1CH.15.5.motu: Kohat garana amo: Uriele, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta ruahui.
1CH.15.5.english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

1CH.2.35.motu: Taunabunai, Sesana ese ia natuna hahinena na ena hesiai tauna Iaraha e henia, baine adavaia; bena una hahine ese natuna Atai e havara henia.
1CH.2.35.english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

1CH.2.19.motu: Asuba e mase murinai, Kaleb ese Efrata e adavaia; una hahine ese natuna Huru e havara henia.
1CH.2.19.english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

1CH.17.7.motu: Taunabunai, harihari egu hesiai tauna David ba hamaoroa, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Rei gabuna amo bona mamoe ireḡudia amo na abimu, egu bese Israel lohiana ai baola helaoreana;
1CH.17.7.english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

1CH.17.12.motu: Ia ese egu ruma auta baine haginia; bona lau ese iena terono baina haginia ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.17.12.english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

1CH.22.9.motu: A itaia, natumu ta baine vara; ia na maino tauna ai bainela, bona lau ese maino baina henia, ana inai taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai. Badina be ladana bae hatoa Solomon; bona iena nega ai lau ese Israel na maino bona laḡa-ani baina henia.
1CH.22.9.english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

1CH.22.16.motu: gold bona silver bona auri labora-labora bona auri iḡaukaralaidia diba herea taudia. A tore isi, a ḡaukara! Iehova ese baine bamomu!
1CH.22.16.english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

1CH.23.14.motu: A Mose, Dirava ena tau, natuna danu Levi oreana taudia ida e gwauraidia hebou.
1CH.23.14.english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

1CH.3.18.motu: Malkiram, Pedaia, Senasara, Iekamia, Hosama, Nedabia.
1CH.3.18.english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

1CH.6.59.motu: Asana, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Betesemese, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.59.english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

1CH.6.63.motu: Merari taudia edia iduhu ta ta amo na hanua gwauta-rua e gwaurai henidia, Ruben bona Gad bona Sebulun iduhudia amo.
1CH.6.63.english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

1CH.16.9.motu: Ane bavabi iena, ia ihanamolaina anedia bavabi,

1CH.28.20.motu: Bena David ese natuna Solomon e hamaoroa, eto, Ba goada, ba boga auka, ba karaia. Basio gari, kudoumu basine hetaha, badina be Dirava Iehova, lauegu Dirava, na oi ida. Ia na basine lalomu rea bona basine rakatanimu, ela bona Iehova ena dubu gaukaradia iboudiai bae ore.
1CH.28.20.english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

1CH.29.20.motu: Bena David ese hebou taudia iboudiai e haḡanidia, eto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ha hanamoa. Bena hebou taudia iboudiai ese Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, e hanamoa, e igo diho, Iehova e toma henia diho; bona hanua pavapavana vairanai danu e igo diho.
1CH.29.20.english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!”

1CH.8.8.motu: Saharaimi ese natuna e havaradia, Moab tanona ai, adavana raruosi Husim bona Baara e hadihodia murinai.
1CH.8.8.english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

1CH.26.4.motu: Obed-edom danu na mai natuna haida: tau-roboana na Semaia, iharuana na Iehosabad, ihatoina na Ioa, ihahanina na Sakara, iha-imana na Netanele,
1CH.26.4.english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

1CH.16.5.motu: Gini-gunana na Asaf; ia murinai na Sekaria, Ieiele, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Matitia, Eliab, Benaia, Obed-edom bona Ieiele. Idia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia bae hatai; Asaf na botabota auridia baine botadia;
1CH.16.5.english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

1CH.16.28.motu: Bese idau-idau taumui kikina badana, Iehova ba herevalaia,
1CH.16.28.english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples,

1CH.6.14.motu: Asaria na Seraia tamana; Seraia na Iehosadak tamana.
1CH.6.14.english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

1CH.2.48.motu: Maaka na Kaleb ese e adavaia hahinena; una hahine ese Sebere bona Tirihana e havara henia.
1CH.2.48.english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

1CH.9.9.motu: bona varavaradia, edia uru ta ta ai, tatau sinahutaurahanita imahui tauratoi. Ini iboudiai na iduhu kwaradia, ta ta ena iduhu ena iduhu ai.
1CH.9.9.english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

1CH.25.16.motu: Ihataurahani-tana na Matania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.16.english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.18.6.motu: Bena David ese tuari oreadia haida na Suria ai e atodia, Damasko ai; bona Suria taudia na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela, bona heaiva ḡaudia e henia. Iehova ese David na kwalimu e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
1CH.18.6.english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

1CH.1.14.motu: E havaradia besedia bini: Iebusu, Amoro, Girigasa,
1CH.1.14.english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

1CH.6.9.motu: Ahimasa na Asaria tamana; Asaria na Iohanan tamana;
1CH.6.9.english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

1CH.5.18.motu: Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana na mai edia goada taudia, kesi bona dare ihuadia bona peva imaredia bona tuari mai dibadia taudia; iboudiai na gerebu-hani daha-hani sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui, heheḡaeḡae tuari totona.
1CH.5.18.english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

1CH.17.4.motu: Aola, egu hesiai tauna David ba hamaoroa, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu noho rumana auta basio haginia.
1CH.17.4.english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

1CH.27.16.motu: Israel ena iduhu itataodia taudia: Ruben iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Eliesere Sikri; Simeon iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Sefatia Maaka;
1CH.27.16.english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

1CH.29.13.motu: Dirava e, harihari a hanamomumu, bona oi ladamu herea-daena a imodaiamu.
1CH.29.13.english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

1CH.9.40.motu: Ionatan natuna na Merib-baal; Merib-baal na Mika tamana.
1CH.9.40.english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

1CH.13.3.motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana baita loulaia, badina be Saulo ena nega ai asita haḡerea.
1CH.13.3.english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

1CH.14.10.motu: Bena David ese Dirava e nanadaia, eto, Bainala, Filistia taudia baina tuari henidia a? Imagu ai bavatodia eiava? Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, lau ese oi imamu ai baina atodia.
1CH.14.10.english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?”

1CH.19.19.motu: Hadadesere ena hesiai taudia ese e itaia Israel taudia ese idia vada e hadareredia, bena idia na David ida e herohemaino, bona ia isiaina e lao heni. Taunabunai una negana amo Suria taudia na asie ura Amono taudia ma bae durudia lou.
1CH.19.19.english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

1CH.21.19.motu: Taunabunai David na ela, Gad ena hereva, Iehova ladana ai e gwauraia, ḡauna dainai.
1CH.21.19.english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

1CH.25.20.motu: Ihagwauta-toina na Subaele, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.20.english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.9.2.motu: Edia tano ai bona edia hanua ai e noho henidia lou matama taudia na Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, bona dubu ena hesiai taudia.
1CH.9.2.english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

1CH.20.6.motu: Ma e tuari lou, Gata ai; unuseni ai tau ḡaulatalata ta e nohova, imana ruaosi bona aena ruaosi kwakikwakidia na tauratoi tauratoi amo; kwakikwakina iboudiai na ruahui-hani. Ia na taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta.
1CH.20.6.english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

1CH.27.3.motu: Ia na Perese garana; bona ia ese tuari lohiadia iboudiai e biagudiava, hua gini-gunana ai.
1CH.27.3.english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

1CH.5.23.motu: Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na una tano ai e nohova; idia na hutuma herea, Basan amo ela bona Baal-heremon bona Seniri bona Heremon ororona.
1CH.5.23.english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

1CH.8.12.motu: Elpala natuna: Ebere, Misama, Semede (ia ese Ono, bona Lod mai hanuana ida, e haginidia),
1CH.8.12.english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

1CH.11.38.english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

1CH.12.24.motu: Iuda taudia, mai edia kesi bona edia io, na tuari taudia daha-tauratoi sinahu-taurahani.
1CH.12.24.english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

1CH.1.20.motu: Ikotan natuna: Alamodad, Selefe, Hasaramavete, Iera,
1CH.1.20.english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

1CH.2.37.motu: Sabada na Efelala tamana; Efelala na Obed tamana;
1CH.2.37.english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

1CH.1.35.motu: Esau natuna: Elifasa, Reuele, Ieusu, Ialam, Kora.
1CH.1.35.english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

1CH.22.6.motu: Bena ia ese natuna Solomon e boiria, e haḡania, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu auta baine haginia.
1CH.22.6.english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

1CH.28.7.motu: Bema ia ese egu haheḡani bona egu taravatu baine badinadia namonamo, asi dokona, hari ina dina ai e karamu heḡereḡerena, lau ese ena basileia baina haginia hanaihanai.
1CH.28.7.english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

1CH.2.9.motu: Hesron natuna mamaruanedia e havaradia ladadia bini: Ierahamele, Ram, Kelubai.
1CH.2.9.english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

1CH.6.74.motu: Bona Asere iduhuna amo: Masala, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Abdon, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.74.english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

1CH.15.6.motu: Merari garana amo: Asaia, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-rua ruahui.
1CH.15.6.english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

1CH.24.4.motu: Eleasara garana bogaragidiai lohia taudia na momo, a Itamara garana bogaragidiai lohia taudia be dia hoho; una dainai Eleasara garana na orea ai e haboudia, edia iduhu kwaradia gwauta-tauratoi henudiai, bona Itamara garana na orea ai e haboudia, edia iduhu kwaradia taurahani henudiai.
1CH.24.4.english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

1CH.8.11.motu: Natuna haida danu adavana Husim enai e havaradia: Abitub bona Elpala.
1CH.8.11.english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

1CH.6.33.motu: Ina ḡaukara e karaia taudia, mai natudia ida, ladadia bini. Kohat iduhuna amo: Ane-abi tauna Hemana, Ioel natuna. (Hari Ioel na Sarnuel natuna,
1CH.6.33.english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

1CH.16.12-13.motu: Ena hesiai tauna Abraham garana e!

1CH.22.15.motu: Emu ḡaukara taudia na hutuma: nadi-utu taudia, nadi-hagini taudia, kamuta taudia, bona ima-karakara taudia idau-idau, asi iduahidia,
1CH.22.15.english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

1CH.6.2.motu: Kohat natuna: Amram, Isahara Heberon, Usiele.
1CH.6.2.english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

1CH.16.4.motu: Ia ese danu Levi taudia haida e duanaidia, Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai toma-diho karadia bae kara; Iehova, Israel Diravana, bae ḡuria, bona bae hanamoa, bona bae imodaia.
1CH.16.4.english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:

1CH.6.11.motu: Asaria na Amaria tamana Arnaria na Ahitubu tamana;
1CH.6.11.english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

1CH.8.30.motu: Natuna roboana na Abdon; ia murinai Suru, Kisa, Baal, Nadab,
1CH.8.30.english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

1CH.14.9.motu: Filistia taudia na vada ema, Refaim kourana taudia tuari e lasi henidia.
1CH.14.9.english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

1CH.16.43.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela. Bona David na ena gabu ela, ena ruma taudia baine hanamodia totona.
1CH.16.43.english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

1CH.15.7.motu: Gereson garana amo: loel, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta toi-ahui.
1CH.15.7.english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

1CH.26.32.motu: King David ese ia mai tadikakana ida e duanaidia, mai dibadia momo taudia daha-rua sinahu-hitu, iduhu kwaradia, Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na idia ese bae itadia tao, Dirava ena ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, bona hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara ai danu.
1CH.26.32.english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

1CH.1.6.english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

1CH.9.17.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia bini: Salumu, Akubu, Talmon, Ahiman, mai varavaradia ida. Ikwaradia na Salumu.
1CH.9.17.english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

1CH.19.15.motu: Amono taudia e itaia, Suria taudia vada e heau, bena idia danu Abisai, Ioab tadina, vairana amo e heau, hanua lalonai e heau vareai. Bena Ioab na Ierusalem ela.
1CH.19.15.english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

1CH.28.17.motu: bona gold ḡoeva-daena, kahi bona kibokibo bona kehere ikaralaidia; bona gold dihudia ta ta metaudia; bona silver dihudia ta ta metaudia;
1CH.28.17.english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

1CH.19.10.motu: Ioab na e itaia, tuari na vairanai bona murina kahana ai vada e atodia, bena ia ese Israel edia goada taudia e abidia hidi, Suria taudia ituari-henidia e siaidia lao.
1CH.19.10.english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

1CH.27.33.motu: Ahitofel na hanua pavapavana ena gwau-sisiba tauna, bona Husai tau Araki na hanua pavapavana turana.
1CH.27.33.english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

1CH.2.7.motu: Karami natuna: Akara, Israel ena kwasima e havaraia tauna; ia na e gwaua ahu ḡauna ai e kerere.
1CH.2.7.english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

1CH.24.6.motu: Bena itorena tauna Semaia Netanele, Levi tauna ta, ese iboudiai ladadia e tore, hanua pavapavana bona bese lohiadia bona hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Ahimelek Abiatara, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, vairadiai; iduhu ta na Eleasara garana amo e abia hidi, ma iduhu ta Itamara garana amo.
1CH.24.6.english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

1CH.12.26.english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

1CH.25.1.motu: David bona ḡaukara biagudia ese Asaf bona Hemana bona Iedutunu natudia haida e abidia hidi, edia ḡaukara be hatai-hatai ḡaudia maraḡidia bona badadia bona botabota ḡaudia amo bae peroveta. Unu ḡaukara taudia ladadia bona edia ḡaukara herevadia bini.
1CH.25.1.english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

1CH.15.24.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Sebania, Iosafat, Netanele, Amasai, Sekaria, Benaia bona Eliesere na kibi bae hiriri. Dirava ena maua helaḡana vairanai. Obed-edom bona lehia danu na maua helaḡana ena ikoukou igimana taudia ai baela.
1CH.15.24.english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

1CH.11.2.motu: Nega gunadia ai, Saulo e lohiava ai, oi ese Israel o hakaua lasi bona o hakaua vareai. Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e hereva henimu, eto, Oi na egu bese Israel ireḡuna tauna ai bona egu bese Israel pavapavana ai baola.
1CH.11.2.english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

1CH.5.16.motu: Edia noho gabudia na Gilead, Basan mai ena hanua ida, bona Saron ena rei gabudia iboudiai ela bona rei dokodia.
1CH.5.16.english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

1CH.15.13.motu: Nega gunana ai asie huaia dainai, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e makohi dagu henida; badina be asita naria namonamo, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
1CH.15.13.english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

1CH.20.8.motu: Ini na Gata taudia ḡaubadabadadia garadia; David imana amo bona ena hesiai taudia imadia amo e hamasedia.
1CH.20.8.english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

1CH.24.13.motu: ihagwauta-toina na Hupa, ihagwauta-hanina na Iesebeaba,
1CH.24.13.english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

1CH.11.17.motu: Bena David na mai lalo-hekisehekisena ida e hereva, eto, Ta ese Betelehem ikoukou badibadinai guri e miamu ranuna kuri ta bema henigu, bama inua.
1CH.11.17.english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

1CH.27.6.motu: Ina Benaia na goada-herea tauna ta, vanegai toi-ahuiosi bogaragidiai, bona ia ese toi-ahuiosi e biagudiava; ia natuna Amisabad ese ena orea e biagudiava.
1CH.27.6.english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

1CH.9.11.motu: bona Asaria (ia na Hilkia natuna, Hilkia na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Sadok natuna, Sadok na Meraioto natuna, Meraioto na Ahitubu natuna - ia na Dirava ena dubu itataona tau badana);
1CH.9.11.english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

1CH.11.9.motu: Bena David na e bada herea e laova, badina be Iehova Sabaota na ia ida.
1CH.11.9.english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.

1CH.17.20.motu: Iehova e, oi na asi idaimu, Dirava ta na ma lasi, taiamai ai a kamonai ḡaudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
1CH.17.20.english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

1CH.5.6.motu: Ia natuna na Bera, Tiglata-pilnesere, Asuria pavapavana, ese e abia mauri bena e laohaia tauna; ia na Ruben iduhuna taudia edia lohia ta.
1CH.5.6.english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

1CH.9.12.motu: bona Adaia (ia na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Pasahuru natuna, Pasahuru na Malkia natuna); bona Maasai (ia na Adiele natuna, Adiele na Iahasera natuna, Iahasera na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Mesilemiti natuna, Mesilemiti na Imere natuna);
1CH.9.12.english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

1CH.2.32.motu: Iada, Samai tadina, natuna: Ietere bona Ionatan. Ietere na e mase, asi natuna.
1CH.2.32.english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

1CH.11.40.motu: Ira, tau Itiri; Gareb, tau Itiri;
1CH.11.40.english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

1CH.27.22.motu: Dan iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Asarele Ierohama. Israel ena iduhu lohiadia bunu.
1CH.27.22.english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

1CH.1.48.motu: Samula e mase, bena Saul, Rehoboto, Eufrate sinavaina hanuana ta, tauna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
1CH.1.48.english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

1CH.27.32.motu: Ionatan, David tamana lahaina, na gwau-sisiba tauna, badina be ia na diba momo tauna bona itorena tauna. Ia bona Iehiele, Hakamoni natuna, ese hanua pavapavana natuna e naridia.
1CH.27.32.english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

1CH.2.54.motu: Salma besena bini: Betelehem, bona Netofa besena, bona Ataroto-bete-ioab, bona Manahata besena kahana, bona Soro besena.
1CH.2.54.english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

1CH.22.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel edia taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia Mose e haḡanilaia ḡaudia na boma badinadia ḡoevaḡoeva negana ai, namomu do baine bada. Ba goada, ba boga auka. Basio gari, basio kudou hetaha.
1CH.22.13.english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

1CH.5.1.motu: Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, natuna bini. (Ia na tau-roboana; ḡau tamona, tamana ena geda e hamiroa dainai ia ahuna na Iosef Israel natuna e henidia; taunabunai edia uru ladadia ai ia ladana se hetore, tau-guna ahuna iabina tauna.
1CH.5.1.english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

1CH.5.26.motu: Taunabunai, Israel Diravana ese Pulu, Asuria pavapavana, bona Tiglata-pilnesere, Asuria pavapavana, na lalodia e haḡaraḡara, bena idia ese hari Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana taudia e laohaidia oho, Hala bona Haboro bona Hara bona Gosan sinavaina badinai e hanohodia, ema bona ina dina.
1CH.5.26.english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

1CH.17.17.motu: Dirava e, una na ḡau pipikina oi vairamu ai; oi ese emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu vada o herevalaia, nega dau ai baine vara ḡauna, bona uru gabedia vada o haheitalaigu, Dirava Iehova e!
1CH.17.17.english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

1CH.2.11.motu: Nason na Salma tamana; Salma na Boa tamana;
1CH.2.11.english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

1CH.26.12.motu: Ini ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea, ta ta mai edia lohia taudia, na mai edia ḡaukara Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia ikaradia ai, tadikakadia heḡereḡeredia.
1CH.26.12.english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

1CH.9.41.motu: Mika natuna: Pitono, Melek, Tarea, Ahasa.
1CH.9.41.english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

1CH.4.30.english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

1CH.9.35.motu: Ieiele, Gibeon tamana, na Gibeon ai e nohova; ia adavana ladana na Maaka.
1CH.9.35.english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

1CH.11.11.motu: David ena goada taudia herevadia bini: Iasobeama, Hakamoni tauna, na tatau tatoi ikwaradia tauna. Nega ta ai ia ese ena io amo tatau sinahu-toi e aladia mase.
1CH.11.11.english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

1CH.9.19.motu: Salumu (ia na Kore natuna, Kore na Ebiasafa natuna, Ebiasafa na Kora natuna) bona iena iduhu, Kora iduhuna, taudia na dubu ḡaukaradia e biagudia bona kalaga raka-vareaina e gimaia, senedia ese Iehova ena taruha e biaguava bona raka-vareaina e gimaiava heḡereḡerena.
1CH.9.19.english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

1CH.4.12.motu: Esetono na Bete-rafa bona Pasea bona Tehina tamadia; Tehina na Irinahasa tamana. Unu na Reka taudia.
1CH.4.12.english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

1CH.24.2.motu: A Nadab bona Abihu na tamadia maurina ai e mase, asi natudia; taunabunai Eleasara bona Itamara na hahelaḡa taudia ai ela.
1CH.24.2.english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

1CH.26.10.motu: Bona Hosa, Merari garana ta, danu na mai natuna haida: Simri, tau lohia, (ia na dia tau-roboana, a tamana ese lohia tauna ai e halaoa);
1CH.26.10.english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

1CH.25.18.motu: Ihagwauta-tana na Asarele, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.18.english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.23.23.motu: Musi natuna na Mali bona Edere bona Ieremoto, tatoiosi.
1CH.23.23.english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

1CH.2.3.motu: Iuda natuna: Ere, Onan, Sela; ini memero tatoiosi na Batasua, hane Kanaan, ese e havara henia. Hari Ere, Iuda natuna roboana, na e kara dika, Iehova vairanai; bena Iehova ese e alaia mase.
1CH.2.3.english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.

1CH.5.11.motu: Gad garana na idia italaidia ai e nohova, Basan tanona ai, ela bona Saleka.
1CH.5.11.english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

1CH.12.30.motu: Efraim taudia gerebu-rua sinahu-taurahani, goada-herea taudia, mai haridia, tamadia edia iduhu ai.
1CH.12.30.english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

1CH.16.12.english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done,

1CH.5.10.motu: Saulo ena nega ai idia ese Hagara taudia e tuari henidia bona e hadareredia; bena edia kalaga ai e nohova, Gilead mairiveina kahana idoinai lalonai.
1CH.5.10.english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

1CH.27.4.motu: Dodai tau Ahohi ese hua iharuana oreana e biaguava; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.4.english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.16.38.motu: bona Obed-edom mai varavarana tauratoi-ahui taurahani danu. A Obed-edom Iedutunu bona Hosa na e gwauraidia, ikoukou bae gima.
1CH.16.38.english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

1CH.7.13.motu: Napatali natuna: Iasiel, Guni, Iesere, Salumu; sinadia na Bilha.
1CH.7.13.english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

1CH.6.40.motu: Simea na Mikael natuna, Mikael na Baaseia natuna, Baaseia na Malkia natuna,
1CH.6.40.english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

1CH.16.40.motu: unuseni ai ḡole-oho bouboudia ḡaudia na ihaboulaina patana latanai bae hahelaḡadia loulou, daba ai bona adorahi ai, Iehova ena taravatu, Israel e haḡanilaia ḡauna, lalonai e tore herevadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
1CH.16.40.english: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

1CH.21.11.motu: Taunabunai, Gad na David dekena ela, e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu. Edena o uramu bavabia:
1CH.21.11.english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

1CH.16.3.motu: bena Israel tataudia bona hahinedia iboudiai ta ta adia e henidia hagau-hagau: flaoa igabuna ta, bona vamu taina, bona vine huahuadia kaukaudia mane ta.
1CH.16.3.english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

1CH.13.2.motu: David ese Israel hegogona idoinai e hamaoroa, eto, Lalomui bema heḡereḡere bona Iehova, eda Dirava, bema ura, ita ese hereva baita siaia, varavarada Israel tanona idoinai e nohomu ediai, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia rei hanuadia ai e nohomu ediai danu; bena idia na baema, ita ida baitame tao hebou.
1CH.13.2.english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

1CH.16.16.english: the covenant which he made with Abraham,

1CH.28.5.motu: Bona natugu mamaruanedia iboudiai bogaragidia amo (badina be Iehova ese natugu hutuma vada e henigu) ia ese lau natugu Solomon vada e abia hidi, Iehova ena basileia teronona latanai baine helai, Israel baine lohiaia.
1CH.28.5.english: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.

1CH.2.30.motu: Nadab natuna: Selede bona Apaimi. Selede na e mase, asi natuna.
1CH.2.30.english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

1CH.11.29.motu: Sibekai, tau Husata; Ilai, tau Ahohi;
1CH.11.29.english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

1CH.6.3.motu: Arnram natuna: Aaron, Mose, Miriama. Aaron natuna: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasara, Itamara.
1CH.6.3.english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

1CH.6.26.motu: Ahimoto natuna na Elkana; Elkana natuna na Sofai; Sofai natuna na Nahata;
1CH.6.26.english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

1CH.2.42.motu: Kaleb, lerahamele tadina, natuna roboana na Maresa; ia na Sifi tamana. Maresa natuna na Heberon.
1CH.2.42.english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

1CH.17.1.motu: David na ena ruma ai e nohova. Una negana ai David ese peroveta tauna Natan e hereva henia, eto, A itaia, lau na sida rumana ai na nohomu, a Iehova ena taravatu mauana na kalaga ai e miamu.
1CH.17.1.english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”

1CH.19.5.motu: Haida ese idia sivaraidia na David e hamaorolaia, bena ia ese haida e siaidia, idia ida bae hedavari, badina be idia na e hemarai bada herea. Hanua pavapavana, eto, Ieriko ai ba noho ela bona aukimui huidia ma bae tubu, bena ba lou mai.
1CH.19.5.english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

1CH.10.1.motu: Filistia taudia ese Israel taudia e tuari henidia; bena Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau, ela bona Gilboa ororona ai Filistia taudia ese e aladia ore.
1CH.10.1.english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

1CH.7.28.motu: Edia tano bona edia noho gabuna na Betele, mai hanuadia ida; bona laurabada kahana ai Naaran; bona lahara kahana ai Gesere, mai hanuadia ida; bona Sekem, mai hanuadia ida; bona Aiaha, mai hanuadia ida;
1CH.7.28.english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

1CH.25.21.motu: Ihagwauta-hanina na Matitia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.21.english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.12.7.motu: Ioela bona Sebadia, Ierohama tau Gedoro natuna raruosi.
1CH.12.7.english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

1CH.1.12.motu: Patarusim, Kasaluhim, Kaftorim. Filistia taudia na Kasaluhim besena amo e vara.
1CH.1.12.english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

1CH.5.13.motu: Varavaradia, tamadia edia iduhu heḡereḡeredia ai, bini: Mikael, Mesulama, Sieba, Iorai, Iakan, Sia, Ebere, taudia hahitu.
1CH.5.13.english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

1CH.8.25.english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

1CH.6.39.motu: Bona ia tadina Asaf; ia na ia idibana kahana ai e giniva. (Hari Asaf na Berekia natuna, Berekia na Simea natuna,
1CH.6.39.english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

1CH.16.15.motu: Ia ese ena gwauhamata e laloa hanaihanaimu,

1CH.22.17.motu: David ese danu Israel lohiadia iboudiai e haḡanidia, idia ese ia natuna Solomon bae durua. Ia eto,
1CH.22.17.english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

1CH.25.31.motu: Iharuahui-hanina na Romamatiesere, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.31.english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

1CH.6.58.motu: Hilene, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Debiri, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
1CH.6.58.english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

1CH.15.21.motu: a Matitia, Elifelehu, Mikineia, Obed-edom, Ieiele bona Asasia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia maraḡidia bae hatai, Seminiti dalana ai.
1CH.15.21.english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

1CH.27.7.motu: Ihahanina na Asahele, Ioab tadina, hua ihahanina ena, bona ia natuna Sebadia ia murinai; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.7.english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.20.1.motu: Komukau negana ai, hanua pavapavadia edia tuari lao negana, Ioab ese tuari oreana e hakaua lasi, bena Amono taudia edia tano e e habuaia tari; bena ma ela, Raba e koua heḡeḡe. A David na Ierusalem ai e noho. Bena Ioab ese Raba e tuari henia, bena e hadarerea.
1CH.20.1.english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

1CH.4.23.motu: Unu na uro ikaradia taudia, bona Netaimi ai bona Gedera ai e nohova taudia; unuseni ai hanua pavapavana ida e nohova, iena ḡaukara ikaradia totona.
1CH.4.23.english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

1CH.21.30.motu: a David na asi ena dala unu bainela, Dirava inanadaina totona, badina be ia ese Iehova ena aneru ena dare garina e gariva.
1CH.21.30.english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

1CH.4.28.motu: Edia noho gabudia na Bere-sieba, Molada, Hasara-sual,
1CH.4.28.english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

1CH.21.23.motu: Bena Oronana ese David e haere henia, eto, Avabia; egu lohia bona egu pavapava na ena lalo-hadai namona heḡereḡerena baine karaia. A itaia, boromakau mamaruanedia na henimumu, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai baela, bona uit ikwadilaina audia na rakuraku audia ai baela, bona uit na flaoa boubou ḡauna ai bainela; idoinai na henimumu.
1CH.21.23.english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

1CH.1.32.motu: Ketura na Abraham ese e adavaia hahinena. Una hahine ese e havaradia memerodia: Simuran, Iokosan, Medan, Midian, Isabak, Sua. Iokosan natuna: Sieba bona Dedan.
1CH.1.32.english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

1CH.4.22.motu: Ia garana haida be lokimi bona Koseba taudia, bona Ioasa, bona Sarafa; hari Sarafa na Moab ai e lohia, bena e lou lao Leheme. (Ini na sene negadia ai e tore ḡaudia.)
1CH.4.22.english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

1CH.12.25.motu: Simeon taudia, goada-herea taudia tuari ai, na daha-hitu sinahu-ta.
1CH.12.25.english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

1CH.24.25.motu: Mika tadina, Isihia; Isihia natuna edia amo, Sekaria
1CH.24.25.english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

1CH.6.73.motu: Ramoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Aneme, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.73.english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

1CH.10.8.motu: Daba rerena ai Filistia taudia na ema, mase taudia edia dabua bae abi eto. Bena Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi ida masedia ai e davaridia, Gilboa ororona ai.
1CH.10.8.english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

1CH.2.6.motu: Sera natuna: Simiri, Etana, Hemana, Kalakolo, Dara, laimaosi.
1CH.2.6.english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

1CH.8.36.motu: Ahasa na Iehoada tamana; Iehoada na Alemete bona Asamavete bona Simiri tamadia; Simiri na Mosa tamana.
1CH.8.36.english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

1CH.17.23.motu: Iehova e, emu hesiai tauna bona ena iduhu o herevalaidia herevana na vada baine gini hanaihanai, bona o gwauraia heḡereḡerena ba karaia.
1CH.17.23.english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

1CH.20.3.motu: Hanua taudia danu e hakaudia lasi, ḡaukara e henidia, iri bona auri isivadia bona ira amo bae ḡaukara. David ese Amono hanuadia iboudiai na unu e karadia toma. Bena David bona ena orea taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem e lou lao.
1CH.20.3.english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

1CH.24.9.motu: iha-imana na Malkia, ihatauratoina na Miamini,
1CH.24.9.english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

1CH.26.16.motu: Supim bona Hosa na e duanaidia, lahara kahana ena; Salekete ikoukouna na unuseni ai, e dae laomu dalana ai. Edia nega edia nega ai e gima.
1CH.26.16.english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

1CH.26.21.motu: Ladan natuna, Gereson iduhuna taudia Ladan ena amo e vara, Gereson iduhuna ikwarana taudia Ladan, tau Gereson, ena amo e vara: Iehieli.
1CH.26.21.english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

1CH.6.22.motu: Kohat natuna na Aminadab; Aminadab natuna na Kora; Kora natuna na Asiri;
1CH.6.22.english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

1CH.21.12.motu: doe laḡani toi lalodiai; eiava inaimu edia hahebua-tari, hua toi lalodiai idia edia dare ese bae lasimu tao; eiava Iehova ena dare, dina toi lalodiai dai-hanai gorerena na tano ai baine kau, bona Iehova ena aneru na Israel tanona idoinai lalonai baine hahebua tari. Lalomu a hadaia, edena haere na e siaigu Diravana baina henia.
1CH.21.12.english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

1CH.25.4.motu: Hemana ena amo: Hemana natuna Bukia, Matania, Usiele, Sebuele; bona Ierimoto, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti; bona Romamatiesere, Iosobekasa, Maloti, Hotiri, Mahasioto.
1CH.25.4.english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

1CH.27.21.motu: Manase iduhu-kahana Gilead ai e nohomu taudia ikwaradia na Ido Sekaria; Beniamina iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Iaasiel Abnere;
1CH.27.21.english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

1CH.9.21.motu: Sekaria Meselemia na ikoukou igimana tauna, hebou kalagana raka-vareaina ai.
1CH.9.21.english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

1CH.7.9.motu: Unu iboudiai na Bekere natuna; edia uru ai ladadia e tore. Idia na edia iduhu kwaradia, bona tuari taudia mai goadadia. Iboudiai na gerebu-rua sinahu-rua.
1CH.7.9.english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

1CH.12.1.motu: Ini na David dekena ela Siklag ai taudia. Una negana ai David na asi ena raka evaeva dalana, Saulo Kisa dainai. Goada-herea taudia, tuari ai e duruava taudia, haida be idia.
1CH.12.1.english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

1CH.8.37.motu: Mosa na Binea tamana; Binea natuna na Rafa; Rafa natuna na Eleasa; Eleasa natuna na Asele.
1CH.8.37.english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

1CH.15.10.motu: Usiele garana amo: Aminadab, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta gwauta-rua.
1CH.15.10.english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

1CH.6.24.motu: Asiri natuna na Tahata; Tahata natuna na Uriele; Uriele natuna na Usia, Usia natuna na Saul.
1CH.6.24.english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

1CH.12.22.motu: Dina ta ta amo tatau na David dekena e maiva, bae durua totona, ela bona tuari oreana na bada herea, e kara Dirava ena tuari oreana ta na heto.
1CH.12.22.english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

1CH.1.18.motu: Afasad ese Sela e havaraia, bona Sela ese Ebere e havaraia.
1CH.1.18.english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

1CH.2.24.motu: Hesron e mase murinai, Kaleb ese Efrata, ia tamana Hesron adavana, ida e eno bou; bena una hahine ese natuna Asahuru e havara henia; ia na Tekoa tamana.
1CH.2.24.english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

1CH.8.40.motu: Ulama natuna na tuari taudia mai goadadia, peva taudia, natudia bona tubudia na hutuma, iboudiai na sinahu-ta imahui. Unu iboudiai na Beniamina taudia.
1CH.8.40.english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

1CH.15.14.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na sibodia e hahelaḡa, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena maua helaḡana bae daelaia totona.
1CH.15.14.english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

1CH.3.16.motu: Iehoiakim garana: natuna na Iekonia; ia natuna na Sedekia.
1CH.3.16.english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

1CH.8.9.motu: Natuna haida adavana Hodese enai e havaradia: Iobab, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam,
1CH.8.9.english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

1CH.12.11.motu: ihatauratoina na Alai; ihahituna na Eliele;
1CH.12.11.english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

1CH.5.21.motu: Bena edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia na e laohaidia: edia kamelo gerebu-ima, edia mamoe domaga-rua gerebu-ima, bona edia doniki daha-rua; tatau domaga-ta danu e abidia mauri.
