1CH.5.21.english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

1CH.17.21.motu: Edena bese tanobada ai na emu bese Israel heḡereḡerena? Dirava ese vada e hamauria, iena bese ai bainela; oi sibomu ladamu o hadaia, kara badadia bona hahegari karadia o karava daidiai; bona bese idau-idau na oiemu bese, Aigupto arrto o hamauria besena, vairana amo o luludia lasi.
1CH.17.21.english: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

1CH.4.40.motu: Unuseni ai idia na rei ḡoeva-daedia gabudia e davaridia; una tano na taora bada, asi tautauna, heato kava, badina be e noholaia gunava taudia na Ham besena taudia.
1CH.4.40.english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

1CH.7.38.english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

1CH.11.37.english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

1CH.19.16.motu: Suria taudia na vada e diba, Israel taudia ese idia vada e hadareredia, bena idia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia lao, Suria taudia Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai e nohova na e hakaudia mai; Sofaka, Hadadesere ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese e kwaradia.
1CH.19.16.english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

1CH.22.3.motu: David ese danu auri momo herea e habou, raka-vareai iduaradia ikokodia bona hakapu-tao auridia ikaradia totona, bona auri labora-labora momo herea danu, metauna na asi ihahetohona dalana;
1CH.22.3.english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

1CH.16.32.motu: Davara baine lolo, mai lalona ḡaudia iboudiai ida;
1CH.16.32.english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

1CH.23.5.motu: daha hani na ikoukou igimadia taudia ai baela, bona daha hani ese hatai-hatai ḡaudia, hahenamo totona vada na kara ḡaudia, amo Iehova bae hanamnoa.
1CH.23.5.english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

1CH.28.6.motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto: Oi natumu Solomon ese egu dubu bona egu maḡu baine haginidia, badina be vada na abia hidi, ia na lau natugu ai bainela, bona lau na ia tamana ai bainala.
1CH.28.6.english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

1CH.3.21.motu: Hanania natuna na Pelatia, ia natuna na Iesaia; ia natuna na Refaia; ia natuna na Aranana; ia natuna na Obadia; ia natuna na Sekania.
1CH.3.21.english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

1CH.8.38.motu: Asele natuna na tauratoi, ladadia bini: Asarikama, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, Hanana. Unu iboudiai na Asele natuna.
1CH.8.38.english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

1CH.7.29.motu: bona Manase taudia edia tano hetoana ai danu, Bete-seana mai hanuadia ida; bona Taanak, mai hanuadia ida; bona Megido, mai hanuadia ida; bona Doro, mai hanuadia ida. Unu hanua lalodiai Iosef Israel garana e nohova.
1CH.7.29.english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

1CH.9.20.motu: Nega gunadia ai, Fineha Eleasara ese e biagudia, bona Iehova na ia ida.
1CH.9.20.english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

1CH.27.13.motu: Ihagwautana, hua ihagwautana ena, na Maharai tau Netofa, Sera iduhuna tauna; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
1CH.27.13.english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

1CH.2.43.motu: Heberon natuna: Kora, Tapua, Rekeme Sema.
1CH.2.43.english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

1CH.16.19.english: when you were but a few men in number,

1CH.2.36.motu: Atai na Natan tamana; Natan na Sabada tamana;
1CH.2.36.english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

1CH.1.53.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

1CH.11.16.motu: David na gabu aukana ai, a Filistia taudia na Betelehem ai e hegimava.
1CH.11.16.english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

1CH.16.25.motu: Badina be Iehova na bada, ia ihanamona danu baine bada;
1CH.16.25.english: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised.

1CH.7.14.motu: Manase natuna na Asriel, Aram hahinena bogana amo; una hahine ese Makiri, Gilead tamana, danu e havaraia.
1CH.7.14.english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

1CH.12.12.motu: ihataurahanina na Iohanan; ihataurahani-tana na Elsabad;
1CH.12.12.english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

1CH.12.9.motu: Gini-gunana na Esere; iharuana na Obadia; ihatoina na Eliab;
1CH.12.9.english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

1CH.28.1.motu: David ese Israel ena heitatao taudia bona iduhu ta ta edia heitatao taudia, bona hanua pavapavana isiaina e lao heniva oreadia biagudia, bona daha bona sinahu lohiadia, bona hanua pavapavana mai natuna ida edia kohu bona edia boromakau iboudiai ireḡudia taudia, bona hanua pavapavana ena ruma itataona taudia, bona goada-herea taudia bona tuari manada taudia iboudiai, na e haboudia, Ierusalem ai.
1CH.28.1.english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

1CH.21.29.motu: Badina be una negana ai Iehova ena kalaga helaḡana, Mose ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e karaia ḡauna, bona ḡole-oho bouboudia patana, na Gibeon ai, atai gabuna ai;
1CH.21.29.english: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

1CH.6.1.english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH.1.47.motu: Hadad e mase, bena Samula, tau Masareka, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
1CH.1.47.english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

1CH.9.14.motu: Levi taudia: Semaia (ia na Hasub natuna, Hasub na Asarikama natuna, Asarikama na Hasabia natuna, Merari garana taudia);
1CH.9.14.english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

1CH.24.11.motu: ihataurahani-tana na Iesua, ihagwautana na Sekania,
1CH.24.11.english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

1CH.11.13.motu: Filistia taudia na tuari totona Pasadamimi ai e hebou negana ai, una tau danu David ida unuseni ai. Bali umana ta na unuseni ai, bena Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau.
1CH.11.13.english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

1CH.2.10.motu: Ram na Aminadab tamana; Aminadab na Nason tamana; una Nason na Iuda taudia edia lohia ta.
1CH.2.10.english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

1CH.4.32.motu: Edia hanua maraḡidia na Etam, Ain, Rimon, Tokene, Asana; hanua ima,
1CH.4.32.english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

1CH.10.9.motu: Bena ena dabua e koki oho, bona kwarana bona ena tuari dabuadia e abi, e laohai. Bena idia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia karoho, Filistia tanona idoinai, hari namona na edia kaivakuku dubudia ai bona edia bese taudia vairadiai bae piua totona.
1CH.10.9.english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

1CH.19.6.motu: Amono taudia vada e diba, David lalona vada e hadikaia ediai; bena Hanunu bona Amono taudia ese silver talent daha-ta e siaidia, kariota bona hosi-gui taudia na bae vatudia, Mesopotamia bona Arama-maaka bona Soba amo.
1CH.19.6.english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

1CH.8.27.english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

1CH.11.24.motu: Ini kara na Benaia Iehoiada ese e karava, bena ia harina na hari goada-herea taudia tatoiosi haridia ida e gwauraidia hebou.
1CH.11.24.english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

1CH.23.1.motu: David vada e buruka, ena mauri dinadia vada e hoho; una negana ai ia ese natuna Solomon na Israel pavapavana ai e halaoa.
1CH.23.1.english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

1CH.23.32.motu: Hebou kalagana bona gabu helaḡana na unu bae naridia toma, bona tadikakadia Aaron garana bae durudia, Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia ikaradia ai.
1CH.23.32.english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

1CH.9.3.motu: Iuda bona Beniamina bona Efraim bona Manase taudia haida na Ierusalem ai e nohova.
1CH.9.3.english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

1CH.22.4.motu: bona sida audia danu, asi iduahidia, badina be Sidono taudia bona Turo taudia ese sida audia momo herea na David dekena e mailaidia.
1CH.22.4.english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

1CH.4.5.motu: Asahuru, Tekoa tamana, adavana na rarua, Hela bona Naara.
1CH.4.5.english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

1CH.6.21.motu: Sima natuna na Ioa; Ioa natuna na Ido; Ido natuna na Sera; Sera natuna na leaterai.
1CH.6.21.english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

1CH.8.13.motu: bona Beria bona Sema (idia na Aialono taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, bona idia ese Gata taudia e hadareredia),
1CH.8.13.english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

1CH.2.21.motu: Una murinai Hesron na Makiri natuna hahinena, Gilead taihuna, ida e eno bou. Una hahine na e adavaia negana ai iena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui; bena una hahine ese natuna Segubu e havara henia.
1CH.2.21.english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

1CH.28.18.motu: bona muramura mai bonadia patana, gold ḡoeva-daena amo e karaia ḡauna, metauna; bona hanidia e toi roro, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e goru ahu, kerubidia edia gold kariotana danu e laloa hata.
1CH.28.18.english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

1CH.15.2.motu: Bena David eto, Asi tauna ta ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana baine huaia, a Levi taudia mo; badina be Iehova ese vada e abidia hidi, Iehova ena maua helaḡana bae huaia bona ia isiaina bae lao heni ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.15.2.english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

1CH.6.7.motu: Meraioto na Amaria tamana; Amaria na Ahitubu tamana;
1CH.6.7.english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

1CH.15.12.motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Umui na Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia; sibomui ba hahelaḡa, umui bona varavaramui danu; Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena maua helaḡana vada na heḡaeḡaelaia gabuna ai ba daelaia totona.
1CH.15.12.english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

1CH.9.28.motu: Idia haida ese tomadiho ai e ḡaukaralaiva ḡau helagadia e nariva; edia ḡaukara be e atodia vareai bona e abidia lasi negadia ai bae hagaudia.
1CH.9.28.english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

1CH.18.1.motu: Una murinai David ese Filistia taudia e hadareredia bona e hamanaudia; bena ia ese Gata mai ena hanua maraḡidia iboudiai ida na Filistia taudia imadia amo e abidia oho.
1CH.18.1.english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

1CH.18.8.motu: Hadadesere ena hanua rua, Tibihata bona Kunu, amo David ese aun labora-labora momo herea e abi; bena Solomon ese ranu nauna bada-hereana bona au-tubua bona ḡau idau-idau na una auri-laboralabora amo e kara.
1CH.18.8.english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

1CH.21.27.motu: Bena Iehova ese hari aneru e haḡania; bena aneru ese ena dare na iudalaina ḡauna ai ma e toia vareai.
1CH.21.27.english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

1CH.3.4.motu: Natuna mamaruanedia tauratoi Heberon ai e vara; ia na laḡani hitu hua tauratoi unuseni ai e lohia.
1CH.3.4.english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

1CH.19.2.motu: Bena David eto, Hanunu Nahasa baina kara momokani henia, badina be tamana ese e kara momokani heniguva. Taunabunai, David ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, tauna ihalona totona, tamana dainai. Bena David ena hesiai taudia na Hanunu dekenai e kau, Amono taudia edia tano ai, tauna ihalona totona.
1CH.19.2.english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.”

1CH.2.23.motu: A Gesuru bona Aram ese Havoto-iairi na idia edia amo e abia oho, bona Kenat mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida danu; e abi hanuadia iboudiai na tauratoiahui. Unu iboudiai na Makiri, Gilead tamana, garana.
1CH.2.23.english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

1CH.6.61.motu: Kohat taudia oredia na hanua gwauta mari amo e henidia, Manase iduhuna kahana ena amo.
1CH.6.61.english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

1CH.16.34.motu: Iehova ba hanamoa, badina be ia na namo,
1CH.16.34.english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,

1CH.16.8.motu: Iehova ba hanamoa, ia ladana ba hahanea;

1CH.5.12.motu: Ioel na lohia tauna; iharuana na Safama; bona lanai bona Safata danu na Basan ai.
1CH.5.12.english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

1CH.4.10.motu: Iabese ese Israel Diravana e noia, eto, Boma hanamogu, egu tano hetoa boma habadaia bona imamu na bema lau dekegu ai, bona dika amo boma rauagu, bena basinema hahisigu. Bena e noia ḡauna na Dirava ese e havara henia.
1CH.4.10.english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!”

1CH.18.5.motu: Bena Suria taudia na Damasko amo ela, Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, bae durua eto; una negana ai David ese Suria taudia gerebu-rua daha-rua e aladia mase.
1CH.18.5.english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

1CH.6.75.motu: Hukoko, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Rehob, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.75.english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

1CH.17.16.motu: Bena King David e raka vareai, Iehova vairanai e helai, eto, Dirava Iehova e, lau be daika bona egu iduhu be dahaka, bena oi ese vada o hakaugu ema bona hari?
1CH.17.16.english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

1CH.19.13.motu: Ba goada balaheni; baita haheauka, eda bese dainai, bona eda Dirava ena hanua daidiai; Iehova ese ena lalo-hadai namodia heḡereḡeredia ai baine kara.
1CH.19.13.english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”

1CH.1.37.motu: Reuele natuna: Nahata, Sera, Sama, Misa.
1CH.1.37.english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

1CH.12.5.motu: Elusai; Ierirnoto; Bealia; Semaria; Sefatia, Harufu tauna;
1CH.12.5.english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

1CH.6.53.motu: Ahitubu natuna na Sadok; Sadok natuna na Ahimasa.
1CH.6.53.english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

1CH.6.42.motu: Adaia na Etana natuna, Etana na Sima natuna, Sima na Simei natuna,
1CH.6.42.english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

1CH.12.8.motu: Goada-herea bona tuari mai dibadia taudia haida Gad iduhuna amo na David dekena e hanai. Ia na ena gabu aukana ai, tano gagaena ai. Idia na kesi bona io dibadia herea; vairadia na leona vairadia na heheto; edia heau na uda diana ororo ai e heaumu na heto.
1CH.12.8.english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

1CH.17.27.motu: taunabunai, mani emu kara emu hesiai tauna ba hanamoa, bena oi vairamu ai baine hesiriu hanaihanai; badina be, Iehova e, oi ese vada o hanamoa ḡauna na baine namo ela bona hanaihanai.
1CH.17.27.english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

1CH.9.25.motu: bona varavaradia hanua ai na taravadia e atu, dina hitu hitu amo baema, edia nega edia nega ai, bae bamodia totona.
1CH.9.25.english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

1CH.24.12.motu: ihagwauta-tana na Eliasibi, ihagwautaruana na lakimi,
1CH.24.12.english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

1CH.4.15.motu: Kaleb lefune natuna: Iru, Elaha, Naama; Elaha natuna na Kena.
1CH.4.15.english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

1CH.16.6.motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia Benaia bona lahasiel na kibi bae hiriri loulou, Dirava ena taravatu mauana vairanai.
1CH.16.6.english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

1CH.21.10.motu: Aola, David ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: ḡau toi na dudui henimumu, tamona bavabia hidi, bena unu baina kara henimu toma.
1CH.21.10.english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

1CH.26.2.motu: Meselemia na mai natuna haida: tau-roboana na Sekaria, iharuana na lediaele, ihatoina na Sebadia, ihahanina na Iataniele,
1CH.26.2.english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

1CH.22.19.motu: Harihari mai Ialomui bona daramui ida Iehova, emui Dirava, ba tahua. A tore isi; Dirava Iehova ena gabu helaḡana ba haginia, bena Iehova ena taravatu mauana bona Dirava ena ḡau helaḡadia na Iehova ladana bagunai vada o haginia rumana lalonai bae vareailaidia.
1CH.22.19.english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”

1CH.2.33.motu: Ionatan natuna: Pelete bona Sasa. Unu na Ierahamele vevena.
1CH.2.33.english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

1CH.11.14.motu: A ia na uma bogaraginai e gini, e gimaia, bona Filistia taudia e aladia mase; una kwalimu badana amo Iehova ese e hamauridia.
1CH.11.14.english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.

1CH.24.15.motu: ihagwautahituna na Hesiri, ihagwauta-taurahanina na Hapisese,
1CH.24.15.english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

1CH.6.17.motu: Gereson natuna ladadia bini: Libni bona Simei.
1CH.6.17.english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

1CH.22.7.motu: David ese Solomon e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, lalogu na e ura dubu auta baina haginia nato, Iehova, egu Dirava, ladana ena.
1CH.22.7.english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.

1CH.17.5.motu: Badina be ruma ta ai asina noho, Israel na hakaua isi dinana amo ema bona ina dina, a kalaga ta amo ela bona kalaga ta, bona noho gabuna ta ela bona noho gabuna ta, vada na noho eva-eva.
1CH.17.5.english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

1CH.21.13.motu: Bena David ese Gad e haere henia, eto, Daragu eme doko dikadika; Iehova imana ai baina moru be namo, badina be ena hebogahisi na bada herea, a taunimanima imadia ai basina moru.
1CH.21.13.english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

1CH.13.12.motu: Una dina ai David ese Dirava garina e gari, eto, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na egu gabu ede baina laohaia toma?
1CH.13.12.english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

1CH.12.13.motu: Ihagwautana na Ieremia; ihagwauta-tana na Makabanai.
1CH.12.13.english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

1CH.12.38.motu: Ini tuari taudia iboudiai na edia tuari oreadia ta ta ai e raka lao Heberon, edia lalo-hadai korikori be David na Israel idoinai pavapavana ai bae halaoa; Israel taudia oredia iboudiai danu edia lalo-hadai tamona na unuheto.
1CH.12.38.english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

1CH.2.28.motu: Onam natuna: Samai bona lada. Sarnai natuna: Nadab bona Abisuru.
1CH.2.28.english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

1CH.11.4.motu: David bona Israel idoinai na Ierusalem (ladana ta na Iebusu) ela. Iebusu taudia, una tano e noholaiava taudia, na unuseni ai.
1CH.11.4.english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

1CH.3.14.motu: ia natuna Amon; ia natuna Iosia.
1CH.3.14.english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

1CH.10.3.motu: Tuari na auka herea, Saulo enai; peva taudia ese e davaria, bena edia diba amo e haberoa.
1CH.10.3.english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

1CH.24.27.motu: Merari natuna, Iaasia ena amo: Beno, Sohama, Sakuru, Ibri.
1CH.24.27.english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

1CH.15.18.motu: bona idia ida ma varavaradia haida orea iharuana ai, Sekaria, Iaasiel, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Uni, Eliab, Benaia, Maaseia, Matitia, Elifelehu bona Mikineia; bona ikoukou igimadia taudia, Obed-edom bona leiele.
1CH.15.18.english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

1CH.2.13.motu: Iese natuna roboana na Eliab, iharuana na Abinadab, ihatoina na Simea,
1CH.2.13.english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

1CH.2.44.motu: Sema na Rahama tamana; Rahama na lorokeama tamana. Rekeme na Samai tamana.
1CH.2.44.english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

1CH.6.60.motu: Bona Beniamina iduhuna amo: Geba, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Alemete, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Anatoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida. Edia iduhu lalodiai edia hanua iboudiai na gwauta-toi.
1CH.6.60.english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

1CH.4.2.motu: Sobal natuna Re-aia na lahata tamana; Iahata na Ahumai bona Lahada tamadia. Unu na Sorata iduhudia.
1CH.4.2.english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

1CH.22.1.motu: Bena David eto, Dirava Iehova ena dubu na iniseni ai baine gini, bona Israel ena ḡole-oho bouboudia patana danu.
1CH.22.1.english: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

1CH.26.22.motu: Iehieli natuna, Setama bona tadina Ioel ese Iehova ena dubu kohudia ihaboudia rumadia e nariva.
1CH.26.22.english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

1CH.3.19.motu: Pedaia natuna: Serubabele bona Simei. Serubabele natuna: Mesulama bona Hanania; idia taihudia na Selomiti;
1CH.3.19.english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

1CH.6.15.motu: Iehova ese Iuda bona Ierusalem taudia na Nebukadnesara imana amo idau gabu ai e hanohodia lao negana ai, hari Iehosadak danu e laohaia.
1CH.6.15.english: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

1CH.16.35.english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation!

1CH.26.5.motu: ihatauratoina na Amiele, ihahituna na Isakara, ihataurahanina na Peuletai; badina be Dirava ese e hanamoa.
1CH.26.5.english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

1CH.7.2.motu: Tola natuna: Usisi, Refaia, Ieriele, Iahamai, Ibsam, Semuel. Idia na edia iduhu, Tola iduhuna, ikwaradia. Idia na tuari taudia mai goadadia edia uru ai; iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-rua sinahu-tauratoi, David ena nega ai.
1CH.7.2.english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

1CH.11.31.motu: Itai Ribai, tau Gibea, Beniamina iduhuna tauna; Benaia, tau Piratono;
1CH.11.31.english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

1CH.11.15.motu: Lohia toiahuiosi bogaragidia amo tatau tatoi na nadi-gini ela, David dekenai, Adulama kohuana ai. Una negana ai Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana na Refaim kourana ai e taruha.
1CH.11.15.english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

1CH.6.45.motu: Maluku na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Amasia natuna, Amasia na Hilkia natuna,
1CH.6.45.english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

1CH.13.9.motu: Idia na Kidono ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai e kau, bena Usa ese imana e toia roro, maua helaḡana baine dogoa tao eto, badina be boromakau mamaruanedia na e hetutuhi.
1CH.13.9.english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

1CH.23.17.motu: Eliesere natuna na Rehabia, tau lohia. Eliesere na asi natuna mamaruanedia haida, a Rehabia natuna na hutuma herea.
1CH.23.17.english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

1CH.9.15.motu: bona Bakabakara; bona Herese; bona Galala; bona Matania (ia na Mika natuna, Mika na Sikri natuna, Sikri na Asaf natuna);
1CH.9.15.english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

1CH.7.27.motu: Elisama natuna na Nunu; Nunu natuna na Iosua.
1CH.7.27.english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

1CH.26.14.motu: Mari ese Selemia e duanaia, laurabada kahana ena. Ia natuna Sekaria danu, hahealo tauna ta mai aonegana, na mari ese e duanaia, mirigini kahana ena.
1CH.26.14.english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

1CH.14.13.motu: Filistia taudia ese koura taudia tuan ma e lasi henidia.
1CH.14.13.english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

1CH.7.36.motu: Sofa natuna: Sua, Haranefere, Sual, Beri, Imra,
1CH.7.36.english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

1CH.12.18.motu: Bena Lauma ese Amasai, toiahuiosi biagudia, na e rohea; bena ia na eto,
1CH.12.18.english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

1CH.21.2.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Ioab bona tuari biagudia e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, Israel taudia ba hagaudia, Bere-sieba amo ela bona Dan; bena hereva ba mailaia, baina diba idia be hahida.
1CH.21.2.english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

1CH.4.37.motu: bona Sisa Sifi; ia na Alono ledaia tubuna, bona hari Alono na Sirnri Semaia tubuna.
1CH.4.37.english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

1CH.11.34.motu: Haseme, tau Gisono; Ionatan Sage, tau Harara;
1CH.11.34.english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

1CH.12.2.motu: Idia na peva taudia; diba ikinodia bona vilipopo nadidia idavedia, ima-idibadia eiava ima-lauridia amo, na mai dibadia; idia na Beniamina taudia, Saulo varavarana.
1CH.12.2.english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

1CH.1.33.motu: Midian natuna: Efa, Efere, Hanok, Abida, Eldaha. Ini iboudiai na Ketura vevena.
1CH.1.33.english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

1CH.12.39.motu: Dina toi unuseni ai David ida e nohova, e anianiva bona e inuinuva, badina be tadikakadia ese adia vada e abi heḡaeḡae.
1CH.12.39.english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

1CH.4.26.motu: Misima natuna na Hamuele; ia natuna na Sakuru; ia natuna na Sirnei.
1CH.4.26.english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

1CH.12.27.motu: Tau lohia Iehoiada, Aaron ena iduhu tauna, ida ela taudia na daha-toi sinahu-hitu.
1CH.12.27.english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

1CH.27.18.motu: Iuda iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Elihu, David kakana ta; Isakara iduhuna taudia ikwaradia na Omri Mikael;
1CH.27.18.english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

1CH.5.8.motu: bona Bela Asasa, Sema Ioel tubuna, ia na Aroere ai e nohova, ela bona Nebo bona Baal-meono.
1CH.5.8.english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

1CH.23.19.motu: Heberon natuna na Ieria, tau lohia; ihararuana na Amaria, ihatatoina na Iahasiel, bona ihahahanina na lekameama.
1CH.23.19.english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

1CH.18.15.motu: Ioab Seruia na tuari oreana lohiana; Iehosafat Ahilud na e tore pepadia inaridia tau;
1CH.18.15.english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

1CH.26.23.motu: Amram bona Isahara bona Heberon bona Usiele iduhudia amo:
1CH.26.23.english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

1CH.28.4.motu: Ḡau tamona, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese tamagu ena ruma taudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo e abigu hidi, Israel baina lohiaia hanaihanai. Badina be ia ese Iuda e abia hidi, baine hegunalai, bona Iuda iduhuna amo lau tamagu ena ruma e abia hidi, bona tamagu natuna bogaragidia amo lau e lalo namo henigu, Israel idoinai baina lohiaia eto.
1CH.28.4.english: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

1CH.18.9.motu: Tou, Hamat pavapavana, e kamonai David ese Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, ena tuari oreana idoinai vada e hadarerea.
1CH.18.9.english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

1CH.6.27.motu: Nahata natuna na Eliab; Eliab natuna na Ierohama; Ierohama natuna na Elkana.
1CH.6.27.english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

1CH.24.31.motu: Ini danu, iduhu kwaradia ta ta mai tadidia ta ta ida, man e abi, tadikakadia Aaron garana heḡereḡeredia, King David bona Sadok bona Ahimelek, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, vairadiai.
1CH.24.31.english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

1CH.1.28.english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

1CH.9.6.motu: Sera garana: Ieuele bona varavara verina, tatau sinahu-tauratoi taurahanita-ahui.
1CH.9.6.english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

1CH.23.16.motu: Geresom natuna na Sebuele, tau lohia.
1CH.23.16.english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

1CH.11.33.motu: Asamavete, Baharumu tauna; Eliaba, tau Saalbon;
1CH.11.33.english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

1CH.7.35.motu: Ia tadina Helere natuna: Sofa, Imna, Selese, Amala.
1CH.7.35.english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

1CH.6.44.motu: Lauri kahana ai na tadikakadia Merari garana, Etana Kisi. (Una Kisi na Abdi natuna, Abdi na Maluku natuna,
1CH.6.44.english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

1CH.6.77.motu: Merari taudia orena na ini hanua Sebulun iduhuna amo e henidia: Rimono, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Taboro, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.77.english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

1CH.24.7.motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna tauna na Iehoiaribi, iharuana na ledaia,
1CH.24.7.english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

1CH.14.3.motu: David ese hahine haida ma e adavadia Ierusalem ai, bona natuna mamaruanedia bona natuna hahinedia haida e havaradia.
1CH.14.3.english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

1CH.29.11.motu: Iehova e, goada bona siahu bona hairai bona kwalimu bona herea-dae na oiemu; badina be ḡau iboudiai guba ai bona tanobada ai na oiemu. Iehova e, basileia na oiemu; vada e imodaimumu, ḡau iboudiai ikwaradia.
1CH.29.11.english: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

1CH.26.1.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea bini. Kora taudia edia amo: Meselemia Kore, Asaf natuna ta.
1CH.26.1.english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

1CH.1.19.motu: Ebere natuna mamaruanedia na rarua: ta ladana Peleg (badina be iena nega ai tano hetoadia e kara); ia tadina ladana na Iokotan.
1CH.1.19.english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

1CH.6.48.motu: Bona tadikakadia Levi taudia na e gwauraidia hidi, Dirava ena dubu ai gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia iboudiai ikaradia taudia.
1CH.6.48.english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

1CH.11.42.motu: Adina Sisa, Ruben iduhuna tauna, Ruben taudia edia lohia ta, bona tatau toi-ahui ia ida;
1CH.11.42.english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

1CH.14.16.motu: Bena David ese Dirava ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e karaia; bena Filistia taudia e rahudia mase, Gibeon amo ela bona Gesere.
1CH.14.16.english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

1CH.9.27.motu: Idia na Dirava ena dubu heḡeḡemadai e nohova, badina be edia ḡaukara korikori na bae gimaia, bona daba daba iboudiai bae kehoa.
1CH.9.27.english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

1CH.11.27.motu: Samota, tau Harod; Helese, tau Pelono;
1CH.11.27.english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

1CH.29.27.motu: Ena lohia laḡanidia Israel ai na hari-ahui; laḡani hitu ia ese Heberon ai e lohiaia, bona laḡani toi-ahui toi Ierusalem ai.
1CH.29.27.english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

1CH.7.20.motu: Efraim natuna na Sutela, (Sutela natuna na Bered, Bered natuna na Tahata, Tahata natuna na Eleada, Eleada natuna na Tahata,
1CH.7.20.english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

1CH.25.26.motu: Ihagwauta-taurahanitana na Maloti, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.26.english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.12.36.motu: Asere taudia na gerebu-hani, tuari manada taudia, heheḡaeḡae tuari.
1CH.12.36.english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

1CH.13.6.motu: Bena David bona Israel idoinai na Baala ela (una na Kiriat-ieanmi, Iuda hanuana ta), Dirava ena maua helaḡana, Iehova, kerubi daediai e helaimu Diravana, ladana e nemailaia ḡauna, na unu amo bae daelaia eto.
1CH.13.6.english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

1CH.17.6.motu: Israel idoinai ida na loa heniva gabudia iboudiai lalodiai Israel ena hahemaoro taudia, na haḡanidia egu orea Israel bae reḡua taudia, ta na hereva henia a, nato “Dahaka dainai egu sida rumana auta to haginia?”
1CH.17.6.english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

1CH.2.29.motu: Abisuru adavana ladana na Abihaili; una hahine ese natuna Ahabana bona Molidi na e havara henia.
1CH.2.29.english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

1CH.23.12.motu: Kohat natuna na Amram bona Isahara bona Heberon bona Usiele, hahaniosi.
1CH.23.12.english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

1CH.4.33.motu: mai edia hanua maraḡidia iboudiai ida, hari hanua badadia e ginidia heḡeḡe-madai ḡaudia, ela bona Baal. Edia noho gabudia bunu; bona senedia ladadia e tore ḡaudia e baladia heni.
1CH.4.33.english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

1CH.9.39.motu: Nere na Kisa tamana, Kisa na Saulo tamana, Saulo na Ionatan bona Malkisua bona Abinadab bona Esebaal tamadia.
1CH.9.39.english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

1CH.28.16.motu: bona flaoa helaḡana patadia ta ta edia gold metaudia, bona silver patadia edia silver metaudia;
1CH.28.16.english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

1CH.6.81.motu: Hesebon, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Iasere, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
1CH.6.81.english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

1CH.25.28.motu: Iharuahui-tana na Hotiri, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.28.english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.11.7.motu: Bena David na una kohoro ai e nohova; una dainai ladana e hatoa “David ena hanua”.
1CH.11.7.english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

1CH.12.20.motu: Siklag ela negana ai hari Manase taudia na ienai e hanai ladadia bini: Adna, Iosabad, Iediaele, Mikael, Iosabad, Elihu, Siletai; idia na daha lohiadia Manase ai.
1CH.12.20.english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

1CH.27.28.motu: Olive bona suke audia Sefela ai itataodia tauna na Baal-hanana, tau Gedere; bona e habou dehorodia itataodia tauna na Ioasa.
1CH.27.28.english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

1CH.6.50.motu: Aaron garana bini: natuna na Eleasara; Eleasara natuna na Fineha, Fineha natuna na Abisua,
1CH.6.50.english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

1CH.5.19.motu: Idia ese Hagara taudia, bona leturu bona Nafisi bona Nodaba, e tuari henidia;
1CH.5.19.english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

1CH.26.24.motu: Sebuele (ia na Geresom garana bona Geresom na Mose garana) na habou-habou rumadia itataodia tauna badana.
1CH.26.24.english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

1CH.24.18.motu: iharuahui-toina na Delaia, iharuahui-hanina na Maasia.
1CH.24.18.english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

1CH.9.23.motu: Taunabunai, idia bona natudia na Iehova ena dubu, kalaga dubuna, ikoukoudia ibiagudia bona igimadia taudia.
1CH.9.23.english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

1CH.2.55.motu: Itorena taudia Iabese ai e nohova danu besedia bini: Tirata bona Simeata bona Sukata besedia. Unu na Kene taudia, Hamat ena amo e vara; una Hamat na Rekab iduhuna senena.
1CH.2.55.english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

1CH.1.49.motu: Saul e mase, bena Baal-hanana Akahoro na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
1CH.1.49.english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

1CH.23.22.motu: Eleasara na e mase, asi natuna mamaruanedia to hahine mo; bena idia varavaradia, Kisa natuna mamaruanedia, ese e adavadia.
1CH.23.22.english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

1CH.25.6.motu: Idia iboudiai na Iehova ena dubu lalonai tamadia ese e biagudiava ane ḡaukaradia ai, mai botabota auridia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia ida, Dirava ena dubu gaukarana lalonai. Asaf bona Iedutunu bona Hemana na hanua pavapavana ese e biagudiava.
1CH.25.6.english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

1CH.28.2.motu: Bena King David e tore isi, eto.
1CH.28.2.english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

1CH.28.21.motu: A itaia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia oreadia, Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai ikaradia taudia; bona lalo-ura taudia iboudiai, ḡaukara idau-idau ikaradia mai dibadia taudia, na oi ida, ḡaukara idoinai lalonai; bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai ese oiemu haheḡani bae badinadia.
1CH.28.21.english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

1CH.8.16.english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

1CH.9.42.motu: Ahasa na Iara tamana; Iara na Alemete bona Asamavete bona Simin tamadia; Simiri na Mosa tamana;
1CH.9.42.english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

1CH.14.8.motu: Filistia taudia na e kamonai David vada e horoa, Israel idoinai pavapavana; bena Filistia taudia iboudiai na David itahuna e dae ela. David e kamonai, bena e raka lasi, baine tuari henidia.
1CH.14.8.english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

1CH.6.64.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese Levi taudia na hanua, mai edia rei gabudia ida, e henidia.
1CH.6.64.english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

1CH.4.1.motu: A Iuda natuna: Perese, Hesron, Karami, Huru, Sobal.
1CH.4.1.english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

1CH.8.21.english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

1CH.10.12.motu: bena boga-auka taudia iboudiai e tore isi, Saulo tau-anina bona natuna mamaruanedia tau-anidia na e abidia oho, Iabese e laohaidia, turiadia na Iabese oak auna henunai e guridia. Bena dina hitu e anivaga.
1CH.10.12.english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

1CH.5.17.motu: Ini iboudiai na Iotam, Iuda pavapavana, bona Ieroboam, Israel pavapavana, negadia ai edia uru ta ta ladadia ai e tore.
1CH.5.17.english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

1CH.11.21.motu: Hari toiahuiosi bogaragidiai, ia mo sibona harina vada e bada, bena biagudia ai ela. A ia na hari tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere.
1CH.11.21.english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

1CH.4.6.motu: Naara ese ia natuna e havara henia ḡaudia bini: Ahusama, Hefere, Temeni, Haahasatari. Naara natuna bunu.
1CH.4.6.english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

1CH.13.4.motu: E hegogo taudia iboudiai lalodia e hatamona unu bae kara toma, badina be taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai una na kara maorona.
1CH.13.4.english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

1CH.26.20.motu: Ahia, Levi iduhuna tauna, ese Dirava ena dubu kohudia bona herahia helaḡadia ihaboudia rumadia e nariva.
1CH.26.20.english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

1CH.5.4.motu: Ioel natuna na Semaia; ia natuna na Goḡ ia natuna na Simei;
1CH.5.4.english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

1CH.19.17.motu: Haida ese David e hamaoroa, bena ia ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia; Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, e lao henidia, bona ena orea e haheḡaeḡaea, idia ituari-henidia totona. David ese tuari taudia e haginidia hegaeḡae, Suria taudia vairadiai; bena idia na ia ida e tuan.
1CH.19.17.english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

1CH.2.2.motu: Dan, Iosef, Beniamina, Napatali, Gad, Asere.
1CH.2.2.english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

1CH.6.16.english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH.9.13.motu: bona varavaradia, edia iduhu kwaradia, tatau daha-ta sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui, Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia mai dibadia herea taudia.
1CH.9.13.english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

1CH.12.31.motu: Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na gerebu-ta daha-taurahani, vada e duanaidia, baela David na pavapava ai bae halaoa.
1CH.12.31.english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

1CH.15.29.motu: Iehova ena taravatu mauana na David ena hanua ai e kau negana ai, Mikala, Saulo natuna hahinena, na gaba-mauru amo e igo lasi, bena King David e itaia, e mavaruva bona e galaḡalava; bena lalona amo e ihi-ihiraia.
1CH.15.29.english: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

1CH.29.15.motu: Badina be oi vairamu ai ai na idau taumai bona noho-hedoa taumai, senemai iboudiai heḡereḡeredia; emai dina tanobada ai na laulau na heto, asi emai helaro.
1CH.29.15.english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

1CH.21.4.motu: A hanua pavapavana ena hereva ese Ioab e laoa ahu. Taunabunai, Ioab na e raka lasi, Israel tanona idoinai e rakaia hanai, bena Ierusalem ma e lou lao.
1CH.21.4.english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

1CH.17.25.motu: Badina be oi, egu Dirava, ese emu hesiai tauna vada o hahedinarai henia, ena iduhu ba haginia oto; una dainai emu hesiai tauna ese goada vada e davaria, oi vairamu ai baine ḡuriḡun.
1CH.17.25.english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

1CH.26.26.motu: Hari Selomoto bona tadikakana ese herahia helaḡadia hanua pavapavana David bona iduhu kwaradia bona daha biagudia bona sinahu biagudia bona tuari oreadia biagudia ese e hahelaḡadia gaudia, ihaboudia rumadia iboudiai na e itadia taova.
1CH.26.26.english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

1CH.23.29.motu: bona flaoa helaḡana, bona boubou flaoadia, bona asie hatubua flaoana atagadia, bona boubou dikeadia, bona dehoro ida e buloa boubouna, bona hahetoho ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai, na bae regudia.
1CH.23.29.english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

1CH.28.10.motu: Harihari nahuamu a tohoa, badina be Iehova ese vada e abimu hidi, helaḡa gabuna dubuna ba haginia. Ba goada, vada ba karaia.
1CH.28.10.english: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

1CH.21.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese Gad, David ena mata-hanai tauna, e hereva henia, eto,
1CH.21.9.english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

1CH.5.3.motu: Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, natuna: Hanok, Palu, Hesron, Karami.
1CH.5.3.english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

1CH.7.21.motu: Tahata natuna na Sabada, Sabada natuna na Sutela); bona Esere, bona Eleada. Unu na Gata taudia, una tano ai vada e vara taudia, ese e aladia mase, badina be idia na e diho ela, edia boromakau ihenaodia.
1CH.7.21.english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

1CH.25.17.motu: Ihagwautana na Simei, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.17.english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.6.28.motu: Samuel natuna roboana na loel; iharuana na Abia.
1CH.6.28.english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

1CH.18.10.motu: Bena ia ese natuna Hadorama na King David dekena e siaia lao, baine hahenamo henia bona baine imodaia totona, ia ese Hadadesere vada e tuari henia bona vada e hadarerea dainai; badina be una Hadadesere na nega momo Tou ida e tuari. Ia ese gold bona silver bona bronze amo e karadia ḡaudia idau-idau na e siaidia lao;
1CH.18.10.english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

1CH.18.13.motu: Bena ia ese tuari oreadia na Edom ai e atodia; bona Edom taudia iboudiai na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela. Iehova ese David na kwalimu e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
1CH.18.13.english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

1CH.21.20.motu: Una negana ai Oronana na uit e kwadiva; bena e roha kerehai, aneru e itaia. Bena natuna mamaruanedia hahaniosi ia dekenai na e komu.
1CH.21.20.english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

1CH.7.16.motu: Bena Makiri adavana Maaka ese mero ta e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Perehe; ia tadina ladana na Serese; ia natuna ladadia na UIama bona Rakeme.
1CH.7.16.english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

1CH.11.8.motu: Bena ia ese hanua e hadaia heḡeḡe, Milo kohorona amo e matamaia ela bona e heḡeḡe dae. A Ioab ese hanua orena e haginia lou.
1CH.11.8.english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

1CH.1.23.motu: Ofiri, Havila, Iobab. Ini iboudiai na Iokotan natuna.
1CH.1.23.english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

1CH.23.24.motu: Levi garana bunu, edia iduhu ta ta ai; idia na iduhu kwaradia; laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia e hagaudia heḡereḡerena amo ta ta ladadia e tore, idia ese Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia bae kara totona.
1CH.23.24.english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

1CH.28.15.motu: bona lamepa patadia, gold amo e kara ḡaudia, mai lamepadia ida, metaudia; lamepa patadia ta ta mai lamepadia ida edia gold metaudia, bona lamepa patana ta mai lamepana ida edia silver metaudia, lamepa patadia ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara heḡereḡeredia;
1CH.28.15.english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

1CH.17.10.motu: egu bese Israel ena hahemaoro taudia na duanaidia negana amo; bona inaimu iboudiai baina hadareredia. Ina danu na hamaoromumu, Iehova ese emu iduhu baine haginia.
1CH.17.10.english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.

1CH.23.26.motu: taunabunai Levi taudia na kalaga helaḡana bona ena ḡaukara kohudia na basie hua lou.
1CH.23.26.english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

1CH.12.21.motu: Idia ese David e durua, ala-ala taudia ilao-ahudia; badina be idia iboudiai na goada-herea taudia bona tuari lohiadia.
1CH.12.21.english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

1CH.8.14.motu: bona Ahio bona Sasaka bona Ieremoto.

1CH.25.11.motu: Ihahanina na Isiri, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.11.english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.7.25.motu: Natuna maruanena na Refa; Refa natuna na Resefe; Resefe natuna na Tela; Tela natuna na Tahan;
1CH.7.25.english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

1CH.16.29.motu: hairai ba gwauraia, Iehova ladana ena,
1CH.16.29.english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.

1CH.2.5.english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

1CH.9.24.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia na kaha haniosi ai, laurabada bona lahara, mirigini bona tahodiho, e gimadiava;
1CH.9.24.english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

1CH.25.22.motu: Ihagwautaimana na Ieremoto, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
1CH.25.22.english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

1CH.13.5.motu: Taunabunai David ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Aigupto sinavaina ladana Sihoro amo ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina ai, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na Kiriat-iearimi amo bae mailaia totona.
1CH.13.5.english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

1CH.16.37.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Asaf mai varavarana ida na Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai e rakatanidia, maua helaḡana vairanai toma-diho karadia bae kara loulou, dina ta ta edia kara heḡereḡeredia;
1CH.16.37.english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

1CH.17.22.motu: Bena emu taunimanima Israel na emu bese ai o halaodia, ela bona hanaihanai; bona oi danu, Iehova e, edia Dirava ai o hahelao.
1CH.17.22.english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

1CH.19.14.motu: Taunabunai, Ioab mai bamona ida ela, Suria taudia e tuari henidia, bena idia na ia vairana amo e heau.
1CH.19.14.english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

1CH.24.26.motu: Merari natuna: Mali bona Musi. Iaasia natuna, Beno.
1CH.24.26.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

1CH.26.13.motu: Iduhu ta ta ai, edia ikoukou iduanai-henidia totona, mari e abi, maraḡidia bona badadia heḡereḡere.
1CH.26.13.english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

1CH.29.8.motu: Bona mai edia dava-bada nadidia ese e heni, Iehova ena dubu habou-habou rumadia ai e ato, Iehiele, tau Gereson, imana ai.
1CH.29.8.english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

1CH.29.24.motu: Lohia iboudiai bona goada taudia iboudiai bona King David natuna iboudiai ese edia gwauhamata na King Solomon e henia.
1CH.29.24.english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

1CH.13.7.motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana na rerue matamatana latanai Abinadab ena ruma amo e laohaia; Usa bona Ahio ese rerue e heaulaia.
1CH.13.7.english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

1CH.16.36.english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel,

1CH.14.14.motu: Bena David ese Dirava ma e nanadaia lou negana ai, Dirava ese e hamaoroa, eto, Basio gavadia; ba raka heḡeḡe, baka audia italaidia amo ba mai henidia.
1CH.14.14.english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

1CO.3.13.motu: ḡau tamona, taunimanima ta ta edia ḡaukara bae hedinarai. Badina be Keriso ena dina ese baine hahedinarai; oibe, lahi ese baine hahedinarai. Bena taunimanima ta ta edia ḡaukara be edeheto, lahi ese baine diba.
1CO.3.13.english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

1CO.14.4.motu: Gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na sibona lalona e hapararaiamu, a e perovetamu tauna ese ekalesia taudia lalodia e hapararadiamu.
1CO.14.4.english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

1CO.9.24.motu: Dibamui, ani, heau-helulu ai heau taudia iboudiai e heaumu, a tau tamona ese davana e abiamu. Unu ba heau toma, bena davamui bavabia.
1CO.9.24.english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

1CO.7.24.motu: Taunimanima ta ta e boiridia negadia ai e nohova heḡereḡerena do bae noho, Dirava ida.
1CO.7.24.english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

1CO.7.7.motu: Lau na uramu taunimanima iboudiai ese lau bae haḡoigu; to ta ta mai edia harihari ḡaudia Dirava ena amo, ta be iniheto, ma ta be unuheto.
1CO.7.7.english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

1CO.10.29.motu: dia oi lalomu asina gwauraiamu, to ia lalona.
1CO.10.29.english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

1CO.15.26.motu: Ana inai gini-gabena be mase: ia danu baine ha-orea.
1CO.15.26.english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

1CO.16.21.motu: Lau Paulo egu hahenamo herevana binai, imagu ai name torea.
1CO.16.21.english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

1CO.1.3.motu: harihari-bada bona maino bavabi, ita Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo.
1CO.1.3.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1CO.3.21.motu: Taunabunai, ta ese taunimanima basine heaḡilaidia. Badina be ḡau iboudiai na umui emui:
1CO.3.21.english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

1CO.12.17.motu: Tauanina idoinai bema mata mo, kamonai vada edena? Eiava idoinai bema kamonai mo, bonabona vada edena?
1CO.12.17.english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

1CO.3.2.motu: Rata na ubulaimuiva, dia aniani aukadia, badina be do asio goadava; harihari danu asio goadamu.
1CO.3.2.english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

1CO.3.17.motu: Tau ta ese Dirava ena ruma helaḡana baine hadikaia, Dirava ese ia do baine hadikaia. Badina be Dirava ena ruma na helaḡa; bona una ruma na umui.
1CO.3.17.english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

1CO.1.18.motu: Badina be satauro herevana na kavakava, mase dalana ai e rakamu taudia ediai; a mauri dalana ai ta rakamu tauda edai ia na Dirava ena siahu.
1CO.1.18.english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

1CO.4.7.motu: Be, daika ese oi mo e ha-idaumu? Bona dahaka ḡau oi dekemu ai, a tau ta ese se henimu? A bema ta ese e henimu, dahaka dainai o heaḡilaiamu, ta basinema henimu na heto?
1CO.4.7.english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

1CO.16.7.motu: Badina be asina uramu harihari rakagu ai baina itamui, to Lohiabada baine ura, lau na dekemui ai baina noho taritari na tomamu.
1CO.16.7.english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO.7.33.motu: A headava tauna ese tanobada ḡaudia e lalo haguhilaimu, adavana ede baine hamoalea toma;
1CO.7.33.english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

1CO.10.28.motu: A tau ta ese baine hamaoromui, baineto “Inana na boubou vamuna”, basio ania, ia dainai bona lalo-hekwakwanai garina;
1CO.10.28.english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

1CO.14.5.motu: Lau na uramu umui iboumui ai gado idaudia ai ba hereva, to na ura badamu ba peroveta. E perovetamu tauna ese gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna e hereaiamu, ena gado idaudia anidia ekalesia taudia lalodia ihapararadia totona se haheḡeregere negadia ai.
1CO.14.5.english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

1CO.3.1.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na asina hereva henimuiva lauma iabidadama-henina taudia hegereḡeredia, a tau-anina iabidadama-henina taudia heḡereḡeredia ai na hereva henimuiva, e kara memero karukarudia Iesu Keriso lalonai na heheto.
1CO.3.1.english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

1CO.2.6.motu: Aonega herevadia a gwauraimu, tatau badadia bogaragidiai, ḡau tamona dia ina tanobada aonegana bona dia ina tanobada lohiadia edia aonega; idia na e lao bubunimu.
1CO.2.6.english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

1CO.2.5.motu: emui abidadama na dia taunimanima edia aonega ai basine gini to Dirava ena siahu ai baine gini helaoreana.
1CO.2.5.english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

1CO.4.4.motu: badina be egu kerere ta asina lalo davari. To una dainai maoromaorogu basie gwaurai; ihahemaoro-henigu tauna na Lohiabada.
1CO.4.4.english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

1CO.11.19.motu: Badina be lalo-hadai idau-idau bogaragimui ai bae vara; bena mai edia lalo-hadai namodia taudia emui at bae hedinarai.
1CO.11.19.english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

1CO.11.20.motu: Emui hebou negadia ai, Lohiabada ena anibou asio ania momokanimu.
1CO.11.20.english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

1CO.12.6.motu: Ḡaukara danu idau-idau, a Dirava be tamona; ia ese ḡau idoidiai taunimanima iboudiai lalodiai e karamu.
1CO.12.6.english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

1CO.14.12.motu: Taunabunai, lauma herahiadia o hekise-hekise henimu dainai, ekalesia ilareba-daena daladia ba tahu goadagoada.
1CO.14.12.english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

1CO.4.11.motu: Dina iboudiai ema bona harihari e hitolomaimu, a ranu masemu, asi emai dabua, e tutumaimu, asi emai noho gabuna.
1CO.4.11.english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

1CO.5.3.motu: Benaini, ena be taugu na idau gabu ai to laumagu na dekemui ai; taunabunai, lau ese una kara e karaia tauna vada na hahemaoro henia vaitani, dekemui ai bama noho na heto.
1CO.5.3.english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

1CO.14.36.motu: Be, Dirava ena hereva na umui emui amo ema, eiava umui mo emui ai vada e kau, a?
1CO.14.36.english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

1CO.15.19.motu: Eda helaro Keriso lalonai bema ina mauri mo, taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidiai ita mo madi ihabaida.
1CO.15.19.english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

1CO.12.23.motu: bona imatauraidia mamaraḡi ta tomamu reḡedia na ta matauraidia badamu; bona asi hairaidia reḡedia ta hanamo badamu;
1CO.12.23.english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

1CO.7.38.motu: Taunabunai, maohenina baine adavaia tauna baine kara namo, a basine adavaia tauna baine kara namo herea.
1CO.7.38.english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

1CO.10.24.motu: Ta sibona ena namo basine tahua, a dekena tauna ena namo danu baine tahua.
1CO.10.24.english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

1CO.9.10.motu: eiava ita daidai unu e gwau tomamu, a? Readia ita daidai vada e torea: badina be ruarua tauna na baine ruarua mai helarona ida, bona uit e kwadiamu tauna danu ahuna iabina baine laroa.
1CO.9.10.english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

1CO.11.16.motu: A ta ese ina hereva baine gwaua tubu, egu haere binai: ai na kara idauna ta asi dibamai, bona Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia danu asi dibadia.
1CO.11.16.english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

1CO.7.18.motu: E peritomea tauna vada e boiria a? Ena peritome basine ḡorea. Asie peritomea tauna vada e boiria a? Basie peritomea.
1CO.7.18.english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

1CO.12.1.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu lauma ena herahia ba diba.
1CO.12.1.english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

1CO.14.13.motu: Badina bunai, gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na baine noinoi, gado anidia danu baine haheḡereḡere diba.
1CO.14.13.english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

1CO.1.8.motu: Ia ese baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka ela bona dokona; bena Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena mai dinana ai ta ese basine habadelaimui.
1CO.1.8.english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1CO.12.2.motu: Badina be umui dibamui, dibura ai o nohova negana ai, e hakaumui negadia iboudiai kaivakuku, asie herevamu diravadia, ediai e hakaumui oho.
1CO.12.2.english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

1CO.7.31.motu: bona tanobada ena ḡau namodia e abimu taudia na basie abi badabada, badina be tanobada oromana vada e lao bubunimu.
1CO.7.31.english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

1CO.13.1.motu: Taunimanima gadodia ai bona aneru gadodia ai bama hereva, to asi egu lalokau, lau na auri e botaiamu eiava gaba e touamu na heto.
1CO.13.1.english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.8.4.motu: Taunabunai, kaivakuku ihaboulaidia vamudia herevadia bini: ita dibada kaivakuku iboudiai tanobada ai na asi anidia; Dirava danu tamona mo.
1CO.8.4.english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

1CO.11.4.motu: Tau e ḡuriḡurimu eiava e perovetamu negadia ai kwarana e kumiamu, una na kwarana e hadikaiamu.
1CO.11.4.english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

1CO.9.14.motu: Unuhetomana, Lohiabada na vada e hahedua, sivarai namo e harorolaiamu taudia na sivarai namo amo adia bae abi.
1CO.9.14.english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

1CO.7.5.motu: Boma hedadarai heheni, ḡuriḡuri igoadalaina totona, negana basinema daudau; bena boma eno bou lou, emui haheauka basinema heḡereḡere bena Satana ese bema dibaḡanimui na garina.
1CO.7.5.english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

1CO.8.13.motu: Benaini, vamu ese varavaragu baine hahekwakwanaia, lau ese vamu basina ania ela bona hanaihanai, varavaragu baina hahekwakwanaia na garina.
1CO.8.13.english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

1CO.10.21.motu: Lohiabada ena kehere bona lauma dikadia edia kehere ruaosi basio inu diba; Lohiabada ena pata anianina bona lauma dikadia edia pata anianidia ruaosi hasio ani diba.
1CO.10.21.english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

1CO.11.7.motu: A tau ese kwarana baine mukoa na dia namo, badina be ia na Dirava ihaḡoina tauna bona Dirava hairaina. A hahine be tau hairaina.
1CO.11.7.english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

1CO.11.29.motu: Badina be e ania kavamu bona e inua kavamu, se laloamu una na Lohiabada tau-anina, tauna ese ia sibona ihahemaoro-henina e aniamu bona e inuamu.
1CO.11.29.english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

1CO.6.14.motu: Dirava ese Lohiabada vada e hatorea isi, bona ita danu baine hatoreda isi, ia sibona ena siahu amo.
1CO.6.14.english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

1CO.7.32.motu: Lau na uramu lalomui na basie hekwarahi. Se headava tauna ese Lohiabada ena ḡau e lalo haguhilaimu, Lohiabada ede baine hamoalea toma.
1CO.7.32.english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

1CO.15.45.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ini e torea toma: Tau gini gunana Adam na lauma maurina ai e halaoa. A Adam gini-gabena be hahemauri laumana ai vada e halaoa.
1CO.15.45.english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” + 15:45 Genesis 2:7 The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

1CO.16.2.motu: Pura dinana gini-gunana umui ta ta ese taidia taidia bavato tabe, emui ḡaukara anidia vada e tubu heḡereḡerena; bena baina vasi negana ai boubou ḡaukarana be baine mia.
1CO.16.2.english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

1CO.12.24.motu: a tau-anida reḡedia mai hairaidia na ḡau ta ai asie dabumu. Dirava ese reḡe iboudiai vada eme habou, tau-anina tamona ai baela; e dabu reḡena danu hemataurai bada vada eme henia,
1CO.12.24.english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

1CO.12.28.motu: Dirava ese haida ekalesia lalonai vada e atodia: gini-gunadia be aposetolo; iharuadia be peroveta taudia; ihatoidia be hahediba taudia; idia muridiai hoa karadia ikaradia taudia; ma idia muridiai gorere ihamauridia mai dibadia taudia bona hekaha taudia bona hahekau taudia bona gado idau-idau taudia.
1CO.12.28.english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

1CO.15.5.motu: Kefa enai e hedinarai, bona gwautararuosi ediai danu;
1CO.15.5.english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

1CO.12.7.motu: A Lauma ese taunimanuma vada e hahedinarai henidia hagau-hagau, namo ihavarana totona.
1CO.12.7.english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

1CO.15.8.motu: Ibouboudiai muridiai, e vara dika merona ta na heto, lau ese vada na itaia.
1CO.15.8.english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

1CO.12.20.motu: A reḡe be idau-idau; tau-anina na tamona.
1CO.12.20.english: But now they are many members, but one body.

1CO.12.29.motu: Iboudiai be aposetolo a? Iboudiai na peroveta taudia a? Iboudiai na hahediba taudia a? Iboudiai na hoa karadia e karamu a?
1CO.12.29.english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

1CO.5.1.motu: Sivarai vada e piua, umui bogaragimui ai lebulebu karana ta mia; kara unuhetomana bese idau-idau taudia na asi dibadia. Karana binai: tau ta tamana adavana ida e heuda hanai.
1CO.5.1.english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

1CO.5.5.motu: bena una kara e karaia tauna na Satana ba henia, Iauanina ihamasena totona; bena laumana do baine mauri Lohiabada ena mai dinana ai.
1CO.5.5.english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

1CO.14.33.motu: badina be Dirava na dia heiri-heiri Diravana, a maino Diravana.
1CO.14.33.english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

1CO.14.28.motu: A bema asi gado ihaheḡereḡerena tauna, gado idauna ai e herevamu tauna na ekalesia hebouna ai basine hereva; a ia lalona ai sibona baine hereva, bona Dirava baine hereva henia.
1CO.14.28.english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

1CO.9.15.motu: A lau ese ḡau ta asina abia. Ini hereva asina tore umui ese unu ba karagu toma helaoreana. Bama mase bema namo; tau ta ese egu heaḡi badina bema abia oho bema dika.
