1CO.9.15.english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

1CO.10.7.motu: Kaivakuku danu basio toma henidia diho, idia haida heḡereḡeredia; Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Taunimanima na e ege diho, e aniani, e inuinu; bena e tore isi, e mavaru.
1CO.10.7.english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.” + 10:7 Exodus 32:6

1CO.13.8.motu: Lalokau na se dokomu. Peroveta herevadia hari bae ore; gado idaudia bae doko; aonega danu baine boio.
1CO.13.8.english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

1CO.8.10.motu: Badina be tau ta ese oi lalo-parara taumu baine itamu, kaivakuku ena dubu ai o ege dihomu, ia lalo-manoka tauna baineto ia danu kaivakuku ihaboulaina vamuna baine ania ani?
1CO.8.10.english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

1CO.10.27.motu: Murimuri tauna ese baine boirimui, bena ba ura baola, vada baola, vairamui ai bae dabara ḡaudia iboudiai bavani, basio henanadailai, lalomui bae hekwakwanai na garina.
1CO.10.27.english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

1CO.1.27.motu: A tanobada ena kavakava ḡaudia Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, aonega taudia ihahemaraidia; bona tanobada ena manokamanoka ḡaudia danu Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, goada ḡaudia ihahemaraidia;
1CO.1.27.english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

1CO.15.12.motu: A bema Keriso na mase amo e hatorea isi a harorolaiamu, edeheto umui haida na o tomamu mase taudia na basie tore isi lou?
1CO.15.12.english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

1CO.15.23.motu: A ta ta ena nega ena nega ai mauri bae abia; guna Keriso, tore-isi-lou roboana; murinai, iena lou mai negana ai, Keriso ibadinana taudia.
1CO.15.23.english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

1CO.1.16.motu: Stefana ena ruma taudia danu na bapatisodia; asina diba ḡoeva ta danu na bapatisoa eiava.
1CO.1.16.english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

1CO.8.8.motu: A aniani basine hanamoda Dirava vairanai; basita ania, basita dika; baita ania, basita namo.
1CO.8.8.english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

1CO.11.27.motu: Benaini, tau ta ese ina flaoa atagana baine ania bona ina kehere baine inua kerere, ia ese Lohiabada tau-anina bona rarana baine hadika.
1CO.11.27.english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

1CO.16.13.motu: Ba gima. Abidadama ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka. Ba haheauka. Ba goada.
1CO.16.13.english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

1CO.1.10.motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai na noimuimu, iboumui ai hereva tamona ba gwauraia; heiri-heiri na bogaragimui ai basie vara, a lalo tamona ai bona lalo-hadai danu tamona ai ba hedaro boubou.
1CO.1.10.english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

1CO.10.14.motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau e, kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia na ba heautani.
1CO.10.14.english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

1CO.5.11.motu: A harihari na tore henimuimu, na tomu, ita varavarada ta bema heudahanai tauna, eiava mata-ḡaniḡani tauna, eiava kaivakuku itomadiho-henina tauna, eiava ere dika tauna, eiava kekero muramurana inuna tauna, eiava dadidadi tauna, umui na ia ida basio hetura bona ia ida basio aniani hebou.
1CO.5.11.english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

1CO.6.13.motu: Aniani ḡaudia na boga ena, bona boga na aniani ḡaudia edia; to Dirava ese ruaosi baine ha-ore. Tau-anina na dia lebulebu ena, a Lohiabada ena; Lohiabada danu tau-anina ena.
1CO.6.13.english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

1CO.8.1.motu: Kaivakuku ihaboulaidia vamudia herevadia bini: ita dibada iboudai mai eda lalo-parara; to lalo-parara ese hekokoroku e havaraiamu, a lalokau ese goada e havaraiamu.
1CO.8.1.english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

1CO.14.38.motu: A bema ta basine diba, bena basio abia dae.
1CO.14.38.english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

1CO.11.22.motu: Be! Asi emui ruma a? Unuseni ai boma aniani bona boma inuinu. Dirava ena ekalesia i'ihi-ihiraina bona ogoḡami taudia ihahemaraidia o uramu a? Ede baina hereva henimui toma a? Baina hanamomui a? Lasi vaitani.
1CO.11.22.english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

1CO.1.26.motu: Varavaragu e, Dirava ese e boirimui na ba laloa; dia hoho mai emui aonega, tau-anina aonegana; bona dia hoho mai emui siahu, tanobada siahuna; bona lohia danu dia hoho.
1CO.1.26.english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

1CO.7.16.motu: Hahine e, ede o diba tomamu adavamu ba hamauria eiava? Tau e, ede o diba tomamu adavamu ba hamauria eiava?
1CO.7.16.english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

1CO.16.9.motu: badina be iduara badana vada eme hekeho, egu ḡaukara baine ḡoeva, to inaida na hutuma.
1CO.16.9.english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

1CO.1.25.motu: Badina be Dirava ena kavakava ese taunimanima edia aonega e hereaiamu; bona Dirava ena manoka-manoka ese taunimanuma edia goada e hereaiamu.
1CO.1.25.english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

1CO.1.6.motu: Keriso idibana umui lalomui ai vada e hamomokania heḡereḡerena.
1CO.1.6.english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

1CO.4.3.motu: Lauegu lalo-hadai binai: umui ese ba hahemaoro henigu, eiava taunimanima haida ese, una na ḡau pipikina mo. Lau danu sibogu asina hahemaoro heni,
1CO.4.3.english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

1CO.12.21.motu: Benaini, mata ese ima-palapala na basine hereva henia, basineto “Asi emu ḡaukara egu ai”, kwara danu aepalapaladia basine hereva henidia, basineto “Asi emui ḡaukara egu ai”,
1CO.12.21.english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

1CO.12.25.motu: tau-anina ai reḡe iboudiai bae hedaro boubou bona bae henari heheni helaoreana.
1CO.12.25.english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

1CO.15.31.motu: Varavaragu e, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada lalonai na heaḡilaimuimu dainai, na hamaoromui momokanimu, lau na daba daba iboudiai na masemu.
1CO.15.31.english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

1CO.14.11.motu: To, gado anina basinama diba, e herevamu tauna vairanai lau na idau taugu na heto, ia danu lau vairagu ai idau tauna na heto.
1CO.14.11.english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

1CO.1.17.motu: Badina be Keriso ese e siaigu dia taunimanima ibapatisodia totona, a sivarai namo iharorolaina; bona dia aonega herevadia amo basina haroro, Keriso ena satauro na asi siahuna baine mia na garina.
1CO.1.17.english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

1CO.14.35.motu: Bae ura ḡau ta bae diba, ruma ai adavadia bae nanadaidia; badina be hahine na hebou lalonai baine hereva na mai hemaraina.
1CO.14.35.english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

1CO.7.4.motu: Hahine ese sibona tau-anina se biaguamu, a tau ese e biaguamu; tau danu sibona tau-anina se biaguamu, a hahine ese e biaguamu.
1CO.7.4.english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

1CO.6.20.motu: badina be vada e hoimui, mai davamui. Taunabunai, tau-animui ai Dirava ba imodaia.
1CO.6.20.english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

1CO.7.34.motu: taunabunai lalona be rua. Se headava hahinena eiava hane-ulato na Lohiabada ena ḡau e lalo haguhilaimu; bena tau-anina ai bona laumana ai baine helaḡa. A headava hahinena ese tanobada ḡaudia e lalo haguhilaimu, adavana ede baine hamoalea toma.
1CO.7.34.english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

1CO.12.19.motu: Iboudiai bema reḡe tamona, tau-anina be vada edena?
1CO.12.19.english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

1CO.11.24.motu: e hanamoa, bena e bitua, eto “Lau taugu binai, umui daimui ai baine makohi; ini ba kara toma, lau ba lalogu”.
1CO.11.24.english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “\+w Take|strong="G2532"\+w*, eat. \+w This|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1699"\+w* \+w body|strong="G4983"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w broken|strong="G2806"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w*. \+w Do|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1519"\+w* memory \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*.”

1CO.9.26.motu: Unu na heau tomamu; asina daradaramu. Unu na tuari tomamu; dia hodahoda asina tutuamu,
1CO.9.26.english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

1CO.11.3.motu: To na uramu ba diba, tatau iboudiai kwaradia na Keriso; hahine kwarana na tau; Keriso kwarana be Dirava.
1CO.11.3.english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

1CO.7.2.motu: to lebulebu garina tatau ese adavadia ta ta bae abidia, hahine ese danu adavadia korikori mo bae abidia.
1CO.7.2.english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

1CO.14.14.motu: Badina be gado idaudia ai baina ḡuriḡuri be laumagu mo e ḡuriḡurimu to lalogu na se pararamu.
1CO.14.14.english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

1CO.12.13.motu: Badina be ita iboudai Lauma tamona lalonai e bapatisoda, tau-anina tamona ai e halaoda, Iuda tauda eiava Helene tauda, hesiai tauda eiava urakwalimu tauda; ita iboudai danu Lauma tamona e ha-inulaida.
1CO.12.13.english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

1CO.15.40.motu: Guba tau-anidia bona tanobada tau-anidia danu mimia; a guba ḡaudia hairaidia be ta, tanobada ḡaudia hairaidia be ma idau.
1CO.15.40.english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

1CO.2.10.motu: A Dirava ese ia Laumana ena amo ini ḡau vada e hahedinarai henida; badina be Lauma ese ḡau iboudiai e tahumu; oibe, Dirava ena dobu ḡaudia e tahumu.
1CO.2.10.english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

1CO.7.26.motu: Lau na tomamu hari ini nega dikadia daidiai, taunimanima na harihari e nohomu heḡereḡeredia ai mo do bae noho, una be namo.
1CO.7.26.english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

1CO.7.10.motu: A headava hahinedia na haganidiamu, hahine ese tau basine dihotania. Ina na dia lauegu haheḡani, to Lohiabada ena.
1CO.7.10.english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

1CO.13.6.motu: kara gageva-gageva se moalelaimu, a hereva momokani e moalelaimu;
1CO.13.6.english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

1CO.3.3.motu: Badina be umui na doene tauanina o abidadama heniamu; vaḡeḡe bona heai umui bogaragimui ai doene e miamu. Benaini, umui na tau-anina iabidadama-henina taumui ani? Umui na taunimanima heḡereḡeredia o rakamu ani?
1CO.3.3.english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

1CO.14.31.motu: Iboumui ai ba peroveta diba, to ta ta ba peroveta hedava, bena hebou taudia iboudiai na aonega bona hahegoada bae davari.
1CO.14.31.english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

1CO.7.37.motu: A ta ese sibona lalona bema hadaia basine headava e tomamu, bona lalona bema ha-aukaia bona bema hadaia momokani ede baine kara toma, bena basine headava be namo.
1CO.7.37.english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

1CO.14.19.motu: A ekalesia hebouna ai hereva ima baina gwaurai mai daragu ida, haida baina hadibalaidia, una be namo; a hereva gerebu gado idaudia ai baina gwaurai, una be dika.
1CO.14.19.english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

1CO.7.35.motu: Unu na gwau tomamu na emui namo ihavarana, dia idoa vairamui ai asina atoamu; a na uramu hemataurai karadia ba kara, bona Lohiabada isiaina ba lao heni, asi daradaramui.
1CO.7.35.english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

1CO.16.20.motu: Varavara iboudiai ese e hanamomuimu. Ba hahenamo heheni, mai haherahu helaḡana ida.
1CO.16.20.english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

1CO.6.18.motu: Heuda-hanai ba heautania. Kara dika iboudiai taunimanima ese e karamu na tau-anina murimurinai; to e heuda hanaimu tauna ese sibona tau-anina e kara dika heniamu.
1CO.6.18.english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

1CO.15.53.motu: Badina be ina baine pata ḡauna ese basine pata ḡauna haine hadokilaia, bona ina baine mase ḡauna ese basine mase ḡauna baine hadokilaia.
1CO.15.53.english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

1CO.3.23.motu: umui danu Keriso ena; Keriso danu Dirava ena.
1CO.3.23.english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

1CO.12.15.motu: Ae-palapala bema toma “Lau na dia ima-palapala dainai lau na dia tau-anina ena”; una dainai ia na dia tau-anina ena a?
1CO.12.15.english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

1CO.2.7.motu: A ai ese Dirava ena aonega hehunina a gwauraiamu; aonega hehunina bunai Dirava ese e lalo-hadailaia guna, tanobada do se karaia negana ai, ita ihanamoda.
1CO.2.7.english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

1CO.9.18.motu: Benaini, ahugu be dahaka? Ahugu binai: sivarai namo iharorolaina ai hari sivarai namo baina heni asi davana; egu siahu sivarai namo lalonai basina ḡaukaralaia kava.
1CO.9.18.english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

1CO.13.5.motu: se kara havaramu; sibona ena ḡau se tahun u; se badll haraḡamu; ihadikal; lina karadia se lalo taomu;
1CO.13.5.english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

1CO.16.11.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ese basine dadaraia; a maino ai ba durua, dekegu bainema. Badina be ia, mai varavarada haida ida, na naridiamu.
1CO.16.11.english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

1CO.4.8.motu: Umui na ina harihari vada o boga kunumu; umui na ina harihari taḡa taumui; umui na lohia o tomamu, a ai be lasi. Boma lohia momokani bema namo, bena ai be umui ida baitama lohia hebou.
1CO.4.8.english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

1CO.15.47.motu: Tau gini-gunana na tano amo ema, ḡahu ai e karaia; tau iharuana na guba amo ema.
1CO.15.47.english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

1CO.14.7.motu: Heḡereḡerena binai: ḡau haida be dia mamauri to mai reḡedia; ivilikou bona gitara reḡedia basiema idau-idau, dahaka e hiririmu bona dahaka e hataimu ede baitama diba toma?
1CO.14.7.english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

1CO.8.2.motu: Tau ta lalona baineto mai ena aonega, ia na aonega korikori do asi dibana;
1CO.8.2.english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

1CO.11.30.motu: Badina bunai hutuma umui bogaragimui ai e manoka-manokamu bona e gorerediamu, haida danu e masemu.
1CO.11.30.english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

1CO.7.30.motu: bona taitai taudia na bae noho asie taimu na heto; bona moale taudia na bae noho asie moalemu na heto; bona hoihoi taudia na bae noho asi edia kohu na heto;
1CO.7.30.english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

1CO.11.14.motu: Lalomui asie pararamu a, tau huina baine lata na hemarai ḡauna ienai,
1CO.11.14.english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

1CO.14.9.motu: Unuhetomana umui danu, emui hereva anidia basie hedinarai, daika ese mamidia baine abi? E kara hodahoda ba hereva henia na heto.
1CO.14.9.english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

1CO.9.12.motu: Haida ese bema biagumui, ai ese basiama biagumui badabada a? To asia biagumui. Ḡau idoidiai a haheaukalai, Keriso ena sivarai namo baia laoa ahu na garina.
1CO.9.12.english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more?

1CO.16.17.motu: Lau na moalemu badina be Stefana bona Forotunato bonaAkaiko vada e gini dae dainai; badina be umui na dia iniseni ai, to idia daidiai egu ai e heḡereḡere.
1CO.16.17.english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

1CO.15.49.motu: Tano amo ema tauna oromana vada ta abia na heto, guba amo ema tauna oromana do baita abia.
1CO.15.49.english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

1CO.14.16.motu: Bema lasi, lauma ai mo Dirava ba hanamoa negana ai, lalona se pararamu tauna ese “amen” ede baine gwauraia toma? Badina be emu hereva anina na asi dibana.
1CO.14.16.english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

1CO.15.42.motu: Mase taudia edia tore-isi-lou na unuheto. Mase ai e hadoamu; mauri hanaihanai ai e hatorea isimu.
1CO.15.42.english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

1CO.2.16.motu: Badina be daika ese Lohiabada darana dibana, bena baine hadibaia? Ḡau tamona, ita ese Keriso darana vada ta abia.
1CO.2.16.english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” + 2:16 Isaiah 40:13 But we have Christ’s mind.

1CO.3.22.motu: Paulo eiava Apolo eiava Kefa eiava tanobada eiava mauri eiava mase eiava harihari e miamu ḡaudia eiava do bae vara ḡaudia. Ibouboudiai na umui emui;
1CO.3.22.english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

1CO.11.23.motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena amo na abia bena umui na hamaorolaimui dalana binai: taona e torea hanuaboina ai, Lohiabada Iesu ese naoa atagana ta e abia;
1CO.11.23.english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

1CO.1.4.motu: Nega idoinai Dirava na hanamoamu umui daimui ai, badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada na Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e henimui.
1CO.1.4.english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

1CO.10.18.motu: Israel ena kara ba itaia: boubou vamudia e animu taudia na boubou patana ai asie heturamu a?
1CO.10.18.english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

1CO.6.1.motu: Edeheto umui ta ese bamona baine habadelaia e tomu, bena kara kerere taudia vairadiai e hahemaoro heniamu, dia helaḡa taudia vairadiai se hahemaoro heniamu?
1CO.6.1.english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

1CO.14.15.motu: Matona: laumagu ai baina ḡuriḡuri, ma lalogu ai danu baina ḡuriḡuri; laumagu ai ane baina abi, ma lalogu ai danu ane baina abi; una be namo.
1CO.14.15.english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

1CO.13.13.motu: Taunabunai, ini ḡau toiosi mo mimia: abidadama, bona helaro, bona lalokau. A herea-daena be lalokau mo.
1CO.13.13.english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

1CO.4.15.motu: Ena be ihadibamui taudia Keriso ai bema gerebu ta, to tamamui basiema hoho; badina be Keriso Iesu bagunai lau ese sivarai namo ai na havaramui.
1CO.4.15.english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

1CO.1.20.motu: Aonega tauna be edeseni ai? Itorena tauna be edeseni ai? Ina tanobada ai hereva e hedavelaimu tauna be edeseni ai? Dirava ese tanobada ena aonega na kavakava ḡauna ai vada e halaoa, ani?
1CO.1.20.english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

1CO.2.13.motu: Una na a gwauraimu, dia taunimanima edia aonega herevadia amo, a Lauma ese e hadibalaimu herevadia amo; taunabunai, lauma ḡaudia na Lauma ese e hahedibalaimu.
1CO.2.13.english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

1CO.12.10.motu: ma ta hoa karadia ikaralaidia siahuna e heniamu, ma ta peroveta siahuna e heniamu, ma ta lauma idibadia e heniamu, ma ta gado idaudia e heniamu, ma ta gado anidia ihahedinaraidia e heniamu.
1CO.12.10.english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

1CO.10.4.motu: bona iboudiai lauma ranuna tamona e inuava; badina be e ḡavadia nadina ranuna tamona e inua loulouva, nadina be Keriso.
1CO.10.4.english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

1CO.12.12.motu: Badina be tau-anina be tamona, to reḡena na momo; bona rege, ena be momo, to iboudiai tau-anina tamona reḡena. Keriso danu unuheto.
1CO.12.12.english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

1CO.8.7.motu: Ḡau tamona, taunimanima iboudiai lalodia unu asie parara tomamu. Haida be kaivakuku karadia vada e manadalai ema bona harihari; una dainai lalodia ai e abia daemu e aniamu vamuna na helaḡa ḡauna, bena lalodia e manoka-manokamu dainai e hekwakwanaimu.
1CO.8.7.english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

1CO.10.33.motu: lau heḡereḡeregu, taunimanima iboudiai ḡau idoidiai na hamoalelaidia tohomu, sibogu egu namo asina tahuamu, a taunimanima loḡora edia namo na tahuamu, ihamauridia helaoreana.
1CO.10.33.english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

1CO.16.10.motu: Timoteo baine vasi negana ai, nahuamui ba toho, bavabia dae, dekemui ai baine noho; badina be ia ese Lohiabada ena ḡaukara e karaiamu, lau hegereḡeregu.
1CO.16.10.english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

1CO.7.20.motu: Ta ta e boiridia negadia ai e nohova heḡereḡerena ai do bae noho.
1CO.7.20.english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

1CO.1.29.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta Dirava vairanai basine heaḡi.
1CO.1.29.english: that no flesh should boast before God.

1CO.7.40.motu: A lau na tomamu vadona ai baine noho, ena lalo-namo baine herea; lau na tomamu danu Dirava Laumana na lalogu ai.
1CO.7.40.english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

1CO.14.27.motu: Gado idaudia ai bae hereva, rarua eiava tatoi mo bae hereva hedava, bena ta ese anidia baine haheḡereḡere.
1CO.14.27.english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

1CO.1.28.motu: bona tanobada ena ḡau pipikidia bona ena hedadarai ḡaudia bona lasihidia ḡaudia danu Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, ia ese miadia ḡaudia baine ha-oredia totona.
1CO.1.28.english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

1CO.13.10.motu: a ḡoeva-daena bainema negana ai, sidia taidia ta diba ḡaudia na bae bubuni.
1CO.13.10.english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

1CO.1.31.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Heaḡi tauna ese Lohiabada baine heaḡilaia.
1CO.1.31.english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” + 1:31 Jeremiah 9:24

1CO.5.12.motu: Badina be murimuri tauna baina hahemaoro henia na dia lauegu ḡaukara; a umui emui ḡaukara be ekalesia lalonai e nohomu taudia na ba hahemaoro henidia, ani?
1CO.5.12.english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

1CO.9.8.motu: Lau na herevamu kavakava tauna na heto a? Taravatu unu se gwau tomamu a?
1CO.9.8.english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

1CO.1.11.motu: Badina be, varavaragu e, Kloe varavarana ese sivaraimui vada e hamaorolaigu, e tomu umui na o noho heai-heaimu.
1CO.1.11.english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

1CO.14.1.motu: A Lalokau na ba ḡavaia goadagoada, lauma herahiadia danu ba tahu, ba peroveta helaoreana.
1CO.14.1.english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

1CO.7.39.motu: Hahine ese adavana baine badinaia ela bona ena mauri dokona. A tau na baine mase, hahine na baine heruha nege, baine ura henia tauna na baine adavaia; to Lohiabada lalonai mo baine adavaia.
1CO.7.39.english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

1CO.15.54.motu: Taunabunai, baine pata ḡauna na basine pata ḡauna baine hadokilaia bona baine mase ḡauna na basine mase ḡauna baine hadokilaia negana ai, e torea herevana baine momokani, eto, Kwalimu ese mase vada e hadonoa.
1CO.15.54.english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” + 15:54 Isaiah 25:8

1CO.15.48.motu: Tanobada taudia be tano amo ema tauna heḡereḡerena; guba taudia be guba amo ema tauna heḡereḡerena.
1CO.15.48.english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

1CO.1.24.motu: to e boiridia taudia, Iuda bona Helene danu, ediai Dirava ena siahu bona ena aonega.
1CO.1.24.english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

1CO.1.5.motu: Taunabunai, ḡau iboudiai ia lalonai vada e hataḡalaimui, hereva ai bona lalo-parara ai danu,
1CO.1.5.english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

1CO.15.1.motu: Varavaragu e, sivarai namo na harorolai henimuiva, o abi daeva, bona lalonai o gini tutuka-tutukamu, ma na hadibalaimuimu.
1CO.15.1.english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

1CO.9.13.motu: Asi dibamui a, hahelaḡa ḡaukaradia e karamu taudia ese Dubu Helaḡa ḡaudia e animu; bona boubou patana e nariamu taudia ese boubou patana amo ahudia e abimu?
1CO.9.13.english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

1CO.6.15.motu: Asi dibamui a, tau-animui na Keriso reḡena? Bena Keriso reḡena baina abi, ariara hahinena reḡena ai baina halao a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
1CO.6.15.english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

1CO.12.14.motu: Badina be tau-anina na dia reḡe tamona, a reḡe diaḡau.
1CO.12.14.english: For the body is not one member, but many.

1CO.9.9.motu: Badina be Mose ena taravatu ai vada e torea, eto, Uit e moimoilaiamu boromakauna na uduna basio ḡuia. O, Dirava ese boromakau e lalodiamu,
1CO.9.9.english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” + 9:9 Deuteronomy 25:4 Is it for the oxen that God cares,

1CO.13.4.motu: Lalokau na e haheauka taritarimu; lalokau na mai ena heabi-dae; asi ena hebore; se heaḡimu; se hekokorokumu;
1CO.13.4.english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

1CO.15.4.motu: vada e ḡuria danu; dina ihatoina ai e hatorea isi, Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena;
1CO.15.4.english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

1CO.15.34.motu: Kara namo enai ba noga; basio kara dika; badina be haida na Dirava asi dibadia. Unu na gwau tomamu, umui ihahemaraimui totona.
1CO.15.34.english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

1CO.9.25.motu: Gadara-helulu taudia na e boga aukamu, kwara iḡeḡena e maraimu ḡauna iabina totona. Ita danu ta boga aukamu, kwara iḡeḡena baine mia hanaihanai ḡauna iabina.
1CO.9.25.english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

1CO.7.13.motu: Bona hahine ta danu bema mai adavana, dia ekalesia tauna, bona una tau bema ura ia ida do bema noho; basinema dihotania.
1CO.7.13.english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

1CO.16.19.motu: Ekalesia oreadia Asia ai ese e hanamomuimu. Akula bona Priskila, ekalesia oreana edia ruma ai e heboumu taudia ida, ese e hanamomui badabadamu Lohiabada ladana ai.
1CO.16.19.english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

1CO.14.22.motu: Taunabunai, gado idaudia na toa, dia kamonai taudia edia, to asi edia kamonai taudia edia. A peroveta herevadia na dia asi edia kamonai taudia edia, to kamonai taudia edia.
1CO.14.22.english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

1CO.10.3.motu: Iboudiai danu lauma anianina tamona e aniava,
1CO.10.3.english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

1CO.10.22.motu: Lohiabada ena vaḡege baita havaraia, a? Be, eda goada ese iena e hereaiamu a?
1CO.10.22.english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

1CO.10.26.motu: Badina be tanobada mai anidia iboudiai ida Lohiabada ena.
1CO.10.26.english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.” + 10:26 Psalms 24:1

1CO.3.6.motu: Lau ese na hadoa; Apolo ese e dairia; a Dirava ese anina e havaraia.
1CO.3.6.english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

1CO.11.32.motu: Ḡau tamona Lohiabada ese e hahemaoro henidamu, matada ihakanidia, ita bona tanobada baita dika bou na garina.
1CO.11.32.english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

1CO.11.31.motu: A ita siboda laloda baitama tahu, hahemaoro na edai basinema kau.
1CO.11.31.english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

1CO.16.8.motu: A Efeso ai baina noho ela bona Pentekoste negana;
1CO.16.8.english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO.10.19.motu: Bena dahaka bainato? Kaivakuku ihaboulaina ḡauna na mai anina a? Bona kaivakuku danu mai anina a?
1CO.10.19.english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

1CO.16.23.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada emui ai baine mia.
1CO.16.23.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

1CO.4.5.motu: Taunabunai, ḡau ta basio hahemaoro henia, negana be dounu; ela bona Lohiabada bainema. Ia ese dibura ai e hehunimu ḡaudia na diari ai baine veri lasi; taunimanima edia lalo-hadai danu baine hahedinarai. Bena taunimanima ta ta Dirava ese baine hanamodia.
1CO.4.5.english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

1CO.15.27.motu: Badina be ia ese ḡau iboudiai aena henudiai vada e ato. A hereva e tomu “ḡau iboudiai ia henunai vada e ato”, dibada anina be dia ḡau iboudiai, badina be ia henunai vada e atodia Diravana na unu se heato toma.
1CO.15.27.english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” + 15:27 Psalms 8:6 But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

1CO.15.52.motu: asi kaimana, mata-hekunumai tamona ai, kibi gabena bae hiriria negana ai. Badina be kibi do bae hiriria, bena mase taudia baine hatoredia isi, basie mase lou; bona ita na do baine ha-idauda.
1CO.15.52.english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

1CO.2.2.motu: Badina be lalogu na hadaia, umui dekemui ai ḡau ta basina diba, Iesu Keriso mai ena satauro ida mo vadaeni.
1CO.2.2.english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

1CO.15.41.motu: Dina hairaina be ta, hua hairaina be ma ta, hisiu hairaidia danu idau; bona hisiu ta ta hairaidia be idau-idau.
1CO.15.41.english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

1CO.3.8.motu: Ihadona tauna bona idairina tauna be heḡereḡere; to ta ta davadia bae abi, edia hekwarahi heḡereḡeredia.
1CO.3.8.english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

1CO.4.6.motu: Varavaragu e, umui daimui ai ini ḡau vada na gwaurai, lau bona Apolo latamai ai; bena ai emai amo vada ba diba, Buka Helaḡa ai e tore herevadia ba badinadia, ta bavabia dae una ta ba dadaraia na garina.
1CO.4.6.english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

1CO.16.16.motu: Taunabunai, unuhetomadia, bona ai ida a ḡaukara heboumu bona a hekwarahi heboumu taudia iboudiai, ba kamonai henidia.
1CO.16.16.english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

1CO.3.15.motu: A tau ta ese e hadaia ḡauna na lahi ese baine araia, una tau do baine dabu; to ia na lahi lalona amo do baine roho mauri.
1CO.3.15.english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

1CO.4.2.motu: Matona, ireḡudia taudia namodia be kara momokani taudia.
1CO.4.2.english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

1CO.4.10.motu: Ai na kakavakava Keriso dainai, a umui na Keriso lalonai o aonegamu. Ai na mamanoka-mamanoka, a umui na gogoada. Umui na e heatolaimuimu, a ai na e ihi-ihiraimaimu.
1CO.4.10.english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

1CO.5.13.motu: Dirava ese murimuri taudia e hahemaoro henidiamu. Umui hari kara dika tauna murimuri ai bavatoa lasi.
1CO.5.13.english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.” + 5:13 Deuteronomy 17:7; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21; 24:7

1CO.9.21.motu: Ena be lau ese Dirava ena taravatu asina tataia utu a Keriso ena taravatu na badinaia, to, asi taravatudia taudia ediai asi taravatuna tauna ai nala, asi taravatudia taudia baina veridia mauri totona.
1CO.9.21.english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

1CO.4.20.motu: Badina be Dirava ena basileia na dia hereva ai, to siahuna ai e miamu.
1CO.4.20.english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

1CO.15.2.motu: Unu amo danu mauri vada o abia; ḡau tamona sivarai namo na harorolai henimuiva boma laloa tao, basioma abia dae kava.
1CO.15.2.english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

1CO.15.7.motu: Muridiai Iakobo enai e hedinarai; bona aposetolo iboudiai ediai danu.
1CO.15.7.english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

1CO.8.5.motu: Ena be “dirava” e gwauraidiamu ḡaudia na guba ai bona tanobada ai nonoho, dirava hutuma bona lohia hutuma,
1CO.8.5.english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

1CO.1.14.motu: Lau ese Dirava na hanamoamu, badina be umui ta asina bapatisoa, Krispo bona Gaio mo;
1CO.1.14.english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

1CO.12.8.motu: Badina be Lauma tamona ena amo, ta aonega igwauraina e heniamu, ma ta lalo-parara igwauraina e heniamu,
1CO.12.8.english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

1CO.7.9.motu: To basiema haheauka, bema headava; badina be bae headava na namo, mata-dika ena lahi ai bae ara na dika.
1CO.7.9.english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

1CO.7.27.motu: Mai adavamu a? Basio hadihoa. Asi adavamu a? Ta basio tahua.
1CO.7.27.english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

1CO.16.5.motu: Makedonia baina rakaia hanai, bena baina vasi. Badina be egu lalohadai be Makedonia do baina rakaia hanai guna,
1CO.16.5.english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

1CO.10.20.motu: Lasi. Bese idau-idau ese e hahelaḡa ḡaudia na e aladiamu lauma dikadia ihaboulaidia, dia Dirava ena ihaboulaina. Asina uramu lauma dikadia ida ba hetura.
1CO.10.20.english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

1CO.4.21.motu: Dahaka o uramu? Kwadi-kwadi auna baina vasilaia, eiava lalokau bona manilu ai baina vasi.
1CO.4.21.english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

1CO.10.11.motu: Unu ḡau be idia ediai e vara, toa ai baela totona; sivaraidia danu vada e tore henida, ina tanobada dokona tauda isisibalai-henida.
1CO.10.11.english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

1CO.16.24.motu: Egu lalokau be umui iboumui ai emui ai, Keriso Iesu lalonai. Amen.
1CO.16.24.english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

1CO.14.30.motu: A helai tauna ta lalona ai hereva hehunina ta baine hedinarai e herevamu tauna na ena hereva baine hadokoa.
1CO.14.30.english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

1CO.15.15.motu: Oibe, ai danu Dirava idiba-koikoina taumai bema gwauraimai, badina be Dirava ese Keriso e hatorea isi sivaraina a harorolaia; a ḡau be mase taudia basinema hatoredia isi negana ai Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi.
1CO.15.15.english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

1CO.13.12.motu: Badina be harihari hevarivari ai ta ita valahu-valahumu, a una negana ai baita ita heida-ida. Harihari sisina mo dibagu, a una negana ai do baina diba ḡoevaḡoeva, vada e dibagumu heḡereḡerena.
1CO.13.12.english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

1CO.1.21.motu: Badina be Dirava ena aonega binai: tanobada na aonega amo Dirava se dibava negana ai iena ura vada e hedinarai, haroro kavakavana amo e abidadama heniamu taudia na do bae mauri.
1CO.1.21.english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

1CO.10.13.motu: Vada e butumui laomu hedibaganidia na taunimanima iboudiai ese e haheaukalai hedibaḡanidia heḡereḡeredia. Bona Dirava na momokani; ia ese baine narimui, emui goada e hereaiamu hedibaḡanina ta ese baine butumui tao na garina; hedihaḡani negana ai ia ese emui roho mauri dalana baine henimui, bena ba haheaukalaqia diba.
1CO.10.13.english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

1CO.2.9.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡerḡerena, eto,

1CO.9.22.motu: Lalo-manoka taudia ediai lalo-manoka tauna ai nala, lalo-manoka taudia baina veridia mauri totona. Taunimanima idau-idau iboudiai edia ḡau idau-idau iboudiai nala, dala idau-idau iboudiai amo haida baina veridia mauri totona.
1CO.9.22.english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

1CO.7.1.motu: Vada o tore henigu herevadia davadia bini. Tatau basiema headava bema namo;
1CO.7.1.english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

1CO.7.25.motu: Uhau bona ulato ediai lau na asi egu haheḡani Lohiabada ena amo; to lau sibogu, Lohiabada ese vada e bogagu hisi dainai bavabidadama henigu diba taugu, egu lalohadai aina henimui.
1CO.7.25.english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

1CO.1.15.motu: ta bema toma lau na sibogu ladagu ai na bapatisomui na garina.
1CO.1.15.english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

1CO.2.1.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na vasi bona Dirava ihahedinaraina herevadia na harorolai henimuiva negana ai, hereva namo-hereadia eiava aonega hereana asina vasilai.
1CO.2.1.english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

1CO.11.21.motu: Badina be tau ana tau ana o animu, una dainai haida e hitolomu, ma haida e kekeromu.
1CO.11.21.english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

1CO.15.16.motu: Momokani; mase taudia basinema hatoredia isi, Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi.
1CO.15.16.english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

1CO.10.12.motu: Taunabunai, lalona e tomamu e gini tutuka-tutukamu tauna ese nahuana baine tohoa, baine keto na garina.
1CO.10.12.english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

1CO.11.5.motu: A hahine e guriḡurimu eiava e perovetamu negadia ai kwarana se kumiamu, ia danu kwarana e hadikaiamu; ia na kwarana e nauamu hahinena heḡereḡerena.
1CO.11.5.english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

1CO.16.4.motu: A boma ura, lau danu idia ida bama lao.
1CO.16.4.english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

1CO.16.18.motu: Badina be idia ese lau lalogu vada e hamauria, bona umui lalomui danu. Unu e kara tomamu taudia na bavabidia dae.
1CO.16.18.english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

1CO.15.38.motu: A Dirava ese anina e heniamu, ena ura heḡereḡerena uhe ta ta anidia korikori e henidiamu.
1CO.15.38.english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

1CO.13.7.motu: ḡaukara iboudiai e goadalaimu; ḡau iboudiai e abi daemu; iboudiai e laromu, dika iboudiai e haheauka henimu.
1CO.13.7.english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

1CO.14.32.motu: Peroveta laumadia ese peroveta taudia e kamonai henidiamu;
1CO.14.32.english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

1CO.15.14.motu: bona Keriso basinema hatorea isi, emai haroro bema asi anina, umui emui abidadama danu bema asi anina.
1CO.15.14.english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

1CO.14.40.motu: Ḡau idoidiai ba kara namonamo, ba kara ḡoevaḡoeva.
1CO.14.40.english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

1CO.14.37.motu: Tau ta lalona baineto ia na peroveta tauna, eiava Lauma ese vada e roheamu, ia ese na tore henimuimu herevadia baine abi dae, baine diba Dirava ena haheḡani bini.
1CO.14.37.english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

1CO.13.9.motu: Badina be sisidia mo dibada, taidia taidia mo ta perovetamu;
1CO.13.9.english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

1CO.6.2.motu: Asi dibamui a, helaḡa taudia ese tanobada bae hahemaoro henia? Matona, asio heḡereḡere ḡau pipikidia ba hahemaorolai.
1CO.6.2.english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

1CO.14.29.motu: Peroveta taudia danu rarua eiava tatoi bae hereva, bena bamodia ese edia hereva bae haero.
1CO.14.29.english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

1CO.14.10.motu: Readia gado idau-ldau be diaḡau tanobada ai, a iboudiai be mai anidia.
1CO.14.10.english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

1CO.2.8.motu: Aonegana bunai ina tanobada lohiadia ta asi dibana; badina be idia bema diba, Hairai Lohiana basiema hasatauroa.
1CO.2.8.english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

1CO.15.10.motu: To Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai lau ini name heto; bona e henigu hariharina danu se henigu kava, badina be ḡaukara lalonai idia iboudiai vada na hereadia; a dia lau mo, to Dirava ena harihari-bada lau ida.
1CO.15.10.english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

1CO.6.17.motu: A Lohiabada ida e heboumu tauna na ia ida lauma tamona.
1CO.6.17.english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

1CO.3.11.motu: badina be ruma badina idauna na tau ta ese basine atoa diba, vada e atoa kau ḡauna mo, Iesu Keriso bunai.
1CO.3.11.english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

1CO.7.15.motu: A murimuri tauna eiava hahinena baine raka oho, basio rua; bena una headava ese tadikakada eiava taihuda basine ḡuia. Dirava ese vada e boirimui, maino ai ba noho.
1CO.7.15.english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

1CO.10.32.motu: Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia, bona Dirava ena ekalesia taudia danu, basio hahekwakwanaidia;
1CO.10.32.english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

1CO.14.18.motu: Dirava na hanamoamu, lau na umui iboumui ai name hereamui, gado idaudia igwauraidia ai.
1CO.14.18.english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

1CO.15.43.motu: Hemarai ai e hadoamu; hairai ai e hatorea isimu. Manoka-manoka ai e hadoamu; goada ai e hatorea isimu.
1CO.15.43.english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

1CO.16.12.motu: A varavarada Apolo vada na noia goadagoada, varavarada haida ida bae vasi nato; to ia na se ura, harihari basine vasi e tomu, a nega namona baine davaria bena baine vasi.
1CO.16.12.english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

1CO.11.8.motu: Badina be tau na hahine ena amo se vara, a hahine hari, tau ena amo e vara;
1CO.11.8.english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

1CO.15.9.motu: Badina be aposetolo iboudiai ese lau e hereagumu; lau na dia namo aposetolo bae gwauraigu, badina be Dirava ena ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava.
1CO.15.9.english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

1CO.15.29.motu: Unu basinema heto, mase daidiai vada e bapatisodia taudia na ede bema heto? Mase taudia basiema tore isi lou, badina be dahaka idia daidiai e bapatisodiamu?
1CO.15.29.english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

1CO.11.15.motu: a hahine huina baine lata na hairai ḡauna ienai? Badina be huina latana amo kwarana baine kumia.
1CO.11.15.english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

1CO.10.31.motu: Benaini, bavaniani eiava ba inuinu eiava dahaka dahaka ba kara, ḡau iboudiai ba kara Dirava iheatolaina ai.
1CO.10.31.english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

1CO.4.18.motu: Haida na vada e hekokorokumu, badina be idia banava lau na basina vasimu e tomu.
1CO.4.18.english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

1CO.9.11.motu: Ai ese lauma ḡaudia baiama hado umui emui, tanobada ḡaudia emui ai baiama abi na ḡau metauna a?
1CO.9.11.english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

1CO.12.9.motu: ma ta abidadama e heniamu, ma ta gorere ihanamolaidia siahuna e heniamu,
1CO.12.9.english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

1CO.15.56.motu: Mase ena hekori na kara dika; bona kara dika ena siahu na taravatu.
1CO.15.56.english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

1CO.15.21.motu: Badina be taunimanima ena amo mase vada e vara; ma taunimanima ena amo mase taudia ihatore-isidia vada e vara.
1CO.15.21.english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

1CO.10.6.motu: Unu ḡau na toa, ita eda; kara dikadia basita ura heni, idia ese e ura heni na heto.
1CO.10.6.english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

1CO.15.25.motu: Badina be ia na do baine lohia, ela bona ana inai iboudiai na ia aena henudiai do baine atodia.
1CO.15.25.english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

1CO.6.12.motu: Kara iboudiai na asi taravatudia lauegu ai; to dia kara iboudiai na nanamo. Kara iboudiai na asi taravatudia lauegu ai; to ta ese basine biagugu.
1CO.6.12.english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

1CO.14.2.motu: Badina be gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na dia taunimanima se hereva henidiamu, a Dirava hari, badina be taunimanima ta na ena hereva anina asi dibana; ia ese lauma ai hereva hehunidia e gwauraimu.
1CO.14.2.english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

1CO.15.44.motu: E hadoamu, tau-anina; e hatorea isimu, lauma-anina ai. Badina be tau-anina e miamu, bona lauma-anina danu e miamu.
1CO.15.44.english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

1CO.6.10.motu: bona henao taudia, bona mata ganigani taudia, bona muramura ese e hakekerodiamu taudia, bona ere dika taudia, bona dadidadi taudia, ini iboudiai na asi ahudia, Dirava ena basileia lalonai.
1CO.6.10.english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

1CO.14.21.motu: Taravatu ai vada e torea: Lohiabada na e tomu “Idau gado idau gado taudia edia amo bona bese idau-idau taudia bibinadia amo lau ese ina bese taudia baina hereva henidia; to basie kamonai henigu”.
1CO.14.21.english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.” + 14:21 Isaiah 28:11-12

1CO.15.24.motu: Bena dokona baine kau: una negana ai ia ese basileia na Tamana Dirava baine henia; una negana ai danu gaubada iboudiai bona lohia iboudiai bona siahu taudia iboudiai na ia ese baine haoredia.
1CO.15.24.english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

1CO.15.13.motu: Mase taudia na basiema tore isi lou, Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi;
1CO.15.13.english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

1CO.15.55.motu: Mase e, emu kwalimu be edeseni ai? Mase e, emu hekori be edeseni ai?

1CO.1.12.motu: Readia umui ta ta o tomamu “Lau na Paulo ena”, “Lau na Apolo ena”, “Lau na Kefa ena”, “Lau na Keriso ena”.
1CO.1.12.english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

1CO.11.13.motu: Sibomui ba haeroa. Hahine be kwarana asi ikumilaina Dirava baine ḡuria namo eiava?
1CO.11.13.english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

1CO.5.7.motu: Hatubu ḡauna gunana ba negea, taba matamatana ai baola, se hatubua ḡauna. Badina be Keriso vada e alaia mase, iseda Lagau-hanai mamoena ai ela.
1CO.5.7.english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

1CO.2.3.motu: Lau na manoka-manoka ai bona gari ai bona heude-heude badana ai umui bogaragimui ai na nohova;
1CO.2.3.english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

1CO.11.6.motu: Badina be hahine ta ese kwarana basine kumia, ia huina do bae utua; a huina iutuna eiava kwarana inauna bema mai hemaraina, hahine ese kwarana bema kumia.
1CO.11.6.english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

1CO.14.6.motu: Varavaragu e, harihari umui dekemui bama vasi gado idaudia ai bama hereva, a gado anidia eiava lalo-diari eiava peroveta eiava hahediba herevadia basinama gwaurai, ede bama hanamomui toma?
1CO.14.6.english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

1CO.12.26.motu: Bena reḡe ta baine hisihisi, reḡe iboudiai na ia ida bae hisihisi hebou; eiava reḡe ta bae hanamoa, reḡe iboudiai na ia ida bae moale hebou.
1CO.12.26.english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

1CO.11.17.motu: Egu hahedua binai na henimuimu, asina hanamomuimu; badina be emui hebou amo namo ta se varamu, a dika mo e varamu.
1CO.11.17.english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

1CO.12.27.motu: Benaini, umui na Keriso tau-anina; umui ta ta be ia reḡena.
1CO.12.27.english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

1CO.15.3.motu: Badina be na davaria herevana na henimui gunava: Keriso na eda kara dika daidiai e mase, Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena;
1CO.15.3.english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

1CO.9.17.motu: Badina be sibogu egu ura dainai bama karaia, ahugu bama abia; to dia sibogu egu ura dainai, hahedua dainai na karaia.
1CO.9.17.english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

1CO.15.35.motu: A tau ta baineto “Mase taudia na ede bae tore isi toma? Tau-anidia edehetomadia ma bae torelai?”
1CO.15.35.english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

1CO.4.14.motu: Ini hereva asina toremu umui ihahemaraimui totona; a natugu, egu lalokau, bama sisiba henidia heḡereḡerena ai umui na sisiba henimuimu.
1CO.4.14.english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

1CO.11.34.motu: Ta ben-a hitolo, ia na ena ruma ai bema aniani, hahemaoro ai ba dika bou na garina. Hereva oredia do bae mia ela bona baina vasi, bena baina hamaoromaoro.
1CO.11.34.english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

1CO.11.1.motu: Lau ba haḡoigu, lau ese Keriso na haḡoiamu heḡereḡerena.
1CO.11.1.english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

1CO.15.30.motu: Bona badina be dahaka lau na nega idoidiai hahedika bogaragidiai na nohomu?
1CO.15.30.english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

1CO.1.22.motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia ese toa e noiamu, Helene taudia ese danu aonega e tahuamu;
1CO.1.22.english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

1CO.10.25.motu: Hoihoi gabuna ai e hoimu vamudia iboudiai na bavani, basio henanadailai, lalomui bae hekwakwanai na garina.
1CO.10.25.english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

1CO.10.17.motu: Badina be ataga be tamona, ita danu ena be hutuma to tau-ani tamona, taunabunai ita iboudai ataga tamona ta ania heboumu.
1CO.10.17.english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

1CO.8.3.motu: a tau ta ese Dirava baine lalokau henia, Dirava ese ia baine dibaia.
1CO.8.3.english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

1CO.3.5.motu: Apolo be daika? Paulo be daika? Hesiai taudia mo, sivarai namo e henimui, Lohiabada ese idia e henidia heḡereḡerena.
1CO.3.5.english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

1CO.2.15.motu: A lauma iabidadama-henina tauna ese ḡau iboudiai e dibamu, a tau ta ese ia se dibaiamu.
1CO.2.15.english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

1CO.14.20.motu: Varavaragu e, daramui ai basio garuḡaru. Lalo-dika ai ba ḡaruḡaru, a daramui na taudia e lo taudia daradia heḡereḡeredia ai baela.
1CO.14.20.english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

1CO.12.5.motu: Hesiai daladia na idau-idau, a Lohiabada be tamona.
1CO.12.5.english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

1CO.16.15.motu: Varavaragu e, na hahealo henimuimu, Stefana mai ena ruma taudia na dibamui, idia na helalo-kerehai taudia gini-gunadia Akaia ai; idia danu sibodia e hegwaurai, helaḡa taudia isiaidia bae lao heni.
1CO.16.15.english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

1CO.3.9.motu: Badina be ai na Dirava ida a ḡaukara heboumu; umui na Dirava ena uma bona Dirava ena ruma.
1CO.3.9.english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

1CO.15.11.motu: Taunabunai, lau na haroro, eiava idia e haroro, herevana be tamona mo, a harorolaiamu bona o abia daemu ḡauna mo.
1CO.15.11.english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

1CO.1.9.motu: Dirava na momokani; bona ia ese vada e boirimui, ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ida ba hetura.
1CO.1.9.english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

1CO.10.10.motu: Bona basio maumau, idia haida e maumau na heto, bena ala-ala aneruna ese e aladia mamase.
1CO.10.10.english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

1CO.7.23.motu: Vada e hoimui, mai davamui: taunimanima edia hesiai taudia ai basiola.
1CO.7.23.english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

1CO.15.17.motu: Bena Keriso na basinema hatorea isi, umui danu boma abidadama kava, bena emui kara dikadia lalodiai doene boma noho;
1CO.15.17.english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

1CO.4.16.motu: Taunabunai lau na noimuimu, lau ba haḡoigu.
1CO.4.16.english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

1CO.15.37.motu: O hadoamu ḡauna na dia gabeai baine vara anina, to uhe mo, readia uit uhena eiava idau uhe ta.
1CO.15.37.english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

1CO.7.8.motu: Asie headava taudia bona vabu na hamaorodiamu, na tomu bae noho lau heḡereḡeregu, una baine namo.
1CO.7.8.english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

1CO.9.7.motu: Daika baine ha tuari, bena ena tuari dokona ai sibona davana baine kara? Daika vine baine hado, bena ena hadohado anina basine ani? Daika ese mamoe baine naridia, bena rata na basine inua?
1CO.9.7.english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

1CO.7.19.motu: E peritomea bona asie peritomea be asi anina; Dirava ena haheḡani ibadinadia mo mai anina.
1CO.7.19.english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

1CO.3.20.motu: Ma e torea, eto, Lohiabada na aonega taudia edia lalo-hadai dibana, idia na asi anidia.
1CO.3.20.english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.” + 3:20 Psalms 94:11

1CO.9.6.motu: Lau Banaba ida asi siahumai imamai ḡaukaradia baia ato diho a?
1CO.9.6.english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

1CO.11.2.motu: Lau na hanamomuimu badina be ḡau iboudiai o lalolaigu, hahediba herevadia na abi bena na henimui ḡaudia o badinamu.
1CO.11.2.english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

1CO.11.33.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, anibou dainai ba hebou negadia ai, ba henari heheni.
1CO.11.33.english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

1CO.13.3.motu: Egu kohu idoinai ogoḡami taudia bama ubulaidia, bona tau-anigu bama heni, lahi ai bema ara ore, to asi egu lalokau, unu ese basie hanamogu.
1CO.13.3.english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

1CO.15.6.motu: gabeamo nega tamona ai varavarada sinahu-ima mai dikoana ediai e hedinarai. Idia hutuma vada e nohomu ema harihari; a haida na vada e mahuta.
1CO.15.6.english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

1CO.4.9.motu: Badina be lau na tomamu Dirava ese ai aposetolo taumai na gabe taumai ai vada e halaomai, vada e revamai mase; badina be tanobada bona aneru bona taunimanima bae raraia hebou ḡauna ai vada e halaomai.
1CO.4.9.english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

1CO.15.39.motu: Hidio danu iboudiai na dia heḡereḡere: ta be taunimanina hidiodia; ma ta be boroma hidiodia; ma ta be manu hidiodia; ma ta be gwarume hidiodia.
1CO.15.39.english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

1CO.15.50.motu: To, varavaragu e, lau na tomamu hidio bona rara ese Dirava ena basileia basie abia diba; mase tauna ese danu se masemu ḡauna ahuna basine abia diba.
1CO.15.50.english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

1CO.7.6.motu: Ina na egu hahealo; dia haheḡani.
1CO.7.6.english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

1CO.11.25.motu: Unuhetomana danu, e aniani vaitani murinai ia ese kehere e abia, bena ma eto “Ina kehere na herohemaino matamatana, lau raragu ai; ba inua negadia ai ini ba kara toma, lau ba lalogu”.
1CO.11.25.english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “\+w This|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w cup|strong="G4221"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w new|strong="G2537"\+w* \+w covenant|strong="G1242"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1699"\+w* blood. \+w Do|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w*, \+w as|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w often|strong="G3740"\+w* \+w as|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w drink|strong="G4095"\+w*, \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* memory \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w me|strong="G3004"\+w*.”

1CO.15.20.motu: Momokani, Keriso na mase amo vada e tore isi, mahuta taudia edia tore-isi-lou roboana.
1CO.15.20.english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

1CO.2.12.motu: Ita ese tanobada laumana asita abia, a Dirava ena amo e maimu laumana tame abia, Dirava ese e henida dudu kaumu ḡaudia baita diba helaoreana.
1CO.2.12.english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

1CO.5.10.motu: To asinato nega idoinai ina tanobada ena heuda-hanai taudia, eiava mata-ḡaniḡani taudia, eiava dadidadi taudia, eiava kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia, ida basio hebou; unu asina gwau toma. Boma ura unu boma kara toma, dala tamona be tanobada boma rakatania vaitani.
1CO.5.10.english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

1CO.8.6.motu: to ita na mai eda Dirava tamona, ia na Tamada; ḡau iboudiai na iena amo e varamu, ita danu iena. Ita na mai eda Lohiabada tamona danu, Iesu Keriso bunai, ia dainai ḡau iboudiai e varamu, ita danu ia dainai vada ta vara.
1CO.8.6.english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

1CO.14.25.motu: bona ena lalo-hadai hehunidia do bae hahedinarai; bena baine goru diho, Dirava baine toma henia diho, baineto “Momokani, Dirava na umui bogaragimui ai”.
1CO.14.25.english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

1CO.3.12.motu: Una ruma badina latanai tau ta ese gold eiava silver eiava nadi nan namo-hereadia eiava au eiava kurukuru eiava biri baine hadai;
1CO.3.12.english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

1CO.15.22.motu: Badina be taunimanima iboudiai Adam bagunai vada e mase na heto, Keriso bagunai iboudiai do bae mauri.
1CO.15.22.english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

1CO.1.19.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Aonega taudia edia aonega baina ha-orea, lalo-parara taudia edia lalo-parara danu baina dadaraia.

1CO.9.4.motu: asi siahumai baia aniani bona baia inuinu a?
1CO.9.4.english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

1CO.5.2.motu: A umui be o hekokorokumu, asio taimu, asio tomu unu e kara toma tauna na bogaragimui amo bema heabi oho bema namo.
1CO.5.2.english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

1CO.7.14.motu: Badina be ekalesia hahinena ese adavana murimuri tauna na e hahelaḡaiamu; bona ekalesia tauna ese adavana murimuri hahinena na e hahelaḡaiamu. Bema lasi, natumui basiema helaḡa; ḡau tamona, idia na harihari hehelaḡa.
1CO.7.14.english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

1CO.6.3.motu: Asi dibamui a, ita ese aneru do baita hahemaoro henidia? Ina mauri ena ḡau basita hahemaorolai a?
1CO.6.3.english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

1CO.7.36.motu: Tau ta na lalona ai bema diba ia ese maohenina asine kara maoromaoro henia, a hegahusi dainai ena ura ienai vada e abia, bena ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine karaia, vada bae headava; una na asi kererena.
1CO.7.36.english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

1CO.9.20.motu: Iuda taudia ediai Iuda tauna ai nala, Iuda taudia baina veridia mauri totona. Ena be lau na dia taravatu henunai, to taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia ediai taravatu henuna tauna ai nala, taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia baina veridia mauri totona.
1CO.9.20.english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

1CO.11.12.motu: Badina be hahine na tau dainai vada e vara, a tau be hahine ena amo e varamu. A ḡau iboudiai na Dirava dainai e varamu.
1CO.11.12.english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

1CO.7.22.motu: Badina be hesiai tauna Lohiabada lalonai vada e boiria, Lohiabada ese vada e ruhaia nege; a e heruha nege tauna vada e boiria, ia na Lohiabada ena hesiai tauna.
1CO.7.22.english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

1CO.16.6.motu: bena dekemui ai baina noho taritari, reana ela bona keru negana baine doko. Bena una negana ai umui ese ba durugu egu laolao idoinai.
1CO.16.6.english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

1CO.12.11.motu: Unu ḡau iboudiai Lauma tamona ese taunimanima e henidia hagau-hagaumu, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
1CO.12.11.english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

1CO.10.2.motu: Iboudiai Mose enai bapatiso e abia, ori bona davara amo.
1CO.10.2.english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

1CO.4.19.motu: A Lohiabada baine ura, lau na asi vanahana baina vasi; bena hekokoroku taudia baina dibadia; edia hereva basina diba, edia siahu mo baina diba.
1CO.4.19.english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

1CO.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Dirava ena ura dainai vada e boirigu, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu ai vada e halaogu, varavarada Sostene ida,
1CO.1.1.english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

1CO.6.8.motu: A umui ese bamomui ma o hadikadiamu, bona edia kohu ma o abi havaramu.
1CO.6.8.english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

1CO.16.1.motu: Boubou, helaḡa taudia idurulaidia, na ekalesia Galatia ai na haḡanilaidia heḡereḡerena umui danu ba karaia.
1CO.16.1.english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

1CO.12.30.motu: Iboudiai na gorere ihamauridia mai dibadia a? Iboudiai na gado idaudia ai e herevamu a? Iboudiai na gado anidia e hahedinaraimu a?
1CO.12.30.english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

1CO.13.2.motu: Peroveta siahuna bama abia, bona hehuni ḡaudia bona aonega ḡaudia iboudiai bama diba, bona egu abidadama amo ororo bama raga oho, to asi egu lalokau, lau na ḡau asi anina na heto.
1CO.13.2.english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

1CO.9.5.motu: Asi siahumai ekalesia hahinedia edia amo adavamai baia abidia, bena baia hakaudia eva-eva, aposetolo oredia bona Lohiabada tadina bona Kefa heḡereḡeredia a?
1CO.9.5.english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

1CO.7.12.motu: A taunimanima oredia ediai lauegu hereva (dia Lohiabada ena) binai: varavarada ta bema mai adavana, dia ekalesia hahinena, bona una hahine bema ura ia ida do bemaa noho; basinema hadihoa.
1CO.7.12.english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

1CO.14.26.motu: Bena edeheto, varavaragu e? Ba hebou negadia ai, umui ta ta mai emui ane, mai emui hahediba, mai emui hereva hehuni ihahedinaraidia, mai emui gado idaudia, mai emui gado idauna anina ihahegeregerena. Ḡau idoidiai ba kara taunimanima lalodia ihapararalaidia.
1CO.14.26.english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

1CO.11.26.motu: Taunabunai, ina flaoa atagana bavania bona ina kehere ba inua negadia iboudiai na umui ese Lohiabada ena mase ba hahedinaraia, ela bona ia do bainema.
1CO.11.26.english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

1CO.12.18.motu: A Dirava ese reḡe ta ta tau-anina lalonai vada e ato, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
1CO.12.18.english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

1CO.1.2.motu: raruosi Dirava ena ekalesia Korinto ai o nohomu taumui a hahenamo henimuimu. Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e hahelaḡamui, helaḡa taumui vada e gwauraimui. Umui, bona Iesu Keriso, edia Lohiabada bona eda Lohiabada, ladana e hahaneamu taudia iboudiai,
1CO.1.2.english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

1CO.9.23.motu: Ḡau iboudiai na sivarai namo dainai na karamu, ia lalonai ahugu baina abia helaoreana.
1CO.9.23.english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

1CO.15.28.motu: A ḡau iboudiai ia henunai bae heato vaitani negana ai, Natuna danu ḡau iboudiai ia henunai vada e atodia Diravana henunai bainela; taunabunai Dirava baine herea, baine herea dae.
1CO.15.28.english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

1CO.9.19.motu: Ena be lau na ura kwalimu taugu taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, to iboudiai edia hesiai tauna ai nala, hutuma baina veridia mauri helaoreana.
1CO.9.19.english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

1CO.12.31.motu: Herahia hereadia ba hekisehekise heni. A dala herea-daena be harihari aina hahedinarai henimui.
1CO.12.31.english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

1CO.6.4.motu: Benaini, ina mauri ena ḡau o hahemaorolaimu negadia ai, edeheto ekalesia lalonai asi haridia taudia vairadiai o hahemaoro hehenimu?
1CO.6.4.english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

1CO.11.28.motu: Tau ta lalona baine tahua guna; bena ataga baine ania bona kehere baine inua.
1CO.11.28.english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
