1CO.14.23.motu: Benaini, ekalesia idoinai gabu tamona ai bae hebou, bona hebou taudia iboudiai gado idaudia ai bae hereva; bena asi dibadia taudia eiava asi edia kamonai taudia bae raka vareai, bena baeto “Umui na readia e kavamui”.
1CO.14.23.english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

1CO.6.7.motu: Taunabunai, umui o hahemaoro hehenimu na vada o kerere vaitani. E hadikamui negadia ai na hisi basio ani a? Emui kohu e abi havaramu negadia ai na basio haheauka a?
1CO.6.7.english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

1CO.4.12.motu: A hekwarahimu, imamai amo a ḡaukaramu. E uduguiraimaimu, to a hanamodiamu; e daḡedaḡe henimaimu, to a haheaukamu;
1CO.4.12.english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

1CO.6.11.motu: Umui haida danu gunaguna unuheto; to vada e hurimui, vada e hahelaḡamui, bena maoromui vada e gwaurai, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai bona iseda Dirava Laumana ai.
1CO.6.11.english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

1CO.6.5.motu: Ini na gwau tomamu, umui ihahemaraimui. Be! Bogaragimui ai aonega tauna ta lasi a, varavarana baine hahemaoro henidia diba?
1CO.6.5.english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

1CO.10.9.motu: Lohiabada danu basita dibagania, idia haida ese e dibaḡania na heto, bena gaigai ese e koridia mamase.
1CO.10.9.english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

1CO.14.24.motu: A iboudiai bae peroveta, bena asi ena kamonai tauna eiava asi dibana tauna baine raka vareai negana ai iboudiai ese bae sisiba henia, bae hahemaoro henia,
1CO.14.24.english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

1CO.4.17.motu: Badina bunai Timoteo vada na siaia vasi dekemui ai; ia na egu lalokau merona mai momokanina ida, Lohiabada alonai. Ia ese egu ḡaukara Keriso Iesu lalonai baine hahelalolaimui, gabu idoidiai ekalesia iboudiai na hadibalaidia heḡereḡerena.
1CO.4.17.english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

1CO.3.19.motu: Badina be ina tanobada aonegana na kavakava, Dirava vairanai. Buka Helaḡa ai vada e torea, eto, Ia ese aonega taudia e idoadia, edia dibaka karadia ai.
1CO.3.19.english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.” + 3:19 Job 5:13

1CO.14.8.motu: Ina danu, tuari kibina basiema hiriria ḡoevaḡoeva, daika ese ena tuari ḡaudia bema heḡaeḡaelai?
1CO.14.8.english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

1CO.7.28.motu: Boma headava, ena na dia kara dikana; bona haneulato bema headava, una danu dia kara dika. Ḡau tamona, unu bae kara toma taudia na hisi do bae ani. A na uramu basinia hametaumui.
1CO.7.28.english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

1CO.16.22.motu: Tau ta ese Lohiabada basinema ura henia, bema uduguiraia. Emai Lohiabada e, aoma!
1CO.16.22.english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

1CO.10.30.motu: Dirava bama hanamoa, bena bama aniani. Dahaka dainai mai ihanamona ida na ania ḡauna dainai baine gwau henigu?
1CO.10.30.english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

1CO.7.29.motu: A varavaragu e, ini na gwau tomamu: nega na kwadogi. Harihari ela, mai adavadia tataudia na bae noho asi adavadia na heto baine namo;
1CO.7.29.english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

1CO.8.12.motu: Taunabunai, varavarada o kara dika henidiamu, bona edia lalo-manoka o habadaiamu, unu amo Keriso danu o hadikaiamu.
1CO.8.12.english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

1CO.15.36.motu: Kava taumu e, o hadoamu ḡauna na basinema mase guna, ia na basinema mauri.
1CO.15.36.english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

1CO.3.10.motu: Dirava ese e henigu hariharina heḡereḡerena ruma iseuna dibana tauna na heto, ruma badina vada na atoa; a idau tauna ta ese ia daenai ruma ta ma e hadaiamu. A ta ta nahuadia bae toho, ede bae hadaia toma;
1CO.3.10.english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

1CO.11.18.motu: Hereva gini-gunana binai: lau na name kamonai emui ekalesia heboudia lalodiai heiri-heiri e varamu bogaragimui ai. Una sivarai kahana na abia daemu.
1CO.11.18.english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

1CO.10.8.motu: Ita na basita lebulebu, idia haida e lebulebu na heto, bena dina tamona ai gerebu-rua daha-toi vada e mase.
1CO.10.8.english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

1CO.4.13.motu: ladamai e hadikamu, to a hamarumarudiamu. Tanobada taḡena ai bona ḡau iboudiai momodia ai vada e halaomaimu ema bona harihari.
1CO.4.13.english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

1CO.1.7.motu: Taunabunai umui na harihari ḡauna ta ai asio dabumu, hari iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ihahedinaraina o nariamu negana ai.
1CO.1.7.english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

1CO.2.4.motu: bona egu hereva bona egu haroro na dia aonega herevadia eiava lalo-ani herevadia, to Lauma ena siahu na hahedinaraia,
1CO.2.4.english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

1CO.7.21.motu: E boirimu negana ai oi na hesiai taumu a? Lalomu basine hekwarahi. A iruha-negemu dalana ba davaria, vada bavabia dae; una be namo herea.
1CO.7.21.english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

1CO.14.34.motu: emui hahine na hebou lalodiai bae mu noho; bae hereva na taravatu. Bae hemataurai noho, taravatu ese e gwauraiamu heḡereḡerena.
1CO.14.34.english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says, + 14:34 Deuteronomy 27:9

1CO.11.11.motu: Ḡau tamona, hahine na dia sibona, a tau ida, bona tau na dia sibona, a hahine ida, Lohiabada lalonai.
1CO.11.11.english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

1CO.5.8.motu: Taunabunai, aria baita karaia, dia hatubu ḡauna gunana ai, bona dia lalo-hadai dikadia bona kara dikadia edia hatubu ḡauna ai, a se hatubua anianina ai: una na lalo ḡoeva bona hereva momokani.
1CO.5.8.english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

1CO.6.16.motu: Asi dibamui a, ariara hahinena ida e heboumu tauna na ia ida tau-anina tamona? Badina be vada e torea, Raruosi na tau-anina tamona ai baela.
1CO.6.16.english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.” + 6:16 Genesis 2:24

1CO.11.10.motu: Una dainai hahine ena siahu toana kwarana ai baine mia, aneru daidiai.
1CO.11.10.english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

1CO.3.14.motu: Tau ta ese e hadaia ḡauna na baine gini, una tau ese davana do baine abia.
1CO.3.14.english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

1CO.5.9.motu: Egu revareva ta lalonai na tore henimui, nato heuda-hanai taudia basio bamodia.
1CO.5.9.english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

1CO.7.17.motu: Lohiabada ese taunimanima ta Ia vada e harihari henidia heḡereḡerena, bona Dirava ese taunimanima ta ta vada e boiridia heḡereḡerena, unu bae raka toma. Ekalesia oreadia iboudiai lalodiai unu na haḡanidia tomamu.
1CO.7.17.english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

1CO.8.9.motu: To nahuamui ba toho, ina emui siahu na manoka taudia ihahekwakwanaidia ḡauna ai bainela na garina.
1CO.8.9.english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

1CO.12.22.motu: Lasi; manoka-manoka ta gwauraimu reḡedia na mai edia ḡaukara badahereadia;
1CO.12.22.english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

1CO.14.17.motu: Oi ese Dirava ihanamona herevana o gwauraia ḡoevaḡoevamu, to bamomu lalona se pararamu.
1CO.14.17.english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

1CO.3.4.motu: Badina be ta e tomu “Lau na Paulo ena”, ma ta e tomu “Lau na Apolo ena”; benaini, umui na tau-anina iabidadama-henina taumui, ani?
1CO.3.4.english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

1CO.10.15.motu: Lalo-parara taumui na hereva henimuimu; egu hereva ba haeroa.
1CO.10.15.english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

1CO.15.18.motu: bona Keriso lalonai vada e mahutamu tauda na bema baia.
1CO.15.18.english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

1CO.3.16.motu: Asi dibamui a, umui na Dirava ena ruma helaḡana; Dirava Laumana danu umui lalomui ai e nohomu?
1CO.3.16.english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

1CO.15.57.motu: A Dirava aita hanamoa: ia ese vada e hakwalimuda, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai.
1CO.15.57.english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

1CO.16.14.motu: Emui ḡaukara idoidiai na lalokau ai ba kara.
1CO.16.14.english: Let all that you do be done in love.

1CO.8.11.motu: Bena lalo-manoka tauna, ena be oi varavaramu, ia dainai Keriso vada e mase, to oiemu lalo-parara dainai ia baine mase.
1CO.8.11.english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

1CO.12.16.motu: Bona taia bema toma “Lau na dia mata dainai lau na dia tau-anina ena”; una dainai ia na dia tau-anina ena a?
1CO.12.16.english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

1CO.10.1.motu: Varavaragu e, na uramu ba diba, seneda iboudiai na ori henunai e nohova, bena unu amo ma iboudiai davara lalona amo e raka raka hanai.
1CO.10.1.english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

1CO.1.23.motu: to ai ese Keriso vada e hasatauroa na a harorolaiamu. Una na hekwakwanai ḡauna Iuda taudia ediai, bona kavakava ḡauna Helene taudia ediai;
1CO.1.23.english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

1CO.15.58.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, egu lalokau, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, basio marere. Lohiabada ena ḡaukara lalonai ba goada balaheni nega idoinai; badina be dibamui emui hekwarahi Lohiabada lalonai na asio hekwarahilaia kavamu.
1CO.15.58.english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

1CO.15.46.motu: Lauma-anina na se guna; tau-anina e gunava, gabe amo lauma-anina.
1CO.15.46.english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

1CO.15.32.motu: Taunimanima edia kara heḡereḡerena Efeso ai uda boromadia ida na heatu, namona be dahaka egu ai? Mase taudia basiema tore isi lou, baitama aniani baitama inuinu hari namo, badina be kerukeru vada baita mase.
1CO.15.32.english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.” + 15:32 Isaiah 22:13

1CO.15.33.motu: Basio hekoi: kara dika taudia edia hebamo ese kara namo taudia e hahekwakwanaidiamu.
1CO.15.33.english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

1CO.10.5.motu: To Dirava ese idia hutuma bada se lalo namo henidia dainai, tano ḡaḡaena ai eha mase.
1CO.10.5.english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

1CO.13.11.motu: Merogu negana ai na herevava mero na heto, lalogu e urava mero na heto, egu lalo-hadai be mero ena lalo-hadai. A taugu e lo negana ai, mero ena kara vada na nege.
1CO.13.11.english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

1CO.4.1.motu: Taunimanima ese ini bae lalolmai toma: ai na Keriso ena hesiai taumai bona Dirava ena hereva hehuni iregudia taumai.
1CO.4.1.english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

1CO.9.2.motu: Idau taudia ediai readia lau na dia aposetolo tauna, a umui emui ai lau be aposetolo tauna momokani; badina be egu aposetolo dagina toana Lohiabada lalonai be umui.
1CO.9.2.english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

1CO.9.27.motu: to sibogu tau-anigu na tutuamu, na ḡuiamu; haida baina haroro henidia to sibogu mauri baina reaia na garina.
1CO.9.27.english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

1CO.12.3.motu: Badina bunai na hadibamuimu, Dirava Laumana ai e herevamu tauna ese Iesu basine uduguiraia diba; bona tau ta basineto “Iesu na Lohiabada”, Lauma Helaḡa ai e herevamu tauna mo sibona.
1CO.12.3.english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

1CO.11.9.motu: bona tau na se karaia hahine ena, a hahine hari e karaia tau ena.
1CO.11.9.english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

1CO.5.4.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai na haḡanimuimu: lau laumagu ida ba hebou Lohiabada Iesu Keriso siahuna ai,
1CO.5.4.english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

1CO.14.3.motu: A e perovetamu tauna ese hahealo bona hahegoada bona tauhalo na taunimanima e herevalai henidiamu.
1CO.14.3.english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

1CO.16.3.motu: Bena dekemui ai baina kau negana ai, ba gwauraidia hidi taudia na revareva ba henidia, baina siaidia, emui herahia ḡaudia Ierusalem bae laohai.
1CO.16.3.english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

1CO.7.3.motu: Tau ese adavana ena headava karana baine henia; hahine danu adavana ena headava karana baine henia.
1CO.7.3.english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

1CO.1.30.motu: Dirava na Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e hamaurimui; bona Keriso Iesu ena amo aonega bona kara maoromaoro bona hahelaḡa bona hahemauri vada eme henida;
1CO.1.30.english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

1CO.3.7.motu: Benaini, ihadona tauna bona idairina tauna be herevadia; Dirava sibona ese anina e havaraiamu.
1CO.3.7.english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

1CO.3.18.motu: Tau ta sibona basine hekoi. Tau ta umui bogaragimui ai lalona baineto ia na ina tanobada aonegana vada e davaria, ia na kavakava tauna ai do bainela, bena aonega korikori baine abia.
1CO.3.18.english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

1CO.6.19.motu: Asi dibamui a, tau-animui na Lauma Helaḡa ena ruma; ia na lalomui ai, Dirava ese vada e henimui? Umui na dia sibomui emui;
1CO.6.19.english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

1CO.10.23.motu: Ḡau iboudiai na asi taravatudia ita edai; to basitato ḡau iboudiai na nanamo. Ḡau iboudiai na asi taravatudia ita edai; to dia ḡau iboudiai ese basie hagoadada.
1CO.10.23.english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

1CO.12.4.motu: Herahia be idau-idau, a Lauma be tamona.
1CO.12.4.english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

1CO.9.3.motu: E nanadaigumu taudia na ini na haere henidia tomamu;
1CO.9.3.english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

1CO.2.14.motu: Tau-anina iabidadama-henina tauna ese Dirava Laumana ḡaudia se abi daemu, badina be idia na kakavakava ienai; lalona se pararamu, badina be lalo-parara na Lauma ena amo.
1CO.2.14.english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

1CO.6.9.motu: Asi dibamui a, kara dika taudia na asi ahudia Dirava ena basileia lalonai? Basio hekoi. Lebulebu taudia, bona kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia, bona heuda-hanai taudia, bona hahine ai e laomu taudia, bona sibodia e hahedika hehenimu taudia,
1CO.6.9.english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

1CO.9.16.motu: Ḡau tamona, sivarai namo na harorolaiamu be asina heaḡilaiamu, badina be vada e haduagu unu baina kara toma: sivarai namo basinama harorolaia madi ihabaigu.
1CO.9.16.english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

1CO.5.6.motu: Emui hekokoroku na dia namo. Asi dibamui a, hatubu ḡauna sisina ese taba idoinai e hatubuamu?
1CO.5.6.english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

1CO.15.51.motu: A kamonai; hereva hehuni aina hamaorolaimui. Ita iboudai basita mahuta; to iboudai do baine ha-idauda;
1CO.15.51.english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

1CO.9.1.motu: Lau na ura-kwalimu taugu ani? Lau na aposetolo taugu ani? Eda Lohiabada Iesu na itaia ani? Umui na lauegu ḡaukara anina Lohiabada lalonai ani?
1CO.9.1.english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

1CO.1.13.motu: Be, Keriso na vada e haheparara a? Paulo e hasatauroa umui daimui ai a? Eiava Paulo ladana ai e bapatisomui a?
1CO.1.13.english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

1CO.6.6.motu: A ekalesia tauna ese bamona e habadelaiamu bona e hahemaoro heniamu, asi edia abidadama taudia vairadia ai.
1CO.6.6.english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

1CO.2.11.motu: Badina be taunimanima edia ḡau be taunimanima laumana mo mai dibana, ani? Unuhetomana, Dirava ena ḡau be ta asi dibana, Dirava Laumana sibona mai dibana.
1CO.2.11.english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

1CO.14.39.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, peroveta siahuna ba hekise-hekise henia, bona gado itlaudia ig vauraidia basio gwau tao.
1CO.14.39.english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

1CO.7.11.motu: A bema dihotania, ia na vadona ai bema noho, eiava adavana enai ma bema daro dae lou. Tau ese danu adavana basine hadihoa.
1CO.7.11.english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

1CO.10.16.motu: Hahenamo keherena ta hanamoamu na hetura, Keriso rarana ai, ani? Ataga ta bakiamu na hetura, Keriso tau-anina ai, ani?
1CO.10.16.english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

1JN.3.8.motu: A kara dika e karamu tauna na diabolo ena, badina be matamana negana amo diabolo na e kara dika. Dirava Natuna e hedinarai badina binai: diabolo ena kara dika baine ha-ore.
1JN.3.8.english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

1JN.5.15.motu: Bona dibada eda noinoi iboudiai e kamonaimu dainai, ita dibada danu ta noiamu ḡaudia baita abi.
1JN.5.15.english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

1JN.2.11.motu: A tadikakana e badu heniamu tauna na dibura ai e nohomu bona dibura ai e rakamu, e lao heniamu gabuna na asi dibana, badina be dibura ese matana vada e hakepulu.
1JN.2.11.english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

1JN.5.7.motu: Lauma ese e hahedinaraiamu, badina be Lauma na momokani.
1JN.5.7.english: For there are three who testify:

1JN.3.18.motu: Natugu e, eda lalokau na dia hereva amo, dia mala amo, a kara ai bona momokani ai baita hahedinaraia.
1JN.3.18.english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

1JN.2.9.motu: Ta e tomamu ia na diari lalonai, a tadikakana e badu heniamu, ia na doini dibura ai e nohomu.
1JN.2.9.english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

1JN.5.16.motu: Tau ta ese tadikakana baine itaia, kara dikana e karaiamu, to dia mase karana, bena baine noinoi ia ena; bena Dirava ese mauri baine henia, e kara dikamu to mase karana asie karaiamu taudia edia. A kara dikana ta be mase karana; asina tomamu una kara dainai baine noinoi.
1JN.5.16.english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

1JN.5.12.motu: Natuna e abia daemu tauna ese mauri e abiamu, a Dirava Natuna se abia daemu tauna ese mauri se abiamu.
1JN.5.12.english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

1JN.2.27.motu: A ia ese e horolaimui siahuna na doene lalomui ai e miamu; taunabunai ta ese baine hadibamui na herevana. A e horolaimui siahuna ese ḡau iboudiai e hadibalaimuimu, bona ena hahediba na momokani, dia koikoi; taunabunai, e hadibalaimui heḡereḡerena ia lalonai ba noho.
1JN.2.27.english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

1JN.3.5.motu: A umui dibamui, ia na kara dika iabi-ohodia totona ema; ia lalonai dika ta se miamu.
1JN.3.5.english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

1JN.3.19.motu: Unu amo baita diba ita na momokani, bona ia vairanai laloda baita hagoadadia.
1JN.3.19.english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

1JN.4.18.motu: Lalokau ai gari sisina taina dia mia; lalokau momokani ese gari e lulua ohomu. Badina be gari na mai ena hisihisi; taunabunai gari tauna na lalokau ai do se ḡuḡuru.
1JN.4.18.english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

1JN.4.16.motu: Dirava ese e ura henidamu vada dibada, bona ta abia daemu.
1JN.4.16.english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

1JN.4.2.motu: Dirava ena Lauma ini ba diba toma: lauma iboudiai ese Iesu Keriso e gwauraiamu, ia na tauanina ai ema, idia na Dirava ena;
1JN.4.2.english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

1JN.5.19.motu: Dibada danu ita na Dirava ena amo ta vara, a tanobada idoinai na dika tauna imana ai.
1JN.5.19.english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

1JN.1.9.motu: A eda kara dika baita gwaurai hedinarai, ia na maoromaoro bona momokani, edia kara dika iboudiai baine gwau tao, bona eda kara gageva-gageva baine huri oho.
1JN.1.9.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN.2.22.motu: Koikoi tauna be daika? Iesu na dia Keriso e tomamu tauna, ani. Keriso inaina binai: Tamana bona Natuna e ḡorediamu tauna.
1JN.2.22.english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

1JN.1.2.motu: Una mauri vada e hedinarai; ai ese a itaia bona a gwauraia hedinaraimu, mauri hanaihanai, Tamada enai e miamu bona ai emai ai e hedinarai, a hamaorolaimuimu.
1JN.1.2.english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

1JN.2.5.motu: A ena hereva e badinaiamu tauna lalona ai Dirava ena uraheni vada eme ḡuḡuru.
1JN.2.5.english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

1JN.3.17.motu: Tau ta bema mai ena kohu, bena tadikakana bema itaia mai ena ogoḡami, a basinema bogaia hisi, Dirava iura-henina na ia lalona ai ede bema mia toma?
1JN.3.17.english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

1JN.1.6.motu: Ita baitato ita na iena orea tauda, a dibura lalonai baita loa, be baita koikoi, hereva momokani basita badinaia.
1JN.1.6.english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

1JN.2.17.motu: Tanobada na baine lao bubuni, mai ena heḡahusi ida, a Ddirava ena ura e karaiamu tauna na baine noho hanaihanai.
1JN.2.17.english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

1JN.1.8.motu: Ita baitato ita na asi eda kara dika, be siboda baita hekoi, bona hereva momokani na ita laloda ai basine mia.
1JN.1.8.english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN.2.1.motu: Natugu e, ini name tore henimui toma na basio kara dika totona; a ta bema kara dika, ita na mai ikahada tauna Tamada vairanai, Iesu Keriso, kara maoromaoro tauna, bunai.
1JN.2.1.english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

1JN.2.12.motu: Natugu e, na tore henimuimu, badina be emui kara dika na ia ladana dainai vada eme gwau tao.
1JN.2.12.english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

1JN.4.12.motu: Taunimanima ta ese Dirava asine itaia; a ta heura hehenimu negadia ai, Dirava na ita laloda ai noho, bona ena lalokau na ita laloda ai eme ḡuḡuru.
1JN.4.12.english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

1JN.2.19.motu: Idia na iseda amo e raka oho, a idia na dia ita bamoda; badina be bema ita bamoda, idia na dekedai bema noho. A e raka oho, baine hedinarai idia iboudiai na dia ita bamoda helaoreana.
1JN.2.19.english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

1JN.2.10.motu: Tadikakana e ura heniamu tauna na diari ai e nohomu; ienai hekwakwanai badina ta dia mia.
1JN.2.10.english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

1JN.4.3.motu: a Iesu asie gwauraiamu laumadia iboudiai na dia Dirava ena. Keriso Inaina laumana binai; vada o kamonai, ia na bainema; bona ia na harihari tanobada ai e nohomu.
1JN.4.3.english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

1JN.4.21.motu: lena amo ta abiamu haheḡanina binai: Dirava e ura heniamu tauna ese tadikakana danu baine ura henia.
1JN.4.21.english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

1JN.2.3.motu: Ena haheḡani baita badina; unu amo baita diba momokani ita dibada ia.
1JN.2.3.english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

1JN.3.6.motu: Ia lalonai e nohomu tauna ese kara dika se karamu; kara dika e karamu tauna ese ia se itaia, bona asi dibana ia.
1JN.3.6.english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

1JN.4.15.motu: Iesu na Dirava Natuna e gwauraiamu tauna na Dirava be ia lalona ai e nohomu, ia danu Dirava lalonai e nohomu.
1JN.4.15.english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

1JN.3.22.motu: Bena baita noia ḡaudia iboudiai ia ese baine henida; badina be iena haheḡani ta badinamu bona ia ihamoalena karadia ta karamu dainai.
1JN.3.22.english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

1JN.4.5.motu: Idia na tanobada ena; taunabunai tanobada herevadia e gwauraimu, bona tanobada ese e kamonai henidiamu.
1JN.4.5.english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

1JN.3.10.motu: Unu amo Dirava natuna bona diabolo natuna bae hedinarai. Kara maoromaoro se karamu tauna bona tadikakana se lalokau heniamu tauna na dia Dirava ena.
1JN.3.10.english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

1JN.4.20.motu: Ta baineto “Lau ese Dirava na ura heniamu”, a tadikakana e inai heniamu, ia na koikoi tauna. Badina be tadikakana, e itaiamu tauna, na basinema ura henia, se itaiamu Diravana ede bema ura henia toma?
1JN.4.20.english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

1JN.4.11.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, Dirava ese unu e ura henida toma dainai, ita danu baita heura heheni ani?
1JN.4.11.english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

1JN.2.4.motu: Ta baineto “Lau na dibagu ia”, a ena haheḡani basine badina, ia na koikoi tauna, hereva momokani na ia lalona ai se miamu.
1JN.2.4.english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

1JN.2.7.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, lau na haheḡani matamatana ta asina tore henimuimu, a haheḡani gunana, matamana ai vada o abia ḡauna. Ina haheḡani gunana be vada o kamonai herevana.
1JN.2.7.english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

1JN.3.1.motu: Mani a laloa, Tamada ese iura-henina bada herea vada e henida, Dirava natuna e gwauraidamu. Momokani, ita na ia natuna. Una dainai tanobada na asi dibana ita, badina be asi dibana ia.
1JN.3.1.english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

1JN.5.20.motu: Ma dibada danu Dirava Natuna vada ema, laloda vada e hapararadia, Dirava Korikori baita diba helaoreana. Ita na ia lalonai, bona ia Natuna Iesu Keriso lalonai, ta nohomu. Ia bunai Dirava Korikori; ia bunai Mauri Hanaihanai.
1JN.5.20.english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

1JN.5.3.motu: Badina be Dirava iurahenina anina binai: ena haheḡani baita badina. Ena haheḡani danu dia memetau.
1JN.5.3.english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

1JN.3.2.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, harihari ita na Dirava natuna, a gabe amo ede baita heto do se hedinarai. Ina mo dibada, ia bainema negana ai, ita na ia ida-idana baitala, badina be ia anitarana korikori baita itaia.
1JN.3.2.english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

1JN.5.6.motu: Ranu bona rara amo ema tauna binai, Iesu Keriso; dia ranu amo mo, a ranu bona rara amo.
1JN.5.6.english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

1JN.3.24.motu: Ena haheḡani e hadinamu tauna na Dirava lalonai e nohomu, Dirava danu ia lalona ai e nohomu. Bena vada e henida Laumana dainai ita dibada ia na laloda ai e nohomu.
1JN.3.24.english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

1JN.5.17.motu: Kara gageva-gagevadia iboudiai na didika; a kara dika haida na dia mase karadia.
1JN.5.17.english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

1JN.3.9.motu: Dirava ena amo e vara tauna ese kara dika se karamu, badina be Dirava ena mauri na ia lalonai e miamu; taunabunai, ia na dika ikarana asi dibana, badina be Dirava ena amo e vara.
1JN.3.9.english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

1JN.2.21.motu: Lau na tore henimuimu, dia hereva momokani asi dibamui dainai, a badina be dibamui, bona dibamui danu koikoi na hereva momokani enai se taomu.
1JN.2.21.english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

1JN.3.7.motu: Natugu e, ta ese basine koimui. Kara maoromaoro e karamu tauna na maoromaoro; Dirava heḡereḡerena ia danu maoromaoro.
1JN.3.7.english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

1JN.2.15.motu: Tanobada na basio ura henia, bona tanobada ḡaudia danu basio ura heni. Tanobada e ura heniamu tauna lalonai ai Tamada iura-henina na se miamu.
1JN.2.15.english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

1JN.3.20.motu: Badina be laloda ese bae habadelaida reana; a Dirava ese ita laloda e hereadiamu, bona ia na ḡau iboudiai dibana.
1JN.3.20.english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

1JN.4.9.motu: Dirava ena lalokau na ini e hahedinarai henida toma: Dirava ese ia Natuna vara-edeana tanobada ai e siaia, ia bagunai baita mauri helaoreana.
1JN.4.9.english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

1JN.2.29.motu: Dibamui ia na maoromaoro, taunabunai dibamui danu kara maoromaoro taudia iboudiai na iena amo vada e vara.
1JN.2.29.english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

1JN.4.7.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, baita heura heheni. Badina be lalokau na Dirava ena amo, bona mai ena lalokau tauna na Dirava ena amo e vara, bona ia dibana Dirava.
1JN.4.7.english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN.5.11.motu: Herevana binai: Dirava ese mauri hanaihanai vada e henida, bona una mauri na ia Natuna lalonai.
1JN.5.11.english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

1JN.5.2.motu: Ini ta diba tomamu ita ese Dirava natuna ta ura henidiamu: Dirava ta ura heniamu bona ena haheḡani ta badinamu.
1JN.5.2.english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

1JN.4.4.motu: Natugu e, umui na Dirava ena, bena vada o hadareredia; badina be lalomui ai e nohomu laumana ese tanobada ai e nohomu laumana e hereaiamu.
1JN.4.4.english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

1JN.4.14.motu: Ai danu vada a itaia, bona dibamai, Tamada ese Natuna tanobada e siaia mai, tanobada ihamaurina totona.
1JN.4.14.english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

1JN.4.10.motu: Lalokau anina binai: dia ita ese Dirava ta ura henia, to ia ese ita e ura henida, bona ia Natuna e siaia, iseda dika kwarana ai ela.
1JN.4.10.english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN.4.6.motu: Ai na Dirava ena; Dirava mai dibana tauna ese e kamonai henimaimu, a Dirava asi dibana tauna ese se kamonai henimaimu. Hereva momokani laumana bona kerere laumana unu ta dibadia tomamu.
1JN.4.6.english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

1JN.2.13.motu: Sihi guna taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be matamana amo e nohomu Tauna na dibamui. Eregabe taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be dika tauna vada o hadarerea. Memero e, na tore henimuimu, badina be Tamada na dibamui.
1JN.2.13.english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.

1JN.2.24.motu: Matamana ai o kamonai herevana na lalomui ai baine mia. Bema matamana ai o kamonai herevana na lalomui ai baine mia, umui danu Natuna lalonai bona Tamana lalonai ba noho.
1JN.2.24.english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

1JN.5.4.motu: Badina be Dirava ena amo e vara tauna ese tanobada e hadarereamu; bona tanobada ihadarerena ḡauna na iseda abidadama.
1JN.5.4.english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

1JN.5.13.motu: Umui Dirava Natuna o abiabiraiamu taumui na tore henimuimu, vada ba diba, umui na mauri hanaihanai vada o abia.
1JN.5.13.english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

1JN.1.5.motu: Iena amo a kamonai bena umui a hamaorolaimuimu herevana binai: Dirava na diari, bona dibura sisina taina ienai dia mia.
1JN.1.5.english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

1JN.2.20.motu: A umui na Helaḡa Tauna ese vada e horomui, bena ḡau iboudiai vada dibamui.
1JN.2.20.english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

1JN.1.4.motu: Ini a tore henimui tomamu na eda moale baine ḡuḡuru totona.
1JN.1.4.english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

1JN.3.16.motu: Ini amo lalokau vada ta diba: ia ese ita daidai ena mauri e atoa diho. Una dainai ita ese tadikakada daidiai eda mauri baita atoa diho hari namo.
1JN.3.16.english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

1JN.5.9.motu: Ita ese taunimanima edia hereva ta abi daemu, a Dirava ena hereva na herea-dae; badina be Dirava ena hereva be Natuna igwaurai-hedinaraina herevana.
1JN.5.9.english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

1JN.2.8.motu: Ḡau tamona, haheḡani matamatana na tore henimuimu, ienai bona umui emui ai vada e momokani; badina be dibura vada e lao bubunimu, bona diari korikori vada e taramu.
1JN.2.8.english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

1JN.1.3.motu: Ai ese a itaia bona a kamonai ḡauna na a hamaorolaimuimu, umui ai ida orea tamona ai baitala helaoreana; ai danu Tamada bona ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ida orea tamona ai vada ala.
1JN.1.3.english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

1JN.2.6.motu: Ia lalonai e nohomu e tomamu tauna ese iena raka heḡereḡerena ai do baine raka.
1JN.2.6.english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

1JN.5.18.motu: Dibada Dirava ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na asie kara dikamu, badina be Dirava Natuna ese e gimadiamu, bena dika tauna ese se abidiamu.
1JN.5.18.english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

1JN.5.10.motu: Una hereva be Dirava Natuna e abiabiraiamu tauna lalona ai e miamu; a Dirava se abiabiraiamu tauna ese Dirava na koikoi ai e halaoamu, badina be Dirava ena hereva, Natuna igwaurai-hedinaraina herevana, ia ese e dadaraiamu.
1JN.5.10.english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

1JN.5.1.motu: Iesu e abia daemu, ia na Keriso e tomu, tauna na Dirava ena amo e vara; bona tamana e ura heniamu tauna ese natuna danu e ura heniamu.
1JN.5.1.english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

1JN.2.14.motu: Sihi guna taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be matamana amo e nohomu Tauna na dibamui. Eregabe taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be umui na mai goadamui, bona Dirava ena hereva na lalomui ai e miamu, bona dika tauna vada o hadarerea.
1JN.2.14.english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.

1JN.3.15.motu: Bona tadikakana e badu heniamu tauna na ala-ala tauna; dibamui mauri hanaihanai na ala-ala tauna lalonai se miamu.
1JN.3.15.english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

1JN.3.21.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, laloda ese basie habadelaida negana ai, ita na Dirava baita raka henia kahi, asi eda gari.
1JN.3.21.english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

1JN.3.4.motu: Kara dika tauna ese taravatu e tata utumu, badina be kara dika na taravatu itata-utuna ḡau.
1JN.3.4.english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

1JN.3.23.motu: Ena haheḡani binai: ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ladana baita abiabiraia, bona baita heura heheni, ia ese e haḡanida heḡereḡerena.
1JN.3.23.english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

1JN.4.1.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, lauma iboudiai basio kamonai henidia, a lauma ba dibadia guna, idia na Dirava ena amo eiava. Badina be peroveta koikoi taudia hutuma na tanobada ai vada e hedinarai.
1JN.4.1.english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

1JN.3.12.motu: Kain ida basio heḡereḡere; ia be dika tauna natuna, bena ia ese tadina e alaia mase. Dahaka dainai e alaia? Badina be iena kara na dika, a tadina ena kara na maoromaoro.
1JN.3.12.english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

1JN.4.13.motu: Ini ta diba tomamu ita na ia lalonai ta nohomu bona ia danu ita laloda ai e nohomu: ia ese ena Lauma vada e henida.
1JN.4.13.english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

1JN.2.28.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, ia lalonai ba noho, bena ia bainema negana ai laloda basie daradara, bona ia vairanai basita hemarai.
1JN.2.28.english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

1JN.2.2.motu: Ia na iseda dika kwarana ai ela, bona dia ita mo eda, a tanobada besedia-idoidiai edia.
1JN.2.2.english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

1JN.2.25.motu: E gwaurai henida hamata ḡauna bunai, mauri hanaihanai.
1JN.2.25.english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

1JN.5.5.motu: Tanobada e hadarereamu tauna be daika? Iesu e abia daemu, Dirava Natuna e gwauraiamu, tauna.
1JN.5.5.english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

1JN.3.13.motu: Varavaragu e, tanobada ese e inai henimuimu na basio hoalaia.
1JN.3.13.english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

1JN.2.26.motu: Ini vada na tore henimui tomamu, bae hakaumui kerere taudia daidiai.
1JN.2.26.english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

1JN.2.18.motu: Natugu e, hora dokona binai. Vada o kamonai, Keriso Inaina be maimu. A Keriso inaina hutuma vada ema; taunabunai ita dibada ina na hora dokona.
1JN.2.18.english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

1JN.5.8.motu: Ihahedinaraina be toi: Lauma bona ranu bona rara; toiosi edia hereva be tamona.
1JN.5.8.english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

1JN.3.11.motu: Badina be matamana amo o kamonai herevana binai: baita heura heheni.
1JN.3.11.english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

1JN.2.16.motu: Badina be tanobada ḡaudia iboudiai, tau-anina ena heḡahusi, mata-dika, mauri ena heaḡi kava, iri na dia Tamada ena amo, a tanobada ena amo e maimu.
1JN.2.16.english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

1JN.4.17.motu: Eda lalokau ihaḡuḡuruna binai: hahemaoro dinana ai ita na basita gari, badina be ina tanobada ai ita na ia ida heḡereḡere.
1JN.4.17.english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

1JN.1.7.motu: A diari lalonai baita raka, ia heḡereḡerena ita na orea tamona tauda, bona ia Natuna Iesu rarana ese eda dika iboudiai baine huri oho.
1JN.1.7.english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN.1.1.motu: Matamana amo e mia ḡauna, taiamai amo a kamonai, matamai amo a itaia, a raraia tao, imamai amo a daua toho ḡauna, mauri herevana, a hamaorolaimuimu.
1JN.1.1.english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

1JN.4.8.motu: A asi ena lalokau tauna na asi dibana Dirava, badina be Dirava na lalokau.
1JN.4.8.english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

1JN.3.3.motu: Ini e laroa tomamu taudia iboudiai ese sibodia e haheḡoevamu, ia eme ḡoevaḡoeva heḡereḡerena.
1JN.3.3.english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

1JN.5.14.motu: Ia ta abidadama heniamu dainai, dibada ḡau ta iena ura heḡereḡerena ai baita noia, ia ese baine hakala henida.
1JN.5.14.english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

1JN.3.14.motu: Ita dibada, mase amo mauri enai vada ta hanai, tadikakada ta lalokau henidiamu dainai. Tadikakana se lalokau heniamu tauna na dounu mase lalonai e nohomu.
1JN.3.14.english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

1JN.1.10.motu: Ḡau tamona, ita baitato asi eda kara dika, ita ese koikoi tauna ai baita halaoa, bona iena hereva na ita laloda ai basine mia.
1JN.1.10.english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

1JN.5.21.motu: Natugu e, nahuamui ba toho dirava koikoidia na garidia.
1JN.5.21.english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

1JN.4.19.motu: Ita na mai eda lalokau, badina be ia ese e lalokau henida guna.
1JN.4.19.english: We love him, because he first loved us.

1JN.2.23.motu: Natuna e ḡoreamu tauna na asi ahuna Tamana enai; a Natuna e abiabiraiamu tauna na mai ahuna Tamana enai.
1JN.2.23.english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

1KI.3.27.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e haere, eto, Mauri merona na hahine gini-gunana ba henia, basio alaia mase; sinana na ia.
1KI.3.27.english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

1KI.8.10.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia na gabu helaḡana amo e raka lasi negana ai, ori ta ese Iehova ena dubu e hahonua.
1KI.8.10.english: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,

1KI.7.6.motu: Ruma ladana Au-tubua Rumana danu e haginia; ena lata na kiubit imahui, lababana na kiubit toi-ahui. Ia vairanai na dehe toi-lasi rumana, mai au-tubuadia bona mai guhina.
1KI.7.6.english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

1KI.10.27.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese silver na ḡau pipikina ai e halaoa Ierusalem ai, nadi na heto; bona sida audia na e hahohodia, Sefela sukedia na heheto.
1KI.10.27.english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

1KI.20.16.motu: Dina tubua ai, idia na e raka lasi. Una negana ai Ben-hadad na kalaga ai vada e inuinu kekero, ia bona iduruna taudia pavapava toi-ahui rua danu.
1KI.20.16.english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

1KI.14.15.motu: Iehova ese Israel baine hamarerea, siriho na ranu ai e marere-mareremu na heto; bona Israel taudia na ina tano namona, ia ese senedia e henidia tanona, amo baine raḡadia oho, Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai baine hakarohodia rohoroho. Badina be idia ese edia au-tubua helaḡadia e karadia amo Iehova e habadua.
1KI.14.15.english: For Yahweh will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking Yahweh to anger.

1KI.18.14.motu: A harihari oi na o tomu “Aola, biagumu ba hamaoroa, baoto ‘Elia na iniseni ai’”; bena ia ese baine alagu mase.
1KI.18.14.english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

1KI.11.35.motu: A basileia na ia natuna imana amo baina abia oho, bena oi baina henimu, iduhu gwauta.
1KI.11.35.english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

1KI.14.13.motu: Bena Israel idoinai na ia taina bae tai, bona bae guria; badina be Ieroboam ena orea amo ia mo sibona gara ai bae guria, badina be ia enai Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ḡau ta ai e lalo namo heniamu, Ieroboam ena iduhu ai.
1KI.14.13.english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

1KI.20.12.motu: Ben-hadad na pavapava haida ida kalaga ai e inuinuva ai na una gwaukau herevana na ienai e kau. Bena ia ese ena orea taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Emui tuari gabudia ai ba gini. Bena edia tuari gabudia ai eha gini, hanua ituari-henina totona.
1KI.20.12.english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

1KI.20.32.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese puse dabuadia e riodia, bona kwaradia ai kwanau e ato; bena Israel pavapavana dekena ela, eto, Emu hesiai tauna Ben-hadad na e tomu “Mani emu kara ba rauagu”. Ia eto, Ia na dounu e maurimu a? Ia na tadigu.
1KI.20.32.english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’”

1KI.15.9.motu: Ieroboam, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ai, Asa ese Iuda e lohiaia matama;
1KI.15.9.english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

1KI.2.2.motu: Lau na tanobada idoinai ena lao dalana ai na laomu. Ba goada, tau doḡadoḡa ai baola.
1KI.2.2.english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

1KI.19.6.motu: Bena e itaia, ia kwarana badibadinai na dikea igabuna ta, nadi siahu amo e guraia ḡauna, bona ranu hodu ta. E aniani, ranu e inua, bena ma e hekure lou.
1KI.19.6.english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

1KI.18.43.motu: Bena ia ese ena hesiai tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, davara kahana ba raraia. Ia na ela, e roha lao, eto, Ḡau ta lasi. Ma eto, A lou lao nega hitu.
1KI.18.43.english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.”

1KI.6.33.motu: Dubu raka vareai iduaradia ihua-ihuadia kahadia kahadia audia e abi danu, olive audia kaha haniosi heḡereḡere dudia;
1KI.6.33.english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

1KI.5.4.motu: A harihari Iehova, egu Dirava, ese laḡa-ani vada e henigu, kaha iboudiai; asi inaigu bona asi ihadikagu ḡauna ta mia.
1KI.5.4.english: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

1KI.6.3.motu: Dubu vairanai na dehe ta; ena lata na kiubit ruahui, dubu lababana heḡereḡerena, bona ena lababa na kiubit gwauta, dubu vairanai.
1KI.6.3.english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

1KI.5.8.motu: Bena Hirama ese hereva e siaia Solomon dekenai, eto, Emu gwaukau herevana dekegu ai o siaia na vada na kamonai; lalogu na heḡereḡere hari sida bona beroso audia herevadia na emu ura idoinai baina karaia.
1KI.5.8.english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

1KI.16.11.motu: Ia e lohia matama negana ai, ena terono ai e helai kau dinana ai, ia ese Baasa ena iduhu taudia iboudiai e aladia ore; varavarana maruanena ta eiava turana maruanena ta se roho mauri.
1KI.16.11.english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

1KI.15.29.motu: Pavapava dagina e abia, bena maoromaoro ia ese Ieroboam ena iduhu taudia iboudiai e aladia mase; Ieroboam ena iduhu tauna ta maurina ai se rakatania, ela bona una iduhu e habuaia tari, Iehova ena hereva, ena hesiai tauna Ahia tau Silono uduna amo e gwauraia, heḡereḡerena.
1KI.15.29.english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

1KI.8.35.motu: Emu ai bae kara dika dainai guba baine hekou bona medu basine diho negadia ai, ina gabu enai bema ḡuriḡuri, bona oi ladamu bema matauraia, bona ba hahisihisidia negadia ai edia kara dika bema rakatanidia,
1KI.8.35.english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

1KI.3.19.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai ina hahine natuna e mase, badina be ia ese e enoa tao.
1KI.3.19.english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

1KI.13.33.motu: Ina kara murinai, Ieroboam ese ena dala dikana se rakatania, a taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidia amo atai gabudia edia hahelaga taudia haida ma e abidia; e urava taudia na ia ese e hahelaḡadia, atai gabudia edia hahelaḡa taudia ai baela.
1KI.13.33.english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

1KI.6.38.motu: Bena laḡani ihagwauta-tana ai, hua ihataurahanina, ladana Bulu, lalonai, dubu tau-anina regena iboudiai vada e ha-oredia. E lalohadailaiva ḡaudia iboudiai heḡereḡerena ai ia ese una dubu na laḡani hitu lalodiai e ha-orea.
1KI.6.38.english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

1KI.20.40.motu: A emu hesiai tauna na unu ini ihekwarahilaidia ai, tauna na vada e heau. Israel pavapavana ese e haere henia, eto, Ihahemaoro-henimu na unu baine heto, sibomu ese o gwauraiamu heḡereḡerena.
1KI.20.40.english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.”

1KI.12.30.motu: Bena ina na kara dika ai ela; badina be taunimanima ese ta e lao henia Betele ai, ma ta ilao-henina totona e laova bona Dan ia.
1KI.12.30.english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

1KI.18.2.motu: Taunabunai Elia na ela, Ahaba enai baine hedinarai totona. Una negana ai doe na bada herea Samaria ai.
1KI.18.2.english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

1KI.1.22.motu: Dounu hanua pavapavana ida e hereva-hereva ai, peroveta tauna Natan na e raka vareai.
1KI.1.22.english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

1KI.6.30.motu: Dubu reireina danu gold amo e ḡovaia, laloma bona murimuri daiutudia ai.
1KI.6.30.english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

1KI.16.34.motu: Iena nega ai Hiele, tau Betele, ese Ieriko e hadaia; ruma badidia e haginidia davana na natuna roboana Abiram, bona ikoukou e haginidia davana na natuna tau-muritai Segubu, Iehova ena hereva Iosua Nunu uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
1KI.16.34.english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

1KI.18.34.motu: Ma eto, A haruaia; bena nega iharuana e karaia. Ma eto, Ma a hatoia; bena nega ihatoina ma e karaia.
1KI.18.34.english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

1KI.15.28.motu: Taunabunai, Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, Baasa ese Nadab e alaia mase; bena gabuna ai e lohia.
1KI.15.28.english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

1KI.9.16.motu: (Farao, Aigupto pavapavana na guna vada e dara dae, Gesere e abia, lahi amo e doua, bona Kanaan taudia una hanua e noholaiava na e aladia ore; bena ia ese una gabu na natuna hahinena, Solomon adavana, e hadabilaia.
1KI.9.16.english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

1KI.18.28.motu: Bena idia na e lolo badabada, bona vaia edia kara dare bona io amo sibodia e heivava, ela bona raradia e aru lohilohiva.
1KI.18.28.english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

1KI.1.6.motu: Tamana ese nega ta lalona se hahisia, seto “Badina be dahaka unu ini vada o kara toma?” Ia na raho-namo tauna; ia danu Absalom murina amo e vara tauna.
1KI.1.6.english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

1KI.20.19.motu: Taunabunai, kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia na e raka lasi guna; bena tuari oreana idoinai na idia muridiai e raka.
1KI.20.19.english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

1KI.22.4.motu: Bena ia ese Iehosafat e hereva henia, eto, Oi na lau ida aitala, Ramoto-gilead ai baita tuari, ani? Iehosafat ese Israel pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Lau oi na tamona, lauegu orea bona oiemu orea danu tamona, lauegu hosi bona oiemu hosi danu tamona.
1KI.22.4.english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?”

1KI.11.27.motu: Hanua pavapavana e inai heniava badina binai: Solomon ese Milo kohorona e haginia, bona tamana David ena hanua maḡuna e ha-aukaia.
1KI.11.27.english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

1KI.6.9.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese dubu e haginia ela bona e ore; bena guhi lalo-ikouna na sida lavadia bona sida reireidia amo e karaia.
1KI.6.9.english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

1KI.6.10.motu: Hari hagere-kau rumana e haginia, dubu idoinai e hagerea kau; ere-ta ta haradia na kiubit ima ima amo. Ruma na dubu habana ai e siriua kau, sida audia amo.
1KI.6.10.english: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

1KI.18.25.motu: Bena Elia ese Baal ena peroveta taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui ba guna. Boromakau maruanena ta bavabia hidi, ba heḡaeḡaelaia; badina be umui na hutuma. Bena emui dirava ladana ba hahanea; a lahi basio karaia.
1KI.18.25.english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

1KI.13.24.motu: A e raka laova ai, leona ta ese dala ai e davaria, bena e alaia mase. Tau-anina na dala ai e henege dobi, bena doniki na ia badibadinai e gini; leona danu una tau tau-anina badibadinai e gini.
1KI.13.24.english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

1KI.1.24.motu: Bena Natan eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava e, oi o hereva, oto “Adonia na lau murigu ai baine pavapava bona egu terono ai baine helai”, a?
1KI.1.24.english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

1KI.14.23.motu: Badina be idia ese atai gabudia bona au-tubua helaḡadia e karadia, bona ororo badadia iboudiai doridia ai bona au mauridia henudiai au-tubua helaḡadia e haginidia;
1KI.14.23.english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

1KI.21.3.motu: A Naboto ese Ahaba e haere henia, eto, Iehova na se uramu senegu edia amo na abia tanona na oi baina henimu.
1KI.21.3.english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

1KI.11.31.motu: Bena ia ese Ieroboam e hamaoroa, eto, Siri gwauta bavabi emu; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: a itaia, basileia na Solomon imana amo baina darea, iduhu gwauta na oi baina henimu;
1KI.11.31.english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

1KI.12.2.motu: Ieroboam Nebata na harina e kamonai; badina be ia na dounu Aigupto ai, King Solomon e heautania negana ai e lao henia gabuna ai. Bena Ieroboam na Aigupto amo e lou.
1KI.12.2.english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

1KI.6.26.motu: Kerubi ta ena lata na kiubit gwauta: iharuana danu unuheto.
1KI.6.26.english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

1KI.9.18.motu: bona Baalata bona Tamara, tano ḡaḡaena ai, Iuda tanona ai,

1KI.2.27.motu: Taunabunai, Solomon ese Abiatara na Iehova ena hahelaḡa tauna dagina amo e lulua lasi; unu amo ia ese Iehova ena hereva, Silo ai Eli ena iduhu e herevalaia herevana, na e hamomokania.
1KI.2.27.english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

1KI.6.1.motu: Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi murinai laḡani sinahu-hani taurahani-ahui vada ela, Solomon ese Israel e lohiaia laḡanina ihahanina ai, hua iharuana, ladana Sivi, lalonai, ia ese Iehova ena dubu e haginia matama.
1KI.6.1.english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build Yahweh’s house.

1KI.12.5.motu: Ia na eto, Ba raka oho, dina toi heḡereḡerena, ma ba lou mai dekegu ai. Taunabunai, taunimanima na e raka oho.
1KI.12.5.english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.”

1KI.16.29.motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani ihatoiahui-taurahanina ai, Ahaba Omri ese Israel e lohiaia matama. Ahaba Omri ese laḡani ruahui-rua Israel e lohiaia, Samaria ai.
1KI.16.29.english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

1KI.20.5.motu: Gwaukau taudia ma ema, eto, Ben-hadad na ini e gwau tomamu: Emu ai na hesiai, nato “Emu silver bona emu gold na dekegu ba siaidia, adavamu bona natumu danu”;
1KI.20.5.english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

1KI.22.16.motu: A hanua pavapavana ese ma e hamaoroa, eto, Nega hida baina haduamu, Iehova ladana ai hereva ta basio gwaurai henigu, a hereva momokani mo?
1KI.22.16.english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

1KI.8.63.motu: Solomon ese boromakau mamaruanedia gerebu-rua daha-rua bona mamoe domaga-ta gerebu-rua e hahelaḡadia, ena herohemaino boubouna, Iehova ena. Unu a hanua pavapavana bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese Iehova ena dubu e hahelaḡaia.
1KI.8.63.english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated Yahweh’s house.

1KI.20.13.motu: Bena peroveta tauna ta ese Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, e raka henia kahi, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hegogo badana vada o itaia a? A kamonai, hari dina ai lau ese oi imamu ai baina atoa; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
1KI.20.13.english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

1KI.19.5.motu: Bena e hekure diho, roteme auna henunai e mahuta; bena aneru ta ese e daua toho, e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, avaniani.
1KI.19.5.english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

1KI.8.38.motu: bena edena ḡuriḡuri eiava edena noinoi tau ta ese eiava emu bese Israel taudia iboudiai ese, bae henimu, ta ta sibona sibona lalodia hisihisidia ihaerodia ai bona imadia ina dubu bae toi roro henia ai,
1KI.8.38.english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

1KI.10.22.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana na mai ena lagatoi oreana ta, Tarasisi lagatoidia, Hirama ena lagatoi oreana ida e heau hebou. Laḡani toi toi amo hari Tarasisi lagatoidia na e lou mai, gold bona silver bona aivori bona maniki badadia bona tukimi e mailaidia.
1KI.10.22.english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

1KI.11.30.motu: Bena Ahia ese ena dabua matamatana e dokia oho, e darea, siri gwauta-rua.
1KI.11.30.english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

1KI.3.18.motu: Lau na mara murinai dina toi vada ela, bena ina hahine danu e mara. Ai na sibomai; asi tauna ta ai ida una ruma ai, ai raruosi mo.
1KI.3.18.english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

1KI.1.3.motu: Taunabunai hane-ulato mai hairaina ta e tahua, Israel tanona idoinai; bena Abisaga, Suneme kekenina, e davana, hanua pavapavana dekena e hakaua lao.
1KI.1.3.english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

1KI.8.7.motu: Badina be kerubi ese hanidia e toidia roro, maua helaḡana ena gabu daenai; taunabunai kerubi ese maua helaḡana mai madunana audia ida e ḡovadia.
1KI.8.7.english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

1KI.21.27.motu: Ahaba ese unu hereva e kamonai, bena ia ese ena dabua e dare, puse dabuadia e dokilaidia, e anivagava, puse dabuadia ai e hekureva, bona mai lalo-metauna ida e loava.
1KI.21.27.english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

1KI.10.6.motu: Bena hari hahine ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Egu tano ai emu kara bona emu aonega haridia na kamonai iboudiai na momomo-kakani,
1KI.10.6.english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

1KI.6.21.motu: Solomon ese dubu laloma kahana na gold ḡoevaḡoevana amo e ḡovaia, bona gold varodia amo helaḡa daiutuna e seroa ahu; ma gold amo e ḡovaia.
1KI.6.21.english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

1KI.4.29.motu: Bena Dirava ese aonega bona lalo-parara bada-herea na Solomon e henia, bona lalo-hadai dobudia momo danu, kone mirina na heto.
1KI.4.29.english: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

1KI.16.7.motu: Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna lehu Hanani ena amo ma e kau, Baasa mai ena iduhu taudia ida latadiai, ena kara dika iboudiai Iehova vairanai e karava ḡaudia ai, ia imana gaukaradia amo e habadua, Ieroboam ena iduhu ida vada e heḡereḡere bona e habuaia tari dainai.
1KI.16.7.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

1KI.2.11.motu: David ese Israel e lohiaia laḡanidia na hari-ahui: laḡani hitu Heberon ai bona laḡani toi-ahui toi Ierusalem ai.
1KI.2.11.english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

1KI.2.37.motu: Badina be ba diba momokani, ba raka lasi bona Kidron sinavaina ba hanaia dinana ai vada ba mase; raramu na oi sibomu kwaramu ai baine mia.
1KI.2.37.english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

1KI.21.25.motu: Tau ta sibona se hehoi, Iehova vairanai kara havara ikarana totona, Ahaba heḡereḡerena; ia lalona na adavana Iesebel ese e ania.
1KI.21.25.english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

1KI.1.21.motu: Bena basioma hereva, egu lohia bona egu pavapava na tubu tama dekediai ba mahuta negana ai lau bona natugu Solomon na bae gwauraimai kerere taudia.
1KI.1.21.english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

1KI.6.32.motu: Hari olive audia iduaradia ruaosi na ikoro amo e ha-ahudia, kerubi bona pamu audia bona au buredia laulaudia e koro; bena gold amo e govadia.
1KI.6.32.english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

1KI.7.47.motu: Solomon ese unu ḡau iboudiai metaudia se hahetohodia, badina be idia na momo herea; hari auri labora-labora ena metau na asie davaria.
1KI.7.47.english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

1KI.8.4.motu: Iehova ena maua helaḡana bona hebou kalagana bona ḡau helaḡadia kalaga lalonai e miava iboudiai na hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ese e daelaidia.
1KI.8.4.english: They brought up Yahweh’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

1KI.14.20.motu: Ieroboam ena lohia negana na laḡani ruahui-rua. Bena ia na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; bona ia natuna Nadab ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
1KI.14.20.english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

1KI.14.25.motu: King Rehoboam ena lohia laḡanina iha-imana ai, Sisaka, Aigupto pavapavana, na ema, Ierusalem e tuari henia.
1KI.14.25.english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

1KI.10.9.motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, bae imodaia; ia ese vada e lalo namo henimu, bona Israel teronona ai vada e hahelaimu kau. Iehova ese Israel e ura henia hanaihanaimu dainai, ia ese pavapava ai vada e halaomu, hahemaoro bona kara maoromaoro ba kara helaoreana.
1KI.10.9.english: Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

1KI.20.43.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana na mai lalo-metauna bona mai baduna ida ena ruma e lou ela; bena Samaria ai e kau.
1KI.20.43.english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

1KI.22.41.motu: Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina lalonai, Iehosafat, Asa natuna, ese Iuda e lohiaia matama.
1KI.22.41.english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

1KI.12.31.motu: Ia ese danu dubu haida e haginidia atai gabudia ai, bona hahelaga taudia e duanaidia taunimanima iboudiai lalodia amo, dia Levi taudia mo lalodiai.
1KI.12.31.english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

1KI.7.28.motu: Hari rerue na ini e karadia toma: idia na mai habahabadia, tua ta ta auridia ai e kapa vareai;
1KI.7.28.english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

1KI.13.25.motu: Taunimanima haida e raka hanai, bena una tau tau-anina dala ai henege-dobina ai e itaia, bona leona na tau-anina badibadinai gini. Bena idia na ela, hari peroveta tauna burukana e noholaiava hanuana lalonai harina e piua.
1KI.13.25.english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

1KI.18.35.motu: Bena ranu ese ihaboulaina patana e arua heḡeḡe, bona dadaira na e utua dae.
1KI.18.35.english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

1KI.22.21.motu: Bena lauma ta e raka lasi, Iehova vairanai e gini, eto, Lau ese baina koia.
1KI.22.21.english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

1KI.22.30.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese Iehosafat e hereva henia, eto, Lau ese ita-itagu baina ha-idaua, bainala tuari lalonai, a oi be emu pavapava dabuadia ba doki. Bena Israel pavapavana ese sibona ita-itana e ha-idaua, ela tuari lalonai.
1KI.22.30.english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

1KI.11.24.motu: Ia ese tatau haida e haboudia, dadidadi oreana ta biaguna ai e hahelao, David ena ala-ala murinai. Bena idia na Damasko ela, unuseni ai e nohova; bena ia na Damasko pavapavana ai e halaoa.
1KI.11.24.english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

1KI.15.6.motu: Ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai Rehoboam bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheniva.
1KI.15.6.english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

1KI.8.30.motu: Emu hesiai tauna bona emu bese Israel na emai ḡuriḡuri ai na ina gabu baia vaira henia negadia ai na emai noinoi ba kamonai; oibe, emu noho gabuna guba ai ba kamonai; bona ba kamonai negana ai emai dika ba gwau tao.
1KI.8.30.english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

1KI.13.31.motu: E guria murinai, ia ese natuna e hamaorodia, eto, Baina mase negana ai, hari Dirava ena tau vada ta haguria garana ai ba gurigu; lau turiagu na ia turiana badibadidiai bavato.
1KI.13.31.english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

1KI.16.32.motu: Ia ese Baal ena dubu auta e haginia, Samaria ai; lalonai Baal ena ihaboulaina patana ta danu e larebaia.
