1KI.1.13.motu: King David dekenai ba raka vareai haraḡa, ba hamaoroa, baoto: Egu lohia bona egu pavapava e, oi ese lau, emu hesiai hahinena, o gwau henigu hamata, oto “Natumu Solomon na lau murigu ai baine pavapava bona egu terono ai baine helai”, ani? Matona, Adonia vada e pavapava badina be dahaka?
1KI.1.13.english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

1KI.7.11.motu: Idia latadiai danu dava-bada nadidia, e hahetoho bona e utu ḡoevaḡoeva ḡaudia, e heato, bona sida audia danu.
1KI.7.11.english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

1KI.18.20.motu: Taunabunai, Ahaba ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia, bona peroveta taudia e haboudia, Karamele ororona ai.
1KI.18.20.english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

1KI.20.15.motu: Bena Ahaba ese kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia e haboudia, idia na sinahu-rua toi-ahui rua; una murinai ia ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, idia na daha hitu.
1KI.20.15.english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

1KI.16.19.motu: Una na ena kara dika daidiai, Iehova vairanai e kara havara bona Ieroboam ena dala ai e raka, kara dika e karava bona Israel danu e hakaraia dikava, daidiai.
1KI.16.19.english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

1KI.1.38.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa tauna Sadok, bona peroveta tauna Natan, bona Benaia Iehoiada, bona Kerete taudia bona Pelete taudia, na e diho ela, Solomon na King David ena doniki ai e hahelaia kau; bena e hakaua lao, ela bona Gihon.
1KI.1.38.english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

1KI.20.6.motu: ḡau tamona, kerukeru, nega inihetomana, egu hesiai taudia baina siaidia vasi, bena emu ruma ai bona emu hesiai taudia edia ruma ai bae hetahu, lalodia bae ura ḡaudia iboudiai na imadia ai bae abi, bae laohai.
1KI.20.6.english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

1KI.1.43.motu: Ionatan ese Adonia e haere henia, eto, Lasi; badina be eda lohia King David ese Solomon na pavapava ai vada e halaoa.
1KI.1.43.english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

1KI.6.6.motu: Henu erena lababana na kiubit irna, bogaragi erena lababana na kiubit tauratoi, ma ere ihatoina lababana na kiubit hitu; badina be dubu habadia ai to-tao ḡaudia e kara, ruma lavadia na dubu habana lalonai basie hetoi vareai helaoreana.
1KI.6.6.english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

1KI.7.36.motu: Bona lada-tao auridia bona habahabadia ai ia ese kerubi bona leona bona pamu audia laulaudia e koro, edia bada heḡereḡeredia, bona heraheradia danu e kara heḡeḡe.
1KI.7.36.english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

1KI.14.9.motu: A oi ese e gunalaimu taudia iboudiai na kara dika ai vada o hereadiamu, vada ola, dirava idaudia bona e haveve auridia amo e kara kaivakukudia vada o kara emu; unu amo vada o habadugu, bona vada o negegu murimu kahana ai.
1KI.14.9.english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

1KI.11.10.motu: bona e hagania dirava idaudia basine badinadia Diravana, na e rakatania. Ia ese Iehova ena haheḡani se badinaia.
1KI.11.10.english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

1KI.15.13.motu: Ia ese danu sinana Maaka ena pavapava dagina e abia oho, badina be iena hahedua dainai haida ese kaivakuku dikana ta e karaia, Asera ena. Asa ese una kaivakuku e utua gari, bena Kidron sinavaina badibadinai e hagabua.
1KI.15.13.english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

1KI.16.17.motu: Taunabunai, hari Omri na Gibeton amo e dae ela, bona Israel idoinai ia ida; bena Tirisa e koua heḡeḡe.
1KI.16.17.english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

1KI.7.25.motu: Hari nau na boromakau mamaruanedia laulaudia gwauta-rua latadiai e helai kau: toi mirigini kahana e vaira henia, ma toi lahara kahana, ma toi diho kahana, ma toi laurabada kahana. Hari nau na idia latadiai e heato kau, bona iboudiai e hekunu heheni.
1KI.7.25.english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

1KI.12.20.motu: A Israel taudia na e kamonai Ieroboam vada e lou mai, bena idia ese e boiria, hebou lalonai; bena Israel idoinai pavapavana ai e halaoa. Ta na David garana murinai se raka, Iuda iduhuna taudia mo sibodia.
1KI.12.20.english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

1KI.13.14.motu: Bena ia na Dirava ena tau murina amo ela, oak auna henunai helaina ai e davaria; bena e nanadaia, eto, Oi na Dirava ena tau Iuda amo oma a? Ia eto, Oibe.
1KI.13.14.english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?”

1KI.1.2.motu: Taunabunai, ena hesiai taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hane-ulato ta bae tahua, egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu; ia ese pavapava isiaimu baine lao heni, bona baine reḡumu. Kememu ai baine hekure, egu lohia bona egu pavapava taumu baine siahu helaoreana.
1KI.1.2.english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

1KI.20.4.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana na e haere, eto, Pavapava e, egu lohia, emu hereva na momokani; lau bona lauegu idoinai na oiemu.
1KI.20.4.english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

1KI.16.21.motu: Bena Israel taudia na haheparara; kahana na Tibni Ginata murinai e raka, hanua pavapavana ai bae halaoa eto; ma kahana na Omri murina amo e raka.
1KI.16.21.english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

1KI.3.7.motu: Iehova e, egu Dirava e, ena be lau na mero maraḡina mo, to oi ese emu hesiai tauna na pavapava ai vada o halaogu, tamagu David gabuna ai. Lau na asi dibagu ede baina raka lasi toma bona ede baina raka vareai toma.
1KI.3.7.english: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

1KI.4.11.motu: Ben-abinadab, Nafata-doro idoinai lalonai, (ia ese Solomon natuna hane-ulatona Tafata e adavaia);
1KI.4.11.english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

1KI.6.29.motu: Dubu habadia danu iboudiai e korodia heḡeḡe, ita-itadia na kerubi bona pamu ḡaudia bona au buredia, laloma daiutuna ai bona murimuri daiutuna ai.
1KI.6.29.english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

1KI.7.34.motu: Tohe iabi-isina auridia na hani, rerue daigunidia haniosi ai; auri bona rerue na auri siri tamona amo e hekara.
1KI.7.34.english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

1KI.15.11.motu: Asa na e kara maoromaorova Iehova vairanai, senena David e karava heḡereḡerena.
1KI.15.11.english: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.

1KI.11.25.motu: Solomon ena dina iboudiai una tau ese Israel taudia e inai henidiava, bona e kara dika henidiava, Hadad heḡereḡerena. Ia ese Israel e inai henia badava, bona Suria e lohiaiava.
1KI.11.25.english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

1KI.7.3.motu: Atai ai, sida audia amo e koua, unu au-tubua hari-ahui ima, ere ta ta ai gwauta-ima gwauta-ima e haginidia ḡaudia, latadiai e karadia daiutudia daediai.
1KI.7.3.english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

1KI.4.20.motu: Iuda taudia bona Israel taudia na hutuma herea, kone mirina na heto; e anianiva, e inuinuva, e moaleva.
1KI.4.20.english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

1KI.6.24.motu: Kerubi ta hanina kahana kahana edia lata na kiubit ima irna amo: hani ta matana amo ela bona ma hani ta matana padadia na kiubit gwauta.
1KI.6.24.english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

1KI.22.7.motu: A Iehosafat eto, Iehova ena peroveta tauna ma ta dia noho iniseni ai, bena ia ma baitama nanadaia a?
1KI.22.7.english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

1KI.8.27.motu: A Dirava na momokani tanobada ai baine noho a? A itaia, guba atai doriva-dorivana na se heḡereḡere emu noho gabuna; matona, ina lau ese vada na haginia dubuna na ede baine heḡereḡere toma?
1KI.8.27.english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

1KI.19.19.motu: Unu amo e raka oho, bena ia ese Elisaia Safata e davaria; tauna na tano e ruaiava, boromakau mamaruanedia ruahui-hani na rua rua amo ia vairanai e rakava, a ia be gabe ḡaudia ruaosi badidiai. Elia na ia badina amo e raka hanai, bona ena hahedoki na ia latanai e tahoa kau.
1KI.19.19.english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

1KI.18.44.motu: Nega ihahituna ai, ia na eto, A itaia, ori maraḡina ta, tau ta imana na heto, davara amo e daemu. Bena Elia eto, Aola, Ahaba ba hamaoroa, baoto “Emu kariota bavabia heḡaegae, ba diho baola, medu ese baine laomu ahu na garina”.
1KI.18.44.english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.”

1KI.21.23.motu: Iesebel danu Iehova ese e herevalaia, eto, Sisia ese Iesebel bae ania, Iesrele tano-hetoana lalonai.
1KI.21.23.english: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

1KI.7.35.motu: Rerue kwarana ai na auri kuborona ta, harana latana na kiubit kahana; ena lada-tao auridia bona ena habahaba na auri tamona amo e hekara.
1KI.7.35.english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

1KI.8.11.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaga taudia na hesiai karadia ikaradia totona asie gini diba, una ori dainai; badina be Iehova hairaina ese ena dubu e hahonua.
1KI.8.11.english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

1KI.5.10.motu: Taunabunai, Hirama ese sida bona beroso audia na Solomon e henia, ena ura idoinai e haheḡereḡerea;
1KI.5.10.english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

1KI.19.20.motu: Bena Elisaia ese boromakau e rakatanidia, Elia murina amo e heau, eto, Tamagu bona sinagu aina harahudia, bena oi baina ḡavamu. A Elia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A lou lao; dahaka emu ai na kara?
1KI.19.20.english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.”

1KI.2.40.motu: Bena Simei e tore isi, doniki ta e heḡaeḡaelaia, bena ena hesiai taudia itahudia totona Gata ela, Akisi dekenai. Simei ese ena hesiai taudia eha abidia, Gata amo e loulaidia.
1KI.2.40.english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

1KI.22.26.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana eto, Mikaia ba dabaia tao, Amon, hanua lohiana, bona Ioasa, hanua pavapavana natuna, dekediai ba loulaia;
1KI.22.26.english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

1KI.22.28.motu: Bena Mikaia eto, Bema oi na maino ai ba lou mai, bena Iehova na lauegu amo vada se hereva. Ma eto, Taunimanima ibouboumui ai, a kamonai.
1KI.22.28.english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

1KI.22.32.motu: Kariota biagudia ese Iehosafat e itaia, bena idia eto, Momokani, una na Israel pavapavana. Taunabunai, idia na e heau kerehai, ia bae heatu henia eto. A Iehosafat na e lolo.
1KI.22.32.english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

1KI.4.12.motu: Baana Ahilud, Taanak ai bona Megido ai bona Bete-seana idoinai lalonai, (una na Saretan badibadinai, Iesrele henunai, bona Bete-seana amo ela bona Abele-mehola, ela bona lokomeama unukahana);
1KI.4.12.english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

1KI.7.23.motu: Bena ranu nauna bada-hereana ta auri labora-laborana, e havevea ḡauna, amo e karaia. Ia na kuboro-kuboro; ena lababa na kiubit gwauta, harana latana na kiubit ima, bona e hahetohoa heḡeḡe na kiubit toi-ahui.
1KI.7.23.english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

1KI.22.10.motu: Una negana ai Israel pavapavana bona Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, na edia terono ai hehelai, edia pavapava dabuadia e kara, uit ikwadina gabuna ai, Samaria hanua ikoukouna ai; bona peroveta taudia iboudiai na idia vairadiai e peroveta.
1KI.22.10.english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

1KI.2.28.motu: Una kara harina na Ioab enai e kau. Ioab ese Adonia e duruava, ḡau tamona Absalom na se duruava. Bena Ioab ese Iehova ena kalaga helaḡana e heau henia, bona ihaboulaina patana doana e dogodia tao.
1KI.2.28.english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

1KI.21.2.motu: Bena Atlaba ese Naboto e hereva henia, eto, Emu vine imeana a henigu, egu uma ai baina halaoa, ia na egu ruma badinai; bena lau ese vine imeana namo-hereana ta amo baina bodohilaia, eiava ba ura davana na moni baina henimu.
1KI.21.2.english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

1KI.10.7.motu: a unu hari na asina abidia dae ema bona lau nama, sibogu matagu amo name ita; a, kahana na asie hamaorogu, emu aonega bona emu taḡa ese na kamonai haridia e hereadiamu.
1KI.10.7.english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

1KI.1.52.motu: Bena Solomon eto, Baina dibaia guna: bema ia na tau namona, ia huina tamona na tano ai basine moru; a bema dika na ia lalonai baina davaria, ia na baine mase.
1KI.1.52.english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

1KI.15.23.motu: Asa ena kara oredia, ena siahu idoinai bona e kara karadia iboudiai, bona e hadai hanuadia, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani? A burukana ai ia ese hisihisi ta e davaria aena ai.
1KI.15.23.english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

1KI.22.36.motu: Dina e diho, bena tuari oreana ai haida e lolo, eto, Ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ena tano ena tano baela.
1KI.22.36.english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

1KI.7.50.motu: bona kehere bona lamepa ihagoevadia ḡaudia bona nau, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia bona gida keberedia, gold goevaḡoevana ḡaudia; bona iduara ihahelai-dobidia matudia, gold amo e kara, helaḡa-herea gabuna iduaradia bona dubu iduaradia edia.
1KI.7.50.english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

1KI.11.40.motu: Taunabunai, Solomon ese Ieroboam iala-masena dalana e tahua. A Ieroboam e tore isi, e heau, Aigupto ela, Sisaka, Aigupto pavapavana, dekenai; ia na Aigupto ai e nohova ela bona Solomon e mase.
1KI.11.40.english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

1KI.21.1.motu: Naboto, tau Iesrele, na mai ena vine imeana ta Iesrele ai, Ahaba, Samaria pavapavana, ena pavapava rumana badinai.
1KI.21.1.english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

1KI.8.34.motu: oi ese guba ai ba kamonai, bena emu bese Israel edia dika ba gwau tao, bona ba loulaidia, senedia o henidia tanona lalonai.
1KI.8.34.english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

1KI.8.36.motu: oi ese guba ai ba kamonai, bena emu hesiai taudia, emu bese Israel, edia dika ba gwau tao, bona bae rakalaia dalana namona ba hadibalaidia; bona emu tano, emu bese taudia vada o henidia bae ḡaunaia tanona, latanai medu ba hadihoa.
1KI.8.36.english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

1KI.17.17.motu: Una murinai, hari ruma biaguna hahinena natuna e gorerea; mero ena gorere e bada e laova, ela bona laḡana e ore.
1KI.17.17.english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

1KI.22.3.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui dibamui Ramoto-gilead na iseda, a ita na asi regereḡeda ta nohomu, Suria pavapavana imana amo asita abiamu, ani?
1KI.22.3.english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

1KI.9.4.motu: Oi danu lau vairagu ai boma raka, tamamu David heḡereḡerena, mai lalo-momokanina bona mai kara maoromaorona ida, bona vada na haḡanilaimu herevadia iboudiai heḡeregeredia ai, bona egu taravatu bona egu hahedua na boma badinadia,
1KI.9.4.english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

1KI.8.31.motu: Tau ta ese ia dekena tauna bema kara dika henia, bena bema haduaia baine gwau hamata, bona ena gwauhamata na ina dubu lalonai emu ihaboulaina patana vairanai bema gwauraia,
1KI.8.31.english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

1KI.8.66.motu: Bena dina ihataurahanina ai ia ese taunimanima na e siaidia oho; bena idia ese hanua pavapavana e hanamoa, bena edia ruma ela mai moaledia bona mai lalo-namodia ida, Iehova ena hahenamo idoinai ena hesiai tauna David bona ena bese Israel latadiai e hahedinaraia dainai.
1KI.8.66.english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

1KI.7.31.motu: Kwarana harana latana na kiubit ta, bona lalona na kohua mauru heḡeḡe, au-tubua lalona na heto; ena dobu na kiubit ta mai kahana. Hari lalo-heḡeḡe isena na mai heraherana; habahabana na mai daigunina hani, dia kuboro.
1KI.7.31.english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

1KI.15.3.motu: Tamana ena dala dikadia iboudiai e rakava; ia ese Iehova, ena Dirava, se badinaia momokaniva, tubuna David lalona ese e badinaiava heḡereḡerena.
1KI.15.3.english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.

1KI.18.21.motu: Bena Elia ese taunimanima iboudiai e raka henidia kahi, e hereva henidia, eto, Lalo rua ai ba raka ege raka ege ela bona edena nega? Bema Iehova na Dirava, ia murina ai ba raka; a bema Baal, ia murina amo ba raka. Bena taunimanima na hereva ta ai asie haere henia.
1KI.18.21.english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.”

1KI.3.25.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Mauri merona a dapaia parara, kaha rua; kaha ta hahine ta ba henia, ma kaha ta hahine ta.
1KI.3.25.english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

1KI.7.51.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai na King Solomon ese e karadia, ela bona vada e ore. Bena tamana David ese e hahelaḡadia gaudia na Solomon ese e vareailaidia, silver bona gold bena ḡau idau-idau, iboudiai na Iehova ena dubu ena habou-habou daiutudia ai e haboudia.
1KI.7.51.english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh’s house.

1KI.7.41.motu: au-tubua ruaosi; au-tubua doridia ikorodia mai ilahasidia kuborodia ida; bona reke-hetomana ḡaudia ruaosi hari au-tubua doridia ikorodia ilahasidia kuborodia iḡeḡelaidia;
1KI.7.41.english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

1KI.18.8.motu: Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Lau binai. Aola, biagumu ba hamaoroa, baoto “A itaia, Elia na iniseni ai”.
1KI.18.8.english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

1KI.1.32.motu: King David eto, Hahelaḡa tauna Sadok bona peroveta tauna Natan bona Benaia lehoiada a boiridia. Taunabunai, idia na e raka vareai, hanua pavapavana vairanai.
1KI.1.32.english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

1KI.20.35.motu: Iehova ena haheḡani dainai, peroveta oreana tauna ta ese ia bamona ta e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a botagu. A tauna na ibotana se ura.
1KI.20.35.english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!”

1KI.7.10.motu: Ruma badidia na dava-bada nadidia bada-hereadia: haida edia bada na kiubit taurahani, ma haida gwauta.
1KI.7.10.english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

1KI.22.51.motu: Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-hituna ai, Ahasia, Ahaba natuna, ese Israel e lohiaia matama Samaria ai. Laḡani rua hona ia ese Israel e lohiaia.
1KI.22.51.english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

1KI.11.8.motu: Unu mo e kara toma, adavana idau bese hahinedia edia; bena idia ese edia dirava vairadiai muramura mai bonadia e gabu bona boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia.
1KI.11.8.english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

1KI.17.4.motu: Sinavai ranuna do ba inua; bona galo vada na haḡanidia, idia ese bae ubumu unuseni ai.
1KI.17.4.english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

1KI.12.24.motu: “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Basiola, varavaramui Israel taudia na basio tuari henidia; ta ta emu ruma emu ruma ba lou lao, badina be ina na lauegu amo e vara”. Taunabunai idia ese Iehova ena hereva e hakala henia, edia ruma e lou heni, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
1KI.12.24.english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s word, and returned and went their way, according to Yahweh’s word.

1KI.19.15.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, emu dala ai ba lou lao ela bona Damasko tano-ḡaḡaena. Ba kau negana ai, Hasaele ba horoa, Suria pavapavana;
1KI.19.15.english: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

1KI.1.5.motu: Una negana ai Adonia, Hagiti natuna, na sibona e heaḡi, eto, Lau baina pavapava. Bena ia ese kariota bona hosi-gui taudia e abidia heḡaeḡae, bona ia vairanai bae heau taudia imahui danu.
1KI.1.5.english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

1KI.3.17.motu: Hahine ta eto, Ḡaubada e, ina hahine bona lau na ruma tamona ai a nohomu; bena ia na una ruma ai nohona ai, lau na na mara, mero ta na abia.
1KI.3.17.english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

1KI.5.7.motu: Hirama ese Solomon ena hereva e kamonai negana ai na e moale dikadika, eto, Hari dina ai Iehova aita hanamoa; ia ese natuna mai aonegana na David vada e henia, ina bese badana ikwarana.
1KI.5.7.english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

1KI.7.8.motu: Ia sibona baine noholaia rumana, maḡu ta ai, una ruma murina kahana ai, na una dala heḡereḡerena ai e karaia. Solomon ese danu ruma auta ma e haginia, una ruma heḡereḡerena, Farao natuna, vada e adavaia hahinena, ena.
1KI.7.8.english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

1KI.13.30.motu: Bena hari tau tau-anina na sibona ena gara ai e atoa; bena idia ese e taitaia, eto, Tadigu o, ihabaimu.
1KI.13.30.english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

1KI.9.25.motu: Laḡani ta ta ai Solomon ese nega hatoi amo ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia na e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana, ia ese vada e haginia ḡauna, latanai; bona muramura mai bonana na Iehova vairanai e gabua. Unu amo dubu iḡaukaralaina vada e haguḡurua.
1KI.9.25.english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to Yahweh three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before Yahweh. So he finished the house.

1KI.21.26.motu: Kara dikahereadia danu e karava, dirava koikoidia igavadia ai, Amoro taudia, Iehova ese Israel taudia vairadiai e luludia lasi besena, e karava heḡereḡerena.
1KI.21.26.english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

1KI.1.7.motu: Bena ia ese Ioab Seruia bona hahelaḡa tauna Abiatara ida e henega bou; bena idia na Adonia murinai e raka, bona e durua.
1KI.1.7.english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

1KI.2.8.motu: Simei Gera, tau Beniamina, Bahurimi amo, danu na oi dekemu ai. Mahanaim nala dinana ai ia ese hereva metaudia amo e ihi-ihiraigu; bena Ioridane sinavaina badinai lau dekegu ai e diho ema negana ai na na gwau henia hamata, Iehova ladana ai, nato, Dare amo basina alamu mase.
1KI.2.8.english: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

1KI.2.26.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese hahelaḡa tauna Abiatara e hereva henia, eto, Emu tano Anatoto baola; badina be davamu maorona na mase. A ina nega ai basina alamu mase, badina be Ḡaubada Iehova ena maua helaḡana na tamagu David vairanai o huaiava, bona tamagu ida o hisihisi hebouva, iena hisihisi iboudiai lalodiai.
1KI.2.26.english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord Yahweh’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

1KI.21.28.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Elia, tau Tisbe, enai e kau, eto,
1KI.21.28.english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

1KI.7.27.motu: Ia ese danu rerue gwauta auri labora-labora amo e karadia. Rerue ta ena lata na kiubit hani, lababana na kiubit hani, bona harana latana na kiubit toi.
1KI.7.27.english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

1KI.12.10.motu: Bena hari ia ida e vara isi hebou taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Hari vada e hamaoromu, eto “Tamamu ese emai maduna e hametaua a oi ese ba haharaḡaia”, taudia na ini ba haere henidia toma, baoto “Lau imagu kwakikwakina maraḡina udunana ese tamagu mamuna udunana na e hereaiamu;
1KI.12.10.english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

1KI.18.33.motu: Au rakuraku e lae heḡaeḡae, bena boromakau maruanena na e ivaia sisi, au latadiai e atoa kau. Bena eto, Hodu auhani ranu amo ba hahonudia, gole-oho boubouna ḡauna latanai ba seia, bona au latadiai danu.
1KI.18.33.english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

1KI.21.5.motu: A adavana Iesebel na ia dekena ela, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka lalomu e hisihisimu bona so anianimu?
1KI.21.5.english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

1KI.21.12.motu: idia ese anivaga e gwauraia, bona Naboto na atai ai e hahelaia, taunimanima bogaragidiai.
1KI.21.12.english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

1KI.4.1.motu: A King Solomon na Israel idoinai pavapavana.
1KI.4.1.english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

1KI.13.5.motu: Ihaboulaina patana danu e heḡiḡi dobi, bona latana kahuna e hebubu nege, hari Dirava ena tau ese Iehova ena hereva dainai vada e henidia toana heḡereḡerena.
1KI.13.5.english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.

1KI.15.7.motu: Abiama ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani? Abiama bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheniva.
1KI.15.7.english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

1KI.14.17.motu: Bena Ieroboam adavana e tore isi, e raka lav, Tirisa ai e kau; bena ruma iduarana ai e kau negana ai, mero vada e mase.
1KI.14.17.english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

1KI.8.65.motu: Taunabunai, Solomon ese aria e karaia una negana ai, bona Israel idoinai ia ida, hegogo bada-hereana, Hama e raka vareai gabuna amo ela bona Aigupto Dokana. Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai, aria dinadia na hitu.
1KI.8.65.english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

1KI.11.7.motu: Bena Solomon ese Kemoso, Moab taudia edia dirava dikana, bona Molek, Amono taudia edia dirava dikana, edia atai gabuna helaḡana e hadaia, ororo ta dorina ai, Ierusalem mairiveina kahana ai.
1KI.11.7.english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

1KI.13.3.motu: Una dina ai ia ese toa ta e herlidia, eto, Ina na hari Iehova vada e hereva toana: a itaia, ihaboulaina patana bae giḡia dobi, bona ia latanai e miamu kahudia na bae hebubu nege.
1KI.13.3.english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

1KI.18.42.motu: Taunabunai Ahaba na ela, baine aniani bona baine inuinu totona. A Elia na Karamele dorina e dae ela; bena tano ai e igo diho, vairana na tuina padadiai e atoa.
1KI.18.42.english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

1KI.22.12.motu: Bona peroveta taudia iboudiai danu unu e peroveta toma; ma eto, Ramoto-gilead baola, ba kwalimu; Iehova ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baine atoa.
1KI.22.12.english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

1KI.6.27.motu: Kerubi ruaosi na helaḡa daiutuna ai e atodia; hanidia na e hetoi roro, bena kerubi ta hanina ta na haba ta ai e hetomu kau, ma kerubi ta hanina ta na haba kahana ai ma e hetomu kau; a hanidia iharuadia na dubu bogaraginai e hetomu heheni.
1KI.6.27.english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

1KI.1.9.motu: Bena Adonia na gabu ta ladana Gaigai Nadina ela, En-rogele kahana ai; unuseni ai ia ese mamoe bona boromakau bona heubu ḡaudia na ihaboulaina patana ai e hahelaḡadia. Hanua pavapavana natuna, ia tadikakana iboudiai, bona hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia iboudiai Iuda tanona ai, na e vavedia;
1KI.1.9.english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

1KI.18.17.motu: Ahaba ese Elia e itaia. Bena Ahaba ese e hereva henia, eto, Israel iharaivana taumu, ena oi a?
1KI.18.17.english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

1KI.18.38.motu: Bena Iehova ena lahi e moru dobi, hari ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna e haḡolea oho, bona au, bona nadi, bona ḡahu; bona dadaira ranuna danu e hakaukaua.
1KI.18.38.english: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

1KI.19.11.motu: Iehova eto, A raka lasi, ororo ai ba gini Iehova vairanai. Bena Iehova na e raka hanai; lai badana mai goadana ida ese ororo e hapararadia bona nadi e hamakohidia rohoroho Iehova vairanai. A Iehova na dia una lai lalonai. Lai murinai tano e laga; a Iehova na dia tano-laga lalonai.
1KI.19.11.english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.”

1KI.6.20.motu: Hari helaḡa daiutuna ena lata na kiubit ruahui, lababana danu kiubit ruahui, bona harana latana danu kiubit ruahui; gold ḡoevaḡoevana amo e ḡovaia. Ihaboulaina patana danu sida audia amo e karaia.
1KI.6.20.english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

1KI.22.6.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese peroveta taudia e haboudia, tatau sinahu-hani sisivana; bena e nanadaidia, eto, Ramoto-gilead baina tuari henia eiava basina tuari henia? Idia na e haere, eto, Vada aola; badina be Ḡaubada ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baina atoa.
1KI.22.6.english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?”

1KI.9.6.motu: A lau iḡavagu amo boma raka siri, oi eiava natumu, bona egu haheḡani bona egu taravatu, oi vairamu ai vada na atodia ḡaudia, na basioma badinadia, a boma lao, dirava idaudia isiaidia boma lao heni bona boma toma henidia diho,
1KI.9.6.english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

1KI.7.9.motu: Ini ruma iboudiai na dava-bada nadidia amo e haginidia; nadi iboudiai na e hahetohodia, bona iri amo e iridia ḡoevagoeva, kahana kahana, badidia ela bona doridia, bona Iehova ena dubu maḡuna ela bona maḡu badana.
1KI.7.9.english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

1KI.14.18.motu: Israel idoinai ese e guria, bona taina e tai, Iehova ena hereva, ena hesiai tauna, peroveta tauna Ahia, uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
1KI.14.18.english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

1KI.19.14.motu: Ia na eto, Lau na vaḡeḡe herea, Dirava, Iehova Sabaota dainai; badina be Israel taudia ese oiemu taravatu vada e rakatania, emu ihaboulaina patadia danu vada e ḡigidia dobi, emu peroveta taudia na dare amo vada e aladia mase; bona lau mo sibogu na nohomu. Bena lauegu mauri e tahuamu, bae abia oho e tomamu.
1KI.19.14.english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

1KI.9.19.motu: bona Solomon ena kohu-habou hanuadia iboudiai, bona ena kariota hanuadia, bona ena hosi-gui taudia edia hanua, bona Solomon e urava baine haginidia ḡaudia iboudiai Ierusalem ai bona Lebanon ai bona e lohiaiava tanona idoinai lalonai, na idia ese e haginidia.
1KI.9.19.english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

1KI.18.22.motu: Bena Elia ese taunimanima na e hamaorodia, eto, Lau na Iehova ena peroveta tauna, lau mo sibogu noho, a Baal ena peroveta taudia na sinahuhani imahui.
1KI.18.22.english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

1KI.11.3.motu: Ia adavana korikori, lohia hahinedia, na sinahu hitu; ma hahine haida sinahu toi danu e adavadia; bena adavana verina ese lalona e aniava.
1KI.11.3.english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

1KI.7.22.motu: Au-tubua doridia ai na sosana heraheradia laulaudia. Autubua ikaradia na unu e ha-orea toma.
1KI.7.22.english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

1KI.22.2.motu: A laḡani ihatoina ai Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, na e diho ela, Israel pavapavana dekenai.
1KI.22.2.english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

1KI.13.32.motu: Badina be iena hereva, Iehova ena hereva dainai ia ese ihaboulaina patana Betele ai bona Samaria hanuadia edia atai gabudia dubudia iboudiai e boi henidia lao herevana, na momokani anina do baine vara.
1KI.13.32.english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

1KI.8.18.motu: A Iehova ese tamagu David e hamaoroa, eto “Emu lalo-hadai be lau ladagu dubuna auta ba haginia, bona unu o laloa tomamu be namo;
1KI.8.18.english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

1KI.12.8.motu: To una hahealo tau badadia ese e henia na ia ese e dadaraia; bona eregabe taudia, ia ida e vara isi hebouva bona ia vairanai e giniva taudia, ida e henega bou.
1KI.12.8.english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

1KI.4.15.motu: Ahimasa, Napatali ai, (ia ese Solomon natuna hane-ulatona Basemata e adavaia);
1KI.4.15.english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

1KI.16.27.motu: Omri ena kara orena, bona ena siahu e hahedinaraia, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore ani?
1KI.16.27.english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

1KI.7.32.motu: Ava-keikeidia haniosi na habahaba henudiai; itoilaidia auridia bona rerue na auri tamona amo e hekara. Ava-keikei ta harana na kiubit ta mai kahana.
1KI.7.32.english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

1KI.14.30.motu: Rehoboam bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheni hanaihanaiva.
1KI.14.30.english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

1KI.16.15.motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani iharuahui-hituna ai, Simiri na dina hitu Tirisa ai e lohia. Una negana ai tuari taudia na Gibeton, Filistia taudia edia hanua ta, ituari-henina ela, e koua heḡeḡe.
1KI.16.15.english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

1KI.16.28.motu: Bena Omri na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta, Samaria ai e guria; bona natuna Ahaba ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
1KI.16.28.english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

1KI.10.28.motu: Solomon ena hosi na Aigupto bona Kue amo e abidia; hanua pavapavana ena hoihoi taudia ese Kue amo e abidia, mai davadia.
1KI.10.28.english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

1KI.19.1.motu: Ahaba ese Elia ena kara iboudiai na Iesebel e hamaorolaia, bona peroveta taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia mase sivaraina danu.
1KI.19.1.english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

1KI.22.15.motu: Ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai e kau; bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Mikaia, ai ese Ramoto-gilead na baia tuari henia eiava basia tuari henia? Bena Mikaia ese e haere henia, eto, Aola, ba kwalimu; Iehova ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baine atoa.
1KI.22.15.english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?”

1KI.7.15.motu: Ia ese au-tubua rua auri labora-labora e havevea bona e hahetaria ḡauna amo e karadia. Au-tubua ta ena lata na kiubit gwauta-taurahani, bona ena kuboro na kiubit gwauta-rua. Ia na auri kuborona lalona kohua; kopina udunana na ima kwakikwaki hani e haheboudia udunana heḡereḡerena. Au-tubua iharuana danu unu e karaia toma.
1KI.7.15.english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

1KI.20.34.motu: Bena Ben-hadad ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu ese tamamu ena amo e abi oho hanuadia na lau ese ma baina henimu lou, bona emu hoihoi gabudia danu ba kara Damasko ai, tamagu ese Samaria ai e kara heḡereḡerena. Bena Ahaba eto, Unu bema heto, baina kahumu nege. Bena raruosi e hegwau hamata heheni; bena ia ese e kahua nege.
1KI.20.34.english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.”

1KI.11.20.motu: Hari Tapene tadina ena amo ia ese natuna maruanena, ladana Genubata, e havaraia; bena Tapene ese una mero na Farao ena ruma ai rata amo e butua oho. Hari Genubata na Farao ena ruma ai e nohova, Farao natuna mamaruanedia bogaragidiai.
1KI.11.20.english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

1KI.3.3.motu: Solomon ese Iehova e ura henia, bona tamana David ena taravatu ai e rakava; ḡau tamona, ia ese danu atai gabudia ai boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiava bona muramura mai bonadia e gabudiava.
1KI.3.3.english: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

1PE.3.1.motu: Hahine e, umui danu adavamui ba kamonai henidia, bena idia haida, ena be hereva asie abia daemu, to umui emui kara daidiai do bae helalo kerehai,
1PE.3.1.english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

1PE.3.20.motu: Idia na gunaguna e gwau ede-edeva, Noa lagatoi e karaia negana ai, bena Dirava ese e naridiava mai haheaukana ida; a una lagatoi ai taunimanima dia hoho, taurahani hona, ranu amo e hamauridia.
1PE.3.20.english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

1PE.1.13.motu: Lalomui ba haḡoeva, ba haheauka. Iesu Keriso baine hedinarai negana ai emui ai baine kau hariharina ba laroa mai lalomui idoidiai.
1PE.1.13.english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

1PE.1.10.motu: Peroveta taudia, Dirava ena harihari-bada emui ai baine kau e gwauraia guna taudia, ese hari hahemauri e henanadailaia bona e tahua malaka-malaka.
1PE.1.10.english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

1PE.2.10.motu: Gunaguna umui na asi besemui, a harihari umui na Dirava ena bese. Gunaguna ta ese se bogamui hisi, a harihari hebogahisi vada o davaria.
1PE.2.10.english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

1PE.2.16.motu: Umui na ura kwalimu taumui, to emui ura kwalimu na kara dika dalana ikehona ḡauna ai basio halaoa; Dirava isiaina ba lao heni.
1PE.2.16.english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

1PE.5.5.motu: Eregabe taumui e, umui ese heitatao taudia ba kamonai henidia. Iboumui ai, lalo-manau ba hahedokilaia; badina be Dirava ese hekokoroku taudia e laodia ahumu, a manau taudia e harihari henidiamu.
1PE.5.5.english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” + 5:5 Proverbs 3:34

1PE.4.15.motu: Dia namo umui ta baine hisihisi ala-ala dainai, eiava henao dainai, eiava kara dika dainai, eiava hesivarai dainai;
1PE.4.15.english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

1PE.5.1.motu: Umui hahidaosi ekalesia ita-taona taumui aina hahealo henimui. Lau danu heitatao taugu. Keriso e hisihisiva lau danu na itaia, bona baine hedinarai hairaina ai lau danu mai ahugu.
1PE.5.1.english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

1PE.5.12.motu: Ina revareva sina na Siluano imana amo vada na torea heau heau. Lau na tomamu ia na varavara korikori. Na haduamuimu, Dirava ena harihari-bada korikorina binai; ia lalonai ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
1PE.5.12.english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

1PE.2.20.motu: Umui na ba kara dika, bena bae dadabamui negana ai ba haheauka, namona be dahaka? A ba kara namo, bena hisi bavani negana ai ba haheauka, una na mai hahenamona Dirava ena amo.
1PE.2.20.english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

1PE.5.6.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava imana siahuna henunai ba hahemanau, bena negana baine gini dae ia ese do baine abimui isi.
1PE.5.6.english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

1PE.5.13.motu: Ekalesia oreana Babulono ai, umui bamomui e abidia hidi taudia, ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Natugu Mareko ese danu e hahenamo henimuimu.
1PE.5.13.english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

1PE.1.11.motu: Keriso ena lauma lalodia ai e nohova; Keriso baine ani hisidia bona murinai baine abi hairaidia e hadibalaidiava; bena idia ese negana bona toana e tahuva.
1PE.1.11.english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

1PE.4.2.motu: Taunabunai, emui mauri orena tau-animui ai, taunimanima edia heḡahusi ḡaudia basio badina, a Dirava ena ura hari ba badinaia.
1PE.4.2.english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

1PE.4.12.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, hisihisi lahi na heto emui ai e kaumu na basio daradaralaia, basioto ḡau idauna ta emui ai e varamu: lasi, ena na itoholaimui ḡauna mo.
1PE.4.12.english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

1PE.5.2.motu: Dirava ena mamoe serina ba reḡudia. Ba itadia tao, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena; dia gwaugwau amo, a lalodia iha-uradia amo; dia kohu idavarina totona, a lalomui e uramu dainai;
1PE.5.2.english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

1PE.4.18.motu: Bona kara maoromaoro tauna na mauri iabina baine hekwarahi, Dirava se badinaiamu tauna eiava kara dika tauna na ede baine gini toma?
1PE.4.18.english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?” + 4:18 Proverbs 11:31

1PE.3.9.motu: Kara dika bona ere dika basio hadava, a e hadikamuimu taudia ba hanamodia. Badina be una totona vada e boirimui, bona una dainai baine hanamomui.
1PE.3.9.english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

1PE.5.9.motu: Ba laoa ahu, abidadama ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka; ba diba, o animu hmisidia heḡereḡeredia varavaramui tanobada heḡeḡe-madai ai danu e animu.
1PE.5.9.english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

1PE.1.17.motu: Taunimanima e hahemaoro henidiamu negadia ai na oromadia se lalomu, a ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara daidiai e hahemaoro henidiamu, Diravana o hahaneamu, Tamamui o gwauraiamu; benaini, ina emui noho-hedoa negana ai ba noho mai garimui ida.
1PE.1.17.english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

1PE.1.2.motu: Ita Tamada Dirava ese e abimui hidi guna, bena Lauma Helaḡa ese e hahelaḡamui, Iesu Keriso ba kamonai henia bena ia rarana ese baine nevarimui helaoreana. Hariharibada bona maino emui ai bae bada.
1PE.1.2.english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

1PE.1.25.motu: A Lohiabada ena hereva do baine hesiriu hanaihanai.
1PE.1.25.english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” + 1:25 Isaiah 40:6-8

1PE.3.5.motu: Sene hahinedia helaḡadia, Dirava e abidadama heniava hahinedia, unu e hera tomava, bona adavadia e kamonai henidiava.
1PE.3.5.english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

1PE.1.9.motu: Emui abidadama huahuana do bavabia, laumamui ihamauridia benai.
1PE.1.9.english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

1PE.4.7.motu: Ḡau iboudiai dokodia vada be kaumu; ba boga auka, ba gima, ba ḡuriḡuri.
1PE.4.7.english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

1PE.1.8.motu: Ena be nega ta asio itaia, to o ura heniamu; ena be asio itaiamu, to o abidadama heniamu bona o moalelaiamu; emui moale na asi igwauraina dalana, o moale hisi daemu.
1PE.1.8.english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

1PE.5.11.motu: Siahu na ia ena, ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
1PE.5.11.english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.1.7.motu: Emui abidadama e tohoamu, gold lahi ai e tohoamu na heto. Ena namo ese gold ena namo e hereaiamu; ia na ihanamolaimui bona iheatolaimui bona imatauraimui ḡauna ai bainela, Iesu Keriso baine hedinarai dinana ai.
1PE.1.7.english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

1PE.5.10.motu: Umui na nega sina mo ba hisihisi; bena harihari-bada idoinai Diravana, Keriso dainai ena mia-hanaihanai hairaina iabina vada e boirimui Diravana, ese baine hanamomui ḡuḡuru, baine haginimui tutukatutuka, baine hakwalimumui.
1PE.5.10.english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

1PE.3.12.motu: Badina be Lohiabada ese kara maoromaoro taudia e haḡerediamu,
1PE.3.12.english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,

1PE.3.18.motu: Badina be Keriso nega tamona mo e mase, dika iabio-hodia; kara maoromaoro tauna ese kara gageva-gageva tauda e hebodohilaida, baine hakauda lou Dirava enai helaoreana. Tau-anina e alaia, a laumana e hamauria;
1PE.3.18.english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

1PE.1.3.motu: Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, aita imodaia. Iena hebogahisi na bada herea dainai, ia ese vada e havarada lou, mauri helarona ai, Iesu Keriso mase amo e tore isi lou dainai.
1PE.1.3.english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

1PE.4.11.motu: Ta baine haroro, ia na Dirava ena hereva baine gwaurai. Ma ta baine hekaha, ia na Dirava ese e heniamu goadana amo baine hekaha. Unu amo ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Dirava ba imodaia Iesu Keriso bagunai: hairai bona siahu na iena, ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
1PE.4.11.english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.4.13.motu: A Keriso ida o hisihisi heboumu dainai ba moale; gabeai ia hairaina baine hedinarai negana ai ba moale hisi dae.
1PE.4.13.english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

1PE.2.2.motu: Lauma ena rata ḡoevaḡoevana ba ura henia, memero karukarudia na heheto; unu amo ba bada oho bada oho, ela bona hahemauri bavabia.
1PE.2.2.english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

1PE.2.7.motu: Taunabunai, o abiabiraiamu taumui emui ai ia na herea dae; a gwau-edeede taudia ediai,
1PE.2.7.english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,

1PE.2.5.motu: Umui danu bae larebamui dae, mauri nadidia na heheto, lauma ena dubu ai baola, hahelaḡa taumui ai baola, lauma ena boubou ḡaudia ba hahelaḡa, Iesu Keriso dainai Dirava ese baine abi dae ḡaudia.
1PE.2.5.english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1PE.3.14.motu: A bema hisi bavani, kara maoromaoro dainai, ba namo. Edia hahegari herevadia na garidia basio gari; kudoumui danu basie hetaha.
1PE.3.14.english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.” + 3:14 Isaiah 8:12

1PE.3.8.motu: Hereva orena binai: iboumui ai lalomui bae tamona; ba hekaha heheni, ba heura heheni, tadikaka na heheto. Ba hebogahisi heheni; ba manau.
1PE.3.8.english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

1PE.2.6.motu: Badina be buka ai ini e torea toma,
1PE.2.6.english: Because it is contained in Scripture,

1PE.4.8.motu: A herea-daena binai: ba heura heheni mai lalomui idoidiai, badina be uraheni ese kara dika momo e tahunimu.
1PE.4.8.english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

1PE.5.8.motu: Ba boga auka, ba gima; inaimui diabolo na e loamu mai ḡouna ida, leona na heto, baine anidia ore taudia na e tahudiamu.
1PE.5.8.english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

1PE.3.16.motu: Lalomui bae ḡoevaḡoeva; bena bae maumauraimui, dikamui bae gwaurai, taudia na emui kara namo Keriso lalonai o karamu ese do bae hahemaraidia.
1PE.3.16.english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

1PE.3.17.motu: Badina be Dirava baine ura emui kara namo daidiai ba hisihisi, una na namo; a dia namo emui kara dika daidiai ba hisihisi.
1PE.3.17.english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

1PE.2.15.motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura be emui kara namo amo kavakava taudia edia hereva kava ba tuidia.
1PE.2.15.english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

1PE.1.21.motu: Ia bagunai Dirava o abidadama heniamu; Dirava ese mase amo e hatorea isi bona hairaina e henia; taunabunai emui abidadama bona emui helaro na Dirava enai mimia.
1PE.1.21.english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

1PE.1.5.motu: Abidadama dainai Dirava ena siahu ese e gimamuimu, ela bona vada e seua hahemaurina, nega gabena ai baine hedinarai ḡauna, bavabia.
1PE.1.5.english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

1PE.2.4.motu: Ia dekena aoma; ia na nadi maurina, taunimanima ese e dadaraia, a Dirava ese vada e abia hidi, davana bada nadina ai vada e hataoa.
1PE.2.4.english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

1PE.1.20.motu: Tanobada do se havaraia negana ai e abia heḡaeḡae, a ini dina gabedia ai vada eme hedinarai, umui daimui ai.
1PE.1.20.english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

1PE.4.6.motu: Badina bunai sivarai namo na mase taudia e harorolai henidia, bena, ena be tau-anidia e hahemaoro henidia, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia, to laumadia na do bae mauri, Dirava maurina ai.
1PE.4.6.english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

1PE.4.9.motu: Ba heabi dae heheni, basio maumau.
1PE.4.9.english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

1PE.1.6.motu: Una dainai, ena be ina nega sina ai hedibaḡani momodaidiai daramui e dokomu, to ba moale.
1PE.1.6.english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

1PE.1.14.motu: Kamonai memeromui ai baola. O diburava negadia ai o ḡahusiva ḡaudia na basio haḡoidia;
1PE.1.14.english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

1PE.3.15.motu: A Keriso na lalomui ai ba hahelaḡaia, emui Lohiabada. Ba heḡaegae, emui helaro badina bae nanadailaimui taudia na ba haere henidia, to, ba haere mai manaumui bona mai hematauraimui ida.
1PE.3.15.english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

1PE.1.16.motu: Badina be vada e torea, Umui na ba helaḡa, badina be lau name helaḡa.
1PE.1.16.english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.” + 1:16 Leviticus 11:44-45

1PE.1.12.motu: E hadibadia danu, unu ḡau e ḡaukaralaidia na dia idia edia, to umui emui; bona harihari sivarai namo e harorolai henimui taudia ese vada e gwaurai, Lauma Helaḡa guba amo vada e siaia diho dainai. Unu ḡau aneru ese itana urana e uramu e tomamu.
1PE.1.12.english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

1PE.2.13.motu: Taunimanima edia taravatu iboudiai ba badina, Lohiabada dainai. Hanua pavapavana ba kamonai henia, badina be ia na herea.
1PE.2.13.english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

1PE.3.3.motu: Heramui namodia na dia kopimui heradia, dia hui ipanina, eiava gold heraheradia, eiava dabua namo-hereadia idokilaidia;
1PE.3.3.english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

1PE.4.4.motu: Harihari idia na e hoamu, badina be umui na asio bamodiamu, idia ida asio lebulebu heboumu; taunabunai dikamui e gwauraimu.
1PE.4.4.english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

1PE.4.14.motu: Keriso ladana dainai bae gwau dika henimui, do ba namo; badina be Dirava ena Lauma, hairai Laumana, na emui ai baine kau.
1PE.4.14.english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

1PE.1.4.motu: Ahumui do bavabia, baine mia hanaihanai, asi bebeka-bebekana, basine marai, guba ai vada e atoa heḡaeḡae umui emui.
1PE.1.4.english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

1PE.2.23.motu: E ere dika henia, to se hedava. Hisi e ani, to se daḡedaḡe. A Hahemaoro Diravana maoromaorona e abidadama henia.
1PE.2.23.english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

1PE.3.6.motu: Sara na heto, Abraham e kamonai heniava, “lohia” e gwauraiava. Umui na ia natuna, o kara maoromaoromu bona ḡau ta garina asio garinlu negadia ai.
1PE.3.6.english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

1PE.4.3.motu: Badina be gunaguna umui na bese idauidau taudia heḡereḡeredia ai o nohova, mata-dika bona heḡahusi karadia o karava, vine ranuna o inu momova, o lebulebuva, o kekerova, kaivakuku dikadia o toma heni dihova.
1PE.4.3.english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

1PE.3.4.motu: a lalomui heraheradia, basie pata ḡaudia, lalo-manau asi daḡedaḡena: una na kohu herea-daena Dirava vairanai.
1PE.3.4.english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

1PE.4.17.motu: Badina be hahemaoro negana vada eme kau, Dirava ena orea ai aine hematama; a ita baine guna henida, Dirava ena sivarai namo e dadaraiamu taudia na ede bae heto?
1PE.4.17.english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

1PE.4.19.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ena ura dainai hisi e animu taudia ese kara namodia mo bae kara, bona laumadia na e karadia Diravana imana nuanai bae atodia.
1PE.4.19.english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

1PE.1.23.motu: Vada o vara matamata, dia baine pata ḡauna ena amo, a Mauri bona Noho-hanaihanai Diravana ena hereva dainai.
1PE.1.23.english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

1PE.2.1.motu: Taunabunai, lalo-hadai dikadia iboudiai bona koikoi iboudiai bona dibaka karadia bona ere dikadia iboudiai ba nege daure.
1PE.2.1.english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

1PE.2.3.motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena harihari-bada vada o mamia toho.
1PE.2.3.english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

1PE.2.9.motu: A umui na e abia hidi besena, hahelaḡa taudia herea-daedia, hanua helaḡana, Dirava ena orea. E abimui hidi, dibura amo e boirimui bona ena diari herea-daena ai e hakaumui lasi tauna ena kara namodia ba gwaurai hedinarai helaoreana.
1PE.2.9.english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

1PE.2.18.motu: Hesiai taumui e, biagumui ba kamonai henidia bona ba matauraidia; dia kara namo bona gado namo taudia mo, a daḡedaḡe taudia danu.
1PE.2.18.english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

1PE.1.22.motu: Hereva momokani vada o kamonai dainai laumamui vada o haḡoevadia bona varavarada o lalokau henidia momokanimu; benaini, ba heura heheni mai lalomui idoidiai.
1PE.1.22.english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

1PE.3.22.motu: Ia na guba ai vada e vareai, Dirava idibana kahana ai e helaimu; aneru bona lohia bona siahu taudia iboudiai na ia henunai e nohomu.
1PE.3.22.english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

1PE.2.22.motu: Ia ese kara dikana ta se karaia, bona ia uduna amo hereva koikoina ta se lasi.
1PE.2.22.english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.” + 2:22 Isaiah 53:9

1PE.4.5.motu: A idia na mauri taudia bona mase taudia e hahemaoro henidiamu Diravana vairanai do bae gini.
1PE.4.5.english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

1PE.2.25.motu: Badina be umui na o dobiva, mamoe na heheto; a harihari, laumamui ireḡudia bona ita-taodia Tauna vada o lou henia.
1PE.2.25.english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

1PE.1.15.motu: a e boirimui Tauna vada e helaḡa heḡereḡerena, umui danu ba helaḡa, emui kara idoidiai lalodiai.
1PE.1.15.english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

1PE.3.11.motu: Dika baine rakatania, kara namo baine kara;
1PE.3.11.english: Let him turn away from evil and do good.

1PE.5.3.motu: dia lohia taumui ai baola totona, a mamoe serina bae haḡoimui totona.
1PE.5.3.english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

1PE.4.1.motu: Keriso na tau-anina ai e hisihisiva dainai, umui ese emui lalo-hadai na iena ida ba haheḡereḡere, lalomui iha-aukadia; badina be tau-anina e hisihisimu tauna ese kara dika e rakatania.
1PE.4.1.english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

1PE.3.2.motu: emui igo-diho bona hemataurai karadia bae ita negadia ai.
1PE.3.2.english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

1PE.3.7.motu: Tatau e, umui danu, adavamui ida o noho heboumu dalana ba haeroa. Hahine ba matauraidia, badina be idia edia goada bona umui emui goada na dia heheḡereḡere, to mauri hariharina na idia mai ahudia, umui mai ahumui; unu ba noho toma, bena emui ḡuriḡuri na asi ilao-ahuna.
1PE.3.7.english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

1PE.2.14.motu: Bona gavana taudia, ia ese kara dika taudia ihadikadia bona kara namo taudia ihanamodia totona e siaidia, ba kamonai henidia.
1PE.2.14.english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

1PE.2.11.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, na noimuimu, umui na noho-hedoa taumui bona laolao taumui na heheto dainai, tau-anina ena heḡahusi karadia basio kara; idia ese lauma e tuari heniamu.
1PE.2.11.english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

1PE.2.17.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ba matauraidia. Iseda orea taudia ba lalokau henidia. Dirava garina ba gari. Hanua pavapavana ba matauraia.
1PE.2.17.english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

1PE.5.14.motu: Lalokau haherahuna amo ba hahenamo heheni. Keriso lalonai o nohomu taumui iboumui ai, maino emui ai baine mia.
1PE.5.14.english: Greet one another with a kiss of love.

1PE.2.12.motu: A bese idau-idau taudia vairadiai emui kara bae ḡoeva; bena, ena be bae habadelaimui, kara dika taumui bae gwauraimui, to emui kara namo do bae ita dainai idia ese Dirava bae imodaia, iena vadivadi dinana ai.
1PE.2.12.english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

1PE.3.21.motu: Una heḡereḡerena be bapatiso, harihari umui eme hamaurimui, dia tau-anina mirona ihuri-ohona, a lalomui ihaḡoevadia Dirava vairanai, Iesu Keriso mase amo e tore isi lou dainai.
1PE.3.21.english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

1PE.4.10.motu: E ahulaimui ḡaudia na ba hariharilai, Dirava ena harihari-bada ireḡuna taudia ai baola.
1PE.4.10.english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

1PE.2.24.motu: Ia tau-anina ai eda dika e hua, au dorina ai, kara dika enai baita mase bona kara maoromaoro enai baita mauri helaoreana. Ia berona ese vada e hamaurida.
1PE.2.24.english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

1PE.1.19.motu: a rara herea-daena, mamoe natuna asi bebeka-bebekana bona asi toutouna rarana na heto, Keriso rarana benai.
1PE.1.19.english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

1PE.5.7.motu: Emui lalo-haguhi na ia enai ba tahoa kau, badina be ia ese e lalomuimu.
1PE.5.7.english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

1PE.5.4.motu: Bena mamoe ireḡudia Tauna badana baine hedinarai negana ai, kwara-havava ḡauna mai hairaina, se maraimu ḡauna, do bavabia.
1PE.5.4.english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

1PE.1.18.motu: Bona ba diba, senemui edia kara asi anidia amo e hamaurimui davana na dia baine pata ḡauna ta, dia silver, dia gold,
1PE.1.18.english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

1PE.1.1.motu: Lau Petro, Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taugu, ese e abimui hidi taumui, Ponto ai bona Galatia ai bona Kapadokia ai bona Asia ai bona Bitunia ai o noho hedoa-hedoamu, na tore henimuimu.
1PE.1.1.english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

1PE.3.13.motu: Kara namo ba lalokau henia, bena daika ese baine hadikamui?
1PE.3.13.english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

1PE.4.16.motu: a ta ese Keriso ibadinana dainai baine hisihisi, ia na basine hemarai, a Dirava baine imodaia.
1PE.4.16.english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

1PE.2.19.motu: Badina be ina na mai hahenamona: asi ena kerere tauna ese Dirava ibadinana dainai hisi baine ani.
1PE.2.19.english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

1PE.2.21.motu: Una dainai e boirimui. Badina be Keriso umui daimui ai e hisihisiva, emui raka dalana e henimui, ia aena gabudia ai ba raka helaoreana.
1PE.2.21.english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

1PE.3.19.motu: bena ia na ela, e koudia laumadia e haroro henidia.
1PE.3.19.english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

1SA.24.16.motu: David ese unu hereva na Saulo e herevalai henia vaitani, bena Saulo na eto, David natugu e, ena oi gadomu a? Bena Saulo na e tai lolololo.
1SA.24.16.english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

1SA.18.23.motu: Bena Saulo ena hesiai taudia ese David unu e hereva henia toma. David eto, Umui o laloamu pavapava ravana ai bainala na ḡau pipikina a? Lau na ogoḡami taugu, bona asi dagigu.
1SA.18.23.english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

1SA.7.10.motu: Samuel ese ḡole-oho boubouna e hahelaḡaia negana ai, Filistia taudiae raka kahira, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona. A una dina ai Iehova gadona e kau guba rahurahu na heto, Filistia taudia latadiai, e hadaradaradia; bena e darere Israel vairadiai.
1SA.7.10.english: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but Yahweh thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.

1SA.23.29.motu: David na unu amo e dae ela, Engedi ena ororo doridia ai e nohova.
1SA.23.29.english: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

1SA.16.11.motu: Samuel ese Iese e nanadaia, eto, Natumu mamaruanedia iboudiai bini, eiava? Ia na e haere, eto, Tau muritai na dounu noho; ia ese mamoe e reḡudiamu. Samuel ese Iese e hamaoroa, eto, Hereva a siaia, bainema; badina be ita na basita helai diho ela bona ia baine kau.
1SA.16.11.english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?”

1SA.2.15.motu: Ma ina danu: digara do se haḡolea oho negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna ena hesiai tauna na bema mai, boubou ḡauna e mailaia tauna bema hereva henia, bema toma, Vamu taina na hahelaḡa tauna ba henia, baine gabua; badina be o naduamu ḡauna na oiemu amo basine abia, kasirina mo e uramu.
1SA.2.15.english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

1SA.17.55.motu: Saulo ese David e itaia, Filistia tauna ituari-henina e raka lasi negana ai, bena ia ese ena tuari oreana biaguna, Abnere, e nanadaia, eto, Abnere e, una tauhau na daika natuna? Abnere e haere, eto, Pavapava e, oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena lau na asi dibagu.
1SA.17.55.english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?”

1SA.14.5.motu: Haga-nadina ta na mirigini kahana ai, Mikmasa vairanai; ma ta diho kahana ai, Geba vairanai.
1SA.14.5.english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

1SA.31.12.motu: bena boga-auka taudia iboudiai e tore isi, e raka rani, Saulo tau-anina natuna mamaruanedia tau-anidia na Bete-sana maḡuna amo e abidia dobi. Bena Iabese ela, unuseni ai e hagabudia.
