1SA.26.21.english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

1SA.17.23.motu: Ia na idia ida e hereva-herevava ai, hari goada-herea tauna, Filistia tauna Gata amo, ladana na Goliata, na Filistia taudia edia tuari oreadia bogaragidia amo e raka lasi, ena hereva gunadia ma e gwaurai lou. Bena David e kamonai.
1SA.17.23.english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

1SA.17.21.motu: Bena Israel taudia bona Filistia taudia edia tuari oreadia na e heḡaeḡae, e hevaira heheni, bae tuari heheni eto.
1SA.17.21.english: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.

1SA.29.5.motu: Ina na David, ani, edia mavaru ai e anelaia, eto,
1SA.29.5.english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying,

1SA.24.7.motu: Unu hereva amo David ese ena orea taudia lalodia e ani, e gwaudia tao, Saulo basie ala-ala henia. Bena Saulo e tore isi, kohua e rakatania, ena dala ela.
1SA.24.7.english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

1SA.17.16.motu: Dina hari-ahui lalodiai hari Filistia tauna na e raka lasiva, e giniva; daba adorahi unu e kara tomava.
1SA.17.16.english: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

1SA.26.7.motu: Taunabunai, David bona Abisai na hanuaboi ai tuari oreana bogaragina amo ela; Saulo na unuseni ai e mahuta, taruha bogaraginai; ena io na tano ai e heholo, kwarana badibadinai. Abnere bona tuari oreana na e hekure heḡeḡe.
1SA.26.7.english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

1SA.4.15.motu: Eli ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ta-ahui taurahani, matana vada e valahu-valahu, gau ta se itaiava.
1SA.4.15.english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

1SA.10.8.motu: Bena lau vairagu ai ba raka, Gilgal baola: bena lau baina vasi, ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia baina hahelaḡadia. Dina hitu ba narigu, ela bona lau na baina vasi, ede ba kara toma na baina hadibamu.
1SA.10.8.english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

1SA.4.6.motu: Filistia taudia ese una lolo reḡena e kamonai, bena e henanadai heheni, eto, Una lolo reḡena badana Heberu taudia edia taruha ai anina be dahaka? Bena vada e diba, Iehova ena maua helaḡana na taruha ai vada e kau.
1SA.4.6.english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh’s ark had come into the camp.

1SA.15.34.motu: Una murinai Samuel na Rama ela, a Saulo na e dae ela, ena ruma ai e nohova Gibea ai, Saulo ena tano ai.
1SA.15.34.english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

1SA.17.35.motu: lau na ia murina amo nala, na botaia, mamoe natuna na ia uduna amo na hamauria. Ia ese e heatu henigu negana ai, lau ese aukina huina ai na abia, na rahua mase.
1SA.17.35.english: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

1SA.14.43.motu: Bena Saulo ese Ionatan e nanadaia, eto, A hamaorogu, ede o kara toma? Bena Ionatan ese e hamaoroa, eto, Bada-ranuna sisina na egu itotohi matana amo na abia, na mamia toho. Lau binai, vada baina mase.
1SA.14.43.english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!”

1SA.23.14.motu: A David na tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova, ororo doridia gabudia ai, Sifi tano ḡaḡaena ororodia ai. Dina iboudiai Saulo ese e tahuava, a Dirava ese ia irnana ai se atoa kau.
1SA.23.14.english: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

1SA.15.26.motu: A Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Oi ida basina lou lao; badina be oi ese Iehova ena hereva vada o dadaraia, bona Iehova ese oi vada e dadaraimu, Israel pavapavana dagina amo.
1SA.15.26.english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh’s word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

1SA.28.24.motu: Una hahine na mai ena boromakau natuna ta, ubu-ubu ḡauna, ruma ai; taunabunai ia ese e alaiaharaga. Bena flaoa e abia, e kuia, asi ihatubuna ḡauna, bena e gabua,
1SA.28.24.english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

1SA.25.12.motu: Taunabunai, David ena eregabe e raka oho, e lou lao, unu hereva iboudiai e hamaorolaia.
1SA.25.12.english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

1SA.9.19.motu: Samuel ese Saulo e haere henia, eto, Mata-hanai tauna be lau; lau vairagu ai ba rakaguna, atai gabuna ai ba dara dae. Hari dina ai, ita raruosi baita aniani hebou; bena daba ai baina kahumu nege, bona o lalo-hadailaimu ḡaudia iboudiaibaina hahedinarai henimu.
1SA.9.19.english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

1SA.19.18.motu: David na e heau, e roho mauri, Rama ela, Samuel dekenai; bena ia ese Saulo vada e kara henia karadia iboudiai na Samuel e hamaorolaia. Bena ia bona Samuel na ela, Naioto ai eha noho.
1SA.19.18.english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

1SA.24.4.motu: Bena David ena orea taudia ese e hereva henia, eto, Iehova ese e herevalai henimu dinana binai, eto “Inaimu na imamu ai baina atoa, emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena do ba kara henia”. Bena David e tore isi, asi reḡereḡena ela, Saulo ena dabua rimuna e utua oho.
1SA.24.4.english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

1SA.10.2.motu: hari dina ai, ba rakatanigu murinai, tatau rarua ida ba hedavari Rahela ena gara gabuna ai, Selesa ai. Beniamina tanona ai; bena idia ese bae hereva henimu, baeto, Itahudia ola donikidia na vada e davaridia, harihari tamamu na doniki se lalodiamu, a oi daimu ai lalona e hekwarahimu, e tomu “Ede baina kara toma natugu dainai?”
1SA.10.2.english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

1SA.25.34.motu: Badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana oi ihadikamu amo vada e gwaugu tao Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, basioma mai haraḡa bena basitama hedavari, momokani, kerukeru daba ai Nabala ena orea maruanena ta basinema mauri.
1SA.25.34.english: For indeed, as Yahweh the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

1SA.24.21.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ladana ai a gwau henigu hamata, lau dihigu na basio aladia ore lau murigu ai. bona lau ladagu na tamagu ena iduhu amo basio haboioa.
1SA.24.21.english: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

1SA.30.25.motu: Una dina amo ema bona hari dina ai, ia ese Israel taudia taravadia unu e atu toma, bona unu e hahemaoro henidia toma.
1SA.30.25.english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

1SA.19.20.motu: Bena Saulo ese gwaukau taudia haida e siaidia, David bae abia. A idia ese peroveta oreana e itadia, e perovetava, bona Samuel danu e giniva, idia ikwaradia: bena Dirava ena Lauma ese Saulo ena gwaukau taudia e rohedia, bena idia danu e perovetava.
1SA.19.20.english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

1SA.28.3.motu: Samuel be vada e mase; Israel taudia iboudiai ia taina vada e tai, bona Rama, ena hanua korikori, ai vada e ḡuria. Saulo ese danu rohe taudia bona mea taudia na Israel tanona amo vada e luludia lasi.
1SA.28.3.english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

1SA.15.11.motu: Lau na helalomu, Saulo na pavapava ai basinama halaoa bema namo; badina be ia na lau iḡavagu amo vada e lou, bona egu haheḡani se badinadiamu. Bena Samuel na e badu; ia ese Iehova e ḡanaḡana henia rani.
1SA.15.11.english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.

1SA.12.3.motu: Lau o ina; Iehova vairanai bona ia ese e horoa tauna vairanai ba habadegu. Daika ena boromakau maruanena vada na dadia? Daika ena doniki vada na henaoa? Daika vada na koia? Daika vada na hahisia? Daika imana amo hahemaoro ihagagevana monina vada na abia, matagu ihakepululaina? Ba hahedinaraia, bena baina henimui lou.
1SA.12.3.english: Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”

1SA.24.10.motu: A itaia, hari ina dina ai matamu ese vada e itaia, Iehova ese hari dina ai lau imagu ai e atomu; bena haida ese e haḡanigu baina alamu mase eto, a na bogamu hisi, nato “Imagu na basina toia roro egu lohia ihadikana totona, badina be ia na Iehova ese e horoa tauna”.
1SA.24.10.english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’

1SA.25.20.motu: Bena doniki ai e gui, ororo helavahuna amo ela; a David mai ena orea taudia ida na una dala amo e hekei ema, bena ia na idia ida e hedavari.
1SA.25.20.english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

1SA.16.23.motu: Bena lauma dikana Dirava ena amo Saulo enai e kau negadia ai, David ese gitara e abia, imana amo e hataia; bena Saulo lalona vada e matamata bona vada e namo, bona lauma dikana ese e rakatania.
1SA.16.23.english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

1SA.2.18.motu: Hari mero Samuel ese Iehova isiaina e lao heniva. Ena hahedoki helaḡana na dabua aukana amo e karaia.
1SA.2.18.english: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

1SA.20.1.motu: Bena David na Naioto Rama amo e heau, Ionatan dekena ela, eto, Lau be ede vada na kara toma? Egu dika be dahaka? Tamamu vairanai ede na kerere toma, bena ia ese egu mauri iabi-ohona dalana etahuamu?
1SA.20.1.english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

1SA.13.22.motu: Taunabunai, tuari dinana ai Saulo bona Ionatan edia orea taudia na asi edia dare bona asi edia io, a Saulo bona ia natuna Ionatan mo mai edia.
1SA.13.22.english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

1SA.17.47.motu: iniseni ai e hebou taudia iboudiai danu bae diba Iehova na dia dare mo bona dia io mo amo ena hahemauri karadia e karamu; badina be tuari na Iehova ena, bona ia ese ai imamai ai baine atomui.
1SA.17.47.english: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

1SA.7.6.motu: Taunabunai, idia na Mispa ai e hebou; unuseni ai ranu e utua, bena Iehova vairanai e bubua nege, a una dina ai e anivaga. Idia eto, Ai na vada a kara dika, Iehova vada a gwau edeede henia. Bena Samuel ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, Mispa ai.
1SA.7.6.english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against Yahweh.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

1SA.16.8.motu: Bena Iese ese Abinadab e boiria, e hagania, Samuel vairanai baine raka hanai. A ia eto, Ina tau danu Iehova ese se abia hidi.
1SA.16.8.english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

1SA.16.12.motu: Hereva e siaia, bena haida ese e hakaua mai. Ia vairana na tonika-tonika, matana na mai hairaina, bona mero raho-namona. Iehova eto, A tore isi, a horoa. tauna benai.
1SA.16.12.english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

1SA.6.13.motu: Una negana ai Bete-semese taudia na edia uit e utuava koura ai. Bena e gaga dae, maua helaḡana e itaia; bena itana ai e moale.
1SA.6.13.english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

1SA.17.15.motu: a David na Saulo ena amo tamana ena mamoe Betelehem ai ireḡudia totona e laova e maiva.
1SA.17.15.english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

1SA.15.8.motu: Ia ese Agag, Amalek pavapavana, e abia mauri, a ena orea taunimanimadia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore.
1SA.15.8.english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

1SA.8.3.motu: A idia na tamadia ena dala ai asie raka; moni iabina totona e raka siri. Idia na hahemaoro e hagagevaia, bona ihagagevana davana e abia.
1SA.8.3.english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

1SA.2.6.motu: Iehova ese e healamu bona e hahemaurimu;

1SA.20.8.motu: Taunabunai, emu hesiai tauna ba bogagu hisi, badina be emu hesiai tauna ida vada ta herohemaino, Iehova ena herohemaino ai. A bema mai egu kerere, oi sibomu bavalagu mase. Anina be dahaka tamamu dekenai ba hakaugu lao?
1SA.20.8.english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

1SA.20.34.motu: Bena Ionatan e badu dikadika, e tore isi, pata e rakatania; hua ena dina iharuana ai ia na e ani vaga, bona lalona e hisihisiva David dainai; badina be tamana ese hemarai karana e kara henia.
1SA.20.34.english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

1SA.26.10.motu: David ma eto, Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena, Iehova ese baine alaia, eiava ena mase dinana korikori ai baine mase, eiava tuari bainela bena ta ese baine alaia mase.
1SA.26.10.english: David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.

1SA.5.7.motu: Bena Asdod taudia lalodia e parara, eto, Israel Diravana ena maua helaḡana na ita dekedai basine mia; badina be ia imana na metau ita latadai, bona eda dirava Dagon latanai.
1SA.5.7.english: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”

1SA.22.9.motu: Doeg, tau Edom, na Saulo ena hesiai taudia badibadidiai e gini, bena ia na e haere, eto, Lau ese Iese natuna na itaia, ia na Nob ema, Ahimelek Ahitubu dekenai;
1SA.22.9.english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

1SA.23.25.motu: Bena Saulo mai ena orea taudia ida na ia itahuna ela. Haida ese David e hadibaia; taunabunai ia na haga-nadina ela, Maono tano-ḡaḡaena ai. Saulo ma e kamonai, benaia ese David e hahavaia, Maono tano-ḡaḡaena ai.
1SA.23.25.english: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.

1SA.28.20.motu: Bena Saulo na maoromaoro e goru parapara tano ai, bona gari ese e butua tao, Samuel ena hereva daidiai; ia taunadanu e manori, badina be ḡau ta se ania, dina idoinai bona hanuaboi idoinai.
1SA.28.20.english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

1SA.8.15.motu: Emui uma anidia bona emui vine anidia baine karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta baine abia, ena ruma ireḡuna taudia bona ena hesiai taudia baine henidia.
1SA.8.15.english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

1SA.19.12.motu: Taunabunai Mikala ese David na gaba-mauru amo e tua dobi; bena David e heau, e roho mauri.
1SA.19.12.english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

1SA.18.30.motu: Bena Filistia lohiadia na tuari totona e raka lasi loulouva, to e raka lasiva negadia iboudiai na David e kwalimu bada, Saulo ena hesiai taudia iboudiai na e hereadia. Taunabunai iboudiai ese ia ladana e heatolaia.
1SA.18.30.english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

1SA.25.17.motu: Taunabunai, ina na ba diba, bona ba haeroa ede ba kara toma; badina be biagumai bona ena ruma na bae hadikadia e tomamu, bona biagumai na e daḡedaḡe hereamu dainai ta ese basine hereva henia diba.
1SA.25.17.english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

1SA.14.30.motu: Orea taudia ese inaidia edia amo e dadi ḡaudia na hari dina ai bema ani bema namo; badina be ala-ala Filistia taudia ediai na dia bada.
1SA.14.30.english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

1SA.8.12.motu: Daha lohiadia bona imahui lohiadia baine duanaidia. Haida be ena tano iruana bona ena uma anidia iutudia baine siaidia; ma haida ena tuari kohudia bona ena kariota kohudia ikaradia baine siaidia.
1SA.8.12.english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

1SA.18.13.motu: Taunabunai Saulo ese ia vairana amo e siaia oho, daha ta biaguna ai e halaoa. Bena ia ese taunimanima vairadiai e raka lasiva e raka vareaiva.
1SA.18.13.english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

1SA.22.13.motu: Bena Saulo ese e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai taogu itorena dalana vada o tahua, oi bona hari Iese natuna? Aniani bona dare o henia, bona Dirava o nanadaia ia bagunai; una dainai ia vada e tore isi, lau ihadikagu totona, bona vada e bani henigu, hari dina ai e karaiamu heḡereḡerena.
1SA.22.13.english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

1SA.13.5.motu: Filistia taudia ese danu Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona e hebou. Edia kariota na gerebu toi, bona edia hosi-gui taudia na daha tauratoi, aedia tuari taudia na hutuma herea, kone mirina na heto. Idia na ema, Mikmasa ai e taruha, Bet-avene mairiveina kahana ai.
1SA.13.5.english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

1SA.30.6.motu: David lalona na e hisihisi bada; badina be ena orea taudia ese nadi amo ihodona e herevalaia. Badina be iboudiai na lalodia e dika. natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia daidiai. A David na e haheauka, Iehova, ena Dirava, enai goada e abia.
1SA.30.6.english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

1SA.25.44.motu: A Saulo ese natuna hahinena Mikala, David adavana, na Palti Laisi, Galimi tauna, vada e henia.
1SA.25.44.english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

1SA.12.14.motu: Iehova garina boma gari, bona isiaina boma lao heni, bona erena boma kamonai, bona Iehova ena haheḡani basioma tataia utu, bona hari pavapava, e halohiamuimu tauna, ida Iehova, emui Dirava, murina amo boma raka, una na baine namo.
1SA.12.14.english: If you will fear Yahweh, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of Yahweh your God.

1SA.1.15.motu: A Hana ese e haere henia, eto, Ḡauka e, lasi. Lau na lalo-hisihisi hahinegu. Vine ranuna eiava kekeromuramurana ta asina inua, a lalogu anina na halasiamu Iehova vairanai.
1SA.1.15.english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

1SA.1.17.motu: Bena Eli ese e haere henia, eto, Mai mainomu ida aola; Israel Diravana ese o noilaia ḡauna na baine henimu.
1SA.1.17.english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

1SA.18.17.motu: Bena Saulo ese David e hereva henia, eto, Natugu kekenina roboana Meraba binai. Baina henimu, bavadavaia. Ḡau tamona, lau daigu ai ba goada, Iehova ena tuari ba tuarilaia. Badina be Saulo na ini e laloa toma, eto, Lau basina alaia mase, a Filistia taudia hari.
1SA.18.17.english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight Yahweh’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

1SA.23.2.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Lau bainala, hari Filistia taudia baina tuari henidia, eiava? Iehova ese David e haere henia, eto, Aola, Filistia taudia ba tuari henidia, bona Keila ba hamauria.
1SA.23.2.english: Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?”

1SA.18.20.motu: Saulo natuna hahinena ta, ladana Mikala, ese David e ura heniava. Haida ese Saulo e hamaoroa; bena Saulo lalona vada e namo.
1SA.18.20.english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

1SA.20.2.motu: Ionatan ese e haere henia, eto, Lasi vaitani; oi na basio mase. A itaia tamagu na ḡau badana ta eiava ḡau maraḡina ta se karaiamu, a lau e hadibagu gunamu. Dahaka dainai tamagu na ina gau egu amo baine hunia? Unu basine kara toma.
1SA.20.2.english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

1SA.3.12.motu: Lau ese Eli vada na hamaorolaia karadia iboudiai, ena ruma taudia daidiai baina kara nato, na una dina ai baina kara henia, matamana ela bona dokona.
1SA.3.12.english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

1SA.10.27.motu: A asi lalodia taudia haida eto, Ina tau ese ede baine hamaurida toma? Bena e dadaraia, bona herahia ḡauna ta asie henia. A ia na se hereva.
1SA.10.27.english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

1SA.12.5.motu: Ia ese ma e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ese umui vairamui ai e hamomokaniamu, bona e horoa tauna ese hari dina ai e hamomokaniamu, umui ese ḡau ta lau imagu ai asio davaria. Idia eto, Ia ese e hamomokaniamu.
1SA.12.5.english: He said to them, “Yahweh is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.”

1SA.15.23.motu: Badina be gwau-edeede ena dika na babalau ena dika heḡereḡerena; bona daḡedaḡe ena dika na kaivakuku bona dirava koikoidia itomadiho-henidia heḡereḡerena. Badina be Iehova ena hereva vada o dadaraiadainai, ia ese danu emu pavapava dagina ai vada e dadaraimumu.
1SA.15.23.english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

1SA.18.7.motu: Edia moale ai idia ese ina ane e abia hebou:
1SA.18.7.english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said,

1SA.7.16.motu: Laḡani ta ta amo ia na eha laolao, Betele bona Gilgal bona Mispa e vadivadi henidia; unu gabu iboudiai ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia.
1SA.7.16.english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

1SA.25.2.motu: Tau ta Maono ai e nohova; ena ḡaukara gabuna be Karamele ai. Ia na taḡa tauna: ena mamoe na daha toi bona ena nani na daha ta. Ia ese ena mamoe huidia e utu Karamele ai.
1SA.25.2.english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

1SA.29.8.motu: Bena David ese Akisi e hamaoroa, eto, Lau be dahaka vada na karaia? Emu hesiai tauna enai dahaka kerere vada o davaria, oi isiaimu na lao heni matama dinana amo ema bona hari, bena una dainai lau na basinala, egu lohia bona egu pavapava inaina ituari-henidia a?
1SA.29.8.english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

1SA.27.1.motu: David be lalona ai eto, Dina ta lau na Saulo imana ai baina mase; egu dala namona be baina heau mauri, Filistia taudia edia tano bainala. Bena Saulo ese Israel tanona ai baine tahugu malaka-malaka elabona baine hesiku; bena ia imana amo baina roho mauri.
1SA.27.1.english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

1SA.24.17.motu: Bena ia ese David e hereva henia, eto, Oi hari kara maoromaoro tauna, a lau be lasi; badina be oi ese kara namo vada o hadava henigu, a lau ese dika na hadavalai henimu.
1SA.24.17.english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

1SA.13.23.motu: Bena Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana na e raka lasi, Mikmasa ela.
1SA.13.23.english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

1SA.29.1.motu: Filistia taudia ese edia tuari oreadia e haboudia Afek ai; bona Israel taudia na Iesrele ranu gurina badibadinai e taruha.
1SA.29.1.english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

1SA.2.16.motu: Bena una tau bema toma “Mani digara bae haḡolea oho guna, bena emu ura heḡereḡerena bavabia”, ia na bema haere, bema toma “Lasi, harihari ba henigu; bema lasi, lau ese baina dadihaia”.
1SA.2.16.english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

1SA.24.8.motu: Gabeai David danu e tore isi, kohua amo e raka lasi, Saulo e boi henia, eto, Pavapava e, egu lohia. Saulo e roha muri; bena David na tano ai e goru diho, e toma henia diho.
1SA.24.8.english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!”

1SA.25.15.motu: A una orea taudia ese ai e hanamomai, dika ta emai ai se kau, bona emai ḡau ta se boio, idia ida tano paka ai a loa hebouva dinadia iboudiai lalodiai.
1SA.25.15.english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

1SA.16.4.motu: Bena Samuel ese Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e karaia, Betelehem ela. Hanua tau-badadia na e raka lasi, ia ida e hedavari, mai kudou-hetahadiaida, eto, Mai mainomu ida vada oma eiava?
1SA.16.4.english: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

1SA.17.48.motu: Filistia tauna na e tore isi, e raka kahi, David e lao henia, negana ai David na e heau haraḡa lao tuari gabuna ai, Filistia tauna e lao henia.
1SA.17.48.english: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

1SA.30.18.motu: Amalek taudia ese e abi ḡaudia iboudiai na David ese ma e abi lou. David ese danu adavana raruosi e hamauridia.
1SA.30.18.english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

1SA.20.9.motu: Ionatan e haere, eto, Lasi ona lasi vaitani. Bama diba tamagu ese kara dikana ta e haeroamu emu ai, bama hamaoromu ani?
1SA.20.9.english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

1SA.30.14.motu: Ai na Kerete taudia edia tano diho kahana, bona Iuda tanona, bona Kaleb ena tano diho kahana, a tuari henidia; bena Siklag na lahi amo a doua.
1SA.30.14.english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

1SA.14.51.motu: Kisa, Saulo tamana, bona Nere, Abnere tamana, raruosi na Abiele natuna.
1SA.14.51.english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

1SA.10.17.motu: Una negana ai Samuel ese taunimanima e boiridia, Iehova vairanai bae hebou Mispa ai.
1SA.10.17.english: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;

1SA.13.7.motu: Haida danu Ioridane sinavaina amo e turu hanai Gad bona Gilead tanodia ela. A Saulo na dounu Gilgal ai; Israel taudia ese ia e ḡavaia, mai kudou-hetahadia ida.
1SA.13.7.english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

1SA.10.15.motu: Saulo tamana lahaina eto, Mani a hamaorogu, Samuel na dahaka e hamaoromui.
1SA.10.15.english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

1SA.16.5.motu: Ia eto, Mai mainogu ida vada nama, Iehova baina boua totona. Sibomui ba hahelaḡa, lau ida boubou karana baita karaia. Bena ia ese Iese mai natuna mamaruanedia ida e hahelaḡadia, bena e boiridia, boubou gabuna baela.
1SA.16.5.english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

1SA.31.2.motu: Bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida e lasidia tao; bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo natuna mamaruanedia Ionatan bona Abinadab bona Malkisua e aladia mase.
1SA.31.2.english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

1SA.16.6.motu: Idia ema negana ai, ia ese Eliab e raraia tao, bena lalona e hadaia, eto, Momokani, Iehova ese baine horoa tauna binai, ia vairanai e ginimu.
1SA.16.6.english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

1SA.14.48.motu: Ia na goada dikadika; ia ese Amalek taudia e hadareredia, bona Israel taudia na e tuari henidia taudia imadia amo e hamauridia.
1SA.14.48.english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

1SA.17.43.motu: Bena Filistia tauna ese David e gwau henia, eto, Lau sisia a, una dainai oi na mai aumu ida lau o mai henigumu a? Bena Filistia tauna ese ena dirava ladadia ai David e uduguiraia.
1SA.17.43.english: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.

1SA.7.12.motu: Bena Samuel na nadi ta e abia, Mispa bona lesana padadiai e haginia, bona ladana e hatoa Ebenesere. Ia eto, Iehova ese vada e kahada ema bona hari.
1SA.7.12.english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”

1SA.30.1.motu: Dina ihatoina ai David na ena orea taudia ida Siklag ai e kau, e diba, Amalek taudia ese diho kahana tanodia bona Siklag danu vada e tuari henidia. Siklag na vada e hadarerea, vada e doua,
1SA.30.1.english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

1SA.6.10.motu: Unu e kara toma: boromakau hahinedia rua e abidia, rerue iverina e ḡuidia, a natudia be ruma ai e koudia.
1SA.6.10.english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

1SA.2.12.motu: Eli natuna na lebulebu taudia; idia ese Iehova asie matauraia.
1SA.2.12.english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.

1SA.8.14.motu: Emui uma bona emui vine imeadia bona emui olive imeadia namo-hereadia baine abidia, ena hesiai taudia baine henidia.
1SA.8.14.english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

1SA.14.11.motu: Taunabunai, raruosi na Filistia taudia vairadiai e hahedinarai. Filistia taudia eto, O itaia, Heberu taudia na edia komu guridia amo e raka lasimu.
1SA.14.11.english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

1SA.20.35.motu: Daba ai Ionatan na hanua murimurina ela, David ida e hegwauhamata heheni heḡereḡerena. Mero maraḡina ta be ia ida ela.
1SA.20.35.english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

1SA.22.6.motu: Saulo ese harina e kamonai, David mai bamona ida vada e davaridia. Una negana ai, Saulo na Gibea ai, atai gabuna ena tamarisk auna henunai e helai; ena io na imana ai, bona ena hesiai taudia na e ginia heḡeḡe.
1SA.22.6.english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

1SA.5.6.motu: Iehova imana vada e metau Asdod taudia latadiai; ia ese e hagaridia, bona gudu dikadia amo e hahisidia, Asdod hanuana ai bona Asdod kahana idoinai.
1SA.5.6.english: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

1SA.14.16.motu: Saulo ena hegima taudia na Gibea ai, Beniamina tanona ai, e gimava. Bena e roha lao, hutuma na e heau maiva e heau laova e itadia.
1SA.14.16.english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

1SA.17.18.motu: Ini cheese gwauta-osi danu edia daha biaguna dekena ba laohai. Kakamu ba itadia, ede e noho tomamu, bona ola toana ta idia edia amo ba mailaia.
1SA.17.18.english: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

1SA.17.32.motu: Bena David ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Tau ta darana basine doko una tau dainai; lau binai emu hesiai tauna bainala, ina Filistia tauna baina heatu henia.
1SA.17.32.english: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

1SA.22.5.motu: Bena peroveta tauna ta, ladana Gad, ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Komu gabuna ai basio noho; ba raka oho, Iuda tanona baola. Taunabunai David na e raka oho, uda ladana Herete ela.
1SA.22.5.english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.”

1SA.20.33.motu: A Saulo ese ena io e tahoa, baine gwadaia eto; unu amo lonatan vada e diba, tamana ese lalona vada e ha-aukaiaDavid baine alaia mase.
1SA.20.33.english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

1SA.31.5.motu: Ena kesi ihuana tauna ese e itaia, Saulo vada e mase, bena ia danu ena dare matana ai sibona e hetoḡe, ia ida e mase hebou.
1SA.31.5.english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

1SA.12.20.motu: Bena Samuel ese e hamaorodia, eto, Asio gari; ini kara dika iboudiai vada o kara ḡau tamona Iehova iḡavana dalana amo basio raka siri. Iehova isiaina ba lao heni, mai lalomui idoidiai;
1SA.12.20.english: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following Yahweh, but serve Yahweh with all your heart.

1SA.14.27.motu: A Ionatan na se kamonai tamana ese taunimanima na taravatu vada e henidia. Taunabunai, ia ese ena itotohi matana na hari bada-ranuna ai e urua diho, bena imana amo uduna ai e atoa. Bena matana e diari.
1SA.14.27.english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

1SA.15.15.motu: Saulo eto, Amalek taudia edia amo vada e abidia; badina be egu orea taudia ese mamoe namo-hereadiabona boromakau mamaruanedia namo-hereadia e abidia mauri, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ihaboulaina ḡaudia ai bae halaodia helaoreana; a oredia vada a habuadia tari.
1SA.15.15.english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

1SA.5.2.motu: unuseni ai Filistia taudia ese dirava ladana Dagon ena dubu ai e vareailaia, Dagon badibadinai e haginia.
1SA.5.2.english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

1SA.20.22.motu: A mero na bama hamaoroa, bama toma “A itaia, diba na unukahamu ai”, oi na do baola, badina be Iehova ese e siaimu ohomu.
1SA.20.22.english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for Yahweh has sent you away.

1SA.24.9.motu: Bena David ese Saulo e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai hari e hereva henimu, e tomu “David ese oi ihadikamu dalana e tahuamu” taudia na o kamonai henidiamu?
1SA.24.9.english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

1SA.28.4.motu: Filistia taudia na e hebou, bona ema, Sunem ai e taruha. Bena Saulo ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Gilboa ai e taruha.
1SA.28.4.english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

1SA.12.19.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese Samuel e noia, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, ba ḡuria, ai bini emu hesiai taumai daimai ai, baia mase na garina; badina be emai kara dika iboudiai latadiai ina kara dikana ta ma vada a atoa kau: emai pavapava ia vada a noinoilaia.
1SA.12.19.english: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to Yahweh your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”

1SA.1.27.motu: Ina mero dainai na ḡuriḡuri; bena Iehova ese na noia ḡauna e henigu.
1SA.1.27.english: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

1SA.25.35.motu: Bena David ese hahine ena herahia ḡaudia na ia imana amo e abi; bena e hereva henia, eto, Emu ruma aola, mai mainomu ida; oi eremu vada na kamonai, bona emu noinoi vada na abia dae.
1SA.25.35.english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

1SA.28.16.motu: Samuel eto, Iehova ese vada e rakatanimu bona e inai henimumu, matogana lau ma o nanadaigumu a?
1SA.28.16.english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

1SA.1.6.motu: Bena hari hahine ta ese e ha-uraia bona lalona e hahisia, Iehova ese gabana vada e ha-aukaia dainai.
1SA.1.6.english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

1SA.6.7.motu: Benaini, rerue matamatana ta bavabia, bona boromakau hahinedia rua, maduna ta paḡadia ai do asie atoa ḡaudia. Hari boromakau na rerue iverina ba ḡuidia a natudia be edia amo bavabihaidia, ruma ai ba koudia.
1SA.6.7.english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

1SA.7.5.motu: Bena Samuel eto, Israel taudia iboudiai ba haboudia Mispa ai. Lau ese Iehova baina noi henia, umui daimui ai.
1SA.7.5.english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”

1SA.21.6.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa tauna ese flaoa helaḡana e henia; ibolona flaoana mai siahu-siahuna ida eha atoa negana ai Iehova vairana amo e abiaoho ḡauna e henia.
1SA.21.6.english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

1SA.16.20.motu: Bena Iese ese flaoa, bona vine ranuna kopi ta, bona nani natuna ta, e abidia, doniki ta doruna ai e ato, natuna David imana amo e siaidia, Saulo dekenai.
1SA.16.20.english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

1SA.4.21.motu: Bena ia ese mero ladana e hatoa Ikabod; eto, Israel hairaina vada e puki. Unu e gwau toma, Dirava ena maua helaḡana vada e dadia dainai, bona ravana bona adavana daidiai.
1SA.4.21.english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

1SA.25.27.motu: Harihari ina herahia ḡauna emu hesiai hahinena ese vada e mailaia na do bavabia, egu lohia murimu ai e rakamu eregabedia na ba hariharilai henidia.
1SA.25.27.english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

1SA.25.22.motu: Bama bogaia hisi, daba ai ena orea maruanena ta baine mauri, Dirava ese davana na David ena amo bema abia.
1SA.25.22.english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

1SA.19.11.motu: Una hanuaboi, Saulo ese kito taudia e siaidia, David ena ruma ai ia bae gimaia; daba ai baine alaia mase eto. A Mikala, David adavana, ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hari hanuaboi basioma heau mauri, kerukeru bema alamu mase.
1SA.19.11.english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

1SA.30.23.motu: A David eto, Tadikakagu e, Iehova ese vada e henida ḡaudia na unu basio karalai toma; ia ese vada e hamaurida, bona e tuari henida oreana na imada ai vada e atodia.
1SA.30.23.english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

1SA.3.19.motu: Samuel na e bada oho bada oho; Iehova ese e bamoava, bona ena hereva ta se hamorua.
1SA.3.19.english: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

1SA.26.24.motu: A itaia, hari dina ai oiemu maun na ḡau hereana lau vairagu ai; una heḡereḡerena lauegu mauri na ḡau hereana ai bainela Iehova vairanai, bena dika iboudiai lalodia amo ia ese baine hamaurigu.
1SA.26.24.english: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in Yahweh’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”

1SA.14.23.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Israel e hamauria una dina ai; tuari na e laohaia ela bona Bet-avene unukahanai.
1SA.14.23.english: So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

1SA.8.8.motu: Edia kara iboudiai lau e kara heniguva, Aigupto amo na hakaudia lasi dinana amo ema bona hari dina, na lau vada e dadaraigu bona dirava idaudia isiaidia vada e lao heni; oi danu unu e karamu tomamu.
1SA.8.8.english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

1SA.21.2.motu: David ese hahelaḡa tauna Ahimelek e harnaoroa, eto, Pavapava ese ḡaukara ta e henigu, e hamaorogu, eto “Ikarana na siaimu bona na haḡanilaimu ḡaukarana na tau ta basio hamaorolaia”. Eregabe taudia ida vada a henega, gabu ta ai baia hebou.
1SA.21.2.english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

1SA.4.13.motu: E kau negana ai, Eli na ena helai ḡauna ai e helaiva, dala isena ai, e hegimava, badina be kudouna e hetahava, Dirava ena maua helaḡana dainai. Hari tau be hanua ai e kau, e hari piu; bena hanua taudia iboudiai e tai lolololo.
1SA.4.13.english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

1SA.17.42.motu: Filistia tauna na e roha lao, David e itaia; bena e dadaraia, badina be ia na tauhau mo, vairana tonika-tonika bona raho-namo merona.
1SA.17.42.english: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.

1SA.2.22.motu: Eli na vada e buruka herea. Ia ese natuna mamaruanedia edia kara iboudiai, Israel taudia iboudiai e kara henidiava karadia, na haridia e kamonai. E kamonai danu, idia na hebou kalagana iduarana ai hesiai karadia e karava hahinedia ida e eno bouva.
1SA.2.22.english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

1SA.28.19.motu: Ina danu, Iehova ese oi bona Israel taudia danu Filistia taudia imadia ai baine atomui; bena kerukeru oi bona natumu mamaruanedia na lau dekegu baoma. Iehova ese danu Israel ena tuari oreana na Filistia ena tuari oreana imadia ai baine atodia.
1SA.28.19.english: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

1SA.4.1.motu: Samuel ena hereva na Israel taudia iboudiai ediai e kau. Bena Israel taudia na e raka lasi, Filistia taudia bae tuari henidia eto. Idia na Ebenesere ai e taruha; a Filistia taudia na Afek ai e taruha.
1SA.4.1.english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel.

1SA.4.14.motu: Eli ese edia taitai reḡena e kamonai, bena eto, Una heloḡo-heloḡo be dahaka? Bena hari tau e heau ela, Eli e hamaorolaia.
1SA.4.14.english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?”

1SA.2.7.motu: Iehova ese taunimanima na e ha-ogoḡamidiamu bona e hataḡadiamu;
1SA.2.7.english: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich.

1SA.14.47.motu: Saulo na Israel e halohiaia negana ai na ia ese inaina iboudiai e tuari henidia, kaha iboudiai; Moab taudia bona Amono taudia bona Edom taudia bona Soba pavapavadia bona Filistia taudia, iboudiai e tuari henidia bona e hadareredia.
1SA.14.47.english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

1SA.4.20.motu: Ena mase vada e kahira-kahira, benahegwaroto hahinedia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Asio gari, natumu maruanena ta vada e vara. A ia na se haere, bona se marere.
1SA.4.20.english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

1SA.27.10.motu: A Akisi e henanadaiva, e tomava “Hari dina ai daidia o tuari henidia?” negadia ai na David e haereva, e tomava “Iuda diho kahana taudia”, eiava “Ierahamele diho kahana taudia”, eiava “Kene diho kahana taudia”.
1SA.27.10.english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?”

1SA.7.2.motu: Nega daudau vada ela, laḡani ruahui sisivana, hari maua helaḡana na Kiriat-iearimi ai e miava. Unu laḡani lalodiai Israel taudia iboudiai ese Iehova e tai henia.
1SA.7.2.english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

1SA.9.11.motu: Ororo ai e dara dae, bena idia ese ulato haida ida e hedavari. Unu ulato na ranu-utu totona vada e raka lasi. Bena idia ese unu ulato e nanadaidia, eto, Mata-hanai tauna iniseni ai a?
1SA.9.11.english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

1SA.17.38.motu: Bena Saulo ese ena tuari dabuadia e abi, David e hahedokilaia; auri labora-laborana kwara ḡauna na kwarana ai e atoa, bona auri hahedokina amo e hahedokia.
1SA.17.38.english: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

1SA.3.3.motu: Dirava ena lamepa do se bodo negana ai; Samuel danu Iehova ena dubu ai e hekureva, Dirava ena maua helaḡana e miava gabuna ai.
1SA.3.3.english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,

1SA.26.22.motu: Bena David e haere, eto, Pavapava e, emu io binai; emu eregabe ta ainema, baine abia.
1SA.26.22.english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

1SA.8.21.motu: Samuel ese hebou taudia edia hereva iboudiai e kamonai, bena ia ese Iehova vairanai ma e gwaurai.
1SA.8.21.english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.

1SA.24.2.motu: Bena Saulo ese tatau mai goadadia daha toi Israel taudia iboudiai edia amo e abidia hidi; bena idia ese David mai ena orea taudia itahudia ela, Uda Nanidia edia Haga-nadidia vairadiai.
1SA.24.2.english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

1SA.20.16.motu: lonatan ladana na David ena ruma amo basine henege daure. Iehova ese David inaina ediai dava baine abia.
1SA.20.16.english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

1SA.14.39.motu: Badina be Iehova, Israel ihamaurina Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena. kerere ihavarana tauna, ena be lau natugu Ionatan, to baine mase. A taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidia amo ta se haere henia.
1SA.14.39.english: For as Yahweh lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

1SA.14.32.motu: taunabunai idia ese e dadi ḡaudia e heau henidia, mamoe bona boromakau mamaruanedia bona boromakau natudia e abidia, tano ai e aladia mase, bena mai raradia ida e ani.
1SA.14.32.english: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.

1SA.6.6.motu: Umui ese lalomui ba ha-auka, Aigupto taudia bona Farao ese lalodia e ha-auka na heto, anina be dahaka? Ia ese e hakavakavadia; una murinai idia ese Israel taudia e kahudia nege, bena e raka oho, ani?
1SA.6.6.english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

1SA.10.24.motu: Bena Samuel ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova vada e abia hidi tauna o itaiamu a? Taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidiai ia na asi idaina. Bena hebou taudia iboudiai e lolo, eto Pavapava na baine mauri daudau.
1SA.10.24.english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?”

1SA.11.10.motu: Taunabunai, Iabese taudia ese Nahasa e hamaoroa, eto, Kerukeru ai na oi dekemu baia raka lasi, bena emu ura heḡereḡerena ba kara henimai.
1SA.11.10.english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

1SA.17.10.motu: Filistia tauna ma eto, Hari dina ai lau ese Israel tuari oreadia na hare henidiamu: tau ta ba henigu, raruosi baia heatu.
1SA.17.10.english: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”

1SA.13.9.motu: Taunabunai Saulo eto, Ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudiana lau dekegu ai ba mailaidia. Bena ia ese ḡole-oho boubouna e hahelaḡaia.
1SA.13.9.english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

1SA.23.13.motu: Bena David mai ena orea taudia sinahu-tauratoi sisivana ida e toreisi, Keila e rakatania, e loa eva-eva. Haida ese Saulo e hamaoroa David na Keila amo vada e roho mauri; bena Saulo na unu se raka lao.
1SA.23.13.english: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

1SA.19.16.motu: A gwaukau taudia na e raka vareai, hari e koroa laulauna e itaia, mahuta patana ai, bona nani huina amo e karaia ikwinana ia kwarana henunai.
1SA.19.16.english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

1SA.28.21.motu: Bena hari hahine na Saulo dekena ema, e itaia, gari ese vada e butua tao; bena ia ese e hereva henia, eto, A itagu, lau binai emu hesiai hahinena na eremu na kamonai, bona emu hereva ikamonai-henina amo egu mauri na atoa diho.
1SA.28.21.english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

1SA.4.12.motu: Beniamina tauna ta na tuari gabuna amo e heau ela, una dina ai Silo ai e kau; ena dabua vada e hedare, bona tano ḡahuna na kwarana ai.
1SA.4.12.english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

1SA.12.21.motu: basio raka siri, dirava koikoidia basio ḡavadia: idia na asi anidia bona asi edia hahemauri, idia na koikoi ḡaudia.
1SA.12.21.english: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.

1SA.25.5.motu: Taunabinai, David ese eregabe gwauta e siaidia; e haḡanidia, eto, Karamele a dae lao, Nabala dekena baola, lau ladagu ai ba hahenamo henia.
1SA.25.5.english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

1SA.14.3.motu: Ahia Ahitubu, Iehova ena hahelaḡa tauna Silo ai, danu unuseni ai; ia na dabua helaḡana e dokia. Ia be Ikabod kakana Ahitubu natuna, bona Fineha Eli tubuna. Taunimanima na asi dibadia lonatan vada ela.
1SA.14.3.english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

1SA.5.10.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ena maua helaḡana ma e siaia Ekron. A Dirava ena maua helaḡana na Ekron ai e kau negana ai, Ekron taudia e taitai, eto, Israel Diravana ena maua helaḡana vada e mailaia, ita ialada bona varavarada ialadia totona.
1SA.5.10.english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron.

1SA.14.37.motu: Bena Saulo ese Dirava e nanadaia, eto, Filistia taudia muridia amo ainala eiava? Israel taudia imadia ai bavatodia eiava? A ia na e haere henia una dina ai.
1SA.14.37.english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

1SA.15.28.motu: Samuel eto, Iehova ese hari dina ai Israel basileiana na oiemu amo vada e darea oho; oi dekemu tauna ta, oi e hereamumu tauna, vada e henia.
1SA.15.28.english: Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

1SA.5.1.motu: Filistia taudia ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana e dadia negana ai, idia ese Ebenesere amo e laohaia ela bona Asdod;
1SA.5.1.english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

1SA.8.18.motu: Una dina ai umui na ba tai lolololo, emui pavapava, sibomui o abia hidi tauna, dainai. A Iehova na basine haere henimui una dina ai.
1SA.8.18.english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”

1SA.18.9.motu: Una dina amo Saulo ese David e vaira hua henia.
1SA.18.9.english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

1SA.9.27.motu: Idia na e raka lasi, hanua murimurinai, bena Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Emu hesiai tauna ba hamaoroa, ia na ita vairadai baine raka guna: bena ia baine raka lao, a oi na iniseni ai ba noho, nega sisina. Dirava ena hereva baina hahedinarai henimu.
1SA.9.27.english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”

1SA.27.2.motu: Taunabunai, David e tore isi, e raka hanai, ia bona ena orea tataudia sinahu-tauratoiosi, Akisi Maoko, Gata pavapavana, dekena ela.
1SA.27.2.english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

1SA.30.3.motu: Taunabunai, David mai ena orea taudia ida hanua ai e kau negana ai, e itaia, lahi ese vada e araia, bona adavadia bona natudia, mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, vada e abidia mauri.
1SA.30.3.english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

1SA.18.15.motu: Saulo ese e itaia, ena kara iboudiai na mai anidia namodia, bena e gari henia.
1SA.18.15.english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

1SA.2.33.motu: Umui bogaragimui ai tau tamona na egu ihaboulaina patana amo basina negea daure, a ia na iruru-matana baine diho bona lalona baine hisihisi. A emu ruma memerodia iboudiai na taunimanima edia dare ai bae mase.
1SA.2.33.english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

1SA.23.9.motu: David be dibana Saulo ese ia ihadikana dalana e tahua; bena ia ese Abiatara e hamaoroa, eto, Dabua helaḡana a mailaia.
1SA.23.9.english: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”

1SA.18.5.motu: David e raka lasi, Saulo ese e siaia gabudia ela; unu gabu iboudiai ai e kwalimu. Bena Saulo ese ena tuari oreana biaguna ai e halaoa. Taunimanima iboudiai bona Saulo ena hesiai taudia danu ese una kara e moalelaia.
1SA.18.5.english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

1SA.25.10.motu: Bena Nabala ese David ena hesiai taudia e haere henidia, eto, David be daika? Ina Iese natuna be daika? Ina nega ai hesiai taudia hutuma ese biagudia e heautanidiamu.
1SA.25.10.english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

1SA.9.8.motu: Hesiai tauna ese Saulo ma e haere henia, eto, Silver sekelena kahana binai dekegu ai; lau ese Dirava ena tau baina henia, bena ia ese eda dala baine hadibalaida.
1SA.9.8.english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

1SA.26.6.motu: Bena David ese Ahimelek, tau Hiti, bona Abisai Seruia, Ioab tadina, na e nanadaidia, eto, Daika na lau ida taruha lalonai baita diho, Saulo dekenai? Abisai eto, Lau na oi ida baita diho.
1SA.26.6.english: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?”

1SA.29.7.motu: Taunabunai, harihari a lou, mai mainomu ida aola, Filistia taudia lohiadia ba habadudia na garina.
1SA.29.7.english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

1SA.31.10.motu: Saulo ena tuari dabuadia na Astaroto ena dubu ai e atoa; bona tau-anina na Bete-sana hanuana maḡuna ai e kapaia kau.
1SA.31.10.english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

1SA.14.7.motu: Bena ena kesi ihuana tauna eto, Lalomu ai vada o haeroa karana idoinai ba karaia; o itaia, lau na oi ida, bona oiemu lalohadai na lauegu lalohadai.
1SA.14.7.english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

1SA.12.16.motu: Taunabunai, a gini, asio marere, ina kara badana Iehova ese vairamui ai baine kara na do ba itaia.
1SA.12.16.english: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Yahweh will do before your eyes.

1SA.25.42.motu: Bena Abigail e tore isi haraḡa, doniki ta ai e gui, bona ena ulato laima ese e bamoa. Bena David ena gwaukau taudia muridia amo ela; bena raruosi e headava.
1SA.25.42.english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

1SA.10.22.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Tauna na ema eiava? Iehova eto, A itaia, ia na kohu lalodiai e komumu.
1SA.10.22.english: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?”

1SA.16.17.motu: Taunabunai, Saulo ese ena hesiai taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Tau ta bavabia, gitara ihataina dibana herea tauna ta, bena dekegu ai ba hakaua mai.
1SA.16.17.english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

1SA.14.10.motu: A idia na bema toma “Dekemai ai a dara dae”, ita na baita dara dae; badina be Iehova ese idia na ita imada ai vada e atodia toana bunai.
1SA.14.10.english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for Yahweh has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

1SA.25.4.motu: David na tano ḡaḡaena ai e kamonai hari Nabala na ena mamoe huidia iutudia vada ela.
1SA.25.4.english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

1SA.14.1.motu: Dina ta Ionatan, Saulo natuna, ese ena kesi ihuana tauhauna e hamaoroa, eto, Aoma, Filistia taudia edia taruha aita lao henia, unukaha ai. A ia ese tamana na se hamaoroa.
1SA.14.1.english: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.

1SA.17.12.motu: David na Iese, tau Efrata, natuna. Iese ena hanua na Betelehem, Iuda tanona ai; natuna mamaruanedia na taurahani. Saulo ena nega ai, ia na tau buruka; ena mauri laḡanidia na hoho.
1SA.17.12.english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.

1SA.31.8.motu: Daba rerena ai Filistia taudia na ema, mase taudia edia dabua bae abi eto. Bena Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi ida masedia ai e dabaridia, Gilboa ororona ai.
1SA.31.8.english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

1SA.2.34.motu: Toana binai emu ai: natumu raruosi, Hofni bona Fineha, na dina tamona ai bae mase.
1SA.2.34.english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

1SA.11.14.motu: Bena Samuel ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, Aoma, Gilgal aitala; unuseni ai basileia ma baita haginia lou.
1SA.11.14.english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

1SA.20.12.motu: Bena Ionatan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana vairanai na herevamu! tamagu lalona do baina tahua, bena nega inihetomana, kerukeru eiava vanegai, bema oi David e lalo namo henimumu, lau ese gwau-kau baina siaia, baina hadibamu, ani?
1SA.20.12.english: Jonathan said to David, “By Yahweh, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

1SA.23.1.motu: Haida ese David e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: Filistia taudia ese Keila e tuari heniamu, bona uit ikwadilaina gabudia ai uit e dadimu.
1SA.23.1.english: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

1SA.15.2.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese Amalek davana baina henia, ena kara dainai; Israel na Aigupto amo e raka lasi negana ai na ia ese e laodia ahu.
1SA.15.2.english: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

1SA.11.2.motu: A Nahasa, tau Amono, ese e haere henidia, eto, Aita herohemaino; ḡau tamona lau na matamui idibadia baina gibodia lasi, unu amo Israel idoinai baina hahemaraia.
1SA.11.2.english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

1SA.26.23.motu: Iehova ese taunimanima iboudiai edia kara maoromaoro bona edia heabidadama davadia e henidiamu; badina be Iehova ese lau imagu ai e atomu hari dina ai, a lau imagu na Iehova ese e horoa tauna ihadikana asina dau lasi.
1SA.26.23.english: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.

1SA.3.14.motu: Taunabunai, Eli ena ruma taudia na gwaurai henidia momokanimu, na tomu edia kara dika na boubou ḡaudia eiava hereahia ḡaudia ese basie roho diba ela bona hanaihanai.
1SA.3.14.english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

1SA.27.9.motu: David ese tano e habuaia tari, tau ta eiava hahine ta se hamauria, a mamoe bona boromakau bona doniki bona kamelo bona dabua e abidia; bena Akisi dekena e lou lao.
1SA.27.9.english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

1SA.17.17.motu: Iese ese natuna David e hamaoroa, eto, Ini uit kakorodia efa ta bona ini flaoa igabudia gwauta bavabi, kakamu adia. Avabidia, ba laohai haraga kakamu dekedia taruha ai.
1SA.17.17.english: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;

1SA.19.10.motu: Bena Saulo ese ena io e abia, David na haba ida baine raia bou eto. A David ese e dekea, bena io na haba ai e heholo. Bena David na e heau, e roho mauri.
1SA.19.10.english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

1SA.30.9.motu: Taunabunai David na e tore isi, bamona sinahu tauratoiosi danu ia ida, ela, Besoro sinavaina ai e kau, haida unuseni ai e rakatanidia.
1SA.30.9.english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

1SA.25.41.motu: Bena hahine na e tore isi, tano ai e igo diho, eto, A itagu, lau binai emu hesiai hahinena na egu lohia emu hesiai taudia aedia ihuridia hahinegu.
1SA.25.41.english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

1SA.17.11.motu: Saulo bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese una Filistia tauna ena hereva e kamonai, bena kudoudia e hetaha bona gari bada ese e butudia tao.
1SA.17.11.english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

1SA.19.1.motu: Saulo ese natuna lonatan bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto David bae alaia mase. A Ionatan, Saulo natuna, ese David e lalokau heniava.
1SA.19.1.english: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

1SA.8.5.motu: E hereva henia, eto, O itaia, oi na vada o buruka, bona natumu na oiemu dala ai asie rakamu; taunabunai, emai pavapava ta bavabia hidi, baine halohiamai, bese iboudiai e karamu heḡereḡeredia.
1SA.8.5.english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

1SA.25.30.motu: Bena Iehova ese egu lohia baine hanamoa, vada e herevalaimu guna heḡereḡerena, bona Israel pavapavana ai baine halaomu;
1SA.25.30.english: It will come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

1SA.15.1.motu: Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova ese e siaigu baina horomu totona; bena na horomu, ena bese Israel pavapavana ai na halaomu. Taunabunai, harihari Iehova ena hereva a kamonaidia.
1SA.15.1.english: Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of Yahweh’s words.

1SA.21.3.motu: Benaini, aniani ḡauna emu ai be dahaka? Flaoa igabu ima. eiava dahaka aniani ḡauna emu ai mia, na boma henigu.
1SA.21.3.english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

1SA.1.5.motu: A Hana be ahu tamona e henia; ena be e lalokau henia bada, to ahu tamona e henia, badina be Iehova ese gabana e ha-aukaia.
1SA.1.5.english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

1SA.20.36.motu: Bena ia ese ena mero e hamaoroa, eto, A heau lao, baina kino dibadia ba tahudia. Mero na e heau ai, Ionatan ese diba ta e kinoa, hari mero unukahana ai.
1SA.20.36.english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

1SA.8.16.motu: Emui hesiai taudia bona emui hesiai hahinedia bona emui boromakau bona emui doniki namo-hereadia ia ese baine abidia, iena ḡaukara bae kara.
1SA.8.16.english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

1SA.16.7.motu: A Iehova ese Samuel e hamaoroa, eto, Oromana eiava ena lata basio laloa, badina be lau ese vada na dadaraia. Badina be Iehova ese ḡau se itamu taunimanima ese e itadiamu heḡereḡerena; taunimanima ese oromana e itaiamu, a Iehova ese lalona e itaiamu.
1SA.16.7.english: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

1SA.4.7.motu: Bena Filistia taudia na kudoudia e hetaha; badina be idia eto, Dirava na taruha ai vada e kau. Ma eto, Madi, ihabaida! Kara inihetomana na nega hata se vara.
1SA.4.7.english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

1SA.7.14.motu: Israel hanuadia Filistia taudia ese vada e abidia na Israel taudia ese ma e abidia lou, Ekron amo ela bona Gata. Israel taudia ese edia tano na Filistia taudia imadia amo ma e abia lou. Israel taudia bona Arnoro taudia danu e herohemaino.
1SA.7.14.english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

1SA.20.10.motu: David ese Ionatan e nanadaia, eto, Tamamu na badu herevadia bema gwaurai henimu, daika ese bema hamaorogu?
1SA.20.10.english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

1SA.13.3.motu: Ionatan ese Filistia taudia edia gima oreana Geba ai e hadareredia: bena Filistia taudia ese harina e kamonai. Bena Saulo ese kibi e hiriria, Israel tanona idoinai, eto, Heberu taumui e, harina a kamonai.
1SA.13.3.english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

1SA.1.25.motu: Bena idia ese boromakau e alaia, bona mero na Eli dekena e hakaua lao.
1SA.1.25.english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

1SA.25.38.motu: Dina gwauta sisivana ela, bena Iehova ese Nabala e alaia, bena e mase.
1SA.25.38.english: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

1SA.3.9.motu: Taunabunai, Eli ese Samuel e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, a hekure; bema boiboi lou, baoto “Iehova e, a hereva, badina be lau binai emu hesiai taugu na hakalamu.” Taunabunai, Samuel na ela, ena gabu ai ma e hekure.
1SA.3.9.english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

1SA.19.8.motu: Tuari ma e vara lou; bena David na e raka lasi, Filistia taudia e tuari henidia, hutuma e aladia mase; bena oredia na ia vairanai e heau.
1SA.19.8.english: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

1SA.27.4.motu: Haida ese Saulo e hamaoroa, David vada e heau, Gata vada ela, bena ia ese ia itahuna e hadokoa.
1SA.27.4.english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

1SA.21.10.motu: Bena David na e tore isi, una dina ai ia ese Saulo e heautania, Akisi Gata pavapavana, dekena ela.
1SA.21.10.english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

1SA.30.31.motu: bona Heberon taudia. Unu gabu iboudiai na David mai bamona ida vada e loa evaeva henidia gabudia.
1SA.30.31.english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

1SA.13.10.motu: E haḡolea oho vaitani, bena Samuel vada e kau. Saulo na e raka lasi, ia ida bae hedavari bona baine hahenamo henia totona.
1SA.13.10.english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

1SA.19.2.motu: Bena Ionatan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu Saulo na iala-masemu dalana e tahuamu; taunabunai, daba ai nahuamu ba tohoa, gabu hehunina ai ba noho, ba komu;
1SA.19.2.english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

1SA.14.13.motu: Bena lonatan na imana bona aena amo e rau dae; ena kesi ihuana tauna danu ia murina amo e rau dae. Bena idia haida na lonatan ese e aladia, ma haida na ena kesi ihuana tauna ese.
1SA.14.13.english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

1SA.15.14.motu: Samuel eto, Matona, ini reḡe na kamonai, mamoe e taimu bona boromakau e ḡoumu, anidia be dahaka?
1SA.15.14.english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

1SA.9.21.motu: Saulo e haere, eto, Be, lau na Beniamina iduhuna tauna. iduhu maraḡi-hereana Israel besena bogaraginai; bona egudogoro na maraḡi-herea Beniamina dogorona iboudiai bogaragidiai. Badina dahaka dala inihetomana o herevalai henigumu?
1SA.9.21.english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

1SA.20.18.motu: Ionatan ese e hereva henia lou, eto, Kerukeru na hua matamatana; bena bae herevalaimu, emu helai gabuna na asi tauna dainai.
1SA.20.18.english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

1SA.25.6.motu: Ini ba hahenamo henia toma, baoto: Maino na oi latamu ai, bona emu ruma latanai, bona emu iboudiai danu latadiai.
1SA.25.6.english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

1SA.22.4.motu: Bena ia ese Moab pavapavana dekenai e rakatanidia; idia ese ia dekenai e nohova, David na ena komu gabuna ai e nohova negana idoinai lalonai.
1SA.22.4.english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
