1SA.18.4.motu: Ionatan ese ena hahedoki badana bona ena tuari dabuadia e doki oho, ena dare bona ena peva bona ena gaba ḡauna danu e ruha, iboudiai na David e henia.
1SA.18.4.english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

1SA.25.9.motu: Bena David ena eregabe ela, unu hereva iboudiai na Nabala e hamaorolaia, David ladana ai; bena e nari.
1SA.25.9.english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

1SA.15.9.motu: A Saulo bona ena orea taudia ese Agag e hamauria; mamoe bona boromakau mamaruanedia bona boromakau natudia bona mamoe natudia namo-hereadia danu e hamauridia. Ḡau namodia iboudiai e hamauridia, asie habuadia tari; a ḡau dikadia na e dadaraidia, bona e habuadia tari.
1SA.15.9.english: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

1SA.13.13.motu: Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Vada o kara kava; Iehova, emu Dirava, ena haheḡani, e henimu ḡauna, na so badinaia. Iehova ese emu basileia na Israel ai baine haginia hanaihanai eto;
1SA.13.13.english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you; for now Yahweh would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

1SA.16.2.motu: Samuel eto, Ede bainala toma? Saulo bema kamonai, ia ese bema alagu mase. Iehova ma eto, Boromakau hahinena matamatana ta ba laohaia, baoto “Lau na Iehova ibouna totona vada nama”.
1SA.16.2.english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.”

1SA.2.17.motu: Taunabunai, hari eregabe edia kara havara na bada herea Iehova vairanai; badina be idia ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡaudia na asie matauraidia.
1SA.2.17.english: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.

1SA.22.17.motu: Bena pavapava ese ena hegima taudia, e ginidia heḡeḡe taudia, na e haḡanidia, eto, Iehova ena hahelaḡa taudia na bavaladia mase, badina be idia ese David e duruamu; idia na dibadia ia vada e heau, to asie hadibagu. A pavapava ena hesiai taudia na lalodia asie heḡereḡere imadia bae toi roro, Iehova ena hahelaḡa taudia ialadia totona.
1SA.22.17.english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of Yahweh, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

1SA.20.19.motu: Ma vanegai bae herevalaimu bada; una dina ai baola haraḡa, o komu guna gabuna baola, nadi ladana Esele badinai ba noho.
1SA.20.19.english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

1SA.8.10.motu: Taunabunai, Samuel ese hari pavapava e noilaia taudia na Iehova ena hereva iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
1SA.8.10.english: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

1SA.1.19.motu: Daba ai, idia na e tore isi haraḡa, Iehova vairanai e toma diho; bena edia ruma e lou henia, Rama ai. Bena Elkana na adavana Hana ida e eno bou, bona Iehova ese e laloa tao;
1SA.1.19.english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.

1SA.22.2.motu: Bena lalo-hisihisi taudia bona maiedia abi-torehai taudia bona maumau taudia iboudiai na ia dekenai e hebou; bena ia ese e biagudia. Ienai e hebou taudia na sinahu hani sisivana.
1SA.22.2.english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

1SA.20.29.motu: ia eto “Ba kahugu nege, badina be egu iduhu taudia na hanua ai boubou karana ta e karaiamu, bona kakagu ese vada e haḡanigu, bainala e tomu; taunabunai, boma lalo namo henigu, boma kahugu nege, bena kakagu bama ha itadia”. Una dainai, ia na pavapava ena pata se mai heniamu.
1SA.20.29.english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

1SA.2.24.motu: Lasi, natugu, Iehova ena orea taudia e hapiuamu sivaraina na dia namo.
1SA.2.24.english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.

1SA.30.26.motu: David na Siklag ai e kau, bena e abi kohudia kahana na turana Iuda tau-badadia dekediai e siaia, eto, Harihari ḡauna binai, Iehova inaina edia amo a dadi ḡaudia.
1SA.30.26.english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”

1SA.3.10.motu: Bena Iehova na ema, e gini, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia e boiboi, eto, Samuel e, Samuel e! Samuel na e haere, eto, A hereva, badina be lau binai emu hesiai taugu na hakalamu.
1SA.3.10.english: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!”

1SA.6.11.motu: Bena Iehova ena maua helaḡana e abia, rerue latanai e atoa; bona gold amo e kara bitadia bona gududia laulaudia mauana danu.
1SA.6.11.english: They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

1SA.20.4.motu: Bena Ionatan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka ba gwauraia, una na baina karaia oiemu.
1SA.20.4.english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

1SA.1.18.motu: Hahine ma eto, Emu hesiai hahinena ba hanamoa. Bena hahine na ena dala ela, e aniani, vairana danu se huaia lou.
1SA.1.18.english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

1SA.14.50.motu: Saulo adavana ladana na Ahinoama; ia na Ahimasa natuna. Ena tuari oreana biaguna ladana na Abnere, Nere natuna. Hari Nere na Saulo tamana lahaina;
1SA.14.50.english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

1SA.2.31.motu: A kamonai: dinadia be maimu lau ese emu goada baina abia oho, bona tamamu ena ruma taudia edia goada baina abia oho. bena iahu ta basine noho emu ruma ai.
1SA.2.31.english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

1SA.20.41.motu: Mero na e raka oho, bena David na nadi senuna badibadina amo e tore isi, tano ai e goru diho, nega toi e igo diho. Bena raruosi e haherahu heheni bona e taitai hebou, ela bona David na taitai ai e herea.
1SA.20.41.english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

1SA.1.8.motu: Bena adavana Elkana ese e nanadaia, eto, Hana e, dahaka dainai o taitaimu? Dahaka dainai so anianimu? Dahaka dainai lalomu e hisihisimu? Egu lalokau oiemu ai ese memero gwauta edia se hereaia a?
1SA.1.8.english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

1SA.9.22.motu: Bena Samuel ese Saulo mai ena hesiai tauna ida e abidia, aniani daiutuna ai e hakaudia vareai, helai gabudia hereadia ai e hahelaidia, e vavedia taudia iboudiai vairadiai. Idia iboudiai na taunimanima toi-ahui sisivana.
1SA.9.22.english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

1SA.30.5.motu: David adavana raruosi danu vada e abidia mauri: Ahinoama, Iesrele hahinena, bona Abigail, Karamele tauna Nabala vabuna.
1SA.30.5.english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

1SA.20.15.motu: bona emu hebogahisi na egu ruma taudia edia amo basio abia oho, ela bona hanaihanai. Iehova ese David inaina iboudiai na tanobada kopina amo baine negedia daure negana ai,
1SA.20.15.english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when Yahweh has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

1SA.14.33.motu: Bena haida ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, tuari taudia na Iehova vairanai e kara havaramu, vamu na mai rarana ida e aniamu. Ia na eto, Vada e kara havara; nadi badana ta ba keia mai iniseni ai.
1SA.14.33.english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against Yahweh, in that they eat meat with the blood.”

1SA.2.4.motu: Goada taudia edia peva e hakwaidudiamu,
1SA.2.4.english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken.

1SA.20.23.motu: A ba laloa, ita raruosi vada ta herevalaia ḡauna ai Iehova na oi bona lau padadai ela bona hanaihanai.
1SA.20.23.english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahweh is between you and me forever.”

1SA.25.37.motu: Daba ai, vine ranuna siahuna na Nabala lalona ai vada e ore negana ai, ia adavana ese unu ḡau iboudiai e hamaorolaia; bena ia laumana e daure, bona tauna e auka nadi na heto.
1SA.25.37.english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

1SA.5.3.motu: Daba maraḡi ai, Asdod taudia e tore isi, e itaia, hari Dagon na tano ai vada e goru parapara, Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai. Taunabunai, idia ese Dagon e abia isi, ena gabu ai e haginia lou.
1SA.5.3.english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

1SA.6.3.motu: Idia eto, Israel Diravana ena maua helaḡana boma siaia lao, basioma siaia kava, a mai emui kerere boubouna ḡauna ida ba siaia, emui kara dika irohona herahiana. Bena ba mauri, bona ba diba badina be dahaka ia imana umui emui amo se abia oho.
1SA.6.3.english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

1SA.15.33.motu: Bena Samuel eto, Hahine na asi natudia e nohomu oiemu dare dainai, heḡereḡerena oi sinamu na asi natuna baine noho. Bena Samuel ese Agag e dapaia sisi, Iehova vairanai, Gilgal ai.
1SA.15.33.english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.

1SA.10.23.motu: Bena idia na e heau lao, e hakaua lasi; bena taunimanima bogaragidiai e gini negana ai ena lata ese iboudiai edia lata e hereadia; ia paḡana na idia kwaradia ida heḡereḡere.
1SA.10.23.english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

1SA.23.22.motu: Aola, ba diba momokani iena noho gabuna be edena, bona daika ese vada e itaia unuseni ai; badina be haida ese vada e hamaorogu, ia na koikoi aonega dikadika tauna.
1SA.23.22.english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.

1SA.26.16.motu: Ina emu kara na dia namo. Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena, oi na boma mase, badina be emu lohia, Iehova ese e horoa tauna, so gimaia. Harihari a itaia, pavapava ena io bona ena hodu, kwarana badinai miadia ḡaudia, be edeseni ai?
1SA.26.16.english: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As Yahweh lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, Yahweh’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”

1SA.4.11.motu: Bona Dirava ena maua helaḡana na e dadia; bona Eli natuna raruosi, Hofni bona Fineha na e aladia mase.
1SA.4.11.english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

1SA.6.9.motu: Bena ba itaia: bema ena tano korikori Bete-semese dalana amo bainela, be ina hahedika badana be ia ese vada e havaraia ita latadai; a bema lasi, ita baita diba dia ia imana ese e hadikada, a ina hahedika na ita latadai vada e vara kava.
1SA.6.9.english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

1SA.27.11.motu: David ese tau ta eiava hahine ta se hamauria badina korikori be harina na Gata bae laohaia na garina; ia lalona e hadaia, eto, Harimai bae piua, baeto “David na unu ini e kara toma” na garina.
1SA.27.11.english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

1SA.1.13.motu: Hana na lalona ai mo e ḡuriḡuriva; bena bibinana e marere-marereva, to gadona na se hekamonaiva, taunabunai Eli banava eto hahine na vada e kekero.
1SA.1.13.english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

1SA.28.7.motu: Bena Saulo ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Rohe hahinena ta a tahua, bena dekena bainala, iena amo baina henanadai. Ena hesiai taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Rohe hahinena ta be En-doro ai e nohomu.
1SA.28.7.english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.”

1SA.14.28.motu: Bena tau ta ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tamamu ese taravatu aukana na orea taudia vada e henidia, eto “Hari dina ai baine aniani tauna na do baine dika”. Taunimanima iboudiai na tau-anidia vada e manori.
1SA.14.28.english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

1SA.20.39.motu: A mero na ḡau ta asi dibana; Ionatan bona David sibodia mo una kara anina mai dibadia.
1SA.20.39.english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

1SA.20.25.motu: Pavapava na vaia ena kara heḡereḡerena ena helai ḡauna ai e helai diho, haba badibadinai. Ionatan na ia ida e hevaira heheni, bona Abnere na Saulo ohenai e helai, a David ena gabu na asi tauna.
1SA.20.25.english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

1SA.10.4.motu: Idia ese bae hahenamo henimu, bona flaoa igabu rua bae henimu; imadia amo do bavabi.
1SA.10.4.english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

1SA.9.17.motu: Bena Samuel ese Saulo e itaia negana ai, Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Na gwauraia tauna binai; ia ese egu bese baine halohiaia.
1SA.9.17.english: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

1SA.26.1.motu: Sifi taudia na Saulo dekena ela, Gibea ai, eto, David na Hakila ororona ai e komumu, Iesimono mairiveina kahana ai.
1SA.26.1.english: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”

1SA.18.16.motu: A Israel bona Iuda taudia iboudiai ese David e ura heniava; badina be ia na idia vairadiai e raka lasiva e raka vareaiva.
1SA.18.16.english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

1SA.12.10.motu: Bena idia ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Ai na vada a kara dika; badina be Iehova vada a rakatania, Baal bona Astaroto isiaidia vada a lao heni; a harihari inaimai imadia amo ame hamaurimai, bena oi isiaimu baia lao heni.
1SA.12.10.english: They cried to Yahweh, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahweh and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

1SA.17.24.motu: Israel taudia iboudiai na una tau e itaia, bena ia vairana amo e heau oho mai garidia ida.
1SA.17.24.english: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified.

1SA.13.18.motu: orea iharuana na Bete-horono kahana ela; ma orea ihatoina natano hetoana dalana amo ela, unu amo e roha lao, Seboimi kourana bona tano ḡaḡaena e itava.
1SA.13.18.english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

1SA.18.28.motu: Saulo ese e itaia bona e diba, Iehova na David ida, bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese ia e ura henia;
1SA.18.28.english: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

1SA.15.16.motu: Bena Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Eremu! Aina hamaoromu, Iehova ese boi hanuaboi ede e hereva henigu toma. Saulo eto, A hereva.
1SA.15.16.english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.”

1SA.1.24.motu: Mero na rata e topoa nege murinai, sinana ese e laohaia; boromakau maruanena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona flaoa efa ta, bona vine ranuna kopi ta, danu e abi kau. E laohaia, ela bona Iehova ena dubu Silo ai e kau. Mero na do maraḡi.
1SA.1.24.english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

1SA.7.4.motu: Taunabunai Israel ese Baalona Astaroto e rakatanidia, Iehova mo isiaina e lao heniva.
1SA.7.4.english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.

1SA.11.6.motu: Saulo na una hereva e kamonai negana ai na Dirava ena lauma ese e rohea badabada, bona e badu dikadika danu.
1SA.11.6.english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

1SA.17.56.motu: Pavapava na eto, A henanadai ia na daika natuna.
1SA.17.56.english: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

1SA.28.5.motu: Saulo ese Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana e itaia, bena e gari, kudouna e hetaha dikadika.
1SA.28.5.english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

1SA.5.9.motu: E laohaia murinai, Iehova ese ia imana e toia roro, una hanua ihadikana totona, bena gari ese e butudia tao. Ia ese hanua taudia kikina-badana e hahisidia, gudu dikadia amo.
1SA.5.9.english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

1SA.16.22.motu: Bena Saulo ese hereva e siaia Iese enai, eto, David na lau isiaigu ilao-henina ai baine noho, badina be lau ese na lalo namo heniamu.
1SA.16.22.english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

1SA.3.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese Samuel e boi henia lou, nega ihatoina. Mero na e tore isi, Eli dekena ela, eto, Lau ina o boirigu. Bena Eli lalona e parara, Iehova ese una mero vada e boi henia.
1SA.3.8.english: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.”

1SA.11.3.motu: Bena labese tau-badadia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Dina hitu ba henimai, unu dina lalodiai ai ese gwaukau taudia baia siaidia Israel tanona idoinai. Bena tau ta ese basinema hamaurimai, ai na oi dekemu ai baia raka lasi.
1SA.11.3.english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

1SA.23.11.motu: Keila taudia ese ia imana ai bae atogu eiava? Saulo na do bainema, lau binai emu hesiai tauna vada na kamonai heḡereḡerena, eiava? Iehova e, Israel Diravana e, lau na noimumu, lau binai emu hesiai tauna ame hamaorogu. Iehova eto, Ia na bainema.
1SA.23.11.english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.”

1SA.19.15.motu: Saulo ese gwaukau taudia ma e siaidia, David bae itaia; eto, Mai ena mahuta patana ida ba huaia mai, bena baina alaia mase.
1SA.19.15.english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

1SA.6.5.motu: Taunabunai, emui gudu dikadia laulaudia ba kara, bona emui tano e hadikaiamu bitadia laulaudia danu ba kara, bona Israel Diravana ba heatolaia. Bena reana ia ese imana baine abia oho, umui emui amo bona emui dirava edia amo bona emui tano amo.
1SA.6.5.english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

1SA.10.7.motu: Ini toa na emu ai bae kau negana ai, imamu ese baine davaria ḡaukarana na ba karaia, badina be Dirava na oi ida.
1SA.10.7.english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

1SA.19.9.motu: Bena lauma dikana ta Iehova ena amo ese Saulo e butua tao. Ia na ena ruma ai e helaiva, imana na mai iona, a David be gitara e hataiava.
1SA.19.9.english: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

1SA.15.31.motu: Taunabunai Samuel na Saulo murina amo e lou lao; bona Saulo ese Iehova e toma henia diho.
1SA.15.31.english: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.

1SA.15.5.motu: Bena Saulo na Amalek hanuana e raka henia kahi, koura ai e bani tao.
1SA.15.5.english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

1SA.6.20.motu: Bena Bete-semese taudia eto. Daika ese ina Dirava helaḡana, Iehova, vairanai baine gini? Bona ita eda amo ia na daidia dekedia bainela?
1SA.6.20.english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

1SA.20.30.motu: Bena Saulo e badu ḡaraḡara, Ionatan e badu henia; bena e gwau henia, eto, Oi na kara gageva-gageva bona gwau-edeede hahinena natuna; oi nao tomu lau na asi dibagu oi ese Iese natuna vada o abia hidi, oi ihahemaraimu bona sinamu tau-anina ihahemaraina ai bainela.
1SA.20.30.english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

1SA.15.7.motu: Bena Saulo ese Amalek taudia e hadareredia, Havila amo ela bona Suru. Hari Suru na Aigupto mairiveina kahana ai.
1SA.15.7.english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

1SA.21.13.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese ena kara e ha-idauaidia vairadiai, e kara idia imadia ai vada e kavaia na heto, maḡu iduaradia e kakasi, bona uduna tabana na aukina huina amo e diho.
1SA.21.13.english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

1SA.21.5.motu: David ese hahelaḡa tauna e haere henia, eto, Momokani, hahine na asie raka henimai kahi; egu tuari lao iboudiai na unu mo heto. Eregabe taudia edia tuari ḡaudia danu vada e hahelaḡadia. Bema laolao kavakava mo danu idia na unu bema kara toma; matona, hari dina ai vada e hahelaḡadia vaitani.
1SA.21.5.english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

1SA.18.11.motu: bena e tahoa, eto, David na haba ida aine raia bou. A David be nega rua e dekea.
1SA.18.11.english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

1SA.23.17.motu: Ia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Asio gari; badina be tarnagu Saulo imana ese basine davarirnu; oi na Israel pavapavana ai baola, bona lau na oi murimu ai bainala. Tamagu Saulo danu dibana.
1SA.23.17.english: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

1SA.29.4.motu: A Filistia edia tuari biagudia ese e badu henia, bena e gwau henia, eto, Ena tau a siaia lou, o henia gabuna baine lou lao; ia na ita ida basine diho tuari gabuna, tuari lalonai baine inai henida na garina. Badina be ina tau na ena lohia ida ede baine herohemaino toma? Ini tatau kwaradia amo ani?
1SA.29.4.english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

1SA.21.1.motu: David na Nob ela, hahelaḡa tauna Ahimelek dekenai e kau. Ahimelek na e raka lasi mai heude-heudena ida, David ida e hedavari, eto, Dahaka dainai sibomu oma? Badina dahaka asi bamomu?
1SA.21.1.english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

1SA.2.9.motu: Ia ese ena helaḡa taudia aedia baine gimadia,
1SA.2.9.english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones,

1SA.12.9.motu: A idia ese Iehova, edia Dirava, e laloa boio; bena ia ese Sisera, Hasoro pavapavana Iabin ena tuari oreana biaguna, imana ai, bona Filistia taudia imadia ai, bona Moab pavapavana imana ai, e atodia; idia ese e tuari henidia.
1SA.12.9.english: But they forgot Yahweh their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

1SA.24.5.motu: Gabeamo David na e helalo, ia ese Saulo ena dabua rimuna e utua oho dainai.
1SA.24.5.english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

1SA.25.3.motu: Una tau ladana na Nabala; adavana ladana na Abigail. Hahine na mai aonegana bona mai hairaina, a tau na mai daḡedaḡena bona kara dika tauna. Ia na Kaleb ena iduhu tauna.
1SA.25.3.english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

1SA.30.19.motu: Ḡau ta se boio, maraḡina eiava badana, eiava natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, eiava e dadi kohudia, eiava e abi ḡaudia ta. David ese idoinai e loulaia.
1SA.30.19.english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

1SA.18.19.motu: A hari Saulo natuna hahinena Meraba na David bae henia eto negana ai, idia ese Adriele, tau Mehola, e henia, ia ese e adavaia.
1SA.18.19.english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

1SA.30.21.motu: Bena David na hari tatau sinahu-rua, tau-manori dainai David murinaiasie raka bena Besoro sinavaina badibadinai e rakatanidia taudia, na dekediai e kau. Idia na e raka lasi, David bona ena orea taudia ida bae hedavari totona. Bena David ese e raka henidia kahi, e hanamodia.
1SA.30.21.english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

1SA.14.40.motu: Bena ia ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui na kaha ta ai ba gini; a lau bona natugu Ionatan na kaha ta ai baia gini. Idia ese Saulo e haere henia, eto, Emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ba karaia.
1SA.14.40.english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.”

1SA.9.2.motu: Kisa na mai natuna maruanena ta, ladana Saulo. Ia na tauhau malaḡana; Israel tataudia iboudiai na ia ese e hereadia. Ena lata ai danu e hereadia; idia kwaradia na ia pagana ida heḡereḡere.
1SA.9.2.english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

1SA.19.7.motu: Bena Ionatan ese David e boiria, unu hereva iboudiai e hamaorolaia. Bena Ionatan ese David na Saulo dekena e hakaua lao; bena ia na ia vairanai e nohova, gunaguna heḡereḡerena.
1SA.19.7.english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

1SA.22.7.motu: Bena Saulo ese ena hesiai taudia, e ginia heḡeḡe taudia, e hamaorodia, eto, Beniamina taumui e, a hakala! Iese natuna na umui ta ta uma bona vine imeadia baine henimui a? Iboumui ai daha biagudia bona sinahu biagudia ai baine halaomui a?
1SA.22.7.english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

1SA.10.18.motu: Ia ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese Israel besena na Aigupto amo na hakaua lasi; Aigupto taudia imadia amo bona e hahisimuiva basileiadia iboudiai imadia amo na hamaurimui.
1SA.10.18.english: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

1SA.6.1.motu: Iehova ena maua helaḡana na hua hitu Filistia tanona ai e miava.
1SA.6.1.english: Yahweh’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

1SA.14.14.motu: Una ala-ala gini-gunana lalonai Ionatan bona enakesi ihuana tauna ese tatau ruahui sisivana e aladia mase, inoḡo ta, dina tamona ai bema ruaia heḡereḡerena, lalonai.
1SA.14.14.english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

1SA.30.10.motu: A David na e ḡava, ia bona tatau sinahu hani; sinahu rua e noho, badina be taudia e manori, asi goadadia Besoro sinavaina bae hanaia.
1SA.30.10.english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

1SA.22.23.motu: Lau dekegu ai ba noho, basio gari; badina be lauegu mauri iabi-ohona e tahuamu tauna ese oiemu mauri danu iabi-ohona e tahuamu. A lau ida ba noho, vada ba mauri.
1SA.22.23.english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”

1SA.17.26.motu: Bena David ese ia badibadinai e giniva taudia na e nanadaidia, eto, Ina tau Filistia baine alaia mase bona Israel ena hemarai baine abia oho tauna na ede bae kara henia toma? Badina be ina tau Filistia, se peritomea tauna, be daika, ia na Mauri Diravana ena tuari oreadia e hare henidiamu a?
1SA.17.26.english: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

1SA.26.11.motu: Lau imagu na Iehova ese e horoa tauna ai bema dau kau, Iehova ese bema gwaugu tao. A harihari io ia kwarana badinai na avabia, una hodu mai ranuna danu, bena baitala.
1SA.26.11.english: Yahweh forbid that I should stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”

1SA.1.21.motu: Hari Elkana mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ela, laḡani ta boubouna bae hahelaḡaia Iehova ena bona ena gwauhamata anina baine heni totodia.
1SA.1.21.english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

1SA.8.17.motu: Emui seri baine karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta baine abia iena. Baine ḡuimui, ena hesiai ai baine halaomui.
1SA.8.17.english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

1SA.6.19.motu: Ia ese Bete-semese taudia haida e aladia mase, badina be idia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana lalonai e igo vareai. Tatau hitu-ahui unu ealadia mase toma: bena hanua taudia na e taitai, badina be Iehova ese una ala-ala badana e karaia Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
1SA.6.19.english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.

1SA.19.13.motu: Bena Mikala ese e koroa laulauna ta e abia, mahuta patana ai e hahekurea, nani huina amo e karaia ikwinana ia kwarana henunai e atoa, bena hetaru amo e tarua.
1SA.19.13.english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

1SA.29.9.motu: Bena Akisi ese David e haere henia, eto, Lau dibagu oi na asi emu kerere lau vairagu ai, Dirava ena aneru heḡereḡerena; ḡau tamona Filistia edia tuari biagudia vada e hereva, eto “Ia na ita ida tuari basinela”.
1SA.29.9.english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

1SA.4.17.motu: Bena una hari e mailaia tauna na e haere, eto, Israel na Filistia taudia vairadia amo vada e heau; hutuma bada vada e aladia mase; oi natumu raruosi danu, Hofni bona Fineha, vada e mase; bona Dirava ena maua helaḡana vada e dadia.
1SA.4.17.english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

1SA.14.15.motu: Bena gari bada vada e vara, taruha ai bona tuari gabuna ai bona taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidiai: taruha ai e nohova taudia bona tuari amo ema taudia na kudoudia e hetahava; tano danu e lagava; bena iboudiai na e gari dikadikava.
1SA.14.15.english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

1SA.18.8.motu: Bena Saulo e badu dikadika, una hereva e badulaia; eto, David ena gerebu gerebu e gwauraidiamu, a lauegu daha daha mo e gwauraidiamu. Ma dahaka baine abia? Ina basileia a?
1SA.18.8.english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”

1SA.30.16.motu: E hakaua lao, bena e itadia, idia na tano idoinai e taruhaia evaeva, e anianiva, e inuinuva, e mavaruva, kohu bada-herea Filistia taudiaedia tano ai bona Iuda tanona ai vada e dadi daidiai.
1SA.30.16.english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

1SA.17.53.motu: A Israel taudia na Filistia taudia ihahavadia amo e lou, bena edia taruha kohudia e dadi ore.
1SA.17.53.english: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.

1SA.14.34.motu: Saulo ma eto, Taunimanima bogaragidiai baola, ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ta ta ena boromakau ena boromakau mamaruanedia bona ena mamoe ena mamoe bae mailaidia, iniseni ai bae aladia mase bona bae anidia. Iehova vairanai basio kara havara; vamu mai rarana basio ania.” Taunabunai, una hanuaboi idia ta ta ena boromakau ena boromakau mamaruanedia e laohaidia, unuseni ai e aladia mase.
1SA.14.34.english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against Yahweh in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

1SA.2.21.motu: Iehova ese Hana e vadivadi henia; bena e rogorogo, natuna haida e abidia, memero tatoi bona kekeni rarua. A Samuel na Iehova vairanai e bada oho bada oho.
1SA.2.21.english: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.

1SA.2.26.motu: Samuel na e bada oho bada oho; Iehova bona taunimanima edia uraheni ienai e bada e laova danu.
1SA.2.26.english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.

1TH.1.9.motu: Badina be idia sibodia harida e hapiuamu, ede o abimai dae toma, bona kaivakuku ede o rakatanidia toma, bona Dirava Mauri, Dirava Momokani, ede o haḡerea toma, isiaina ede o lao heni tomamu,
1TH.1.9.english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

1TH.5.13.motu: Bona edia ḡaukara dainai emui lalokau ai bavabidia dae. Ba hedaro boubou.
1TH.5.13.english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake.

1TH.5.22.motu: ḡau dikana ena amo ba raka oho.
1TH.5.22.english: Abstain from every form of evil.

1TH.3.11.motu: Benaini, Tamada Dirava bona eda Lohiabada Iesu ese do bae hakaumai vasi.
1TH.3.11.english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

1TH.2.17.motu: Varavaramai e, ina nega sisina ai vairamui asia itamu; tau-anida na mai padadia, to laumada na asi padadia; taunabunai ai na a ura lalo-dika vairamui baiama ita lou ato.
1TH.2.17.english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

1TH.5.21.motu: Ḡau iboudiai ba diba toho: ḡau namona ba kahua tarika-tarika;
1TH.5.21.english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

1TH.3.12.motu: Lohiabada ese emui heura-heheni baine havaraia bona baine habadaia; bona baine durumui, taunimanima iboudiai ba lalokau henidia, ai ese umui a lalokau henimuimu heḡereḡerena;
1TH.3.12.english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

1TH.5.25.motu: Varavaramai e, ai daimai ai ba ḡuriḡuri.

1TH.3.13.motu: bona lalomui baine hagoadadia, bena eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso mai ena helaḡa taudia loḡora ida baema negana ai, Tamada Dirava vairanai ba helaḡa, asi bebeka-bebekamui.
1TH.3.13.english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

1TH.5.5.motu: Umui iboumui ai diari memeromui, dina memeromui: ita na dia hanuaboi ena, dia dibura ena.
1TH.5.5.english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

1TH.4.8.motu: Taunabunai, e dadaraiamu tauna ese dia taunimanima se dadaraidiamu, a ena Lauma Helaḡa e henimuimu Diravana e dadaraiamu.
1TH.4.8.english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

1TH.5.1.motu: Varavaramai e, nega bona laḡani herevadia na basia torelai henimui;
1TH.5.1.english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

1TH.5.23.motu: Maino Diravilla ese idoimui ai baine hahelaḡamui ḡuḡuru. Lalomui bona laumamui bona taumui ia ese baine dogodia tao, asi bebeka-bebekamui ba noho, ela bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bainema
1TH.5.23.english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.1.3.motu: Emui kamonai karadia, bona emui uraheni ḡaukaradia, bona emui helaro Lohiabada Iesu Keriso enai e aukamu, ini ḡau nega idoidiai Tamada Dirava vairanai, a lalo taomu.
1TH.1.3.english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

1TH.2.3.motu: Badina be emai hahealo herevadia na dia lalo-hadai kerere amo, dia lalo-hadai mirodia amo, dia koikoi amo, asie vara;
1TH.2.3.english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

1TH.3.4.motu: ta noho hebouva negana ai a hamaoromui heḡaeḡaeva hisi bae vara; benaini, vada e vara, ani!
1TH.3.4.english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

1TH.2.5.motu: Umui dibamui ai na nega ta asia gwaumui lalo-aniva; bona Dirava dibana ai na kohu asia ḡaima hehuniva.
1TH.2.5.english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

1TH.4.4.motu: bona iboumui ai ba diba, ta ta adavamui bavabidia mai helaḡamui bona mai hematauraimui ida,
1TH.4.4.english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

1TH.5.8.motu: A ita, dina tauda, baita haheauka; kemeda ai kamonai bona lalokau baita hadabualai, bona hahemauri helarona na kwarada ḡauna ai baita halaoa.
1TH.5.8.english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

1TH.3.5.motu: Badina binai, egu haheauka e ore negana ai na siaia vasi, emui abidadama sivaraina baina diba, hedibaḡani tauna ese bema dibaḡanimui bena emai hekwarahi anina bema boio na garina.
1TH.3.5.english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

1TH.3.9.motu: Dirava ede baia hanamoa toma, emai Dirava vairanai umui a moalelaimuimu moalena idoinai dainai?
1TH.3.9.english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

1TH.4.11.motu: Mai manaumui ida ba noho, sibomui emui ḡaukara ba kara, imamui amo ba ḡaukara, a haḡanimuiva heḡereḡerena.
1TH.4.11.english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

1TH.5.18.motu: Ḡau iboudiai daidiai Dirava ba hanamoa; badina be una na Dirava ena ura emui, Keriso Iesu bagunai.
1TH.5.18.english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

1TH.3.6.motu: A harihari Timoteo na emui amo vada e lou mai, emui abidadama bona emui lalokau haridia vada e mailai; e tomu, umui ese nega idoinai o lalomaimu mai moalemui ida, bona o uramu ha itamai, ai a uramu baia itamui heḡereḡerena.
1TH.3.6.english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

1TH.4.6.motu: Bona ta ese varavarana basine koia bona basine hurea hanai; badina be ini kara iboudiai davadia ihenina tauna na Lohiabada, ai ese a hamaoromui gunava bona vada a gwauraia hedinaraiva heḡereḡerena.
1TH.4.6.english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

1TH.4.13.motu: Varavaramai e, a uramu umui na basio daradara mase taudia daidiai; bona daramui basie doko, asi edia helaro taudia na heheto.
1TH.4.13.english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

1TH.2.13.motu: Una dainai ai ese Dirava ihanamona asia hadokoamu, badina be emai ai o kamonai herevana na o abia dae, dia taunimanima mo emai hereva, a Dirava ena hereva. Una be momokani, bona una hereva be umui kamonai taumui lalomui ai e ḡaukaramu.
1TH.2.13.english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

1TH.5.9.motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura ita edai na dia badu; ena ura be hahemauri baita abia, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai
1TH.5.9.english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

1TH.2.7.motu: Ai na bogaragimui ai a manauva, natuna e ubudia hahinena na heto.
1TH.2.7.english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

1TH.4.2.motu: Badina be haheḡani, Lohiabada Iesu ena amo a abi a henimui, na dibamui.
1TH.4.2.english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

1TH.5.28.motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na emui ai baine mia.
1TH.5.28.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

1TH.3.2.motu: a tadimai Timoteo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna Keriso ena sivarai namo lalonai, a siaia vasi, emui abidadama ai lalomui baine hagoadadia bona taumui baine halodia totona,
1TH.3.2.english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

1TH.2.16.motu: ai danu e gwaumai taomu, idau bese taudia mauri herevadia basia harorolai henidia e tomamu. Edia kara dika e haḡuḡurumu; Dirava ena badu na latadiai vada e kau, baine habuadia tari.
1TH.2.16.english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

1TH.4.9.motu: Varavara iura-henidia herevadia na basina tore henimui, badina be Dirava ese vada e hadibamui umui ta ta ba heura heheni.
1TH.4.9.english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

1TH.5.26.motu: Varavara iboudiai na haherahu helaḡana amo ba hanamodia.
1TH.5.26.english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

1TH.5.15.motu: Ta ese dika na dika basine davalaia. Namo ba gavaia, bamomui edia bona taunimanima iboudiai edia.
1TH.5.15.english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

1TH.2.19.motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada Iesu baine lou mai negana ai emai helaro, emai moale, emai heaḡi toana, ia vairanai be dahaka? Umui, ani!
1TH.2.19.english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

1TH.4.5.motu: dia mata-dika ena ura bodagadia daidiai basio abidia, Dirava asi dibadia besedia na heheto.
1TH.4.5.english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

1TH.2.9.motu: Varavaramai e, emai hekwarahi bona emai hisihisi o lalo taomu ani? Dina hanuaboi a ḡaukarava, baia hahekwarahimui na garina; bena Dirava ena sivarai namo a harorolai henimuiva.
1TH.2.9.english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

1TH.5.27.motu: Lohiabada ladana ai na haḡanimuimu, ina revareva na varavara iboudiai vairadiai ba duahia.
1TH.5.27.english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

1TH.2.4.motu: a Dirava ese vada e abimai hidi bona sivarai namo vada e henimai heḡereḡerena mo a gwauraiamu; dia taunimanima ihamoaledia, a laloda e dibamu Diravana ihamoalena.
1TH.2.4.english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

1TH.4.10.motu: Momokani, umui ese varavara iboudiai Makedonia ai o lalokau henidiamu; to, varavaramai e, a noimuimu, una kara ba habadaia.
1TH.4.10.english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

1TH.5.24.motu: E boirimuimu Tauna na momokani; ia ese baine karaia.
1TH.5.24.english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

1TH.2.15.motu: Idia ese Lohiabada Iesu e alaia, edia peroveta taudia danu e aladia, bona ai e lulumai. Idia ese Dirava e habaduamu, bona taunimanima e inai henidiamu;
1TH.2.15.english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

1TH.4.3.motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura binai: ba helaḡa, mata-bodaga kaladia basio kara;
1TH.4.3.english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

1TH.5.7.motu: Mahuta taudia be hanuaboi ai e mahutamu, bona kekero taudia be hanuaboi ai e kekeromu.
1TH.5.7.english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

1TH.4.17.motu: gabeamo, doini tanobada ai ta maurimmu tauda baine abida isi, ori latadiai Lohiabada ida baita hedavari, guba padanai. Bena Lohiabada ida baita noho hebou hanaihanai.
1TH.4.17.english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

1TH.1.1.motu: Ai taloiosi, Paulo bona Siluano bona Timoteo, ese Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia ekalesia oreana Tesalonika ai a tore henimuimu: harihari-bada bona maimo bavabi.
1TH.1.1.english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.1.4.motu: Dibamai danu, varavaramai e, Dirava ese umui, ena lalokau taumui, vada e abimui hidi.
1TH.1.4.english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

1TH.2.14.motu: Varavaramai e, Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia Iudea ai ida vada o heḡereḡere, Keriso Iesu lalonai; badina be Iuda taudia ese idia e hahisidia heḡereḡerena umui emui bese taudia ese vada e hahisimui.
1TH.2.14.english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

1TH.1.2.motu: Ai na nega iboudiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai, bona emai ḡuriḡuri ai umui ladamui a hato louloumu.
1TH.1.2.english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

1TH.2.1.motu: Varavaramai e, dibamui a vasi negana ai na emai heigo-ita na mai anina.
1TH.2.1.english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

1TH.3.7.motu: Varavaramai e, emui abidadama dainai taumai vada eme lo, emai hisihisi bona emai daradoko lalodiai.
1TH.3.7.english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

1TH.5.12.motu: Varavaramai e, a noimuimu, bogaragimui ai e ḡaukaramu bona Lohiabada ladana ai e reḡumuimu bona e sisiba henimuimu taudia na ba hakala henidia.
1TH.5.12.english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

1TH.4.15.motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena hereva a henimuimu, a tomu, Lohiabada ena mai dinana ai tanobada ai ta nohomu tauda ese mase taudia basita laidia oho.
1TH.4.15.english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

1TH.1.5.motu: Badina be emai sivarai namo emui ai e kau, dia hereva ai mo, a siahu ai bona Lauma Helaḡa ai, bena emui ai e momokani vaitani; bona emai kara daimui ai vairamui ai e hedinarai be dibamui.
1TH.1.5.english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

1TH.4.7.motu: Badina be Dirava ese vada e boirida, dia mata-dika enai, to helaḡa enai.
1TH.4.7.english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

1TH.2.12.motu: Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena ai ba raka helaoreana. Ia ese vada e boirimui, ena basileia bona hairaina baine henimui.
1TH.2.12.english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

1TH.1.8.motu: Badina be umui emui amo Lohiabada ena hereva vada e piua rohoroho, Makedonia ai bona Akaia ai; bona dia una mo, a gabu iboudiai emui abidadama Dirava enai vada e diba. Taunabunai, ai baia hereva na asi badina.
1TH.1.8.english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

1TH.2.8.motu: Unu a ura henimui tomava dainai, lalomai e urava dia Dirava ena sivarai namo mo baiama henimui, a laumamai danu; badina be a lalokau henimuiva.
1TH.2.8.english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

1TH.3.3.motu: ini hisihisi lalodiai ta basine marere-marere helaoreana. Badina be dibamui hisi-ani e ahulaida;
1TH.3.3.english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

1TH.5.14.motu: Varavaramai e, a haḡanimuimu: noho kava taudia ba sisiba henidia, lalo-hesiku taudia ba hagoadadia, manoka taudia ba imudadia, taunimanima iboudiai ba haheauka henidia.
1TH.5.14.english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

1TH.2.6.motu: Ena be ai na Keriso ena aposetolo dainai baiama hametaumui diba, to nega ta heimodai asia tahuava, umui emui ai eiava haida ediai.
1TH.2.6.english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

1TH.5.6.motu: Benaini, basita mahuta, haida e mahutamu na heto; a matada baita hapapa nega iboudiai, baita haheauka.
1TH.5.6.english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

1TH.4.12.motu: Unu amo murimuri taudia vairadiai ba raka bena idia ese bae matauraimui, bona ḡau ta ai basio dabu.
1TH.4.12.english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

1TH.2.11.motu: Tama ese natuna e kara henidiamu heḡereḡerena, a hahealo henimuiva, taumui a halova, a haḡanimuiva,
1TH.2.11.english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

1TH.1.7.motu: Bena kamonai taudia iboudiai Makedonia ai bona Akaia ai edia ihaḡoina ḡauna ai ola.
1TH.1.7.english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

1TH.3.1.motu: Emai haheauka e ore, bena ato ai raruosi mo Atena ai baia noho,
1TH.3.1.english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

1TH.5.2.motu: badina be umui dibamui Lohiabada ena dina na bainema, henao tauna hanuaboi ai e maimu na heto.
1TH.5.2.english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

1TH.2.18.motu: Bena baia vasi ato; momokani, lau Paulo dala na tahu loulouva baina vasi nato. To Satana ese e laomai ahu.
1TH.2.18.english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

1TH.5.11.motu: Taunabunai, ba hahealo heheni, ba hahegoada heheni, ina harihari o karamu heḡereḡerena.
1TH.5.11.english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

1TH.2.20.motu: Emai heaḡi bona emai moale badidia na umui.
1TH.2.20.english: For you are our glory and our joy.

1TH.5.10.motu: Ia na ita daidai e mase, bena nogada ai eiava mahutada ai ia ida baita noho hebou.
1TH.5.10.english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

1TH.2.2.motu: Dibamui a hisihisi gunava, Filipi ai e daḡedaḡe henimaiva; a Dirava ladana ai a haheauka, daḡedaḡe bogaraginai Dirava ena sivarai namo a hadibalaimuiva, asia gariva.
1TH.2.2.english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

1TH.5.3.motu: Idia baeto “Maino” bona “Namo” negana ai, hebuatari ese baine lasidia tao, hekamonai ese rogorogo hahinena e lasia taomu na heto; bena basie roho mauri diba.
1TH.5.3.english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

1TH.3.10.motu: Dina bona hanuaboi a ḡuriḡuri goadagoadamu, vairamui do baia ita a tomu, bena abidadama ai o dabumu ḡaudia baia henimui ḡuḡuru.
1TH.3.10.english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

1TH.4.18.motu: Benaini, ini hereva daidiai ba hahegoada heheni.
1TH.4.18.english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

1TH.5.4.motu: To, varavaramai e, umui na dia dibura taumui; una dina ese basine lasimui tao, henao tauna na heto.
1TH.5.4.english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

1TH.3.8.motu: Umui Lohiabada enai bo gini tutuka-tutukamu dainai ai baia maurimu.
1TH.3.8.english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

1TH.2.10.motu: Umui dibamui, Dirava danu dibana, umui kamonai taumui bogaragimui ai a nohova mai helaḡamai bona mai maoromaoromai ida, asi bebeka-bebekamai.
1TH.2.10.english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

1TH.4.14.motu: Ta abia daemu herevana binai: Iesu e mase, ma e tore isi lou. Benaini, Iesu enai e masemu taudia na Dirava ese ia ida baine hakaudia vareai mauri ai.
1TH.4.14.english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

1TH.4.1.motu: Varavaramai e, orena binai: Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai a noimuimu, bona a haḡanimuimu, emui raka dalana bona Dirava ihamoalena dalana, emai ai o abia, ba goadalaia.
1TH.4.1.english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

1TH.4.16.motu: Badina be Lohiabada na guba amo mai lolona ida baine diho; bona aneru badana danu mai gadona ida bona mai kibi be Dirava ena. Bena Iesu enai e mase taudia na hae tore isi guna;
1TH.4.16.english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

1TH.1.6.motu: Bena ai o haḡoimai, Lohiabada danu o haḡoia, hereva o abia daeva mai hisihisimui ida, to mai moalemui ida danu, Lauma Helaḡa moalena.
1TH.1.6.english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

1TH.1.10.motu: bona ia Natuna guba amo ede o naria tomamu: Iesu bunai, ia na mase amo e tore isi, bainema baduna amo e hamauridamu.
1TH.1.10.english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

1TI.2.12.motu: Hahine na na gwaua tubumu, basine hahediba, bona tau basine gunalaia; ia na asi reḡereḡena baine noho.
1TI.2.12.english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

1TI.2.1.motu: Taunabunai, egu hahealo gini-gunana binai: noinoi bona ḡuriḡuri be Dirava igamena bona ihanamolaina ba kara, taunimanima daidiai,
1TI.2.1.english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

1TI.5.4.motu: To vabu ta bema mai natuna eiava mai tubuna, idia na bae diba, Dirava ibadinana na edia ruma korikori ai bae haḡuḡurua guna, natudia ese tamadia sinadia bae ubudia; badina una be kara namona Dirava vairanai.
1TI.5.4.english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

1TI.4.8.motu: Badina be tau-anina ihagoadana na taina namo, a Dirava ibadinana ese ḡau iboudiai e hanamodiamu; ia hari mai gwauhamatana, ina mauri ena bona mauri gabena ena.
1TI.4.8.english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

1TI.1.2.motu: natugu korikori Iesu ibadinana ai, Timoteo, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona hebogahisi bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ena amo, bavabi.
1TI.1.2.english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1TI.6.19.motu: Unu amo edia badi namona bae abia heḡaeḡae, vairada dinadia ena, bena mauri korikori bae abia tao.
1TI.6.19.english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

1TI.4.3.motu: Idia ese taunimanima e gwaudia taomu, basie headava e tomu, bona aniani haida basie ani. A unu aniani na Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia; kamonai taudia bona hereva momokani dibadia taudia ese Dirava bae hanamoa guna ḡuriḡuri ai, bena bae ani.
1TI.4.3.english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

1TI.3.4.motu: Iena ruma baine reḡua namonamo, natuna danu baine reḡudia, bae kamonai henia bona bae matauraia;
1TI.3.4.english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

1TI.1.11.motu: Unu hahediba herevadia momokanidia be Herea-dae bona Hairai Diravana ena sivarai namo; bona ia ese ena sivarai namo ireḡuna tauna ai vada e halaogu.
1TI.1.11.english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

1TI.2.9.motu: Hahine danu dava maraḡi dabuadia bae hahedokilai, mai manaudia bona mai hematauraidia ida. Huidia basie pani, goldeiava aḡeva mai hairaidia basie heralai, dava bada dabuadia danu basie doki.
1TI.2.9.english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

1TI.1.13.motu: Ena be gunaguna na ere dikava, na daḡedaḡe heniava, ladana na hadikaiava, to e bogagu hisi; badina be mata-lahui ai na karava, asi egu kamonai dainai
1TI.1.13.english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

1TI.1.9.motu: A baita diba, taravatu vada e haginia, dia kara maoromaoro tauna ena, a kara-havara taudia edia bona gwau-edeede taudia edia, Dirava garina asie garimu taudia edia bona kara dika taudia edia, tamadia sinadia e aladiamu taudia edia bona roroma taudia edia,
1TI.1.9.english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

1TI.5.15.motu: Badina be haida vada e raka oho vaitani, Satana vada e ḡavaia.
1TI.5.15.english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

1TI.2.14.motu: Adam danu se koia; hahine hari e koia, bena kara havara ese e butua tao.
1TI.2.14.english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

1TI.5.18.motu: Badina be Buka Helaḡa na e gwaumu: Boromakau ese uit e moimoilaiamu negana ai na uduna basio ḡuia. Ma e gwaumu: Ḡaukara tauna ese davana baine abia, una na baine namo.
1TI.5.18.english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” + 5:18 Deuteronomy 25:4 And, “\+w The|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w laborer|strong="G2040"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* worthy \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w wages|strong="G3408"\+w*.” + 5:18 Luke 10:7; Leviticus 19:13

1TI.5.16.motu: Iesu ibadinana hahinena ta varavarana haida bema vabu, ia ese bema naridia, ekalesia oreana basinema hametaua. Unu amo ekalesia ese vabu korikori baine naridia diba.
1TI.5.16.english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

1TI.1.5.motu: Egu hahedua anina korikori be lalokau, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva amo bona lalo hadai maoromaorodia amo bona abidadama korikori amo e varamu.
1TI.1.5.english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

1TI.6.7.motu: Badina be ḡau ta tanobada ai asita mailaia, ḡau ta danu basita laohaia.
1TI.6.7.english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

1TI.5.8.motu: Varavarana se naridiamu bona ena ruma taudia se ubudiamu tauna ese Iesu ibadinana e ḡoreamu; ena dika ese murimuri tauna ena dika e hereaiamu.
1TI.5.8.english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

1TI.5.3.motu: Vabu ba matauraidia, bema vabu korikori.
1TI.5.3.english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

1TI.1.6.motu: Haida ese unu amo vada e raka siri, edia dala vada e reaia, hereva kavakavadia e gwauraimu,
1TI.1.6.english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

1TI.2.7.motu: Una dainai haroro tauna bona aposetolo tauna e gwauraigu; na hereva momokanimu, asina koikoimu. Bona idau bese taudia edia hahediba tauna ai e halaogu, kamonai ai bona hereva momokani ai baina hadibadia.
1TI.2.7.english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

1TI.4.10.motu: Badina bunai ta hekwarahimu bona ta hisihisimu, badina be Mauri Diravana ta abidadama heniamu. Ia na taunimanima iboudiai ihamauridia, to kamonai taudia ediai anina na bada.
1TI.4.10.english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

1TI.2.6.motu: Ia sibona ena mauri e heni, taunimanima iboudiai idavalaidia, ihamomokanina na nega korikori ai e hedinarai.
1TI.2.6.english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

1TI.4.15.motu: Ini ḡau ba manadalai, lalomu idoinai ba henidia, bena emu goada na taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai baine hedinarai.
1TI.4.15.english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

1TI.4.11.motu: Ini hereva ba hahedualai, ba hahedibalai.

1TI.1.18.motu: Natugu Timoteo e, ina hahegani na henimumu e gwauraimu gunava herevadia heḡereḡeredia; unu amo tuari namona ba tuarilaia,
1TI.1.18.english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

1TI.2.2.motu: bona hanua pavapavadia bona lohiadia danu daidiai. Unu amo Dirava ibadinana bona imatauraina lalodiai baita noho namonamo mai mainoda ida.
1TI.2.2.english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

1TI.4.7.motu: A taunimanima mo edia gori kavakavadia ba dadarai; Dirava ibadinana mo ba goadalaia.
1TI.4.7.english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

1TI.3.1.motu: Ina hereva na momokani: tau ta ese heitatao dagina baine tahua, ia na dagi namona baine ura henia.
1TI.3.1.english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

1TI.5.1.motu: Tau badana ta basio gwau henia; ba hahealo henia tamamu na heto. Eregabe taudia ba hereva henidia tadikakamu na heheto.
1TI.5.1.english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

1TI.5.5.motu: A vabu korikori, asi varavarana, ese Dirava e abidadama heniamu, e noinoi hanaihanaimu, e ḡuriḡuri boimu e ḡuriḡuri ranimu.
1TI.5.5.english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

1TI.5.9.motu: Vabu ladana basio torea ela bona ena vara laḡanidia tauratoi-ahui bae ore. Tau tamona e adavaia hahinena,
1TI.5.9.english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

1TI.1.19.motu: abidadama bona lalo-hadai namodia ba kahu tao tarika-tarika. Haida ese vada e kahu nege, e kara edia abidadama vada eha tata kohi na heto.
1TI.1.19.english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

1TI.6.8.motu: Taunabunai, malamala bona hahedoki baita davari, unu hari laloda ese bae moalelai na namo.
1TI.6.8.english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

1TI.4.6.motu: Ini hereva oi ese varavarada ba hadibalaidia; bena Keriso Iesu ena hesiai tauna namona ai baola, Iesu ibadinana bona hahediba herevadia namodia, vada o badina guna ḡaudia, ese do bae ubumu.
1TI.4.6.english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

1TI.3.6.motu: Ekalesia tauna matamatana ese ina dagi do basine abia, baine hekokoroku bena diabolo ena hedibaḡani ese baine butua tao na garina.
1TI.3.6.english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

1TI.1.7.motu: sibodia taravatu ihadibalaidia taudia ai baela e tomu. Ḡau tamona, edia hereva anidia bona e gwaurai goadagoadamu ḡaudia na asi dibadia.
1TI.1.7.english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

1TI.5.22.motu: Imamu na tau ta tubuana ai basio ato kau haraḡa; haida edia kara dikadia basio durudia; sibomu nahuamu ba tohoa, ba ḡoevaḡoeva.
1TI.5.22.english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

1TI.6.15.motu: Nega namona ai Ḡaubada namo-hereana ese baine hahedinaraia; ia mo sibona Ḡaubada; pavapava edia Pavapava; lohia edia Lohia;
1TI.6.15.english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

1TI.1.10.motu: heuda-hanai taudia edia bona mata-bodaga taudia edia, taunimanima e henaodiamu taudia edia bona koikoi taudia edia, gwau-hamata koikoi taudia edia bona hahediba herevadi momokanidia e inai henimu taudia edia.
1TI.1.10.english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

1TI.5.19.motu: Haida ese heitatao tauna bae habadelaia, edia hahebade basio abia dae, ela bona dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi ese bae gwauraia hedinarai.
1TI.5.19.english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

1TI.6.9.motu: A taḡa e ura heniamu taudia na hedibaḡani ese e butudia taomu, bona ura kavakavadia bona ura dikadia, idoa na heheto, ese e abidiamu. Taunimanima ihabua-taridia ḡaudia bunu, mase hanaihanai ai e hadonodia masemu.
1TI.6.9.english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

1TI.3.9.motu: Iesu ibadinana herevadia bae badina mai lalodia ḡoevadia ida.
1TI.3.9.english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

1TI.1.14.motu: Bona eda Lohiabada ena harihari-bada vada e bada herea egu ai, abidadama bona lalokau na davaria Keriso Iesu lalonai.
1TI.1.14.english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

1TI.4.9.motu: Ina na hereva momokani; baita abia dae hari namo.
1TI.4.9.english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

1TI.3.2.motu: Taunabunai, heitatao tauna na basie habadelaia diba baine namo; ia danu hahine tamona adavana, boga-auka tauna, aonega tauna, kara manada tauna, heabi-dae tauna, hahediba mai dibana tauna.
1TI.3.2.english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

1TI.6.21.motu: Unu na haida ese vada e abi dae, bena Iesu ibadinana vada e reaia.
1TI.6.21.english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith.

1TI.1.8.motu: Taravatu be namo, tau ta ese baine ḡaukaralaia maoromaoro negana ai.
1TI.1.8.english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

1TI.3.11.motu: Adavadia danu bae matau, basie ere dika, bae boga auka, ḡau iboudiai bae heabidadama.
1TI.3.11.english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

1TI.4.12.motu: Ta basine dadaraimu oi na eregabe mo dainai. A hereva ai, kara ai, lalokau ai, abidadama ai, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva ai, kamonai taudia edia ihaḡoina tauna ai baola.
1TI.4.12.english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

1TI.6.11.motu: A oi, Dirava ena hesiai taumu e, unu ḡau iboudiai ba heautani; kara maoromaoro, Dirava ibadinana, kamonai, lalokau, haheauka, lalo-manau, ba ḡava.
1TI.6.11.english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

1TI.4.5.motu: Badina be Dirava ena hereva bona taunimanima edia ḡuriḡuri ese eme hahelaḡadia.
1TI.4.5.english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

1TI.2.15.motu: A natuna iabina ai mauri baine davaria, kamonai bona lalokau bona kara helaḡa baine badina mai lalo-pararana ida negana ai.
1TI.2.15.english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

1TI.5.10.motu: ena kara namo daidiai e imodaiamu hahinena, natuna e ubudiava hahinena, laolao taudia e abidia daeva hahinena, helaḡa taudia aedia e huriva hahinena, hisihisi taudia e durudiava bona kara namodia iboudial e goadalaiva hahinena, ia hari ladana ba torea.
1TI.5.10.english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

1TI.3.15.motu: A bama halahe, ini amo boma diba taunimanima na ede bae kara toma Dirava ena orea lalonai; Mauri Diravana ena ekalesia bunai, hereva momokani duna bona badina.
1TI.3.15.english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

1TI.6.6.motu: Momokani, Dirava ibadinana mai lalo-uamona be kohu badana ta.
1TI.6.6.english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

1TI.4.16.motu: Sibomu nahuamu ba tohoa, bona emu hahediba herevadia nahuadia ba toho; ba badina tarika-tarika. Unu ba kara toma, bena sibomu ba hahemauri, bona bae kamonai henimu taudia danu ba hamauridia.
1TI.4.16.english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

1TI.3.13.motu: Badina be diakono ḡaukarana e karaia namonamomu taudia na taunimanima ese bae matauraidia, bona Keriso Iesu ikamonaina ai bae goada balaheni.
1TI.3.13.english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

1TI.2.5.motu: Badina be Dirava na tamona; bona herohemaino tauna danu tamona, Dirava bona taunimanima padadiai, tauna be Keriso Iesu.
1TI.2.5.english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

1TI.4.13.motu: Buka Helaḡa iduahina, haroro, hahediba, ba goadalai ela bona lau baina vasi.
1TI.4.13.english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.3.5.motu: badina be tau ta ese ena ruma korikori taudia basinema reḡudia diba, Dirava ena ekalesia oreana ede bema reḡua toma?
1TI.3.5.english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

1TI.2.10.motu: A kara namo mo bae heralai: una na maoro, Dirava imatauraina e gwaurai hamatamu hahinedia ediai.
1TI.2.10.english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

1TI.5.13.motu: Bona lahedo karadia e manadalaimu, idau ruma idau ruma e dae kau dae kaumu; dia lahedo mo, a udu mauri danu, e gado kau gado kaumu, e ere dikamu.
1TI.5.13.english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

1TI.6.5.motu: bona lalodia e kereremu bena hereva momokani vada e rakatanimu taudia edia hepapahuahu asi anidia. Idia banava e tomu Dirava ibadinana na kohu idavarina dala.
1TI.6.5.english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

1TI.1.12.motu: Siahu e henigu tauna, eda Lohiabada Keriso Iesu, na hanamoamu, badina be e haerogu vada na momokani, bona e abigu hidi ena hesiai taugu.
1TI.1.12.english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

1TI.1.16.motu: Badina binai e bogagu hisi: Iesu Keriso ese haheauka idoinai lauegu ai baine hahedinaraia guna, gabeamo bae abidadama henia ela bona mauri hanaihanai bae abia taudia ese lau bae haḡoigu.
1TI.1.16.english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

1TI.1.17.motu: Uru iboudiai edia Pavapava, mase asi dibana, asi ita-itana, sibona mo Dirava, aita matauraia bona aita imodaia, harihari ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
1TI.1.17.english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

1TI.2.8.motu: Taunabunai, lau na uramu gabu iboudiai tatau bae ḡuriḡuri, ima helaḡadia bae dudui isi; basie badu bona basie hepapahuahu.
1TI.2.8.english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

1TI.3.10.motu: Bae dibadia guna; bena ta basinema habadelaidia, diakono karana bema kara.
1TI.3.10.english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

1TI.3.8.motu: Diakono danu unu bae heto: bae matau; basie udu mauri; vine ranuna basie inu momo; moni basie mata ḡaniḡani heni;
1TI.3.8.english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

1TI.4.2.motu: Hari hahediba koikoidia na dibaka taudia haida edia amo. Idia be e kara lalodia na auri siahuna amo e gabu na heto.
1TI.4.2.english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
