2CO.2.4.english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

2CO.13.4.motu: Badina be ia na manoka-manoka ai e hasatauroa, to Dirava ena siahu dainai vada e maurimu. Ai danu mamanoka ia lalonai, to eda hebamo lalonai ai na Dirava ena siahu amo ia ida baia mauri.
2CO.13.4.english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

2CO.9.5.motu: Taunabunai na laloa varavarada aina noidia hari namo, idia bae vasi guna, o gwauraia hamata ḡauna bae haboua heḡaeḡae; bena ia na herahia ḡauna korikori ai bainela, dia ai ese emui ai baiama dadihaia ḡauna na heto.
2CO.9.5.english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

2CO.1.23.motu: Dirava hari lalogu dibana, lau na Korinto asina vasi badina korikori be na bogamui hisi dainai.
2CO.1.23.english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

2CO.8.20.motu: Badina be emai gari tamona be tau ta ese baine habadelaimai, ina herahia badana a ḡaukaralaiamu dainai;
2CO.8.20.english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

2CO.4.5.motu: Badina be emai haroro badina na dia ai sibomai, to Keriso Iesu, ia na Lohiabada, bona ai, umui isiaimui ilao-henina taumai Iesu dainai.
2CO.4.5.english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

2CO.11.29.motu: Daika e manokamu, bena lau asina manokamu? Daika e hekwakwanaimu, bena lau lalogu se siahumu?
2CO.11.29.english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

2CO.5.4.motu: Ina kalaga ai a nohomu taumai emai maduna daidiai a ḡanaḡanamu; asia uramu baia dokia oho, to a uramu matamatana baia dokilaia; bena mauri ese mase baine hadonoa.
2CO.5.4.english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

2CO.1.20.motu: Badina be ia lalonai Dirava ena gwauhamata iboudiai na “oibe”; una dainai ia lalonai Dirava i'imodaina na “amen” amo ta hamomokaniamu.
2CO.1.20.english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

2CO.5.21.motu: Ia na kara dika asi dibana, to tau dikana ai e halaoa ita daidai, ita na ia bagunai Dirava ena maoromaoro ai baitala helaoreana.
2CO.5.21.english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

2CO.11.32.motu: Damasko ai, Areta Ḡaubada ena gavana tauna ese Damasko hanuana e gimaia, lau idabai-taogu totuna.
2CO.11.32.english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

2CO.3.1.motu: Sibomai a hahenamo loumu o tomu a? Eiava, ai na haida heḡereḡeredia, hahenamo revarevadia emui ai eiava emui amo baia abi a?
2CO.3.1.english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

2CO.5.9.motu: Taunabunai, emai lalo-hadai tamona binai: iniseni ai eiava unuseni ai ia mo baia hamoalea.
2CO.5.9.english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

2CO.3.11.motu: Bena se vanaha ḡauna bema mai hururu-hururuna, e miamu ḡauna hururu-hururuna vada herea.
2CO.3.11.english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

2CO.3.13.motu: dia Mose na heto, vairana muko ai e koua, Israel taudia ese se miamu ḡauna basie raraia tao helaoreana.
2CO.3.13.english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

2CO.12.20.motu: Lau na na garimu, baina vasi negana ai baina davarimui, umui na dia lauegu ura heḡereḡerena; umui danu lau ba davarigu, dia umui emui ura heḡereḡerena; bena heai, vaḡeḡe, badu, ani-gunita, hahebade, maumau, hekokoroku, heloḡo-heloḡo, bae vara.
2CO.12.20.english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

2CO.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu Dirava ena ura dainai, varavarada Timoteo ida, Dirava ena ekalesia taumui Korinto ai, bona helaḡa taumui iboumui ai Akaia tanona idoinai, a tore henimuimu:
2CO.1.1.english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

2CO.3.18.motu: Ita iboudai vairada asi mukodia na heto Lohiabada hururu-hururuna ta hahedinaraiamu; hevarivari na heto; bena e haidaudamu, ia heida-ida ai, hairai ta amo ela bona ma hairai la, Lohiabada Laumana dainai.
2CO.3.18.english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

2CO.10.7.motu: Hedinarai ḡaudia ba itadia. Tau ta baineto ia na Keriso ena, ia na baine haeroa lou, ai danu Keriso ena, ia heḡereḡerena.
2CO.10.7.english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

2CO.9.14.motu: Idia ese e lalokau henimuimu, bona Dirava e noiamu daimui ai, badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada na umui emui ai.
2CO.9.14.english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

2CO.13.6.motu: Lau na uramu umui ba diba, ai na heḡereḡere.
2CO.13.6.english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

2CO.2.12.motu: Lau be Troa nala, Keriso ena sivalai namo iharorolaina, bena Lohiabada ese iduara ta e kehoa egu;
2CO.2.12.english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

2CO.2.16.motu: ini idia ediai mase bonana, mase ihavarana, a unu idia ediai mauri bonana, mauri ihavarana.
2CO.2.16.english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

2CO.10.4.motu: Badina be emai tuari ḡaudia na dia tau-anina ena, a Dirava ena amo e maimu siahuna, kohoro irohodia.
2CO.10.4.english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

2CO.4.11.motu: Badina be dina idoidiai, ai mauri taumai taomai e tore Iesu dainai, Iesu ena mauri ai hidiomai ai baine hedinarai helaoreana.
2CO.4.11.english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

2CO.10.9.motu: Basioto egu revareva na ihagarimui totona na tore henimuimu.
2CO.10.9.english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

2CO.3.9.motu: Badina be taunimanima iḡuidia bema mai hururu-hururuna, taunimanima iruhanegedia hururu-hururuna vada herea.
2CO.3.9.english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

2CO.1.14.english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

2CO.8.7.motu: Benaini, ḡau iboudiai emui ai na babada: abidadama, bona hereva, bona lalo-parara, bona haheauka, bona iura-henimai; ina herahia karana danu emui ai baine bada.
2CO.8.7.english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

2CO.13.14.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada bona Dirava ena uraheni bona Lauma Helaḡa ena hetura ese iboumui ai bae bamomui.
2CO.13.14.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

2CO.11.7.motu: Sibogu na hahemanau, umui bae imodaimui totona; Dirava sivaraina namona na harorolai henimuiva asi davagu. Na kerere a?
2CO.11.7.english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

2CO.2.9.motu: Una dainai na tore henimui: toamui baina diba, hereva iboudiai o badina eiava lasi.
2CO.2.9.english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

2CO.11.14.motu: Unu na basita hoalaidia. Badina be Satana sibona diari aneruna ai e hahelao;
2CO.11.14.english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

2CO.12.6.motu: Heaḡi bama ura, to basinama heaḡi kava; hereva momokani bama gwaurai hari. A asina heaḡimu, tau ta ese baine lalogu, lau na herea, dia egu ai e itamu bona e kamonaimu heḡereḡerena, na garina.
2CO.12.6.english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

2CO.8.9.motu: Badina be iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada vada dibamui: ia na taḡa tauna, to umui daimui ai ogoḡami tauna ai ela, ena ogoḡami amo umui baine hataḡamui totona.
2CO.8.9.english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

2CO.6.15.motu: Keriso bona Beliara ede bae herohemaino toma? Kamonai tauna ahuna be dahaka, asi ena kamonai tauna enai?
2CO.6.15.english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

2CO.2.7.motu: harihari ena dika ba gwau tao bona tauna ba haloa, dara-doko ese baine gugubaia mase na garina.
2CO.2.7.english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

2CO.12.5.motu: Una tau hari baina heaḡilaia, a sibogu basina heaḡi. Eiava, sibogu egu manoka-manoka mo baina heaḡilaia.
2CO.12.5.english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

2CO.11.30.motu: Lau bama heaḡi, bena egu manoka-manoka baina heaḡilaia.
2CO.11.30.english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

2CO.4.9.motu: e daḡedaḡe henimaimu, to bamomai asie rakatanimaimu; e haketomaimu, to asia masemu.
2CO.4.9.english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

2CO.3.17.motu: Lohiabada na Lauma; bona Lohiabada Laumana e nohomu gabudia ai ura kwalimu danu e nohomu.
2CO.3.17.english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

2CO.5.2.motu: Momokani, iniseni ai a ḡanaḡanamu, a ura badamu emai guba rumana baia hadokilaia;
2CO.5.2.english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

2CO.10.6.motu: bona umui ba kamonai ḡuḡuru negana ai, gwau-edeede iboudiai davadia baia heni.
2CO.10.6.english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

2CO.11.1.motu: Lau na uramu egu kavakava sina ba haheaukalaia. Mani emui kara ba haheauka henigu.
2CO.11.1.english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

2CO.12.14.motu: Nega ihatoina binai vada name heḡaeḡae, baina vasi na tomu; bona basina hahekwarahimui. Lau na dia emui kohu asina tahuamu, a umui hari na tahumuimu; badina be memero ese kohu basie habou tamadia sinadia edia, a tamadia sinadia ese kohu bae habou natudia edia.
2CO.12.14.english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

2CO.9.4.motu: Bena Makedonia taudia haida ese bema bamogu, baiama vasi davarimui, a do asio hegaegae, bena emai heaḡi kava dainai baiama hemarai, umui danu boma hemarai.
2CO.9.4.english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

2CO.5.18.motu: Ḡau iboudiai danu Dirava ena amo; ia ese Keriso bagunai ia ida vada e haheroheda maino; bona herohemaino isiaina ilao-henina taumai ai vada e halaomai.
2CO.5.18.english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

2CO.4.15.motu: Badina be ini ḡau iboudiai na umui daimui ai; hutuma ese harihari-bada bae abia bena Dirava bae imodaia badabada helaoreana.
2CO.4.15.english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

2CO.7.9.motu: Harihari na moalemu, dia lalomui e hisihisiva dainai, to emui lalo-hisihisi ese helalo-kerehai e havaraia dainai. Badina be emui lalo-hisihisi na Dirava ena amo, taunabunai dika ta emai amo asio davaria.
2CO.7.9.english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

2CO.9.6.motu: Ba laloa: baine hado gadoi tauna ese baine ḡei gadoi; baine hado hoho tauna ese baine ḡei hoho.
2CO.9.6.english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

2CO.9.15.motu: Dirava aita imodaia, ena harihari-bada herea-daena, igwauraina asi dibadia ḡauna, dainai.
2CO.9.15.english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

2CO.7.10.motu: Badina be Dirava ena amo lalo-hisihisina ese helalokerehai e havaraiamu, bona helalo-kerehai ese hahemauri e havaraiamu; basita daradaralaia. A tanobada ena amo lalo-hisihisina ese mase e havaraiamu.
2CO.7.10.english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

2CO.13.5.motu: Sibomui ba hetahu bona sibomui ba hediba, umui na abidadama taumui eiava lasi. Lalomui asie pararamu Iesu Keriso na lalomui ai a? Bema lasi, umui na dia heḡereḡere.
2CO.13.5.english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

2CO.12.1.motu: Heaḡi na dia namo, to ma baina heaḡi: mata-hanai bona Lohiabada ihahedinaraina herevadia baina gwaurai.
2CO.12.1.english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

2CO.5.1.motu: Dibamai emai kalaga binai tanobada ai baine heroho, guba ai ruma ta Dirava ena amo baia abia, dia ima karakara ḡauna to mia-hanaihanai ḡauna.
2CO.5.1.english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

2CO.7.11.motu: Mani ba laloa: ina Dirava ena amo lalo-hisihisina dainai nahuamui o toho ani? lalomui o hamaoromaoro ani? lalomui e hekwarahi ani? o gari ani? o helaro ani? o haheauka ani? dika davana o heni ani? Kara iboudiai lalodiai kerere vada o hamaoromaoro.
2CO.7.11.english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

2CO.7.5.motu: Makedonia ai a kau negana ai, tau-animai asie laḡa ani, hekwarahi ese e ḡeḡemai dae; murimai ai be heatu, Ialomai ai be gari.
2CO.7.5.english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

2CO.6.6.motu: laloḡoevaḡoeva dainai, aonega dainai, lalo-manada dainai, hebogahisi dainai, Lauma Helaḡa dainai, lalokau korikori dainai,
2CO.6.6.english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

2CO.2.5.motu: A hisihisi e havaraia tauna ese dia lau mo se hahisigu, a umui danu taina (herevana basina ha-aukaia) e hahisimui.
2CO.2.5.english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

2CO.7.1.motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau e, ini gwauhamata herevadia tame abi dainai, tau-anina bona lauma ihadikadia karadia iboudiai baita huri oho, helaḡa karadia baita haḡuḡuru, Dirava imatauraina ai.
2CO.7.1.english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

2CO.6.11.motu: Korinto taumui e, hereva momo a hamaorolaimui; lalomai anidia eme hedinarai emui ai.
2CO.6.11.english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

2CO.1.24.motu: Ai ese emui abidadama asia biaguamu, to ai na emui moale ikahana taumai; badina be abidadama dainai o ginimu.
2CO.1.24.english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

2CO.8.4.motu: bona e noimai lalo-dika, edia harihari ḡaudia baia abi, helaḡa taudia idurulaidia, eto.
2CO.8.4.english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

2CO.10.17.motu: A ta baine heaḡi, ia ese Lohiabada baine heaḡilaia.
2CO.10.17.english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” + 10:17 Jeremiah 9:24

2CO.8.6.motu: Una dainai Tito a noia, ina herahia ḡaukarana ia ese e matamaia, bena ia ese emui ai do baine haḡuḡurua ato.
2CO.8.6.english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

2CO.7.16.motu: Lau na moalemu badina be na abidadama henimui momokanimu.
2CO.7.16.english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

2CO.4.6.motu: Badina be Dirava eto “Dibura amo diari baine tara”; Diravana bunai ai lalomai ai e taramu, Dirava hairaina Iesu Keriso vairana ai baia itaia helaoreana.
2CO.4.6.english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” + 4:6 Genesis 1:3 who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2CO.10.13.motu: Ai na basia heaḡi kava, a Dirava ese e henimai hahetohona ai baia heaḡi: hahetohona benai emui ai vada e kau.
2CO.10.13.english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

2CO.4.10.motu: Nega idoinai tau-animai ai Iesu ena mase a loalaiamu, Iesu ena mauri danu tau-animai ai baine hedinarai helaoreana.
2CO.4.10.english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

2CO.4.1.motu: Iena hebogahisi dainai ina hesiai ḡaukarana vada a abia; taunabunai ai na asia hesikumu.
2CO.4.1.english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

2CO.11.4.motu: Ta ese Iesu idauna bema harorolaia, dia ai ese a harorolaiava heḡereḡerena eiava Lauma idauna boma abia dae, dia o abia dae guna laumana heḡereḡerena eiava sivarai namo idauna boma kamonai, dia o kamonai guna ḡauna heḡereḡerena o abi dae haraḡamu ani?
2CO.11.4.english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

2CO.5.14.motu: Badina be Keriso ena uraheni ese e haduamaimu: a tomamu, ta ese iboudiai daidiai e mase, taunabunai iboudiai vada e mase;
2CO.5.14.english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

2CO.11.24.motu: Nega ima Iuda taudia ese hekwadi toi-ahui taurahani-ta amo e kwadigu.
2CO.11.24.english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

2CO.1.8.motu: Varavaramai e, a uramu Asia ai a aniva hisidia ba diba: e gugubamai maseva, emai goada e oreva, banava baia mase ato.
2CO.1.8.english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

2CO.10.5.motu: Hepapahuahu bona Dirava idibana e laoa ahumu ḡaudia iboudiai a haketodiamu; bona lalo-hadai iboudiai a ḡuidiamu, Keriso ikamonaihenina ai;
2CO.10.5.english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

2CO.13.9.motu: Badina be ai a manokamu umui o goadamu negadia ai a moalemu; emai noinoi tamona binai, umui ba namo ḡuḡuru.
2CO.13.9.english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

2CO.2.6.motu: Una tau ena dika davana umui hutuma ese vada o gwauraia vada e heḡereḡere;
2CO.2.6.english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

2CO.3.4.motu: Ai ese Dirava unu a abidadama henia tomamu, Keriso bagunai.
2CO.3.4.english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

2CO.10.3.motu: Ena be tau-anina ena dala ai a rakamu, to emai tuari na dia tau-anina tuarina.
2CO.10.3.english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

2CO.10.16.motu: Bena unukahamui tanodia ai sivarai namo do baia harorolaia; a idauna ta ena ḡaukara basia heaḡilaia.
2CO.10.16.english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

2CO.10.18.motu: Badina be sibona e hahenamomu tauna na namona basine gvauraia, a Lohiabada ese e hanamoamu tauna hari.
2CO.10.18.english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

2CO.5.15.motu: bona iboudiai daidiai e mase, taunabunai e maurimu taudia na sibodia ediai basie mauri, to idia daidiai e mase ma e tore isi lou tauna enai bae mauri.
2CO.5.15.english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

2CO.8.15.motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto,
2CO.8.15.english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.” + 8:15 Exodus 16:18

2CO.13.11.motu: Varavaragu e, na hahetonimuimu; ba namo ḡuḡuru, egu hereva ba kamonai; lalomui bae tamona; maino ai ba noho. Bena uraheni bona maino Diravana ese baine bamomui.
2CO.13.11.english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

2CO.1.2.motu: Tamada Dirava ena amo, bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, harihari-bada bona maino bavabi.
2CO.1.2.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2CO.11.23.motu: Idia na Keriso ena hesiai taudia a? Lau ese na hereadiamu. Na hereva kavamu, ani? Na hekwarahi bada; dibura rumadia ai e kougu loulou; e dadabagu dikadikava; nega hoho masegu danu e kahira-kahirava.
2CO.11.23.english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

2CO.10.2.motu: Lau na noimuimu, dekemui ai baina noho negadia ai gwaugwau badina ta basine hedinarai. Ḡau tamona, lau na tomamu haida, e gwauraimaimu tau-anina ena dala ai a rakamu e tomu taudia, baina gwau henidia dikadika.
2CO.10.2.english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

2CO.11.31.motu: Dirava, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, bae imodaia hanaihanai Diravana, ia hari dibana lau na asina koikoimu.
2CO.11.31.english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

2CO.10.14.motu: Emai siahu asia halataiamu, hetoana asia hanaiamu, umui iabi-vareaimui; badina be Keriso ena sivarai namo a vasilaia.
2CO.10.14.english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

2CO.9.12.motu: Badina be ina herahia ena heduru ese helaḡa taudia edia dabu ḡaudia e henidia ḡuḡurumu; bona Dirava ihanamona danu e habadaiamu.
2CO.9.12.english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

2CO.11.21.motu: Ai na a hemaraimu, badina ai na mamanoka-mamanoka. A ta baine heaḡi, lau danu baina heaḡi. Na hereva kavamu, ani?
2CO.11.21.english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

2CO.5.3.motu: bena baia hadokilaia negana ai basie davarimai kopi kavakava.
2CO.5.3.english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

2CO.10.10.motu: Badina be haida e tomu “Ena revareva na mai metaudia bona mai siahudia, to tau-anina na manoka-manoka bona uduna herevadia danu asi mamidia”.
2CO.10.10.english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

2CO.3.16.motu: a lohiabada bae haḡerea negana ai hari muko baine heabi oho.
2CO.3.16.english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

2CO.11.18.motu: Hutuma ese tau-anina ḡaudia e heaḡilaimu; benaini, lau danu unu baina kara toma.
2CO.11.18.english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

2CO.12.3.motu: Una tau be dibagu, a tau-anina lalonai eiava tau-anina murimurinai e heabi isi na asi dibagu, Dirava dibana; to dibagu ia na Paradiso ai e heabi isi,
2CO.12.3.english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

2CO.5.11.motu: Taunabunai, Lohiabada garina dibamai dainai, ai ese taunimanima lalodia a animu. Dirava vairanai lalomai e hedinaraimu; lau na uramu umui lalomui ai danu lalomai bae hedinarai.
2CO.5.11.english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

2CO.13.10.motu: Taunabunai, lau na dauha amo na tore henimuimu; bena baina vasi negana ai Lohiabada ese vada e henigu siahuna, una na taunimanima ihaginidia dia ihaketodia ḡauna, na basina ḡaukaralaia daḡedaḡe.
2CO.13.10.english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

2CO.4.4.motu: Ina tanobada diravana ese asi edia abidadama taudia lalodia vada e hadiburadia, Keriso namona, Dirava ihagoina tauna, ena sivarai namo diarina ediai baine tata dae roha na garina.
2CO.4.4.english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

2CO.13.3.motu: Toana bunai umui o tahuamu ḡauna, Keriso lauegu amo e herevamu toana. Ia na emui ai se manokamu, a lalomui ai e siahumu.
2CO.13.3.english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

2CO.11.12.motu: A na karamu karadia do baina kara; bena edia dala e tahuamu bae heaḡi, baeto ḡaukara ai idia na ai heḡereḡeremai, taudia na dala ta basie davaria.
2CO.11.12.english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

2CO.1.7.motu: Ai a abidadama henimuimu danu; dibamai ai ida hisihisi ahuna o abiamu, ma ai ida tauhalo ahuna bavabia.
2CO.1.7.english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

2CO.5.19.motu: Herevana binai: Dirava be Keriso lalonai, tanobada taudia ia ida e haheroheda maino, eda kara dika asine lalo tao. Herohemaino herevana binai ai e henimai.
2CO.5.19.english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

2CO.5.12.motu: Sibomai asia hahenamo loumu; to heaḡi badina a henimuimu, ai daimai ai ba heaḡi; bena taunimanima lalodia asie heagilaimu a oromadia mo e heaḡilaimu taudia ba haere henidia diba.
2CO.5.12.english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

2CO.1.3.motu: Dirava aita imodaia; ia na iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, Tama hebogahisina, tauhalo Diravana.
2CO.1.3.english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

2CO.4.8.motu: Ini amo unu amo hahedika e aru maimu, to asia dareremu; a daradaramu, to daramai asie dokomu;
2CO.4.8.english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

2CO.3.8.motu: Benaini, Lauma isiaina ilao-henina hururu-hururuna ese ia basine hereaia a?
2CO.3.8.english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

2CO.2.13.motu: to asina noho namonamova, badina be tadigu Tito asina davaria. Taunabunai na hatonidia, Makedonia nala.
2CO.2.13.english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

2CO.8.3.motu: Na gwauraia hedinaraimu, idia na edia goada heḡereḡerena e heni, ma edia goada e hereaia danu;
2CO.8.3.english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

2CO.11.2.motu: Badina be Dirava ena vaḡeḡe heḡereḡerena ai daimui na vaḡeḡemu; e kara Keriso enai maohenimui vada na kara, haneulato rami-hebouna na heto.
2CO.11.2.english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

2CO.11.16.motu: Na gwau loumu, ta basineto lau na kavakava. A unu boma laloa toma, boma haheauka henigu, kavakava tauna boma haheauka henia na heto; bena taina bama heaḡi.
2CO.11.16.english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

2CO.12.9.motu: To ia ese e hamaorogu eto “Egu harihari-bada na oiemu ai baine davana, badina be manoka-manoka ai lauegu siahu na herea”. Taunabunai egu manoka baina heaḡilaia mai moalegu ida, bena Keriso ena siahu egu ai baine kau.
2CO.12.9.english: He has said to me, “\+w My|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w grace|strong="G5485"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* sufficient \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w power|strong="G1411"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w made|strong="G3004"\+w* perfect \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

2CO.11.33.motu: To bosea lalonai e udagu, maḡu gaba-mauruna amo e tugu dobi; bena na heau mauri, ia imana lalona amo.
2CO.11.33.english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

2CO.4.14.motu: Ai dibamai Lohiabada Iesu e hatorea isi Diravana ese ai danu Iesu ida baine hatoremai isi, bena ai bona umui ia vairanai baita gini.
2CO.4.14.english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

2CO.3.3.motu: Eme hedinarai vaitani umui na Keriso ena revareva, ai ese a reḡuamu; dia ink amo se torea, a Mauri Diravana ena Lauma amo e torea; dia nadi ai se torea, a taunimanima lalodia ai e torea.
2CO.3.3.english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

2CO.5.20.motu: Taunabunai, ai na Keriso ena gwaukau taumai: Dirava ese ai udumai amo e noimuimu, Keriso bagunai Dirava ida ba herohemaino.
2CO.5.20.english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

2CO.4.18.motu: A itamu ḡaudia na asia raraidi mu, to mata-tuna ḡaudia a raraidiamu; badina be a itamu ḡaudia na mai negadia, to mata-tuna ḡaudia na bae mia hanaihanai.
2CO.4.18.english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

2CO.12.19.motu: Reana umui na nega daudau vada o laloa ai na emai kara a hekoramu. Ai na Dirava vairanai a herevamu, Keriso lalonai. Egu lalokau e, ḡau iboudiai a karamu umui ihagoadamui.
2CO.12.19.english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

2CO.3.6.motu: Ia ese e ha-aonegamai, herohemaino matamatana isiaina ilaohenina taumai ai e halaomai; dia buka ai ta duahiamu ḡauna a Lauma ese e hadibildamu ḡauna. Badina be buka ḡauna be hahemase ḡauna, a Lauma ḡauna be hahemauri ḡauna.
2CO.3.6.english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

2CO.1.16.motu: bena umui emui amo Makedonia bainala, ma Makedonia amo baina lou dekemui ai; bena umui ese Iudea bainala dalana ba lailaia nato.
2CO.1.16.english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

2CO.5.13.motu: Ai baiama kava, una na Dirava dainai; a baiama aonega, una na umui daimui ai.
2CO.5.13.english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

2CO.11.10.motu: Keriso ena hereva momokani lalogu ai e miamu dainai, tau ta ese ina egu heaḡi badina na egu amo basine abia oho, Akaia kahana idoinai.
2CO.11.10.english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

2CO.2.10.motu: Umui ese tau ta ena dika ba gwau tao, lau danu ena dika baina gwau tao. Badina be tau ta ena dika bama gwau tao una na umui daimui ai bona Keriso vairanai bama gwau tao,
2CO.2.10.english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

2CO.6.7.motu: hereva momokani dainai, Dirava ena siahu dainai, kara maoromaoro ena tuari ḡaudia imamai idibadia ai bona lauridia ai daidiai.
2CO.6.7.english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

2CO.13.2.motu: O kerere guna taumui bona harihari o kereremu taumui, nega gunana ai na sisiba henimui bona harihari dauha amo ma na tore henimuimu: nega iharuana na vasi heḡereḡerena, baina vasi negana ai basina bogamui hisi.
2CO.13.2.english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

2CO.6.3.motu: Tau ta asia hahekwakwanaia, emai hesiai ilao-henina baine dika na garina.
2CO.6.3.english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

2CO.6.10.motu: Daramai e doko, to nega idoidiai a moalemu. Ogoḡami taumai, to hutuma a hataḡadiamu. Asi emai ḡau ta, to ḡau iboudiai na ai emai.
2CO.6.10.english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

2CO.12.15.motu: Lau na mai moalegu ida egu kohu baina ha-ore bona tau-anigu danu baina ha-orea, umui laumamui daidiai. Lau ese na ura henimui badamu dainai umui ese o ura henigu maraḡimu a!
2CO.12.15.english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

2CO.6.4.motu: A emai kara iboudiai daidiai taunimanima bae diba, ai na Dirava ena hesiai taumai: haheauka dainai, hisihisi daidiai, ogoḡami dainai, lalohisihisi daidiai,
2CO.6.4.english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

2CO.2.8.motu: Taunabunai na noimuimu, emui iura-henina lalonai bavabia lou.
2CO.2.8.english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

2CO.1.21.motu: Ai bona umui na Keriso enai e haginida tutuka-tutukamu bona vada e horoda tauna na Dirava.
2CO.1.21.english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

2CO.11.5.motu: Lau na tomamu, ene aposetolo hereadia na ḡau ta ai asie hereagumu.
2CO.11.5.english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

2CO.12.17.motu: Be; dekemui na siaidia vasi taudia edia amo na koimui a?
2CO.12.17.english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

2CO.13.12.motu: Haherahu helaḡana amo ba hahenamo heheni.
2CO.13.12.english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

2CO.4.3.motu: Emai sivarai namo bema hehuni, ia na mase e lao heniamu taudia mo ediai bema hehuni.
2CO.4.3.english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

2CO.11.26.motu: Egu laolao na momo: sinavai ai na hekwarahi; dadidadi taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; egu bese taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; idau bese taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; hanua lalodiai na hekwarahi; tano ḡaḡaedia ai na hekwarahi; gadobada ai na hekwarahi, varavara koikoi imadia ai na hekwarahi.
2CO.11.26.english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

2CO.1.10.motu: Ia ese mase badana amo e hamaurimaiva bona e hamaurimaimu; a abidadama heniamu danu ia ese do baine hamaurimai.
2CO.1.10.english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

2CO.5.5.motu: E karamai heḡaeḡae tauna na Dirava, bena ihamomokanina Laumana vada e henimai.
2CO.5.5.english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

2CO.8.8.motu: Asina haḡanimuimu; to idia haida edia haheauka amo umui emui uraheni na dibaiamu, ia na momokani eiava lasi.
2CO.8.8.english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

2CO.13.1.motu: Nega ihatoina binai baina vasi. Rarua eiava tatoi edia hereva daidiai hereva iboudiai bae hamomokani.
2CO.13.1.english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.” + 13:1 Deuteronomy 19:15

2CO.8.18.motu: Varavarada ta danu ia ida vada a siaia vasi; ia na mai harina namo, sivarai namo ihapiuna ai, ekalesia oreadia iboudiai lalodiai.
2CO.8.18.english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

2CO.4.7.motu: A ina kohu namona na e kara hodu lalodiai a abiamu na heto; taunabunai siahu herea-daena na Dirava ena amo bainema, dia ai emai amo.
2CO.4.7.english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

2CO.4.13.motu: Emai kamonai be e torea herevana heḡereḡerena, eto, Lau na kamonai, bena na hereva; ai danu a kamonaimu, bena a herevamu.
2CO.4.13.english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” + 4:13 Psalms 116:10 We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

2CO.5.17.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta bema Keriso lalonai, ia na e kara tau matamatana na heto; ḡau gunadia vada e lao bubuni, ḡau iboudiai vada matamata.
2CO.5.17.english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

2CO.3.10.motu: Momokani, gunaguna e hururuhururuva ḡauna harihari se hururu-hururumu, badina be ina hururu-hururu matamatana vada herea.
2CO.3.10.english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

2CO.9.3.motu: A varavarada vada na siaidia vasi, a heaḡilaimui kava na garina, bena umui ba heḡaeḡae, na herevalaimui heḡereḡerena ai.
2CO.9.3.english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

2CO.12.16.motu: Benaini, asina hahekwarahimui. A readia dibaka karana ta amo na koimui o tomu, bena na abimui.
2CO.12.16.english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

2CO.7.15.motu: Tito ese umui e ura henimui lalo-dikamu, badina be iboumui ai emui kamonai karadia ia ese e lalo unemu; mai garimui bona mai hematauraimui ida o abia dae danu e laloa unemu.
2CO.7.15.english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

2CO.9.2.motu: nato “Akaia na laḡani gunana ai e heḡaeḡae”. Bena emui goada ese idia e hagoadadia.
2CO.9.2.english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

2CO.3.12.motu: Taunabunai, unu a helaro tomamu dainai a hereva goadamu;
2CO.3.12.english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

2CO.7.8.motu: Egu revareva dainai lalomui e hisihisiva, bena na daradarava. To harihari asina daradaramu, badina be dibagu una revareva ese nega sina mo lalomui e hahisiva.
2CO.7.8.english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

2CO.12.21.motu: Na garimu danu, baina vasi negana ai egu Dirava ese baine hahemaraigu umui bogaragimui ai; bona kara dika taudia hutuma taidia baina tai, badina be edia mata-bodaga, edia heuda-hanai, edia lebulebu karadia amo, asie helalo kerehaimu daidiai.
2CO.12.21.english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

2CO.8.21.motu: bona emai ura tamona be baia ḡaukara maoromaoro, Dirava vairanai bona taunimanima vairadiai.
2CO.8.21.english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

2CO.10.11.motu: Unu e laloa tomamu tauna baine haeroa, dauha amo emai hereva e vasimu heḡereḡerena dekemui ai emai kara unu baia kara toma.
2CO.10.11.english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

2CO.11.3.motu: To lau na garimu, gaigai ese Heva e koia heḡereḡerena ai, helalo idau-idau ese bae koimui, bena emui lalokau momokanina bona ḡoeva-daena Keriso enai na ba rakatania.
2CO.11.3.english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

2CO.6.8.motu: E heatolaimai bona e hahemaraimai. Namomai e gwaurai bona dikamai e gwaurai. Koikoimai e gwaurai, ḡau tamona ai na momokani.
2CO.6.8.english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

2CO.11.19.motu: Badina be umui, aonega taumui, na kavakava taudia ihaheaukahenidia mai dibamui.
2CO.11.19.english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

2CO.1.11.motu: Umui danu ba kahamai emui ḡuriḡuri ai; bena ḡuriḡuri momo amo baia davaria hariharina dainai hutuma ese Dirava bae hanamoa.
2CO.1.11.english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

2CO.7.2.motu: Bavabimai dae: tau ta asia hadikaia, ta asia ha-ogoḡamia, ta ena kohu asia abia koikoi.
2CO.7.2.english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

2CO.7.14.motu: Ia vairana na heaḡilaimuiva, bena asio hahemaraigu: a herevalai henimui herevadia vada momokani, bona Tito vairanai a heaḡilaimui herevadia danu vada momokani.
2CO.7.14.english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

2CO.8.24.motu: Taunabunai, emui lalokau toana bona ai ese a heaḡilaimuimu badina ba hahedinarai, ekalesia oreadia vairadiai.
2CO.8.24.english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

2CO.7.3.motu: Bona asina gwau henimuimu: vada na hereva guna heḡereḡerena, a lalokau henimuimu; umui ida baita mase hebou, baita mauri hebou.
2CO.7.3.english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

2CO.6.1.motu: Ai danu, ia ida a ḡaukara heboumu taumai, a noimuimu, Dirava ena harihari-bada basio abia kava.
2CO.6.1.english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

2CO.13.13.motu: Helaḡa taudia iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimuimu.

2CO.6.2.motu: Badina be ia na e tomu,

2CO.12.7.motu: E hahedinarai henigu ḡaudia babada heherea daidiai, ḡiniḡini ta, amo e gwadagu, baina hekokoroku garina; una na Satana ena hesiai tauna na heto, itutulaigu ḡauna ai ela, baina hekokoroku herea na garina.
2CO.12.7.english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

2CO.13.7.motu: Dirava a noiamu, umui na basio kara dika; dia ai maoromai bae gwaurai, a, ena be ai kereremai bae gwaurai to umui ba kara maoromaoro, helaoreana.
2CO.13.7.english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

2CO.12.4.motu: hehuni herevadia e kamonai, taunimanima basie gwaurai diba herevadia.
2CO.12.4.english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

2CO.7.4.motu: Lau na abidadama henimuimu, na heaḡilaimuimu. Emai hisihisi iboudiai lalodiai taugu eme lo, bona na moale badamu.
2CO.7.4.english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

2CO.8.14.motu: Lasi, iboumui ai ba heḡereḡere. Harihari umui na mai emui ḡau, a idia be e ogoḡamimu; taunabunai, ba kahadia. Kerukeru vanegai umui ba ogoḡami, bena idia ese bae kahamui; bena vada ba heḡereḡere.
2CO.8.14.english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

2CO.1.4.motu: Emai hisihisi iboudiai lalodiai ia ese taumai e halodiamu, taunabunai ai ese hisi e animu taudia na taudia ihalodia dibamai; Dirava ena tauhalo e henimaimu ai ese ma a henidiamu.
2CO.1.4.english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

2CO.11.25.motu: Nega toi au amo e dadabagu. Nega ta nadi amo e hodogu. Nega toi na ḡui kau lagatoidia e hure kau; hanuaboi ta dina ta gadobada ai na hure.
2CO.11.25.english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

2CO.7.12.motu: Una dainai na tore henimui, dia kerere e havaraia tauna dainai, eiava e hadikaia tauna dainai, to emui lalokau korikori emai ai Dirava vairanai baine hedinarai totona.
2CO.7.12.english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

2CO.4.12.motu: Benaini, ai lalomai ai mase e gaukaramu, a umui lalomui ai mauri e ḡaukaramu.
2CO.4.12.english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

2CO.9.8.motu: Dirava na mai siahuna herahia ḡaudia iboudiai emui ai baine habada; taunabunai, nega idoidiai ḡau bavabi hoho, bona emui kara namodia iboudiai ba habada.
2CO.9.8.english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

2CO.2.11.motu: Satana ese bema hadarereda garina; badina be iena dibaka karadia na dibada.
2CO.2.11.english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

2CO.9.1.motu: Badina be emui lalo-haraḡa na dibagu bona Makedonia taudia vairadiai na heaḡilaimui.
2CO.9.1.english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

2CO.9.10.motu: Uhe bona aniani e henimu Dirava ese uhe baine henimui bona baine hatubu; emui kara maoromaoro huahuadia danu baine hahoho.
2CO.9.10.english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

2CO.8.13.motu: Lau asina tomamu haida ese laḡadia bae ani, a umui be ba hekwarahi mase.
2CO.8.13.english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

2CO.4.16.motu: Taunabunai, ai na asia hesikumu. Tau-animai e manokamu, a daba daba idoinai lalomai e hamatamatamu.
2CO.4.16.english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

2CO.10.12.motu: Ai na asia tomamu ai na sibodia e hahenamomu taudia heḡereḡeredia. Idia na sibodia e hahetohomu, bona sibodia e haheḡereḡeremu: madi, asi edia aonega.
2CO.10.12.english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

2CO.5.7.motu: badina be abidadama dainai a rakamu, dia ita-itana dainai.
2CO.5.7.english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

2CO.5.6.motu: Benaini, ai na lalomai e goadamu nega idoidiai. Dibamai tau-animai ai a nohomu negana ai, ai na dia Lohiabada enai;
2CO.5.6.english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

2CO.12.10.motu: Una dainai, manoka-manoka bona badu herevadia bona ogoḡami bona daḡedaḡe karadia bona hahehisi ḡaudia be Keriso dainai na moalelaimu; badina be na manokamu negadia ai na goadamu.
2CO.12.10.english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

2CO.11.15.motu: unuhetomana ena hesiai taudia ese kara maoromaoro taudia ai e hahelaomu; a dokodia ai be edia kara ihaheḡereḡeredia bae abi.
2CO.11.15.english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

2CO.11.17.motu: Hari na hamaorolaimuimu herevadia na dia Lohiabada ena amo, to sibogu na hereva kavamu, na heaḡi kavamu.
2CO.11.17.english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

2CO.9.9.motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto,

2CO.3.7.motu: Hahemase isiaina ilao-henina herevadia nadi ai e tore na mai hururuhururuna ida ema; bena Israel taudia Mose vairana asie raraia diba, hururuhururuna dainai. Ḡau tamona, una hururu-hururu se mia daudau.
2CO.3.7.english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

2CO.10.8.motu: Lau na emai siahu, Lohiabada ese e henimai dia ikure-dobimui totona a ilarebamui helaoreana, bainama heaḡilaia, lau na basinama hemarai.
2CO.10.8.english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

2CO.7.6.motu: A dara-doko ihakeruna Diravana ese Tito ena gini-dae amo lalomai e hakerudia;
2CO.7.6.english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

2JN.1.13.motu: Tadimu, e abia hidi hahinena, natuna ese e hahenamo henimumu.
2JN.1.13.english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

2JN.1.3.motu: Hariharibada bona hebogahisl bona maino dekedai bae mia, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Tamada Natuna, Iesu Keriso, ena amo, hereva momokani ai bona lalokau ai.
2JN.1.3.english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

2JN.1.4.motu: Lau na moale bada, badina be natumu haida na davaridia, hereva momokani dalana ai e rakamu, Tamada ese e henida haheḡanina heḡereḡerena.
2JN.1.4.english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

2JN.1.10.motu: A ta baine vasi, ini hahediba herevadia basine vasilai, tauna na basio abia dae emu ruma ai, bona basio hanamoa.
2JN.1.10.english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

2JN.1.5.motu: Hane lohia e, na noimumu, baita heura heheni; dia haheḡani matamatana ta asina tore henimumu, a matamana amo ta abia ḡauna.
2JN.1.5.english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

2JN.1.2.motu: hereva momokani laloda ai e miamu bona dekedai do baine mia hanaihanai dainai.
2JN.1.2.english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

2JN.1.8.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, o tahumu ḡaudia ba rea na garina; davamui do bavabi ḡuḡuru.
2JN.1.8.english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

2JN.1.1.motu: Lau heitatao taugu ese e abimu hidi hahinemu mai natumu ida na tore henimuimu. Lau na hereva momokani ai na lalokau henimuimu; bona dia lau mo, a hereva momokani dibadia taudia iboudiai danu,
2JN.1.1.english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

2JN.1.9.motu: E raka hanaimu, Keriso ena hahediba herevadia se badinamu, tauna na Dirava enai se taomu; a hahediba herevadia e badinamu tauna na Tamada enai e taomu, bona Natuna danu enai e taomu.
2JN.1.9.english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

2JN.1.6.motu: Lalokau binai: iena haheḡani dalana ai baita raka. Una haheḡani na matamana amo o kamonai, ba badinaia totona e henimui.
2JN.1.6.english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

2JN.1.7.motu: Badina be koikoi taudia hutuma na tanobada ai e loamu, Iesu Keriso tau-anina ai ema na asie gwauraiamu; idia na koikoi taudia, Keriso inaina.
2JN.1.7.english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

2JN.1.12.motu: Hereva hoho aina tore henimui na tomu, to pepa bona ink amo basina tore. A lau na uramu baina vasi itamui, bena baita hereva heheni, eda moale danu baine ḡuḡuru.
2JN.1.12.english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

2JN.1.11.motu: Badina be baine hanamoa tauna ese ena kara dika baine durua.
2JN.1.11.english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

2KI.13.19.motu: Bena Dirava ena tau ese e badu henia, eto, Nega ima eiava tauratoi boma tutua, bena Suria boma tutua gwada, ela bona boma habuaia tari. A harihari oi na nega toi hona Suria ba tutua gwada.
2KI.13.19.english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

2KI.17.30.motu: Babulono taudia ese Sukoto-benoto e karaia; Kutu taudia ese Neregala e karaia; Hamat taudia ese Asima ekaraia;
2KI.17.30.english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

2KI.16.15.motu: Bena King Ahasa ese hahelaḡa tauna Uria e haḡania, eto, Daba ḡole-oho boubouna ḡaudia bona adorahi flaoa boubouna gaudia, bona hanua pavapavana ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona ena flaoa boubouna ḡaudia, bona tano taudia iboudiai edia ḡole-oho bouboudia bona edia flaoa bouboudia bona edia inuinu bouboudia ḡaudia, iboudiai na hari ihaboulaina patana badana latanai ba hahelaḡadia; bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona boubou iboudiai raradia na ia latanai ba nevari. A auri-laboralabora ihaboulaina patana na lauegu bagu-haoro ḡauna ai bainela.
2KI.16.15.english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

2KI.19.8.motu: Bena Rabsake e lou ela, Asuria pavapavana e davaria, ia na Libna e tuari heniava; badina be vada e kamonai hanua pavapavana na Lakisi amo vada e raka oho.
2KI.19.8.english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

2KI.12.15.motu: Unu moni ede e ḡaukaralai tomava na e henidia taudia ediai asie tahua, badina be idia na e ḡaukara maoromaorova.
2KI.12.15.english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

2KI.14.29.motu: Bena Ieroboam na tubu tama, Israel pavapavadia, dekediai e mahuta, bona ia natuna Sekaria na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.14.29.english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

2KI.17.20.motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel garana iboudiai e dadaraidia bona e hahisihisidia, bona ihadikadia taudia imadia ai e atodia, ela bona ia vairana amo e negedia daure.
2KI.17.20.english: Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

2KI.12.5.motu: unu iboudiai na hahelaḡa taudia ese bae abi, ta ta turadia bona dekedia taudia edia amo bae abi; bena dubu baine dika gabudia na bae hanamolai.
2KI.12.5.english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

2KI.22.7.motu: A unu imadia ai bae ato monidia igaukaralaidia daladia na basie nanadailaidia, badina be idia ese e ḡaukaralai momokanimu.
2KI.22.7.english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

2KI.1.11.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese imahui biagudia ma ta ia dekena e siaia, mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida. Ia na e dae ela, e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena tau e, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani binai, e tomu “A diho haraḡa”.
2KI.1.11.english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

2KI.2.13.motu: Hahedoki badana, Elia ena amo e moru ḡauna, na Elisaia ese e abia, e lou lao, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e gini.
2KI.2.13.english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

2KI.10.11.motu: Taunabunai, Iehu ese Ahaba ena orea taudia Iesrele ai na e aladia mase, ena tau-badadia iboudiai bona turana korikori bona ena hahelaḡa taudia, ela bona ta se hanohoa.
2KI.10.11.english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

2KI.11.7.motu: a kaha rua, Dina Helaḡa ai emui nega o matamaiamu bona Iehova ena ruma o gimaiamu taumui na
2KI.11.7.english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.

2KI.18.11.motu: Asuria pavapavana ese Israel taudia na Asuria e laohaidia, Hala ai bona Haboro, Gosan sinavaina, badibadinai, bona Mede hanuadia ai, e hanohodia.
2KI.18.11.english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

2KI.8.21.motu: Bena Ioram e hanai, mai ena kariota iboudiai ida, Sairi kahana ela. Bena hanuaboi ai e tore isi; bena ia bona ena kariota biagudia ese Edom oreana, ia e daia heḡeḡe taudia, na e rahudia mase. A ena tuari taudia na e heau, edia hanua ela.
2KI.8.21.english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

2KI.4.17.motu: A hahine na e rogorogo, bena tubu-kau negana sisivana ai mero ta e abia, Elisaia ese e hamaoroa negana heḡereḡerena ai.
2KI.4.17.english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

2KI.23.3.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na au-tubua badibadinai e gini, Iehova vairanai e gwau hamata, Iehova ena dala ai baine raka, bona ena haheḡani bona ena hahediba herevadia bona ena taravatu baine badinadia mai lalona idoinai bona mai laumana idoinai ida, bona taravatu herevadia una buka lalonai e hetore na karadia do baine kara. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na ia ida e gwau hamata hebou.
2KI.23.3.english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

2KI.3.6.motu: Taunabunai, una negana ai King Iehoram na Samaria amo e raka lasi, Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia.
2KI.3.6.english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

2KI.3.15.motu: Benaini, hatai-hatai ḡaudia e hataimu tauna ta ba hakaua mai dekegu ai. Bena hatai-hatai ḡaudia e hatai tauna ta ese ena ḡau e hataia negana ai, Iehova ena siahu ese Elisaia e rohea.
2KI.3.15.english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.

2KI.13.17.motu: Ia ma eto, Gaba-mauru a kehoa, mairiveina kahana ai. Bena e kehoa. Bena Elisaia eto, A kinoa. Bena e kinoa. Ma eto, Ina diba na Iehova ena kwalimu ḡauna, Suria ihadarerena ḡauna. Badina be Suria taudia ba tuari henidia Afek ai, ela bona ba habuadia tari.
2KI.13.17.english: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “Yahweh’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

2KI.19.36.motu: Bena Senakerib, Asuria pavapavana, na e raka oho, e lou lao, Nineve ai e noho.
2KI.19.36.english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

2KI.15.1.motu: Ieroboam, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuahui-hituna ai, Asaria Amasia ese Iuda e lohiaia matama.
2KI.15.1.english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

2KI.15.9.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, senena heḡeregeredia; Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika, Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai ḡaudia na se rakatanidia.
2KI.15.9.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

2KI.25.1.motu: Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahani-tana ai, hua ihagwautana dinana ihagwautana lalonai, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, na ena tuari oreana idoinai ida Ierusalem ihadikana ema, e koua heḡeḡe bona tano e larebaia heḡeḡe.
2KI.25.1.english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

2KI.18.24.motu: Aigupto edia kariota bona edia hosi-gui taudia ediai o hetao kaumu negana ai, biagugu ena hesiai taudia bogaragidia amo tuari biaguna maraḡi-maraḡina tamona mo ede ba hadarerea toma?
2KI.18.24.english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

2KI.4.12.motu: laḡana e ania. Bena ia ese ena hesiai tauna Gehasi e hamaoroa, eto, Hari hane Suneme a boiria. E boiria, bena ia vairanai e gini.
2KI.4.12.english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

2KI.15.15.motu: Salumu ena kara oredia bona ena ala-ala karana sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore.
2KI.15.15.english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

2KI.20.17.motu: Dinadia vada e maimu, emu ruma kohudia iboudiai, senemu ese vada e haboudia ema bona hari dina, na Babulono bae laohaidia; ḡau ta basine mia. Iehova e gwaumu.
2KI.20.17.english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

2KI.4.34.motu: Bena ia na ela, mero latanai e goru kau, ia uduna mero uduna latanai, ia matana mero matana latadiai, ia imana mero imana latadiai; bena latanai e goru parapara negana ai hari mero tau-anina e siahu-siahu.
2KI.4.34.english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

2KI.19.25.english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

2KI.23.1.motu: Hanua pavapavana na e hesiai, bena Iuda bona Ierusalem tau-badadia iboudiai na ia dekenai e hebou.
2KI.23.1.english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

2KI.23.6.motu: Ia ese au-tubua ladana Asera na Iehova ena dubu lalona amo e abia, e laohaia Ierusalem murimurinai, ela bona Kidron sinavaina. Kidron sinavaina badibadinai ia ese e gabua, e kwadia dimura-dimura, bena kahuna na hanua taudia garadia ai e negea.
2KI.23.6.english: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

2KI.14.25.motu: Israel tano-hetoana e abia lou, Hamat raka-vareaina amo ela bona Araba gohuna, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena hereva, ena hesiai tauna lona Amitai, peroveta tauna Gata-hefere amo, uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
2KI.14.25.english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to Yahweh, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

2KI.19.18.motu: bona edia dirava na lahi ai vada e tahodia kau; badina be idia na dia dirava korikoridia, a taunimanima imadia ese e kara ḡaudia, au bona nadi; una dainai vada e habuadia tari.
2KI.19.18.english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

2KI.21.10.motu: Bena Iehova na peroveta taudia, ena hesiai taudia, ududia amo e hereva, eto,
2KI.21.10.english: Yahweh spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

2KI.13.21.motu: Bena tau ta e guria negana ai, dadidadi oreana ta e hedinarai; bena mase tauna na Elisaia ena guri ai e tahoa dobi. Ia na Elisaia turiana ai e dau kau, bena maoromaoro e mauri lou, bona aena ai e gini tore.
2KI.13.21.english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

2KI.14.28.motu: Ieroboam ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, bona ena goada tuari ai, bona Damasko bona Hamat hanuadia na Iuda ena amo e abidia lou, Israel ena, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani?
2KI.14.28.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

2KI.9.1.motu: Bena peroveta tauna Elisaia ese peroveta oreana tauna ta e boiria, e hamaoroa, eto, Emu rami ba hekasilaia, ina dehoro kavabuna na imamu ai bavabia, Ramoto-gilead baola.
2KI.9.1.english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

2KI.14.5.motu: Lohia siahuna ia imana ai e ha-aukaia negana ai, ia ese ena hesiai taudia, ia tamana e alaia mase taudia, na e aladia mase.
2KI.14.5.english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

2KI.16.3.motu: a Israel pavapavadia edia dala ai e raka. Ia ese danu natuna maruanena na lahi ai e haḡolea oho, Iehova ese Israel taudia vairadiai e luludia lasi besedia edia kara dika-hereadia heḡereḡeredia.
2KI.16.3.english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel.

2KI.4.19.motu: Bena ia ese tamana e tai henia, eto, Kwaragu o, kwaragu o. Bena tamana ese ena hesiai tauna e hamaoroa, eto, A rosia, sinana dekena a laohaia.
2KI.4.19.english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!”

2KI.3.9.motu: Taunabunai Israel pavapavana na Iuda pavapavana bona Edom pavapavana ida ela. Dina hitu lalodiai idia na dala magevana amo e raka heḡeḡe; bena tuari taudia bona edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia, idia muridiai e rakava gaudia, na asi adia ranu.
2KI.3.9.english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

2KI.17.37.motu: Hahedua bona hahemaoro herevadia bona taravatu bona haheḡani, e tore emui, ḡaudia na nega idoinai karadia ba kara nahua-toho. Dirava idaudia garidia basio gari,
2KI.17.37.english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

2KI.18.16.motu: Una negana ai danu Hesekia ese Iehova ena dubu iduaradia e ḡovalai gold na e koki oho, bona iduara kahadia kahadia audia Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ese e ḡovalai gold danu ma e koki, Asuria pavapavana e henia.
2KI.18.16.english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of Yahweh’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

2KI.22.14.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa tauna Hilkia, bona Ahikama bona Akaboro bona Safana bona Asaia, na peroveta hahinena Hulda, Salumu Tikva adavana, dekena ela. Una Salumu na Harahasa tubuna. Ia na pavapava ena dabua inaridia tauna. Hahine na Ierusalem kaha matamatana ai e nohova. Idia na ia ida e hereva-hereva.
2KI.22.14.english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

2KI.8.17.motu: E lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui rua; ia na Ierusalem ai e lohia, laḡani taurahani.
2KI.8.17.english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

2KI.5.17.motu: Bena Naaman eto, Bema lasi be lau na noimumu, emu hesiai tauna na tano taina ba henigu, doniki rua edia huahua heḡeregeredia; badina be harihari bainela emu hesiai tauna na ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna eiava boubou ḡauna ta basina hahelaḡaia dirava ta ena, a Iehova mo ena.
2KI.5.17.english: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Yahweh.

2KI.15.11.motu: Sekaria ena kara oredia sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore.
2KI.15.11.english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

2KI.11.18.motu: Bena tano taudia iboudiai na Baal ena dubu ela, eha ḡiḡia dobi; ena ihaboulaina patadia bona ena kaivakuku danu e hamakohidia rohoroho; bona Matan, Baal ena hahelaḡa tauna, na ihaboulaina patadia vairadiai e alaia mase. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese Iehova ena dubu igimana taudia e atodia.
2KI.11.18.english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.

2KI.2.8.motu: Bena Elia ese ena hahedoki badana e abia, e lokua, bena ranu e botalaia; bena ranu na e parara, kahana ela kahana ela, ela bona raruosi na tano kaukauna ai e raka hanai.
2KI.2.8.english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

2KI.2.16.motu: Bena idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, emu hesiai taudia dekemai ai na goada taudia imahui; mani emu kara idia na baela, biagumu bae tahua; reana Iehova ena Lauma ese vada e abia isi, ororo ta ai eiava koura ta lalonai vada e tahoa dobi. Bena ia e haere, eto, Basio siaidia.
2KI.2.16.english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps Yahweh’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.”

2KI.15.20.motu: Menaheme ese Israel taudia edia amo una moni na taḡa taudia iboudiai ta ta ediai silver sekeledia imahui imahui amo e abi bagubagu, Asuria pavapavana baine henia totona. Taunabunai, Asuria pavapavana e lou, Israel tanona ai se noho.
2KI.15.20.english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

2KI.12.17.motu: Una negana ai Hasaele, Suria pavapavana, na ela, Gata hanuana e tuari henia, bena e abia. A Hasaele be Ierusalem e raka lao, baine tuari henia totona, negana ai na
2KI.12.17.english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

2KI.25.30.motu: bona hanua pavapavana ese ahuna e henia, dina ta ta amo, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai.
2KI.25.30.english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

2KI.3.24.motu: A Israel edia taruha ai e kau negana ai, Israel taudia na e tore isi, Moab taudia e guru henidia, ela bona Moab taudia na idia vairadia amo e heau. Bena idia ese e lao henidia, Moab taudia e aladia laova.
2KI.3.24.english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

2KI.9.16.motu: Bena Iehu na ena kariota ai e gui, Iesrele ela; badina be loram na unuseni ai. Ahasia, Iuda pavapavana, danu Ioram igo-itana totona vada ema.
2KI.9.16.english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

2KI.10.18.motu: Bena Iehu ese taunimanima iboudiai e haboudia, e hereva henidia, eto, Ahaba ese Baal isiaina e lao henia sisina, a Iehu ese isiaina baine lao henia bada.
2KI.10.18.english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

2KI.20.4.motu: Isaia na bogaragi maḡuna amo do se raka lasi ai, Iehova ena hereva na ienai e kau, eto,
2KI.20.4.english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

2KI.1.10.motu: A Elia ese hari imahui biagudia e haere henia, eto, Bema lau na Dirava ena tau, Iahi na guba amo baine diho, bena baine ḡolemui oho, oi bona emu orea taudia imahuiosi danu. Bena lahi na guba amo e diho, una tau mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida e goledia oho.
2KI.1.10.english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

2KI.22.2.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara maoromaoro, senena David ena dala idoinai e rakalaia, se raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
2KI.22.2.english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

2KI.23.9.motu: Ḡau tamona, atai gabudia edia hahelaḡa taudia ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana Ierusalem ai asie dara henia dae, a tadikakadia bogaragidiai se hatubua flaoana e aniva.
2KI.23.9.english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

2KI.19.22.motu: Daika vada o ḡonagonalaia, vada o ihi-ihiraia?
2KI.19.22.english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

2KI.22.3.motu: King Iosia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahanina ai, ia ese Safana, toretore tauna, Asalia Mesulama natuna, na e siaia lao, Iehova ena dubu ai; eto,
2KI.22.3.english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,

2KI.12.19.motu: Ioasa ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada eme hetore, ani?
2KI.12.19.english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
