2KI.12.10.english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.

2KI.21.7.motu: Hari kaivakuku e karaia, ladana Asera, na dubu ai e haginia; dubuna bunai Iehova ese David bona David natuna Solomon e herevalai henidia, eto “Ina dubu ai bona Ierusalem, Israel iduhudia iboudiai lalodia amo vada na abia hidi hanuana, lalonai lau ladagu baina atoa ela bona hanaihanai;
2KI.21.7.english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

2KI.4.40.motu: Bena e seia, tatau bae inua totona. A vasiahu inuna ai idia na e lolo, eto, Dirava ena tau e, mase na uro lalonai. Idia na asie inua diba.
2KI.4.40.english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

2KI.23.17.motu: Bena ia eto, Una be dahaka pupuna na itaiamu unuseni a? Hanua taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Una na Dirava ena tau garana; ia na Iuda amo ema, bona Betele ihaboulaina patana ihadikana karadia oi ese vada o kara na ia ese e gwaurai guna.
2KI.23.17.english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?”

2KI.6.3.motu: Bena idia ta eto, Mani emu kara oi danu emu hesiai taudia ida baitala. Ia na e haere, eto, Baitala.
2KI.6.3.english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.”

2KI.15.37.motu: Unu dinadia ai Iehova ese Resini, Suria pavapavana, bona Peka Remalia e siaidia matama, Iuda ituari-henina.
2KI.15.37.english: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

2KI.24.1.motu: Iena nega ai Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, na ema; bena Iehoiakim ese ia isiaina e lao heni ela bona laḡani toi e ore; bena e hegiro, e gwau edeede henia.
2KI.24.1.english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

2KI.2.12.motu: Elisaia e itaia, bena e boi lolo, eto, Tamagu e, tamagu e, Israel ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia. Bena se itaia lou. Bena ia sibona ena dabua e abidia, e daredia parara.
2KI.2.12.english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

2KI.3.17.motu: Badina be Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lai eiava medu basio itadia, to una koupa na ranu ai baine honu, ba inu helaoreana, umui bona emui boromakau bona emui ubu-ubu ḡaudia iboudiai.
2KI.3.17.english: For Yahweh says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

2KI.8.13.motu: Bena Hasaele eto, Emu hesiai tauna be daika, ia na una kara badana baine karaia? Ia na sisia mo. Elisaia na e haere, eto, Iehova ese vada e haheitalaigu, oi na Suria pavapavana ai baola.
2KI.8.13.english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?”

2KI.14.27.motu: A Iehova na asineto Israel ladana na guba henunai baine rohoa; taunabunai ia ese Ieroboam Ioasa imana amo e hamauridia.
2KI.14.27.english: Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

2KI.23.24.motu: Iosia ese rohe taudia bona mea taudia bona laulau helaḡadia bona kaivakuku, bona kara dika-hereadia iboudiai Iuda ai bona Ierusalem ai e heitava, na e atodia tabe, taravatu herevadia, hahelaḡa tauna Hilkia ese Iehova ena dubu ai e davaria bukana ai e hetore gaudia, iboudiai anidia ihavaradia helaoreana.
2KI.23.24.english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

2KI.11.13.motu: Atalia na gima taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai eredia e kamonai, bena Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareai, taunimanima dekediai.
2KI.11.13.english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house;

2KI.13.15.motu: Bena Elisaia ese e hereva henia, eto, Peva bona diba bavabi. Taunabunai, ia ese peva ta bona diba haida e abi.
2KI.13.15.english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

2KI.6.2.motu: Mani Ioridane sinavaina aiala, ta ta au ta ta baia abi, bena emai noho gabuna ta baia karaia unuseni ai. Ia na e haere, eto, Aola.
2KI.6.2.english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.”

2KI.17.29.motu: A bese ta ta ese sibodia edia dirava dounu e karava ḡaudia na atai gabudia, Samaria taudia ese e kara gaudia, dubudia ai e atodia, bese ta ta e noho heniva hanuadia lalodiai.
2KI.17.29.english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

2KI.13.14.motu: Elisaia na e gorerea, baine mase gorerena e davaria. Bena Ioasa, Israel pavapavana, na dekena ela, ia vairanai e tai, eto, Tamagu o, tamagu o! Israel kariotadia bona ena hosi-gui taudia!
2KI.13.14.english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

2KI.15.8.motu: Asaria, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoiahui-taurahanina ai, Sekaria Ieroboam ese Israel e lohiaia Samaria ai, hua tauratoi hona.
2KI.15.8.english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

2KI.7.8.motu: Hari lepra taudia na taruha isena ai e kau, bena kalaga ta ai e raka vareai, e aniani, e inuinu, bena silver bona gold bona dabua e hua lao, e hunidia. Bena e lou lao, ma kalaga ta ai e raka vareai, ḡau haida ma e hua lao, e hunidia.
2KI.7.8.english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

2KI.18.23.motu: Be, biagugu Asuria pavapavana ida ba gwau hamata. Ia e tomu “Lau ese hosi daha-rua baina henimu, bema oi ese gui taudia na latadiai ba hahelaidia kau diba negana ai”.
2KI.18.23.english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

2KI.10.36.motu: Iehu ena lohia laḡanidia, Samaria ai Israel e lohiaia, na laḡani ruahui taurahani.
2KI.10.36.english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

2KI.10.23.motu: Bena Iehu na Baal ena dubu ai e dae kau, lehonadab Rekab ida. Bena ia ese Baal itomadiho-henina taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Mani a hetahu, ba itaia, Iehova itomadiho-henina tauna ta umui padamui ai basine noho, a Baal itomadiho-henina taudia mo sibodia.
2KI.10.23.english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of Yahweh are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

2KI.10.6.motu: Bena Iehu ese revareva ta ma e tore henidia, eto, Bema umui na lauegu kaha ai, bona lalomui bema heḡereḡere lau ba kamonai henigu, biagumui natuna mamaruanedia kwaradia bavabidia, bena kerukeru, nega inihetomana ai, dekegu baoma Iesrele ai. Una negana ai hari hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia hitu-ahuiosi na hanua tau-badadia dekediai e nohova; idia ese e regudiava.
2KI.10.6.english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.”

2KI.23.34.motu: Bena Farao Neko ese Eliakim, Iosia natuna, e abia, pavapava ai e halaoa, tamana Iosia gabuna ai, bona lada matamatana e henia, Iehoiakim eto. A Iehoahasa na e hakaua ela Aigupto; bena unuseni ai e mase.
2KI.23.34.english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

2KI.5.14.motu: Taunabunai, ia na e diho ela, nega hitu Ioridane sinavaina ai e heuru utu, Dirava ena tau ena hereva heḡereḡerena. Bena tauna vada e namo lou, mero karukaruna heḡereḡerena ai ela; bena vada e ḡoeva.
2KI.5.14.english: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

2KI.15.13.motu: Usia, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoiahui-taurahani-tana ai, Salumu Iabese na e lohia matama; Samaria ai e lohia, hua tamona mo.
2KI.15.13.english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

2KI.8.15.motu: A daba ai ia ese hetaru ḡauna e abia, ranu ai e urua diho; bena hanua pavapavana vairana e ḡovalaia ela bona e mase. Bena Hasaele na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.8.15.english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

2KI.9.35.motu: A idia ese igurina ela negana ai na ḡau ta asie davaria, kwarana koukouna bona aena bona imana palapaladia mo.
2KI.9.35.english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

2KI.14.20.motu: Bena hosi ai e atoa kau, e huaia lao; bena Ierusalem ai e guria, tubu tama dekediai, David ena hanua ai.
2KI.14.20.english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

2KI.17.34.motu: Una kara gunana heḡereḡerena mo e karaiamu ema bona ina dina. Iehova garina asie garimu, hahedua eiava hahemaoro herevadia eiava taravatu eiava Iehova ese Iakob (e nemaia Israel) natuna e henidia haheḡanina asie badinadiamu.
2KI.17.34.english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

2KI.17.18.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Israel taudia e badu henidia dikadika, ia vairana amo e abidia oho; ta se noho, Iuda iduhuna mo sibona.
2KI.17.18.english: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

2KI.20.20.motu: Hesekia ena kara oredia, bona ena goada sivaraidia, bona gohu bona dadaira e karadia, ranu na e mailaia hanua lalonai, sivaraina, na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
2KI.20.20.english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

2KI.15.23.motu: Asaria, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iha-imahuina ai, Pekahia Menaheme ese Israel e lohiaia matama Samaria ai; ena lohia laḡanidia na rua hona.
2KI.15.23.english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

2KI.25.16.motu: Hari au-tubua ruaosi, bona nau badana, bona rerue, Solomon ese e kara Iehova ena dubu ena, auri labora-laboraidia lalodiai metauna na asi ihahetohona.
2KI.25.16.english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

2KI.13.6.motu: Ḡau tamona, idia ese Ieroboam ena iduhu taudia edia kara dika, Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai ḡaudia, na asie rakatanidia, a dounu e rakalaidia, bona au-tubua helaḡana danu dounu e miava Samaria ai.
2KI.13.6.english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

2KI.19.33.motu: Ema dalana amo ma baine lou; ina hanua lalonai basine raka vareai. Iehova vada e hereva.
2KI.19.33.english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

2KI.11.4.motu: Laḡani ihahituna ai, Iehoiada na e hesiai, Kariti biagudia bona gima oreana biagudia e boiridia, ia dekenai bae hebou, Iehova ena dubu ai; bena e gwau henidia hamata bona idia edia amo gwauhamata e abia, Iehova ena dubu ai; bena ia ese hanua pavapavana natuna e haheitalaidia.
2KI.11.4.english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into Yahweh’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in Yahweh’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

2KI.7.7.motu: Taunabunai, idia na dina kerekerena ai e heau oho, edia kalaga, edia hosi, edia doniki e rakatanidia, taruha lalona ḡaudia miadia ai e laputani, mauridia e tahu.
2KI.7.7.english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

2KI.9.32.motu: Bena Iehu na gaba-mauru e roha dae henia, eto, Daika na lauegu kaha ai? Daika? Bena hesiai taudia rarua eiava tatoi na e igo lasi, e itaia.
2KI.9.32.english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?”

2KI.16.17.motu: Bena King Ahasa ese rerue habahabadia e utudia oho, bona edia amo nau e abi oho. Bona ranu nauna bada-hereana na boromakau mamaruanedia laulaudia, auri labora-labora ḡaudia, latadia amo e abia dobi, nadi-palaka latanai e atoa.
2KI.16.17.english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

2KI.15.30.motu: Bena Hosea Elaha ese Peka Remalia iala-masena dalana e tahua; bena e botaia hekida diho, e alaia mase; bena ia gabuna ai e lohia, Iotama Usia ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina lalonai.
2KI.15.30.english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

2KI.20.5.motu: A lou lao, Hesekia, egu bese lohiana, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova, senemu David ena Dirava, na ini e gwau tomamu: Emu ḡuriḡuri vada na kamonai, bona iruru-matamu vada na ita. A kamonai, do baina hamaurimu; dina ihatoina ai Iehova ena dubu ai ba dae kau.
2KI.20.5.english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh’s house.

2KI.17.14.motu: A idia na asie kamonai, a lalodia na a'auka, senedia heḡereḡeredia, idia danu Iehova, edia Dirava, asie abia dae.
2KI.17.14.english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.

2KI.5.26.motu: A ia ese e gwau henia, eto, Lauma ai oi ida asita lao hebou, una tau na ena kariota amo e hegiro oi ihedavari-henimu totona negana ai a? Una na moni bona dabua, eiava olive bona vine imeadia, eiava mamoe bona boromakau, eiava hesiai taudia bona hahinedia, iabidia negana buna a?
2KI.5.26.english: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

2KI.24.12.motu: Bena Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, na sibona Babulono pavapavana imana ai e heato, ia bona sinana bona ena hesiai taudia, bona ena lohia taudia bona ena ruma itataona taudia. Babulono pavapavana ese e abia mauri, ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahanina ai;
2KI.24.12.english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

2KI.2.22.motu: Taunabunai, una ranu vada e namo ema bona hari dina, Elisaia ese e gwauraia herevana heḡereḡerena.
2KI.2.22.english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

2KI.23.32.motu: Iehoahasa na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, senena edia kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
2KI.23.32.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

2KI.6.27.motu: Ia eto, Bema Iehova ese basine durumu, lau na ede amo baina durumu? Uit ikwadilaina gabuna amo eiava vine itaolaina gabuna amo a?
2KI.6.27.english: He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

2KI.25.7.motu: Bena Sedekia natuna mamaruanedia na ia vairanai e aladia mase; bena Sedekia matana e hakepuludia, bena auri gadeadia amo e ḡuia, Babulono e laohaia.
2KI.25.7.english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

2KI.10.26.motu: au-tubua helaḡana Baal ena dubu ai e miava ḡauna na e huaia lasi, e gabua.
2KI.10.26.english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

2KI.12.20.motu: Iena hesiai taudia na e tore isi, ia iala-masena totona e henega bou; bena idia ese Ioasa e alaia mase Milo kohorona ai, Sila lao dalana ai.
2KI.12.20.english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

2KI.6.12.motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia ta eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava e, ta lasi; to Elisaia, peroveta tauna Israel ai e nohomu, ia ese emu mahuta daiutuna lalonai o gwauraimu herevadia na Israel pavapavana e hamaorolaiamu.
2KI.6.12.english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

2KI.20.1.motu: Unu dinadia ai Hesekia na e gorerea, mokona e mase. Bena peroveta tauna Isaia Amoso na dekena ema, e hereva henia, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emu ḡau iboudiai bavatodia ḡoevaḡoeva, badina be oi na ba mase, emu gorere amo basio namo lou.
2KI.20.1.english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

2KI.20.21.motu: Bena Hesekia na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; bona ia natuna Manase na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.20.21.english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

2KI.17.31.motu: Ava taudia ese Nibihasa bona Tarataka e karadia; bona Sefaravaimi taudia ese natudia na lahi ai e haḡoledia oho, Adram-melek bona Anam-melek, Sefaravaimi diravadia, edia.
2KI.17.31.english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

2KI.11.9.motu: Bena orea biagudia ese hahelaḡa tauna Iehoiada ena haheḡani idoinai heḡereḡerena e karaia; ta ta ese ena orea ena orea, Dina Helaḡa ai e raka lasiva bona Dina Helaḡa ai e raka vareaiva taudia, na e mailaidia, hahelaḡa tauna Iehoiada dekenai.
2KI.11.9.english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

2KI.1.4.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: O hekure kau patana amo basio diho, a momokani vada ba mase. Taunabunai Elia na ela.
2KI.1.4.english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

2KI.14.15.motu: Iehoasa ena kara oredia, bona ena goada sivaraina, bona Amasia, Iuda pavapavana, e tuari henia sivaraina, na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani?
2KI.14.15.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

2KI.10.33.motu: Ioridane sinavaina amo mairiveina kahana tanodia, bona GDead tanona idoinai, bona Gad bona Ruben bona Manase taudia edia tano, Aroere, Aranon kourana badina, amo; unu na Gilead bona Basan tanodia.
2KI.10.33.english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

2KI.14.12.motu: Bena Iuda na Israel ese e hadarerea, bona Iuda taudia na e heau, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela.
2KI.14.12.english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

2KI.14.7.motu: Ia ese Edom taudia gerebu-ta e aladia mase, Damena Kourana ai; bona Sela hanuana na e daea ai e abia, bena ladana e hatoa lokotele. Ia ladana na unu e hatoa tomamu ema bona ina dina.
2KI.14.7.english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

2KI.18.37.motu: Bena Eliakim Hilkia, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ireḡuna tauna, bona Sebna, toretore tauna, bona loa Asaf, e tore pepadia inaridia tau, na edia dabua e dare, bena Hesekia dekenai e raka vareai, Rabsake ena hereva e hamaorolaia.
2KI.18.37.english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.

2KI.16.7.motu: Taunabunai Ahasa ese gwaukau taudia na Tiglata-pilesere, Asuria pavapavana, dekena e siaidia lao, eto, Lau na oiemu hesiai tauna bona oi natumu. Aoma, e tuari henigumu taudia, Suria pavapavana bona Israel pavapavana, imadia amo ba hamaurigu.
2KI.16.7.english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

2KI.13.12.motu: Ioasa ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, bona mai goadana ida Amasia, Iuda pavapavana, e tuari henia sivaraidia, na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
2KI.13.12.english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

2KI.5.11.motu: A Naaman na e badu, e raka oho, eto, Lau banava nato ia korikorina ese baine mai henigu, bena baine gini, Iehova, ena Dirava, ladana baine hahanea bona hisi gabuna baine daroa, unu amo lepragu baine hanamoa nato.
2KI.5.11.english: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Yahweh his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

2KI.2.19.motu: Bena hanua taudia ese Elisaia e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, ina hanua e ginimu gabuna na gabu namona, egu lohia o itaiamu heḡereḡerena. A ranu na dika, bona tano anina e ruru negemu.
2KI.2.19.english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

2KI.11.20.motu: Taunabunai, tano taudia iboudiai e moaleva. Atalia na hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai dare amo e alaia mase, bena hanua na asi reḡereḡena.
2KI.11.20.english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

2KI.3.16.motu: Bena ia eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina koupa kaukauna lalonai lau ese ranu gohogohudia baina karadia.
2KI.3.16.english: He said, “Yahweh says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

2KI.2.20.motu: Ia eto, Nau matamatana ta a mailaia, lalonai damena ba uda. Taunabunai idia ese e mailaia ia dekenai.
2KI.2.20.english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

2KI.24.14.motu: Ierusalem taudia iboudiai na e laohaidia, lohia iboudiai bona tuari taudia mai goadadia iboudiai, iḡui taudia gerebu ta; bona ima namo taudia bona auri igaukaralaina mai dibadia taudia. Tau ta se noho, ogogami dikadika taudia mo.
2KI.24.14.english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

2KI.9.27.motu: Ahasia, Iuda pavapavana, ese una kara e itaia, bena ia na Bete-hagana dalana ai e heau lao. Bena Iehu ese e hahavaia, eto, Ia danu ba tarakia. Bena ena kariota ai e tarakia, Guru dara-daena ai, Ibleam badibadinai. Bena e heau, Megido ela, unuseni ai e mase.
2KI.9.27.english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

2KI.8.24.motu: Bena Ioram na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta, senena ida e guridia hebou, David ena hanua ai. Bena ia natuna Ahasia ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.8.24.english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

2KI.10.28.motu: Unu amo Iehu ese Baal na Israel ai e halasihiaia.
2KI.10.28.english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

2KI.15.14.motu: Bena Menaheme Gadi na Tirisa amo ema, Samaria ai e kau, bena ia ese Salumu Iabese e botaia hekida diho, e alaia mase Samaria ai; bena ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.15.14.english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

2KI.17.24.motu: Bena Asuria pavapavana ese taunimanima haida na Babulono bona Kuta bona Ava bona Hamat bona Sefaravaimi amo e mailaidia, Samaria hanuadia ai e hanohodia, Israel taudia ibolodia; bena idia ese Samaria e abia, edia tano ai e halaoa, bona hanuadia e noholaidia.
2KI.17.24.english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

2KI.22.6.motu: unu na kamuta taudia bona ruma ihaginidia taudia bona nadi iḡaukaralaidia taudia. Una moni amo danu au bona e ḡei nadidia bae hoi, dubu ibanilaina.
2KI.22.6.english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

2KI.20.13.motu: Bena Hesekia ese e abidia dae, ena kohu namo-hereadia e habouva rumana idoinai na e haheitalaidia, silver, gold, muramura mai bonadia, dehoro namo-hereana, ena tuari ḡaudia, bona ḡau iboudiai ena habou-habou rumadia ai mimia; asi ḡauna ta ena ruma ai eiava ena tano ai Hesekia ese se haheitalaidia.
2KI.20.13.english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

2KI.18.17.motu: Bena Asuria pavapavana ese Taratana bona Rabsarisi bona Rabsake na e siaidia lao, mai tuari oreana badana ida, Lakisi amo King Hesekia dekena ela Ierusalem ai. Idia na e dae ela, Ierusalem ai e kau. E kau negana ai, idia na ela, atai gohuna dadairana badibadinai e gini, Dabua-huri Taudia Edia Tano lao dalana ai.
2KI.18.17.english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

2KI.15.24.motu: Iehova vairanai e kara havara; Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika, Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai gaudia, na se rakatanidia.
2KI.15.24.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

2KI.6.15.motu: Dirava ena tau ena hesiai tauna na daba matana ai e tore isi, e raka lasi, e itaia, tuari oreana ta mai hosidia bona mai kariotadia ida, ese hanua vada e koua heḡeḡe. Hesiai tauna eto, Biagugu e, madi ihabaida! Ede baita kara toma?
2KI.6.15.english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

2KI.7.1.motu: A Elisaia eto, Iehova ena hereva a kamonaia. Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Kerukeru, hari ina hora sisivana, flaoa namo-hereana bosea ta eiava bali bosea rua na Samaria ikoukouna ai bae hoi, davadia na sekele tamona.
2KI.7.1.english: Elisha said, “Hear Yahweh’s word. Yahweh says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

2KI.13.9.motu: Taunabunai, Iehoahasa na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta, Samaria ai e guria. Bena natuna Ioasa ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.13.9.english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

2KI.9.18.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta na hosi ai e gui, ela, ia ida e hedavari, eto, Hanua pavapavana na ini e gwau tomamu: maino ai oma a? Iehu eto, Maino be dahaka ikaralaina emu ai? A hegiro, murigu ai a raka.
2KI.9.18.english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’”

2KI.24.4.motu: bona asi edia kerere taudia raradia ia ese e hahebubua dainai. Badina be ia ese Ierusalem na asi edia kerere taudia raradia amo e hahonua; bona Iehova ese una kara na se laloa nege.
2KI.24.4.english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.

2KI.9.28.motu: Ena hesiai taudia ese kariota ai e laohaia, Ierusalem ela; bena senena ida ena gara ai e guria, David ena hanua lalonai.
2KI.9.28.english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

2KI.25.28.motu: ia ese e hereva namo henia, bona helai ḡauna hereana e henia, pavapava iboudiai ia ida Babulono ai e nohova daediai.
2KI.25.28.english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

2KI.7.12.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na hanuaboi ai e tore isi, ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Aina hamaoromui, Suria taudia ese ita ihadikada dalana na ede e hegaeḡaelaia toma. Dibadia ita na e hitolodamu; taunabunai idia na taruha vada e rakalania, tano paka ai e komumu, e tomamu “Hanua amo bae raka lasi negana ai baita abidia mauri, bona hanua lalonai baita didi vareai”.
2KI.7.12.english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

2KI.12.12.motu: bona nadi iḡaukaralaidia bona iutudia taudia danu. Idia ese danu au bona vada e ḡei nadidia na e hoi, dubu ihanamo-louna ḡaudia, bona dubu ihanamo-louna ḡaukaradia ma haida davadia e kara.
2KI.12.12.english: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to Yahweh’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

2KI.21.5.motu: Ia ese ihaboulaina patadia e haginidia, guba hisiudia iboudiai edia, Iehova ena dubu maḡuna ruaosi lalodiai.
2KI.21.5.english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

2KI.13.3.motu: Bena Iehova ena badu vada e ḡaraḡara Israel taudia latadiai; Hasaele, Suria pavapavana, bona Ben-hadad, Hasaele natuna, imadia ai e atodia loulou.
2KI.13.3.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

2KI.2.11.motu: Idia na dounu e rakava bona e hereva-herevava ai, lahi kariotana ta bona lahi hosidia ese raruosi e hapararadia. Bena Elia na koehirihiri amo e dae guba ai.
2KI.2.11.english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

2KI.4.16.motu: Elisaia eto, Laḡani vairai, nega inihetomana ai, natumu merona ta ba rosia. Hahine eto, Egu lohia, Dirava ena tau e, lasi; emu hesiai hahinena basio koia.
2KI.4.16.english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.”

2KI.13.7.motu: Tuari oreana dounu Iehoahasa dekenai e nohova na hosi-gu i taudia imahui hona, bona kariota gwauta bona ae-raka taudia gerebu-ta; badina be Suria pavapavana ese e habuadia tari, uit ikwadina gabuna momoruna heḡereḡerena ai e halaoa.
2KI.13.7.english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

2KI.5.7.motu: Israel pavapavana ese revareva e duahia, bena ena dabua e dare, eto, Lau na Dirava, bona taunimanima baina hamasedia bona baina hamauridia, a? Una dainai ina tau ese lepra tauna ta ihanamona herevana egu ai e siaia mai a? Mani a haeroa, a itaia, iheai-henigu dalana e tahuamu.
2KI.5.7.english: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

2KI.15.4.motu: Ḡau tamona, atai gabudia na se abidia oho; taunimanima na dounu boubou karadia e karava bona muramura mai bonadia e gabuva unu atai gabudia ai.
2KI.15.4.english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

2KI.3.21.motu: Moab taudia iboudiai na e kamonai, hari pavapava na idia ituari-henidia totona vada ema; bena tuari dabuadia bae doki diba taudia, maragina amo ela bona badana, e boiridia, tano hetoana ai e haginidia heḡaeḡae.
2KI.3.21.english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

2KI.12.7.motu: Taunabunai, King Iehoasa ese hahelaḡa tauna Iehoiada bona hahelaḡa taudia oredia na e boiridia, e gwau henidia, eto, Dahaka dainai dubu na asio hanamoa loumu? Benaini, turamui bona dekemui taudia edia amo moni haida ma basio abi lou, a ba heni, dubu ihanamo-louna ḡauna.
2KI.12.7.english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

2KI.20.9.motu: Bena Isaia eto, Emu toa binai Iehova ena amo, Iehova ese vada e gwauraia ḡauna na baine karaia: ikerukeru na vadavada gwauta ma baine ha-ikerukerudia, eiava baine lou, vadavada gwauta ma bae diari?
2KI.20.9.english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

2KI.4.28.motu: Bena hahine eto, Lau ese egu lohia emu ai natugu na noia a? Lau nato “Basio koigu” ani?
2KI.4.28.english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

2KI.9.14.motu: Bena Iehu, Iehosafat Nimisi natuna, ese Ioram ihadikana dalana e tahua. (Hari loram na Israel taudia iboudiai ida Ramoto-gilead ai vada e hegima, Hasaele, Suria pavapavana, ilao-ahuna totona,
2KI.9.14.english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

2KI.9.33.motu: Ia eto, A tahoa dobi. E tahoa dobi; bena rarana pisipisidia na haba ai bona hosi ediai e kau. Bena hosi ese e moimoilaia.

2KI.25.8.motu: Hua iha-imana dinana ihahituna ai, (una na King Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahani-tana ai), Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, Babulono pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, na Ierusalem ai e kau.
2KI.25.8.english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

2KI.15.28.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara; Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika, Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai ḡaudia, na se rakatanidia.
2KI.15.28.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

2KI.15.35.motu: Ḡau tamona, atai gabudia helaḡadia na se abidia oho; taunimanima na dounu boubou karadia e karava bona muramura mai bonadia e gabuva unu atai gabudia ai. Ia ese Iehova ena dubu atai kahana ikoukouna e karaia.
2KI.15.35.english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house.

2KI.4.3.motu: Bena Elisaia eto, A raka lasi, bamomu dekediai kavabu haida do a ha-abi, kavabu asi anidia taina momo.
2KI.4.3.english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

2KI.23.25.motu: Nega gunadia ai asi pavapava ta ia heḡereḡerena, Iehova e lou henia mai lalona idoinai, mai laumana idoinai, bona mai goadana idoinai ida, Mose ena taravatu idoinai heḡereḡerena; bona ia murinai danu asi pavapava ta e tore isi, ia heḡereḡerena.
2KI.23.25.english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

2KI.16.1.motu: Peka Remalia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-hituna ai, Ahasa Iotam ese Iuda e lohiaia matama.
2KI.16.1.english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

2KI.6.14.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese hosi bona kariota bona tuari oreana badana ta e siaidia. Idia na hanuaboi ai ela, hanua e koua heḡeḡe.
2KI.6.14.english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

2KI.17.22.motu: Israel taudia ese Ieroboam ena kara dika iboudiai e tohotohodia, asie rakatanidia;
2KI.17.22.english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

2KI.7.16.motu: Bena hanua taudia na e raka lasi, Suria taudia edia taruha ela, edia kohu e abi ore. Taunabunai, flaoa namo-hereana bosea ta e hoia, davana na sekele tamona, bona bali bosea rua danu e hoi, davana na sekele tamona, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
2KI.7.16.english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Yahweh’s word.

2KI.22.15.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: dekegu e siaimui mai tauna ba hamaoroa, baoto,
2KI.22.15.english: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

2KI.21.2.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, Iehova ese Israel taudia vairadiai e luludia lasi besedia edia kara dika-hereadia heḡereḡeredia.
2KI.21.2.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

2KI.25.23.motu: Bena tano paka ai e nohova oreadia biagudia iboudiai, mai edia orea taudia ida, e kamonai Babulono pavapavana ese Gedalia vada e duanaia baine biagudia negana ai, idia na edia orea taudia ida Gedalia dekena ela, Mispa ai. Taudia bini: Ismael Netania; lohanan Karea; Seraia Tanahumete, tau Netofa; bona Iaasania, tau Maakata natuna.
2KI.25.23.english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

2KI.17.26.motu: Taunabunai, haida ese Asuria pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Vada o laohaidia, Samaria hanuadia ai o hanohodia, taudia na una tano diravana ena taravatu asi dibadia; una dainai ia ese leona na bogaragidiai vada e siaidia lao, bena leona ese e aladia masemu, badina be idia na una tano diravana ena taravatu asi dibadia.
2KI.17.26.english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

2KI.23.18.motu: Ia eto, Baine mia, tau ta ese ia turiana basine abidia oho. Taunabunai ia turiana, bona peroveta tauna ta Samaria amo ema tauna turiana, asie daudia toho.
2KI.23.18.english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

2KI.6.20.motu: Samaria ai e raka vareai, bena maoromaoro Elisaia eto, Iehova e, ini taunimanima matadia ba hapapadia, do bae ita. Taunabunai Iehova ese idia matadia e hapapadia, bena e itaia, idia na Samaria bogaraginai.
2KI.6.20.english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “Yahweh, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.”

2KI.23.14.motu: Ia ese danu nadi au-tubuadia e hamakohidia bona au au-tubuadia e utudia, bena gabudia na mase taudia turiadia amo e hahonudia.
2KI.23.14.english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

2KI.12.14.motu: badina be unu moni na Iehova ena dubu ihanamo-louna e ḡaukaralaiava taudia e henidia.
2KI.12.14.english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

2KI.6.30.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese hahine ena hereva e kamonai; bena maḡu latana amo rakana ai ia ese ena dabua e dare; bena taunimanima ese e itaia, ena dabua henunai na puse dabuana vada e hahedokilai.
2KI.6.30.english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

2KI.20.10.motu: Hesekia na e haere, eto, Ikerukeru baine lata na ḡau haraḡana, a ikerukeru na vadavada gwauta amo baine lou be namo.
2KI.20.10.english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

2KI.4.21.motu: Bena hahine ese e daelaia, Dirava ena tau ena mahuta ḡauna ai e kurea kau, bena iduara e koua. Bena e diho.
2KI.4.21.english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

2KI.1.12.motu: A Elia ese e haere henia, eto, Bema lau na Dirava ena tau, lahi na guba amo baine diho, baine ḡolemui oho, oi bona emu orea taudia imahuiosi danu. Bena Dirava ena lahi na guba amo e diho, una tau mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida e ḡoledia oho.
2KI.1.12.english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

2KI.17.8.motu: bona Israel taudia vairadiai Iehova ese e luludia lasi besedia edia kara bona Israel pavapavadia ese e haginidia karadia na e karava.
2KI.17.8.english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

2KI.6.22.motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Basio aladia mase. Emu dare bona emu peva amo boma abidia mauri taudia na boma aladia mase a? Aniani bona ranu na vairadiai ba dabara, bae aniani bona ranu bae inu, bena biagudia dekena baela.
2KI.6.22.english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

2KI.18.31.motu: Hesekia basio kamonai henia; badina be Asuria pavapavana na ini e gvau tomamu: umui na lau ida baita herohe maino; lau dekegu ba raka lasi mai. Bena iboumui ai na ta ta ena vine ena vine ena suke ena suke anidia baine ani, bona ena guri ena guri ranuna baine inu;
2KI.18.31.english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

2KI.18.3.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara maoromaoro, senena David ena kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
2KI.18.3.english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

2KI.14.10.motu: Momokani, oi ese Edom vada o hadarerea, una dainai lalomu e heabi isimu; una heimodaina ba moalelaia, bona emu hanua ai ba noho. Anina be dahaka hekwarahi ba havaraia, bena ba moru, oi bona Iuda idoinai danu oi ida?
2KI.14.10.english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

2KI.24.5.motu: Iehoiakim ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
2KI.24.5.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

2KI.6.8.motu: Nega ta, Suria pavapavana ese Israel e tuari heniava negana ai, ia na ena hesiai taudia ida e henega bou, gabu ta ladana e hatoa, eto, Una gabu ai baina taruha.
2KI.6.8.english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

2KI.23.11.motu: Hosi laulaudia danu, Iuda pavapavadia ese e hahelaḡadia dina ena, bona Iehova ena dubu raka-vareaina ai, hesiai tauna Natana-melek ena daiutu badibadinai, dubu murimurinai e atodia, na ia ese ma e abidia oho; bona dina ena kariota danu e gabudia.
2KI.23.11.english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

2KI.23.8.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai Iuda hanuadia amo e hakaudia lasi, bona atai gabudia, hahelaḡa taudia ese muramura mai bonadia e gabuva gabudia, na ia ese e hamirodia, Geba amo ela bona Bere-sieba. Ikoukou ai gabu helaḡadia danu, Iosua, hanua lohiana, ena ikoukou raka-vareaina badinai e miava, hanua ikoukouna lauri kahana ai, ia ese e ḡiḡidia dobi.
2KI.23.8.english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

2KI.18.4.motu: Atai gabudia helaḡadia e abidia oho, bona au-tubua e hakwaidudia, bona kaivakuku e utudia. Gaigai laulauna, Mose ese auri labora-labora amo e karaia ḡauna, danu ia ese e hamakohia rohoroho. Gunaguna ema bona unu dinadia Israel taudia ese muramura mai bonadia na una ḡau vairanai e gabuva; ladana e gwauraiava Nehustana.
2KI.18.4.english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

2KI.6.28.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese hahine na e nanadaia, eto, Emu hekwakwanai be dahaka? Hahine na e haere, eto, Ina hahine ese e hamaorogu, eto “Natumu a heni, hari dina ai baita ania, bena kerukeru lau natugu baita ania”.
2KI.6.28.english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?”

2KI.6.32.motu: Elisaia na ena ruma ai e helaiva, bona tau-badadia na ia ida hehelai. Hanua pavapavana ese tau ta ia vairana amo vada e siaia lao; a hari gwaukau tauna do se kau ai, Elisaia ese unu tau-badadia e hamaorodia, eto, O itaiamu, una roroma tauna vada e hesiai, lau kwaragu iabi-ohona totona. Gwaukau tauna bainema negana ai, iduara na ba koua kunuka-kunuka, ia ba laoa ahu. Biaguna aena regedia na ia murina amo se maimu a?
2KI.6.32.english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

2KI.25.2.motu: Taunabunai, hanua e koua heḡeḡe ela bona King Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-tana.
2KI.25.2.english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

2KI.16.20.motu: Bena Ahasa na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; senena ida e guria, David ena hanua ai. Bena natuna Hesekia na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.16.20.english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

2KI.20.6.motu: Emu mauri na ma baina hadaudaua laḡani gwauta-ima. Oi bona ina hanua na Asuria pavapavana imana amo baina harohomui mauri, bona ina hanua baina gimaia, lau sibogu daigu ai bona egu hesiai tauna David dainai.
2KI.20.6.english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

2KI.15.18.motu: Iehova vairanai e kara havara; ena dina iboudiai Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika, Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai ḡaudia, na se rakatanidia.
2KI.15.18.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

2KI.2.2.motu: Bena Elia ese Elisaia e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara iniseni ai do ba noho, badina be Iehova ese vada e siaigu, Betele bainala. A Elisaia eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau basina rakatanimu. Taunabunai, raruosi na Betele ela.
2KI.2.2.english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me as far as Bethel.”

2KI.17.9.motu: Kara dia maoro, Iehova, edia Dirava, ihadikana karadia, na Israel taudia ese e karadia hehuniva. Idia ese atai gabudia e haginidia edia hanua iboudiai lalodiai, gima kohorona ela bona hanua mai maḡudia.
2KI.17.9.english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

2KI.4.20.motu: E abia isi, sinana dekena e laohaia; bena mero na sinana mamuna ai e helai ela bona dina tubua, bena e mase.
2KI.4.20.english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

2KI.18.20.motu: Oi o laloamu hereva kavakavadia na tuari ihaerolaina bona igoadalaina a? Daika enai o hetao kaumu dainai vada o gwau edeede henigu?
2KI.18.20.english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

2KI.24.19.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, Iehoiakim ena kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
2KI.24.19.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

2KI.4.1.motu: Peroveta oreana tauna ta vabuna ese Elisaia e tai henia, eto, Emu hesiai tauna, lau adavagu, na vada e mase. Oi dibamu emu hesiai tauna na Iehova garina e gariva, to enai e abi torehai tauna na vada ema, natugu raruosi baine abidia oho, ena hesiai memerodia ai baine halaodia e tomamu.
2KI.4.1.english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared Yahweh. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

2KI.4.2.motu: Elisaia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ede baina karamu toma? A hamaorogu, emu ruma ai na dahaka ḡau mia? Hahine na eto, Emu hesiai hahinena na asi ena ḡau ta ruma ai mia, dehoro kavabu tamona mo.
2KI.4.2.english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?”

2KI.10.27.motu: Baal ena au-tubua bona ena dubu danu idia ese e ḡigidia dobi, bona mei rumana ai e halaoa, ema bona ina dina.
2KI.10.27.english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

2KI.24.8.motu: Iehoiakini e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na gwautataurahani; ia na hua toi hona Ierusalem ai e lohia. Sinana ladana na Nehusuta, Elnatan, Ierusalem tauna, natuna.
2KI.24.8.english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

2KI.15.5.motu: Iehova ese hanua pavapavana e hagorerea, bena lepra e davaria ela bona ena mase dinana, una dainai ia na sibona ruma ta ai e nohova. A hanua pavapavana natuna Iotam ese hanua pavapavana ena ruma taudia e reḡudiava bona tano taudia e lohiadia.
2KI.15.5.english: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

2KI.14.3.motu: Amasia na Iehova vairanai e kara maoromaoro, a dia senena David heḡereḡerena; tamana Ioasa e karava karadia iboudiai ia ese ma e kara.
2KI.14.3.english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

2KI.18.28.motu: Bena Rabsake na e tore isi, Iuda gadona ai e boi lolo, eto, Pavapava badana, Asuria pavapavana, ena hereva a kamonai.
2KI.18.28.english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

2KI.7.3.motu: Lepra taudia hahani na hanua ikoukouna ai nonoho, bena e hereva heheni, eto, Iniseni ai ta helaimu ela bona baita mase anina be dahaka?
2KI.7.3.english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

2KI.2.21.motu: Bena ia na ranu gurina ela, damena na ranu lalonai e tahoa dobi, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina ranu vada na haḡoevaia; ina negana amo ia ese mase eiava ruru-nege basine havaraia.
2KI.2.21.english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

2KI.5.1.motu: Naaman, Suria pavapavana ena tuari oreana lohiana, na biaguna ena tau badana ta, bona e lalo namo heniava; badina be iena amo Iehova ese kwalimu na Suria e henia. Ia na goada dikadika bona boga-auka tauna; to ia na lepra tauna.
2KI.5.1.english: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

2KI.4.30.motu: Bena mero sinana eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau na oi basina rakatanimu. Taunabunai, ia na e tore isi, hahine murina amo e raka.
2KI.4.30.english: The child’s mother said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.”

2KI.6.19.motu: Bena Elisaia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Dalana na dia inai, bona hanuana na dia inai; murigu amo a raka, bena baina hakaumui lao, o tahuamu tauna dekenai. Bena ia ese e hakaudia lao, ela bona Samaria.
2KI.6.19.english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

2KI.5.9.motu: Taunabunai, Naaman na mai hosina bona mai kariotana ida ela, Elisaia ena ruma iduarana vairanai e gini.
2KI.5.9.english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

2KI.19.14.motu: Hesekia ese revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia amo e abia, bena e duahia. Bena Hesekia na Iehova ena dubu ai e dae kau, bena revareva e kehoa Iehova vairanai.
2KI.19.14.english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

2KI.11.12.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese hanua pavapavana natuna e hakaua lasi, havava ḡauna na kwarana ai e atoa, bona dagi toana e henia, bena idia ese ia e gwauraia hanua pavapavana, bona e horoa danu, bena imadia e patapata, eto, Hanua pavapavana baine mauri daudau.
2KI.11.12.english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

2KI.9.20.motu: Bena kito tauna ma e hereva, eto, Dekediai e kau, to se lou maimu; kariota ihaheauna danu Iehu Nimisi ena kariota e heaumu na heto, badina be ia na vaia ena kariota e haheaua lalo-dikamu.
2KI.9.20.english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

2KI.4.29.motu: Elisaia ese Gehasi e hamaoroa, eto, Emu rami ba hekasilaia, egu itotohi na imamu ai bavabia, baola. Ta ida boma hedavari, Basio hahenamo henia; bona ta ese bema hahenamo henimu, basio haere henia. Bena egu itotohi na mero vairana latanai ba dagaia diho.
2KI.4.29.english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

2KI.21.6.motu: Ia ese danu natuna na haḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna ai e halaoa, bona mari bona bagu-haoro karadia e kara, bona rohe taudia bona mea taudia na e daidaidia. Iehova vairanai e kara havara-havara, bona e habadua.
2KI.21.6.english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

2KI.4.14.motu: Elisaia ma eto, Vada dahaka baita kara henia? Gehasi na e haere, eto, O, ia na asi natuna merona ta, bona adavana na vada e buruka.
2KI.4.14.english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?”

2KI.15.7.motu: Bena Asaria na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; senena ida e guria, David ena hanua ai. Bena natuna lotam na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.15.7.english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

2KI.8.10.motu: Elisaia ese e haere henia, eto, Aola, ba hamaoroa, baoto “Momokani, vada ba mauri lou”; ḡau tamona, Iehova ese vada e haheitalaigu, momokani ia na baine mase.
2KI.8.10.english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”

2KI.15.10.motu: Salumu Iabese ese ia iala-masena dalana e tahua, bena Ibleama ai e botaia hekida diho, e alaia mase; bena ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.15.10.english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

2KI.16.8.motu: Ahasa ese danu Iehova ena dubu ai bona hanua pavapavana ena ruma habou-habou gabudia ai e davari silver-na bona gold-na e abi, herahia ḡauna e siaia, Asuria pavapavana ena.
2KI.16.8.english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in Yahweh’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

2KI.3.19.motu: bena hanua mai maḡudia iboudiai bona abi-hidi hanuadia iboudiai na ba hadareredia, au namodia iboudiai na ba hagaridia, ranu guridia iboudiai na ba tahunidia, bona tano namodia iboudiai na nadi amo ba hadikadia.
2KI.3.19.english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

2KI.13.24.motu: Hasaele, Suria pavapavana, e mase negana ai, ia natuna Ben-hadad na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.13.24.english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

2KI.19.28.english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

2KI.17.16.motu: Iehova, edia Dirava, ena haheḡani iboudiai e rakatanidia; edia boromakau natudia laulaudia rua e kara, bona kaivakuku ta danu; bona guba hisiudia iboudiai e toma henidia diho; bona Baal isiaina e lao heni.
2KI.17.16.english: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

2KI.13.25.motu: Bena ia ese Iehoasa tamana Iehoahasa ena amo tuari ai e abi hanuadia na Iehoasa Iehoahasa ese ma e abidia lou. Nega toi Ioasa ese e hadarerea, bona Israel hanuadia e abidia lou.
2KI.13.25.english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

2KI.9.9.motu: Ahaba ena iduhu na Ieroboam Nebata ena iduhu bona Baasa Ahia ena iduhu heḡeregeredia ai baina halaodia.
2KI.9.9.english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

2KI.3.3.motu: Ḡau tamona, Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika, Israel e hakaralaia dika ḡauna, na ia ese e dogoa tao, se rakatania.
2KI.3.3.english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

2KI.16.4.motu: Ia ese danu boubou karadia e karava bona muramura mai bonadia e gabuva, atai gabudia ai bona ororo ai bona au mauridia iboudiai henudiai.
2KI.16.4.english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

2KI.3.12.motu: Iehosafat eto, Iehova ena hereva na ia enai. Taunabunai Israel pavapavana bona Iehosafat bona Edom pavapavana na ia dekena ela.
2KI.3.12.english: Jehoshaphat said, “Yahweh’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

2KI.10.4.motu: Bena idia na e gari dikadika, e hereva heheni, eto, A itaia, hari pavapava raruosi na ia vairanai se gini diba, matona ita na ede baita gini toma?
2KI.10.4.english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

2KI.10.21.motu: Bena Iehu ese herevana e siaia lao, Israel idoinai; bena Baal itomadiho-henina taudia iboudiai ema, ta se noho. Bena Baal ena dubu ai e dae kau, ela bona Baal ena dubu na e honu, duduna ela bona duduna.
2KI.10.21.english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

2KI.6.18.motu: Bena Suria taudia na ia iabina totona e hekei diho negana ai, Elisaia ese Iehova e ḡuria, eto, Na noimumu, ina orea na matadia a huari kepulu. Taunabunai ia ese matadia e huari kepulu, Elisaia ena ḡuriḡuri heḡereḡerena.
2KI.6.18.english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.”

2KI.17.21.motu: Ia ese Israel na David ena iduhu amo e darea oho negana ai, idia ese Ieroboam Nebata e abia, edia pavapava ai e halaoa. Bena Ieroboam ese Israel e lulua oho, Iehova iḡavana amo, bona e hakaradia dika bada herea.
2KI.17.21.english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.

2KI.24.7.motu: Una negana ai Aigupto pavapavana na ena tano amo se raka lasi lou, badina be Babulono pavapavana ese Aigupto pavapavana ena tano, Aigupto sinavaina amo ela bona Eufrate sinavaina, iboudiai vada e abidia.
2KI.24.7.english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

2KI.3.13.motu: Elisaia ese Israel pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka baina kara henimu? Tamamu bona sinamu edia peroveta taudia dekedia aola. A Israel pavapavana ese e hamaoroa, eto, Lasi, Iehova ese pavapava taumai tatoiosi vada e boirimai, Moab taudia imadia ai baine atomai totona.
2KI.3.13.english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.”

2KI.6.23.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese aria badana e dabaraia adia; bena e aniani bona e inuinu vaitani murinai ia ese e siaidia, bena biagudia dekena ela. Suria taudia ese Israel tanona asie daea lou.
2KI.6.23.english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

2KI.10.32.motu: Unu dinadia ai, Iehova ese Israel tanona e hamaraḡia matama. Israel tanona idoinai lalonai Hasaele ese Israel taudia e hadareredia:
2KI.10.32.english: In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

2KI.2.25.motu: Unu amo ia na ena dala ai e raka, ela bona Karamele ororona; bena unu amo Samaria ma e lou lao.
2KI.2.25.english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

2KI.16.19.motu: Ahasa ena kara oredia sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani?
2KI.16.19.english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

2KI.8.27.motu: Ia danu Ahaba ena iduhu edia dala ai e rakava, bona Iehova vairanai e kara dikava, Ahaba ena iduhu taudia e karava heḡereḡerena; badina be ia na Ahaba iduhuna ravadia.
2KI.8.27.english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

2KI.11.5.motu: Bena e haganidia, eto, Umui na ini ba kara toma: emui orea kaha toiosi ai kaha ta be Dina Helaḡa ai o raka vareaimu, hanua pavapavana ena ruma o gimaiamu,
2KI.11.5.english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

2KI.1.15.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Elia e hamaoroa, eto, Ia ida baola, garina basio gari. Taunabunai, ia na e tore isi, unu tau ida ela, hanua pavapavana dekenai.
2KI.1.15.english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.”

2KI.23.37.motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, senena edia kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
2KI.23.37.english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

2KI.7.20.motu: Benaini, unu e vara toma ienai, badina be hanua taudia ese ikoukou raka-lasina ai e moia taotao, bena e
2KI.7.20.english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

2KI.13.18.motu: Ma eto, Diba avabi. Bena e abi. Bena ia ese Israel pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Diba amo tano a tutua. Nega toi e tutua, bena e hadokoa.
2KI.13.18.english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

2KI.3.10.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana eto, Madi ihabaida, Iehova ese ita pavapava tatoiosi vada e boirida, Moab pavapavana imana ai baine atoda totona.
2KI.3.10.english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

2KI.5.12.motu: Damasko sinavaina Abana bona Farapara, ese Israel sinavaidia iboudiai na asie hereadiamu a? Idia lalodiai basinama digu basinama ḡoeva diba a? Bena e raka muri, mai lalo-ḡaraḡarana ida e raka oho.
2KI.5.12.english: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

2KI.6.10.motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese haida e siaidia lao, Dirava ena tau ese e hamaorolaia gabuna baela. Unuhetomana ia ese vaevae e sisiba heniava, bena e roho mauri, dia nega tamona eiava nega rua hona.
2KI.6.10.english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

2KI.22.11.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese taravatu bukana herevadia e kamonai negana ai, ena dabua e dare.
2KI.22.11.english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

2KI.9.4.motu: Taunabunai, hari tau peroveta eregabena na Ramoto-gilead ela.
2KI.9.4.english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

2KI.10.31.motu: A Iehu na Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena taravatu dalana ai se raka namonamo mai lalona idoinai, ia na Ieroboam ena kara dika, Israel e hakaraia dika ḡaudia, na se rakatanidia.
2KI.10.31.english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

2KI.10.13.motu: Unuseni ai Iehu na Ahasia, Iuda pavapavana, varavarana ida e hedavari, bena e nanadaidia, eto, Umui, be daidia? Idia na e haere, eto, Ai na Ahasia varavarana, hanua pavapavana natuna bona ia sinana natuna baia igodia ita totona vada ama.
2KI.10.13.english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?”

2KI.21.26.motu: Bena ena gara ai e guria, Usa ena uma-uma ai; bena natuna Iosia na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
2KI.21.26.english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

2KI.25.11.motu: Bena hanua taudia kwabukwabudia dounu hanua ai e nohova, bona e heau Babulono pavapavana enai e hanai taudia, bona taunimanima oredia, na Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese dauha e laohaidia.
2KI.25.11.english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

2KI.2.3.motu: Bena peroveta oreana taudia Betele ai e nohova na Elisaia dekena e raka lasi, e hereva henia, eto, Oi dibamu hari dina ai Iehova ese biagumu na oiemu amo baine abia oho a? Ia eto, Oibe, dibagu; asio hereva.
2KI.2.3.english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?”

2KI.3.14.motu: Elisaia eto, Iehova Sabaota, isiaina na lao heniamu Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, basinama matauraia, lau ese oi basinarna haḡeremu bona basinama itamu.
2KI.3.14.english: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

2KI.18.27.motu: A Rabsake ese e hamaorodia, eto, Biagugu vada e siaigu, ini hereva na umui biagumui bona umui emui ai mo baina gwaurai totona, dia unu maḡu latanai e helaimu taudia, idia na umui ida vada e ahumui vaitani sibomui taḡemui bavani bona meimui ba inu taudia, ediai a?
2KI.18.27.english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

2KI.5.13.motu: A iena hesiai taudia na e raka kahira, e hereva henia, eto, Tamagu e, peroveta tauna ese kara aukana ta bema haḡanilaimu, boma karaia ani? Matogana, ia e gwaumu “Ba digu bena ba ḡoeva” be edeheto?
2KI.5.13.english: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

2KI.25.27.motu: Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, ena noho-hedoa laḡanina ihatoiahui-hituna ai, hua ihagwauta-ruana dinana iharuahui-hituna ai, Evil-merodak, Babulono pavapavana, e lohia matama. Bena ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai ia ese Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, e bogaia hisi, dibura rumana amo e ruhaia nege;
2KI.25.27.english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

2KI.24.11.motu: Bena Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ena hesiai taudia ese hanua e koua heḡeḡeva lalonai, ia na hanua ai e kau.
2KI.24.11.english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

2KI.8.3.motu: Laḡani hitu e ore ai, hahine na Filistia taudia edia tano amo e lou lao, bena ia na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, baine noia totona; ena ruma bona ena tano iabi-loudia herevadia baine gwaurai.
2KI.8.3.english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

2KI.22.17.motu: Badina be lau vada e rakatanigu, bona idau dirava vairadiai muramura mai bonadia vada e gabu; imadia ḡaukaradia iboudiai amo vada e habadugu. Taunabunai, egu badu baine ḡaraḡara ina gabu latanai, bona ta ese basine habodoa.
2KI.22.17.english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

2KI.5.3.motu: Bena ia ese biaguna hahinena e hereva henia, eto, Una egu lohia na bema Samaria peroveta tauna dekenai, ia ese ena lepra bema hanamoa.
2KI.5.3.english: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

2KI.15.29.motu: Peka, Israel pavapavana, ena nega ai Tiglata-pilesere, Asuria pavapavana, ema. Ia ese lono bona Abele-bete-maka bona lanoa bona Kede bona Hasoro bona Gilead bona Galilea, bona Napatali tanona idoinai, na tuari ai e abidia; bona unu gabu taudia na e ḡuidia, Asuria e laohaidia.
2KI.15.29.english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

2KI.19.3.motu: Idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hesekia na ini e g vau tomamu: Hari dina na lalo-hisihisi bona gwau-gwau bona hemarai dinana; memero edia vara negana vada e kau, to ihavaradia ai goada na vada lasi.
2KI.19.3.english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

2KI.15.21.motu: Menaheme ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani?
2KI.15.21.english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

2KI.25.14.motu: Bona uro bona gaga bona lamepa ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia, bona auri labora-labora ḡaudia, kara helaḡadia ai e ḡaukaralaiva ḡaudia, na iboudiai e laohai.
2KI.25.14.english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

2KI.12.8.motu: Taunabunai hahelaḡa taudia ese lalodia e hatamonadia, taunimanima edia moni basie abi lou, bona dubu danu basie ḡaukaralaia.
2KI.12.8.english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

2KI.9.19.motu: Bena ia ese hosi-gui tauna ihararuana e siaia lao. Ia na dekediai e kau, eto, Hanua pavapavana na ini e gwau tomamu: maino ai oma a? Iehu e haere, eto, Maino be dahaka ikaralaina emu ai? A hegiro, murigu ai a raka.
2KI.9.19.english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’”

2KI.18.1.motu: Hosea Elaha, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, Hesekia Ahasa ese Iuda e lohiaia matama.
2KI.18.1.english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

2KI.24.13.motu: bona Iehova ena dubu kohudia iboudiai bona pavapava ena ruma kohudia e laohaidia, bona gold gaudia iboudiai Iehova ena dubu ai e miava, Solomon, Israel pavapavana, ese e kara gaudia, na e utudia sisi-sisi, Iehova ese vada e gwauraia guna heḡereḡerena.
2KI.24.13.english: He carried out from there all the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in Yahweh’s temple, as Yahweh had said.

2KI.17.19.motu: Iuda taudia ese danu Iehova, edia Dirava, ena haheḡani asie badinadia, to Israel taudia ese e haginidia daladia ai e raka.
2KI.17.19.english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

2KI.17.5.motu: Bena Asuria pavapavana ese Israel tanona idoinai e tuari henia, ela bona Samaria ai e kau, bena hanua na e koua ahu ela bona laḡani toi e ore.
2KI.17.5.english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

2KI.7.5.motu: Taunabunai, dina kerekerena ai e tore isi, taruha bae lao henia totona; a Suria taudia edia taruha isena ai e kau negana ai, tau ta asie davaria unuseni ai.
2KI.7.5.english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

2KI.20.15.motu: Isaia ma eto, Oiemu ruma ai dahaka dahaka e ita? Hesekia ma e haere, eto, Ḡau iboudiai egu ruma ai na vada e itadia; asi ḡauna ta egu habou-habou rumadia ai lau ese asina haheitalaidia.
2KI.20.15.english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?”

2KI.2.24.motu: Ia na e gini kerehai, e itadia; bena Iehova ladana ai e uduguiraidia. Bena bea hahinedia rua na uda amo e raka lasi, memero hari-ahui rua e aladia mase.
2KI.2.24.english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

2KI.17.1.motu: Ahasa, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana ai, Hosea Elaha ese Israel e lohiaia matama, Samaria ai; bona ena lohia laḡanidia na taurahani-ta.
