2PE.3.5.motu: Unu e laloa tomamu badina be ina na vada e laloa boio: gunaguna guba e miava, bena Dirava ena hereva dainai tanobada na gadobada lalona amo e dae bona gadobada bogaraginai e miava.
2PE.3.5.english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

2PE.1.9.motu: A ini ḡau ai e dabumu tauna, ia na matakepulu tauna; matana e tunamu dainai e helalo boiomu ena kara dika gunadia vada e huri oho vaitani.
2PE.1.9.english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

2PE.1.21.motu: Badina be peroveta herevadia na taunimanima edia ura kava amo asie vara, a Lauma Helaḡa ese Dirava ena helaḡa taudia e haduadia heḡereḡerena e herevava.
2PE.1.21.english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

2PE.2.1.motu: Peroveta taudia koikoidia na taunimanima bogaragidiai e nohova; bona umui bogaragimui ai danu hahediba koikoi taudia do bae gini tore. Idia na hahediba herevadia koikoidia bae hadibalai hehuni, bona Biagudia, e hoidia Tauna, bae ḡorea. Bae mase haraga, sibodia edia hahedika ai.
2PE.2.1.english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

2PE.2.4.motu: Dirava ese e kara havara anerudia na se bogadia hisi, a dibura masemase gabuna ai e tahodia dobi, unuseni ai e ḡuidia ela bona hahemaoro negana.
2PE.2.4.english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

2PE.2.17.motu: Idia na ranu guridia kororodia na heheto, eiava ḡahu lai ese e hodaia isi na heto; dibura masemase gabuna vada e seua, idia edia.
2PE.2.17.english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

2PE.1.20.motu: A ina na ba diba guna: ta ese sibona ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai peroveta bukadia anidia basine gwaurai.
2PE.1.20.english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

2PE.3.17.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, vada o diba guna, taunabunai nahuamui ba toho, kara havara taudia edia kerere ese baine hakaumui siri na garina, emui gini tutuka-tutuka amo ba keto na garina.
2PE.3.17.english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

2PE.2.22.motu: Hereva heḡereḡerena na idia ediai vada eme momokani, eto, Sisia be ena mumuta e lou heniamu; bona boroma be bae huria to kopukopu ai baine hekui-hekui lou.
2PE.2.22.english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” + 2:22 Proverbs 26:11 and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

2PE.1.7.motu: Dirava ibadinana enai tadikakamui irua-henidia bavatoa kau; bona tadikakamui iura-henidia enai lalokau bavatoa kau.
2PE.1.7.english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

2PE.2.13.motu: edia kara dika davadia do bae abi. Lebulebu karadia dina ai e moalelaimu; idia na toutou eiava bero na heto; umui ida o aniani heboumu negadia ai danu e aniani lalo-dikamu.
2PE.2.13.english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

2PE.2.16.motu: a ena kerere dainai e sisiba henia, doniki, hereva asi dibana ḡauna, ese taunimanima gadodia ai una peroveta tauna e hereva henia, ena kara kava e gwaua tubu.
2PE.2.16.english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

2PE.1.6.motu: lalo-parara enai haheauka bavaloa kau; haheauka enai boga-auka bavatoa kau; boga-auka enai Dirava ibadinana bavatoa kau;
2PE.1.6.english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

2PE.3.15.motu: Lohiabada ena haheauka ba haeroa, una na hahemauri ḡauna; varavara-dosida Paulo ese e henia aonegana amo e tore henimui heḡereḡerena.
2PE.3.15.english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

2PE.1.13.motu: to lau na tomamu, ina taruha doini na noho heniamu ai, baina haomui bona ini ḡau baina hahelalolaimui une.
2PE.1.13.english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

2PE.3.9.motu: Lohiabada na ena gwauhamata ihamomokanina ai se halahemu, haida e laloamu na heto; to, e haheauka henimuimu, badina be ia na se uramu ta baine mase; e uramu iboumui ai ba helalo kerehai.
2PE.3.9.english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

2PE.2.3.motu: Edia mata-ḡaniḡani dainai, koikoi herevadia amo lalomui bae ani, ela bona bae abimui; a ihahemaorohenidia na se halahemu, bona ihamasedia na se mahutamu.
2PE.2.3.english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

2PE.2.15.motu: Idia na dala maoromaorona vada e rakatania, vada e raka kerere, Balaam, Beoro natuna, ena dala vada e rakalaia. Ia na kara dika davana iabina urana e urava tauna;
2PE.2.15.english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

2PE.1.14.motu: Badina be lau dibagu egu taruha iraḡana negana vada eme kahira-kahira; iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso unu vada e hadibagu toma.
2PE.1.14.english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

2PE.2.12.motu: Ini na boroma na heheto, asi daradia; unu e vara toma, ma unu bae dika toma. Asi dibadia ḡaudia e ḡonaḡonalaimu; edia dika lalonai bae mase vaitani,
2PE.2.12.english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

2PE.2.20.motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso dibadia murinai tanobada ena miro ḡaudia amo vada e roho mauri taudia na unu miro ḡaudia ese ma bae idoadia lou bona bae hadareredia, madi, edia dika gunana na maraḡi, edia dika gabena na baine bada.
2PE.2.20.english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

2PE.3.1.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, revareva iharuana binai na tore henimuimu. Ruaosi badidia be lalomui ihaodia, mai lalomui ḡoevaḡoevadia ida ba helalo une.
2PE.3.1.english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

2PE.2.10.motu: Dika hereadia bini: tauanina ena ura bodagadia e ḡava taudia, bona gwau-maoro taudia e dadaraidia taudia. E hekokorokumu, sibodia edia ura e karamu, atai taudia i'ihiihiraidia asie garimu;
2PE.2.10.english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

2PE.1.17.motu: Badina be Tamada Dirava ena amo hemataurai bona hairai e abi negana ai, ere ta Diari-diari Herea-daena lalona amo e kamonai, eto, “Ina na Natugu, egu lalokau; lau ia na lalo namo heniamu”.
2PE.1.17.english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.” + 1:17 Matthew 17:5; Mark 9:7; Luke 9:35

2PE.1.19.motu: Unu amo peroveta herevadia vada e momokani vaitani, ai emai ai. Umui danu ba badinadia baine namo; idia na lamepa gabu diburana ai e diarimu na heto, ela bona daba baine rere, bona hisiu bada na lalomui ai baine dae.
2PE.1.19.english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

2PE.2.8.motu: ia na kara maoromaoro tauna, a idia padadiai e nohova dinadia iboudiai edia kara havara e itava e kamonaiva dainai ia lalona e hisihisiva.
2PE.2.8.english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

2PE.2.19.motu: Ura kwalimu bae henidia e tomamu, to idia sibodia na mase ena iḡui taudia; badina be darere tauna na kwalimu tauna ena hesiai ai bainela.
2PE.2.19.english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

2PE.3.4.motu: baeto “Ena lou mai gwauhamatana na edeheto? Badina be tubuda tamada e mahutava negadia ema harihari, ḡau iboudiai vada eme hesiriu, tanobada e karaia negana heḡereḡerena”.
2PE.3.4.english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

2PE.1.15.motu: A baina goada toho, bena egu mase murinai ini ḡau ba helalolai une, nega iboudiai.
2PE.1.15.english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

2PE.1.11.motu: Bona unu amo emui dala baine lailai ḡoevaḡoeva, eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena mia-hanaihanai basileiana lalonai ba raka vareai.
2PE.1.11.english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

2PE.3.8.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, ina hereva tamona basio laloa boio, Lohiabada enai dina tamona na laḡani daha na heto, bona laḡani daha na dina tamona na heto.
2PE.3.8.english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

2PE.3.14.motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau taumui e, ini ḡau o narimu dainai ba goada balaheni, hedaro-bouboumui ai baine davarimui, asi toutoumui bona asi kereremui ia vairanai.
2PE.3.14.english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

2PE.1.16.motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena siahu bona ena mai herevadia a hamaorolaimuiva negadia ai, ai na dia gori herevadia asia sivaraiva, a ia hairaina na matamai amo a itaia.
2PE.1.16.english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

2PE.1.12.motu: Badina bunai lau na tomamu ini hereva baina hamaorolaimui loulou. Ena be mai dibamui bona hereva momokani ai o gini tutuka-tutukamu,
2PE.1.12.english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

2PE.3.12.motu: Dirava ena dina ena mai ba nari bona ba kahaia; una dina ai lahi ese guba baine araia ore, bona siahu-badana ese ḡau iboudiai baine havevedia.
2PE.3.12.english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

2PE.2.11.motu: a aneru, ena be edia goada bona edia siahu na herea, to unu atai taudia asie habadelaidia Lohiabada vairanai.
2PE.2.11.english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

2PE.3.13.motu: Ita na guba matamatana bona tanobada matamatana, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena, ta narimu; kara maoromaoro taudia ese bae noholaia.
2PE.3.13.english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

2PE.3.18.motu: A eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada bona ena lalo-diari ai ba tubu daga dae. Hairai na iena, harihari ela hanaihanai. Amen.
2PE.3.18.english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

2PE.2.14.motu: Matadia e bodagamu; kara dika ai asie hesikumu; lalo-manoka taudia e idoadiamu; mata-ḡaniḡani karadia ai vada e manada. Uru dikana!
2PE.2.14.english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

2PE.2.5.motu: Bona bese gunana danu se bogaia hisi; Noa mo, kara maoromaoro iharorolaina tauna, mai bamona hahituosi ida, e hamauridia, a ia garina asie gariva taudia be utu-utu ese e habuadia.
2PE.2.5.english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

2PE.1.1.motu: Lau, Simona Petro, Iesu Keriso isiaina ilao-henina bona ena aposetolo taugu, umui ai ida eda abidadama tamona iseda Dirava bona Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena kara maoromaoro enai e miamu taumui na tore henimuimu:
2PE.1.1.english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

2PE.1.3.motu: Dirava ena siahu ese eda mauri bona ia ibadinana ḡaudia iboudiai vada e henida, hairaina bona ḡoeva-daena amo vada e boirida Tauna tame diba dainai.
2PE.1.3.english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

2PE.1.2.motu: harihari-bada bona maino emui ai bae bada, emui laloparara danu Dirava enai bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso enai baine bada.
2PE.1.2.english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

2PE.2.6.motu: Sodoma bona Gomora danu e habuadia tari, kahu ai e halaodia, gabeai ia garina basie gari taudia matadia ihakanidia;
2PE.2.6.english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

2PE.1.8.motu: Badina be bema ini ḡau lalomui ai bae mia bona bae bada, umui na lahedo taumui bona asi damumui taumui ai basiola, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso mai dibamui dainai.
2PE.1.8.english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2PE.1.10.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, ba goada balaheni, e boirimui bona e abimui hidi vada ba hamomokania, badina be unu ba kara toma negana ai umui na basio keto.
2PE.1.10.english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

2PE.1.4.motu: Unu amo ena gwauhamata badadia bona hereadia vada e henida; unu gwauhamata ese tanobada ena heḡahusi bodagadia amo bae harohomui mauri, bena Dirava lalona korikorina bavabia.
2PE.1.4.english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

2PE.2.18.motu: E hereva kavamu; e heaḡi kavamu; kara kerere-kerere taudia bogaragidia amo e roho maurimu taudia e idoadiamu tau-anina ena heḡahusi bona ena mata-dika amo.
2PE.2.18.english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

2PE.1.18.motu: Ina ere ai ese a kamonai, ia ida ororo helaḡana ai a nohova negana ai.
2PE.1.18.english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

2PE.3.6.motu: A una tanobada na gadobada ese e habubunia, bena vada e ore.
2PE.3.6.english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

2PE.3.10.motu: A Lohiabada ena dina baine kau, henao tauna na heto; una dina ai guba baine puki mai rege-badana ida, ḡau iboudiai na siahu badana ese baine havevedia, tanobada danu, mai anina idoinai ida, lahi ese baine araia ore.
2PE.3.10.english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

2PE.2.7.motu: a Lot mo, kara maoromaoro tauna, e hamauria. Una Lot be lalona e hesiku, kara dika taudia edia lebulebu karadia daidiai;
2PE.2.7.english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

2PE.3.11.motu: Benaini, ini ḡau iboudiai unu bema ore toma, umui ede boma kara toma? Emui kara iboudiai bema helaḡa; Dirava boma badinaia.
2PE.3.11.english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

2PE.2.21.motu: Idia na dala maoromaorona basiema diba bema namo; a dibadia bena e henidia haheḡanina helaḡana amo e raka oho na dika.
2PE.2.21.english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

2SA.5.12.motu: Bena David lalona e parara Iehova ese vada e haginia, Israel pavapavana, bona ena basileia vada e hadaea herea, ena orea taudia Israel daidiai.
2SA.5.12.english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

2SA.17.11.motu: A lauegu lalo-hadai be Israel taudia iboudiai na oi dekemu bae hebou, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba; bae hutuma kone mirina na heto. Bena oi danu tuari baola.
2SA.17.11.english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

2SA.18.7.motu: Unuseni ai David ena hesiai taudia ese Israel taudia e hadareredia; una dina ai ala-ala na bada herea, taunimanima gerebu-rua e mase.
2SA.18.7.english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

2SA.7.13.motu: Ia ese ruma auta baine haginia, lau ladagu ena; bona lau ese iena basileia teronona baina haginia, baine gini hanaihanai.
2SA.7.13.english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

2SA.13.16.motu: A hahine ese e haere henia, eto, Taihugu e, lasi; hari vada o karagu kererena na maragi, a o lulugumu kererena na bada. A ia ese asine kamonai henia.
2SA.13.16.english: She said to him, “Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!”

2SA.16.18.motu: Husai ese Absalom e haere henia, eto, Lasi badina be Iehova bona ini taunimanima bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese vada e abia hidi tauna na lau ese danu baina abia dae, bona ia dekenai baina noho.
2SA.16.18.english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

2SA.8.12.motu: Besedia be Edom bona Moab, bona Amono taudia bona Filistia taudia bona Amalek taudia; Hadadesere Rehob, Soba pavapavana, ena amo e abi kohudia danu ia ese e hahelaḡadia.
2SA.8.12.english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

2SA.15.8.motu: Badina be emu hesiai tauna na Gesuru ai, Aram tanona ai, na nohova negana ai na gwau hamata, nato, Iehova na baine hakaugu lou ela bona Ierusalem ai baina kau, lau ese Iehova baina toma henia diho.
2SA.15.8.english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If Yahweh shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.’”

2SA.13.29.motu: Taunabunai, Absalom ena hesiai taudia ese Amnon na Absalom ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e kara henia. Bena hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia iboudiai na e tore isi, ta ta ena doniki ena doniki ai e gui, e heau.
2SA.13.29.english: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.

2SA.9.4.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Ia be edeseni ai? Siba ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Ia na Makiri Arniele ena ruma ai, Lo-debara ai.
2SA.9.4.english: The king said to him, “Where is he?”

2SA.1.13.motu: Bena David ese una hari e mailaia tau-eregabena ma e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ede amo oma? Ia e haere, eto, Lau na tau Amalek, noho-hedoa tauna ta, natuna.
2SA.1.13.english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?”

2SA.14.15.motu: Ina hereva na egu lohia, hanua pavapavana, ihamaorolaina totona vada nama, badina be taunimanima ese vada e hagarigu. Bena emu hesiai hahinena ese lalona e hadaia, eto, Hanua pavapavana baina hereva henia; reana hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai hahinena ena noinoi heḡereḡerena baine karaia.
2SA.14.15.english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

2SA.18.19.motu: Bena Ahimasa Sadok eto, Mani aina heau, harina na hanua pavapavana dekena baina laohaia, ia na Iehova ese ia inaina edia siahu amo vada e hamauria.
2SA.18.19.english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”

2SA.17.3.motu: a ena orea taudia iboudiai na dekemu baina hakaudia mai, headava matamata hahinena ese adavana enai e raka vareaimu na heto. Tau tamona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana o tahuamu; bena taunimanima iboudiai na bae maino.
2SA.17.3.english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

2SA.20.25.motu: Seva na toretore tauna; Sadok bona Abiatara na hahelaḡa taudia;
2SA.20.25.english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

2SA.4.6.motu: Iduara igimana hahinena na uit ihaḡoevana ai matana vada e ḡaraia, vada e mahuta; taunabunai Rekab mai tadina Baanaha ida e dae kau hehuni.
2SA.4.6.english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

2SA.13.6.motu: Taunabunai, Amnon na e hekure, e gorere koikoi; bena hanua pavapavana ema e itaia negana ai, Amnon ese hanua pavapavana e noia, eto, Mani emu kara, taihugu Tamara bainema, ataga rua iau vairagu ai baine gabu, bena ia imana amo baina ani.
2SA.13.6.english: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”

2SA.5.4.motu: David ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui, e lohia matama negana ai; ena lohia laḡanidia na hari-ahui.
2SA.5.4.english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

2SA.23.7.motu: A baine daudia toho tauna na
2SA.23.7.english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear.

2SA.6.21.motu: David ese Mikala e haere henia, eto, Iehova, e abigu hidi tamamu bona ena iduhu taudia iboudiai baina hereadia bona Israel, Iehova ena bese, pavapavana ai e halaogu Diravana, ia vairanai na karaia; bona Iehova vairanai moale karadia do baina kara.
2SA.6.21.english: David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Yahweh, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before Yahweh.

2SA.17.12.motu: Taunabunai ita ese ia e nohomu gabuna ai baita lasia tao, bona latanai baita diho hunu tano latanai e dihomu na heto; bena ia bona e bamoamu taudia iboudiai na tau ta basine mauri.
2SA.17.12.english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

2SA.11.20.motu: hanua pavapavana baine badu reana, baine gwau henimu, baineto “Dahaka dainai tuari o laohaia ela bona hanua badibadinai? Asi dibamui idia ese maḡu amo bae tarakimui a?
2SA.11.20.english: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?

2SA.19.39.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia; hanua pavapavana danu e hanai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Barasilai e harahua bona e hanamoa; bena ia ese ena hanua korikori e lou henia.
2SA.19.39.english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

2SA.22.19.motu: Egu hisihisi dinana ai e davarigu,
2SA.22.19.english: They came on me in the day of my calamity,

2SA.21.10.motu: Bena Rispa Aia ese puse dabuana ta e abia, nadi-haga ai e lahaia, e hahelaia kau, taboro e matamaia negana amo ela bona medu na latadiai e diho. Dina ai atai manudia e laodia ahu, latadiai basie roho kau, bona hanuaboi ai uda boromadia ma e laodia ahu.
2SA.21.10.english: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

2SA.10.5.motu: David e kamonai; bena ia ese haida e siaidia, idia ida bae hedavari, badina be idia na e hemarai bada herea. Hanua pavapavana eto, Ieriko ai ba noho, ela bona aukimui huidia ma bae tubu lou, bena ba lou mai.
2SA.10.5.english: When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

2SA.15.13.motu: Bena gwaukau tauna ta ese David dekenai e kau, eto, Israel taudia na Absalom e lalokau heniamu.
2SA.15.13.english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

2SA.8.18.motu: Benaia Iehoiada na Kerete bona Pelete taudia biagudia. David natuna mamaruanedia na hahelaḡa taudia.
2SA.8.18.english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

2SA.2.2.motu: Taunabunai, David na unua ela, mai adavana raruosi ida: Ahinoama, Iesrele hahinena, bona Abigail, Nabala tau Karamele vabuna.
2SA.2.2.english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

2SA.4.12.motu: Bena David ese ena eregabe taudia e haḡanidia; bena idia ese raruosi na e aladia mase, imadia bona aedia e utudia oho, bena tau-anidia na Heberon gohugohuna badibadinai e taudia dae. A Isiboset kwarana e abia, Abnere ena gara ai e guria, Heberon ai.
2SA.4.12.english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

2SA.3.12.motu: Bena Abnere ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia, Heberon ai, eto, Tano be daika ena? Aita herohemaino, bena lau imagu ese baine durumu, Israel idoinai na emu ai baina vena hanai.
2SA.3.12.english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

2SA.13.4.motu: Ia ese Amnon e hereva henia, eto, Hanua pavapavana natuna e, dahaka dainai daba daba medemu e hore e laomu? Basio hamaorogu a? Amnon ese e haere henia, eto, Tadigu Absalom taihuna Tamara na ura heniamu.
2SA.13.4.english: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?”

2SA.17.6.motu: Bena Husai na Absalom dekenai e kau negana ai, Absalom ese e nanadaia, eto, Ahitofel na unu ini e gwau tomamu; iena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baita karaia eiava? Bema lasi, oi na ba hereva.
2SA.17.6.english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

2SA.21.15.motu: Filistia taudia ese Israel taudia ma e tuari henidia; bena David mai ena hesiai taudia ida e hekei lao, Filistia taudia ida e tuari, ela bona David tauna e boera.
2SA.21.15.english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

2SA.23.33.motu: Sama, tau Harara; Ahiama Sarara, tau Harara;
2SA.23.33.english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

2SA.17.14.motu: Bena Absalom bona Israel taudia iboudiai eto, Husai tau Araki ena lalo-hadai ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai na e hereaiamu. Badina be Iehova ese dalana vada e lailaia Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai namona baine hadarerea, Iehova ese Absalom baine hadikaia helaoreana.
2SA.17.14.english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

2SA.7.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese peroveta tauna Natan na e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, lau na sida rumana ai na nohomu, a Dirava ena maua helaḡana na kalaga ai e miamu.
2SA.7.2.english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

2SA.7.20.motu: Ma dahaka David ese baine hamaoromu? Ḡaubada Iehova e, emu hesiai tauna na vada dibamu.
2SA.7.20.english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.

2SA.7.11.motu: egu bese Israel na hahemaoro taudia na henidia negana amo. Laḡa-ani danu baina henimu, inaimu iboudiai vairadiai. Ina danu, Iehova ese e hamaoromumu, emu iduhu na Iehova ese baine haginia.
2SA.7.11.english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.

2SA.18.30.motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, A raka siri, iniseni ai ba gini. Bena ia na e raka siri, e gini.
2SA.18.30.english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

2SA.22.39.motu: Na ha-oredia, na gwadadia uru dainai asie tore isi,

2SA.12.5.motu: Bena David ena badu e ḡaraḡara una tau enai. Ia ese Natan e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova e maurimu hegereḡerena, una kara e karaia tauna na bema mase hari namo.
2SA.12.5.english: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As Yahweh lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!

2SA.13.24.motu: Absalom danu hanua pavapavana dekena ela, e hereva henia, eto, Mani a kamonai; emu hesiai tauna na mai ena mamoe huidia iutudia taudia haida; mani emu kara hanua pavapavana mai ena hesiai taudia ida na emu hesiai tauna ida baitala.
2SA.13.24.english: Absalom came to the king and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”

2SA.9.5.motu: Bena King David ese hereva e siaia, bena Lo-debara ai Makin Amiele ena ruma amo e hakaua mai.
2SA.9.5.english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

2SA.15.7.motu: Laḡani hani e ore, bena Absalom ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a kahugu nege, Heberon bainala, unuseni ai egu gwauhamata, Iehova na gwau henilaia hamata ḡauna, na anina do baina havaraia.
2SA.15.7.english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.

2SA.15.9.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e haere henia, eto, Mai mainomu ida aola. Bena Absalom e tore isi, Heberon ela.
2SA.15.9.english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.”

2SA.22.30.motu: Momokani, oi bagumu ai orea badana baina hadarerea diba;
2SA.22.30.english: For by you, I run against a troop.

2SA.3.8.motu: Bena Abnere e badu dikadika, Isiboset ena hereva dainai, eto, Be, lau na Iuda ena sisia kwarana ta a? Han dina ai, tamamu Saulo iduhuna bona tadikakana bona turana doini na badinadiamu. Oi na David imana ai asina atomu. Matona han dina ai o habadegumu, hahine ta ida na kerere dainai.
2SA.3.8.english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

2SA.22.31.motu: Ina Dirava ena dala na herea dae;
2SA.22.31.english: As for God, his way is perfect.

2SA.14.4.motu: Hari Tekoa hahinena na hanua pavapavana dekenai e kau negana ai, ia na tano ai e goru diho, e toma henia diho, eto, Pavapava e, a kahagu.
2SA.14.4.english: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

2SA.19.13.motu: Amasa danu ba hamaoroa, baoto, Oi na lau turiagu bona lau hidiogu ani? Ina murinai oi na egu tuari oreana basioma biagua, Ioab gabuna ai, Dirava ese davagu metauna bema henigu, ma bema hametaua.
2SA.19.13.english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

2SA.24.11.motu: Daba ai, David na e tore isi negana ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Gad, David ena mata-hanai tauna, enai e kau, eto,
2SA.24.11.english: When David rose up in the morning, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

2SA.14.33.motu: Bena Ioab na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, e hamaoroa. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e boiria. Absalom na hanua pavapavana dekenai e kau, bena tano ai e igo diho, hanua pavapavana vairanai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e harahua.
2SA.14.33.english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

2SA.12.8.motu: Biagumu ena ruma na henimu, bona biagumu adavana na henimu, bavadavadia; bona Israel bona Iuda iduhudia na henimu. Una bema maraḡi, ma bama habadaia harua emu.
2SA.12.8.english: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that would have been too little, I would have added to you many more such things.

2SA.2.24.motu: A Ioab bona Abisai ese Abnere e gavaia. Dina e dihova ai, idia na Ama ororona ai e kau; una ororo na Gia vairanai, Gibeon tanoḡaḡaena e lao heniamu dalana ai.
2SA.2.24.english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

2SA.17.4.motu: Una lalo-hadai na Absalom bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai ese e moalelaia.
2SA.17.4.english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

2SA.2.8.motu: Una negana ai Abnere, Nere natuna, Saulo ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese Saulo natuna Isiboset e abia, Mahanaim e laohaia,
2SA.2.8.english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

2SA.17.20.motu: Bena Absalom ena hesiai taudia na una ruma ai e dae kau; bena idia ese hahine na e nanadaia, eto, Ahimasa bona Ionatan na edeseni ai? Han hahine ese e haere henidia, eto, Sinavai maragina amo e turu hanai. Bena e tahudia, to asie davaridia; bena Ierusalem e lou lao.
2SA.17.20.english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?”

2SA.23.38.motu: Ira, tau Itiri; Gareb, tau Itiri;
2SA.23.38.english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

2SA.13.33.motu: Taunabunai, egu lohia bona egu pavapava kudouna basine hetaha, basineto hanua pavapavana natuna iboudiai vada e mase; lasi, Amnon sibona vada e mase.
2SA.13.33.english: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”

2SA.2.26.motu: Bena Abnere ese loab e boi henia, eto, Dare baine ala-ala hanaihanai a? Asi dibamu dokona na baine idita a? Edena negai emu orea taudia ba haḡanidia, tadikakadia ihahavadia amo bae lou?
2SA.2.26.english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

2SA.1.27.motu: Goada taudia madi vada e keto,

2SA.15.5.motu: Ina danu, tau ta ese itomadiho-henina totona bema raka henia kahi, Absalom ese imana bema toi roro, bema rosia, bena bema harahua.
2SA.15.5.english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

2SA.7.14.motu: Lau na ia tamana ai bainala, bona ia na lau natugu ai bainela. Baine kara dika negadia ai na taunimanima edia ikwadi amo baina kwadia, bona taunimanima natudia edia hedadaba amo baina dadabaia.
2SA.7.14.english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

2SA.19.25.motu: Ia na Ierusalem amo e raka lasi, hanua pavapavana ida e hedavari; bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Mefiboset e, dahaka damal lau ida asitala.
2SA.19.25.english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

2SA.7.6.motu: Ruma ta ai asina noho, Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi dinana amo ema bona hari ina dina ai, a vada na loa eva-eva, kalaga ai vada na noho.
2SA.7.6.english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

2SA.22.24.motu: Ia vairanai lau na asi egu kerere.
2SA.22.24.english: I was also perfect toward him.

2SA.12.11.motu: Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu; Oi sibomu emu ruma lalona amo dika baina havaraia latamu ai; adavamu na oi vairamu ai baina abidia oho, dekemu tauna baina henia, bena ia na ina dina diarina ai oi adavamu ida bae eno bou.
2SA.12.11.english: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

2SA.23.35.motu: Hesero, Karamele tauna; Paarai, Arab tauna;
2SA.23.35.english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

2SA.18.22.motu: Bena Ahimasa Sadok ese Ioab ma e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka baine vara na herevana; mani emu kara lau danu Kusu tauna murina amo baina heau. Ioab eto, Natugu e, dahaka dainai ba heau; ina hari ilaohaina na asi davana.
2SA.18.22.english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.”

2SA.7.1.motu: Hanua pavapavana na ena ruma ai e nohova, bona Iehova ese laḡa-ani e henia, ana inai iboudiai vairadiai.
2SA.7.1.english: When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

2SA.16.23.motu: Unu dinadia ai Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai e gwaurai na e kara Dirava ena hereva na heto. David bona Absalom ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai iboudiai na unu e abidia dae tomava.
2SA.16.23.english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

2SA.3.34.english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.”

2SA.19.27.motu: Ia ese emu hesiai tauna vada e habadelaigu koikoi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai. A egu lohia bona egu pavapava na Dirava ena aneru na heto; taunabunai, emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena do ba kara henigu.
2SA.19.27.english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

2SA.15.4.motu: Absalom rna bema toma, Lau na ina tano ai hahemaoro bama karaia bema namo; bena mai edia noinoi eiava mai edia daradara taudia iboudiai na dekegu bema mai, bena bama hahemaoro henidia.
2SA.15.4.english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

2SA.14.22.motu: Bena Ioab na tano ai e goru diho, hanua pavapavana e toma henia diho, bona e hanamoa. Ioab eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava, hari dina ai emu hesiai tauna dibana oi ese vada o lalo namo henigumu, badina be hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai tauna ena noinoi vada e abia dae.
2SA.14.22.english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

2SA.12.26.motu: Ioab ese Raba, Amono taudia edia hanua ta, e tuari henia, bena hanua pavapavana ena hanua e abia.
2SA.12.26.english: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

2SA.11.26.motu: Uria adavana e kamonai ia adavana Uria vada e mase, bena ia na adavana taina e tai.
2SA.11.26.english: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

2SA.3.23.motu: Ioab mai ena tuari oreana idoinai ida e kau; bena haida ese e hamaoroa, eto, Abnere Nere na pavapava dekena ema; ma vada e kahua nege, mai mainona ida ela.
2SA.3.23.english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

2SA.17.5.motu: Bena Absalom eto, Husai tau Araki danu a boina, iena hereva baita kamonai.
2SA.17.5.english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

2SA.19.32.motu: Barasilai na buruka herea, ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ahui. Hanua pavapavana na Mahanaim ai e nohova negana ai hari Barasilai ese e ubuava; badina be ia na taḡa bada tauna.
2SA.19.32.english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

2SA.19.21.motu: Bena Abisai Seruia e haere, eto, Hari Simei bae alaia mase, ani? Badina be Iehova ese vada e horoa tauna na ia ese e uduguiraia.
2SA.19.21.english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”

2SA.19.5.motu: Bena Ioab na ruma ai e dae kau, hanua pavapavana dekenai, bena eto, Hari dina ai emu hesiai taudia iboudiai vairadia na hemarai amo vada o ḡovadia. Hari dina ai, idia ese emu mauri vada e rauaia, bona natumu mamaruanedia bona natumu hahinedia bona adavamu bona unu vada o adavadia hahinedia iboudiai danu vada e hamauridia,
2SA.19.5.english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

2SA.9.2.motu: Hesiai tauna ta e noho, Saulo ena iduhu lalona amo, ladana na Siba. E boiria, David dekena bainema; bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi Siba a? Ia e haere, eto, Emu hesiai tauna binai.
2SA.9.2.english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?”

2SA.6.2.motu: Bena David e tore isi, mai bamona iboudiai ida Baale-iuda ela, unu amo Dirava ena maua helaḡana, Iehova Sabaota, kerubi latadiai e helaimu Diravana, ladana e hahenemailaia mauana, bae daelaia totona.
2SA.6.2.english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of Yahweh of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

2SA.12.9.motu: Dahaka dainai Iehova ena hereva vada o dadaraia? Dahaka dainai ia vairanai vada o kara havara? Uria, tau Hiti, na dare amo vada o alaia, ia adavana vada o abia, oi adavamu ai vada o halaoa; bona Amono taudia edia dare amo vada o alaia mase.
2SA.12.9.english: Why have you despised Yahweh’s word, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriah the Hittite with the sword, have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

2SA.19.6.motu: a oi ese e inai henimumu taudia be o ura henidiamu, bona e ura henimumu taudia be o inai henidiamu. Hari dina ai vada o hahedinaraia, tuari biagudia bona hesiai taudia na so lalodiamu; badina be hari dina ai lalogu vada eme parara, Absalom na hari dina ai bema mauri bona ai iboumai ai baiama mase, bena oi na boma moale.
2SA.19.6.english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

2SA.22.17.motu: Atai amo e dau dobi, e abigu,
2SA.22.17.english: He sent from on high and he took me.

2SA.12.31.motu: Hanua taudia danu e hakaudia lasi, ḡaukara e henidia, iri bona aun isivadia bona auri iradia amo bae ḡaukara; bona e siaidia danu, raro amo e kara nadidia igabudia ai bae ḡaukara. Amono hanuadia iboudiai na unu e karadia toma. Bena David bona ena orea taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem e lou lao.
2SA.12.31.english: He brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work under saws, under iron picks, under axes of iron, and made them go to the brick kiln; and he did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

2SA.8.13.motu: David na sibona ladana e habadaia. E lou negana ai, ia ese Edom taudia gerebu-ta daha-taurahani na Damena Kourana ai e aladia mase.
2SA.8.13.english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

2SA.18.10.motu: Tau ta ese e itaia, bena ia ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, Absalom na itaia, oak auna ta ai e hetau dae.
2SA.18.10.english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

2SA.19.10.motu: To Absalom, eda pavapava ai ta horoa tauna, na tuan ai vada e mase. Matona, hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna asio herevalaiamu badina be dahaka?
2SA.19.10.english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

2SA.13.5.motu: Ionadab ese e hamaoroa, eto, Emu mahuta patana ai ba hekure, ba gorere koikoi. Bena tamamu ese baine itamu negana ai na ba hamaoroa, baoto “Mani emu kara taihugu Tamara bainema, flaoa baine henigu baina ania, bona aniani taina na vairagu ai baine gabua, baina itaia, bona ia imana amo baina ania”.
2SA.13.5.english: Jonadab said to him, “Lay down on your bed and pretend to be sick. When your father comes to see you, tell him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’”

2SA.18.29.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Hari eregabe tauna Absalombe namo a? Ahimasa e haere, eto, Ioab ese emu hesiai tauna e siaigu negana ai, heloḡo-heloḡo bada-hereana ta na itaia, a asina diba dahaka heloḡo-heloḡona.
2SA.18.29.english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?”

2SA.22.21.motu: Iehova ese davagu vada e henigu, egu kara maoromaoro heḡereḡerena,
2SA.22.21.english: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness.

2SA.19.16.motu: Bena Simei Gera, tau Beniamina, na Bahurimi amo e diho haraḡa-haraḡa Iuda taudia ida David ihedavari-henina ela;
2SA.19.16.english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

2SA.14.19.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Ina kara ai Ioab imana na oi ida a? Hahine na e haere, eto, Mornokani, egu lohia bona egu pavapava o maurimu heḡereḡerena, egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu hereva amo taunimanima ta basine raka sin diba, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai. Emu hesiai tauna Ioab ese e haḡanigu; ia ese ini hereva iboudiai na emu hesiai hahinena uduna ai e atoa.
2SA.14.19.english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?”

2SA.23.13.motu: Lohia toiahuiosi bogaragidia amo hari tatoiosi ela, taboro negana ai David enai e kau, Adulama kohuana ai. Filistia taudia edia orea ta na Refairn kourana ai e taruha.
2SA.23.13.english: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

2SA.3.10.motu: Gwauhamata na binai: basileia na Saulo ena iduhu amo baine heabi oho, David ena terono baine hahedai, Israel bona Iuda baine lohiadia, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba.
2SA.3.10.english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

2SA.5.25.motu: Bena David ese Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia; bena ia ese Filistia taudia e rahudia mase, Geba amo ela bona Gesere.
2SA.5.25.english: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

2SA.15.31.motu: Bena haida ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Absalom ida e henega boumu taudia ta na Ahitofel. Bena David eto, Iehova e, na noimumu, Ahitofel ena hahealo na kavakava ai ba halaoa.
2SA.15.31.english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.”

2SA.22.9.motu: Kwalahu na ia uduna matudia amo e dae,
2SA.22.9.english: Smoke went up out of his nostrils.

2SA.22.10.motu: Guba e beua tari, bena e diho;
2SA.22.10.english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down.

2SA.8.5.motu: Suna taudia na Damasko amo ela, Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, bae durua eto; bena David ese Suria taudia gerebu-rua daha-rua e aladia mase.
2SA.8.5.english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

2SA.14.31.motu: Bena Ioab e tore isi, Absalom dekena ela, ena ruma ai, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka emu hesiai taudia ese egu uma vada e doua?
2SA.14.31.english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

2SA.15.20.motu: Varani mo oma, ma han baina hakaumu loaloa a? Lau na ede bainala na asi dibagu. A lou, tadikakamu danu ba hakaudia; bena Iehova ese ena hebogahisi bona ena heabidadama na baine hahedinarai henimu.
2SA.15.20.english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

2SA.16.16.motu: Bena Husai, tau Araki, David turana, na Absalom dekena ela. Bena Husai ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua pavapavana ena mauri baine daudau! Hanua pavapavana ena mauri baine daudau!
2SA.16.16.english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

2SA.20.20.motu: Ioab e haere, eto, Unu asina ura tomamu, asina uramu ḡau ta baina hadonoa eiava baina habuaia tari.
2SA.20.20.english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

2SA.7.4.motu: A una hanuaboi Iehova ena hereva na Natan enai e kau, eto,
2SA.7.4.english: That same night, Yahweh’s word came to Nathan, saying,

2SA.22.25.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese vada e hanamogu, egu kara maoromaoro heḡereḡerena ai;
2SA.22.25.english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness,

2SA.10.8.motu: Bena Amono taudia e raka lasi, edia tuari ḡaudia e abidia bona e gini hagaeḡae, edia ikoukou raka-vareaina ai. A Suria taudia Soba bona Rehob amo, bona Tobo bona Maaka taudia, na sibodia tano paka ai nonoho.
2SA.10.8.english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the field.

2SA.20.26.motu: bona Ira, tau lairi, na David ena hahelaḡa tauna danu.
2SA.20.26.english: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

2SA.2.27.motu: Bena Ioab eto, Dirava e maurimu heḡereḡerena, oi basioma hereva ina orea taudia ese tadikakadia ihahavadia na daba ai bema hadokoa.
2SA.2.27.english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

2SA.1.24.motu: Israel hahinemui e, Saulo taina ba tai;
2SA.1.24.english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul,

2SA.14.1.motu: Ioab Seruia lalona vada e parara, hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e laloa badava.
2SA.14.1.english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

2SA.8.4.motu: David ese hosi-gui taudia daha-ta sinahu-hitu bona ae-raka taudia gerebu rua na iena amo e abidia. David ese kariota hosidia iboudiai danu mamudia varovarodia e utu, a kariota sinahu-ta hosidia mo asie utudia.
2SA.8.4.english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

2SA.2.16.motu: Bena ta ta ese ana dagae ana daḡae kwaradia e heabi heheni, edia dare amo ohedia e gwada; bena e keto hebou. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Helkatahasurim; gabuna na Gibeon ai.
2SA.2.16.english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

2SA.3.32.motu: Abnere na Heberon ai e guria; bena hanua pavapavana na gadona e habadaia, Abnere gurina badibadinai e tai; taunimanima iboudiai danu e taitai.
2SA.3.32.english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

2SA.14.18.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese hahine na e haere henia, eto, Na noimumu, ḡau ta egu ai basio hunia. Hahine na eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava na aine hereva.
2SA.14.18.english: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.”

2SA.22.8.motu: Una negana ai tanobada e laga, e heude-heude,
2SA.22.8.english: Then the earth shook and trembled.

2SA.23.14.motu: Una negana ai David na ena kohua ai e nohova, a Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana na Betelehem ai.
2SA.23.14.english: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

2SA.9.3.motu: Hanua pavapavana ma e henanadai, eto, Saulo ena iduhu tauna ta noho eiava? Dirava ena gado-namo ia baina hahedinarai henia. Siba ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Ionatan natuna ta do noho; ia na aena ruaosi e hedairike.
2SA.9.3.english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?”

2SA.7.8.motu: Taunabunai, egu hesiai tauna David na ba hamaoroa, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Rei gabuna amo, mamoe ireḡudia amo na abimu, egu bese Israel edia pavapava ai baola helaoreana,
2SA.7.8.english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

2SA.11.1.motu: Komukau ai, hanua pavapavadia na tuari e laomu negana ai, David ese Ioab mai ena hesiai taudia bona Israel taudia iboudiai ida e siaidia lao; bena idia ese Amono taudia e habuadia tari, bona Raba e koua heḡeḡe. A David na Ierusalem ai e noho.
2SA.11.1.english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

2SA.16.6.motu: Bena ia ese David na nadi amo e hodoa, bona King David ena hesiai taudia iboudiai danu e hododia. Hanua taudia iboudiai bona tuari taudia iboudiai na David idibana kahana ai bona laurina kahana ai e gini.
2SA.16.6.english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

2SA.16.20.motu: Bena Absalom ese Ahitofel e hamaoroa, eto, Emu lalo-hadai a gvvaurai, ede baita kara toma?
2SA.16.20.english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

2SA.6.11.motu: Bena Iehova ena maua heḡana na Obed-edom, tau Gata, ena ruma ai e miava, hua toi; bona Iehova ese Obed-edom mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida e hanamodia.
2SA.6.11.english: Yahweh’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

2SA.17.8.motu: Husai ma eto, Oi dibamu, tamamu bona ena orea taudia na goada-herea taudia, bona e badu dikadikamu, bea hahinena tano paka ai haida ese natuna vada e dadidia oho na heto. Ina danu, tamamu na tuari mai dibana tauna; ia na ena orea taudia ida basine noho rani.
2SA.17.8.english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

2SA.17.27.motu: David na Mahanaim ai e kau negana ai, Sobi Nahasa, tau Amono, na Raba amo, bona Makiri Amiele na Lo-debara amo, bona Barasilai, tau Gilead, na Rogelim amo,
2SA.17.27.english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

2SA.22.16.english: Then the channels of the sea appeared.

2SA.12.18.motu: Dina ihahituna ai mero na e mase. Bena David ena hesiai taudia na ena mase herevana ihamaorolaina garina e gariva; badina be idia eto, A itaia, mero maurina ai ta hereva henia, to se kamonai henida; matona, ede baita hamaoroa toma mero na vada e mase? Sibona baine heala dahaka.
2SA.12.18.english: On the seventh day, the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him and he didn’t listen to our voice. How will he then harm himself if we tell him that the child is dead?”

2SA.21.6.motu: natuna mamaruanedia hahitu ba henimai; bena Gibeon ai, Iehova ena ororo ai bona Iehova vairanai, baia taudia dae. Hanua pavapavana eto, Baina henimui.
2SA.21.6.english: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to Yahweh in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Yahweh.”

2SA.5.10.motu: Bena David na e goada e laova, badina be Dirava, Iehova Sabaota, na ia ida.
2SA.5.10.english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.

2SA.21.8.motu: A Rispa Aia natuna mamaruanedia raruosi, Saulo ena amo e abidia taudia, ladadia be Aramoni bona Mefiboset, bona Meraba Saulo natuna mamaruanedia laimaosi, Adriele Barasilai, tau Mehola, ena amo e abidia taudia, na hanua pavapavana ese e abidia,
2SA.21.8.english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

2SA.22.5.motu: Mase hurehuredia ese e ḡeḡegu ahuva,
2SA.22.5.english: For the waves of death surrounded me.

2SA.7.9.motu: bona vada na bamomu emu loa daladia iboudiai, bona inaimu vada na hadareredia vairamu ai, bona ladamu do baina habadaia, tanobada Iohiadia ladadia hegereḡeredia.
2SA.7.9.english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

2SA.7.23.motu: Edena bese tanobada ai na emu bese Israel heḡereḡerena? Dirava ese e hamauridia, iena bese ai baela; ia sibona ladana e habadaia, bona kara badadia, hahegari karadia, idia daidiai e kara, iena orea taudia vairadiai bese ta mai ena dirava iboudiai ida e luludia lasi.
2SA.7.23.english: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

2SA.1.6.motu: Hari eregabe tauna eto, Lau na so vada na loa kavava Gilboa ororona ai. Saulo na unuseni ai, ena io ai e heto'o tao, bona kariota bona hosi ai e gui taudia na vada e mai heniamu.
2SA.1.6.english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

2SA.9.7.motu: David ese e hamaoroa, eto, Asio gari; tamamu Ionatan dainai baina kara namo henimu. Tubumu Saulo ena tano na idoinai ma baina henimu lou; bona egu pata ai bavaniani, nega idoinai.
2SA.9.7.english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

2SA.9.13.motu: Taunabunai, Mefiboset na Ierusalem ai e nohova; badina be ia na hanua pavapavana ena pata ai e anianiva, nega idoinai. Ia na aena ruaosi e hedairike.
2SA.9.13.english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

2SA.13.21.motu: King David ese unu kara iboudiai haridia e kamonai, bena e badu dikadika.
2SA.13.21.english: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

2SA.19.12.motu: Umui na varavaragu, lau turiagu bona lau hidiogu; matona, dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna ai umui na vada o halahemu?
2SA.19.12.english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

2SA.13.15.motu: Bena Amnon ese ia e ihi-ihiraia bada; una dainai e ihi-ihiraiava heihi-ihiraina ese e ḡahusia gunava heḡahusina e hereaia. Bena Amnon ese e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, lao.
2SA.13.15.english: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”

2SA.14.17.motu: Bena emu hesiai hahinena ese lalona e hadaia, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava ena hereva ese lalogu baine hamarumarua; badina be egu lohia bona egu pavapava na Dirava ena aneru na heto, namo bona dika itadia mai dibana. Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine bamomu.
2SA.14.17.english: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May Yahweh, your God, be with you.’”

2SA.5.3.motu: Taunabunai, Israel tau-badadia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, Heberon ai; bena King David na idia ida e hegwauhamata heheni Heberon ai, Iehova vairanai. Bena idia ese David e horoa, Israel pavapavana ai e halaoa.
2SA.5.3.english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

2SA.24.19.motu: Bena Gad ena hereva dainai David na e dae ela, Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
2SA.24.19.english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.

2SA.2.19.motu: Bena Asahele ese Abnere e ḡavaia; iḡavana ai se heau siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
2SA.2.19.english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

2SA.24.18.motu: Una dina ai, Gad na David dekena ela, eto, A dae lao, Arauna, tau Iebusu, ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta ba larebaia.
2SA.24.18.english: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

2SA.1.9.motu: Ia ma eto, Badibadigu ai ba gini, bavalagu mase; badina be hisihisi ese e gugubagumu, a doini na maunmu.
2SA.1.9.english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

2SA.11.5.motu: Hahine na e rogorogo, bena ia ese hereva e siaia, David e hamaoroa, eto, Lau vada na rogorogomu.
2SA.11.5.english: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

2SA.19.35.motu: Hari dina ai egu mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ahui; ḡau namodia bona ḡau dikadia baina hididia diba a? Emu hesiai tauna ese na animu bona na inumu gaudia baina mamidia diba a? Ane e abimu taudia bona hahinedia edia ane baina kamonai diba a? Matona, emu hesiai tauna ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava baina hahekwarahimu anina be dahaka?
2SA.19.35.english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

2SA.13.28.motu: Bena Absalom ese ena hesiai taudia na e haḡanidia, eto, Amnon ba itaia tao, ela bona vine ranuna ese baine hakekeroa; bena bainato “Amnon bavalaia”, bena bavalaia mase. Basio gari; vada na haḡanimui ani? Ba haheauka, ba goada balaheni.
2SA.13.28.english: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”

2SA.22.6.motu: Mase gabuna ena iḡui varodia ese e idoagu,
2SA.22.6.english: The cords of Sheol were around me.

2SA.5.22.motu: Filistia taudia ma ema, Refaim kourana ma e hahonua lou.
2SA.5.22.english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

2SA.9.10.motu: Oi bona natumu bona emu hesiai taudia ese tano ba ruaia iena, bona tano anina ba haboua, biagumu natuna na ana aniani baine davaria totona. A biagumu natuna Mefiboset na egu pata ai baine aniani, nega idoinai.
2SA.9.10.english: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.”

2SA.18.16.motu: Bena Ioab ese kibi e hiriria; bena tuari taudia iboudiai na Israel taudia ihahavadia amo e lou; badina be Ioab ese e gwaudia tao.
2SA.18.16.english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

2SA.14.16.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana baine kamonai, bena ia ese ena hesiai hahinena baine hamauna, lau bona natugu na Dirava ena orea lalona amo baine habuamai tari eto tauna imana amo.
2SA.14.16.english: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

2SA.14.29.motu: Bena Absalom ese gwau-kau e siaia, Ioab na hanua pavapavana, dekenai bainela; a Ioab na e gwau edeede. Nega iharuana ia ese gwau-kau e siaia, a Ioab ma e gwau edeede.
2SA.14.29.english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

2SA.5.7.motu: A David ese Siona kohorona e abia: David ena hanua bunai.
2SA.5.7.english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

2SA.12.1.motu: Iehova ese Natan na David dekena e siaia lao. Ia na dekenai e kau, bena e hereva henia, eto, Hanua ta lalonai tatau rarua e nohova, ta be taga tauna, ma ta ogoḡami tauna.
2SA.12.1.english: Yahweh sent Nathan to David. He came to him, and said to him, “There were two men in one city: the one rich, and the other poor.

2SA.5.13.motu: David ese hahine haida ma e adavadia, Ierusalem ai, Heberon e rakatania murinai; bena natuna mamaruanedia bona natuna hahinedia haida ma e vara.
2SA.5.13.english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

2SA.17.17.motu: Una negana ai Ionatan bona Ahimasa na En-rogele ai e nariva; hesiai kekenina ta vaevae e laova, hereva e henidiava, bena idia ese King David e hamaoroa laova; badina be idia na hanua badana ai raka-vareaidia ai bae itadia na garina.
2SA.17.17.english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

2SA.1.10.motu: Bena badibadinai na gini, na alaia mase; badina be na diba momokani ena keto murinai na basine maun diba. Bena havava ḡauna na kwarana ai bona toea na imana ai na kokidia; vada na mailaidia, egu lohia, oi dekemu ai.
2SA.1.10.english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

2SA.17.2.motu: Bena tauna dounu e boeramu bona lalona dounu e metaumu ai baina lasia tao, bona baina hagaria; bena e bamoamu taudia iboudiai na bae heau. Hanua pavapavana mo sibona baina rahua mase;
2SA.17.2.english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

2SA.19.17.motu: bona Beniamina taudia danu daha ta ia ida ela. Bena Siba, Saulo ena iduhu taudia edia hesiai tauna, mai natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-ima bona ena hesiai taudia ruahui, e rou hekei guna lao Ioridane sinavaina ai, hanua pavapavana do se kau ai,
2SA.19.17.english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

2SA.6.1.motu: David ese Israel ai e abidia hidi taudia iboudiai ma e haboudia lau: iboudiai na gerebu toi.
2SA.6.1.english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

2SA.14.8.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese hahine na e hamaoroa. eto, Emu ruma aola, taravamu do baina atua.
2SA.14.8.english: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

2SA.20.12.motu: Hari Amasa na sibona rarana lalonai e hekure, laolao dalana ai; raka-hanai taudia na e itaia, bena e gini. Bena una tau ese e itadia, idia na vada e gini, bena ia ese Amasa e abia, laolao dalana amo e huaia lao, rei lalonai e atoa, bena dabua amo e tarua ahu.
2SA.20.12.english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

2SA.18.27.motu: Hegima tauna ma eto, Mata ai e heaumu tauna ena heau ita-itana na Ahimasa Sadok ena heau hegereḡerena. Hanua pavapavana eto, Ia na tau namona, hari namona e mailaiamu.
2SA.18.27.english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.”

2SA.19.29.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e hamaoroa, eto, Emu noho na basio herevalaia lou. Vada na haeroa vaitani: oi bona Siba ese tano ba haria.
2SA.19.29.english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

2SA.6.18.motu: David ese unu ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia bona herohemaino boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia vaitani, bena ia ese Israel taudia na e hanamodia, Iehova Sabaota ladana ai,
2SA.6.18.english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.

2SA.22.35.motu: Ia ese lau imagu e hadibadiamu, tuari karadia ai,
2SA.22.35.english: He teaches my hands to war,

2SA.23.27.motu: Abiesere, Anatoto tauna; Mebunai, tau Husata;
2SA.23.27.english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

2SA.15.35.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara na unuseni ai, oi ida, ani? Taunabunai, dahaka dahaka ba kamonai hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai, unu na hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara ba hadibalaidia.
2SA.15.35.english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

2SA.23.37.motu: Seleke, Amono tauna; Naharai, tau Beroto, Ioab Seruia ena kesi ihuana tauna;
2SA.23.37.english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

2SA.10.19.motu: Hanua pavapavadia hahidaosi Hadadesere isiaina e lao heniva na lalodia vada e parara Israel taudia ese vada e hadareredia, bena idia na Israel taudia ida e herohemaino, bona isiaidia e lao heni. Taunabunai, una negana amo Suria taudia na Amono taudia idurudia garina e gariva.
2SA.10.19.english: When all the kings who were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the children of Ammon any more.

2SA.7.24.motu: Emu bese Israel danu oi ese o haginia, emu bese ai bainela ela bona hanaihanai; bona oi danu, Iehova e, edia Dirava ai o hahelao.
2SA.7.24.english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

2SA.17.26.motu: Israel taudia bona Absalom na Gilead tanona ai e taruha.
2SA.17.26.english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

2SA.5.11.motu: Hirama, Turo pavapavana, ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia; bona sida audia, bona kamuta taudia, bona nadi-koro taudia. Bena idia ese ruma auta e hadaia, David ena.
2SA.5.11.english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

2SA.13.22.motu: A Absalom ese Amnon se hereva henia, namo eiava dika herevana ta se gwauraia; badina be Absalom ese Amnon e inai henia, taihuna Tamara e hadikaia dainai.
2SA.13.22.english: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

2SA.21.16.motu: Bena Isibibenob, taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta, ese David baine alaia mase eto. Una tau ena io na auri labora-labora ḡauna, metauna na sekele sinahu-toi, ena dare matamatana mai ḡauna ida na gabana ai e ḡegea.
2SA.21.16.english: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

2SA.20.15.motu: Bena Ioab ena orea idoinai ema, Sieba e koua ahu, Abele, Bete-maka hanuana, lalonai. Bena tano e senua hanua vairanai, hanua maḡuna hegaga-hehenina ai, bena maḡu iḡiḡi-dobina ai e gugu mase.
2SA.20.15.english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

2SA.12.12.motu: Badina be una kara o karaia hehuni; a lau ese ina kara baina karaia hedinarai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai, bona dina ai.
2SA.12.12.english: For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’”

2SA.5.21.motu: Filistia taudia ese edia kaivakuku e rakatanidia unuseni ai, bena David bona ena orea taudia ese e haboudia, e huadia lao.
2SA.5.21.english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

2SA.22.45.motu: Idau bese taudia na lau vairagu ai e igo diho;
2SA.22.45.english: The foreigners will submit themselves to me.

2SA.17.28.motu: mahuta ḡaudia bona nau bona uro e mailaidia; bona uit, bali, flaoa, uit kakorodia, bini, lentils,
2SA.17.28.english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

2SA.11.17.motu: Bena hanua taudia na e raka lasi, Ioab e tuari henia; bena ena orea lalona amo David ena hesiai taudia haida e moru, bona Uria, tau Hiti, danu e alaia mase.
2SA.11.17.english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

2SA.2.29.motu: Una hanuaboi idoinai Abnere mai ena orea taudia ida e raka, Araba tanona e rakaia hanai, Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, ma e raka, ela bona dina tubua ai Mahanaim ai e kau.
2SA.2.29.english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

2SA.17.29.motu: bada ranuna, butter, mamoe, bona cheese, boromakau ratana amo e karaia ḡauna, danu. E mailaidia David ana bona ia e bamoava taudia adia; badina be idia na eto, Ini taunimanima na tano ḡaḡaena ai e hitolodiamu, taudia e boeramu, bona e ranu masemu danu.
2SA.17.29.english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”

2SA.2.28.motu: Taunabunai, Ioab ese kibi e hiriria; bena ena orea taudia iboudiai e gini, Israel taudia ihahavadia e hadokoa, bona asie tuari lou.
2SA.2.28.english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

2SA.21.11.motu: Haida ese Rispa Aia, Saulo vabuna, ena kara na David e hamaorolaia;
2SA.21.11.english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

2SA.6.17.motu: David ese kalaga auta vada e hadaia heḡaeḡae, Iehova ena maua helaḡana ena; bena idia ese e vareailaia, ena gabu ai e atoa kau. Bena David ese ḡole-oho boubou =audia bona herohemaino boubou ḡaudia na Iehova vairanai e hahela=adia.
2SA.6.17.english: They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

2SA.16.7.motu: Bena Simei e uduguirai henia, eto, Rara ihahebubuna taumu, asi emu kara namona ta taumu, a raka oho, a raka oho.
2SA.16.7.english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

2SA.18.14.motu: Ioab eto, Lau na nega basina ha-orea dekemu ai. Bena ia ese io autoi imana ai e abidia, Absalom kudouna e gwadaia, oak auna ai dounu e mauriva negana ai.
2SA.18.14.english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

2SA.24.17.motu: David ese hari taunimanima e aladiava aneruna e itaia, bena ia ese Iehova e hereva henia, eto, Lau na vada na kara dika, vada na kara havara; a ini mamoe be ede vada e kara toma? Lau na noimumu, oi imamu ese lau baine hadikagu, bona tamagu ena iduhu baine hadikaia.
2SA.24.17.english: David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

2SA.15.17.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e raka lasi, bona ena orea taudia iboudiai na ia murinai e raka; bena hanua dokona rumana badinai e gini.
2SA.15.17.english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.
