2SA.16.4.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Siba e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, Mefiboset ena ḡau iboudiai harihari na oiemu. Siba eto, Lau na na toma henimu dihomu. Egu lohia bona egu pavapava, ba lalo namo henigu hanaihanai.
2SA.16.4.english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.”

2SA.17.1.motu: Ahitofel ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara tatau gerebu-ta daha-rua aina abidia hidi, bena baina tore isi, hari hanuaboi ai David baina ḡavaia.
2SA.17.1.english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

2SA.14.27.motu: Absalom natuna na e vara, mamaruanedia tatoi, hahine tamona. Natuna hahinena ladana e hatoa Tamara; ia na hane namo.
2SA.14.27.english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

2SA.4.2.motu: Saulo natuna na mai ena tuari oreadia maraḡidia biagudia rarua; ladadia na Baanaha bona Rekab. Raruosi na Beniamina iduhuna tauna ta, ladana Rimon, Beroto tauna, natuna. (Hari Beroto danu e gwauraiamu Beniamina hanuana ta;
2SA.4.2.english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

2SA.22.12.english: He made darkness a shelter around himself,

2SA.22.23.motu: Badina be ena haheḡani iboudiai na lau vairagu ai;
2SA.22.23.english: For all his ordinances were before me.

2SA.23.16.motu: Bena hari goada-herea taudia tatoiosi na Filistia taudia edia taruha amo e raka uru, Betelehem ikoukouna badibadinai e miamu gurina amo ranu e utua, bena e abia, David dekena e laohaia. A David na lalona se hegereḡere baine inua; ia na e bubua dobi, Iehova ena;
2SA.23.16.english: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.

2SA.3.17.motu: Bena Abnere na Israel tau-badadia ida e henega bou, eto, Nega taina daudau vada e lao bubuni, umui ese David vada o ura heniava, emui pavapava ai bainela.
2SA.3.17.english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

2SA.3.5.motu: Ihatauratoina na Itireama, David adavana Egla natuna. Una na David ese e havaradia, Heberon ai.
2SA.3.5.english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

2SA.13.13.motu: Egu hemarai ede baina huaia lao? Bona oi na Israel ai lebulebu tauna ai bae halaomu. Una dainai na noimumu, hanua pavapavana ba hereva henia; badina be ia ese emu amo basine rugu.
2SA.13.13.english: As for me, where would I carry my shame? And as for you, you will be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you.”

2SA.19.20.motu: Badina be lau emu hesiai tauna dibagu vada na kara dika; a itaia, hari dina ai vada nama, Iosef iduhuna taudia iboudiai vada na gunalaidia, egu lohia bona egu pavapava ihedavari-henimu.
2SA.19.20.english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

2SA.21.18.motu: Una murinai Filistia taudia ida ma e tuari lou, Gob ai. Bena Sibekai, tau Husata, ese Safa, taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta, e alaia mase.
2SA.21.18.english: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

2SA.11.15.motu: Revareva ai ini e torea toma: Uria na tuari e aukamu gabuna ai bavatoa, bena iena amo ba raka Iou, bae rahua mase totona.
2SA.11.15.english: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

2SA.3.24.motu: Bena Ioab na pavapava dekena ela, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? A itaia, Abnere na dekemu ema; dahaka dainai vada o siaia oho, bena ela?
2SA.3.24.english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

2SA.11.27.motu: Taitai dinadia vada e ore murinai, David na e hesiai, hahine e hakaua mai iena ruma ai; bena e adavaia. Bena natuna maruanena ta iena amo e havaraia. A Iehova ese David ena kara na e badulaia.
2SA.11.27.english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.

2SA.14.2.motu: Bena Ioab e hesiai, aonega hahinena ta Tekoa amo e boiria, e hamaoroa, eto, Mase tauna taina e taimu hahinena ba tohotohoa, guma dabuadia ba dokilai; taumu na dehoro amo basio dahua, a dina momo mase tauna taula vada e tai hahinena heḡereḡerena ai baola;
2SA.14.2.english: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

2SA.23.12.motu: bena hari Sama na uma bogaraginai e gini ahu, Filistia taudia e aladia mase. Unu amo Iehova ese kwalimu badana e karaia.
2SA.23.12.english: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.

2SA.24.9.motu: Bena Ioab ese taunimanima ihagaudia herevana na hanua pavapavana e henia: Israel ai goada taudia mai edia dare na domaga taurahani, bona Iuda taudia na domaga ima.
2SA.24.9.english: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

2SA.13.18.motu: Hari hahine ena dabua na dabua latana, imana lata ḡauna; badina be nega gunadia ai hanua pavapavana natuna ulatodia rami-hebou na unu e hadabuadia tomava. Taunabunai, ena hesiai merona ese hahine na e doria lasi murimuri ai, bena ia murinai iduara e koua ahu kunuka-kunuka.
2SA.13.18.english: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king’s daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her.

2SA.11.7.motu: Uria na ia dekenai e kau negana ai, David ese Ioab mai ena orea taudia ida na edeheto bona tuan na ede e lao tomamu e nanadailaia.
2SA.11.7.english: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.

2SA.20.9.motu: Bena Ioab ese Amasa e hereva henia, eto, Tadigu, oi namo a? Bena Ioab ese imana idibana amo Amasa aukina huina e abia, baine harahua totona.
2SA.20.9.english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

2SA.13.25.motu: A hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e haere henia, eto, Lasi, natugu e, iboumai ai basiala, baia hahekwarahimu na garina. E noia loulou, to se ura, a ena hahenamo mo e henia.
2SA.13.25.english: The king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let’s not all go, lest we be burdensome to you.” He pressed him; however he would not go, but blessed him.

2SA.3.4.motu: Ihahanina na Adonia, Hagiti natuna; bona iha-imana na Sefatia, Abitala natuna.
2SA.3.4.english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

2SA.24.22.motu: Bena Arauna ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu lalo-hadai namona heḡereḡerena, ḡau bavabi bona ba hahelaḡa. Boromakau mamaruanedia bini, ḡole-oho boubouna gaudia; bona uit ikwadilaina audia bona boromakau pagadia madunadia na lahi audia ai baela.
2SA.24.22.english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

2SA.13.19.motu: Bena Tamara ese kahu na kwarana tubuana ai e atoa, bona hari ena dabua ima-lata e dokia ḡauna na e darea; bena imana tubuana ai e atoa; bena e raka lao mai tai Iolololona ida.
2SA.13.19.english: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went.

2SA.2.12.motu: Abnere Nere, Isiboset Saulo ena hesiai taudia ida, na Mahanaim e rakatania, Gibeon ela.
2SA.2.12.english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

2SA.1.18.motu: Bona e hahedua, Iuda taudia bae hadibalaidia eto. A itaia, ḡauna na lasara ena buka ai vada e torea. Ia eto:
2SA.1.18.english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

2SA.7.10.motu: Egu bese Israel edia gabu baina gwauraidia hidi, bona baina hadaidia, edia gabu korikori ai bae noho, ta ese basine hamareredia. Daḡedaḡe taudia ese basie hahisidia lou, gunaguna e karava heḡereḡerena,
2SA.7.10.english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

2SA.3.3.motu: Iharuana na Kilea, Abigail natuna; una Abigail na Nabala, tau Karamele, vabuna. Ihatoina na Absalom, Maaka natuna; una Maaka na Talmai, Gesuru pavapavana, natuna hahinena.
2SA.3.3.english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

2SA.13.36.motu: Ena hereva e doko ai, hanua pavapavana natuna e kau; bena gadodia e habada, e tai lolololo. Hanua pavapavana danu mai ena hesiai taudia iboudiai na e tai dikadika.
2SA.13.36.english: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

2SA.18.24.motu: David na ikoukou ruaosi padadiai e helaiva; bena hegima tauna na maḡu amo e dae ela bona ikoukou guhina ai e gini. Bena e roha lao, tau ta e itaia, sihona e heauva.
2SA.18.24.english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

2SA.4.1.motu: Isiboset Saulo e kamonai Abnere na Heberon ai e mase, bena e gari dikadika, bona Israel taudia iboudiai danu kudoudia e hetaha.
2SA.4.1.english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

2SA.23.29.motu: Helebe Baanaha, tau Netofa; Itai Ribai, tau Gibea, Beniamina iduhuna tauna;
2SA.23.29.english: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

2SA.8.15.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Israel idoinai e lohiaia. David ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaorona ida.
2SA.8.15.english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

2SA.20.8.motu: Nadi-bada Gibeon ai enai e kau negana ai, Amasa na ema, idia ida e hedavari. Ioab ese tuari dabuana e hahedokilaia, Iatanai dare mai iudalaina ḡauna mai varona ida na gabana ai e ḡeḡea; bena rakana ai dare na iudalaina ḡauna amo e moru.
2SA.20.8.english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

2SA.15.32.motu: David na ororo dorina ai e kau, Dirava e toma henia dihova gabuna ai, unuseni ai Husai, tau Araki, na ia ihedavari-henina ema; ena dabua vada e hedare, bona kwarana na mai tanona.
2SA.15.32.english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

2SA.19.40.motu: A hanua pavapavana na Gilgal ela, bona hari Kimuhamu na ia ida ela. Iuda taudia iboudiai, bona Israel besena kahana, ese David e bamoa.
2SA.19.40.english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

2SA.14.7.motu: Harihari egu iduhu taudia iboudiai ese emu hesiai hahinena vada e daḡedaḡe henigumu, e tomu, Tadikakana e alaia tauna a henimai, baia alaia mase, hari tadikakana e alaia tauna ena mauri davana. Unu amo idia ese dihi danu bae ha-orea; unu amo egu gida tamona doini e aramu na bema habodoa, adavagu na ladana eiava garana basiema mia tanobada latanai.
2SA.14.7.english: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

2SA.15.28.motu: A itaia, tano ḡaḡaena ai, turu-hanai gabuna ai, baina henari, ela bona hereva ta umui emui amo egu ai baine kau.
2SA.15.28.english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

2SA.7.7.motu: Israel taudia iboudiai ida na loa henidiava gabudia iboudiai na Israel edia hanemaoro tauna ta, egu orea Israel ireguna ai na halaoa tauna, na nanadaia a, nato “Dahakadainai sida rumana auta to haginia egu?”
2SA.7.7.english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

2SA.18.32.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Kusu tauna e nanadaia, eto, Hari eregabe tauna Absalom be namo a? Kusu tauna e haere, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava inaina bona ihadikamu totona e tuari henimumu taudia iboudiai na una eregabe tauna ida bae heḡereḡere baine namo.
2SA.18.32.english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?”

2SA.15.18.motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ese e rakaia hanai; bona Kerete taudia iboudiai bona Pelete taudia iboudiai, bona Gata taudia sinahu-tauratoiosi, Gata amo vada e ḡavaia taudia, na hanua pavapavana vairana amo e raka lao.
2SA.15.18.english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

2SA.18.20.motu: Bena Ioab ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hari dina ai harina basio laohaia; dina ta harina ba laohaia, a hari dina ai hari ta basio laohaia, badina be hanua pavapavana natuna vada e mase.
2SA.18.20.english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

2SA.3.14.motu: Bena David ese gwaukau taudia na Isiboset Saulo dekena e siaidia, eto, Adavagu Mikala a henigu, badina be na mao henia davana na Filistia taudia sinahu-ta peritome ai e iva heḡeḡe kopidia amo vada na karaia.
2SA.3.14.english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

2SA.19.15.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na e lou, Ioridane sinavaina ela; bona Iuda taudia na Gilgal ela, hanua pavapavana ida bae hedavari bona Ioridane sinavaina amo bae hakaua hanai totona.
2SA.19.15.english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

2SA.8.7.motu: David ese gold kesidia, Hadadesere ena hesiai taudia ese e hua ḡaudia, danu e abidia, Ierusalem e laohaidia.
2SA.8.7.english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

2SA.3.7.motu: Saulo vabuna ta ladana na Rispa, Aia natuna. Bena Isiboset ese Abnere e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai tamagu vabuna ta ida o eno bou?
2SA.3.7.english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

2SA.23.1.english: Now these are the last words of David.

2SA.24.14.motu: Bena David ese Gad e haere henia, eto, Daragu eme doko; Iehova imana ai baita moru be namo, badina be ena hebogahisi na bada; a lau na taunimanima imadia ai basina moru.
2SA.24.14.english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

2SA.18.25.motu: Bena hegima tauna e boi dobi, hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa. Hanua pavapavana e haere, eto, Bema ia na sibona, unu na hari ia e mailaiamu. E heau mai haraḡa, una gabu e kahi henia.
2SA.18.25.english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

2SA.18.15.motu: Bena eregabe taudia gwauta, Ioab ena kesi ihuana taudia, ese Absalom e ginia ahu, e rahua mase, e alaia.
2SA.18.15.english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

2SA.15.33.motu: David ese e hereva henia, eto, Bema oi na lau ida baitala negana ai oi ese ba hametaugu.
2SA.15.33.english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

2SA.24.7.motu: bona Turo kohorona, bona Hivi taudia bona Kanaan taudia edia hanua iboudiai. Unu amo Iuda diho kahana ai e lasi, Bere-sieba ai.
2SA.24.7.english: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

2SA.11.25.motu: David ese gwaukau tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Ioab na ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto “Lalomu basine hekwarahi ina sivarai dainai; badina be dare na nega ta, ta baine alaia, ma nega ta, ta ma baine alaia. Una hanua ituan-henina ba goadalaia bena ba hadarerea”. Ia lalona unu ba hagoadaia toma.
2SA.11.25.english: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

2SA.14.10.motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, Bema tau ta ese hereva ta baine hamaorolaimu, dekegu ba hakaua mai; ia na nega ta basine daumu toho lou.
2SA.14.10.english: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

2SA.11.6.motu: Taunabunai, David ese hereva ta e siaia Ioab enai, eto, Uria, tau Hiti, na a siaia mai.
2SA.11.6.english: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

2SA.8.6.motu: Bena David ese tuari oreadia haida e siaidia, Aram, Damasko kahana ai, ela, unuseni ai bae noho; bena Suria taudia na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela, bona heaiva ḡaudia e henia. Iehova ese David na kwalimu e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai.
2SA.8.6.english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

2SA.2.17.motu: Una dina ai tuari na auka herea, bona David ena hesiai taudia ese Abnere bona Israel taudia na e hadareredia.
2SA.2.17.english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

2SA.6.12.motu: Haida ese King David e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova ese Obed-edom ena ruma taudia bona ena kohu idoinai vada e hanamodia, Dirava ena maua helaḡana dainai. Taunabunai David na ela, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na Obed-edom ena ruma amo e abia, David ena hanua ai e daelaia, mai moalena ida.
2SA.6.12.english: King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.”

2SA.10.6.motu: Amono taudia vada e diba, David lalona vada e dika ediai; bena idia ese Suria taudia Bete-rehob amo bona Soba amo e boiridia, e vatudia, tuari taudia, ae-raka taudia, gerebu-rua; bona Maaka pavapavana mai ena orea taudia daha ta, bona Tobo taudia gerebu-ta daha-rua, danu e vatudia.
2SA.10.6.english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.

2SA.15.25.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Sadok e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na ba huaia lou lao hanua lalonai. Iehova ese bema lalo namo henigu, ia ese baine hakaugu lou, bena ma baina itaia, bona iena noho gabuna ma baina itaia;
2SA.15.25.english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

2SA.11.3.motu: Bena David na e hesiai, hahine henanadaina e karaia. Ta eto, Una na Bataseba Eliama, Uria tau Hiti adavana.
2SA.11.3.english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

2SA.8.1.motu: Una murinai David ese Filistia taudia e hadareredia bona e hamanaudia. David ese danu Metegama na Filistia taudia imadia amo e abia.
2SA.8.1.english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

2SA.13.39.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana lalona ese Absalom ilao-henina e ura lalo-dikava; e diba Amnon na vada e mase dainai una lalo-hisina amo lalona na vada e hakerua.
2SA.13.39.english: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.

2SA.6.23.motu: Una Saulo natuna hahinena Mikala na e gabani ela bona e mase.
2SA.6.23.english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

2SA.15.14.motu: Bena David ese ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ia ida Ierusalem ai e nohova na e hamaorodia, eto, O tore tore isi, aita heau; eiava Absalom imana amo basita roho mauri diba. Aitala haraḡa, ia baine lasida tao bona baine hadikada bona hanua na dare matana amo baine habuaia tari na garina.
2SA.15.14.english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

2SA.20.13.motu: Laolao dalana amo vada e abia oho murinai, taunimanima iboudiai na Ioab murina amo ela, Sieba Bikri e hahavaia.
2SA.20.13.english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

2SA.19.9.motu: Bona taunimanima iboudiai, Israel iduhudia iboudiai lalodiai, na e hedoria masemaseva, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese inaida imadia amo e hamauridava bona Filistia taudia imadia amo e harohoda mauriva, a harihari ia na Absalom ena amo eda tano vada e heautania.
2SA.19.9.english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

2SA.12.20.motu: Bena David na tano amo e tore isi, e digu, tauna na dehoro amo e dahua, dabua ḡoevadia e doki; bena Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareai, e toma diho. Una murinai ia na ena ruma ela; bena e hereva negana ai idia ese aniani ia vairanai e atoa, bena e aniani.
2SA.12.20.english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into Yahweh’s house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate.

2SA.2.30.motu: Ioab na Abnere iḡavana amo e lou ela, ena orea taudia iboudiai e haboudia; David ena hesiai taudia gwauta taurahani-ta vada lasihidia, bona Asahele danu.
2SA.2.30.english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

2SA.14.6.motu: Lau binai emu hesiai hahinena natugu mamaruanedia na rarua. Nega ta idia na tano paka ai e heai; asi tauna ta unuseni ai baine dogodia, bena ta ese ta e alaia mase.
2SA.14.6.english: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

2SA.15.26.motu: a ia bema toma “Lau na asina lalo namo henimumu”, vadaeni, lau binai, ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine kara henigu.
2SA.15.26.english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

2SA.22.29.motu: Momokani, Iehova e, oi na egu lamepa;
2SA.22.29.english: For you are my lamp, Yahweh.

2SA.24.16.motu: A aneru ese Ierusalem ihabua-tarina totona imana e toi roro henia negana ai, Iehova na una dika amo e helalo kerehai, bena ia ese taunimanima ihabua-taridia aneruna na e hamaoroa, eto, Vadaeni, imamu a haloua.
2SA.24.16.english: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

2SA.21.17.motu: A Abisai Seruia na ia iduruna ema; ia ese Filistia tauna e heatu henia, bena e alaia mase. Bena David ena orea taudia ese David e sisiba henia, eto, Oi na ai ida basita tuari hebou lou, Israel ena diari ba habodoa na garina.
2SA.21.17.english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

2SA.8.9.motu: Toi, Hamat pavapavana, hari e kamonai David ese Hadadesere ena tuari oreana idoinai vada e hadarerea.
2SA.8.9.english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

2SA.12.16.motu: Bena David ese Dirava e noia, natuna dainai. David na e ani vaga danu, bona ruma ai e raka vareai, tano ai e hekure rani.
2SA.12.16.english: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in and lay all night on the ground.

2SA.18.33.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na darana e doko; ikoukou daena daiutuna ai e dae kau, e tai. Bona daekauna ai danu e tai, eto, Natugu Absalom o, natugu o, natugu Absalom o! Oi gabumu ai bama mase, Absalom o; natugu o, natugu o!
2SA.18.33.english: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

2SA.3.37.motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai hebou taudia iboudiai bona Israel idoinai lalodia na e parara, una Abnere Nere iala-masena na dia hanua pavapavana ena ura.
2SA.3.37.english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

2SA.8.17.motu: Sadok Ahitubu bona Ahimelek Abiatara na hahelaḡa taudia; Seraia na toretore tauna;
2SA.8.17.english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

2SA.18.6.motu: Taunabunai, tuari oreana idoinai ela, Israel taudia e tuari henidia; bena Efraim udana ai e tuari heheni.
2SA.18.6.english: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

2SA.4.7.motu: Ruma lalonai e raka vareai negana ai, idia ese Isiboset na ena mahuta daiutuna ai ena mahuta patana latanai mahutana ai e rahua mase, bona kwarana e utua oho. Bena idia na kwara e abia, Araba dalana amo e raka boi e raka rani,
2SA.4.7.english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

2SA.24.24.motu: A hanua pavapavana ese Arauna e haere henia, eto, Lasi, baina hoia, davana na baina henimu. Asi davadia gaudia na basina hahelaḡadia, gole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai basina halaodia, Iehova, egu Dirava, ena. Taunabunai, David ese uit ikwadilaina gabuna bona boromakau mamaruanedia na e hoi, davadia na e heni, silver sekeledia imahui.
2SA.24.24.english: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to Yahweh my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

2SA.3.13.motu: David eto, Namo; aita herohemaino. Ḡau tamona, dekegu baoma negana ai na Saulo natuna hahinena, Mikala, ba hakaua mai guna; bema lasi, vairagu basio itaia.
2SA.3.13.english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

2SA.16.19.motu: Bona ina danu, daika isiaina baina lao heni? Ia natuna, ani? Tamamu isiaina na lao heniva heḡereḡerena, oi isiaimu danu baina lao heni.
2SA.16.19.english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

2SA.3.21.motu: Bena Abnere ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Aina tore isi, bainala, Israel taudia iboudiai baina haboudia, egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai. Idia na oi ida bae herohemaino; bena o ura henidiamu taudia iboudiai na ba biagudia. Taunabunai David ese Abnere e siaia oho; ia na mai mainona ida ela.
2SA.3.21.english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

2SA.12.24.motu: Bena David ese adavana Bataseba lalona e hamarumarua; bena dekenai e raka vareai, raruosi na e eno bou. Bena hahine ese mero ta e abia; ladana na e hatoa Solomon. Iehova ese e lalokau henia,
2SA.12.24.english: David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. Yahweh loved him;

2SA.23.17.motu: eto, Iehova e, egu ai unu basine heto, lasi ona lasi vaitani; edia mauri inegedia asie laloa taudia raradia baina inu a? Taunabunai, ia na inuna se ura. Ini kara be hari goada-herea taudia tatoiosi ese e kara.
2SA.23.17.english: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

2SA.2.4.motu: Bena Iuda taudia na ela; unuseni ai idia ese David e horoa, Iuda iduhuna pavapavana ai e halaoa.
2SA.2.4.english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

2SA.10.17.motu: Haida ese David e hamaoroa, bena ia ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia; idia ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, Helam ela. Bena Suria taudia na David ituari-henina e raka lasi, bena e tuari henia.
2SA.10.17.english: David was told that; and he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. The Syrians set themselves in array against David and fought with him.

2SA.22.18.motu: Lau inaigu goadana ena amo e hamaurigu,
2SA.22.18.english: He delivered me from my strong enemy,

2SA.24.5.motu: Idia ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, Aroere ai e matamaia; koura bogaraginai e miamu hanuana amo e matamaia, Gad kahana ai ela, ma ela, ela bona lasere.
2SA.24.5.english: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

2SA.14.26.motu: Laḡani ta ta dokodia ai ia ese huina e utua, e metauva dainai; bena e utua negadia ai na huina metauna e hahetohoa; metauna na sekele sinahu-rua, hanua pavapavana ena metau hahetohona ḡaudia amo.
2SA.14.26.english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

2SA.19.4.motu: Hanua pavapavana na vairana e govaia ahu, bena e tai lolololo, eto, Natugu Absalom o, Absalom o, natugu o, natugu o!
2SA.19.4.english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

2SA.17.15.motu: Bena Husai ese hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara e hamaorodia, eto, Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai Absalom bona Israel tau-badadia e henidia na unu ini e hamaorodia toma, a Iauegu lalo-hadai na henidia na unu ini na hamaorodia toma.
2SA.17.15.english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

2SA.3.9.motu: Iehova ena gwauhamata, David enai, anina basinama havaraia, Dirava ese Abnere davana bema henia, ma bema habadaia.
2SA.3.9.english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

2SA.1.23.motu: Saulo bona lonatan, mai lalokaudia bona mai raho-namodia,
2SA.1.23.english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives.

2SA.2.18.motu: Seruia natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi na unuseni ai: Ioab bona Abisai bona Asahele. Hari Asahele na mai heau dibana, ena heau na uda diana ena heau na heto.
2SA.2.18.english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

2SA.5.18.motu: Filistia taudia na ema, Refaim kourana idoinai e hahonua.
2SA.5.18.english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

2SA.22.4.motu: Iehova, e imodaiamu Diravana, na tai heniamu,
2SA.22.4.english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised;

2SA.3.15.motu: Bena Isiboset e hesiai, hahine na adavana Paltiel Laisi ena amo e vena lou.
2SA.3.15.english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

2SA.2.7.motu: Taunabunai, imamui ba ha-aukadia, ba goada; badina be biagumui Saulo vada e mase, bona Iuda taudia ese vada e horogu, edia pavapava ai bainala.
2SA.2.7.english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

2SA.13.10.motu: Bena Amnon ese Tamara e hamaoroa, eto, Hari aniani ame vareailai daiutu lalonai, bena oi imamu amo baina ania. Bena Tamara ese e kara atagadia na e abi, daiutu ai e vareailai, taihuna Amnon dekenai.
2SA.13.10.english: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.

2SA.21.4.motu: Gibeon taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Saulo mai ena iduhu taudia ida bona ai padamai ai gold bona silver na herevadia; bona dia ai emai ḡaukara Israel tauna ta baia alaia mase. David ma eto, Emui ura be dahaka, ede baina karamui toma?
2SA.21.4.english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.”

2SA.1.25.english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle!

2SA.11.2.motu: Adorahi ta, David na ena mahuta patana amo e tore isi, hanua pavapavana ena ruma guhina ai e rakava; bena guhi amo hahine ta e diguva ai e itaia. Ia na hane namo, mai hairaina.
2SA.11.2.english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

2SA.17.23.motu: Ahitofel vada e diba iena lalo-hadai na asie abia dae, bena ena doniki e abia, ena hanua korikori e lou lao. Ena kohu iboudiai e atodia namonamo bena sibona e hemata. E mase; bena tamana ena gara ai e guria.
2SA.17.23.english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

2SA.22.22.motu: Badina be Iehova ena dala vada na badinadia;
2SA.22.22.english: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways,

2SA.15.29.motu: Taunabunai, Sadok bona Abiatara ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana e huaia lou lao Ierusalem ai; idia na unuseni ai e nohova.
2SA.15.29.english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

2SA.4.8.motu: Isiboset kwarana na David dekena e laohaia Heberon ai. Idia ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Oi inaimu Isiboset Saulo, emu maun iabi-ohona dalana e tahuava tauna, kwarana binai. Han dina ai Iehova ese Saulo mai garana ida davadia vada e henidia, oi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava, vada e hadava henimu.
2SA.4.8.english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! Yahweh has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

2SA.10.9.motu: Ioab na e itaia, inaina na vairai bona muri ai e ginia ahu, bena ia ese Israel edia goada taudia haida e abidia hidi, Suria taudia ituari-henidia e siaidia lao.
2SA.10.9.english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

2SA.15.11.motu: Ierusalem taudia sinahu-rua, Absalom ese e vavedia taudia, na ia ida ela; a idia na mai lalo-goevaḡoevadia ida ela, ḡau ta asi dibadia.
2SA.15.11.english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

2SA.6.3.motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana na rerue matamatana ta latanai e atoa, Abinadab ena ruma amo e abia lasi. Una ruma na ororo ai. Abinadab natuna raruosi, Usa bona Ahio, ese hari rerue matamatana e heaulaia,
2SA.6.3.english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

2SA.12.7.motu: Bena Natan ese David ma e hereva henia, eto, Tauna na oi. Iehova, Israel Diravana, ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese na horomu, Israel pavapavana, bona Saulo imana amo na hamaurimu.
2SA.12.7.english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.

2SA.6.16.motu: A Iehova ena maua helagana na David ena hanua ai e kau negana ai, Saulo natuna hahinena Mikala na gaba-mauru amo e igo lasi, bena King David e itaia, e mavaru roho-isi roho-isiva Iehova vairanai; bena lalona ese e dadaraia.
2SA.6.16.english: As Yahweh’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before Yahweh; and she despised him in her heart.

2SA.6.6.motu: Idia na Nakono ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai e kau, bena Usa ese imana e toia roro, Dirava ena maua helaḡana ai e dau kau, baine dogoa tao eto. badina be boromakau mamaruanedia na e hetutuhi.
2SA.6.6.english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

2SA.2.5.motu: Bena David ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Iabese-gilead taudia dekediai, e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova ese baine hanamomui, badina be emui abidadama na biagumui Saulo enai o hahedinaraia, bena o guria.
2SA.2.5.english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

2SA.12.22.motu: Ia eto, Mero na dounu mauri negana ai, na ani vaga bona na taitai, badina be lau nato “Daika dibana, Iehova baine bogagu hisi bena mero na baine mauri eiava?”
2SA.12.22.english: He said, “While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows whether Yahweh will not be gracious to me, that the child may live?’

2SA.12.17.motu: Ena ruma tau-badadia na badibadinai e gini, tano amo bae hatorea isi eto; to ia na se ura. Aniani idia ida se aniva danu.
2SA.12.17.english: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread with them.

2SA.12.19.motu: David ese ena hesiai taudia e itadia, e hemaunu heheni, bena lalona e parara, mero na vada e mase. Bena David ese ena hesiai taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Mero na e mase a? Idia eto, Vada e mase.
2SA.12.19.english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; and David said to his servants, “Is the child dead?”

2SA.9.9.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Saulo ena hesiai launa Siba e boina, eto, Saulo mai ena idunu taudia ida edia kohu idoinai na biagumu natuna vada na henia.
2SA.9.9.english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

2SA.18.9.motu: Bena Absalom na David ena hesiai taudia ida e hedavari taku. Absalom na ena doniki ai e gui; bena doniki na oak auna badana ta rigina momo henudiai e heau vareai. Bena kwarana na oak rigina ai e headai; bena e hetau veriveri. A doniki na ia henuna amo e heau oho.
2SA.18.9.english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

2SA.12.2.motu: Taḡa tauna ena mamoe bona nani seridia na momo herea;
2SA.12.2.english: The rich man had very many flocks and herds,

2SA.20.17.motu: Ioab na dekena e raka kahi lao, bena hahine na eto, Oi na Ioab a? Ia na e haere, eto, Oibe. Bena hahine ese e hereva henia, eto, Emu hesiai hahinena egu hereva ba kamonai. Ia na e haere, eto, Na hakalamu.
2SA.20.17.english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?”

2SA.10.11.motu: Ia eto, Suria taudia bema goada herea, vada ba durugu; a Amono taudia na egu ai bema goada herea, lau ese baina vasi durumu.
2SA.10.11.english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

2SA.22.1.motu: Iehova ese David na inaina iboudiai imadia amo bona Saulo imana amo e hamauria dinana ai, David ese Iehova e hereva henia ina ane ai.
2SA.22.1.english: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

2SA.16.14.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana mai bamona iboudiai ida na Ioridane sinavaina ai e kau, taudia na boboera. Unuseni ai laḡana e ania.
2SA.16.14.english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

2SA.22.40.motu: Oi ese goada o hariolaigu, baina tuari totona;
2SA.22.40.english: For you have armed me with strength for the battle.

2SA.16.21.motu: Ahitofel ese Absalom e haere henia, eto, Tamamu e adavadia hahinedia, ruma inarina totona e rakatanidia, na dekediai ba raka vareai; bena Israel taudia iboudiai bae kamonai, oi ese tamamu lalona vada o hadikaia emu ai, bena emu ai e taomu taudia iboudiai na imadia bae ha-aukadia.
2SA.16.21.english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

2SA.18.26.motu: Bena hegima tauna na tau ma ta e itaia, e heauva; bena hegima tauna na ikoukou e boi lao, eto, A itaia, ta ma sibona e heau e maimu. Hanua pavapavana eto, Ia danu hari ta e mailaiamu.
2SA.18.26.english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!”

2SA.23.26.motu: Helese, tau Palti; Ira Ikese, Tekoa tauna;
2SA.23.26.english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

2SA.23.20.motu: Benaia lehoiada na boga-auka tauna ta, Kabsele amo; ia na kara badadia e karava. Ia ese Ariele natuna raruosi Moab amo na e aladia mase; bona leona ta guri lalonai e alaia mase, snow e dihova dinana ai.
2SA.23.20.english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

2SA.23.2.motu: Iehova ena Lauma na udugu amo e herevamu,

2SA.14.3.motu: bena hanua pavapavana dekenai ba raka vareai, ini ba hereva henia toma. Bena baine gwaurai herevadia na Ioab ese e henia.
2SA.14.3.english: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

2SA.18.28.motu: Bena Ahimasa ese hanua pavapavana e boi henia, eto, Namo herea. Bena ia na tano ai e goru diho, hanua pavapavana vairanai, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, aita imodaia; ia ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava e tuari heniava taudia na vada e hadareredia.
2SA.18.28.english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

2SA.18.21.motu: Bena Ioab ese Kusu tauna e haduaia, eto, Aola, o ita ḡaudia na hanua pavapavana ba hamaorolaia. Kusu tauna na Ioab vairanai e igo diho, bena e heau.
2SA.18.21.english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

2SA.3.20.motu: Bena Abnere, tatau ruahui ida, David dekena ela, Heberon ai. Una negana ai, David ese aria ta e karaia, Abnere mai bamona ida adia.
2SA.3.20.english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

2SA.7.3.motu: Bena Natan ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, Ialomu e hadaiamu karana idoinai do ba karaia, badina be Iehova na oi ida.
2SA.7.3.english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for Yahweh is with you.”

2SA.20.19.motu: Lau be maino bona heabidadama Israel ai e badinadiamu taudia ta; a oi na Israel hanuana gunana ta ihabua-tarina dalana o tahuamu. Dahaka dainai Iehova ahuna ba hadonoa?
2SA.20.19.english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”

2SA.12.13.motu: Bena David ese Natan e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova vairanai vada na kara dika. Natan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova ese emu dika vada e gwau tao, basio mase;
2SA.12.13.english: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against Yahweh.”

2SA.21.13.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Saulo bona natuna Ionatan turiadia na unu amo e laohaidia; bona haida ese hari e taudia dae taudia turiadia danu e haboudia.
2SA.21.13.english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

2SA.19.8.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e tore isi, ikoukou ai e helai diho. Bena haida ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, hanua pavapavana na ikoukou ai e helaimu. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na hanua pavapavana vairanai e hebou.
2SA.19.8.english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

2SA.2.31.motu: A David ena hesiai taudia ese Beniamina taudia sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui, Abnere ena orea taudia, vada e aladia mase.
2SA.2.31.english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

2SA.4.11.motu: Matona, kara dika taudia ese kara maoromaoro tauna ta na ena ruma korikori ai bona ena mahuta patana ai vada e alaia mase, ia rarana davana na umui imamui amo basina abia, tanobada ai basina habuamui tari a?
2SA.4.11.english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

2SA.6.5.motu: Bena David bona Israel besena idoinai e moale hisi dae mai goadadia idoinai, Iehova vairanai, mai anedia bona hatai-hatai gaudia idau-idau bona tareko bona bota-bota auridia idau-idau reḡedia ida.
2SA.6.5.english: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

2SA.2.10.motu: Isiboset Saulo ena mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui, Israel besena e lohiaia matama negana ai; laḡani rua hona e lohiaia. A Iuda iduhuna ese David e badinaia.
2SA.2.10.english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

2SA.8.3.motu: David ese Hadadesere Rehob, Soba pavapavana, danu e hadarerea, una tau ese Eufrate sinavaina tanodia iabi-loudia totona ela negana ai.
2SA.8.3.english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

2SA.12.6.motu: Ia ese mamoe natuna davana do baine heni hahani, unu e kara toma dainai; badina be asi ena hebogahisi.
2SA.12.6.english: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!”

2SA.21.1.motu: David ena nega ai doe e vara, bena se doko ela bona laḡani toi e ore. Bena David ese Iehova vairana e tahua. Iehova eto, Kerere na Saulo bona ena iduhu taudia latadiai, rara dainai; badina be ia ese Gibeon taudia e aladia mase.
2SA.21.1.english: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Yahweh. Yahweh said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

2SA.16.10.motu: A hanua pavapavana eto, Seruia natuna e, lau oiemu ai be dahaka? Bema ia na e heuduguiraimu badina be Iehova ese vada e haḡania, eto “David ba uduguiraia”, bena daika baineto “Dahaka dainai unu o kara tomamu?”
2SA.16.10.english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

2SA.22.36.motu: Emu hahemauri kesina vada o henigu;
2SA.22.36.english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation.

2SA.5.20.motu: Bena David na Baal-perasimi ela, unuseni ai e hadareredia. Bena ia eto, Iehova ese lau inaigu vada e haheḡiḡidia dobi, abata ese ḡau ta bema ḡiḡia dobi na heto. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Baal-perasimi.
2SA.5.20.english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

2SA.15.2.motu: Absalom ena kara be daba ai e tore isi haragava, hanua ikoukouna ilao-henina dalana badinai e giniva. Bena tau ta bema mai, hanua pavapavana vairanai ihahemaoro-henina totona, Absalom ese bema boi henia, bema toma, Oi na edena hanua amo? Bena una tau bema haere, iduhu ta ladana bema hatoa, bema toma “Emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu na unai Israel ai” negana ai na
2SA.15.2.english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?”

2SA.17.10.motu: Bena goada-herea tauna, lalona na leona lalona na heto tauna, na gari ese baine butua tao; badina be Israel taudia iboudiai na dibadia tamamu na goada-herea tauna, bona ia e bamoamu taudia danu goada-herea taudia.
2SA.17.10.english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

2SA.10.16.motu: Bena Hadadesere e hesiai, Suria taudia Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai e nohova na e boindia; bena idia na ema, Helam ai e kau; Sobaka, Hadadesere ena tuari lohiana, ese e biagudia.
2SA.10.16.english: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

2SA.1.2.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, tau ta ema, Saulo ena taruha amo; ena dabua vada e hedare bona tano na kwarana tubuana ai heato. Ia na David dekenai e kau, bena e igo diho.
2SA.1.2.english: on the third day, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

2SA.23.21.motu: Aigupto tauna ta danu, raho-namo tauna, na ia ese e alaia mase. Una Aigupto tauna na imana mai iona; a Benaia na au ta e abia, e lao henia, io na Aigupto tauna imana amo e dadia, bena sibona ena io amo e gwadaia mase.
2SA.23.21.english: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

2SA.15.30.motu: Bena David na Olive ororona amo e dara dae, mai taina ida. Aena asi tamakadia ela, bona kwarana danu e koua; bena ia ida ela taudia iboudiai ese kwaradia e koudia, bona e dara dae mai taidia ida.
2SA.15.30.english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

2SA.7.25.motu: Iehova, Dirava e, emu hesiai tauna bona ia garana o herevalaidia herevana hari ba hamomokania hanaihanai, bona karana ba karaia.
2SA.7.25.english: “Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

2SA.18.5.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioab bona Abisai bona Itai e haḡanidia, eto, Lau daigu ai han eregabe tauna Absalom ba bogaia hisi. Taunimanima iboudiai ese hanua pavapavana ena hereva e kamonai, ia ese tuari biagudia iboudiai na han Absalom herevana e haganilaidia negana ai.
2SA.18.5.english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

2SA.17.25.motu: Absalom ese Amasa vada e gwauraia, tuari oreana baine biagua, Ioab gabuna ai. Hari Amasa na Ismael tauna ta, ladana Itira, natuna; adavana na Abigail Nahasa, Ioab sinana Seruia tadina.
2SA.17.25.english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

2SA.21.2.motu: Taunabunai, David ese Gibeon taudia e boiridia; hari Gibeon taudia na dia Israel besena taudia, idia na Amoro kwabukwabudia. Israel taudia ese gunaguna e gwau henidia hamata, basie hamasedia eto; to Saulo ese ialadia dalana e tahuava, Israel bona Iuda taudia ihanamodia e uralaia badava dainai.
2SA.21.2.english: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

2SA.11.23.motu: Hari gwaukau tauna ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Idia ese e hadareremai, tano paka ai e tuari henimai; ma a luludia lou ela bona hanua ikoukouna.
2SA.11.23.english: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

2SA.14.12.motu: Bena hahine eto, Mani emu kara, lau binai emu hesiai hahinena ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava na hereva ta aina hamaorolaimu. Ia eto, A hereva.
2SA.14.12.english: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.”

2SA.24.12.motu: Aola, David ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ḡau toi na dudu henirnumu, tamona bavabia hidi, bena unu baina kara henimu toma”.
2SA.24.12.english: “Go and speak to David, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

2SA.1.17.motu: Bena David ese Saulo mai natuna Ionatan ida taidia e tai, ena tai anena binai.
2SA.1.17.english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

2SA.22.15.motu: Ena diba e kino, e hakarohodia;
2SA.22.15.english: He sent out arrows and scattered them,

2SA.7.21.motu: Emu gwauhamata dainai bona emu lalo-hadai bagunai ini kara badadia vada o kara, emu hesiai tauna lalona baine parara helaoreana.
2SA.7.21.english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

2SA.16.8.motu: Iehova ese Saulo, dagina o abia tauna, mai ena iduhu taudia ida raradia davadia idoinai na oiemu amo vada e abia; bona Iehova ese basileia na natumu Absalom imana ai vada e atoa. A itaia, emu dika na vada latamu ai vada e kau; badina be oi na rara ihahebubuna tauna.
2SA.16.8.english: Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

2SA.24.20.motu: Arauna na e roha lao, hanua pavapavana mai ena hesiai taudia ida e itadia, ia dekena e maiva; bena Arauna na e raka lasi, tano ai e goru diho, hanua pavapavana e toma henia diho.
2SA.24.20.english: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

2SA.11.21.motu: Abimelek Ierubeset na daika ese e alaia mase? Hahine ta ese uit iririlaina nadina ta na magu amo e tahoa dobi ia latanai, bena Tebese ai e mase ani? Dahaka dainai maḡu badibadina ola?” Bena ba hamaoroa, baoto “Emu hesiai tauna Uria, tau Hiti, danu vada e mase”.
2SA.11.21.english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

2SA.13.26.motu: Absalom ma eto, Bema oi basiola, mani emu kara kakagu Amnon na ai ida baiala. Hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai ia na oi ida baola?
2SA.13.26.english: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.”

2SA.20.6.motu: Bena David ese Abisai e hamaoroa, eto, Absalom ese e hadikada maraḡi, a hari Sieba Bikri ese baine hadikada bada. Emu lohia ena hesiai taudia bavabidia, ia ba ḡavaia, hanua mai magudia haida baine abidia bena baine hahekwarahida na garina.
2SA.20.6.english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

2SA.2.15.motu: Bena e tore isi, e raka hanai, gwauta-rarua Beniamina bona Isiboset Saulo edia, bona David ena hesiai taudia danu gwauta-rarua.
2SA.2.15.english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

2SA.15.22.motu: Bena David ese Itai e hamaoroa, eto, Mato, vada a raka lao. Taunabunai Itai, tau Gata, e raka ela, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida, bona natudia maraḡidia danu.
2SA.15.22.english: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

2SA.13.27.motu: A Absalom e noia louIou, ela bona ia ese Amnon bona hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia iboudiai na e kahudia nege, ia ida ela.
2SA.13.27.english: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

2SA.1.19.motu: Israel e, oi hairaimu na emu ororo doridia ai vada e hamasea;
2SA.1.19.english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places!

2SA.22.50.motu: Ina dainai, Iehova e, lau baina imodaimu bese idau-idau bogaragidiai;
2SA.22.50.english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations,

2SA.14.23.motu: Taunabunai, Ioab na e tore isi, Gesuru ela, Absalom e hakaua mai Ierusalem ai.
2SA.14.23.english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

2SA.18.17.motu: Bena idia ese Absalom e abia, guri badana ta lalonai e tahoa dobi, uda ai; bena nadi momo-herea e senudia, ia latanai. Bena Israel taudia iboudiai e heau, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela.
2SA.18.17.english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

2SA.12.15.motu: Natan na ena ruma ela. Bena Iehova ese David natuna, Bataseba ena amo e havaraia merona, na e daua toho; bena mero na e gorerea.
2SA.12.15.english: Then Nathan departed to his house.

2SA.19.28.motu: Badina be tamagu ena iduhu taudia iboudiai na egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai e revadia mase; a oi ese emu hesiai tauna na emu pata ai e anianimu taudia bogaragidiai o atogu. Dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ma baina tai henia lou?
2SA.19.28.english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

2SA.6.9.motu: Una dina ai David ese Iehova garina e gari, eto, Iehova ena maua helaḡana na egu ai ede bae mailaia toma?
2SA.6.9.english: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”

2SA.9.12.motu: Mefiboset na mai natuna maraḡina ta, ladana na Mika. Siba ena ruma ai e nohova taudia iboudiai ese Mefiboset isiaina e lao heniva.
2SA.9.12.english: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

2SA.5.24.motu: Bena reḡe ta baka audia doridia ai ba kamonai, e kara tuari taudia e raka hanaimu reḡedia na heheto, negana ai vada ba raka haraḡa; badina be ba diba, Iehova vada e guna oi vairamu ai, Filistia edia tuari taudia irahu-masedia totona.
2SA.5.24.english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

2SA.15.36.motu: Ina danu, idia natudia raruosi, Ahimasa Sadok bona Ionatan Abiatara, na unuseni ai; ba kamonai herevadia iboudiai na idia edia amo lau dekegu ba siaidia.
2SA.15.36.english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

2SA.5.6.motu: Hanua pavapavana na ena tuari taudia ida Ierusalem ela, Iebusu taudia, una tano taudia, bae tuari henidia totona. Idia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na iniseni ai basio dae kau, a mata-kepulu taudia bona ae-hedairie taudia ese bae laomu ahu. Edia lalo-hadai be David na unuseni ai basine dae kau diba.
2SA.5.6.english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

2SA.3.18.motu: Harihari, karana ba karaia; badina be Iehova ese David vada e gwau henia hamata, eto, Egu hesiai tauna David imana amo lau ese egu orea Israel na Filistia taudia imadia amo bona inaina iboudiai imadia amo baina hamauria.
2SA.3.18.english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

2SA.9.8.motu: Bena ma e toma henia diho, eto, Emu hesiai tauna be dahaka? Lau na sisia masena na heto; ba haḡeregu anina be dahaka?
2SA.9.8.english: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

2SA.11.16.motu: Bena Ioab na hanua e koua heḡeḡe negana ai, ia ese Uria na gabu ta e henia, ia dibana una na tuari dibaka taudia baema gabuna.
2SA.11.16.english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

2SA.18.4.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e haere henidia, eto, Edena dala umui ese o laloamu dala namona, una na baina karaia. Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na ikoukou badibadinai e gini; bena tuari oreana idoinai e raka lasi, sinahu ta ta amo, bona daha ta ta amo.
2SA.18.4.english: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.”

2SA.7.22.motu: Taunabunai oi na bada, Iehova, Dirava e; badina be asi idaimu bona Dirava ta ma lasi; taiamai e kamonaimu sivaraidia iboudiai na unu e hadibamai tomamu.
2SA.7.22.english: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

2SA.10.14.motu: Amono taudia e itaia, Suria taudia na vada e heau, bena idia danu Abisai vairanai e heau, hanua lalonai e heau vareai. Bena Ioab na Amono taudia ituari-henidia amo e lou, Ierusalem e lou henia.
2SA.10.14.english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

2SA.20.18.motu: Hahine na eto, Sene negadia ai ini e gwau tomava “Abele ai lalo-hadai namona ba tahua”, bena unu e kara tomava.
2SA.20.18.english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

2SA.14.14.motu: Ita iboudai baita mase; ita na ranu tano ai e hebubumu na heto, tau ta ese basine haboua lou diba. A vada e murimuria tauna se negea daure vaitanimu to iabi-louna dalana e haeroamu tauna na Dirava ese ena mauri basine abia oho.
2SA.14.14.english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

2SA.1.12.motu: Bena e lalo hisihisiva, e taiva, bona e ani vagava, ela bona dina e diho; Saulo bona natuna Ionatan bona Iehova ena orea taudia bona Israel besena taidia e taiva, badina be idia na dare amo vada e mase.
2SA.1.12.english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

2SA.20.11.motu: A Ioab ena orea tauna ta ese Amasa badibadinai e gini, eto, Daika ese Ioab bona David e lalo namo henidiamu, ia na Ioab murina amo baine raka.
2SA.20.11.english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

2SA.3.1.motu: Saulo ena orea bona David ena orea na e tuari heheni: tuan na vada e daudau. David na e goada e laova, a Saulo ena orea na e manoka e laova.
2SA.3.1.english: Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

2SA.2.11.motu: David ese laḡani hitu hua tauratoi Iuda iduhuna e lohiaia, Heberon ai.
2SA.2.11.english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

2SA.21.19.motu: Bena Filistia taudia ida ma e tuari lou, Gob ai; una negana ai Elhanan Iaare-oregimi, tau Betelehem, ese Goliata, tau Gata, e alaia mase. Una tau ena io auauna na dabua ihatuna tauna ena au na heto.
2SA.21.19.english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

2SA.22.42.motu: Hekaha e noilaia, a ta ese se hamauridia;
2SA.22.42.english: They looked, but there was no one to save;

2SA.22.37.motu: Taora bada gabuna vada o lailaia, lau aegu bae moia tao;
2SA.22.37.english: You have enlarged my steps under me.

2SA.11.11.motu: Bena Uria ese David e haere henia, eto, Maua helaḡana bona Israel bona Iuda taudia na kalaga ai e nohomu; biagugu Ioab mai ena hesiai taudia ida na tano paka ai e taruhamu; matona, lau na egu ruma bainala, baina aniani, baina inuinu, adavagu ida baina eno bou, a? Oi o maurimu bona laumamu e maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau na unu basina kara toma.
2SA.11.11.english: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

2SA.19.34.motu: A Barasilai ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Laḡani hida baina mauri dainai hanua pavapavana ida Ierusalem bainala?
2SA.19.34.english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

2SA.23.6.motu: A Dirava asie matauraiamu taudia na
2SA.23.6.english: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away,

2SA.23.36.motu: Igala Natan, tau Soba; Bani, tau Gad;
2SA.23.36.english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

2SA.15.16.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana e raka lasi, mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida. A hanua pavapavana ese vada e adavadia hahinedia gwauta e rakatanidia, ruma inarina totona.
2SA.15.16.english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

2SA.4.5.motu: Han Rimon, tau Beroto, natuna raruosi, Rekab bona Baanaha, e raka lasi, dina tubua ai Isiboset ena ruma ai e kau, tauna na laḡana e ania negana ai.
2SA.4.5.english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

2SA.8.8.motu: Hadadesere ena hanua rua, Beta bona Berotai, amo King David ese auri labora-laboradia momo herea e abi.
2SA.8.8.english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

2SA.5.8.motu: Una dina ai David eto, Daika ese Iebusu taudia baine hadareredia, ia na ranu gabuna amo baine dae, ae-hedairike taudia bona mata-kepulu taudia, David laumana ese e inai henidiamu taudia, baine tuari henidia. Unu amo ina hereva e vara: Mata-kepulu taudia bona ae-hedairike taudia na ruma ai basie dae kau.
2SA.5.8.english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

2SA.19.18.motu: bena e turu hanai, hanua pavapavana ena orea taudia bae hakaudia hanai bona hanua pavapavana isiaina baine lao heni totona. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioridane sinavaina baine hanaia eto negana ai, Simei Gera na hanua pavapavana vairanai e igo diho,
2SA.19.18.english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good.

2SA.18.1.motu: Bena David ese e bamoava taudia na e haboudia, biagudia e gwauraidia, daha ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia e haginidia.
2SA.18.1.english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

2SA.19.14.motu: Bena ia ese Iuda taudia iboudiai lalodia e ani, bona e hatamonadia; taunabunai idia ese hereva e siaia, hanua pavapavana enai, eto, A lou, oi bona emu hesiai taudia iboudiai danu.
2SA.19.14.english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

2SA.4.9.motu: A David ese Rimon tau Beroto natuna raruosi, Rekab mai tadina Baanaha ida, e haere henidia, eto, Iehova, dika iboudiai lalodia amo vada e hamaurigu Diravana, e maunmu heḡereḡerena,
2SA.4.9.english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

2SA.16.11.motu: Bena David ese Abisai bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, natugu korikori ese lauegu mauri baine abia oho e tomamu; o, ina Beniamina iduhuna tauna ese egu mauri iabi-ohona basine ura badabada a? Aine noho, baine heuduguirai; badina be Iehova ese vada e haḡania.
2SA.16.11.english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

2SA.8.2.motu: Ia ese Moab taudia danu e hadareredia, bena hetoadia e kara, e hahekuredia ere-ere; ere rua hetoana e karaia bae mase, a ere ta idoinai e hamauridia. Bena Moab taudia na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela, bona heaiva ḡaudia danu e henia.
2SA.8.2.english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

2SA.15.6.motu: Israel taudia na hahemaoro totona hanua pavapavana dekena e maiva iboudiai na Absalom ese unu e karadia tomava; unu amo Absalom ese Israel taudia lalodia e aniva.
2SA.15.6.english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

2SA.18.12.motu: A una tau ese Ioab e haere henia, eto, Ena be silver monidia daha ta imagu ai bama mamidia, to imagu na hanua pavapavana natuna ihadikana totona basinama toia roro. Badina be ai a kamonai hanua pavapavana ese oi bona Abisai bona Itai e haḡanimui, eto, Lau daigu ai eregabe tauna Absalom ba hamauria.
2SA.18.12.english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

2SA.20.7.motu: Bena Ioab bona Kerete taudia bona Pelete taudia bona goada taudia iboudiai na Abisai murinai ela; Ierusalem amo e raka lasi, Sieba Bikri bae hahavaia totona.
2SA.20.7.english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

2SA.16.17.motu: Bena Absalom ese Husai e hamaoroa, eto, Turamu enai emu heabidadama binai a? Dahaka dainai turamu ida asiola?
2SA.16.17.english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

2SA.10.3.motu: A Amono lohiadia ese Hanunu, edia pavapava, e hereva henia, eto, Oi na o laloamu David ese tauhalo taudia na dekemu ai vada e siaidia tamamu e matauraiamu dainai a? David ese ena hesiai taudia dekemu ai vada e siaidia badina korikori be hanua bae loaia, bae hasinadoa, bena bae hadarerea, ani?
2SA.10.3.english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Hasn’t David sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?”

2SA.22.32.english: For who is God, besides Yahweh?

2SA.10.12.motu: Ba goada balaheni; baita haheauka, eda bese dainai, bona eda Dirava ena hanua daidiai; Iehova ese ena lalo-hadai namodia heḡereḡeredia do baine kara.
2SA.10.12.english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may Yahweh do what seems good to him.”

2SA.23.28.motu: Salmon, tau Ahohi; Maharai, tau Netofa;
2SA.23.28.english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

2SA.13.2.motu: Heḡahusi ese lalona e gugubaia, bena e gorerea, taihuna Tamara dainai; badina be ia na hane-ulato rami-hebou, bona Amnon na asi ena dala ta ienai.
2SA.13.2.english: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.

2SA.14.28.motu: Taunabunai, Absalom na Ierusalem ai e nohova, hanua pavapavana dekenai se raka vareai, ela bona Iaḡani rua vada e ore.
2SA.14.28.english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

2SA.22.33.motu: Ina Dirava na egu roho-mauri gabuna aukana;

2SA.19.31.motu: Barasilai, tau Gilead, na Rogelim amo ema, hanua pavapavana e bamoa ela bona Ioridane sinavaina, sinavai amo baine hakaua hanai totona.
2SA.19.31.english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

2SA.10.18.motu: Bena Suria taudia na Israel taudia vairadiai e heau. Suria edia kariota sinahu hitu taudia bona hosi gui taudia gerebu hani David ese e aladia mase; Sobaka danu, edia tuari lohiana, e haberoa, bena unuseni ai e mase.
2SA.10.18.english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the captain of their army, so that he died there.

2SA.15.3.motu: Absalom ese bema hereva henia, bema toma, A kamonai, emu hereva na namo bona maoro, a tau ta hanua pavapavana ese se duanaia baine hahemaoro henimu.
2SA.15.3.english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

2SA.12.4.motu: Nega ta laolao tauna ta ema, una taga tauna dekenai; bena una taḡa tauna na lalona se ura iena mamoe ta eiava nani ta ena seri amo baine abia, baine nadua, laolao tauna ana. A ia be ogoḡami tauna ena mamoe natuna e abia, e nadua, ena vadivadi tauna ana.
2SA.12.4.english: A traveler came to the rich man, and he didn’t want to take of his own flock and of his own herd to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

2SA.2.9.motu: pavapava ai e halaoa: Gilead bona Asuru bona Iesrele bona Efraim bona Beniamina oreadia edia pavapava, bona Israel idoinai pavapavana.
2SA.2.9.english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

2SA.20.3.motu: David na ena ruma ai e kau, Ierusalem ai; bena hanua pavapavana ese e adavadia hahinedia gwautaosi, hari ruma inarina totona e rakatanidia hahinedia, na e abidia, ruma ta ai e koudia ahu mai igimadia; unuseni ai e ubudia, a dekediai se raka vareai. Taunabunai idia na e hekou ahu, e nohova vabu na heheto, ela bona e mase.
2SA.20.3.english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

2SA.7.27.motu: Badina oi, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ese emu hesiai tauna vada o hahedinarai henia, oto “Emu iduhu baina haginia”. Una dainai emu hesiai tauna ese goada vada e davaria, ini baine ḡuriḡun henimu toma.
2SA.7.27.english: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

2SA.24.4.motu: A hanua pavapavana ena hereva ese Ioab bona tuari biagudia edia hereva e laodia ahu. Taunabunai, Ioab bona tuari biagudia ese hanua pavapavana vairana amo e raka lasi, Israel taudia bae hagaudia totona.
2SA.24.4.english: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

2SA.5.23.motu: A David ese Iehova e nanadaia negana ai, Iehova ese e haere henia, eto, Basiola; a ba rakadia hegeḡe, bona muridia kahana amo ba hahoadia, baka audia italaidia.
2SA.5.23.english: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

2SA.5.17.motu: Filistia taudia hari e kamonai David vada e horoa, Israel pavapavana; bena Filistia taudia iboudiai na e tore isi, David itahuna ela. A David e kamonai, bena ena kohoro ela.
