2SA.5.17.english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

2SA.3.39.motu: Ena be e horogu, pavapava ai e halaogu, to hari ina dina ai vada na manoka-manokamu; ina Seruia natuna na egu ai eme auka herea. Iehova ese kara dika tauna davana do baine henia, ena kara dika heḡereḡerena.
2SA.3.39.english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

2SA.1.1.motu: Saulo ena mase murinai, David na Amalek taudia ialadia amo e lou; bena David na dina rua e nohova Siklag ai.
2SA.1.1.english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

2SA.15.1.motu: Una murinai Absalom ese ena kariota ta e abia, bona hosi, bona tatau imahui, ia vairanai bae heau.
2SA.15.1.english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

2SA.19.2.motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai kwalimu na taitai ai e hahelao, taunimanima iboudiai ediai; badina be una dina ai idia e kamonai “Hanua pavapavana na natuna dainai lalona e hisihisimu”.
2SA.19.2.english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

2SA.22.46.motu: Idau bese taudia na kudoudia e hetaha;

2SA.19.43.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iuda taudia e haere henidia, eto, Ai ahumai na gwauta, hanua pavapavana enai; David enai ai ahumai na bada, umui ahumui be maraḡi. Matona, dahaka dainai o dadaraimaimu? Ai na asia guna, hanua pavapavana iabi-louna dalana iherevalaina ai a? A Iuda taudia edia hereva daḡedaḡena na bada, Israel taudia edia hereva daḡedaḡena na maraḡi.
2SA.19.43.english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

2SA.12.28.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima oredia ba haboudia, hanua na ba koua heḡeḡe, bavabia, lau ese hanua baina abia bena ladagu bae nemailaia na garina.
2SA.12.28.english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city and take it; lest I take the city, and it be called by my name.”

2SA.19.24.motu: Bena Mefiboset, Saulo dihina, na hanua pavapavana ihedavan-henina ema. Aena se haḡoevadiava, aukina huina se utuava, bona ena dabua se huridiava, hanua pavapavana e raka oho dinana amo ema bona mai namona ida e lou mai.
2SA.19.24.english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

2SA.7.28.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi na Dirava; emu hereva na momomo-kakani. Ina ḡau namona emu hesiai tauna vada o gwaurai henia hamata;
2SA.7.28.english: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

2SA.5.5.motu: Laḡani hitu hua tauratoi ia ese Iuda iduhuna e lohiaia Heberon ai, ma laḡani toi-ahui toi ia ese Israel idoinai bona Iudea idoinai e lohiadia Ierusalem ai.
2SA.5.5.english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

2SA.10.4.motu: Taunabunai, Hanunu ese David ena hesiai taudia e abidia, aukidia huidia kahadia e utudia oho, bona edia hahedoki e utudia kwadogi ela bona koekoedia; bena e siaidia oho.
2SA.10.4.english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

2SA.3.36.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese e haeroa, bona lalodia e namo, hanua pavapavana ena kara iboudiai ese lalodia e hanamodiava heḡereḡerena.
2SA.3.36.english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

2SA.24.8.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese tano idoinai e rakaia hanai, ela bona Ierusalem ai ma e kau. Edia laolao dinadia na hua taurahani-ta bona dina ruahui.
2SA.24.8.english: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

2SA.6.20.motu: Bena David na e lou ela, ena ruma taudia baine hanamodia eto. A Saulo natuna hahinena, Mikala, e raka lasi, David ida e hedavari, eto, Israel pavapavana han dina ai sibona dahaka heimodai? Ena hesiai kekenidia vairadiai sibona e heruharuha, tau-kavakava e heruherahamu asi hemaraina na heto.
2SA.6.20.english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

2SA.11.10.motu: Haida ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Uria na ena ruma sela. Bena David ese Uria e hereva henia, eto, Oi na laolao amo vada oma ani? Dahaka dainai emu ruma sola?
2SA.11.10.english: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

2SA.18.31.motu: Bena Kusu tauna e kau. Kusu tauna eto, Hari namona, egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu. Badina be hari dina ai Iehova ese e tuari henimuva taudia iboudiai edia siahu amo vada e harohomu mauri.
2SA.18.31.english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for Yahweh has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

2SA.14.30.motu: Bena ia ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, Ioab ena uma na lauegu uma badibadinai; ena bali na unuseni ai; aola, a doua. Taunabunai, Absalom ena hesiai taudia ese uma na e doua.
2SA.14.30.english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

2SA.20.21.motu: Una na koikoi. A tau ta Efraim ororodia amo, ladana Sieba Bikri, ese King David vada e tuan henia; ia mo sibona ba henigu, bena hanua amo baina raka oho. Una hahine ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, Benaini, ia kwarana na magu amo baia tahoa hanai emu ai.
2SA.20.21.english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.”

2SA.1.22.english: From the blood of the slain,

2SA.17.18.motu: A mero ta ese e itadia, bena ia ese Absalom e hamaoroa; taunabunai raruosi na e raka oho haraḡa, Bahurimi ela, tau ta ena ruma ai e kau. Una tau na mai ena ranu gurina ta, ena maḡu lalonai; bena raruosi na ranu gurina ai e diho.
2SA.17.18.english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

2SA.5.2.motu: Nega gunadia ai, Saulo ese e lohiadava negadia ai, oi ese ai Israel taumai o hakaumai lasi bona o hakaumai vareai. Bena Iehova ese e hamaoromu, eto “Oi ese egu bese Israel do ba reḡua, bona pavapavana ai baola”.
2SA.5.2.english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

2SA.14.24.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Ia na sibona ena ruma ai baine noho edea, vairagu basinema. Taunabunai, Absalom na sibona ena ruma ai e noho edea, hanua pavapavana dekenai se raka vareai.
2SA.14.24.english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

2SA.11.14.motu: Daba ai, David ese revareva ta e torea, Ioab ena; bena Uria imana ai e siaia.
2SA.11.14.english: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

2SA.1.5.motu: Bena David ese han tau eregabe, una hereva e hamaorolaia tauna, ma e nanadaia, eto, Ede o diba toma Saulo mai natuna lonatan ida vada e mase?
2SA.1.5.english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

2SA.13.37.motu: A Absalom na e heau, Talmai Amihud, Gesuru pavapavana, dekena ela. Bena David na natuna taina e taiva, dina iboudiai.
2SA.13.37.english: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.

2SA.15.24.motu: Abiatara na ema, bona Sadok danu, Levi taudia iboudiai ida, Dirava ena taravatu mauana e huaia; bena idia ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana e atoa diho, ela bona taunimanima iboudiai na hanua badana amo vada e raka lasi.
2SA.15.24.english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

2SA.6.7.motu: Bena Iehova ena badu na Usa latanai e kau; bena Dirava ese e rahua mase, imana e toia roro maua helaḡana enai e kau kau dainai; bena unuseni ai e mase, Dirava ena maua helaḡana badibadinai.
2SA.6.7.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

2SA.4.3.motu: Beroto taudia na e heau, Gitaimi ela, unuseni ai e noho hedoamu ema bona hanhan).
2SA.4.3.english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

2SA.11.4.motu: Taunabunai, David ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, hahine na e abia; hahine na ia dekena ema, bena raruosi e eno bou. (Una negana ai, ia na hahine gorerena amo do e haheḡoevava). Bena hahine na ena ruma e lou lao.
2SA.11.4.english: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

2SA.15.21.motu: A Itai ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava, o maurimu heḡereḡerena, egu lohia bona egu pavapava ba noho gabuna ai lau, emu hesiai tauna, danu baina noho henia, mase ai eiava maun ai.
2SA.15.21.english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As Yahweh lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

2SA.7.17.motu: Ini hereva iboudiai bona ina mata-hanai idoinai heḡereḡeredia, Natan ese David e hamaorolaia.
2SA.7.17.english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

2SA.13.17.motu: Bena ia ese ena hesiai merona e boina, eto, Ina hahine na vairagu amo avabia oho, bena ia murinai iduara ba koua ahu kunuka-kunuka.
2SA.13.17.english: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, “Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.”

2SA.15.15.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, A itaia, emu hesiai taudia vada heheḡaeḡae; emai lohia bona emai pavapava emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baia kara.
2SA.15.15.english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

2SA.19.19.motu: e hereva henia, eto, Egu lohia e, basioto lau na kerere, bona emu hesiai tauna egu kerere, egu lohia bona egu pavapava na Ierusalem o rakatania dinana ai na havaraia, na basio laloa une; hanua pavapavana ese basioma laloa tao.
2SA.19.19.english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

2SA.20.4.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Amasa e hamaoroa, eto, Iuda taudia ba boiridia, dina toi do basie ore idia na lau dekegu ai bae hebou iniseni ai, bona oi danu baoma.
2SA.20.4.english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

2SA.1.14.motu: David ese ma e nanadaia, eto, Edeheto oi na imamu itoi-rorona, Iehova ese e horoa tauna iala-masena, na garina to gari a?
2SA.1.14.english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”

2SA.24.2.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ese Ioab bona ena tuari biagudia e hamaorodia, eto, Israel iduhudia iboudiai ba rakadia hanai, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba, bona taunimanima iboudiai ba hagaudia, baina diba idia be hahida.
2SA.24.2.english: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

2SA.22.38.motu: Lau inaigu na hahavadia, na lasidia tao;
2SA.22.38.english: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them.

2SA.3.38.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Umui asi dibamui a, lohia tauna, tau badana ta, hari ina dina ai vada e mase Israel ai.
2SA.3.38.english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

2SA.15.23.motu: Unu taunimanima iboudiai e raka hanaiva negana ai, hanua hanua taudia ibouboudiai na e tai lolova. Hanua pavapavana ese sinavai maragina ladana Kidron e hanaia, bena taunimanima iboudiai na tano ḡaḡaena dalana amo e raka ela.
2SA.15.23.english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

2SA.23.5.motu: Momokani, Dirava ese egu iduhu na unu vada e tomaia ani?
2SA.23.5.english: Isn’t my house so with God?

2SA.23.4.motu: ia na idia latadiai e diarimu, daba e reremu na heto,
2SA.23.4.english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises,

2SA.23.39.motu: bona Uria, Hiti tauna. Iboudiai na toi-ahui hitu.
2SA.23.39.english: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

2SA.1.26.motu: Tadigu Ionatan e, lalogu na e hisihisi hereamu oi daimu ai.
2SA.1.26.english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan.

2SA.20.1.motu: Kara-kava kara-kava tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Sieba Bikri, Beniamina tauna ta. Ia ese kibi e hiriria, bena eto,
2SA.20.1.english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

2SA.23.8.motu: David ena goada-herea taudia ladadia bini: loseb-basebete, Takemono tauna; tuari lohiadia tatoiosi bogaragidiai gini gunana be ia. Ia ese tatau sinahu-taurahani na nega tamona ai ena io amo e aladia mase.
2SA.23.8.english: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

2SA.16.3.motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, Biagumu natuna be edeseni ai? Siba ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Ia na Ierusalem ai e nohomu; badina be ia na eto “Hari dina ai Israel taudia ese tamagu ena basileia na ma bae henigu lou”.
2SA.16.3.english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?”

2SA.8.11.motu: ini danu King David ese e hahelagadia, Iehova ena, vada e hadareredia besedia iboudiai edia amo e abi bona e hahelaḡa gold-na bona silver-na ida.
2SA.8.11.english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

2SA.5.1.motu: Bena Israel iduhudia iboudiai na David dekena ela, Heberon ai, eto, Ai na oi turiamu bona oi hidiomu.
2SA.5.1.english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

2SA.4.10.motu: tau ta ese e hamaorogu, eto “A kamonai, Saulo vada e mase”, bona e laloa ia na hari namona ta vada e mailaia, negana ai na na dabaia tao, Siklag ai na alaia mase, ena hari davana unu na henia toma.
2SA.4.10.english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

2SA.18.11.motu: Ioab ese hari e hamaoroa tauna na e gwau henia, eto, Be, o itaia a? Matona, so lapaia dobi tano ai? Silver monidia gwauta bona gaba ḡauna ta bama henimu mai moalegu ida.
2SA.18.11.english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

2SA.1.3.motu: David ese e nanadaia, eto, Ede amo oma? Ia e haere, eto, Lau na Israel taudia edia taruha amo vada na roho mauri.
2SA.1.3.english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?”

2SA.2.25.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia e hebou, Abnere murinai; orea tamona ai e hahebou, ororo ta dorina ai e gini.
2SA.2.25.english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

2SA.13.38.motu: Taunabunai Absalom na e heau, Gesuru ela, laḡani toi unuseni ai e nohova.
2SA.13.38.english: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

2SA.15.34.motu: A hanua ba lou lao, Absalom ba hereva henia, baoto “Hanua pavapavana e, lau na emu hesiai tauna ai bainala; nega gunadia ai tamamu isiaina na Iao heniva heḡereḡerena, harihari oi isiaimu baina lao heni”. Unu amo oi ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai ba utu, lau daigu ai.
2SA.15.34.english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

2SA.17.13.motu: A bema hanua ta ai baine raka vareai, Israel taudia iboudiai na kwanau bae laohai, una hanua na baita veria dobi, ela bona koura lalonai, ela bona ia nadina momoruna ta basine mia.
2SA.17.13.english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

2SA.3.22.motu: Una negana ai, David ena hesiai taudia na Ioab ida tuari amo e kau; e dadi kohudia momo e mailai. A Abnere na dia David dekenai Heberon ai; badina be vada e siaia oho, bena mai mainona ida ela.
2SA.3.22.english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

2SA.13.34.motu: A Absalom na e heau. Bena tau eregabe, kito tauna, na e gaga isi, e roha lao, taunimanima hutuma na Horonaimi dalana amo e maiva, ororo gabaena ai.
2SA.13.34.english: But Absalom fled. The young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming by way of the hillside behind him.

2SA.7.5.motu: Aola, egu hesiai tauna David ba hamaoroa, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu noho rumana auta ba haginia a?
2SA.7.5.english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

2SA.21.3.motu: Bena David ese Gibeon taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Ede baina kara henimui toma? Dika davana na ede baina halou henirnui toma, bena umui ese Iehova dihina ba hanamoa?
2SA.21.3.english: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless Yahweh’s inheritance?”

2SA.16.12.motu: A reana Iehova ese egu hisihisi baine itaia, bena hari dina ai Iehova ese dava namona ta baine henigu, ina heuduguirai davana.
2SA.16.12.english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

2SA.1.16.motu: David ese e hamaoroa, eto, Raramu be sibomu kwaramu ai, badina be sibomu vada o hahebade, oto “Iehova ese e horoa tauna na na alaia mase”.
2SA.1.16.english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”

2SA.7.12.motu: Emu dina bae ore, bena tubumu tamamu ida ba hekure, negana ai lau ese natumu baina haginia oi murimu ai; ia na oi tau-animu amo baine vara, bona lau ese ena basileia baina haginia.
2SA.7.12.english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

2SA.2.22.motu: Bena Abnere ese Asahele e hereva henia lou, eto, Iḡavagu amo ba raka siri; baina gwadamu mase anina be dahaka? Kakamu Ioab vairanai ede baina igo isi toma?
2SA.2.22.english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

2SA.21.14.motu: Bena Saulo bona natuna Ionatan turiadia na Sela ai, Beniamina tanona ai, e guridia, tamana Kisa ena gara gabuna ai. Hanua pavapavana ena hahedua idoinai heḡereḡerena ai e karaia. Una murinai Dirava ese edia noinoi tano dainai vada e abia dae.
2SA.21.14.english: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

2SA.24.23.motu: Pavapava e, Arauna ese ini ḡau iboudiai na hanua pavapavana e heniamu. Arauna ese hanua pavapavana ma e hereva henia, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine abimu dae.
2SA.24.23.english: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May Yahweh your God accept you.”

2SA.23.24.motu: Ioab tadina Asahele na toiahuiosi taudia ta. Oredia bini: Elhanan Dodo, tau Betelehem;
2SA.23.24.english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

2SA.3.30.motu: Badina bunai Ioab bona tadina Abisai ese Abnere e alaia mase, badina be ia ese Gibeon tuarina ai idia tadidia Asahele e alaia mase davana.
2SA.3.30.english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

2SA.23.18.motu: Abisai Seruia, Ioab tadina, ese hari lohia toiahuiosi na e biagudiava. Ia ese tatau sinahu-toi na ena io amo e aladia mase; bena ia harina na hari tatoiosi haridia ida e haheḡereḡeredia.
2SA.23.18.english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

2SA.24.25.motu: Bena David ese ihaboulaina patana ta unuseni ai e larebaia, Iehova ena; bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia. Taunabunai, Iehova ese noinoi tano dainai na e kamonaidia, bona dai-hanai gorerena na Israel ena amo e hegwau tao.
2SA.24.25.english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahweh was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

2SA.14.25.motu: Israel idoinai raho-namo tauna ta asie imodaiava, Absalom heḡereḡerena; aena henuna amo ela bona kwarana tubuana ia na asi bebeka-bebekana.
2SA.14.25.english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

2SA.24.15.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese dai-hanai gorerena ta Israel latanai e siaia, daba amo, ela bona e gwauraia negana e ore. Bena Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba taunimanima gerebu-hitu e mase.
2SA.24.15.english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

2SA.6.14.motu: Bena David na Iehova vairanai e mavaru, mai goadana idoinai; ia ese hahedoki helaḡana, dabua aukana amo e karaia ḡauna, e hahedokilaia.
2SA.6.14.english: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

2SA.24.13.motu: Taunabunai, Gad na David dekena ela, e hamaoroa, eto, Laḡani toi lalodiai doe na emu tano ai baine kau a? Eiava, hua toi lalodiai inaimu ese bae hahavamu, bena vairadia amo ba heau a? Eiava, dina toi lalodiai gorere na emu tano ai baine dai hanai a? Ba haeroa, bena ba hereva, e siaigu Diravana ese ede baina haere henia toma.
2SA.24.13.english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

2SA.11.8.motu: Bena David ese Uria e hamaoroa, eto, Emu ruma aola, aemu ba huridia. Bena Uria na hanua pavapavana ena ruma amo e diho, bona hanua pavapavana ese herahia ḡauna ta ia murina amo e siaia.
2SA.11.8.english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

2SA.12.10.motu: Benaini, dare na emu ruma amo basine heabi oho ela bona hanaihanai; badina be lau vada o dadaraigu, bona Uria tau Hiti adavana vada o abia, oi adavamu ai vada o halaoa.
2SA.12.10.english: Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken Uriah the Hittite’s wife to be your wife.’

2SA.22.7.motu: Egu hisihisi ai Iehova na boi henia,
2SA.22.7.english: In my distress, I called on Yahweh.

2SA.8.10.motu: Bena Toi ese natuna loram na King David dekena e siaia lao, baine hahenamo henia bona baine imodaia totona, ia ese Hadadesere vada e tuan henia bona vada e hadarerea dainai; badina be una Hadadesere na nega momo Toi ida vada e tuan. Ioram na gold gaudia bona silver gaudia bona bronze gaudia e mailaidia;
2SA.8.10.english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

2SA.13.1.motu: David natuna Absalom na mai taihuna ta, ladana na Tamara; ia na hane namo. Nega ta e kau David natuna ta, ladana na Amnon, ese e ura henia.
2SA.13.1.english: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

2SA.23.34.motu: Elifelete Ahasabai, tau Maaka; Eliama Ahitofel, tau Gilo;
2SA.23.34.english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

2SA.10.15.motu: Suna taudia na vada e diba, Israel taudia ese vada e hadareredia, bena idia na e hegogo.
2SA.10.15.english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.

2SA.11.18.motu: Bena Ioab na hereva e siaia, tuan harina idoinai David e hamaorolaia.
2SA.11.18.english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

2SA.22.47.motu: Iehova na e maurimu; egu nadi-gini na hanamoamu;

2SA.19.3.motu: Bena una dina ai taunimanima na asi rakirakidia hanua lalonai e didi vareai helada, tuari amo e heau bena mai hemaraidia ida asi rakirakidia edia hanua ai e raka vareai helada taudia na heheto.
2SA.19.3.english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

2SA.23.23.motu: Ia na mai harina unu toiahuiosi bogaragidiai; ḡau tamona hari tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere. Bena David ese ia igimana oreana biaguna ai e halaoa.
2SA.23.23.english: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

2SA.20.2.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia iboudiai ese David e rakatania, Sieba Bikri murina amo ela; a Iuda taudia ese edia hanua pavapavana e ḡavaia, Ioridane sinavaina amo ela bona Ierusalem.
2SA.20.2.english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

2SA.13.14.motu: A ia na erena se kamonai; bena mai goadana dainai e butua tao, e hadikaia.
2SA.13.14.english: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.

2SA.20.22.motu: Bena hahine ese hanua taudia iboudiai dekedia ela, mai aonegana ida e hereva henidia. Bena idia ese Sieba Bikri kwarana e utua oho, e tahoa lasi Ioab enai. Taunabunai, ia ese kibi e hiriria, bena idia na una hanua amo e raka oho, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela. Bena Ioab na Ierusalem e lou lao, hanua pavapavana dekena ela.
2SA.20.22.english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

2SA.2.3.motu: Bena David ese ena orea taudia e hakaudia dae; iboudiai na edia ruma taudia ida ela. Bena Heberon hanuadia ai e nohova.
2SA.2.3.english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

2SA.3.31.motu: Bena David ese Ioab bona ena orea taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Emui dabua ba dare, puse dabuadia ba hedokilai, Abnere taina ba tai. Hanua pavapavana David na mase patana murinai e raka.
2SA.3.31.english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

2SA.19.33.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Barasilai e hamaoroa, eto, Aita hanai, lau ese baina narimu Ierusalem ai.
2SA.19.33.english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

2SA.15.12.motu: Absalom ese hahelaḡa karadia e karava lalonai ia ese hereva e siaia, David iduruna tauna ta ladana Ahitofel, tau Gilo, enai, ena hanua Gilo amo bainema eto. Lalo-hadai dikana e henegalaia bada; bona Absalom enai e taova taudia na e hutuma e laova.
2SA.15.12.english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

2SA.16.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Siba e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai ini ḡau vada o mailai. Siba e haere, eto, Doniki na hanua pavapavana ena ruma taudia edia gui ḡaudia; flaoa bona au huahuadia na eregabe taudia adia; vine ranuna na tano gaḡaena ai bae manori taudia ese bae inua.
2SA.16.2.english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?”

2SA.3.35.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai na David dekena ela, lalona e ania toho, ia na dina ai do baine aniani. A David na hereva metauna e gwauraia, eto, Dina do basine diho ai flaoa eiava aniani ḡauna ta baina mamia toho, Dirava ese do baine hadikagu, baine hadikagu bada.
2SA.3.35.english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

2SA.17.22.motu: Bena David bona e bamoava taudia iboudiai na e tore isi, Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia. Daba ai, iboudiai vada e hanai, ta se noho.
2SA.17.22.english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

2SA.3.25.motu: Oi dibamu Abnere Nere na ikoimu totona ema, emu raka lasi emu raka vareai bona emu kara iboudiai baine diba totona.
2SA.3.25.english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

2SA.11.24.motu: Una negana ai peva taudia ese maḡu amo emu hesiai taudia e tarakidia, bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia haida na e mase; emu hesiai tauna Uria, tau Hiti, danu e mase.
2SA.11.24.english: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

2SA.23.15.motu: Bena David na mai lalo-hekisehekisena ida e hereva, eto, Ta ese Betelehem ikoukouna badibadinai e miamu gurina amo ranu kuri ta bema henigu, bama inua.
2SA.23.15.english: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

2SA.13.23.motu: Laḡani heboudia rua e lao bubuni. Bena Absalom ena mamoe huidia iutudia taudia na Baal-hasoro ai, Efraim badinai. Bena Absalom ese hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia iboudiai e vavedia.
2SA.13.23.english: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim; and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

2SA.14.11.motu: Hahine ma eto, Namona be hanua pavapavana ese Iehova, emu Dirava, do ba hahanea, bena rara davana iabina tauna basine ala-ala lou, bona natugu na basine mase. Hanua pavapavana eto, Iehova e maunmu heḡereḡerena, natumu huina tamona na tano ai basine moru.
2SA.14.11.english: Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.”

2SA.15.37.motu: Taunabunai David turana Husai na hanua lalonai e raka vareai, Absalom na Ierusalem ai e dae kau negana ai.
2SA.15.37.english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

2SA.24.1.motu: Iehova ena badu ma e vara lou Israel taudia latadiai. Bena idia ihadikadia totona ia ese David e dibaḡania, eto, Aola, Israel taudia bona Iuda taudia ba hagaudia lao.
2SA.24.1.english: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

2SA.22.41.motu: Lau inaigu o hakerehaidia lau vairagu ai;
2SA.22.41.english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me,

2SA.9.6.motu: Bena Mefiboset, Ionatan Saulo natuna, na David dekenai e kau; bena e goru diho, e toma henia diho. David eto, Meribosel. Ia na e haere, eto, Lau binai emu hesiai tauna.
2SA.9.6.english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?”

2SA.3.29.motu: Ioab latanai, bona tamana ena iduhu taudia latadiai, baine kau. Uru iboudiai Ioab ena iduhu ai haida na enobougorerena bae davaria, eiava bae lepra, eiava hahine edia ḡaukara bae kara, eiava dare amo bae mase, eiava bae hitolo.
2SA.3.29.english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

2SA.16.1.motu: David ese ororo dorina taina e rakaia hanai, bena ia na Siba, Mefiboset ena hesiai tauna, ida e hedavari. Hari Siba ese doniki rua e hakaudia, edia maduna na flaoa igabu sinahu-rua, vine huahuadia kaukaudia tako sinahu-ta, au huahuadia idau-idau sinahu-ta, bona vine ranuna kopi ta.
2SA.16.1.english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

2SA.5.9.motu: Bena David na una kohoro ai e nohova, ladana e hatoa “David ena hanua”. David ese danu hanua ma e hadaia heḡeḡe, hetoa ladana Milo lalonai.
2SA.5.9.english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

2SA.13.3.motu: A Amnon na mai turana ta, ladana na Ionadab, David kakana Simea natuna; hari Ionadab na kara hegui-heḡui tauna.
2SA.13.3.english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

2SA.22.14.motu: Iehova ese guba-rahua ai e hereva,

2SA.13.31.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e tore isi, sibona ena dabua e dare, bona tano ai e goru diho. Ena hesiai taudia una gabu ai gigini iboudiai danu sibodia edia dabua e dare.
2SA.13.31.english: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

2SA.23.3.motu: Israel ena Dirava vada e hereva,

2SA.23.32.motu: Eliaba, tau Saalbon; lasene natuna; Ionatan;
2SA.23.32.english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

2SA.13.11.motu: A ianidia totona ia dekena e laohai negana ai, ia ese e rosia, eto, Taihugu e, aoma, aita eno bou.
2SA.13.11.english: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”

2SA.20.10.motu: A Amasa na dare se itaia, Ioab imana ai. Taunabunai, Ioab ese ia bogana e gwadaia, bona bogarauna na tano ai e heḡiḡi dobi; ma se gwadaia harua. A tau na e mase.
2SA.20.10.english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

2SA.3.2.motu: David ese natuna mamaruanedia haida e havaradia Heberon ai. Roboana na Amnon; ia na Ahinoama, hane Iesrele, natuna.
2SA.3.2.english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

2SA.12.3.motu: a ogoḡami tauna ena mauri ḡauna na tamona mo, mamoe natuna hahinena ta, e hoia ḡauna. Ia ese e ubua; ia natuna ida ia badibadinai e bada oho bada oho; ana aniani bahudia e ani, bona ena kebere amo ranu e inu, bona kopana ai e hekure, ia natuna kekenina na heto.
2SA.12.3.english: but the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised. It grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food, drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was like a daughter to him.

2SA.20.23.motu: Ioab ese Israel tuari oreana idoinai e biaguava; Benaia Iehoiada ese Kerete taudia bona Pelete taudia e biagudiava;
2SA.20.23.english: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

2SA.7.15.motu: A egu hebogahisi na iena amo basina abia oho, Saulo ena amo na abia oho heḡereḡerena, ia na oi vairamu amo na atoa siri negana ai.
2SA.7.15.english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

2SA.2.13.motu: Bena loab Seruia, David ena hesiai taudia ida, na e raka lasi, Gibeon gohugohuna isena ai idia ida e hedavari. Bena e helai diho, orea ta gohugohu kahana ai, ma orea ta kahana ai.
2SA.2.13.english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

2SA.20.24.motu: Adorama ese e haḡaukaradiava taudia na e biagudiava. Iehosafat Ahilud na e tore pepadia inaridia tau;
2SA.20.24.english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

2SA.1.4.motu: David ese ma e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka e vara? A hamaorogu. Ia ma e haere, eto, Orea taudia na tuari amo e heau, bena hutuma vada e keto, vada e mase; Saulo mai natuna lonatan ida danu vada e mase.
2SA.1.4.english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.”

2SA.7.29.motu: taunabunai, mani emu kara emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu ba hanamoa, bena oi vairamu ai baine hesiriu hanaihanai. Badina be, Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi ese vada o gwauraia, bona oiemu hahenamo ese emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu baine hanamoa, ela bona hanaihanai.
2SA.7.29.english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

2SA.7.18.motu: Bena King David e raka vareai, Iehova vairanai e helai, eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, lau be daika, bona egu iduhu be dahaka? Matona, oi ese vada o hakaugu ema bona hari.
2SA.7.18.english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

2SA.3.28.motu: Gabeai, David e kamonai negana ai, ia eto, Lau bona egu basileia na asi emai kerere Iehova vairanai, Abnere Nere rarana dainai.
2SA.3.28.english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

2SA.17.7.motu: Bena Husai ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Ina nega ai Ahitofel ese vada e henimui lalo-hadaina na dia namo.
2SA.17.7.english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

2SA.22.11.motu: Kerubi ai e gui, e roho lao;
2SA.22.11.english: He rode on a cherub, and flew.

2SA.11.9.motu: A Uria na hanua pavapavana ena ruma iduarana ai e mahuta, ena lohia ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ida; ia na ena ruma korikori sela.
2SA.11.9.english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

2SA.3.26.motu: Ioab na David vairana amo e raka lasi, bena ia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Abnere bae ḡavaia. Bena Siragohugohuna amo e hakaua lou mai; a David na asi dibana.
2SA.3.26.english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

2SA.22.26.motu: Heabidadama tauna oi ese o abidadama heniamu;
2SA.22.26.english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful.

2SA.22.49.motu: Oi ese o imodaigu, lau inaigu daediai;
2SA.22.49.english: who brings me away from my enemies.

2SA.13.9.motu: Bena ia vairanai e bubu diho, a ia ese e dadaraidia. Bena Amnon eto, Iboudiai a siaidia lasi. Taunabunai, iboudiai na iena amo e raka lasi.
2SA.13.9.english: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.

2SA.10.2.motu: Bena David eto, Hanunu Nahasa baina kara momokani henia, tamana ese e kara momokani heniguva heḡereḡerena. Taunabunai, David ese ena hesiai taudia e siaidia, tauna ihalona totona, tamana dainai. Bena David ena hesiai taudia na Arnono taudia edia tano ai e kau.
2SA.10.2.english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

2SA.11.12.motu: Bena David eto, Hari dina ai iniseni ai ba noho, kerukeru baina kahumu nege. Taunabunai, Uria na Ierusalem ai e nohova, una dina bona daba-rerena.
2SA.11.12.english: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

2SA.1.15.motu: Bena David ese eregabe taudia ta e boiria, eto, A ha alaia. Bena e rahua mase.
2SA.1.15.english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

2SA.22.27.motu: Lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva tauna enai oi lalomu danu baine ḡoevaḡoeva;
2SA.22.27.english: With the pure you will show yourself pure.

2SA.23.31.motu: Abialabono, Araba tauna; Asamavete, Bahurimi tauna;
2SA.23.31.english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

2SA.3.16.motu: A adavana ese e bamoa, bona murina amo e tai, ela bona Bahurimi. Bena Abnere ese e hamaoroa, eto, A lou aola. Bena e lou ela.
2SA.3.16.english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

2SA.6.13.motu: Iehova ena maua helaḡana ihuana taudia ese daḡa tauratoi hona e raka, bena ia ese boromakau maruanena ta bona ubu-ubu ḡauna ta e hahelaḡadia bona e aladia mase.
2SA.6.13.english: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

2SA.2.1.motu: Una murinai David ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Iuda hanuadia haida baina dae henidia eiava? Iehova ese e haere henia, eto, A dae lao. David eto Edena baina dae henia? Iehova eto, Heberon.
2SA.2.1.english: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?”

2SA.2.14.motu: Bena Abnere ese loab e hamaoroa, eto, Eregabe taudia na bae tore isi, ita vairadai bae heatu heatu helulu. Ioab eto, Ae tore isi.
2SA.2.14.english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!”

2SA.1.7.motu: Ia e roha mun, e itagu; bena e boirigu. Lau na haere, nato, Lau o ina.
2SA.1.7.english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

2SA.14.9.motu: Tekoa hahinena ese hanua pavapavana ma e hamaoroa, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava, kerere na lau latagu ai bona tamagu ena ruma latanai baine mia; hanua pavapavana bona ena terono na asi kereredia.
2SA.14.9.english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

2SA.21.7.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Saulo tubuna, Mefiboset Ionatan, na e hamauria gunaguna ia bona Ionatan Saulo na Iehova vairanai e gwauhamata heheni dainai.
2SA.21.7.english: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

2SA.12.25.motu: bona gwaukau ta peroveta tauna Natan uduna amo e siaia. Taunabunai, mero ladana ma e hatoa ledidia, Iehova dainai.
2SA.12.25.english: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh’s sake.

2SA.24.21.motu: Bena Arauna eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava na ena hesiai tauna dekegu vada oma badina be dahaka? David eto, Emu uit ikwadina gabuna na baina hoia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta baina larebaia, dai-hanai gorerena na taunimanima edia amo baine heabi-oho helaoreana.
2SA.24.21.english: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?”

2SA.13.30.motu: Idia na dounu dala ai, haida ese hari e laohaia David dekenai, eto, Absalom ese hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia iboudiai vada e aladia mase, ta se mauri.
2SA.13.30.english: While they were on the way, the news came to David, saying, “Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left!”

2SA.23.10.motu: Bena ia na e tore isi, Filistia taudia e aladia ela bona imana e hisihisi bona dare idogo-taona ai imana e hekamo dae. Una dina ai Iehova ese kwalimu badana e karaia; bona orea taudia na ia murinai ela, hari mase taudia edia ḡau iboudiai bae hagogo mo totona.
2SA.23.10.english: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

2SA.12.29.motu: Taunabunai, David ese orea taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Raba ela, e tuari henia ela bona e abia.
2SA.12.29.english: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it.

2SA.12.30.motu: Bena edia hanua pavapavana ena havava ḡauna na kwarana amo e abia oho: metauna be gold talent ta; bona lalonal na mai herahera nadina herea-daena ta. Bena David kwarana ai e atoa kau. Bena kohu momo herea na hanua ai e dadi, e laohai.
2SA.12.30.english: He took the crown of their king from off his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and in it were precious stones; and it was set on David’s head. He brought a great quantity of plunder out of the city.

2SA.2.32.motu: Bena idia ese Asahele e abia, tamana ena gara ai e guria, Betelehem ai. Bena loab mai ena orea taudia ida e raka rani; daba e rere, idia na Heberon ai e kau.
2SA.2.32.english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

2SA.3.33.motu: Bena haulua pavapavana na Abnere taina e tai, eto,
2SA.3.33.english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

2SA.22.20.motu: Ia ese taora bada gabuna ai e hakaugu lasi;
2SA.22.20.english: He also brought me out into a large place.

2SA.19.37.motu: Mani emu kara emu hesiai tauna do baina lou lao, egu hanua korikori ai baina mase, tamagu bona sinagu edia gara badibadinai. A emu hesiai tauna Kimuhamu binai, ia ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava ida baine hanai, bena emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena do ba kara henia.
2SA.19.37.english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

2SA.13.20.motu: Bena taihuna Absalom ese e hereva henia, eto, Taihumu Amnon na oiemu ai e raka vareai a? Taihugu e, asio tai, badina be ia na oi taihumu, asio laloa bada. Taunabunai, Tamara na taihuna Absalom ena ruma ai e nohova mai dara-dokona ida.
2SA.13.20.english: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.”

2SA.9.11.motu: Bena Siba ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava ese ena hesiai tauna vada e henia haheḡanidia iboudiai na emu hesiai tauna ese unu baine kara toma. Taunabunai, Mefiboset na David ena pata ai e anianiva, pavapava natuna ta na heto.
2SA.9.11.english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

2SA.8.14.motu: Edom tanona idoinai ia ese tuari oreadia e hanohodia; bena Edom taudia iboudiai na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela. Iehova ese kwalimu na David e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai.
2SA.8.14.english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

2SA.22.51.motu: Kwalimu badana ia ese ena pavapava e heniamu;
2SA.22.51.english: He gives great deliverance to his king,

2SA.16.9.motu: Bena Abisai Seruia ese hanua pavapavana e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai ina sisia masena ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava e uduguiraimumu? Mani ainala, kwarana baina utua oho.
2SA.16.9.english: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”

2SA.11.22.motu: Taunabunai hari gwaukau tauna ela, bena e kau negana ai Ioab ese e henia herevadia iboudiai na ia ese David e herevalai henia.
2SA.11.22.english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

2SA.16.15.motu: Absalom bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem ai e kau, Ahitofel danu ia ida.
2SA.16.15.english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

2SA.14.32.motu: Bena Absalom ese Ioab e haere henia, eto, Badina be gwau-kau na dekemu ai na siaia, nato “Baoma, hanua pavapavana dekena baina siaimu lao, ba henanadai, baoto: Dahaka dainai Gesuru amo nama? Unuseni ai bama noho ema bona harihari bema namo.” Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana dekenai aina raka vareai na tomu; bena bema mai egu kerere, ia ese baine alagu mase.
2SA.14.32.english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

2SA.10.7.motu: David e kamonai, bena ia ese Ioab mai ena tuari oreadia iboudiai ida e siaidia lao.
2SA.10.7.english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

2SA.15.19.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Itai, tau Gata, e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai oi danu ai ida ta laomu? A lou lao, hanua pavapavana ida ba noho; badina be oi na idau tauna bona noho-hedoa tauna.
2SA.15.19.english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

2SA.18.8.motu: Tuari na una tano idoinai e da'ania guḡuru; hutuma na uda ahu ese e hamasedia, gadoina mo dare ai e mase.
2SA.18.8.english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

2SA.21.9.motu: hahituosi na Gibeon taudia e henidia. Bena Gibeon taudia ese Iehova ena ororo ai e taudia dae; hahituosi na e mase hebou. E hamasedia dinana be taboro matamana ai, bali iutuna e matamaia negana ai.
2SA.21.9.english: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

2SA.22.3.motu: egu Dirava, egu nadi-gini, na abidadama heniamu tauna;
2SA.22.3.english: God is my rock in whom I take refuge;

2SA.13.32.motu: A Ionadab, David tadina Simea natuna, eto, Egu lohia na basine laloa hari eregabe taudia, hanua pavapavana natuna, na iboudiai vada e aladia mase; Amnon sibona vada e mase, Absalom ena haheḡani dainai, badina be lalona unu vada e hadaia toma, hari Amnon ese taihuna Tamara e hadikaia dinana amo ema bona harihari.
2SA.13.32.english: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

2SA.22.28.motu: Badina be lalo-manau taudia na oi ese o hamauridiamu;
2SA.22.28.english: You will save the afflicted people,

2SA.15.10.motu: A Absalom ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia hehuni, Israel iduhudia iboudiai ediai, eto, Kibi reḡena ba kamonai negana ai baoto “Absalom na hanua pavapavana Heberon ai e nohomu”.
2SA.15.10.english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

2SA.12.21.motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia ese e hereva henia, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? Mero maurina ai o ani vaga bona o taitai; a mero na e mase, bena o tore isi, o aniani.
2SA.12.21.english: Then his servants said to him, “What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive, but when the child was dead, you rose up and ate bread.”

2SA.10.1.motu: Una murinai Amono taudia edia pavapava e mase, bona natuna Hanunu ese ia gabuna e abia.
2SA.10.1.english: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.

2SA.6.10.motu: Taunabunai, David lalona na se heḡereḡere, Iehova ena maua helaḡana na David ena hanua ai bae vareailaia. A David ese e heaulaia siri, Obed-edom, tau Gata, ena ruma e laohaia.
2SA.6.10.english: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

2SA.19.42.motu: Bena Iuda taudia iboudiai ese Israel taudia e haere henidia, eto, Badina be hanua pavapavana na ai varavaramai. Ina kara dainai o badu henimaimu badina be dahaka? Ai na hanua pavapavana ena aniani taidia a animu a? Eiava herahia ḡauna ta vada e henimai a?
2SA.19.42.english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

2SA.14.20.motu: Kara iha-idaudia totona emu hesiai tauna Ioab na unu e kara toma. A egu lohia na Dirava ena aneru heḡereḡerena, tanobada ḡaudia iboudiai na mai dibana.
2SA.14.20.english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”

2SA.17.9.motu: A laloa, ina harihan ia na guri ta ai eiava gabu ta ai vada e komumu. Bena tuari baine hematama negana ai haida bema keto, bae kamonai taudia na baeto Absalom murinai e rakamu taudia vada e mase oremu.
2SA.17.9.english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

2SA.19.26.motu: Ia e haere, eto, Pavapava e, egu lohia, egu hesiai tauna ese e koigu; badina be emu hesiai tauna ese na hamaoroa, nato, Doniki ta ba heḡaeḡaelaia, baina gui kau, hanua pavapavana ida bainala. Badina be emu hesiai tauna aegu eme hedairike.
2SA.19.26.english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

2SA.23.22.motu: Ini kara na Benaia lehoiada ese e karava, bena ia harina na unu tatoiosi haridia ida e gwauraidia hebou.
2SA.23.22.english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

2SA.4.4.motu: Ionatan Saulo na mai natuna ta, ae-hedairike merona. Saulo bona Ionatan sivaraidia na Iesrele amo e kau negana ai, una mero ena mauri laḡanidia na ima hona. Bena ireḡuna hahinena ese e abia isi, e heaulaia; heauna ai mero na e moru, bena aena e hedairike. Mero ladana na Mefiboset.
2SA.4.4.english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

2SA.19.38.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e haere, eto, Kimuhamu na lau ida baia hanai, bena oiemu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baina kara henia, bona egu ai ba gwaurai ḡaudia iboudiai do baina henimu.
2SA.19.38.english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

2SA.21.20.motu: Ma e tuari lou Gata ai; unuseni ai tau ḡaulatalatana ta e nohova, imana ruaosi ai bona aena ruaosi ai kwakikwaki be tauratoi tauratoi amo - kwakikwakina iboudiai na ruahui-hani. Ia danu taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta.
2SA.21.20.english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

2SA.20.14.motu: Sieba na Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo e raka hanai ela bona Abele, Bete-maka kahana hanuana ta; bena Bikri ena taunimanima iboudiai e hebou, ia murina amo ela, hanua lalonai e didi vareai.
2SA.20.14.english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

2SA.18.23.motu: Ahimasa eto, Dahaka baine vara na herevana; baina heau. Taunabunai Ioab ese e hamaoroa, elo, A heau. Bena Ahimasa na taora dalana amo e heau, Kusu tauna e heautania.
2SA.18.23.english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.”

2SA.8.16.motu: Ioab Seruia na tuari oreana lohiana; lehosafat Ahilud na e tore pepadia inaridia tau;
2SA.8.16.english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

2SA.3.19.motu: Abnere ese Beniamina taudia danu e hereva henidia. Bena Abnere na Heberon ela, Israel besena bona Beniamina iduhuna idoinai edia lalo-hadai ede bae kara toma eto na David baine hamaorolaia totona.
2SA.3.19.english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

2SA.3.6.motu: Saulo ena orea bona David ena orea e tuari heheniva ai na Abnere ese ena siahu e habadaia, Saulo ena orea ai.
2SA.3.6.english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

2SA.24.3.motu: A Ioab ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese taunimanima na nega sinahu-ta amo baine hahutumadia, bona egu lohia bona egu pavapava matamu ese bae itadia; a dahaka dainai egu lohia bona egu pavapava ese ina kara o moalelaiamu?
2SA.24.3.english: Joab said to the king, “Now may Yahweh your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

2SA.23.11.motu: Ihatatoina be Sama Age, Harara tauna. Filistia taudia na Lehi ai e hebouva; lentil umana ta be unuseni ai. Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau;
2SA.23.11.english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

2SA.24.6.motu: Bena Gilead ai e kau, una murinai Kade ai e kau, Hiti taudia edia tano ai. Una murinai Dan ai e kau; bena Dan amo e raka heḡeḡe ela bona Sidono,
2SA.24.6.english: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

2SA.23.30.motu: Benaia, tau Piratono; Hidai, Gaasa sinavaidia amo;
2SA.23.30.english: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

2SA.3.27.motu: Bena Abnere na Heberon e lou henia negana ai na Ioab ese hanua ikoukouna amo e hakaua siri, baine hereva henia hehuni eto; bena bogana e gwada, bena e mase, ia tadina Asahele rarana davana.
2SA.3.27.english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

2SA.6.15.motu: Taunabunai David bona Israel besena idoinai ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana e daelaia, mai honedia bona mai kibi reḡedia ida.
2SA.6.15.english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

2SA.14.5.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Emu hekwarahi be dahaka? Hahine na e haere, eto, Lau na vabu, adavagu na vada e mase.
2SA.14.5.english: The king said to her, “What ails you?”

2SA.1.11.motu: Bena David ese ena dabua e abi, e daredia; ia bamona iboudiai danu unu e kara toma.
2SA.1.11.english: Then David took hold on his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

2SA.2.6.motu: Iehova ese ena hebogahisi bona ena heabidadama emui ai baine hahedinarai. Bona lau danu baina hanamomui, una kara o karaia dainai.
2SA.2.6.english: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

2SA.18.2.motu: David ese tuari oreana e haria, kaha toi, bena e siaidia lao; kaha ta be Ioab ese e biagua, ma kaha ta Abisai Seruia, Ioab tadina, ese e biagua, ma kaha ihatoina Itai, tau Giti, ese e biagua. Bena hanua pavapavana ese tuari taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Lau danu umui ida baitala.
2SA.18.2.english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

2SA.17.21.motu: Vada e raka oho murinai, idia raruosi na ranu gurina amo e dae; bena ela, King David e hamaoroa. Idia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, sinavai ba hanaia haraḡa; badina be Ahitofel ese oi ihadikamu dalana na unu ini e gwau tomamu.
2SA.17.21.english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

2SA.20.5.motu: Taunabunai, Amasa na Iuda taudia iboiridia ela, to e halahe, vada e gwauraia hamata dinadia ai se lou mai.
2SA.20.5.english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

2SA.19.36.motu: Emu hesiai tauna ese Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai do baina bamomu taina. Anina be dahaka hanua pavapavana ese unu ba hanamogu toma?
2SA.19.36.english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

2SA.1.8.motu: Ia e nanadaigu, eto, Oi be daika? Na haere, nato, Lau na Amalek tauna.
2SA.1.8.english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

2SA.22.48.motu: Dirava ese lau inaigu davadia e henidiamu;
2SA.22.48.english: even the God who executes vengeance for me,

2SA.21.12.motu: bena David na ela, Saulo bona natuna Ionatan turiadia na Iabese-Gilead taudia edia amo e abidia. Badina be Filistia taudia ese Saulo na Gilboa ai e alaia mase dinana ai, idia ese Bete-sana ariarana ai e taudia dae, bena Iabese-Gilead taudia ese unu alno e henaodia.
2SA.21.12.english: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

2SA.14.13.motu: Bena hahine na eto, Dahaka dainai Dirava ena orea taudia na kara idauna amo o kara henidiamu? Badina be ina hereva amo hanua pavapavana ese sibona e hahemaoro henimu; badina be hanua pavapavana ese natuna vada e negea daure bena se hakaua lou mai.
2SA.14.13.english: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

2SA.3.11.motu: Bena Isiboset ese Abnere se haere henia, badina be ia garina e gari.
2SA.3.11.english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

2SA.23.19.motu: Hari toiahuiosi bogaragidiai, ia mo sibona harina vada e bada, bena biagudia ai ela. A ia na unu tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere.
2SA.23.19.english: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

2SA.18.3.motu: A tuari taudia eto, Oi na basiola; badina be ai baiama heau, idia na basiema lalomai. Ena be emai orea kahana bema mase, a basiema lalomai. A oi idaimu na ai gerebu ta heḡereḡerena; taunabunai namona be ikahamai na hanua amo ba siaidia.
2SA.18.3.english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

2SA.21.22.motu: Unu tatau hahaniosi na Cata taudia ḡaubadabadadia garadia; David imana amo bona ena hesiai taudia imadia amo e mase.
2SA.21.22.english: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

2SA.7.16.motu: Emu iduhu bona emu basileia na bae gini tutuka-tutuka vairagu ai, bona emu terono na baine hedai hanainanai.
2SA.7.16.english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

2SA.16.13.motu: Taunabunai David mai ena orea taudia ida na dala amo e raka, a Simei na ororo gabaena ai e raka, ia hegaga-hehenina ai, bena rakana ai e heuduguirai, bona nadi amo e hodoa, bona ḡahu e tahoa.
2SA.16.13.english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

2SA.10.10.motu: A ena tuari taudia eredia na tadina Abisai e henia. baine biagudia, Amono taudia ituari-henidia baela.
2SA.10.10.english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon.

2SA.17.24.motu: David na Mahanaim ai e kau. Bena Absalom ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, Israel taudia iboudiai ida.
2SA.17.24.english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

2SA.19.7.motu: Be, a tore isi, a raka lasi, emu hesiai taudia na hereva namodia ba henidia; badina be Iehova ladana ai na gwaumu, basio raka lasi negana ai, hari hanuaboi tau ta oi dekemu ai basine noho; bena emu ai baine kau dikana ese hahedika gunadia, tauhaumu negana ema bona hanhari, iboudiai na baine hereadia.
2SA.19.7.english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

2SA.11.13.motu: Bena David ese e vavea, bena pavapava vairanai e aniani bona vine ranuna e inu, ela bona vada e hakekeroa. Hanua e boi, bena ia na e raka lasi, ena mahuta gabuna ai e hekure, ena Iohia ena hesiai taudia ida; a ena ruma korikori sela.
2SA.11.13.english: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

2SA.2.23.motu: A lalona e ha-aukaia, se raka siri. Taunabunai, Abnere ese ena io dorina amo ia bogana e gwadaia; bena io na doruna amo e lasi; e keto, bena e keto gabuna ai e mase. Bena Asahele e mase gabuna ai e kau taudia iboudiai na unuseni ai e gini.
2SA.2.23.english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

2SA.19.22.motu: A David eto, Seruia natuna e, dahaka ta kara dainai umui ese hari dina ai ba inai henigu? Hari dina ai tau ta bae hamasea Israel ai a? O tomu asi dibagu a, hari dina ai lau na Israel pavapavana?
2SA.19.22.english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

2SA.22.44.motu: Taunimanima edia tuari amo o hamaurigu;
2SA.22.44.english: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people.

2SA.15.27.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese hahelaḡa tauna Sadok ma e hamaoroa, eto, O itaiamu? Mai mainomu ida hanua a lou henia, oi bona Abiatara, bona natumui raruosi, oi natumu Ahimasa bona Abiatara natuna Ionatan.
2SA.15.27.english: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

2SA.6.22.motu: Hemarai karadia do baina habada, bona oi ese be ba dadaraigu, to unu o gwauraidiamu kekenidia ese be bae imodaigu.
2SA.6.22.english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

2SA.6.8.motu: Bena David na e badu, Iehova ese Usa e rahua mase dainai; bona una gabu ladana e hatoa Perese-usa, ema bona harihari.
2SA.6.8.english: David was displeased because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

2SA.20.16.motu: Bena aonega hahinena ta hanua lalona amo e boiboi, eto, A kamonai, a kamonai; Ioab a hamaoroa, aine raka mai, baina hereva henia.
2SA.20.16.english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

2SA.7.19.motu: A Ḡaubada Iehova e, una na ḡau pipikina oi vairamu ai; oi ese emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu vada o herevalaia, nega dau ai baine vara ḡauna, bona uru gabedia vada o haheitalaigu, Ḡaubada Iehova e!
2SA.7.19.english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord Yahweh!

2SA.18.13.motu: Ina danu, ena mauri bama hadikaia, (ḡau ta hanua pavapavana ena amo basine hehuni diba), oi na boma gini tabe.
2SA.18.13.english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

2SA.23.9.motu: Hari goada taudia tatoiosi bogaragidiai, ihararuana be Eleasara; ia na Dodo Ahohi natuna. Filistia taudia na tuari totona e hebouva bena Israel taudia na e lou negana ai, una tau na David ida.
2SA.23.9.english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

2SA.2.20.motu: Bena Abnere e roha mun, eto, Asahele, ena oi a? Asahele e haere, eto, Ina na lau.
2SA.2.20.english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?”

2SA.2.21.motu: Abnere eto, Idibamu kahana ai eiava laurimu kahana ai a heau siri, eregabe tauna ta ba dabaia tao, ena ḡau ba dadi. A Asahele na Abnere iḡavana amo se heau siri.
2SA.2.21.english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

2SA.5.14.motu: Natuna Ierusalem ai e vara taudia ladadia bini: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Solomon,
2SA.5.14.english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

2SA.5.19.motu: Bena David ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Bainala, Filistia taudia baina tuan henidia eiava? Imagu ai bavatodia eiava? Iehova ese David e haere henia, eto, Aola: momokani lau ese Filistia taudia na oi imamu ai baina atodia.
2SA.5.19.english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?”

2SA.10.13.motu: Taunabunai, Ioab mai bamona ida ela, Suria taudia e tuari henidia, bena idia na ia vairanai e heau.
2SA.10.13.english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

2SA.13.12.motu: Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Taihugu e, lasi, unu basio karagu toma; badina be kara unuhetomana na Israel ai asie karamu. Ina lebulebu karana basio karaia.
2SA.13.12.english: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me! For no such thing ought to be done in Israel. Don’t you do this folly!

2SA.12.27.motu: Bena Ioab ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia, eto, Raba vada na tuari henia, bona ranu hanuana vada na abia.
2SA.12.27.english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

2SA.13.8.motu: Bena Tamara na taihuna Amnon ena ruma ela, e hekureva gabuna ai e raka vareai Bena ia ese flaoa e hapariparia, e kuia, Amnon vairanai ataga e kara, bena e gabudia.
2SA.13.8.english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

2SA.14.21.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioab e hereva henia, eto, A kamonai, na gwau maoromu: aola, eregabe tauna Absalom ba hakaua lou mai.
2SA.14.21.english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

2SA.6.19.motu: bona Israel taudia iboudiai, tatau bona hahine, adia e henidia hagau-hagau, flaoa igabu ta, bona vamu taina, bona vine huahuadia kaukaudia mane ta. Bena taunimanima iboudiai e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela.
2SA.6.19.english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

2SA.21.21.motu: Una tau ese Israel taudia e ḡonaḡonalaidia; bena Ionatan, David kakana Simei natuna, ese e alaia mase.
2SA.21.21.english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

2SA.12.23.motu: A harihari vada e mase; baina ani vaga anina be dahaka? Baina hamauria lou diba a? Lau na ia dekena bainala, a ia na lau dekegu basine lou mai.
2SA.12.23.english: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”

2SA.18.18.motu: Absalom ena mauri ai pupu ta e abia, Pavapava Kourana ai e haginia, ia sibona ena; badina be ia eto “Lau na asi natugu, ladagu ihahedinaraina”. Hari pupu na ia sibona ladana e henemailaia; ladana na doini e hatoamu “Absalom pupuna” ema bona hari dina.
2SA.18.18.english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

2SA.13.7.motu: Bena David ese hereva e siaia Tamara enai; eto, Taihumu Amnon ena ruma aola, ana taina ba ha karaia.
2SA.13.7.english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”

2SA.21.5.motu: Idia ese hanua pavapavana ma e haere henia, eto, E hadikamaiva bona ihabua-tarimai dalana e tahuava tauna, e urava Israel tanona idoinai emai gabu ta basine mia e tomava tauna,
2SA.21.5.english: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

2SA.22.43.motu: Lau ese na botadia patapata, tano ḡahuna na heto;
2SA.22.43.english: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth.

2SA.16.5.motu: King David na Bahurimi ai e kau, bena Saulo varavarana ta unuseni ai, ladana Simei Gera, na e raka lasi; rakana ai ia na e heuduguirai havara havara.
2SA.16.5.english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

2SA.13.35.motu: Bena Ionadab ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, hanua pavapavana natuna na vada ema; emu hesiai tauna e gwauraia heḡereḡerena, unu vada e vara toma.
2SA.13.35.english: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

2SA.11.19.motu: Ia ese gwaukau tauna e hadibadibaia, eto, Tuari harina idoinai hanua pavapavana ba hamaorolaia vaitani, murinai
2SA.11.19.english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

2SA.16.22.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese kalaga auta na ruma guhina latanai e haginia, Absalom ena; bena Absalom na tamana ese e adavadia hahinedia dekediai e raka vareai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
2SA.16.22.english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

2SA.9.1.motu: David eto, Saulo ena iduhu tauna ta noho eiava? Bama kara namo henia, Ionatan dainai.
2SA.9.1.english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

2SA.19.1.motu: Haida ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua pavapavana na e taitaimu, Absalom taina e taimu.
2SA.19.1.english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

2SA.17.16.motu: Taunabunai, hereva ba siaia haraḡa, David ba hamaoroa, baoto “Hari ina hanuaboi tano ḡaḡaena ena turu-hanai gabudia badibadidiai basio noho, a ba hanai vaitani, hanua pavapavana bona e bamoarnu taudia iboudiai bae hadonodia ore na garina”.
2SA.17.16.english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

2SA.17.19.motu: Bena ruma hahinena na ranu gurina e koua ahu, bena latanai uit nadinadidia e ḡiḡi eva-eva. Una kara na tau ta asi dibana.
2SA.17.19.english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

2SA.19.41.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana enai e kau, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka tadikakamai Iuda taudia ese vada e dadihaimai, hanua pavapavana bona ena ruma taudia na Ioridane sinavaina amo vada e hakaudia hanai, bona David ena orea taudia iboudiai danu ia ida.
