2SA.19.41.english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

2SA.22.34.motu: Ia ese lau aegu na dia aedia heḡereḡeredia ai e halaodia;
2SA.22.34.english: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet,

2SA.19.11.motu: Bena King David ese gwaukau ta e siaia, hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara dekediai, eto, Iuda tau-badadia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Badina be dahaka hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna ena ruma ai na o halahemu a Israel taudia iboudiai edia hereva na hanua pavapavana enai vada e kaui
2SA.19.11.english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

2SA.24.10.motu: Bena David na lalona ese e botaia, taunimanima e hagaudia murinai. Bena David ese Iehova e hereva henia, eto, Vada na kerere dikadika egu kara ai. Iehova e, na noimumu, emu hesiai tauna ena dika bavabia oho; badina be vada na kavakava herea.
2SA.24.10.english: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to Yahweh, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

2SA.19.30.motu: Bena Mefiboset ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Vadaeni, idoinai ia ese baine abia; badina be egu lohia bona egu pavapava na mai namomu ida vada o lou mai.
2SA.19.30.english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

2SA.12.14.motu: ḡau tamona, una kara ai Iehova vada o dadaraia vaitani dainai, hari vada e vara merona na do baine mase.
2SA.12.14.english: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”

2SA.23.25.motu: Sama, tau Harod; Elika, tau Harod;
2SA.23.25.english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

2SA.7.26.motu: Bena oi ladamu bae imodaia hanaihanai, baeto “Iehova Sabaota na Israel Diravana”; bona emu hesiai tauna David ena iduhu baine gini tutuka-tutuka vairamu ai.
2SA.7.26.english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

2SA.6.4.motu: Dirava ena maua helagana na rerue latanai, bona Ahio na maua helaḡana vairanai e raka.
2SA.6.4.english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

2SA.19.23.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Simei e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na basio mase. Bena hanua pavapavana ese e gwau henia hamata.
2SA.19.23.english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

2TH.2.13.motu: Varavaramai e, Lohiabada ena lalokau taumui e, ai ese nega idoidiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai. Badina be Dirava ese matamana amo e abimui hidi, Lauma ena hahelaḡa bona hereva momokani iabi-daena daidiai mauri bavabia.
2TH.2.13.english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

2TH.3.4.motu: Ai ese Lohiabada lalonai a abidadama henimuimu, a halḡanimui karadia o karamu bona ba kara.
2TH.3.4.english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

2TH.3.7.motu: Umui dibamui ai ba haḡoimai hari namo; badina be ai na padamui ai asia kara havara-havarava,
2TH.3.7.english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

2TH.2.2.motu: lalomui na basie haraḡa-haraḡa; bona, ena be lauma ta eiava hereva ta eiava revareva ta, ai emai na heto, baineto “Lohiabada ena dina vada be gini daemu”, to kudoumui na basie hetaha.
2TH.2.2.english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

2TH.2.9.motu: Hari dika tauna na Satana ena siahu ai bainema, mai siahu koikoidia, mai toa koikoidia mai hoa karadia koikoidia ida.
2TH.2.9.english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

2TH.2.16.motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bona Tamada Dirava, e lalokau henidamu bona ena harihari-bada ai mia-hanaihanai tauhalona bona helaro-namona vada e henida Diravana, ese
2TH.2.16.english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

2TH.1.3.motu: Varavaramai e, ai na nega idoidiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai. Una na maoro, badina be emui abidadama e badamu, bona emui heura-heheni danu bada.
2TH.1.3.english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

2TH.2.4.motu: Ia ese dirava ai e halaodiamu bona e toma heni dihomu ḡaudia iboudiai e inai henidiamu, bona e hereadiamu e tomu; Dirava ena helai gabuna helaḡana ai e helaimu, sibona Dirava ai e hahelaomu.
2TH.2.4.english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

2TH.1.7.motu: A umui ai ida hisi ta animu tauda laḡada baita ani, Lohiabada Iesu mai ena aneru siahudia ida guba amo baema negana ai, Iahi hururu-hururuna ai bainema.
2TH.1.7.english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

2TH.2.5.motu: Asio helalo unemu a, ta noho hebouva negadia ai ini ḡau na hamaorolaimuiva?
2TH.2.5.english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

2TH.3.10.motu: Dekemui ai a nohova negana ai danu ina haheḡani a henimui, ato “Ta basine ḡaukara, ia na basine aniani”.
2TH.3.10.english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

2TH.3.13.motu: Varavaramai e, kara namo ikarana ai basio hesiku.
2TH.3.13.english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

2TH.2.10.motu: Bona ia ese ena kara gagevagagevadia amo mase dalana ai e rakamu taudia baine koidia; badina be hereva momokani iura-henina ese bema hamauridia, to asie ura henia.
2TH.2.10.english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

2TH.2.12.motu: Bena hereva momokani asie abia dae a kara dika e moalelai taudia na baine hahemaoro henidia.
2TH.2.12.english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

2TH.1.9.motu: Davadia binai: Lohiabada vairana amo bona ena siahu hairaina amo mase hanaihanai bae abia,
2TH.1.9.english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

2TH.1.12.motu: Bena eda Lohiabada Iesu ladana bae imodaia umui daimui ai, bona umui bae imodaimui ia dainai, iseda Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia harihari-bada heḡereḡerena.
2TH.1.12.english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.3.14.motu: Tau ta ese ina revareva ai a tore herevadia basine abi dae, ia toana ba itaia, bona bavatoa tabe, bena kopina baine hemarai.
2TH.3.14.english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

2TH.1.2.motu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo bavabi.
2TH.1.2.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.1.1.motu: Ai tatoiosi, Paulo bona Siluano bona Timoteo, ese Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia ekalesia oreana Tesalonika ai a tore henimuimu:
2TH.1.1.english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

2TH.2.11.motu: Badina binai Dirava ese lalodia baine haduhu, hereva koikoi bae abia dae helaoreana.
2TH.2.11.english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

2TH.3.16.motu: Bena Maino Lohiana ese ena maino baine henimui, nega idoidiai bona gabu iboudiai. Lohiabada ese iboumui ai baine bamomui.
2TH.3.16.english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

2TH.2.14.motu: Una dainai emai sivarai namo amo e boirimui, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso hairaina bavabia helaoreana.
2TH.2.14.english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.3.18.motu: Iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na iboumui ai emui ai baine mia.
2TH.3.18.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

2TH.3.9.motu: Unu a kara tomava, badina he dia asi emai siahudainai, a umui ese ba haḡoimai helaoreana.
2TH.3.9.english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

2TH.3.12.motu: Unu e kara tomamu taudia na Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai a haḡanidiamu bona a sisiba henidiamu, bae ḡaukara manaumanau, sibodia adia malamala bae ani.
2TH.3.12.english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

2TH.3.11.motu: Haida haridia ame kamonai, bogaragimui ai e raka havara-havaramu, asie ḡaukaramu; unu na gado-dae gado-dae taudia.
2TH.3.11.english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

2TH.3.17.motu: Ina hahenamo herevana na lau, Paulo, sibogu imagu amo na toreamu. Egu revareva iboudiai toadia na ini na tore tomamu.
2TH.3.17.english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

2TH.3.6.motu: Varavaramai e, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai a haḡanimuimu, e raka havara-havaramu taudia bona emai hahediba herevadia asie badinamu taudia edia amo ba raka oho.
2TH.3.6.english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

2TH.3.1.motu: Varavaramai e, orena binai: ai daimai ai ba ḡuriḡuri, bena Lohiabada ena hereva na baine pere rohoroho, bena hutuma ese bae imodaia, umui ese o imodaiamu heḡereḡerena;
2TH.3.1.english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

2TH.3.5.motu: Lohiabada ese lalomui baine hakaudia, Dirava ena uraheni ai bona Keriso ena haheauka ai.
2TH.3.5.english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

2TH.1.4.motu: Taunabunai, ai ese Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia vairadiai a heaḡilaimuimu, badina be e butumui taomu daḡedaḡedia bona hisihisidia lalodiai emui haheauka bona emui abidadama o hahedinaraimu.
2TH.1.4.english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

2TH.3.15.motu: To basio inai henia; ba sisiba henia, tadimui na heto.
2TH.3.15.english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

2TH.1.10.motu: ena helaḡa taudia ida heimodai iabma bainema negana ai. Una dina ai abidadama taudia iboudiai bae hoa, badina be emai haroro o abia dae.
2TH.1.10.english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

2TH.2.17.motu: lalomui bae hakeru, bona kara namodia bona hereva namodia iboudiai lalodiai bae hagoadamui.
2TH.2.17.english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

2TH.3.3.motu: A Lohiabada na vada momokani; bena ia ese baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka, dika amo baine hamaurimui.
2TH.3.3.english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

2TH.1.11.motu: Taunabunai, nega idoidiai a ḡuriḡurimu umui daimui ai, Dirava ese baine haeromui ena boiboi ikamonaina ba heḡereḡere, bona ena siahu amo emui ura namodia iboudiai bona emui kamonai karadia baine haḡuḡuru
2TH.1.11.english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

2TH.2.3.motu: Ta ese ḡau ta ai basine koimui; badina be una dina na basine gini dae ela bona raka-muri baine vara, bona dika tauna, hahemase natuna, baine hedinarai guna.
2TH.2.3.english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

2TH.2.15.motu: Taunabunai, varavaramai e, ba gini tutuka-tutuka; udumai amo eiava emai revareva ai a hadibamui herevadia na ba kahu tao tarika-tarika.
2TH.2.15.english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

2TH.3.2.motu: bona ura kerere bona ura dika taudia imadia amo baine hamaurimai. Badina be haida mo mai edia abidadama.
2TH.3.2.english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

2TH.2.1.motu: Varavaramai e, ai a noimuimu, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ma bainema bena ia ida baita hebou dainai
2TH.2.1.english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

2TH.2.8.motu: Una negana ai hari dika tauna baine hedinarai; bena Lohiabada ese baine hahoho henia, baine alaia mase; ia maina diaridiarina ese baine ha-orea.
2TH.2.8.english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

2TH.3.8.motu: bona tau ta ana aniani asia ani kavava; dina hanuaboi a ḡaukarava, a hekwarahiva, umui baia hametaumui na garina.
2TH.3.8.english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

2TH.1.6.motu: Badina be Dirava ena kara maoromaoro binai, e hahisihisimui taudia davadia hisihisi baine henidia.
2TH.1.6.english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

2TH.1.5.motu: Ina na Dirava ena hanemaoro namona toana: ena basileia, bagunai o hisihisimu basileiana, lalonai do ba heḡereḡere.
2TH.1.5.english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

2TH.2.7.motu: Badina be dika na e ḡaukara hehunimu; basine hedinarai ela bona iruna tauna baine heabi oho.
2TH.2.7.english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

2TH.1.8.motu: Dirava asi dibadia taudia bona Lohiabada Iesu ena sivarai namo asie abia daemu taudia davadia do baine henidia.
2TH.1.8.english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

2TH.2.6.motu: Harihari ia iruna tauna dibamui; baine rua ela bona ena nega korikori ai baine hedinarai.
2TH.2.6.english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

2TI.1.13.motu: Hereva momokanidia lauegu amo o kamonaiva ba badinadia tarikatarika, Keriso Iesu iabi-daena ai bona irua-henina ai.
2TI.1.13.english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.5.motu: Tau ta danu gadara gabuna ai baine goada helulu, a gadara taravatuna basine badinaia, ia ese kwalimu toana basine abia.
2TI.2.5.english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

2TI.2.16.motu: A hereva dikadia bona kavakava herevadia amo ba raka oho, badina be idia ese dika bae habadaia.
2TI.2.16.english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

2TI.1.14.motu: E henimu ḡauna namona ba gimaia, Lauma Helaga, ita laloda e noho henimu Laumana, dainai.
2TI.1.14.english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

2TI.4.1.motu: Dirava vairanai na haduamumu, bona Keriso Iesu vairanai danu; ia ese mauri taudia bona mase taudia be hahemaoro henidiamu. Ena mai bona ena basileia daidiai danu na haduamumu:
2TI.4.1.english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

2TI.2.6.motu: Biru tauna ena hekwarahi davana be uma anina baine abi guna.
2TI.2.6.english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

2TI.3.17.motu: Unu amo Dirava ena tau baine ḡoeva dae, bona kara namo iboudiai ikaradia ai baine kwalimu.
2TI.3.17.english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

2TI.1.10.motu: a harihari vada eme hahedinaraia, Keriso Iesu, iseda Hahemauri Tauna, ihahedinaraina ai. Ia ese mase vada e ha-orea; ia ese sivarai namo amo ina mauri bona mauri hanaihanai vada e hadiaridia.
2TI.1.10.english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

2TI.4.14.motu: Alesana, auri labora-labora iḡaukaralaina tauna, ese eme hadikagu herea; Lohiabada ese ena kara davana do baine henia.
2TI.4.14.english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

2TI.1.4.motu: Emu tai na helalo unelaiamu, bona na ura badamu baina itamu, baina moale bada helaoreana.
2TI.1.4.english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

2TI.2.9.motu: bona ia dainai hisi na animu egu iḡui ai, kara dika tauna na heto; ḡau tamona, Dirava ena hereva asie ḡuia.
2TI.2.9.english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

2TI.3.13.motu: Bona kara dika taudia bona koikoi taudia ese edia kara dika bona edia koikoi bae habada; idia ese haida bae koidia bona haida ese idia bae koidia.
2TI.3.13.english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

2TI.2.3.motu: Hisihisi lalodiai ba haheauka, Keriso Iesu ena tuari tauna namona na heto.
2TI.2.3.english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

2TI.3.12.motu: Oibe, Keriso Iesu lalonai Dirava ibadinana bae ura taudia iboudiai na daḡedaḡe do bae hisihisilai.
2TI.3.12.english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

2TI.4.22.motu: Lohiabada ese laumamu baine bamoa. Harihari-bada emu ai baine mia.
2TI.4.22.english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

2TI.4.5.motu: A oi na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ba boga auka, hisihisi ba haheaukalai, sivarai namo iharorolaina tauna ena kara ba karaia, emu hesiai karana ba haḡuḡurua.
2TI.4.5.english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

2TI.4.10.motu: Badina be Dema ese vada eme rakatanigu, ina tanobada eme ura henia dainai, Tesalonika vada ela. Kreske be Galatia vada ela. Tito be Dalamatia vada ela.
2TI.4.10.english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

2TI.2.22.motu: Uhau edia lebulebu karadia ba heautani. Ini na ba ḡava: kara maoromaoro, abidadama, lalokau, maino. Lalodia ḡoevadia ai Lohiabada ladana e hahaneamu taudia ida ba hebamo heheni.
2TI.2.22.english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

2TI.2.21.motu: Tau ta na hari ḡau dikadia amo sibona baine haheḡoeva, ia na e matauraiamu keberena ai bainela, baine helaḡa, biaguna isiaina ilaohenina baine heḡereḡere, ḡaukara namodia iboudiai ikaradia ai baine heḡereḡere.
2TI.2.21.english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

2TI.3.1.motu: Ina danu ba diba, dina gabedia ai nega dikadia do bae vara.
2TI.3.1.english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

2TI.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, Keriso Iesu lalonai mauri gwauhamatana e miamu heḡereḡerena
2TI.1.1.english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

2TI.1.5.motu: Emu kamonai korikori danu na helalo unelaiamu; una kamonai na gunaguna tubumu hahinena Loi bona sinamu Eunike lalodia ai e miava; lau na tomamu harihari oi lalomu ai e miamu danu.
2TI.1.5.english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

2TI.4.12.motu: Tukiko vada na siaia, Efeso ela.
2TI.4.12.english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

2TI.4.16.motu: Egu kota gini-gunana ai, ta ese se kahagu; iboudiai ese e rakatanigu. Madi, hahebade latadiai basine kau baine namo.
2TI.4.16.english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

2TI.2.25.motu: E gwaua tubumu taudia baine sisiba henidia mai manauna ida; readia Dirava ese baine hahelalodia kerehai, bena hereva momokani bae diba.
2TI.2.25.english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

2TI.1.15.motu: Dibamu Asia ai e nohomu taudia iboudiai na egu amo e raka oho, Fugelo bona Heremogene danu.
2TI.1.15.english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

2TI.1.11.motu: Una sivarai namo iharorolaina bona iloalaina bona ihahedibalaina tauna ai vada e halaogu.
2TI.1.11.english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

2TI.3.6.motu: Idia haida na ruma lalodiai e rau vareaimu, hahine kavakavadia e ḡuidiamu; unu hahine na edia kara dika ese e hametaudiamu, bona edia ura dikadia ese e hakaudia kereremu,
2TI.3.6.english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

2TI.4.9.english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

2TI.2.15.motu: Ba goada; Dirava vairanai namomu baine hedinarai, ḡaukara taumu asi emu hemarai, hereva momokani igwaurai-ḡoevana taumu ai baola.
2TI.2.15.english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

2TI.2.24.motu: Lohiabada ena hesiai tauna na basine heai, a taunimanima iboudiai baine gado namo henidia, baine hahediba ḡoevaḡoeva, baine haheauka.
2TI.2.24.english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

2TI.2.14.motu: Ini ḡau na ba hahelalolaidia; bona Lohiabada vairanai danu ma ba sisiba henidia, hereva idau-idau basie hepapahuahulaidia, badina be una na asi anina, bona unu amo ikamonaina taudia lalodia bae hadai kerere.
2TI.2.14.english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

2TI.1.3.motu: Dirava na hanamoamu; senegu ese isiaina e lao heniva heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese danu na lao heniamu mai lalogu ḡoevaḡoevana ida. Hanuaboi ai, dina ai, egu ḡuriḡuri ai na hanamoamu bona oi ilalomu asina hadokoamu.
2TI.1.3.english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

2TI.1.12.motu: Una dainai lau ini na hisihisi tomamu; to asina hemaraimu. Badina be egu abidadama vada dibagu, bona lalogu na hadaiamu, na tomu ia na mai goadana egu ai vada e atoa ḡauna baine gimaia diba, ela bona una dina baine kau.
2TI.1.12.english: For this cause I also suffer these things.

2TI.4.17.motu: A Lohiabada ese e kahagu bona e hagoadagu, lau daigu ai sivarai namo baine hedinarai ḡoevaḡoeva bona bese iboudiai bae kamonaia helaoreana. Leona ududia amo vada e hamaurigu.
2TI.4.17.english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

2TI.4.21.motu: A kara haraḡa, keru negana do basine kau ai baoma. Eubulo bona Pude bona Lino bona Klaudia bona varavarada iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimumu.
2TI.4.21.english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

2TI.1.16.motu: Onesiforo mai ena ruma taudia ida Lohiabada ese baine bogadia hisi; badina be nega momo ia ese lalogu vada e hamatamataia, bona egu gadea hemaraina se hemarai;
2TI.1.16.english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

2TI.2.20.motu: Ruma badana lalonai kebere na dia gold bona silver ḡaudia mo, a au bona raro keberedia danu mimia; unu be e matauraimu, a ini be asie matauraimu.
2TI.2.20.english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

2TI.2.2.motu: Dibadia taudia hutuma vairadiai vada na hamaorolaimu herevadia na kamonai taudia ba hamaorolaidia; bena idia ese haida ma bae hadibadia.
2TI.2.2.english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

2TI.2.11.motu: Ina hereva be momokani: ia ida tama mase, ia ida danu tama mauri;

2TI.2.23.motu: Henanadai kavakavadia bona mata-lahuidia ihedorilaidia ba dadarai; dibamu idia ese heai e havaramu.
2TI.2.23.english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

2TI.3.7.motu: nega idoinai e hahediba tohomu, a hereva momokani asie diba kaumu.
2TI.3.7.english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

2TI.3.15.motu: Maraḡimu negana ema, revareva helaḡadia vada o manadalai; idia ese bae ha-aonegamu ela bona hahemauri ba davaria, Keriso Iesu ikamonai-henina lalonai.
2TI.3.15.english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.1.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, Keriso Iesu ena harihari-bada lalonai ba goada.
2TI.2.1.english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.7.motu: Egu hereva anidia ba haero; badina be Lohiabada ese ḡau iboudiai lalodiai aonega baine henimu.
2TI.2.7.english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

2TI.2.26.motu: Bena, ena be diabolo ese vada e abidia mauri ena ura ikarana, to bae noga, ena idoa amo bae roho mauri.
2TI.2.26.english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

2TI.3.14.motu: A oi ese vada o diba bona vada o abi dae herevadia na ba kahu tarikatarika; daidia ese e hadibalaimu vada dibamu.
2TI.3.14.english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

2TI.4.8.motu: Harihari egu kara maoromaoro ena kwara-havava ḡauna vada e heḡaeḡae; una dina ai Lohiabada ese baine henigu; badina be ia na Hahemaoro Tauna, mai ena kara maoromaoro. Bona dia lau mo, to ena mai e laroamu taudia iboudiai danu baine henidia.
2TI.4.8.english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

2TI.3.3.motu: lalokau basie diba; bae tudaga; bae habade koikoi; bae lebulebu; bae daḡedaḡe; kara namo basie ura heni;
2TI.3.3.english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

2TI.2.12.motu: baita haheauka, ia ida lohia ai baitala; a baita ḡorea, ia ese baine ḡoreda.

2TI.1.9.motu: Ia ese vada e hamaurida, bona boiboi helaḡana amo vada e boirida, dia ila eda kara heḡereḡeredia, a ia sibona ena lalo-hadai bona ena harihari-bada heḡereḡeredia. Una harihari-bada be Keriso Iesu lalonai e henida, seneda do asie vara negana ai,
2TI.1.9.english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

2TI.4.2.motu: hereva iharorolaina ai ba goada balaheni, nega namodia ai bona nega dikadia ai; taunimanima ba hahelalodia kerehai, ba sisiba henidia, ba halodia, ba hadibadia mai haheaukamu ida.
2TI.4.2.english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

2TI.4.13.motu: Egu hetaru Troa ai na rakatania, Kapo dekenai, o maimu negana ai bavabia kau; buka danu; a hereana be kopi, toretore ḡaudia.
2TI.4.13.english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

2TI.4.7.motu: Tuari namona vada na tuarilaia; egu heau-helulu vada e ore; kamonai karana vada na haḡuḡurua.
2TI.4.7.english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

2TI.3.11.motu: Dibamu danu daḡedaḡe bona hisihisi ese e butugu tao, Antioka ai bona Ikonio ai bona Lustra ai. Daḡedaḡe idau-idau na hisihisilaiva; to idoidiai lalodia amo Lohiabada ese e harologu mauri.
2TI.3.11.english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

2TI.1.6.motu: Una dainai na halomumu, Dirava ena herahia ḡauna be imagu tubuamu ai na ato kau negana ai o abia, herahiana ba hahururu-hururua.
2TI.1.6.english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

2TI.3.16.motu: Revareva helaḡadia iboudiai na Dirava ena heuda-roha dainai e tore; idia na mai siahudia taunimanima ihadibadia, bona ihahelalo-kerehaidia, bona isisiba-henidia, bona kara maoromaoro ai ihakaulaidia.
2TI.3.16.english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

2TI.2.8.motu: Iesu Keriso ba laloa tao: ia na David garana; ia danu mase amo e tore isi. Egu sivarai namo bunai;
2TI.2.8.english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

2TI.1.7.motu: Badina be Dirava ese gari laumana se henida, a siahu bona lalokau bona boga-auka laumana e henida.
2TI.1.7.english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

2TI.2.10.motu: Badina binai hisihisi iboudiai na haheaukalaimu, vada e abidia hidi taudia daidiai, Keriso Iesu ena hahemauri bona mia-hanaihanai hairaina bae abi helaoreana.
2TI.2.10.english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

2TI.1.17.motu: a Roma ai e kau negana ai e tahugu goadagoada ema bona e davarigu.
2TI.1.17.english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

2TI.3.5.motu: Dirava ibadinana na koukouna mo bae abia, a anina bae dadaraia. Ini iboudiai edia amo ba raka oho.
2TI.3.5.english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

2TI.4.20.motu: Erasto na dounu Korinto ai e nohomu; a Trofimo na Mileto ai na rakatania, mai ena gorere.
2TI.4.20.english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

2TI.1.8.motu: Taunabunai, eda Lohiabada igwauraina ai basio hemarai, bona lau e ḡuigu hemaraina basio hemarai. Dika iboudiai lalodiai ba haheauka, sivarai namo dainai, Dirava ese goada baine henimu heḡereḡerena.
2TI.1.8.english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

2TI.2.18.motu: raruosi ese hereva momokani vada e reaia, e tomu tore-isi-lou vada e ore vaitani, bena haida edia kamonai vada e uhea hebubu.
2TI.2.18.english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

2TI.2.17.motu: Hereva unuhetomadia na e kara toto dikana e ara moru ara morumu na heto. Humenaio bona Fileto na unuheto;
2TI.2.17.english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

2TI.2.19.motu: Ḡau tamona, Dirava ena badi aukana vada e ginimu; toana bini, Lohiabada na ena taunimanima iboudiai vada dibana, bona, Lohiabada ladana e hatoamu taudia iboudiai ese kara dika bae heautania.
2TI.2.19.english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” + 2:19 Numbers 16:5 and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

2TI.3.2.motu: Badina be taunimanima na sibodia bae heura heni; moni bae mata ḡaniḡani henia; bae heaḡi; bae hekokoroku; bae ere dika; tamadia sinadia bae gwau edeede henidia; basie hahenamo; basie helaḡa;
2TI.3.2.english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

2TI.4.19.motu: Priska bona Akula bona Onesitoro ena ruma taudia ba hahenamo henidia.
2TI.4.19.english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

2TI.3.10.motu: A oi ese egu hahediba herevadia vada o diba vaitani; egu kara, egu ura, egu abidadama, egu hebogahisi, egu lalokau, egu haheauka, vada dibamu.
2TI.3.10.english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

2TI.2.13.motu: Ena be ita ese basita badinaia, to ia ese ita baine badinada, nega iboudiai; badina be sibona basine heḡore.

2TI.4.11.motu: Luka mo sibona dekegu ai. Mareko bavabia, raruosi baoma, badina be ia na egu ḡaukara ai baine heduru diba.
2TI.4.11.english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

2TI.3.4.motu: bae tao tore; bae kara kava; bae hereva kava; lebulebu karadia bae ura heni bada, Dirava bae ura henia maraḡi;
2TI.3.4.english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

2TI.4.4.motu: Taiadia ese hereva momokani enai bae kudima, a gori bae hakala henidia.
2TI.4.4.english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

2TI.1.2.motu: natugu Timoteo, egu lalokau, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona hebogahisi bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo, bona Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ena amo bavabi.
2TI.1.2.english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

2TI.4.6.motu: Badina be lau raragu na ina harihari be hebubumu; egu raka-oho negana vada be kaumu.
2TI.4.6.english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

2TI.4.3.motu: Badina be negana do baine gini dae, hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia basie abi dae; edia ura kavakavadia daidiai haroro taudia hutuma bae abidia; taiadia do bae hemaihemai.
2TI.4.3.english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

2TI.3.8.motu: Iane bona lambre ese Mose e laoa ahu na heto, idia ese hereva momokani e laoa ahumu; lalodia eme dika bona edia kamonai na koikoi.
2TI.3.8.english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

2TI.2.4.motu: Tuari tauna ese ina mauri ḡaudia basine haturialai; unu amo tuari oreana lalonai e abia vareai tauna baine hamoalea.
2TI.2.4.english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

2TI.4.15.motu: Nahuana ba tohoa, badina be eda hahediba herevadia vada e gwau lubu hereamu.
2TI.4.15.english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

2TI.1.18.motu: Lohiabada ena hebogahisi do baine davaria, una dina ai. Isiaigu ede e lao heni tomava Efeso ai vada dibamu.
2TI.1.18.english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

2TI.3.9.motu: A basie raka daudau, badina be edia kavakava na taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai baine hedinarai, unu raruosi heḡereḡeredia.
2TI.3.9.english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

2TI.4.18.motu: Lohiabada ese dika iboudiai amo baine harohogu mauri, guba ai. Heimodai baita henia hanaihanai. Amen.
2TI.4.18.english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

3JN.1.7.motu: Badina be ia ladana dainai e raka lasi, bese idau-idau taudia edia amo ḡau ta asie abia.
3JN.1.7.english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

3JN.1.2.motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, na ura lalo-dikamu oi na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ba namo, bona tau-animu danu baine namo, laumamu e namomu heḡereḡerena.
3JN.1.2.english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

3JN.1.12.motu: Demetrio be harina namo tauna, taunimanima iboudiai bona hereva momokani ese namona e gwauraiamu. Ai danu unu a gwauraia tomamu, bona umui dibamui ai emai hereva na momokani.
3JN.1.12.english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

3JN.1.14.motu: Asi vanahana baina vasi itamu na tomamu, bona baita hereva heheni.
3JN.1.14.english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face.

3JN.1.3.motu: Varavarada haida ema, e hamaorogu oi na kara momokani taumu eto, bena na moale bada, hereva momokani dalana ai o rakamu dainai.
3JN.1.3.english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

3JN.1.1.motu: Lau heitatao taugu ese egu lalokau Gaio na tore henimumu. Hereva momokani ai na lalokau henimumu.
3JN.1.1.english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

3JN.1.8.motu: Taunabunai, ita ese baita abidia dae baine namo; unu amo hereva momokani ikahalaina tauda ai baitala.
3JN.1.8.english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

3JN.1.15.motu: Maino emu ai baine mia. Turamu iniseni ai e hahenamo henimumu. Turagu eneseni ai ta ta ladadia ba hato, ladagu ai ba hahenamo henidia.

3JN.1.10.motu: Una dainai, baina vasi negana ai, ena kara baina lalo tao. Ia ese hereva dikadia amo e maumauraimaimu; a dia una mo, varavarada danu se abidia daemu, bona iabi-daedia e uramu taudia ia ese e gwaudia tubumu bona ekalesia oreana amo e atodia tabemu.
3JN.1.10.english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

3JN.1.9.motu: Ekalesia oreana na tore henidia, a Diotrefe, sibona e heimodaimu tauna, ese e dadaraimaimu.
3JN.1.9.english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

3JN.1.13.motu: Hereva hoho aina tore henimu na tomu, to ink bona pen amo basina tore.
3JN.1.13.english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

3JN.1.5.motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, varavarada bona laolao taudia o abidia dae na heabidadama ḡaukarana namona.
3JN.1.5.english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

3JN.1.11.motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, dika basio haḡoia, a namo hari. Kara namo e karamu tauna na Dirava ena; a kara dika e karamu tauna ese Dirava se itaia.
3JN.1.11.english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

3JN.1.4.motu: Moale bada-herea egu ai badina binai: natugu haridia na kamonaimu, idia be hereva momokani dalana ai e rakamu.
3JN.1.4.english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

3JN.1.6.motu: Idia ese ekalesia oreana vairadiai oiemu heabi-dae karadia vada e gwaurai hedinarai. Edia laolao ai ba kahadia baine namo herea, Dirava ibadinana karana.
3JN.1.6.english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

ACT.3.12.motu: Petro ese e itadia, bena hutuma e hereva henidia, eto, Israel taumui e, dahaka dainai ina ḡau o hoalaiamu? Bona badina be dahaka o raraimai taomu? O laloamu ai na sibomai emai siahu eiava emai namo daidiai ina tau a hamauria a?
ACT.3.12.english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

ACT.5.32.motu: Ai na ini ḡau a gwauraimu, Lauma Helaḡa danu e gwauraimu: Laumana bunai Dirava ese ia ikamonai-henina taudia vada e henidia.

ACT.20.35.motu: Ḡau iboudiai lalodiai dala namona na hahedinarai henimui; ba gaukara, lau bamogu, manoka-manoka taudia ba kahadia; bona Lohiabada Iesu ena hereva ba laloa tao, eto “Ḡau ihenina be namo bada, ḡau iabina be namo maraḡi”.

ACT.1.13.english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

ACT.28.9.motu: Gabeai gorere taudia haida una motumotu ai ma ema, bena ia ese e hamauridia.

ACT.15.14.motu: Simona ese vada e hamaoroda, Dirava ese gunaguna bese idau-idau e haḡeredia, edia amo bese ta baine abia hidi, ia ladana baine nemailaia.
ACT.15.14.english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

ACT.16.1.motu: Ia na Derebe bona Lustera ai e lasi: Lustera ai Iesu ibadinana tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Timoteo: sinana he Iuda hahinena, sivarai namo vada e abiabiraia, a tamana be Helene tauna.
ACT.16.1.english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

ACT.17.28.motu: badina be ia lalonai ta maurimul, bona ta marere-mareremu, bona ta nohomu, emui ane isisibadia taudia haida ese vada e gwauraia heḡereḡerena, eto, Badina be ita danu ia natuna.
ACT.17.28.english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

ACT.13.43.english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

ACT.17.24.motu: Tanobada bona lalonai e miamu ḡaudia idoidiai ikaradia Diravana ese guba bona tanobada na e lohiadiamu; ia na taunimanima imadia ai e karava dubudia lalodiai se nohomu.
ACT.17.24.english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

ACT.18.10.motu: badina be lau na oi dekemu ai na nohomu; tau ta ese basine guru henimu, basine hadikamu, badina be lauegu taunimanima na hutuma ina hanua lalonai.

ACT.16.5.motu: Taunabunai, ekalesia oreadia iboudiai edia abidadama e goada e laova, bona dina iboudiai ekalesia taudia na e hutuma e laova.

ACT.4.12.motu: Hahemauri be idau tauna ta lalonai dia mia; badina be ihamaurida ladana idauna ta guba henunai se henida, lasi vaitani.

ACT.17.18.motu: Bona Epikuro ena orea bona Stoa oreana taudia haida Paulo ida e hepapahuahuva. Haida eto, Ina hereva kava tauna be dahaka e gwauraiamu? Haida ma eto, Ia na dirava idaudia e gwauraidiamu dahaka. Idia na unu e gwau toma badina be ia ese Iesu bona ena tore-isi-lou sivaraina namona e harorolaiava.
ACT.17.18.english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?”

ACT.20.23.motu: ḡau tamona, hanua hanua lalodiai Lauma Helaḡa ese vada e hamaorogu, iḡui bona hisihisi momo vairagu ai eme hure.
ACT.20.23.english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

ACT.28.13.motu: Unu amo badibadina amo a heau, Regio ai a heau kau, dina ta unuseni ai, bena diho e toa, dina iharuana ai Puteoli ai a heau kau.
ACT.28.13.english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

ACT.7.58.motu: hanua murimurinai e veria lasi, nadi amo e hodoa. Herarai taudia ese edia dabua na eregabe tauna ta, ladana Saulo, aena badibadinai e ato.
ACT.7.58.english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

ACT.12.21.motu: Bena e gwauraia hidi dinana ai, Herod ese pavapava dabuadia e doki, hahemaoro teronona ai e helai kau, e haroro henidia matama.
ACT.12.21.english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

ACT.20.14.motu: Taunabunai ai na ia ida Aso ai a hedavari, e ḡui kau, bena Mitulene ai a heau kau.
ACT.20.14.english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

ACT.26.8.motu: Badina be dahaka umui na o tomamu Dirava ese mase taudia e hatoredia isi herevana na basita abia dae diba?
ACT.26.8.english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

ACT.22.24.motu: Una dainai tuari biaguna badana ese ena orea taudia e haduadia, Paulo na kohoro lalonai bae hakaua vareai, unuseni ai bae dadabaia, bona bae nanadaia, unu e lolo henia tomava anina be dahaka.
ACT.22.24.english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

ACT.24.27.motu: A laḡani rua vada e lao bubuni, bena Porokio Festo ese Feliki e boloa. Bena Feliki na Iuda taudia lalodia ihanamodia urana e urava dainai, ia ese Paulo na iḡuina ai e rakatania.
ACT.24.27.english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

ACT.15.25.motu: Taunabunai, ai iboumai ai emai lalo-hadai tamona binai, tatau haida baia abidia hidi, baia siaidia, emai lalokau taudia Banaba bona Paulo ida bae vasi.
ACT.15.25.english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

ACT.20.11.motu: Ma e dae kau, flaoa alagana e bakia, e aniani; bena idia ida e hereva-hereva ela bona daba e rere. Bena e raka oho.
ACT.20.11.english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

ACT.28.20.motu: Badina binai na boirimui; baina itamui bona baina hereva henimui nato; badina be Israel ena helaro dainai ini e ḡuigu toma.
ACT.28.20.english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

ACT.2.7.motu: Iboudiai e daradara bona e hoa, eto, Ini e herevamu taudia na dia Galilea taudia a?
ACT.2.7.english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

ACT.16.15.motu: Ia mai ena ruma taudia ida bapatiso e abia; bena ia ese e noimai, eto, Lalomui bema toma lau na Lohiabada iabiabiraina hahinegu, egu ruma baitama lao, unuseni ai boma noho. Ia ese lalomai e ani, bena vada ala.
ACT.16.15.english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

ACT.4.37.motu: ena tano vada e hoia, bena davana e laohaia, aposetolo vairadiai e atoa diho.
ACT.4.37.english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

ACT.27.40.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese dogo kwanaudia e rahu utu, dogo na davara ai e rakatanidia; tari iḡuidia kwanaudia e ruha, bona idama larana na lai hoho-hohona ai e kidaia; bena lagatoi e taria diho.
ACT.27.40.english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

ACT.18.17.motu: Bena idia iboudiai ese dubu biaguna, Sostene, e dabaia tao, hahemaoro gabuna vairanai e dadabaia. A Galio na una kara se haerolaia.
ACT.18.17.english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

ACT.8.39.motu: Raruosi ua ranu amo e dae kau ai Lohiabada Laumana ese Filipo vada e abia olio; eunuko tauna ese se itaia lou, a dala amo e laova mai moalena ida.
ACT.8.39.english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

ACT.19.32.motu: Haida ese hereva ta e lololaiava, ma haida hereva ta; bena hebou na e heloḡo ahuahuva dainai hutuma na hebou badina asi dibadia.
ACT.19.32.english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

ACT.25.17.motu: Taunabunai, idia na iniseni ai e hebou negana ai, lau na asina halahe, a kerukeru hahemaoro gabuna ai na helai, na gwau isi, hari tau bae hakaua mai.
ACT.25.17.english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

ACT.20.22.motu: Harihari Ierusalem bainala, Lauma ese vada e ḡuigu dainai, a dahaka ese unuseni ai baine butugu tao na asi dibagu;
ACT.20.22.english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

ACT.3.11.motu: Aena vada e namo tauna ese Petro bona Ioane e dogodia taova ai, taunimanima hutuma ese e heau henidia hebou, dehe ta ai, ladana na “Solomon ena dehe”. Laumadia na e daure.
ACT.3.11.english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

ACT.7.1.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana eto, Edia hereva na momokani a?
ACT.7.1.english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

ACT.16.7.motu: Idia na Musia hetoana ai e kau, Bitunia baela eto; to Iesu ena Lauma ese e rudia.
ACT.16.7.english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

ACT.3.15.motu: Mauri Biaguna be umui ese o alaia mase, to Dirava ese mase amo ma e hatorea isi; ini ai be dibamai taumai.
ACT.3.15.english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

ACT.15.10.motu: Benaini, badina be dahaka Dirava o dibaiamu taumui ese Iesu ibadinana taudia paḡadia ai maduna metauna o atoa kaumu, seneda bona ita danu ihuana asita heḡereḡere madunana?
ACT.15.10.english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

ACT.16.21.motu: bona kara haida, iabi-daedia bona ibadinadia na mai taravatuna ita Roma tauda edai, karadia danu e gwaurai hedinaraimu.
ACT.16.21.english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

ACT.4.9.motu: harihari o nanadaimaimu ina ae-hedairike tauna ai ese a kara namo henia na ede e namo toma?
ACT.4.9.english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

ACT.25.7.motu: Ia e gini dae, bena Ierusalem amo e diho taudia ese e ginia heḡeḡe, hereva metaudia momo e habadelaia, to asie hamomokani diba.
ACT.25.7.english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

ACT.15.29.motu: kaivakuku ihaboulaidia ḡaudia bona rara bona aiodia e gigi ḡaudia hidiodia na basio ani, bona basio heuda-hanai. Unu ḡau idoidiai na basio abi dae, vada ba namo. Ba mahuta.
ACT.15.29.english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

ACT.3.24.motu: Oibe; bona peroveta taudia iboudiai danu, Samuel ena amo ema bona hari, ini dina vada e gwauraiva.
ACT.3.24.english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

ACT.6.5.motu: Ina hereva na iboudiai ese e abia dae, bena haida e gwauraidia hidi: Stefano, abidadama bada bona Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea tauna; bona Filipo; bona Prokoro; bona Nikanoro; bona Timona; bona Pamena; bona Nikolao, ia na tau Antioka, Iuda tauna ai e halaoa.
ACT.6.5.english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

ACT.20.25.motu: Harihari lau na dibagu, emui ai na loaloa bona Basileia na harorolai henimui taumui iboumui ai ese vairagu basio itaia lou.
ACT.20.25.english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

ACT.26.9.motu: Lau danu lalogu na hadaia, nato Iesu tau Nasaret ladana ihadikana karadia momo bama kara bema namo.
ACT.26.9.english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

ACT.10.12.motu: Ialonai be mauri ḡaudia loḡora iboudiai, e rakamu gaudia, e raumu ḡaudia, bona atai ai e rohomu manudia, iboudiai e uda.
ACT.10.12.english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

ACT.10.45.motu: Bena Iuda taudia, Iesu e badinaia bona Petro e bamoa taudia, na e hoa, badina be Lauma Helaḡa na idau bese taudia latadiai vada e seia dobi.
ACT.10.45.english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

ACT.24.6.motu: Ia ese Dubu Helaḡa e hadikaia toho, to ai ese a dabaia tao, baia hahemaoro henia emai taravatu heḡereḡerena ato.
ACT.24.6.english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

ACT.7.19.motu: Ia ese seneda e dibaḡanidia bona e hahisidia; bona e haduadia, natudia karukarudia bae negedia, bena bae mase.
ACT.7.19.english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

ACT.6.1.motu: Unu dinadia ai, Iesu ibadinana taudia e hahutumava, bena Helene gado ai e herevava taudia ese Heberu gado ai e herevava taudia na e maumauraidia matama, badina be edia hahine vadodia na dina iboudiai aniani iharina ai e dabu loulouva.
ACT.6.1.english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

ACT.15.27.motu: Badina bunai Iuda bona Sila vada a siaidiamu, ini hereva heḡereḡeredia mo ududia amo ma bae gwaurai.
ACT.15.27.english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

ACT.7.38.motu: Una tau danu tano ḡaḡaena ai hegogo lalonai, bona Sinai ororona dorina ai ia ida e hereva-hereva aneruna ida, bona ita seneda ida, e nohova. Ia ese mauri herevadia e abi, ita ma baine henida helaoreana.
ACT.7.38.english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

ACT.25.10.motu: Paulo eto, Lau na Kaisara ena hahemaoro gabuna vairanai na ginimu; ia ese baine hahemaoro henigu. Lau be Iuda taudia asina hadikadia; oi danu dibamu.
ACT.25.10.english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

ACT.20.8.motu: Atai daiutuna ai a hebou; una daiutu ai lamepa na momo.
ACT.20.8.english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

ACT.23.9.motu: Bena heloḡoheloḡo vada e badava; itorena taudia haida Farisea oreana amo e gini tore, e hereva goada-goada, eto, ina tau enai kara dika ta asiame davaria; lauma ta eiava aneru ta ese vada e hereva henia dahaka.
ACT.23.9.english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

ACT.16.6.motu: Bena Paulo mai bamona ida Frugia bona Galatia tanodia e rakadia hanai; badina be Lauma Helaḡa ese vada e gwaudia ahu, Asia tanona ai sivarai namo basie harorolaia eto.
ACT.16.6.english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

ACT.20.27.motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura idoinai vada na hamaorolaimui; sina taina asina moia tao.
ACT.20.27.english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

ACT.7.40.motu: Bona idia ese Aaron e hereva henia, eto “Dirava haida a karadia ita eda, ita vairadai bae raka; badina be asi dibada hari Mose, Aigupto amo e hakauda lasi tauna, na ede eha heto”.
ACT.7.40.english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’ + 7:40 Exodus 32:1

ACT.10.33.motu: Bena gwaukau dekemu na siaia vasi haraḡa-haraḡa; vada oma dainai na hanamomumu. Ai iboumai ai iniseni ai Dirava vairanai vada ame hebou, Lohiabada ese vada e haḡanilaimu herevadia baia kamonai a tomu.
ACT.10.33.english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

ACT.12.9.motu: Petro e raka lasi, hari aneru e ḡavaia; to e daradara, hari aneru ena kara na momokani eiava; ia banava e mata hanai eto.
ACT.12.9.english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

ACT.11.22.motu: Ekalesia oreana Ierusalem ai ese haridia e kamonai, bena Banaba e siaia, Antioka bainela.
ACT.11.22.english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

ACT.7.11.motu: A doe be Aigupto idoinai bona Kanaan ai e vara, hisi ani bada danu; bena seneda e hitolodia maseva.
ACT.7.11.english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

ACT.20.1.motu: Helogo-helogo e doko murinai, Paulo ese Iesu ibadinana taudia e haboudia, e hahealo henidia, e hatonidia; bena e rakatanidia, Makedonia ela.
ACT.20.1.english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

ACT.8.40.motu: A Filipo na Asoto ai eha kau. Bena ena laolao ai e raka vareaiva hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai sivarai namo e harololaiava, ela bona Kaisarea ai eha kau.
ACT.8.40.english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

ACT.4.31.motu: E ḡuriḡuri vaitani, bena edia hebou rumana vada e heude-heude. Lauma Helaḡa ese iboudiai e rohedia, bena idia ese Dirava ena hereva e harorolaia mai goadadia ida.
ACT.4.31.english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

ACT.21.6.motu: bena a hatonidia, lagatoi ai a ḡui kau. Idia ese edia ruma e lou heni.
ACT.21.6.english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

ACT.21.11.motu: dekemai ai e gini dae. Bena ia ese Paulo ena dabua e abia, sibona aena bona imana e ḡuilai, eto, Lauma Helaḡa be ini e gwau tomamu: ina dabua biaguna na Iuda taudia ese Ierusalem ai ini bae ḡuia toma, bena idau bese taudia bae henidia.
ACT.21.11.english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

ACT.22.1.motu: Tadikakagu bona tamagu logora e, sivaraigu aina hamaorolaimui mani a kamonai.
ACT.22.1.english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

ACT.27.42.motu: Tuari taudia edia lalo-hadai be mai iḡuidia taudia bae aladia mase eto, haida bae nahu vareai kone ai bena vada bae heau na garina.
ACT.27.42.english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

ACT.20.36.motu: Unu e gwau toma, bena tuina e hadai, idia iboudiai ida e ḡuriḡuri.
ACT.20.36.english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

ACT.12.25.motu: Bena Banaba bona Saulo ese edia ḡaukara e ha-orea, bena Ierusalem e rakatania, e lou ela; Ioane Mareko danu e hakaua lao, idia ida vada ela.
ACT.12.25.english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

ACT.22.23.motu: E lolova ai edia dabua danu e taho nege, bona ḡahu e taho dae taho dae.
ACT.22.23.english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

ACT.26.15.motu: Lau nato “Lohiabada e, oi na daika?” Ia eto “Lau na Iesu, o daḡedaḡe henigumu.

ACT.8.17.motu: Bena raruosi ese imadia na idia latadiai e ato kau; bena Lauma Helaḡa e abia.
ACT.8.17.english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

ACT.10.6.motu: Ia na Simona, boromakau kopidia iseudia tauna, dekena ai e nohomu; ena ruma na kone ai.
ACT.10.6.english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

ACT.12.20.motu: Herod ese Turo mai Sidono taudia e badu henidia dikadika; una dainai idia iboudiai lalodia e hatamonaia, bena dekena ela. Idia ese Ḡaubada ena mahuta daiutuna ita-taona tauna, ladana Blasto, e hamarumarua guna; murinai herohemaino e gwauraia, badina be Ḡaubada ena tano amo edia tano taudia ese aniani e abiva.
ACT.12.20.english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

ACT.15.35.motu: Paulo Banaba ida be Antioka lalonai e nohova, e hahedibava, bona Lohiabada ena hereva e harorolaiava, hutuma ida.
ACT.15.35.english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

ACT.5.36.motu: Idau nega ai Teuda na e gini tore, eto ia na herea tauna, bena taunimanima sinahu-tlani sisivana ienai e tao; to e alaia mase, bona ena orea taudia e hakarohodia bona e ha-oredia.
ACT.5.36.english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

ACT.27.17.motu: Idia ese dingi e veria dae; bena pae-tao kwanauna e abia, lagatoi gabenana ai kwanau e mataia, bena e veria tao. Lagatoi boe ai baine hure kau garina idia ese lara e veria dobi; bena a hagogoa.
ACT.27.17.english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

ACT.2.8.motu: O edeheto ita iboudai ta ta ena gado ena gado korikori ai edia hereva ta kamonaimu?
ACT.2.8.english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

ACT.16.23.motu: E dadabadia dikadika, bena dibura rumana igimana tauna e haduaia, baine gimadia namonamo.
ACT.16.23.english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

ACT.7.44.motu: Dabua dubuna, taravatu ihahedinaraina ḡauna, na seneda ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e abia; e karaia Dirava ese Mose e haduaia bona Mose ese oromana e itaia heḡereḡerena.
ACT.7.44.english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

ACT.21.13.motu: Bena Paulo e haere, eto, Ini o tai tomamu bona lalogu ini o hamanokaia tomamu anina be dahaka? Lau be vada name heḡaeḡae, bae ḡuigu; oibe, dia una mo, baina mase danu Ierusalem ai, Lohiabada Iesu ladana bagunai.
ACT.21.13.english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

ACT.24.8.motu: bona e habadelaia taudia e haganidia, oi dekemu baema. Mani oi ese ba nanadaia, bena hari kara idoidiai a habadelaiamu herevadia sibomu ba diba.
ACT.24.8.english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

ACT.15.1.motu: Taunimanima haida na Iudea amo e diho ela, varavara e hadibadia, eto, Basie peritomemui, Mose ena taravatu heḡereḡerena umui ese hahemauri basio abia diba.
ACT.15.1.english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

ACT.20.12.motu: A hebou taudia ese eregabe tauna e hakaua Iao mai maurina ida; edia lalo-namo na dia maraḡi.

ACT.7.30.motu: Laḡani hari-ahui e ore, bena aneru ta ese tano ḡaḡaena ai, ororo ladana Sinai ai, e hahedinarai henia, au ḡiniḡini e arava hururuna lalonai.

ACT.26.28.english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

ACT.23.18.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese e hakaua lao, tuari biaguna badana dekena, eto, Hari mai iḡuina tauna, Paulo, ese e boirigu, e noigu, ina tauhau na oi dekemu baina hakaua mai eto, badina be ia na hereva ta aine hamaorolaimu e tomu.
ACT.23.18.english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

ACT.9.5.motu: Ia e haere, eto, Lohiabada e, oi na daika? Ia eto, Lau na Iesu, o daḡedaḡe henigumu.

ACT.9.39.motu: Petro na e tore isi, idia ida ela. E gini dae, bena idia ese atai daiutuna ai e hakaua dae. Hahine vadodia iboudiai na unuseni ai mai taidia ida gigini. Bena hahedoki bona hetaru dabuadia iboudiai Doreka ese maurina ai e turiva na e haheitalaia.
ACT.9.39.english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

ACT.12.11.motu: Bena Petro lalona e parara, eto, Harihari name diba momokani, Lohiabada ese ena aneru vada e siaia, Herod imana amo bona Iuda taudia e larova karadia iboudiai amo vada eme hamaurigu.
ACT.12.11.english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

ACT.13.28.motu: Ena be ihamasena badina ta asie davaria, to idia ese Pilato e noia, baine alaia mase.

ACT.21.3.motu: Kupro a itaia, bena laurina kahana ai a heautania, Suria ai a heau kau, Turo ai a diho; badina be lagatoi kohuna unuseni ai bae vaia eto.
ACT.21.3.english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

ACT.28.24.motu: Bena haida ese ena hereva e abia dae, a haida ese e dadaraia;
ACT.28.24.english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

ACT.10.18.motu: E boiboi, eto, Simona, e nemaia Petro, na iniseni ai e nohomu eiava?
ACT.10.18.english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

ACT.7.15.motu: Bena Iakob na Aigupto ela; unuseni ai e mase; bona seneda danu unuseni ai e mase.
ACT.7.15.english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

ACT.27.6.motu: Unuseni ai tuari biaguna ese Alesandria lagatoina ta e davaria, Italia bainela; una dainai e haguimai hanai una lagatoi ai.
ACT.27.6.english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

ACT.2.11.motu: haida danu Krete taudia bona Arabia taudia. Tatau bini Dirava ena hoa ḡaudia e herevalai henidamu, eda gado korikori ai.
ACT.2.11.english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

ACT.8.15.motu: Raruosi e diho ela, bena e guriḡuri, Samaria taudia ese Lauma Helaḡa bae abia;

ACT.10.2.motu: Ia na Dirava ibadinana tauna; ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida Dirava garina e gariva. Ia danu ogoḡami taudia e harihari henidia badabadava; bona nega iboudiai Dirava e ḡuriava.
ACT.10.2.english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

ACT.13.7.motu: ia na gavana launa, Seregio Paulo, dekenai e nohova. Una gavana be lalo-parara tauna: ia ese Banaba bona Saulo e boiridia, e ura henidia, Dirava ena hereva bae hamaorolaia.
ACT.13.7.english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

ACT.21.37.motu: Kohoro lalonai bae hakaua vareai eto; bena Paulo ese tuan biaguna badana e noia, eto, Mani bama hereva henimu. Tuari biaguna badana eto, Helene gadodia mai dibamu a?
ACT.21.37.english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?”

ACT.2.24.motu: A Dirava ese e hatorea isi lou, mase ena iḡui e ruha; badina be mase na ia idogo-taona asi dibana.
ACT.2.24.english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

ACT.27.13.motu: Lahu diho e toa, bena idia banava eto nega namona vada e davaria; taunabunai idia ese dogo e veria, bena Krete badibadina amo a heau.
ACT.27.13.english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

ACT.5.16.motu: Ierusalem badina hanuadia taudia hutuma bada danu e hebouva, gorere taudia bona lauma dikadia ese e bolodia taudia danu e laohaidia, bena idia ese ibouboudiai e hamauridia.
ACT.5.16.english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

ACT.2.19.motu: Bena hoa ḡaudia na guba ai baina hahedinarai,
ACT.2.19.english: I will show wonders in the sky above,

ACT.15.40.english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

ACT.18.20.motu: Bena idia ese e noia, baine noho taritari; to ia ese edia noinoi se abia dae.
ACT.18.20.english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

ACT.13.47.motu: badina be Lohiabada ese vada e haduada, eto,
ACT.13.47.english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying,

ACT.23.23.motu: Bena ia ese tuari biagudia rarua e boiridia, eto, Tuari taudia sinahu-rua bona hosi ai e guimu taudia hitu-ahui bona io taudia sinahu-rua ba haboudia heḡaeḡae, hari hanuaboi hora taurahani-ta Kaisarea baela.
ACT.23.23.english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

ACT.13.30.motu: A Dirava ese mase amo ma e hatorea isi.
ACT.13.30.english: But God raised him from the dead,

ACT.5.5.motu: Anania ese una hereva e kamonai, bena e hekida diho, e mase vailani. Bena harina e kamonai taudia iboudiai e gari dikadika.
ACT.5.5.english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

ACT.4.26.english: The kings of the earth take a stand,

ACT.5.30.motu: Hari Iesu, umui ese satauro ai o taua dae, o alaia mase, tauna na tamada edia Dirava ese vada e hatorea isi lou.
ACT.5.30.english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

ACT.25.19.motu: edia toma-diho karadia mo e herevalai. Bona tau ta, ladana Iesu, herevana danu, ia na vada e mase, a Paulo ese e herevalaia goadagoadava, eto vada eme mauri.
ACT.25.19.english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

ACT.7.51.motu: Aio auka taumui e, lalomui bona taiamui e kara asie peritomedia taudia na heheto, umui ese nega idoinai Lauma Helaḡa o laoa ahumu. Tamamui edia kara na umui ese danu doini o badinamu.
ACT.7.51.english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

ACT.7.12.english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

ACT.2.28.english: You made known to me the ways of life.

ACT.21.25.english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

ACT.21.24.english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

ACT.27.28.motu: Idia ese davara ena dobu e hahetohoa, roha ruahui e abia; asi vanahana ma e hahetohoa lou, roha gwauta-ima e abia.
ACT.27.28.english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

ACT.16.22.english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

ACT.23.7.motu: Ia na unu e gwau toma; bena Farisea taudia bona Sadukea taudia e hepapahuahu, edia hebou e haheparara;
ACT.23.7.english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

ACT.21.2.motu: Unuseni ai Foenikia bainela lagatoina ta a davaria, bena a ḡui kau, a heau.
ACT.21.2.english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

ACT.24.1.motu: A Dina ima e ore ai, Anania, hahelaḡa tauna badana, e gini dae, hanua tau-badadia haida ida, bona haroro mai dibana tauna ta, ladana Teretulo. Bena idia ese gavana e hereva henia, Paulo e habadelaia.
ACT.24.1.english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

ACT.12.6.motu: Herod ese baine hakaua lasi eto; bena una hanuaboi ai Petro na tuari taudia rarua ihuadiai e mahutava, mai iḡuina gadeadia danu rua. Hegima taudia danu dibura rumana iduarana vairanai e gima.
ACT.12.6.english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

ACT.3.7.motu: Imana idibana amo e veria tore, bena aena bona aena komukomuna vada e hedai kunu.
ACT.3.7.english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

ACT.24.12.motu: Dubu Helaḡa ai lau tau ta ida hepapahuahumai ai asie davarigu; bona dubu maraḡidia ai eiava hanua ariaradia ai heloḡo-heloḡo ta asina havaraia.
ACT.24.12.english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

ACT.5.8.motu: Bena Petro ese e nanadaia, eto, A hamaorogu, umui raruosi ese tano o hoia davana gaunabinai a? Ia e haere, eto, Oibe, davana ḡaunabenai.
ACT.5.8.english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.”

ACT.6.3.motu: Taunabunai, varavaramai e, umui na taumui hahitu avabidia hidi, haridia namodia taudia, Lauma bona aonega ai e honumu taudia; bena ina ḡaukara baia henidia.
ACT.6.3.english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

ACT.5.6.motu: Bena eregabe e tore isi, tau-anina dabua ai e hiria, e huaia lasi, e ḡuria.
ACT.5.6.english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

ACT.15.9.motu: ita bona idia se ha-idauda. Badina be edia abidadama ese lalodia vada e haḡoevadia.
ACT.15.9.english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

ACT.11.27.motu: Una negana ai peroveta taudia haida Ierusalem amo ela Antioka.
ACT.11.27.english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

ACT.16.20.motu: Hahemaoro taudia vairadiai e hakaudia lao, eto, Ini raruosi na Iuda taudia, eda hanua e haturiaiamu,
