ACT.25.5.motu: Ma eto, Umui bogaragimui amo mai siahudia taudia na lau ida baiala, bena hari tau bema mai ena kerere, idia ese bae habadelaia.
ACT.25.5.english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

ACT.23.33.motu: Kaisarea ai e lasi; bena hari revareva na gavana e henia, Paulo danu e hakaua vareai ia vairanai.
ACT.23.33.english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

ACT.2.26.english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced.

ACT.7.57.motu: Bena idia na e lolo badabada, bona taiadia e kodobe. Bena dekena e heau lao, e abia,
ACT.7.57.english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

ACT.14.21.motu: Raruosi ese Derebe ai sivarai namo e harorolaia, bona Iesu ibadinana taudia hutuma e abidia. Bena Lustera bona Ikonio bona Antioka maraḡina e lou heni,
ACT.14.21.english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

ACT.14.27.motu: E gini dae, bena ekalesia taudia e haboudia, Diraya ida e kara bouva ḡaudia idoidiai sivaraidia, bona Iesu iabiabiraina iduarana idau bese taudia ediai e kehoa herevadia, e gwaurai.
ACT.14.27.english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

ACT.1.14.motu: Idia iboudiai na ḡuriḡuri totona e hebou, mai lalodia tamona ida; hahine haida danu idia ida e hebou, bona Maria, Iesu sinana, bona Iesu tadina danu.
ACT.1.14.english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

ACT.20.37.motu: Idia iboudiai na e tai dikadika, aiona ai e hagagiu dae, e harahua.
ACT.20.37.english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

ACT.1.6.motu: E hebou, bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, Lohiabada e, basileia vada ina nega ai Israel ba henia lou eiava?
ACT.1.6.english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

ACT.24.9.motu: Bena Iuda taudia ese ena hereva e durua, eto, Unu hereva iboudiai na momomo-kakani.
ACT.24.9.english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

ACT.13.3.motu: Taunabunai, idia na e anivaga bona e ḡuriḡuri, bena imadia na raruosi latadiai e ato kau, bena e kahudia nege.
ACT.13.3.english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

ACT.4.25.motu: Oi danu Lauma Helaḡa ena amo ai senemai David uduna ai o hereva, eto,
ACT.4.25.english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said,

ACT.10.23.motu: Bena Petro ese e abidia dae, ruma ai e mahuta.
ACT.10.23.english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay.

ACT.17.26.motu: Rara tamona ai ia ese taunimanima besedia iboudiai vada e karadia, tanobada kopina idoinai bae noho henia, edia nega bona edia tano hetoadia vada e gwaurai,
ACT.17.26.english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

ACT.21.27.motu: Haheḡoeva dinadia hituosi kahira-kahira e ore ai na Iuda taudia haida Asia amo ese Paulo e itaia, Dubu Helaḡa lalonai, bena idia ese aru taudia lalodia e ani. Bena e dabaia tao,
ACT.21.27.english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

ACT.5.27.motu: E hakaudia vareai, kaunsil taudia vairadiai e haginidia. Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana ese e nanadaidia, eto,
ACT.5.27.english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

ACT.27.19.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, lagatoi ḡaudia danu ma e nege dobi.
ACT.27.19.english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

ACT.4.29.motu: Taunabenai, Lohiabada e, edia hahegari herevadia ame kamonai; emu hesiai taumai goada bame henimai, emu hereva baia gwaurai mai goadamai ida.
ACT.4.29.english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

ACT.10.47.motu: Daika ese ranu baine gwaua tao, ini Lauma Helaḡa vada e abia, ita ta abia heḡereḡerena, taudia na baine rudia, bapatiso basie abia?
ACT.10.47.english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

ACT.16.27.motu: Dibura rumana igimana tauna na mahuta amo e noga, iduara e ita, iboudiai hehekeho; bena ia ese ena dare e veria lasi, sibona baine heala mase eto, badina be ia banava dibura taudia vada e heau lasi eto.
ACT.16.27.english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

ACT.18.19.motu: Tatoiosi Efeso ai e heau kau; unuseni ai ia ese raruosi e rakatanidia. Ia sibona dubu ai e dae kau, Iuda taudia ida e hereva-hereva.
ACT.18.19.english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

ACT.27.43.motu: A tuari biaguna ena ura be Paulo baine hamauria, taunabunai ia ese e gwaudia tao. A nahu mai dibadia taudia be e haduadia, bae pau dobi guna, tano ai bae nahu vareai;
ACT.27.43.english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

ACT.13.41.motu: Heihi-ihirai taumui e, a itaia, ba hoa, ba mase ore;

ACT.9.34.motu: Bena Petro ese e hereva henia, eto, Aenea e, Iesu Keriso ese e hamaurimumu; emu geda a lokua. Bena vada e tore isi.
ACT.9.34.english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

ACT.5.10.motu: Bena ia Petro ae-badinai ma e hekida diho, vada e mase.
ACT.5.10.english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

ACT.15.17.motu: Bena taunimanima gabedia ese Lohiabada bae tahua;
ACT.15.17.english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord:

ACT.18.21.motu: E hatonidia, eto, Dirava baine ura, ma baina lou mai dekemui ai. Bena Efeso e heautania.
ACT.18.21.english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

ACT.4.7.motu: Bena raruosi na bogaragidiai e haginidia, e nanadaidia, eto, Edena siahu ai bona daika ladana ai ina ḡau o karaia?
ACT.4.7.english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

ACT.16.2.motu: Varavara Lustera bona Ikonio taudia ese e gwauraiava tau namona.
ACT.16.2.english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

ACT.26.26.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada danu ini mai goadagu ida na gwaurai heniamu ḡaudia na dibana. Vada name diba ini ḡau ta ienai se hehunimu, badina be ina ḡau na dia daiguni ai asie karaia.
ACT.26.26.english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

ACT.21.9.motu: Ia na mai natuna ulatodia hahani; hahaniosi ese e perovetava.
ACT.21.9.english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

ACT.20.24.motu: A egu mauli na herevana, asina lalokau heniamu: egu heau baina ha-orea, hesiai ilaohenina Lohiabada Iesu ese vada e henigu, Dirava ena harihari-bada sivaraina namona baina gwauraia hedinarai, vada baina haḡuḡurua.
ACT.20.24.english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

ACT.26.31.motu: e raka lasi, e hereva heheni, eto, Ina tau be mase karana ta eiava iḡuina karana ta se karaia.
ACT.26.31.english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

ACT.9.43.motu: Petro na nega taina daudau Iopa ai e nohova, boromakau kopidia iseudia tauna ta, ladana Simona, dekena ai.
ACT.9.43.english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

ACT.15.4.motu: Idia na Ierusalem ai e gini dae ai, ekalesia taudia bona aposetolo taudia bona heitatao taudia ese e abidia dae; bena idia ese Dirava ida e kara bouva ḡaudia idoidiai e hamaorolaidia.
ACT.15.4.english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

ACT.14.28.motu: Bena raruosi na nega taina daudau unuseni ai e noho, Iesu ibadinana taudia dekediai.
ACT.14.28.english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

ACT.19.30.motu: Bena Paulo ena ura be baine raka vareai hanua taudia dekediai, to Iesu ibadinana taudia ese e rua.
ACT.19.30.english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

ACT.17.27.motu: Dirava bae tahua totona; bena bae darahua bonal bae davaria readia. Ḡau tamona, ia bona ita ta ta padada na dia daudau;
ACT.17.27.english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

ACT.23.11.motu: Hanuaboi ai Lohiabada na Paulo badibadinai e gini, eto, Ba goada balaheni, badina be Ierusalem ai vada o gwauraigu heḡereḡerena ai Roma ai danu ma ba gwauraigu.

ACT.1.2.motu: ema bona e heabi isi dinana ai e abidia hidi hahedibadia e haḡanidia.

ACT.21.33.english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

ACT.22.26.english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

ACT.3.16.english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

ACT.27.35.english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

ACT.22.10.motu: Bena na henanadai, nato “Lohiabada e, ede baina kara toma?”, Lohiabada e haere, eto “A tore isi, Damasko ai ba raka vareai, unuseni ai ta ese baine hamaoromu ede ba kara toma”.

ACT.4.22.english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

ACT.28.23.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese dina ta e gwauraia hidi; bena una dina ai hutuma bada na ena ruma ai e hebou. Bena daba ai ela bona adorahi ai ia ese Dirava ena basileia e harorolaia, bona Iesu herevana Mose ena taravatu bona peroveta taudia edia buka amo e gwauraia hedinarai.
ACT.28.23.english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

ACT.7.21.motu: Bena e negea; to Farao natuna kekenina ese e abia, natuna ai e haloa.
ACT.7.21.english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

ACT.4.13.motu: Idia ese Petro bona Ioane e itadia, asi edia gari; dibadia danu idia na hahediba gabuna ta asiela bona asi aonegadia taudia; bena e hoa, bona lalodia e parara idia na Iesu bamona.
ACT.4.13.english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

ACT.10.13.motu: Bena ere ta ienai e kau; eto, Petro e, a tore isi, avaladia, bavani.
ACT.10.13.english: A voice came to him, “Rise, \+w Peter|strong="G4074"\+w*, \+w kill|strong="G2380"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w eat|strong="G2068"\+w*!”

ACT.22.28.motu: Tuari biaguna badana eto, Una dagi be moni badana amo na hoia. Paulo eto, A lau be una dagi ai na vara.
ACT.22.28.english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.”

ACT.2.10.motu: Frugia amo, Pamfulia amo, Aigupto amo, bona Kurene amo (una na Afrika kahana ta). Haida be vadivadi taudia Roma amo; haida be Iuda taumai; haida be Iuda ai e halaodia taudia;
ACT.2.10.english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

ACT.1.3.motu: Hisi e ani murinai, ia na maurina ai ediai e hedinarai, mai toa momokanidia diaḡau ida; dina hari-ahui lalodiai idia ese e itaia loulouva, bona ia ese Dirava ena basileia e herevalai henidiava.
ACT.1.3.english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

ACT.7.17.motu: Dirava ena gwauhamata Abraham enai ihamomokanina negana e kahirakahira ai, taunimanima Aigupto ai vada e vara rohorohova bona e hutumava;
ACT.7.17.english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

ACT.20.31.motu: Taunabunai, ba gima, ina danu ha laloa tao laḡani toi vaitani umui ta ta isisiba-henimui asina hadokoa; na sisiba henimui boiva na sisiba henimui raniva mai irurumatagu ida.
ACT.20.31.english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

ACT.28.14.motu: Unuseni ai varavara haida ida a hedavari; bena idia ese e dogomai tao, dina hitu idia ida a noho. Unu amo ai na a raka lao, Roma ai a kau.
ACT.28.14.english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

ACT.19.1.motu: Apolo na Korinto ai e nohova negana ai, Paulo gunika kahana amo e lasi, Efeso ai e kau; Iesu ibadinana taudia haida unuseni ai ma e davaridia.
ACT.19.1.english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

ACT.9.31.motu: Una negana ai Iudea tanona idoinai, bona Galilea bona Samaria ai danu, ekalesia oreadia ese maino vada e abia, bona e goada e laova; Lohiabada garina e gariva bona Lauma Helaḡa ese taudia e halodia, e hahutumadiava danu.
ACT.9.31.english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

ACT.22.25.motu: Idia ese boromakau kopina varodia amo e mataia, bena ia ese tuari biaguna, ia badibadinai e gini tauna, e nanadaia, eto, Roma tauna na do basie hahemaoro henia a vada bae dadabaia guna na maoro a?
ACT.22.25.english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

ACT.7.6.motu: Dirava ese ma e hamaoroa eto, garana loḡora idau tano ai bae ha noho, bena una tano taudia ese isiaidia ilao-henidia taudia ai bae halaodia, bona bae hahisidia laḡani sinahu-hani.
ACT.7.6.english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

ACT.10.25.motu: Petro e dae kau; bena Korenelio na ia ida e hedavari, aena badinai e goru diho, e toma henia diho.

ACT.12.24.english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

ACT.8.1.motu: Saulo ese Stefano iala-masena na e hanamoa.

ACT.7.47.motu: To ena dubu ihaginina be Solomon.
ACT.7.47.english: But Solomon built him a house.

ACT.22.3.english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

COL.4.18.motu: Ina hahenamo na lau Paulo imagu amo na toreamu. Ba laloa tao, lau na iḡui ai na nohomu. Harihari-bada na dekemui ai baine mia.
COL.4.18.english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

COL.1.17.motu: Ia e noho guna, a ḡau iboudiai be gabeamo, bona ḡau iboudiai ia lalonai e hekamo boumu.
COL.1.17.english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

COL.1.23.motu: Ḡau tamona, kamonai ai ba noho, ba badinaia tarika-tarika, ba gini tutukatutuka; sivarai namo ena helaro amo basie daromui daudau. Sivarai namo bunai vada o kamonai; sivarai namo bunai taunimanima iboudiai guba henunai vada e harorolai henidia; sivarai namo bunai lau Paulo na hesiai tauna ai vada eme halaogu.
COL.1.23.english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

COL.2.12.motu: Emui bapatiso ai ia ida e gurimui hebou bona ia ida o tore isi hebou, Dirava o abidadama heniamu, ia siahuna ese Keriso e hatorea isi lou, dainai.
COL.2.12.english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

COL.4.7.motu: Sivaraigu idoinai Tukiko ese baine hamaorolaimui. Ia na varavaragu, egu lalokau; ia danu hesiai tauna namona ta, ai raruosi ese Lohiabada isiaina a lao heni heboumu.
COL.4.7.english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

COL.4.16.motu: Ina revareva na bogaragimui ai ba duahia murinai Laodikea hebouna ai danu bae duahia. Bona Laodikea taudia edia revareva na umui danu ba duahia.
COL.4.16.english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

COL.1.25.motu: Ena hesiai taugu ai nala, bena Dirava ese dagi e henigu umui emui ai, Dirava ena hereva baina harorolaia ḡuḡuru helaoreana.
COL.1.25.english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

COL.2.16.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ese basine hahemaoro henimui aniani dainai, eiava inuinu dainai, eiava aria daidiai, eiava hua matamatadia daidiai, eiava dina helaḡadia daidiai.
COL.2.16.english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

COL.4.4.motu: Taunabunai do baina gwauraia hedinarai; e henigu ḡaukarana binai.
COL.4.4.english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

COL.2.1.motu: Badina be na uramu ba diba, lau na hekwarahi hereamu umui daimui ai, bona Laodikea taudia daidiai, bona vairagu do asie itaia taudia iboudiai daidiai.
COL.2.1.english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

COL.1.8.motu: Ia ese danu emui uraheni, Lauma lalonai, vada e hamaorolaimai.
COL.1.8.english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

COL.3.23.motu: Emui kara iboudiai na ba kara balaheni, Lohiabada vairanai, dia taunimanima mo vairadiai;
COL.3.23.english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

COL.2.3.motu: Ia lalonai aonega bona lalo-parara kohudia iboudiai na vada e hehunimu.
COL.2.3.english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

COL.2.21.motu: O tomu “Basio dogoa tao” bona “Basio mamia toho” bona “Basio daua toho”;

COL.4.8.motu: Na siaia vasimu badina binai: ai sivaraimai baine hamaorolaimui, bena lalomui baine hakeru.
COL.4.8.english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

COL.1.21.motu: Umui danu, gunaguna ia bona umui na mai padamui; lalomui ai o inai heniava emui kara dika daidiai.
COL.1.21.english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

COL.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, bona varavarada Timoteo,
COL.1.1.english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

COL.1.15.motu: Ia na asita itaiamu Diravana heida-idana, e vara ḡaudia iboudiai roboadia.
COL.1.15.english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

COL.1.13.motu: ia danu dibura siahuna amo vada e hamaurida, ia Natuna, ena lalokau, ena basileia lalonai vada e abida vareai;
COL.1.13.english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

COL.3.25.motu: A kara dika tauna ese ena kara dika davana do baine abia; eda Lohiabada na taunimanima toadia se lalomu.
COL.3.25.english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

COL.3.8.motu: A harihari ini ḡau iboudiai ba nege: badu, daḡedaḡe, lalo-dika, ere-dika, udumui herevadia dikadia.
COL.3.8.english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

COL.2.5.motu: Ena be tau-anigu na dia dekemui ai, to laumagu na dekemui ai; bena na moalemu, badina be emui hereḡu namona na itaiamu, bona Keriso o abidadama henia tarika-tarikamu danu na itaiamu.
COL.2.5.english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

COL.2.17.motu: Unu na gabeai bae vara ḡaudia laulaudia mo, a anina korikori be Keriso ena.
COL.2.17.english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

COL.3.5.motu: Taunabunai, tau-animui edia ura dikadia ba hamase: heuda-hanai, kara dika, mata-dika, lalo-heḡani, mata-ḡaniḡani. Ena na kaivakuku itomadiho-henina na heto.
COL.3.5.english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

COL.3.9.motu: Basio hekoi heheni. Badina be tau gunana mai ena dika vada o dokia oho,
COL.3.9.english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

COL.4.3.motu: Dirava ba noia emai ai, ia ese iduara ta baine kehoa emai, Keriso herevana hehunina baia harorolaia. Ina iḡui ai na nohomu badina bunai.
COL.4.3.english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

COL.4.6.motu: Nega idoinai ba hereva mai gadonamomui ida; emui hereva na damena ai ba damenaia. Bena taunimanima ta ta ba haere henidia mai dibamui ida.
COL.4.6.english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

COL.4.15.motu: Varavarada Laodikea ai ba hanamodia. Numufa, bona ekalesia oreana iena ruma ai e heboumu, danu ba hanamodia.
COL.4.15.english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

COL.2.2.motu: Na uramu lalodia bae hagoadadia, bona lalokau ai bae hedaro boubou; na uramu danu lalo-parara idoinai ese baine hataḡadia, ela bona Dirava ena hereva hehunina, Keriso bunai, bae diba.
COL.2.2.english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

COL.3.4.motu: Keriso, eda mauri badina, baine hedinarai negana ai, umui danu ia ida hairai ai ba hedinarai.
COL.3.4.english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

COL.4.12.motu: Bamomui Epafra, Keriso Iesu ena hesiai tauna, ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Nega idoinai umui daimui ai e ḡuriḡurimu, e noinoimu, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, ba namo ḡuḡuru, bona Dirava ena ura ba diba ḡoeva.
COL.4.12.english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

COL.1.6.motu: Ina na umui emui ai vada e kau, tanobada idoinai vada eha kau heḡereḡerena: bona tanobada idoinai huahuana e dobimu, umui bogaragimui ai e dobimu heḡereḡerena; dia ina harihari mo, to Dirava ena harihari-bada sivaraina o kamonai bona o diba momokani dinana amo.
COL.1.6.english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

COL.1.4.motu: badina be ai na vada a kamonai Keriso Iesu o abidadama heniamu, bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai o ura henidiamu.
COL.1.4.english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

COL.1.5.motu: Badina be emui helaro na guba ai, sivarai namo ena hereva momokani ai o kamonai guna helarona.
COL.1.5.english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

COL.2.18.motu: Ena mata-hanai e heaḡilaiamu bona lalonai e hahemanau koikoimu bona aneru e toma henidia dihomu tauna ese basine hahemaoro henimui. Ia na tau-anina ena lalo-hadai kavakavadia e heagilaimu, a una na asi anina.
COL.2.18.english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

COL.1.19.motu: Badina be Diravana ena ura dainai, ena honuhonu-dae na ienai e miava;
COL.1.19.english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

COL.1.7.motu: Ai bamomai, emai lalokau Epafra, ese e hadibamui; ia na Keriso ena hesiai tauna korikori emui ai.
COL.1.7.english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

COL.1.9.motu: Una dainai, ai a kamonai dinana amo ema bona harihari, ḡuriḡuri asia hadokoa umui daimui ai; a noinoimu, iena ura ba diba vaitani mai aonegamui idoinai, laumamui danu bae diari;
COL.1.9.english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

COL.3.6.motu: Ene ḡau daidiai Dirava ena badu e kaumu, gwau-edeede taudia latadiai.
COL.3.6.english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

COL.1.16.motu: Badina be ḡau iboudiai guba ai bona tanobada ai ia ese e kara, ta itamu ḡaudia bona asita itamu ḡaudia, guba pavapavadia, lohia badadia, ḡaubada hereadia, siahu taudia: iboudiai ia ese e karadia, iena ḡau.
COL.1.16.english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

COL.3.11.motu: Tau matamatana lalonai asi Helene tauna, asi Iuda tauna, e peritomea tauna na lasi, bona se peritomea tauna danu lasi, idau tauna ta lasi, asi Skute tauna, asi hesiai tauna, bona asi ura-kwalimu tauna, a Keriso mo sibona, taunimanima bona ḡau iboudiai lalodiai.
COL.3.11.english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

COL.3.15.motu: Keriso ena maino danu lalomui baine biagudia; e boirimui, tau-anina tamona ai e haboumui, badina bunai. Dirava ba hanamoa.
COL.3.15.english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

COL.2.8.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, tau ta ese ena dadidadi damuna ai baine halaomui na garina, taunimanima edia aonega kavakavadia eiava edia lalo-hadai koikoidia eiava sene taudia edia toma-diho karadia ai baine koimui na garina; Keriso ena dala na dia unu-heto.
COL.2.8.english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

COL.3.24.motu: ba diba, ahumui na Lohiabada ena amo bavabi, badina be umui na Lohiabada Keriso ena hesiai taumui.
COL.3.24.english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

COL.4.13.motu: Na hamaoromui momokanimu, ia na e hekwarahi bada, umui daimui ai, bona Laodikea taudia daidiai, bona Hieropoli taudia daidiai.
COL.4.13.english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

COL.2.15.motu: Lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia ia ese vada e haketodia, taunimanima vairadiai vada e hahemaraidia, ia murina amo vada e hakaudia.
COL.2.15.english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

COL.2.22.motu: a ene ḡau iboudiai na iabidia ai bae ore; idia na taunimanima edia hahedua bona edia hahediba herevadia mo.
COL.2.22.english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

COL.1.29.motu: Una totona na hekwarahimu bona na goada tohomu; iena ḡaukara heḡereḡerena lau lalogu ai e ḡaukaramu, mai siahuna ida.
COL.1.29.english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

COL.1.12.motu: Ita Tamada baita imodaia. ia ese vada e haḡoevada, diari ai helaḡa taudia ida ahuda baita abia;
COL.1.12.english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

COL.1.24.motu: Harihari egu hisihisi umui daimui ai na moalelaimu; bona Keriso ena hisihisi orena lau taugu ai na haḡuḡuruamu, ekalesia, ia tau-anina, dainai.
COL.1.24.english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

COL.1.10.motu: bena Lohiabada imatauraina ai ba raka, kara iboudiai ia ba hamoalea, kara namodia iboudiai anidia ba havara, bona emui diba Dirava enai baine tubu.
COL.1.10.english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

COL.3.1.motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ida vada o tore isi dainai, atai ḡaudia ba haero; gabuna bunai Keriso na Dirava idibana kahana ai e helaimu.
COL.3.1.english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

COL.1.28.motu: Ai ese ia a harorolaiamu; taunimanima iboudiai a sisiba henidiamu, launimanima iboudiai a hadibadiamu, aonega iboudiai lalodiai; taunimanima iboudiai danu baia haginidia, bae namo ḡuḡuru Keriso lalonai.
COL.1.28.english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

COL.3.12.motu: Dirava ena abi-hidi taumui, ena helaḡa taumui, ena lalokau taumui e, ini na ba hahedokilai: hebogahisi, gado namo, manau, manada, haheauka.
COL.3.12.english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

COL.1.3.motu: Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, a hanamoamu, umui daimui ai a noiamu negadia iboudiai;
COL.1.3.english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

COL.3.21.motu: Tama e, natumui basio turia riki henidia, lalodia bae hesiku na garina.
COL.3.21.english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

COL.1.18.motu: Ia na ekalesia kwarana; ekalesia na ia tau-anina. Ia na mase amo toreisi-lou roboana, taunabunai ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ia na herea.
COL.1.18.english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

COL.1.27.motu: bena idia ediai, Dirava ena ura dainai, ina hereva hehunina hairaina herea-daena na bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai baine hedinarai. Herevana binai: Keriso na umui lalomui ai, emui hairai helarona.
COL.1.27.english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

COL.3.20.motu: Memero kekeni e, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai tamamui sinamui eredia ba kamonai, bena Lohiabada ese baine lalo namo henimui.
COL.3.20.english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

COL.4.17.motu: Akipo ba hamaoroa, ia ese hesiai ḡaukarana, Lohiabada enai e abia, na nahuana baine tohoa, karana baine karaia ḡuḡuru.
COL.4.17.english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

COL.2.11.motu: Ia lalonai peritome vada o abia, dia taunimanima imadia amo, a tau dikana idokiohona ḡauna, Keriso ena amo.
COL.2.11.english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

COL.4.14.motu: Egu lalokau Luka, muramura tauna, bona Dema, raruosi ese e hahenamo henimuimu.
COL.4.14.english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

COL.3.10.motu: tau matamatana vada o hahedokilaia; ia na aonega ai e hamatamataia, ikarana Diravana heida-idana.
COL.3.10.english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

COL.4.10.motu: Aristako, lau bamogu dibura rumana ai, bona Banaba tadina Mareko, raruosi ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Mareko dainai hahedua vada o abia: bema vasi, boma abia dae.
COL.4.10.english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

COL.3.14.motu: A unu ḡau iboudiai latadiai, lalokau ba hahedokilaia; ia na ihatamonada ḡauna herea-daena.
COL.3.14.english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

COL.1.2.motu: ai raruosi ese umui helaḡa taumui Kolose ai, Keriso iabidadama-henina taumui, a tore henimuimu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bavabi.
COL.1.2.english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

COL.2.4.motu: Ini na gwau tomamu, tau ta ese lalo-ani herevadia baine koilaimui na garina.
COL.2.4.english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

COL.2.13.motu: Umui na asie peritomemui taumui, emui kara dika ai o maseva; to Dirava ese ia ida vada e hamaurimui, bona iseda kara dika iboudiai vada e gwau tao.
COL.2.13.english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

COL.4.2.motu: Ba ḡuriḡuri goada, basio hadokoa; ba ḡuriḡuri dudukau, Dirava ba hanamoa.
COL.4.2.english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

COL.2.9.motu: Badina be Dirava ena mauri ḡoeva-daena na Keriso tau-anina ai vada e noho.
COL.2.9.english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

COL.2.19.motu: Ia danu Keriso, ia na Kwara, enai se kahua taomu. Keriso ena amo tau-anina idoinai ese goada e abiamu, bena garugaru bona varovaro ese e hatamonaiamu, bena e bada oho bada ohomu, Dirava ena heubu dainai.
COL.2.19.english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

COL.1.14.motu: ia lalonai ita na mai eda hahemauri bona mai eda dika igwau-taodia.
COL.1.14.english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

COL.2.10.motu: Ia lalonai umui vada o namo ḡuḡuru. Ia na lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia iboudiai kwaradia.
COL.2.10.english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

COL.1.20.motu: bona iena amo ḡau iboudiai, tanobada ḡaudia bona guba ḡaudia, ienai baine hadarodia dae, ia idia ida bae herohemaino, iena satauro rarana dainai.
COL.1.20.english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

COL.3.17.motu: Emui hereva ai bona emui ḡaukara ai, ḡau iboudiai Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai ba kara; bona Dirava ba hanamoa ia bagunai.
COL.3.17.english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

COL.3.22.motu: Hesiai memeromui e, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai biagumui ina tanobada ai ba kamonai henidia, dia vairadiai mo, taunimanima ihamoaledia karana, a mai lalomui idoidiai, Lohiabada imatauraina karana.
COL.3.22.english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

COL.4.11.motu: Iesu, ladana ta be Iusto, ese danu e hahenamo henimuimu. Peritome taudia na idia tatoiosi mo sibodia lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu, Dirava ena basileia iharorolaina ai; idia ese danu lalogu vada eme hakerua.
COL.4.11.english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

COL.3.18.motu: Hahine e, adavamui ba kamonai henidia; una na maoro, Lohiabada lalonai.
COL.3.18.english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

COL.3.2.motu: Atai ḡaudia ba haero; tanobada ḡaudia basio haero.
COL.3.2.english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

COL.4.5.motu: Murimuri taudia vairadiai ba raka mai aonegamui ida; nega emui ai mia na ba ḡaukaralaia namonamo.
COL.4.5.english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

DAN.12.6.motu: Bena dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona sinavai ranudia daediai nohona tauna na nanadaia, nato, Nega ede daudauna bainela ela bona ini hoa karadia dokodia.
DAN.12.6.english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

DAN.1.12.motu: Emu hesiai memerodia na ba dibamai toho, dina gwauta lalodiai; uma anianidia mo bona ranu mo bae henimai, baia ani bona baia inu
DAN.1.12.english: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

DAN.3.2.motu: Bena King Nebukadnesara ese hereva e siaia lao, heitatao taudia, hanua lohiadia, basileia lohiadia, hahealo taudia, moni inaridia taudia, hahemaoro taudia badadia bona maraḡidia bona kaha ta ta ai mai dagidia taudia iboudiai na baema, hari King Nebukadnesara ese vada e haginia kaivakukuna ihahelaḡana totona.
DAN.3.2.english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

DAN.7.23.motu: Taunabunai ia eto, Mauri ḡauna ihahanina na iniheto:
DAN.7.23.english: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces.

DAN.4.18.motu: Una nihi na lau, King Nebukadnesara, ese na itaia. A oi, Beletesasara e, anina ba gwauraia hedinarai, badina be aonega taudia iboudiai egu basileia lalonai na anina ihamaorolaigu asi dibadia, a oi na mai dibamu, badina be dirava helaḡadia ese vada e rohemu.
DAN.4.18.english: “This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”

DAN.11.25.motu: Bena tuari oreana badana amo ena siahu bona ena haheauka baine habadadia, diho kahana pavapavana ihadikana totona; bona diho kahana pavapavana danu tuari oreana bada-hereana bona goada-hereana amo baine tuari; a basine gini tutuka, badina be haida ese ia ihadikana totona bae henega bou.
DAN.11.25.english: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

DAN.2.5.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Kaldea taudia e haere henidia, eto, Na hamaoromui momokanimu, nihi bona anina danu basio hamaorolaigu, vada bae daremui patapata bona emui ruma bae ḡiḡidia dobi.
DAN.2.5.english: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

DAN.5.17.motu: Bena Daniel na hanua pavapavana vairanai e haere, eto, Emu herahia ḡaudia na emu ai bae mia, bona emu dava ḡaudia na tau ta ba henia; ḡau tamona lau ese revareva baina duahia, hanua pavapavana emu ai, bona anina danu baina hadibalaimu.
DAN.5.17.english: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

DAN.8.17.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese egu gini gabuna e raka henia kahi; bena ia ema negana ai na gari, bena na goru diho. A ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ba diba, una mata-hanai na nega dokona e hahedinaIaiamu.
DAN.8.17.english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”

DAN.10.2.motu: Unu dinadia ai, lau, Daniel, Ialogu e hisihisiva pura toi lalodiai.
DAN.10.2.english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

DAN.4.17.motu: Irevana na hegima taudia edia hahedua amo, bona ihahemaoro-henina na helaḡa taudia edia hereva amo, bena mauri taudia na bae diba, Herea Mikamika Diravana ese taunimanima edia basileia e lohiaiamu, bona e uramu baine henia tauna na e heniamu, bona uhugai herea tauna na hekwara tauna ai e halaoamu.
DAN.4.17.english: “‘The sentence is by the decree of the watchers and the demand by the word of the holy ones, to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.’

DAN.11.3.motu: Bena pavapava mai siahuna ta baine tore isi; ia baine lohia mai siahu-badana ida, bona ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine karaia.
DAN.11.3.english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

DAN.3.30.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego e hadaedia, Babulono tanona ai.
DAN.3.30.english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

DAN.9.14.motu: Taunabunai Iehova ese hahehisi karana vada e haheḡaeḡaea bona latamai ai vada e mailaia; badina be Iehova, emai Dirava, na maoromaoro, vada e kara karadia iboudiai lalodiai, bona ai ese ia erena asia kamonaia.
DAN.9.14.english: Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

DAN.11.5.motu: Bena diho kahana pavapavana baine goada, a iena lohia tauna ta ese goada ai baine hereaia, bena ena lohia siahuna na baine herea.
DAN.11.5.english: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

DAN.7.12.motu: Hari mauri ḡaudia oredia na edia lohia siahuna na e abia oho, a edia mauri na nega taina e hadaudaua ela bona nega ta.
DAN.7.12.english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

DAN.4.37.motu: Harihari lau Nebukadnesara ese guba Pavapavana na imodaiamu, na heatolaiamu bona na matauraiamu; badina be iena kara iboudiai na mamaoro-mamaoro bona ena dala na gogoeva-goḡoeva; bona mai hekokorokudia ida e rakamu taudia ihahemaraidia na mai dibana.
DAN.4.37.english: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways justice; and those who walk in pride he is able to abase.

DAN.11.36.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena ura heḡereḡerena baine karaia; sibona baine heimodai, sibona baine heaḡi, dirava iboudiai daediai, bona hoa herevadia baine gwaurai, dirava edia Dirava latanai. Namona baine hesiriu, ela bona badu baine guguru; badina be vada e gwawaia hata karana do baine hekara.
DAN.11.36.english: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.

DAN.7.7.motu: Una murinai, hanuaboi mata-hanaidia ai, mauri ḡauna ihahanina na itaia, mai garina bona mai kudou-hetahana; ia na goada dikadika danu. Isena na auri gaudia, bona bada herea; bena ia ese ḡau e aniva, e dare patapatava, bona momoruna na aena amo e moia patapatava. Ia na idau, dia e gunalaia ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia; ia doana na gwauta.
DAN.7.7.english: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome, powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.

DAN.2.47.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Daniel e hereva henia, eto, Momokani, emu Dirava na dirava edia Dirava bona pavapava edia Lohia, bona ḡau hehunidia ihahedinaraidia Diravana; badina be oi ese ina ḡau hehunina ihahedinaraina vada o diba.
DAN.2.47.english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

DAN.7.11.motu: Bena hereva badadia, hari doa ese e gwaurai gaudia, daidiai na roha lao. Bena na roho laova ai, hari mauri ḡauna na e alaia mase, tau-anina na e habuaia tari, e heni, Iahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
DAN.7.11.english: “I watched at that time because of the voice of the arrogant words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

DAN.5.4.motu: Idia ese vine ranuna vada e inu, bena gold, silver, auri labora-labora, auri, au bona nadi diravadia e imodaidia.
DAN.5.4.english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

DAN.3.22.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hahedua na auka bona lahi na siahu herea dainai, lahi hururuna ese unu Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego e abidia lao taudia na e aradia mase.
DAN.3.22.english: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

DAN.11.8.motu: Edia dirava bona edia kaivakuku, e hahetaridia ḡaudia, bona edia sdver bona gold ḡaudia, ḡau namo-hereadia, danu baine abidia, Aigupto baine laohaidia; bena laḡani haida lalodiai ia ese mirigini kahana pavapavana basine tuari henia.
DAN.11.8.english: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.

DAN.4.28.motu: Ina idoinai na King Nebukadnesara latanai e kau.
DAN.4.28.english: All this came on the King Nebuchadnezzar.

DAN.6.23.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e moale dikadika, bena e haheḡani, Daniel na kohua lalona amo bae abia lasi. Taunabunai Daniel na kohua lalona amo e abia lasi; bena bero ta ienai asie davaria, badina be h ese ena Dirava vada e abidadama henia.
DAN.6.23.english: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

DAN.10.5.motu: lau na roha isi, tau ta na itaia, ena hahedoki na dabua aukana ḡaua bona ena gaba ḡauna na Ufasa gold-na.
DAN.10.5.english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

DAN.6.26.motu: Na haheḡanimu, lau ese na lohiaiamu basileiana idoinai lalonai taunimanima na bae heude-heude bona bae gari, Daniel ena Dirava vairanai.
DAN.6.26.english: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel.

DAN.2.27.motu: Daniel ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Aonega taudia eiava babalau taudia eiava mea taudia eiava hisiu toadia mai dibadia taudia ta ese hari ḡau hehunina, hanua pavapavana ese vada e nanadailaia ḡauna, na hanua pavapavana basine hamaorolaia diba.
DAN.2.27.english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

DAN.1.14.motu: Taunabunai, se edia hereva e abia dae, bena dina gwauta lalodiai e dibadia toho.
DAN.1.14.english: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

DAN.2.46.motu: Bena King Nebukadnesara na tano ai e goru diho, Daniel e toma henia diho, bena e hahegani, boubou ḡauna bona muramura mai bonana na bae hahelaḡaia iena.
DAN.2.46.english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

DAN.2.1.motu: Nebukadnesara ena lohia laḡania iharuana ai, Nebukadnesara e nihi; bena lalona na e hekwarahiva bona se mahutava.
DAN.2.1.english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

DAN.3.21.motu: Bena unu tatau na mai dabuadia bona hahedokidia bona mai edia kwara ḡaudia bona mai dabua logoradia ida e guidia, e hururu herea bona e siahu herea lahina ai e tahodia vareai.
DAN.3.21.english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.

DAN.2.6.motu: A nihi bona anina vada ba hahedinarai, bena lauegu amo harihari ḡaudia bona dava namodia bona dagi badadia baina henimui. Taunabunai, nihi bona anina danu ba hadibalaigu.
DAN.2.6.english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

DAN.2.43.motu: Bona auri o itaia, ia na raro manoka-manokana ida e hebulo, heḡereḡerena ai idia na bae headava hedoa-hedoa, a basie hahetamona, auri bona raro e hebulomu ai asie hahetamonamu na heto.
DAN.2.43.english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

DAN.12.5.motu: Bena lau, Daniel, na roha lao, tatau rarua ginidia ai na itadia, ta sinavai inikahana ai bona ta sinavai unukahana ai.
DAN.12.5.english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

DAN.4.36.motu: Una negana ai danu daragu ma e vara lou; bona pavapava dagina bona hairaina ma e ahulaigu, egu basileia ihahairaina totona. Egu hahealo taudia bona egu lohia taudia ese e tahugu, bona egu basileia ai e haginigu, bena egu siahu na e bada e laova.
DAN.4.36.english: At the same time my understanding returned to me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and brightness returned to me. My counselors and my lords sought me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent greatness was added to me.

DAN.11.4.motu: Baine tore isi murinai, ena basileia baine heḡiḡi rohoroho bona baine hehari, guba laidia haniosi ediai; ia garana basie abia, bona ta ese basine lohiaia mai siahuna ida, iena lohia siahuna heḡereḡerena; badina be ena basileia baine heraḡa oho, idaudia haida ese bae abia, dia idia:
DAN.11.4.english: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.

DAN.6.2.motu: bona idia daediai hekwara taudia tatoi e atodia, ta be Daniel. Hari heitatao taudia ese edia ḡaukara sivaraidia na hekwara taudia bae hamaorolaidia, hanua pavapavana ena ḡau ta basine boio helaoreana.
DAN.6.2.english: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

DAN.9.6.motu: emu hesiai taudia, peroveta taudia, oi ladamu ai emai pavapava, emai lohia, senemai bona tano taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia taudia na asia kamonai henidia.
DAN.9.6.english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

DAN.3.29.motu: Taunabunai, lau na haheganimu; bese ta eiava basileia ta eiava gado ta taudia ese Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego edia Dirava na bae uduguiraia, vada bae daredia patapata, bona edia ruma na bae ḡiḡidia dobi; badina be asi dirava ta na hahemauri mai dibana ina heḡereḡerena.
DAN.3.29.english: Therefore I make a decree that every people, nation, and language which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill, because there is no other god who is able to deliver like this.”

DAN.9.17.motu: Taunabunai, emai Dirava e, emu hesiai tauna ena ḡuriḡuri bona ena noinoi ba hakala henidia, bona oi sibomu daimu ai, Ḡaubada e, oi vairamu ese emu gabu helaḡana, vada eme vahu gabuna, baine hadiaria.
DAN.9.17.english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

DAN.6.13.motu: Bena idia na hanua pavapavana vairanai e haere, eto, Pavapava e vanegai Daniel, Iuda amo e mailaidia taudia ta, ese se kamonai henimumu, bona vada o torea taravatu pepana se badinaiamu, a dina ta ta amo nega hatoi e ḡuriḡurimu.
DAN.6.13.english: Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”

DAN.1.6.motu: Unu uhau bogaragidiai na Daniel bona Hanania bona Misael bona Asaria, Iuda iduhuna memerodia.
DAN.1.6.english: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

DAN.3.19.motu: Bena Nebukadnesara na badu ai e honu honu dae, bona ia vairana na e ha-idaua Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego ediai. Ia e hahedua, eto lahi na nega hahitu ma bae hasiahua, dia vaevae e hasiahuava heḡereḡerena.
DAN.3.19.english: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.

DAN.7.19.motu: Bena na ura baina diba, hari mauri ḡauna ihahanina herevana korikorina be dahaka. Ia na idau, dia oredia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia. Ia na mai gari-badana; isena na auri bona kahauna na auri labora-labora. Ia ese ḡau e aniva, e dare patapatava, bona momoruna na aena amo e moi patapatava.
DAN.7.19.english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

DAN.3.24.motu: Bena King Nebukadnesara e hoa dikadika; bena e tore isi haraḡa-haraḡa. Ia ese ena hahealo taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Tatau tatoi na mai iḡuidia ida lahi lalonai ta tahodia vareai ani? Idia ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Pavapava e, momokani.
DAN.3.24.english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste. He spoke and said to his counselors, “Didn’t we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire?”

DAN.8.21.motu: Hari nani maruanena na Helene tanona pavapavana; doa badana ia matana ruaosi padadiai na pavapava gini-gunana.
DAN.8.21.english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

DAN.10.7.motu: Lau, Daniel, sibogu ese mata-hanai na itaia, badina be bamogu ese asie itaia, to gari ese e butudia tao, bena e heau, bae komu totona.
DAN.10.7.english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

DAN.9.8.motu: Ḡaubada e, hemarai na ai emai ai, bona emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona senemai ediai, badina be ai ese vada a kara dika henimu.
DAN.9.8.english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

DAN.3.16.motu: Bena Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Nebukadnesara e, asi badina baia haere henimu.
DAN.3.16.english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.

DAN.9.1.motu: Darauese Ahasuero, tau Mede, ese Kaldea basileiana e pavapavaia laḡanina gini-gunana ai,
DAN.9.1.english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

DAN.11.9.motu: Bena hari mirigini kahana pavapavana na diho kahana pavapavana ena tano lalonai baine raka vareai, a ma baine lou, ena tano korikori bainela.
DAN.11.9.english: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

DAN.2.12.motu: Una hereva dainai hanua pavapavana na e badu, lalona na e ḡaraḡara herea, bena e haheḡani aonega taudia iboudiai Babulono ai na bae aladia ore.
DAN.2.12.english: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

DAN.5.10.motu: Hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia edia hereva daidiai, hanua pavapavana hahinena na aria rumana ai e raka vareai. Bena hanua pavapavana hahinena eto, Pavapava e, ba mauri hanaihanai! Emu lalo-hadai ese basie halalaḡamu bona basine laboramu guguru.
DAN.5.10.english: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

DAN.4.4.motu: Lau Nebukadnesara na egu ruma ai na noho namonamova, egu pavapava rumana ai egu namo na habadaiava.
DAN.4.4.english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.

DAN.2.16.motu: Bena Daniel na e raka vareai, hanua pavapavana e noia, nega ta baine gwaurai henia, nihi anina na hanua pavapavana baine hamaorolaia helaoreana.
DAN.2.16.english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

DAN.4.35.motu: tanobada inoholaina taudia iboudiai e nenediamu, dia ḡau ta na heto;
DAN.4.35.english: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing;

DAN.4.23.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese hegima tauna helaḡana e itaia, guba amo e diho, eto: Au ba hagaria, ba habuaia tari, a au badina mai ramuna ida na tano ai ba rakatania, bona igegelaina aurina, auri bona auri-laboralabora amo e karaia ḡauna, amo ba ḡeḡea, bena rei matamata lalonai baine mia; bena guba hununa ese baine hapariparia, uda boromadia ida baine noho, ela bona laḡani hitu na ia latanai bae ha-ore.
DAN.4.23.english: “Whereas the king saw a holy watcher coming down from the sky and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.’

DAN.2.25.motu: Bena Ariok ese Daniel e hakaua vareai haraḡa, hanua pavapavana vairanai, e hamaoroa, eto, Iuda amo e mailaidia bena iniseni ai e hanohodia taudia bogaragidiai tau ta vada na davaria, ia ese nihi anina na hanua pavapavana baine hamaorolaimu diba.
DAN.2.25.english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

DAN.8.4.motu: Bena na itaia, hari mamoe maruanena na mai daḡedaḡena ida e heau taiko-taiko, lahara kahana ai bona mirigini kahana ai bona diho kahana ai; mauri ḡauna ta se heḡereḡere ia vairanai baine gini, bona ta se heḡereḡere iena siahu amo baine heraua. Ia ese sibona ena ura e karava, bona sibona e heimodaiva.
DAN.8.4.english: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

DAN.11.18.motu: Gabeamo ia talaina na kone tanodia baine henidia, bena momo herea baine abidia. A tuari lohiana ta ese ena hekokoroku baine laoa ahu; momokani, ma baine haloua ia latanai.
DAN.11.18.english: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

DAN.1.8.motu: A Daniel ese lalona e hadaia, ia na hanua pavapavana ana aniani gaihodia eiava e inuava vine-ranuna amo basine hahemiro eto; taunabunai ia ese hesiai tauna badana e noia, baine gwau maoro, ia na sibona basine hahemiro.
DAN.1.8.english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

DAN.3.6.motu: a daika basine goru diho bona basine toma diho, ia na maoromaoro bae abia, lahi ta, e hururu hereamu bona e siahu hereamu lahina, Ialonai bae tahoa vareai.
DAN.3.6.english: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”

DAN.10.9.motu: Bena erena na kamonai. Erena na kamonai negana ai, lau na goru parapara tano ai, na mahuta hedavauhe.
DAN.10.9.english: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

DAN.1.16.motu: Taunabunai hereḡu tauna ese adia aniani gaihodia bona aida vine ranuna na e abi oho, bena uma anianidia mo e henidia.
DAN.1.16.english: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

DAN.3.13.motu: Bena Nebukadnesara na e badu garaḡara, e hahedua, Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego bae mailaiadia. Bena unu tatau na e hakaudia vareai, hanua pavapavana vairanai.
DAN.3.13.english: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king.

DAN.4.11.motu: Au na e tubu, e lo e laova, dorina na guba ai e kau, bena tanobada idoinai dokona amo e itaiava.
DAN.4.11.english: The tree grew and was strong. Its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth.

DAN.5.14.motu: Harimu vada na kamonai, dirava helaḡadia ese e rohemumu, bona diari bona lalo-parara bona aonega herea-daena na oi lalomu ai vada e davaria.
DAN.5.14.english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.

DAN.6.14.motu: Unu hereva e kamonai negana ai, hanua pavapavana lalona vada e hisihisi herea, bona lalona e hadaia Daniel ede baine hamauria toma; ia na e hekwarahi ela bona dina e diho, Daniel Ihamaurina totona.
DAN.6.14.english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.

DAN.9.11.motu: Israel idoinai ese emu taravatu vada e tataia utu; vada a raka siri, oi eremu ikamonaina asia ura. Heuduguirai bona gwauhamata helaḡana Dirava ena hesiai tauna Mose ena taravatu ai e hetore gaudia, na ai latamai ai vada eme hebubu dobi, badina be ai ese vada a kara dika henia.
DAN.9.11.english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice.

DAN.4.5.motu: Nega ta na nihi, bena una nihi ese e hagarigu; egu mahuta patana latanai na hekureva negana ai, egu lalo-hadai bona mata-hanai ḡaudia kwaragu lalonai ese e hagarigu.
DAN.4.5.english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

DAN.8.13.motu: Bena helaḡa tauna ta gadona na kamonai; bena helaḡa tauna ma ta ese e hereva guna tauna na e nanadaia, eto, Ini mata-hanai ḡaudia, ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, bona kara havara, gabu e havahuamu gauna, bona gabu helaḡana bona orea na ae-moimoilai ḡaudia ai e halaodiamu na bae hesiriu ela bona edena nega ai?
DAN.8.13.english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”

DAN.10.3.motu: Aniani gaihodia asina ani, vamu eiava vine ranuna na udugu ai asie vareai, bona dehoro ai asina hedahu, ela bona unu pura ḡuḡurudia toi.
DAN.10.3.english: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

DAN.3.3.motu: Bena hari heitatao taudia, hanua lohiadia, basileia lohiadia, hahealo taudia, moni inaridia taudia, hahemaoro taudia badadia bona maraḡidia bona kaha ta ta ai mai dagidia taudia iboudiai na e hebou, King Nebukadnesara ese vada e haginia kaivakukuna ihahelaḡana totona, bena idia na King Nebukadnesara ese vada e haginia kaivakukuna vairanai e gini.
DAN.3.3.english: Then the local governors, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

DAN.2.8.motu: Hanua pavapavana ma e haere, eto, Lau dibagu momokani umui na o halahemu, badina be vada o diba egu hereva na momokani,
DAN.2.8.english: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

DAN.5.2.motu: Belesasara ese vine ranuna e demaia toho, bena ia na e haheḡani, tamana Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem dubuna amo e abidia keheredia, gold bona silver gaudia, na bae mailaidia, bena hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia bona adavana korikoridia bona e adavadia hahinedia danu ese vine ranuna na unu ḡau amo bae inu.
DAN.5.2.english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him, that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

DAN.11.16.motu: A baine tuari henia tauna ese sibona ena ura heḡereḡerena baine karaia; tau ta ia vairanai basine gini diba. Ia na tano herea-daena ai baine gini; idoinai na ia siahuna lalonai baine mia.
DAN.11.16.english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.

DAN.11.41.motu: Tano herea-daena lalonai baine kau. Gerebu gerebu bae hekida diho, a ini na id imana amo bae roho mauri: Edom bona Moab bona Amono besena kahana badana.
DAN.11.41.english: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

DAN.11.32.motu: Herohemaino e hadikaiamu taudia na boga-alaga herevadia amo baine dibaganidia; a edia Dirava dibadia taudia na bae gini tutuka-tutuka, bona edia kara bae kara.
DAN.11.32.english: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.

DAN.6.17.motu: Bena nadi ta e mailaia, kohua iduarana e koulaia; bena hanua pavapavana ese ia toana bona ena lohia taudia toadia na una nadi ai e kara, Daniel enai vada e kara ḡaudia na ta ese basine ha-idau helaoreana.
DAN.6.17.english: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.

DAN.8.9.motu: Idia ta ena amo doa maragina ta e vara, bena e tubu badabada, diho kahana bona mairiveina kahana bona mai hairaina tanona e tubu henidia.
DAN.8.9.english: Out of one of them came out a little horn which grew exceedingly great—toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

DAN.11.37.motu: Senena edia dirava eiava hahine e lalokau heniamu diravana na basine kamonai henidia; bona dirava idauna ta basine kamonai henia, badina be sibona baine heimodai, dirava iboudiai daediai.
DAN.11.37.english: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.

DAN.8.20.motu: Hari mamoe maruanena o itaia mai doana rua, unu na Media bona Parasa pavapavadia.
DAN.8.20.english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

DAN.10.21.motu: A baina hamaoromu, hereva momokanina bukana ai ede e hetore tomamu; asi tauna ta ohegu kahana ai e tuarimu, emu lohia Mikael mo sibona.
DAN.10.21.english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.

DAN.8.22.motu: Doa ta e kwaidu, bena ia gabuna ai doa hani e tubu anina be basileia hani na iena bese amo bae vara, a iena siahu basie haheḡereḡerea.
DAN.8.22.english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

DAN.11.31.motu: lena tuari oreadia haida bae hedinarai, dubu bona ruma aukana bae hamirodia, bona ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, bae abia oho, bona ḡau dika-rohorohona, hahevahu ḡauna, bae haginia.
DAN.11.31.english: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.

DAN.9.20.motu: Egu hereva bona egu ḡuriḡuri lalodiai egu kara dika bona egu bese Israel edia kara dika na gwaurai hedinaraiva, bona Iehova, egu Dirava, na noinoi heniava, egu Dirava ena ororo helaḡana dainai;
DAN.9.20.english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God—

DAN.2.18.motu: bena e hamaorodia danu, guba Duavana ena hebogahisi bae tahua, una ḡau hehunina dainai, Daniel mai bamona ida na aonega taudia Babulono ai oredia ida basie mase bou helaoreana.
DAN.2.18.english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

DAN.5.25.motu: E torea revarevana binai: MENE, MENE, TEKELE, PARASINI.
DAN.5.25.english: “This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’

DAN.7.22.motu: ela bona Ḡauka na ema, bena ia ese hahemaoro e karaia, Herea Mikamika Diravana ena helaḡa taudia maorodia e gwaurai; bena negana e gini dae helaḡa taudia ese basileia e abia.
DAN.7.22.english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

DAN.11.2.motu: Harihari lau ese hereva momokanina baina hahedinarai henimu. A itaia, pavapava tatoi ma bae tore isi Parasa ai, bona ihahanina ena taḡa ese idia tatoiosi edia taḡa baine hereadia; bena ena taḡa dainai baine goada negana ai, ia ese taunimanima iboudiai lalodia baine ani, Helene basikiana bae hadikaia.
DAN.11.2.english: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

DAN.8.10.motu: E tubu badabada ela bona guba oreana; bena hisiu haida na tano ai e tahodia dobi, bena e moidia patapata.
DAN.8.10.english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.

DAN.5.26.motu: Anina binai: MENE, Dirava ese emu basileia dinadia vada e hagaudia bena vada e hadokoa;
DAN.5.26.english: “This is the interpretation of the thing:

DAN.9.27.motu: Bena ia ese hutuma ida bae hegwau hamata heheni, gwauhamata aukana ta, ela bona pura ta baine ore. Pura kahana ai ia ese boubou bona herahia karadia baine hadokodia, bona ḡau dika-rohorohona hanina latadiai hahevahu tauna ta bainema, ela bona vada e gwauraia hata dokona negana na hahevahu tauna latanai baine hebubu dobi.
DAN.9.27.english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”

DAN.10.18.motu: Una murinai ta, ita-itana na taunimanima na heto, ese e daugu toho, e hagoadagu.
DAN.10.18.english: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.

DAN.7.28.motu: Hereva dokona binai. A lau Daniel egu lalo-hadai ese e hagarigu bona na labora ḡuḡuru; a ina hereva na lalogu ai na dogoa tao.
DAN.7.28.english: “Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”

DAN.11.13.motu: Badina be hari mirigini kahana pavapavana ese hutuma ma baine haboudia, ina hutuma ese e haboua guna oreana na baine hereaia; bena laḡani haida baela murinai ia na ma baine tore isi, mai ena tuari oreana badana bona ena kohu momo herea ida.
DAN.11.13.english: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with abundant supplies.

DAN.9.26.motu: Bena unu pura tauratoi-ahui rua muridiai, e horoa tauna na bae negea daure, ḡau ta ienai basine mia; bona bainen-a lohiana ena orea taudia ese hanua bona gabu helaḡana bae habuadia tari. Utu-utu ese baine ha-orea, bona tuari do baine hesiriu ela bona dokona. Hahevahu karadia vada e gwaurai hata.
DAN.9.26.english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

DAN.12.4.motu: A oi, Daniel, hereva ba hunidia, bona buka ba koua kunuka-kunuka, ela bona dokona negana. Hutuma na bae heau lao heau mai, bona lalo-parara bae habadaia.
DAN.12.4.english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

DAN.2.34.motu: Bena o raraia negana ai, nadi ta vada e heutu oho, a d; a taunimanima imana ese; bena una nadi ese una kaivakuku aena palapaladia, auri bona raro gaudia, ai e tubu, e hamakohidia rohoroho.
DAN.2.34.english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

DAN.8.2.motu: Egu mata-hanai ai ḡau haida na itadia; na itadia negana ai lau na hanua badana Susa ai, Elam tanona ai; bena mata-hanaigu ai na itaia, lau na Ulai sinavaina isena ai.
DAN.8.2.english: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

DAN.11.21.motu: Ia gabuna ai bonegita tauna ta e tore isi, pavapava dagina asie henia tauna; ia na baine gini lasi kava, boga-alaga herevadia amo basileia na baine abia.
DAN.11.21.english: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

DAN.9.19.motu: Ḡaubada e, a kamonai; Ḡaubada e, emai dika ba gwau tao; Ḡaubada e, ba lalomai, ba kara; egu Dirava e, basio halahe, oi sibomu daimu ai, badina be emu hanua bona emu bese na oi ladamu e hahenemailaia.
DAN.9.19.english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

DAN.4.9.motu: Beletesasara e, oi na mea tauna badana, badina be lau dibagu dirava helaḡadia ese vada e rohemu, bona ḡau hehunina ta na dia hehuni oiemu ai. Na itaia nihina binai; oi ese anina do ba hamaorolaigu.
DAN.4.9.english: “Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

DAN.5.3.motu: Bena haida ese hari gold bona silver keheredia, Ierusalem dubuna, Dirava ena dubu, amo e abi ḡaudia, na e mailaidia; bena hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia bona adavana korikoridia bona e adavadia hahinedia ese vine ranuna na unu ḡau amo e inuinulai.
DAN.5.3.english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

DAN.3.14.motu: Nebukadnesara ese e nanadaidia, eto, Sadaraka, Mesaka bona Abedenego e, momokani umui ese egu dirava isiaidia asio lao henimu bona gold kaivakukuna, vada na haginia ḡauna, asio toma henia dihomu a?
DAN.3.14.english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?

DAN.9.16.motu: Ḡaubada e, emu kara maoromaorodia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai, emu badu bona emu lalo-dika na emu hanua Ierusalem, emu ororo helaḡana, amo baine siri; badina be emai kara dika bona senemai edia kara havara daidiai, Ierusalem bona oiemu bese na gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai vada e hahelao, e ḡeḡemai dae taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
DAN.9.16.english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

DAN.9.7.motu: Ḡaubada e, kara maoromaoro na oiemu ai, a ai emai ai na hemarai, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena, Iuda taudia ediai, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ediai, bona Israel idoinai enai, gabu kahikahi taudia bona gabu daudau taudia, vada o luludia lao tanodia iboudiai lalodiai; badina be idia ese oi ihadikamu karadia vada e kara.
DAN.9.7.english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
