DAN.2.35.english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

DAN.6.21.motu: Bena Daniel ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Pavapava e, ba mauri hanaihanai.
DAN.6.21.english: Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!

DAN.5.8.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena aonega taudia iboudiai e raka vareai, a una revareva iduahina asi dibadia bona asie heḡereḡere anina na hanua pavapavana bae hadibalaia.
DAN.5.8.english: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.

DAN.7.21.motu: Lau na roha laova ai, una doa ese helaḡa taudia e tuari henidia bona e hadareredia,
DAN.7.21.english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,

DAN.2.22.motu: Ia ese ḡau dobudia bona ḡau hehunidia e hahedinaraidiamu;
DAN.2.22.english: He reveals the deep and secret things.

DAN.2.24.motu: Taunabutlai Daniel na Ariok, hanua pavapavana ese aor!ega taudia Babulono ai iala-masedia e duanaia tauna, dekenai e raka vareai. Ela, e hereva henia, eto, Aonega taudia Babulono ai basio aladia mase; lau ba hakaugu vareai hanua pavapavana vairanai, bena lau ese hanua pavapavana ena nihi anina baina hamaorolaia.
DAN.2.24.english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

DAN.7.8.motu: Doana na haerodia, bena na itaia, doa ma ta idia bogaragidiai e tubu, maraḡi-muaḡina; bena ia vairanai unu doa gunadia toi e heraga oho. Na itaia danu, una doa na mai matana, tau matana na heto; bona mai uduna, hereva badadia e gwaurai.
DAN.7.8.english: “I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking arrogantly.

DAN.2.45.motu: Nadi ta o itaia heḡereḡerena, ororo amo e heutu oho, a dia taunimanima imana ese; bena una nadi ese auri, auri labora-labora, raro, silver bona gold na e hamakohi sisisisi. Dirava badana ta ese nega gabena ai bae vara ḡaudia na hanua pavapavana vada e hadibalaimu. Nihi na momokani, bona anina na momokani.
DAN.2.45.english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

DAN.7.25.motu: Ia ese Herea Mikamika Diravana baine gonagonalaia,
DAN.7.25.english: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

DAN.5.21.motu: taunimanima bogaragidia amo e lulua lasi, lalona na boroma lalona heḡereḡerena ai ela, uda donikidia ida e nohova; rei e aniva, boromakau na heto, bona tau-anina na guba hununa ese e haparipariava, ema bona ia vada e diba Herea Mikamika Diravana ese taunimanima edia basileia e lohiaiamu, bona e uramu baine henia tauna na e heniamu, baine lohiaia totona.
DAN.5.21.english: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

DAN.2.29.motu: Pavapava e, emu mahuta patana latanai o hekureva negana ai, lalo-hadai haida na emu ai e kau, nega gabedia ai bae vara ḡaudia o lalo hadailai; bona ḡau hehunidia e hahedinaraidiamu Diravana ese bae vara ḡaudia na e hadibalaimu.
DAN.2.29.english: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

DAN.9.10.motu: bona Iehova, emai Dirava, gadona asia kamonai henia, ena taravatu, ena hesiai peroveta taudla eaia amo vairamai ai e atodia taravatudia, asia badinadia.
DAN.9.10.english: We haven’t obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

DAN.4.1.motu: A King Nebukadnesara ena hereva, bese idau-idau bona basileia idau-idau bona gado idau-idau iboudiai, tanobada idoinai e noho heniamu taudia iboudiai ediai, binai.

DAN.4.32.motu: taunimanima bogaragidia amo bae lulumu lasi, uda boromadia ida ba noho; rei do bavani, boromakau na heto; laḡani hitu na oi latamu ai ba ha-ore, ela bona vada ba diba, Herea Mikamika Diravana ese taunimanima edia basileia e lohiaiamu, bona e uramu baine henia tauna na e heniamu”.
DAN.4.32.english: You shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like oxen. Seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.’”

DAN.4.10.motu: Egu mahuta patana latanai na hekureva negana ai, mata-hanai ḡaudia kwaragu lalonai bini: na roha lao, au ta na itaia, tanobada bogaraginai; ia na gaulatalata.
DAN.4.10.english: These were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.

DAN.8.24.motu: Ena siahu baine bada; ia ese hahebua-tari badana baine havaraia, ena ḡaukara ai baine kwalimu, goada tauna bona orea helaḡana taudia na baine habuadia tari.
DAN.8.24.english: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

DAN.6.1.motu: Ena ura dainai, Darauese ese heitatao taudia sinahu-ta ruahui e duanaidia, basileia na bae biagua, basileia kahadia iboudiai;
DAN.6.1.english: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

DAN.11.45.motu: Ena kalaga herea-daedia na davara bona ororo helaḡana mai hairaina padadiai baine haginidia; ḡau tamona ena doko negana baine kau, una negana ai ta ese basine kahaia.
DAN.11.45.english: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

DAN.2.23.english: I thank you and praise you,

DAN.2.37.motu: Pavapava e, oi na pavapava edia pavapava; guba Diravana ese basileia bona siahu bona goada bona hairai na oi vada e henimu;
DAN.2.37.english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

DAN.6.22.motu: Egu Dirava ese ena aneru ta e siaia mai, bena ia ese leona ududia e hakapudia, bena asie hadikagu; badina be ia vairanai lau na asi egu kerere, bona oi vairamu ai danu, pavapava e, lau na asina kara kerere.
DAN.6.22.english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”

DAN.6.25.motu: Bena King Darauese ese revareva ta e torea, bese idau-idau bona basileia idau-idau bona gado idau-idau taudia iboudiai, tanobada idoinai latanai e nohomu taudia, ediai, eto: Maino na emui ai baine bada.
DAN.6.25.english: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages who dwell in all the earth:

DAN.2.32.motu: Una kaivakuku kwarana na gold namo-hereana, kemena bona imana na silver, bogana bona koekoena na auri labora-labora,
DAN.2.32.english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

DAN.6.6.motu: Bena hari hekwara taudia bona heitatao taudia na e raka bou ela, hanua pavapavana dekenai, e hereva henia, eto, King Darauese e, ba mauri hanaihanai!
DAN.6.6.english: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!

DAN.6.16.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e hahegani; bena haida ese Daniel e mailaia, leona edia kohua lalonai e tahoa vareai. Hanua pavapavana ese Daniel e hamaoroa, eto, Emu Dirava, o toma henia diho louloumu Diravana, ese baine hamaurimu.
DAN.6.16.english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.”

DAN.4.27.motu: Taunabunai, pavapava e, egu hahealo na boma abia dae; emu kara dika boma hadoko, kara maoromaorodia boma kara, bona emu kara havara danu boma hadoko; e hahisidiamu taudia boma bogadia hisi; bena reana emu noho-maino taina ma baine daudau.
DAN.4.27.english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.”

DAN.5.20.motu: A sibona e heabi isi bona lalona e ha-aukaia, bena hekokoroku karadia e karava; una negana ai pavapava teronona amo e hadihoa bona hairaina e abia oho,
DAN.5.20.english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.

DAN.4.8.motu: Dokona ai Daniel e raka vareai; ia ladana ta na Belelesasara, egu dirava ladana e nemailaia, bona dirava helaḡadia ese e roheamu. Bena una nihi na hamaorolaia, nato,
DAN.4.8.english: But at last, Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,

DAN.2.26.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Daniel, ladana ta be Beletesasara, e nanadaia, eto, Egu nihi bona anina danu ba hamaorolaigu diba eiava?
DAN.2.26.english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

DAN.9.12.motu: Ia ese ena hereva vada e hamomokanidia. ai latamai ai bona ikwaramai taudia latadiai e gwaurai gaudia, hahehisi karana badana na ai latamai ai vada e mailaia; badina be guba idoinai henunai kara ta nega ta ai se karaia, Ierusalem vada e kara henia heḡereḡerena.
DAN.9.12.english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

DAN.5.28.motu: PERE, emu basileia vada e haria, Mede bona Parasa taudia vada e henidia.
DAN.5.28.english: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”

DAN.2.9.motu: nihi na basioma hadibalaigu davamui baine tamona mo. Vada o henega bou, hereva koikoidia bona dikadia lau vairagu ai ba gwaurai, ela bona nega ta. Taunabunai, nihi vada ba hamaorolaigu, bena baina diba umui na anina danu ba hamaorolaigu diba.
DAN.2.9.english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

DAN.10.14.motu: Bena nama, dina gabedia ai dahaka dahaka baine vara emu bese taudia ediai baina hadibamu totona. Badina be mata-hanai na nega vaira ḡauna.
DAN.10.14.english: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”

DAN.1.2.motu: Bena Ḡaubada ese Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, na ia imana ai e atoa, bona Dirava ena dubu kohudia haida danu. Bena ia ese unu dubu kohudia na Sinara tanona e laohaidia, ena dirava ena dubu ai, bena hari kohu na ena dirava ena habou-habou daiutuna ai e atodia.
DAN.1.2.english: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

DEU.11.8.motu: Taunabunai, hari dina ai vada na haḡanilaimui haheḡanidia ba badinadia; bena ba goada, ba raka vareai, iabina totona ba hanai tanona vada bavabia;
DEU.11.8.english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

DEU.13.2.motu: gabeamo ia ese e gwauraia guna toana eiava hoa karana bema vara, bena ia bema toma “Dirava idaudia, umui do asi dibamui diravadia, baita tahudia bona isiaidia baita lao heni”,
DEU.13.2.english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

DEU.19.11.motu: A tau ta ese ia dekena tauna bema inai henia, bena bema bani henia, bema heatu henia, bona bema haberoa dikadika; bena tau na baine mase, bona ala-ala tauna be una hanua ta baine heau henia,
DEU.19.11.english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

DEU.12.29.motu: Iehova, umui Dirava, ese gabudia bavabi besedia baine negedia daure, bena umui ese gabudia bavabi bona edia tano ba noholaia;
DEU.12.29.english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

DEU.20.7.motu: Eiava bema tau ta ese, maohenina vada e abia a do se adavaia, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ese hane-ulato bema adavaia na garina.
DEU.20.7.english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

DEU.4.31.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na hebogahisi Diravana; ia na basine kahumui nege bona basine habuamui tari, bona ena gwau-hamata, senemui e gwau henidia hamata, na basine laloa boio.
DEU.4.31.english: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

DEU.28.9.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani boma badinadia, bona ena dala ai boma raka, Iehova ese baine hahelaḡamui, iena bese ai baine halaomui, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.28.9.english: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.

DEU.32.25.motu: Murimuri ai dare ese baine aladia,

DEU.1.35.motu: Momokani, ina uru dikana taudia ta ese hari tano namona, lau ese senemui na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona, basine itaia.
DEU.1.35.english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

DEU.27.8.motu: Huro nadidia ai ina taravatu herevadia iboudiai ba tore hedinarai.
DEU.27.8.english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

DEU.11.6.motu: Ma ba laloa, Datan mai tadina Abiram, Eliab Ruben natuna, ede e karadia toma: tano ese e hadonodia, idia bona edia ruma taudia bona edia kalaga bona edia mauri ḡaudia iboudiai, Israel taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
DEU.11.6.english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

DEU.16.5.motu: Lagauhanai boubouna na Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui hanuadia ai basio alaia,
DEU.16.5.english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;

DEU.18.20.motu: A peroveta tauna ta ese lau asina haḡanilaia herevana ta lau ladagu ai baine gwauraia, eiava dirava idaudia ladadia ai baine hereva, una peroveta tauna na baine mase.
DEU.18.20.english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

DEU.2.12.motu: Hori taudia danu gunaguna Seiri ai e nohova, a Esau garana ese e luludia lasi, e habuadia tari, bona edia tano e abia, Israel na Iehova ese e henidia tanona e kara henia heḡereḡerena.)
DEU.2.12.english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)

DEU.6.15.motu: badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, bogaragimui ai e nohomu Diravana, na vaḡeḡe Diravana. Ba heita, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena badu na emui ai baine siahu bena tanobada kopina amo baine habuamui tari na garina.
DEU.6.15.english: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

DEU.2.28.motu: Aniani na emu ai baina hoia, moni davana, bena baina aniani; ranu danu oiemu amo baina abia, moni davana, bena baina inua. Ḡau tamona ba gwau maoro, aegu amo baina raka hanai.
DEU.2.28.english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

DEU.5.30.motu: Baola, ba haḡanidia, baoto “Emui kalaga ba lou heni”.

DEU.8.10.motu: Bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba imodaia, tanona; namona na ia ese vada e henimui dainai.
DEU.8.10.english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

DEU.5.25.motu: A baia mase ena namo be dahaka? Badina be ina lahi badana ese baine aramai ore. Iehova, eda Dirava, gadona ma baia kamonai lou, vada baia mase;
DEU.5.25.english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

DEU.24.1.motu: Tau ta baine headava, gabeai adavana basine ura henia, hahine ena kara mirona ta dainai, ia ese hekoho revarevana baine torea, baine henia; bena baine hadihoa.
DEU.24.1.english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

DEU.27.11.motu: Una dina ai danu Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto:
DEU.27.11.english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

DEU.28.68.motu: Iehova ese lagatoi ai baine laohaimui, Aigupto ba lou henia; na hamaorolaimui nato “Basio itaia lou” dalana amo ma ba lou. Unuseni ai sibomui ba hehoi toho, inaimui edia hesiai taudia bona edia hesiai hahinedia ai baola totona; a tau ta ese basine hoimui.
DEU.28.68.english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

DEU.4.44.motu: Taravatu binai, Mose ese Israel taudia vairadiai e gwauraia.
DEU.4.44.english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

DEU.30.8.motu: A umui na Iehova erena ma ba kamonai, bona ena haheḡani iboudiai, hari ina dina ai na haḡanilaimui, ḡaudia, na ba badinadia.
DEU.30.8.english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

DEU.1.44.motu: Bena Amoro taudia na unu ororo amo e hekei diho, e lulumui, nanigo ese bema lulumui na heto; bena Seiri ai e hadareremui, e havamui ela bona Horoma.
DEU.1.44.english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

DEU.4.23.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e henimui taravatuna na basio laloa boio; bona laulau ta basio koroa, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese una kara taravana vada e atua.
DEU.4.23.english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

DEU.7.9.motu: Taunabunai, ba diba, Iehova, emui Dirava, na Dirava korikori, heabidadama Diravana: ia na ena hebogahisi ai ena gwauhamata e hamomokanimu ela bona uru daha, e lalokau heniamu bona ena haheḡani e badinamu taudia ediai.
DEU.7.9.english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

DEU.14.29.motu: bena Levi tauna (badina be asi ahuna bona asi ena tano bogaragimui ai), bona noho-hedoa taunabona ihareha bona vabu emu hanua ai nonoho na baela, adia bae ha abi, bena bogadia bae kunu. Unuheto amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, bona imamu amo e karamu karadia iboudiai baine hanamodia.
DEU.14.29.english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

DEU.28.50.motu: vaira-hua taudia, iahu basie matauraidia bona memero basie bogadia hisi.
DEU.28.50.english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

DEU.28.5.motu: Emui bosea bae namo, bona emui dihu bae namo.
DEU.28.5.english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

DEU.16.8.motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana bavania. Dina ihahituna ai hebou helaḡana bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; una dina ai ḡaukara ta basio karaia.
DEU.16.8.english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.

DEU.33.20.motu: Gad be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.3.6.motu: Bena ta habuadia tari, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ta kara henia heḡereḡerena; hanua ta ta lalodiai tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, ta aladia ore;
DEU.3.6.english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

DEU.19.16.motu: Koikoi tauna ta ese tau ta bema habadelaia, baineto ia na vada e kerere,
DEU.19.16.english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

DEU.19.8.english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

DEU.11.14.motu: ia ese medu baine henimui ena nega korikori ai, medu gunadia bona medu gabedia, tano ihapariparina; bena emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro ba haboudia.
DEU.11.14.english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

DEU.33.17.motu: Ena boromakau natuna maruanena roboana na herea dae;
DEU.33.17.english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd.

DEU.28.56.motu: Eiava bogaragimui ai readia hahine ta tau-anina manada-manada bona aniani inonoḡadia mo e animu, aena danu taina se hamareremu, badina be ia na aboni-noho hahinena; to ena kara baine auka, adavana enai bona natuna maruanena enai bona natuna hahinena enai.
DEU.28.56.english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

DEU.19.8-9.motu: A ina haheḡani idoinai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimui na ba badinaia namonamo, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia bona ena dala ba rakalaia hanaihanai; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui tano baine habadaia, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena, bona senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona idoinai baine henimui: una negana ai umui ese hanua toi ma ba gwauraidia hidi, unu gunadia toiosi ida bae mia;

DEU.4.46.motu: Gabuna be Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Bete-peoro e vaira henia kourana ai, Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, ena tano ai. Hari Sihon na Mose bona Israel taudia ese e hadarerea, Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai,
DEU.4.46.english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

DEU.11.25.motu: Tau ta ese basine laomui ahu diba; Iehova ese gari baine havaraia, ba lao henia tanona Ialonai; iboudiai na umui garimui bae gari, ia ese e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.11.25.english: No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

DEU.18.16.motu: Horeb ai, hebou badana dinana ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, o noia heḡereḡerena, oto “Mani emu kara Iehova, emai Dirava, erena basia kamonai lou, bona ina lahi badana basia itaia lou, baia mase garina”.
DEU.18.16.english: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

DEU.19.14.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai, dekemu tauna ena tano hetoa holoahuna, uru gunadia taudia ese e holoa ḡauna, na basio raḡaia oho.
DEU.19.14.english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

DEU.17.6.motu: Dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi edia hahebade dainai una tau eiava una hahine ba hodoa mase; a tau tamona ena hahebade dainai basio hodoa mase.
DEU.17.6.english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

DEU.28.60.motu: Ia ese Aigupto goreredia iboudiai, o garilaidiamu ḡaudia, latamui ai baine hadihodia, bae gugubamui.
DEU.28.60.english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

DEU.26.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese imana e toia roro, mai siahuna ida, Aigupto amo e hakaumai lasi, mai hahegari karadia bona toa idau-idau bona hoa karadia ida;
DEU.26.8.english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

DEU.12.18.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bavani, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai, oi bona natumu maruanena bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna emu hanua ai e nohomu; bona emu ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai ba moale.
DEU.12.18.english: but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all that you put your hand to.

DEU.29.8.motu: edia tano ta abia, Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhu kahana taudia ta henidia, edia tano ai bae halaoa totona.
DEU.29.8.english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

DEU.3.4.motu: Una negana ai, ena hanua iboudiai ta abidia, hanua ta asita reaia; ta abi hanuadia iboudiai na tauratoi-ahui, Aragob tanona ai; Og, Basan pavapavana, ena basileia bunai.
DEU.3.4.english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

DEU.7.13.motu: Ia ese baine lalokau henimui, baine hanamomui, baine hahutumamui; garamui danu baine hanamodia, bona emui tano anidia baine hanamodia, emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro bona emui boromakau natudia bona emui mamoe natudia, senemui e gwau henidia hamata baine henimui eto tanona ai.
DEU.7.13.english: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

DEU.12.6.motu: bena ba lao henia, emui ḡole-oho bouboudia, bona emui boubou idauidaudia, bona emui karoa ihagwautadia, bona emui dudui-isi ḡaudia, bonaemui gwauhamata ḡaudia, bona emui herahia ḡaudia, bona emui boromakau natudia roboadia, bona emui mamoe natudia roboadia, iboudiai ba laohai.
DEU.12.6.english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

DEU.7.6.motu: Badina be umui na bese helaḡana, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tanobada besedia iboudiai bogaragidia amo vada e abimui hidi, iena bese korikori ai baine halaomui totona.
DEU.7.6.english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

DEU.23.18.motu: Ariara hahinena davana eiava sisia davana na Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ruma ai basio vareailaia, emu gwauhamata davana ai basio halaoa; badina be unu kara ruaosi na Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e dadaraimu.
DEU.23.18.english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

DEU.29.21.motu: Iehova ese Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo baine abia siri, bona baine hadikaia, heuduguirai herevadia iboudiai vada e gwaurai hamata bona ina taravatu bukana lalonai vada e tore heḡereḡeredia.
DEU.29.21.english: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

DEU.18.14.motu: Badinabe hari gabudia bavabidia besedia ese rohe taudia bona mari taudia e kamonai henidiamu; a umui be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e gwaumui tao, basio karaia e tomu.
DEU.18.14.english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

DEU.32.10.motu: Ia ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e davaria,
DEU.32.10.english: He found him in a desert land,

DEU.4.42.motu: ala-ala tauna, bamona e alaia mase, dia e inai henia guna dainai, toe hapadidia dainai, ia ese unu hanua ta baine heau henia, baine; roho mauri helaoreana.
DEU.4.42.english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

DEU.23.22.motu: A basioma gwau hamata, oi na asi emu kara dika.
DEU.23.22.english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

DEU.15.10.motu: Ba henia mai lalomu idoinai; lalomu basine hisihisi o heniamu dainai. Badina be unu amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, emu ḡaukara iboudiai bona imamu karadia idoidiai lalodiai.
DEU.15.10.english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

DEU.31.21.motu: Bena dika momo bona hekwarahi momo ediai bae kau negana ai, ina ane ese baine habadelaidia; badina be idia garadia ududia amo basine boio. Badina be lau dibagu lalohadai dahaka dahaka ina harihari lalodia ai e varamu, na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai do asina hakaudia vareai negana ai.
DEU.31.21.english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

DEU.32.24.english: They shall be wasted with hunger,

DEU.7.4.motu: Badina be unu boma kara toma, idia ese natumui mamaruanedia na lauegu amo bema hakaudia siri, idau diravadia itomadiho-henidia totona; bena Iehova ena badu bema siahu, umui latamui ai, bona bema habuamui tari haraḡa-haraḡa.
DEU.7.4.english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

DEU.4.47.motu: bena ena tano e abia. Og, Basan pavapavana, ena tano danu e abia. Unu pavapava raruosi na Amoro taudia edia pavapava: edia noho gabuna na mairiveina kahana ai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai;
DEU.4.47.english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

DEU.22.28.motu: Tau ta ese hane-ulato rami-hebou ta asi maohenina bema davaria, bena bema rosia bona bema eno henia, bena taunimanima ese bae davaria,
DEU.22.28.english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

DEU.7.17.motu: Readia lalomu ai baoto “Ini bese ese lau e hereagumu: ede baina luludia lasi toma?”
DEU.7.17.english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

DEU.1.4.motu: Una be Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, Astaroto ai bona Edrei ai e nohova tauna, e hadareredia murinai.
DEU.1.4.english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

DEU.33.14.english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun,

DEU.33.27.motu: Noho-hanaihanai Diravana na emu noho gabuna;
DEU.33.27.english: The eternal God is your dwelling place.

DEU.25.19.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese inaimui iboudiai bogaragidiai laḡa-ani baine henimui, Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai. Una negana ai Amalek ilalolaina ba rohoa oho, guba henunai. Basio laloa boio.
DEU.25.19.english: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

DEU.15.19.motu: Roboa mamaruanedia emu boromakau seridia ai bona emu mamoe seridia ai ba hahelaḡadia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena. Boromakau natuna roboana na basio haḡaukaraia; mamoe natuna roboana na huina basio abia;
DEU.15.19.english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

DEU.23.10.motu: Tau ta hanuaboi ai baine miro, ia na taruha baine rakatania, murimuri ai baine noho;
DEU.23.10.english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

DEU.22.14.motu: bena hemarai herevana bema tahotaholaia, ladana bema hadikaia bema toma “Ina hahine na abia, a ia ida a eno bou negana ai na diba ia na dia rami-hebou ulatona”.
DEU.22.14.english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

DEU.3.9.motu: (Hari Heremon ororona na Sidono taudia ese ladana e hatoamu “Sirion”, a Amoro taudia ese ladana e hatoamu “Seniri”).
DEU.3.9.english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

DEU.5.16.motu: Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimu heḡereḡerena; bena emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, bona emu noho baine namo, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e henimu tanona ai.
DEU.5.16.english: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

DEU.28.8.motu: Iehova ese emui roge baine hanamodia, bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai baine hanamodia. Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ia ese baine hanamomui.
DEU.28.8.english: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

DEU.2.30.motu: A Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ese e gwauda tao, basita raka hanai eto; badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese laumana e ha-aukaia bona lalona e hagoadaia, umui imamui ai baine atoa helaoreana, hari ina dina ai heḡereḡerena.
DEU.2.30.english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

DEU.28.37.motu: Umui na hahegari ḡauna ai bona hereva lada-isina ai bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai baola, Iehova ese bogaragidiai bae kahumui nege besena taudia ediai.
DEU.28.37.english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.

DEU.1.39.motu: Natumui maraḡidia, haida ese bae abidia mauri oto, bona natumui karukarudia, kara namo bona kara dika do asi dibadia, idia na bae raka vareai: una tano baina henidia, edia tano.
DEU.1.39.english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

DEU.11.2.motu: Hari dina ai ba laloa namonamo: badina be ini hereva na dia natumui, ḡau ta asi dibadia bona ḡau ta asie itaia, asina herevalai henidiamu. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena mata-hakani, bona ena siahu, bona imana mai goadana ida e toia roro, ba haerodia.
DEU.11.2.english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

DEU.30.19.motu: Guba bona tanobada na boi henidiamu, lau na habadelaimuimu herevadia na hari dina ai idia ese bae hamomokani: lau na mauri bona mase, bona hahenamo bona heuduguirai, na vairamui ai vada na atodia. Taunabunai, mauri bavabia hidi; bena umui ba mauri, bona garamui bae mauri;
DEU.30.19.english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

DEU.4.5.motu: A laloa, Iehova egu Dirava ese vada e henigu taravatudia bona haheḡanidia lau ese vada na henimui, ba raka vareai bona bavabia tanona ai ba badinadia totona.
DEU.4.5.english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

DEU.31.1.motu: Mose ese ini hereva iboudiai na Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia.
DEU.31.1.english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

DEU.15.17.motu: auri mai matana ta bavabia, iduara ai taiana abona ba daia uru; bena ia ese oi isiaimu baine lao heni ela bona mase. Emu hesiai hahinena danu unu ba karaia toma.
DEU.15.17.english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

DEU.33.9.motu: Ia ese tamana bona sinana e herevalaidia, eto
DEU.33.9.english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’

DEU.28.44.motu: Ia ese baine henimui torehai; emui ai basine abi torehai. Ia na kwara ai bainela; umui na iu ai baola.
DEU.28.44.english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

DEU.5.24.motu: oto, O itaia, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese ia hairaina bona siahuna vada e haheitalaida; ia gadona danu lahi bogaragina amo vada ta kamonai. Hari dina ai tame diba Dirava ese taunimanima vada e hereva henidia, bona unu taunimanima na doini mamauri.
DEU.5.24.english: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

DEU.13.8.motu: Unu bema kara toma, ena lalo-ani basio abia dae, bona basio kamonaihenia, bona basio bogaia hisi, bona basio hamauria, bona basio hunia.
DEU.13.8.english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

DEU.16.19.motu: Hahemaoro basio hagagevaia, tau ta iduruna totona. Hahemaoro ihagagevana davana basio abia, badina be hahemaoro ihagagevana; davana na aonega tauna matana e hakepuludiamu bona kara maoromaoro tauna, ena hereva e hakoikoidiamu.
DEU.16.19.english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

DEU.3.13.motu: A Gilead kahana bona Basan, Og ena basileia, idoinai, Aragob tanona idoinai mai Basan ida, lau ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia na henidia. (Una Basan tanona na ladana e hatoamu “Refaim taudia edia tano”.
DEU.3.13.english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

DEU.25.9.motu: vabuna baine raka kahira, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai una tau ena tamaka na aena amo baine veria oho, bona vairana baine kanudia, baineto “Tadikakana garana basine havaradia tauna na ene baine heto”.
DEU.25.9.english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

DEU.31.27.motu: Badina be emui gwau-edeede bona emui daḡedaḡe be dibagu; hari dinaai, lau na doini dekemui ai na mauri nohomu ai, umui ese Iehova vada Ia gwau edeede henia; matona, baina mase murinai ede ba kara toma?
DEU.31.27.english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?

DEU.21.6.motu: Bena una mase tauna enai e kahikahi hanuana ena tau badadia ese una boromakau natuna hahinena koura ai aiona e hakwaidua ḡauna daenai imadia bae huri;
DEU.21.6.english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

DEU.12.15.motu: Ḡau tamona, emui hanua idau-idau iboudiai lalodiai, mauri ḡaudia haida, uda nanidia bona dia na heheto, bavaladia diba, bona hidiodia bavani, emui ura heḡereḡerena, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena hahenamo vada e henimui heḡereḡerena; vada e taubu taudia bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba.
DEU.12.15.english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

DEU.11.19.motu: Natumui ba hadibalaidia, ruma ai o helaimu negadia ai, bona dala ai o rakamu negadia; ai, bona o hekuremu negadia ai, bona o tore isimu negadia ai, do ba herevalaidia.
DEU.11.19.english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

DEU.21.15.motu: Tau ta adavana bema rarua, ta bema ura henia, ma ta bema inai henia; bena natuna na hahine raruosi, e ura heniamu hahinena bona e inai heniamu hahinena, edia amo bema abidia, a roboana na e inai heniamu hahinena ena amo,
DEU.21.15.english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

DEU.18.21.motu: Readia oi lalomu ai baoto “Iehova ese se gwauraia herevana na ede baia diba toma?”
DEU.18.21.english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”

DEU.12.31.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na unu basio kara henia toma; badina be lebulebu karadia iboudiai Iehova ese e inai henimu be idia ese vada e kara, edia dirava ihanamolaidia; oibe, natudia mamaruanedia bona natudia hahinedia na lahi ai e haḡoledia oho, edia dirava ihanamolaidia.
DEU.12.31.english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

DEU.18.9.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai negana ai, unu bese edia kara bodagadia na basio kara.
DEU.18.9.english: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

DEU.1.45.motu: Bena o Iou, Iehova vairanai o taitai, a Iehova na emui taitai se kamonai bona emui hereva se abi dae.
DEU.1.45.english: You returned and wept before Yahweh, but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

DEU.7.23.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, baine haheḡonudia patapata, ela bona bae ore vaitani.
DEU.7.23.english: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

DEU.19.5.motu: Tau ta bamona ida uda bema lao, au bema utu; bena ira bema davea, au ta iutuna totona, a ira anina na ira auna amo bema hedave oho, bamona enai bema tubu, bema hamasea, ia na unu hanua toiosi ta baine heau henia, baine roho mauri;
DEU.19.5.english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

DEU.22.17.motu: ia ese vada e hahemaraia, eto ia na dia rami-hebou ulatona; a natugu ena rami-hebou toadia bini”. Bena idia ese hari dabua na bae papaia, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai.
DEU.22.17.english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

DEU.32.52.motu: Taunabunai tano ba itaia vairamu ai; a Israel taudia na henidiamu tanona na basio lao henia bona lalonai basio raka vareai.
DEU.32.52.english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

DEU.3.27.motu: Pisga ororona ba dara dae, dorina ai ba gini, ba roha lao, tano na matamu amo ba itaia, lahara kahana ai, mirigini kahana ai, diho kahana ai, mairiveina kahana ai; badina be ina Ioridane sinavaina na basio hanaia.
DEU.3.27.english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

DEU.1.34.motu: Iehova ese emui hereva e kamonai, bena e badu, e gwau hamata, eto,
DEU.1.34.english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

DEU.28.23.motu: Guba na kwaramui daediai auri labora-labora heḡereḡerena ai bainela; tanobadana aemui henudiai auri heḡereḡerena ai bainela.
DEU.28.23.english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

DEU.21.21.motu: Bena hanua taudia iboudiai ese bae hodoa mase. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure: Israel taudia iboudiai ese harina bae kamonai, bena bae gari.
DEU.21.21.english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

DEU.18.5.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abia hidi, emui iduhu iboudiai lalodia amo, baine gini, hahelaḡa karadia baine kara Iehova ladana ai, ia bona ia garana ela bona hanaihanai.
DEU.18.5.english: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.

DEU.32.35.motu: Dika davana be lau imagu ai, bona namo davana danu,

DEU.9.7.motu: Ba laloa tao, basio laloa boio, Iehova, emui Dirava, ede o habadua toma tano ḡaḡaena ai: Aigupto amo o raka lasi dinana ai ema bona ina gabu ai o kau, umui ese Iehova vada o gwau edeede henia.
DEU.9.7.english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.

DEU.19.15.motu: Dibana tauna tamona ena hereva basine heḡereḡere, kerere tauna ta ena kara dika eiava ena kerere ihamomokanina: a dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi edia hereva ese hahebade bae hamomokania.
DEU.19.15.english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

DEU.31.24.motu: Mose ese ina taravatu ena hereva iboudiai na buka ai e tore ḡuḡuru.
DEU.31.24.english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

DEU.14.20.motu: Mai hanidia; ḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia iboudiai na bavani.
DEU.14.20.english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

DEU.27.20.motu: Tamana adavana ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia, badina be ia ese tamana vada e haida hahemaraia. (Bena taunimanima; iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.20.english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’

DEU.4.34.motu: Eiava nega ta Dirava ese bese ta vada e lao henia, idau bese bogaragina amo vada e abia, iena a?, hahehisi amo, toa amo, hoa karadia amo, tuari amo, imana goadana amo, imana itoi-rorona amo, hahegari badadia amo, vada e abia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai bona umui vairarnui ai Aigupto ai, e karaia heḡereḡerena, a?
DEU.4.34.english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

DEU.31.22.motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese ina ane e torea una dina ai, bona ia ese Israel taudia e hadibalaidia.
DEU.31.22.english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

DEU.3.19.motu: A adavamui bona natumui bona emui boromakau - dibagu emui boromakau na momo - vada na henimui hanuadia ai bae noho,
DEU.3.19.english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

DEU.22.6.motu: Manu rumana ta boma davaria, au ai eiava tano ai, lalonai be manu hahinena mai natuna ida eiava mai gatoina ida, manu hahinena na natuna ida basio abidia;
DEU.22.6.english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

DEU.34.10.motu: Una negana ema bona harihari, peroveta tauna ta basine hedinarai Israel ai, Mose heḡereḡerena; ia na Iehova ida e hevaira heheni bona e hahediba heheni.
DEU.34.10.english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

DEU.32.50.motu: Bena ba dara dae ororona ai ba mase, tubu tama dekedia ba hahebou, Horo ororona ai kakamu Aaron e mase bona tubu tama dekediai e hahebou heḡereḡerena.
DEU.32.50.english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

DEU.10.21.motu: Ia ba imodaia, ia na emui Dirava; siahu bona hahegari karadia iboudiai matamui ese vada e ita be ia ese e kara.
DEU.10.21.english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

DEU.2.3.motu: Ina ororo badi-tanona ai vada o loa daudau; harihari mirigini kahana baola.
DEU.2.3.english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

DEU.20.9.motu: Orea taudia na unu bae hamaorodia toma, bena heitatao taudia ese tuari biagudia bae duanaidia.
DEU.20.9.english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

DEU.6.24.motu: Bena Iehova ese e haḡanimai, ini taravatu iboudiai baia badinadia, bona Iehova, eda Dirava, garina baia gari, baia namo hanaihanai bona baine hamaurimai helaoreana, hari dina ai e hamauridamu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.6.24.english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

DEU.8.13.motu: emui boromakau seridia bona emui mamoe seridia bae hutuma; emui silver bona emui gold bae bada; emui ḡau iboudiai bae momo.
DEU.8.13.english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

DEU.18.18.motu: lau na ediabese bogaragina amo peroveta tauna ta baina abia hidi, oi heḡereḡeremu; lauegu hereva na ia uduna amo baina gwaurai, bena lau ese baina haḡanilaia herevadia na ia ese baine gwaurai henidia.
DEU.18.18.english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

DEU.30.15.motu: 0 itaia, hari ina dina ai mauri bona namo, bona mase bona dika, vairamui ai vada na atodia.
DEU.30.15.english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

DEU.32.17.motu: Lauma dikadia e boudia, idia na dia Dirava,
DEU.32.17.english: They sacrificed to demons, not God,

DEU.21.7.motu: baeto: Imamai ese ina rara asie hahebubua, bona matamai ese ihahebubuna asie itaia.
DEU.21.7.english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

DEU.8.19.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, boma laloa boio, dirava idaudia boma raka henidia kahi, isiaidia boma lao heni bona boma toma henidia diho, hari dina ai na hamaoromui momokanimu, vada ba mase.
DEU.8.19.english: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

DEU.14.14.motu: mukou danu, mai ia bamona manudia ida;

DEU.28.40.motu: Olive audia na bae vara emui tano idoinai, a olive dehorona basio hedahulai; badina be emui olive huahuadia bae ruru nege.
DEU.28.40.english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

DEU.20.18.motu: Unuheto amo idia ese edia dirava itomadiho-henidia karadia bodagadia iboudiai na basiehadibamui, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, basio kara dika henia.
DEU.20.18.english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against Yahweh your God.

DEU.23.21.motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ba gwau henia hamata negana ai, emu gwauhamata ihamomokanina ai basio halahe. Badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, ese emu gwauhamata anina na emu ai baine tahua; bema lasi, ia ese baine gwauraimu kara dika tauna.
DEU.23.21.english: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

DEU.12.21.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna bema daudau, emui boromakau eiava emui mamoe, Iehova ese vada e henimui ḡaudia, bavaladia diba, vada na haḡanimui heḡereḡerena; bena emui hanua ai bavani, emui ura heḡereḡerena.
DEU.12.21.english: If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

DEU.23.8.motu: Uru ihatoina ai bena idia garadia ese Iehova ena hebou lalonai bae raka vareai.
DEU.23.8.english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

DEU.24.16.motu: Tama na basie aladia mase natudia daidiai, bona memero na basie aladia mase tamadia daidiai; a ta ta ena kara dika ena kara dika daidiai bae aladia mase.
DEU.24.16.english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

DEU.28.32.motu: Natumu mamaruanedia bona natumu hahinedia na idau bese taudia bae henidia; matamu amo ba raraidia, bona iruru-matamu bae diho, to irudia na imamu basie goada.
DEU.28.32.english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

DEU.28.41.motu: Natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia bae vara, to dekemui ai basie noho; mai iḡuidia bae hakaudia lao.
DEU.28.41.english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

DEU.6.3.motu: Taunabunai, Israel e, a kamonai, bona nahuamui ba toho; bena ba namo bona ba hutuma, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumutanona ai, Iehova, tamamui edia Dirava, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.6.3.english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

DEU.20.12.motu: A maino basiema ura, bema ura tuari, vada ba koua heḡeḡe,
DEU.20.12.english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

DEU.27.24.motu: Dekena tauna e alaia mase hehunimu tauna na bae uduguriaia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.24.english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’

DEU.12.28.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ini na haḡanilaimuimu herevadia iboudiai na karadia ba kara; bena ba namo, natumui danu umui murimui ai bae namo hanaihanai, kara namodia bona kara maoromaorodia Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai o karamu dainai.
DEU.12.28.english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

DEU.3.14.motu: Iairi Manase ese Basan tanona, Aragob tanona idoinai ela bona Gesuru taudia edia tano bona Maakata taudia edia tano, e abia, unu tano hanuadia ladadia e hato “Havoto-iairi”, ia inemaina; ladana na unu e hatoa tomamu emabona hari.)
DEU.3.14.english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

DEU.19.10.motu: asi ena kerere tauna rarana na Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai baine hebubu, bena una rara na umui latamui ai baine mia na garina.
DEU.19.10.english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

DEU.16.10.motu: Bena pura ariana ba karaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; emui herahia ba henia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena herahia vada e hanamolaimui heḡereḡerena.
DEU.16.10.english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.

DEU.9.12.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, ina gabu amo a hekei; haraḡa-haraḡa; badina be Aigupto amo vada o hakaudia lasi taudiavada e kara havara; na haḡanilaidia dalana amo vada e raka siri haraḡa-haraḡa, kaivakuku ta vada e karaia.
DEU.9.12.english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

DEU.14.2.motu: Badina be umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese helaḡana, Iehova ese tanobada kopina ai e nohomu besedia iboudiai edia amo vada e abimui hidi, ena orea korikori ai baine halaomui totona.
DEU.14.2.english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

DEU.32.1.motu: Guba e, a hakala, lau baina hereva;
DEU.32.1.english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak.

DEU.18.8.motu: Bona idia ida ana baine abia, iboudiai ahudia bae heḡereḡere, a ahuna ena hanua amo baine abia na ma idau.
DEU.18.8.english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

DEU.11.1.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba ura henia bona ba kamonai henia; ena hahedua bona ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani ba badinadia nega iboudiai.
DEU.11.1.english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

DEU.16.14.motu: Emui aria ai ba moale hebou, oi bona natumu maruanena bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna bona noho-hedoa tauna bona ihareha bona vabu emuhanua ai nonoho.
DEU.16.14.english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

DEU.31.10.motu: Mose ese e haḡanidia, eto, Laḡani ihahitudia dokodia ai, heruha-nege laḡanina ena nega helaḡana ai, kalaga ariana dainai
DEU.31.10.english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

DEU.9.6.motu: Taunabunai ba diba, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ina tano namona e henimuimu na dia emui kara maoromaoro daidiai; badina be umui na gwau-daḡe taumui.
DEU.9.6.english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

DEU.27.19.motu: Idau tauna enai eiava ihareha enai eiava vabu enai hahemaoro e hagagevaiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.19.english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’

DEU.9.20.motu: Iehova ese Aaron danu e badu heniava una negana ai, baine alaia mase eto; ia dainai danu na ḡuriḡuriva.
DEU.9.20.english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

DEU.13.11.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai bae kamonai bona bae gari, gabeai kara havara unuhetomana nega ta basie karaia lou, ela bona hanaihanai.
DEU.13.11.english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

DEU.5.31.motu: A oi be lau badibadigu ai ba gini, bena baina hamaorolaimu taravatudia bona haheḡanidia iboudiai o ese ba hadibalaidia; bena baina henidia tanona bae noholaia negana ai bae badinadia.
DEU.5.31.english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

DEU.1.27.motu: Emui kalaga ai o maumau noho, oto, Iehova ese vada e inai henida dainai ia ese Aigupto tanona amo e hakauda lasi, Amoro taudia imadia ai baine negeda bena idia ese bae alada ore totona.
DEU.1.27.english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

DEU.33.21.motu: Tano namona ia ese e abia hidi, iena,
DEU.33.21.english: He provided the first part for himself,

DEU.34.9.motu: Bena Iosua Nunu na aonega laumana ese e rohea; badina be Mose ese imana na ia tubuana ai vada e ato kau. Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese e kamonai henia, bona Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia haheḡanidia na idia ese e badinadia.
DEU.34.9.english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

DEU.2.8.motu: Taunabunai ta laolao, varavarada Esau garana, Seiri ai e nohomu taudia, ta rakatanidia, Araba dalana danu ta rakatania, bona Elata bona Esiono-gebere ta rakatanidia. Bena ta lou lao, Moab tano-ḡaḡaena dalana ai tala.
DEU.2.8.english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

DEU.10.2.motu: Bena revareva baina tore unu huro nadidia ai, nadi gunadia ai e hetore heḡereḡeredia. Bena maua ai ba udadia.
DEU.10.2.english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

DEU.20.8.motu: Heitatao taudia ese orea taudia ma bae hereva henidia, baeto: Bema tau ta gari ese e butua taomu, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, bamona lalodia baine hamanokadia na garina.
DEU.20.8.english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

DEU.18.19.motu: Bena daika ese lauegu hereva, ia ese lau ladagu ai baine gwaurai, na basine abi dae, lau ese davana baina henia.
DEU.18.19.english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

DEU.26.6.motu: Aigupto taudia ese e daḡedaḡe henimai, e hahisimai, maduna metaudia na paḡamai ai e atodia.
DEU.26.6.english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

DEU.19.19.motu: bavabia, ia ese tadikakana baine kara henia eto heḡereḡerena na ia ba kara henia.
DEU.19.19.english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.27.7.motu: Herohemaino bouboudia danu ba hahelaḡadia. Unuseni ai danu bavaniani bona ba moale hebou, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
DEU.27.7.english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.

DEU.3.21.motu: Una negana ai Iosua na haḡania, nato, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ini pavapava raruosi ede e karadia toma na matamu amo vada o itaia; benaini, ba lao henidia basileiadia danu unu baine karadia toma.
DEU.3.21.english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

DEU.21.4.motu: Hari hanua tau-badadia ese bae laohaia, koura ta maisinavaina, tano asie ruaia bona ḡau ta asie hadoa gabuna, unuseni ai aiona bae hakwaidua.
DEU.21.4.english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

DEU.24.17.motu: Hahemaoro basio hagagevaia, idau tauna enai eiava ihareha enai. Vabu ena dabua na basio abia, abitorehai davana.
DEU.24.17.english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

DEU.7.5.motu: A ini ba karadia toma: edia ihaboulaina patadia baḡiḡi rohoroho; edia dubu au-tubuadia ba tara kohikohi; edia au helaḡadiaba hagaridia; edia kaivakuku na lahi ai ba doudia.
DEU.7.5.english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

DEU.29.13.motu: Iena bese taudiaai baine halaomui hari ina dina ai, bona emui Dirava ai bainela, e gwau henimui hamata bona senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.29.13.english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

DEU.28.43.motu: Bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna na atai ai bainela; umui be henu amo baola.
DEU.28.43.english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

DEU.27.14.motu: Bena Levi taudia na bae hereva badabada, Israel taudia iboudiai bae hamaorodia, baeto:
DEU.27.14.english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

DEU.24.10.motu: Dekemu tauna na ḡau ta ba henia torehai negana ai, ena ruma ai basio dae kau, ena abitorehai toana iabina.
DEU.24.10.english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

DEU.12.8.motu: Harihari iniseni ai ta karamu karadia na unuseni ai basio kara. Iniseni ai ta ta ena ura ena ura ta karamu,
DEU.12.8.english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

DEU.25.8.motu: Bena hanua tau-badadia ese una tau bae boiria, bae hereva henia. Benaena hereva bema ha-aukaia, bema toma “Lau na iabina asina uramu”,
DEU.25.8.english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

DEU.33.28.motu: Taunabunai Israel na e noho namonamova,

DEU.2.20.motu: (Una tano ladana ta be “Refaim”, badina be gunaguna Refaim taudia unuseni ai e nohova. A Amono taudia ese ladadia e hato “Samsumim”:
DEU.2.20.english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

DEU.33.24.motu: Asere be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.26.10.motu: Taunabunai lau vada nama, oi Iehova vada o henigu tanona anina roboana vada na mailaia.
DEU.26.10.english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

DEU.20.14.motu: a hahine mai natudia ida bavabidia mauri, bona boromakau bona hanua rumadia mai kohudia ida na bavabi emui. Bena inaimui adia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui, vada bavania.
DEU.20.14.english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

DEU.28.4.motu: Taumui anidia bae namo, bona emui tano anidia bae namo. Emui mauri ḡaudia anidia bae namo, bona emui seri bae hutuma; emui mamoe natudia bae mauri.
DEU.28.4.english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

DEU.23.24.motu: Dekemu tauna ena vine imeana ai ba raka vareai negana ai, vine anidia bavani, emu hitolo heḡereḡerena, a haida basio uda emu moda ai.
DEU.23.24.english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

DEU.19.7.motu: Taunabunai na haḡanimuimu, hanua toi ba gwauraidia hidi.
DEU.19.7.english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

DEU.32.27.motu: A inaidia edia hevaseha herevadia garidia na gari,
DEU.32.27.english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy,

DEU.17.10.motu: Bena Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna amo bae haere henimui herevana ba bavabia dae, bona bae gwaurai henimui karadia iboudiai ba kara,
DEU.17.10.english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

DEU.4.27.motu: Iehova ese baine hakarohomui rohoroho tanobada besedia bogaragidiai; vada ba gadoi, idau bese idau bese bogaragidiai, Iehova ese baine hakarohomui gabudia ai.
DEU.4.27.english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

DEU.6.21.motu: Bena oi ese natumu ba haere henia, baoto: Ai na Farao isiaina a lao heniva Aigupto ai; bena Iehova ese ia imana siahuna amo e hakaumai lasi, Aigupto tanona amo;
DEU.6.21.english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

DEU.22.4.motu: Varavaramu ena boromakau eiava ena doniki na dala ai bema keto, bena boma itaia, ketona ai basio rakatania; ihagini-torenaai varavaramu ba durua.
DEU.22.4.english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

DEU.5.29.motu: Nega iboudiai unu bemalaloa toma bema namo; bena bema matauraigu bona egu haheḡani iboudiai bema badina, unu amo edia noho bema namo, bona natudia edia noho bema namo, ela bona hanaihanai.
DEU.5.29.english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

DEU.6.2.motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, garina ba gari, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani, na henimumu ḡaudia, iboudiai ba badinadia, oi bona natumu bona tubumu, emu mauri dinadia iboudiai; unu amo emu mauri dinadia bae hoho.
DEU.6.2.english: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

DEU.28.12.motu: Iehova ese ena guba kohuna namona baine keho henimui, medu na emui tano ai baine hadihoa, ena nega korikori ai, bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai baine hanamodia. Bese momo ba henidia torehai, a ediai basio abi torehai.
DEU.28.12.english: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

DEU.24.6.motu: Asi tauna ta ese uit iririlaina nadidia, henu nadina eiava atai nadina, baine abia, abitorehai toana; badina be unu bema kara toma, una tau ena mauri badina bema abia oho.
DEU.24.6.english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

DEU.12.27.motu: bona emui ḡole-oho bouboudia hidiodia bona raradia naIehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ai ba hahelaḡadia. Bena emui boubou ḡaudia raradia na Iehova emui Dirava ena ihaboulaina patana ai ba sei, a hidiodia be bavani.
DEU.12.27.english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Yahweh your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

DEU.31.28.motu: Emui iduhu tau-badadia iboudiai bona emui heitatao taudia ba haboudia, lau eseini hereva baina gwaurai henidia, bena guba bona tanobada na umui ihabadelaimui ai baina halaodia.
DEU.31.28.english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

DEU.7.3.motu: Basio adavadia; umui natumui ulatodia na edia uhau basio henidia, bona idia natudia ulatodia basio abidia, emui uhau adavadia.
DEU.7.3.english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

DEU.2.24.motu: A tore isi, eto, emui laolao baola, Aranon kourana ba hanaia; Sihon, Amoro tauna, Hesebon pavapavana, na umui imamui ai, ena tano danu vada na henimui; ba raka vareai, ba tuari henia.
DEU.2.24.english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

DEU.13.14.motu: Unu bema heto, umui na ba tahua bona ba henanadai malaka-malaka. Bema momokani kara dika-hereana unuhetomana vada e karaia bogaragimui ai,
DEU.13.14.english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

DEU.28.38.motu: Uhe momo ba hado, a anidia ba gogo bae maraḡi: badina be kwadi ese bae ha-ore.
DEU.28.38.english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

DEU.11.12.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e reḡuamu tanona. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e haḡereamu, nega iboudiai, laḡani matamana ela bona laḡani dokona.
DEU.11.12.english: a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

DEU.25.7.motu: A ihana na iabina basinema ura, hari vabu na hanua tau-badadia dekediabainela, hanua ikoukouna ai; baineto “Ihagu na se uramu tadikakana dihina baine havaraia Israel ai; vabu ihana ena kara ikarana ai e gwau edeedemu”,
DEU.25.7.english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

DEU.1.8.motu: A itaia, una tano idoinai vairamui ai vada na lailaia; ba raka vareai, tano na bavabia, Iehova ese umui senemui, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, e gwau henidia hamata, tano na idia baine henidia bona idia garadia baine henidia eto.
DEU.1.8.english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

DEU.32.40.motu: Badina be imagu na duduia isimu atai ai,
DEU.32.40.english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare,

DEU.29.2.motu: Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia, e hamaorodia, eto: Iehova ese Aigupto tanona ai umui vairamui ai e kara karadia na o itadia, Farao mai ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ida bona ena tano i (idoinai ede e karadia toma.
DEU.29.2.english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them:

DEU.9.5.motu: Edia tano bavabia emui, dia emui kara maoromaoro eiava lalomui ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva daidiai, to unu bese edia kara havara daidiai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vairamui amo baine luludia lasi, senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwaurai henidia hamata herevana ihamomokanina totona.
DEU.9.5.english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

DEU.15.21.motu: A bema mai bebeka-bebekana, eiava aena bema hedairike, eiava matana bema kepulu, eiava bema mai ena dika ta, basio hahelaḡaia Iehova, emu Dirava, ena.
DEU.15.21.english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

DEU.28.52.motu: Emui hanua na edia tuari oreadia ese bae koudia ahu, ela bona emui maḡu badadia, o abidadama henidiamu ḡaudia, na bae heḡiḡi dobi, emui tano idiodia. Edia tuari oreadia ese emui hanua bae koudia hegege, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona idoinai.
