DEU.28.52.english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.

DEU.28.13.motu: Iehova ese kwara ai baine halaomui, iu ai basiola. Atai ai mo baola; henu amo basiola. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani hari dina ai na henimuimu na boma badinadia namonamo bona karadia boma kara,
DEU.28.13.english: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

DEU.4.48.motu: Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai, e matamaia, e laomu ela bona Sirion ororona (una na Heremon ladana ta);
DEU.4.48.english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

DEU.21.1.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai, mase tauna ta; tano paka ai boma davaria, basioma diba daika ese e aIaia,
DEU.21.1.english: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

DEU.17.18.motu: Ena basileia teronona ai baine helai negana ai, ia ese ina taravatu buka ta ai baine torea, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi iduhuna amo, edia taravatu bukana amo baine torea hanai.
DEU.17.18.english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

DEU.28.33.motu: Do asi dibamu besena ese emu tano anina bona imamu amo ba kara ḡaudia, iboudiai bae dadihai; bae daḡedaḡe henimu bona bae hahisimu dina iboudiai lalodiai,
DEU.28.33.english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

DEU.2.6.motu: Idia ediai aniani ba hoia, moni davana, bena bavania; bona idia ediai ranu ba hoia, moni davana, bena ba inua.
DEU.2.6.english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

DEU.30.13.motu: Ḡauna na dia davara unukahana ai; ta basioto “Daika ita daidai bainela davara unukahana ai, baine mailaia edai, bena baita kamonaia bona karana baita karaia?”
DEU.30.13.english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

DEU.1.24.motu: Bena idia na ororo kahadia amo eha laolao, ela bona Eskol kourana ai e kau, unuseni ai e hasinadoa.
DEU.1.24.english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

DEU.32.13.motu: Tanobada latalatana ai ena laolao ai e siaia lao,
DEU.32.13.english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth.

DEU.17.15.motu: Iehova emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi tauna na emui pavapava ai ba halaoa. Emui bese tauna ta bavabia, emui pavapava ai ba halaoa; idau bese tauna ta, basio abia.
DEU.17.15.english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

DEU.15.18.motu: Basio laloa iruha-negena na karaaukana; badina be laḡani tauratoi oi isiaimu vada e lao heni, hesiai tauna mai davana ena nega vada e haruaia. Taunabunai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, emu kara iboudiai lalodiai.
DEU.15.18.english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

DEU.24.12.motu: Bema ogoḡami tauna, ena abitorehai toana basio dogoa tao rani;
DEU.24.12.english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

DEU.7.18.motu: To idia garidia basio gari. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Farao bona Aigupto idoinai ede e karadia toma na ba laloa tao;
DEU.7.18.english: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

DEU.29.9.motu: Taunabunai, ini taravatu herevadia ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara, emui ḡaukara iboudiai anidia bae vara helaoreana.
DEU.29.9.english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

DEU.9.24.motu: Emui ai na kau dinana ema bona harihari umui ese Iehova vada o gwau edeede henia.
DEU.9.24.english: You have been rebellious against Yahweh from the day that I knew you.

DEU.2.1.motu: Una murinai ta Iou lao, tano ḡaḡaena ai ta loaloa, Davara Kakakakana kahana ai, Iehova ese e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena. Dina hoho Seiri ororona ta rakaia heḡeḡe.
DEU.2.1.english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

DEU.2.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese e haduagu, eto, Moab taudia na basio daḡedaḡe henidia bona basio tuari henidia; badina be edia tano taina basina henimu; badina be Ara na Lot garana vada na henidia, edia tano.
DEU.2.9.english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

DEU.14.1.motu: Umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, natuna. Mase daidiai kopimui basio iva bona ramamui basio nau.
DEU.14.1.english: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

DEU.30.7.motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini heuduguirai iboudiai na inaimui latadiai bona e badu henimui, e daḡedaḡe henimui, taudia latadiai baine gwaurai.
DEU.30.7.english: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

DEU.8.3.motu: Ia ese e hamanaumui bona e hahitolomui, bena mana e henimui, aniani ḡauna matamatana emui ai, tamamui asi dibadia ḡauna. Unu amo e hadibamui, taunimanima na dia aniani amo mo se maurimu, a Iehova uduna amo e lasimu herevadia iboudiai amo danu.
DEU.8.3.english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.

DEU.6.13.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari; ia isiaina ba lao heni; ia ladana ai ba gwau hamata.
DEU.6.13.english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

DEU.22.26.motu: a hane-ulato enai kara ta basio karaia, badina be ia na se kerere, taunabunaiasi badina ia baine mase. Una na tau ta baine tore isi, dekena tauna baine aIaia mase, na heto.
DEU.22.26.english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

DEU.14.5.motu: dia badana, bona dia maraḡina, bona uda diana, bona uda nanina, bona ororo diana, bona taora diana, bona ororo mamoena.
DEU.14.5.english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

DEU.11.17.motu: Unu boma kara toma, Iehova ena badu emui ai baine vara; bena ia ese guba baine koua, medu na basine diho bona tano anidia na basie vara; bena tano namona, Iehova ese e henimuimu tanona, lalona amo ba boio haraḡa.
DEU.11.17.english: and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahweh gives you.

DEU.11.26.motu: O itaia, hari dina ai lau na hahenamo bona heuduguirai umui vairamui ai na atodiamu:
DEU.11.26.english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

DEU.14.25.motu: vada ba hoia, moni davana. Bena moni na imamu ai bavabia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena abi-hidi gabuna baola,
DEU.14.25.english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

DEU.34.8.motu: Dina toi-ahui Israel taudia ese Mose taina e tai, Moab taoradia ai, ela bonaedia taitai bona edia lalo-hisihisi, Mose dainai, dinadia vada e ore ai.
DEU.34.8.english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

DEU.31.11.motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova, emui Dirava, ena abi-hidi gabuna ai ia vairanai bae hebounegana ai, ina taravatu ba duahia hedinarai Israel taudia vairadiai, ibouboudiai vada bae kamonai.
DEU.31.11.english: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

DEU.19.18.motu: Bena hahemaoro taudia bae tahua namonamo: bema hahebade tauna na mai koikoina, tadikakana vada e habadelaia koikoi,
DEU.19.18.english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

DEU.32.32.motu: Badina be edia vine na Sodoma ena vine na heto,
DEU.32.32.english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom,

DEU.14.18.motu: bona boge bona noko, mai bamodia manudia ida; bona turumu, bona sisiboi.
DEU.14.18.english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

DEU.23.6.motu: Ihamainodia bona ihanamodia na basio tahu, emui mauri dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.23.6.english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

DEU.1.10.motu: badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e hahutumamui; harihari umui na hutuma herea, guba hisiudia na heheto.
DEU.1.10.english: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

DEU.24.13.motu: dina baine diho ai ba henia lou; bena ena hetaru ai baine mahuta, bona baine hanamomu. Una na kara maoromaoro oiemu ai, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai.
DEU.24.13.english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before Yahweh your God.

DEU.32.38.motu: Edia boubou ḡaudia digaradia e ani
DEU.32.38.english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices,

DEU.16.22.motu: bona pupu nadina ta basio haginia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e inai henidiamu.
DEU.16.22.english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.

DEU.34.7.motu: Mose ena mase negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta ruahui; a matana se valahu-valahu, bona tauna se manoka.
DEU.34.7.english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

DEU.20.10.motu: Hanua ta ba raka henia kahi, ba tuari henia totona, maino ba gwaurai henidia guna.
DEU.20.10.english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

DEU.2.31.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A itaia, Sihon bona ena tano ina harihari aina henimu; avabia, ba noholaia.
DEU.2.31.english: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

DEU.9.26.motu: Bena Iehova na noia, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, emu bese basio habuaia tari, dihimu basio aladia ore. Oi siahumu amo vada o hamauridia; oi imamu siahuna ai Aigupto amo vada o hakaudia lasi.
DEU.9.26.english: I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

DEU.24.7.motu: Tau ta ese bamona, Israel tauna ta, baine dabaia tao, ena hesiai tauna ai baine halaoa eiava baine hoia, ia na henao tauna; bae alaia mase. Unu amo kara dika unuhetomana na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
DEU.24.7.english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.32.8.motu: Herea Mikamika ese bese ta ta ahudia e henidia negana ai,
DEU.32.8.english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance,

DEU.24.18.motu: Ba laloa tao, oi na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai, bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e hamaurimu. Badina bunai lau ese ini na haḡanimu toma.
DEU.24.18.english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

DEU.33.18.motu: Sebulun be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.5.3.motu: tamada se henidia, to ita, doini ta mauri nohomu bona hari dina ai ina gabu ai ta heboumu tauda iboudai vada e henida.
DEU.5.3.english: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

DEU.15.12.motu: Varavaramu ta, Heberu tauna ta eiava Heberu hahinena ta, boma hoia, ia na laḡani tauratoi lalodiai isiaimu baine lao heni, bena laḡani ihahituna ai ba ruhaia nege.
DEU.15.12.english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

DEU.18.22.motu: Benaini; peroveta tauna ta ese hereva ta Iehova ladana ai baine gwauraia, bena una hereva na basine momokani bona anina basine vara, una na Iehova ese se gwauraia herevana. Peroveta tauna na sibona ena hekokoroku ai vada e hereva; ia garina basio gari.
DEU.18.22.english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

DEU.11.30.motu: Idia na Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, lahara kahana ai, dina e dihomu kahana ai, Kanaan taudia Araba ai e nohomu edia tano ai. Una tano na hevaira henina ai, More au helaḡana badinai.
DEU.11.30.english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

DEU.12.16.motu: A mai raradia na basio ani; rara na tano ai ba hahebubua, ranu na heto.
DEU.12.16.english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

DEU.16.7.motu: Ba nadua, bena bavania, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai; bena daba ai ba lou, emui kalaga baola.
DEU.16.7.english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

DEU.19.13.motu: Basio bogaia hisi, a Israel na asi ena kerere tauna rarana amo ba haḡoevaia; unu amo vada ba namo.
DEU.19.13.english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

DEU.26.7.motu: Bena Iehova, senemai edia Dirava, a tai henia; bena Iehova ese gadomai e kamonai, bona emai hisihisi bona emai hekwarahi bona emai maduna e haḡeredia.
DEU.26.7.english: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

DEU.26.9.motu: e hakaumai ema bona ina gabu ai, bona ina tano vada e henimai, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona.
DEU.26.9.english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

DEU.25.14.motu: Emu ruma ai danu efa rua, momokanina bona koikoina, basie mia.
DEU.25.14.english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

DEU.27.6.motu: Asie utu nadidia amo Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia; bena una pata latanai ḡole-oho bouboudiaba hahelaḡadia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena.
DEU.27.6.english: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.

DEU.4.43.motu: Hanuadia bini: Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ororodia ai, na Ruben iduhuna taudia edia; Ramoto, Gilead ai, na Gad iduhuna taudia edia; bona Golan, Basan ai, na Manase taudia edia.
DEU.4.43.english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

DEU.8.20.motu: Iehova ese bese haida umui vairamui ai e habuadia tarimu na heto, umui danu baine habuamui tari; badina be o gwau edeede, Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona asio kamonai henia.
DEU.8.20.english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

DEU.32.47.motu: Badina be ina na dia ḡau pipikina emui ai. Ina na emui mauri; ia dainai emui mauri dinadia bae hoho, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai bavabia bona emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai.
DEU.32.47.english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

DEU.3.16.motu: bona Gilead ela bona Aranon kourana na Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia na henidia; edia tano hetoana na koura bogaragina amo ela, ela bona Iabok sinavaina, Amono taudia edia tano hetoana.
DEU.3.16.english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

DEU.5.22.motu: Ini hereva na Iehova ese iboumui ai e gwaurai henimui, ororo ai o hebouva negana ai. Lahi bogaragina amo, bona ori bona dibura amo, e hereva henimui mai gao badana ida; una murinai hereva ta se gwauraia. A unu hereva na huro-nadidia palakadia rua ai e tore, bena e henigu.
DEU.5.22.english: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

DEU.20.19.motu: Hanua ta boma tuari henia, bena boma koua heḡeḡe ela bona nega bema, daudau, una gabu auna na emui ira amo basio hagaridia, badina be huahuadia na amui aniani. Imea audia na taunimanima a? Una dainai ba tuari henidia a?
DEU.20.19.english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

DEU.5.2.motu: Iehova eda Dirava ese taravatu e henida Horeb ai;
DEU.5.2.english: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

DEU.11.28.motu: heuduguirai be Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani basio badinadia, a hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu dalana amo ba raka siri bona dirava idaudia, asi dibamui diravadia, muridiai ba raka na davana.
DEU.11.28.english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

DEU.11.5.motu: Ba laloa danu ede e karamui toma tano ḡaḡaena ai, ema bona ina gabu ai o kau.
DEU.11.5.english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

DEU.12.25.motu: Basio ania, bena ba namo, umui bona natumui umui murimui ai, Iehova vairanai o kara maoromaoromu dainai.
DEU.12.25.english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

DEU.22.15.motu: una hahine tamana bonasinana ese ena rami-hebou toadia bae abi, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai baehahedinarai, hanua ikoukouna ai.
DEU.22.15.english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

DEU.2.25.motu: Hari dina ai lau ese gari baina havaraia guba henunai e nohomu besedia iboudiai lalodia ai; idia ese umui harimui bae kamonai, bena garimui bae gari; kudoudia bae hetaha bona daradia bae doko umui daimui ai.
DEU.2.25.english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

DEU.9.2.motu: Unu bese taudia na babada bona lalata; idia na Anakim taudia: dibamui, bona haridia vada o kamonai, e tomu “Anak natuna vairadiai daika baine gini?”
DEU.9.2.english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

DEU.12.19.motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, Levi tauna basio reaia, emu tano ai ba noho dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.12.19.english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

DEU.22.2.motu: A biaguna ena ruma basinema kahikahi, eiava boma daradara biaguna be daika, ba laohaia oiemu ruma, unuseni ai ba naria ela bona biaguna ese baine tahua, bena ba henia lou.
DEU.22.2.english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

DEU.23.14.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na emui taruha bogaraginai e loamu, baine hamaurimui bona inaimui na vairamui ai baine hadareredia totona. Taunabunai, emui taruha baine helaḡa, ia ese ḡau mirona ta bogaragimui ai baine itaia bena emui amo baine raka oho na garina.
DEU.23.14.english: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

DEU.11.31.motu: Badina be umui ese Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, ba raka vareai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henimuimu tanona bavabia, emui tano. Bena bavabia bona ba noholaia negana ai,
DEU.11.31.english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

DEU.22.30.motu: Tau ta ese tamana adavana basine abia, basine eno henia.
DEU.22.30.english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

DEU.6.16.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na basio dibaḡania, Masa ai o dibaḡania heḡereḡerena.
DEU.6.16.english: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

DEU.23.2.motu: Ariara natuna na Iehova ena hebou lalonai basine raka vareai; ia garana danu Iehova ena hebou lalonai basie raka vareai, ela bona uru ihagwautana.
DEU.23.2.english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

DEU.9.15.motu: Taunabunai na raka muri, ororo amo na hekei. Ororo na lahi ese e araia. Taravatu nadidia ruaosi na imagu ai.
DEU.9.15.english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

DEU.16.3.motu: E hatubua flaoana basio ania una aria lalonai; dina hitu asie hatubua flaoana mo, hisihisi toana, bavania, badina be Aigupto tanona o heautania haraḡa-haraḡa. Una kara amo emui mauri dinadia iboudiai na Aigupto tanona o rakatania dinana ba laloa tao.
DEU.16.3.english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

DEU.6.1.motu: Haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henigu, baina hadibalaimui, bena ba raka hanai, emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai ba badinadia.
DEU.6.1.english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

DEU.20.3.motu: baineto: Israel e, a kamonai; hari dina ai inaimui ba tuari henidia; kudoumui basie hetaha, laumamui basie daure, basio daradara, basio gari henidia.
DEU.20.3.english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

DEU.13.10.motu: Nadi amo ba hodoa mase, badina be ia ese Iehova, emu Dirava, Aigupto tanona amo bona iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ena amo baine hakaumui siri eto dainai.
DEU.13.10.english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

DEU.14.15.motu: bona kokokoko bona kito bona kanaḡe bona kipa, mai bamodia manudia ida;
DEU.14.15.english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

DEU.24.14.motu: Emu hesiai tauna mai davana, Israel tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna, bema ogoḡami, emu kara na basine auka ienai.
DEU.24.14.english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

DEU.31.29.motu: Badina be lau dibagu, lauegu mase murinai umui na do ba kara havara, bona vada na haḡanilaimui daladia na ba rakatani; bena dina gabedia ai dika na emui ai baine kau, badina be Iehova vairanai do ba kara havara, bona ena badu ba havaraia, imamui ḡaukaradia daidiai.
DEU.31.29.english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

DEU.15.11.motu: Badina be ogoḡami na basine doko emui tano ai; taunabunai na haḡanilaimumu, imamu ba hahekidaia era varavaramu enai, bona ogoḡami tauna enai eiava asi ena ḡau tauna enai, emui tano lalonai.
DEU.15.11.english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

DEU.3.26.motu: A Iehova ese e badu henigu, umui daimui ai; bena se kamonai henigu. Ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Vadaeni, ena hereva na basio gwauraia lou.
DEU.3.26.english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

DEU.1.19.motu: Bena Horeb amo ma ta laolao, tano ḡaḡaena badana bona dika-hereanaamo, umui danu dibamui, ela bona Amoro taudia edia tano, ororo kahadia ai, ta rakaia hanai, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e haḡanida heḡereḡerena; bena Kade-baranea ai ta kau.
DEU.1.19.english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

DEU.6.4.motu: Israel e, a kamonai: Iehova na eda Dirava, Iehova mo sibona.
DEU.6.4.english: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

DEU.13.16.motu: Kohuna idoinai na ariara ai ba habou, unuseni ai ba doudia; kohu na bae ara, hanua danu baine ara, e kara ḡole-oho boubouna na heto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena. Gabu na baine vahu hanaihanai, hanua na basie haginia lou.
DEU.13.16.english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

DEU.26.2.motu: tano anina roboana, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu tanona ai baine vara ḡauna, kahana bavabia, bosea ai ba udaia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine hahenemailaia gabuna baola.
DEU.26.2.english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

DEU.20.5.motu: Bena heitatao taudia ese orea taudia bae hereva henidia, baeto: Bema tau ta ena ruma matamatana vada e haginia, a do se kehoa, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ta ese bema kehoa na garina.
DEU.20.5.english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

DEU.32.14.english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock,

DEU.6.25.motu: Eda kara maoromaoro binai, ina haheḡani idoinai baita badinaia Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai, vada e haḡanilaida heḡereḡerena.
DEU.6.25.english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

DEU.14.27.motu: Levi tauna danu emu hanua ai e nohomu na basio reaia, badina be ia na asi ahuna bona asi ena tano bogaragimui ai.
DEU.14.27.english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

DEU.20.2.motu: Tuari gabuna ba raka henia kahi negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna na baine raka lasi, orea taudia baine hereva henidia,
DEU.20.2.english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

DEU.16.11.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai ba moale, oi bona natumu maruanena, bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna, bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna emu hanua ai noho, bona noho-hedoa tauna bona ihareha bona vabu bogaragimui ai e nohomu; Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai ba moale hebou.
DEU.16.11.english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

DEU.12.13.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, emui ḡole-oho bouboudia na basio hahelaḡadia gabu kavakava ai,
DEU.12.13.english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

DEU.21.9.motu: Taunabunai, asi ena kerere tauna rarana na bogaragimui amo baine heabi oho, umui na Iehova vairanai ba kara maoromaoro negana ai.
DEU.21.9.english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

DEU.14.23.motu: Bena aria ba karaia; Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, ia baine abia hidi gabuna ai, emu karoa ihagwautadia bavani, uit bona vine ranuna bona dehoro; bona emu boromakau natudia roboadia bona emu mamoe natudia roboadia danu bavani, nega iboudiai Iehova, emu Dirava, garina ba gari helaoreana.
DEU.14.23.english: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

DEU.29.16.motu: Umui dibamui, ani, Aigupto tanona ai ede ta noho tomava, bona dala ai bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo ede ta raka hanai tomava.
DEU.29.16.english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

DEU.27.5.motu: Bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana nadi amo ba larebaia unuseni ai; auri amo asie utudia nadidia.
DEU.27.5.english: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

DEU.34.2.motu: bona Napatali tanona idoinai; bona Efraim bona Manase tanodia; bona Iuda tanona idoinai ela bona Davara Badana, Lahara kahana ai;
DEU.34.2.english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

DEU.27.9.motu: Bena Mose bona hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo ese Israel taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto: Israel taumui e, eremui. A hakala. Hari dina ai umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese ai vada ola.
DEU.27.9.english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.

DEU.19.20.motu: Bena taunimanima oredia na bae kamonai bona bae gari, kara dika unuhetomana basie karaia lou umui bogaragimui ai.
DEU.19.20.english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

DEU.29.17.motu: Ediakara havara danu vada o itaia; edia kaivakuku danu, au bona nadi bona silver bona gold amo e karadia, vada o itadia.
DEU.29.17.english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

DEU.9.25.motu: Taunabunai lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui Iehova vairanai nagoru dihova; badina be Iehova ese baine habuamui tari eto.
DEU.9.25.english: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.

DEU.1.18.motu: Una negana ai, ba kara karadia iboudiai na haḡanilaimuiva.
DEU.1.18.english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

DEU.27.4.motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bena hari na haḡanilaimuimu nadidia ba haginidia, Ebal ororona ai; bena taba-taba ḡauna amo ba tabaia ahu.
DEU.27.4.english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

DEU.8.18.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ba laloa, badina be ia ese siahu e henimuimu, taḡa bavabilaia, ena gwauhamata, senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata ḡauna, baine hamomokania totona, hari dina ai e karamu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.8.18.english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

DEU.3.15.motu: Gilead tanona na Makiri na henia;

DEU.4.16.motu: boma kerere, laulau ta boma koroa na garina: tau laulauna eiava hahine laulauna,
DEU.4.16.english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

DEU.9.3.motu: Vada ba diba, hari dina ai Iehova, emui Dirava, na vairamui ai baine hanai, lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka na heto; baine habuadia bona baine hamanokadia; bena umui ese ba hahavadia bona bavaladia ore haraḡa, Iehova ese vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.9.3.english: Know therefore today that Yahweh your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as Yahweh has spoken to you.

DEU.23.12.english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

DEU.15.23.motu: Ḡau tamona, mai rarana basio ania; rarana na tano ai ba bubua nege, ranu na heto.
DEU.15.23.english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

DEU.4.49.motu: bona Araba taorana idoinai, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, ela bona Araba gohuna, Pisga ororona badi-tanona ai.
DEU.4.49.english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

DEU.28.47.motu: Iehova emui Dirava isiaina ilao-henina asio moalelaia bona ḡau momoemui ai mimia daidiai asio moale henia;
DEU.28.47.english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

DEU.10.22.motu: Senemui na Aigupto ela, taunimanima hitu-ahui hona; a harihari Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e hahutumamui, guba hisiudia na heheto.
DEU.10.22.english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

DEU.25.2.motu: Kerere tauna davana bema hedadaba, hahemaoro tauna baine hahedua, bena ia vairanai; kerere tauna bae hagorua diho bona bae kwadia, nega hidaosi, ena kerere metauna heḡereḡerena.
DEU.25.2.english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

DEU.18.2.motu: Asi ahudia edia bese taudia bogaragidiai: Iehova na idia ahudia, e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.18.2.english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

DEU.3.8.motu: Una negana ai Amoro pavapavadia raruosi edia tano ta abi, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Aranon kourana amo ela bona Heremon ororona.
DEU.3.8.english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

DEU.28.39.motu: Vine audia bahado bona ba reḡu, a vine basio gogo bona vine ranuna basio inua; gaigai-gaigai ese bae ani ore.
DEU.28.39.english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

DEU.6.6.motu: Ini hereva, hari dina ai na haḡanilaimumu herevadia, na lalomu ai do bae mia;
DEU.6.6.english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

DEU.17.1.motu: Boromakau ta eiava mamoe ta mai bebeka-bebekana eiava mai enadika ta basio hahelaḡaia Iehova, emui Dirava, ena: badina be una na kara dika-rohorohona Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
DEU.17.1.english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

DEU.28.29.motu: Dina tubua ai ba hedarahu, matakepulu tauna ese dibura ai e hedarahumu na heto. Emui ḡaukara ta anina basine vara. Taunimanima ese bae daḡedaḡe henimui, bona emui amo bae dadidadi, dina iboudiai tau ta ese basine hamaurimui.
DEU.28.29.english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

DEU.33.12.motu: Beniamina be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.29.4.motu: a Iehova ese lalo-parara bona mata-itaita bona taia-kamonai nado se henimui ema bona hari dina.
DEU.29.4.english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

DEU.24.19.motu: Emu uma anina ba utua negana ai, iḡui ta boma reaia, basio lou henia, basio abia. Idau tauna eiava ihareha eiava vabu ese baine abia. Unu boma kara toma, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, oi imamu ḡaukaradia iboudiai lalodiai.
DEU.24.19.english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

DEU.13.9.motu: Bavalaia mase; oi imamu baine guna ia ialana ai, murinai taunimanima iboudiai imadia ienai bae kau.
DEU.13.9.english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

DEU.10.1.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Huro nadidia rua ma ba utu palaka, gunadia heḡereḡeredia, bena ororo ai ba dara dae dekegu ai. Bona maua ta reirei amo ba karaia.
DEU.10.1.english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

DEU.28.15.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, erena basioma kamonai, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu na basioma badinadia namonamo bona karadia basioma kara, ini uduguirai anidia iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho, bona dekemui ai bae kau.
DEU.28.15.english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

DEU.5.21.motu: Dekemu tauna adavana basio ḡahusia; ena ruma danu, eiava ena uma, eiava ena hesiai tauna, eiava ena hesiai hahinena, eiava ena boromakau, eiava ena doniki, eiava ena kohu ta, basio ḡahusi.
DEU.5.21.english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

DEU.5.32.motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho, Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani ba badinadia; basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
DEU.5.32.english: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

DEU.4.3.motu: Matamui amo vada o itaia, Iehova na ede e kara toma Baal-peoro ai; badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese Peoro taudia edia Baal e toma henia diho taudia umui bogaragimui ai e aladia mase,
DEU.4.3.english: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

DEU.28.35.motu: Iehova ese iohururu amo baine hahisimu, tuimu ai bona aemu ai, bona aemu palapaladia amo ela bona kwaramu tubuana; muramura ta ese baine.basine hamaurimu, diba.
DEU.28.35.english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

DEU.29.14.motu: Dia umui sibomui ida ina herohemaino bona ina hegwau-hamata heheni asina karamu,
DEU.29.14.english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

DEU.14.3.english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

DEU.18.1.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo bona Levi taudia iboudiai na asi ahudia bona asi edia tano Israel ai. Ahudia na ḡole-oho bouboudiabona boubou idau-idau taunimanima ese e mailaidiamu, Iehova ena.
DEU.18.1.english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

DEU.9.11.motu: Dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui e ore ai, Iehova ese unu nadi e henigu, taravatu nadidia.
DEU.9.11.english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

DEU.23.9.motu: Tuari baola bena ba taruha negadia ai, nahuamui ba toho, ḡau dikadia garidia.
DEU.23.9.english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

DEU.9.4.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vairamui ai baine luludia lasi murinai, lalomu ai basioto “Egu kara maoromaoro dainai Iehova ese ina tano vada e henigu”. Lasi; idia edia kara havara daidiai Iehova ese unu bese na vairamui amo baine luludia lasi.
DEU.9.4.english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

DEU.4.4.motu: a umui Iehova, emui Dirava, o abidadama henia taumui iboumui ai vada ome mauri ema bona hari.
DEU.4.4.english: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

DEU.8.16.motu: Tane ḡaḡaena ai ia ese mana amo e ubumuiva, tamamui asi dibadia anianina, baine hamanaumui bona lalomai baine dibadia bona dokona ai baine hanamomui helaoreana.
DEU.8.16.english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

DEU.13.4.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, murina amo ba raka, ia garina ba gari, iena haheḡani ba badinadia, ia gadona ba kamonai, ia isiaina ba lao heni, bona ienai ba tao.
DEU.13.4.english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

DEU.3.20.motu: ela bona Iehova ese tadikakamui na laḡa-ani baine henidia, bona umuidanu laḡa-ani baine henimui. Bena Iehova ese be henidiamu tanona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai na idia ese bae abia, edia tano; bona umui na iboumui ai ba lou lao, vada na henimui tanona ai ba noho.
DEU.3.20.english: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

DEU.10.11.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, emu orea taudia vairadiai ba raka; bena senedia na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona ai bae raka vareai, bona bae abia edia.
DEU.10.11.english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

DEU.32.48.motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
DEU.32.48.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

DEU.21.2.motu: emui tau badadia bona emui hahemaoro taudia ese bae raka Iasi, mase tauna bona hetabira hanuadia padadia bae hahetoho,
DEU.21.2.english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

DEU.21.12.motu: vada ba laohaia emu ruma. Ia na kwarana baine naua bona kahauna baine utu,
DEU.21.12.english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

DEU.28.67.motu: Daba ai baoto “Hanua bema boi”. Hanuaboi ai baoto “Daba bema rere”. Lalomui bae garilai ḡaudia bona matamui bae ita ḡaudia daidiai unu ba hereva toma.
DEU.28.67.english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

DEU.1.12.motu: To lau sibogu ese ede baina reḡumui toma? Emui hekwarahi bona emui heiriheiri ede baina huahai toma?
DEU.1.12.english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

DEU.1.32.motu: Ḡau tamona, umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, asio abidadama henia.
DEU.1.32.english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,

DEU.12.30.motu: una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, idia do bae hebua tari murinai edia dala ai ba raka na garina, bona edia dirava ba herevalaidia, baoto “Ini bese na edia dirava ede e toma henidia diho tomamu Lau danu unu baina kara toma”, na garina.
DEU.12.30.english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

DEU.9.18.motu: Bena Iehova vairanai na goru diho, nega gunana heḡereḡerena, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui aniani asina aniva bona ranu asina inuva, emui karadika iboudiai daidiai; badina be Iehova vairanai o kara havara bona ena badu o havaraia.
DEU.9.18.english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

DEU.28.51.motu: Idia ese emui boromakau natudia bona emui tano anidia bae ani ore, ela bona umui na ba mase ore; emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro sisina taina basie rakatania; emui boromakau natudia bona emui mamoe natudia danu ta basie rakatania, ela bona umui na ba mase ore.
DEU.28.51.english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

DEU.31.26.motu: Ina taravatu bukana bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena taravatu mauana badibadinai bavatoa; ia ese umui baine habadelaimui.
DEU.31.26.english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

DEU.20.1.motu: Inaimu ba tuari henidia negadia ai, hosi bona kariota momo bona tuari taudia hutuma ba itadia, to garidia basio gari; badina be Iehova, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ese e bamomuimu.
DEU.20.1.english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

DEU.24.11.motu: Murimuri ai ba gini, ela bona abitorehai tauna baine raka lasi, ena abitorehai toana baine henimu.
DEU.24.11.english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

DEU.26.4.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese bosea oi imamu amo baine abia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana vairanai baine atoa diho.
DEU.26.4.english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.

DEU.4.28.motu: Unuseni ai au diravadia bona nadi diravadia, taunimanima imadia amo e kara ḡaudia, asie roharohamu, asie kamonaimu, asie anianimu, asie bonabonamu, ḡaudia ba toma henidia diho.
DEU.4.28.english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

DEU.8.7.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tano namona ai be hakaumui vareaimu: sinavai momo tanona, mai ranu gabudia bona ranu guridia, koura ai bona ororo ai.
DEU.8.7.english: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

DEU.2.33.motu: Bena Iehova eda Dirava ese ita imada ai e atoa; ia bona natuna bona ena orea idoinai ta hadareredia.
DEU.2.33.english: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

DEU.1.9.motu: Una negana ai lau ese na hamaoromui, nato, Lau na sibogu basina reḡumui diba,
DEU.1.9.english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

DEU.17.12.motu: A tau ta bema hekokoroku, hahelaḡa tauna, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai e ginimu bona isiaina e lao henimu tauna, basine kamonai henia, eiava hahemaoro tauna basine kamonai henia, una tau baine mase; unu amo kara dika na Israel ena amo ba negea daure.
DEU.17.12.english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

DEU.27.25.motu: Dava e abiamu, asi ena kerere tauna baine alaia mase totona, tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.25.english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’

DEU.23.17.motu: Israel hahinena ta ariara hahinena ai basinela, dirava ta ihanamolaina; bona Israel tauna ta tau ta ida basine eno bou, dirava ta ihanamolaina.
DEU.23.17.english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

DEU.27.3.motu: Ina taravatu herevadia iboudiai na latadiai ba tore, ba hanai negana ai. Unu amo Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona bavabia, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, Iehova, senemuiedia Dirava, ese vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.27.3.english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

DEU.14.8.motu: Boroma danu na miro emui ai, badina be imana aena palapaladia e parara, to ana aniani se ḡauaia loumu. Hidiodia na basio ani, bona masedia ai basio daudia toho.
DEU.14.8.english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

DEU.27.1.motu: Bena Mose bona Israel tau-badadia ese Israel taudia e haḡanidia, eto: Hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia ba badinadia.
DEU.27.1.english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

DEU.8.17.motu: Taunabunai, lalomu ai basioto “Lau siahugu bona imagu goadana ese ina taḡa vada na abia, egu”.
DEU.8.17.english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

DEU.23.1.motu: Abona nadinadina e heala eiava usina e heutu tauna na Iehova ena hebou lalonai basine raka vareai.
DEU.23.1.english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

DEU.16.4.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai flaoa ihatubuna muramurana na basine hedinarai emui tano idoinai; bona aria dinana ginigunana adorahina a ai emui boubou ḡauna hidiona na basine mia rani.
DEU.16.4.english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

DEU.28.7.motu: Inaimui bae tuari henimui negadia ai Iehova ese baine hadareredia; dala tamona ai bae mai henimui, a dala hitu amo vairamui ai bae heau.
DEU.28.7.english: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

DEU.8.14.motu: Una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, ba hekokoroku na garina, bona Iehova, Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ba reaia na garina.
DEU.8.14.english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

DEU.12.4.motu: Iehova emui Dirava, na unu basio kara henia toma.
DEU.12.4.english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God.

DEU.15.16.motu: A ia ese oi mai emu ruma taudia ida bema lalokau henimui, dekemui ai ena noho na namo dainai, bena bema toma “Lau na asina uramu baina rakatanimu”,
DEU.15.16.english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

DEU.11.23.motu: bena Iehova ese ini bese iboudiai na umui vairamui ai baine luludia Iasi, bena bese badadia, umui e hereamui besedia, gabudia do bavabi.
DEU.11.23.english: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

DEU.32.34.motu: Ina na dia lauegu roge ai a?
DEU.32.34.english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me,

DEU.31.15.motu: Bena Iehova na kalaga ai e hahedinarai henidia, ori dubuna ai. Hari ori dubuna na kalaga iduarana badinai e hedinarai.
DEU.31.15.english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

DEU.2.17.motu: Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto,

DEU.17.14.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai ba kau, bavabia, emui tano korikori ai ba halaoa, bona ba noholaia; una negana ai boma ura pavapava ta ba haginia, e noho hetabiramu besedia na heheto,
DEU.17.14.english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

DEU.1.28.motu: Ede baitala? Tadikakada ese vada e hagarida, eto “Una tano taudia na babada bona lalata; ita na mamaraḡi bona kwakwadogi; edia hanua na babada, maḡudia danu e daemu ela bona guba ai; ina danu, Anakim taudia unuseni ai a itadia”.
DEU.1.28.english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

DEU.9.8.motu: Horeb ai danu Iehova ena badu o havaraia; bena ena badu ai baine habuamui tari eto.
DEU.9.8.english: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.

DEU.13.1.motu: Bogaragimui ai peroveta tauna eiava nihi tauna ta bema tore isi, toa ta eiava hoa karana ta bema gwauraia guna,
DEU.13.1.english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

DEU.33.16.motu: Tano ena ḡau namodia mai anidia idoidiai amo,
DEU.33.16.english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness,

DEU.7.12.motu: Ini hahedua ba hakala henidia bona ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara dainai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania bona ena hebogahisi baine hahesiriua, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.7.12.english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

DEU.28.62.motu: Vada o hutuma, guba hisiudia na heheto, a do ba gadoi; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona asio kamonai.
DEU.28.62.english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

DEU.14.9.motu: Ranu ai e nohomu ḡaudia na mai taiadia bona mai unadia bavani.
DEU.14.9.english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

DEU.19.6.motu: mase tauna varavarana ese hapadidi tauna baine hahavaia mai baduna ida, bena dala na daudau dainai baine ḡavaia tao bona baine alaia mase na garina; a ia be mase karana se karaia, badina be bamona se inai henia.
DEU.19.6.english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

DEU.3.2.motu: A Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ia garina basio gari; badina be ia bona ena orea taudia iboudiai bona ena tano na oi imamu ai vada na atodia; Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, o kara henia heḡereḡerena, ina tau danu unu ba kara henia toma.
DEU.3.2.english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

DEU.1.46.motu: Taunabunai umui na nega daudau Kade ai o nohova.
DEU.1.46.english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

DEU.11.4.motu: Aigupto ena tuari oreadia danu, mai edia hosi bona mai edia kariota, Davara Kakakakana abatana amo e habubunidia, umui e havamui negana ai; Iehova ese ma e habuadia tari ema bona hari dina.
DEU.11.4.english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

DEU.17.11.motu: bae haduamui heḡereḡerena ai bona bae haere henimui eḡerena ai mo ba kara. Edia hahemaoro herevana amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
DEU.17.11.english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

DEU.26.3.motu: Bena hahelaḡa karadia una dina ai e karamu tauna dekena baola.l, baoto “Hari dina ai na gwauraia hedinaraimu, lau na Iehova ese seneda e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ani vada na kau”.
DEU.26.3.english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”

DEU.32.51.motu: Badina be Israel taudia vairadiai o gwau edeede henigu, Meribata-kade ranudia badibadidiai, Sin tano-ḡaḡaena ai; bona asio hahelaḡagu Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
DEU.32.51.english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

DEU.19.12.motu: ena hanua korikori lohiadia ese unu amo bae ha-abia, mase tauna varavarana bae henia, benaia danu baine mase.
DEU.19.12.english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

DEU.24.2.motu: Hahine na baine diho; bena baine ura negana ai ia na bainela, tau ta ma baine adavaia.
DEU.24.2.english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

DEU.15.5.motu: = tamona, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena ba kamonai, bona hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia ba badinadia.
DEU.15.5.english: if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

DEU.9.14.motu: A siri, baina habuadia tari, ladadia na baina roho guba henuna amo. Bena oiemu amo bese badana ta, idia baine hereadia besena, baina havaraia.
DEU.9.14.english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

DEU.26.5.motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai ba hereva, ini ba gwau toma: Senegu na tau Aram, laolao tauna; ia na Aigupto ela, taunimanima kwabu-kwabudiaida, unuseni ai ia ese bese badana bona goadana e havaraia; garana na hutuma.
DEU.26.5.english: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

DEU.29.6.motu: Flaoa asio ania; vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana ta asio inua. Taunabunai, vada o diba, lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
DEU.29.6.english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

DEU.32.18.english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful,

DEU.9.23.motu: Bena Iehova ese Kade-baranea amo ma e siaimui, eto “Vada aola; vada na henimui tanona bavabia”. Una negana ai umui na o gwau edeede, Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani asio badinaia, bona asio abidadama henia, bona gadona asio kamonai.
DEU.9.23.english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

DEU.3.23.motu: Una negana ai danu lau ese Iehova na noia, nato,
DEU.3.23.english: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,

DEU.32.44.motu: Mose na ema, ina ane herevadia iboudiai e gwaurai hedinarai taunimanima vairadiai, ia bona Iosua Nunu ese.
DEU.32.44.english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

DEU.5.27.motu: Oi na ba raka kahi lao, Iehova, eda Dirava, ena hereva iboudiai ba kamonai; bena Iehova, eda Dirava, ese baine hamaoromu herevadia iboudiai ba hamaoromai. Ai na baia kamonai, bona karadia baia kara.
DEU.5.27.english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

DEU.32.43.motu: Bese idau-idau e, iena bese ba imodaia!
DEU.32.43.english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people,

DEU.9.1.motu: Israel e, a kamonai. Hari dina ai umui ese Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bese badadia, goada ai e hereamui besedia, edia tano bavabi emui; hanua badadia danu, edia maḡu na guba ai e daemu hanuadia, bavabi emui.
DEU.9.1.english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

DEU.17.7.motu: Dibadia bena e habadea taudia ese bae hodoa guna; idia muridiai taunimanima iboudiai ese bae hodoa, ela bona baine mase. Unuhetomana, dika na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
DEU.17.7.english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.23.3.motu: Amono tauna ta eiava Moab tauna ta Iehova ena hebou ai basine raka vareai, ela bona uru ihagwautana, eIa bona hanaihanai;
DEU.23.3.english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,

DEU.1.1.motu: Mose ena hereva bini, Israel taudia iboudiai e harorolai henidia tano ḡaḡaena ai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai. Gabu ladana na Araba, Sufu e hevaira henia; kahana ta ai be Paran, ma kahana ta ai be Tofele bona Laban bona Haseroto bona Disahab.
DEU.1.1.english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

DEU.33.7.motu: Iuda be ini e herevalaia toma:
DEU.33.7.english: This is for Judah. He said,

DEU.24.8.motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, lepra garina. Hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo ese bae hadibalaimui karadia iboudiai ba kara; lau ese idia vada na haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, umui danu unu ba kara toma.
DEU.24.8.english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

DEU.5.1.motu: Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, e haroro henidia, eto, Israel e, a kamonai: ini taravatu bona haheḡani hari dina ai baina gwauraidia hedinarai na ba kamonaidia, bona lalomai ai bavabidia dae, bona ba badinadia.
DEU.5.1.english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

DEU.16.2.motu: Lagau-hanai boubouna na emui seri amo bavabia, ba hahelaḡaia Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; ia ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai ba hahelaḡaia.
DEU.16.2.english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

DEU.25.11.motu: Tatau rarua bae heatu, bena idia ta adavana baine raka kahira, adavana na e heatu heniamu tauna imana amo baine hamauria totona, bena imana baine toia roro, una tau na usina eiava abona amo baine abia,
DEU.25.11.english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

DEU.34.6.motu: Bena Iehova ese e guria, Moab kourana ta ai, Bete-peoro hegaga hehenina ai. A e guria gabuna na tauta asi dibana ema bona hari.
DEU.34.6.english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

DEU.14.21.motu: E mase kava ḡauna na basio ania. Emu hanua ai e noho hedoamu tauna ba henia diba, bena baine ania; eiava idau bese tauna enai ba hoia. Badina be umui na bese helaḡana, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena.
DEU.14.21.english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God.

DEU.19.21.motu: Basio hebogahisi: mauri davana na mauri; mata davana na mata; ise davana na ise; ima davana na ima; ae davana na ae.
DEU.19.21.english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

DEU.11.7.motu: Siahu karadia iboudiai Iehova ese vada e kara, umui ese matamui amo vada o ita.
DEU.11.7.english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

DEU.5.8.motu: Laulau ta basio koroa, ḡau ta laulauna: guba ḡauna ta, eiava tanobada ḡauna ta, eiava tanobada henuna ḡauna ta, basio karaia.
DEU.5.8.english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

DEU.10.12.motu: Israel e, harihari Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ura be dahaka emui ai? Ina mo: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari, bona ena dala iboudiai ba raka. Iehova, emui Dirava, ba ura henia, bona isiaina ba lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai;
DEU.10.12.english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

DEU.29.26.motu: dirava idaudia isiaidia e lao heni bona e toma henidia diho, asi dibadia bona ia ese se henidia diravadia.
DEU.29.26.english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

DEU.30.1.motu: Ini hahenamo bona heuduguirai herevadia vada na gwaurai henimui na anidia iboudiai do bae vara vaitani negana ai umui do ba helalo. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baine hakarohomui rohoroho gabudia ai.
DEU.30.1.english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

DEU.28.54.motu: Bogaragimui ai readia tau ta tau-anina manada-manada bona aniani inonoḡadia mo e animu; to ena karabaine auka bona baine daḡedaḡe, tadikakana enai bona adavana enai bona natuna hahidaosi dounu mauridia ediai.
DEU.28.54.english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

DEU.32.11.motu: Ugava na heto, natuna e harohodiamu negana ai,
DEU.32.11.english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest,

DEU.21.8.motu: Iehova e, emu bese Israel, o hamauria besena, ba bogaia hisi; ina asi ena kerere tauna rarana na emu bese Israel bogaraginai basine mia. Bena una rara kererena na ediai baine hegwau tao.
DEU.21.8.english: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

DEU.11.15.motu: Rei matamata danu baine henimui, emui seri adia; bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu.
DEU.11.15.english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

DEU.1.22.motu: Bena umui iboumui ai na lau dekegu oma, oto, Mani emu kara, hasinadoa taudia baita siaidia guna, idia ese tano na do bae itaia bona sivaraina bae mailaia, edena dala amo baitala, bona edena hanua edena hanua ai baita kau.
DEU.1.22.english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

DEU.4.37.motu: Senemui e ura henidia bena garadia e abidia hidi, bona umui na ia vairanai Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi mai siahu-badana ida,
DEU.4.37.english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

DEU.15.7.motu: Bogaragimui ai varavaramui ta bema ogoḡami, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona hanuana ta ai, lalomu basio ha-aukaia, bonarimamu basio hagorua, varavaramu ogoḡamina enai.
DEU.15.7.english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

DEU.30.9.motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui; imamui ḡaukaradia anidia baine habada, bona garamui baine hahutumadia, bona emui seri baine hahohodia, bona emui taboro baine habada.
DEU.30.9.english: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

DEU.8.4.motu: Unu laḡani hari-ahui iboudiailalodiai emui dabua; asie dika, bona aemui asie gudu.
DEU.8.4.english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

DEU.22.24.motu: raruosi na bavabidia, hanua ikoukouna amo ba hakaudia lasi, bena ba hododia mase. Hane-ulato bahodoa mase badina, ena be hanua lalonai, to ia na se lolo; bona tau ba hodoa mase, badina be ia ese dekena tauna maohenina vada e hahemaraia. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
DEU.22.24.english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.11.29.motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona Ialonai baine hakaumui vareai negana ai, umui ese hahenamo na Gerisim ororona ai bavatoa, bona heuduguirai na Ebal ororona ai bavatoa.
DEU.11.29.english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

DEU.14.28.motu: Laḡani toi toi amo, emu karoa ihagwautadia, una laḡani ihatoina anina amo, bavabi, emu hanua rogena ai bavato;
DEU.14.28.english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

DEU.27.13.motu: Ma iduhu ikwaradia bini Ebal ororona ai bae gini, heuduguirai herevadia bae gwaurai: Ruben bona Gad bona Asere bona Sebulun bona Dan bona Napatali.
DEU.27.13.english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

DEU.29.10.motu: Hari dina ai umui na iboumui ai Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai gigini: iduhu ikwaradia taumui, iduhu tau-badadia, heitatao taumui, bona Israel taumui iboumui ai;
DEU.29.10.english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

DEU.10.8.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Levi iduhuna e abia hidi, Iehova ena taravatu mauana bae huaia, bona Iehova vairanai bae gini; ena ḡaukara bae kara, bona ia ladana bae heatolaia, ema bona hari dina.
DEU.10.8.english: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

DEU.12.5.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese gabu ta baine abia hidi, emui iduhu iboudiai lalodia amo, unuseni ai ladana baine atoa, bona unuseni ai baine noho. Una gabu ba tahua;
DEU.12.5.english: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

DEU.32.16.motu: Idia ese dirava idaudia amo e havaḡeḡea,
DEU.32.16.english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods.

DEU.22.29.motu: hari tau ese hane-ulato tamana na silver sekeledia imahui baine henia, bona hane-ulato baine adavaia danu; badina be ia ese vada e hahemaraia. Ia na basine hadihoa, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.22.29.english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

DEU.32.49.motu: Abarim ororona ai ba dara dae. (Una ba Nebo ororona, Moab tanona ai, Ieriko hegaga hehenina ai.) Unu amo ba roha lao, Kanaan tanona, Israel taudia baina henidia edia tano ai bae halaoa tanona, ba itaia.
DEU.32.49.english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

DEU.1.37.motu: Iehova ese lau danu e badu henigu, umui daimui ai; eto, Oi na unuseni ai basio raka vareai,
DEU.1.37.english: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

DEU.4.40.motu: Taunabunai, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani, hari dina ai na henimuimu ḡaudia, na ba badinadia; bena ba namo, bona natumui danu bae namo umui murimui ai, bona emui dina bae hoho, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henimui hanaihanaimu tanona ai.
DEU.4.40.english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.

DEU.32.23.motu: Dika idau-idau na idia latadiai baina senu senu kau,

DEU.32.36.motu: Iehova ese ena bese taudia maorodia baine gwaurai,
DEU.32.36.english: For Yahweh will judge his people,

DEU.29.29.motu: Ḡau hehunidia na Iehova, eda Dirava, ena; to hedinarai ḡaudia na ita eda bona ita garada edia ela bona hanaihanai, ini taravatu herevadia iboudiai baita badinadia helaoreana.
DEU.29.29.english: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

DEU.32.41.english: if I sharpen my glittering sword,

DEU.2.27.motu: Mani emu kara emu tano amo baina raka hanai; dala ai mo baina raka hanai, basina raka siri, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo.
DEU.2.27.english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

DEU.19.3.motu: Daladia danu ba lailai; bena Iehova; emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona na ba hapararaia kaha toi. Bena ala-ala tauna ese unu hanua ta baine heau henia.
DEU.19.3.english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

DEU.6.10.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwau henidia hamata baine henemui eto tanona, ai baine hakaumui vareai ai; unuseni ai hanua badadia bona namodia, umui ese asio daidia,
DEU.6.10.english: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

DEU.21.14.motu: A gabeamo basioma ura henia, vada ba kahua nege; basio hoia moni davana, bona emu hesiai hahinena ai basio halaoa, badina be vada o hahemaraia.
DEU.21.14.english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

DEU.21.10.motu: Inaimui ba tuari henidia negana ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese imamui ai baine atodia kau, bena bavabidia mauri.
DEU.21.10.english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

DEU.30.14.motu: A ḡauna na badibadimu ai, bona udumu ai, bona lalomu ai, karana ba karaia totona.
DEU.30.14.english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

DEU.25.3.motu: Bae kwadia diba ela bona nega hari-ahui, a hari-ahui basie hanai, bae kwadia momo ela bona bae hadikaiana garina.
DEU.25.3.english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

DEU.22.1.motu: Varavaramu ena boromakau eiava ena mamoe bema boio, bena oi ese boma itaia, basio rakatania; ba hakaua lao, varavaramu ba henia.
DEU.22.1.english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

DEU.33.22.motu: Dan be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.3.3.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova eda Dirava ese Og, Basan pavapavana, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida, ita imada ai e atodia; bena ta hadarerea vaitani, ena orea tauna ta se roho mauri.
DEU.3.3.english: So Yahweh our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
