DEU.22.13.motu: Tau au ta ese hane-ulato ta bema adavaia, bena ia ida baine eno boumurinai bema dadaraia,
DEU.22.13.english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

DEU.27.21.motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida e eno boumu tauna a na bae uduguirai. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.21.english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’

DEU.8.9.motu: Unuseni ai flaoa bavania boga-kunu; ḡau ta ai basio dabu. Una tanoena nadi na auri nadidia; ena ororo ai danu auri labora-labora ba ḡeia.
DEU.8.9.english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

DEU.28.6.motu: Emui raka vareai baine namo, bona emui raka lasi baine namo.
DEU.28.6.english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

DEU.32.2.motu: Egu hahediba na medu na heto baine diho,
DEU.32.2.english: My doctrine will drop as the rain.

DEU.10.5.motu: Bena na raka muri, ororo amo na hekei, hari nadi na na karaia heḡaeḡae mauana ai na udadia. Idia na doini mimia, Iehova ese ena haheḡani e henigu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.10.5.english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

DEU.6.17.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena haheḡani bona ena hahedua bona ena taravatu vada e, henimui: ba badinadia mai goadamui ida.
DEU.6.17.english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

DEU.11.13.motu: Hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu haheḡanidia boma badinadia, Iehova, emui Dirava, boma ura henia, bona isiaina boma lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai,
DEU.11.13.english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

DEU.27.12.motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bena ini na Gerisim ororona ai bae gini, taunimanima bae hanamodia: Simeon bona Levi bona Iuda bona Isakara bona Iosef bona Beniamina.
DEU.27.12.english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

DEU.32.9.motu: Badina be Iehova ahuna na ena bese,
DEU.32.9.english: For Yahweh’s portion is his people.

DEU.32.5.motu: Idia na ia vairanai vada e kara havara,
DEU.32.5.english: They have dealt corruptly with him.

DEU.28.58.motu: Ina buka ai e tore taravatudia iboudiai basioma badinadia bona karadia basioma kara, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ladana ḡoeva-daena bona herea-daena basioma matauraia,
DEU.28.58.english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

DEU.10.6.motu: (Israel taudia na Bene-iaakan ranu-guridia amo e laolao, ela bonaMosera ai e kau; unuseni ai Aaron e mase, bena e guria. Ia natuna Eleasara ese e boloa, hahelaḡa tauna dagina ai.
DEU.10.6.english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

DEU.3.17.motu: Araba taorana danu na henidia, hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina, Kinerete gohuna amo ela bona Tadi Gohuna, taora ai, bona Pisga ororona badi-tanona mairiveina kahana ai.
DEU.3.17.english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

DEU.4.10.motu: Horeb ai Iehova emu Dirava vairanai o gini dinana ai, Iehova ese lau e hereva henigu, eto “Taunimanima ba haboudia vairagu ai, egu hereva bae kamonai, bena lau garigu bae gari, tanobada ai bae noho dinadia iboudiai, bona natudia bae hadibadia, idia danu unu bae kara toma”.
DEU.4.10.english: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

DEU.1.13.motu: Emui iduhu ta ta lalodiai tatau haida, mai aonegadia bona mai edia lalo-parara bona mai dibadia taudia, bavabidia hidi, bena lau ese ikwaramui taudia ai baina halaodia.
DEU.1.13.english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

DEU.29.1.motu: Taravatu herevadia bini, Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia Moab tanona ai, Israel taudia ma baine haḡanilaidia totona; ini hereva na Horeb ai e henidia taravatudia latadiai e ato kau.
DEU.29.1.english: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

DEU.34.1.motu: Mose na Moab taorana amo Nebo ororona ela, e dara dae ela bona Pisga dorina, Ieriko hegaga hehenina ai. Bena Iehova ese tano idoinai e haheitalaia: Gilead tanona ela bona Dan;
DEU.34.1.english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

DEU.4.29.motu: To unu amo Iehova, emui Dirava, do ba tahua; bena ba tahua mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai negana ai vada ba davaria.
DEU.4.29.english: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

DEU.4.35.motu: Umui emui ai vada e hedinarai: ba diba Iehova na Dirava; ia na asi idaina.
DEU.4.35.english: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.

DEU.15.6.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena. Bese loḡora ba henidia torehai, to ediai basio abi torehai; bona bese loḡora ba halohiadia, to idia ese basie halohiamui.
DEU.15.6.english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

DEU.27.10.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona ba kamonai; ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu hari ina dina ai na henimuimu vada ba badinadia.
DEU.27.10.english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

DEU.28.20.motu: Iehova ese heuduguirai bona daradara bona lalo-hesiku latamui aibaine siaia, emui ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, ela bona ba dika vaitani bona ba mase haraḡa; badina be emui kara havara ai vada o rakatanigu.
DEU.28.20.english: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

DEU.32.15.motu: A Iesurunu na tauna e bada, e daḡedaḡe.
DEU.32.15.english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked.

DEU.6.14.motu: Idau dirava, hetabira tanodia ai e nohomu besedia edia dirava, basio toma henidia diho;
DEU.6.14.english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

DEU.12.10.motu: A Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai ba hanai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano korikori ai ba halaoa tanona; bena ia ese inaimui bogaragidia amo baine hamaurimui ela bona mai mainomui ida ba noho;
DEU.12.10.english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

DEU.6.11.motu: bona ruma, kohu namodia amo e honu umui ese asio habou, bona ranu guridia, umui ese asio ḡei, bavabi; bona vine imeadia bona olive audia umui ese asio hadodia na anidia bavani boga kunu.
DEU.6.11.english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

DEU.16.18.motu: Hahemaoro taudia bona heitatao taudia ba duanaidia, Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai, emui iduhu ta ta amo bavabidia hidi. Idia ese taunimanima bae hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaorodia ida.
DEU.16.18.english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

DEU.19.17.motu: raruosi na Iehova vairanai bae gini, bona hahelaḡa tauna bona hahemaoro dagina unu negana ai vada e abia taudia vairadiai.
DEU.19.17.english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

DEU.28.27.motu: Iehova ese Aigupto iohururudia bona toto dikadia amo baine hahisihisimui. Udumui bae totototo, bona kopimui bae kuhikuhi; basio namo diba.
DEU.28.27.english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

DEU.4.1.motu: Israel e, vada na hadibalaimui taravatudia bona haheḡanidia ba kamonaidia bona ba badinadia; bena vada ba mauri, bona Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai bona bavabia, emui.
DEU.4.1.english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

DEU.31.20.motu: Badina be senemui na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai baina hakaudia vareai, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona; unuseni ai bae aniani, bogadiabae hakunu, taudia bae bada. Una negana ai idia ese dirava idaudia bae tahudia, bona isiaidia bae lao heni, a lau bae dadaraigu, bona egu taravatu bae tataia utu.
DEU.31.20.english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

DEU.32.39.motu: Harihari a itaia, lau binai Dirava;
DEU.32.39.english: “See now that I myself am he.

DEU.4.25.motu: Natumui bona tubumui bae vara, bona una tano ai ba buruka, murinai boma kerere, ḡau ta laulauana boma koroa, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai boma kara havara bona ena badu boma havaraia,
DEU.4.25.english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

DEU.34.11.motu: Toa bona hoa karadia, Iehova ese Aigupto tanona e siaia negana ai ia ese Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona ena tano idoinai e kara henidia na ikaradia ai ia na asi idaina.
DEU.34.11.english: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

DEU.6.9.motu: Emu iduara ihua-ihuana kahana kahana audia ai ba tore, bona emu ikoukou ai danuba tore.
DEU.6.9.english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

DEU.33.19.motu: Taunimanima bae boiridia, edia ororo baela,
DEU.33.19.english: They will call the peoples to the mountain.

DEU.5.9.motu: Basio toma henia diho, bona isiaina basio lao heni. Badina be lau Iehova emu Dirava na vaḡeḡe Diravana: e inai henigumu taudia edia kara dika davadia na natudia bona tubudia latadiai baina kara ela bona uru ihatoina bona ihahanina;
DEU.5.9.english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

DEU.24.22.motu: Ba laloa tao, oi na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai; badina bunai lau ese ini na haḡanimu toma.
DEU.24.22.english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

DEU.6.19.motu: bona inaimui iboudiai na vairamui ai ba luludia lasi, Iehova ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.6.19.english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

DEU.2.14.motu: Kade-baranea ta rakatania ela bona Serede sinavainata hanaia na eda laolao laḡanidia na toi-ahui taurahani; una negana ai unauru ena tuari taudia iboudiai vada e mase ore eda taruha ai, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
DEU.2.14.english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.

DEU.22.10.motu: Emu tano iruana ḡauna na boromakau bona doniki basie veri hebou.
DEU.22.10.english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

DEU.29.23.motu: bae itaia danu tano idoinai na teio bona damena ese vada e hadikaia, tano ḡaḡaena; ai vada e halaoa; ḡau ta asie hadoamu, ḡau ta se tubumu, rei danu se varamu, e dika vaitanimu Sodoma bona Gomora bona Adma bona Seboimi na heheto, Iehova ese ena badu ḡaraḡarana ai e habuadia tari hanuadia.
DEU.29.23.english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

DEU.33.1.motu: Bena Dirava ena hesiai tauna Mose ese Israel taudia e hanamodia, ia do se mase negana ai. Ena hahenamo herevadia bini.
DEU.33.1.english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

DEU.26.15.motu: Guba ai emu noho gabuna helaḡana amo ba roha dobi, emu bese Israel ba hanamoa, ina vada o henimai tanona, senemai o gwaurai henidia hamata tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, danu ba hanamoa.
DEU.26.15.english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

DEU.14.10.motu: A asi taiadia bona asi unadia ḡaudia na basio ani: idia na mimiro emui ai.
DEU.14.10.english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

DEU.4.33.motu: Nega ta bese ta taudia, ese Dirava gadona lahi bogaragina amo e hereva vada e kamonai, umui o kamonaiva heḡereḡerena, bena dounu e mauri, eiava?
DEU.4.33.english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

DEU.6.18.motu: Kara maoromaorodia bona kara namodia ba kara, Iehova vairanai; bena ba namo, ba raka vareai, tano namona, Iehova ese e gwau hamata senemui baine henidia eto tanona, bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa;
DEU.6.18.english: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,

DEU.18.6.motu: Levi tauna ta, ena ura korikori dainai ena noho hanuana Israel ai bema rakatania, Iehova baine abia hidi gabuna bema lao henia,
DEU.18.6.english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,

DEU.20.11.motu: Maino herevadia amo bema haere henimui, bona edia hanua ikoukoudia bema keho emui, idia iboudiai na emui hesiai taudia ai baela, isiaimui bae lao heni.
DEU.20.11.english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

DEU.6.5.motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ba lalokau henia mai lalomu idoinai, mai laumamu idoinai, bona mai goadamu idoinai.
DEU.6.5.english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

DEU.23.20.motu: Idau bese tauna ena amo atokauna bavabia; a varavaramu ena amo basio abia. Unu amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ena hahenamo na imamu ḡaukaradia latadiai baine mia, bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai.
DEU.23.20.english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

DEU.21.20.motu: bena hanua taubadadia bae hamaorodia, baeto “Natumai binai e daḡedaḡemu bona e gwau edeedemu, bona eremai se kamonaimu; ia na aniani dika tauna bona vine ranuna e inu momomu tauna”.
DEU.21.20.english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

DEU.4.20.motu: A Iehova ese Aigupto amo vada e hakaumui lasi, e kara auri amuna amo bema verimui lasi na heto, ena bese korikori ai baine halaomui totona. Hari dina ai umui na iena bese.
DEU.4.20.english: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

DEU.15.8.motu: Imamu ba hahekidaia era, bona ba henia, ena dabu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.15.8.english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

DEU.17.17.motu: Adavana danu basine hahohodia, idia ese lalona bae ania na garina; bona silver momo bona gold momo basine habou.
DEU.17.17.english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

DEU.31.13.motu: Natudia danu do asi dibadia, vada bae kamonai bona bae diba; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, garina bae gari, Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia murinai emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai ba noho dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.31.13.english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

DEU.22.22.motu: Tau ta ese ma tau ta adavana ida bae heuda hanai, bena enoboudia ai bae davaridia, raruosi na bae mase: tau baine mase, hahine danu baine mase. Unu amo kara havara na Israel bogaragina amo ba negea daure.
DEU.22.22.english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

DEU.7.26.motu: Vada e dadaraia ḡauna na emui ruma ai basio vareailaia, ena dika ai ba dika na garina: ena amo ba raka oho, ba rakatania, ba gari henia bona ba inai henia, badina be ia na heuduguirai ḡauna.
DEU.7.26.english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

DEU.34.5.motu: Taunabunai Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, na unuseni ai e mase, Moab tanona ai, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
DEU.34.5.english: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

DEU.29.15.motu: a ita ida Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai e heboumu taudia iboudiai ida, bona ma hebou asiema taudia ida danu.
DEU.29.15.english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

DEU.5.6.motu: Lau binai Iehova, emu Dirava: Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo na hakaumu lasi.
DEU.5.6.english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

DEU.22.27.motu: Badina be tano paka ai e davaria, bena hane-ulatona e lolo, a asi iduruna tauna ta unuseni ai.
DEU.22.27.english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

DEU.28.55.motu: Bena natuna vada e mase hidiodia e animu na taidia basine henidia, badina be ena hitolo baine bada herea, emui hanua iboudiai lalodiai inaimui ese baine koumui ahu bona baine hadabumui dainai.
DEU.28.55.english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

DEU.19.9.english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

DEU.23.13.motu: Isiva ta emu tuari ḡaudia ida bavabi kau, bena o uramu ba helai diho negana ai guri ba ḡeia, bena ba kukuri murinai tano amo ba tahunia.
DEU.23.13.english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

DEU.16.16.motu: Laḡani ta lalonai emui maruane iboudiai na nega toi Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bae hedinarai, ia ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai: asie hatubua flaoana ariana negana ai, bona pura ariana negana ai, bona kalaga ariana negana ai. Imadia asi anidia basie hedinarai Iehova vairanai:
DEU.16.16.english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.

DEU.33.13.motu: Iosef be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.33.26.motu: Iesurunu o, Dirava na asi idaina.
DEU.33.26.english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun,

DEU.24.3.motu: A adavana ihararuana basinema ura henia, bena hekoho revarevana baine henia bona baine hadihoa, eiava hari adavana ihararuana bema mase,
DEU.24.3.english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

DEU.1.11.motu: Egu ḡuriḡuri be Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ese nega daha amo do baine hahutumamui, bona baine hanamomui, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.1.11.english: May Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

DEU.26.1.motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu emu tano ai ba halaoa tanona bavabia bona ba noholaia negana ai,
DEU.26.1.english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

DEU.4.21.motu: Iehova ese lau e badu henigu umui daimui ai, bena e gwau hamata, lau ese Ioridane sinavaina basina hanaia, bona Iehova emui Dirava ese baine henimui tanona namona basina raka vareai eto.
DEU.4.21.english: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;

DEU.26.16.motu: Hari dina ai Iehova ese e haḡanimuimu, ini taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia; taunabunai ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
DEU.26.16.english: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

DEU.24.4.motu: ia adavana gunana, e hadihoa guna tauna, basine abia lou diba; vada e miro ienai. Una na kara mirona Iehova enai; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu emu tano ai ba halaoa tanona na basio hamiroa.
DEU.24.4.english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land to sin, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

DEU.32.31.motu: Badina be edia nadi-ginina be dia iseda Nadi-ginina heḡereḡerena,
DEU.32.31.english: For their rock is not as our Rock,

DEU.22.9.motu: Uhe idau-idau emu vine imeana ai basio hado, anina idoinai, uhe bonahuahua, baine helaḡa na garina.
DEU.22.9.english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

DEU.25.13.motu: Emu moda ai metau hahetoho ḡaudia rua, momokanina bona koikoina, ruaosi basio uda hebou.
DEU.25.13.english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

DEU.30.18.motu: lau ese hari dina ai na hamaoromui gunamu, vada ba mase; Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, unukahai tano ta bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai emui mauri dinadia basie hoho.
DEU.30.18.english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

DEU.30.4.motu: Ena be taunimanima haida be guba dokona henuna ai e nohomu, to ia ese unu amo baine haheboumui bona unu amo baine hakaumui mai.
DEU.30.4.english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

DEU.15.3.motu: Idau bese tauna enai iabi-louna ba gwauraia diba; to emu ḡau ta bema varavaramu imana ai, vada ba gwaua tao.
DEU.15.3.english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

DEU.29.3.motu: Hedibaḡani badadia bona toa bona hoa karadia na matamui ese e itadia;
DEU.29.3.english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

DEU.14.22.motu: Laḡani ta ta amo emu uma anidia ba karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ba hahelaḡaia.
DEU.14.22.english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

DEU.18.10.motu: Ta ese natuna maruanena eiava natuna hahinena na lahi ai basine haḡolea oho. Ta ese babalau eiava mari eiava rohe karadia basine kara, eiava mea ḡaudia basine abi,
DEU.18.10.english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

DEU.1.20.motu: Bena lau ese na hamaoromui, nato, Umui naAmoro taudia edia ororo tanodia ai vada o kau; ina tano be Iehova eda Dirava ese be henidamu.
DEU.1.20.english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.

DEU.2.7.motu: Badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e hanamomui, imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai Ialodiai; emui loaloa ina tano ḡaḡaena badana ai ia dibana. Ini laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e bamomuiva; ḡau ta ai asio dabu.
DEU.2.7.english: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

DEU.27.22.motu: Taihuna, tamana natuna eiava sinana natuna, ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.22.english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’

DEU.30.3.motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hamaurimui, baine bogamui hisi; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiaie hakarohomui rohoroho gabudia amo ma baine haheboumui lou.
DEU.30.3.english: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

DEU.30.11.motu: Badina be hari ina dina ai na haḡanilaimui haheḡanina na dia auka herea bona dia daudau herea.
DEU.30.11.english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

DEU.22.23.motu: Hane-ulato rami-hebou ta bema mai maohenina, bena tau ta ese hanualalonai bema davaria bona bema eno henia,
DEU.22.23.english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

DEU.7.10.motu: To e inai heniamu tauna ia ese basine bogaia hisi; davana do baine henia.
DEU.7.10.english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

DEU.28.21.motu: Iehova ese gorere metaudia amo baine hahisimui, ela bona o lao heniamu emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai ba mase ore.
DEU.28.21.english: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

DEU.22.25.motu: A tau ta ese hane-ulato mai maohenina na tano paka ai bema davaria, bena bema rosia bona bema eno henia, una tau mo sibona baine mase;
DEU.22.25.english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

DEU.26.17.motu: Hari dina ai vada o gwau hamatamu, o tomu, Iehova na emui Dirava; iena dala ai ba raka, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani bona ena hahemaoro herevadia ba badinadia, bona ia erena ba kamonai.
DEU.26.17.english: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

DEU.7.19.motu: hahehisi bona toa bona hoa karadia matamui ese e itadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese imana mai siahuna amo e hakaumui lasi na ba haeroa. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese o gari henidiamu besedia iboudiai na unu baine karadia toma.
DEU.7.19.english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

DEU.16.15.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai aria ba karaia, Iehova emui Dirava ena, Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, emui biru ai bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai Ialodiai; bena ba moale hisi dae.
DEU.16.15.english: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

DEU.27.18.motu: Matakepulu tauna e koiamu, dala amo e hakaua sirimu, tauna bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.18.english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’

DEU.29.18.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, bogaragimui ai tau ta eiava hahine ta eiava doḡoro ta eiava iduhu ta ese hari dina ai Iehova, eda Dirava, bae dadaraia bona unu bese edia dirava isiaidia bae lao heni na garina; eiava bogaragimui ai mase huahuana ta ramuna eiava huahua iditana ta ranuna baine mia na garina.
DEU.29.18.english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

DEU.31.30.motu: Bena Mose na Israel taudia iboudiai edia hebou ai ina ane herevadia e gwaurai hedinarai, ela bona e ore.
DEU.31.30.english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

DEU.25.6.motu: Bena natudia roboana na mase tauna dihina ai bainela, unu amo ia ladana basine boio Israel ai.
DEU.25.6.english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

DEU.31.23.motu: Iehova ese Iosua Nunu e haḡania, eto, Ba goada, lalomu ba ha-aukaia: Israel taudia do ba hakaudia vareai, lau ese vada na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona lalonai. Lau danu baina bamomu.
DEU.31.23.english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

DEU.26.12.motu: Laḡani ihatoina ai, emu uma anidia ba karoadia negana ai, karoa ihagwautana amo Levi tauna bona idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ba harihari henidia, emu hanua lalonai bae aniani, bogadia bae kunu.
DEU.26.12.english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

DEU.7.20.motu: Oibe, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese nanigo baine siaidia bogaragidiai, ela bona bese kwabukwabudia, bae komu taudia, na bae ore vaitani.
DEU.7.20.english: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

DEU.31.17.motu: Una dina ai egu badu baine siahu ediai; baina rakatanidia, vairagu na edia amo baina hunia; bena bae hebua tari, dika momo bona hekwarahi momo ediai bae kau. Bena una dina ai idia baeto “Ina dika na latadai vada e kau badina be eda Dirava na bogaragidai se nohomu ani?”
DEU.31.17.english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

DEU.1.25.motu: Una tano huahuadia taidia taidia imadia ai e abi, bena e lou henida, harina e hamaorolaida, eto, Iehova eda Dirava ese be henidamu tanona na tano namona.
DEU.1.25.english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”

DEU.10.15.motu: to Iehova ese umui senemui e abidia dae, ena lalokau, bona garadia e abidia hidi, ena bese, umui sibomui, bese iboudiai bogaradiai, ema bona hari ina dina.
DEU.10.15.english: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

DEU.31.14.motu: Iehova ese :Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: dina na vada eme kahikahi oi vada ba mase. Iosua a boiria, raruosi na hebou kalagana lalonai ba raka vareai, unuseni ai lau ese baina haḡania.
DEU.31.14.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.”

DEU.5.14.motu: a dina ihahituna na dina helaḡana, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena. Una dina ai basio ḡaukara, oi eiava natumu hahinena, eiava natumu hahinena, eiava emu hesiai tauna eiava emu hesiai hahinena, eiava emu boromakau eiava emu doniki eiava emu ubu-ubu ḡauna ta, eiava idau tauna emu ruma ai e noho hedoamu, emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena na oi ida bae laḡa ani helaoreana.
DEU.5.14.english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

DEU.28.24.motu: Ḡahu na emui tano ai baine diho medu na heto; guba amo baine diho latamui ai, ela bona ba mase ore.
DEU.28.24.english: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

DEU.11.21.motu: bena emui mauri dinadia bona natumui edia mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai, guba na tanobada daenai baine mia negana idoinai.
DEU.11.21.english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

DEU.4.19.motu: Nahuamui ba toho danu, guba ai ba gaga dae, dina bona hua bona hisiu ba itadia, negadia ai na lalomui bae hekwakwanai bena ba toma henidia diho na garina. Idia be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e kara, guba henunai e nohomu besedia iboudiai ihanamodia.
DEU.4.19.english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

DEU.9.21.motu: Bena emui kara havara ḡauna, hari boromakau natuna laulauna, na abia, Iahi ai na gabua; bena na huaria sisisisi, ḡahu na heto; bena hari ḡahu na ororo amo e aruva sinavaina ai na negea.
DEU.9.21.english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

DEU.32.26.english: I said that I would scatter them afar.

DEU.28.2.motu: Oibe, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, ini hahenamo iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho bona dekemui ai bae kau.
DEU.28.2.english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

DEU.23.4.motu: badina be Aigupto amo oma negana ai idia na raka hanaimui ai aniani bona ranu asie henimui. Badina danu idia ese Balaam Beoro na Petoro, Mesopotamia tanona hanuana, amo e boiria, bona davana e henia, baine uduguiraimui totona.
DEU.23.4.english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

DEU.22.21.motu: idia ese una hahine na tamana ena ruma iduarana amo bae hakaua lasi murimuri ai; bena hanua taudia ese bae hodoa mase, badina be ia na Israel ai vada e kara havara, tamana ena ruma ai vada e noho, ariara hahinena na heto. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
DEU.22.21.english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.30.20.motu: bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, bona erena ba kamonai, bona ba badinaia tarika-tarika. Badina be ia na emui mauri, bona ia bagunai emui mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova ese senemui, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, e gwaurai henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai do ba noho.
DEU.30.20.english: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

DEU.21.3.motu: edena be kahikahi; bena una kahikahi hanuana ena tau badadia ese boromakau natuna hahinena ta edia seri amo bae abia, do asie ḡaukaralaia bona aiona madunana do asie atoa kau ḡauna.
DEU.21.3.english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

DEU.29.5.motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai vada nahakaumui tano ḡaḡaena ai; emui dabua na asie dika taumui ai, bona emui tamaka na asie dika aemui ai.
DEU.29.5.english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

DEU.1.29.motu: Bena na hamaoromui, nato, Kudoumui basie hetaha; idia garidia basio gari.
DEU.1.29.english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

DEU.28.63.motu: Iehova na ihanamomui bona ihahutumamui vada e moalelai; to ia na ihadikamui bona ihamasemui do baine moalelai; ba raka vareai emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona amo baine butumui tao.
DEU.28.63.english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

DEU.32.30.motu: Ta ese daha-ta ede bema luludia toma?
DEU.32.30.english: How could one chase a thousand,

DEU.28.36.motu: Umui, bona ikwaramui; ai ba halaoa pavapavana, na Iehova ese baine kahumui nege, umui asi dibamui bona senemui asi dibadia besena bogaraginai ba noho; unuseni ai dirava idaudia, au amo bona nadi amo e karadiamu diravadia, isiaidia ba lao heni.
DEU.28.36.english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

DEU.12.1.motu: Taravatu bona haheḡani bini, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vada e henimui tanona ai ba badinadia namonamo, tanobada ai ba mauri noho dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.12.1.english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

DEU.28.59.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hahisimui bona garamui baine hahisidia, hisihisi metaudia, bae hesiriu daudau hisihisidia, bona gorere metaudia, bae hesiriu daudau goreredia, amo baine hahisimui.
DEU.28.59.english: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

DEU.19.2.motu: Una negana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai hanua toi ba gwauraidia hidi.
DEU.19.2.english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

DEU.12.17.motu: Ini na basio ani diba, emui hanua idau-idau iboudiai lalodiai: emuiuit eiava emui vine ranuna eiava emui dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia, eiava emui boromakau eiava emui mamoe natudia roboadia, eiava emui gwauhamata ḡaudia eiava emui herahia ḡaudia eiava emui dudui-isi ḡauna.
DEU.12.17.english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

DEU.31.7.motu: Bena Mose ese Iosua e boiria, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai e hereva henia, eto, Ba goada, lalomu ba ha-aukaia; ina orea ida ba raka vareai, Iehova ese seneda e gwaurai henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai. Tano na ba henidia, edia tano ai bainela.
DEU.31.7.english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

DEU.33.29.motu: Israel e, oi na namo. Daika na oi sisivamu?

DEU.12.23.motu: Ḡau tamona, mai raradia basio ani; badina be rara be mauri, bona mauri be hidio ida basio ani.
DEU.12.23.english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

DEU.5.10.motu: a lau e ura henigumu bona egu taravatu e badinamu taudia baina bogadia hisi ela bona uru daha.
DEU.5.10.english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

DEU.9.10.motu: Bena Iehova ese huro nadidia ruaosi e henigu, Dirava imana kwakikwakina e torelai ḡaudia; idia latadiai Iehova ena hereva iboudiai vada e hetore, hebou badana dinana ai, ororo ai, lahi bogaragina amo e hamaorolaimui herevadia.
DEU.9.10.english: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

DEU.4.39.motu: una dainai hari dina ai vada ba diba bona lalomui ai bavabia dae, Iehova na Dirava, guba ai bona tanobada ai; ia na asi idaina.
DEU.4.39.english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

DEU.5.5.motu: A lau be Iehova bona umui padamui ai na gini una negana ai, Iehova ena hereva na gwaurai henimui; badina be umui na lahi garina o gariva dainai ororo ai asio dara dae. Ia eto,
DEU.5.5.english: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

DEU.28.49.motu: Iehova ese bese ta dauha amo baine mailaia, tanobada dokona amo. Ugava e rohomu heḡereḡerena baema, umui bae tuari henimui. Una bese na edia gado asi dibamui;
DEU.28.49.english: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

DEU.21.18.motu: Tau ta natuna bema daḡedaḡe bona bema gwau edeede, tamana bona sinana eredia basinema kamonai, ena be bae dadabaia to basine kamonai henidia,
DEU.21.18.english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

DEU.34.12.motu: Bona siahu karadia bona hahegari karadia, Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai e kara, ikaradia ai ia na asi idaina.
DEU.34.12.english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

DEU.3.11.motu: (Hari Og, Basan pavapavana, na Refaim tauna; Refaim taudia iboudiai vada e mase ore, ia mo noho. Ena mahuta patana na auri amo e karaia; ḡauna na do mia Raba ai, Amono taudia edia tano ai. Vaevae ita Israel tauda eda kiubit amo e hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit taurahani-ta, bona ena lababana kiubit hani.)
DEU.3.11.english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

DEU.11.9.motu: emui mauri dinadia bae hoho danu, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai. Una tano na idia mai garadia ida bae abia eto; ia na rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona.
DEU.11.9.english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

DEU.10.20.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari; ia isiaina ba lao heni; ia ba badinaia; ia ladana ai emui gwauhamata ba gwaurai.
DEU.10.20.english: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

DEU.3.10.motu: Ororo doridia hanuadia iboudiai ta abidia, bona Gilead tanona idoinai bona Basan tanona idoinai, ela bona Saleka bona Edrei: Og, Basan pavapavana, ena hanua bunu.
DEU.3.10.english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

DEU.12.14.motu: a Iehova ese emui iduhu bogaragidia amo baine abia hidi gabuna ai mo; unuseni ai emui ḡole-oho bouboudia ba hahelaḡadia, bona unuseni ai na haḡanilaimuimu karadia iboudiai ba kara.
DEU.12.14.english: but in the place which Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

DEU.1.36.motu: A Kaleb Iefune mo sibona ese baine itaia; bona aena amo vada e moia tao tanona lau ese ia baina henia, bona natuna baina henidia, badina be ia ese Iehova vada e abidadama henia mai lalona idoinai.
DEU.1.36.english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”

DEU.30.10.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu, ina taravatu bukana ai vada e hetore ḡaudia, na boma badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, boma lou henia mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai ida, ia ese unu baine karamui toma.
DEU.30.10.english: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

DEU.4.9.motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, laumamu ba gimaia, matamu amo vada o ita ḡaudia ba readia na garina, bena emu mauri dinadia iboudiai lalomu amo bae boio na garina. Natumu bona tubumu ba hadibadia,
DEU.4.9.english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

DEU.28.66.motu: Emui mauri dainai ba daradara: dina ai bona hanuaboi ai kudoumui bae hetaha, ba mauri eiava lasi.
DEU.28.66.english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

DEU.32.6.english: Is this the way you repay Yahweh,

DEU.33.8.motu: Levi be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.4.38.motu: bese badadia bona bese goadadia umui vairamuiai e luludia lasi, umui baine hakaumui vareai bona edia tano baine henimui totona, hari dina ai vada e karaiamu heḡereḡerena:
DEU.4.38.english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

DEU.33.5.motu: Iehova na Iesurunu pavapavana ai ela,

DEU.28.18.motu: Taumui anidia bae dika, bona emui tano anidia bae dika; emui seri basie hutuma, bona emui mamoe natudia basie mauri.
DEU.28.18.english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

DEU.7.14.motu: Bese iboudiai bogaragidiai umui baine hanamomomui badabada; taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ibouboudiai natudia bae havaradia, ta basine gabani.
DEU.7.14.english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

DEU.16.17.motu: ta ta ena goada ena goada heḡereḡerena ena herahia baine heni, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena herahia vada e hanamolaimui heḡereḡerena.
DEU.16.17.english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.

DEU.32.21.motu: Edia dirava asi anina amo vada e havaḡeḡegu,
DEU.32.21.english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God.

DEU.23.23.motu: Udumu bibinadia amo bae lasi herevadia ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara; lalomu ena ura dainai udumu vada e hereva, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, taunabunai karana ba karaia.
DEU.23.23.english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

DEU.23.11.motu: adorahi ai baine digu, bena dina baine diho murinai ia na taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai.
DEU.23.11.english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

DEU.31.8.motu: Iehova na oi vairamu ai bainela; ia ese baine bamomu. Ia ese basine lalomu rea, bona basine rakatanimu. Basio gari; kudoumu basine hetaha.
DEU.31.8.english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

DEU.3.22.motu: Idia garidia basio gari; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese oi daimu ai baine tuari.
DEU.3.22.english: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”

DEU.21.13.motu: bona ena abi-mauri toana dabuadia baine doki oho, bena emu ruma ai baine noho, tamana sinana taidia baine tai ela bona hua ta baine ore. Una murinai ba raka vareai ia dekenai, bona bavadavaia; ia na oi adavamu ai bainela.
DEU.21.13.english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

DEU.2.29.motu: Esau garana, Seiri ai e nohomu, na unu e karagu toma, bona Moab taudia, Ara ai e nohomu, na unu e karagu toma; unu mo baina kara toma, ela bona Ioridane sinavaina baina hanaia. Iehova emai Dirava vada e henimai tanona ai baina raka vareai.
DEU.2.29.english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”

DEU.4.45.motu: Haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia bini, Mose ese Israel taudia e gwaurai henidia, Aigupto amo e raka Iasi murinai.
DEU.4.45.english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

DEU.18.15.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese peroveta tauna ta, lau heḡereḡeregu, emui bese bogaragina amo baine abia hidi; bena ia erena ba kamonai:
DEU.18.15.english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

DEU.3.7.motu: a edia boromakau bona edia kohu ta abidia, eda.
DEU.3.7.english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

DEU.4.2.motu: Vada na henimui haheḡanidia latadiai hereva ta basio atoa kau, bona edia amo hereva ta basio abia oho, a Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani ba badinadia, lau ese vada na henimui heḡereḡerena.
DEU.4.2.english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.

DEU.28.30.motu: Hahine ta bavadavaia, to idau tauna ese baine eno henia. Ruma auta ba haginia, to basio noholaia. Vine imeana ba hadoa, to anina basio abia.
DEU.28.30.english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

DEU.31.16.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: oi na tubu tama dekediai ba mahuta. Bena ina bese taudia bae tore isi, dirava idaudia, bae lao henia tanona taudia edia dirava, bae toma henidia diho, lau bae rakatanigu, bona egu taravatu vada na henidia be bae tataia utu.
DEU.31.16.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

DEU.1.7.motu: harihari a tore isi, ba laolao, ororo kahadia baola, Amoro taudia edia tano bona hetabira tanodia Araba taorana ai, ororo ai bona taora ai, diho kahana ai bona kone kahana ai, Kanaan tanona ai bona Lebanon tanona ai, ela bona sinavai badana, ladana na Eufrate.
DEU.1.7.english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

DEU.8.15.motu: Ia ese una tano ḡaḡaena badana bona dikana amo e hakaumui hanai; gaigai bona doadoa edia hekori amo e hamaurimui; bona tano kaukauna ai, asi ranuna tanona ai, ranu na nadi hagahagana amo e ha-arua lasi, amui.
DEU.8.15.english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

DEU.16.13.motu: Kalaga ariana ba karaia, emui uma anidia na ikwadilaina gabuna amo bona emui vine ranuna na vine imoilaina gurina amo ba habou ḡuḡuru negana ai.
DEU.16.13.english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

DEU.4.11.motu: Bena umui na o raka kahira, ororo badi-tanona ai o gini. Una negana ai Iahi hururu-hururudia na ororoamo e daeva guba ai, bona ori dubuna ese gabu idoinai e havaburaia.
DEU.4.11.english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

DEU.28.16.motu: Hanua lalonai vada ba dika, bona taruha ai ba dika.
DEU.28.16.english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

DEU.33.3.motu: Oibe, ena orea taudia e lalokau henidia,

DEU.4.32.motu: Nega gunadia sivaraidia ai ba tahua, Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia matama tanobada ai ema bona hari umui emui nega ai, bona guba dokona ela, bona guba dokona ai, ba henanadai, kara badana ta inihetomana na nega gunana ta ai, e vara bena sivaraina e gwauraia eiava.
DEU.4.32.english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

DEU.9.27.motu: Emu hesiai taudia, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, ba lalodia; ina bese taudia edia gwau-daḡe bona ediakara havara bona edia kara dika basio lalodia;
DEU.9.27.english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

DEU.20.20.motu: A huahuadia asie animu audia mo ba hagaridia, bena hanua maḡuna ihamakohina audia ai ba halaodia, ela bona; una e tuari henimuimu hanuana bavabia.
DEU.20.20.english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

DEU.28.11.motu: Iehova ese baine hataḡamui, ḡau namodia iboudiai: taumui anidia, bona emui seri anidia, bona emui tano anidia; Iehova ese senemui e gwau henidia hamata baine henimui eto tanona ai.
DEU.28.11.english: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

DEU.28.14.motu: hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo bona dirava idaudia basio lao henidia bona isiaidia basio lao heni, bona ia ese unu baine karamui toma.
DEU.28.14.english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

DEU.1.6.motu: Iehova eda Dirava ese Horeb ai e hereva henida, eto: Umui na nega daudau vada o halahe ina ororo ai;
DEU.1.6.english: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

DEU.17.8.motu: Daradara bema vara, daika ese rara e haida; hahebubua, eiava daika ena hahebade na momokani, eiava daika ese heatu e matamaia, bona hanua taudia ese danu bema hepapahuahulaia; bena ba tore isi, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna baola,
DEU.17.8.english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

DEU.3.25.motu: Iehova e, mani emu kara bama raka hanai, taora namona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai bona ororo tanodia namodia ela bona Lebanon bama itadia.
DEU.3.25.english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

DEU.7.22.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini bese na metaira-metaira umui vairamui ai baine luludia lasi; basio habuadia haraḡa-haraḡa, uda boromadia bae momo emui tano ai na garina.
DEU.7.22.english: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

DEU.2.34.motu: Una negana ai ena hanua iboudiai ta abidia, ta habuadia tari, tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, ta aladia ore, ta se roho mauri.
DEU.2.34.english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

DEU.10.9.motu: Una dainai Levi na asi ahuna tadikakana bogaragidiai. Ia ahuna na Iehova, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e hamaoroa heḡereḡerena.)
DEU.10.9.english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

DEU.28.22.motu: Iehova ese tau-varoda, bonakeru, bona ḡoudae-ḡoudae, bona siahu, bona doe, bona gesegese, bonavalavala, amo baine hahisimui; bae hahisimui ela bona ba mase.
DEU.28.22.english: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

DEU.33.11.motu: Iehova e, ena kohu ba hanamoa;

DEU.12.11.motu: una negana ai vada na haḡailaimui ḡaudia iboudiai ba laohaidia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese, ia ladana unuseni ai baine mia totona, baine abia hidi gabuna ai: emui ḡole-oho bouboudia, bona emui boubou idau-idaudia, bona emui karoa ihagwautadia, bona emui dudui-isi ḡaudia, bona emui gwauhamata ḡaudia, Iehova ena.
DEU.12.11.english: then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to Yahweh.

DEU.12.22.motu: Uda nanina eiava dia boma ani heḡereḡerena, unu danu bavani; vada e taubu bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba.
DEU.12.22.english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

DEU.14.26.motu: unuseni ai lalomu e ura henimuḡaudia na emu moni amo ba hoi, boromakau eiava mamoe eiava vine ranuna eiava inuinu ḡauna ta, emu ura heḡereḡerena. Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai bavaniani, bona ba moale, oi bona emu ruma taudia iboudiai.
DEU.14.26.english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

DEU.13.13.motu: kara havara taudia haida bogaragimui amo vada e raka lasi, hanua taudia lalodia vada e ani, eto, “Dirava idaudia, umui do asi dibamui diravadia, isiaidia baita lao heni”.
DEU.13.13.english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

DEU.2.11.motu: Haida ese ladadia e hatomu “Refaim”, Anakim taudia e gwauraidiamu heḡereḡerena; a Moab taudia ese ladadia e hatomu “Emim”.
DEU.2.11.english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

DEU.3.1.motu: Una dala amo ta raka siri, Basan dalana amo tala; bena Og, Basan pavapavana, e raka lasi, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai, Edrei ai e tuari henida.
DEU.3.1.english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

DEU.12.9.motu: badina be emui laḡa-ani gabuna bonaemui tano korikori, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui gabuna, na do asio kau.
DEU.12.9.english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.

DEU.2.37.motu: A Amono taudia edia tano, Iabok sinavaina isena ai, bona ororo hanuadia, na asio raka henidia kahi, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e gwau tao gabudia iboudiai asio raka henidia kahi.
DEU.2.37.english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.

DEU.8.2.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai tano ḡaḡaena ai e hakaumui daladia ba haero, ihamanaumui bona lalomui itohodia totona unu e kara toma, baine diba, ena haheḡani ba badinadia eiava lasi.
DEU.8.2.english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

DEU.12.3.motu: Edia ihaboulaina patadia ba ḡiḡidia dobi; edia pupu nadidia ba hamakohidia rohoroho; edia au helaḡadia ba. doudia; edia kaivakuku ba hamakohidia, bona ladadia ba roho una gabu ai.
DEU.12.3.english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

DEU.25.17.motu: Ba laloa tao, Amalek ese ede e karamui toma, Aigupto amo o raka Iasi negana ai.
DEU.25.17.english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

DEU.23.5.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Balaam na se hakala henia; iuduguiraimui herevana na ihanamolaimui herevana ai e halaoa, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e ura henimui.
DEU.23.5.english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

DEU.15.2.motu: Ini ba kara toma: taunimanima ta ta ese dekena tauna e henia torehai ḡauna baine gwaua tao, iabi-louna basine gwauraia, dekena taunaena amo eiava varavarana ena amo; badina be Iehova ese abi-torehai igwau-taodiavada e gwauraia.
DEU.15.2.english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.

DEU.11.27.motu: hahenamo be Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani, hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu ḡaudia, ba badinadia davana;
DEU.11.27.english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;

DEU.22.18.motu: Bena hanuatau-badadia ese una tau bae abia; bena bae dadabaia,
DEU.22.18.english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

DEU.15.14.motu: a emu seri amo, emu uit amo bona emu vine ranuna amo imana anina ba heni dudukau. Herahia ba henia; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese herahia vada e henimu heḡereḡerena, ia ba henia.
DEU.15.14.english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

DEU.9.28.motu: emu hahekau dainai a rakatania tanona taudia ese bae kirikirilaimu na garina, baeto “Iehova na asi goadana e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai baine hakaudia vareai”, bona “E inai henidia dainai vada e hakaudia lasi tano ḡaḡaena ai, baine aladia mase totona”.
DEU.9.28.english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

DEU.12.32.motu: Vada na henimui haheḡanidia iboudiai ba badinadia namonamo; latadiai hereva ta basio atoa kau, bona edia amo hereva ta basio kokia.
DEU.12.32.english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

DEU.4.22.motu: Lau na ina tano ai baina mase, basina hanaia Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; a umui vada ba hanaia, una tano namona bavabia emui.
DEU.4.22.english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

DEU.15.1.motu: Laḡani ihahitudia dokodia ai, abi-torehai iboudiai na bae hegwau tao.
DEU.15.1.english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

DEU.20.4.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e, bamomuimu; ia ese inaimui baine tuari henidia umui daimui ai, bona imadia amo baine hamaurimui.
DEU.20.4.english: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

DEU.31.3.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na umui vairamui ai baine hanai; ia ese unu bese na umui vairamui ai baine habuadia tari, bena edia tano bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa. Iosua ese baine gunalaimui, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
DEU.31.3.english: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

DEU.32.46.motu: bena ma eto: Hari dina ai vada na haḡanilaimui herevadia iboudiai na ba Ialodia tao; natumui danu ba hadibalaidia, bena idia ese ina taravatu ena hereva iboudiai bae badinadia bona karadia bae kara.
DEU.32.46.english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

DEU.2.26.motu: Taunabunai, Kedemoto tano-ḡaḡaena amo lau ese gwaukau taudia nasiaidia, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, dekenai, maino herevadia bae gwaurai, baeto:
DEU.2.26.english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

DEU.5.26.motu: badina be tanobada idoinai taunimanima be daika, mauri Diravana gadona vada e kamonai, ita vada ta kamonai heḡereḡerena, Iahi bogaragina amo e hereva henia, bena vada e mauri?
DEU.5.26.english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

DEU.34.4.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Tanona bunai Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob na gwaurai henidia hamata, nato “Umui garamui baina henidia”. Harihari vada na haheitalaimu, matamu amo vada o itaia; to basio lao henia.
DEU.34.4.english: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

DEU.3.28.motu: A Iosua ba haḡania bona ba hagoadaia, bona lalona ba ha-aukaia; badina be ia ese ina besetaudia baine hakaudia hanai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; bena oi ese matamu amo ba itaia tanona na ia ese baine henidia, edia tano.
DEU.3.28.english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

DEU.32.3.motu: Badina be Iehova ladana baina heatolaia;
DEU.32.3.english: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name.

DEU.28.46.motu: Idia na toa ai bona hoa ḡaudia ai baela, umui emui ai bona garamui ediai, ela bona hanaihanai.
DEU.28.46.english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

DEU.4.36.motu: Guba amo e hereva henimui, baine hadibamui totona. Tanobada ai ena lahi badana e haheitalaimui; bena ena hereva na lahi bogaragina amo o kamonai.
DEU.4.36.english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

DEU.20.6.motu: Eiava bema tau ta vine imeana vada e hadoa, a anina do se abia, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ese ena vine anidia roboadia bema abi na garina.
DEU.20.6.english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

DEU.29.24.motu: Oibe, idia bona bese iboudiai baeto “Badina be dahaka Iehova ese ina tano na ini e karaia toma? Ina badu ḡaraḡarana anina be dahaka?”
DEU.29.24.english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

DEU.29.19.motu: Readia unuhetomana ta ese ini gwau-hamata herevadia ikamonaina ai sibona baine hahemarumaru, baineto “Ena be na rakamu mai lalogu aukana ida, to vada baina namo”; bena unu amo pariparina bona kaukauna bae dika bou.
DEU.29.19.english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

DEU.27.2.motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai, dinana ai, huro nadidia badadia ba hagini, bona taba-taba ḡaunaamo bae tabaia ahu.
DEU.27.2.english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

DEU.1.16.motu: Una negana ai danu emui hahemaoro taudia na haḡanidia, nato, Varavaramui ba hahemaoro henidia, tau ta tadikakana ida bae hemaka, eiava tau ta idau bese tauna ida bae hemaka, ba hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaoromui ida.
DEU.1.16.english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

DEU.9.29.motu: Badina be idia na oiemu bese, oi dihimu; oi ese imamu o toia roro, emu siahu badana amo o hakaudia lasi.
DEU.9.29.english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

DEU.12.2.motu: Gabudia bavabi besedia edia dirava e toma henidia dihomu gabudia iboudiai ba habuadia tari, ororo badadia ai bona ororo maraḡidia ai bona au mauridia henudiai.
DEU.12.2.english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

DEU.9.9.motu: Ororo ai na dara dae, huro nadidia, Iehova ese e henimui taravatudia e torelai nadidia, iabidia; una negana ai lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahuiororo ai na nohova, aniani asina aniva, ranu asina inuva.
DEU.9.9.english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

DEU.25.1.motu: Taunimanima bae heai, bena hahemaoro gabuna baela, hahemaoro taudia ese bae hahemaoro henidia; asi ena kerere tauna na bae kahua nege, bona kerere tauna na ena dika davana bae henia.
DEU.25.1.english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

DEU.11.20.motu: Emui iduara ihua-ihuadia kahana kahana audia ai ba tore, bona emui ikoukou ai danu ba tore;
DEU.11.20.english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

DEU.12.24.motu: Basio ania; tano ai ba bubua, ranu na heto.
DEU.12.24.english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

DEU.15.20.motu: unu na laḡani ta ta amo emu ruma taudia ida bavani, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, ia ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai.
DEU.15.20.english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

DEU.21.17.motu: A natuna roboana, e inai heniamu hahinena ena amo e havaraia, na baine hahedinaraia ahu rua ihenina ai, badina be ia na ena goada roboana; una dainai roboa ahuna be ena.
DEU.21.17.english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

DEU.6.22.motu: una negana ai Iehova ese toa bona hoa karadia, babada bona memetau, e hahedinarai, Aigupto Iatanai bona Farao Iatanai bona Farao ena ruma taudia latadiai, ai vairamai ai.
DEU.6.22.english: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

DEU.5.11.motu: Iehova emu Dirava ladana na basio hatoa kava hatoa kava; badina be Iehova ladana baine hatoa kava tauna na Iehova ese kara dika tauna ai baine halaoa;.
DEU.5.11.english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

DEU.5.7.motu: Idau dirava ta basio abia lau vairagu ai.
DEU.5.7.english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

DEU.8.5.motu: Ba laloa danu, tamana ese natuna matana e hakaniamu na heto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui matamui unu e hakani tomava.
DEU.8.5.english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

DEU.18.3.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia ahudia na boubou ḡaudia, boromakau eiava mamoe e mailaidiamu taudia edia amo bae abi. Ḡaudia bini: larolarona, bona vahana ruaosi, bona boukana, hahelaḡa tauna bae henia.
DEU.18.3.english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

DEU.17.20.motu: Lalona danu basine hekokoroku, ena bese taudia basine dadaraidia, bona haheḡani amo basine raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai; bena ena mauri dinadia bae hoho bona natuna edia mauri dinadia bae hoho, ena basileia Israel ai.
DEU.17.20.english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

DEU.2.35.motu: A ta abi boromakaudia bona ta habuadia tari hanuadia kohudia ta laohai.
DEU.2.35.english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

DEU.6.7.motu: natumu danu ba hadibalaidia mai goadamu ida; ruma ai ba helai negadia ai, bona dala ai ba raka negadia ai, bona ba hekure negadia ai, bona ba tore isi negadia ai, ba herevalaidia.
DEU.6.7.english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

DEU.13.17.motu: = helaḡana ta imamu ai basio abia. Bena Iehova na ena badu siahuna ma baine keruma; ia na baine bogamui hisi bona baine hahutumamui, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.13.17.english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

DEU.15.9.motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa danu, lalomu ba hadaia kerere na garina, baoto “Laḡani ihahituna, abi-torehai igwau-taodia laḡanina, vada eme kahikahi”, bena varavaramu ogoḡaminaba vaira hua henia, bona ḡau ta basio henia; bena ia ese Iehova baine tai henia, oi baine habadelaimu, kara dika taumu.
DEU.15.9.english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.

DEU.25.5.motu: Tadikaka bae noho hebou, bena ta baine mase asi natuna, vabu na idau tauna ta basine adavaia. Ihana na ia dekenai baine raka vareai, baine adavaia; vabu ihana ena kara korikori baine karaia.
DEU.25.5.english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

DEU.32.33.motu: Edia vine ranuna na gaigai edia mase muramurana na heto,
DEU.32.33.english: Their wine is the poison of serpents,

DEU.3.29.motu: Taunabunai, ita na koura ai ta taruha, Bete-peoro hevaira hehenina ai.
DEU.3.29.english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

DEU.12.26.motu: To, emui ḡau helaḡadia bona emui gwauhamata ḡaudia vada ba laohaidia, Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai;
DEU.12.26.english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.

DEU.1.17.motu: Ba hahemaoro henidia negadia ai emui hahemaoro basio hagagevaia: dagi maraḡi tauna bona dagi bada tauna bae heḡereḡere umui vairamui ai. Tau ta garina basio gari, badina be hahemaoro be Dirava ena. Bena kara ta dainai ba daradara, hereva na lau dekegu ai ba mailaia, lau ese baina haeroa.
