DEU.1.17.english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

DEU.23.15.motu: Hesiai tauna ta ese biaguna bema heautania, oi dekemu ai bema heau kau, biaguna basio henia lou.
DEU.23.15.english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

DEU.24.9.motu: Aigupto amo o raka lasi negana ai Iehova, emu Dirava, na dala ai Miriama ede e karaia toma vada ba laloa tao.
DEU.24.9.english: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

DEU.30.17.motu: A lalomui bema auka bona taiamui bema kudima, bena haida muridia amo baola, dirava idaudia ba toma henidia diho bona isiaidia ba lao heni,
DEU.30.17.english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

DEU.14.16.motu: bona baimumu maraḡina, bona baimumu badana, bona kema;
DEU.14.16.english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

DEU.29.28.motu: edia tano amo e raḡadia oho, ena badu siahuna ai, bona e luludia lasi idau tano ai bae noho, hari ina dina ai e nohomu heḡereḡerena.”
DEU.29.28.english: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

DEU.14.24.motu: A dala daudau dainai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu negadia ai oi ese hari karoa helaḡadia basio laohai diba, Iehova, emu Dirava, vada e abia hidi bona ladana vada e nemailaia gabuna na daudau dainai,
DEU.14.24.english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

DEU.13.3.motu: una peroveta tauna eiava nihi tauna ena hereva basio abia dae. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e tohomuimu, baine diba, Iehova emui Dirava o lalokau heniamu mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai ida eiava lasi.
DEU.13.3.english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to know whether you love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

DEU.2.4.motu: Bona Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Harihari umui na varavaramui, Esau garana, edia tano amo ba raka hanai; idia na Seiri ai e nohomu. Idia ese umui garimui bae gari. Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho:
DEU.2.4.english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

DEU.23.19.motu: Emu ḡau ta na varavaramu basio henia torehai, mai atokauna ida bavabi lou totona; ena abi-torehai bema moni eiava aniani eiava ma ḡau ta, to atokauna na basio tahua.
DEU.23.19.english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

DEU.2.5.motu: basio tuari henidia, badina be edia tano taina basina henimui; oibe, aemu palapalana bema moia heḡereḡerena na basina henimui, badina be Seiri ororona na Esau na henia, ena tano.
DEU.2.5.english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

DEU.1.42.motu: A Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tuari na basiola, badina be lau na dia umui ida; basiola, inaimui ese bae hadareremui na garina.
DEU.1.42.english: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

DEU.8.8.motu: Ia na uit momo bona bali momo tanona, mai vine audia bona suke audia bona rimono audia bona olive audia, bona mai bada-ranuna danu.
DEU.8.8.english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

DEU.11.3.motu: Ena toa bona ena hoa karadia, Aigupto ai e kara, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, bona ena tano idoinai, ede e karadia toma danu ba haeroa.
DEU.11.3.english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

DEU.13.7.motu: a bogaragidiai o nohomu besedia edia dirava, gabu kahikahidia ai eiava gabu daudaudia ai, eiava tanobada dokona kahana amo ela bona tanobada dokona kahana.
DEU.13.7.english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

DEU.28.1.motu: Benaini, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, bona ena haheḡani iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimui na boma badinadia namonamo bona karadia boma kara, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abimui isi, tanobada besedia iboudiai daediai.
DEU.28.1.english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

DEU.30.5.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese senemui edia tano ai ma baine hakaumui vareai; bavabia, emui tano. Ia ese baine hanamomui bona baine hahutumamui, ela bona senemui edia hutuma ba hereaia.
DEU.30.5.english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

DEU.14.7.motu: Ḡau tamona, adia aniani e ḡaua loumu eiava imadia aedia pararadia ḡaudia haida na basio ani. Ḡaudia bini: kamelo bona hea bona koni, badina be adia aniani e ḡaua loumu to imadia aedia palapaladia asie parara. Idia na mimiro emui ai.
DEU.14.7.english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

DEU.28.19.motu: Emui raka vareai bona emui raka Iasi do bae dika.
DEU.28.19.english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

DEU.2.21.motu: idia na taunimanima badadia, bona hutuma, edia lata na Anakim taudia edia lata heḡereḡerena. A Iehova ese e habuadia tari; bena Amono taudia ese gabudia e abi bona edia tano e abia:
DEU.2.21.english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

DEU.28.17.motu: Emui bosea bae dika, bona emui dihu bae dika.
DEU.28.17.english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

DEU.6.23.motu: Unu amo e hakaumai lasi, seneda e gwau henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai baine hakaumai vareai bona baine henimai helaoreana.
DEU.6.23.english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

DEU.20.17.motu: Bavaladia ore: Hiti taudia, bona Amoro taudia, bona Kanaan; taudia bona Perisi taudia, bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimui heḡereḡerena.
DEU.20.17.english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;

DEU.5.13.motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai emu ḡaukara idoinai ba karaia,
DEU.5.13.english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

DEU.29.7.motu: Ina gabu oma negana ai, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, e raka lasi, e tuari henida. Bena ita ese ta hadareredia,
DEU.29.7.english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

DEU.1.26.motu: To umui na o gwau edeede, asiola; Iehova, emui Dirava, ena hereva o utua.
DEU.1.26.english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.

DEU.13.15.motu: una hanua taudia na dare amo bavaladia mase; hanua na ba habuaia tari, bona taunimanima iboudiai bona boromakau iboudiai na dare amo bavaladia ore.
DEU.13.15.english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

DEU.21.23.motu: ia na au ai basine hetau dae rani; ba taua dae dinana ani ba guria. Badina be au ai e taua dae tauna na Dirava ese e uduguiraiamu. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona na basio hamiroa.
DEU.21.23.english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

DEU.24.20.motu: Emu olive audia huahuadia ba hamorudia negana ai, au rigidia na basio kwadidia nega harua. Orena na idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ese bae abi.
DEU.24.20.english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

DEU.6.20.motu: Nega gabena ai natumu ese baine nanadaimu, baineto “Ini haheḡani bona hahedua bona taravatu Iehova, eda Dirava, ese vada e henida anidia be dahaka?”
DEU.6.20.english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”

DEU.28.45.motu: Ini hahedika iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho; bae ḡavamui bona emui ai do bae kau, ela bona ba mase ore. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, erena asio kamonai, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu asio badinadia.
DEU.28.45.english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

DEU.2.13.motu: A tore isi, eto, Serede sinavaina ba hanaia. Taunabunai, ita na Serede sinavaina ta hanaia.
DEU.2.13.english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

DEU.11.24.motu: Aemui bae moi tao gabudia na bavabi, emui. Emui tano bavabia, tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Lebanon, bona Eufrate sinavaina amo ela bona Davara Badana.
DEU.11.24.english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

DEU.4.26.motu: lau ese hari dina ai guba ladana ai bona tanobada ladana ai na hamaoromuimu umui na asi vanahana ba mase ore, una tano, iabina totona Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia tanona, lalona amo ba boio. Basio noho daudau unuseni ai: do ba mase ore.
DEU.4.26.english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

DEU.5.12.motu: Dina Helaḡa ba badinaia bona ba hahelaḡaia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e haḡanimu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.5.12.english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.

DEU.27.16.motu: Tamana bona sinana se matauraidiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.16.english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’

DEU.17.3.motu: dirava idaudia isiaidia vada e lao heni bona vada e toma henidia diho, eiava dina eiava hua eiava hisiu vada e toma henidia diho, unu amo egu taravatu vada e tataia utu,
DEU.17.3.english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

DEU.12.7.motu: Unuseni ai danu Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bavaniani, bona ba moale hebou, emui ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, umui bona emui ruma taudia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e hanamomui.
DEU.12.7.english: There you shall eat before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which Yahweh your God has blessed you.

DEU.32.37.motu: Ia na baineto, Edia dirava na edeseni ai?
DEU.32.37.english: He will say, “Where are their gods,

DEU.11.32.motu: nahuamui ba toho, taravatu bona haheḡani iboudiai, hari ina dina ai na henimuimu ḡaudia, na ba badinadia.
DEU.11.32.english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

DEU.14.12.motu: A ini na basio ani: ugava-bada, bona larata, bona ugava maraḡina;
DEU.14.12.english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

DEU.14.11.english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

DEU.2.22.motu: Esau garana Seiri ai e kara henidia heḡereḡerena, ia ese Hori taudia e habuadia tari, bena Esau garana ese edia tano e abia bona e noholaiamu ema bona harihari.
DEU.2.22.english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

DEU.28.65.motu: Unu bese bogaragidiai basio noho namonamo, bona aemui basie laḡa ani. Iehova ese kudoumui baine hahetahadia, bona matamui baine hakepuludia, bona laumamui baine hadauredia.
DEU.28.65.english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

DEU.1.40.motu: A umui na ba lou lao, tano ḡaḡaena ai ma ba halaolao, Davara Kakakakana kahana ai.
DEU.1.40.english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

DEU.33.25.motu: Emu tamaka na auri bona auri labora-laborana;
DEU.33.25.english: Your bars will be iron and bronze.

DEU.28.53.motu: Taumui anidia amo e vara hidiodia, natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui hidiodia, bavani, inaimui bae koumui ahu bona bae hadabumui dainai.
DEU.28.53.english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

DEU.10.19.motu: Taunabunai, noho-hedoa tauna ba lalokau henia; badina be umui danu Aigupto tanonaai o noho hedoava.
DEU.10.19.english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

DEU.21.22.motu: Tau ta ese kara dikana ta baine karaia, bena una kara davana be mase, bena au ai ba taua dae ela bona baine mase,
DEU.21.22.english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

DEU.22.12.motu: Emu dabua rimudia ba kara, emu hetaru dabuana isena haniosi ai.
DEU.22.12.english: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

DEU.27.23.motu: Rava bada hahinena ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.23.english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’

DEU.3.5.motu: Ini hanua iboudiai na mai maḡudia bona mai ikoukoudia bona mai ikahidia ida; hanua maraḡidia; si maḡudia danu diaḡau ta abidia.
DEU.3.5.english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

DEU.4.15.motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho; badina be Iehova ese Horeb ai lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui dinana ai ia oromana asio itaia,
DEU.4.15.english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

DEU.9.19.motu: Iehova ese e badu henimui dikadikava bona e urava baine habuamui tari dainai kudougu e hetaha; a una negana ai danu Iehova ese egu noinoi ma e abia dae.
DEU.9.19.english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

DEU.21.11.motu: Una negana ai, hane namo ta abi-mauri taudia bogaragidiai boma itaia, bena boma ura henia, benaboma abia adavamu,
DEU.21.11.english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

DEU.8.6.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani ba badinadia; ena dala ai ba raka, bona ia garina ba gari.
DEU.8.6.english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

DEU.2.23.motu: Avim besena danu unuheto: idia na hanua maraḡidia e noholai ela bona Gasa. A Kaftorim taudia na Kaftoro amo ema, e aladia ore, bena edia tano e abia.)
DEU.2.23.english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

DEU.10.10.motu: Lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui ororo ai na nohova, nega gunana heḡereḡerena; bena nega iharuana ai danu Iehova ese egu noinoi e abia dae, bena se habuamui tari.
DEU.10.10.english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

DEU.7.25.motu: Edia dirava laulaudia na lahi ai ba doudia; iheralaidia gold-na bona silver-na na basio hekise-hekise henibona basio abi, ba hekwakwanai na garina. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese unu ḡau e dadaraimu.
DEU.7.25.english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

DEU.16.9.motu: Pura hitu ba duahidia; emui uma anidia ba utu matama dinana amo ba duahidia.
DEU.16.9.english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

DEU.8.11.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba reaia na garina, eiava ena haheḡani eiava ena taravatu eiava ena hahedua hari dina ai na henimuimu ba readia na garina.
DEU.8.11.english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

DEU.25.10.motu: Bena una tau ena ruma na Israel ai ladana bae hatoa “Tamaka veri-oho tauna ena ruma”.
DEU.25.10.english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

DEU.5.28.motu: O hamaorolaigu herevadia na Iehova ese e kamonai. Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ini taunimanima edia hereva vada na kamonai; edia hereva iboudiai na mamaoro-mamaoro.
DEU.5.28.english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

DEU.13.5.motu: A una peroveta tauna eiava una nihi tauna na bavalaia mase; badina be gwau-edeede karadia e hahedibalai, e tomu Iehova, emui Dirava, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi bona iḡui rumana amo e ruhamui nege Diravana, ba gwau edeede henia, ma e tomu, Iehova, emui Dirava, vada e haḡanilaimui dalana amo ba raka siri. Kara havara na bogaragimui amo unu ba negea daure toma.
DEU.13.5.english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

DEU.18.11.motu: eiava basine vada, eiava lauma basine nanadaidia, eiava kara hehunidia basine kara, eiava mase taudia basine hahanedia.
DEU.18.11.english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

DEU.29.25.motu: Bena taunimanima baeto “Badina be idia ese Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, ena taravatu, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi negana ai e henidia taravatuna, e laloa nege,
DEU.29.25.english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

DEU.28.61.motu: Bona ina taravatu bukana ai asie tore goreredia bona hisihisidia iboudiai Iehova ese baine hadihodia latamui ai, ela bona ba mase ore.
DEU.28.61.english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

DEU.4.24.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka; ia na vaḡeḡe Diravana.
DEU.4.24.english: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

DEU.21.19.motu: tamana bona sinana ese bae dabaia tao, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai bae hakaua lao, hanua ikoukouna badinai;
DEU.21.19.english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

DEU.16.12.motu: Ba laloa tao, umui na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai; bena ini taravatu iboudiai ba badinadia namonamo.
DEU.16.12.english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

DEU.31.2.motu: Bena ia ese ma e hereva henidia, eto, Hari dina ai lauegu mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta ruahui. Asi goadagu baina raka Iasi bona baina raka vareai; bona Iehova ese vada e hamaorogu, eto “Oi na ina Ioridane sinavaina basio hanaia”.
DEU.31.2.english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

DEU.1.3.motu: Laḡani hari-ahui vada e lao bubuni, hua ihagwauta-tanaena dina gini gunana ai, Mose ese Israel taudia e haroro henidia, Iehova ese ia e henia haheḡanidia iboudiai na ia ese idia ma e henidia.
DEU.1.3.english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them,

DEU.9.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ina bese taudia vada na itadia, idia na gwau-daḡe taudia.
DEU.9.13.english: Furthermore Yahweh spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

DEU.5.4.motu: Iehova ida o hevaira heheni una ororo ai, bena lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui.
DEU.5.4.english: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

DEU.34.3.motu: bona diho kahana; bona Ieriko kourana taoradia, pamu audia gabuna bunai, ela bona Soara.
DEU.34.3.english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

DEU.32.28.motu: Badina be idia na dia aonega besena,
DEU.32.28.english: For they are a nation void of counsel.

DEU.10.17.motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na dirava edia Dirava bona lohia edia Lohia; ia na Ḡaubada; ia na siahu bona hahegari Diravana. Ia vairanai taunimanima iboudiai na heḡereḡere; ta ese ia lalona basine ania diba.
DEU.10.17.english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

DEU.25.15.motu: Emu metau hahetoho ḡauna baine maoromaoro, bona emu efa baine maoromaoro; bena emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova, emu Dirava, baine henimu tanona ai.
DEU.25.15.english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

DEU.4.14.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese e haḡanigu, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani baina hadibalaimui, bena ba lao henia bona bavabia tanona ai ba badinadia.
DEU.4.14.english: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

DEU.12.20.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui tano baine habadaia, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena, bena gado dainai baoto “Lau na vamu baina ania”, una negana ai vamu do bavania, emui ura heḡereḡerena.
DEU.12.20.english: When Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

DEU.26.18.motu: Hari dina ai danu Iehova vada e gwau hamatamu, e tomu, umui na ena bese korikori, ena gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena. Mae tomu, ena haheḡani iboudiai ba badinadia;
DEU.26.18.english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

DEU.4.7.motu: Badina be edena bese badana edia dirava ese e raka henida kahimu, Iehova ita eda Dirava ta boi heniamu negadia ai e raka henida kahimu heḡereḡerena
DEU.4.7.english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?

DEU.3.12.motu: Una negana ai ta abia tanona, Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai e miamu hanuana, amo, bona Gilead ororodia kahana mai hanuadia ida, lau ese Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia na henidia.
DEU.3.12.english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

DEU.23.16.motu: Ia na dekemu ai baine noho, emu ruma taudia bogaragidiai; baine abia hidi bona baine ura henia gabuna ai emu maḡu lalonai, unuseni ai baine noho; basio daḡedaḡe henia.
DEU.23.16.english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

DEU.16.21.motu: Au helaḡana ta basio hadoa, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia gabuna ai;
DEU.16.21.english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

DEU.5.15.motu: Ba laloa, oi na hesiai tauna Aigupto tanona ai, bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese imana e toia roro mai siahuna ida, unu amo e hakaumu lasi; taunabunai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimu, Dina Helaḡa ba badinaia.
DEU.5.15.english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

DEU.9.17.motu: Bena huro nadidia ruaosina abidia, imagu amo na tahodia dobi; idia na vairamui ai e makohi rohoroho.
DEU.9.17.english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

DEU.17.4.motu: bena haida ese bema hamaorolaimui: ba kamonai negana ai anina do ba tahua malaka-malaka. Bena boma diba momokani una kara dika-rohorohona vada e karaia Israel ai,
DEU.17.4.english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

DEU.17.2.motu: Tau ta eiava hahine ta boma davaria bogaragimui ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui hanuadia ta lalonai, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai vada e kara havara ena taravatu vada e tataia utu,
DEU.17.2.english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

DEU.29.27.motu: Una dainai Iehova ena badu vada e siahu ina tano enai bona heuduguirai idoinai ina buka ai e hetore na anina e havaraia;
DEU.29.27.english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

DEU.5.33.motu: Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e haḡanilaimui dalana ai ba raka; bena ba mauri, bona emui noho baine namo bona emui dina bae hoho, ba noholaia tanona lalonai.
DEU.5.33.english: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

DEU.31.18.motu: Momokani, una dina ai lau ese vairagu baina hunia, edia kara dika bona dirava idaudia vada e lao henidia daidiai.
DEU.31.18.english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

DEU.17.13.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae kamonai, bena bae gari, bona basie hekokoroku lou.
DEU.17.13.english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

DEU.1.41.motu: Bena umui ese o haere henigu, oto, Ai na vada a kara havara, Iehova enai. Ai na baiala, baia tuari, Iehova ese vada e haḡanida heḡereḡerena. Bena emui tuari ḡaudia; o abi kau, ororo kahadia ai ba ha tuari haraḡa-haraḡa oto.
DEU.1.41.english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh. We will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

DEU.25.12.motu: una hahine na imana ba utui oho; basio bogaia hisi.
DEU.25.12.english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

DEU.2.32.motu: Bena Sihon e raka lasi, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai, e tuari henida Iahasa ai.
DEU.2.32.english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

DEU.2.16.motu: Ina bese ena tuari taudia iboudiai e mase ore murinai,
DEU.2.16.english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

DEU.24.5.motu: Headava matamata tauna na tuari basinela, bona ḡaukara ta basio henia. Ena ruma ai baine noho, adavana baine hamoalea, ela bona laḡani ta baine ore.
DEU.24.5.english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

DEU.28.57.motu: Bena momo aena padadia amo e lasimu bona natuna bogana amo e varamu na baine anidia hehuni, badina be ena hitolo baine bada herea, emui hanua lalodiai inaimui ese baine koumui ahu bona baine hadabumui dainai.
DEU.28.57.english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

DEU.2.18.motu: Hari dina ai Moab ena tano hetoana ba hanaia, Ara ai;
DEU.2.18.english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

DEU.13.6.motu: Readia tadikakamu korikorina eiava natumu maruanena eiava natumu hahinena eiava adavamu lalokauna eiava turamu lalokauna ese lalomu baine ania hehuni, baineto “Dirava idaudia isiaidia baita lao heni”. Unu dirava na readia oi asi dibamu bona senemu asi dibadia diravadia,
DEU.13.6.english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

DEU.20.16.motu: A ini Iehova, emui Dirava, ese edia hanua vada e henimui emui hanua ai baela besedia na mauri ḡauna ta basio bogaia hisi: ibouboudiai bavaladia mase.
DEU.20.16.english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

DEU.10.18.motu: Ia ese vabu bona ihareha na ena hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoevana amo e hanamodiamu, bona noho-hedoatauna e lalokau heniamu, e ubuamu bona e hadabualaiamu.
DEU.10.18.english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

DEU.26.11.motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese oi bona emu ruma taudia vada e hanamolaimui ḡaudia na ba moalelai: Levi tauna bona dekemu ai e noho hedoamu tauna ida ba moale hebou.
DEU.26.11.english: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

DEU.33.10.motu: Idia ese emu haheḡani na Iakob bae hadibalaia,
DEU.33.10.english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances,

DEU.31.25.motu: Bena Mose ese Levi taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaiava taudia, e haḡanidia, eto,
DEU.31.25.english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,

DEU.1.14.motu: Bena umui ese o haere henigu, oto, Emu hereva vada e namo; ai na unu baia kara toma.
DEU.1.14.english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

DEU.27.26.motu: Ini taravatu herevadia se abi daemu bona se badinamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.26.english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’

DEU.9.16.motu: Bena na roha lao, na itamui, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai vada o kara havara, boromakau natuna laulauna vada o koroa, Iehova vada e haḡanilaimui dalana amo vada o raka siri haraḡa-haraḡa.
DEU.9.16.english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.

DEU.14.6.motu: Imadia aedia palapaladia aukadia bona pararadia, bona aniani e hadonomu ma e lori lasimu, ududia ai ma e ḡauamu, ḡaudia iboudiai bavani.
DEU.14.6.english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

DEU.23.25.motu: Dekemu tauna ena uit umana ai ba raka vareai negana ai, uit anidia na imamu ai ba buruki, a emu ilapa amo basio utu.
DEU.23.25.english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

DEU.5.23.motu: Umuiese dibura bogaragina amo una gado o kamonaiva, bona ororo o itaia, lahi ese e araiava, bena o raka henigu kahi, iduhu lohiadia bona tau-badadia iboumui ai;
DEU.5.23.english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

DEU.1.43.motu: Unu na hamaoromui toma, to umui na asio kamonai: Iehova o gwau edeede henia, o hekokoroku, ororo ai o dara dae.
DEU.1.43.english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

DEU.13.12.motu: Readia Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui hanuana ta ai harina ba kamonai,
DEU.13.12.english: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that

DEU.14.4.motu: Bavani ḡaudia bini: boromakau, bona mamoe, bona nani;
DEU.14.4.english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

DEU.4.17.motu: eiava tanobada ena mauri ḡauna ta laulauna, eiava atai ai e rohomu manuna ta laulauna,
DEU.4.17.english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

DEU.30.16.motu: Hari ina dina ai vada na haḡanimuimu, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, ena dala ai ba raka, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu bona ena hahemaoro herevadia ba badinadia; unu amo ba mauri, bona ba hutuma, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, ba raka vareai bona emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai.
DEU.30.16.english: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

DEU.32.29.motu: Bema mai aonegadia, lalodia bema parara,
DEU.32.29.english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this,

DEU.32.19.motu: Iehova ese e itaia, bena e dadaraidia,

DEU.10.7.motu: Unu amo ma e laolao, Gudugoda ela. Gudugoda amo ma e laolao, Iotobata, sinavai momo tanona, ela.
DEU.10.7.english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

DEU.20.13.motu: ela bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese una hanua baine henimui. Bena edia mamaruane ibouboudiai bavaladia mase;
DEU.20.13.english: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

DEU.14.13.motu: bona pivai bona bogibada, mai bamodia manudia ida;
DEU.14.13.english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

DEU.30.6.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui lalomui bona garamui lalodia baine hahelaḡadia; bena ba lalokau henia mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai; bena vada ba mauri.
DEU.30.6.english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

DEU.17.9.motu: hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo bona hahemaoro dagina enai e miamu tauna vairadiai ba gini, ba nanadaidia. Bena idia ese bae haeroa bona) na bae haere henimui.
DEU.17.9.english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

DEU.1.38.motu: a Iosua Nunu, emu hesiai tauna, na una tano ai baine raka vareai. Ba hamaoroa, do baine goada; badina be ia ese Israel taudia baine hakaudia vareai.
DEU.1.38.english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

DEU.9.22.motu: Tabera ai danu, bona Masa ai, bona Kibroto-hatava ai, umui ese Iehova o habadua.
DEU.9.22.english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

DEU.29.20.motu: A Iehova ese basine bogaia hisi. Iehova ena badu bona ena vaḡege bae siahu ḡaraḡara una tau latanai; bena heuduguirai ina buka ai e hetore na ia latanai bae kau, bona Iehova ese ia ladana baine rohoa, guba henunai baine boio.
DEU.29.20.english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

DEU.4.30.motu: Dina gabedia ai, hisi bavani dinadia ai, ini kara iboudiai na emui ai bae vara; una negana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, do ba lou henia bona ba kamonai henia.
DEU.4.30.english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

DEU.1.31.motu: Tano ḡaḡaena ai danu vada o itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abimui isi, tau ta ese natuna e geiamu na heto, emui laolao iboudiai lalodiai, ema bona ina gabu ai vada o kau.
DEU.1.31.english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

DEU.11.18.motu: Taunabunai, ini egu hereva na lalomui ai bona laumamui ai ba dogodia tao; idia na toa ai baela, imamui ai bona bagumui ai.
DEU.11.18.english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

DEU.19.1.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona inoholaina besedia do baine negedia daure, bena umui ese ba luludia lasi, edia hanua bavabidia bona edia ruma ba noholaidia.
DEU.19.1.english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

DEU.28.26.motu: Masemui ai atai manudia iboudiai bona tanobada boromadia ese hidiomui bae ani; tau ta basine luludia oho.
DEU.28.26.english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

DEU.22.3.motu: Eiava ena doniki eiava ena dabua eiava ena ḡau ta bema boio, bena oi ese boma davaria, vada ba henia lou; basio rakatania.
DEU.22.3.english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

DEU.22.16.motu: Bena hahine tamana ese hanua taubadadia baine hereva henidia, baineto “Natugu na ina tau na henia, baine adavaia, to se ura heniamu dainai
DEU.22.16.english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

DEU.25.16.motu: Badina be kara koikoidia unuhetomadia e karamu taudia na Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e dadaraidiamu.
DEU.25.16.english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

DEU.28.48.motu: una dainai inaimui na Iehova ese baine siaidia, bae tuari henimui totona. Isiaidia do ba lao heni, mai hitolomui bona mai ranu-masemui ida; dabua ai ba dabu, ḡau iboudiai badabu; auri gadeadia na aiomui ai bae ato; ela bona bae alamui ore.
DEU.28.48.english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

DEU.10.14.motu: A laloa, Iehova, emui Dirava, na guba biaguna bona atai gabudia lohiana; tanobada na iena, bona tanobada anina idoinai danu iena;
DEU.10.14.english: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

DEU.25.4.motu: Boromakau ese uit e moimoilaiamu negana ai na uduna basio ḡuia.
DEU.25.4.english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

DEU.29.11.motu: bona natumui, bona adavamui, bona idau bese taudia emui taruha ai e noho hedoamu, bona emui au-siri bona emui ranu-ututaudia.
DEU.29.11.english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

DEU.10.3.motu: Taunabunai lau ese kela reireidia na abi, maua na karaia, bona huro nadidia rua na utu palaka, gunadia heḡereḡeredia, ororo ai na daralai dae.
DEU.10.3.english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

DEU.7.15.motu: Iehova ese gorere iboudiai na emui amo baine abi oho, Aigupto ai o davari goreredia na umui latamui ai basine atodia to inaimui iboudiai latadiai baine atodia.
DEU.7.15.english: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

DEU.5.20.english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

DEU.7.16.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui oreadia iboudiai na umui ese bavaladia ore; basio bogadia hisi bona edia dirava basio toma henidia diho; badina be unu ba kara toma, vada ba hekwakwanai.
DEU.7.16.english: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

DEU.4.18.motu: eiava tano ai e raumu ḡauna ta laulauna, eiava davara ai e nohomu gwarumena ta laulauna.
DEU.4.18.english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

DEU.22.8.motu: Ruma matamatana ba haginia negana ai, guhi isena ai helaoahu ḡauna ba karaia, emu ruma guhina amo tau ta baine moru dobi bena rarana na emu ruma latanai baine mia na garina.
DEU.22.8.english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

DEU.27.15.motu: Laulau ta au amo eiava nadi amo eiava auri amo e koroamu tauna na.bae uduguiraia. Unuhetomana, taunimanima imadia amo e karaiamu bona gabu hehunina ai e haginiamu, be Iehova ese e dadaraiamu. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae haere, baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.15.english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’

DEU.17.19.motu: Buka na dekenai baine mia, bona ena mauri dinadia iboudiai baine duahia. Unu amo Iehova, ena Dirava, imatauraina ai baine manada, bona ina taravatu bona ini haheḡani baine badinadia bona karadia baine kara.
DEU.17.19.english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

DEU.23.7.motu: Edom tauna ta basio inai henia, badina be ia na tadikakamu. Aigupto tauna ta danu basio inai henia, badina be ena tano ai o noho hedoava.
DEU.23.7.english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

DEU.33.23.motu: Napatali be ini e herevalaia toma:

DEU.31.9.motu: Mose ese ina taravatu idoinai e torea, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi natuna, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaiava taudia, bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai, e henidia.
DEU.31.9.english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

DEU.17.5.motu: una kara dikana e karaia tauna eiava hahinena na hanua ikoukouna murimurinai ba hakaua lasi, bena nadi amo ba hodoa mase.
DEU.17.5.english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

DEU.28.31.motu: Emu boromakau na vairamu ai bae alaia, to oi na hidiona taina basio ania. Emu doniki na vairamu ai bae dadia, basie henimu lou. Emu mamoe na inaimu bae henidia, tau ta basine durumu.
DEU.28.31.english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

DEU.28.34.motu: ela bona matamu bae ita ḡaudia ese do bae hakavamu.
DEU.28.34.english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

DEU.7.24.motu: Edia pavapava na imamui ai baine atodia; ladadia ba haboiodia guba henuna amo; ta ese basine laomui ahu diba, ela bona ba habuadia tari vaitani.
DEU.7.24.english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

DEU.6.8.motu: Idia na toa ai ba halaodia, imamu ai bona bagumu ai.
DEU.6.8.english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

DEU.7.21.motu: Basio gari henidia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na bogaragimui ai e nohomu: ia na Dirava badana, hahegari Diravana.
DEU.7.21.english: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

DEU.3.24.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi na emu siahu bona imamu ena goada toadia vada o haheitalaigu matama; badina be edena dirava, guba ai eiava tanobada ai, ḡaukara badadia bona siahu toadia ikaradia mai dibana, oi heḡereḡeremu?
DEU.3.24.english: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

DEU.13.18.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, bona ena, haheḡani iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu na boma badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai boma kara maoromaoro, bena unu baine karamui toma.
DEU.13.18.english: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

DEU.2.15.motu: Badina be Iehova imana ese e inai henidia, e habuadia, ela bona e mase ore.
DEU.2.15.english: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

DEU.18.13.motu: Umui na asi bebeka-bebekamui ba gini Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
DEU.18.13.english: You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God.

DEU.30.2.motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lou henia, ia erena ba kamonai, ena haheḡani iboudiai hari ina dina ai vada na gwaurai henimui na ba badinadia, umui bona natumui danu, mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
DEU.30.2.english: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

DEU.8.1.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia iboudiai ba badinadia, unu amo ba mauri, bona ba hutuma, a ba raka vareai, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa.
DEU.8.1.english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

DEU.18.7.motu: ia ese hahelaḡa karadia baine kara Iehova ena Dirava ladana ai, varavarana Levi taudia Iehova vairanai hahelaḡa karadia unuseni ai e karamu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.18.7.english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

DEU.11.16.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, sibomui lalomui ba hekoi bena ba raka siri, dirava idaudia isiaidia ba lao heni bona ba toma henidia diho, na garina.
DEU.11.16.english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

DEU.11.11.motu: A iabina totona ba raka hanai tanona na ororo bona koura tanona, guba medudia ese e haparipariamu tanona,
DEU.11.11.english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

DEU.10.13.motu: bona Iehova ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu iboudiai, lau ese umui ihanamomui totona hari ina dina ai vada na gwaurai henimui ḡaudia, ba badinadia.
DEU.10.13.english: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

DEU.11.10.motu: Badina be iabina totona ba rakavareai tanona na dia o rakatania tanona Aigupto bamona. Unuseni ai emui uhe o hado, bena aemui amo ihapariparidia ola, aniani avadia umadia na heheto.
DEU.11.10.english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

DEU.12.12.motu: Una negana ai umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai ba moale hebou, umui bona natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia, bona emui hesiai taudia bona emui hesiai hahinedia; bona Levi tauna emui hanua ai e nohomu danu, badina be ia na asi ahuna bona asi ena tano umui bogaragimui ai.
DEU.12.12.english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

DEU.31.12.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ba haboudia: tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, bona idau taudia emui hanua ai e noho hedoamu danu. Bena bae kamonai, lalodia bae parara, Iehova, emui Dirava, garina bae gari, bona ina taravatu ena hereva iboudiai bae badinadia, bona karadia bae kara.
DEU.31.12.english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

DEU.28.3.motu: Hanua lalonai vada ba namo, bona taruha ai ba namo.
DEU.28.3.english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

DEU.19.4.motu: Ala-ala tauna taravatuna binai: dekena tauna se inai henia to e hapadidia tauna baine roho mauri, unu hanua ta baine heau henia negana ai.
DEU.19.4.english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

DEU.22.7.motu: a sinadia ba harohoa mauri, natuna mo bavabidia. Unu ba kara toma, vada ba namo; emu mauri dinadia danu bae hoho.
DEU.22.7.english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

DEU.32.45.motu: Mose ese ina hereva na Israel taudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia vaitani,
DEU.32.45.english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

DEU.4.41.motu: Mose ese hanua toi e abidia hidi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai,
DEU.4.41.english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

DEU.7.11.motu: Taunabunai, haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahedua hari dina ai na henimuimu na ba badinadia namonamo.
DEU.7.11.english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

DEU.1.5.motu: Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Moab tanona ai, Mose ese taravatu e gwaurai hedinarai matama, eto,
DEU.1.5.english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

DEU.32.42.motu: Egu diba na rara baina ha-inudia loulou,
DEU.32.42.english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood.

DEU.6.12.motu: Una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, Iehova ba reaia na garina; ia ese Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi.
DEU.6.12.english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

DEU.4.8.motu: Bona edena bese badana edia taravatu bona edia haheḡani na mamaoro-mamaoro, lau ese hari dina ai na henimuimu taravatudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia
DEU.4.8.english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

DEU.30.12.motu: Ḡauna na dia guba ai; ta basioto “Daika ita daidai baine dae guba ai, baine mailaia edai, bena baita kamonaia bona karana baita karaia?”
DEU.30.12.english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

DEU.7.8.motu: A Iehova ese e lalokau henimuimu bona ena gwauhamata senemui ediai ihamomokanina e uramu; una dainai mai imana siahuna ida vada e hakaumui lasi, iḡui rumana amo bona Aigupto pavapavana Farao imana amo vada e hamaurimui.
DEU.7.8.english: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

DEU.20.15.motu: Dauha hanuadia, bavabia tanona murimurinai, na unu ba karadia toma.
DEU.20.15.english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

DEU.7.7.motu: Iehova ese e lalokau henimui bona e abimui hidi, dia umui na bese badana dainai; lasi, bese iboudiai bogaragidiai umui na maraḡi herea.
DEU.7.7.english: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

DEU.11.22.motu: Badina be na haḡanilaimuimu haheḡanidia iboudiai boma badinadia namonamo, Iehova emui Dirava boma ura henia bona ena dala iboudiai lalodiai boma raka bona enai boma tao,
DEU.11.22.english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

DEU.16.1.motu: Hua ladana Abib ba laloa, bona Lagau-hanai ariana ba karaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; badina be Abib huana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese hanuaboi ai Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi.
DEU.16.1.english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

DEU.31.4.motu: Iehova ese baine habuadia tari, Sihon bona Og, Amoro taudia edia pavapava, e habuadia tari bona edia tano e habuaia tari heḡereḡerena.
DEU.31.4.english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

DEU.2.36.motu: Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura hanuana amo ela bona Gilead, hanua ta se auka, iboudiai ta abidia; Iehova eda Dirava ese ita imada ai e atodia.
DEU.2.36.english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.

DEU.2.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto,

DEU.14.17.motu: bona boebedi, bona lokoru, bona manubada;
DEU.14.17.english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

DEU.32.4.motu: Ia na Nadi-ginina; ena ḡaukara na ḡoeva-dae;
DEU.32.4.english: The Rock: his work is perfect,

DEU.8.12.motu: Bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu; ruma namodia ba hagini, ba noholai;
DEU.8.12.english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

DEU.1.23.motu: Emui hereva na haeroa, hereva namona; bena tatau gwauta-rarua umui bogaragimui amo na abidia, iduhu ta ta amo tatau ta ta na abidia.
DEU.1.23.english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

DEU.18.4.motu: Ini danu ba henia: emu uma anidia roboadia, bona emu vine ranuna bona emu dehoro roboadia, bona emu mamoe huina roboana.
DEU.18.4.english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

DEU.22.11.motu: Mamoe huidia bona uda varodia e hatu hebou dabu; ma na basio hahedokilaia.dinadia.
DEU.22.11.english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

DEU.7.1.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hakaumui vareai, emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai, umui vairamui ai bese idau-idau baine luludia Iasi: Hititaudia, Girigasa taudia, Amoro taudia, Kanaan taudia, Perisi taudia, Hivi taudia, Iebusu taudia; bese hitu, badadia bona mai goadadia.
DEU.7.1.english: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

DEU.18.17.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Edia hereva iboudiai na mamaoro-mamaoro:
DEU.18.17.english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

DEU.22.20.motu: A una tau ena hahebade bema momokani, una hahine ena rami-heboutoadia bema lasi,
DEU.22.20.english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

DEU.32.20.motu: Eto, Vairagu na edia amo baina hunia
DEU.32.20.english: He said, “I will hide my face from them.

DEU.1.30.motu: Iehova emui Dirava, umui vairamui ai e rakamu Diravana, ia ese umui daimui ai baine tuari, hoa karadia baine kara, umui vairamui ai Aigupto ai e karava heḡereḡerena.
DEU.1.30.english: Yahweh your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

DEU.21.5.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia, Levi iduhuna amo, bae raka kahira; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abidia hidi, ia isiaina bae lao heni bona Iehova ladana bae heatolaia totona, bona hepapahuahu eiava heatu iboudiai idia ese bae hahemaorolai.
DEU.21.5.english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

DEU.14.19.motu: Mai hanidia bona mai imadia aedia ḡaudia na mimiro emui ai, basio ani.
DEU.14.19.english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

DEU.22.19.motu: bona ena kereredavana, silver sekeledia sinahu-ta, na iena amo bae abia, hahine tamanabae henia. Badina be una tau ese Israel hane-ulato rami-hebouna ta ladanavada e hadikaia. Bona baine abia, ia adavana; basine hadihoa, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai.
DEU.22.19.english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

DEU.4.13.motu: Bena ena taravatu e henimui, taravatu gwauta ba badinadia eto, bona huro-nadidia palakadia ruaosi ai etoredia.
DEU.4.13.english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

DEU.26.13.motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai ba hereva, baoto: Ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai egu ruma amo vada na abidia lasi, Levi tauna bona idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu vada na harihari henidia, emu haheḡani heḡereḡerena. Emu haheḡani ta asina tataia utu, bona ta asina laloa boio.
DEU.26.13.english: You shall say before Yahweh your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

DEU.32.22.motu: Badina be egu badu ese lahi vada e havaraia,
DEU.32.22.english: For a fire is kindled in my anger,

DEU.18.12.motu: Badina be unu kara bodagadia e karamu taudia na Iehova ese e dadaraidiamu; bona unu kara bodagadia daidiai Iehova ese umui vairamui amo e luludia lasimu.
DEU.18.12.english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

DEU.28.25.motu: Iehova ese baine hadareremui, inaimui vairadiai. Dala tamona ai ba raka lasi, ba tuari henidia; dala hitu amo vairadiai ba heau. Tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ese bae dadaraimui.
DEU.28.25.english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

DEU.25.18.motu: Dala ai e davarimui, taumui e boerava bona e manoriva negana ai, bena e manokava dainai murimui ai e raka heveriveriva taudia na e aladia mase; ia na Dirava garina se gariva.
DEU.25.18.english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

DEU.15.22.motu: Hanua ai bavania; vada e taubu taudia bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba, uda nanidia bona dia o animu heḡereḡerena.
DEU.15.22.english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

DEU.4.6.motu: Ba badinadia, bona karadia ba kara; badina be emui aonega bona emui lalo-parara na unu amobae hedinarai, bese idau-idau vairadiai. Bena ini taravatu iboudiai baekamonai negana ai na baeto “Momokani ina bese badana na aonega bona lalo-parara besena”.
DEU.4.6.english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

DEU.15.13.motu: Ba ruhaia nege negana ai, ima kavakavana ai basio kahua nege;
DEU.15.13.english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

DEU.3.18.motu: Una negana ai na haḡanimui, nato: Iehova ese ina tano vada e henimui, emui. Emui goada taudia iboudiai na edia tuari ḡaudia bae abi, tadikakamui Israel taudia vairadiai.
DEU.3.18.english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

DEU.1.33.motu: Ia ese dala ai e gunalaimui, emui taruha gabudia e tahu; emui dala danu e hahedinarai henimui, lahi amo hanuaboi ai, bona ori amo dina ai.
DEU.1.33.english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

DEU.4.12.motu: Bena Iehova ese lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui; ena hereva vada o kamonai, to oromana asio itaia, gadona mo o kamonai.
DEU.4.12.english: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

DEU.27.17.motu: Dekena tauna ena tano hetoana e raḡaiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
DEU.27.17.english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’

DEU.1.21.motu: O itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tano vada eme lailaia vairamui ai; ba raka vareai, bavabia, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimui heḡereḡerena. Basio gari; lalomui na basie hekwarahi.
DEU.1.21.english: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

DEU.1.2.motu: Horeb amo bema laolao, Seiri ororona amo bema lao ela bona Kade-baranea, Iaolao dinadia na bemagwauta-ta na heto.
DEU.1.2.english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

DEU.10.16.motu: Taunabunai, lalomui ba hahelaḡadia, bona emui gwau-daḡe ba negea.
DEU.10.16.english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

DEU.24.21.motu: Emu vine imeana ai danu vine ba pada negana ai, tano ai bae moru ḡaudia na basio gogodia; idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ese bae gogo.
DEU.24.21.english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

DEU.17.16.motu: Ḡau tamona, ia ese ena hosi basine hahohodia, bona ena orea taudia basine siaidia lou Aigupto ai, hosi ihahohodia totona. Badina be Iehova ese vada e hereva henimui, eto “Nega ta una dala amo basio lou lao”.
DEU.17.16.english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

DEU.1.15.motu: Taunabunai, emui iduhu lohiadia na abidia, mai aonegadia bona mai dibadia taudia, bena umui ikwaramui taudia ai na halaodia: daha biagudia, sinahu biagudia, imahui biagudia, gwauta biagudia, bona heitatao taudia, emui iduhu ta ta lalodiai.
DEU.1.15.english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

DEU.29.12.motu: Hari dina ai Iehova emui Dirava, ida ba herohemaino, bona ia ida ba hegwau-hamata heheni totona vada oma.
DEU.29.12.english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,

DEU.28.28.motu: Iehova ese baine hakavamui, bona matamui baine hakepuludia, bona lalomui baine hadaradaradia.
DEU.28.28.english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

DEU.28.42.motu: Emui au iboudiai bona emui uma anidia na kwadi ese bae ani.
DEU.28.42.english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

DEU.15.4.motu: A tau ta basine ogoḡami umui bogaragimui ai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, vada e henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai Iehova ese baine hanamomui.
DEU.15.4.english: However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

DEU.15.15.motu: Ba laloa tao, umui danu hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto tanona ai, bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e ruhamui nege; taunabunai ina haheḡani name henimui hari ina dina ai.
DEU.15.15.english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

DEU.10.4.motu: Bena ia ese taravatu gwautaosi e tore, unu huro nadidia ai, gunadia ai e hetore heḡereḡeredia. Unu taravatu be Iehova ese ororo ai e henimui ḡaudia, lahi bogaragina amo e gwaurai, hebou dinana ai. Bena Iehova ese unu nadi vada e henigu.
DEU.10.4.english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

DEU.21.16.motu: ena kohu baine haria natuna ahudia baine henidia dinana ai, ia na e ura heniamu hahinena natuna na dihina ai basine halaoa, roboana korikori, e inai heniamu hahinena natuna, gabuna basine abia.
DEU.21.16.english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

DEU.24.15.motu: Dina ta ta amo davana ba henia; dina do basine diho vada ba henia. Badina be ia na e ogoḡamimu, bona davana iabina e uramu. Ia ese Iehova baine tai henia, oi baine habadelaimu, bena oi na ba kerere na garina.
DEU.24.15.english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.

DEU.31.6.motu: Ba goada, lalomui ba ha-aukadia, idia garidia basio gari; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine bamomui. Ia ese basine lalomui rea, bona basine rakatanimui.
DEU.31.6.english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

DEU.31.19.motu: Taunabunai, ina ane ba torea bona Israel taudia ba hadibalaidia. Ududia ai bavatoa: ina ane ese Israel taudia baine habadelaidia lau vairagu ai.
DEU.31.19.english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

DEU.28.10.motu: Bena tanobada taudia iboudiai ese bae itaia, Iehova ese ia ladana e hanemailaimui; bena idia na garimui bae gari.
DEU.28.10.english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

DEU.26.14.motu: Hari karoa ihagwautana taina asina ania, mase na tailaia negana ai; bona taina asina abia, na taubu negana ai; bona mase latanai e helaḡalaimu karadia e kara tauna na taina asina henia. Iehova, egu Dirava, erena vada na kamonai, bona o haḡanigu karadia iboudiai na kara.
DEU.26.14.english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

DEU.31.5.motu: Iehova ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, bena vada na haḡanilaimui haheḡanidia heḡereḡeredia ba kara henidia.
DEU.31.5.english: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

DEU.33.15.motu: Ororo gunadia edia ḡau hereadia amo,
DEU.33.15.english: for the best things of the ancient mountains,

DEU.16.6.motu: a Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai, unuseni ai lagau-hanai boubouna ḡauna bavalaia, adorahiai, dina baine diho ai, Aigupto amo o raka lasi dinana ai.
DEU.16.6.english: but at the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

DEU.2.19.motu: bena Amono garana edia tano hetoana ba raka henia kahi negana ai, basio daḡedaḡe henidia bona basio tuari henidia, badina be Amono garana edia tano taina basina henimui; badina be una tano na Lot garana vada na henidia, edia tano.
DEU.2.19.english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

DEU.26.19.motu: bena ia ese baine abimui isi, e karadia besedia iboudiai daediai, imodaimui ai bona harimui ai bona imatauraimui ai; Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese helaḡana ai baola, iena hereva heḡereḡerena.
DEU.26.19.english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.

DEU.16.20.motu: Kara maoromaoro ba ḡava, bena ba mauri, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona na emui tano korikori ai bainela.
DEU.16.20.english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

DEU.29.22.motu: Uru gabedia ai, umui garamui bona dauha amo ena laolao ai bainema tauna ese una tano ena dika bona ena gorere Iehova ese baine hahisilaia na bae itaia;
DEU.29.22.english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,

DEU.7.2.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, bena ba hadareredia negana ai ba habuadia tari bona bavaladia ore; idia ida basio herohemaino, bona basio bogadia hisi.
DEU.7.2.english: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

DEU.22.5.motu: Tau ta ese hahine ena dabua basine dokilaia; hahine ta danu tau ena dabua basine dokilaia. Unu e kara tomamu tauna eiava hahinena na Iehova ese e dadariamu.
DEU.22.5.english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

DEU.28.64.motu: Iehova ese baine hakarohomui rohoroho, bese idau-idauiboudiai bogaragidiai, tanobada dokona amo ela bona tanobada dokona. Unuseni ai dirava idaudia, umui asi dibamui bona senemui asi dibadia diravadia, au bona nadi amo e karadia diravadia, isiaidia ba lao heni.
DEU.28.64.english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

DEU.2.10.motu: (Gunaguna Emim besena unuseni ai e nohova: idia na hutuma bona taunimanima badadia; edia lata na Anakim taudia edia lata heḡereḡerena.
DEU.2.10.english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

ECC.2.24.motu: Tau ta ena dala namo-hereana binai: baine aniani, baine inuinu, bona ena hekwarahi baine moalelaia. Bena lalogu e parara, ina danu be Dirava imana amo;
ECC.2.24.english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

ECC.9.4.motu: To mauri taudia iboudiai ida e heturamu tauna na mai ena helaro; badina be e maurimu sisiana ese vada e mase leonana na e hereaiamu.
ECC.9.4.english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

ECC.9.2.motu: badina be kara tamona na iboudiai ediai e kaumu, kara maoromaoro tauna enai bona kara dika tauna enai, tau namona enai bona tau dikana enai, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva tauna enai bona lalo-bodaga tauna enai, boubou ḡauna e hahelaḡaiamu tauna enai bona boubou ḡauna se hahelaḡaiamu tauna enai. Kara namo tauna bona kara dika tauna na heḡereḡere; e gwau hamatamu tauna bona gwauhamata se uramu tauna na heḡereḡere.
ECC.9.2.english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

ECC.5.12.motu: Ḡaukara tauna na bogana baine kunu eiava baine hitolo, to ena mahuta baine namo; a taḡa tauna na baine ani paru dainai basine mahuta diba.
ECC.5.12.english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

ECC.1.1.motu: Ini na Haroro Tauna ena hereva; ia be David natuna, Ierusalem pavapavana.
ECC.1.1.english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

ECC.8.16.motu: Lalogu na hadaia, aonega baina diba, bona tanobada ai e karaiamu ḡaukarana baina itaia; e kara boimu e kara ranimu, matadia asie mahutamu.
ECC.8.16.english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

ECC.7.15.motu: Egu mauri asi anina lalonai, ḡau iboudiai vada na itadia: kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro ai e masemu, bona kara dika tauna na ena kara dika ai ena mauri e hadaudauamu.
ECC.7.15.english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

ECC.7.3.english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

ECC.2.17.motu: Taunabunai, mauri na inai heniava; badina be dina henunai e karava karadia na lalogu ese e hisihisilaiva. Badina be iboudiai na asi anidia, Iai ianina mo.
ECC.2.17.english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ECC.7.27.motu: Haroro Tauna e tomamu: A itaia, ina na vada na davaria. Lalo-hadai idau-idau vada na haboudia, ede bae hatamona toma;
ECC.7.27.english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

ECC.9.11.motu: Dina henunai ma na itaia lou: heau helulu ai heau haraḡa taudia asie gunamu, bona tuari ai goada taudia asie kwalimumu, bona aonega taudia ese aniani asie aniamu, bona lalo-parara taudia ese taḡa asie abiamu, bona idibaka taudia na asie lalo-namo henidiamu; a nega bona kara na e vara kavamu mo, iboudiai ediai.
ECC.9.11.english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

ECC.12.7.motu: ḡahu ese tano do se lou henia, oromana gunana heḡereḡerena do se abia, bona lauma na e henia Diravana dekena do se lou lao negana ai.
ECC.12.7.english: and the dust returns to the earth as it was,

ECC.9.18.motu: Aonega ese tuari ḡaudia na e hereadiamu, a kara dika tauna tamona ese ḡau namodia diagau e hadikadiamu.
ECC.9.18.english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

ECC.10.2.motu: Aonega tauna lalona ese idiba kahana e hakaua laomu,
ECC.10.2.english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand,

ECC.10.7.motu: Hesiai taudia vada na itadia, hosi ai e guimu; bona hanua lohiadia vada na itadia, aedia amo e rakamu, hesiai taudia na heheto.
ECC.10.7.english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

ECC.7.25.motu: Lalogu na haloua, baina diba, bona aonega bona ḡau badidia baina tahudia; bona kara dika ena kavakava bona kavakava ena kava kukuha baina dibadia.
ECC.7.25.english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

ECC.4.9.motu: Rarua ese tamona e hereaiamu; badina be edia hekwarahi davana namona e abiamu.
ECC.4.9.english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

ECC.6.10.motu: Vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai na ladadia vada e hato guna, bona dibada taunimanima be dahaka, bona dibada ia ese goada-herea tauna basine hepapahuahu henia diba.
ECC.6.10.english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

ECC.7.28.motu: Ialogu ai vada na tahua loulou, to asina davaria. Daha ta lalodia amo tau tamona na davaria, a ini iboudiai lalodia amo hahine ta asina davaria.
