ECC.7.28.english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

ECC.12.11.motu: Aonega taudia edia hereva na ikodo na heheto; bona e haboudia herevadia na e kokodia kau ikokodia na heheto; idia na Hereḡu Tauna tamona ese e heni.
ECC.12.11.english: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

ECC.3.7.motu: dabua idarena mai negana, dabua iturina mai negana;

ECC.1.13.motu: Bena guba henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai na tahudia, mai lalogu idoinai bona mai aonegagu ida. Dirava ese taunimanima natudia unu vada e hahekwarahidia tomamu.
ECC.1.13.english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

ECC.9.16.motu: A lau na tomamu, ena be ogoḡami tauna ena aonega e dadaraiamu bona ena hereva asie kamonaimu, to aonega ese goada e hereaiamu.
ECC.9.16.english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

ECC.2.19.motu: Bona daika dibana ia na baine aonega eiava baine kavakava? A mai aonegagu ida dina henunai na hekwarahilaiva ḡaudia iboudiai na ia ese baine biagudia. Ina danu asi anina.
ECC.2.19.english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

ECC.4.13-14.motu: Eregabe tauna mai aonegana, ena be ia na e vara ogoḡami tauna mo basileia lalonai bena dibura rumana lalona amo e raka lasi pavapava ai ela, to ia ese pavapava burukana mai ena kavakava, aonega taudia edia hahealo iabi-daena vada e rakatania tauna, na e hereaiamu.

ECC.2.11.motu: Bena imagu ḡaukaradia iboudiai bona ikaradia hekwarahidia idoidiai na haerodia; bena lalogu e parara, idoinai na asi anina, lai ianina mo. Ihanamogu ḡauna ta lasi dina henunai.
ECC.2.11.english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

ECC.1.4.motu: Uru ta e lao bubunimu, ma uru ta e vara isimu;
ECC.1.4.english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

ECC.10.8.motu: Guri e ḡeiamu tauna na una guri lalonai baine moru;
ECC.10.8.english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

ECC.2.23.motu: Badina be ena dina iboudiai na hisihisi ai e honumu, bona ena ḡaukara na lalo-hekwarahi ḡauna; hanuaboi ai danu ia lalona se laḡa animu. Ina danu asi anina.
ECC.2.23.english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

ECC.11.3.motu: Dagadaga na ranu ai bema honu,
ECC.11.3.english: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth;

ECC.1.7.motu: Sinavai iboudiai na davara ai e aru lasimu,
ECC.1.7.english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

ECC.10.16.motu: Tano e, pavapavamu bema mero bona emu lohia na daba ai bema ani lava dae negana ai,
ECC.10.16.english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child,

ECC.10.1.motu: Muramura mai bonadia ikaradia tauna ena dehoro lalonai lao e masemu,
ECC.10.1.english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor;

ECC.12.5.motu: Una dina ai. atai gabudia garidia bae gari, bona dala ai danu hahegari ḡaudia bae mia. Una dina ai sakada auna baine burea, bona kwadi baine bainabaina lao, bona heḡahusi baine ore. Badina be taunimanima na baine noho henia hanaihanai gabuna e laomu, bona taitai taudia na ariara ai e tai loaloamu.
ECC.12.5.english: yes, they shall be afraid of heights,

ECC.4.10.motu: Badina be ta bema keto, bamona ese bema abia isi; a ta bema raka edea bena bema keto negana ai asi iabi-isina tauna, ia madi ihabaina.
ECC.4.10.english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

ECC.2.18.motu: Dina henunai na hekwarahilaiva ḡaudia iboudiai na na inai henidiava; badina be murigu ai bainema tauna enai baina rakatanidia.
ECC.2.18.english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

ECC.10.10.motu: Auri asi ganona basie segea negana ai, ḡaukara tauna ena hekwarahi baine bada,
ECC.10.10.english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

ECC.7.21.motu: Taunimanima edia hereva iboudiai basio hakala henidia, emu hesiai tauna baine uduguiraimu bena ena hereva ba kamonai na garina.
ECC.7.21.english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

ECC.8.4.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana ena hereva na herea; daika ese baine nanadaia, baineto “Dahaka o karamu?”
ECC.8.4.english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

ECC.3.4.motu: taitai mai negana, kiri mai negana;

ECC.3.21.motu: Daika dibana taunimanima laumana na e daemu bona boroma laumana na tano ai e dihomu eiava?
ECC.3.21.english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

ECC.10.5.motu: Dika ta vada na itaia dina henunai, hanua pavapavana ena kerere ta na heto reana.
ECC.10.5.english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

ECC.11.2.motu: Hahitu eiava taurahani ahudia ba henidia,
ECC.11.2.english: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight;

ECC.2.7.motu: Hesiai taudia bona hahinedia na hoidia, bona hesiai memerodia bona kekenidia na egu ruma ai e vara. Egu nani bona egu mamoe seridia na momo herea, Ierusalem ai e gunalaigu taudia iboudiai edia e hereadia.
ECC.2.7.english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

ECC.1.18.motu: Badina be aonega bada lalonai lalo-hekwarahi danu bada;
ECC.1.18.english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

ECC.3.20.motu: Iboudiai na gabu tamona e laomu; iboudiai na ḡahu amo, bona iboudiai na ḡahu ai ma baela.
ECC.3.20.english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

ECC.7.20.motu: Momokani, asi kara-maoromaoro tauna ta tanobada ai e kara namomu mo, bona nega ta se kara dikamu.
ECC.7.20.english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

ECC.3.8.motu: heura-heheni mai negana, heinai-heheni mai negana;

ECC.5.20.motu: Badina be idia ese edia mauri dinadia basie lalodia bada; badina be Dirava ese e hamoalediamu, bona una mo bae laloa bada.
ECC.5.20.english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

ECC.10.12.motu: Aonega tauna uduna herevadia ese taunimanima edia hahenamo e abiamu,
ECC.10.12.english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

ECC.1.10.motu: Ḡau be edena, bae herevalaia, baeto
ECC.1.10.english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

ECC.3.16.motu: Dina henunai ma na itaia, hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva gabuna ai kara dika e miava, bona kara maoromaoro gabuna ai kara gageva-gagevadia danu e miava.
ECC.3.16.english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

ECC.9.12.motu: Badina be taunimanima ese ena nega se dibaiamu. Gwarume na hekoi rekena ai e hetoamu eiava manu na idoa ai e heidoamu na heto, taunimanima natudia na unu e heidoa tomamu, nega dika ese e hahoadiamu negana ai.
ECC.9.12.english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

ECC.12.6.motu: Ia ba laloa tao, silver varona do se motu, eiava gold dihuna do se makohi, eiava hodu na ranu gabuna ai do se hesea rohoroho, eiava ava keikeina na ranu gurina isena ai do se kwaidu ai;
ECC.12.6.english: before the silver cord is severed,

ECC.2.26.motu: Badina be Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu tauna na aonega bona lalo-parara bona moale e heniamu; a kara dika tauna na ina hekwarahi e heniamu, ia ese kohu baine habou bona baine hasenu, Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu tauna ihenina totona. Ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
ECC.2.26.english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ECC.3.5.motu: nadi inegedia mai negana, nadi ihaboudia mai negana;
ECC.3.5.english: a time to cast away stones,

ECC.3.13.motu: Ina danu, iboudiai bae aniani bona bae inuinu, bona edia hekwarahi idoinai bae moalelaia; una na Dirava ena harihari ḡauna taunimanima ediai.
ECC.3.13.english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

ECC.6.3.motu: Tau ta natuna bema sinahu-ta, bona ena mauri bema daudau, ela bona ena mauri laḡanidia bema momo herea, a ena mauri ihanamona ḡaudia basinema moalelaidia bona ena mase negana ai basiema ḡuria; lau na tomamu masena ai e vara merona ese ia e hereaiamu.
ECC.6.3.english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

ECC.10.19.english: A feast is made for laughter,

ECC.9.9.motu: Adavamu, o ura heniamu hahinena, ida ba moale hebou, emu mauri asi anina dinadia Dirava ese dina henunai vada e henimu iboudiai lalodiai, badina be oi ahumu bunai emu mauri ai, bona dina henunai o hekwarahilaimu ḡaukaradia lalodiai.
ECC.9.9.english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

ECC.1.3.motu: Tau ta ena hekwarahi idoinai dina henunai e karaiamu
ECC.1.3.english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

ECC.1.9.motu: E vara guna ḡauna ma baine vara lou;
ECC.1.9.english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

ECC.2.2.motu: Kiri na herevalaia, nato “Ia na kavakava”; bona moale na herevalaia, nato “Ena namo be dahaka?”
ECC.2.2.english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

ECC.5.4.motu: Dirava ba gwau hamata henia negana ai, anina ikarana ai basio halahe; badina be ia ese kavakava taudia se moalelaidiamu. Emu gwauhamata anina ba karaia.
ECC.5.4.english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

ECC.4.6.motu: Ima tamona na laḡa-ani amo baine honu be namo; ima ruaosi na hekwarahi bona lai ianina amo bae honu na dika.
ECC.4.6.english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

ECC.5.14.motu: hekwakwanai negana ai una taḡa e boio, bena ia na mai natuna, to imana e tuna.
ECC.5.14.english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

ECC.6.12.motu: Badina be daika dibana taunimanima ena namo be dahaka, ena mauri asi anina dinadia oreoredia lalodiai? E raka hanaimu laulau ta na heto, ani? Badina be daika ese baine hamaoroa, ia murinai dahaka baine hedinarai dina henunai?
ECC.6.12.english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

ECC.6.4.motu: Badina be ena mai na asi anina, ena lao be dibura e lao heniamu, bona ia ladana na dibura ai e bubunimu;
ECC.6.4.english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

ECC.10.6.motu: Kererena binai: kavakava na atai gabudia ai e abia daemu, a taḡa taudia na henu ai e helaimu.
ECC.10.6.english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

ECC.1.16.motu: Lalogu ai nato: Aonega badana vada na abia; egu aonega ese Ierusalem e biagua gunava taudia iboudiai edia aonega na e hereadiamu; oibe, lalogu ese aonega bona lalo-parara vada e dibadia bada.
ECC.1.16.english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

ECC.2.15.motu: Bena lalogu ai nato: Kavakava tauna enai e kaumu ḡauna na lauegu ai danu baine kau; matona, na aonega hereamu anina be dahaka? Ma lalogu ai nato: Ina danu asi anina.
ECC.2.15.english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

ECC.3.17.motu: Lalogu ai nato: Dirava ese kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia baine hahemaoro henidia; badina be ia ese bae vara ḡaudia iboudiai bona ḡaukara iboudiai edia nega vada e gwaurai.
ECC.3.17.english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

ECC.4.7.motu: Bena kara asi anina dina henunai ma na itaia. Kara na binai:
ECC.4.7.english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

ECC.1.15.motu: Ḡau gageva-gagevana na basie hamaoromaoroa diba,
ECC.1.15.english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

ECC.8.10.motu: Na itaia danu, kara dika taudia na e guridia; gunaguna-idia na gabu helaḡana ai e raka vareai e raka lasi, bona hanua lalonai e imodaidia edh kara daidiai. Ina danu asi anina.
ECC.8.10.english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

ECC.9.6.motu: Edia heura-heni bona edia heinai-heni bona edia vaḡeḡe vada e ore vaitani; bona dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai lalodiai idia na asi ahudia, ela bona hanaihanai.
ECC.9.6.english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

ECC.9.8.motu: Nega iboudiai dabua kurokurodia ba hahedokilai; dehoro na kwaramu ai baine mia hanaihanai.
ECC.9.8.english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

ECC.3.10.motu: Dirava ese taunimanima natudia vada e henidia bae hekwarahilai ḡaukaradia vada na itadia.
ECC.3.10.english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

ECC.5.1.motu: Dirava ena dubu ai ba raka vareai negadia ai na aemu ba nari; ikamonaina totona ba raka kahira be namo, kavakava taudia edia boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia na e hereaiamu, badina be idia na asi dibadia e kara dikamu.
ECC.5.1.english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

ECC.8.7.motu: Badina be ia na asi dibana dahaka baine vara, bena daika ese baine hamaoroa diba ede baine vara toma?
ECC.8.7.english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

ECC.10.4.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese bema badu henimu, emu gabu basioma rakatania;
ECC.10.4.english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

ECC.1.5.motu: Dina e daemu, ma e dihomu;
ECC.1.5.english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

ECC.4.1.motu: Ma na roha lao, hahehisi karadia iboudiai dina henunai e karamu na itadia. Hahehisi ese e hahisidiamu taudia iruru-matadia na itadia, bona tau ta ese taudia se halodia. Siahu na hahehisi taudia ediai; bona taudia ihalodia tauna ta lasi.
ECC.4.1.english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

ECC.3.1.motu: Ḡau iboudiai na mai edia nega korikori, bona ḡaukara iboudiai guba henunai e karamu be mai negadia:
ECC.3.1.english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

ECC.6.1.motu: Dika ta vada na itaia dina henunai, taunimanima e hametaudiamu ḡauna:
ECC.6.1.english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

ECC.12.8.motu: Haroro Tauna na e tomu: Asi anidia ḡaudia, ḡau iboudiai be asi anidia.

ECC.5.10.motu: Moni e ura heniamu tauna ese moni baine abi, to lalona basine heḡereḡere; bona taḡa e ura heniamu tauna ese ena taḡa baine habadaia, to lalona basine heḡereḡere. Ina danu asi anina.
ECC.5.10.english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

ECC.11.4.motu: Lai e nariamu tauna na uhe basine hado,
ECC.11.4.english: He who observes the wind won’t sow;

ECC.2.20.motu: Taunabunai, lalogu na na haloua bona daragu e doko, egu hekwarahi idoinai ai dina henunai na ḡaukaralaiva ḡaudia daidiai;
ECC.2.20.english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

ECC.6.7.motu: Taunimanima edia hekwarahi idoinai na ududia daidiai; ḡau tamona, bogadia na asie kunumu.
ECC.6.7.english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

ECC.9.14.motu: Hanua maragina ta ena taunimanima na dia hoho; bena hanua pavapavana badana ta ese e tuari henia, e koua heḡeḡe, bona tano e larebaia heḡeḡe ia iabina totona.
ECC.9.14.english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

ECC.1.2.english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

ECC.4.8.motu: tau ta na asi bamona ta, asi natuna, asi tadikakana; ḡau tamona ena hekwarahi na se dokomu, bona ena roharoha ai ena taḡa na nega ta se heḡereḡeremu; bena nega ta se henanadaimu, seto “Daika bagunai na hekwarahimu bona moale ai na dabumu?” Ina danu asi anina, kara asi moalena.
ECC.4.8.english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

ECC.12.13.motu: Ḡaukara dokona binai; hereva iboudiai vada o kamonai. Dirava garina ba gari, bona ena haheḡani ba badinadia; badina be una na taunimanima ena kara korikori idoinai.
ECC.12.13.english: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

ECC.3.15.motu: Harihari e miamu ḡaudia na gunaguna e miava, bona do bae vara ḡaudia danu gunaguna e miava; bona Dirava ese vada e heabi oho ḡaudia na e tahudiamu.
ECC.3.15.english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

ECC.7.8.motu: Kara dokona ese kara matamana e hereaiamu,
ECC.7.8.english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning.

ECC.7.23.motu: Ina idoinai aonega amo vada na tohoa. Lau nato “Baina aonega”; to aonega egu amo na idauhai.
ECC.7.23.english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

ECC.1.11.motu: E vara guna ḡaudia na ta ese se lalodia taomu,
ECC.1.11.english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

ECC.7.9.english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

ECC.2.9.motu: Unu amo na herea dae; Ierusalem ai e gunalaigu taudia iboudiai na na hereadiava, bona egu aonega na egu ai e miava danu.
ECC.2.9.english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

ECC.7.10.motu: Basioto “Dahaka dainai nega gunadia ese ina nega e hereaia?”
ECC.7.10.english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

ECC.2.13.motu: Bena lalogu e parara, aonega ese kavakava e hereaiamu, diari ese dibura e hereaiamu na heto.
ECC.2.13.english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

ECC.2.1.motu: Lalogu ai nato: Be, moale baina dibaia; ba hahemoale. To una danu na asi anina.
ECC.2.1.english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

ECC.9.7.motu: Aola, amu bavania mai moalemu ida, bona emu vine ranuna ba inua mai lalo-namomu ida; badina be Dirava ese emu kara vada e hanamoa guna.
ECC.9.7.english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

ECC.7.5.motu: Aonega tauna ena gwau-gwau e hakala heniamu tauna be namo,
ECC.7.5.english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

ECC.7.14.motu: Emu namo e badamu dinana ai ba moale, bona emu dika e badamu dinana ai ba laloa, Dirava ese unu ruaosi vada e karadia, taunimanima na basie diba dahaka dahaka ia murinai bae vara helaoreana.
ECC.7.14.english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

ECC.7.1.motu: Lada namona ese dehoro namo-hereana e hereaiamu,
ECC.7.1.english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

ECC.7.16.motu: Metaira ba kara maoromaoro, metaira ba aonega; sibomu ba heala anina be dahaka?
ECC.7.16.english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

ECC.10.14.motu: Kavakava tauna ena hereva na momo,

ECC.2.6.motu: Ranu gabudia na ḡei, egu imea audia ihapariparidia.
ECC.2.6.english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

ECC.5.16.motu: Ina danu dika badana ta: ema heḡereḡerena ai ma bainela; ia na lai iabina e hekwarahilaia,
ECC.5.16.english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

ECC.8.12.motu: Ena be kara dika tauna na nega sinahu-ta e kara dikamu bona ena mauri e hadaudauamu, to lau dibagu Dirava garina e garimu taudia na bae namo, badina be ia vairanai e garimu.
ECC.8.12.english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

ECC.12.14.motu: Badina be Dirava ese kara iboudiai bona ḡau hehunidia iboudiai, namodia bona dikadia, na baine hahemaorg henidia.
ECC.12.14.english: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

ECC.9.3.motu: Dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai edia dika ta binai: kara tamona na iboudiai ediai e kaumu. Ina danu, taunimanima lalodia na dika ai e honu honu daemu, edia mauri dinadia ai lalodia na kakavakava, una murinai mase gabuna e laomu.
ECC.9.3.english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

ECC.1.6.motu: Lai ese diho kahana e toa heniamu,
ECC.1.6.english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

ECC.2.3.motu: Tau-anigu ihanamona dalana vine ranuna i'inuna amo na lalogu ai na tahua; ḡau tamona, lalogu ese dounu aonega e badinaiava. Kavakava idogo-taona dalana danu na tahua, baina itaia nato, taunimanima natuna na edia mauri dinadia oreoredia guba henunai ede bae namo toma.
ECC.2.3.english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

ECC.7.11.motu: Kohu iabina mai aonegana ida be namo,
ECC.7.11.english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

ECC.9.17.motu: Aonega tauna ena hereva asi regerege gabuna ai e gwauraimu ese lohia ena haroro kavakava taudia bogaragidiai na e hereaiamu.
ECC.9.17.english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

ECC.6.9.motu: Matada e itamu ḡaudia ese ta lalo haguhilaimu ḡaudia na e hereadiamu; ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
ECC.6.9.english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ECC.5.15.motu: Sinana bogana amo ema heḡereḡerena ai ma bainela, ḡaḡaena ai, ema heḡereḡerena; ena hekwarahi danu asi anina, ḡau ta na imana ai basine laohaia.
ECC.5.15.english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

ECC.7.7.motu: Momokani, hahehisi ese aonega tauna e hakavaiamu.
ECC.7.7.english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

ECC.5.9.motu: A e birulaiamu tanona na pavapava ese baine biagua, una na namo.
ECC.5.9.english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

ECC.6.6.motu: Ena be ena mauri laḡanidia bema daha rua, to ḡau namona ta basinema moalelaia: be, iboudiai na gabu tamona se laomu a?
ECC.6.6.english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

ECC.3.14.motu: Lau dibagu Dirava ena kara Iboudiai na bae mia hanaihanai; ḡau ta ma basie atoa kau eiava basie abia oho; Dirava ese unu vada e karaia toma, taunimanima na ia vairanai bae gari helaoreana.
ECC.3.14.english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

ECC.12.1.motu: Eregabemu dinadia ai ikaramu Diravana na ba laloa tao, hahedika dinadia do asie kau ai, bona ba herevalaidia baoto “Asina moalelaidiamu” laḡanidia do asie kahira-kahira ai;
ECC.12.1.english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth,

ECC.9.1.motu: Ina idoinai na laloa bona na haeroa: kara maoromaoro taudia bona aonega taudia bona edia kara danu na Dirava imana ai; taunimanima na asi dibadia ia ese e ura henidiamu eiava e inai henidiamu. Ḡau iboudiai idia vairadiai na asi anidia;
ECC.9.1.english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

ECC.5.3.motu: Badina be nihi na hekwarahi momo amo e varamu, bona hereva momo na kavakava tauna gadona amo.
ECC.5.3.english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

ECC.7.13.english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

ECC.11.1.motu: Amu aniani na davara kopina ai ba negea,
ECC.11.1.english: Cast your bread on the waters;

ECC.6.8.motu: Aonega tauna ese kavakava tauna ede e hereaia tomamu? Ogoḡami tauna na mauri taudia vairadiai ede baine kara toma bema mai dibana, to ahuna be dahaka namona?
ECC.6.8.english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

ECC.5.13.motu: Dika badana ta guba henunai vada na itaia: taḡa tauna na ena taḡa igogosina ai e dika;
ECC.5.13.english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

ECC.10.15.motu: Kavakava tauna na ena hekwarahi ai e hesikumu;
ECC.10.15.english: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.

ECC.2.12.motu: Bena aonega bona kavakava bona lebulebu ma na haerodia; badina be hanua pavapavana murina amo e maimu tauna na ede baine kara toma? E kara gunava karadia mo, ani.
ECC.2.12.english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

ECC.3.3.motu: ala-ala mai negana, hahemauri mai negana;

ECC.12.12.motu: Natugu e, ini e hereadiamu ḡaudia nahuadia ba toho. Buka momo itoredia na asi dokona, bona ihaerodia ese hesiku e havaraiamu.
ECC.12.12.english: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

ECC.4.3.motu: A herea-daena be do se vara bena kara dikadia dina henunai e karamu na do se ita tauna hari.
ECC.4.3.english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

ECC.4.4.motu: Bena na itaia, hekwarahi idoinai bona ima-idibaka ḡaukaradia iboudiai na tau ta ese dekena tauna e vaḡeḡelai heniamu amo e varamu. Ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
ECC.4.4.english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

ECC.12.4.motu: bona ariara ai ruma iduaradia bae hekou. Una dina ai uit iririna reḡena baine maraḡi, bona ta baine noga haraḡa manu ena tai ai, bona ane-abi hahinedia eredia bae manoka.
ECC.12.4.english: and the doors shall be shut in the street;

ECC.3.19.motu: Badina be taunimanima natudia ediai e varamu bona boroma ediai e varamu dalana be tamona; ta e masemu heḡereḡerena, ma ta danu e masemu. Iboudiai laḡadia na heḡereḡere, taunimanima ese boroma asie hereadiamu; badina be iboudiai na asi anidia.
ECC.3.19.english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

ECC.8.13.motu: A kara dika tauna basine namo; ena mauri basine hadaudaua laulau na heto; badina be ia na Dirava vairanai se garimu.
ECC.8.13.english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

ECC.1.14.motu: Dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai vada na itadia; iboudiai na asi anidia, lai ianina na heto.
ECC.1.14.english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ECC.1.8.motu: Ḡau iboudiai na hekwarahi ai e honumu;
ECC.1.8.english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

ECC.4.2.motu: Bena na laloa, vada e mase guna taudia na nanamo; idia ese doini e maurimu taudia na e hereadiamu.
ECC.4.2.english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

ECC.8.2.motu: Hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani ba badinaia, bona emu gwauhamata helaḡana dainai kudoumu basine hetaha.
ECC.8.2.english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

ECC.2.16.motu: Aonega tauna bona kavakava tauna na raruosi basie lalodia tao daudau; badina be dina gabedia ai iboudiai na bae lalodia boio vaitani. Aonega tauna na e masemu, kavakava tauna heḡereḡerena.
ECC.2.16.english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

ECC.5.17.motu: bona ena dina iboudiai na dibura bona lalo-hisihisi bona lalo-hekwarahi bona gorere bona tudaga lalodiai e ha-oredia, anina be dahaka?
ECC.5.17.english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

ECC.6.11.motu: Hereva bae momo, kavakava danu baine bada; idia ese taunimanima ede bae hanamodia toma?
ECC.6.11.english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

ECC.12.9.motu: Haroro Tauna na mai aonegana, bona ia ese taunimanima e ha-aonegadiava. Hereva lada-isidia e tahudia, bona e haerodia, bona e haboudia ḡoevaḡoeva.
ECC.12.9.english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

ECC.3.18.motu: Lalogu ai ma nato: Dirava ese taunimanima natudia e tohodiamu, baine hahedinarai henidia idia na boroma mo.
ECC.3.18.english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

ECC.4.15.motu: Mauri taudia iboudiai dina henunai e raka eva-evamu na itadia, bona una pavapava burukana baine boloa eregabena danu.
ECC.4.15.english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

ECC.11.10.motu: Lalo-hekwarahi na lalomu amo bavatoa lasi, bona hisihisi na taumu anina amo bavabia oho; badina be tauhau bona eregabe negadia na asi anidia.
ECC.11.10.english: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart,

ECC.4.11.motu: Ina danu, rarua bema hekure hebou, tau-anidia bema siahu; a ta bema hekure edea, tauna ede bema siahu toma?
ECC.4.11.english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

ECC.4.5.motu: Kavakava tauna ese imana e lokumu, bona sibona tau-anina e aniamu.
ECC.4.5.english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

ECC.11.6.motu: Daba ai emu uhe ba hado, bona adorahi ai danu basio hesiku; badina be asi dibamu ina baine namo eiava una baine namo, eiava ruaosi bae namo.
ECC.11.6.english: In the morning sow your seed,

ECC.4.14.english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

ECC.8.14.motu: Kara ta tanobada ai na asi anina: kara namo taudia haida na kara dika taudia ahudia heḡereḡeredia ai e abimu, bona kara dika taudia haida na kara namo taudia ahudia heḡereḡeredia ai e abimu. Lau nato una danu asi anina.
ECC.8.14.english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

ECC.2.21.motu: badina be nega haida tau ta ese mai aonegana bona mai lalo-pararana bona mai idibakana ida e karava ḡaudia iboudiai na baine rakatanidia, bena se hekwarahilaiva tauna ese baine moalelai. Ina danu asi anina, bona dika herea.
ECC.2.21.english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

ECC.12.3.motu: Una dina ai ruma igimana taudia na bae heude-heude, bona goada taudia dorudia bae laoho; uit iriridia bae hadoko badina be, idia na gagadoi mo, bona gaba-mauru amo e igo lasimu hahinedia na matadia bae valahu-valahu,
ECC.12.3.english: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble,

ECC.5.7.motu: Badina be nihi bae momo negadia ai, hereva asi anidia bae vara momo; a oi ese Dirava garina ba gari.
ECC.5.7.english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

ECC.11.8.motu: Badina be tau ta ena mauri dinadia bema hoho, ia ese iboudiai baine moalelaidia; to, baine laloa, dibura dinadia bae hoho. E varamu ḡaudia iboudiai na asi anidia.
ECC.11.8.english: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all;

ECC.8.6.motu: Badina be, ena be taunimanima edia hekwarahi na metau, to ḡaukara iboudiai na mai negadia bona mai daladia.
ECC.8.6.english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

ECC.5.5.motu: Basioma gwau hamata be namo, a ba gwau hamata bena anina basio karaia na dika.
ECC.5.5.english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

ECC.8.9.motu: Ina idoinai na itaia, kara iboudiai dina henunai e karamu na haerodia negana ai. Na itaia danu, taunimanima haida ese bamodia e biagudiamu bona e hahisidiamu.
ECC.8.9.english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

ECC.7.19.motu: Aonega ese aonega tauna e hagoadaiamu; bena ia ese hanua lohiadia gwauta e hereadiamu.
ECC.7.19.english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

ECC.8.17.motu: Bena Dirava ena kara idoinai na itaia, dina henunai e karamu ḡaukaradia anidia na taunimanima ese basine davaridia diba. Ena be itahudia ai baine hekwarahi bada, to basine davaridia; ena be aonega tauna baineto mai dibana, to basine davaridia diba.
ECC.8.17.english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

ECC.2.22.motu: Tau ta ena ḡaukara iboudiai bona ena hekwarahi idoinai dina henunai davadia be dahaka baine abi?
ECC.2.22.english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

ECC.10.3.motu: Kavakava tauna, ena be dala ai e rakamu, to lalona se pararamu;
ECC.10.3.english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

ECC.2.14.motu: Aonega tauna matana na kwarana ai, a kavakava tauna na dibura ai e rakamu; ḡau tamona na diba, iboudiai dokodia be tamona mo.
ECC.2.14.english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

ECC.9.15.motu: A una hanua lalonai na ogoḡami tauna ta mai aonegana; bona ia ese ena aonega amo una hanua e hamauria. A asi tauna ta ese una ogoḡami tauna e laloa tao.
ECC.9.15.english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

ECC.7.12.motu: badina be aonega ena hegima na moni ena hegima na heto,
ECC.7.12.english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

ECC.3.9.english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

ECC.1.17.motu: Bena lalogu na hadaia, aonega baina dibaia, bona kavakava bona lebulebu baina dibadia. Bena lalogu vada e parara, ina danu lai ianina mo.
ECC.1.17.english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

ECC.4.12.motu: Tau ta ese tau tamona baine hadarerea diba reana, a tatau rarua ese bae laoa ahu diba. Varo ere toi na basie motu haraḡa.
ECC.4.12.english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

ECC.6.5.motu: oibe, dina na se itaia, bona ḡau ta asi dibana, ḡau tamona ia na laḡa-ani e davariamu; a una tau be lasi.
ECC.6.5.english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

ECC.7.6.english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

ECC.10.18.motu: Lahedo dainai ruma guhina e kohumu,
ECC.10.18.english: By slothfulness the roof sinks in;

ECC.8.11.motu: Kara dika davadia na asie heni haraḡamu dainai, taunimanima natudia lalodia ese kara dika e ura heni badamu.
ECC.8.11.english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

ECC.10.20.motu: Lalomu ai hanua pavapavana basio uduguiraia,
ECC.10.20.english: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts;

ECC.7.24.motu: E miamu ḡauna na idauhai; ia na dobu, dobu masemase. Daika ese baine davaria diba?
ECC.7.24.english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

ECC.5.11.motu: Kohu bae momo, to iha oredia taudia danu bae hoho; bena kohu biaguna ese anidia basine abi, a matana amo baine itadia mo, ani?
ECC.5.11.english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

ECC.5.6.motu: Udumu ba naria, kara dika ai basine hakaumu vareai; bona gwaukau tauna vairanai basioto “Na kerere”. Namona be dahaka Dirava ese eremu baine badulaia, bona imamu ḡaukaradia baine habuadia tari?
ECC.5.6.english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

ECC.8.15.motu: Moale na hanamoamu, badina be taunimanima na asi ena ḡau namona ta dina henunai; a baine aniani, baine inuinu bona baine moale; badina be unu ese ena hekwarahi ai bae bamoa, ena mauri dinadia Dirava ese dina henunai baine henia lalodiai.
ECC.8.15.english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

ECC.10.17.motu: Tano e, pavapavamu bema ura-kwalimu taudia natudia,
ECC.10.17.english: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles,

ECC.2.8.motu: Silver bona gold na haboudia egu; bona pavapava idau-idau edia kohu bona tano idau-idau kohudia danu. Ane-abi taudia bona hahinedia danu na abidia; bona hahine momo na adavadia, taunimanima edia moale dalana bunai.
ECC.2.8.english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

ECC.12.10.motu: Haroro Tauna na hereva mai mamidia e tahudia, bona hereva momokanidia e tore maoromaoro.
ECC.12.10.english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

ECC.11.5.motu: Lai ede e toa tomamu na asi dibamu; mero matamatana turiana na sinana bogana ai ede e vara tomamu danu asi dibamu; benaini, ḡau iboudiai ikaradia Diravana ena ḡaukara danu asi dibamu.
ECC.11.5.english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind,

ECC.7.4.motu: Aonega taudia lalodia na taitai rumana ai,
ECC.7.4.english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

ECC.6.2.motu: tau ta be Dirava ese taḡa bona kohu bona dagi e heniamu, bena ena ura ḡauna ta ai se dabumu; ḡau tamona, Dirava ese imoalelaina siahuna se heniamu, a idau tauna ta ese e moalelaidiamu. Ina na asi anina, hahehisi badana.
ECC.6.2.english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

ECC.8.5.motu: Haheḡani e badinaiamu tauna na basine dika; bona aonega tauna lalona baine parara, nega bona dala be ededia.
ECC.8.5.english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

ECC.10.11.motu: Mea tauna ese gaigai do se hamanadaia negana ai ia na bema hekori,
ECC.10.11.english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

ECC.7.17.motu: Metaira ba kara dika, bona basio kavakava; emu nega do basine ore ai vada ba mase anina be dahaka?
ECC.7.17.english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

ECC.2.5.motu: Uma bona imea na kara, bona huahua audia idau-idau na idia lalodiai na hado.
ECC.2.5.english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

ECC.11.7.motu: Diari be namo, bona matada ese dina e itaiamu na mai moalena.

ECC.3.12.motu: Lau dibagu taunimanima edia dala namona tamona binai: bae moale, edia mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai bae hahemoale.
ECC.3.12.english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

ECC.7.18.motu: Ina na ba kahua tao bona una na basio kahua nege be namo; badina be Dirava garina e garimu tauna na idia iboudiai bogaragidia amo baine raka lasi.
ECC.7.18.english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

ECC.8.8.motu: Asi tauna ta mai siahuna ia laumana baine dogoa tao eiava mai siahuna ena mase dinana enai. Tuari ai tau ta basine raka siri diba; bona dika ese kara dika tauna basine hamauria.
ECC.8.8.english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

ECC.3.22.motu: Taunabunai vada na diba, taunimanima ena dala namo-hereana binai, ena ḡaukara baine moalelaia, badina be ia ahuna bunai. Ia murinai bae vara ḡaudia na daika ese baine haheitalaia.
ECC.3.22.english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

ECC.12.2.motu: dina bona diari bona hua bona hisiu do asie dibura bona medu murinai dagadaga do asie hahebou lou negana ai.
ECC.12.2.english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened,

ECC.11.9.motu: Eregabe taumu e, eregabemu ai ba moale, eregabemu dinadia ai lalomu ese baine hamoalemu; lalomu ena ura bona matamu ena ita-ita daladia ai ba raka. A ba diba, ini ḡau iboudiai daidiai Dirava ese baine hahemaoro henimu.
ECC.11.9.english: Rejoice, young man, in your youth,

ECC.7.22.motu: Lalomu ai vada o diba, nega momo oi ese haida na vada o uduguiraidia.
ECC.7.22.english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

ECC.9.10.motu: Oi imamu ese baine davaria ḡaukarana na ba karaia mai goada-badamu ida; badirla be o lao heniamu gabuna, mase taudia edia gabu, lalonai na asi ḡaukara ta, asi lalo-hadai ta, asi lalo-parara ta, bona asi aonega ta.
ECC.9.10.english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ECC.9.13.motu: Ina aonega toana na dina henunai vada na itaia danu; bona na laloa, ia na ḡau badana.
ECC.9.13.english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

ECC.5.19.motu: Dirava ese taḡa bona kohu vada e henidia taudia iboudiai na siahu danu vada e henidia, bae moalelaidia, bona ahudia bae abi dae, bona edia hekwarahi ai bae moale; una na Dirava ena harihari ḡauna.
ECC.5.19.english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

ECC.5.2.motu: Udumu basine hereva haraga-haraga, bona lalomu na hereva ta igwauraina ai basine haraḡa Dirava vairanai; badina be Dirava na guba ai a oi na tanobada ai, una dainai emu hereva na bae gadoi.
ECC.5.2.english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

ECC.5.8.motu: Basileia ta ai ogoḡami taudia e hahisidiamu bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona ahu korikori e dadihaidiamu boma itaia negana ai basioma hoalaia; badina be herea tauna na herea-dae tauna henunai, bona idia raruosi daediai na herea mikamika taudia haida.
ECC.5.8.english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

ECC.1.12.motu: Lau, Haroro Tauna, ese Israel taudia na biagudia Ierusalem ai.
ECC.1.12.english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

ECC.10.9.motu: Nadi e taradiamu tauna na nadi ese bae haberoa;
ECC.10.9.english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

ECC.4.16.motu: Unu taunimanima iboudiai na asi iduahidia; ia ese iboudiai e biagudiava. Ḡau tamona, gabeai baema taudia ese basie moalelaia. Momokani, ina danu asi anina, bona lai ianina.
ECC.4.16.english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ECC.7.2.english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

ECC.10.13.motu: Ia uduna herevadia matamadia na kavakava,
ECC.10.13.english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

ECC.8.3.motu: Ia vairana amo ba raka oho; ena be ḡaukara mamina na dika to basio halahe, badina be ia ese ena ura iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai e karamu.
ECC.8.3.english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

ECC.2.4.motu: Ḡaukara badadia na kara: ruma na hadai, bona vine imeadia na hado egu.
ECC.2.4.english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

ECC.3.11.motu: Ia ese ḡau iboudiai vada e hahairaidia, ta ta ena nega ena nega ai; a taunimanima lalodia vada e haduhudia, idia ese Dirava ena ḡaukara, matamana ela bona dokona, basie davaria diba.
ECC.3.11.english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

ECC.2.25.motu: badina be bema ia dauhai, daika bema aniani eiava bema moale?
ECC.2.25.english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

ECC.3.6.motu: itahuna mai negana, ihaboiona mai negana;

ECC.9.5.motu: Badina be mauri taudia na dibadia do bae mase; a mase taudia na ḡau ta asi dibadia, bona asi ahudia, a ilalo-taodia na e boiomu.
ECC.9.5.english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

ECC.3.2.motu: vara mai negana, mase mai negana;

ECC.2.10.motu: Matagu edia ura ta ediai asina rua, bona lalogu ena moale dalana ta enai asina laoa ahu; badina be lalogu ese egu hekwarahi idoinai e moalelaiava, egu hekwarahi idoinai ahuna bunai.
ECC.2.10.english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

ECC.4.13.english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

ECC.5.18.motu: Vada na itaia, ina na namo bona heḡereḡere: taunimanima na btine aniani, bona baine inuinu, bona ena hekwarahi idoinai Dirava ese ena mauri dinadia oreoredia dina henunai vada e henia lalodiai baine moalelaia; badina be ia ahuna korikori bunai.
ECC.5.18.english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

ECC.7.26.motu: Bena ḡau idita-hereana ta na davaria, mase iditana e hereaiamu ḡauna; una ḡau be lalona na idoa bona huo bona imana na gadea hahinena. Dirava e hamoaleamu tauna na iena amo e roho maurimu; a kara dika tauna na ia ese e abiamu.
ECC.7.26.english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

ECC.8.1.english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

ECC.7.29.motu: A itaia, ina mo vada na davaria: Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia mai edia maoromaoro, a idia ese dala idau-idau vada e tahudia.
ECC.7.29.english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

EPH.3.18.motu: bena helaḡa taudia iboudiai ida Keriso ena lalokau lababana bona rohana bona harana-latana bona dobuna
EPH.3.18.english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

EPH.2.6.motu: Ia ida vada e hatoreda isi, ia ida danu guba ai vada e hahelaida, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
EPH.2.6.english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

EPH.4.28.motu: Henao tauna na basine henao lou; ḡaukara namona ta imana amo baine karaia, bena e dabumu tauna na baine durua diba.
EPH.4.28.english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

EPH.5.13.motu: A e hahedinaraidia ḡaudia iboudiai na diari ese e hahedinaraimu; badina be e hahedinaraimu ḡaudia iboudiai na didiari.
EPH.5.13.english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

EPH.6.6.motu: Isiaidia ba lao heni, dia vairadiai mo, taunimanima ihamoaledia e uramu taudia na heheto, a Keriso ena hesiai taudia ese Dirava ena ura e karamu mai lalodia ida na heto.
EPH.6.6.english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

EPH.5.26.motu: ena hereva amo ranu ai e huria, baine hahelaḡaia,
EPH.5.26.english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

EPH.5.24.motu: A ekalesia ese Keriso e kamonai heniamu heḡereḡerena, hahine ese ḡau iboudiai lalodiai adavadia unu bae kamonai henidia toma.
EPH.5.24.english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

EPH.5.25.motu: Tatau e, adavamui ba lalokau henidia, Keriso ese ekalesia e lalokau henia na heto. Ia dainai sibona e heni,
EPH.5.25.english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

EPH.6.24.english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

EPH.6.10.motu: Hereva dokona binai: Lohiabada siahuna ai ba siahu, bona goadana ai ba goada.
EPH.6.10.english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

EPH.2.20.motu: Aposetolo taudia bona peroveta taudia latadiai vada e hadaimui, ruma na heto; ruma daigunina nadina na Iesu Keriso sibona.
EPH.2.20.english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

EPH.4.1.motu: Badina bunai lau, Lohiabada ese e ḡuigu taugu, na hahealo henimuimu: ba raka, e boirimui rakana heḡereḡerena.
EPH.4.1.english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

EPH.5.32.motu: Ina hereva hehunina anina na bada; to lau ese Keriso bona ekalesia na gwauraidiamu.
EPH.5.32.english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

EPH.5.31.motu: “Badina binai tau ese tamana sinana baine rakatanidia, adavana mo enai baine tao, bena raruosi vada tau-anina tamona na heto.”
EPH.5.31.english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.” + 5:31 Genesis 2:24

EPH.6.3.motu: “bena ba namo, ba mauri daudau tanobada ai.”
EPH.6.3.english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.” + 6:3 Deuteronomy 5:16

EPH.5.33.motu: Benaini, umui tatau ta ta adavamui ba lalokau henidia, sibomui o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena. Hahine danu adavana baine matauraia.
EPH.5.33.english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

EPH.3.9.motu: bona ḡau iboudiai ikaradia Diravana ese sene negadia ema harihari vada e hunia herevana anina baina hahedinaraia taunimanima iboudiai ediai.
EPH.3.9.english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

EPH.1.13.motu: Ia lalonai danu umui ese hereva momokanina, emui hahemauri sivaraina namona, o abia dae. Umui ese danu Keriso o abidadama henia bona Dirava ese ia toana e tlenimui, Lauma Helaḡa, e gwaurai hamata Laumana, bunai.
EPH.1.13.english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

EPH.4.9.motu: Ina hereva “la e dae” anina be dahaka? Anina binai: e diho guna ela bona tanobada henuna kahana, ani?
EPH.4.9.english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

EPH.4.14.motu: Bena memero karukarudia heḡereḡeredia basita noho; hahediba herevadia lai na heto basie hureda dae hureda diho; taunimanima edia kara gagevagagevadia bona koikoidia basiehakauda kerere.
EPH.4.14.english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

EPH.5.14.motu: Badina bunai hereva na e tomu,
EPH.5.14.english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

EPH.4.16.motu: Ia enai garugaru iboudiai e ḡaukara heboumu, bena tau-anina idoinai vada e hesiriu kaumu bona e hekamo boumu, bona rege ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara e karamu; unu amo tau-anina e bada oho bada ohomu, bona lalokau ai e tubumu.
EPH.4.16.english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

EPH.3.12.motu: Ia lalonai ita na mai boga-aukada bona mai goadada baita raka henia kahi, ta abidadama heniamu dainai.
EPH.3.12.english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

EPH.2.18.motu: Ia dainai umui bona ai na Tamada dekenai baita raka vareai diba, Lauma tamona lalonai.
EPH.2.18.english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

EPH.4.26.motu: Ba badu, to basio kara dika; dina do basine diho ai emu badu baine doko.
EPH.4.26.english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” + 4:26 Psalms 4:4 Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

EPH.6.13.motu: Una dainai Dirava ena tuari dabuadia iboudiai ba hahedokilai, bena dika dinana ai ba laodia ahu diba; ḡau iboudiai ba kara ḡuḡuru, bena ba gini.
EPH.6.13.english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

EPH.3.17.motu: bona emui abidadama dainai Keriso na umui lalomui ai baine noho. Bena lalokau ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka bona ba badinaia tarika-tarika dainai, ba goada momokani;
EPH.3.17.english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

EPH.2.12.motu: Una negana ai umui bona Keriso na mai padamui; umui bona Israel besena danu mai padamui; herohemaino gwauhamatadia na asi dibamui; asi emui helaro bona asi emui Dirava tanobada ai.
EPH.2.12.english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

EPH.1.7.motu: Ia lalonai hahemauri vada ta abiamu, ia rarana dainai, bona eda dika vada eme hegwau tao. Ina na ena harihari-bada ḡoeva-daena
EPH.1.7.english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

EPH.2.11.motu: Taunabunai, ba helalo: umui na gunaguna idau bese taumui; peritome taudia na tau-anidia vada e ivadia dainai “asi peritome taumui” e gwauraimuiva.
EPH.2.11.english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

EPH.3.14.motu: Una dainai lau na Tamada vairanai na hetuituimu.
EPH.3.14.english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

EPH.3.19.motu: vadaba diba, bona basita diba ḡuḡuru lalokauna, Keriso ena, danu. Unu amo Dirava ena honuhonu-dae ese baine hahonumui.
EPH.3.19.english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

EPH.4.10.motu: E diho tauna danu e dae, guba doriva-dorivana ela, ḡau iboudiai baine hahonu helaoreana.
EPH.4.10.english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

EPH.1.23.motu: Ekalesia na Keriso tau-anina; ḡau iboudiai e haḡuḡurumu Tauna ihaḡuḡuruna.
EPH.1.23.english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

EPH.2.3.motu: Ai iboumai ai danu, gunaguna idia ida a nohova, tau-anina ena ura a karava; tau-animai edia ura bona lalomai edia ura a badinava, bena ahumai korikorina na badu, taunimanima oredia heḡereḡeredia.
EPH.2.3.english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

EPH.5.18.motu: Vine ranuna basio inua momo, kekero garina; a Lauma ese baine hahonumui.
EPH.5.18.english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

EPH.6.18.motu: Ḡuriḡuri bona noinoi iboudiai Lauma lalonai ba gwaurai, nega idoinai. Ba gima malaka-malaka; helaḡa taudia daidiai ba noinoi,
EPH.6.18.english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

EPH.6.7.motu: Emui hesiai ilao-henina ba karaia mai lalo-manaumui ida, Lohiabada enai boma karaia na heto.
EPH.6.7.english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

EPH.2.2.motu: gunaguna ina tanobada ena kara o karava, guba padana siahuna lohiana o badinaiava, laumana bunai gwau-edeede memerodia lalodia ai e ḡaukaramu.
EPH.2.2.english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

EPH.3.11.motu: nega hanaihanai e lalo-hadailaia heḡereḡerena ai, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada lalonai e hamomokania.
EPH.3.11.english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

EPH.1.11.motu: Badina be Dirava ese ḡau iboudiai na ena lalohadai heḡereḡerena e karamu. Bona matamana negana ai Dirava ese e gwauraimai hidi, ena ura ihaḡuḡuruna.
EPH.1.11.english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

EPH.3.8.motu: Helaḡa taudia iboudiai lau mo sibogu maraḡi-maraḡi herea; to ia esevada e harihari henigu, bese idau-idau vairadiai Keriso ena taḡa, iduahina ta asi dibana taḡana, baina harorolaia,
EPH.3.8.english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

EPH.5.11.motu: Dibura karadia asi huahuadia na basio hetura henidia, a ba hahedinaraidia;
EPH.5.11.english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

EPH.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, helaḡa taumui Efeso ai, Keriso Iesu o abidadama heniamu taumui, na tore henimuimu:
EPH.1.1.english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

EPH.1.3.motu: Dirava, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, aita hanamoa: ia ese Keriso lalonai Lauma ena hahenamo iboudiai guba ai e miamu ḡaudia na vada e hanamolaida.
EPH.1.3.english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

EPH.3.4.motu: Iduahina ai do ba diba, lau na Keriso sivaraina hehunina na mai dibagu.
EPH.3.4.english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

EPH.4.27.motu: Lalomui iduaradia basio keho diabolo ena.
EPH.4.27.english: and don’t give place to the devil.

EPH.4.8.motu: Una dainai ini e torea toma:

EPH.1.14.motu: Toana bunai, ita ese ahuda baita abia Dirava ena gwauhamata hegereḡerena, bona ia ese ena taunimanima baine hamauridia. Ia hairaina baita heatolaia hebou.
EPH.1.14.english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

EPH.5.19.motu: Ba hereva heheni, salamo ai bona ane ai bona lauma anedia ai. Ane bavabi, bona Lohiabada ba hanamoa lalomui ai.
EPH.5.19.english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

EPH.3.3.motu: hereva hehunina, vada na torea kwadoḡi ḡauna, ia ese e hahedinarai henigu.
EPH.3.3.english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

EPH.2.9.motu: bona dia ḡaukara daidiai, tau ta baine heaḡi na garina.
EPH.2.9.english: not of works, that no one would boast.

EPH.5.8.motu: Badina be gunaguna umui na didibura, a harihari umui vada ome diari, Lohiabada lalonai: ba raka, diari memerodia heḡereḡeredia.
EPH.5.8.english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

EPH.5.6.motu: Tau ta ese hereva kavakavadia basine koilaimui; badina be unu ḡau daidiai Dirava ena badu na gwau-edeede taudia latadiai e kaumu.
EPH.5.6.english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

EPH.5.21.motu: Ba hemataurai heheni, Keriso o matauraiamu heḡereḡerena.
EPH.5.21.english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

EPH.2.8.motu: Badina be harihari-bada ese vada e hamaurimui, abidadama dainai; dia sibomui ese, a Dirava ena harihari-bada ese;
EPH.2.8.english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

EPH.4.29.motu: Hereva mirodia udumui amo basie lasi; hereva namodia ba gwaurai, taunimanima lalodia ba hapararalai, bena bae kamonai taudia ese harihari-bada bae abia.
EPH.4.29.english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

EPH.6.23.english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EPH.6.4.motu: Tama e, natumui basio habadudia, a Lohiabada ena hahediba herevadia bona ena sisiba herevadia ba ubulaidia.
EPH.6.4.english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

EPH.5.9.motu: Badina be diari huahuadia na lalohadai namodia ai bona kara maoromaorodia ai bona hereva momokanidia ai e hedinaraimu.
EPH.5.9.english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

EPH.2.4.motu: A hebogahisi-bada Diravana ese, e ura henimai lalo-dika dainai,
EPH.2.4.english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

EPH.4.11.motu: Ena herahia be haida e heni, aposetolo taudia ai baela; ma haida e heni, peroveta taudia ai baela; ma haida sivarai namo iharorolaina; ma haida hereḡu taudia bona hahediba taudia ai baela.
EPH.4.11.english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

EPH.5.28.motu: Unuhetomana tatau ese adavadia bae lalokau henidia, sibodia tau-anidia e lalokau henimu heḡereḡerena. Adavana e lalokau heniamu tauna ese sibona e helalokaumu.
EPH.5.28.english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

EPH.4.6.motu: Dirava danu tamona, ia na taunimanima iboudiai Tamadia; ia ese iboudiai e hereadiamu, iboudiai e rohediamu, iboudiai lalodiai e nohomu.
EPH.4.6.english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

EPH.2.1.motu: Umui ese kara havara bona kara dika lalodiai o maseva;
EPH.2.1.english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

EPH.3.1.motu: Badina bunai lau Paulo na Keriso Iesu ese e ḡuigu, idau bese taumui daimui ai.
EPH.3.1.english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

EPH.5.1.motu: Taunabunai, umui, Dirava natuna, ena lalokau, Dirava ba haḡoia.
EPH.5.1.english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

EPH.4.30.motu: Dirava ena Lauma Helaḡa basio turia riki henia; ia ese vada e abumui hidi, ia toana emui ai baine mia ela bona hahemauri dinana.
EPH.4.30.english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

EPH.1.22.motu: Dirava ese ḡau iboudiai ia aena palapaladia henudiai e ato, bona ḡau iboudiai ikwaradia ai vada e halaoa, ekalesia lalonai.
EPH.1.22.english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

EPH.3.10.motu: Harihari, ekalesia ena amo, lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia, guba ai e nohomu, ese Dirava ena aonega idau-idau bae diba,
EPH.3.10.english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

EPH.2.16.motu: bona ena satauro dainai ruaosi Dirava enai baine hatamonada, helaoreana. Eda heinai-heheni ia ese satauro dorina ai e ha-orea.
EPH.2.16.english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

EPH.4.24.motu: tau matamatana ba hahedokilaia, Dirava heida-idana, kara maoromaoro ai bona hereva momokani helaḡana ai vada e karaia.
EPH.4.24.english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

EPH.6.2.motu: “Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia,” (ina na haheḡani mai gwauhamatana gini-gunana),
EPH.6.2.english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

EPH.5.27.motu: ma baine abia iena; ekalesia mai hairaina, asi toutouna, asi makukuna, asi berona; baine helaḡa asi bebeka-bebekana helaoreana.
EPH.5.27.english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

EPH.2.7.motu: Vairada negadia ai danu ena harihari-bada bona ena gado namo ita edai baine hedinarai, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
EPH.2.7.english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

EPH.3.21.motu: ia hairaina be ekalesia lalonai bona Keriso Iesu lalonai baine mia, ela bona uru iboudiai ela hanaihanai. Amen.
EPH.3.21.english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

EPH.1.5.motu: ia ese lalona e hadaia guna, ia natuna ai baine halaoda Iesu Keriso dainai. Ina na ena ura namona heḡereḡerena.
EPH.1.5.english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

EPH.4.13.motu: ela bona ita iboudai eda abidadama baine tamona bona eda diba danu baine tamona, Dirava Natuna; ela bona tauda bae lo, Keriso tauna e lo hahetohona heḡereḡerena.
EPH.4.13.english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

EPH.4.32.motu: Ba hekaha heheni; ba hebogahisi heheni; emui dika ba hegwau tao heheni, Dirava ese Keriso lalonai emui dika vada e gwau tao na heto.
EPH.4.32.english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

EPH.4.15.motu: A hereva momokani na lalokau ai baita gwaurai; bena unu kara ai baita bada oho bada oho, ela bona Keriso enai baita kau; ia na eda orea ikwarana.
EPH.4.15.english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

EPH.2.21.motu: Ia latanai ruma idoinai e larebaia daemu, dubu helaḡana ai bainela, Lohiabada lalonai.
EPH.2.21.english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

EPH.1.17.motu: eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena Dirava, Tamada herea-daena, ese aonega bona lalo-parara laumana baine henimui, bena ienai ba manada.
EPH.1.17.english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

EPH.1.8.english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

EPH.1.15.motu: Badina bunai, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso o abidadama heniamu bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai o lalokau henidiamu sivaraina na kamonai dainai,
EPH.1.15.english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

EPH.6.11.motu: Dirava ena tuari dabuadia iboudiai ba hahedokilai; bena ba goada, diabolo ena kara dibaka ba laoa ahu.
EPH.6.11.english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

EPH.5.17.motu: Benaini, basio kavakava; Lohiabada ena ura ba diba ḡoeva.
EPH.5.17.english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

EPH.4.12.motu: Ini e kara toma, ia ese Dirava ena helaḡa taudia iboudiai baine reḡudia, bena idia ese Keriso isiaina bae lao heni, bena Keriso tau-anina bae larebaia dae;
EPH.4.12.english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

EPH.6.21.english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

EPH.3.6.motu: Herevana binai: idau bese taudia bona Iuda taudia na ahudia be tamona, bona tau-anidia be tamona; gwauhamata tamona danu e abia heboumu Iesu Keriso lalonai, sivarai namo dainai.
EPH.3.6.english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

EPH.2.15.motu: Ia tau-anina ai ia ese taravatu ena hahedua iboudiai vada e ha-ore, beseda ruaosi amo matamatana ta baine havaraia, bona maillo baine haginia,
EPH.2.15.english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

EPH.5.23.motu: Badina be tau na adavana kwarana, Keriso na ekalesia kwarana na heto; ekalesia na ia tau-anina, ia danu ekalesia ihamaurina.
EPH.5.23.english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

EPH.5.30.motu: Badina be ita na ia tau-anina regena.
EPH.5.30.english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

EPH.4.19.motu: Mami namodia asie abimu; a lebulebu daladia ai e rakamu, bona mata-dika karadia e ura heni lalodikamu.
EPH.4.19.english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

EPH.1.9.motu: Badina be ena aonega ai bona ena lalo-parara ai, Dirava ese ena lalohadai hehunidia vada e hadibada, ena ura namona Keriso lalonai e rataia heḡereḡerena,
EPH.1.9.english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

EPH.2.13.motu: A gunaguna dauhai o nohova taumui na harihari Keriso Iesu lalonai vada o kahikahimu; Keriso rarana ese vada e harakamui kahi.
EPH.2.13.english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

EPH.2.14.motu: Badina be ia na eda maino; ia ese bese ruaosi vada e hatamonada; e hapararada maḡuna vada e raḡaia.
EPH.2.14.english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

EPH.6.19.motu: lau daigu ai danu ba noinoi, baina haroro negadia ai sivarai namo ena hereva hehunidia baina hahedinarai ḡoevaḡoeva.
EPH.6.19.english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

EPH.5.10.motu: Lohiabada ihamoalena karana na ba tahua.
EPH.5.10.english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

EPH.5.5.motu: Dibamui, auli, heuda-hanai tauna bona mata-dika tauna bona mata-ḡaniḡani tauna na asi ahudia, Keriso bona Dirava edia basileia lalonai; idia be kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia na heheto.
EPH.5.5.english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

EPH.6.15.motu: aemui palapaladia sivarai namo mainona iseuna ba kumilai.
EPH.6.15.english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

EPH.3.20.motu: Ita laloda ai mai siahuna ida e ḡaukaramu Diravana do baine ḡaukara, ela bona eda noinoi bona eda lalo-hadai idoidiai baine hereadia;
EPH.3.20.english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

EPH.6.5.motu: Hesiai memeromui e, biagumui tanobada ai ba kamonai henidia mai heude-heudemui ida bona mai lalomui tamona ida, Keriso boma kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
EPH.6.5.english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

EPH.1.16.motu: egu Dirava ihanamona na asi dokona daimui ai. Bona daimui ai na ḡuriḡurimu,
EPH.1.16.english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

EPH.1.6.motu: Ena harihari-bada ḡoeva-daena, ina na ena lalokau tauna ai vada e hataḡalaida hariharina, dainai baita imodaia.
EPH.1.6.english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

EPH.2.22.motu: Ia latanai danu umui e larebamui heboumu, Dirava ena ruma ai baola, Lauma lalonai.
EPH.2.22.english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

EPH.3.2.motu: Reana vada o kamonai, ena harihari-bada dainai Dirava ese ḡaukara e henigu, umui daimui ai;
EPH.3.2.english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

EPH.5.12.motu: badina be edia kara hehunidia igwaurai-hedinaraidia na mai hemaraina.
EPH.5.12.english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

EPH.6.9.motu: Biagu e, kara heḡereḡeredia ba kara henidia; ihagarilaidia herevadia na ba hadoko. Umui dibamui umui bona idia Biagumui be tamona guba ai; ia ese taunimanima toadia se lalomu.
EPH.6.9.english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

EPH.5.2.motu: Lalokau ai ba raka, Keriso ese e lalokau henida heḡereḡerena; ia sibona e heni, ita daidai, herahia ḡauna bona boubou ḡauna mai bonana namona, Dirava ena.
