EPH.5.2.english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

EPH.4.3.motu: Lauma ena lalo-tamona ba kahua tao, maino ena iḡui ai.
EPH.4.3.english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

EPH.4.4.motu: Tau-anina be tamona; Lauma danu tamona; e boirimui negadia ai boiboi helarona na tamona;
EPH.4.4.english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

EPH.5.20.motu: Nega idoinai Tamada Dirava ba hanamoa, ḡau iboudiai daidiai, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai.
EPH.5.20.english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

EPH.5.3.motu: Heuda-hanai bona mata-dika bona mata-ḡaniḡani na bogaragimui ai basio herevalai; helaḡa taudia edia dala bunai.
EPH.5.3.english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

EPH.1.2.motu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi.
EPH.1.2.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EPH.3.16.motu: Na noiamu, ia hairaina taḡadia amo ia Laumana ese siahu baine henimui, bena lalomui idoidiai do bae goada,
EPH.3.16.english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

EPH.1.21.motu: Keriso na ḡaubada iboudiai daediai, gavana iboudiai daediai, siahu taudia iboudiai daediai, lohia iboudiai daediai; ia ladaula danu lada iboudiai, ina mauri ai bona mauri gabena ai, e hereadiamu.
EPH.1.21.english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

EPH.3.5.motu: Uru gunadia ediai se hedinarai; a harihari ena aposetolo taudia helaḡadia bona peroveta taudia na Lauma ese vada e hahedinarai henidia.
EPH.3.5.english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

EPH.2.5.motu: kara havara ai a mase taumai na Keriso ida e hamaurimai. Umui danu harihari-bada ese e hamaurimuimu.
EPH.2.5.english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

EPH.2.17.motu: Benaini, ia ema, maino e harorolaia, umui dauhai o nohomu taumui emui, bona gabu kahikahidia ai e nohomu taudia edia.
EPH.2.17.english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

EPH.1.12.motu: Taunabunai ai Keriso a laroa gunava taumai ese ia hairaina baia heatolaia.
EPH.1.12.english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

EPH.4.20.motu: A Keriso enai vada o diba dalana na dia unuheto.
EPH.4.20.english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

EPH.6.20.motu: Badina bunai lau na hesiai taugu mai iḡuigu ida na nohomu. Lau daigu ai ba noinoi, baina hereva goadagoada, vada e haduagu heḡereḡerena.
EPH.6.20.english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

EPH.4.5.motu: Lohiabada na tamona; abidadama na tamona; bapatiso na tamona.
EPH.4.5.english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

EPH.6.12.motu: Badina be ita eda tuari na dia taunimanima ida, a ḡaubada hereadia bona siahu taudia bona tanobada diburana lohiadia bona lauma dikadia guba gabudia ai ida ta tuarimu.
EPH.6.12.english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

EPH.4.23.english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

EPH.3.15.motu: Bese iboudiai guba ai bona tanobada ai be ia nemaina.
EPH.3.15.english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

EPH.6.8.motu: Umui dibamui ita ta ta baita kara namo negadia ai na davada baita abi, Lohiabada ena amo; iḡui tauna eiava ura-kwalimu tauna, dava tamona.
EPH.6.8.english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

EPH.4.22.motu: Bena tau gunana mai ena kara ida ba doki oho; ia na dika, badina be koikoi e ura heniamu.
EPH.4.22.english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

EPH.4.7.motu: Ita ta ta harihari-bada vada eme henida, Keriso ese ena herahia e hahetohoamu hegereḡerena.
EPH.4.7.english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

EPH.4.31.motu: Heiri-heiri, daḡedaḡe, badu, heloḡo-heloḡo, hereva mirodia, hahebade, iboudiai ba nege daure.
EPH.4.31.english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

EPH.5.15.motu: Taunabunai, emui raka nahuana ba tohoa; aonega taudia heḡereḡeredia ai ba raka, dia kavakava taudia na heheto.
EPH.5.15.english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

EPH.1.18.motu: Lalomui matadia danu baine hapapa, bena ena boiboi helarona bona ahuna herea-daena, davana bada ḡauna helaḡa taudia edia, vada ba diba.
EPH.1.18.english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

EPH.4.25.motu: Taunabunai, hereva koikoidia ba nege daure, dekemui taudia ida hereva momokani mo ba gwaurai; badina be ita bona idia na tau-anina tamona regedia.
EPH.4.25.english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

EPH.6.1.motu: Memero kekeni e, tamamui sinamui ba kamonai henidia, Lohiabada lalonai, badina be ena na maoro.
EPH.6.1.english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

EPH.2.10.motu: Badina be ita na ia imana ai e karada tauda, Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e havarada, ḡaukara namodia ikaradia totona: ḡaukara namodia bunu Dirava ese vada e heḡaeḡaelai, ita ese baita kara.
EPH.2.10.english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

EPH.5.16.motu: E henimui negana ba ḡaukaralaia namonamo, badina be ina na nega dikana.
EPH.5.16.english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

EPH.2.19.motu: Taunabunai, umui na harihari dia idau bese taumui, dia noho-hedoahedoa taumui; umui na helaḡa taudia ida hanua tamona taumui; umui na Dirava ena ruma taumui.
EPH.2.19.english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

EPH.1.19.motu: Iena siahu badana bona ena goada hereadaena ita kamonai tauda edai danu ba diba.
EPH.1.19.english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

EPH.4.2.motu: Lalomui bae manau, bae manada, bae haheauka. Lalokau ai ba haheauka heheni.
EPH.4.2.english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

EPH.1.20.motu: Siahuna bunai Keriso enai e hedinarai: ia ese mase amo e hatorea isi, guba ai vada e abia dae, ia idibana kahana ai e hahelaia.
EPH.1.20.english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

EPH.5.29.motu: Badina be tau ta ese sibona tau-anina se inai heniamu, to e ubuamu bona e dosiamu, Keriso ese ekalesia e ubuamu bona e dosiamu heḡereḡerena.
EPH.5.29.english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

EPH.4.21.motu: Ia gadona vada o kamonai, ia lalonai vada o hahediba, hereva momokanina Iesu ena amo vada o abia.
EPH.4.21.english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

EPH.4.17.motu: Taunabunai, Lohiabada lalonai na halomuimu, na tomu, harihari ela basio raka dibura taudia heḡereḡeredia; idia na edia lalo-hadai kavakavadia ai e rakamu
EPH.4.17.english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

EPH.5.7.motu: Badina bunai, idia ida basio hetura.
EPH.5.7.english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

EPH.5.22.motu: Hahine e, adavamui ba kamonai henidia, Lohiabada boma kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
EPH.5.22.english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

EPH.3.13.motu: Taunabunai na noimuimu, daramui basie doko umui bagumui ai na hisihisimu; lauegu hisihisi na umui ihahairaimui ḡauna.
EPH.3.13.english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

EPH.6.14.motu: Benaini, ba gini: koekoemui ai hereva momokani ba ḡeḡea; kememui ai kara maoromaoro ba hadabualai;
EPH.6.14.english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

EPH.6.16.motu: Nega idoinai abidadama kesina bavabia kau, unu amo Tau Dikana ena diba lahidia ba habodo diba.
EPH.6.16.english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

EPH.6.22.english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

EPH.1.4.motu: Tanobada do se karaia negana ai, Dirava ese Keriso lalonai e abida hidi, ia vairanai helaḡa tauda ai bona asi bebeka-bebekada tauda ai baitala helaoreana. Ena lalokau dainai
EPH.1.4.english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

EPH.4.18.motu: Lalodia na didibura; Dirava ena mauri ai idia na asi ahudia, edia mata-lahui bona edia lalo-duhu daidiai.
EPH.4.18.english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

EPH.3.7.motu: Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai ena siahu ese egu ai vada e ḡaukara, sivarai namo isiaina ilaohenina taugu ai vada e halaogu.
EPH.3.7.english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

EPH.6.17.motu: Hahemauri bavabia, emui kwara ḡauna; bona Lauma ena dare, Dirava ena hereva bunai.
EPH.6.17.english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

EPH.5.4.motu: Lebulebu, kavakava, hevaseha herevadia danu dia nanamo; a hahenamo herevadia hari namo.
EPH.5.4.english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

EPH.1.10.motu: negadia bae ḡuḡuru ai na ḡau iboudiai, guba ḡaudia bona tanobada ḡaudia, Keriso ai baine haboudia helaoreana.
EPH.1.10.english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

EST.2.23.motu: Hereva na e tahua, e davaria vada e momokani; bena unu tatau raruosi na tau-dae auna ai e matadia. Bena sivarai na Sisiga Bukana ai e torea, hanua pavapavana vairanai.
EST.2.23.english: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.

EST.9.24.motu: Badina be Hamana Hamedata, tau Aga, Iuda taudia iboudiai adia inai tauna, ese Iuda taudia ihabua-taridia dalana e lalo-hadailaia, bona mari karana ta ladana Puru e karaia, idia ihadareredia bona ihabua-taridia totona.
EST.9.24.english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

EST.8.13.motu: Pepa unuhetomadia ta ta be basileia ta ta ai bae halasidia, taravatu na heto, bona bae duahi hedinarai taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai; bena Iuda taudia na bae heḡaeḡae, una dina ai inaidia davadia bae henidia.
EST.8.13.english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

EST.5.10.motu: Ḡau tamona, Hamana na e haheauka, bona ena ruma ela. Bena ia ese haida e siaidia lao, ia turana bona adavana Serese bae hakaudia mai.
EST.5.10.english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

EST.8.3.motu: Bena Eseta ese hanua pavapavana ma e hereva henia lou. Ia na ia aena badinai e goru diho, mai taina ida e noia, Hamana tau Agag ena lalo-hadai dikana, Iuda taudia ihadikadia dalana vada e lailaia, na baine gwaua tubu.
EST.8.3.english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

EST.9.31.motu: unu Purimi dinadia na bae badinadia, negadia korikori ai, Morodekai, tau Iuda, bona Queen Eseta ese Iuda taudia vada e haḡanidia, bona idia sibodia ese idia bagudiai bona garadia bagudiai vada e gwau hamata, heḡereḡerena, bona edia anivaga bona edia taitai negadia danu.
EST.9.31.english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

EST.2.9.motu: Bena hari hane-ulato ese una tau lalona e hamoalea; bena ia ese hane-ulato na e lalo namo henia, bona dahudahu muramuradia e henia haraḡa. Ana aniani danu e henia, bona hesiai kekenidia hahitu, hanua pavapavana ena ruma kekenidia bogaragidia amo e abidia hidi, na e henia. Bena ia bona ena hesiai kekenidia na gabu namo-hereana e henidia, hahine edia ruma ai.
EST.2.9.english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

EST.3.7.motu: King Ahasuero ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana ai, hua gini-gunana, ladana Nisan, lalonai, idia ese mari karana ta, ladana Puru, na Hamana vairanai e karaia, dina ta ta amo bona hua ta ta amo, ela bona mari ese hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, na e duanaia.
EST.3.7.english: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

EST.7.10.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Una ḡau ai a mataia. Taunabunai idia ese Hamana e mataia, ia ese Morodekai imatalaina e heḡaeḡaelaia ḡauna dorina ai. Bena hanua pavapavana ena badu vada e keru.
EST.7.10.english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

EST.6.9.motu: bena dabua bona hosi na hanua pavapavana emu lohia badadia ta bae henia. Bena una tau ese hari hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na baine hadabualaia bona hosi latanai baine hahelaia kau; bena hanua ariarana amo baine hakaua hanai, bona vairanai baine haroro, baineto “Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma”.
EST.6.9.english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

EST.4.15.motu: Bena Eseta ese e hamaorodia, Morodekai na bae haere henia, baeto:
EST.4.15.english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

EST.4.9.motu: Bena Hataka na ela, Morodekai ena hereva na Eseta e hamaorolaia.
EST.4.9.english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

EST.5.13.motu: A ina idoinai na do se hanamolaigu ḡuḡurumu, hari Morodekai, Iuda tauna, na doini hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai helaina ai na itaiamu negadia ai.
EST.5.13.english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

EST.2.14.motu: Adorahi ai ela, bena daba ai ma e lou, hahine edia ruma iharuana ela, Saasagasa, hanua pavapavana ese e adavadia hahinedia inaridia tauna, ena hereḡu ai e nohova. Ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai basinema raka vareai lou, a hanua pavapavana ese bema ura henia, ia ese ladana bema hatoa, bena bema boiria.
EST.2.14.english: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

EST.7.7.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na aniani gabuna amo e tore isi mai baduna ida, e raka lasi, ena ruma uma-umana ai. A Hamana na e noho, Queen Eseta enai ena mauri baine noia eto; badina be lalona vada e parara, hanua pavapavana ese ia ihadikana baine gwauraia.
EST.7.7.english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

EST.8.14.motu: Taunabunai, gwaukau taudia na edia hosi, hari heau-dikadika ḡaudia, hanua pavapavana isiaina ilao-henina ai e ḡaukaralaidiava ḡaudia, na latadiai e gui, e heau haraḡa-haraḡa, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua aukana dainai. Hari haheḡani herevana na hanua badana Susa ai danu e gwauraia hedinarai.
EST.8.14.english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

EST.8.4.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi auna, gold ḡauna, na e toia roro, Eseta e dudui henia.
EST.8.4.english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

EST.9.17.motu: Una na hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-toina ai; bena dina ihagwauta-hanina ai idia na lagadia e ani, aria bona moale dinana ai e halaoa.
EST.9.17.english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

EST.6.3.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e henanadai, eto, Hari Morodekai na dahaka hahenamona eiava edena dagi badana vada e henia, ina kara dainai? Hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia, ia vairanai ginidia taudia, na eto, Ḡau ta asie kara henia.
EST.6.3.english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?”

EST.2.22.motu: Ina na Morodekai e diba, bena ia ese Queen Eseta e hadibaia, bena Eseta ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, Morodekai ladana ai.
EST.2.22.english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.

EST.8.6.motu: Badina be dika badana na egu bese taudia latadiai be kaumu na itana ai ede baina haheauka toma? Varavaragu ihabua-taridia baina itaia negana ai, ede baina haheauka toma?
EST.8.6.english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

EST.1.5.motu: Unu dina vada e ore murinai, hanua pavapavana ese aria ta ma e karaia, hanua badana Susa lalonai e nohova taudia kikina-badana iboudiai adia. Una aria na hanua pavapavana ena ruma uma-umana maḡuna lalonai e dabaraia, ela bona dina hitu e ore.
EST.1.5.english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

EST.6.10.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Hamana e hamaoroa, eto, A kara haraḡa, dabua bona hosi avabidia, emu hereva heḡereḡerena; bena Morodekai, tau Iuda, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e helaimu tauna, na unu ba kara henia toma. Vada o herevalai ḡaudia ta basio reaia.
EST.6.10.english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

EST.5.9.motu: Una dina ai, Hamana na e raka lasi mai moalena ida; lalona na e moale bada. A Hamana ese Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e itaia, ia na se tore isi bona ia vairanai se gari, bena ena badu na e ḡaraḡara Morodekai enai.
EST.5.9.english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

EST.5.11.motu: Bena Hamana ese e hereva henidia, ena taḡa hairaidia, bona natuna mamaruanedia na edehohodia, bona dagi idau-idau hanua pavapavana ese vada e henia, ia ihanamolaina totona, bona hanua pavapavana ese vada e abia dae, ena lohia taudia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai daediai, sivaraidia e gwaurai.
EST.5.11.english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

EST.1.19.motu: Bema hanua pavapavana lalona baine heḡereḡere, pavapava haheduana ta na iena amo bainela, Parasa taudia bona Media taudia edia taravatu ai baine hetore, bena ta ese basine ha-idaua diba. Hahedua na iniheto: Vasati na King Ahasuero vairanai ma basine raka vareai lou; a hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi na hahine ta, ia e hereaiamu hahinena, baine henia.
EST.1.19.english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

EST.4.11.motu: Hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia bona ena basileia taudia iboudiai na dibadia tau ta eiava hahine ta na laloma maḡuna ai baine raka vareai hanua pavapavana dekenai, se boiria negana ai, taravatuna be tamona: iboudiai na bae karadia heḡereḡere, bae aladia mase mo. Ḡau tamona, hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi auna, gold ḡauna, amo ta baine dudui henia, una tau eiava una hahine na baine mauri. Bona lau na dina toi-ahui asie boirigu, hanua pavapavana dekenai baina raka vareai totona.
EST.4.11.english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

EST.4.4.motu: Eseta ena hesiai kekenidia bona ena hesiai taudia na dekena ema, bona e hamaoroa; bena pavapava hahinena na lalona e hisihisi bada. Ia ese dabua haida e siaidia, Morodekai ese ena puse dabuadia baule doki oho bona unu dabua baine hahedokilai eto; to ia ese se abidia.
EST.4.4.english: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.

EST.1.21.motu: Ina hahealo herevana na hanua pavapavana bona hanua hanua lohiadia ese e moalelaia; bena hanua pavapavana na Memukana ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai e kara.
EST.1.21.english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

EST.1.2.motu: unu dinadia ai King Ahasuero na ena pavapava teronona ai e helaiva, hanua badana ladana Susa ai.
EST.1.2.english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

EST.1.10.motu: Dina ihahituna ai hanua pavapavana lalona e moaleva, vine ranuna e inuava dainai, bena ia ese Mehumana bona Bisita bona Harabona bona Bigita bona Abagata bona Setara bona Karakasa, King Ahasuero ena ruma irefiuna taudia hahituosi, na e haḡanidia,
EST.1.10.english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

EST.9.14.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na e haheḡani, unu bae karadia toma; haheḡani na Susa ai e gwauraia hedinarai, bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi na e taudia dae.
EST.9.14.english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

EST.9.15.motu: Bena Iuda taudia Susa ai na hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai ma e hebou, Susa ai tatau sinahu-toi ma e aladia mase; a kohu asie dadi.
EST.9.15.english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

EST.1.4.motu: Una negana ai ia ese ena basileia herea-daena taḡadia bona ena siahu hairaina bada-herea e haheitalaidia, dina momo lalodiai; unu dina iboudiai na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui.
EST.1.4.english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

EST.9.9.motu: bona Paramasta bona Arisai bona Aridai bona Vaisata;

EST.4.14.motu: Badina be nega inihetomana ai udumu boma hakapua, hekaha bona hahemauri na idau kaha amo bae hedinarai Iuda taudia edia, a oi bona tamamu ena iduhu taudia na ba mase. Daika dibana, oi na reana nega inihetomana bagunai dagi vada o abia ina basileia lalonai.
EST.4.14.english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

EST.4.10.motu: Bena Eseta ese Hataka e hereva henia, gwaukau herevana e henia Morodekai ena, eto,
EST.4.10.english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

EST.5.14.motu: Bena ia adavana Serese bona turana iboudiai ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tau-dae auna ta, ena lata na kiubit imahui, na baine hekara; bena daba ai hanua pavapavana ba hamaoroa, baine hahedua, Morodekai na una ḡau dorina ai bae mataia. Bena hanua pavapavana ida aniani ianina baola mai moalemu ida. Ina hereva na Hamana ese e abia dae; bena e hahedua, hari tau-dae auna bae karaia.
EST.5.14.english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

EST.7.2.motu: Dina iharuana ai, idia na vine ranuna e inuva ai, hanua pavapavana ese Eseta ma e nanadaia lou, eto, Queen Eseta e, emu noinoi be dahaka? Do baina henimu. Emu ura ḡauna be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana ba gwauraia, to bavabia vaitani.
EST.7.2.english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

EST.9.22.motu: Iuda taudia na inaidia imadia amo e roho mauri dinadia, bona edia lalo-hisihisi na moale ai bona edia taitai na laḡa-ani ai e hahelao huana; unu dina na aria bona moale dinadia ai bae halaodia; bona unu dina ai idia na aniani namo-hereadia bae herahialai heheni, bona ogogami taudia bae harihari henidia.
EST.9.22.english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

EST.8.11.motu: Unu revareva lalodiai hanua pavapavana na e gwau maoro, Iuda taudia hanua ta ta lalodiai bae hebou diba, edia mauri igimadia totona, bona bese ta eiava basileia ta ena tuari taudia ese bema ala-ala henidia, idia ese idia bona natudia bona adavadia na bae habuadia tari bona bae aladia mase bona bae ha-oredia vaitani, bona edia kohu bae dadi,
EST.8.11.english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

EST.9.5.motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia ese inaidia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia; e aladia mase bona e habuadia tari, bona e inai henidia taudia na edia ura heḡereḡerena ai e kara henidia.
EST.9.5.english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

EST.7.6.motu: Bena Eseta e haere, eto, Daḡedaḡe tauna, inai tauna, ina tau dikana Hamana. Bena Hamana na e gari dikadika, hanua pavapavana mai adavana ida vairadiai.
EST.7.6.english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!”

EST.9.18.motu: A Iuda taudia Susa ai na dina ihagwauta-toina ai bona dina ihag vauta-hanina ai e hebou, bena dina ihagwauta-imana ai lagadia e ani, aria bona moale dinana ai e halaoa.
EST.9.18.english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

EST.5.4.motu: Bena Eseta eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na hari dina ai raruosi baoma, aniani vada na heḡaeḡaelaia hanua pavapavana ana, na raruosi bavania.
EST.5.4.english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

EST.8.16.motu: diari bona moale bona lalo-namo bona heimodai na Iuda taudia latadiai.
EST.8.16.english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

EST.3.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia iboudiai, pavapava ena ikoukou ai e nohova taudia, na e igo diho; idia ese Hamana e toma henia diho, badina be hanua pavapavana na unu vada e haheḡanilaia toma. A Morodekai na se igo diho bona se toma henia diho.
EST.3.2.english: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

EST.9.13.motu: Bena Eseta eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, Iuda taudia Susa ai na hari dina haheḡanina heḡereḡerena ai kerukeru ma bae karaia; bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi tau-dae auna ai bae taudia dae.
EST.9.13.english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

EST.9.32.motu: Queen Eseta ena haheḡani ese ini kara e haginidia, bona revareva ese e hamomokanidia.
EST.9.32.english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

EST.1.11.motu: idia ese Queen Vasati na bae hakaua vareai hanua pavapavana vairanai, mai ena havava ḡauna kwarana ai, hanua taudia bona hanua hanua lohiadia na ia hairaina baine haheitalaidia totona; badina be ia na hane namo, mai hairaina.
EST.1.11.english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

EST.6.4.motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, Daika na maḡu lalonai noho? Una negana ai Hamana na hanua pavapavana ena ruma maḡuna lalonai vada e raka vareai, ena ura be vada e heḡaeḡaelaia tau-dae auna ai Morodekai baine mataia dalana na hanua pavapavana baine herevalai henia.
EST.6.4.english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

EST.9.27.motu: Iuda taudia na e haheḡani bona e gwau hamata, idia sibodia bagudiai bona garadia- bona edia orea ai bae vareai taudia bagudiai, eto unu dina ruaosi be basie readia a bae badinadia, vada e tore herevadia heḡereḡeredia, laḡani ta ta amo vada e gwauraia negana ai;
EST.9.27.english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

EST.3.12.motu: Bena hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, hanua pavapavana ena toretore taudia e boiridia, bona haheḡani pepana ta, Hamana ena haheḡani herevadia iboudiai ihaheḡereḡeredia, na e tore, hanua pavapavana ena heitatao taudia, bona ena basileia iboudiai ikwaradia taudia, bona bese iboudiai lohiadia, ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo, bona bese ta ta edia gado ai. King Ahasuero ladana ai e tore, bona kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo hanua pavapavana toana e karaia.
EST.3.12.english: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

EST.2.8.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevana bona ena haheḡani e gwauraia hedinarai, bena ulato momo na hanua badana Susa ai e haboudia, Hegai ena hereḡu ai, negana ai Eseta danu e abia, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai e atoa, Hegai, hahine inaridia tauna, ena hereḡu ai.
EST.2.8.english: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

EST.8.8.motu: Bona Iuda taudia herevadia na emui ura heḡereḡerena ba tore, hanua pavapavana ladagu ai, bona hanua pavapavana imagu kwakikwakina vaḡivagina amo toana ba karaia; badina be haheḡani herevana hanua pavapavana ladana ai e torea bona imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo toana e karadia na ta ese basine gwaua tao diba.
EST.8.8.english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

EST.1.8.motu: I'inuna na taravatu heḡereḡerena, ta asie haduaia baine inu; badina be hanua pavapavana ese ena ruma ireḡuna taudia iboudiai vada e haḡanidia, eto ta ta ena ura ena ura heḡereḡeredia bae kara.
EST.1.8.english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

EST.9.3.motu: Bona basileia lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona hekwara taudia bona hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ese Iuda taudia e durudia, badina be Morodekai garina e gariva.
EST.9.3.english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

EST.1.12.motu: A Queen Vasati e gwau edeede; hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani hari ruma ireḡuna taudia ese e mailaia na ibadinana se ura. Una dainai, hanua pavapavana lalona e siahu, e badu ḡaraḡara.
EST.1.12.english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

EST.2.17.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Eseta e ura henia bada, hahine oredia iboudiai e ura henidia maragi; bona ulato iboudiai bogaragidia amo ia sibona ese hanua pavapavana ena harihari bona ena hahenamo e abidia badabada. Taunabunai, ia ese havava ḡauna na ia kwarana ai e atoa, bona pavapava hahinena ai e halaoa, Vasati ibolona.
EST.2.17.english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

EST.9.2.motu: King Ahasuero ena basileia lalodiai Iuda taudia na edia hanua lalodiai e hebou, una dina ai, ihadikadia dalana e tahuava taudia na bae dabaidia tao totona. A asi tauna ta ese baine laodia ahu diba, badina be taunimanima iboudiai ese idia garidia e gariva.
EST.9.2.english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

EST.6.11.motu: Bena Hamana ese dabua bona hosi e abidia, Morodekai e hadabualaia bona e hahelaia kau, bena hanua ariarana amo e hakaua hanai, e haroro, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma.
EST.6.11.english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

EST.4.7.motu: Bena Morodekai ese ienai vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai e hamaorolaia, bona e hamaoroa danu moni hida Hamana ese vada e gwauraia hamata, hanua pavapavana ena kohu-habou gabuna ai baine atoa, Iuda taudia ihabua-taridia davana.
EST.4.7.english: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.

EST.5.1.motu: Dina ihatoina ai Eseta ese ena dagi dabuadia e hahedokilaidia, bena ela, hanua pavapavana ena ruma maguna lalonai e gini, hanua pavapavana ena daiutu vairanai. Hanua pavapavana na ena terono ai e helaiva, ena ruma lalonai, ruma iduarana hevaira hehenina ai.
EST.5.1.english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

EST.3.15.motu: Gwaukau taudia na e heau ela, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua heḡereḡerena; bona haheḡani na hanua badana Susa ai e gwauraia hedinarai danu. Bena hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na e helai diho, vine ranuna e inua; a Susa ai hanua taudia na e daradara.
EST.3.15.english: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.

EST.6.2.motu: E torea sivaraina ta be Morodekai ese Bigitana bona Terese e hahebadelaidia sivaraina. Idia be hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia rarua, iduara raka-vareaina e gimaiava taudia; bena idia ese King Ahasuero idabai-taona dalana e tahua.
EST.6.2.english: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

EST.5.6.motu: Bena vine ranuna e inuva negana ai, hanua pavapavana ese Eseta e nanadaia, eto, Emu noinoi ḡauna be dahaka? Baina henimu. Emu ura be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana, to baina henimu vaitani.
EST.5.6.english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

EST.8.17.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevana bona ena haheḡani e kamonai basileiadia bona hanuadia iboudiai Ialodiai, Iuda taudia na e moaleva bona e hisi daeva, aria e karava bona e kone nohova. Bona unu tano taudia hutuma na sibodia Iuda taudia ai e hegwaurai, badina be Iuda taudia garidia e gariva.
EST.8.17.english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

EST.9.7.motu: E aladia taudia haida ladadia be Parasanadata bona Dalafono bona Aspata,

EST.4.1.motu: Unu kara iboudiai na Morodekai vada e diba; bena ia ese ena dabua e daredia, puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, bona kahu ai e hebubu tao. Bena hanua bogaragina ela, e tai lolololo, e tai hahane;
EST.4.1.english: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.

EST.5.3.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Queen Eseta, edeheto? Emu ura be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana to baina henimu.
EST.5.3.english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

EST.9.11.motu: Una dina ai haida ese hanua pavapavana e hadibaia, hanua badana Susa ai taunimanima edehohodia vada e aladia mase.
EST.9.11.english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

EST.6.7.motu: Bena Hamana ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma:
EST.6.7.english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

EST.2.10.motu: Eseta na ena iduhu bona ena bese se hahedinaraidia, badina be Morodekai ese vada e haḡania ia na basine gwauraidia hedinarai.
EST.2.10.english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.

EST.4.2.motu: bena ma ela, ela bona hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou vairanai, badina be puse dabuana e hahedokilaia tauna ta na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou lalonai basine raka vareai diba.
EST.4.2.english: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

EST.9.21.motu: E haḡanidia, eto hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina bona ihagwauta-imana ai, laḡani ta ta lalodiai, na bae badinadia,
EST.9.21.english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

EST.6.6.motu: Taunabunai, Hamana na e raka vareai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ede bae karaia toma? Hamana na sibona lalona e hadaia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese daika ihanamona bema moalelaia bada, a lau ihanamogu be bema moalelaia maraḡi?
EST.6.6.english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?”

EST.3.13.motu: Revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia ai e siaidia lao, hanua pavapavana ena basileia kahadia iboudiai ediai, eto, dina tamona ai, hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, Iuda tataudia iboudiai kikina-badana bona hahine bona natudia na bae habuadia tari, bae aladia mase, bae ha-oredia vaitani, bona edia kohu bae dadi.
EST.3.13.english: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.

EST.6.5.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hamana na unuseni ai, magu ai e ginimu. Hanua pavapavana eto, Aine raka vareai.
EST.6.5.english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.”

EST.7.9.motu: Bena Harabona, hanua pavapavana isiaina e lao heniva tauna ta, eto, Ina danu, Hamana ena tau-dae auna, Morodekai, ena hereva amo hanua pavapavana e hamauria tauna, imatana totona e heḡaeḡaelaia ḡauna, na ena ruma ai gini; ena lata na kiubit imahui.
EST.7.9.english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.”

EST.9.23.motu: Bena Iuda taudia na e gwau hamata, sibodia vada e matamaia bona Morodekai ese vada e tore henidia heḡereḡerena ai bae karaia.
EST.9.23.english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

EST.1.7.motu: Inuinu ḡaudia na gold keheredia ai e sei bona e diu henidia; unu kehere na idau-idau; bona vine ranuna momo, pavapava e inumu ḡauna, hanua pavapavana ena harihari-bada heḡereḡerena.
EST.1.7.english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

EST.1.22.motu: Ia ese revareva e siaidia, e lohiadia basileiadia iboudiai ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo, bona bese ta ta edia gado ai, tatau ta ta ena ruma ena ruma bae biagudia, bona edia bese herevadia korikoridia bae gwaurai.
EST.1.22.english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

EST.9.6.motu: Hanua badana Susa ai Iuda taudia ese tatau sinahu-ima e aladia mase bona e habuadia tari.
EST.9.6.english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

EST.9.29.motu: Bena Queen Eseta, Abihaili natuna, bona Morodekai, tau Iuda, ese revareva iharuana ma e torea, mai siahudia ida, hari Purumi herevana ihamomokanina.
EST.9.29.english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

EST.1.15.motu: Ia na eto, Taravatu ai ede e torea tomamu, Queen Vasati ede baita kara henia toma? Badina be ia ese King Ahasuero ena haheḡani, ena ruma ireḡuna taudia ududia amo e siaia, na se badinaia.
EST.1.15.english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

EST.9.20.motu: Bena Morodekai ese ini ḡau iboudiai sivaraidia e tore, bona revareva e tore, Iuda taudia iboudiai ediai e siaidia, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai, gabu kahikahidia bona daudaudia.
EST.9.20.english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

EST.9.10.motu: ini na Hamana Hamedata, Iuda taudia inaidia, natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi.
EST.9.10.english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

EST.2.3.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese heitatao taudia baine duanaidia, ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai; bena idia ese rami-hebou ulatodia matamatadia mai hairaidia iboudiai na bae haboudia, Susa bae siaidia mai; bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna Hegai, hanua pavapavana adavana edia ruma ireguna tauna, ese una ruma ai do baine naridia, bona dahudahu muramuradia baine henidia.
EST.2.3.english: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women’s house, to the custody of Hegai the king’s eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;

EST.4.8.motu: Morodekai ese danu haheḡani pepadia, Susa ai e tore ḡaudia, ta e henia, Eseta baine haheitalaia totona; bona e hamaoroa anina na baine hadibalaia, bona baine noia, ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai, baine noinoi, ena bese taudia daidiai baine noia.
EST.4.8.english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

EST.6.1.motu: Una hanuaboi ai hanua pavapavana na se mahutava; bena e boiboi, sisiga bukana bae mailaia. Una buka lalonai kara mai haridia vada e hetore; bena hanua pavapavana vairanai e duahidia hedinarai.
EST.6.1.english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

EST.1.13.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese aonega taudia, nega mai dibadia taudia, na e hereva henidia. (Hanua pavapavana na vaia ena kara unu e kara tomava, taravatu bona hahemaoro mai dibadia taudia ediai.
EST.1.13.english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

EST.2.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia eto, Rami-hebou ulatodia matamatadia mai hairaidia bae tahudia, hanua pavapavana ena.
EST.2.2.english: Then the king’s servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.

EST.9.4.motu: Badina be Morodekai na bada herea hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai, bona harina vada e piua, basileia heḡeḡemadai iboudiai lalodiai; badina be una tau Morodekai ena siahu e bada e laova.
EST.9.4.english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

EST.1.3.motu: Bena ena Iohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, ia ese aria ta e karaia, ena Iohia taudia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai, bona Parasa bona Media tuari lohiadia, bona basileia lohiadia bona ikwaradia taudia, adia.
EST.1.3.english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

EST.1.14.motu: Ia badinai e giniva taudia be Karasena bona Setara bona Adamata bona Tarasisi bona Merese bona Marasena bona Memukana, Parasa bona Media lohiadia hahituosi; idia na nega idoinai hanua pavapavana vairana e itaiava, bona helai gabudia hereadia ai e helaiva una basileia lalonai.)
EST.1.14.english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

EST.2.5.motu: Hanua badana Susa ai, Iuda tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Morodekai lairi, Simei Kisa tubuna, Beniamina tauna.
EST.2.5.english: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,

EST.2.1.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, King Ahasuero lalona ma e keru, bena ia ese Vasati e helalolaia une, bona ena kara bona hari hahedua herevana ia latanai e gwauraia na e helalolai.
EST.2.1.english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

EST.5.2.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Queen Eseta na maḡu ai ginana ai e itaia, bena e lalo namo henia. Ena dagi auna, gold ḡauna, na imana ai mia, bena ia ese e toia roro, Eseta e dudui henia. Bena Eseta e raka kahira, hari dagi auna dorina e daua toho.
EST.5.2.english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

EST.2.12.motu: Ini ulato na hahine taravatudia henunai e nohova ela bona hua gwauta-rua e ore; una na ihahairaidia negana korikorina, hua tauratoi muro dehorona amo bona hua tauratoi muramura mai bonadia bona hahine edia dehoro haida amo. Bena ulato ta ta edia nega e kau, King Ahasuero dekenai bae raka vareai, negadia ai na
EST.2.12.english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).

EST.2.21.motu: Bena unu dinadia ai, Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e helaiva ai, Bigitana bona Terese, hanua pavapavana ena raka-vareaina e gimaiava taudia, na e badu, King Ahasuero na bae dabaia tao eto.
EST.2.21.english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

EST.1.9.motu: Queen Vasati danu aria ta e karaia, hahine adia, King Ahasuero ena ruma ai.
EST.1.9.english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

EST.8.12.motu: dina tamona ai, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai; una dina be hua ihagwauta-ruana ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina.
EST.8.12.english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

EST.9.28.motu: bona unu dina na bae lalodia tao bona bae badinadia uru iboudiai lalodiai, iduhu iboudiai bona basileia iboudiai bona hanua iboudiai lalodiai. Unu amo hari Purimi dinadia ibadinadia karadia basie boio, Iuda taudia bogaragidiai, bona garadia bogaragidiai danu unu dina ilalolaidia na basine doko.
EST.9.28.english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

EST.8.10.motu: King Ahasuero ladana ai e torea, bona hanua pavapavana imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo toa e karaia. Bena revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia ai e siaidia; unu gwaukau taudia na heau-dikadika hosidia ai e gui, hanua pavapavana ena hosi maḡuna ai e vara bona hanua pavapavana isiaidia ilao-henina ai e loalaidia hosidia.
EST.8.10.english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

EST.8.5.motu: Bena Eseta e tore isi, hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini, eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, bona boma lalo namo henigu, boma haeroa bema kara maoromaoro oi vairamu ai, bona boma moalelaigu, haheḡani herevana ta bae torea, Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, ena revareva, hanua pavapavana ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai Iuda taudia bae habuadia tari totona e tore ḡaudia, bae gwaudia tao.
EST.8.5.english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

EST.10.3.motu: Badina be Morodekai, tau Iuda, na King Ahasuero henuna tauna; Iuda taudia bogaragidiai ia na bada herea, bona varavarana logora ese e moalelaia; badina be ena bese ena namo e tahuava, bona ena bese taudia iboudiai na maino dalana e herevalai henidiava.
EST.10.3.english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

EST.2.13.motu: hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai hane-ulatona ena ura ḡauna na e henia, hanua pavapavana adavana edia ruma amo baine laohaia, bainela pavapava ena ruma ai.
EST.2.13.english: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.

EST.6.13.motu: Bena Hamana ese adavana Serese bona turana iboudiai na enai vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia. Bena ena aonega taudia bona adavana Serese ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ina Morodekai, vairanai vada o moru matama tauna, bema Iuda besena tauna ta, oi na basio laoa ahu diba, to ia vairanai ba moru vaitani.
EST.6.13.english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

EST.2.7.motu: Hari Morodekai ese Hadasa (ladana ta be Eseta), tamana lahaina natuna, vada e ubua, badina be tamana bona sinana vada e mase. Ia na hane namo mai hairaina; bena tamana bona sinana e mase negana ai, Morodekai ese e abia, ia natuna ai e halaoa.
EST.2.7.english: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

EST.4.12.motu: Bena idia ese Eseta ena hereva na Morodekai e hamaorolaia.
EST.4.12.english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

EST.6.14.motu: Idia na dounu ia ida e herevava ai, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia na e kau; bena idia ese Hamana e hakaua lao haraḡa, Eseta ese vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ianina totona.
EST.6.14.english: While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

EST.3.10.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ese ia imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina, ena toa ikarana ḡauna, na kwakikwakina amo e veria oho, Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, Iuda taudia adia inai, na e henia.
EST.3.10.english: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

EST.7.1.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na e raka vareai, Queen Eseta ida bae aniani hebou totona.
EST.7.1.english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

EST.10.2.motu: Ena siahu bona ena goada herevadia, bona Morodekai ena dagi badana hanua pavapavana ese e henia sivaraina idoinai, na Media bona Parasa Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
EST.10.2.english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

EST.3.14.motu: Pepa unuhetomadia ta ta be basileia ta ta ai bae halasidia, taravatu na heto, bona bae duahi hedinarai, taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, bae hegaeḡae, una dina bae naria, totona.
EST.3.14.english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

EST.1.16.motu: Bena Memukana na hanua pavapavana bona hanua hanua lohiadia vairadiai e hereva, eto, Queen Vasati vada e kerere, dia hanua pavapavana mo enai, to lohia iboudiai bona taunimanima iboudiai ediai, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai.
EST.1.16.english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

EST.2.19.motu: Ulato na hahine edia ruma iharuana ai e haboudia negana ai, Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ruma ikoukouna ai e helaiva.
EST.2.19.english: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.

EST.1.1.motu: Ahasuero ena nega ai, (una Ahasuero na basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu e lohiadia, India amo ela bona Etiopia),
EST.1.1.english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

EST.1.20.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani herevana na ena basileia bada-hereana idoinai bae piua, bena hahine iboudiai, lohia hahinedia bona hanua hahinedia, ese adavadia bae matauraidia.
EST.1.20.english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

EST.3.9.motu: Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, boma haheḡani, bae habuadia tari, bena lau ese silver talent gerebu ta hanua pavapavana ena moni e reguamu taudia imadia ai baina ato, bena idia ese hanua pavapavana ena kohu-habou rumadia ai bae ato.
EST.3.9.english: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

EST.5.12.motu: Hamana ma eto, Queen Eseta ese danu ta se boiria, hanua pavapavana baine bamoa, vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ianina totona, a lau mo sibogu; bona ma vada e vavegu lou, kerukeru hanua pavapavana ida ma baiala.
EST.5.12.english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

EST.2.20.motu: Eseta ese ena iduhu bona ena bese do se gwaurai hedinarai, Morodekai ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena; badina be Eseta ese dounu Morodekai e kamonai henia, gunaguna ia dekenai e nohova negana ai e kamonai heniava heḡereḡerena.
EST.2.20.english: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.

EST.8.15.motu: Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana vairana amo e raka lasi. Pavapava dabuadia e hahedokilai, vaiuridia bona kurokurodia; ena havava ḡauna na gold ḡauna bada-hereana; ena hahedoki na dabua aukana ḡoeva-daena bona dabua kakakakana amo e karaia. Bena Susa taudia na e lolo bona e moale hisi dae;
EST.8.15.english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

EST.9.12.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Queen Eseta e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua badana Susa lalonai Iuda taudia ese tatau sinahu-ima vada e aladia mase, bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi danu. Hanua pavapavana ena basileia oredia ai be edehohona vada e aladia mase! Harihari emu noinoi be dahaka? Vada baina henimu. Dahaka ma o uramu? Baine hekara ḡuḡuru.
EST.9.12.english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

EST.3.1.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, King Ahasuero ese Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, e abia dae, dagi badana e henia, bona ia ida e lohia hebou taudia iboudiai daediai e hahelaia.
EST.3.1.english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.

EST.3.6.motu: A Morodekai na ia sibona ese baine dabaia tao na se ura. Taunabunai, haida ese e hadibaia, Morodekai ena bese be edena; bena Hamana ese Iuda taudia, Morodekai ena bese taudia, iboudiai ihabua-taridia dalana e tahua, Ahasuero ena basileia idoinai lalonai.
EST.3.6.english: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone, for they had made known to him Mordecai’s people. Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai’s people.

EST.9.16.motu: Iuda taudia oredia hanua pavapavana ena basileia lalodiai e nohova danu e hebou, edia mauri igimana totona; bena inaidia imadia amo e roho mauri, bona e inai henidia taudia gerebu-hitu daha-ima na e aladia mase; a kohu na asie dadi.
EST.9.16.english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

EST.2.11.motu: A dina iboudiai Morodekai ese hahine edia ruma maḡuna vairanai e rakava, baine diba Eseta na edeheto bona ena noho na edeheto totona.
EST.2.11.english: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.

EST.3.8.motu: Bena Hamana ese King Ahasuero e hereva henia, eto, Bese ta na e noho rohorohomu, emu basileia kahadia iboudiai taudia bogaragidiai e noho hedoa-hedoamu; edia taravatu na idau, dia bese oredia iboudiai edia heḡereḡeredia, bona hanua pavapavana ena taravatu asie badinadiamu; una dainai dia namo hanua pavapavana ese baine haheauka henidia.
EST.3.8.english: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.

EST.9.1.motu: Hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani bona ena revareva anidia bae vara negana vada e kau. Una dina ai Iuda taudia inaidia ese bae hadareredia eto, ḡau tamona Iuda taudia ese inaidia e hadareredia una dina lalonai.
EST.9.1.english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

EST.1.18.motu: Hari ina dina ai, hanua pavapavana adavana ena kara sivaraina vada e kamonai dainai, Parasa bona Media lohiadia adavadia ese hanua pavapavana ena lohia iboudiai ediai bae herevalaia, bena hemarai bona badu na bae bada herea.
EST.1.18.english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

EST.8.9.motu: Una negana ai hanua pavapavana ena toretore taudia na e boiridia, hua ihatoina, ladana Sivana, dinana iharuahui-toina ai. Bena haheḡani herevana e torea, Morodekai ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, Iuda taudia daidiai, basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu, India amo ela bona Etiopia, edia heitatao taudia bona edia basileia ikwaradia taudia bona edia bese lohiadia ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo bona bese ta ta edia gado ai, bona Iuda taudia ediai danu, edia revareva dalana amo bona edia gado ai.
EST.8.9.english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

EST.4.13.motu: Bena Morodekai ese e hamaorodia, ina haere na bae laohaia, Eseta bae henia, baeto: Basioto hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai oi na ba roho maun, a Iuda taumai iboumai ai baia mase.
EST.4.13.english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

EST.9.26.motu: Taunabunai, unu dina ladadia e hato Purimi, hari hereva Puru dainai. Bena ina revareva ai e hetore herevadia bona ina kara ai vada e ita ḡaudia bona ediai vada e vara ḡaudia daidiai,
EST.9.26.english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

EST.4.16.motu: Aola, Iuda taudia iboudiai Susa ai ba davandia na ba haboudia, lau daigu ai bavanivaga; dina toi hanuaboi toi basio aniani bona ranu basio inua. Lau bona egu hesiai kekenidia danu baia anivaga, umui heḡereḡeremui. Una murinai, ena be vada e taravatua to hanua pavapavana dekenai baina raka vareai; bama mase be vada baina mase.
EST.4.16.english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

EST.5.7.motu: A Eseta eto, Egu noinoi bona egu ura be iniheto:
EST.5.7.english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

EST.1.6.motu: Seseahu dabuadia kurokurodia bona vaiundia na e taudia dae, bona varo aukadia bona varo kakakakadia amo silver ikekedia ai bona nadi hururu-hururu au-tubuadia ai e matadia kau. Helai ḡaudia na gold bona silver amo e kara, bona reireina na nadi hururu-hururudia kakakakadia bona kurokurodia amo e karaia, bona mairi bona dava-bada nadidia amo e haheraia.
EST.1.6.english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

EST.5.8.motu: bema oi hanua pavapavana ese o lalo namo henigumu, bona o uramu egu noinoi ḡauna ba henigu bona egu ura ba haḡuḡurua, mani emu kara hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na raruosi kerukeru ma baoma, baina heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ma bavania, bena hanua pavapavana emu hereva heḡereḡerena do baina karaia.
EST.5.8.english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

EST.2.16.motu: King Ahasuero ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai, hua ihagwautana, ladana Tebete, lalonai, Eseta na King Ahasuero dekenai e hakaua vareai, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai.
EST.2.16.english: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

EST.6.12.motu: Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou e lou henia; a Hamana na ena ruma e lou lao haraḡa, mai taitaina ida, kwarana danu e ḡovaia ahu.
EST.6.12.english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

EST.8.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ia imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina, ena toa ikaralaina ḡauna, Hamana ena amo vada e abia oho, Morodekai e henia. Bena Eseta ese Morodekai na Hamana ena ruma biaguna ai e halaoa.
EST.8.2.english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

EST.7.3.motu: Bena Queen Eseta e haere, eto, Pavapava e, bema o lalo namo henigumu bona lalomu na bema heḡereḡere, egu noinoi dainai egu mauri ba henigu, bona egu ura dainai egu bese ba hamauria.
EST.7.3.english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

EST.7.4.motu: Badina be vada e hoimai, lau bona egu bese taudia, bae habuamai tari, bae alamai mase, bona bae ha-oremai vaitani totona. Bema hoimai, hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia ai bema halaomai, lau na basinama hereva; badina be ai emai hisihisi na ḡau maraḡina, a hanua pavapavana imamu bema pari be ḡau badana, basita haheḡereḡeredia diba.
EST.7.4.english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

EST.3.3.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e nohova taudia, ese Morodekai e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani o tataia utumu?
EST.3.3.english: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

EST.3.11.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Hamana e hamaoroa, eto, Moni na oiemu, taunimanima danu oiemu, emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ba karalaidia.
EST.3.11.english: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”

EST.3.5.motu: Hamana ese e itaia, Morodekai na se igo diho bona se toma henia diho, bena Hamana na e badu dikadika.
EST.3.5.english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.

EST.7.8.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na ena ruma uma-umana amo e lou, vine ranuna e inuva gabuna ai ma e raka vareai; una negana ai Hamana na Eseta ena ege-diho patana ai vada e goru diho. Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Egu ruma ai bona vairagu ai adavagu baine eno henia a? Hanua pavapavana na dounu e hereva ai, idia ese Hamana vairana e ḡovaia ahu.
EST.7.8.english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

EST.9.8.motu: bona Porata bona Adalia bona Aridata,

EST.2.6.motu: Morodekai na abi-mauri taudia ida Ierusalem amo e laohaia, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese Iekonia, Iuda pavapavana, na e abia mauri bona e laohaia negana ai.
EST.2.6.english: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

EST.10.1.motu: King Ahasuero na heaiva e abia, tano idoinai lalonai, bona kone kahana tanodia danu.
EST.10.1.english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

EST.7.5.motu: Bena King Ahasuero ese Queen Eseta e nanadaia, eto, Tauna na daika ina kara baine karaia e tomu? Ia be edeseni ai?
EST.7.5.english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

EST.4.17.motu: Bena Morodekai na e raka oho, ḡau iboudiai e kara, Eseta ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EST.4.17.english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

EST.4.6.motu: Bena Hataka na e raka lasi, Morodekai dekena ela, hanua ariarana ai, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou vairanai.
EST.4.6.english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.

EST.3.4.motu: Dina momo lalodiai idia ese e hereva henia loulou, to ia ese se kamonai henidia. Bena idia ese Hamana e hamaoroa; bae itaia, Morodekai ena hereva baine kwalimu eiava. Badina be ia ese vada e hamaorodia ia na Iuda tauna.
EST.3.4.english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

EST.8.1.motu: Una dina ai King Ahasuero ese Hamana, Iuda taudia adia inai tauna, ena ruma na Queen Eseta e henia. Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini, badina be Eseta vada e hamaoroa idia raruosi na varavara.
EST.8.1.english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

EST.2.18.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese aria badana e karaia, ena lohia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai adia; una na Eseta ena aria. Bona basileia iboudiai edia laḡa-ani e henidia, bona harihari ḡaudia e heni hagauhagau, pavapava ena harihari-bada heḡereḡerena.
EST.2.18.english: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.

EST.9.19.motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia hanua hanua lalodiai, hanua asi maḡudia ai e nohova taudia, ese hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina na moale bona aria bona kone-noho dinana ai e halaoamu, bona una dina ai idia na aniani namo-hereadia e herahialai hehenimu.
EST.9.19.english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

EST.8.7.motu: Bena King Ahasuero ese Queen Eseta bona Morodekai, tau Iuda, na e e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, Hamana ena ruma na Eseta vada na henia, bona tauna na tau-dae ḡauna ai vada e mataia, badina be ia ese Iuda taudia baine dabaidia tao eto.
EST.8.7.english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

EST.2.4.motu: Bena edena hane-ulato na hanua pavapavana ese baine ura henia bada be pavapava hahinena dagina baine abia, Vasati gabuna ai. Hanua pavapavana ese ina hereva e moalelaia, bena unu e kara toma.
EST.2.4.english: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

EST.9.25.motu: A Eseta na hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini negana ai, hanua pavapavana ese hahedua revarevana e torea, unu amo Hamana ena lalo-hadai dikana na ia sibona kwarana ai e kau, bona ia bona natuna mamaruanedia na tau-dae auna ai e taudia dae.
EST.9.25.english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

EST.5.5.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Hamana a boiria haraḡa, ai raruosi na Eseta ena ura heḡereḡerena baia karaia. Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na ela, Eseta ese vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina bae ania totona.
EST.5.5.english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

EST.4.3.motu: Bona hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevadia bona ena haheḡani e kau basileiadia iboudiai lalodiai, Iuda taudia na e tai noho tai nohova, e anivagava, e taitaiva, e tai hahane-hahaneva; bona hutuma na puse dabuadia e hahedokilaiva bona kahu ai e hebubu taova, bena e hekure nohova.
EST.4.3.english: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

EST.9.30.motu: Revareva na vada e siaidia lao, Iuda taudia iboudiai ediai, King Ahasuero ena basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu lalodiai; maino herevadia bona hereva momokanidia ai e hetore, eto
EST.9.30.english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

EST.1.17.motu: Badina be ina hanua pavapavana adavana ena kara na hahine iboudiai ese sivaraina bae kamonai, bena idia ese adavadia basie matauraidia; badina be idia na baeto “King Ahasuero na e hahedua, Queen Vasati na ia vairanai bae hakaua mai, to sema”.
EST.1.17.english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

EST.2.15.motu: Eseta, Morodekai tamana lahaina Abihaili natuna, Morodekai ese e natua kekenina, ena nega e kau, hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai; bena ia ese ḡau ta se gwauraia, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna Hegai, hahine e naridiava tauna, ena lalo-hadai ḡauna mo. E itaia taudia iboudiai ese Eseta e lalo namo heniava.
EST.2.15.english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.

EST.6.8.motu: pavapava dabuadia bae mailai, oi pavapava taumu vada o doki oho ḡaudia, bona hosi ta, latanai hanua pavapavana vada o gui bona kwarana ai havava ḡauna, pavapava toana, vada e atoa ḡauna;
