EST.6.8.english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

EST.4.5.motu: Bena Eseta ese Hataka, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, hanua pavapavana ese vada e hagania ia isiaina baine lao heni tauna, e boiria, e haḡania, Morodekai dekena bainela, baine diba una kara be dahaka bona anina be dahaka.
EST.4.5.english: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.

EXO.7.16.motu: Bena ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova, Heberu taumai emai Dirava, vada eme siaigu dekemu ai, e tomu: Egu orea taudia a kahudia nege, tano ḡaḡaena ai bae toma henigu diho. A oi ese do so kamonai henia.
EXO.7.16.english: You shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

EXO.26.31.motu: Bena seseahu na dabua aukana bona namona amo ba karaia, dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana; ihaheralaina be dibana tauna ese kerubi laulaudia baine turi.
EXO.26.31.english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

EXO.29.27.motu: Hari keme, e davedavelaia ḡauna, bona mamu, e duduia isi ḡauna, ba hahelaḡadia; badina be ia na Aaron mai natuna ida ihahelaḡadia mamoena.
EXO.29.27.english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

EXO.34.15.motu: Taunabunai ba heita, una tano taudia ida basio herohemaino; edia dirava basio toma henidia diho; edia boubou karadia basio kara; edia ihaboulaina ḡaudia basio ani.
EXO.34.15.english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

EXO.10.8.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ma e hakaudia vareai lou, Farao vairanai. Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto Aola, Iehova emui Dirava ba toma henia diho; a umui ida baela taudia be daidia?
EXO.10.8.english: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve Yahweh your God; but who are those who will go?”

EXO.22.19.motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida baine eno bou tauna sa bae alaia mase.
EXO.22.19.english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

EXO.19.19.motu: Kibi reḡena na e bada e laova; bena Mose na e hereva, bona Dirava ese guba rahurahu lalona amo e haere henia.
EXO.19.19.english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

EXO.2.6.motu: Ia ese e kehoa, mero e itaia; ina! mero madi e taiva. Bena ia ese e bogaia hisi, eto, Ina na Heberu hahinena ta natuna.
EXO.2.6.english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

EXO.20.22.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Israel taudia na ini ba hamaorodia toma, baoto: Umui na vada o diba, lau gadogu na guba amo vada ema.
EXO.20.22.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

EXO.1.12.motu: Edia hekwarahi e habadaia loulou, to besedia ma eha hutuma, ela bona tano idoinai e hahonua davana. Bena Aigupto taudia ese Israel taudia garidia e gariva.
EXO.1.12.english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.

EXO.25.5.motu: mamoe kopidia, e hakakakakadia ḡaudia, bona nani kopidia; kela audia;
EXO.25.5.english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

EXO.24.16.motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na ororo dorina ai e kau, bona ori ese ororo e ḡovaia ahu ela bona dina tauratoi e ore. Dina ihahituna ai Iehova ese Mose ladana e hatoa, ori bogaragina amo.
EXO.24.16.english: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

EXO.9.15.motu: Badina be imagu bama toia roro, siahuna korikorina amo bama hahisimui, boma mase ore.
EXO.9.15.english: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

EXO.28.33.motu: Isena ai herahera ba turi, rimono huahuadia na heheto, varo vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia ba turilai, padadia ai gold gabagabadia ba turi kau:
EXO.28.33.english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

EXO.26.7.motu: Bena dabua haida nani huidia amo ba kara, kalaga ai baela, dubu ikoulaina; unu dabua iboudiai bae gwauta-ta.
EXO.26.7.english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

EXO.29.14.motu: A boromakau hidiona bona kopina bona taḡena na taruha murimurinai ba gabudia, bae ḡoledia oho. Ina na kara dika iabi-ohona boubouna.
EXO.29.14.english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

EXO.34.8.motu: Bena Mose na tano ai e goru diho haraḡa, e toma henia diho,
EXO.34.8.english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

EXO.26.10.motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai kunipa imahui ba kara, ma tauratoiosi ta isena ai kunipa imaosi ma ba kara.
EXO.26.10.english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

EXO.3.18.motu: Bena Israel tau-badadia ese bae hakala henimu, bae bamomu, Aigupto pavapavana dekena baola, baoto “Iehova, Heberu taumai emai Dirava, na vada e hahedinarai; taunabunai, mani ba kahumai nege, dina toi baia laolao tano ḡaḡaena ai, unuseni ai Iehova, emai Dirava, baia boua”.
EXO.3.18.english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’

EXO.8.14.motu: E haboudia bena vada e bodaga, bonadia na tano idoinai e dae.
EXO.8.14.english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

EXO.3.15.motu: Dirava ese Mose ma e hamaoroa lou, eto, Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto “Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, Abraham ena Dirava, Isaak ena Dirava, Iakob ena Dirava, vada e siaigu dekemui ai”. Lau ladagu binai ela hanaihanai; uru iboudiai lalodiai ini ba lalogu toma.
EXO.3.15.english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.

EXO.3.16.motu: Aola, Israel tau-badadia ba haboudia, ba hereva henidia, baoto “Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, Abraham ena Dirava, Isaak ena Dirava, Iakob ena Dirava, ese vada e hahedinarai henigu, eto: Momokani, lau ese vada na haḡeremui, Aigupto ai e kara henimui karadia vada na ita;
EXO.3.16.english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.

EXO.18.18.motu: oiemu goada bona ini taunimanima edia goada vada bae ore, badina be ina ḡaukara na metau herea; sibomu basio karaia diba.
EXO.18.18.english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

EXO.30.29.english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

EXO.6.8.motu: Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona lalonai baina hakaumui vareai; vada baina henimui, emui tano korikori. Lau binai Iehova.
EXO.6.8.english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”

EXO.26.29.motu: Hari kaha be gold amo ba ḡovadia. Raroraro idogo-taodia ring-dia na gold amo ba kara, bona raroraro na gold amo ba ḡovadia.
EXO.26.29.english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

EXO.23.28.motu: Nanigo danu baina siaidia vairamu ai, idia ese Hivi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia oi vairamu ai baina luludia lasi.
EXO.23.28.english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

EXO.21.13.motu: To bema iala-masena basine haeroa guna, a Dirava ese ia imana ai baine atoa, lau na gabu ta baina gwaurai henimu, ia baine heau mauri gabuna.
EXO.21.13.english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

EXO.24.11.motu: Ia imana na Israeltau-badadia latadiai se ato kau; idia ese Dirava e itaia, bena e aniani, ranu e inua danu.
EXO.24.11.english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

EXO.29.7.motu: Bena ihorona dehorona bavabia, ia kwarana ai ba seia, ba horoa.
EXO.29.7.english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

EXO.29.23.motu: Flaoa igabuna ta, bona flaoa dehoro amo e kuia atagana ta, bona ataga kavakava ta, asie hatubua flaoana boseana amo ba vai, Iehova vairanai.
EXO.29.23.english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

EXO.30.37.motu: Muramura ia heḡereḡerena na basio karaia sibomui emui; ia na baine helaḡa Iehova ena.
EXO.30.37.english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

EXO.37.7.motu: Kerubi rua danu e kara, gold amo e korodia, hari ikaruhi duduna duduna ai,
EXO.37.7.english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

EXO.7.7.motu: Iehova ena hereva Farao e hamaorolaia negana ai Mose ena mauri laḡanidia be taurahani-ahui, a Aaron ena be taurahani-ahui toi.
EXO.7.7.english: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

EXO.25.18.motu: Ikaruhi duduna duduna kerubi rua ba koro,
EXO.25.18.english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

EXO.36.22.motu: Hari kaha ta ta be ikoko rua rua amo e kokodia heririu; dubu habana kahadia iboudiai unu e kokodia hesiriu toma.
EXO.36.22.english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

EXO.16.6.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ese Israel taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Hari adorahi ai vada ba diba Iehova ese Aigupto tanona amo vada e hakaumui lasi;
EXO.16.6.english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that Yahweh has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

EXO.8.2.motu: a basio kahudia nege, lau na parapara baina siadia emu tano idoinai bae hadikaia.
EXO.8.2.english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

EXO.21.28.motu: Boromakau ta ese tau ta eiava hahine ta baine doaia mase, una boromakau na bae hodoa mase bona hidiona na basie ania; a biaguna be asi ena kerere.
EXO.21.28.english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

EXO.33.6.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia na Horeb ororona ai edia herehera ḡaudia e kokidia oho, asie kara lou.
EXO.33.6.english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

EXO.4.23.motu: taunabunai na haḡanimumu, natugu a kahua nege, lau isiaigu baine lao heni helaoreana; a boma dogoa tao, oi natumu roboana bama alaia mase.”
EXO.4.23.english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”

EXO.16.32.motu: Bena Mose eto, Iehova ena haheḡani binai: nau autamona mo bavatoa tabe, baine mia, uru gabedia ese tano ḡaḡaena ai na ubulaimui anianina, Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi negana ai, do bae itaia.
EXO.16.32.english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

EXO.21.16.motu: Ta ese tau ta baine henaoa, bena baine hoia, eiava ia imana ai bae davaria, vada bae alaia mase.
EXO.21.16.english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

EXO.39.28.motu: bona Aaron ena kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana bona kwara dabuadia namodia haida e kara; bona piribou na dabua aukadia amo e kara.
EXO.39.28.english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

EXO.40.25.motu: bena lamepa e ha-ara Iehova vairanai, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.40.25.english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.29.34.motu: Hari ihahelaḡadia vamuna eiava flaoana bahudia bema mia rani, idia na lahi ai bema gabu bena bema ḡole oho; basiema ani, badina be hehelaḡa.
EXO.29.34.english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

EXO.7.21.motu: Bena Nilo sinavaina gwarumedia iboudiai e mase ore, ranuna danu e bodaga; Aigupto taudia na Nilo sinavaina ranuna bae inua na lalodia asie heḡereḡere. Aigupto tanona idoinai rara mo e aruva.
EXO.7.21.english: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

EXO.17.15.motu: Bena Mose ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, bona ladana e hatoa Iehova-nisi.
EXO.17.15.english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.

EXO.27.15.motu: ma ikoukou kahana ai danu itautau dabuadia na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi.
EXO.27.15.english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

EXO.20.16.english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

EXO.22.11.motu: ia be Iehova vairanai baine gwau hamata, ia ese dekena tauna ena ḡau se daua toho, bena ḡau biaguna ese ena gwau-hamata baine abia dae, ena ḡau davana basine abia.
EXO.22.11.english: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

EXO.39.38.motu: pata helaḡana, gold ḡauna, mai ena dehoro helaḡana bona mai ena muramura mai bonaida; iduara dabuana;
EXO.39.38.english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

EXO.29.40.motu: Flaoa namona nau auta dehoro namona kehere ta amo ba kuia, mamoe natuna ida bavato kau; bona vine ranuna kehere ta ihaboulaina patana latanai ba seia.
EXO.29.40.english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

EXO.1.21.motu: Hari hegwaroto hahinedia ese Dirava e matauria dainai, ia ese natudia e henidia.
EXO.1.21.english: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.

EXO.7.11.motu: Bena Farao ese aonega taudia bona mea taudia e boiridia; bena idia danu, hari Aigupto mea taudia, ese una kara heḡereḡerena ma e kara, edia mea diadiai.
EXO.7.11.english: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

EXO.12.51.motu: Bena una dina ai Iehova ese Israel taudia edia orea iboudiai na Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi.
EXO.12.51.english: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

EXO.7.23.motu: Hari Farao na e lou, ena ruma ela, se helalo.
EXO.7.23.english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

EXO.14.30.motu: Unuhetomana Iehova ese Israel taudia na Aigupto taudia imadia amo e hamauridia una dina ai. Bena Israel taudia ese Aigupto taudia masedia ai e itadia, kone ai.
EXO.14.30.english: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

EXO.7.24.motu: Bena Aigupto taudia iboudiai ese guri e ḡei, sinavai isena ai, inuinu ranuna e tahua, badina be sinavai ranuna na se heḡereḡere bae inua.
EXO.7.24.english: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

EXO.12.35.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Mose ena hereva e badinaia, Aigupto taudia ediai herahera ḡaudia, gold bona silver amo e karava, bona dabua e noi.
EXO.12.35.english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

EXO.35.16.motu: ihaboulaina patana mai iha-aukana auri labora-laborana, mai ena maduna bona ena kohu idoinai ida; auri labora-labora dihuna, mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida;
EXO.35.16.english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

EXO.36.12.motu: Dabua ta ia kunipa imahui e kara, ma dabua ta ai imahui: hari kunipa vada e hevaira heheni.
EXO.36.12.english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

EXO.3.1.motu: Mose ese ravana Ietero, Midian hahelaḡa tauna, ena seri e reḡuava. Ia ese seri e hakaua lao tano ḡaḡaena unukahana ai, Dirava ena ororo, ladana Horeb, ela.
EXO.3.1.english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.

EXO.6.4.motu: Na gwau henidia hamata danu, Kanaan tanona, edia noho-hedoa gabuna, vada baina henidia nato.
EXO.6.4.english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

EXO.29.30.motu: Ia natuna, hahelaḡa dagina ai baine boloa tauna, ese dina hitu lalodiai baine doki, hebou kalagana ai baine raka vareai, gabu helaḡana ai ḡaukara helaḡadia baine kara negadia ai.
EXO.29.30.english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

EXO.34.19.motu: Roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na lauegu: boromakau natudia roboa mamarunedia bona mamoe natudia roboa mamaruanedia.
EXO.34.19.english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

EXO.15.18.english: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”

EXO.26.16.motu: Kaha ta ena lata be kiubit gwauta, bona ena lababa be kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.26.16.english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

EXO.32.34.motu: A harihari aola, taunimanima ba hakaudia lao, vada na hamaorolaimu tanona ai ba hakaudia vareai. Momokani, egu aneru ese baine gunalaimui. Ḡau tamona, egu hahemaoro dinana baine kau ai, edia dika davadia do baina henidia.
EXO.32.34.english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

EXO.4.12.motu: Taunibunai, oi baola, lau be udumu ai baina noho, ba gwaurai herevadia baina henimu.
EXO.4.12.english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

EXO.29.41.motu: Mamoe natuna iharuana na adorahi ai ba gabua, bona ia ida flaoa boubouna bona inuinu danu ba heni. Ina na bonana namo ḡauna, ḡole-oho boubouna, Iehova ena.
EXO.29.41.english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

EXO.34.34.motu: A Iehova ihereva-henina totona e raka vareai negadia ai, Mose ese dabua na vairana amo e kokia oho. Bena e raka lasi negadia ai, ia ese e kamonai haheḡanidia na Israel taudia e gwaurai henidia.
EXO.34.34.english: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

EXO.31.16.motu: Israel taudia ese Dina Helaḡa bae matauraia uru idoidaia; ia na baine mia hanaihanai herohemainona toana.
EXO.31.16.english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

EXO.21.22.motu: Tatau edia heatu ai rogorogo hahinena ta bae haberoa, bena hahine baine mara dika, natuna baine dika to ia be baine namo, adavana ese e haberoa tauna baine habadelaia, bena hahemaoro taudia bae hereva, moni hida ia ese hahine adavana baine henia.
EXO.21.22.english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

EXO.33.15.motu: Mose ma eto, Basioma bamogu, ini amo basioma siaimai.
EXO.33.15.english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

EXO.25.35.motu: Rigi rua rua amo danu buredia ta ta ba koro: rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigi bure ta, rigidia henudia kahadia ai.
EXO.25.35.english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

EXO.32.4.motu: Bena ia ese edia gold ḡaudia e abi, iboudiai e havevedia kubou; bena e koroa, boromakau natuna laulauna e karaia. Bena idia eto, Israel e, emui dirava binai, Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi diravana.
EXO.32.4.english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

EXO.35.30.motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, Iehova ese Besalele, Uri natuna, Huru tubuna, Iuda iduhuna tauna, vada e abia hidi.
EXO.35.30.english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

EXO.39.39.motu: ihaboulaina patana, auri labora-labora ḡauna, mai iha-aukana auri labora-laborana, bona mai ena maduna, bona mai kohuna idoinai; hurihuri dihuna ai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida;
EXO.39.39.english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

EXO.23.17.motu: Laḡani ta lalonai emu mamaruane iboudiai na nega toi Ḡaubada Iehova vairanai bae hedinarai.
EXO.23.17.english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

EXO.3.20.motu: Taunabunai lau na imagu do baina toia roro, egu hoa karadia amo Aigupto taudia baina hadareredia; una murinai ia ese baine kahumui nege.
EXO.3.20.english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.

EXO.19.8.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai e haere hebou, eto, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena ai baia karaia. Bena Mose ese taunimanima edia haere na Iehova e hamaorolaia.
EXO.19.8.english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.”

EXO.9.30.motu: Ḡau tamona, lau dibagu oi bona oiemu hesiai taudia ese Dirava Iehova do basio matauraia.
EXO.9.30.english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”

EXO.16.9.motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e haduaia, eto, Israel hegogona idoinai ba hereva henidia, baoto “A raka kahira Iehova vairanai; badina be ia ese emui maumau herevadia vada e kamonai”.
EXO.16.9.english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

EXO.26.11.motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui auri labora-labora amo ba kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo ba hakapudia tao hesiriu, kalaga tamona ai bainela.
EXO.26.11.english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

EXO.28.17.motu: Nadi hururu-hururudia ere hani ba turi kau: ere ta ai sadio bona topasio bona barekete;
EXO.28.17.english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

EXO.34.27.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Ini hereva ba tore, badina be ini hereva amo lau na oi bona Israel taudia ida vada tame herohemaino.
EXO.34.27.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

EXO.34.35.motu: A Israel taudia na Mose vairana e itaia, kopina vada e hururu-hururu; taunabunai, mose na vvairana ma e ḡovaia ahu ela bona Iehova ihaere-henina totona e raka vareai lou.
EXO.34.35.english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

EXO.20.3.motu: Idau dirava ta basio abia lau vairagu ai.
EXO.20.3.english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

EXO.8.28.motu: Bena Farao eto, Baina kahumui nege; Iehova, emui Dirava, do ba boua tano ḡaḡaena ai; ḡau tamona dauha basiola, bona lau daigu ai ba ḡuriḡuri.
EXO.8.28.english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

EXO.20.26.motu: Ina danu: egu ihaboulaina patana na vadavada amo basio dae henia, ḡaḡaemu ai bae itamu na garina.
EXO.20.26.english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

EXO.36.36.motu: Ena ihua-ihua hani kela audia amo e kara, bona gold amo e ḡovadia. Gold igaudia danu e kara, bona silver hahelai-kau ḡaudia hani.
EXO.36.36.english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

EXO.21.7.motu: Tau ta ese natuna kekenina baine hoia, hesiai ai bainela, biaguna be basine kahua nege hesiai taudia mamaruanedia e kahudia negemu heḡereḡerena.
EXO.21.7.english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

EXO.34.10.motu: Iehova eto, A kamonai, aita herohemaino. Emu orea taudia iboudiai vairadiai hoa karadia baina kara, tanobada idoinai bese idau-idau bogaragidiai asie hedinaraiva karadia; bogaragidiai o nohomu oreadia iboudiai na Iehova ena kara bae itaia, badina be daimui ai baina kara karadia na mai garidia.
EXO.34.10.english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

EXO.8.31.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ena noinoi heḡereḡerena e karaia: lao momo be Farao ena amo bona hesiai taudia edia amo bona ena orea taudia edia amo e abi oho, ta se miava.
EXO.8.31.english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

EXO.26.36.motu: Kalaga iduarana seseahuna danu dabua aukana bona namona amo ba karaia, dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana, bona ihaheralaina danu bae turi.
EXO.26.36.english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

EXO.10.24.motu: Bena Farao ese Mose e boiria, eto, Vada aola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, ḡau tamona emui mamoe seridia bona emui boromakau seridia ba rakatanidia, natumui mo ba hakaudia lao.
EXO.10.24.english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

EXO.37.24.motu: Hari lamepa patana mai kohuna idoinai ikaralaina gold-na ena metau be talent ta.
EXO.37.24.english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

EXO.29.38.motu: Boubou ḡaudia ihaboulaina patana ai ba gabu, bena bae ḡole oho, ḡaudia bini: mamoe natudia rua, laḡani ta do asie haḡuḡurua ḡaudia, dina ta ta amo ba gabu;
EXO.29.38.english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

EXO.19.16.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, daba kahana ai, guba e rahua bona kevaru e kevaru isi, bona badana ta ororo dorina ai e kau. Bena kibi ta reḡena e kamonai, reḡena na bada herea: taruha taudia iboudiai na kudoudia e hetaha.
EXO.19.16.english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

EXO.24.7.motu: Bena ia ese taravatu bukana e abia, Israel taudiavairadiai e duahia hedinarai. Bena idia eto, Iehova ena hereva iboudiai baia kamonai henidia, bona ena taravatu baia badinadia.
EXO.24.7.english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

EXO.19.22.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia ese danu Iehova do basie raka henia kahi; sibodia bae hahelaḡa guna, Iehova ese ediai baine hedinarai taku na garina.
EXO.19.22.english: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”

EXO.5.2.motu: A Farao eto, Iehova be daika? Ia erena baina kamonai, Israel taudia baina kahudia nege, badina be dehaka? Iehova na asi dibagu; Israel taudia danu basina kahudia nege.
EXO.5.2.english: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

EXO.20.19.motu: Mose e hereva henia, eto, Oi ba hereva henimai, bena baia kamonai henimu; a Dirava basine hereva henimai, baia mase na garina.
EXO.20.19.english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

EXO.37.3.motu: Ring hani na gold amo e kara, maua daigunina haniosi ai e koko kau, kahana ai rua kahana ai rua.
EXO.37.3.english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

EXO.4.6.motu: Iehova ese ma e haduaia, eto, Imamu na emu hahedoki lalonai a toia vareai. Ia ese imana ena hahedoki ai e toia vareai; bena e veria lasi negana ai imana na kuroka-kuroka, lepra tauna imana na heto.
EXO.4.6.english: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.”

EXO.38.30.motu: Ina auri labora-labora amo hebou kalagana iduarana ena hahelai-kau ḡaudia e kara, bona ihaboulaina patana, bona ihaboulaina patana iha-aukana ḡauna, bona ihaboulaina patana kohudia iboudiai;
EXO.38.30.english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

EXO.22.16.motu: Tau ta be hane-ulato rami-hebou, asi imaohenina, ida bae eno bou, ia ese baine adavaia, bona davana baine heni.
EXO.22.16.english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

EXO.29.1.motu: Ini ba hahelaḡadia toma, bena egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela. Boromakau natuna maruanena ta bona mamoe mamaruanedia rua, asi bebeka-bebekadia, bavabidia.
EXO.29.1.english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

EXO.33.13.motu: Taunabunai, na noimumu, boma lalo namo henigu, emu dala boma hadibalaigu, bama diba oi, emu lalo-namo danu bama diba. Boma laloa danu, ina bese na oiemu orea.
EXO.33.13.english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

EXO.23.4.motu: Inaimu ena boromakau eiava ena doniki baine heau boio bena oi ese ba davaria, ba hakaua lou lao ia dekenai.
EXO.23.4.english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

EXO.19.24.motu: Iehova ma eto, A hekei, bena Aaron ida ma ba dara dae; a hahelaḡa taudia bona taunimanima kavakavadia na basie didi dara Iehova enai, ia ese idia ediai baine hedinarai taku na garina.
EXO.19.24.english: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”

EXO.6.12.motu: A Mose ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Mani a laloa, Israel taudia asie kamonai henigumu; hari Farao ese bibinagu na e metaumu taugu ede baine kamonai henigu toma?
EXO.6.12.english: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

EXO.28.31.motu: Hahedoki badana na dabua vaiuri amo ba karaia.
EXO.28.31.english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

EXO.33.5.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto “Umui na lalo-auka taumui; nega kwadogi-kwadogi mo bama vasi, bama habuamui tari. Taunabunai, emui herahera ḡaudia ba kokidia oho, bena baina diba ede baina karamui toma”.
EXO.33.5.english: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

EXO.13.3.motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Ina dina ba laloa tao, badina be hari dina ai Aigupto amo, iḡui rumana amo, vada o raka lasi; Iehova imana goadana ese ina gabu amo vada e hakaumui lasi. E hatubua flaoana na basio ania.
EXO.13.3.english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

EXO.40.30.motu: Bena ihaboulaina patana bona hebou kalagana padadiai ia ese hurihuri dihuna e atoa, bona ranu e seia,
EXO.40.30.english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

EXO.10.7.motu: Bena Farao ena hesiai taudia ese e hereva henia, eto, Ina tau ese baine hahekwakwanaida ela bona edena nega ai? Tatau be ba kahudia nege, baela, Iehova edia Dirava bae toma henia diho. Asi dibamu Aigupto vada e dika vaitani a?
EXO.10.7.english: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

EXO.29.19.motu: Mamoe maruanena iharuana bavabia, Aaron mai natuna ida imadia na ia kwarana ai bae atodia kau.
EXO.29.19.english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

EXO.12.38.motu: Orea idau-idau taudia hutuma ese e bamodia; edia mamoe seridia bona edia boromakau seridia danu momo herea.
EXO.12.38.english: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

EXO.19.7.motu: Bena Mose na ema, Israel tau-badadia e boiridia, Iehova ena haheḡani herevadia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
EXO.19.7.english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.

EXO.31.15.motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai ba ḡaukara, a dina ihahituna na Dina Helaḡa, laḡa-ani dinana; vada e helaḡa vaitani, Iehova ena. Dina Helaḡa, laḡa-ani dinana; vada e helaḡa vaitani, Iehova ena. Dina Helaḡa ai baine ḡaukara tauna na bae alaia mase.
EXO.31.15.english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

EXO.16.18.motu: to e hahetohoa negana ai e abi badabada tauna na asi bahuna, bona e abi gadoi tauna na se dabu; ta ta ena hitolo ena hitolo heḡereḡeredia e abi.
EXO.16.18.english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

EXO.35.20.motu: Bena Israel hegogona idoinai e didi karoho, Mose vairana amo e raka oho.
EXO.35.20.english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

EXO.25.28.motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo ba kara, bona gold amo ba ḡovadia, pata ihualaina.
EXO.25.28.english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

EXO.27.6.motu: Maduna audia danu ba kara, ihaboulaina patana ena; kela audia amo ba kara, bona auri labora-labora amo ba ḡovadia.
EXO.27.6.english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

EXO.29.35.motu: Ini kara iboudiai na Aaron mai natuna ida ba kara henidia, egu hahedua heḡereḡerena; dina hitu lalodiai ihahelaḡadia karadia bae hesiriu.
EXO.29.35.english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

EXO.9.10.motu: Bena idia ese lahi kahuna e abia, Farao vairanai e gini; bena Mose ese e tahoa dae, bena iohururu e vara bona e toto, taunimanima kopidia ai bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai kopidia ai.
EXO.9.10.english: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

EXO.33.10.motu: Taruha taudia ese ori e itaia negadia ai na iboudiai e goru goru diho, ta ta ena kalaga iduarana ena kalaga iduarana ai.
EXO.33.10.english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

EXO.36.23.motu: Hari dubu habana kahadia iboudiai na ini e haginidia toma: diho kahana ai kaha ruahui e haginidia.
EXO.36.23.english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

EXO.29.11.motu: bena boromakau na Iehova vairanai bavalaia, hebou kalagana iduarana badibadinai. ?
EXO.29.11.english: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.34.13.motu: Edia ihaboulaina patadia ba ḡiḡi rohoroho; edia kaivakuku ba hamakohidia; edia dubu ba tara patapata;
EXO.34.13.english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

EXO.17.14.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Ina hereva na buka ta ai ba torea, taunimanima bae laloa tao helaoreana; bona Iosua ba hadibaia, lau na Amalek sivaraina ihelalolaina na baina haboioa, tanobada ai baine boio vaitani.
EXO.17.14.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

EXO.15.11.motu: Iehova e, dirava loḡora bogaragidiai oi heḡereḡeremu be daika?
EXO.15.11.english: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods?

EXO.32.29.motu: Bena Mose eto, Hari dina ai umui na sibomui vada o hahelaḡa, Iehova ena hesiai taumui; natumui bona tadikakamui na boubou ḡaudia ai vada o halaodia. Iehova ena hahenamo na latamui ai hari ina dina ai.
EXO.32.29.english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

EXO.38.16.motu: Hari dabua iboudiai be dabua namodia bona aukadia.
EXO.38.16.english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

EXO.4.16.motu: Ia ese oiemu hereva taunimanima baine hamaorolaidia; ia na oi udumu ai bainela, oi be Dirava heḡereḡerena ai baola ienai.
EXO.4.16.english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

EXO.34.25.motu: Egu ihaboulaina rarana na flaoa ihatubuna muramurana ida basio bulodia. Lagau-hanai Ariana bahuna na basine mia rani.
EXO.34.25.english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

EXO.18.26.motu: Dina iboudiai idia ese taunimanima e hahemaoro henidia; hereva aukadia be Mose vairanai e gwaurai, a hereva maraḡidia na sibodia e haero.
EXO.18.26.english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

EXO.12.46.motu: Ruma lalonai bavania; hidiona taina basio laohaia murimuri ai, bona turiana ta basio hakwaidua.
EXO.12.46.english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

EXO.9.2.motu: Badina be boma rudia, doene boma dogodia tao,
EXO.9.2.english: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

EXO.17.13.motu: Unu amo Iosua ese Amalek mai ena orea taudia ida e hadareredia, dare matana amo.
EXO.17.13.english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

EXO.36.24.motu: Hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui silver amo e kara; bena hahelai-kau ḡaudia rua rua kaha ta ta henudiai e atodia bona e kokodia tao.
EXO.36.24.english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

EXO.12.33.motu: Aigupto taudia ese danu e haduadia goadagoada, edia tano amo bae raka lasi haraḡa-haraḡa eto. Badina be idia eto, Ai iboumai ai baia mase na garina.
EXO.12.33.english: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

EXO.5.21.motu: Bena idia ese raruosi e gwau henidia, eto, Iehova ese baine he-geremui bona baine hahemaoro henimui; badina be Farao bona ena hesiai taudia vairadiai ladamai vada o hadika, e kara ialalaimai darena imadia ai vada o atoa na heto.
EXO.5.21.english: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

EXO.35.19.motu: gabu helaḡana dabuadia mai heraheradia ida, bona Aaron, hahelaḡa tauna, ena dabua helaḡadia, bona ia natuna hahelaḡa karadia bae kara negadia ai bae doki dabuadia.
EXO.35.19.english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

EXO.29.36.motu: Dina ta ta ai boubou boromakauna ta bavalaia, kara dika itahunina ḡauna; kara dika iabi-ohona boubouna ta danu ba karaia, ihaboulaina patana ena; ba horoa bona ba hahelaḡaia.
EXO.29.36.english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

EXO.6.15.motu: Simeon natuna bini: Iemuel bona Iamin bona Ohad bona Iakin bona Sohara bona Kanaan hahinena natuna Saul. Simeon ena iduhu bunai.
EXO.6.15.english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

EXO.19.4.motu: “Aigupto taudia ede na karadia toma vada o itaia, dibamui danu ede na abimui toma, ugava hanidia latadiai na heto, bena na hakaumui mai dekegu ai.
EXO.19.4.english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

EXO.12.22.motu: Muramura avana iḡuina bavabia, rara dihuna ai ba urua diho, iduara ihua-ihuama kahana kahana audia bona iduara daena auna na dihu rarana amo ba dahudia; bena atu ta ena ruma iduarana amo basine raka lasi ela bona daba.
EXO.12.22.english: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

EXO.30.26.motu: Ina dehoro amo hebou kalagana ba nevaria; bona taravatu mauana ba nevaria,
EXO.30.26.english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

EXO.39.2.motu: Hahedoki helaḡana e karaia, gold bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia.
EXO.39.2.english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

EXO.7.3.motu: A Farao lalona baina ha-aukaia; ena be toa bona hoa karadia baina hahohodia Aigupto tanona ai,
EXO.7.3.english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

EXO.21.10.motu: Bema hahine ta ma baine abia, ia ese hahine gunana ana aniani bona ena dabua ihenina basine hamaraḡi, bona basine hadihoa.
EXO.21.10.english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

EXO.32.25.motu: Mose ese taunimanima e itadia, vada e heloḡo-heloḡova; badina be Aaron ese vada e kahudia nege bae heloḡo-heloḡo, inaidia vairadiai bae hemarai helaoreana.
EXO.32.25.english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

EXO.3.11.motu: Bena Mose ese Dirava e haere henia, eto, Lau be daika Farao dekena bainala bona Israel taudia Aigupto amo baina hakaudia lasi?
EXO.3.11.english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”

EXO.8.12.motu: Taunabunai, Mose bona Aaron ese Farao e rakatania, e raka lasi. Bena Mose ese Iehova e noia, hari parapara, Farao e hadikalaiava ḡaudia, herevadia e gwaurai.
EXO.8.12.english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

EXO.12.27.motu: umui ba haere, baoto “Ina na Iehova ena lagau-hanai boubou karana; Aigupto ai ia ese Israel taudia edia ruma e lagaudia hanai, Aigupto taudia mo e aladia mase, eda iduhu iboudiai e hamauridia”. Bena taunimanima iboudiai e igo diho, e toma diho, e toma diho.
EXO.12.27.english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’”

EXO.21.8.motu: Bema biaguna ese baine adavaia bena basine ura henia, hahine varavarana ese ma bae davalaia bena bae abia lou. Basine hoia diba idau taudia ediai, badina be ia ese vada e dadaraia.
EXO.21.8.english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

EXO.23.30.motu: Metaira-metaira baina luludia lasi, ela bona umui na ba hutuma, bena tano bavabia emui.
EXO.23.30.english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

EXO.37.10.motu: Pata ta danu kela audia amo e karaia; latana na kiubit rua, lababana na kiubit ta, harana ena lata na kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.37.10.english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

EXO.13.9.motu: Ia na toa ta ai bainela imamu ai, bona helalo-tao ḡauna ai bainela bagumu ai, Iehova ena taravatu udumu ai baine mia helaoreana. Badina be Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto amo e hakaumu lasi;
EXO.13.9.english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt.

EXO.4.28.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e siailai herevadia bona e hahedualai toadia na Mose ese Aaron e hamaorolaia.
EXO.4.28.english: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.

EXO.8.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e haduaia, eto, Farao dekena aola, ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu orea taudia a kahudia nege, baela, bae toma henigu diho;
EXO.8.1.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

EXO.27.12.motu: Lahara kahana ai, maḡu lababana na kiubit imahui; du bae gwauta, badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae gwauta.
EXO.27.12.english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

EXO.9.3.motu: lau Iehova imagu na emu seri taora ai e nohomu latadiai baine kau, hosi latadiai bona doniki latadiai bona kamelo latadiai bona boromakau latadiai bona mamoe latadiai: gorere dikana ediai baine kau.
EXO.9.3.english: behold, Yahweh’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

EXO.27.17.motu: Maḡu duna iboudiai na silver amo ba haheralaidia, bona edia igau na silver amo ba kara. A du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia be auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
EXO.27.17.english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

EXO.30.14.motu: Ladadia bae tore tataudia iboudiai, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, una herahia ḡauna Iehova bae henia.
EXO.30.14.english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

EXO.8.10.motu: Ia eto, Kerukeru. Bena Mose eto, Emu hereva heḡereḡerena baine hekara; bena vada ba diba, Iehova, ai amai Dirava, na asi idaina.

EXO.2.12.motu: Ia na e roha roha, tau ta se itaia; bena ia ese Aigupto tauna e alaia mase, tauna na raria ai e hunia.
EXO.2.12.english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

EXO.39.23.motu: mai matuna bogaraginai, kwara gabuna, e karaia; matuna isena danu e turia, vaia hahedoki isedia e turimu heḡereḡerena, bae hedare na garina.
EXO.39.23.english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

EXO.31.11.motu: bona ihorodia dehorona, bona muramura mai bonadia, gabu helaḡana ena. Na haḡanilaimu ḡaudia iboudiai na idia ese bae kara.
EXO.31.11.english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

EXO.35.32.motu: ḡau namo-hereadia ikaradia daladia baine haero, gold amo bona silver amo bona auri labora-labora amo baine kara.
EXO.35.32.english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

EXO.22.26.motu: Dekemu tauna ena dabua bavabia, ena abi-torehai toana, dina do basine diho ai ba henia lou;
EXO.22.26.english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

EXO.27.3.motu: Kahuna iudalaina urodia bona ikado-laina gagana bona dihu bona kahi bona rahurahu na iboudiai auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
EXO.27.3.english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

EXO.21.33.motu: Tau ta ese guri ta hekehona ai baine rakatania, eiava guri baine ḡeia, bena basine koua ahu, bena boromakau ta eiava doniki ta una guri lalonai baine moru dobi,
EXO.21.33.english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

EXO.19.2.motu: Refidim e rakatania negana ai, idia na Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai e kau: bena tano ḡaḡaena ai e taruha, ororo badi-tanona ai. Unuseni ai Israel e taruha.
EXO.19.2.english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

EXO.32.12.motu: Namona be dahaka Aigupto taudia baeto “Ia ese dala dikana amo e hakaudia lasi, ororo ai e aladia mase, tanobada kopina amo e habuadia tari”. Emu badu amo ba raka siri, bona emu orea taudia ialadia amo ba helalo kerehai.
EXO.32.12.english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

EXO.2.18.motu: Bena tamadia Reuele dekena e lou lao negana ai ia ese e nanadaidia, eto Edeheto hari dina ai vada o lou mai haraḡa?
EXO.2.18.english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

EXO.13.8.motu: Una dina ai natumu do ba hamaoroa, baoto, “Ina na Iehova ese e kahagu Aigupto amo e hakaugu lasi negana dainai”.
EXO.13.8.english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

EXO.30.16.motu: Ina kara dika itahundia monina na Israel taudia ediai bavabia, hebou kalagana monina ai ba halaoa: ia na helalo-tao ḡauna ai bainela Israel taudia edia, Iehova vairanai, bona emui kara dika itahunidia ḡauna ai bainela.
EXO.30.16.english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”

EXO.35.31.motu: Dirava ena Lauma ese vada e rohea, lalo-parara bona aonega vada e henia, bona ima karakara daladia idau-idau vada e hadibaia;
EXO.35.31.english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

EXO.8.5.motu: Iehova ese Mose me e hamaoroa, eto, Aaron ba haduaia, baoto “Emu itotohi imamu ai bavabia, ba toia roro sinavai badadia bona maraḡidia bona gohu daediai, parapara ba hadaedia Aigupto tanona idoinai”.
EXO.8.5.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

EXO.24.12.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Lau dekegu ai ba dara dae, ororo ai ba narigu; lau be hro-nadidia palakadia baina henimu, ini nadi ai taravatu bona haheḡani vada na tore, taunimanima ihadibaladia.
EXO.24.12.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

EXO.5.5.motu: Farao ma eto, Momokani, ina tano taudia vada e hutuma e laomu, a umui na ḡaukara ai o rudiamu.
EXO.5.5.english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”

EXO.30.21.motu: imadia bona aedia bae huri, bae mase garina. Mia-hanaihanai haheḡanina binai, idia edia, Aaron mai rarana ida edia, ela uru idoidiai.
EXO.30.21.english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

EXO.26.21.motu: mai silver hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai-kau ḡaudia rua rua amo ba kokodia.
EXO.26.21.english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

EXO.18.2.motu: Bena Mose ese adavana e siaia oho murinai, Mose ravana, Ietero, ese Mose adavana, Sipora, e abia,
EXO.18.2.english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

EXO.18.25.motu: Israel idoinai ai tatau namodia e abidia hidi, bese ikwaradia taudia ai e halaodia, daha daha lohiadia, sinahu sinahu lohiadia, imahui imahui lohiadia, bona gwauta gwauta lohiadia.
EXO.18.25.english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

EXO.16.22.motu: Dina ihatauratoina, idia ese dina rua anianidia e habou, taunimanima ta ta nau rua rua e abi: bena hebou igunalaina taudia iboudiai ela, Mose e hamaorolaia.
EXO.16.22.english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

EXO.30.8.motu: Adorahi iboudiai danu, lamepa baine ha-ara negana ai, ma baine gabu lou; unu amo bona namodia bae dae hanaihanai Iehova vairanai, ela uru idoidiai.
EXO.30.8.english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

EXO.13.16.motu: Ia na toa ai bainela imamu ai bona bagumu ai: badina be Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto ese Aigupto amo vada e hakauda lasi.
EXO.13.16.english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”

EXO.28.2.motu: Kakamu Aaron ena dabua helaḡadia danu ba kara, mai toana bona mai hairaina ida baine noho helaoreana.
EXO.28.2.english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

EXO.23.23.motu: Egu aneru na oi vairamu ai bainela, Amoro taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, bena lau ese baina habuadia tari.
EXO.23.23.english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

EXO.14.5.motu: Una negana ai haida ese Aigupto pavapavana e hamaoroa Israel taudia vada e heau; bena Farao mai ena hesiai taudia ida e halalo, lalodia ma e idau Israel taudia ediai. Idia eto “Israel taudia ta kahudia nege, isiaida ilao-henina ai bae doko, anina be dahaka?”
EXO.14.5.english: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

EXO.7.12.motu: Badina be ta ta ese edia itotohi e nege dobi, bena gaigai ai ela. A Aaron ena itotohi ese idia edia itotohi e hadonodia.
EXO.7.12.english: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

EXO.24.15.motu: Mose na ororo ai e dara e dara dae, bena ori ese ororo e ḡovaia ahu.
EXO.24.15.english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

EXO.13.13.motu: Bena doniki natuna roboana davana na mamoe natuna ba heni; eiava davana basio heni negana ai aiona ba hakwaidua. A taunimanima natudia roboadia iboudiai na davadia ba kara.
EXO.13.13.english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

EXO.15.4.motu: Farao ena kariota bona ena tuari oreana na davara ai vada e tahodia dobi,
EXO.15.4.english: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea.

EXO.14.22.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese tano kaukauna ai davara e rakaia hanai; davara ranuaia e kara haba na heheto, idibidia kahana ai bona lauridia kahana ai.
EXO.14.22.english: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

EXO.40.31.motu: Mose bona Aaron bona Aaron natuna imadia bona aedia ihurilaidia ranuna.
EXO.40.31.english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

EXO.25.11.motu: Lalona kahana gold amo ba lahasia, bona murina kahana gold amo ba ḡovaia, bona gold amo ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.25.11.english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

EXO.2.9.motu: Bena Farao natuna hahinena ese e haduaia, eto, Ina mero a laohaia, ba ubua lauegu; lau ese davana baina henimu. Bena hahine ese mero e abia, e laohaia, e ubua.
EXO.2.9.english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.”

EXO.17.10.motu: Bena Iosua ese Amalek e tuari henia, Mose ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. A Mose bona Aaron bona Huru na ororo dorina ela.
EXO.17.10.english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

EXO.30.5.motu: Maduna rua danu ba kara, kela audia amo, bona gold amo ba ḡovadia.
EXO.30.5.english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

EXO.34.21.motu: Dina tauratoi ba ḡaukara, a dina ihahituna ai laḡamui bavani; tano iruana negana ai bona taboro negana ai danu ba laḡa ani.
EXO.34.21.english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

EXO.14.15.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka dainai o tai henigumu? Israel taudia ba haduadia, bae raka lao.
EXO.14.15.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

EXO.33.19.motu: Ia eto, Egu namo idoinai baina haheitalaimu, bona lau ladagu IEHOVA oi vairamu ai baina gwauraia. Baina harihari henidia na tomu taudia vada baina harihari henidia, bona baina bogadia hisi na tomu taudia vada baina bogadia hisi.
EXO.33.19.english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

EXO.29.15.motu: Una murinai mamoe maruanena ta bavabia, Aaron mai natuna ida imadia na ia kwarana ai bae atodia kau.
EXO.29.15.english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

EXO.2.13.motu: Kerukeru ma e raka lasi, Heberu taudia rarua e itadia, e heatu. Bena ia ese heatu e matamaia tauna e gwau henia, eto, Badina be dahaka oi ese bamomu o dadabaiamu?
EXO.2.13.english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”

EXO.19.18.motu: Una negana ai Sinai ororona na kwalahu ese e ḡovaia ahu, badina be Iehova na lahi ai e diho, ororo latani. Taunabunai, kwalahuna e dae badabada, amu kwalahuna na heto; ororo tanona idoinai danu e laga.
EXO.19.18.english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

EXO.14.18.motu: Bena Farao bona ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia baina hadareredia negana ai Aigupto taudia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
EXO.14.18.english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

EXO.38.9.motu: Dubu maḡuna danu e karaia. Diho kahana ai itautau dabuadia aukadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai kiubit sinahu-ta.
EXO.38.9.english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

EXO.11.10.motu: Mose bona Aaron ese unu hoa karadia iboudiai Farao vairanai e kara; a Iehova ese Farao lalona e ha-aukaia, taunabunai ia ese Israel taudia na ena tano amo se kahudia nege.
EXO.11.10.english: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.

EXO.35.10.motu: Bena karakara taudia iboudiai bae hebou, Iehova vada e haḡanilai ḡaudia iboudiai bae kara: dubu
EXO.35.10.english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

EXO.10.14.motu: Bena kwadi na Aigupto tanona idoinai e heḡiḡi rohoroho ela bona Aigupto tanona hetoana idoinai; idia na dika rohoroho. Kwadi unuhohodia na nega ta asie hedinarai ema bona una negana, ma unuhohodia na basie hedinarai lou.
EXO.10.14.english: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

EXO.33.23.motu: Bena imagu baina abia oho: dorugu vada ba itaia, a vairagu basio itaia.
EXO.33.23.english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

EXO.29.43.motu: Unuseni ai lau ese Israel taudia baina hahedinarai henidia, bona lau hairaiagu ese kalaga baine hahelaḡaia.
EXO.29.43.english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

EXO.22.28.motu: Dirava basio maumauraia, bona emu bese lohiana ta basio uduguiraia.
EXO.22.28.english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

EXO.39.10.motu: Nadi hururu-hururudia ere hani e turi kau: ere ta ai sadio bona topasio bona barekete,
EXO.39.10.english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

EXO.4.5.motu: Bena bae diba Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, Abraham ena Dirava, Isaak ena Dirava, Iakob ena Dirava, ese vada e hahedinarai henimu.
EXO.4.5.english: “This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”

EXO.36.18.motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui auri labora-labora amo e kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo e hakapudia tao hesiriu, kalaga tamona ai e halaoa.
EXO.36.18.english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

EXO.15.8.motu: Hurehure o hahodi heni, bena e hahebou,
EXO.15.8.english: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up.

EXO.26.17.motu: Hari kaha ta ta be ikoko rua rua amo bae koko hesiriu; dubu habana kahadia iboudiai kaha rua rua amo unu bae koko hesiriu toma.
EXO.26.17.english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

EXO.11.6.motu: Aigupto tanona idoinai tai badana baine vara; nega ta unu asie tai toma ema bona hari, bona ina murinai danu unu basie tai toma.
EXO.11.6.english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

EXO.34.28.motu: Dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui ia na Iehova ida e nohova unuseni ai, aniani se ania bona ranu se inua. Una negana ai ia ese hari herohemaino herevadia na huro-nadidia palakadia ai e tore: taravatu gwautaosi.
EXO.34.28.english: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

EXO.40.6.motu: Ihaboulaina patana na dubu vairanai bavatoa, hebou kalagana lalonai;
EXO.40.6.english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.26.18.motu: Hari kaha iboudiai na ini ba haginidia toma: diho kahana ai kaha ruahui;
EXO.26.18.english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

EXO.40.4.motu: Pata helaḡana danu lalonai bavatoa, mai kohuna idoinai, ḡau ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai. Lamepa patana danu lalonai bavatoa; bona ena lamepa ba ha-ara.
EXO.40.4.english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

EXO.36.6.motu: Taunabunai, Mose na e haheḡani, bona ena haheḡani vada e hapiua taruha idoinai; eto, Tau ta eiava hahine ta herahia ḡauna ta basine mailaia, dubu ena. Taunabunai, taunimanima ese herehia ihenina e hadokoa;
EXO.36.6.english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

EXO.4.15.motu: Oi ese ba hereva henia, ia uduna herevadia ba henia; a lau be oi udumu ai bona ia uduna ai baina noho, raruosi baina hadibamui ede ba kara toma.
EXO.4.15.english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

EXO.4.10.motu: Mose ese Iehova ma e hereva henia, eto, Egu Ḡaubada e, lau na hereva ai malagu seme haraḡa, gunaguna, bona harihari oi ome hereva henigu negana ai danu; badina be lau na hereva manau taugu, malagu danu se haraḡamu.
EXO.4.10.english: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

EXO.13.22.motu: Bena hari ori dubuna asine rakatanidiava dina ai, bona lahi mamana asine rakatanidiava hanuaboi ai.
EXO.13.22.english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

EXO.20.24.motu: Ihaboulaina patana na tano amo ba larebaia, ia latanai emu boubou ḡaudia, heḡole-oho ḡaudia bona herohemaino ḡaudia, mamoe bona boromakau, ba henigu. lau ladagu ilalolaina vada na atoa gabudia iboudiai lau baina vasi bona baina henamomu.
EXO.20.24.english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

EXO.23.5.motu: Inaimu ena doniki ba itaia, ena maduna matauna dainai e goru dihomu, ba durua; ena be iduruna so uramu, to ba durua.
EXO.23.5.english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

EXO.38.17.motu: Du edia hahelai-kau ḡaudia be auri labora-labora; edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver. Hari du kwaradia na silver amo e ḡovadia, bona du be silver amo e kapadia heḡeḡe.
EXO.38.17.english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

EXO.1.22.motu: Bena Farao ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e haḡanidia, eto, Natudia mamaruanedia na sinavai ai ba negedia, a kekeni na bae mauri.
EXO.1.22.english: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.”

EXO.13.12.motu: una negana ai roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai ba hididia, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia danu; maruane iboudiai bae helaḡa, Iehova ena.
EXO.13.12.english: that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be Yahweh’s.

EXO.26.37.motu: Seseahu ena ihua-ihua bae ima; kela audia amo ba kara, bona gold amo ba ḡovadia. Edia igau na gold amo ba kara, a hahelai-kau ḡaudia imaosi na auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
EXO.26.37.english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

EXO.30.6.motu: Taravatu mauana bona e karuhia ahu ikaruhina, taravatu nadidia e karuhidia ahu ḡauna, baina hahedinarai henimu gabuna, seseahuna vairanai, bavatoa.
EXO.30.6.english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

EXO.36.5.motu: Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Taunimanima edia herahia na Iehova ena hahedua ḡaukaradia vada e davana vaitani bona vada e hanaia danu.
EXO.36.5.english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”

EXO.20.1.english: God spoke all these words, saying,

EXO.35.21.motu: Bena taigadia nanamo taudia na laumadia ese e hagoadadia heḡereḡerena ta ta ena herahia ena herahia e mailai, Iehova ena, hebou kalagana ḡaudia bona kohudia bona dabua helaḡadia ikaralaidia ḡaudia.
EXO.35.21.english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

EXO.10.21.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Imamu ba duduia isi, bena dibura ese Aigupto tanona idoinai baine gorua ahu; idia ese dibura bae mamia toho.
EXO.10.21.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

EXO.1.1.motu: Israel natuna Aigupto ela taudia bini, idia na ta ta edia ruma taudia ida Iakob e bamoa ela.
EXO.1.1.english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel, who came into Egypt (every man and his household came with Jacob):

EXO.7.4.motu: to Farao basine kamonai henimui. Taunabunai lau ese imagu Aigupto latanai baina atoa kau, bena egu orea, egu bese, Israel taudia, Aigupto tanona amo baina hakaudia lasi, mai hahemaoro karadia badadia ida.
EXO.7.4.english: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

EXO.24.14.motu: Ia ese Israel tau-badidia e haduadia, eto, Iniseni ai ba noho, ela bona ai baia lou mai dekemui ai. hari Aaron bona Huru na dekemui ai nonoho; tau ta hahemaoro baine ura negana ai, ia na idia raruosi dekedia bainela.
EXO.24.14.english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

EXO.4.4.motu: A Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Imamu a toia roro, iuna ai avabi. (Taunabunai, ia ese imana e toia roro, e abia, bena itotohi ai ma ela ia imana ai.)
EXO.4.4.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.”

EXO.4.17.motu: Hari itotohi danu imamu ai bavabia, toa ba karalaia.
EXO.4.17.english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

EXO.23.31.motu: Emu tano hetoadia baina kara, Davara Kakakakana amo ela bona Filistia taudia edia davara, bona tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Eufrate sinavaina: badina be umu tano taudia oi imamu ai baina atodia, oi vairamu ai do ba luludia lasi.
EXO.23.31.english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

EXO.8.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e kamonai henia; bena ruma ai bona ariara ai bona uma ai parapara e mase ore.
EXO.8.13.english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

EXO.34.7.motu: Daha daha na bogadia hisimu; kara-havara bona kara rea bona kara-dika na gwau taomu. Ḡau tamona, kerere taudia basina kahudia nege, a tamadia edia kara dika davadia na natudia baina henidia, bona tubudia baina henidia, ela uru ihatoina bona ihahanina danu.
EXO.34.7.english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

EXO.4.30.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoro-laia herevadia iboudiai Aaron ese e gwaurai hedinarai, bona hari hari toa danu Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai e kara.
EXO.4.30.english: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

EXO.15.1.motu: Bena Mose bona Israel taudia na ina ane e abia, Iehova ena; eto,
EXO.15.1.english: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said,

EXO.39.9.motu: Latana bona lababana na heḡereḡere, bona e ha-ere ruaia; latana bona lababana na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.9.english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

EXO.9.4.motu: Lau Iehova ese Israel edia seri bona Aigupto edia seri baina hididia: Israel taudia edia ḡau ta basine mase”.
EXO.9.4.english: Yahweh will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

EXO.18.20.motu: Oi ese danu ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani ba hadibadia, edia raka daladia bona edia ḡaukara ba hadibalaidia.
EXO.18.20.english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

EXO.21.11.motu: A ini ḡau ai baine hadabua, ia na baine kahua nege, asi davana.
EXO.21.11.english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

EXO.13.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,

EXO.38.24.motu: Gold idoinai, taunimanima ese edia herahia ihenina ai e heni bena dubu ḡaukaradia idau-idau ai e ḡaukaralaia gold-na, ena metau be talent ruahui taurahani-ta sekele sinahu-hitu toi-ahui gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena.
EXO.38.24.english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

EXO.26.25.motu: Taunabunai, kaha bae taurahani bona silver hahelai-kau ḡaudia bae gwauta-tauratoi, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai=kau ḡaudia rua rua.
EXO.26.25.english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

EXO.32.28.motu: Bena Levi natuna ese Mose ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia, taunimanima daha-toi sisivana e aladia mase una dina ai.
EXO.32.28.english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

EXO.9.7.motu: Bena Farao ena hesiai taudia ese hereva e mailaia, Israel taudia edia seri ai ḡau ta se mase. A Farao ese lalona ma e ha-aukaia, Heberu taudia se kahudia nege.
EXO.9.7.english: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

EXO.33.9.motu: Badina be Mose na hebou kalagana ai e raka vareai negadia iboudiai, ori ta e diho, kalaga iduarana e sesea ahu, bena Iehova na Mose ida e hereva hereva.
EXO.33.9.english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.

EXO.35.7.motu: mamoe kopidia, e hakakakakadia ḡaudia, bona nani kopidia; kela audia;
EXO.35.7.english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

EXO.8.30.motu: Taunabunai Mose na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi, Iehova e ḡuria.
EXO.8.30.english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

EXO.29.3.motu: Bosea ai ba uda, ba laohai; boromakau natuna maruanena bona mamoe mamaruanedia ruaosi ida.
EXO.29.3.english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
