EXO.15.14.motu: Bese idau-idau na e kamonaimu, bena e garimu;

EXO.40.16.motu: Mose na unu e kara toma. Iehova ese haḡania heḡereḡerena, unu mo e kara toma.
EXO.40.16.english: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

EXO.16.17.motu: Bena Israel taudia na unu e kara toma. Haida e abi badabada, bona haida na sisidia mo e abi;
EXO.16.17.english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

EXO.35.34.motu: Siahu danu ia vada e henia, bona Oholiab, Ahisamaka natuna, Dan iduhuna tauna, danu vada e henia, raruosi ese haida ma bae hadibadia ini ḡaukara ai.
EXO.35.34.english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

EXO.25.3.motu: Bavabi dae ḡaudia bini: gold bona silver bona auri labora-labora;
EXO.25.3.english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

EXO.14.20.motu: Aigupto taudia edia taruha bona Israel taudia edia taruha padadiai eha gini. Bena ori na dibura ai e miava, to ia ese diari e henidia hanuaboi ai; bona una hanuaboi idoinai orea ta ese orea ta se raka henia kahi.
EXO.14.20.english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

EXO.29.39.motu: ta be daba ai ba gabua, ma ta adorahi ai.
EXO.29.39.english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

EXO.6.27.motu: Idia raruosi ese Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, e hereva henia, Israel taudia ihakaudia herevana e hamaorolaia, hari Aaron bona hari Mose ese.
EXO.6.27.english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

EXO.21.29.motu: To, bema una boromakau be nega haida unu vada e kara toma, nega gunadia ai, bona biaguna be mai dibana; bena biaguna basine koua kunuka-kunuka dainai tau ta eiava hahine ta ma baine doaia mase, boromakau na bae hodoa mase, bona biaguna danu bae alaia mase.
EXO.21.29.english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

EXO.40.33.motu: Bena maḡu dabuadia e tau dae heḡeḡe, dubu bona ihaboulaina patana e ḡeḡe ahu, bona e sesea ahu. Mose ena ḡaukara idoinai unu e haḡuḡurua toma.
EXO.40.33.english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

EXO.38.14.motu: ikoukou kahana ai itautau dabuadia edia lata na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi;
EXO.38.14.english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

EXO.7.2.motu: Baina haḡanilaimu herevadia iboudiai na ba gwaurai; kakamu Aaron ese Farao baine hamaoroa, ia ese Israel taudia do baine kahudia nege, ena tano amo bae raka lasi.
EXO.7.2.english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

EXO.35.2.motu: Dina taura-toi ba ḡaukara, a dina ihahituna na baine helaḡa emui ai, Dina Helaḡa bona laḡa-ani dinana ai bainela, Iehova ena; una dina ai baine ḡaukara tauna na bavalaia.
EXO.35.2.english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

EXO.38.2.motu: Doa hani e koro, pata daigunina haniosi ai; hari doa na pata ida au tamona amo e kara. Kopina idoinai na auri labora-labora amo e ḡovaia.
EXO.38.2.english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

EXO.39.21.motu: Bena vaina ring-dia bona hahedoki ring-dia e kwatu kubou, varo baiurina amo, bona gaba ḡauna ai danu e mata kau: unuhetomana vaina bona hahedoki na asie heruha, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.21.english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.13.7.motu: Unu dina hituosi lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana mo bavania; e hatubua flaoana na basine hedinarai dekemu ai, bona hatubu muramurana basine mia emu noho gabuna idoinai.
EXO.13.7.english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

EXO.5.13.motu: A ḡaukara biagudia e gwaugwau, eto, Dina ta ta ahudia ba haḡuḡuru, gunaguna uit momona a henimui negadia ai heḡereḡerena.
EXO.5.13.english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

EXO.12.3.motu: Israel taudia iboudiai edia hebou ai ba hereva henidia, ina hua dinana ihagwautana, ta ta ena iduhu ena iduhu ai mamoe natudia bae abidia, ruma ta mamoe natuna ta, unu bae abidia toma.
EXO.12.3.english: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

EXO.26.4.motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai, kunipa varo vaiurina amo ba kara; ma imaosi ta isena ai danu unu ba kara toma.
EXO.26.4.english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

EXO.13.4.motu: Hari ina dina ai ome raka lasi, hua ladana Abib ai.
EXO.13.4.english: Today you go out in the month Abib.

EXO.36.20.motu: Dubu habana kahadia na kela audia amo e kara.
EXO.36.20.english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

EXO.25.37.motu: Bena lamepa hitu ba kara, gabudia ai bavatodia, edia diari na pata vairana kahana bae hadiaria.
EXO.25.37.english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

EXO.4.7.motu: Dirava ma eto, Imamu na emu hahedoki lalonai ma a toia vareai lou. (Taunabunai, ia ese imana ma e toia vareai lou ena hahedoki ai, bena e veria lasi negana ai e itaia, vada e namo, kopina gunana heḡereḡerena.)
EXO.4.7.english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.”

EXO.37.12.motu: Digina danu e karaia, lababana na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena; ia danu gold amo e haheriaia heḡeḡe.
EXO.37.12.english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

EXO.15.2.motu: Iehova na egu goada bona egu ane,
EXO.15.2.english: Yah is my strength and song.

EXO.34.20.motu: Doniki natuna roboana davana na mamoe natuna ta ba henigu; a davana basioma karaia, aiona boma hakwaidua. Umui natumui roboa mamaruanedia danu davadia ba kara. Asi tauna ta ima kavakava ai baine hedinarai lau vairagu ai.
EXO.34.20.english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

EXO.8.20.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Daba vaburana ai ba tore isi, Farao ba naria, digu bainela negana ai, bena ba hereva henia, baoto “Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Egu orea taudia e kahudia nege, bae toma henigu diho.
EXO.8.20.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

EXO.32.31.motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e lou henia, eto, Ini taunimanima vada e kara havara, edia kaivakuku na gold amo vada e karaia.
EXO.32.31.english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

EXO.36.8.motu: Bena karakara taudia ese dubu dabuadia gwautaosi e kara, dabua aukadia bona namodia, vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia; ihaheralaidia be kerubi laulaudia e turi.
EXO.36.8.english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

EXO.36.10.motu: Dabua ima e siriudia, ma ima e siriudia.
EXO.36.10.english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

EXO.12.13.motu: Hari rara na toa ai bainela emui noho rumadia ai; rara baina itaia negana ai, baina lagaumui hanai hahedika ta emui ai basine kau, basine alamui, imagu na Aigupto ai baine kau negana ai.
EXO.12.13.english: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

EXO.20.20.motu: Bena Mose ese e hamaorodia, eto, Basio gari; badina be Dirava vada ema, baine dibamui totona, bena ia imatauraina dainai umui na basio kara dika.
EXO.20.20.english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

EXO.34.24.motu: Badina be lau na bese idau-idau baina luludia lasi umui vairamui ai, bona emui tano hetoadia baina habada; asi tauna ta ese danu emui tano baine hekise-hekise henia, umui na laḡani ta ta amo nega toi toi Iehova emui Dirava vairanai ba dara dae bona ba toma henia diho negadia ai.
EXO.34.24.english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.

EXO.28.19.motu: ere ihatoina ai huakinto bona akate bona ametuso;
EXO.28.19.english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

EXO.40.22.motu: Pata helaḡana na hebou kalagana ai e atoa, dubu mirigini kahana ai, seseahu murimurinai;
EXO.40.22.english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

EXO.32.2.motu: Bena Aaron ese e hamaorodia, eto, Gold badeidia na adavamui bona natumui taiadia amo ba koki oho, vada ba henigu.
EXO.32.2.english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

EXO.16.15.motu: Israel taudia ese una ḡau e itaia, bena e henanadai heheni, eto, Ia be dahaka? Badina be asi dibadia una ḡau. Bena Mose ese e hamaorodia, eto, Amui aniani benai, Iehova ese vada e henimui ḡauna.
EXO.16.15.english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.

EXO.16.4.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: lau na amui aniani guba amo baina hadihoa, medu na heto; dina ta ta ai taunimanima bae raka lasi, dina tamona ahuna bae haboua; unu amo baina dibadia, lauegu taravatu bae badina eiava lasi.
EXO.16.4.english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

EXO.3.17.motu: vada na gwau hamata danu, Aigupto hisihisidia amo baina hakaumui lasi, Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano ai baina hakaumui vareai, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona bunai”.
EXO.3.17.english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’

EXO.25.40.motu: Ba heita, ini ḡau ba kara hari ina ororo ai emu ai vada eme hedinarai heḡereḡerena.
EXO.25.40.english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

EXO.20.8.motu: Dina Helaḡa ba laloa, ba hahelaḡaia.
EXO.20.8.english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

EXO.23.33.motu: Emu tano ai basie noho, bae hahekwakwanaimu bena vairagu ai ba kara dika na garina; badina be edia dirava boma toma henidia diho, oi na boma hekwakwanai.
EXO.23.33.english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

EXO.4.22.motu: Bena Farao ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel be natugu roboana,
EXO.4.22.english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

EXO.14.27.motu: Bena Mose ese imana e toia roro daenai, bena daba matana ai davara ma e lou gabuna ai; bena Aigupto taudia na davara vairanai e heau. Unu amo Iehova ese Aigupto taudia e hadareredia, davara bogaraginai:
EXO.14.27.english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. Yahweh overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

EXO.38.26.motu: Beka ta ta na ladadia e tore taudia ta ta ese e heni; e heni taudia iboudiai na tatau domaga-tauratoi daha-toi sinahu-ima imahui, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia. Una beka be gabu helaḡana ena sekele kahana heḡereḡerena.
EXO.38.26.english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

EXO.40.27.motu: bona muramura mai bonadia ia latanai e gabu, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.40.27.english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.31.6.motu: Oholiab danu vada na abia hidi: ia na Ahisamaka natuna, Dan iduhuna tauna. Kara-kara taudia iboudiai danu lalodia vada na hapararadia, vada na haḡanilaimu ḡaudia iboudiai bae kara diba:
EXO.31.6.english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

EXO.23.18.motu: Egu ihaboulaina rarana na e hatubua flaoana ida basio atodia hebou; egu aria digarana na basine mia rani.
EXO.23.18.english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

EXO.5.15.motu: Bena Israel edia heitatao taudia na Farao dekena ela, e tai henia, eto, Dahaka dainai emu hesiai taudia ini o karamai tomamu?
EXO.5.15.english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

EXO.34.3.motu: Tau ta basine bamomu, bona tau ta basine hedinarai ororo dorina ai; bona mamoe seridia bona boromakau seridia basie aniani ororo badi-tanona ai.
EXO.34.3.english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

EXO.39.6.motu: Onuku nadidia e abi, nadi isedia na gold e moḡe ḡauna amo e kou heḡeḡe; bena nadi kopidia e ḡasidia, Israel natudia ladadia e tore.
EXO.39.6.english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

EXO.17.7.motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Masa bona Meriba, badina be Israel taudia e ḡadeḡade, bona Iehova e dibaḡania, eto “Iehova na dekedekeda ai eiva lasi?”
EXO.17.7.english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”

EXO.34.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, Huro-nadidia palakadia rua ma bavabi, gunadia heḡereḡeredia; bena revarevadia ma baina tore, gunadia ruaosi, o hamakohidia ḡaudia, revarevadia na tore heḡereḡerena.
EXO.34.1.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

EXO.38.11.motu: Mirigina kahana ai danu itautau dabuadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai na kiubit sinahu ta. Auri labora-labora dudia bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia na ruahui, mai silver igaudia bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia.
EXO.38.11.english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

EXO.38.20.motu: Dubu ikokodia bona maḡu ikokodia iboudiai na auri labora-labora ikokodia mo.
EXO.38.20.english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

EXO.25.6.motu: lamepa diaranuna bona muramura mai bonadia bona e gabu muramuradia;
EXO.25.6.english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

EXO.28.1.motu: Kakamu Aaron, mai natuna mamaruanedia ida, israel taudia bogaragidia amo ba hakaudia siri, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela helaoreana. Aaron mai natuna hahaniosi, Nadab bona Abihu bona Eleasara bona Itamara, unu bavabidia toma.
EXO.28.1.english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

EXO.7.17.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ma e tomu: Ini amo ba diba lau be Iehova; a itaia, Nilo sinavaina na ina imagu ai e miamu itotohina amo baina botaia, bena rara ai bainela;
EXO.7.17.english: Yahweh says, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

EXO.7.10.motu: Taunabunai, Mose bona Aaron na Farao dekena ela, Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia. Aaron ese ena itotohi e negea dobi, Farao bona ena hesiai taudia vairadiai, bena gaigai ai ela.
EXO.7.10.english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

EXO.7.19.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Aaron ba haduaia, baoto “Emu itotohi imamu ai bavabia, ba toia roro Aigupto ranudia daediai, bona edia sinavai badadia bona edia sinavai maraḡidia daediai, bona edia gohu daediai bona edia koupa iboudiai daediai, bena rara ai baela; Aigupto tanona idoinai rara mo baine mia, popou ai bona hodu ai”.
EXO.7.19.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

EXO.29.22.motu: Mamoe maruanena digarana bavabia, bona iuna digarana, bona bogarauna urubina, bona ase digarana, bona nadinadi mai digaradia ida, bona idiba mamuna; badina be ina na hahelaḡa mamoena.
EXO.29.22.english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

EXO.34.26.motu: Emui mua anidia roboadia na Iehova emui Dirava ena ruma ba laohai, boubou ḡaudia ai baela. Nani natuna na sinana ratana ai basio nadua.
EXO.34.26.english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God.

EXO.38.5.motu: Ring hani danu auri labora-labora amo e kara, hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana ena daiguni haniosi ai, maduna bae hetoi hanai totona.
EXO.38.5.english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

EXO.21.26.motu: Tau ta ese ena hesiai tauna eiava ena hesiai hahinena matana baine haberoa, bena baine kepulu, ia na baine kahua nege, matana davana.
EXO.21.26.english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

EXO.7.13.motu: A Farao lalona na dounu auka, ia ese se kamonai henidia, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
EXO.7.13.english: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

EXO.6.7.motu: Egu bese ai baina halaomui, bona emui Dirava ai bainala; vada ba diba, lau na Iehova, emui Dirava, Aigupto taudia edia maduna amo name hamaurimui Diravana
EXO.6.7.english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

EXO.26.1.motu: Dubu auta ba karaia egu: haba be dabua aukadia bona namodia gwauta amo ba kara, vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia; ihaheraladia be dibana tauna ese kerubi laulaudia baine turi.
EXO.26.1.english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

EXO.32.27.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena hahedua binai: unui ta ta ena dare ena dare bavabi, taruha ba rakaia hanai, tadikakamui bona turamui bona dekemui taudia bavaladia mase.
EXO.32.27.english: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

EXO.30.35.motu: Ba bulodia, muramura ikarana tauna korikori ese e karaimu heḡereḡerena; bena damena ida ma ba bulodia, baine ḡoevaḡoeva bona baine helaḡa.
EXO.30.35.english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

EXO.37.2.motu: Lalona kahana na gold amo e lahasia, bona murina kahana na gold amo e ḡovaia, bona gold amo e haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.37.2.english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

EXO.39.41.motu: gabu halaḡana dabuadia; Aaron mai natuna ida edia dabua helaḡadia, hahelaḡa karadia bae kara negadia ai bae doki ḡaudia.
EXO.39.41.english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

EXO.40.19.motu: Bena dubu na kalaga amo e koua heḡeḡe, bona guhi dabuana amo e ḡovaia ahu, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.40.19.english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.12.45.motu: A noho-kau tauna bona e ḡaukaramu mai davana tauna na basie ania.
EXO.12.45.english: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

EXO.39.15.motu: Gold varodia na vaina ai e turi kau.
EXO.39.15.english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

EXO.15.7.motu: Emu siahu herea-daena ese e inai henimumu taudia e hadarerediamu;
EXO.15.7.english: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you.

EXO.37.26.motu: Kopina na gold namo-hereana amo e ḡovaia, pata bona aena bona doana; bona digina na gold amo e haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.37.26.english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

EXO.25.26.motu: Ring hani danu gold amo ba kara, pata aena haniosi ai ba koko kau.
EXO.25.26.english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

EXO.37.29.motu: Dehoro helaḡana danu e karaia, bona muramura mai bonadia e bulo, bae gabua ḡauna, muramura ikarana tauna korikori ese e karaiamu heḡereḡerena.
EXO.37.29.english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

EXO.40.37.motu: A ori ese e ḡovaia ahu negadia ai, idia na asie tore isi, asie laolao, ela bona ma e daetania.
EXO.40.37.english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

EXO.32.20.motu: Bena ia ese boromakau natuna laulauna, idia ese e karaia ḡauna, e abia, lahi ai e gabua, bena e huaria sisi, ranu lalonai e ḡiḡia uda; bena e buloa patapata, Israel taudia e ha-inulaidia.
EXO.32.20.english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

EXO.39.19.motu: Bena gold ring-dia rua ma e kara, vaina laloma kahana ai vaina isena ruaosi ai e turi kau;
EXO.39.19.english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

EXO.24.6.motu: Bena Mose ese rara kahana na dihu ai e haboua, a rara kahana na ihaboulaina patana ai e seia.
EXO.24.6.english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

EXO.25.25.motu: Digina danu ba karaia, labalaba na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena, ia danu gold namo-hereana amo ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.25.25.english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

EXO.25.29.motu: Pata ḡaudia danu, mereki bona nau bona bio bona kehere, iboudiai na gold namo-hereana amo ba kara.
EXO.25.29.english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

EXO.20.18.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na guba rahurahu bona kevaru bona kibi reḡena bona ororo kwalahuna e kamonai bona e ita negana ai, idia na e gari, kudoudia danu e hataha. Idia na dauhai e gini,
EXO.20.18.english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

EXO.28.28.motu: Bena vaina ring-dia bona hahedoki ring-dia ba kwatu kubou, varo vaiurina amo, bona gaba ḡauna ai danu bae hemata kau; unuhetomana vaina bona hahedoki basie heruha diba.
EXO.28.28.english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

EXO.18.10.motu: Ietero eto, Iehova aita imodaia, ia ese Aigupto taudia imadia amo bona Farao imana amo vada e hamaurimui, Israel taudia na Aigupto edia iḡui amo vada e ruhadia nege.
EXO.18.10.english: Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

EXO.18.24.motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese ravana ena hereva e kamonai, bona ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia.
EXO.18.24.english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

EXO.35.27.motu: Iduhu lohiadia ese onuku nadidia, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki bona edia vaina ihaheralaidia nadidia,
EXO.35.27.english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

EXO.10.25.motu: A Mose eto, Lasi, emai boubou ḡaudia bona lahi ese baine ḡole oho ḡaudia ba hemimai, Iehova emai Dirava do baia boua.
EXO.10.25.english: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh our God.

EXO.32.22.motu: Aaron eto, Ḡauka e, basio badu henigu; oi dibamu ini taunimanima na mai lebu-lebudia.
EXO.32.22.english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

EXO.35.8.motu: lamepu dehorona, bona dehoro helaḡana muramuradia, bona muramura mai bonadia, bae gabu ḡaudia;
EXO.35.8.english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

EXO.40.26.motu: Bena muramura patana, gold ḡauna, na hebou kalagana ai e atoa, seseahu vairanai;
EXO.40.26.english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

EXO.32.18.motu: Mose eto, Lasi na kamonaimu ḡauna na dia kwalimu dainai asie hisi daemu, bona darere dainai asie ehonimu, to ane e abimu.
EXO.32.18.english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

EXO.2.7.motu: Bena hari taihuna ese Farao natuna hahinena e hereva henia, eto, Lau ainala, ani, Heberu mararoto hihinena ta baina boiria, ia ese mero baine ubua.
EXO.2.7.english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

EXO.10.20.motu: A Iehova ese Farao lalona ma e ha-aukaia, bena Israel taudia se kahudia nege.
EXO.10.20.english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

EXO.16.28.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e gwau henia, eto, Egu haheḡani bona egu taravatu ba dadaraidia ela bona edena nega ai?
EXO.16.28.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

EXO.9.23.motu: Bena Mose ese ena itotohi e duduia isi; bena Iehova ese guba-rahu bona medu-hetari e hadiho tanobada ai, lahi danu tanobada ai e diho. Iehova ese medu-hetarina e hadihoa Aigupto tanona idoinai.
EXO.9.23.english: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and Yahweh sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. Yahweh rained hail on the land of Egypt.

EXO.6.20.motu: Amram ese lalana Iokedbed e adavaia. Natudia be Aaron bona Mose. Amram ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta toi-ahui hitu.
EXO.6.20.english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

EXO.20.12.motu: Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia; unu amo emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova emu Dirava ese e henimumu tanona ai.
EXO.20.12.english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

EXO.40.38.motu: Badina be edia laolao iboudiai lalodiai Iehova ena ori ese dubu e ḡovaia ahu dina ai, bona hanuaboi ai lahi na ia lalonai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
EXO.40.38.english: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

EXO.39.37.motu: lamepa patana, gold ḡoevaḡoeva e karalaia ḡauna, mai ena lamepa bona mai kohuna idoinai bona ena lamepa diaranuna;
EXO.39.37.english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

EXO.18.6.motu: Bena ia ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Lau, oi ravamu, vada nama dekemu ai, adavamu bona natumu raruosi danu vada na hakaudia mai.
EXO.18.6.english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

EXO.39.12.motu: ere ihatoina ai huakinto bona akate bona ametuso;
EXO.39.12.english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

EXO.30.11.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,

EXO.15.3.motu: Iehova na tuari tauna; ia ladana be Iehova.
EXO.15.3.english: Yahweh is a man of war.

EXO.12.42.motu: Una hanuaboi na bae badinaia tarika-tarika Iehova vairanai, ia ese Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi dainai: una hanuaboi na Iehova ena, Israel taudia iboudiai bae badinaia ela uru iboudiai.
EXO.12.42.english: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

EXO.30.18.motu: Dihu ta auri labora-labora amo ba karaia, hurihuri ḡauna mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna, ia danu auri labora-labora. Hebou kalagana bona ihaboulaina patana padadiai ba haginia. Ia lalonai ranu ba seia.
EXO.30.18.english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

EXO.36.38.motu: Seseahu ena ihua-ihua ima e kara, mai igaudia. Hari ihua-ihua kwaradia na gold amo e ḡovadia, bona ihua-ihua na gold amo e kapadia heḡeḡe. A edia hahelai-kau ḡaudia imaosi na auri labora-labora amo e kara.
EXO.36.38.english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

EXO.6.30.motu: A Mose ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Bibinagu na eme metau; Farao na ede baine kamonai henigu toma?
EXO.6.30.english: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”

EXO.8.6.motu: Taunabunai, Aaron na imana e toia roro Aigupto ranudia daediai, bena parapara na ranu amo e dae kau, Aigupto tanona e hahonua.
EXO.8.6.english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

EXO.32.10.motu: A siri: egu badu vada eme siahu idia ediai. Idia baine habuadia tari, a oi na bese badana ai baina halaomu.
EXO.32.10.english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

EXO.34.29.motu: Mose na Sinai ororona amo e hekei diho, mai taravatu nadidia ruaosi, imana ai e kadidiha. Una negana ai ia na se diba vairana vada e hururu-hururu, Dirava ida e hereva hereva dainai.
EXO.34.29.english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

EXO.6.14.motu: Tamadia edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia ladadia bini. Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, natudia bini: Hanok bona Palu bona Hesron bona Karami. Ruben ena iduhu bunai.
EXO.6.14.english: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

EXO.39.43.motu: Mose ese ḡaukara idoinai e itaia, bona vada e diba idia ese ḡau iboudiai vada e kara Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena. Bena Mose ese e hanamodia.
EXO.39.43.english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

EXO.25.22.motu: Unuseni ai baita hedavari: ikaruhi daenai, taravatu mauana latanai e miamu kerubidia raruosi padadia amo, lau ese baina hereva henimu; haheḡani iboudiai, Israel taudia ba henidia ḡaudia, na baina hadibalaimu.
EXO.25.22.english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

EXO.4.3.motu: Iehova eto, Tano ai avatoa diho. Tano ai e atoa diho, bena itotohi na gaigai ai ela; bena Mose ese e heautania.
EXO.4.3.english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.”

EXO.30.2.motu: Pata na latana bona lababana bae heḡereḡere. kiubit tamona; harana ena lata na kiubit rua; doana na ia ida au tamona amo bae koro.
EXO.30.2.english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

EXO.34.32.motu: Gabeai Israel taudia iboudiai ese e raka henia kahi; bena Iehova ese Sinai ororona ai e henia haheḡanidia iboudiai na Mose ese e gwaurai henidia.
EXO.34.32.english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

EXO.39.3.motu: Hari gold na e hodoa ela bona vada e severa-severa herea, hena e utua, varo na heto, hari dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia ihaheralaidia.
EXO.39.3.english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

EXO.8.19.motu: Bena hari mea taudia ese Farao a hamaoroa, eto, Ina na Dirave imana kwakikwakina. A Farao lalona ma e auka, se kamonai henidia, Iehova ese e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
EXO.8.19.english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

EXO.30.22.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
EXO.30.22.english: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

EXO.19.12.motu: Hetoa danu bavabia, ororo baine ḡeḡea ahu, bena ba hamaorodia, baoto “Nahuamui ba toho, ororo ai basio dae kau, bona badibadina basiola; daika na ororo ai baine dae kau, vada bae alaia mase;
EXO.19.12.english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

EXO.40.7.motu: bona hurihuri dihuna, mai ranuna, na hebou kalagana bona ihaboulaina patana padadiai bavatoa.
EXO.40.7.english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

EXO.26.33.motu: hari seseahu na hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo ba taua dae; bena taravatu mauana na bae huaia vareai: seseahu na helaḡa gabuna bona helaḡa-herea gabuna baine seses ahu.
EXO.26.33.english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

EXO.39.26.motu: gold gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta gold gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta, ela bona hahedoki isena e haheraia heḡeḡe, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.26.english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.16.25.motu: Mose ma eto, Hari dina ai bahu mo bavani, badina be hari na Iehova ena dina helaḡa; hari dina ai ḡau ta basio davaria tano ai.
EXO.16.25.english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.

EXO.21.4.motu: A biaguna ese hahine ta baine henia, baine adavaia, bena natuna mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia na una hahine ena amo baine abidia, una hahine mai natuna ida na biaguna ena; hesiai tauna na sibona baine raka lasi.
EXO.21.4.english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

EXO.36.13.motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui gold amo e kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo e hakapudia tao hesiriu, dubu tamona ai e halaoa.
EXO.36.13.english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

EXO.13.6.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai flaoa dikeadia, asie hatubu ḡaudia, bavani; bena dina ihahituna Iehova ena aria ba karaia.
EXO.13.6.english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to Yahweh.

EXO.37.1.motu: Besalele ese maua helaḡana danu e karaia, kela reireidia amo; latana na kiubit rua mai kahana, lababana na kiubit ta mai kahana, bona harana ena lata na kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.37.1.english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

EXO.1.16.motu: Ia eto, Umui raruosi ese Heberu hahinedia ba hamaradia negadia ai ba itadia, idia bae mara, bema mero, bavalaia, a bema kekeni be baine mauri.
EXO.1.16.english: and he said, “When you perform the duty of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them on the birth stool, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live.”

EXO.21.27.motu: Eiava uduna baine botaia bena isena ta baine heraḡa, ia na baine kahua nege, isena davana.
EXO.21.27.english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

EXO.12.34.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese edia flaoa, ranu ai e kui ḡaudia, e abi, edia kuikui dihudia danu e abi, edia dabua ai e kumi, e dibu ela.
EXO.12.34.english: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

EXO.33.4.motu: Una hari dikana e kamonai ai, Israel taudia na lalodia e hisihisiva: tau ta ena herahera ḡaudia se kara.
EXO.33.4.english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

EXO.38.19.motu: Ia duna be hani, mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu hani, auri labora-labora ḡaudia. Edia igau na silver. Du kwaradia na silver amo e ḡovadia, bona du be silver amo e kapadia heḡeḡe.
EXO.38.19.english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

EXO.18.23.motu: Ini ba kara toma, bona Dirava ese ini baine haḡanimu toma, bena ba haheauka diba; ini taunimanima iboudiai danu edia kalaga bae lou heni mai mainodia ida.
EXO.18.23.english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

EXO.27.11.motu: Mirigini kahana ai danu maḡu latana na kiubit sinahu-ta; itautau dabuadia na du ruahui amo bae hetau dae, du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae ruahui. Du bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia na auri labora-labora amo ba kara, a edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver amo ba kara.
EXO.27.11.english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

EXO.35.25.motu: Dabua ḡaukaradia mai dibadia hahinedia iboudiai ese danu dabua e hatu, bena imadia ḡaukaradia e heni: dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia.
EXO.35.25.english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

EXO.1.2.motu: Ladadia bini: Ruben; Simeon; Levi; Iuda;

EXO.37.20.motu: Duna ai danu kehere na hani, sakada huahuadia na heto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia.
EXO.37.20.english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

EXO.12.7.motu: Bena rarana bavabia, iduara ihua-ihuana kahana kahana audia bona daena auna ba dahulai, bae ani rumadia ai.
EXO.12.7.english: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

EXO.21.23.motu: A hahine danu baine dika, mauri davana na mauri baine henia,
EXO.21.23.english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

EXO.1.17.motu: To hari hegwaroto hahinedia ese Dirava garina e gariva dainai idia ese Aigupto pavapavana ena hahedua herevana asie badinaiava, natudia mamaruanedia idia ese e hamauridiava.
EXO.1.17.english: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.

EXO.21.5.motu: A hesiai tauna baine hereva hedinarai, baineto “Baigugu bona adavagu bona adavagu bonanatugu na ura henidiamu; una dainai lau basina raka lasi”,
EXO.21.5.english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

EXO.25.34.motu: Duna ai danu kehere bae hani, sakada huahuadia na heheto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia.
EXO.25.34.english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

EXO.4.2.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Ena na dahaka imamu ai? Ia e haere, eto, Itotohi.
EXO.4.2.english: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?”

EXO.10.22.motu: Bena Mose ese imama e duduia isi. Bena Aigupto tanona idoinai e dibura masemase, ela dina toi vada e ore.
EXO.10.22.english: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

EXO.36.37.motu: Kalaga iduarana seseahuna danu dabua aukana bona namona amo e karaia, vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana; bona ihaheralaina danu e turi.
EXO.36.37.english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

EXO.1.5.motu: Iakob garana iboudiai be taunimanima hitu-ahui, Iosef ese e gunalaidia Aigupto ai.
EXO.1.5.english: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.

EXO.12.20.motu: E hatubua ḡauna ta basio ania; emui noho gabudia iboudiai flaoa dikeadia, asie hatubu ḡaudia, mo bavani.
EXO.12.20.english: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

EXO.24.5.motu: Bena ia ese Israel eregabedia haida e siaidia, boromakau mamaruanedia e laohai, boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia: haida lahi ese e ḡole oho ḡaudia, ma haida herohemano ḡaudia, Iehova ena.
EXO.24.5.english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.

EXO.6.28.motu: Iehova ese Mose Aigupto tanona ai e hereva henia dinana ai,
EXO.6.28.english: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

EXO.24.17.motu: Iehova hairaina ita-itana na lahi hururu-hururuna na heto ororo dorina ai: Israel taudia iboudiai ese e itaia.
EXO.24.17.english: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

EXO.39.7.motu: Bena unu nadi be hari hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai e atodia kau, helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, Israel natuna edia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.7.english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.4.27.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Aaron e hereva henia, eto, Tano ḡaḡaena aola, Mose ida ba hedavari. Bena ia na ela, Dirava ena ororo ai Mose e davaria, bena e harahua.
EXO.4.27.english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.”

EXO.31.3.motu: Dirava ena Lauma vada na henia, baine aonega bona lalona baine parara bona ima karakara ḡaukaradia baine diba helaoreana.
EXO.31.3.english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

EXO.29.12.motu: Bena boromakau rarana kuri ta bavabia, ihaboulaina patana doadia na imamu kwakikwakina amo ba dahulai; a rara orena na pata badinai ba bubua.
EXO.29.12.english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

EXO.28.24.motu: Hari gold varodia rua na vaina ring-dia ruaosi ai ba mata kau,
EXO.28.24.english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

EXO.36.9.motu: Dabua ta ena lata be kiubit ruahui taurahani, lababana be kiubit hani, iboudiai edia lata vada e heḡereḡere bona edia lababa danu vada e heḡereḡere.
EXO.36.9.english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

EXO.28.22.motu: Gold namo-hereana ba moḡea, gold varodia ba kara, vaina ena.
EXO.28.22.english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

EXO.22.24.motu: bena egu badu baine siahu, bena dare amo baina alamui mase: adavamui bae vabu bona natumui bae ihareha.
EXO.22.24.english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

EXO.30.4.motu: Ring rua gold amo ba kara, pata digina henunai ba kokodia kau, ta pata kahana ai, ma ta kahana ai, maduna itoi-hanaidia ḡaudia, bae huaia negadia ai.
EXO.30.4.english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

EXO.1.6.motu: Iosef e mase, tadikakana bona ena uru taudia iboudiai danu e mase.
EXO.1.6.english: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.

EXO.12.36.motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia lalodia e hakerudia Israel taudia ediai, bena idia ese e noi ḡaudia na e henidia. Unu amo idia ese Aigupto taudia edia Kohu e dadi ore.
EXO.12.36.english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

EXO.21.36.motu: Bema biaguna mai dibana una boromakau na vaia unu vada e kara toma, to basine koua kunuka-kunuka, ia ese davana do baine karaia, boromakau ta boromakau ta davana, bona mase ḡauna be iena.
EXO.21.36.english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

EXO.25.21.motu: Hari ikaruhi na maua latanai bavatoa kau, hebogahisi teronona ai bainela; bona taravatu nadidia, do baina henimu ḡauna, na maua lalonai ba udaia.
EXO.25.21.english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

EXO.6.26.motu: Hari Aaron bona Mose be Iehova ese e haḡanidia, eto, Israel taudia na iduhu ta ta amo ba hakaudia lasi, Aigupto tanona bae rakatania.
EXO.6.26.english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

EXO.33.8.motu: A Mose na hebou kalagana ela negadia ai, taunimanima iboudiai e tore tore isi, edia kalaga iduaradia ai e gini, Mose e raraia tao ela bona hebou kalagana ai e raka vareai. ?
EXO.33.8.english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

EXO.34.18.motu: Flaoa asie hatubua Ariana ba badinaia. Dina hitu asie hatubua flaoana mo bavania, vada na haḡanimui heḡereḡerena, nega korikorina ai, hua ladana Abib ai, badina be Abib huana ai umui na Aigupto amo o raka lasi.
EXO.34.18.english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

EXO.5.12.motu: Taunabunai, iboudiai e karoho rohoroho, Aigupto tanona idoinai uit momodia eha gogo.
EXO.5.12.english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

EXO.19.13.motu: imadia amo basie daua toho, a nadi amo bae hodoa mase eiava diba amo bae tarakia mase; bema taunimanima eiava ubu-ubu ḡauna, to basine mauri. A kibi reḡena daudauna bae kamonai, bena ororo ai bae dara dae”.
EXO.19.13.english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

EXO.24.10.motu: Israel edia Dirava e itaia, aena na sapairo nadina ai e hadai, e negari-negari, guba na heto.
EXO.24.10.english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

EXO.5.14.motu: Bena idia ese Israel edia heitatao taudia, hari Farao ena ḡaukara biagudia ese e badinadia taudia, na e dadabadia, a gwau henidia, eto, Dahuka dainai hari dina ai emui ḡaukara ahuna korikorina asio haḡuḡurua?
EXO.5.14.english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

EXO.16.35.motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai Israel taudia ese mana e aniava, ela bona tano namona ai e kau; mana mo e aniava ela bona Kanaan tanona hetoana ai e kau.
EXO.16.35.english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

EXO.8.32.motu: A Farao na lalona ma e ha-aukaia lou, Heberu taudia se kahudia nege.
EXO.8.32.english: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.

EXO.28.43.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida hari piribou bae kara, gabu helaḡana ai kara helaḡadia bae kara totona hebou kalagana ai bae raka vareai negadia iboudiai bona ihaboulaina patana bae raka henia kahi negadia iboudiai bae kara, bae kerere bena bae mase na garina. Ina haheḡani na ia bona ia garana ese bae badina ela bona hanaihanai.
EXO.28.43.english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

EXO.37.28.motu: Maduna rua danu e kara, kela audia amo, bona gold amo e ḡovadia.
EXO.37.28.english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

EXO.29.25.motu: Bena imadia amo bavabi lou, ihaboulaina patana latanai ba gabu, hari ḡole-oho vamuna ida. Ia na bonana namo ḡauna Iehova vairanai; ḡole-oho boubouna, Iehova ena.
EXO.29.25.english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

EXO.20.6.motu: a e ura henigumu bona egu taravatu e badinamu taudia baina bogadia hisi ela uru daha.
EXO.20.6.english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

EXO.29.28.motu: Idia ahudia bunu, Israel taudia ese bae henidia hanaihanai. Badina be hahelaḡa taudia ahudia bunu, Israel taudia ese edia herohemaino bouboudia amo bae henidia; edia boubou ḡauna bae duduia isi, Iehova ena.
EXO.29.28.english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

EXO.8.3.motu: Sinavai na parapara ai bae honu; bena bae dae emu ruma ai, bona emu mahuta gabuna ai, bona emu mahuta patana ai, bona emu hesiai taudia edia ruma ai, bona emu orea taudia edia ruma ai, bona emu amu lalodiai, bona emu dihu lalodiai.
EXO.8.3.english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

EXO.24.18.motu: Bena Mose na e dara dae ori lalonai, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui unuseni ai e nohova.
EXO.24.18.english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

EXO.23.15.motu: Asie-hatubua-flaoana ariana ba karaia: dina hitu asie hatubua flaoana bavania, gunaguna na haduamu heḡereḡerena, nega korikorina ai, hua ladana Abib lalonai, badina be una hua lalonai Aigupto amo o raka lasi. Asi tauna ta imana kavakava baine hedinarai lau vairagu ai.
EXO.23.15.english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

EXO.35.14.motu: lamepa patana mai ena kohu idoinai, bona ena lamepa bona ena lamepa dehorona;
EXO.35.14.english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

EXO.39.5.motu: Gaba ḡauna danu ḡau heḡereḡeredia ai e karaia, gold bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.5.english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.17.1.motu: Israel hegogona idoinai ese tano ḡaḡaena ladana Sin e rakatania, e laolao metaira-metaira, Iehova ese e haduadia heḡereḡerena, ela bona Refidim ai e taruha. Unuseni ai idia na asi edia inuinu ranuna.
EXO.17.1.english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

EXO.18.11.motu: Harihari lau dibagu Iehova ese dirava iboudiai e hereadiamu, badina be edia hekokoroku ai vada e hadareredia.
EXO.18.11.english: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

EXO.2.5.motu: Farao natuna hahinena na ela, sinavai ai baine digu eto; bena ena hesiai kekenidia na sinavai badibadinai e loava. Ia ese bosea bautama lalodiai e itaia, bena ena hesiai kekenina ta e siaia, baine mailaia.
EXO.2.5.english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

EXO.23.26.motu: emu mauri ḡauna ta basine mara dika bona ta basine gabani emu tano ai; emu mauri dinadia baina haḡuḡurudia.
EXO.23.26.english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

EXO.19.25.motu: Taunabunai Mose e hekei taunimanima dekediai, unu hereva e hamaorolaidia.
EXO.19.25.english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

EXO.36.1.motu: Benaini, Besalele bona Oholiab bona karakara taudia, Iehova ese lalo-parara bona aonega vada e henidia taudia, iboudiai ese ḡaukara bae matamaia, dubu do bae karaioa, Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡeredia.
EXO.36.1.english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”

EXO.1.19.motu: Hari hegwaroto hahinedia ese Farao e haere henia, eto, BAdina be Heberu hahinedia na dia Aigupto hahinedia bamodia; idia na mai goadadia, bena hegwaroto hahinena do se gini daemu negana ai idia ese e mara gunamu.
EXO.1.19.english: The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them.”

EXO.15.22.motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia na Davara Kakakakana amo e hakaudia lao, tano ḡaḡaena ladana Suru amo e hakaudia hanai. Dina toi tano ḡaḡaena ai eha laolao, ranu asie davaria.
EXO.15.22.english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

EXO.6.9.motu: Mose ese ina hereva Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia, to asie kamonai henia, daradia e doko bona edia maduna na metau dainai.
EXO.6.9.english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

EXO.18.9.motu: Bena Ietero e moale, Iehova ese Israel taudia e hanamodiava, Aigupto taudia imadia amo e hamauridiava, dainai.
EXO.18.9.english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

EXO.9.24.motu: Taunabunai, medu-hetarina bona lahi e diho bou, vada e bada herea; Aigupto tanona idoinai nega ta unu asie diho toma, Aigupto besena e vara matama amo ema.
EXO.9.24.english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

EXO.35.15.motu: muramura patana mai ena maduna ida, bona dehoro helaḡana, bona muramura mai bonaida; dubu iduarana seseahuna;
EXO.35.15.english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

EXO.35.17.motu: maḡu dabuadia, bona maḡu duna mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida, bona maḡu ikoukouna seseahuna;
EXO.35.17.english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

EXO.23.10.motu: Laḡani tauratoi uma ḡaudia ba hado emu tano ai, bona anidia ba habou;
EXO.23.10.english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

EXO.9.26.motu: Gosen tanona ai mo, Israel taudia ese e noholaia tanona ai, medu-hetarina na se diho.
EXO.9.26.english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

EXO.25.39.motu: Hari lamepa patana, mai kohuna idoinai, ikaralaina gold-na ena metau be talent ta.
EXO.25.39.english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

EXO.39.22.motu: Bena hahedoki badana na dabua vaiurina amo e karaia,
EXO.39.22.english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

EXO.33.12.motu: Mose ese Iehova e hereva henia, eto, Mani a laloa, vada o hamaorogu, oto “Ini taunimanima ba hakaudia lao”; to oi na do so hamaorogu, daika ba siaia baine bamogu. Ma vada o hamaorogu, oto “Ladamu be dibagu, bona na lalo namo henimumu”.
EXO.33.12.english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

EXO.26.6.motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui gold amo ba kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo be hakapudia tao hesiriu, unu amo dubu tamona ai bainela.
EXO.26.6.english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

EXO.38.29.motu: Auri labora-labora idoinai be talent hitu-ahui sekele daha-rua sinahu-hani.
EXO.38.29.english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

EXO.27.4.motu: Pata digina na auri labora-labora amo ba ha-aukaia heḡeḡe, bona rina hani auri labora-labora amo ba kara, hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana ena daiguni haniosi ai.
EXO.27.4.english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

EXO.33.3.motu: Baola, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona ai ba raka vareai; to umui na lalo-auka taumui dainai lau na basina bamomui, dala ai baina habuamui tari na garina.
EXO.33.3.english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

EXO.31.12.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,

EXO.32.5.motu: Aaron ese edia kara e itaia, bena ia ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, una kaivakuku vairanai, bona hereva e hapiua, eto, Kerukeru aria baita karaia, Iehova ena.
EXO.32.5.english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”

EXO.25.8.motu: Gabu helaḡana danu bae karaia egu, bogaragidiai baina noho helaoreana.
EXO.25.8.english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

EXO.21.31.motu: Bema tau ta natuna maruanena eiava natuna hahinena na boromakau ese baine doaia mase, unu bae karaia toma.
EXO.21.31.english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

EXO.16.23.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova ena hereva binai: kerukeru na laḡa-ani dinana, Iehova ena dina helaḡa; be gabu ḡaudia na ba gabu, ba nadu ḡaudia na ba nadu, bona bahu baine mia rani.
EXO.16.23.english: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

EXO.30.20.motu: hebou kalagana ai bae raka vareai hegadia iboudiai ranu amo unu bae haheḡoeva toma, bae mase garina. Ihaboulaina patana bae raka kahi henia negadia ai, Iehova ibouna ḡaudia bae haḡole oho totona,
EXO.30.20.english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

EXO.7.9.motu: eto, Farao ese baine hamaoromui, baineto “Hoa karana ta a karaia, baina dibamui”, una negana ai oi ese Aaron ba haduaia, baoto, “Emu itotohi avabia, Farao vairanai ba negea dobi tano ai, gaigai ai bainela”.
EXO.7.9.english: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

EXO.29.18.motu: idoinai na ihaboulaina patana latanai ba gabudia. Ina na ḡole-oho boubouna, Iehova ena; ia na bonana namo ḡauna, lahi boubouna, Iehova ena.
EXO.29.18.english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

EXO.5.9.motu: Edia ḡaukara ba hametaua: bae ḡaukara goada, koikoi herevadia basie hakala heni.
EXO.5.9.english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

EXO.28.10.motu: lada tauratoi nadi ta ai ma tauratoi nadi ta ai, murina murina amo ba tore edia vara heḡereḡeredia.
EXO.28.10.english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

EXO.28.21.motu: Hari nadi hururu-hururudia na gwauta-rua, Israel natuna gwauta-raruosi ihaheḡereḡeredia; nadi ta ta ai iduhu ta ta ladadia bae ḡasi.
EXO.28.21.english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

EXO.30.13.motu: Ini bae henia toma: ladadia bae tore taudia iboudiai na ta ta sekele kahana kahana bae heni, gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena; una sekele anina be gera ruahui. Ina na herahia ḡauna, Iehova ena.
EXO.30.13.english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.

EXO.29.44.motu: Lau ese hebou kalagana bona ihaboulaina patana baina hahelaḡadia; Aaron mai natuna ida danu baina hahelaḡadia, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela.
EXO.29.44.english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

EXO.18.3.motu: bona natuna raruosi danu e abidia. Ta ladana na Geresom; badina be tamana eto, Lau na idau tano ai na noho hedoamu.
EXO.18.3.english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

EXO.15.15.motu: Edom lohiadia na daradia e dokomu;
EXO.15.15.english: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed.

EXO.37.18.motu: Rigina na tauratoi, kahana toi kahana toi.
EXO.37.18.english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

EXO.12.40.motu: Hari Israel besena Aigupto tanona ai e nohova laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-hani toi-ahui.
EXO.12.40.english: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

EXO.40.2.motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai hebou kalagana mai dubuna ida ba hagini. ?
EXO.40.2.english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.12.8.motu: Una hanuaboi amui aniani na mamoe natuna hidiona, amu ai bae guraia, bona flaoa kavakava, muramura ai basie hatubua, bona aniani avadia iditadia.
EXO.12.8.english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

EXO.15.23.motu: Bena gabu ladana Mara ai e lasi, a una gabu ranuna asie inua diba, badina na idita; una dainai una gabu ladana e hatoa Mara.
EXO.15.23.english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

EXO.1.9.motu: Ia ese ena orea taudia e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, ita na gagadoi, Israel besena taudia na hutuma; ita na mamanoka, idia na gogoada;
EXO.1.9.english: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.

EXO.10.17.motu: Taunabunai, na noimumu, ina nega tamona mo egu dika ba gwaua tao, bona Iehova emui Dirava ba noia, ia ese ina mase ḡauna egu amo baine abia oho.
EXO.10.17.english: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

EXO.37.25.motu: Bena pata helaḡana ta e karaia, muramura mai bonaida igabudia ḡauna: kela audia amo e karaia. Ena lata bona ena lababa na heḡereḡere, kiubit tamona; harana ena lata na kiubit rua; doana na ia ida au tamona amo e koro.
EXO.37.25.english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

EXO.25.17.motu: Ikaruhi ta danu gold namo-hereana amo ba karaia, ena lata kiubit rua mai kahana, ena lababa kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.25.17.english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

EXO.37.17.motu: Lamepa patana danu e karaia, gold namo-hereana amo. Aena bona duna na gold amo e koro: aena bona duna bona kehere bona heraherana, bure bona huahua, iboudiai na gold siri tamona amo e koro.
EXO.37.17.english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

EXO.32.7.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, A diho haraḡa; badina be emu orea taudia, Aigupto amo o hakaudia lasi taudia, vada e kara havara;
EXO.32.7.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

EXO.40.23.motu: bona flaoa helaḡana na pata latanai e dabaraia, Iehova vairanai, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡere=herena.
EXO.40.23.english: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.24.13.motu: Taunabunai, Mose na ena hesiai tauna Iosua ida e tore isi; bena Mose na Dirava ena ororo ai e dara dae.
EXO.24.13.english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

EXO.39.34.motu: guhi, mamoe kopidia e hakakakakadia ḡauna; ma guhi ta, nani kopidia ḡauna; seseahu;
EXO.39.34.english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

EXO.4.19.english: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”

EXO.31.4.motu: Ia na gold bona silver bona auri labora-labora ḡaudia namodia baine kara,
EXO.31.4.english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

EXO.16.5.motu: A dina ihatauratoina idia na dina rua ahudia bae heḡaeḡaelai.
EXO.16.5.english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

EXO.36.3.motu: Bena idia ese Israel taudia edia herahia ḡaudia iboudiai, dubu ḡaukarana idurulaina ḡaudia, na Mose ena amo e abi. A herahia ḡaudia haida be daba iboudiai ma e laohai, e henia;
EXO.36.3.english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

EXO.10.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Farao dekenai a raka vareai; badina be ia lalona vada na ha-aukaia, ena hesiai taudia danu lalodia vada na ha-aukadia, egu toa bini bogaragtidiai baina hahedinarai helaoreana.
EXO.10.1.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

EXO.17.4.motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Ina orea taudia na ede baina karadia toma? Lalodia e hadaimu nadi amo bae hodogu mase e tomu.
EXO.17.4.english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

EXO.26.26.motu: Raroraro danu kela audia amo ba kara, au-ima dubu habana kahana ai,
EXO.26.26.english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

EXO.8.24.motu: Bena Iehova na uni e kara toma: lao momo herea e kau, Farao ena ruma ai bona hesiai taudia edia ruma ai; Aigupto tanona idoinai vada e dika rohoroho, lao daidiai.
EXO.8.24.english: Yahweh did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

EXO.35.18.motu: dubu bona maḡu ikokodia, mai kwanaudia ida;
EXO.35.18.english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

EXO.35.1.motu: Mose ese Israel hegogona idoinai e haheboudia, e haḡanidia, eto, Iehova ena hahe-gani emui ai bini:
EXO.35.1.english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

EXO.5.20.motu: Bena Farao ena amo e raka lasi ai idia na Mose bona Aaron ida e hedavari, raruosi ese e naridiava.
EXO.5.20.english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

EXO.22.25.motu: Egu orea taudia ogoḡamidia haida emu ai bae abi torehai, basio kara henidia abi-torehai taudia na heheto, bona heato-kau monina na ediai basio tahua.
EXO.22.25.english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

EXO.3.6.motu: Ma eto, Lau na tamamu ena Dirava, Abraham ena Dirava, Isaak ena Dirava, Iakob ena Dirava. Bena Mose na vairana e koua, Dirava baine itaia na garina.
EXO.3.6.english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.”

EXO.9.33.motu: Bena Mose ese Farao e rakatania, hanua amo e raka lasi, imana e toi roro Iehova enai; bena guba-rahu bona medu-hetari na e doko, bona medu na se diho tanobada ai.
EXO.9.33.english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to Yahweh; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

EXO.3.2.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese e hahedinarai henia, lahi hururu-hururuna ai, lahi na au ginigini ai. Mose ese e itaia, lahi na au amo e hururu lasiva, to au na lahi ese se araiava.
EXO.3.2.english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

EXO.13.2.motu: Roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai Israel ai ba hahelaḡadia lauegu, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia; roboana be lauegu.
EXO.13.2.english: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”
