EXO.34.6.english: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

EXO.18.12.motu: Bena Mose ravana, Ietero, ese ihaboulaina karana e karaia, Dirava ena; lahi ese e ḡolea oho ḡauna amo Dirava e boua. Bena Aaron bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai e hebou, Mose ravana ida e aniani hebou, Dirava vairanai.
EXO.18.12.english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

EXO.7.15.motu: Daba ai, Farao dekena baola, ranu baine lao henia negana ai. Sinavai isena ai ba naria, itotohi danu, gaigai ai ela ḡauna, bavabia kau.
EXO.7.15.english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

EXO.11.3.motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia lalodia e hakerudia Israel taudia ediai; Mose danu ladana na bada Aigupto ai, Farao ena hesiai taudia ediai bona hanua taudia ediai.
EXO.11.3.english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

EXO.33.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e haduaia, eto, Ina gabu amo ba raka lao, oi bona Aigupto amo o hakaudia lasi taudia, lau na gwauraia hamata tanona baola: Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob na gwau henidia hamata, nato “Umui garamui baina henidia”, tanona bunai.
EXO.33.1.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

EXO.40.17.motu: Laḡani iharuana gini-gunana dina na gini-gunana ai dubu na e haginia.
EXO.40.17.english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

EXO.13.14.motu: Bena negana baine kau natumu ese baine nanadaimu, baineto “Ina kara be dahaka?”, oi ese ba haere henia baoto “Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto, maduna metaudia gabuna, amo e hakaumai lasi;
EXO.13.14.english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

EXO.32.11.motu: A Mose ese Iehova, ena Dirava, e noia, eto, Iehova e, dahaka dainai emu badu vada eme siahu emu orea taudia ediai, Aigupto amo o hakaudia lasi mai siahumu badana bona mai imamu goadana ida oreana enai.
EXO.32.11.english: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

EXO.40.3.motu: Lalonai taravatu mauana bavatoa bona ba sesea ahu.
EXO.40.3.english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

EXO.25.32.motu: Rigina bae tauratoi, kahana toi kahana toi.
EXO.25.32.english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

EXO.32.13.motu: Emu hesiai taudia Abraham bona Isaak bona Israel ba lalodia: sibomu o gwau henidia hamata, oto “Umui garamui baina hahutumadia, guba hisiudia na heheto; ina tano idoinai, vada na gwauraia hamata tanona, umui garamui baina henidia, edia tano ai bainela, ela bona hanaihanai”.
EXO.32.13.english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

EXO.9.22.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Imamu a duduia isi, medu-hetarina baine diho Aigupto tanona idoinai, taunimanima latadiai bona mauri ḡaudia idau-idau latadiai bona au idau-idau ava idau-idau iboudiai latadiai, Aigupto tanona idoinai.
EXO.9.22.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

EXO.20.21.motu: Bena taunimanima na dounu dauhai e giniva, a Mose ese Dirava e noholaiava dagadagana e raka henia kahi.
EXO.20.21.english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

EXO.16.13.motu: Adorahi ai, kibi momo e roho kau, taruha tanona e habubunia. Daba ai, hunu na taruhu tanona idoinai e miava,
EXO.16.13.english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

EXO.11.7.motu: A Israel taudia mai edia boromakau ida sisia ta ese basine kwaru henidia: taunabunai, vada ba diba Iehova ese Aigupto taudia bona Israel taudia vada e hididia.
EXO.11.7.english: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that Yahweh makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

EXO.36.15.motu: Dabua ta ta edia lata na kiubit toi-ahui, lababadia na kiubit hani; iboudiai edia lata vada e heḡereḡere, bona edia lababa danu vada e heḡereḡere.
EXO.36.15.english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

EXO.18.17.motu: Bena Mose ravana ese e hamaoroa, eto, Emu kara na dia namo;
EXO.18.17.english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

EXO.11.8.motu: Bena ini emu hesiai taudia iboudiai lau dekegu baema, vairagu ai bae goru diho, baeto “A raka lasi, emu orea taudia iboudiai ida”; una murinai baina raka lasi. Bena ia na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi ma badu ḡaraḡarana ida.
EXO.11.8.english: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

EXO.28.32.motu: Matuna bogaragi ai ba karaia, kwara gabuna; matu isena danu ba turia, vaia hahedoki isedia e turimu heḡereḡerena, baine hedare garina.
EXO.28.32.english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

EXO.13.5.motu: Bena kerukeru vanegai, Iehova ese Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro, taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, senemu e gwau henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona: una negana ai oi ese ina tomadiho karana ba karaia ina hua lalonai.
EXO.13.5.english: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

EXO.26.24.motu: Hari daiguni ḡaudia na henu ai bae kokodia hesiriu, a atai ai idia na ring amo bae hesiriu. Ruaosi na unu bae heto; idia na daiguni ḡaudia ruaosi ai baela.
EXO.26.24.english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

EXO.39.25.motu: bona padadia ai gold gabagabadia e turi kau:
EXO.39.25.english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

EXO.28.41.motu: Kakamu Aaron mai natuna ida unu ba hahedokilaidia toma; ba horodia danu, dagi ba henidia; bona ba hahelaḡadia, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela.
EXO.28.41.english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

EXO.5.19.motu: Israel taudia edia heitatao taudia vada e diba idia na ihadikadia totona e haduadia, eto “Dina ta ta ai emui ḡaukara ahuna na basine maraḡi”.
EXO.5.19.english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

EXO.27.10.motu: du ruahui amo bae hetau dae, du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae ruahui; hari du bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia na auri labora-labora amo ba kara. A edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver amo ba kara.
EXO.27.10.english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

EXO.8.23.motu: Lauegu orea taudia bona oiemu orea taudia baina hapararadia: kerukeru ina toa ba itaia”.
EXO.8.23.english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

EXO.38.13.motu: Mairiveina kahana ai maḡu lababana be kiubit imahui:
EXO.38.13.english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

EXO.9.11.motu: Bena mea taudia na asi goadadia Mose vairanai bae gini, badina be idia danu mai iohururudia, Aigupto taudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
EXO.9.11.english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

EXO.5.7.motu: Ḡaukara taudia na uit momona, raro ida e buloamu ḡauna, na basio henidia lou, dina iboudiai vada o henidiamu heḡereḡerena; ina murinai idia na sibodia bae ha gogoa.
EXO.5.7.english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

EXO.6.17.motu: Gereson natuna bini: Libni bona Simei, edia iduhu taudia ida.
EXO.6.17.english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

EXO.22.21.motu: Noho-hedoa tauna basio hadikaia bona basio hahisia, badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava.
EXO.22.21.english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

EXO.40.35.motu: Taunabunai Mose na asi ena dala hebou kalagana ai baine raka vareai, badina be ori ese e ḡovaia ahu, bona Iehova diaridiarina ese dubu e hahonua.
EXO.40.35.english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

EXO.25.9.motu: Dubu auta danu ba karaia; dubu bona dubu lalona ḡaudia iboudiai be lau ese baina hadibalaimu heḡereḡerena ai ba kara.
EXO.25.9.english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

EXO.39.24.motu: Isena ai herahera e turi, rimono huahuadia na heheto, varo vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia e turilai;
EXO.39.24.english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

EXO.26.8.motu: Dabua ta ta edia lata na kiubit toi-ahui, lababadia na kiubit hani; iboudiai edia bae heḡereḡere, edia lababa danu bae heḡereḡere.
EXO.26.8.english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

EXO.38.6.motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo e kara, bona auri labora-labora amo e ḡovadia.
EXO.38.6.english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

EXO.28.30.motu: Urim bona Tumim na vaina ai ba uda, Aaron kemena ai bae mia, Iehova vairanai baine raka vareai negadia ai: unu amo Aaron na nega iboudiai Israel taudia baine hahemaoro henidia Iehova vairanai, mai siahuna ida.
EXO.28.30.english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

EXO.12.6.motu: Ba balaia heni ela bona hua dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai; bena dina baine hakere ai Israel hegogona idoinai ese edia mamoe natudia bae aladia mase.
EXO.12.6.english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

EXO.26.9.motu: Ini dabua ima ba siriudia, ma tauratoi ba siriudia: ihatauratoina na iha-imana baine ha-ere-ruaia, kalaga vairanai.
EXO.26.9.english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

EXO.15.16.motu: Gari bona kudou-hetaha ese e butudia tao;
EXO.15.16.english: Terror and dread falls on them.

EXO.26.27.motu: ma au-ima kahana ai, ma au-ima dubu duduna ai, lahara kahana ai.
EXO.26.27.english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

EXO.26.30.motu: Dubu na ba haginia, hari ina ororo ai emu ai vada eme hedinarai heḡereḡerena.
EXO.26.30.english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

EXO.15.27.motu: Bena idia na Elim ai e kau; unuseni ai ranu guridia na gwauta-rua, bona pamu audia na hitu-ahui. Bena unu ranu badidiai e taruha.
EXO.15.27.english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

EXO.12.18.motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai asie hatubua flaoana bavania, ela bona dina iharuahui-tana adorahina.
EXO.12.18.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.

EXO.8.25.motu: Bena Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e boiridia, eto, Aola, ina tano ai emui Dirava ba boua.
EXO.8.25.english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

EXO.38.10.motu: Du be ruahu; bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia danu ruahui, auri labora-labora amo e kara. Igau bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver amo e kara.
EXO.38.10.english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

EXO.36.31.motu: Raroraro danu kela audia amo e kara, au-ima dubu habana kahana ena,
EXO.36.31.english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

EXO.39.33.motu: Bena ḡau iboudiai e laohai Mose dekenai: dubu; kalaga mai kohuna idoinai; ena igau; ena haba kahadia; ena raroraro; ena du, mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida;
EXO.39.33.english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

EXO.40.11.motu: Hurihuri dihuna danu mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida ba nevaridia, vada bae helaḡa.
EXO.40.11.english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

EXO.15.9.motu: Inai tauna eto: Baina hahavadia, baina lasidia tao,
EXO.15.9.english: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder.

EXO.30.38.motu: Tau ta muramura ia heḡereḡerena baine karaia ia sibona ena, ia be ena iduhu amo bae negea daure.
EXO.30.38.english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

EXO.37.6.motu: Ikaruhina danu e karaia, gold namo-hereana amo; ena lata na kiubit rua mai kahana, ena lababa na kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.37.6.english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

EXO.37.4.motu: Maduna danu e kara, kela audia amo, bona gold amo e ḡovadia.
EXO.37.4.english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

EXO.33.16.motu: Badina be ede baina diba toma o lalo namo henigumu bona ina bese taudia o lalo namo henidiamu? Ba bamomai dainai baia, ani? Unu amo lau bona ina bese taudia vada baia idau, tanobada besedia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
EXO.33.16.english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

EXO.29.16.motu: Bena mamoe na bavalaia, rarana bavabia, ihaboulaina patana ohena kahana kahana ba nevaridia heḡeḡe.
EXO.29.16.english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

EXO.30.36.motu: Bena taina bavabia, ba hodoa dimura-dimura; bena taravatu mauana vairanai bavatoa diho, hebou kalagana lalonai, baina hahedinarai henimu gabuna ai. Ia na baine helaḡa herea emui ai.
EXO.30.36.english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

EXO.18.8.motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova ena kara idoinai harina na ravana e hamaorolaia: Israel dainai Iehova ese Farao bona Aigupto taudia ede e karadia toma, bona Israel taudia dala ai be ede e hekwarahi toma, bona Iehova ese ede e hamauridia toma.
EXO.18.8.english: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.

EXO.39.14.motu: Hari nadi hururu-hururudia na gwauta-rua, Israel natuna gwauta-raruosi heḡereḡeredia; nadi ta ta ai iduhu ta ta ladadia bae ḡasidia.
EXO.39.14.english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

EXO.7.18.motu: bena Nilo sinavaina gwarumedia bae mase ore bona ranuna baine bodaga; bena Aigupto taudia na Nilo sinavaina ranuna bae dadaraia, basie inua”.
EXO.7.18.english: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

EXO.19.17.motu: Bena Mose ese taunimanima na edia taruha amo e hakaudia lasi, Dirava vairanai bae gini; idia na e raka ela bona ororo badi-tanona ai.
EXO.19.17.english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

EXO.38.28.motu: A silver sekele daha-ta sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui ima e ḡaukaralai, du igaudia e karalai, bona du kwaradia e ḡovalai, bona du e kapalai heḡeḡe.
EXO.38.28.english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

EXO.6.11.motu: A raka vareai, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, ba hamaoroa, Israel taudia na baine kahudia nege, ena tano bae rakatania.
EXO.6.11.english: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

EXO.13.19.motu: Mose ese Iosef turiana danu e laohai; badina be Iosef ese Israel taudia taravadia vada e atua, eto “Momokani, Dirava ese baine vadivadi henimui; una negana ai umui ese lau turiagu bavabi kau”.
EXO.13.19.english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

EXO.31.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,

EXO.36.26.motu: mai silver hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai-kau ḡaudia rua rua.
EXO.36.26.english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

EXO.4.18.motu: Bena Mose ela, ia ravana Ietero dekena e lou lao, e hamaoroa, eto, Mani a kahugu nege, lau varavaragu Aigupto ai dekedia baina lou lao, baina diba idia dounu mamauri eiava lasi. Ietero ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Mai mainomu ida aola.
EXO.4.18.english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.”

EXO.21.15.motu: Tamana eiava sinana baine botaia tauna na bae alaia mase.
EXO.21.15.english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

EXO.9.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Daba matana ai ba tore isi, Farao vairanai ba gini, ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova, Heberu taumai emai Dirava, ini e gwau tomamu: Egu orea taudia ba kahudia nege, bae toma henigu diho.
EXO.9.13.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

EXO.35.6.motu: dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia; nani huidia;
EXO.35.6.english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

EXO.26.13.motu: Hari kalaga dabuana ena lata na dubu harana ena lata baine hereaia, kahana kiubit ta, ma kahana kiubit ta, unu bae hetau dobi toma, dubu ikoulaina.
EXO.26.13.english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

EXO.12.25.motu: Benaini, Iehova ese baine henimui tanona ai ba kau, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena negana ai ina toma-diho karana ba badinaia.
EXO.12.25.english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

EXO.26.5.motu: Dabua ta ai kunipa imahui ba kara, ma dabua ta ai imahui: hari kunipa bae hevaira heheni.
EXO.26.5.english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

EXO.40.10.motu: Ihaboulaina patana danu mai kohuna ida ba nevaridia: unu ba hahelaḡadia toma; hari ihaboulaina patana baine helaḡa herea.
EXO.40.10.english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

EXO.32.15.motu: Bena Mose na ororo dorina amo e hekei, taravatu nadidia ruaosi imana ai e kadidiha, unu nadi palakadia na kaha ruaosi ai, vairadia kahadia bona muridia kahadia, revareva vada e hetore.
EXO.32.15.english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

EXO.3.4.motu: Iehova ese e itaia, ia na vada e raka siri. Bena Dirava ese au ginigini amo e boi henia, eto Mose e! Ia na e haere, eto, Lau o ina.
EXO.3.4.english: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!”

EXO.32.32.motu: Edia dika boma gwau tao; a bema lasi, lau ladagu danu vada o torea bukana amo ba rohoa.
EXO.32.32.english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

EXO.9.17.motu: Doini o heaḡimu egu orea taudia vairadiai dainai ikahu-negedia so uramu.
EXO.9.17.english: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

EXO.10.26.english: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve Yahweh, until we come there.”

EXO.31.5.motu: bona herahera nadidia baine utu, bona au baine koro, ḡaukara idau-idau ikaralaidia.
EXO.31.5.english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

EXO.34.11.motu: Hari dina ai baina henimui haheḡanidia vada ba badinadia. A itaia, lau na Amoro taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia na umui vairamui ai baina luludia lasi.
EXO.34.11.english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

EXO.12.17.motu: Flaoa-asie-hatubua Ariana unu ba karaia toma: badina be emui orea loḡora Aigupto amo name hakaudia lasi dinana binai; taunabunai hari dina na uru iboudiai ese bae badinaia bona taravana bae atua ela bona hanaihanai.
EXO.12.17.english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

EXO.30.3.motu: Kopina na gold namo-hereana amo ba ḡovaia, pata bona aena bona doana; bona digina na gold amo ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.30.3.english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

EXO.25.27.motu: Hari ring be pata digina henunai ba koko kau, maduna audia bae hetoi hanai.
EXO.25.27.english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

EXO.26.20.motu: Ma dubu kahana ta, mirigini kahana ai, kaha ruahui ba haginidia,
EXO.26.20.english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

EXO.37.16.motu: Pata ḡaudia danu, mereki bona nau bona bio bona udu-ahudia keheredia, iboudiai na gold namo-hereana amo e kara.
EXO.37.16.english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

EXO.8.21.motu: Badina be basioma kahudia nege, lau na lao momo baina siaidia, oi latamu ai bona emu hesiai taudia bona emu orea taudia bona emui ruma latadiai bae kau; Aigupto taudia edia ruma bona edia tano be lao ai bae honu.
EXO.8.21.english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

EXO.27.14.motu: Ikoukou kahana ai itatau dabuadia na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi;
EXO.27.14.english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

EXO.38.27.motu: Hari silver be talent sinahu-ta e ḡaukaralaia, dubu duna ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia bona seseahu duna ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia e karalai: hahelai-kau ḡauna ta talent ta, hahelai-kau ḡauna ta talent ta.
EXO.38.27.english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

EXO.19.5.motu: Harihari lau eregu boma kamonai bona egu taravatu boma badinaia, umui na egu bese korokori ai boma lao, bese iboudiai bogaragidiai, badina be tanobada idoinai be lauegu.
EXO.19.5.english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

EXO.30.19.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida imadia bona aedia na una ranu ai bae huri:
EXO.30.19.english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

EXO.38.22.motu: Besalele, Uri natuna, Huru tubuna, Iuda iduhuna tauna, ese ḡau iboudiai e kara, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.38.22.english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.3.8.motu: Lau vada name diho, Aigupto taudia imadia amo baina hamauridia, una tano amo baina hakaudia lasi ela bona tano namo-hereana ai, taora badana ai, bae kau; una tano ai rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu, Kanaan taudia edia tano bunai, Hiti taudia edia, bona Amoro taudia edia, bona Perisi taudia edia, bona Hivi taudia edia, bona Iebusu taudia edia.
EXO.3.8.english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

EXO.27.18.motu: Maḡu ena be kiubit sinahu-tu, lababana be kiubit imahui, harana ena lata be kiubit ima. Itautau dabuadia be dabua aukadia. Du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia be auri labora-labora.
EXO.27.18.english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

EXO.20.23.motu: Silver diravadia eiava gold diravadia na basio kara.
EXO.20.23.english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

EXO.29.9.motu: bona edia gaba ḡaudia ba ḡeḡelaidia, bona edia kwara dabuadia kwaradia ai ba ḡeḡe. Edia hahelaḡa dagina na lauegu ai bae abia, baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna dainai. Aaron mai natuna ida unu ba hahelaḡadia toma.
EXO.29.9.english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

EXO.19.21.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, A hekei, taunimanima ba hadibadia, Iehova itana totona bae didi dara bena hutuma bae mase na garina.
EXO.19.21.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.

EXO.9.35.motu: Farao lalona vada e auka, Israel taudia se kahudia nege, Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa heḡereḡerena.
EXO.9.35.english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as Yahweh had spoken through Moses.

EXO.6.6.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ba hamaorodia: Lau binai Iehova; Aigupto taudia pa-gamui ai e ato madunadia na emui amo baina abi oho; vada e ḡuimui, a lau ese baina ruhamui nege; imagu goadana amo bona hahemaoro karadia metaudia amo do baina hamaurimui.
EXO.6.6.english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

EXO.17.3.motu: A taunimanima na ranu e masedia, bena idia ese Mose e maumauraia, eto, Dahaka dainai Aigupto ai vada o hakaumai lasi, bena ai bona natumai bona emai seri ranu-mase amo bavalamai?
EXO.17.3.english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

EXO.10.11.motu: Dia unuheto: umui tatau mo baola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, badina be emui ura bunai. Bena Farao vairana amo e luludia lasi.
EXO.10.11.english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

EXO.36.32.motu: ma au-ima dubu habana kahana ena, ma au-ima dubu duduna ena, lahara kahana ai.
EXO.36.32.english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

EXO.37.19.motu: Rigi ta ena kehere na toi, itadia na sakada huahuadia na heto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia, rigi iboudiai.
EXO.37.19.english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

EXO.9.16.motu: A ina dainai vada na hamaurimu: egu siahu baina haheitalaimu bena tanobada idoinai lau ladagu bae heatolaia helaoreana.
EXO.9.16.english: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

EXO.22.17.motu: A tamana ese baine rua, ia ese davana doi baine heni, bema adavaia heḡereḡerena.
EXO.22.17.english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

EXO.12.29.motu: Bena una hanuaboi malokihina ai Iehova ese roboadia iboudiai Aigupto tanona idoinai e aladia mase, Farao, terono ai e helaiva tauna, natuna roboana, ela bona dibura rumana ai e hekouva tauna natuna roboana, bona boromakau natudia roboadia danu.
EXO.12.29.english: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

EXO.12.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, Aigupto tanona ai, eto.
EXO.12.1.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

EXO.28.39.motu: Muri hahedokina na dabua aukana namo-hereana amo ba karaia, mai revarevana. Kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana danu dabua aukana amo ba karaia. Gaba ḡauna danu dabua aukana amo ba karaia, bona heraherana ba turi.
EXO.28.39.english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

EXO.31.14.motu: Taunabunai, Dina Helaḡa na ba matauraia, badina be ia na helaḡa emui ai: basine matauraia tauna na bae alaia mase; bona una dina ai baine ḡaukara tauna na ena iduhu amo bae negea daure.
EXO.31.14.english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

EXO.30.32.motu: taunimanima kavakava na kopidia basio dahulaidia, bona ia heḡereḡerena na basio karaia; ia na helaḡa, bona baine helaḡa emui ai.
EXO.30.32.english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

EXO.14.19.motu: Bena Dirava ena aneru, Israel ena taruha vairanai e nohova aneruna, na muridia kahana ela; bona ori dubuna danu idia vairadia kahana amo e heabi isi, idia muridia kahana ela,
EXO.14.19.english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

EXO.12.32.motu: Emui mamoe seridia bona emui boromakau seridia danu ba laohai, emui hereva heḡereḡerena. Vada aola: lau danu ba hanamogu.
EXO.12.32.english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

EXO.8.29.motu: Bena Mose eto, Oi vairamu amo aina raka lasi, Iehova baina noia, ini lao momo be Farao ena amo bona ena hesiai taudia edia amo bona ena orea taudia edia amo kerukeru bae heabi oho. Ḡau tamona, Farao na basine koikoi lou, emai taunimanima na Iehova ibouna baela, basine rudia.
EXO.8.29.english: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahweh.”

EXO.37.23.motu: Bena lamepa hitu e kara, bona ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia bona momoru iudadia merekidia, iboudiai na gold namo—hereana anmo e kara.
EXO.37.23.english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

EXO.30.24.motu: bona kida, metauna na sekele sinahu-ima; iboudiai gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡeredia; bona olive dehorona hini ta.
EXO.30.24.english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

EXO.22.20.motu: Ihaboulaina karana baine karaia, dia Iehova ena to idau dirava ta ena, tauna na baine havahuraia vaitani.
EXO.22.20.english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.

EXO.29.26.motu: Aaron ihahelaḡana mamoena kemena bavabia, ba davedavelaia, dave-dave boubouna ai bainela Iehova vairanai; bena bavabia, oi ahumu.
EXO.29.26.english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

EXO.30.7.motu: Daba iboudiai, lamepa baine haḡoevadia negana ai, Aaron ese muramura mai bonadia baine gabu, una pata ai.
EXO.30.7.english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

EXO.38.25.motu: Silver idoinai, hebou ai ladadia e tore taudia ese e heni ḡauna, ena metau be talent sinahu-ta sekele daha-ta sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui ima, gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena.
EXO.38.25.english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

EXO.30.30.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida danu ba horodia, ba hahelaḡadia; lau isiaigu bae lao heni, egu hahelaḡa taudia.
EXO.30.30.english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

EXO.21.24.motu: eiava mata davana na mara, eiava ise davana na ise, eiava ia davana na ima, eiava ae davana na ae,
EXO.21.24.english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

EXO.14.10.motu: Farao na e raka kahira; bena Israel taudia e roha isi, Aigupto taudia e itadia vada e lasidia tao, bena e gari dikadika, Iehova e tai henia.
EXO.14.10.english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to Yahweh.

EXO.38.3.motu: Kohuna idoinai danu auri labora-labora amo e kara: kahuna iudalaina urodia bona ikadolaina gagana bona dihu bona kahi bona rahurahu.
EXO.38.3.english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

EXO.24.4.motu: Mose ese Iehova ena hereva iboudiai e tore vaitanil; bena daba vaburana ai e tore isi, ororo badi-tanona ai ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, bona au=tubua gwauta-rua e holo, Israel idududia gwauta-ruaosi edia.
EXO.24.4.english: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

EXO.1.10.motu: aita laloa namonamo, bae hutuma herea bena tuari negana ai bae tore isi, inaida bae durudia, bae tuari henida, bona eda tano bae toretania na garina.
EXO.1.10.english: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”

EXO.22.22.english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

EXO.27.20.motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, olive dehorona ḡoevaḡoevana bae mailaia, lamepa diaranuna ai bainela; bena lamepa baine ara hanaihanai.
EXO.27.20.english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

EXO.3.13.motu: Bena Mose ese Dirava ma e hereva henia, eto Lau na Israel taudia dekedia bainala, baina hamaorodia, bainato “Tamamui edia Dirava ese vada e siaigu dekemui ai”, bena idia ese bae nanadaigu, baeto “Ia ladana be daika?”, lau be ede baina haere henidia toma?
EXO.3.13.english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”

EXO.39.16.motu: Gold e moḡe ḡaudia rua bona gold ring-dia rua danu e kara, hari ring na vaina isena ruaosi ai e turi kau.
EXO.39.16.english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

EXO.28.36.motu: Gold ḡoevaḡoeva mairina ta danu ba karaia, revarevana ba ḡasia, ini ba torea toma: HELAḠA IEHOVA ENA.
EXO.28.36.english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

EXO.2.21.motu: Bena Mose na una tau dekenai e nohova mai moalena ida. Bena una tau ese natuna kekenina ta, ladana Sipora, na Mose e henia, baine adavaia. ?
EXO.2.21.english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

EXO.7.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto, A kamonai: lau ese Dirava heḡereḡerena ai baina halaomu Farao enai, bona kakamu Aaron ese emu peroveta tanua ai bainela.
EXO.7.1.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

EXO.11.2.motu: Harihari Israel taudia ba haduadia, ta ta ese dekena tauna dekena tauna bae noidia, hahine danu unu bae kara toma, herahera ḡaudia, silver bona gold amo e karamu, bae noilai.
EXO.11.2.english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

EXO.40.12.motu: Bena Aaron mai natuna ida hebou kalagana iduarana ai bae gini bou. Ba hadigudia;
EXO.40.12.english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

EXO.22.18.motu: Babalau hahinena na basio bogaia hisi, vada baine mase.
EXO.22.18.english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

EXO.30.1.motu: Pata helaḡana ta ba karaia, muramura mai bonadia igabudia ḡauna; kela audia amo ba karaia.
EXO.30.1.english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

EXO.35.23.motu: Mai edia dabua taudia danu, vaiurina eiava mia-kakana eiava kakakakana eiava kurokurona, vada e heni. Haida danu nani huidia bona mamoe kopidia, e hakakakakadia ḡaudia, bona nani kopidia e heni.
EXO.35.23.english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

EXO.40.8.motu: Maḡu dabuadia danu ba tau dae heḡeḡe, bona maḡu ba sesea ahu.
EXO.40.8.english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

EXO.26.19.motu: hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui silver amo ba kara, kaha ruahuiosi henudiai bae mia, hahelai-kau ḡaudia kaha ta ta henudiai bae heato, ikoko rua rua amo ba kokodia tao.
EXO.26.19.english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

EXO.37.9.motu: Hari kerubi na hanidia amo ikaruhi e hakerukerua; e hevaira heheni, bona ikaruhi danu e vaira henia.
EXO.37.9.english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

EXO.16.10.motu: Bena AAron ese Israel hegogona idoinai e hereva henidia negana ai idia ese tano ḡaḡaena e haḡerea, bena Iehova diaridiarina na ori ai e itadia.
EXO.16.10.english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.

EXO.37.21.motu: Rigi rua tua amo danu buredia ta ta e koro: rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigidia henudia kahadia ai.
EXO.37.21.english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

EXO.12.19.motu: Dina hitu flaoa ihatubuna muramurana basie mia emui ruma ai: badina be e hatubua flaoana baine ania tauna, ena be noho-hedoa tauna eiava Isreal tauna korikori, to Israel hebouna amo bae nega daure.
EXO.12.19.english: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

EXO.20.17.motu: Dekemu tauna ena ruma basio ḡahusia, adavana danu basio ḡahusia, eiava ena hesiai tauna eiava ena hesiai hahinena eiava ena boromakau eiava ena doniki eiava ena kohu ta basio ḡahusi.
EXO.20.17.english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

EXO.38.12.motu: Lahara kahana ai itautau dabuadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai na kiubit imahui. Du bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia na gwauta; igau bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia be silver.
EXO.38.12.english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

EXO.4.13.motu: A Mose eto, Egu Ḡaubada e, mani emu kara idauna ta ba siaia.
EXO.4.13.english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

EXO.10.29.motu: Bena Mose eto, Vada o hereva momokani; vairamu basina itaia lou.
EXO.10.29.english: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”

EXO.29.42.motu: Ina ḡole-oho boubouna ba kara loulou, uru iboudiai; hebou kalagana iduarana badibadinai bae kara, Iehova vairanai. Unuseni ai lau baina hahedinarai henimui, bona oi baina hereva henimu.
EXO.29.42.english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

EXO.23.25.motu: Iehova emui Dirava mo isiaina ba lao heni; bena emu flaoa bona emu ranu lau ese baina hanamodia, bona emu gorere baina abia oho;
EXO.23.25.english: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

EXO.4.29.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ela, Israel tau-badadia iboudiai e haboudia.
EXO.4.29.english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.

EXO.2.3.motu: Bena ihunina asi dibana negana ai ia ese nini boseana ta e abia iena, raro-kaka mai kopukopu e tabaia ahu: bena ia ese mero e udaia, sinavai isena ai bautama lalodiai e atoa.
EXO.2.3.english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

EXO.39.8.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ena vaina danu e karaia, hahedoki e karaia heḡereḡerena, gold bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia.
EXO.39.8.english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

EXO.18.21.motu: Ḡau tamona, ini taunimanima iboudiai edia amo tatau namodia hahidaosi bavabidia hidi, Dirava garina e garimu taudia, kara gageva-gageva e inai henimu taudia. Edia dagi ba henidia: daha daha lohiadia, sinahu sinahu lohiadia, imahui imahui lohiadia, bona gwata gwata lohiadia.
EXO.18.21.english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

EXO.6.25.motu: Eleasara, Aaron natuna, ese Putiele natuna kekenina ta e adavaia; ia ese Fineha e havaraia. Levi ena iduhu ai ruma ikwaradia taudia bunu.
EXO.6.25.english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

EXO.25.2.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, edia herahia ḡaudia bae henigu; lalodia e namomu taudia iboudiai edia herahia ḡaudia bavabi dae, egu.
EXO.25.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

EXO.39.20.motu: ma ring rua e kara, hahedoki ai e turi kau, paḡa ḡaudia na hahedoki ida e hasiriudia gabudia ai, gaba ḡauna daenai.
EXO.39.20.english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

EXO.2.25.motu: Bena Dirava ese Israel taudia e haḡeredia bona e lalodia.
EXO.2.25.english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.

EXO.16.34.motu: Taunabunai, Aaron ese maua helaḡana vairanai e atoa, unuseni ai baine mia, Iehova ese Mose e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
EXO.16.34.english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

EXO.34.9.motu: eto, Ḡaubada e, boma lalo namo henigu, mani emu kara, ai, lalo-auka besena taumai, bogaragimai ai baola, emai kara-havara bona emai kara-dika ba gwau tao, bona dihimu ai ba halaomai.
EXO.34.9.english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

EXO.29.8.motu: Natuna danu ba hakaudia mai, bena edia ba hadokilaidia,
EXO.29.8.english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

EXO.26.2.motu: Dabua ta ena lata be kiubit ruahui taurahani, lababana be kiubit bhani; iboudiai edia lata bae heḡereḡere, edia lababa danu bae heḡereḡere.
EXO.26.2.english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

EXO.29.4.motu: Bena Aaron mai natuna ida ba hakaudia lao, hebou kalagana iduarana badibadinai ranu amo ba hadigudia.
EXO.29.4.english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

EXO.37.14.motu: hari ring be pata digina henuanai e koko kau, maduna audia bae hetoi hanai totona.
EXO.37.14.english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

EXO.25.30.motu: Nega iboudiai flaoa helaḡana na una pata latanai baine hedabara lau vairagu ai.
EXO.25.30.english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

EXO.38.15.motu: ma ikoukou kahana ai itautau dabuadia edia lata na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi.
EXO.38.15.english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

EXO.27.7.motu: Hari maduna na ring amo ba toidia hanai, ihaboulaina patana ohena kahana kahana ai, ihualaina ḡaudia.
EXO.27.7.english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

EXO.12.43.motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, eto, Lagau-hanai taravatuna binai: idau tauna ta basine ania;
EXO.12.43.english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

EXO.17.12.motu: A Mose imana e mase. Bena raruosi ese nadi ta e abia, ia murinai e atoa; bena ia e halai kau. Bena Aaron bona Huru ese ia imana ruaosi e dudui isi, ta idibana ai ma ta laurina ai; bena imana asie marere ela bona dina e diho.
EXO.17.12.english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

EXO.8.15.motu: A Farao ese e itaia, vada e madinamo, bena lalona ma e ha-aukaia, se kamonai henidia, Iehova ese e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
EXO.8.15.english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

EXO.3.5.motu: Dirava eto, Basio raka kahi mai, emu tamaka danu aemu amo ba koko oho, badina be o ginimu gabuna na tano helaḡana.
EXO.3.5.english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”

EXO.29.37.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai boubou ba kara, ihaboulaina patana ena; unu amo ba hahelaḡaia ela bona baine helaḡa vaitani, bona enai bae dau kau ḡaudia danu bae helaḡa.
EXO.29.37.english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

EXO.8.7.motu: A mea taudia na una kara heḡereḡerena ma e kara, edia mea daidiai, parapara ma e hahohodia Aigupto tanona idoinai.
EXO.8.7.english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

EXO.20.7.motu: Iehova emu Dirava ladana na basio hatoa kava hatoa kava; badina be Iehova ladana baine hatoa kava tauna na Iehova basineto ia na asi ena kerere.
EXO.20.7.english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

EXO.9.27.motu: Bena Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e boiridia, eto Lau na ina nega ai vada na kara havara: Iehova na maoromaoro; lau bona egu orea taudia na kara dika taumai.
EXO.9.27.english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

EXO.35.13.motu: pata helaḡana, mai ena maduna bona mai ena kohu idoinai ida, bona flaoa helaḡana;
EXO.35.13.english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

EXO.23.24.motu: Una negana ai edia dirava basio toma henidia diho bona isiaidia basio lao heni, bona edia kara danu basio tohotohodia; ba hadareredia vaitani, bona edia au-tubua ba ḡiḡidia rohoroho.
EXO.23.24.english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

EXO.32.16.motu: Hari nadi be Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia, bona revareva be Dirava ese e tore revarevadia.
EXO.32.16.english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

EXO.8.8.motu: Bena Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e boiridia, eto, Iehova ba noia, parapara na lauegu amo bona egu orea taudia edia amo baine abi oho, bena emui orea taudia baina kahudia nege, baela, Iehova bae boua.
EXO.8.8.english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat Yahweh, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to Yahweh.”

EXO.12.9.motu: Kasirina ai basio ania, bona basio nadua; tau-anina idoinai amu ai ba guraia, mai kwarana, mai imana, mai aena, bona mai bogana ida.
EXO.12.9.english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

EXO.3.3.motu: Bena Mose eto, Aina raka siri, ina kara idauna baina itaia, au ginigini na edeheto se ara ore.
EXO.3.3.english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”

EXO.38.4.motu: Pata digina na auri labora-labora amo e ha-aukaia heḡeḡe; hari auri labora-laborana na pata e ḡeḡea ahu, bona digina harana kahana ai e diho.
EXO.38.4.english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

EXO.13.11.motu: Bena Iehova ese Kanaan taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, e gwau henimu hamata bona senemu e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena, bona baine henimu,
EXO.13.11.english: “It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

EXO.12.44.motu: a emui hesiai taudia moni amo o hoidia na ba peritomedia, marinai vada bae ania.
EXO.12.44.english: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

EXO.9.28.motu: Iehova ba noia, badina be ini guba-rahu bona medu-hetari badadia vada eme davana. Vada baina kahumui nege; ina murinai basina dogomui tao.
EXO.9.28.english: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

EXO.28.5.motu: Idia na gold bae abia, bona dabua idau-idau, vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia.
EXO.28.5.english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

EXO.34.33.motu: Ena hereva e hadokoa, bena vairana na dabua amo e ḡovaia ahu.
EXO.34.33.english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

EXO.23.11.motu: a laḡani ihahituna ai ia na baine vahu, ogoḡami taudia ese anina bae abia. Orena na uda boromadia ese bae ania. Emu vine imeana bona emu olive imeana danu unu ba karadia toma.
EXO.23.11.english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

EXO.23.3.motu: A ogoḡami tauna danu basio durua hahemaoro ihagagevana ai.
EXO.23.3.english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

EXO.9.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Farao dekenai ba raka vareai, ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova, Heberu taumai emai Dirava, ini e gwau tomamu: Egu orea taudia ba kahudia nege, bae toma henigu diho. ?
EXO.9.1.english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

EXO.3.12.motu: Dirava ma eto, Momokani, lau ese baina bamomu, bona na siaimumu toana binai: oi ese Istarel taudia Aigupto tanona amo ba hakaudia lasi murinai, ina ororo ai umui ese Dirava ba toma henia diho.
EXO.3.12.english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”

EXO.9.34.motu: A Farao ese e itaia, medu bona medu-hetari bona guba-rahu vada e doko, bena is ese ena kara dika ma e habadaia, lalona ma e ha-aukaia lou, ia bona ena hesiai taudia danu.
EXO.9.34.english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

EXO.14.2.motu: Israel taudia ba haduadia, bae lou, Pi-hahiroto vairanai bae taruha, Migdol bona davara padadiai, Baal-sefon vairanai; ia hevaira-hehenina ai davara badinai ba taruha.
EXO.14.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

EXO.12.30.motu: Bena Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona Aigupto taudia iboudiai na hanuaboi ai e tore isi; bena taitai badana e vara Aigupto tanona ai, badina be ruma ta mase asi se kwabu.
EXO.12.30.english: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

EXO.14.23.motu: Bena Aigupto taudia ese davara bogaragina amo e ḡavadia, Farao ena hosi bena ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia iboudiai ese e ḡavadia. ?
EXO.14.23.english: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

EXO.30.10.motu: Laḡani ta ta lalodiai dina tamona ai Aaron ese kara dika itahunidia karana baine karaia una pata doana ai: kara dika boubouna rarana amo baine dahudia, laḡani ta ta amo, ela uru iboudiai; ia na helaḡa herea Iehova enai.
EXO.30.10.english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

EXO.17.9.motu: Bena Mose ese Iosua e haduaia, eto, Eda orea tataudia haida bavabidia hidi, baola, Amalek ba tuari henia. Kerukeru lau na ororo dorina ai do baina gini, Dirava ena itotohi imagu ai baina abia.
EXO.17.9.english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

EXO.36.11.motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai, kunipa varo vaiurina amo e kara; ma imaosi ta isena ai danu unu e kara toma.
EXO.36.11.english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

EXO.1.14.motu: Edia noho na dika, ḡaukara metaudia daidiai: raro amo e kara nadidia bona ihakamo-taodia ḡaudia e karava, uma ai danu ḡaukara idau-idau e karava mai hekwarahidia ida. Hesiai karadia idoidiai ikaradia ai e hahekwarahidiava.
EXO.1.14.english: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve.

EXO.12.49.motu: Taravatu be tamona, Israel tauna korikori enai bona noho-kau tauna enai.
EXO.12.49.english: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

EXO.31.13.motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, egu Dina Helaḡa bae matauraidia hanaihanai. Badina be ia na toa ta, lau bona umui padadai, emui uru idoidiai lalodiai: iena amo ba diba lau na Iehova, umui ihahelaḡamui Diravana.
EXO.31.13.english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

EXO.32.35.motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel taudia e hahisidia, badina be boromakau natuna laulauna Aaron ese e karaia idia ese e toma henia diho.
EXO.32.35.english: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

EXO.14.21.motu: Bena Mose ese imana e toia roro davara daenai; bena Iehova ese lai gubana amo davara e haloua, una hanuaboi idoinai. Bena davara na e haheparara, tano kaukauna e hedinarai.
EXO.14.21.english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

EXO.3.19.motu: A lau dibagu Aigupto pavapavana na basine kahumui nege ela bona lau imagu metauna bae mamia toho.
EXO.3.19.english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

EXO.36.35.motu: Bena seseahu na dabua aukana bona namona amo e karaia, vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana, bona kerubi laulaudia e turi, ia ihaheralaina.
EXO.36.35.english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

EXO.36.34.motu: Hari kaha na gold amo e ḡovadia; raroraro idogo-taodia ring-dia na gold amo e kara, bona raroraro na gold amo e ḡovadia.
EXO.36.34.english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

EXO.15.24.motu: Bena laolao taudia ese Mose e maumauraia, eto, Ai na dahaka baia inua?
EXO.15.24.english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

EXO.40.28.english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

EXO.30.31.motu: Bena Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ina na Iehova ena dehoro helaḡana, uru iboudiai;
EXO.30.31.english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

EXO.40.32.motu: Hebou kalagana ai e raka vareai bona ihaboulaina patana e raka henia kahi negadia iboudiai idia na unu e digu tomava, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.40.32.english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.37.15.motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo e kara, bona gold amo e ḡovadia, pata ihualaina.
EXO.37.15.english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

EXO.22.2.motu: Henao taudia na ruma ihamakohina ai bae davaria, bena bae botaia mase, ia rarana na asi davana;
EXO.22.2.english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

EXO.18.27.motu: Bena Mose ese ravana e hatonia; bena ravana na ena tano korikori ela.
EXO.18.27.english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

EXO.20.2.motu: Lau binai Iehova, emu Dirava: Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo na hakamu lasi. ?
EXO.20.2.english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

EXO.28.26.motu: Ma ring rua gold amo ba kara, vaina laloma kahana ai, isena ruaosi ai, ba turi kau;
EXO.28.26.english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

EXO.33.17.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Emu noinoi heḡereḡerena baina kara henimu, badina be lau ese na lalo namo henimumu, bona ladamu be dibagu.
EXO.33.17.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

EXO.36.14.motu: Una murinai dabua haida nani huidia amo e kara, dubu daena kalagana ena: unu dabua iboudiai be gwauta-ta.
EXO.36.14.english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

EXO.10.10.motu: Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Bama kahumui nege, Iehova ese bema rumui. Emui lalo-hadai na dika. ?
EXO.10.10.english: He said to them, “Yahweh be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

EXO.6.5.motu: Israel taudia, Aigupto taudia ese e hahisidiamu, edia taitai vada na kamonai; bona egu gwauhamata vada na laloamu.
EXO.6.5.english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

EXO.12.14.motu: Ina dina danu ba laloa tao hanaihanai; ariana danu ba karaia Iehova ena; uru iboudiai bae karaia, taravana danu bae atua.
EXO.12.14.english: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

EXO.38.21.motu: Hari dubu, taravatu dubuna, ikaralaina ḡaudia ihagaudia bini; Mose ena hahedua dainai e duahidia, Levi iduhuna taudia, Itamara, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna, ese e gunalaia oreana, edia ḡaudara bunai.
EXO.38.21.english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

EXO.7.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron ma e hereva henidia,
EXO.7.8.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

EXO.28.40.motu: Aaron natuna danu edia muri hahedokidia bona edia kwara iḡeḡelaidia dabuadia bona gaba ḡaudia ba kara, mai toadia bona mai hairaidia ida bae noho halaoreana.
EXO.28.40.english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

EXO.13.21.motu: Iehova na idia vairadiai ela, dina ai ori dubuna lalonai, edia dala ihahedinaraina, bona hanuaboi ai lahi mamana lalonai, edia diari, bae laolao boi bae laolao rani helaoreana.
EXO.13.21.english: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

EXO.33.14.motu: Iehova eto, Lau baina bamomu, laḡa-ani baina henimu.
EXO.33.14.english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

EXO.31.8.motu: bona pata helaḡana mai kohuna idoinai, bona lamepa patana mai kohuna idoinai, bona muramura patana,
EXO.31.8.english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

EXO.8.26.motu: A Mose eto, Unu baia kara toma na dia maoro; badina be Iehova emai Dirava ibouna ai baia aladia ḡaudia na Aigupto taudia ese e dadaraidiamu ḡaudia, bena idia vairadiai unu baia kara toma, idia ese nadi amo bae hodomai.
EXO.8.26.english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahweh our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

EXO.22.3.motu: a bema daba e rere murinai bae botaia mase, rarana na mai davana.
EXO.22.3.english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

EXO.20.5.motu: basio toma henia diho, bona isiaina basio lao heni. Badina be lau Iehova emu Dirava na vaḡeḡe Diravana: e inai henigumu taudia edia kara dika davadia na natudia bona tubudia latadiai baina kara ela bona uru ihatoina bona ihahanina,
EXO.20.5.english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

EXO.18.4.motu: A tau muritai ladana na Eliesere; badina ba tamnana eto, Tamagu ena Dirava ese e kahagu, Farao ena dare amo e hamaurigu.
EXO.18.4.english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

EXO.7.6.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron unu e kara toma; Iehova ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, unu mo e kara tona.
EXO.7.6.english: Moses and Aaron did so. As Yahweh commanded them, so they did.

EXO.22.1.motu: Tau ta ese boromakau ta eiava mamoe ta baine henaoa, bena baine alaia eiava baine hoia, ia na davana do baine karaia: boromakau ta davana boromakau ima baine heni, eiava mamoe ta davana mamoe hani baine heni. Davana na unu baine karaia toma; a imana bema tuna, ia bema hoia, davana ihaḡuḡuruna.
EXO.22.1.english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

EXO.32.1.motu: Israel taudia e itaia, Mose na ororo dorina ai e halahe, bena idia na Aaron dekenai eha hebou, e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, kaivakuku ba karaia emai, ai vairamai ai bainela; badina be hari Mose, Aigupto amo e hakaumai lasi tauna, na ede ela ai asi dibamai.
EXO.32.1.english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

EXO.36.4.motu: ela bona karakara taudia iboudiai, dubu e ḡaukaralaiava taudia, ese edia ḡaukara e rakatani,
EXO.36.4.english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

EXO.15.25.motu: Bena ia ese Iehova e noia; bena Iehova ese au ta e haheitalaia: ia ese una au ranu e urua diho, bena ranu gaiho vada e davaria. Una gabu ai Iehova ese taravatu bona haheḡani e henidia, e dibadia,
EXO.15.25.english: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

EXO.29.33.motu: Hari kara dika itahunidia bona edia dagi ihahelaḡadia ḡaudia na idia ese bae ani; a taunimanima kavakavadia na basie ani, badina be unu ḡau be hehelaḡa.
EXO.29.33.english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

EXO.12.12.motu: Badina be una hanuaboi ai Aigupto tanona baina rakaia hanai, natudia roboadia iboudiai baina aladia mase, taunimanima bona boromakau danu; bona Aigupto diravadia iboudia danu baina hahemaoro henidia; lau binai Iehova.
EXO.12.12.english: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am Yahweh.

EXO.28.12.motu: Bena unu nadi ruaosi be hari hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai bavatodia kau, helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, Israel natuna edia; Aaron ese ladadia na paḡana ruaosi ai baine hua, Iehova vairanai, helalo-tao toana.
EXO.28.12.english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

EXO.38.8.motu: Dihu ta danu auri labora-labora amo e karaia, mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna, ia danu auri labora-labora. Hari dihu mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida na hebou kalagana iduarana ai e gimava hahinedia edia auri labora-labora hevarivaridia amo e karaia.
EXO.38.8.english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.15.20.motu: Bena Miriama, peroveta hahinena, Aaron taihuna, ese tareko e abia imana ai; bona hahine iboudiai edia tareko e abi, ia murina amo ela mai mavarudia ida.
EXO.15.20.english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

EXO.16.30.motu: Taunabunai, dina ihahituna ai taunimanima na laḡadia e aniva.
EXO.16.30.english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

EXO.26.3.motu: Dabua ima ba siriudia, ma ima ba siriudia.
EXO.26.3.english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

EXO.14.3.motu: Badina be Farao ese Israel taumui baine herevalaimui, baineto “Idia na tano ḡaḡaena ai e raka hehiri-hehirimu, lalodia vada e haboioboio”.
EXO.14.3.english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

EXO.5.18.motu: Vada aola, emui ḡaukara a lou henia: uit momona na basie henimui, to emui ḡaukara ahuna korikorina do ba haḡuḡurua.
EXO.5.18.english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

EXO.13.18.motu: Bena Dirava ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e hakaudia lao, Davara Kakakakana badinai. Israel taudia ese mai edia tuari ḡaudia imadia ai Aigupto tanona e rakatania.
EXO.13.18.english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

EXO.8.18.motu: Bena mea taudia ese edia mea amo namo e havaradia toho, to ihavaradia asi dibadia. A namo ese taunimanima bona boromakau e koridia.
EXO.8.18.english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

EXO.22.12.motu: A ta ese iena amo bema henaoa, ia ese davana na biaguna bema henia.
EXO.22.12.english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

EXO.26.34.motu: Hari maua danu ikaruhi amo ba karuhia, helaḡa-herea gabuna ai.
EXO.26.34.english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

EXO.30.27.motu: bona pata mai ena ḡau iboudiai, bona lamepa patana mai kohuna idoinai, bona muramura patana,
EXO.30.27.english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

EXO.19.3.motu: Bena Mose e dara dae Dirava dekenai. Iehova gadona na ororo amo ema ia enai, eto, Iakob ena bese taudia ini ba hereva henidia toma, Israel taudia ini ba hamaorodia toma. Baoto
EXO.19.3.english: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

EXO.32.9.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Ina orea taudia vada na itadia, lalo-auka oreana.
EXO.32.9.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

EXO.25.4.motu: dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia; nani huidia;
EXO.25.4.english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

EXO.14.4.motu: Bena lau ese Farao lalona baina ha-aukaia, bena ia ese baine ḡavamui; a lau ese Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai baina hadareredia, bena Aigupto taudia vada bae diba lau na Iehova. Bena unu e kara toma.
EXO.14.4.english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh.” They did so.

EXO.18.1.motu: Mose ravana, Ietero, Midian hahelaḡa tauna, ese Dirava ena kara Mose enai bona ena bese Israel ediai harina e kamonai, e kamonai danu Iehova ese Israel taudia Aigupto amo vada e hakaudia lasi.
EXO.18.1.english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.

EXO.25.19.motu: duduna ta kerubi ta ma duduna ta kerubi ta; ikaruhi bona kerubi raruosi na gold siri tamona amo ba kara.
EXO.25.19.english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

EXO.18.19.motu: Egu hereva a kamonai; lau ese baina hahealo henimu bena Dirava ese baine hanamomu: oi na Dirava vairanai ba gini, taunimanima daidiai; edia daradara ba hedinarai ia vairanai.
EXO.18.19.english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

EXO.30.34.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Muramura mai gaihodia bavabi: natafa bona sekelete bona kelebena bona libano ḡoevaḡoevana, iboudiai metaudia heḡereḡeredia bavabi.
EXO.30.34.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

EXO.29.6.motu: Kwara dabuna danu kwarana ai ba ḡeḡea; bona korona helaḡana na kwara dabuana latanai bavatoa kau.
EXO.29.6.english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

EXO.4.31.motu: Idia na e kamonai; bena vada e diba Iehova ese Israel besena taudia vada e vadivadi henidia bona edia hisihisi vada e itaia dainai idia na e igo diho, e toma henia diho.
EXO.4.31.english: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.

EXO.29.31.motu: Ihahelaḡadia mamoena hidiona bavabia, gabu helaḡana ai ba nadua.
EXO.29.31.english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

EXO.23.32.motu: Idia ida basio herohemaino, bona edia dirava ida basio herohemaino.
EXO.23.32.english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

EXO.28.25.motu: a varo dududia na hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai bae hemata kau.
EXO.28.25.english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

EXO.6.23.motu: Aaron ese Elisebae adavaia: ia na Aminadab natuna, Nason taihuna. Ia ese e havaradia memerodia be Nadab bona Abihu bona Eleasara bona Itamara.
EXO.6.23.english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

EXO.25.24.motu: Gold amo ba ḡovaia, bona ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
EXO.25.24.english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

EXO.19.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, lau na ori badana ai baina vasi, bena baina hamaorolaimu herevadia na taunimanima bae kamonai; bena bae abidadama henimu ela hanaihanai. Bena Mose ese taunimanima edia hereva na Iehova e hamaorolaia.
EXO.19.9.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.

EXO.9.21.motu: a Iehova ena hereva e dadaraia tauna ese ena hesiai taudia bona ena seri e rakatanidia taora ai.
EXO.9.21.english: Whoever didn’t respect Yahweh’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

EXO.23.8.motu: Laloani monina basio abia; badina be lalo-ani monidia ese mata-kito taudia matadia e hakepuludiamu, bona kara maoromaoro taudia edia kara e hagagevadiamu.
EXO.23.8.english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

EXO.32.33.motu: A Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Vairagu ai vada e kara havara taudia iboudiai ladadia na egu buka amo bae heroho.
EXO.32.33.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
