EXO.34.30.motu: A Aaron bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese Mose e itaia, vairana e hururu-hururuva, bena iraka-kahi-henina e gari.
EXO.34.30.english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

EXO.35.12.motu: maua helaḡana, mai ikaruhina bona mai ena maduna ida, bona iseseahulaina seseahuna;
EXO.35.12.english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

EXO.25.7.motu: onuku nadidia bona hahelaḡa taudia edia dabua ihaheralaidia bona edia vaina ihaheralaidia nadidia.
EXO.25.7.english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

EXO.5.22.motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e lou henia, eto, Ḡaubada e, dahaka dainai ina bese taudia vada o hadikadia? Dahaka dainai o siaigu?
EXO.5.22.english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

EXO.37.27.motu: Ring rua danu gold amo e kara, pata digina henunai e kokodia kau, ta pata kahana ai, ma ta kahana ai, maduna itoi-hanaidia ḡaudia, bae huaia negadiai.
EXO.37.27.english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

EXO.10.23.motu: Taunimanima na asie heita heheni, bona edia helai noho gabudia amo asie tore isi, dina toi lalodiai. A Israel taudia iboudiai edia noho gabudia na didiari.
EXO.10.23.english: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

EXO.34.12.motu: A ba heita, ba lao henia tanona taudia ida basio herohemaino, ba hekwakwanai na garina.
EXO.34.12.english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

EXO.37.8.motu: ta duduna ta ai ma ta duduna ta ai. Idia na ikaruhi ida gold siri tamona amo e kara.
EXO.37.8.english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

EXO.12.11.motu: Ini bavania tona: emui rami ba hekasilai, emui tamaka aemui ai, emui itotohi imamui ai. Bavani haraḡa: una na Iehova ena lagau hanai.
EXO.12.11.english: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.

EXO.1.20.motu: Una dainai Dirava ese hari hegwaroto hahinedia e hanamodia, bona Heberu besena na eha hutumava bona e goada dikadikava.
EXO.1.20.english: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty.

EXO.28.35.motu: Ena ḡaukara helaḡana baine karaia negadia ai Aaron ese baine dokia, bena reḡena baine hedinarai, Iehova vairanai helaḡa gabuna ai baine raka vareai bona baine raka lasi negadia ai, baine mase garina.
EXO.28.35.english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.

EXO.33.7.motu: Mose ena kara na iniheto: kalaga e haginia taruha murimurinai, taina dauhai; ladana e hatoa Hebou Kalagana. Bena Iehova baine ḡuria e tomava tauna ese una hebou kalagana ela, taruha murimurinai.
EXO.33.7.english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

EXO.12.28.motu: Bena Israel taudia na ela, Mose bona Aaron e haduadia heḡereḡerena unu mo e kara toma.
EXO.12.28.english: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

EXO.16.21.motu: Daba iboudiai e habou, ta ta ena hitolo ena hitolo heḡereḡeredia. A dina e dae ai e veve oho.
EXO.16.21.english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

EXO.30.33.motu: Tau ta ese dehoro ia heḡereḡerena baine kariai, idau tauna baine dahulaia, ia na ena iduhu amo bae negea daure.”
EXO.30.33.english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

EXO.25.31.motu: Lamepa patana ta danu ba karaia, gold namo-hereana amo. Aena bona duna na gold amo ba koro: aena bona duna bona kehere bona heraherana, bure bona huahua, iboudiai na gold siri tamona amo ba koro.
EXO.25.31.english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

EXO.23.13.motu: Egu hereva iboudiai ba lalodia tao; dirava idaudia basio herevalaidia, bona ladadia basio hato.
EXO.23.13.english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

EXO.27.9.motu: Dubu maḡuna danu ba karaia. Diho kahana ai maḡu latana na kiubit sinahu-ta; itautau dabuadia aukadia na
EXO.27.9.english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

EXO.36.30.motu: Taunabunai, kaha na taurahani bona silver hahelai-ku ḡaudia na gwauta tauratoi, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai-kau ḡaudia rua rua.
EXO.36.30.english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

EXO.16.2.motu: Bena Israel hegogona idoinai ese Mose bona Aaron e maumauraidia, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
EXO.16.2.english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

EXO.2.14.motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Daika ese emai lohia ai bona emai hahemaoro tauna ai e halaomu? Emu ura be bavalagu mase, tau Aigupto o alaia mase na heto a? Bena Mose e gari, eto Ḡauna vada eme hedinarai.
EXO.2.14.english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?”

EXO.16.33.motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e haduaia, eto, Hodu ta avabia, mana nau auta heḡereḡerena ba udaia, Iehova vairanai bavatoa, uru gabedia edia.
EXO.16.33.english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”

EXO.38.18.motu: Ikoukou dabuana na vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka, varo aukana amo e turi, bona heraherana danu e turi. Ena lata na kiubit ruahui, bona harana ena lata na kiubit ima, maḡu dabuadia heḡereḡeredia.
EXO.38.18.english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

EXO.4.26.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese e kahua nege. Una negana ai hahine na eto, Rara ai vada ta headava, peritome dainai.
EXO.4.26.english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

EXO.8.4.motu: Harihari parapara na oi latamu ai bae dae, bona emu orea taudia latadiai, bona emu hesiai taudia iboudiai latadiai”.
EXO.8.4.english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

EXO.8.11.motu: Parapara ese oi bae rakatanimu, emu ruma bona emu hesiai taudia bona emu orea taudia danu bae rakatanidia, sinavai ai mo bae noho.
EXO.8.11.english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

EXO.18.14.motu: Mose ravana ese ena kara idoinai e itaia, taunimanima ede e karadia toma, bena ia ese e nanadaia, eto, Taunimanina ini o karadia tomamu anina be dahaka? Dahaka dainai oi sibomu o helaimu, a taunimanima iboudiai na vairamu ai gigini, daba ela bona adorahi.
EXO.18.14.english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

EXO.22.5.motu: Tau ta ese boromakau baine hakaua vareai idau tauna ena uma ai eiava ena vine imeana ai, eiava baine kahua nege bena sibona baine vareai, ia na ena boromakau ese e hadika ḡaudia davadia na ena uma ḡaudia bona ena vine anidia hereadia amo do baine heni.
EXO.22.5.english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

EXO.30.15.motu: Taḡa tauna basine habadaia, ogoḡami tauna basine hamaraḡia, sekele kahana mo bae henia, emui kara dika itahunidia herehiana Iehova ba henia negadia ai.
EXO.30.15.english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.

EXO.30.23.motu: Muramura namo-hereadia bavabi: muro ranuna, metauna na sekelesinahu-ima; kinamomo mai gaihona, metauna na sekele sinahu-rua imahui; kane mai gaihona, metauna na sekele sinahu-rua imahui;
EXO.30.23.english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

EXO.36.21.motu: Kaha ta ena lata be kiubit gwauta, bona ena lababa be kiubit ta mai kahana.
EXO.36.21.english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

EXO.2.24.motu: Dirava ese edia taitai e kamonai, bona ena gwau-hamata, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwau henidia hamata ḡauna, e helalolaia une.
EXO.2.24.english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

EXO.29.13.motu: Bena bogarau urubina bona ase digarana bona nadinadi mai digaradia ida bavabi, ihaboulaina patana latanai ba gabudia, bena bae ḡoledia oho.
EXO.29.13.english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

EXO.2.19.motu: Idia na e haere, eto, Aigupto tauna ta ese e durumai, mamoe ireḡudia taudia e gwaudia tao, ranu e utu henimai, bona emai seri e ha-inulaidia.
EXO.2.19.english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

EXO.23.29.motu: Laḡani tamona lalonai basina luludia lasi, edia tano baine vahu na garina, bona uda boromadia bae hutuma bena bae hadikamu na garina.
EXO.23.29.english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

EXO.36.25.motu: Ma dubu kahana ta, mirigini kahana ai, kaha ruahui ma e haginidia,
EXO.36.25.english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

EXO.35.33.motu: Herehera nadidia iutudia danu, bona au ikorodia, bona ima karakara daladia iboudiai baine diba.
EXO.35.33.english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

EXO.13.17.motu: Farao ese Israel taudia e kahudia nege murinai, Dirava ese dala kwadogina, Filistia taudia edia tano ai, se hakaudia; badina be Dirava eto “Idia na tuari mamina bae diba, bena bae helalo kerehai, Aigupto bae lou henia readia”.
EXO.13.17.english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

EXO.21.25.motu: eiava heara davana na heara, eiava bero davana na bero, eiava hedadaba davana na hedadaba.
EXO.21.25.english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

EXO.22.30.motu: emu boromakau bona emu mamoe danu unuheto. Dina hitu natuna roboana na sinana dekenai baine noho; dina ihataurahanina ai lau ba henigu.
EXO.22.30.english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

EXO.39.17.motu: Bena hari gold varodia rua na vaina ring-dia ruaosi ai e mata kau,
EXO.39.17.english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

EXO.18.16.motu: bona e hepapahuahumu negadia ai danu, idia na dekegu ai e maimu, benia na hahemaoro henidiamu, bona Dirava ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani na hadibalaidiamu.
EXO.18.16.english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

EXO.10.13.motu: Bena Mose ese ena itotohi toia roro Aigupto tanona daenai: bena Iehova ese lai laurabada kahana amo e siaia, una tano e toa henia boi, e toa henia rani. Dabi ai, una lai ese kwadi e mailaidia.
EXO.10.13.english: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

EXO.14.25.motu: edia kariota uilidia e hepuni, bena kariota na asie heau namonamova. Taunabunai Aigupto taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Israel taudia vairadia amo baita heau, badina be Iehova ese idia e durudiamu, ita e tuari henidamu.
EXO.14.25.english: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for Yahweh fights for them against the Egyptians!”

EXO.5.10.motu: Taunabunai ḡaukara biagudia bona heitatao taudia e raka lasi, Heberu taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Farao na e tomu “Uit momona basina hunimui lou;
EXO.5.10.english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

EXO.17.16.motu: Ia eto, Iehova vada e gwau hamata: Iehova ese Amalek baine tuari henia ela uru iboudiai.
EXO.17.16.english: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

EXO.36.7.motu: badina be vada e heni ḡaudia vada davana, una ḡaukara ena, bona orena baine mia e tomava.
EXO.36.7.english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

EXO.14.6.motu: Bena ia ese ena kariota e abia heḡaeḡae, bona ena orea taudia e hakaudia lao.
EXO.14.6.english: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

EXO.6.2.motu: Dirava ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Lau binai Iehova.
EXO.6.2.english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

EXO.16.31.motu: Israel taudia ese una aniani ladana e hatoa Mana: ia na nadinadi kurokurona na heto, a mamina na bada-ranuna amo e karamu dikeadia na heheto.
EXO.16.31.english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

EXO.24.2.motu: Mose sibona ese Iehova baine raka henia kahi; bamona be basie raka kahira, bona edia orea taudia danu basie dara dae.
EXO.24.2.english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

EXO.16.14.motu: bena hunu e kaukau negana ai ḡau maraḡidia kuborodia e hedinarai, itadia na medu hetarina na heto.
EXO.16.14.english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

EXO.35.11.motu: mai kalagana bona mai guhina ida; ena igau bona ena haba kahadia bona ena raroraro bona ena du, mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida;
EXO.35.11.english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

EXO.39.1.motu: Dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia amo gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia ikaralaidia dabuadia e kara, bona Aaron ena dabua helaḡadia danu, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.1.english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.26.32.motu: Gold igaudia amo ba taua dae; ena ihua-ihua bae hani, kela audia amo ba kara bona gold amo ba ḡovadia, bena silver hahelai-kau ḡaudia ai ba haginidia. Unuhetomana seseahu ba taua dae.
EXO.26.32.english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

EXO.21.12.motu: Ta ese tau ta baine alaia mase, ia danu bae alaia mase.
EXO.21.12.english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

EXO.26.12.motu: Hari e haruaia ḡauna na dubu murina kahana ai baine hetau dobi.
EXO.26.12.english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

EXO.33.2.motu: Aneru ta oi vairamu ai baina siaia; Kanaan taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia baina luludia lasi.
EXO.33.2.english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

EXO.36.17.motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai kunipa imahui e kara, ma tauratoiosi ta isena ai kunipa imahui e kara.
EXO.36.17.english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

EXO.10.28.motu: Bena Farao ese e hamaoroa, eto, A siri, nahuamu ba tohoa danu, lau vairagu basio itaia lou; badina be vairagu ba itaia lou dinana ai vada ba mase.
EXO.10.28.english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

EXO.23.7.motu: Basio hahebade koikoi; asi ena kerere tauna eiava kara maoromaoro tauna basio alaia mase; badina be kara dika tauna basina bogaia hisi.
EXO.23.7.english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

EXO.30.12.motu: Israel taudia ladadia ba tore negana ai, tatau ta ta ese edia mauri davana na Iehova bae henia, lada itoredia lalonai gorere ese baine aladia na garina.
EXO.30.12.english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

EXO.18.5.motu: Bena Ietero, Mose ravana, ese Mose natuna raruosi bona adavana e hakaudia lao, Mose na tano ḡaḡaena ai e taruha gabunai ai, Dirava ena ororo ai.
EXO.18.5.english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

EXO.16.1.motu: Israel hegogona idoinai na Elim amo ela, tano ḡaḡaena ladana Sin ai e kau, Elim Bona Sinai padadiai. Hua iharuana dinana ihagwauta-imana, Aigupto e rakatania murinai, idia na unuseni ai e kau.
EXO.16.1.english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

EXO.29.32.motu: Bena Aaron mai natuna ida bae ania, bona bosea lalonai e miamu flaoana danu bae ania, hebou kalagana iduarana badibadinai.
EXO.29.32.english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.28.15.motu: Hahemaoro vainana danu ba karaia, hahedoki e karaia heḡereḡerena ba karaia ḡoevaḡoeva, gold bona dabua idau-idau, vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka bona kurokuro, ba karalaia.
EXO.28.15.english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

EXO.9.9.motu: Una kahu na baine heḡiḡi rohoroho Aigupto tanona idoinai, bena iohururu bae vara bona bae toto, taunimanima kopidia ai bona mauri ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai kopidia ai, Aigupto tanona idoinai.
EXO.9.9.english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

EXO.10.16.motu: Bena Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e boiridia haraḡa-haraḡa, e hamaorodia, eto, Lau na Iehova emui Dirava vairanai bona umui vairamui ai vada na kara havara.
EXO.10.16.english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against Yahweh your God, and against you.

EXO.25.16.motu: Bena taravatu nadidia, baina henimu ḡauna, do ba udaia maua lalonai.
EXO.25.16.english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

EXO.6.3.motu: Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob vairadiai na hedinarai, Siahu-idoinai Diravana; a ladagu korikori IEHOVA asina hadibadia. ?
EXO.6.3.english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.

EXO.23.16.motu: Taboro ariana danu bba karaia, emu uma anidia ba utu matama negana ai. Lailai huana lalonai roge ariana danu ba karaia, emu uma anidia idoidiai emu roge ai ba habou vaitani negana ai.
EXO.23.16.english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

EXO.39.40.motu: maḡu dabuadia; maḡu duna mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida; ikoukou dabuana; varo bona ikoko; dubu bona hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaralaidia ḡudia iboudiai;
EXO.39.40.english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

EXO.13.10.motu: taunabunai ina haheḡani ba badinaia ena nega korikori ai laḡani iboudiai lalodiai.
EXO.13.10.english: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

EXO.29.21.motu: Bena ihaboulaina patana latanai e miamu rarana bona ihorona dehorona bavabi, Aaron mai dabuana ida bona natuna mai dabuadia ida ba nevarilaidia. Ia mai dabuana ida bae helaḡa; natuna danu mai dabuadia ida bae helaḡa.
EXO.29.21.english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

EXO.10.15.motu: Badina be tano kopina adoinai idia ese e ḡovaia ahu; tano vada e korema. Idia ese aniani avadia iboudiai e ani ore una tano ai, bona au huahuadia iboudiai medu-hetarina ese se hadika ḡaudia na idia ese e ani ore. E tubumu ḡauna ta, au eiava tano avana, se miava, Aigupto tanona idoinai.
EXO.10.15.english: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

EXO.3.22.motu: Badina be hahine ta ta na dekedia hahinedia bona edia ruma ai e nohomu hahinedia ediai bae noinoi, silver heraheradia bona gold heraheradia bona dabua bae gwaurai; bena natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia ba haheralaidia bona ba hahedokilaidia, Aigupto taudia edia kohu namodia vada ba dadihaidia.
EXO.3.22.english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”

EXO.40.13.motu: bena Aaron na dabua helaḡadia do ba hadokilaia. Bena ba horoa, baine helaḡa; lauegu hahelaḡa tauna ai bainela.
EXO.40.13.english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

EXO.9.20.motu: Bena Farao ena hesiai taudia hahidaosi, Iehova gadona garina e gariva, ese edia hesiai taudia bona edia seri e hakaudia vareai ruma ai;
EXO.9.20.english: Those who feared Yahweh’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

EXO.7.5.motu: Bena imagu Aigupto latanai baina atoa kau bona taudia na bogaragidia amo baina hakaudia lasi negana ai, Aigupto taudia vada bae diba lau binai Iehova.
EXO.7.5.english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

EXO.9.31.motu: Una negana ai flax bona bali vada e dika: badina ba bali anina vada e dobi bona flax vada e tubu.
EXO.9.31.english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

EXO.3.7.motu: Iehova ma eto, Momokani, egu bese edia hisihisi Aigupto ai vada na itaia, bona edia taitai, biagudia ese e hahekwarahidiamu dainai e taimu, vada na kamonai; badina be edia hisihisi vada name diba.
EXO.3.7.english: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

EXO.13.15.motu: bena Farao ese baine dogomai tao eto negana ai Iehova ese roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai Aigupto tanona ai e aladia mase, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia danu: taunabunai roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡaudia ai na halaodiamu, a natugu roboadia na davadia na karamu”.
EXO.13.15.english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

EXO.9.6.motu: Bena kerukeru Iehova ese unu e kara toma; bena Aigupto taudia edia seri iboudiai eha mase, a Israel taudia edia seri ai ḡau ta se mase.
EXO.9.6.english: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

EXO.12.37.motu: Bena Israel taudia na Ramese amo e laolao ela bona Sukoto. Aedia amo e raka taudia na domaga tauratoi sisivana, bona memero kekeni danu.
EXO.12.37.english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

EXO.14.13.motu: A Mose eto, Basio gari, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, Iehova ena hahemauri do ba itaia, hari dina ai baine hamaurilaimui, badina be Aigupto taudia harihari o itadiamu na basio itadia lou, lasi ona lasi vaitani.
EXO.14.13.english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

EXO.12.41.motu: Laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui e ore dinana korikorina, Iehova ena orea iboudiai na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi.
EXO.12.41.english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

EXO.39.35.motu: taravatu mauana mai ena maduna, bona mai ikaruhina;
EXO.39.35.english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

EXO.15.12.motu: Oi imamu idibana o toia roro, bena tano ese e hadonodia.
EXO.15.12.english: You stretched out your right hand.

EXO.23.9.motu: Noho-hedoa tauna basio hahisia. Noho-hedoa mamina vada o abia, badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava.
EXO.23.9.english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

EXO.39.11.motu: ere iharuana ai samarago bona sapairo bona vasiga;
EXO.39.11.english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

EXO.18.15.motu: Mose ese ravana e haere henia, eto, Badina be taunimanima na lau dekegu ai e maimu, Dirava ena ura bae diba totona;
EXO.18.15.english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

EXO.12.31.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e haduadia, eto, A tore isi, egu orea taudia bogaragidia amo ba raka lasi, umui bona Israel taudia iboudiai. Aola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, emui hereva heḡereḡerena.
EXO.12.31.english: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!

EXO.2.23.motu: Nega taina vada e daudau, Aigupto pavapavana e mase. Una negana ai Israel taudia e taitaiva mai lalo-hisihisidia ida, edia maduna metaudia daidai Dirava e tai henia.
EXO.2.23.english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

EXO.27.21.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida bae naria boi naria rani Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana lalonai, maua helaḡana seseahuna murimurinai. Ina haheḡani na Israel taudia ese bae badinaia hanaihanai, uru iboudiai lalodiai.
EXO.27.21.english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

EXO.36.28.motu: bona daiguni ruaosi danu kaha ta ta, dubu duduna ena.
EXO.36.28.english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

EXO.29.45.motu: Lau na Israel taudia bogaragidiai baina noho, edia Dirava.
EXO.29.45.english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

EXO.33.22.motu: Bena lau hairaigu baine raka hanai negana ai, lau na nadi kohuana lalonai baina atomu vareai, bona imagu amo baina koumu ahu, ela bona baina raka hanai.
EXO.33.22.english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

EXO.21.3.motu: Sibona emu ai baine raka vareai, sibona ma baine raka lasi; a mai adavana ida bae raka vareai, mai adavana ida ma bae raka lasi.
EXO.21.3.english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

EXO.32.24.motu: Bena lau nato “Mai edia gold taudia na bae koki oho”; bena idia ese e henigu. Lau ese lahi ai na tahoa vareai; bena ina boromakau natuna e lasi.
EXO.32.24.english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

EXO.37.5.motu: Unu maduna na ring amo e toi hanai, maua kahana kahana ai, ihualaina ḡaudia ai baela totona.
EXO.37.5.english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

EXO.36.33.motu: Bogaragi rarorarona na kaha iboudiai e hahesiriudia, duduna ela bona duduna.
EXO.36.33.english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

EXO.4.24.motu: Dala ai, adorahi ta ai e taruhava gabuna ai, Iehova ese e ginia ahu, baine alaia eto.
EXO.4.24.english: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.

EXO.26.28.motu: Bogaragi rarorarona na kaha iboudiai baine hahesiriudia, duduna ela bona duduna.
EXO.26.28.english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

EXO.27.19.motu: Dubu kohuna idoinai na auri labora-labora amo bae kara; dubu ikokodia bona maḡu ikokodia danu iboudiai na auri labora-labora ikokodia mo.
EXO.27.19.english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

EXO.14.17.motu: A lau be Aigupto taudia lalodia baina ha-aukadia, bena bae ḡavamui: bena lau ese Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai, ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia, baina hadareredia.
EXO.14.17.english: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

EXO.35.35.motu: Aonega vada e henidia, ima karakara daladia iboudiai bae haero bona bae kara; dabua ḡaukaradia danu bae diba: dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia bae hatu bona bae turi. Ima karakara ḡaudia iboudiai bae haero ḡoevaḡoeva bona bae kara ḡoevaḡoeva.
EXO.35.35.english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

EXO.20.11.motu: Badina be dina tauratoi lalodiai Iehovva ese guba bona tanobada bona davara bona lalodia ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, bena dina ihahituna ai e laḡa ani. Badina bunai Iehova ese dina ihahituna vada e hanamoa bona e hahelaḡaia.
EXO.20.11.english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

EXO.1.18.motu: Taunabunai, Aigupto pavapavana ese hagwaroto hahinedia e boiridia, e nanadaidia, Dahaka dainai ini vada o kara toma? Dahaka dainai natudia mamaruanedia vada o hamauridia?
EXO.1.18.english: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”

EXO.7.20.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ese Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia. Farao vairanai bona ena hesiai taudia vairadiai ia ese ena itotohi e abia, Nilo sinavaina ranuna e botaia; bena Nilo sinavaina ranuna idoinai rara ai ela.
EXO.7.20.english: Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahweh commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

EXO.39.31.motu: Bena varo vaiurina kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana ai e turia kau, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
EXO.39.31.english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

EXO.12.47.motu: Israel hebouna idoinai vada bae ania.
EXO.12.47.english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

EXO.2.10.motu: Mero na e bada oho bada oho, bena hari hahine ese e hakaua lao Farao natuna hahinena dekenai. Bena ia ese natuna ai e halaoa. Ia ese ladana e hatoa Mose; eto, Badina be ranu amo na veria lasi.
EXO.2.10.english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

EXO.23.2.motu: Hutuma muridiai basio raka, kara dika ikarana totona, eiava hahemaoro ihagagevana totona.
EXO.23.2.english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

EXO.26.35.motu: Pata na seseahu murimurinai bavatoa; lamepa patana be dubu diho kahana ai bavatoa, pata baine vaira henia, a pata be mirigini kahana ai baine gini.
EXO.26.35.english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

EXO.25.12.motu: Ring hani na gold amo ba kara, maua daigunina haniosi ai ba koko kau, kahana ai rua kahana ai rua.
EXO.25.12.english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

EXO.27.16.motu: Ikoukou dabuana na kiubit ruahui: dabua na vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka; varo aukana amo bae turi, bona heraherana danu bae turi. Ia duna bae hani, bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia bae hani.
EXO.27.16.english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

EXO.10.12.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Imamu a toia roro Aigupto tanona daenai, kwadi vada bae kau Aigupto tanona ai, aniani avadia iboudiai medu-hetarina ese se hadika na idia ese bae ani ore.
EXO.10.12.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

EXO.12.4.motu: A ruma ta taudia basie hoho, una ruma taudia bona e gini hetabira rumana taudia na mamoe natuna ta bae abia hebou, taunimanina hahidaosi na vamu iani-orena bae davana heḡereḡerena.
EXO.12.4.english: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

EXO.25.15.motu: hari maduna na ring lalodiai do bae mia, basie veridia lasi.
EXO.25.15.english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

EXO.29.20.motu: Bena mamoe na bavalaia, rarana kuri ta bavabia, Aaron taiana idibana abona natuna taiadia idibadia abodia ba dahulaidia, imadia idibadia bona aedia idibadia sinabadadia danu ba dahulaidia. Bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana ohena kahana kahana ba nevaridia heḡeḡe.
EXO.29.20.english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

EXO.28.13.motu: Nadi isedia na gold e moḡe ḡoevaḡoeva ba karalai;
EXO.28.13.english: You shall make settings of gold,

EXO.23.14.motu: Laḡani ta lalonai aria toi ba kara, egu.
EXO.23.14.english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

EXO.33.18.motu: Mose ese ma e noia, eto, Oi hairaimu bama itaia.
EXO.33.18.english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

EXO.5.4.motu: Bena Aigupto pavapavana ese e haere henidia, eto, Mose bona Aaron, dahaka dainai emui orea taudia na edia ḡaukara amo ba hakaudia siri? Aola, emui ḡaukara ba lou henia.
EXO.5.4.english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

EXO.12.50.motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia na unu e kara toma. Mose bona Aaron ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena.
EXO.12.50.english: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

EXO.2.20.motu: Ia ese natuna hahinedia e gwau henidia, eto, Tauna be edeseni ai? Dahaka dainai o rakatania? A boiria, ana ba dabaraia.
EXO.2.20.english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”

EXO.28.14.motu: bona gold namo-hereana danu ba moḡea, gold varodia rua ba kara, bena unu gold varodia na hari nadi isedia ida ba hunu kau.
EXO.28.14.english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

EXO.35.9.motu: onuku nadidia, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki bona edia vaina ihaheralaidia nadidia.
EXO.35.9.english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

EXO.5.11.motu: vada baola, sibomui uit momona ba ha tahua; ḡau tamona, emui ḡaukara ahuna basine maraḡi”.
EXO.5.11.english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

EXO.8.9.motu: Bena Mose ese Farao e haere henia, eto, Mani a hereva, edena nega ai baina noinoi oi daimu ai bona emu hesiai taudia daidiai bona emu orea taudia daidiai, bena parapara na unui emui amo bona emui ruma amo bae heabi oho, sinavai ai mo bae noho.
EXO.8.9.english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

EXO.32.23.motu: Badina be idia ese e hamaorogu, eto “Kaivakuku ba karaia emai, ai vairamai ai bainela; badina ba hari Mose, Aigupto amo e hakaumai lasi tauna, na ede ela ai asi dibamai”.
EXO.32.23.english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

EXO.21.17.motu: Tamana eiava sinana baine uduguiraia tauna na bae alaia mase.
EXO.21.17.english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

EXO.1.15.motu: Bena Aigupto pavapavana ese Heberu edia hegwaroto hahinedia e hereva henidia: hahine ta ladana na Sifra, ma ta ladana na Pua.
EXO.1.15.english: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah,

EXO.26.23.motu: bona daiguni ruaosi danu kaha ta ta. ?
EXO.26.23.english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

EXO.35.22.motu: Idia na ema, lalo-namo tataudia bona hahinedia iboudiai, gold ḡaudia idau-idau e mailai: pini bona gadei bona vaḡivaḡi bona ageva. Ibouboudiai ese edia gold e herahialai, Iehova ena.
EXO.35.22.english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

EXO.4.9.motu: A toa ruaosi basiema abi dae bona eremu basiema kamonai, sinavai ranuna do bavabia, tano ai ba seia, bena sinavai amo bavabia ranuna na rara ai bainela tano ai.
EXO.4.9.english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

EXO.24.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova enai ba dara dae, oi bona Aaron bona Nadab bona Abihu bona Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahui: dauha amo ba toma henigu diho.
EXO.24.1.english: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

EXO.23.6.motu: Ogoḡami tauna baine hahemaoro negana ai, hahemaoro basio hagagevaia ienai.
EXO.23.6.english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

EXO.29.10.motu: Bena boromakau maruanena ba hakaua lao, hebou kalagana vairanai. Aaron mai natuna ida imadia na ia kwarana ai bae atodia kau;
EXO.29.10.english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

EXO.21.35.motu: Tau ta ena boromakau ese tau ta ena boromakau baine alaia mase, mauri ḡauna na bae hoia, bena raruosi ese davana bae haria; mase ḡauna danu bae haria.
EXO.21.35.english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

EXO.28.38.motu: ia na Aaron baguna ai baine mia. Unu amo Israel taudia ese edia boubou ḡaudia bae hahelaḡadia kerere negadia ai na Aaron ese edia kerere baine hua; bena hari mairi na baguna ai mia dainai Iehova ese edia boubou baine abi dae.
EXO.28.38.english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

EXO.2.11.motu: Dina ta, Mose tauhauna ai, ia ne e raka lasi varavarana dekediai, edia hekwarahi e itaia. Bena ia ese Aigupto tauna ta e itaia, Heberu tauna ta, ia varavarana ta, e dadabaia.
EXO.2.11.english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

EXO.28.4.motu: Bae kara ḡaudia bini: keme ai e ha-inuamu vainana; hahedoki, muri hahedokina; hahedoki badana, kwara iḡe4ḡelaina dabuana; gaba ḡauna. Dabua helaḡadia bini bae kara, kakamu Aaron ena bona natuna mamaruanedia edia, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela helaoreana.
EXO.28.4.english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

EXO.39.13.motu: ere ihahanina ai berulio bona onuku bona iaspi: iboudiai isedia na gold e moḡe ḡauna amo e koudia heḡeḡe.
EXO.39.13.english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

EXO.40.15.motu: bena ba horodia, tamadia o horoa heḡereḡerena, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela. Ihorodia dainai idia na hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, edia uru iboudiai, ela bona hanaihanai.
EXO.40.15.english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

EXO.35.29.motu: Israel taudia bona hahinedia iboudiai ese edia lalo-namo dainai edia herahia ḡaudia Iehova e henia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia ḡaukaradia ikaradia totona.
EXO.35.29.english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

EXO.29.24.motu: Bena Aaron imana ai bona natuna imadia ai bavato, bae davedavelai, davedave boubouna ai baela Iehova vairanai.
EXO.29.24.english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

EXO.37.22.motu: Hari rigi bona bure na gold namo-hereana sirina tamona amo e koro.
EXO.37.22.english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

EXO.23.1.motu: Sivarai koikoi basio gwauraia. Kara dika taudia ida basio henega bou, hahebade koikoi igwaurina totona.
EXO.23.1.english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

EXO.19.23.motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Taunimanima na ororo ai basie dara dae diba, badina be oi ese o haduamai, hetoa baia abia, ororo baine ḡeḡea ahu, baia hahelaḡaia oto.
EXO.19.23.english: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

EXO.2.15.motu: Farao na una kara herevana e kamonai negana ai ia ese Mose baine alaia mase eto. A Mose ese Farao e heautania, ela, Midian tanona ai eha noho. Ia na ranu gurina ta badinai e halaiva.
EXO.2.15.english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

EXO.21.9.motu: A bema natuna maruanena baine henia, ia ese ravana korikori ai baine halaoa.
EXO.21.9.english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

EXO.22.9.motu: Boromakau eiava doniki eiava mamoe eiava dabua bae heailai, bena tau ta baineto “Ḡauna binai egu”, kaha ruaosi na Dirava vairanai bae hahemaoro; bena hahemaoro ai baine kerere tauna ese davana nega harua ia dekena tauna baine henia.
EXO.22.9.english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

EXO.15.6.motu: Iehova e, oi imamu idibana siahuna na herea-dae;
EXO.15.6.english: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power.

EXO.29.5.motu: Bena dabua bavabi, muri hahedokina bona hahedoki haleḡana bona hahedoki badana bona vaina, iboudiai na Aaron ba hadokilaia; bona gaba ḡauna danu ba ḡeḡelaia.
EXO.29.5.english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

EXO.5.1.motu: Una murinai Mose bona Aaron ela Farao dekenai, e hereva henia, eto, Iehova, Israel emai Dirava, ini e gwau tomamu: Egu bese taudia ba kahudia nege, idia ese agu aria bae karaia, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
EXO.5.1.english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”

EXO.10.27.motu: A Iehova ese Farao lalona ma e ha-aukaia, bena se kahudia nege.
EXO.10.27.english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

EXO.28.18.motu: ere iharuana ai samarago bona sapairo bona vasiga;
EXO.28.18.english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

EXO.16.8.motu: Mose ma eto, Iehova ese vamu baine henimui adorahi ai, bona daba ai aniani baine henimui, bogamui ihakunudia: badina be emui maumau, Iehova o maumauraiamu, herevadia ia ese vada e kamonai. A ai be daidia? Emui maumau be dia ai asio maumauraimaimu; Iehova hari o maumauauriamu.
EXO.16.8.english: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

EXO.29.2.motu: Flaoa asie hatubua e gabua, bona flaoa asie hatubua atagadia dehoro ida e bulo, bona flaoa asie hatubua atagadia latadia dehoro e seia ḡaudia danu bavabi. Ini na uit flaoana amo ba kara.
EXO.29.2.english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

EXO.10.18.motu: Bena Mose na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi, Iehova e now henia.
EXO.10.18.english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

EXO.5.6.motu: Una dina ai Farao ese ḡaukara biagudia bona heitatao taudia e haḡanidia, eto,
EXO.5.6.english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

EXO.7.25.motu: Iehova ese sinavai e botaia murinai dina hitu vada ela.
EXO.7.25.english: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.

EXO.8.27.motu: A baia laolao tano ḡaḡaena ai, dina toi baia raka, Iehova, emai Dirava, baia boua, baine haḡanimai heḡereḡerena.
EXO.8.27.english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”

EXO.32.26.motu: Bena Mose na taruha ikoukouna ai e gini, eto, Iehova ena kaha taudia na dekegu aema. Bena Levi natuna iboudiai na ia dekenai e hebou.
EXO.32.26.english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!”

EXO.21.19.motu: murinai ma baine tore isi, itotohi amo baine loaloa, hari e haberoa tauna na basine kerere; ḡau tamona, ena hekure dinadia davadia baine henia, bona ena muramura dalana baine lailaia ela bona baine namo vaitani.
EXO.21.19.english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

EXO.14.12.motu: Ai na Aigupto ai asia hereva henimu, a, asiato “Emai ai a raka oho, ai na Aigupto taudia isiaidia baia lao heni”, a? Badina be Aigupto taudia isiaidia baiama lao heni be namo, a tano ḡaḡaena ai baiama mase na dika.
EXO.14.12.english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

EXO.6.21.motu: Isahara natuna bini: Kora bona Nefeg bona Sikri.
EXO.6.21.english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

EXO.36.29.motu: Hari daiguni ḡaudia na henu ai e kokodia hesiriu, a atai ai idia na ring amo e hesiriu; unuhetomadia rua e kara, daiguni ḡaudia ruaosi ai e halaodia.
EXO.36.29.english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

EXO.7.14.motu: Bena Iehova ese Aaron bona Mose e hamaorodia, eto, Farao lalona vada e aukamu, taunimanima na basine kahudia nege.
EXO.7.14.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

EXO.31.17.motu: Ia na mia hanaihanai toana, lau bona umui Israel taumai padadai. Badina be Iehova ese guba bona tanobada e karadia, dina tauratoi lalodiai, a dina ihahituna ai e laḡa ani, bona e kara ḡaudia e moalelai.
EXO.31.17.english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

EXO.32.6.motu: Taunabunai, daba matana ai e tore isi, ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e kara. Bena e ege ege diho, e aniani, vine ranuna e inua; bena e tore tore isi, e gadara.
EXO.32.6.english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

EXO.39.42.motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na ḡaukara idoinai unu e haḡugurua toma.
EXO.39.42.english: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

EXO.8.16.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Aaron ba haduaia, baoto “Emu itotohi ba toia roro ḡahuna, namo ai bainela, Aigupto tanona idoinai”.
EXO.8.16.english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

EXO.16.12.motu: Israel taudia edia maumau herevadia vada na kamonai. Harihari ba hereva henidia, baoto “Adorahi ai vamu bavania, bona daba ai aniani bavania, bogamui ba hakunu; bena vada ba diba lau be Iehova, emui Dirava”.
EXO.16.12.english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’”

EXO.39.36.motu: pata helaḡana, mai ena kohu idoinai bona mai ena flaoa helaḡana;
EXO.39.36.english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

EXO.40.36.motu: Edia laolao iboudiai ori ese dubu e daetania negadia ai, Israel taudia na e tore isi, edia laolao ela.
EXO.40.36.english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

EXO.12.24.motu: Ina kara ba badinaia bona taravana bavatua, oiemu bona natumu edia, ela bona hanaihanai.
EXO.12.24.english: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

EXO.17.11.motu: Bena Mose imana e duduia isi negana ai israel taudia e kwalimu, a imana e hadihoa negana ai Amalek taudia e kwalimu.
EXO.17.11.english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

EXO.23.12.motu: Dina tauratoi ba ḡaukara. Dina ihahituna ai ba laḡa ani; emu boromakau bona emu doniki danu bae laḡa ani; emu hesiai hahinena natuna bona noho-hedoa tauna ese danu goada matamata bae abia.
EXO.23.12.english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

EXO.28.16.motu: Latana bona lababana bae heḡereḡere, bae ere rua; latana bona lababana na palapala lababana heḡereḡerena ai ba karaia.
EXO.28.16.english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

EXO.32.30.motu: Kerukeru, Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Emui kara dika na bada herea: a lau na Iehova enai baina dara dae, emui kara dika itahunina dalana baina tahua.
EXO.32.30.english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

EXO.2.16.motu: Midian hahelaḡa tauna na mai natuna hahinedia hahitu; bena idia na ema, ranu e utua, tamadia ena mamoe seridia e ha-inulaidia.
EXO.2.16.english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

EXO.15.26.motu: eto, Oi ese Iehova emu Dirava gadona boma hakala henia, bona ia vairanai boma kara maoromaoro, ena haheḡani boma badina bona ena taravatu boma kara, lau na hisihisi idau-idau amo basinama hahisimu, Aigupto taudia na hahisidia heḡereḡeredia; badina be lau na Iehova, oi ihamaurimu Diravana.
EXO.15.26.english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”

EXO.32.8.motu: na haḡanilaidia dalana vada e rakatania haraḡa, boromakau natuna laulauna vada e karaia, vada e toma henia diho, vada e boua, e tomu “Israel e, emui dirava binai, Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi”.
EXO.32.8.english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

EXO.32.21.motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e gwau henia, eto, Ini taunimanima na ede e karamu toma dainai oi ese ini vada o hakaradia dika toma?
EXO.32.21.english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

EXO.36.16.motu: Unu dabua ima e siriudia, ma tauratoi e siridia.
EXO.36.16.english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

EXO.10.5.motu: idia ese tano kopina bae ḡovaia ahu, tano na basio itaia diba. Bena amui aniani orena, medu-hetarina ese se hadikaia ḡauna, na idia ese bae ania ore; bona au iboudiai dounu mimia taora ai vada bae ani ore.
EXO.10.5.english: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

EXO.14.14.motu: Iehova na umui daimui ai baine tuari; umui na ba noho boioboio.
EXO.14.14.english: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

EXO.11.5.motu: bena Aigupto taudia natudia roboadia iboudiai bae mase, Farao, terono ai e helaimu tauna, natuna roboana, ela bona hesiai hahinena, uit iririlaina nadina e giroamu hahinena, natuna roboana, ela bona boromakau iboudiai natudia roboadia danu.
EXO.11.5.english: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

EXO.39.27.motu: Bena muri hahedokidia danu e kara, Aaron mai natuna ida edia, dabua aukana namo-hereana amo e kara;
EXO.39.27.english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

EXO.40.34.motu: Bena ori ese hebou kalagana e ḡovaia ahu, bona Iehova diaridiarina ese dubu e hahonua.
EXO.40.34.english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

EXO.18.13.motu: Daba ai, ose na hahemaoro gabuna ai e helai, taunimanima e hahemaoro henidia: bena taunimanima na Mose vairanai e gini, daba amo ela bona dina e diho.
EXO.18.13.english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

EXO.5.23.motu: Badina be Farao dekena nama, emu hereva na hamaorolaia; una negana ema bona hari ia ese ina bese taudia vada e hadikadia, bona oi ese so hamauridiamu.
EXO.5.23.english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”

EXO.35.28.motu: bona muramura, bona lamepa dehorona, bona dehoro helaḡana, bona muramura mai bonadia, e heni.
EXO.35.28.english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

EXO.31.9.motu: bona ihaboulaina patana mai kohuna idoinai, bona ranu dihuna mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida,
EXO.31.9.english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

EXO.34.23.motu: Laḡani ta lalonai emui maruane iboudiai na nega toi Ḡaubada Iehova, Israel Diravana, vairanai bae hedinarai.
EXO.34.23.english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

EXO.17.6.motu: A kamonai: lau na oi vairamu ai baina gini, Horeb nadi hagahagana ai, bena nadi hagahagana ba botaia, bena ranu unu amo baine aru lasi, taunimanima edia inuinu ḡauna. Bena Mose unu e kara toma, Israel tau-badadia vairadiai.
EXO.17.6.english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

EXO.23.21.motu: Ba hakala henia, erena ba kamonai; basio gwau edeede henia; badina be emu kara rea basine laloa nege, lau ladagu na ia lalonai dainai.
EXO.23.21.english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

EXO.26.15.motu: Dubu habana na kela audia amo kaha ta ta ba kara.
EXO.26.15.english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

EXO.28.11.motu: Nadi hururuhururudia iḡaukaralaidia tauna ese e ḡasidiamu heḡereḡerena, Israel natuna ladadia unu bas tore toma, unu nadi ruaosi ai. Bena isedia na gold e moḡe ḡaudia amo ba koudia heḡeḡe.
EXO.28.11.english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

EXO.29.29.motu: Aaron ena dabua halaḡadia na natuna ese bae abi, ia murinai; ihahelaḡadia negadia ai bae doki.
EXO.29.29.english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

EXO.27.5.motu: Hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana na pata baine ḡeḡea ahu, bona digina harana kahana ai baine diho.
EXO.27.5.english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

EXO.32.19.motu: Taruha e raka henia kahi ai, boromakau natuna laulauna e itaia, bona taunimanima e mavaruva e itadia. Bena Mose e badu dikadika, taravatu nadidia imana amo e tahodia dobi, ororo badi-tanona ai e makohi rohoroho.
EXO.32.19.english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

EZK.15.8.motu: Tano danu baina havahua, badina be e kara hebeatai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.15.8.english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.16.37.motu: a itaia, e ura henimu taudia iboudiai, olebulebulaidia taudia, o ura henidia taudia bona o dadaraidia taudia iboudiai, na lau ese baina haboudia; oi ihadikamu totona kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, bena gagaemu ai baina haheitalaidia; taumu idoinai ḡaḡaena ai bae itaia.
EZK.16.37.english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

EZK.44.30.motu: Uma ḡaudia roboadia idau-idau iboudiai bona emui herahia ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai, na hahelaḡa taudia ese bae abidia edia; bona emui igabu roboadia danu hahelaḡa taudia ba henidia, hahenamo na emui ruma latadiai baine mia helaoreana.
EZK.44.30.english: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

EZK.28.22.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.10.5.motu: Kerubi hanidia hudia na murimuri maḡuna ai e kamonai; unu hu na Siahu-idoinai Diravana gadona, e herevamu negadia ai, na heto.
EZK.10.5.english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

EZK.18.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva egu ai ma e kau, eto:
EZK.18.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

EZK.5.2.motu: Bena karoa toiosi amo karoa ta na lahi ai ba gabua, hanua bogaraginai, hanua idai-ahuna baine ore negana ai; ma karoa ta bavabia, dare amo ba tara utu-utu, hanua heḡeḡemadai ai; ma karoa ta na lai ai ba giḡia oda-oda; bena unu muridiai lau ese dare na pauana lalona amo baina veria lasi.
EZK.5.2.english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

EZK.22.28.motu: Ena peroveta taudia danu ahu ai e hedahu, vada e mata hanai koikoi bona vada e bagu haoro koikoi idia daidiai; vada eto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”, a ḡau be Iehova se gwa.
EZK.22.28.english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,’ when Yahweh has not spoken.

EZK.44.1.motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lou lao, gabu helaḡana murimurina kahana ikoukouna ala, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna. Ḡauna na vada e hekou.
EZK.44.1.english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

EZK.7.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Israel tanona na ini e hamaorolaia tomamu: Dokona binai! Dokona vada e kau, tano daigunina haniosi latadiai.
EZK.7.2.english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

EZK.29.21.motu: Una dina ai lau ese doa ta baina hatubua Israel besena ena, bona oi udumu bibinadia baina hapapa, idia bogaragidiai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.29.21.english: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.47.12.motu: Sinavai isena kahana kahana ai huahua audia idau-idau iboudiai bae vara. Idia raudia basie marai, bona huahuadia basie hehuhu, a hua ta ta amo huahuadia bae dobi, badina be ihapariparidia ranudia na gabu helaḡana amo e aru e laomu. Huahuadia na aniani ḡaudia bona raudia na hahemauri ḡaudia ai baela.
EZK.47.12.english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

EZK.33.25.motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hidio na mai rarana ida o aniamu, bona emui kaivakuku o gaga dae henidiamu, bona rara o hahebubuamu, matona, tano ba ḡaunaia a?
EZK.33.25.english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

EZK.7.27.motu: Hanua pavapavana e taitaimu; hanua lohiana darana e dokomu; bona tano taudia imadia na e hedabarai, gari dainai. Idia edia kara heḡereḡerena ai baina kara henidia, bona idia edia hanemaoro herevadia heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henidia; bena bae diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.7.27.english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.41.24.motu: Iduara ta ta mai kahadia rua rua, bona kaha ruaosi e helokuva bona e hulalava, iduara ta ta ai.
EZK.41.24.english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

EZK.27.21.motu: Arabia bona Kedara lohiadia Iboudiai edia hoihoi ḡaudia na o uralai bada: ḡaudia na mamoe natudia bona mamoe mamaruanedia bona nani; ini ḡau na emui ai e hoihoilaiva.
EZK.27.21.english: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.

EZK.27.12.motu: Tarasisi taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva, emui kohu idau-idau momo herea daidiai; silver bona auri bona auri haraga-haragana bona auri metauna na e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.12.english: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

EZK.40.49.motu: Dehe ena lata na kiubit ruahui, bona ena lababa na kiubit gwauta-rua. Vadavada moi-kaudia gwauta amo e dae henia; bona ihua-ihua badibadidiai na au-tubua, ohe kahana kahana ai.
EZK.40.49.english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

EZK.37.22.motu: Bena bese tamona ai baina halaodia una tano ai, Israel ororodia ai; pavapava tamona ese iboudiai baine pavapavadia. Idia na bese rua ai basie hahelao lou, bona basileia rua ai basie haheparara lou.
EZK.37.22.english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

EZK.36.36.motu: Bena doene e ḡeḡemui daemu besedia na bae diba lau Iehova ese e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia vada na haginidia lou, bona e vahu tanodia ai vada na hadohado lou. Lau Iehova vada na hereva; bona karana do baina karaia.
EZK.36.36.english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

EZK.8.15.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a? Kara dika-rohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, na do ba itadia.
EZK.8.15.english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

EZK.48.20.motu: Ba gwauraia hidi, tano idoinai ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima; una na tano helaḡana bona hanua tanona.
EZK.48.20.english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

EZK.28.25.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena taudia na bogaragidiai vada e karoho rohoroho besedia lalodia amo ma baina gogodia bona egu helaḡa idia lalodiai na bese idau-idau vairadiai baina hahedinaraia negana ai, idia na edia tano korikori, egu hesiai tauna Iakob na henia tanona, lalonai bae noho.
EZK.28.25.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

EZK.2.1.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a gini tore, bena baina hereva henimu.
EZK.2.1.english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

EZK.41.2.motu: Rakavareaina lababana na kiubit gwauta; bona raka-vareaina ohena habadia na kiubit ima, ohe kahana kahana ai. Dubu laloma kahana e hahetohoa; ena lata na kiubit hari-ahui bona ena lababa na kiubit ruahui.
EZK.41.2.english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

EZK.33.3.motu: bena una tau ese dare na tano latanai e kaumu ai bema itaia negana ai, kibi bema hiriria, taunimanima ihadibadia:
EZK.33.3.english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

EZK.43.25.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai, dina ta ta ai nani maruanena ta ba heni, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna ai bainela; bona boromakau maruanena ta bona seri mamoe maruanena ta asi bebekabebekadia, danu ba heni.
EZK.43.25.english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

EZK.23.41.motu: ege-diho patana namo-hereana ai o helai; ia vairanai pata ta o atoa, bona egu muramura mai bonana bona egu dehoro na pata latanai o atodia.
EZK.23.41.english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.

EZK.44.19.motu: Bena murimuri maḡuna ai taununanima dekediai bae raka lasi negana ai, idia ese unu dabua, kara helaḡadia e karalai ḡaudia, na bae doki oho, daiutu helaḡadia ai bae atodia, bena dabua idaudia bae dokilai, edia dabua amo unu taunimanima na helaḡa siahuna bae henidia hanai na garina.
EZK.44.19.english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

EZK.40.18.motu: Hari nadi ariarana na ikoukou badibadidiai ela; lababana na hari ikoukou lababadia heḡereḡeredia. Una nadi ariarana na henu ariarana.
EZK.40.18.english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

EZK.7.13.motu: Badina be kohu e hoihoilaimu tauna ese e hoilaia kohuna basine lou henia, edia mauri dinadia iboudiai. Badina be badu ḡaraḡara na edia hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai, bona basine heabi oho. Ena kara havara dainai tau ta ese sibona ena mauri basine rauaia diba.
EZK.7.13.english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

EZK.22.15.motu: Baina hakarohomui, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, bona tano idau-idau ai baina hakarohomui rohoroho; bona emu miro na bogaragimu amo baina ha-orea.
EZK.22.15.english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

EZK.1.15.motu: Hari mauri ḡaudia na raraidia, bena ava-keikeina na tanobada ai na itaia, mauri ḡaudia ta ta ediai ta ta.
EZK.1.15.english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

EZK.11.17.motu: Taunabunai baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia, amo baina hahegogomui, bona tano idau-idau, lalodiai vada e hakarohomui tanodia, amo baina haheboumui, Israel tanona na baina henimui.
EZK.11.17.english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

EZK.11.16.motu: Taunabunai oi na baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ena be dauha na laohaidia, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, ena be tano idau-idau lalodiai na hakarohodia rohoroho, to vada ela tanodia lalodiai lau na edia gabu helaḡana ina nega hekada hanai.
EZK.11.16.english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

EZK.27.11.motu: Aravada bona Heleke taudia na maḡumu latadiai e gini heḡeḡe, bona Gamada taudia na kohoromu ai; idia ese oi maḡumu heḡege-madai ai edia kesi e taudia dae; oi hairaimu na vada e haḡuḡurua.
EZK.27.11.english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around,

EZK.34.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.34.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.16.26.motu: Aigupto taudia, dekemu taudia mai edia mata-bodaga, ida danu vada o lebulebu, emu ariara karadia vada o habada, lau ihabadugu.
EZK.16.26.english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

EZK.33.27.motu: Ini ba hamaorodia toma, baoto, Ḡaubada. Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, gabu ḡagaedia ai e nohomu taudia na dare ai do bae mase; bona tano paka ai e nohomu tauna na uda boromadia baina henidia, idia ese bae ania; bona gabu aukadia ai bona kohua lalodiai e nohomu taudia na dai-hanai gorerena ese baine hamasedia.
EZK.33.27.english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

EZK.36.23.motu: Lau ladagu hereana ena helaḡa, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai vada e miro badina be umui ese vada o hamiroa ḡauna, na lau ese baina gwauraia maoro; bena umui emui amo egu helaḡa na idia vairadiai baina gwauraia maoro negana ai, bese idau-idau bae diba lau na Iehova. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.36.23.english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh,” says the Lord Yahweh, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

EZK.46.1.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Laloma maḡuna ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna, na baine hekou, ḡaukara dinadia tauratoiosi lalodiai; a dina helaḡa ai bona hua matamatana dinana ai vada bae kehoa.
EZK.46.1.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

EZK.47.4.motu: Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo ma e hakaugu hanai; tuimai ai e raro. Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo ma e hakaugu hanai; koekoemai ai e raro.
EZK.47.4.english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

EZK.15.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, vine auna ese au haida ede e hereadia tomamu; vine rigina ese uda audia rigidia ede e hereadia tomamu?
EZK.15.2.english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

EZK.34.9.motu: una dainai, mamoe ireḡudia taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
EZK.34.9.english: therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word!”

EZK.30.21.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, imana vada na hakwaidua; a itaia, ihanamona totona ikumi dabuana amo bema kumia, bena bema auka, dare iḡaukaralaina heḡereḡerena, a ta ese se kumia.
EZK.30.21.english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.

EZK.39.14.motu: Tatau haida bae gwauraidia hidi, idia ese tano bae rakaia hanai loulou bona tano kopina ai miadia taudia bae guridia totona; unu amo tano bae haḡoevaia. Hua hitu bae ore ai do bae hetahu.
EZK.39.14.english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.
