EZK.35.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, vairamu ba huaia Seiri ororona enai; bena ia latanai ba peroveta,
EZK.35.2.english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

EZK.32.9.motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, asi dibamu tanodia lalodiai, mai iguimu ida baina laohaimu negana ai, bese momo taudia kudoudia baina hahetahadia.
EZK.32.9.english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples,

EZK.43.27.motu: Unu dina bae haḡuḡurudia, bona dina ihataurahanina amo hahelaḡa taudia ese emui ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emui maino bouboudia ḡaudia na bae hahelaḡadia, ihaboulaina patana latanai; bena lau ese baina abimui dae. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.43.27.english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.45.5.motu: Ma kaha ta, ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta na Levi taudia, dubu lalonai kara helaḡadia e karamu taudia, edia; bae ḡaunaia, bae noholaidia hanuadia unuseni ai bae hadai.
EZK.45.5.english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

EZK.27.19.motu: bona vine ranuna Usala amo e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia; o hoihoilai ḡaudia haida na auri hururu-hururuna bona kida bona kane.
EZK.27.19.english: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.

EZK.17.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.17.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.1.14.motu: Bona hari mauri ḡaudia na e tata eva-eva, kevaru na heto.
EZK.1.14.english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

EZK.48.29.motu: Tanona bunai ba haria, Israel iduhudia ahudia ba henidia; ahudia ta ta bunu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.48.29.english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.20.27.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina kara ai danu senemui ese e uduguiraigu, e kara koikoi henigu dainai.
EZK.20.27.english: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

EZK.23.33.english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow,

EZK.36.16.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.36.16.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.44.12.motu: Badina be idia ese kara helaḡadia e kara, edia kaivakuku vairadiai, bona kara dika-rohorohodia amo Israel besena ihahekwakwanaina ḡauna ai ela; taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu: Lau na idia latadiai vada na gwau hamata, edia dika davadia do bae hua.
EZK.44.12.english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and they will bear their iniquity.

EZK.23.37.motu: Badina be idia na vada e heuda hanai, bona rara na imadia ai; edia kaivakuku ida vada e heuda hanai; bona natudia mamaruanedia, lauegu amo e abidia memerodia, na boubou karana ai idia e henidia, adia.
EZK.23.37.english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

EZK.9.10.motu: A lau be basina haḡeredia bona basina bogadia hisi, a edia kara heḡereḡeredia ai na tubuadia ai baina kara.
EZK.9.10.english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

EZK.21.9.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a peroveta, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Baoto
EZK.21.9.english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says:

EZK.22.5.motu: Harimu dika-rohoroho ḡauna, heloḡo-ahuahu hanuana, e noho hetabiramu taudia bona daudaudia ai e nohomu taudia ese bae ḡonaḡonalaimu.
EZK.22.5.english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.

EZK.16.9.motu: Bena ranu ai na hadigumu, raramu na huria oho, bona dehoro amo na dahumu.
EZK.16.9.english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

EZK.8.5.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a gaga isi, mirigini kahana ba roha henia. Bena na gaga isi, mirigini kahana na roha henia, na itaia, ihaboulaina patana ikoukouna mirigini kahana ai, raka-vareaina ai, hari vaḡeḡe kaivakukuna na mia.
EZK.8.5.english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.”

EZK.13.18.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e g vau tomamu: Taunimanima laumadia idoadia totona mea ganadia na ima ganaganadia iboudiai ai e turidia, bona heḡova-ahu mukodia, taunimanima kikina-badana kwaradia igovalaidia, e karamu, hahinedia madi ihabaidia! gu orea taudia laumadia ba idoadia bona ma haida danu laumadia ba hamauridia, umui sibomui emui namo ihabadana a?
EZK.13.18.english: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

EZK.22.21.motu: Baina haboumui, egu badu ḡaraḡara lahina ai baina pururumui, bena ia bogaraginai ba veve oho.
EZK.22.21.english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.

EZK.3.18.motu: Kara dika tauna bama hamaoroa, bama toma “Oi na vada ba mase”, bena oi basioma sisiba henia, una kara dika tauna na ena dala dikana amo ihakau-sirina bona ena mauri irauana herevadia basioma sisibalai henia, una kara dika tauna na ena dika ai baine mase; a ia rarana davana na oi imamu amo baina gwauraia.
EZK.3.18.english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

EZK.24.11.motu: Bena asi anina ai gida latadiai bavatoa kau, baine siahu totona, bena aurina labora-laborana na baine kiama-kiama; bena mirona na baine veve ia lalonai, bona deḡideḡina na baine ara ore.
EZK.24.11.english: Then set it empty on its coals,

EZK.16.24.motu: oi ese emu kalaga o haginidia bona emu pata helaḡadia o kara, ruma ariaradia iboudiai lalodiai.
EZK.16.24.english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

EZK.21.25.motu: Oi danu, Israel pavapavana, tau dikana, o hahemiro taumu, emu dina vada e kau, davamu bavabia vaitani negana vada e kau.
EZK.21.25.english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

EZK.36.4.motu: Taunabunai, Israel ororodia e, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai; ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, bona koura dobudobudia bona koura iboudiai, bona gabu gagaedia bona hanua ahutudia, bese oredia hegegemadai ai ese damudia ai vada e halaodia bona vada e kirikirilaidiamu ḡaudia na Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini e hereva henidia tomamu.
EZK.36.4.english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

EZK.40.15.motu: Ikoukou vaira-kahana raka-vareaina ela bona ikoukou lalona kahana dehena na kiubit imahui.
EZK.40.15.english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

EZK.16.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ierusalem na ena kara dika-rohorohodia ba hedaraunelai henia,
EZK.16.2.english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

EZK.7.25.motu: Lalo-hisihisi bada baine kau negana ai, idia ese maino bae tahua, to basie davaria.
EZK.7.25.english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

EZK.29.20.motu: Lau ese Aigupto tanona vada na henia, ena hekwarahi davana, badina be idia na lauegu ai e ḡaukara. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.29.20.english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.36.8.motu: A umui, Israel ororodia e, emui au rigidia bae gara kau, bona emui au huahuadia bae dobi, egu bese Israel adia; badina be asi vanahana edia gabu korikori bae lou henia.
EZK.36.8.english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

EZK.12.18.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, amu bavania mai kudou-hetahamu ida, bona ranu ba inua mai heudeheudemu bona mai garimu ida,
EZK.12.18.english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

EZK.12.24.motu: Badina be mata-hanai koikoidia bona bagu-haoro koikoidia na bae doko, Israel besena ai.
EZK.12.24.english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

EZK.23.35.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be vada o lalogu boio bona murimu ai vada o negegu, una dainai emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia davadia bavabi.
EZK.23.35.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”

EZK.10.14.motu: Idia ta ta vairadia na hani: vaira gini-gunana na kerubi vairana; vaira iharuana na tau vairana; vaira ihatoina na leona vairana, bona vaira ihahanina na ugava vairana.
EZK.10.14.english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

EZK.11.13.motu: Bena lau na perovetava lalonai Pelatia Benaia e mase. Bena na goru diho, na lolo badabada, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, Israel kwabukwabudia ba ha-oredia vaitani a?
EZK.11.13.english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

EZK.12.11.motu: Ma baoto, Lau na toa ta emui ai; lau vada na karaia heḡereḡerena ai, unu bae kara henidia toma; idia na dauhai bae hanohodia mai iḡuidia ida.
EZK.12.11.english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

EZK.46.10.motu: Bae raka vareai negana ai, hanua pavapavana na idia ida baine raka vareai; bona bae raka lasi negana ai, ia danu baine raka lasi.
EZK.46.10.english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

EZK.20.35.motu: Bena bese idau-idau edia tano ḡaḡaena ai baina hakaumui vareai; unuseni ai hevaira-hehenida ai baina hahemaoro henimui.
EZK.20.35.english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

EZK.4.16.motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, Ierusalem ai mauri anianina na baina abia oho; aniani metauna bae hahetohoa guna bena bae ania mai garidia ida; bona ranu na bae hahetohoa guna, bena bae inua mai kudou-hetahadia ida.
EZK.4.16.english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

EZK.11.24.motu: Bena Lauma ese e haheabigu isi, bona Dirava ena Lauma mata-hanaina lalonai Kaldea e laohaigu, unuseni ai vada e hanohodia taudia dekediai. Bena hari mata-hanai, na itaia ḡauna, ese e rakatanigu.
EZK.11.24.english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives.

EZK.19.8.motu: Bena bese idau-idau ese ia iabina idoadia e oto hegeḡe;
EZK.19.8.english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces.

EZK.43.21.motu: Bena una boromakau maruanena, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna, na bavabia, vada e gwauraia hidi gabuna ai ba haḡolea oho, dubu tanona ai, to helaḡa gabuna murimurinai.
EZK.43.21.english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

EZK.43.24.motu: Iehova vairanai ba heni, bena hahelaḡa taudia ese damena na latadiai bae ḡiḡi, bena bae haḡoledia oho, Iehova ena.
EZK.43.24.english: You shall bring them near to Yahweh, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

EZK.8.6.motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, idia na ede e kara tomamu o itaiamu a? Kara dika-rohoroho bada-hereadia, Israel besena ese egu gabu helaḡana amo bae lulugu oho helaoreana ai e karamu ḡaudia, o itadiamu a? A kara dikarohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, na do ba itadia.
EZK.8.6.english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

EZK.44.24.motu: Heai lalodiai idia na hahemaoro taudia ai baela; bona lauegu hahemaoro daladia amo bae hahemaoro. Egu taravatu bona egu hahedua herevadia bae badinadia, vada na gwauraidia ariadia iboudiai lalodiai; bona egu dina helaḡadia bae hahelaḡadia.
EZK.44.24.english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

EZK.40.43.motu: Igau haida danu, edia lata na ima-palapala ta lababana heḡereḡerena, na lalonai e hetau dae heḡeḡe. Unu pata latadiai na boubou ḡaudia hidiodia bae atodia.
EZK.40.43.english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

EZK.20.39.motu: A oi, Israel besena e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bema basio kamonai henigu, vada baola, ta ta ena kaivakuku ena kaivakuku isiaidia ba lao heni, harihati bona nega gabedia ai danu; a lau ladagu helaḡana na emui herahia ḡaudia eiava emui kaivakuku amo nega ta ai basio hamuoa lou.
EZK.20.39.english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord Yahweh says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

EZK.38.12.motu: edia kohu baina dadi, bona baina dadi ḡaudia na baina laohai; gunaguna e vahu a harihari taunimanima ese e noholaimu gabudia baina tuari henidia; bona bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo vada e hahebou edia boromakau bona edia kohu vada e habou taudia, tano bogaraginai e nohomu taudia, danu baina tuari henidia.
EZK.38.12.english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’

EZK.26.14.motu: Nadi kikiri ai baina halaomu; reke itoredia gabuna ai ba hahelao; nega ta ai basie haginimu lou; badina be lau Iehova vada na hereva. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.26.14.english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.48.25.motu: Simeon ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Isakara ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.25.english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

EZK.43.17.motu: Digina danu ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, latana kiubit gwauta-hani bona lababana kiubit gwauta-hani; isena danu baine geḡea ahu, ia lababana na kiubit duduna. Bona ia badina heḡeḡemadai ai na kiubit tamona. Ihaboulaina patana vadavadana na mairiveina kahana baine vaira henia.
EZK.43.17.english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

EZK.45.10.motu: Hahetoho ḡaudia momokanidia bavabi, bona efa momokanina bona bata momokanina danu.
EZK.45.10.english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

EZK.11.23.motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na hanua bogaragina amo e dae, hanua mairiveina kahana ororona ai e miava.
EZK.11.23.english: Yahweh’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

EZK.33.9.motu: A kara dika tauna boma sisiba henia, ena dala amo baine raka siri totona, bena ia na ena dala amo basinema raka oho, ia na ena dika ai baine mase, a oi na emu mauri do ba rauaia.
EZK.33.9.english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

EZK.22.11.motu: Ta na dekena tauna adavana ida e heuda hanaimu; ma ta na rava-maragi hahinena ida e eno boumu; ma ta oi lalomu ai na ia taihuna korikorina ida e eno boumu.
EZK.22.11.english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

EZK.30.16.english: I will set a fire in Egypt

EZK.12.15.motu: Bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina luludia lao, bona tano idau-idau lalodiai baina hakarohodia negana ai, idia na bae diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.12.15.english: “‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

EZK.18.10.motu: Natuna maruanena ta bema havaraia, bena una mero na dadidadi bona rara ihahebubuna tauna ai bema hahelao,
EZK.18.10.english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

EZK.11.7.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui mase taudia, hanua bogaraginai vada o atodia, idia na vamu, bona ina hanua na inadulaidia urona; a umui na bogaragina amo bae hakaumui lasi.
EZK.11.7.english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

EZK.23.10.motu: Idia ese ena geda e hamiroa; ia natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na e dabaidia tao, a ia be dare amo e alaia mase; hahemaoro na ia latanai vada e haḡuḡurua negana ai, ia na gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai ela hahine bogaragidiai.
EZK.23.10.english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.

EZK.18.32.motu: Badina be lau ese ta ena mase asina moalelaiamu; taunabunai, ba helalo kerehai, bena ba mauri. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.18.32.english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

EZK.23.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.23.1.english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK.13.9.motu: E mata hanai koikoimu bona e bagu haoro koikoimu peroveta taudia na lau imagu ese baine laodia ahu; egu orea taudia ida basie henega bou, bona Israel besena taudia ladadia itoredia ai idia ladadia basie hetore, bona Israel tanona ai basie raka vareai; bena umui na ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
EZK.13.9.english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.23.8.motu: Ena ariara karadia, Aigupto ai e nohova dinadia amo vada e kara, na se hadokodia; badina be ulatona ai tatau na ia ida e eno bou, bona ulato rami-hebouna ai idia ese ratana e ḡiḡidia; bona e kara lebulebu henia.
EZK.23.8.english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.

EZK.27.6.english: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan.

EZK.38.20.motu: davara gwarumedia, atai manudia, uda boromadia, tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai, bona tanobada latanai e nohomu taudia iboudiai danu, bae heude-heude lau vairagu ai; ororo danu bae heḡiḡi dobi bona haga nadidia bae moru, bona maḡu iboudiai na tano ai bae heḡiḡi dobi.
EZK.38.20.english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

EZK.41.23.motu: Dubu bona gabu helaḡana ruaosi iduaradia na kaha rua rua amo.
EZK.41.23.english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

EZK.6.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ororodia ba raraidia tao, latadiai ba peroveta,
EZK.6.2.english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

EZK.10.7.motu: Bena kerubi ta ese imana e toia roro, hari kerubi bogaragidiai e arava lahina amo gida e abi, una dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna imana ai e ato; bena una tau ese e abi, e raka lasi.
EZK.10.7.english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

EZK.20.1.motu: Laḡani ihahituna huana iha-imana dinana ihagwautana ai, Israel tau-badadia haida na ema, Iehova enai bae henanadai totona; bena idia na lau vairagu ai e helai.
EZK.20.1.english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.

EZK.47.5.motu: Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu na vada sinavai ta; asi turu-hanai dibagu, badina be ranu vada e dae; vada e dobu, nahu heḡereḡerena, ta basinema turu hanai diba.
EZK.47.5.english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

EZK.20.36.motu: Aigupto tano-ḡaḡaena ai senemui na hahemaoro henidia heḡereḡerena ai umui danu baina hahemaoro henimui. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.20.36.english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.27.15.motu: Rodo taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva; kone tanodia momo lalodiai emui hoihoi gabudia e miava; idia ese elefant doadia bona eboni audia e matlai, emui ḡau davadia.
EZK.27.15.english: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

EZK.17.22.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau sibogu ese sida auna dorina amo rigirigi ta baina abia, bena baina hadoa; dorina rigirigidia ediai manoka-manokana ta baina gadaia oho, bena lau sibogu ese baina hadoa, ororo bada-hereana bona lata-hereana dorina ai.
EZK.17.22.english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

EZK.2.10.motu: Bena ia ese lau vairagu ai e hulalaia: pepa kahana kahana na mai revarevadia, unu kaha ruaosi ai herohe-ahu bona taitai bona lalo-hisihisi herevadia vada e hetore.
EZK.2.10.english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

EZK.19.9.motu: Mai igauna ida maua ai e udaia,
EZK.19.9.english: They put him in a cage with hooks,

EZK.14.4.motu: Taunabunai ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena tauna ta ese kaivakuku na lalona ai baine abidia dae, bona ena kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai baine halaoa vairanai, bena peroveta tauna dekena bainema, lau Iehova sibogu ese baina haere henia, ena kaivakuku na momo dainai;
EZK.14.4.english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

EZK.14.12.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.14.12.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.10.22.motu: Vairadia ita-itadia na Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itadia ḡaudia vairadia ita-itadia heḡereḡeredia. Idia na ta ta e lao vaira.
EZK.10.22.english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

EZK.35.8.motu: Emu ororo iboudiai na e aladia mase taudia ai baina hahonudia; dare amo bae aladia mase taudia na emu ororo ai bona emu koura ai bona emu koura dobudobudia iboudiai lalodiai bae hekida diho.
EZK.35.8.english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

EZK.29.11.motu: Tau ta aena ese basine rakaia hanai bona boroma ta aena ese basine rakaia hanai: asi inoholaina ai baine mia laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai.
EZK.29.11.english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

EZK.5.16.motu: Una negana ai egu doe dibadia amo baina tarakimui mamase, hahebua-tari dibadia, umui ihabua-tarimui totona baina kinodia; doe na baina habadaia loulou emui ai, emui mauri anianina na baina abia oho.
EZK.5.16.english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

EZK.4.7.motu: Bena Ierusalem ikou-ahuna ba raraia tao, mai imamu ḡaḡaena Ia; bena hanua ihadikana ba perovetalaia.
EZK.4.7.english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

EZK.29.15.motu: Basileia iboudiai bogaragidiai ia na baine maraḡi herea; nega ta ai basileia idau-idau daediai basine heaḡi lou; baina hamaragidia herea dainai, idia ese nega ta ai basileia idau-idau na basie biagudia lou.
EZK.29.15.english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.

EZK.20.31.motu: Emui herahia ḡaudia o henimu, bona natumui mamaruanedia na ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodiamu, negadia ai na umui na sibomui o hahemiromu, emui kaivakuku iboudiai ida, ema bona ina dina. Israel besena e, ba nanadaigu a? Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui na basio nanadaigu.
EZK.20.31.english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will not be inquired of by you!

EZK.37.27.motu: Idia ida baina noho; edia Dirava ai bainala, egu bese ai baela.
EZK.37.27.english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

EZK.23.31.motu: Kakamu ena dala ai vada o raka; taunabunai iena kehere na oi imamu ai baina atoa.
EZK.23.31.english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

EZK.14.7.motu: Badina be Israel besena tauna ta, eiava idau tauna Israel ai e noho hedoamu ta, ese baine rakatanigu, ena kaivakuku na lalona ai baine abidia dae, bona ena kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai baine halaoa vairanai, bena peroveta tauna dekena bainema, peroveta tauna ese ia dainai baine nanadaigu totona, lau Iehova sibogu ese baina haere henia.
EZK.14.7.english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

EZK.17.3.motu: Baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ugava badana ta mai hanina badadia bona hape latadia, huina oromadia danu idau-idau, na Lebanon ema, sida auna ta dorina e bitua.
EZK.17.3.english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

EZK.21.23.motu: A idia ese mamina bae abia, bagu-haoro koikoina na heto; idia ese gwauhamata helaḡadia vada e gwaurai; a ia ese edia kerere e hahelalolaidia une, bae heabi mauri totona.
EZK.21.23.english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

EZK.27.28.motu: Emu tari taudia edia tai e hekamonaimu negana ai,
EZK.27.28.english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots,

EZK.37.19.motu: ba haere henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, Iosef bona Israel iduhudia ia ida e heboumu edia au (Efraim imana ai e miamu ḡauna) aina abia, Iuda ena au ida baina hahesiriudia, au tamona ai baina halaodia lau imagu ai.
EZK.37.19.english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

EZK.36.37.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena taudia baina ha-uradia dainai, ina danu egu ai bae noia; edia taunimanima na baina hahutumadia, mamoe serina na heto.
EZK.36.37.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

EZK.1.26.motu: Hari kwaradia daediai e miava gubana daenai na ḡau ta, terono ta hetomana, ita-itana na sapairo na heto; bona hari terono hetomana ḡauna daenai na ḡau ta helaina ai na itaia, taunimanima oromana hetomana.
EZK.1.26.english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

EZK.47.10.motu: Haoda taudia na gohu badinai bae gini; En-gedi amo ela bona En-eglaimi edia reke bae tore; gwarumena bae idau-idau, Davara Badana gwarumedia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.47.10.english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

EZK.46.11.motu: Aria negadia ai bona e gwaurai negadia ai, flaoa boubouna boromakau natuna maruanena ida bae heni ḡauna na efa ta; bona mamoe maruanena ta ida danu efa ta; a mamoe natudia ida ihenina tauna ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni. Eta ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta bae heni.
EZK.46.11.english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

EZK.23.32.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.30.17.motu: Ono bona Pibesete edia eregabe taudia na dare ai bae mase,
EZK.30.17.english: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword.

EZK.22.18.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena na momo ai vada ela lauegu ai; iboudiai na silver bona auri labora-laborana bona auri hururu-hururuna bona auri bona auri metauna lahi lalonai na heheto. Momo ai vada ela.
EZK.22.18.english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

EZK.42.17.motu: Bena kahana ma ela, mirigini kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
EZK.42.17.english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

EZK.38.23.motu: Unu amo egu herea-dae bona egu helaḡa baina hahedinaraidia, bona bese momo vairadiai sibogu baina hahedinarai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.38.23.english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’

EZK.20.43.motu: Unuseni ai emui dala bona sibomui o hahemirolai karadia iboudiai na ba lalodia une; bena sibomui ba hedadarai, emui kara dika iboudiai daidiai.
EZK.20.43.english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

EZK.43.22.motu: Bena dina iharuana ai, nani maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ba hahelaḡaia, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna ai bainela. Unu amo ihaboulaina patana ma ba haḡoevaia, boromakau maruanena amo o haḡoevaia heḡereḡerena.
EZK.43.22.english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

EZK.44.23.motu: Idia ese egu orea taudia na bae hadibadia, ḡau helaḡadia bona ḡau uhugaidia ede e idau tomamu; bona ḡau dia gogoeva bona ḡau ḡoevaḡoevadia edia idau ede bae diba toma.
EZK.44.23.english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

EZK.26.18.english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall.

EZK.3.24.motu: A Lauma ese e rohegu, bena ia ese e haginigu tore. Bena e hereva henigu, eto, Aola, sibomu emu ruma lalonai ba hekou ahu.
EZK.3.24.english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

EZK.9.11.motu: Bena hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona toretore ḡaudia vainana e daharaia tauna ese hereva ma e loulaia, eto, O haḡanilaigu heḡereḡerena ai vada na karaia.
EZK.9.11.english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

EZK.36.13.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be taunimanima ese e gwau henimuimu, e tomu “Umui ese taunimanima o ha-orediamu bona emui bese taudia natudia na mase ai o abidia ohomu”,
EZK.36.13.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

EZK.38.22.motu: Dai-hanai gorerena bona rara ihahebubuna amo baina hahemaoro henia, bona medu bada-hereadia bona medu-hetaridia, lahi bona teio na ia bona ena hutuma bona baine bamoa besedia loḡora latadiai baina hadiho.
EZK.38.22.english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

EZK.3.13.motu: una na mauri ḡaudia hanidia e hetomu heheni reḡedia bona idia badibadidiai e miava ava-keikeidia reḡedia, e hekara tano-laga reḡena na heto.
EZK.3.13.english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

EZK.43.4.motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na mairiveina kahana e vaira heniava ikoukouna amo dubu ai e vareai negana ai,
EZK.43.4.english: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

EZK.6.6.motu: Emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai emui hanua bae vahu bona emui atai gabudia helaḡadia bae heḡiḡi dobi; emui ih-aboulaina paladia bae vahu bona bae heḡiḡi dobi; emui kaivakuku bae makohi bona bae hebua tari; emui muramura mai bonadia patadia bae heḡiḡi dobi bona emui ḡaukara anidia bae boio.
EZK.6.6.english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

EZK.38.7.motu: A hegaegae, bona ba heḡaeḡae noho, oi bona emu ai e heboumu oreadia badadia iboudiai, bona ba gimadia.
EZK.38.7.english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

EZK.12.12.motu: Bena lohia tauna idia bogaragidiai ese ena laolao kohuna na pagana ai baine abia isi, dibura lalonai, bena baine huaia lao. Ia ese ruma habana baine hamaurua, bena mauruna amo baine rau lasi; ia ese vairana baine ḡovaia, ia matana amo tano basine itaia helaoreana.
EZK.12.12.english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

EZK.44.22.motu: Idia ese vabu ta eiava e diho hahinena ta na basie adavaia, a rami-hebou ulatona ta, Israel besena amo, eiava hahelaḡa tauna ta vabuna.
EZK.44.22.english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

EZK.34.14.motu: Rei namona gabudia ai baina ubudia; Israel ororodia doridia ai rei bae ani; unuseni ai rei namona gabudia ai bae hekure, bona rei namo-hereana bae ania, Israel ororodia ai.
EZK.34.14.english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

EZK.33.19.motu: Bona kara dika tauna na ena kara dika amo baine raka oho bona taravatu henunai baine kara maoromaoro, ia na una kara dainai baine mauri.
EZK.33.19.english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

EZK.1.20.motu: Lauma e urava bainela gabudia na idia danu e lao heniva, bona hari ava-keikei na idia ida ela; badina be hari mauri ḡaudia laumadia na ava-keikei lalodiai.
EZK.1.20.english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

EZK.36.32.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Baina ḡaukara, to dia umui daimui ai; una na ba diba. Israel besena taumui e, emui dala daidiai ba hemarai bona ba baia.
EZK.36.32.english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

EZK.42.10.motu: Murimuri kahana maḡuna na unu amo e hematama.
EZK.42.10.english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

EZK.43.6.motu: Una tau na badibadigu ai ginina ai, lau ese gado ta na kamonai, dubu lalona amo e hereva henigu;
EZK.43.6.english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

EZK.47.16.motu: bona Berota bona Sibiraimi amo (una Sibiraimi na Damasko bona Hamat hetoadia ai) ela bona Hasere-hatikono, Haurana hetoana ai.
EZK.47.16.english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

EZK.28.14.motu: Kerubi ta na horoa, oi igimamu kerubina ai bainela,
EZK.28.14.english: You were the anointed cherub who covers.

EZK.31.14.motu: Ini kara anidia be sinavai isedia audia haida basie tubu daga dae ela bona doridia na ori lalodiai bona ranu e inumu audia haida edia lata na idia edia lata ida basie heḡereḡere helaoreana; badina be iboudiai na bae mase, taunimanima bogaragidiai baela, mase gabuna ai, guri ai e dihomu taudia ida.
EZK.31.14.english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

EZK.7.12.motu: Negana vada e kau, dinana vada eme kahikahi. E hoihoimu tauna basine moale, bona kohu e hoihoilaimu tauna lalona basine hisihisi, badina be badu ḡaraḡara na edia-hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai.
EZK.7.12.english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

EZK.40.26.motu: Vadavada moi-kaudia auhitu amo e dae henia, bona dehena na ena laloma kahana ai; ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia, ta ohena ta ai, ma ta ohena ta ai.
EZK.40.26.english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

EZK.9.9.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Israel bona Iuda besedia edia kerere na bada herea; tano na rara ai e honumu, bona hanua na hahemaoro karadia gageva-gagevadia ai e honumu. Badina be idia na e tomu “Iehova ese tano vada e rakatania; Iehova na se heitamu”.
EZK.9.9.english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn’t see.’

EZK.23.3.motu: Idia ese ariara karadia e karava, Aigupto ai; ulatodia ai ariara karadia e karava. Unuseni ai tatau haida ese kemedia e rosidia; bona ulato rami-heboudia ai ratadia e ḡiḡidia.
EZK.23.3.english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.

EZK.32.15.english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste,

EZK.37.4.motu: Ma e hereva henigu, eto, Ini turia na ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Turia kakorodia e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
EZK.37.4.english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

EZK.48.33.motu: Diho kahana ai (ia danu ena lata na kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima), ikoukou toi bae mia, Simeon ena ikoukou, Isakara ena ikoukou, bona Sebulun ena ikoukou.
EZK.48.33.english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

EZK.27.35.english: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you,

EZK.40.5.motu: Bena na itaia, maḡu ta ese dubu tanona e ḡeḡea dae. Hari hahetoho sirihona una tau imana ai latana na kiubit badadia tauratoi. (Unu kiubit badadia ta anina be kiubit idoinai ta bona ima-palapala lababana ta). Bena ia ese maḡu udunana e hahetohoa, hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena; harana latana danu hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
EZK.40.5.english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

EZK.24.22.motu: Bena-lauegu kara heḡereḡerena ai do ba kara; udumui basio ḡovadia bona basio ani helaḡa.
EZK.24.22.english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

EZK.46.5.motu: Flaoa boubouna mamoe maruanena ida baine heni ḡauna na efa ta, bona flaoa boubouna ḡaudia mamoe natudia ida na ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni; flaoa efadia ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta baine heni danu.
EZK.46.5.english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

EZK.7.7.motu: Tano inoholaina taumu e, emu ai baine kau ḡauna vada e kau; negana vada eme kau; heloḡo-ahuahu dinana vada eme kahikahi, dia moale lolodia dinana ororo latadiai.
EZK.7.7.english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

EZK.15.4.motu: A itaia, lahi auna ai e halaoamu; bena lahi ese duduna duduna e aradia oremu bona bogaragina na gida ai e laomu murinai ia na mai ena ḡaukara a?
EZK.15.4.english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

EZK.1.12.motu: Idia na ta ta e lao vaira: lauma e urava baela gabudia, unu e laova, bona laodia ai asie hegiro.
EZK.1.12.english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

EZK.36.17.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena taudia na edia tano korikori ai e nohova negana ai, idia ese edia dala bona edia kara amo e hamiroa; edia kara lau vairagu ai na mimiro, hahine ta ena rara-kara mirona na heto.
EZK.36.17.english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

EZK.20.3.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel tau-badadia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau inanadaigu oma a? Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui ese lau basio nanadaigu.
EZK.20.3.english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’

EZK.42.7.motu: Murimuri ai na hehari maḡuna ta, ia bona hari daiutu padadia idoinai na heḡereḡere. Ia na murimuri kahana maḡuna e lao heniava, bona daiutu e vaira henidiava. Ena lata na kiubit imahui.
EZK.42.7.english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

EZK.30.15.motu: Pelusio, Aigupto ena gabu aukana, latanai
EZK.30.15.english: I will pour my wrath on Sin,

EZK.1.9.motu: hanidia na e hekapa hekapa heheni; hahaniosi na e raka vairava, asie hegirova.
EZK.1.9.english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

EZK.20.21.motu: A idia natudia ese e daḡedaḡe henigu; egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia; ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia, asie badinadia namonamo, egu dina helaḡadia danu e hamirodia.
EZK.20.21.english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

EZK.18.17.motu: imana na kara havara amo bema rua, abitorehai heatokauna eiava heatokau monidia haida basinema abi, egu hahedua herevadia bema badinadia bona egu taravatu daladia ai bema raka: una tau na tamana ena kara havara dainai basine mase; momokani ia na do baine mauri.
EZK.18.17.english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor,

EZK.40.23.motu: Hari mirigini kahana ikoukouna hevaira-hehenina ai na laloma maḡuna ikoukouna ta, mairiveina kahana ḡauna heḡereḡerena; bena ia ese padadia e hahetohoa, ikoukou ta ela bona ikoukou ta padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
EZK.40.23.english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

EZK.43.19.motu: Levi hahelaḡa taudia, Sadok ena iduhu taudia, kara helaḡadia ikaradia totona e raka henigu kahimu taudia, na boromakau maruanena ta ba henidia, kara dika iabi-ohona boubou ḡauna ai bainela. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.43.19.english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

EZK.2.7.motu: Egu hereva ba hamaorolaidia, bena bae kamonai eiava kamonai basie ura; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
EZK.2.7.english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

EZK.24.13.motu: Deḡideḡina na oiemu lebulebu miro-hereana. Badina be bama haḡoevamu, to emu miro badana amo asio goeva; basio ḡoevaḡoeva lou ela bona egu badu na baina hagugurua latamu ai.
EZK.24.13.english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

EZK.12.25.motu: A lau Iehova ese baina gwauraia herevana vada baina gwauraia, bona karana baina karaia. Basine halahe, a oiemu nega ai, gwau-edeede besena e, hereva baina gwauraia bona karana baina karaia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.12.25.english: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.8.10.motu: Bena na raka vareai, na roharoha; unuseni ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau bona boroma dika-rohoroho-lia bona Israel taudia edia kaivakuku iboudiai laulaudia na haba ai vada e tore.
EZK.8.10.english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

EZK.8.9.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A raka vareai, kara dika-rohoroho badahereadia unuseni ai e karamu na ba itadia.
EZK.8.9.english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

EZK.23.38.motu: Ina danu vada e kara henigu: dina tamona ai egu gabu helaḡana bona egu dina helaḡadia vada e hamirodia.
EZK.23.38.english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

EZK.20.5.motu: ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel na abia hidi dinana ai, Iakob vevena na gwau henidia hamata. Aigupto tanona ai na hahedinarai henidia, bena na gwau henidia hamata, nato, Lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
EZK.20.5.english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’

EZK.28.3.motu: (Momokani, emu aonega ese Daniel ena aonega na e hereaiamu,
EZK.28.3.english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel.

EZK.19.10.motu: Sinamu na vine auna na heto,
EZK.19.10.english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters.

EZK.11.6.motu: Emui mase taudia vada o hahutumadia ina hanua ai, bona ariarana na vada e aladia taudia ai vada o hahonudia.
EZK.11.6.english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

EZK.22.22.motu: Silver na lahi ai e haveveamu na heto, lau ese egu badu ai baina havevemui; bena ba diba lau Iehova ese egu badu na latamui ai vada na bubua dobi.
EZK.22.22.english: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.’”

EZK.39.6.motu: Lau ese lahi baina siaia lao, Magog latanai, bona kone tanodia ai e noho namonamomu taudia latadiai; bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.39.6.english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.35.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.35.1.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.22.16.motu: Bena oi daimu ai lau ladagu baine miro bese idau-idau vairadiai; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.22.16.english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

EZK.26.12.motu: Idia ese emui taḡa na bae dadidia oho, bona emui hoihoi kohudia na damudia ai bae halaodia; maḡumu bae gigi dobi, bona emui ruma namo-hereadia bae habuadia tari; emui nadi bona emui au bona emui uma tanodia na davara lalonai bae negedia dobi.
EZK.26.12.english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

EZK.22.17.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.22.17.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.39.11.motu: Una dina ai lau ese Gog na gara gabuna ta baina henia Israel ai, koura ta ladana na “Laolao taudia edia Koura”, Tadi Gohuna mairiveina kahana ai. Laolao taudia edia dala na baine helao ahu, badina be unuseni ai Gog bona ena hutuma idoinai na bae guridia; ladana bae hatoa Hamono-gog Kourana.
EZK.39.11.english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

EZK.36.1.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ororodia ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Israel ororodia e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
EZK.36.1.english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.

EZK.47.17.motu: Unu amo hetoa na davara amo bainela ela bona Hasara-enono, Damasko mirigini kahana hetoana ai. Hamat hetoana danu na ia miriginina kahana ai. Mirigini kahana hetoana bunai.
EZK.47.17.english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

EZK.40.8.motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou dehena e hahetohoa: ia na kiubit taurahani;
EZK.40.8.english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

EZK.43.13.motu: Ihaboulaina patana ihahetohona, kiubit amo e hahetohoa, binai. (Ini kiubit na kiubit ta bona ima-palapala lababana ta). Ia badina hara-latana na kiubit ta, bona lababana na kiubit ta; ia na mai isena, ohena idoinai e ḡeḡea ahu ḡauna, isena lababana na ima-kwakikwaki daḡana ta heḡereḡerena. Ihaboulaina patana harana latana na ini baine heto:
EZK.43.13.english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

EZK.40.41.motu: Pata hani na laloma kahana ai bona pata hani na murimuri kahana ai, ikoukou raka-vareaina ai; pata taurahaniosi latadiai boubou ḡaudia na bae aladia mase.
EZK.40.41.english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

EZK.48.24.motu: Beniamina ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Simeon ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.24.english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

EZK.28.4.motu: emu aonega bona emu lalo-parara dainai,
EZK.28.4.english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches,

EZK.3.20.motu: Ina danu, kara maoromaoro tauna ta na ena kara maoromaoIo amo bema raka siri, bena bema kara havara, bena lau ese hekwakwanai ḡauna ta ia vairanai bama atoa, ia na baine mase; oi ese to sisiba henia dainai ia na baine mase, ena kara dika bagunai, bona ena kara maoromaorodia, guna ia ese e kara ḡaudia, na basie lalodia tao; a ia rarana davana na oi imamu amo baina gwauraia.
EZK.3.20.english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

EZK.18.12.motu: ogoḡami taudia bona e dabumu taudia bema hahisidia, kohu bema dadi, abitorehai toana basinema heni lou, kaivakuku bema gaga dae henidia, kara dika-rohorohodia bema kara,
EZK.18.12.english: has wronged the poor and needy,

EZK.1.2.motu: Hua dinana iha-imana ai (una na King Iehoiakini dauhai ai e hanohoava laḡanina iha-imana lalonai),
EZK.1.2.english: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

EZK.3.21.motu: Ḡau tamona, oi ese kara maoromaoro tauna boma sisiba henia basinema kara dika, bena basine kara dika, ia na do baine mauri, badina be sisiba herevana na e abia dae; bena oi ese sibomu emu mauri do ba rauaia.
EZK.3.21.english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

EZK.20.42.motu: Bena Israel tanona, senemui na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona, Ialonai baina hakaumui vareai negana ai, umui na ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.20.42.english: You will know that I am Yahweh when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

EZK.23.27.motu: Unuhetomana lau ese emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia, Aigupto amo o mailai, na baina hadokodia; una dainai, Aigupto taudia na basio gaga dae henidia lou, bona basio lalodia tao lou.
EZK.23.27.english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’

EZK.29.17.motu: Laḡani iharuahui-hituna huana gini-gunana dinana ginigunana lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.29.17.english: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.36.26.motu: Lalo matamatana baina henimui, bona lauma matamatana na lalomui ai baina atoa; Ialo-auka na umui lalomui amo baina abia oho, Ialo-manada baina henimui.
EZK.36.26.english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

EZK.24.6.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hanua mai rarana madi ihabaina! Uro mai deḡideḡina, deḡideḡina do asie negea ḡauna, madi ihabaina! Hidio taidia taidia na ia lalona amo ba vai dae, namodia bona dikadia basio hididia.

EZK.45.14.motu: bona dehoro ahuna na koro ta ta lalodia amo bata ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ba heni. (Hari koro lalonai na bata gwauta, homere heḡereḡerena).
EZK.45.14.english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),

EZK.28.24.motu: A Israel besena taudia na ava ḡiniḡinina ta eiava au ḡiniḡinina ta ese basine hahisidia, idia dekedia taudia, vada e dadaraidia taudia, iboudiai bogaragidiai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
EZK.28.24.english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.13.19.motu: Egu orea taudia bogaragidiai lau ladagu vada o hamiroa, bali taidia bona flaoa atagadia iabidia ai, basiema mase taudia na o aladia masemu, bona basiema mauri taudia na o hamauridiamu, emui koikoi amo; egu orea taudia, koikoi e abi daemu taudia, na o koidia.
EZK.13.19.english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

EZK.41.16.motu: na mai iḡovalaidia reireidia, bona toiosi heḡeḡemadai ai na gaba-mauru; unu gaba-maurudia ioradia na au rotonadia amo e kara. Rakavareaina hevaira-hehenina habana heḡeḡemadai ai na mai iḡovalaina reireidia, ruma reireina amo ela bona gaba-mauru, (hari gaba-mauru na mai ikoulaidia ḡaudia),
EZK.41.16.english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

EZK.30.26.motu: bena Aigupto taudia baina hakarohodia bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, baina hakarohodia rohoroho tano idau-idau lalodiai. Bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.30.26.english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.23.20.motu: unuseni ai ia e ura heniava taudia, taudia reḡedia na doniki reḡedia na heheto bona natudia na hosi natudia na heheto taudia, na ia ese e mata dika henidia.
EZK.23.20.english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

EZK.32.11.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Babulono pavapavana ena dare na oi latamu ai baine kau.

EZK.34.31.motu: Umui na lauegu mamoe, egu rei mamoedia, bona lau na emui Dirava. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.34.31.english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.45.2.motu: Ia lalonai gabu ta baine mia, dubu helaḡana gabuna, ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, kiubit sinahu-ima; bona hegeḡemadai ai tano taina baine mia ḡagae, ia lababana na kiubit imahui.
EZK.45.2.english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

EZK.7.11.motu: daḡedaḡe vada e tubu, kara dika vada e tubu kau. Idia ta basine noho; edia kohu-momo bona edia taḡa basie mia; bona idia bogaragidiai ta basine herea.
EZK.7.11.english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

EZK.20.4.motu: Oi ese ba hahemaoro henidia a? Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese ba hahemaoro henidia a? Benaini, senedia edia kara dika-rohorohodia ba hadibalaidia,
EZK.20.4.english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

EZK.10.2.motu: Bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Hari e hegiro-hegiromu ava-keikeidia bogaragidiai baola, kerubi henudiai, imamu ruaosi na gida hururu-hururudia amo ba hahonudia, kerubi bogaragidiai; bena hanua latanai ba petadia rohoroho.
EZK.10.2.english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.”

EZK.39.13.motu: Tano taudia iboudiai ese bae guridia; bena idia haridia bae namo, lau ese hairaigu baina hahedinaraia dinana ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.39.13.english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.40.32.motu: Bena ia ese laloma kahana maḡuna ai e hakaugu vareai, mairiveina kahana ai. Ia ese ikoukou e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.40.32.english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

EZK.48.22.motu: bona Levi taudia edia tano bona hanua tanona, na hanua pavapavana ena tano bogaraginai bae mia. Hanua pavapavana ahuna na Iuda ena tano bona Beniamina ena tano padadiai baine mia.
EZK.48.22.english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

EZK.11.11.motu: Ina hanua na emui uro ai basinela, bona umui na vamu ai basiola ia lalonai. Israel tanona hetoana ai baina hahemaoro henimui,
EZK.11.11.english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

EZK.23.9.motu: Taunabunai, e ura heniava taudia, hari Asuria taudia, ia ese e mata dika henidia taudia, imadia ai na atoa.
EZK.23.9.english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

EZK.26.6.motu: bona ia natuna hahinedia tanobada ai na dare ese baine aladia mase. Bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.26.6.english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’

EZK.46.22.motu: Maḡu daigunina haniosi na mai maḡumaḡudia, edia lata na kiubit hari-ahui bona edia lababa na kiubit toi-ahui; haniosi edia bada na heḡereḡere.
EZK.46.22.english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

EZK.28.13.motu: Oi na Eden, Dirava ena imea, lalonai o nohova;

EZK.40.11.motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou raka-lasina e hahetohoa, kiubit gwauta; bona ikoukou idoinai lababana, kiubit gwauta-toi.
EZK.40.11.english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

EZK.6.5.motu: Israel taudia na masedia ai baina hahekidadia diho, edia kaivakuku vairadiai; bona turiamui baina ḡiḡidia rohoroho, emui ihaboulaina patadia hegegemadai ai.
EZK.6.5.english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

EZK.40.20.motu: unuseni ai ikoukou ta ese mirigini kahana e vaira henia; una na murimuri kahana maḡuna ikoukouna. Ia ese latana bona lababana e hahetohodia.
EZK.40.20.english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

EZK.36.5.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu vaḡeḡe bada lalonai lau ese bese oredia bona Edom idoinai danu na gwau dika henidiamu; idia ese egu tano e ḡaunaia mai moale badana bona mai hedadarai bada-hereana ida, bae abia bona lalonai bae dadidadi totona.
EZK.36.5.english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

EZK.27.5.english: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir.

EZK.6.10.motu: Bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova; ini baina karadia toma nato negana ai na asina hereva kava.
EZK.6.10.english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

EZK.24.23.motu: Kwaramui dabuadia na kwaramui ai bae mia, bona emui tamaka na aemui ai bae mia; lalomui basie hisihisi bona basio taitai, a emui kara havara ai ba varoda-varoda, bona ba heḡanaḡana heheni.
EZK.24.23.english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

EZK.17.14.motu: basileia na baine manau, basine hekokoroku, bona iena taravatu ibadinana ai baine gini helaorearia.)
EZK.17.14.english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

EZK.24.27.motu: Una dina ai, udumu baine hekeho una heau tauna enai; vada ba hereva, basio mu lou. Unu amo oi na toa ta ai baola, idia ediai; bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.24.27.english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.5.13.motu: Unu amo egu badu baine ore; egu badu ḡaraḡarana amo baina kara henidia ela bona lalogu baine keru. Bena idia na bae diba lau Iehova na egu vageḡe ai vada na hereva, egu badu garagarana na latadiai baina ha-orea negana ai.
EZK.5.13.english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

EZK.40.39.motu: Ikoukou dehena ai danu na pata rua, ohe kahana kahana ai; idia latadiai ḡole-oho bona kara dika bona kerere boubou ḡaudia bae aladia mase.
EZK.40.39.english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

EZK.3.26.motu: Bena lau ese malamu na udumu atai maona ai baina hakapea dae; taunabunai vada ba mu, bena basio gwau henidia diba; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
EZK.3.26.english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

EZK.3.5.motu: Badina be idau gado aukana ta taudia dekedia asina siaimumu, a Israel besena enai;
EZK.3.5.english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

EZK.20.41.motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaumui lasi bona lalodiai o karoho rohoroho tanodia amo baina gogomui negana ai, lau ese baina abimui dae, bonana namo ḡauna na heto. Itelaḡagu na umui bogaragimui ai baina hahedinaraia, bese idau-idau vairadiai.
EZK.20.41.english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

EZK.25.14.motu: Egu hahedava-heni na Edom latanai baina atoa kau, egu bese Israel taudia imadia ai; Edom ai bae ḡaukara, egu badu bona egu badu-ḡaraḡara heḡereḡeredia ai; bona egu hahedava-heni bae diba. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.25.14.english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.23.24.motu: Idia na oi ihadikamu totona mirigini kahana amo baema, mai edia kariota bona edia rerue bona edia orea taudia hutuma ida. Idia ese bae koumu heḡeḡe, mai edia keme auridia bona edia kesi bona edia kwara ḡaudia, bona siahu baina henidia bae hanemaoro, bena edia hahemaoro herevadia amo bae hahemaoro henimu.
EZK.23.24.english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

EZK.48.1.motu: Iduhu ladadia bini. Mirigini kahana hetoana na davara amo baine hematama, Hetelono amo bainela ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina, ela bona Hasara-enono (una na Damasko mirigini kahana hetoana, Hamat hevaira-hehenina ai), laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana: una na Dan ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.1.english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

EZK.34.8.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, badina be egu mamoe na uda boromadia iboudiai adia ai vada e hahelao, asi ireḡudia dainai; bona badina be egu mamoe ireḡudia taudia ese egu mamoe asie tahudia, a mamoe ireḡudia taudia na sibodia e heubu, egu mamoe asie ubudia;
EZK.34.8.english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

EZK.36.14.motu: una dainai umui ese taunimanina basio ha-oredia lou, bona emui bese taudia natudia na mase ai basio abidia oho lou. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.36.14.english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.9.7.motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaorodia, eto, Dubu ba hamiroa, bona maḡudia na mase tau-anidia amo ba hahonudia. A raka lasi! Taunabunai, idia na e raka lasi, hanua na e daea.
EZK.9.7.english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!”

EZK.22.29.motu: Tano taudia ese dava vada e gwaurai lagau, bona dadidadi karadia vada e kara; ogoḡami tauna bona e dabumu tauna vada e hahisidia, bona noho-hedoa tauna enai dava vada e gwaurai lagau, ena ḡau na asi iabi-louna dalana.
EZK.22.29.english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

EZK.43.8.motu: eiava edia raka-vareaina na lauegu raka-vareaina bona edia iduara ihua-ihuadia na lauegu iduara ihua-ihuadia badibadidiai bae alodia, bena lau bona idia padamai ai na hehari maḡuna mo baine mia dainai. Edia kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara dainai lau ladagu helaḡana vada e hamiroa, taunabunai lau ese egu badu garaḡarana ai vada na ha-oredia.
EZK.43.8.english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

EZK.10.17.motu: Idia na e gini negadia ai, unu danu e gini; bona idia na e dae negadia ai, unu danu e dae; badina be unu mauri ḡaudia laumadia na idia lalodiai.
EZK.10.17.english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

EZK.41.14.motu: bona dubu mai maḡuna ida, mairiveina kahana ai, labahadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
EZK.41.14.english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

EZK.14.3.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, ini tatau ese edia kaivakuku na lalodia ai vada e abidia dae, bona edia kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai vada e halaoa vairadiai; bae nanadailaigu herevadia baina kamonaidia eiava lasi?
EZK.14.3.english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

EZK.30.5.motu: Etiopia bona Put bona Lud bona Arabia idoinai bona Libia taudia, bona idia ida e ḡaukara heboumu taudia, na idia ida dare ai bae mase.
EZK.30.5.english: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”

EZK.18.2.motu: Badina be dahaka ina hereva lada-isina o gwauraia louloumu, o tomu
EZK.18.2.english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying,

EZK.45.21.motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihag vauta-hanina ai, lagau-hanai ariana ba karaia; dina hitu lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana bae ania.
EZK.45.21.english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

EZK.36.7.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na gwau hamatamu, na tomu, e gegemui dae besedia latadiai hedunirai herevadia na bae kau.
EZK.36.7.english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

EZK.21.17.motu: Lau ese danu imagu baina pata dagu, egu badu ḡaraḡarana baina ha- orea. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.21.17.english: I will also strike my hands together,

EZK.41.11.motu: Hari ohe kahana kahana daiutudia iduaradia na patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana ai e hekeho, iduara ta na mirigini kahana e vaira henia, bona iduara ta na diho kahana e vaira henia. Una patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana lababana na kiubit ima, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai.
EZK.41.11.english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

EZK.44.6.motu: Bona gwau-edeede besena, Israel besena, na ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai ba hadoko.
EZK.44.6.english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

EZK.11.3.motu: Idia na e tomu, Ruma ihaginidia negana na do se kahikahi; ina hanua na vamu inadulaina urona, bona vamu na ita.
EZK.11.3.english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

EZK.23.12.motu: Ia ese Asuria taudia e mata dika henidia; hekwara taudia bona tuari lohiadia, edia auri dabuadia e hahedokilaiva taudia, edia hosi ai e guiva taudia, iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia.
EZK.23.12.english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.

EZK.9.3.motu: Una negana ai Israel Diravana hairaina na kerubi daedia, vaia e miava gabuna, amo e dae, dubu raka-vareaina e lao henia; bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona toretore ḡaudia vainana e daharaia tauna na e boi henia.
EZK.9.3.english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

EZK.30.22.motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, na inai heniamu, ia imana ruaosi baina hakwaidudia, mai goadana ḡauna bona e kwaidu guna ḡauna; bena dare na imana amo baina hamorua.
EZK.30.22.english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

EZK.41.20.motu: dubu reireina amo ela bona iduara daena, kerubi bona pamu audia laulaudia na haba ai e hekoro.
EZK.41.20.english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

EZK.4.4.motu: Bena ohemu laurina ai ba eno dere; bena lau ese Israel besena ena dika davana na oi latamu ai baina atoa; dina edehohodia ai ba eno dere na edia dika davadia latamu ai bae mia.
EZK.4.4.english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

EZK.45.17.motu: Hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara korikori be ḡole-oho bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, aria negadia ai bona hua matamatadia negadia ai bona dina helaḡadia ai, Israel besena ena aria korikoridia iboudiai negadia ai. Ia ese kara dika bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, Israel besena ena kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia.
EZK.45.17.english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

EZK.17.17.motu: Farao bona ena tuari oreana mai goadana bona ena orea badana idoinai ese basie durua tuari ai, hutuma iala-masedia totona tano bae larebaia bona hanua bae magua heḡeḡe negana ai.
