EZK.17.17.english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

EZK.35.15.motu: Israel ahuna latanai o moaleva, vada e hebua tari dainai, heḡereḡerena ai lau ese baina kara henimu; oi danu ba hebua tari, Seiri ororona bona Edom idoinai, oibe, idoinai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.35.15.english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.28.21.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na Sidono ba henia, ia latanai ba peroveta,
EZK.28.21.english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

EZK.32.32.motu: Badina be ia ese hahegari e piua rohoroho, mauri taudia edia tano ai; una dainai ia na do se haheperitome taudia bogaragidiai bae hahekurea, dare ai e mase taudia, Farao mai ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai, ida. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.32.32.english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.38.19.motu: Badina be egu vaḡeḡe ai bona egu badu ḡaraḡara ai na gwaumu, Una dina ai Israel tanona baine heude-heude bada;
EZK.38.19.english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,

EZK.36.21.motu: A lau ladagu helaḡana, Israel taudia ese ediai e kau besedia bogaragididi e hamiroa ḡauna, na lau ese na helalolaia bada.
EZK.36.21.english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

EZK.18.26.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna ese ena kara maoromaoro baine rakatania bena baine kara havara negana ai, ia na una kara havara dainai baine mase; ena kara havara dainai do baine mase.
EZK.18.26.english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

EZK.27.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, harihari Turo latanai ba rohe ahu.
EZK.27.2.english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

EZK.4.13.motu: Bena Iehova na e tomu, Israel taudia adia aniani mirodia unu bae ani toma, ediai baina luludia lao besedia bogaragidiai.
EZK.4.13.english: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

EZK.42.12.motu: Hari diho kahana daiutudia henudiai na raka-vareai gabuna ta, mairiveina kahana ai, unuseni ai raka-hanai gabuna ai e raka vareaimu. Idia vairadiai be hehari maḡuna ta.
EZK.42.12.english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

EZK.29.19.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Aigupto tanona na Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, baina henia; ia ese kohuna namodia baine laohai, baine dadihaia, ia damuḡana ai baine halaoa; unu amo ena tuari taudia davadia baine henidia.
EZK.29.19.english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.

EZK.32.12.motu: Emu orea taudia hutuma na goada taudia edia dare amo baina hamasedia, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e gari henidia badamu taudia iboudiai bunu.
EZK.32.12.english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty.

EZK.39.18.motu: Goada-herea taudia hidiodia bavani, bona tanobada lohiadia raradia ba inu; mamoe mamaruanedia bona mamoe natudia bona nani bona boromakau mamaruanedia danu, iboudiai na Basan ubu-ubu boromadia.
EZK.39.18.english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

EZK.12.4.motu: Dina ai emu laolao kohuna ba lasilaia idia vairadiai, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena laolao kohuna na heto, bona adorahi ai idia vairadiai ba raka lasi, dauhai bae hanohodia taudia na heheto.
EZK.12.4.english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

EZK.23.44.motu: Badina be idia na ia dekenai vada e raka vareai, haida ese ariara hahinena dekenai e raka vareaimu na heto. Ohola bona Oholiba dekediai unu e raka vareai toma, bae kara lebulebu totona.
EZK.23.44.english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

EZK.40.40.motu: Dehe murimurina kahana ai, mirigini kahana ikoukouna raka-vareaina ai, na pata rua; hona ikoukou dehena kahanadanu pata rua.
EZK.40.40.english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

EZK.31.18.motu: Taunabunai, Eden audia bogaragidiai oi na edena heḡereḡerena, hairai ai bona herea-dae ai? Eden audia ida mase gabuna ai do ba diho; asie peritomedia taudia ida, dare ai e mase taudia ida, do ba hekure.
EZK.31.18.english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword.

EZK.39.29.motu: bona vairagu na edia amo basina hunia lou; egu Lauma ese Israel besena baine rohea. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.39.29.english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.32.13.motu: Ena ubu-ubu ḡaudia iboudiai baina habuadia tari,
EZK.32.13.english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters.

EZK.43.23.motu: Ba haḡoevaia ḡuḡuru, bena boromakau maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta bona seri mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ba hahelaḡadia.
EZK.43.23.english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

EZK.16.43.motu: Badina be eregabemu negana so laloa taomu; to ini ḡau iboudiai amo vada o habadugu. Taunabunai, a itaia, emu kara davadia na tubuamu ai baina kara. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.43.english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

EZK.41.17.motu: ma ela bona iduara daena, ma ela bona laloma daiutuna, bona murimuri ai danu. Bona haba iboudiai heḡeḡemadai ai, laloma daiutuna ai bona dubu ai, na laulau e koro:
EZK.41.17.english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

EZK.23.29.motu: bena daḡedaḡe ai bae kara henimu, emu hekwarahi anina idoinai bae abia oho, gagaemu ai bae rakatanimu, bena emu ariara karadia anidia korikori bae hedinarai. Emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia ese
EZK.23.29.english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

EZK.12.5.motu: Idia vairadiai ruma habana ba hamaurua, bona mauruna amo ba rau lasi.
EZK.12.5.english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

EZK.47.13.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tano hetoadia bini: tano na ba haria, Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi ese ahudia bae abi, a Iosef na ahu rua baine abi.
EZK.47.13.english: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

EZK.11.15.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, tadikakamu, tadikakamu korikori, oi ida gabu daudau ai vada e hanohodia taudia, Israel besena idoinai, ena taunimanima iboudiai, na Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese vada e herevalaidia, eto, Idia ese Iehova vada e rakatania, dauha vada ela; ina tano na ita vada e henida, baita ḡaunaia totona.
EZK.11.15.english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

EZK.28.12.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Turo pavapavana latanai ba rohe ahu. Ba hereva henia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:
EZK.28.12.english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:

EZK.38.17.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Nega gunadia ai egu hesiai taudia, Israel ena peroveta taudia, ududia amo na herevalaia tauna na oi a? Idia na laḡani gunadia lalodiai e perovetava oi baina mailaimu idia ituarihenidia totona.
EZK.38.17.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

EZK.7.19.motu: Edia silver na ariara ai e negeamu, bona edia gold na ḡau mirona na heto. Iehova ena badu-ḡaraḡara dinana ai, edia silver bona edia gold ese basie hamauridia diba; edia hitolo basie ha-orelai diba, bona bogadia basie hakunulai diba. Badina be una na ihahekwakwanailaidia ḡauna edia kara havara ai.
EZK.7.19.english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

EZK.24.14.motu: Lau Iehova vada na hereva; ina na baine vara, lau ese baina karaia; lau na basina helalo lou, basina hebogahisi, basina helalo kerehai. Emu dala bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.24.14.english: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.44.31.motu: E mase kava ḡauna ta eiava ḡau ta ese e haberoa ḡauna ta, roho manuna eiava timo kopina ai e nohomu ḡauna, na hahelaḡa taudia ese basie ania.
EZK.44.31.english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

EZK.20.32.motu: Emui lalo-hadai anina na nega ta ai basine vara; o laloamu, o tomu “Bese idau-idau, tano idau-idau besedia, heḡereḡeredia ai baia hahelao, au bona nadi baia toma henidia diho”.
EZK.20.32.english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’

EZK.8.4.motu: Na itaia danu, Israel Diravana hairaina na unuseni ai, taora ai mata-hanai ai na itaia heḡereḡerena.
EZK.8.4.english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

EZK.21.30.motu: Iudalaina pauana lalonai ba udaia lou. E havaramu gabuna ai, emu vara tanona korikorina ai, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimu.
EZK.21.30.english: Cause it to return into its sheath.

EZK.23.26.motu: Idia ese danu emu dabua bae hadokidia oho, bona emu herahera nadidia namo-hereadia bae abidia oho.
EZK.23.26.english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

EZK.36.38.motu: Boubou mamoedia serina na heto, e gwaurai hata negadia ariadia ai Ierusalem ai e habouamu serina na heto, vada e vahu hanuadia na taunimanima seridia ai bae honu. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.36.38.english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.45.25.motu: Hua ihahituna dinana ihagwauta-imana ai, bona aria dinadia hituosi lalodiai, ia ese unu heḡereḡeredia ma baine heni, dika iabi-ohona bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona naoa bouboudia ḡaudia, bona dehoro danu.
EZK.45.25.english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

EZK.16.38.motu: Bena lau ese baina hahemaoro henimu, adavadia e dihotanidiamu bona rara e hahebubuamu hahinedia e hahemaoro henidiamu heḡereḡerena.
EZK.16.38.english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

EZK.40.13.motu: Bena ikoukou na e hahetohoa, ohena ta daiutuna durana iduarana amo ela bona ma ohena ta daiutuna durana iduarana, lababa idoinai na kiubit ruahui-ima, iduara amo ela bona iduara.
EZK.40.13.english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

EZK.21.5.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae diba, lau Iehova ese egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo vada na veria lasi; ḡauna na basine hetoi vareai lou.
EZK.21.5.english: All flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

EZK.39.27.english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

EZK.16.11.motu: Herahera ḡaudia amo na haheralaimu; vagivagi na imamu ai na ato, bona ageva na ha-inulaimu.
EZK.16.11.english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

EZK.19.1.motu: Israel lohiadia irohe-ahudia ba ladaia ist,
EZK.19.1.english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

EZK.23.22.motu: Taunabunai, Oholiba e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, e ura henimumu taudia, mai hedadaraimu ida o rakatanidia taudia, na baina hatoredia isi, kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, oi ihadikamu totona:
EZK.23.22.english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:

EZK.25.15.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Filistia taudia na e hahedava heni, bona edia badu ai hahedava-heni karadia e kara, miahanaihanai heinai-hehenina ai bae hahebua tari totona;
EZK.25.15.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

EZK.48.16.motu: Ena bada be iniheto: mirigini kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima; diho kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima; laurabada kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima, bona lahara kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima.
EZK.48.16.english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

EZK.18.23.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Edena na moalelaiamu, kara dika tauna baine mase, eiava ena dala baine rakatania bena baine mauri, a?
EZK.18.23.english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

EZK.47.9.motu: Bena sinavai na e aru e laomu gabudia iboudiai, mauri ḡaudia na bae vara heḡiḡi oda-oda, bona gwarume danu seridia seridia. Badina be ina ranu na e aru e laomu, gohu baine hanegaria; taunabunai sinavai na e aru e laomu gabudia ai, ḡau iboudiai na bae mauri daehai daehai.
EZK.47.9.english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

EZK.21.4.motu: Badina be kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na oiemu amo baina utudia oho dainai, egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo baine lasi, taunimanima iboudiai, diho kahana amo ela bona mirigini kahana, ihadikadia totona.
EZK.21.4.english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

EZK.4.8.motu: A itaia, lau ese varo ai baina guimu, bena basio eno hegiro diba, ela bona emu hanua ikou-ahuna dinadia ba haguḡurudia.
EZK.4.8.english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

EZK.24.5.english: Take the choice of the flock,

EZK.21.21.motu: Badina be Babulono pavapavana na dala katakata ai e ginimu, dala ruaosi badi-tanodia baine bagu haoro totona; diba e rubediamu, ena dirava laulaudia e nanadaidiamu, ase ai toa e tahudiamu.
EZK.21.21.english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

EZK.35.7.motu: Seiri ororona na baina havahua bona baina habuaia tari; bona lao mai taudia iboudiai na iena amo baina hadokodia dae.
EZK.35.7.english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

EZK.48.13.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia edia tano ohena ai, Levi taudia ese edia inogo bae abia; ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta. Latana idoinai na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, bona lababana idoinai na kiubit gerebu-rua.
EZK.48.13.english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

EZK.20.46.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na diho kahana ba henia, diho kahana latanai ba haroro, bona diho kahana uda-tanona latanai ba peroveta.
EZK.20.46.english: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

EZK.21.27.motu: Baina havahua, baina havahua, baina havahua; sisina taina basine mia, ela bona ia biaguna korikorina bainema; bena ia baina henia.
EZK.21.27.english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

EZK.44.11.motu: Idia ese egu gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia bae kara, bona dubu ikoukoudia bae itadia tao, bona dubu ai kara helaḡadia bae kara. Idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡauna bona taunimanima edia boubou ḡaudia na bae aladia mase; taunimanima bae naridia bona isiaidia bae lao heni.
EZK.44.11.english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

EZK.7.26.motu: Dikadika na dikadika latanai e kaumu; hari lahulahuna ta na hari lahulahuna ta murinai e maimu. Mata-hanai na peroveta tauna enai e tahuamu; a taratvatu na hahelaḡa tauna enai e boiomu, bona hahealo na hanua tau-badadia ediai e oremu.
EZK.7.26.english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

EZK.39.4.motu: Bena Israel ororodia ba hekida diho, oi bona emu hutuma idoinai bona e bamomumu besedia; bena lau ese baina abimui, kasiri-ani manudia idau-idau bona uda bolomadia adia ai baina halaomui;
EZK.39.4.english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

EZK.7.3.motu: Harihari dokona na oi latamu ai vada e kau, egu badu na oiemu ai baina hulalaia, bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai davadia do baina henimu.
EZK.7.3.english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

EZK.32.21.motu: Lohia herea-daedia ese idia bona idurudia taudia na mase gabuna bogaragina amo bae herevalaidia, baeto “Asie peritomedia taudia na vada e diho, e hekuremu, asie marere-mareremu; dare ese vada e aladia mase”.
EZK.32.21.english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

EZK.40.46.motu: bona mirigini kahana e vaira heniamu daiutuna na hahelaḡa taudia, ihaboulaina patana e biaguamu taudia, edia. Unu na Sadok garana; Levi garana iboudiai bogaragidiai amo idia sibodia ese Iehova bae raka henia kahi, isiaina ilao-henina totona.
EZK.40.46.english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

EZK.16.30.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Emu mata-bodaga na bada herea; una dainai ini kara iboudiai o kara, ariara hahinena se hemaraimu ena kara;
EZK.16.30.english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

EZK.23.43.motu: Bena lau nato, Tatau na ia ida e eno boumu negadia ai, idia na asie heuda hanaimu a?
EZK.23.43.english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’

EZK.32.26.motu: Mesek bona Tubal na unuseni ai, mai edia orea taudia hutuma ida; edia gara ese e ḡeḡedia daemu. Iboudiai na do se heperitome taudia, dare ai e mase taudia mo. Badina be idia ese mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari e havaraia rohoroho.
EZK.32.26.english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

EZK.33.11.motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu, e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau ese dika tauna ena mase asina moalelaiamu, a dika tauna na ena dala amo baine raka siri bena baine mauri, una na na moalelaiamu. A lou, emui dala dikadia amo a lou! Israel besena e, anina be dahaka ba mase?
EZK.33.11.english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

EZK.13.17.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi danu vairamu ba ha-aukaia emu bese taudia natudia hahinedia, sibodia edia lalo-hadai e perovetalaimu hahinedia, ediai. Idia latadiai ba peroveta,
EZK.13.17.english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

EZK.13.3.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Peroveta taudia kavakavadia, sibodia lalodia e badinamu a ḡau ta asie itaia taudia, madi ihabaidia!
EZK.13.3.english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

EZK.48.30.motu: Hanua lalona amo bae raka lasi gabudia bini: Mirigini kahana ai (ena lata na kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima),
EZK.48.30.english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

EZK.16.19.motu: Egu flaoa igabudia danu, na henimu ḡauna, (badina be lau ese flaoa namo-hereana bona dehoro bona bada-ranuna amo na ubumu) na idia vairadiai o atodia, bonadia bae moalelai totona. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.19.english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.35.3.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Seiri ororona e, a itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu. Lau imagu baina toia roro, oi ihadikamu totona; baina habuamu tari bona baina havahumu.
EZK.35.3.english: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

EZK.28.16.motu: Emu hoihoi karadia momo herea lalodiai
EZK.28.16.english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence,

EZK.3.25.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, oi na varo amo bae ḡuimu, bena taunimanima dekediai basio raka lasi diba.
EZK.3.25.english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

EZK.20.33.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani mai imagu goadana bona mai imagu itoi-rorona bona mai badu-hebubugu ida baina pavapavamui.
EZK.20.33.english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

EZK.48.12.motu: Idia ahudia korikorina ai bainela, tano helaḡana lalonai, gabu helaḡa-hereana ai bainela, Levi taudia edia tano ohena ai.
EZK.48.12.english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

EZK.8.8.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, maḡu ba hamaurua. Magu na hamaurua, bena iduara ta na itaia.
EZK.8.8.english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.”

EZK.45.19.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese kara dika iabi-ohona boubou ḡauna rarana kuri ta baine abia, dubu iduaradia ihua-ihuadia bona ihaboulaina patana isena daigunina haniosi bona laloma maḡuna ikoukouna audia baine dahulaidia.
EZK.45.19.english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

EZK.22.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
EZK.22.1.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.20.47.motu: Hari diho kahana udana ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, oi lalomu ai lahi ta baina ha-araia; bena una lahi ese au mauridia iboudiai bona au masedia iboudiai na baine aradia ore; ta ese lahi hururu-hururuna basine habodoa, bona vaira iboudiai, diho kahana amo ela bona mirigini kahana, na baine hodaridia.
EZK.20.47.english: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

EZK.18.25.motu: Ḡau tamona umui na o tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena e, a kamonai! Egu dala na dia maoro a? Lasi, umui emui dala hari dia mamaoro ani?
EZK.18.25.english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

EZK.21.6.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba ganaḡana, mai dara-dokomu bona mai lalo-hisihisimu iditana ida ba ḡanaḡana, idia vairadiai.
EZK.21.6.english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

EZK.34.21.motu: Badina be ohemui bona paḡamui amo o hebibimu, bona manoka ḡaudia iboudiai na doamui amo o bibidia ohomu, ela bona o hakarohodia rohorohomu;
EZK.34.21.english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

EZK.41.19.motu: vaira ta, taunimanima vairana na heto, ese pamu auna ta e vaira henia ohena ta ai; bona vaira ta, leona natuna vairana na heto, ese pamu auna ta e vaira henia, ohena ma ta ai. Idia na dubu idoinai heḡeḡemadai ai e hekoro;
EZK.41.19.english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

EZK.7.20.motu: Edia herahera mai hairaidia e heagilai, bona edia kaivakuku dika-rohorohodia bona edia ḡau dika-hereadia na unu amo e karadia; taunabunai lau ese ḡau mirona ai baina halaoa idia ediai.
EZK.7.20.english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

EZK.11.4.motu: Taunabunai, idia latadiai ba peroveta; taunimanimanatuna e, ba peroveta.
EZK.11.4.english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

EZK.16.41.motu: Emu ruma bae doudia; hahemaoro karadia oi latamu ai bae kara, hahine momo vairadiai; emu ariara karadia ai baina hadokomu, bona henitao basio heni lou.
EZK.16.41.english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

EZK.46.9.motu: E gwaurai ariadia daidiai tano taudia na Iehova vairanai baema negadia ai, mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo toma-diho totona baine raka vareai tauna na diho kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka lasi; bona diho kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka vareai tauna na mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka lasi; asi tauna ta ese e raka vareai ikoukouna amo ma baine raka lasi; a ta ta na bae raka vairai, bena bae raka lasi.
EZK.46.9.english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

EZK.23.34.english: You will even drink it and drain it out.

EZK.37.7.motu: Taunabunai, lau na peroveta, vada e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena; bena na perovetava lalonai hesede-hesede reḡena e reḡedagu; bena turia na e hahebou, turia ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai e hemudu-hemudu kau.
EZK.37.7.english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

EZK.38.5.motu: Parasa bona Kusu bona Put taudia na idia ida; iboudiai na mai edia kesi bona auri kwara-gaudia;
EZK.38.5.english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

EZK.33.20.motu: Ḡau tamona umui na o tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena taumui e, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, ta ta ena kara ena kara heḡereḡeredia ai.
EZK.33.20.english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

EZK.47.11.motu: A gohugohuna bona laguta-lagutana na basie negari; bae mia, damena gabudia.
EZK.47.11.english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

EZK.39.7.motu: Bena lau ladagu helaḡana baina hahedibalaia, egu bese Israel bogaraginai; baina gwaudia tao, lau ladagu helaḡana basie hamiroa lou; bena bese idau-idau na bae diba, lau na Iehova, Helaḡa Diravana Israel ai.
EZK.39.7.english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.

EZK.25.8.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Moab eto “A itaia, Iuda besena na bese idau-idau iboudiai heḡereḡeredia”,
EZK.25.8.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

EZK.1.22.motu: Hari mauri ḡaudia kwaradia daediai ḡau ta, ita-itana na guba na heto, e hururu-hururu gabisi na heto; kwaradia daediai e heidi roro.
EZK.1.22.english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

EZK.7.14.motu: Kibi vada e hiriria, ḡau iboudiai vada e hegaegaelai; a ta na tuari se laomu, badina be egu badu na edia hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai.
EZK.7.14.english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

EZK.30.23.motu: Aigupto taudia baina hakarohodia bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, baina hakarohodia rohoroho tano idau-idau lalodiai.
EZK.30.23.english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

EZK.3.8.motu: A itaia, oi vairamu vada na ha-aukaia, idia edia vaira-auka davana; bona oi vairamu vada na hahuakaia, idia edia vaira-hua davana.
EZK.3.8.english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

EZK.31.3.motu: A itaia, lau ese Lebanon sida-auna ta ida baina haheḡereḡeremu,
EZK.31.3.english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon

EZK.14.11.motu: unu amo Israel taudia na egu amo basie raka oho lou, bona edia kara havara iboudiai amo sibodia basie hahemiro lou, a egu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.14.11.english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.23.48.motu: Unu amo lebulebu karadia na tano ai baina hadokodia, hahine ese nahuadia bae toho totona, bena lebulebu karadia basie kara, umui vada o kara heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.23.48.english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.

EZK.4.12.motu: Bavania, bali atagana na heto, idia vairadiai ba gabua, taunimanima taḡedia kakorodia lahina latanai.
EZK.4.12.english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

EZK.32.22.motu: Asuria na unuseni ai, ena orea idoinai danu; edia gara ese e geḡea daemu, iboudiai na dare ai e mase taudia mo.
EZK.32.22.english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

EZK.27.22.motu: Sieba bona Raama edia hoihoi taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva; idia ese aniani mamidia ihanamolaidia muramuradia namo-hereadia idau-idau bona herahera nadidia idau-idau iboudiai bona gold e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.22.english: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.

EZK.27.18.motu: Damasko taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva, emui kohu momo herea bona emui taḡa bada-herea ḡau idau-idau ai daidiai; idia ese Helebono ena vine ranuna, bona mamoe huina kurokurona
EZK.27.18.english: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

EZK.43.5.motu: Lauma ese e abigu isi, laloma kahana maḡuna lalonai e laohaigu; bena na itaia, Iehova hairaina ese dubu vada e hahonua.
EZK.43.5.english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

EZK.14.14.motu: ena be ini tatau tatoiosi, Noa bona Daniel bona Iobu, na ia lalonai bema noho, to edia kara maoromaoro amo idia sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.14.14.english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.30.10.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.18.21.motu: A kara dika tauna na ena kara dika iboudiai amo bema raka oho, bona egu taravatu iboudiai bema badinadia, bona taravatu lalodiai bema ḡaukara bona bema kara maoromaoro, ia na momokani do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
EZK.18.21.english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

EZK.1.27.motu: Bena ia koekoena hetomana ḡauna amo e dae e laova na itaia, e hekara auri labora-labora hururu-hururuna na heto, ita-itana na lahi hekou hegeḡena na heto; bona ia koekoena hetomana ḡauna amo e diho e laova na itaia, ita-itana na lahi na heto, bona diari badana ese e ḡeḡea dae.
EZK.1.27.english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

EZK.12.9.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena, gwau-edeede besena, e nanadaimu, eto “Dahaka o karamu?”, ani?
EZK.12.9.english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

EZK.16.21.motu: Una dainai lau natugu o aladia mase, bona ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodia, idia edia, a?
EZK.16.21.english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

EZK.33.14.motu: Ina danu, ena be kara dika tauna na hamaoroamu, na tomu “Oi na do ba mase”, to ena kara dika amo bema raka oho, taravatu henunai bema noho bona kara maoromaorodia bema kara;
EZK.33.14.english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

EZK.48.19.motu: Hanua ena ḡaukara taudia, Israel iduhudia iboudiai amo, ese bae biru henia.
EZK.48.19.english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

EZK.24.10.motu: Lahi audia momo ba raku, Iahi ba ha-araia, hidio ba nadua namonamo, vasiahu ba seia oho, turia ba haḡoledia oho.

EZK.38.3.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Gog e, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana e, lau ese oi na inai henimumu;
EZK.38.3.english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

EZK.20.25.motu: Ina danu, taravatu dikadia bona hahedua herevadia, ibadinadia ai mauri basie davaria ḡaudia, na henidia;
EZK.20.25.english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.

EZK.13.22.motu: Badina be emui koikoi amo kara maoromaoro tauna lalona vada o hamanokaia, ena be lau ese lalona asina hamanokaia; bona kara dika tauna lalona vada o hagoadaia, ena dala dikana amo basine raka siri, ena mauri basine rauaia;
EZK.13.22.english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

EZK.16.28.motu: Asuria taudia ida danu ariara karadia o kara, badina be emu mata-bodaga na bada herea; oibe, idia ida ariara karadia o kara, a lalomu do se heḡereḡere.
EZK.16.28.english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

EZK.8.3.motu: Ima hetomana ḡauna ta e toia lasi, doboraḡigu ai e abigu; bena Lauma ese e abigu isi, tanobada bona guba padadiai, bena Dirava imata-hanailaina ai Ierusalem e laohaigu, ela bona laloma maguna ikoukouna raka-vareaina, mirigini kahana e vaira henia ḡauna; unuseni ai vaḡeḡe kaivakukuna, vaḡeḡe e havaraiamu ḡauna, ena gini gabuna e miava.
EZK.8.3.english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

EZK.27.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.27.1.english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK.37.10.motu: Taunabunai, lau na peroveta, e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena, bena laḡa na idia lalodiai e vareai; bena e mauri, e tore isi, hutuma bada herea.
EZK.37.10.english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

EZK.23.39.motu: Badina be natudia e aladia mase, edia kaivakuku iboulaidia ḡaudia ai e halaodia, dinana lalonai idia ese egu gabu helaḡana lalonai e didi vareai, bae hamiroa totona. A itaia, egu dubu ai unu e kara toma.
EZK.23.39.english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.

EZK.17.10.motu: A itaia, bae hadoa hanai negana ai, baine tubu namonamo a? Laurabada baine toa henia negana ai, ia na basine marai a? E tubu gabuna ai baine marai ani?
EZK.17.10.english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

EZK.43.9.motu: Harihari edia kaivakuku itomadihohenidia bona edia pavapava tau-anidia masedia na bae negedia daure, bena lau na idia bogaragidiai baina noho hanaihanai.
EZK.43.9.english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

EZK.21.11.motu: Taunabunai, dare na vada e heni lao, bae hakimore-kimorea, bona imadia ai bae abia kau totona; vada e segea bona vada e hakimore-kimorea, ala-ala tauna iunana ai bae atoa totona.
EZK.21.11.english: It is given to be polished,

EZK.44.2.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina ikoukou na hekouna ai do baine mia; ta ese basine kehoa, bona ta na iena amo basine raka vareai; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na iena amo vada e raka vareai, una dainai ia na hekouna ai do baine mia.
EZK.44.2.english: Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

EZK.7.16.motu: Haida bema roho mauri, idia na ororo ai bema noho, koura punedia na heheto; iboudiai na bae ḡanaḡana, ta ta ena kara havara ena kara havara daidiai.
EZK.7.16.english: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

EZK.16.18.motu: Emu dabua mai heraheradia danu o abidia, unu ḡau o govalaidia, bona egu dehoro bona egu muramura mai bonana na vairadiai o atodia.
EZK.16.18.english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

EZK.41.6.motu: Hari ohe daiutudia na ere toi, latana latana ai. Daiutu na toi-ahui toi-ahui amo, ere Ia ta ai. Dubu heḡeḡemadai ai to-tao ḡaudia e kara, dubu habana ai, bena daiutu lavadia na unu ḡau latadiai e heato kau, unu lava na dubu habana lalonai basie hetoi vareai helaoreana.
EZK.41.6.english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

EZK.25.4.motu: una dainai lau ese mairiveina kahana taudia imadia ai na atomuimu, idia ese edia ai bae halaomui, bona bogaragimui ai bae taruha bona bae noho; idia ese emui au-huahua bae ani bona emui rata bae inu.
EZK.25.4.english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

EZK.23.17.motu: Bena Babulono taudia na ia dekena ela, ia ida e eno bou, ela bona edia lebulebu karadia amo e hamiroa. E hamiroa murinai, ia ese e rakatanidia mai hedadaraina ida.
EZK.23.17.english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

EZK.12.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese gwau-edeede besena bogaraginai o nohomu. Idia na mai matadia, ḡau bema ita, to ḡau ta asie itaiamu, bona mai taiadia, hereva bema kamonai, to hereva ta asie kamonaimu;
EZK.12.2.english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

EZK.41.18.motu: kerubi laulaudia bona pamu audia laulaudia; kerubi padadia amo na pamu audia ta ta. Kerubi ta ta vairadia na rua rua:
EZK.41.18.english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

EZK.16.40.motu: Tuari oreana ta bae mailaia, oi ihadikamu; nadi amo bae hodomu, bona edia dare amo bae dapamu rohoroho.
EZK.16.40.english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

EZK.14.15.motu: Eiava uda boromadia na una tano ai bama harakadia hanai, bena idia ese bema havahua, ela bona tano ḡaḡaena ai bema hahelao, bena tau ta basinema rakaia hanai diba unu uda boromadia daidiai, negana ai,
EZK.14.15.english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

EZK.1.25.motu: Bena kwaradia daediai e miava gubarta daena amo gado ta ema; idia e gini negadia ai na hanidia e hakapudia.
EZK.1.25.english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

EZK.33.33.motu: Ina na bainema negana ai, (bona ia na momokani bainema), bena idia na bae diba peroveta tauna ta na bogaragidiai vada ema.
EZK.33.33.english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

EZK.30.4.motu: Dare ta na Aigupto latanai baine kau,
EZK.30.4.english: A sword will come on Egypt,

EZK.16.53.motu: Edia noho-namo baina henidia lou, Sodoma mai natuna hahinedia ida edia noho-namo bona Samaria mai natuna hahinedia ida edia noho-namo, bona oiemu noho-namo baina henimu lou idia bogaragidiai;
EZK.16.53.english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

EZK.20.44.motu: Bena lau ladagu bagunai baina kara henimui, dia emui dala dikadia eiava emui kara bodagadia heḡereḡeredia, negana ai umui ba diba lau na Iehova. Israel besena e, Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.20.44.english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.25.16.motu: una dinai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese imagu na baina toia roro Filistia taudia ihadikadia, bona Kerete taudia baina negedia daure, bona kone kahana orena na baina habuaia tari.
EZK.25.16.english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

EZK.36.2.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be inaimui ese e herevalaimui, eto ‘Aha”, bona “Ororo gunadia doridia vada a ḡaunaidia,”
EZK.36.2.english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

EZK.3.6.motu: dia bese idau-idau momo, edia gado na i'idau bona a'auka besedia, ediai. Momokani, unuhetomadia ediai bama siaimu, idia ese bema kamonai henimu.
EZK.3.6.english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

EZK.10.20.motu: Unu mauri ḡaudia Israel Diravana henunai na itadia ḡaudia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai; bena na diba idia na kerubi.
EZK.10.20.english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

EZK.17.7.motu: A ugava ma ta ema; hanina na babada, bona huina na momo. A itaia, hari vine ramuna ese ia e hata hema bona gavena danu e tubu henia, baine hapariparidia totona. Bena e hadoa tanona amo
EZK.17.7.english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

EZK.9.4.motu: Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ierusalem hanuana ba rakaia hanai, kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai, hanua lalonai e karamu, na e taitailaidiamu bona e ḡanaḡanalaidiamu taudia bagudia ai toa ba kara.
EZK.9.4.english: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

EZK.36.6.motu: Taunabunai, Israel tanona ba perovetalaia, ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, bona koura dobudobudia bona koura iboudiai, ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu vaḡeḡe baduna ai na herevamu; badina be bese idau-idau edia hedunirai herevadia na umui latamui ai.
EZK.36.6.english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

EZK.37.3.motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ini turia na bae mauri diba a? Lau na haere, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi hari mai dibamu.
EZK.37.3.english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?”

EZK.40.27.motu: Laloma maḡuna ena diho kahana na mai ikoukouna. Bena ia ese padadia e hahetohoa, ikoukou ta amo ela bona ikoukou ta, diho kahana ai; padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
EZK.40.27.english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

EZK.44.13.motu: Idia ese basie raka henigu kahi, hahelaḡa karadia ai isiaigu basie lao heni; egu ḡau helaḡadia bona egu ḡau helaḡa-hereadia basie raka henidia kahi, a hemaraidia bae hemarai, kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara daidiai.
EZK.44.13.english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

EZK.34.16.motu: Boio ḡaudia na baina tahudia davari, bona e raka eva-evamu ḡaudia baina hakaudia lou, bona ae-hedairike ḡaudia aedia baina kumidia; manoka ḡaudia baina hagoadadia, bona mai digaradia bona mai goadadia ḡaudia na baina gimadia, hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva ai baina ubudia.
EZK.34.16.english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

EZK.35.12.motu: Bena ba diba, lau Iehova ese emu hereva, Israel ororodia o gonaḡonalaidia herevadia, iboudiai vada na kamonai; oto “Idia na vada e habuadia tari; vada e henimai, baia ha-oredia”.
EZK.35.12.english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

EZK.41.1.motu: Bena ia ese dubu ai e hakaugu vareai; bena ihua-ihua e hahetohodia. Ohe kahana kahana ai ihua-ihua padadia na kiubit tauratoi.
EZK.41.1.english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

EZK.17.6.motu: bena ia na e tubu, vine auna ai ela, e raga rohoroho; bena gavena na ia e tubu henia, a ramuna na ena gini gabuna ai e mia. Taunabunai, ia na vine auna ai ela, gavena e tubu bona rauna e urumo-urumo.
EZK.17.6.english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

EZK.41.5.motu: Bena ia ese dubu habana e hahetohoa, udunana na kiubit tauratoi. Ohena daiutudia lababadia na kiubit hani, idia ese dubu e haheḡeḡea dae.
EZK.41.5.english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

EZK.27.33.motu: Emu hoihoi kohudia na davara kahadia idau-idau amo ema negadiai na
EZK.27.33.english: When your wares came from the seas,

EZK.29.9.motu: bena Aigupto tanona na baine hebua tari bona baine vahu. Bena idia na bae diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.29.9.english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.31.15.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Mase gabuna ai baine diho negana ai, lau ese ranu dobudia baina haḡanidia, bae tailaia; bona sinavaina baina laodia ahu, ranu momo danu bae helao ahu. Lebanon na baina havaburaia, ia dainai, bona tano paka audia iboudiai na ia dainai bae marai.
EZK.31.15.english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

EZK.46.7.motu: Ena ilaoa bouboudia na boromakau maruanena ida efa ta bona mamoe maruanena ida efa ta, bona mamoe natudia ida ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni; flaoa efadia ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta baine heni.
EZK.46.7.english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

EZK.26.1.motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-tana lalonai, hua dinana gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.26.1.english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.27.24.motu: Idia ese hahedoki namo-hereadia, bona dabua vaiuridia, bona dabua mai heraheradia, bona dabua gedadia, oromadia idau-idau ḡaudia, e loku ḡoevaḡoeva ḡaudia, na emui ai e hoihoilai.
EZK.27.24.english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

EZK.34.7.motu: Taunabunai, mamoe ireḡudia taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.

EZK.40.12.motu: Ohe kahana kahana daiutudia na mai seaseadia lababadia kiubit tamona, bona hari daiutu na kiubit tauratoi, ohe kahana kahana ai.
EZK.40.12.english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

EZK.5.6.motu: A ia ese bese idau-idau vada e hereadia egu hahedua herevadia iutudia ai, bona heḡeḡemadai tanodia vada e hereadia egu taravatu itata-utudia ai; egu hahedua herevadia vada e dadaraidia, bona egu taravatu daladia ai asie raka.
EZK.5.6.english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

EZK.30.19.motu: Unuhetomana lau ese hahemaoro karadia baina kara Aigupto latanai,
EZK.30.19.english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt.

EZK.21.16.motu: Idibamu ai bona launmu ai ba lapalapa, emu dare isena e lapa henimu gabudia.

EZK.45.3.motu: Hari kaha helaḡana lalonai, tano ta ba hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta; ia lalonai dubu helaḡana, helaḡa herea gabuna, na baine gini.
EZK.45.3.english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

EZK.10.1.motu: Bena na roha lao, na itaia, kerubi daediai, unu kerubi daedia gubana ai, ḡau ta e hedinarai, sapairo nadina na heto, oromana na terono ta hetomana.
EZK.10.1.english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

EZK.19.12.motu: A hari vine auna na badu ai e raḡaia oho,
EZK.19.12.english: But it was plucked up in fury.

EZK.21.32.motu: Oi na lahi auna ai baina halaomu; oi raramu na tano bogaraginai baine mia; badina be lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.21.32.english: You will be for fuel to the fire.

EZK.12.23.motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hereva lada-isina na baina hadokoa; basie gwauraia lou Israel ai. A ba hamaorodia, baoto, Nega na vada e kahikahi, mata-hanai iboudiai anidia ihaḡuḡurudia danu vada e kahikahi.
EZK.12.23.english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

EZK.27.20.motu: Dedan taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva, edia hoihoi ḡaudia na hosi dorudia dabuadia.
EZK.27.20.english: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

EZK.38.10.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Una dina ai lalo-hadai haida na lalomu ai bae vara, bena kara dikana ta ba laloa hata,
EZK.38.10.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

EZK.47.14.motu: Ba haria, ahu iboudiai bae heḡereḡere; na gwau hamata senemui baina henidia nato; ina tano na ahumui korikori ai bainela.
EZK.47.14.english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

EZK.1.28.motu: Medu e dihomu dinana ai kevau na ori ai e hedinaraimu na heto, hari e haheḡeḡea dae diarina na unuheto.
EZK.1.28.english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around.

EZK.20.38.motu: Daḡedaḡe taudia bona egu taravatu e tata utumu taudia na umui bogaragimui amo baina negedia daure, e noholaiamu tanona amo baina hakaud a lasi, a Israel tanona lalonai basie raka vareai. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.20.38.english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.39.17.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini e hereva henimu tomamu: Manu idau-idau bona uda boromadia iboudiai na ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ba hegogo bena baoma; kaha iboudiai amo ba hebou, boubou ariana lau ese na hegaegaelaiamu amui na bavania, boubou ariana badana Israel ororodia ai; vamu bame ani bona rara bame inu.
EZK.39.17.english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

EZK.44.3.motu: Hanua pavapavana sibona na ia lalonai baine helai, Iehova vairanai baine aniani totona. Ia na ikoukou dehena amo baine raka vareai, bona unu amo ma baine raka lasi.
EZK.44.3.english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

EZK.17.24.motu: Bena tano paka audia iboudiai na bae diba lau Iehova ese au latana na hakwadogiamu bona au kwadogina na halataiamu, au maurina na hakakoroamu bona au masena na hatubuamu. Lau Iehova vada na hereva, bona karana baina karaia.
EZK.17.24.english: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish.

EZK.22.3.motu: Oi na baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hanuana binai, bogaraginai rara e hahebubuamu, ena nega baine kau helaoreana, bona kaivakuku e karamu, ia sibona ihamirolaina.
EZK.22.3.english: You shall say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!

EZK.18.13.motu: moni bema heni torehai mai heatokauna, bona heatokau monidia haida bema abi: una tau be baine mauri a? Ia na basine mauri. Ini ḡau dika-rohorohodia iboudiai vada e kara; momokani, ia na baine mase; ia rarana na ia sibona latanai.

EZK.20.2.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.20.2.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.48.6.motu: Efraim ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Ruben ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.6.english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

EZK.34.4.motu: Manoka taudia asio hagoadadia, gorere taudia asio hanamodia, ae-hedairike taudia aedia asio kumidia, e raka oho taudia asio hakaudia lou, e boio taudia asio tahudia, a mai siahumui bona mai dagedagemui ida vada o biagudia.
EZK.34.4.english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

EZK.11.20.motu: Bena egu taravatu daladia ai bae raka bona egu hahedua herevadia bae badinadia bona karadia bae kara, idia na lauegu bese taudia ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala.
EZK.11.20.english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

EZK.41.12.motu: Lahara kahana ai dubu maḡuna e vaira henia rumana ena lababa nil kiubit hitu-ahui. Ruma habana udunana na kiubit ima, ruma heḡeḡemadai ai; bona ena lata na kiubit taurahanita-ahui.
EZK.41.12.english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

EZK.36.33.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui kara havara iboudiai amo baina haḡoevamui dinana ai, lau ese taunimanima na hanua lalodiai baina hanohodia, bona e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia na bae haginidia lou.
EZK.36.33.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

EZK.25.5.motu: Raba na kamelo edia rei gabuna ai baina halaoa, bona Amono taudia edia hanua na mamoe seridia edia maḡu ai baina halaodia. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.25.5.english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.32.16.motu: Unu bae rohe ahu toma; bese idau-idau hahinedia ese bae rohe ahu; Aigupto latanai bona ena taunimanima hutuma latadiai bae rohe ahu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.32.16.english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.26.21.motu: Dala dika-rohorohona amo baina hadokomu, bena ba puki oho; ena be bae tahumu, to nega ta ai basie davarimu lou. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.26.21.english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.18.18.motu: A tamana, badina be moni na gwaurai-lagau amo e abiva, bona tadikakana ena kohu e dadiva, bona ena bese taudia bogaragidiai kara dia nanamo e karava, ia na ena kara havara dainai do baine mase.
EZK.18.18.english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

EZK.13.23.motu: taunabunai, ina murinai umui na basio mata hanai koikoi lou, bona bagu haoro karadia basio kara lou; egu orea taudia na umui imamui amo baina harohodia mauri. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.13.23.english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.39.28.motu: Bena idia bae diba, lau na Iehova, edia Dirava; badina be gabu daudau ai na hanohodia, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, bena ma na gogodia lou, edia tano korikori ai. Lau ese idia ta na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai basina rakataia lou;
EZK.39.28.english: They will know that I am Yahweh their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

EZK.16.10.motu: Dabua mai heraheradia amo na hahedokilaimu, bona boromakau kopina tamakadia na aemu ai na kara. Dabua aukana ḡoeva-daena amo na hariolaimu, bona dabua manoka-manokana amo na hahedokilaimu.
EZK.16.10.english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

EZK.16.57.motu: emu kara dika do se hedinarai negana ai? Harihari oi na ia heḡereḡerena, duni-dae ḡauna ai vada ola Edom natuna hahinedia ediai, bona ia dekena hahinedia iboudiai ediai, bona Filistia taudia natudia hahinedia ediai, e ḡeḡemu daemu bona e dadaraimumu hahinedia iboudiai ediai.
EZK.16.57.english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

EZK.34.15.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau sibogu ese egu mamoe baina reḡudia bona baina hahekuredia.
EZK.34.15.english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.30.3.motu: Badina be una dina vada e kahikahimu,

EZK.47.23.motu: Edena iduhu ai idau tauna na e nohomu, unuseni ai ia ahuna ba henia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.47.23.english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.37.16.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, au ta bavabia bona ia latanai ba torea: “Iuda, bona Israel taudia ia ida e heboumu, edia”. Bena au ma ta bavabia bona ia latanai ba torea: “Iosef (Efraim auna), bona Israel besena idoinai ia ida e heboumu, edia”.
EZK.37.16.english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

EZK.26.17.motu: Bena oi latamu ai bae rohe ahu, bae hamaoromu, baeto:
EZK.26.17.english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you,

EZK.22.27.motu: Ena lohia verina ia bogaraginai na uda sisiadia na heheto; damudia e daremu, rara e hahebubuamu, bona taunimanima edia mauri e ha orediamu, unu amo kohu e ḡaunai.
EZK.22.27.english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

EZK.22.31.motu: Taunabunai, egu badu na idia latadiai vada na bubua dobi; egu badu-ḡaraḡara lahina ai vada na ha-aradia; edia kara davana vada na haloua, idia kwaradia ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.22.31.english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.13.11.motu: una dainai ahu amo haba e dahuamu taudia na ba hamaorodia, una haba na baine heḡiḡi dobi. Medu bada-herea baine diho, medu-hetari badadia bae moru, lai-gubana baine toa;
EZK.13.11.english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

EZK.46.4.motu: Ḡole-oho boubouna, hanua pavapavana ese dina helaḡa ai Iehova baine henia ḡauna, na mamoe natudia asi bebeka-bebekadia tauratoi, bona mamoe maruanena asi bebekabebekana ta.
EZK.46.4.english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to Yahweh shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

EZK.9.5.motu: Bena na kamonai, ia ese unu haida e hamaorodia, eto, Ia murinai hanua ba rakaia hanai, bavala-ala; basio haḡeredia bona basio bogadia hisi;
EZK.9.5.english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

EZK.3.19.motu: A kara dika tauna boma sisiba henia, bena ia na ena kara dika amo eiava ena dala dikana amo basine raka siri, ia na ena dika ai baine mase; a oi ese sibomu emu mauri do ba rauaia.
EZK.3.19.english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

EZK.33.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, emu bese taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Dare na tano ta latanai bama mailaia, bena una tano taudia ese tau ta idia bogaragidia amo bema abia hidi, edia gima tauna ai bema halaoa;
EZK.33.2.english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

EZK.37.12.motu: Taunabunai ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu bese e, a itaia, emui guri baina kehodia, emui guri amo baina hatoremui isi, bena baina hakaumui lou, Israel tanona ai.
EZK.37.12.english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

EZK.48.11.motu: Una na vada e hahelaḡadia taudia, Sadok vevena, edia; idia ese egu hahedua e badinadiava, bona Israel taudia e raka siri negana ai idia na asie raka siri, hari Levi taudia e raka siri na heto.
EZK.48.11.english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

EZK.39.19.motu: Digara bavania, ela bona bogamui bae kunuka-kunuka, bona rara ba inua, ela bona ba kekero, hari boubou ariana, amui na heḡaeḡaelaiamu ḡauna, lalonai.
EZK.39.19.english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

EZK.16.27.motu: Taunabunai a itaia, lau imagu na toia roro oi ihadikamu, oi ahumu, e gwaurai henimu guna ḡauna, na hamaraḡia, oi inaimu Filistia hahinedia, mata-ganigani hahinedia, imadia ai na atomu; idia ese emu lebulebu karadia hemaraidia e hemaraiva.
EZK.16.27.english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

EZK.40.44.motu: Bena ia ese murimuri kahana amo e hakaugu vareai, laloma maḡuna lalonai; unuseni ai daiutu rua na itadia, laloma maḡuna lalonai. Ta be mirigini kahana ikoukouna badibadinai, diho kahana e vaira henia. Ma ta be diho kahana ikoukouna badibadinai, mirigini kahana e vaira henia.
EZK.40.44.english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

EZK.47.19.motu: Diho kahana ai, hetoa na Tamara amo baine hematama, bainela ela bona Meribata-kade ranu gabudia, bena Aigupto Dokana amo bainela, ela bona Davara Badana. Diho kahana hetoana bunai.
EZK.47.19.english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

EZK.4.10.motu: Bavania anianina metauna ba hahetohoa, sekele ruahui dina ta lalonai; dina ta ai nega tamona mo bavaniani.
EZK.4.10.english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

EZK.39.22.motu: Israel besena na una dina amo bae diba, lau na Iehova, edia Dirava.
EZK.39.22.english: So the house of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.

EZK.34.23.motu: Lau ese mamoe ireḡudia tauna tamona, egu hesiai tauna David, na idia ireḡudia tauna ai baina halaoa; ia ese baine ubudia bona baine reḡudia.
EZK.34.23.english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

EZK.34.30.motu: Bena idia na bae diba, lau Iehova, edia Dirava, na idia ida bona idia, Israel besena taudia, na lauegu orea taudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.34.30.english: They will know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.40.33.motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia. Gaba-mauru ese e haheḡeḡea dae. Ia latana na kiubit imahui, bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
EZK.40.33.english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

EZK.40.36.motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia. Gaba-mauru ese e haheḡeḡea dae. Ia latana na kiubit imahui, bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
EZK.40.36.english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

EZK.27.8.motu: Sidono taudia bona Aravada taudia na emu bara taudia;
EZK.27.8.english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers.

EZK.44.8.motu: Egu ḡau helaḡadia danu asio baladia heni, a idau bese taudia vada o duanaidia, egu ḡau bae baladia heni, egu gabu helaḡana lalonai.
EZK.44.8.english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

EZK.30.20.motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-tana huana gini gunana dinana ihahituna ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.30.20.english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.40.38.motu: Daiutu ta iduarana na ikoukou dehena ai; unuseni ai ḡole-oho boubouna na bae huria.
EZK.40.38.english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

EZK.23.4.motu: Hane guna ladana na Ohola; ia tadina ladana na Oholiba. Lau ese na adavadia; bena idia ese natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia. Ladadia anidia na iniheto: Ohola na Samaria, bona Oholiba na Ierusalem.
EZK.23.4.english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

EZK.33.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.33.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.19.11.english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled.

EZK.11.12.motu: bena ba diba lau na Iehova; badina be egu taravatu daladia ai asio raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia asio badinadia, a e ḡeḡemui dae besedia edia hahedua herevadia heḡereḡeredia ai vada o kara.
EZK.11.12.english: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

EZK.20.19.motu: Lau Iehova na emui Dirava; lauegu taravatu lalodiai ba raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia ba badinadia namonamo;
EZK.20.19.english: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

EZK.43.1.motu: Una murinai ia ese e hakaugu lao, mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna ai.
EZK.43.1.english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

EZK.46.19.motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou badina iduarana amo e hakaugu hanai, ela bona hahelaḡa taudia edia daiutu helaḡadia mirigini kahana erena; bena una ere dokodokona ai, lahara kahana ai, gabu ta na itaia.
EZK.46.19.english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

EZK.48.7.motu: Ruben ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Iuda ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.7.english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

EZK.10.19.motu: Bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro bona raka lasidia ai tanobada amo e dae ela, lau vairagu ai; bona ava-keikeidia na idia badibadidiai. Bena idia na Iehova ena dubu mairiveina kahana ikoukouna iduarana enai e gini; bona Israel Diravana hairaina na idia daediai.
EZK.10.19.english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

EZK.26.4.motu: Idia ese Turo maḡudia bae ḡiḡidia dobi, bena kohorodia bae haheḡiḡidia tari, bena lau ese tanona baina tahia oho, nadina mo baine kikiri.
EZK.26.4.english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

EZK.21.19.motu: Taunimanuna natuna e, Babulono pavapavana ena dare daladia rua toadia ba kara; ruaosi na tano tamona amo baema. Bona toa auna ba haginia, hanua dalana badi-tanona ai.
EZK.21.19.english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

EZK.23.15.motu: mai edia gaba ḡaudia koekoedia ai bona edia kwara dabuadia kwaradia ai, iboudiai ita-itadia na lohia taudia, Kaldea taudia, Babulono tanona ai e nohomu taudia, laulaudia.
EZK.23.15.english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

EZK.48.3.motu: Asere ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Napatali ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.3.english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

EZK.27.16.motu: Edom na emui ai e hoihoiva, emui kohu momo herea daidiai; idia ese samarago nadidia bona dabua kakakakadia bona dabua mai heraheradia bona dabua aukadia namo-hereadia bona ramoto bona kadokodo nadidia e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.16.english: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

EZK.6.3.motu: baoto, Israel ororodia e, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva a kamonai! Ḡaubada Iehova ese ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, koura dobudobudia bona koura-koura na ini e gwau henidia tomamu: A itaia, lau ese dare na latamui ai baina hadihoa, bona emui atai gabudia helaḡadia baina habuadia tari.
EZK.6.3.english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.
