EZK.3.22.motu: Unuseni ai Iehova imana na lau latagu ai mia. Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, ba raka lasi, taora baola; unuseni ai baina hereva henimu.
EZK.3.22.english: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

EZK.2.3.motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel taudia dekedia na siaimumu, daḡedaḡe besena, lau e daḡedaḡe henigumu taudia, dekediai; idia bona tamadia ese vada e kara dika henigu ema bona hari ina dina ai.
EZK.2.3.english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

EZK.18.22.motu: Kerere iboudiai, ia ese e kara ḡaudia, na ta basie laloa tao ia latanai; ena kara maoromaoro dainai ia na baine mauri.
EZK.18.22.english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

EZK.28.18.english: By the multitude of your iniquities,

EZK.18.4.motu: A itaia, lauma iboudiai na lauegu, tama laumana bona natuna laumana danu; kara dika tauna laumana na baine mase.
EZK.18.4.english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

EZK.18.20.motu: Kara dika tauna laumana na baine mase. Natuna basine hisihisi tamana ena kara havara dainai, bona tamana basine hisihisi natuna ena kara havara dainai; kara maoromaoro tauna ena kara maoromaoro na ia sibona latanai, bona kara dika tauna ena kara dika na ia sibona latanai.
EZK.18.20.english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

EZK.48.21.motu: Tano orena, tano helaḡana bona hanua tanona ohena ohena ai, na hanua pavapavana ena. Tano helaḡana ena kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima amo ela bona laurabada kahana hetoana, bona lahara kahana ai hari kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima amo ela bona lahara kahana hetoana, na hanua pavapavana ena tano. Una tano bona iduhu ta ta ahudia padadia na basie maraḡi bona basie bada edia lata idoinai. Tano helaḡana bona dubu helaḡana ia bogaraginai danu,
EZK.48.21.english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

EZK.33.8.motu: Kara dika tauna bama hamaoroa, bama toma “Kara dika taumu e, oi na vada ba mase,” bena oi ese basioma hereva henia, basioma sisiba henia, ena dala amo baine raka siri totona; bena una kara dika tauna na ena dika ai baine mase, a ia rarana davana na oiemu ai baina gwauraia.
EZK.33.8.english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

EZK.1.17.motu: E hekei laova negana ai, ena be asie hegiro to kaha haniosi ilao-henidia mai dibadia.
EZK.1.17.english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

EZK.42.5.motu: Atai daiutudia na taidia i'iora, badina be idia dehedia lababadia na taidia babada a henu bona bogaragi eredia dehedia lababadia na taidia mamaraḡi.
EZK.42.5.english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

EZK.26.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, badina be Turo ese Ierusalem e herevalaia, eto “Aha, taunimanima edia ikoukou vada e makohi, egu ai vada e hekeho; ia vada e vahu dainai lau baina namo lou”;
EZK.26.2.english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

EZK.26.20.motu: una negana ai baina dorimu dobi, Guri Badana ai e dihomu taudia ida, sene taudia dekediai; bona tanobada henuna gabuna ai baina hanohomu, idau nega ai e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia bogaragidiai, Guri Badana ai e dihomu taudia ida. Taunabunai, ta ese basine noholaimu, bona mauri taudia edia tano ai basio mia.
EZK.26.20.english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

EZK.1.5.motu: Bena bogaragina amo mauri ḡaudia hani hetomadia e hedinarai. Ita-itadia na iniheto: oromadia na taunimanima na heheto,
EZK.1.5.english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

EZK.5.17.motu: Lau ese doe bona uda boromadia baina siaidia vasi, umui ihadikamui totona; idia ese natumui na emui amo bae dadidia oho; dai-hanai gorerena bona rara ese bae daemui, bena dare na latamui ai baina siaia. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.5.17.english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”

EZK.47.22.motu: Ahumui ba duanaidia, umul emui bona idau taudia, bogaragimui ai e nohomu bona natudia na bogaragimui ai vada e havaradia taudia. Idia na Israel memerodia korikoridia heḡereḡeredia ai baela umui emui ai; umui ida ahumui ba duanaidia Israel iduhudia bogaragidiai.
EZK.47.22.english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

EZK.48.2.motu: Dan ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Asere ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.2.english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

EZK.20.24.motu: badina be idia ese egu hahedua herevadia asie badinadia, bona egu taravatu e dadaraidia, bona egu dina helaḡadia e hamirodia, bona tamadia edia kaivakuku e haḡeredia.
EZK.20.24.english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

EZK.12.16.motu: A idia kwabukwabudia haida na dare bona dai-hanai gorerena bona doe amo baina harohodia mauri, bena bae lao heni besedia bogaragidiai edia kara dikarohorohodia iboudiai na bae gwaurai hedinarai, bona bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.12.16.english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.20.18.motu: Bena tano ḡaḡaena ai idia natudia na hamaorodia, nato, Tamamui edia taravatu lalodiai basio raka, eiava edia hahedua herevadia basio badinadia, eiava edia kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia ai sibomui basio hahemiro.
EZK.20.18.english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

EZK.20.30.motu: Taunabunai, Israel besena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Senemui heḡereḡeredia ai ba hahemiro, bona edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia igavadia ai ba raka siri, a?
EZK.20.30.english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?

EZK.14.6.motu: Taunabunai Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A helalo kerehai, emui kaivakuku bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai amo ba mede daudau.
EZK.14.6.english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

EZK.37.24.motu: Egu hesiai tauna David ese baine pavapavadia; iboudiai na ireḡudia tauna tamona ese baine regudia. Egu hahemaoro herevadia na bae gavadia,
EZK.37.24.english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

EZK.12.19.motu: bona tano taudia na ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Ierusalem inoholaina taudia Israel tanona lalonai na ini e herevalaidia tomamu: Adia bae ani mai garidia ida, bona ranu bae inu mai kudou-hetahadia ida, badina be edia tano anina idoinai baine heabi oho vaitani, e noholaiamu taudia iboudiai edia daḡedaḡe dainai.
EZK.12.19.english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

EZK.2.8.motu: A taunimanima natuna e, na hamaorolaimumu herevana ba kamonai: oi na basio daḡedaḡe, una daḡedaḡe besena na heto; udumu a hagaia, aina henimu ḡauna bavania.
EZK.2.8.english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

EZK.20.48.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na bae diba lau Iehova ese na ha-araia; bena ta ese basine habodoa.
EZK.20.48.english: All flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”

EZK.3.15.motu: Bena dauhai e hanohodia taudia dekediai na kau, Telabibi ai; idia na Kebara sinavaina isena ai e nohova. Bena unuseni ai na helai, idia bogaragidiai, laumagu na e daure ela bona dina hitu e ore.
EZK.3.15.english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

EZK.21.14.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba peroveta; imamu ba pata dagu, bena dare na baine dapadapa nega harua, oibe nega hatoi, taunimanima iala-masedia darena, ia na heala-ala badana darena, e ḡeḡedia ahumu ḡauna.

EZK.6.12.motu: Gabu daudau ai e nohomu tauna na dai-hanai gorerena amo baine mase; bona gabu kahikahina ai e nohomu tauna na dare amo baine mase; bona do noho maurina tauna na doe amo baine mase. Unuhetomana egu badu-ḡaraḡara baina ha-orea idia latadiai.
EZK.6.12.english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

EZK.36.29.motu: Emui miro iboudiai amo baina haḡoevamui; bona uma ḡaudia baina haḡanidia, bae vara momo; basina hahitolomui.
EZK.36.29.english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

EZK.21.8.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.21.8.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.29.16.motu: Bena Israel besena taudia ese basie abidadama henidia lou, bona edia hekaha iabina totona basie kara havara lou. Bena idia bae diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
EZK.29.16.english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”

EZK.32.25.motu: Idia ese ena hekure gabuna vada e lailaia, e aladia mase taudia bogaragidiai, ia mai ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai ida; edia gara ese e ḡeḡea daemu, iboudiai na do se heperitome taudia, dare ai e mase taudia mo. Badina be idia igari-henidia vada e hepiu rohoroho, mauri taudia edia tano ai; idia na guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu, e aladia mase taudia ida e atodiamu.
EZK.32.25.english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

EZK.33.24.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, gabu ḡaḡaedia e noholaimu taudia Israel tanona lalonai na e hereva louloumu, e tomu, Abraham na tau tamona, to ia ese tano e ḡaunaia; a ai na hutuma, matona, tano na bae henimai, vada baia ḡaunaia.
EZK.33.24.english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

EZK.14.8.motu: Lau ese vairagu baina ha-aukaia una tau enai; toa bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai baina halaoa, bona egu bese taudia bogaragidia amo baina negea daure; bena umui na ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.14.8.english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.32.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, latanai ba rohe ahu, ba hereva henia, baoto:
EZK.32.2.english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him,

EZK.1.6.motu: a vairadia na hani hani amo, bona hanidia na hani hani amo.
EZK.1.6.english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

EZK.7.24.motu: Bese dika-hereadia baina mailaidia, edia ruma bae ḡaunaidia; edia goada, e heaḡilaiamu ḡauna, baina ha-orea; edia gabu helaḡadia bae hamirodia.
EZK.7.24.english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

EZK.18.5.motu: Tau ta ena kara bema maoromaoro, taravatu ibadinana ai bona kara maoromaoro ikaradia ai bema noho,

EZK.6.9.motu: umui roho-mauri taumui hahidaosi ese lau ba lalogu tao, iguimui ai bae laohaimui besedia bogaragidiai. Bona mai lebulebudia ida vada e rakatanigu taudia na lalodia baina gugubadia, bona mai lebulebudia ida edia kaivakuku e gavadiamu taudia na matadia baina hakepuludia negana ai, idia na sibodia bae hedadarai, edia kara havara bona edia kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai.
EZK.6.9.english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

EZK.21.18.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
EZK.21.18.english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

EZK.26.8.motu: Ia ese natumu hahinedia tanobada ai na dare amo baine aladia mase. Ia ese maḡu ta amo baine koumu heḡeḡe, bona tano baine larebaia bona kesi momo bae duduidia isi oi ihadikamu.
EZK.26.8.english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

EZK.12.8.motu: Daba ai Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.12.8.english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.30.25.motu: Babulono pavapavana imana baina hagoadadia, a Farao imana na bae hedabarai; bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova. Egu dare na Babulono pavapavana imana ai baina atoa negana ai, ia ese Aigupto tanona baine dudui henia;
EZK.30.25.english: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am Yahweh when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.

EZK.44.7.motu: Idau bese taudia, lalodia asie hahelaḡadia bona tauanidia asie peritomedia taudia, na egu gabu helaḡana lalonai o harakadia vareai, bona gabu o hamiroa, agu aniani, digara bona rara, na egu ai o hahelagadiamu negadia ai. Emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai latadiai danu egu taravatu itata-utuna vada o atva kau.
EZK.44.7.english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

EZK.38.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Gog, Magog tanona tauna, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana, ba vaira henia bona latanai ba peroveta,
EZK.38.2.english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

EZK.8.17.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a? Iuda besena taudia ese hari kara dika-rohorohodia iniseni ai e karamu na ḡau pipikina a, una dainai idia ese tano na daḡedaḡe amo e hahonuamu, bona e habadugu hereamu? A itaia, idia ese ududia mukurodia e kara.
EZK.8.17.english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

EZK.27.9.motu: Gebala tau-badadia bona ena idibaka taudia na oi lalomu ai,

EZK.38.16.motu: Baoma, egu bese Israel taudia ba daedia, dagadaga ese tano e ḡovaia ahumu na heto. Dina gabedia ai, lau ese baina hakaumu mai, egu tano ituari-henina totona; bena oiemu amo, Gog e, egu helaḡa na bese idau-idau vairadiai baina hamomokania, unu amo idia ese bae dibagu.
EZK.38.16.english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”

EZK.48.4.motu: Napatali ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Manase ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.4.english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

EZK.9.8.motu: Idia e daea negana ai, lau na sibogu na nohova, bena na goru diho, na tai, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, emu badu ḡaraḡara Ierusalem latanai iseina ai na Israel orena idoinai ba habuadia tari a?
EZK.9.8.english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

EZK.39.23.motu: Bena bese idau-idau na bae diba, Israel besena na iḡui gabuna ai ela, edia kara havara dainai; badina be edia kara amo e koigu dikadika dainai lau ese vairagu na edia amo na hunia, bona adia inai taudia imadia ai na atodia, bena iboudiai na dare ai e mase.
EZK.39.23.english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

EZK.11.14.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.11.14.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.37.26.motu: Lau na idia ida baia herohemaino; emai herohemaino baine hesiriu hanaihanai. Lau ese baina hanamodia bona baina hahutumadia; egu gabu helaḡana na idia bogaragidiai baina atoa, unuseni ai baine mia hanaihanai.
EZK.37.26.english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

EZK.34.12.motu: Mamoe ireḡudia tauna ese ena mamoe serina baine tahua davari, ena mamoe haida vada e karoho rohoroho negana ai, una heḡereḡerena ai lau ese egu mamoe baina tahudia davari; bona dagadaga bona dibura masemase dinana ai e karoho rohoroho gabudia iboudiai amo baina rauadia.
EZK.34.12.english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

EZK.35.13.motu: Sibomu emu heaḡi vada o habadaia, lau ihadikagu herevadia vada o gwaurai; bona emu hereva vada o hahohodia, lau ihadikagu; lau vada na kamonai.
EZK.35.13.english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

EZK.29.14.motu: bena Aigupto ena noho namo baina havaraia lou, bona Pataro tanona, edia sene tanona, Ialonai ma baina hakaudia vareai lou; unuseni ai idia na basileia maragina ai baela.
EZK.29.14.english: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

EZK.42.4.motu: Daiutu vairadiai, raka-hanai gabuna ta ese laloma kahana e lao heniava, ena lababa na kiubit gwauta bona ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta; daiutu iduaradia na mirigini kahana ai.
EZK.42.4.english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

EZK.45.23.motu: Bona aria dinadia hituosi lalodiai ia ese boromakau natudia mamaruanedia hitu bona mamoe mamaruanedia asi bebeka-bebekadia hitu baine heni, Iehova ena, unu dina ta ta ai, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia; bona nani maruanena ta, unu dina ta ta ai, dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡaudia.
EZK.45.23.english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahweh, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

EZK.42.3.motu: Laloma kahana maḡuna ena kiubit ruahui badibadidiai bona murimuri kahana maḡuna nadi-ariarana vairanai na dehe haida e hevaira heheniva, ere toiosi ai.
EZK.42.3.english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

EZK.26.11.motu: Ena hosi aedia amo ia ese ariaramu iboudiai baine moimoilaidia; emu taunimanima iboudiai ia ese baine aladia mase, emu au-tubua auka-hereadia na tano ai bae moru.
EZK.26.11.english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

EZK.28.17.motu: Lalomu na e hekokorokuva, raho-namomu dainai;
EZK.28.17.english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty.

EZK.32.4.english: I will leave you on the land.

EZK.36.11.motu: Taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia na baina hahohodia umui latamui ai; bae hutuma, bae vara rohoroho. Bae noholaimui taudia baina hahutumadia, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia, bona baina hanamomui badabada. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.36.11.english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.36.22.motu: Taunabunai, Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, lau ba ḡaukaramu na dia umui daimui ai, to lau ladagu helaḡana, ediai o kau besedia bogaragidiai o hamiroa ḡauna, dainai.
EZK.36.22.english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

EZK.40.31.motu: Dehena na murimuri kahana maḡuna e vaira henia; ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia; vadavada moi-kaudia taurahani amo e dae henia.
EZK.40.31.english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

EZK.27.7.english: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt,

EZK.34.26.motu: Bena egu ororo badi-tanodia ai baina hanohodia; bona medu batugudia baina hadihodia, negadia korikoridia ai; idia na hahenamo medudia ai baela.
EZK.34.26.english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

EZK.11.25.motu: Bena Iehova ese vada e haheitalaigu ḡaudia iboudiai na lau ese unuseni ai vada e hanohodia taudia na hamaorolaidia.
EZK.11.25.english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.

EZK.38.9.motu: A ba orea isi, baola, lai gubana na heto, dagadaga ese tano bema ḡovaia ahu na heto, oi bona emu hutuma idoinai bona bese momo oi ida.
EZK.38.9.english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

EZK.27.10.motu: Parasa bona Lud bona Put taudia na emu tuari taudia, emu tuari oreana lalonai; kesi bona auri kwara ḡauna na oi lalomu ai e taudia dae; idia edia amo hairaimu o abia.
EZK.27.10.english: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army,

EZK.40.29.motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe na unu haida heḡereḡeredia; gaba-mauru ese ia bona ia dehena e haheḡeḡedia dae; ia latana na kiubit imahui bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
EZK.40.29.english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

EZK.30.11.motu: Ia mai ena orea taudia, hahegari bada-herea oreana bese idau-idau bogaragidiai,
EZK.30.11.english: He and his people with him,

EZK.19.4.motu: Bese idau-idau ia dainai e ko,
EZK.19.4.english: The nations also heard of him.

EZK.43.12.motu: Dubu taravatuna binai ororo dorina tanona hegeḡemadai idoinai baine helaḡa herea. A itaia, dubu taravatuna bunai.
EZK.43.12.english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

EZK.22.25.motu: Ia bogaraginai ena lohia verina na e goumu bona damuna e dareamu leonana na heto; idia ese taunimanima edia mauri vada e ha-oredia; kohu namo-hereadia bona dava bada ḡaudia vada e dadidia, hahine momo vada e havabudia ia bogaraginai.
EZK.22.25.english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

EZK.45.18.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai, boromakau natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta bavabia, bena gabu helaḡana ba haḡoevaia.
EZK.45.18.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

EZK.22.30.motu: Bena idia bogaragidiai tau ta na tahua, maḡu baine haginia, bena e mauru gabuna ai lau vairagu ai baine gini, tano igimana totona baina habuaia tari na garina; a tau ta asina davaria.
EZK.22.30.english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.

EZK.45.15.motu: Bona mamoe sinahu-rua sinahu-rua amo mamoe ta ta ba heni; Israel iduhudia iboudiai ese unu bae heni toma. Boubou ḡaudia bunu, flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia, edia dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.45.15.english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.34.5.motu: Taunabunai idia na e karoho rohoroho, badina be asi ireḡudia ta; bona uda boromadia iboudiai ediai e hahelao.
EZK.34.5.english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

EZK.8.7.motu: Bena ma e laohaigu, maḡu ikoukouna badibadinai, bena na gaga isi, mauru ta magu ai na itaia.
EZK.8.7.english: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

EZK.4.2.motu: ituari-henina ḡaudia bona ikoulaina maguna bona tano senudia bona taruha bona vaḡoma danu laulaudia ba tore.
EZK.4.2.english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

EZK.42.6.motu: Badina be idia na ere toi ai bona asi edia au-tubua, murimuri kahana maḡuna ena au-tubua heḡereḡeredia, una dainai atai daiutudia na taidia mamaraḡi a henu bona bogaragi eredia daiutudia na taidia babada.
EZK.42.6.english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

EZK.13.13.motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese egu badu ḡaraḡara ai lai-gubana baina hatoaia; bona egu badu ai medu bada-hereana baina hadihoa, bona medu-hetari badadia baina hamorudia, badu ḡaraḡara ai bae habuadia tari.
EZK.13.13.english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

EZK.16.59.motu: Oibe, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Oiemu kara heḡereḡerena ai baina kara henimu. Oi ese hereva helaḡana vada o dadaraia, gwauhamata itata-utuna;
EZK.16.59.english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

EZK.41.9.motu: Ohe kahana kahana daiutudia murimuridia kahadia habadia lababadia na kiubit ima; patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana lababana na kiubit ima. Hari dubu patapatana
EZK.41.9.english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

EZK.29.18.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese ena tuari oreana e siaia, Turo ituarihenina baine ha-aukaia totona; kwara iboudiai e haboha, bona paḡa iboudiai e hatoto; ḡau tamona ia bona ena tuari oreana ese ḡau ta Turo amo asie abia, ituari-henina ai e hekwarahiva davana.
EZK.29.18.english: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

EZK.34.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ireḡuna taudia latadiai ba peroveta. Ba peroveta, ireḡuna taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel ireḡuna taumui e, sibomui o heubumu taumui! Mamoe ireḡudia taudia na mamoe basie ubudia a?
EZK.34.2.english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?

EZK.16.62.motu: Eda gwauhamata baina haginia tutuka-tutuka, bena ba diba lau na Iehova;
EZK.16.62.english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;

EZK.46.16.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bema hanua pavapavana ese harihari ḡauna na ia ahuna amo natuna haida baine henidia, unu natuna ese bae abia, bae ḡaunaia, ahudia korikoridia ai baela.
EZK.46.16.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

EZK.20.6.motu: Una dina ai na gwau henidia hamata, nato, Aigupto tanona amo baina hakaudia lasi, idia daidiai vada na lalo davari tanona ta, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, tano herea-daena, tano iboudiai e hereadiamu ḡauna, lalonai baina hakaudia vareai.
EZK.20.6.english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

EZK.22.6.motu: A itaia, oi lalomu ai Israel lohiadia, ta ta ena siahu ena siahu heḡereḡeredia ai, lalodia na rara ihahebubuna vada e uralai bada.
EZK.22.6.english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

EZK.10.11.motu: E hekei laova negana ai, ena be asie hegiro to kaha haniosi ilao-henidia mai dibadia, a edena kaha ai vaira ava-keikeina ese e vaira henia, murina kahana ḡaudia na ia murinai ela, bona laodia ai asie hegiro.
EZK.10.11.english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

EZK.14.22.motu: Ḡau tamona, ia lalonai haida na bema mauri, bena natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bema hakaudia lasi, idia na dekemu ai bae raka lasi, bena edia dala bona edia kara ba ita negana ai taumu na baine lo, dika na Ierusalem latanai vada na mailaia dainai; oibe, kara iboudiai ia latanai vada na mailai daidiai.
EZK.14.22.english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

EZK.42.13.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Mirigini bona diho kahadia daiutudia, maḡu hevaira-hehenina ai, na daiutu helagadia; hahelaḡa taudia ese Iehova bae raka henia kahi negadia ai, herahia anianidia helaḡa-hereadia na unuseni ai bae ani; unuseni ai herahia anianidia helaḡa-hereadia bae atodia - naoa boubouna, bona kara dika bona kerere iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia; badina be una gabu na helaḡa.
EZK.42.13.english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

EZK.8.2.motu: Bena na roha isi, ḡau ta na itaia, ita-itana taunimanima na heto; ia koekoena hetomana ḡauna henunai na lahi, bona koekoena daenai na diari-diari hetomana, auri laboralabora hurwu-hururuna na heto.
EZK.8.2.english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

EZK.40.4.motu: Bena una tau ese e hereva henigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, lau ese baina haheitalaimu ḡaudia iboudiai na matamu amo ba itadia, bona taiamu amo ba kamonai bona lalomu amo ba haerodia, badina be ini ḡau baina haheitalaimu totona e mailaimu iniseni ai. Ba ita ḡaudia iboudiai na Israel besena taudia ba hamaorolaidia.
EZK.40.4.english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

EZK.35.5.motu: Badina be o daḡedaḡe hanaihanaiva, bona Israel taudia na dare ena siahu ai o atodia kauva, edia hisi-ani negana ai, edia dava-abi orena ai;
EZK.35.5.english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

EZK.14.9.motu: A peroveta tauna lalona bema hekwakwanai bena hereva ta bema gwauraia, anina be lau Iehova ese vada na koia; bena lau ese imagu baina toia roro ia ihadikana, bona egu bese Israel bogaragina amo baina habuaia tari.
EZK.14.9.english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

EZK.37.18.motu: Bena emu orea taudia ese bae nanadaimu, baeto “Ina kara anina basioma hamaorolaimai a?” negana ai
EZK.37.18.english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

EZK.25.11.motu: bona Moab na baina hahemaoro henia. Bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.25.11.english: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.44.4.motu: Bena ia ese mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lao, ela bona dubu vairanai a kau. Bena na roha lao, na itaia, Iehova hairaina ese Iehova ena dubu vada e hahonua; bena tano ai na goru diho.
EZK.44.4.english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

EZK.32.28.motu: Taunabunai ba makohi, dare ese e aladia mase taudia ida ba hekida diho, do se haheperitome taudia bogaragidiai.
EZK.32.28.english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

EZK.17.15.motu: A ia ese e daḡedaḡe henia, gwaukau taudia na Aigupto e siaidia lao, idia ese hosi haida bona tuari oreana badana ta bae henia helaoreana. Baine kwalimu a? Kara unuhetomadia e karamu tauna na baine roho mauri diba a? Taravatu baine tataia utu, bena baine roho mauri diba a?
EZK.17.15.english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

EZK.32.14.motu: Bena edia ranu gabudia baina hanegaridia,
EZK.32.14.english: Then I will make their waters clear,

EZK.33.18.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro amo baine raka oho, bena baine kara havara, ia na una kara dainai baine mase.
EZK.33.18.english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

EZK.18.31.motu: Emui kerere iboudiai, lau o kara henigu karadia, na ba negedia daure, lalo matamatadia bona lauma matamatadia bavabi. Israel besena e, ba mase anina be dahaka?
EZK.18.31.english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

EZK.40.42.motu: E utu hata nadidia patadia hani danu mimia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia patadia. Latadia na kiubit ta mai kahana, lababadia danu kiubit ta mai kahana, bona haradia latadia be kiubit tamona. Ḡole-oho bouboudia bona boubou haida ialalaidia ḡaudia na unu pata latadiai bae heato.
EZK.40.42.english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

EZK.44.25.motu: Mase tauna iraka-kahi-henina ai sibodia basie hahemiro; ḡau tamona tamadia eiava sinadia eiava natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, eiava tadikakadia eiava taihudia ulatodia daidiai sibodia bae hahemiro diba.
EZK.44.25.english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

EZK.45.16.motu: Tano taudia iboudiai ese ini boubou ḡaudia na Israel pavapavana bae henia.
EZK.45.16.english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

EZK.31.7.motu: Vada e bada herea bona rigina na lalata dainai
EZK.31.7.english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness,

EZK.33.29.motu: Bena edia kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai lau ese tano na baina havahua, tano ḡaḡaena ai baina halaoa, negana ai idiu na bae diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.33.29.english: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

EZK.2.6.motu: Oi danu, taunimanima natuna e, idia garidia basio gari bona edia hereva basio garilaidia; ena be au ginigini bona ava ginigini na emu ai bona doadoa o helaidia taomu, to edia hereva garidia basio gari bona edia vaira-hua basio garilaia, badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
EZK.2.6.english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

EZK.44.10.motu: A Levi taudia ese edia dika davadia bae hua, egu amo idauhai e raka kerere dainai; idia ese lau e rakatanigu bona edia kaivakuku muridiai ela, Israel besena e raka kerere negana ai.
EZK.44.10.english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

EZK.39.9.motu: Bena Israel hanuadia e noholaidiamu taudia na bae raka lasi, tuari ḡaudia na Iahi ai bae haboudia, bae doudia; kesi bona keme auridia, peva bona diba, kareva bona io. Lahi audia ai bae halaodia ela bona laḡani hitu bae ore;
EZK.39.9.english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

EZK.37.23.motu: Edia kaivakuku eiava edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia eiava edia kerere amo sibodia basie hahemiro lou; a edia raka muri ai e kara dika karadia iboudiai amo baina hamauridia bona baina haḡoevadia. Idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala.
EZK.37.23.english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

EZK.27.27.motu: Emu taḡa, emu kohu, emu hoihoi ḡaudia,
EZK.27.27.english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise,

EZK.28.23.motu: Badina be dai-hanai gorerena na ia lalonai baina siaia,
EZK.28.23.english: For I will send pestilence into her,

EZK.33.5.motu: Kibi reḡena e kamonai, to e noho hedavauhe; ia rarana na ia sibona latanai. A bema hedaraunelaia, bena ena mauri bema rauaia.
EZK.33.5.english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

EZK.47.8.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina ranu na mairiveina kahana e aru e laomu, Araba kourana ai e dihomu; bena gohu ai e aru lasimu negana ai, gohu na e negarimu.
EZK.47.8.english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

EZK.8.14.motu: Bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu mirigini kahana ikoukouna raka-vareaina e laohaigu; unuseni ai hahine haida na itadia, e helaiva, Tamusu taina e taiva.
EZK.8.14.english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

EZK.33.17.motu: Ḡau tamona, emu bese taudia na e tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”; a ḡau be idia sibodia edia dala na dia maoro.
EZK.33.17.english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

EZK.41.26.motu: Ohe kahana kahana ai, dehe ohena habadia ai, na gaba-mauru, ioradia na au rotonadia amo e kara ḡaudia; bona pamu audia laulaudia danu.
EZK.41.26.english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

EZK.44.28.motu: Ahudia ta basie abia, badina be ahudia na lau; bona kohu ta Israel ai basio henidia, badina be edia kohu na lau.
EZK.44.28.english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

EZK.20.34.motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaumui lasit bona lalodiai vada o karoho rohoroho tanodia amo baina gogomui, mai imagu goadana bona mai imagu itoi-rorona bona mai badu-hebubugu ida.
EZK.20.34.english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.

EZK.16.22.motu: Emu kara dika-rohorohodia bona emu ariara karadia iboudiai lalodiai, maragimu negana, asi dabuamu ḡagaemu ai o nohova negana, rara ai o hekure, so laloa tao.
EZK.16.22.english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

EZK.3.9.motu: Vairamu vada na ha-aukaia, nadi-vasiga ena auka e hereaiamu nadina na heto; idia garidia basio gari bona edia vaira-hua basio garilaia, badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
EZK.3.9.english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

EZK.36.34.motu: E vahu tanona na bae biru henia, bena raka-hanai taudia iboudiai ese vahuna ai basie itaia lou.
EZK.36.34.english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

EZK.36.15.motu: Bena lau ese bese idau-idau baina gwaudia tubu, basie lodu henimui lou, bona taunimanima hemaraidia na basio hua lou, bona emui bese na basio hahekwakwanaia lou. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.36.15.english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.3.7.motu: A Israel besena ese basine kamonai henimu, badina be idia na asie uramu lau bae kamonai henigu. Badina be Israel taudia iboudiai na vairadia e huamu bona lalodia e ha-aukamu.
EZK.3.7.english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

EZK.27.30.motu: idia ese oi taimu e taimu,
EZK.27.30.english: and will cause their voice to be heard over you,

EZK.36.28.motu: Senemui na henidia tanona ai ba noho; egu bese ai baola, lau danu emui Dirava ai bainala.
EZK.36.28.english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

EZK.26.5.motu: Ia na davara bogaraginai baine mia, reke itoredia gabuna ai bainela. Lau, Ḡaubada Iehova, vada na hereva. Bena ia na bese idau-idau damudia ai bainela;
EZK.26.5.english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

EZK.28.20.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.28.20.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.10.8.motu: Hari kerubi hanidia henudiai na ḡau ta, ita-itana na taunimanima imana hetomana.
EZK.10.8.english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

EZK.16.63.motu: ba laloa tao, bena ba baia, bona udumu basio kehoa lou, emu hemarai dainai, lau ese emu kara iboudiai baina lalodia nege negana ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.63.english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.29.12.motu: Lau ese Aigupto tanona baina habuaia tari, vada e hebua tari tanodia bogaragidiai; bona hanuana iboudiai bae hebua tari, laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai, e vahumu hanuadia bogaragidiai. Lau ese Aigupto taudia baina hakarohodia rohoroho, tano idau-idau lalodiai.
EZK.29.12.english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

EZK.45.24.motu: Ia ese danu flaoa boubouna baine heni, efa ta ta boromakau mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona efa ta ta mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona dehoro hini ta ta efa ta ta ida.
EZK.45.24.english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

EZK.30.9.motu: Una dina ai gwaukau taudia na mai heaudia ida lauegu amo baela, Etiopia taudia bae hahebolorudia; bena lalo-hisihisi bada-herea na latadiai bae kau, Aigupto ihabua-tarina dinana ai; badina be, a itaia, dinana be e maimu.
EZK.30.9.english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”

EZK.12.13.motu: Egu huo baina otoa ia iabina, bona egu idoa ai baina idoaia; Babulono, Kaldea tanona ai, baina laohaia; ḡau tamona, ia ese basine itaia, ia na unuseni ai baine mase.
EZK.12.13.english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

EZK.22.9.motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese e hahebademu, rara ihahebubuna totona; oi lalomu ai haida ese ororo ai e ani rahimu; oi bogaragimu ai haida ese lebulebu karadia e karamu.
EZK.22.9.english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.

EZK.25.12.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Edom ese Iuda besena taudia edia daḡedaḡe e hadava henidia, bona e kerere dikadika idia ihadava-henidia ai,
EZK.25.12.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

EZK.44.5.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a laloa namonamo; baina hamaorolaimu ḡaudia iboudiai ba itadia bona herevadia ba kamonai, Iehova ena dubu herevadia, hahedua herevadia bona taravatuna iboudiai danu. Ba laloa namonamo danu, daika daika na dubu ai bae raka vareai diba, bona daika daika na gabu helaḡana lalonai basie raka vareai diba.
EZK.44.5.english: Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

EZK.30.6.motu: Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.23.16.motu: E itadia negana ai na e mata dika henidia; bena gwaukau taudia na dekedia e siaidia lao Kaldea ai.
EZK.23.16.english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

EZK.26.13.motu: Emui ane reḡedia baina hadoko; emui gitara reḡedia na basie hekamonai lou.
EZK.26.13.english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

EZK.34.29.motu: Lau ese imea namodia baina henidia, bena basie hitolodia lou edia tano ai, bona bese idau-idau ese basie ḡonaḡonalaidia lou.
EZK.34.29.english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

EZK.43.7.motu: e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Egu terono bona ae-palapalagu imoina gabuna binai; iniseni ai baina noho hanaihanai, Israel taudia bogaragidiai. Israel besena taudia ese lau ladagu helaḡana basie hamiroa lou, idia bona edia pavapava edia ariara karadia amo, eiava edia pavapava tau-anidia masedia amo,
EZK.43.7.english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

EZK.47.21.motu: Ina tano na unu ba haria toma, Israel iduhudia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.47.21.english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

EZK.42.11.motu: bona raka-hanai gabuna ta na idia vairadiai. Idia na mirigini kahana daiutudia heḡereḡeredia, edia lata bona edia lababa na unu idia ida heheḡereḡere; edia raka lasi gabudia bona ihaginidia daladia bona iduara danu na unu idia ida heheḡereḡere.
EZK.42.11.english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

EZK.23.11.motu: Ina kara na ia tadina Oholiba ese e itaia, ḡau tamona ia ese kakana e hereaia, ena mata dika ai bona ena ariara karadia ai; unu kara ai kakana na dika, a ia be dika herea.
EZK.23.11.english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

EZK.13.10.motu: Oibe, badina be egu orea taudia vada e koidia, eto “Maino”, maino na lasi negadia ai; bona badina be taunimanima ese haba e haginiamu negadia ai, ini peroveta taudia ese ahu amo e dahuamu;
EZK.13.10.english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

EZK.37.17.motu: Bena au ruaosi ba hahesiriudia, au tamona ai baela oi imamu ai.
EZK.37.17.english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

EZK.39.26-27.motu: Bena bese idauidau bogaragidia amo baina loulaidia, bona inaidia edia tano hidaosi amo baina haboudia, bona idia edia amo egu helaḡa na bese momo vairadiai baina hamomokania negana ai, idia ese edia hemarai bae laloa boio, bona edia kara koikoi, lau e koilaigu karadia, edia tano ai e noho namonamova bona haida ese asie hagaridiava negadia ai e karava karadia, danu bae lalo boio.

EZK.29.10.motu: una dainai, a itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu, bona emu sinavai na inai henidiamu, bona Aigupto tanona na baina havahua bona baina habuaia tari, Migdol amo ela bona Suene, ela bona Etiopia tano-hetoana.
EZK.29.10.english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.

EZK.36.9.motu: Badina be, a itaia, lau na umui ida; lau ese baina hageremui, bena bae ruamui bena uhemui bae hado.
EZK.36.9.english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

EZK.33.26.motu: Dare amo o ala-alamu, kara dika-rohorohodia o karamu, bona umui iboumui ai na ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna adavadia ida o heuda hanaimu; matona, tano ba ḡaunaia a?
EZK.33.26.english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

EZK.40.35.motu: Bena ia ese ma e hakaugu lao, mirigini kahana ikoukouna ala. Bena e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.40.35.english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

EZK.24.24.motu: Unuhetomana, Esekiel na toa ta ai bainela emui ai, ia ese e kara karadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia, umui ese ba kara. Ina na baine kau negana ai, ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
EZK.24.24.english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”’”

EZK.16.44.motu: A itaia, hereva lada-isidia e gwauraimu taudia iboudiai ese ina hereva lada-isina ai bae herevalaimu, baeto “Sinana hetomana, natuna hahinena danu unuheto”.
EZK.16.44.english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

EZK.16.51.motu: Samaria ena kara dika na taina bada, a oiemu na bada herea; oiemu kara dika-rohorohodia ese idia edia vada e hereadia; oiemu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai tadikakamu ita-itadia na kara maoromaoro hahinedia ita-itadia na heheto.
EZK.16.51.english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

EZK.24.26.motu: una dina ai heau tauna ta na dekemu bainema, hari baine hamaorolaimu.
EZK.24.26.english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

EZK.5.15.motu: Umui na hesivarai bona heḡonaḡonalai bona sisiba bona hahegari ḡauna ai baola, e ḡeḡemui ahumu besedia ediai, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui mai badugu bona mai lalo-siahugu bona mai hedadaba aukadia ida negana ai. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.5.15.english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—

EZK.24.3.motu: Hereva heḡereḡerena na ina gwau-edeede besena ba gwaurai henia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:
EZK.24.3.english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,

EZK.39.15.motu: Bena tano iraka-hanaina ai idia ta ese tau ta turiana baine davaria negana ai, ia ese toa ta baine holoa una turia badibadinai, ela bona mase iguridia taudia ese Hamono-gog Kourana ai bae ḡuria.
EZK.39.15.english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

EZK.16.8.motu: Ma na rakamu hanai negana ai na itamu, oi na vada o ulato; bena egu dabua amo na tarumu, taumu na govalaia; oibe, maohenimu na karaia, bona oi ida ta hegwau hamata heheni, bena adavagu ai ola. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.8.english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.

EZK.34.18.motu: Rei namona o aniamu na dia heḡereḡere, una dainai emui rei orena na aemui amo o moia taomu a? Ranu negari-negarina o inuamu na dia heḡereḡere, bena orena na aemui amo o haduhuamu a?
EZK.34.18.english: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

EZK.9.1.motu: Bena ia ese taiagu ai e lolo, mai gao badana ida, eto, Hanua ihabua-tarina taumui e, a raka kahira, ta ta mai emui ala-ala ḡaudia imamui ai.
EZK.9.1.english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

EZK.13.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ena peroveta taudia latadiai ba peroveta; sibodia edia lalo-hadai e perovetalaimu taudia na ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
EZK.13.2.english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:

EZK.43.3.motu: Egu mata-hanai na hanua ihabua-tarina totona ema negana ai na mata hanailaia ḡauna bona Kebara sinavaina badibadinai na mata hanailaia ḡauna heḡereḡeredia. Bena tano ai na goru diho.
EZK.43.3.english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

EZK.41.10.motu: bona maḡu daiutudia padadia na kiubit ruahui, dubu hegegemadai idoinai.
EZK.41.10.english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

EZK.32.19.motu: Daika na hairai ai o hereaiamu?
EZK.32.19.english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

EZK.1.10.motu: Vairadia ita-itadia na iniheto: vaira kahadia ai ta ta vairadia na taunimanima vairadia, idibadia kahadia ai hahaniosi vairadia na leona vairadia, lauridia kahadia ai hahaniosi vairadia na boromakau mamaruanedia vairadia, bona muridia kahadia ai hahaniosi vairadia na ugava vairadia.
EZK.1.10.english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

EZK.21.24.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be emui kerere ihelalolaidia na taunimanima lalodiai vada o havaraia, bona emui kara kerere vada o hulalalaidia, bena emui kara iboudiai lalodiai emui dika e hedinaraimu, bona badina be umui na sibomui o helalo unemu, una dainai emui kara dika lalodiai bae abimui.
EZK.21.24.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

EZK.14.16.motu: ena be unu tatau tatoiosi na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba; idia tatoiosi sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua, a tano na bema ḡaḡae.
EZK.14.16.english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

EZK.20.22.motu: A imagu na na rua, bona ladagu bagunai na ḡaukara, vairadiai na hakaudia lasi besedia vairadiai lau ladagu basine miro helaoreana.
EZK.20.22.english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

EZK.4.9.motu: Ina danu, oi ese uit, bali, bini, lentil, millet, bona rae na bavabidia, nau tamona ai ba udadia hebou, bena igabu ba kara. Bena ohemu ai ba eno dere dinadia hidaosi, dina sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui lalodiai bavani.
EZK.4.9.english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

EZK.37.14.motu: Bena egu Lauma na lalomui ai baina atoa, bena ba mauri; bena emui tano korikori ai ma baina hanohomui. Bena ba diba, lau Iehova vada na hereva bona karana vada na karaia. Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.37.14.english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”

EZK.33.16.motu: Ena kara dikadia ta basine helalo tao, ia ihadikana; ia na taravatu henunai vada e kara maoromaoro, ia na do baine mauri.
EZK.33.16.english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

EZK.44.18.motu: Kwaradia na dabua aukadia amo bae havavalaidia, bona koekoedia ai dabua auka piriboudia bae kara; varahu ihavarana ḡauna ta basie dokilaia.
EZK.44.18.english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

EZK.27.14.motu: Bete-togarama taudia ese hosi bona tuari hosidia bona doniki na e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.14.english: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

EZK.44.9.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Idau bese tauna ta, lalona se hahelaḡaia bona tau-anina asie peritomea tauna, idau bese taudia iboudiai Israel besena taudia padadiai e nohomu taudia ta, na egu gabu helaḡana lalonai basine raka vareai.
EZK.44.9.english: The Lord Yahweh says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

EZK.18.8.motu: moni basinema heni torehai mai heatokauna eiava heatokau monidia haida basinema abi; imana na kara havara amo bema rua; taunimanima padadiai hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoevana bema karaia;
EZK.18.8.english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest,

EZK.30.7.motu: Ia na baine vahu, vada e vahu tanodia bogaragidiai,
EZK.30.7.english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate.

EZK.35.11.motu: una dainai (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu) lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena ai, oi ese o inai henidia dainai badu bona vaḡeḡe karadia o karalai henidia heḡereḡeredia ai lau ese baina kara henimu; bona bogaragimu ai baina hedinarai, baina hahemaoro henidia negana ai.
EZK.35.11.english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

EZK.23.6.motu: Idia na tuari taudia, dabua kakakakadia e hahedokilaiva; idia na hekwara taudia bona tuari lohiadia; iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia, hosi ai e guiva taudia.
EZK.23.6.english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.

EZK.44.14.motu: Ḡau tan-ona lau ese baina duanaidia, dubu bae naria; bona toma-diho karadia iboudiai bona ḡaukara iboudiai ia lalonai e karamu na idia ese bae kara.
EZK.44.14.english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

EZK.1.23.motu: Hari guba henunai idia hahaniosi hanidia na e toi roro heheni; bona mauri ḡaudia ta ta na mai hanidia rua rua, tau-anidia igovalaidia ḡaudia.
EZK.1.23.english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

EZK.29.1.motu: Laḡani ihagwautana huana ihagwautana dinana ihagwauta-ruana lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.29.1.english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.16.56.motu: Emu hekokoroku dinana ai oi tadimu Sodoma na udu gwaurai-gwawai herevana oi udumu ai, ani,
EZK.16.56.english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

EZK.47.6.motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a?
EZK.47.6.english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?”

EZK.48.14.motu: Taina basie hoia, eiava basie hebodohilaia. Ina ahu namohereana tanona na haida basie henidia, badina be ia na helaḡa, Iehova ena.
EZK.48.14.english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

EZK.7.8.motu: Asi vanahana egu badu ḡaraḡara na latamu ai baina bubua, egu badu na emu ai baina ha-orea, bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu; bena emu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai davadia baina henimu.
EZK.7.8.english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

EZK.4.5.motu: Badina be dina na gwaurai henimumu, dina sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui, idia ese edia dika davadia bae abi laḡanidia heḡereḡeredia; nega unudaudauna na Israel besena ena dika davana latamu ai baine mia.
EZK.4.5.english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

EZK.21.13.motu: Badina be ia na dia hahetoho. Hekwadi auna boma dadaraia, ia ese dahaka bema havaraia diba? Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.21.13.english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.27.25.motu: Tarasisi lagatoidia na o vatudia, emui hoihoi ḡaudia bae loalai totona.
EZK.27.25.english: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise.

EZK.28.7.motu: una dainai, a itaia, idau taudia na
EZK.28.7.english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you,

EZK.32.24.motu: Elam na unuseni ai, bona ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai ese iena gara e ḡeḡea daemu. Iboudiai na dare ai e mase; do se heperitome ai idia na mase gabuna ela. Gunaguna idia ese mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari karadia e karava; harihari guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu.
EZK.32.24.english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

EZK.32.29.motu: Edom na unuseni ai, ena pavapava bona ena lohia iboudiai. Idia na goada dikadika, to dare ai e mase taudia ida vada e hahekuredia. Idia na se haheperitome taudia, guri ai e dihomu taudia, ida e hekuremu.
EZK.32.29.english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

EZK.13.5.motu: Magu vada e gwadadia mauru gabudia asio lao henidia, Israel besena maḡuna asio larebaia, Iehova ena dina ai tuari ai baine auka totona.
EZK.13.5.english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

EZK.4.15.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A itaia, na gwau maoromu, amu ataga na taunimanima taḡena kakorona lahina latanai basio gabua, a boromakau taḡena kakorona lahina latanai ba gabua.
EZK.4.15.english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

EZK.5.9.motu: Bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai lau ese nega gunana ta ai asina karaia bona nega gabena ta ai basina karaia lou karana ta baina kara henimui.
EZK.5.9.english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

EZK.3.23.motu: Taunabunai na tore isi, na raka lasi, taora nala; unuseni ai Iehova hairaina ginina ai na itaia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itaia hairaina heḡereḡerena. Bena na goru diho.
EZK.3.23.english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

EZK.7.22.motu: Bena idia edia amo baina mede daudau, egu gabu ḡoeva-daena na bae hamiroa totona; dadidadi taudia ese ia lalonai bae raka vareai, bae hamiroa,
EZK.7.22.english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

EZK.40.28.motu: Bena ia ese laloma maḡuna lalonai e hakaugu vareai, diho kahana ikoukouna amo. Bena ia ese diho kahana ikoukouna e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.40.28.english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

EZK.31.9.english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches,

EZK.26.7.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, mirigini kahana amo Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, pavapava edia pavapava, mai ena hosi bona ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia bona ena tuari taudia hutuma herea ida, baina mailaidia, Turo latanai.
EZK.26.7.english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

EZK.33.22.motu: Heau mauri tauna na do se gini dae ai, adorahi ai Iehova imana na latagu ai e kau; bena daba ai, hari tau na dekegu ai e kau negana ai, Iehova ese udugu vada e kehoa guna; taunabunai, udugu vada e hekeho, egu mu negana vada e ore.
EZK.33.22.english: Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

EZK.42.15.motu: Ia ese dubu maḡuna laloma kahana e hahetohoa vaitani, bena mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lasi, bena dubu maḡuna murimurina kahana e hahetohoa heḡeḡe.
EZK.42.15.english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

EZK.40.45.motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina diho kahana e vaira heniamu daiutuna na hahelaḡa taudia, dubu e biaguamu taudia, edia;
EZK.40.45.english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

EZK.29.6.motu: Bena Aigupto inoholaina taudia iboudiai na bae diba, lau na Iehova. Badina be oi na siriho itotohina, Israel enai;
EZK.29.6.english: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

EZK.20.45.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.20.45.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.43.20.motu: Bena rarana kuri ta bavabia, ihaboulaina patana ena doa haniosi ba dahulaidia, bona digi daigunina haniosi danu, bona isena heḡeḡemadai ai; unu amo ihaboulaina patana ba haḡoevaia bona kara dika na iena amo bavabia oho.
EZK.43.20.english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

EZK.43.2.motu: Bena Israel Diravana hairaina na itaia, mairiveina kahana amo ema. Ena mai reḡena na sinavai momo reḡedia na heheto; bena ia hairaina ese tanobada na e hakiama-kiamaia.
EZK.43.2.english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

EZK.1.3.motu: Iehova ena hereva na hahelaḡa tauna Esekiel, Busi natuna, enai e kau, Kaldea taudia edia tano ai, Kehara sinavaina isena ai. Iehova imana na ia latanai mia una gabu ai.
EZK.1.3.english: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.

EZK.27.34.motu: Harihari davara ese vada e hamutumu,
EZK.27.34.english: In the time that you were broken by the seas,

EZK.32.6.english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood,

EZK.30.24.motu: Babulono pavapavana imana baina ha-aukadia, bona egu dare na ia imana ai baina atoa; a Farao imana na baina hakwaidudia, bena ia na ia vairanai baine ḡanaḡana, mase berona e davaria tauna na heto.
EZK.30.24.english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.

EZK.43.15.motu: Ihaboulaina patana rahurahuna na kiubit hani; bona ihaboulaina patana rahurahuna amo doa hani e hagini, edia lata na kiubit tamona.
EZK.43.15.english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

EZK.26.10.motu: Ena hosi bae hutuma herea dainai, aedia kahudia ese bae govamu. Ia na ikoukoumu amo baine raka vareai, ta ese maḡuna e hamaurua hanuana ai bema raka vareai heḡereḡerena; una negana ai hosi-gui taudia bona rerue bona kariota reḡedia ese maḡumu bae haheude-heudedia.
EZK.26.10.english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

EZK.34.24.motu: A lau Iehova na edia Dirava ai bainala, bona egu hesiai tauna David ese baine lohiadia. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.34.24.english: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.

EZK.17.11.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.17.11.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.14.18.motu: ena be unu tatau tatoiosi na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba, a idia tatoiosi sibodia mo bema heraua.
EZK.14.18.english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

EZK.11.5.motu: Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese e rohegu; bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A hereva, agowa, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, umui na ene o laloa tomamu; badina be lalo-hadai dahaka dahaka lalomui ai e varamu na dibagu.
EZK.11.5.english: Yahweh’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘Yahweh says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

EZK.35.10.motu: Badina be oi oto “Ini bese ruaosi bona ini tano ruaosi na lau ese baina abidia, bena ai ese baia ḡaunaidia”, (gau tamona Iehova na unuseni ai);
EZK.35.10.english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,

EZK.40.17.motu: Bena ia ese murimuri kahana maḡuna lalonai e hakaugu vareai; unuseni ai daiutu haida bona nadi ariarana ta na itadia, maḡu e ḡegea dae; daiutu toi-ahui ese hari nadi ariarana e vaira henia.
EZK.40.17.english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

EZK.25.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na Amono taudia ba henidia, bona idia latadiai ba peroveta.
EZK.25.2.english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

EZK.16.3.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Ierusalem na ini e hamaoroa tomamu: Senemu bona emu vara na Kanaan taudia edia tano ai, tamamu na Amoro tauna, sinamu na Hiti hahinena.
EZK.16.3.english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

EZK.15.5.motu: A itaia, au tutuana miana ai na asi ena ḡaukara; matona lahi ese vada e araia bona gida ai vada ela negana ai ena ḡaukara be dahaka?
EZK.15.5.english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

EZK.12.27.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, Israel besena taudia na e tomu “Ena mata-hanai na dina momo vairai ḡauna, bona ena peroveta herevadia na nega daudau bainela herevadia”.
EZK.12.27.english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

EZK.20.17.motu: Ḡau tamona, matagu ese e bogadia hisi; asina habuadia tari eiava asina ha-oredia vaitani, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
EZK.20.17.english: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.

EZK.44.29.motu: Flaoa boubouna bona kara dika bona kerere iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia na bae ani; bona ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai Israel ai na idia edia.
EZK.44.29.english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

EZK.22.14.motu: Baina kara henimu dinadia ai na emu haheauka baine hesiriu eiava imamu bae goada a? Lau Iehova vada na hereva, bona karana do baina karaia.
