EZK.22.14.english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.

EZK.24.7.motu: Badina be rarana, vada e hebubu ḡauna, na dounu ia bogaraginai; nadi latanai e atoa, tano ai se bubua bena ḡahu ese se tahunia.
EZK.24.7.english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her.

EZK.29.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, na vairamu ba hua henia, bona ia latanai bona Aigupto idoinai latanai ba peroveta,
EZK.29.2.english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

EZK.1.21.motu: Unu na e laova negadia ai, ini danu e laova; unu na e giniva negadia ai, ini danu e giniva; bona unu na tano amo e daeva negadia ai, hari ava-keikei na idia ida e daeva; badina be hari mauri ḡaudia laumadia na ava-keikei lalodiai.
EZK.1.21.english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

EZK.5.3.motu: Bona unu amo danu hui haida bavabi, emu dabua gevena ai ba turidia.
EZK.5.3.english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

EZK.4.3.motu: Bena auri palaka-palakana ta bavabia, auri maḡuna ai bainela, oi bona hanua padamui ai; bena ba raraia tao, ikou-ahuna bona ituari-henina ba ha-aukaia. Ina na toa ta, Israel besena enai.
EZK.4.3.english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

EZK.46.6.motu: Hua matamata dinana ai, ia ese boromakau natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta, bona mamoe natudia tauratoi bona mamoe maruanena ta, asi bebeka-bebekadia, na baine heni.
EZK.46.6.english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

EZK.5.7.motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be umui ese e gegemui ahumu besedia na o hereadiamu, heloḡo ahuahu ai, bona egu taravatu daladia ai asio raka bona egu hahedua herevadia asio badinadia, a e gegemui ahumu besedia edia hahedua herevadia, vada o badinadia;
EZK.5.7.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

EZK.40.9.motu: bona ena ihua-ihua danu, idia na kiubit rua. Hari ikoukou dehena na laloma kahana ai.
EZK.40.9.english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

EZK.36.25.motu: Lau ese ranu negarinegarina amo baina sisirimui, bena emui miro idoinai amo ba ḡoeva; bona emui kaivakuku iboudiai edia amo baina haḡoevamui.
EZK.36.25.english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

EZK.16.16.motu: Emu dabua haida o abi, pata helaḡadia o haheralai, bena latadiai ariara karadia o kara; kara unuhetomana na nega gunadia ta ai se vara, bona nega gabedia ta ai basine vara Iou.
EZK.16.16.english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

EZK.16.39.motu: E ura henimu taudia imadia ai baina atomu; bena idia ese emu kalaga bae ḡiḡia dobi, bona emu pata helaḡadia bae hamakohidia, emu dabua bae dokidia oho, emu herahera nadidia namo-hereadia na bae abidia, gagaemu ai asi dabuamu bae rakatanimu.
EZK.16.39.english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

EZK.24.12.motu: Vada na hekwarahi kava; ia deḡideḡina udunanana lahi ai se oremu.

EZK.25.9.motu: una dainai lau ese Moab igimana na kaha ta amo baina abia oho, ena tano hetoana hanuadia amo baina abia oho; unu na tano hairaina, Bet-iesimoto, Baal-meono, Kiriataimi.
EZK.25.9.english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

EZK.32.17.motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-ruana huana gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-imana ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.32.17.english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.35.4.motu: Emu hanua na baina habuadia tari; oi na gabu ḡaḡaena ai ba hahelao; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.35.4.english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.42.9.motu: Ini daiutu henudiai na raka-vareai gabuna ta, mairiveina kahana ai, murimuri kahana maḡuna amo daiutu lalodiai e raka vareaiva gabuna ai.
EZK.42.9.english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

EZK.28.8.motu: Idia ese guri ai bae dorimu dobi,
EZK.28.8.english: They will bring you down to the pit.

EZK.46.24.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Nanadu gabudia bini, kara helaḡadia dubu ai e karamu taudia ese taunimanima edia boubou ḡaudia na iniseni ai bae nadu.
EZK.46.24.english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

EZK.17.9.motu: Baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu; Baine tubu namonamo a? Ramuna basine raḡadia bona gavena basine utudia, rauna matamatadia iboudiai bae marai totona, a? Dia ima mai goadana mo, eiava taunimanima hutuma mo, bae heḡereḡere ramuna amo bae raḡaia, ani?
EZK.17.9.english: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

EZK.44.21.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ta ese vine ranuna basine inua, laloma maḡuna ai e raka vareaimu negana ai.
EZK.44.21.english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

EZK.18.30.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Taunabunai, Israel besena e, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, ta ta ena dala ena dala heḡereḡeredia. Ba helalo kerehai, emui kerere iboudiai amo ba raka siri, kara havara ese baine hadikamui vaitani na garina.
EZK.18.30.english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

EZK.3.3.motu: E hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na henimumu pepana bavania, bogamu ba hakunulaia. Bena na ania; udugu ai e gaiho, bada-ranuna na heto.
EZK.3.3.english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.”

EZK.19.7.motu: Edia gabu aukadia na e habuadia tari,

EZK.22.2.motu: Oi danu, taunimanima natuna, ba hahemaoro heni a? Ina hanua mai rarana ba hahemaoro henia a? Benaini, ena kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai ba gwaurai henia.
EZK.22.2.english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

EZK.37.15.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.37.15.english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK.24.25.motu: iBona oi, taunimanima natuna e, edia gabu aukana, edia moale bona edia hairai, matadia ese e moalelaiamu bona lalodia ese e uralaiamu ḡauna, bona natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu, na edia amo baina abidia oho dinana ai,
EZK.24.25.english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

EZK.22.19.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Umui iboumui ai na momo ai vada o hahelao dainai, taunabunai, a itaia, lau ese Ierusalem bogaraginai baina haboumui.
EZK.22.19.english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

EZK.16.36.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be e ura henimu taudia ida emu ariara karadia o kara lalodiai, oi ihahemaraimu na e hehulala bona gagaemu ai na o hedinarai dainai, bona emu kaivakuku iboudiai daidiai, bona natumu, idia o henidia memerodia, raradia daidiai,
EZK.16.36.english: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

EZK.15.7.motu: Lau ese vairagu na ediai baina ha-aukaia; ena be lahi amo bae roho mauri, to lahi ese do baine aradia ore; bena lau ese vairagu na ediai baina ha-aukaia negana ai na ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.15.7.english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

EZK.11.1.motu: Bena Lauma ese e haheabigu isi, Iehova ena dubu mairiveina kahana ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ḡauna, e laohaigu. Hari ikoukou iduarana ai tatau ruahui-ima na itadia, bona idia bogaragidiai laasania Asuru bona Pelatia Benaia, bese lohiadia, na itadia.
EZK.11.1.english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

EZK.12.14.motu: Ia bamona iboudiai, iduruna taudia bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai, na lau ese baina hakarohodia, lai kahadia iboudiai baela; bona dare na iudalaina ḡauna amo baina veria lasi, idia muridia amo.
EZK.12.14.english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

EZK.26.16.motu: Bena davara lohiadia iboudiai na edia terono amo bae diho, edia hahedoki badadia bae atodia tabe bona edia hahedoki mai heraheradia bae dokidia oho. Mai heude-heudedia ida edia dabua bae hahedokilai; tano ai bae helai; nega idoinai bae heude-heude bona oi daimu ai bae gari.
EZK.26.16.english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

EZK.38.21.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e lomu, Hahegari karadia idau-idau iboudiai baina havaradia, Gog ihadikana; taunimanima iboudiai na tadikakadia ida bae heala-ala heheni, edia dare amu.
EZK.38.21.english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

EZK.16.49.motu: A itaia, tadimu Sodoma ena kerere binai: ia mai natuna ida e hekokorokuva, e aniani boga-kunuva, e noho namonamova mai tagadia ida; a ogoḡami taudia bona e dabuva taudia na asie durudia.
EZK.16.49.english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

EZK.3.2.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese udugu na hagaia; bena ia ese pepa na e henigu, baina ania.
EZK.3.2.english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

EZK.28.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Turo pavapavana ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:
EZK.28.2.english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:

EZK.46.17.motu: A bema ia ese harihari ḡauna na ia ahuna amo ena hesiai taudia ta baine henia, una tau ese baine abia, ela bona heruha-nege laḡanina; una negana ai hanua pavapavana ese baine abia lou. Ia natuna mo sibodia ese harihari ḡauna ta ia ahuna amo na bae dogoa tao diba.
EZK.46.17.english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

EZK.1.24.motu: E rohova negana ai, hanidia reḡedia na kamonai, sinavai momo reḡedia na heheto, eiava Siahu-idoinai Diravana ena guba-rahu reḡena na heto, eiava tuari oreana bada-hereana heloḡo-heloḡona na heto. E gini negadia ai, idia ese hanidia e hakapudia.
EZK.1.24.english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

EZK.5.4.motu: Ma unu haida danu bavabi, lahi ai ba tahodia kau, ba gabudia; bena unu amo lahi ta baine lasi Israel besena idoinai enai.
EZK.5.4.english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

EZK.45.7.motu: Bena kaha helaḡana ohena ohena tanodia bona hanua ena kaha ohena ohena tanodia, lahara kahana ai bona laurabada kahana ai, na hanua pavapavana ese baine ḡaunaia, ena lata na iduhu ta ahuna ena lata heḡereḡerena, lahara kahana hetoana ela bona laurabada kahana hetoana.
EZK.45.7.english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

EZK.17.16.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani hanua pavapavana ta ese tau ta na pavapava tauna ai e halaoa, bena una pavapava ai e halaoa tauna ese dagi na e henia tauna ena gwauhamata helaḡana e dadaraia, bona e atua taravatuna e tataia utu; benaini, una tau na dagina e henia pavapavana ena noho gabuna ai baine mase, oibe, Babulono ai baine mase.
EZK.17.16.english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

EZK.24.21.motu: Israel besena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu gabu helaḡana baina hamiroa, emui siahu iheaḡilaina toana, matamui ese e moalelaiamu ḡauna, laumamui ese e uralaiamu ḡauna; bena natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia unuseni ai o rakatanidia na dare amo bae mase.
EZK.24.21.english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

EZK.23.13.motu: Bena na itaia, vada e miro vaitani; idia raruosi na dala tamona ai vada e raka.
EZK.23.13.english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

EZK.12.26.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto:
EZK.12.26.english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.48.17.motu: Hanua ena gabiruma tanona danu baine mia: mirigini kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; diho kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; laurabada kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; bona lahara kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui.
EZK.48.17.english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

EZK.16.61.motu: Bena emu kara ba lalodia tao, bona emu hane-guna bona emu hane-muritai baina abidia, natumu ai baina halaodia, negana ai vada ba hemarai, a dia eda gwauhamata dainai.
EZK.16.61.english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

EZK.20.20.motu: bona egu dina helaḡadia ba matauraidia, bena toa ai baela, lau bona umui padadai, bona ba diba lau Iehova na emui Dirava.
EZK.20.20.english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’

EZK.28.5.motu: emu aonega bada hoihoi karadia ai dainai,

EZK.38.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.38.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.16.55.motu: A tadimu Sodoma bona natuna hahinedia ese edia noho dalana Kunana bae lou henia; bona kakamu Samaria bona natuna hahinedia ese edia noho dalana gunana bae lou henia; bona oi bona natumu hahinedia ese emui noho dalana gunana ba lou henia.
EZK.16.55.english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

EZK.2.4.motu: Unu taunimanima danu asie matauraigumu, bona lalodia e ha-aukadiamu; dekedia na siaimumu, ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”.
EZK.2.4.english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’

EZK.45.12.motu: Sekele na gera ruahui heḡereḡeredia; sekele ima be sekele anidia korikoridia inta ba heni, bona sekele gwauta be sekele anidia korikoridia gwauta ba heni. Emui mina lalonai sekele bae imahui.
EZK.45.12.english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

EZK.14.5.motu: unu amo Israel besena taudia, edia kaivakuku daidiai vada e rakatanigu taudia, na lalodia baina abidia lou.
EZK.14.5.english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

EZK.18.29.motu: Ḡau tamona, Israel besena na e tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena e, egu dala na dia maoro a? Lasi, umui emui dala hari dia mamaoro ani?
EZK.18.29.english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

EZK.8.13.motu: Ia ese ma e hamaorogu, eto, Kara dika-rohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, idia ese e karamu na do ba itadia.
EZK.8.13.english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

EZK.8.18.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese badu ḡaraḡara karadia baina kara; basina haḡeredia bona basina bogadia hisi; ena be taiagu ai bae tai mai gao badadia ida, to basina kamonai henidia.
EZK.8.18.english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

EZK.15.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.15.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.22.13.motu: Taunabunai, a itaia, lau ese imagu ruaosi na tutu hekapumu, moni vada o abi koikoi bona rara na bogaragimu ai vada e hebubu daidiai.
EZK.22.13.english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.

EZK.36.12.motu: Oibe, baina gwau maoro, bena egu bese, Israel taudia, na latamui ai bae loaloa; bae ḡaunaimui, ahudia ai bae halaomui; bona natudia na mase ai basio abidia oho lou.
EZK.36.12.english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

EZK.46.15.motu: Taunabunai, mamoe natuna bona flaoa boubouna bona dehoro na daba daba iboudiai bae heni, ḡole-oho boubouna, bae heni loulou ḡauna, ai bainela.
EZK.46.15.english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

EZK.33.23.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.33.23.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.12.21.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.12.21.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.46.3.motu: Tano taudia na Iehova vairanai bae toma diho, una ikoukou raka-vareaina ai dina helaḡadia ai bona hua matamata dinadia ai.
EZK.46.3.english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

EZK.46.2.motu: Hanua pavapavana na murimuri kahana amo baine raka vareai, ikoukou dehena ai; bena ikoukou auna badibadinai baine gini. Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona ena maino bouboudia ḡaudia na bae hahelaḡadia; bena ia na ikoukou raka-vareaina ai baine toma diho. Bena ia na baine raka lasi, a ikoukou na basie koua ela bona dina baine diho.
EZK.46.2.english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

EZK.7.4.motu: Lau ese basina hageremu bona basina bogamu hisi; a emu kara davadia baina henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia na doini bogaragimu ai mimia negana ai. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.7.4.english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’

EZK.1.18.motu: Hari ava-keikei haniosi na mai isedia auridia kuborodia bona heto'o-tao auridia; bona isedia auridia kuborodia idoidiai na mata ai e honu.
EZK.1.18.english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

EZK.34.22.motu: una dainai egu mamoe serina baina hamauria. Idia na damu ai basie hahelao lou; lau ese mamoe ta bona mamoe ta padadiai baina hahemaoro.
EZK.34.22.english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

EZK.20.37.motu: Itotohi henuna amo baina harakamui hanai, bona ta ta amo baina harakamui vareai.
EZK.20.37.english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

EZK.32.1.motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-ruana huana ihagvauta-ruana dinana gini-gunana ai Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.32.1.english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.1.13.motu: Hari mauri ḡaudia bogaragidiai na ḡau ta, ita-itana na gida hururu-hururudia na heheto, eiava kede na heheto, mauri ḡaudia bogaragidiai e loa eva-evava. Lahi na mai hururu-hururuna, bona lahi lalona amo kevaru na e kevarua isi.
EZK.1.13.english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

EZK.29.7.motu: imadia ai e dogomu tao negana ai o kwaidu, pagadia iboudiai e helada oho; bona emu ai e tabe kau negana ai o kwaidu, bena koekoedia iboudiai e herogi-herogi.
EZK.29.7.english: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”

EZK.35.14.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tanobada idoinai ihamoalena totona lau ese baina habuamu tari.
EZK.35.14.english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

EZK.16.5.motu: E itamu tauna ta ese se bogamu hisi, ini kara ta se kara henimu ena hebogahisi dainai; a tano paka ai e negemu; badina be o vara dinana ai e dadaraimu herea.
EZK.16.5.english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

EZK.16.17.motu: Emu herahera ḡaudia danu, lauegu gold bona silver amo e kara bona lau ese na henimu ḡaudia, na o abidia, tatau laulaudia o karalai, bena o lebulebulai.
EZK.16.17.english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

EZK.25.7.motu: una dainai, a itaia, imagu na vada na toia roro, umui ihadikamui, bona bese idau-idau imadia ai baina atomui, edia ai bae halaomui; bena bese idau-idau edia amo baina negemui daure, bona tano idau-idau lalodia amo baina hamasemui, baina habuamui tari. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.25.7.english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

EZK.40.14.motu: Dehe danu e hahetohoa, kiubit ruahui; maḡu ta ese ikoukou dehena e ḡeḡea dae.
EZK.40.14.english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

EZK.23.30.motu: ina kara na latamu ai vada e hadihoa, badina be bese idau-idau ida ariara karadia o kara, bona edia kaivakuku ediai o hahemiro.
EZK.23.30.english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.

EZK.38.18.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ma e tomu, A una dina ai, Gog ese Israel tanona ituari-henina bainema dinana ai, egu badu baine vara.
EZK.38.18.english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.

EZK.34.19.motu: Lauegu mamoe ese aemui amo o moia tao reina bae ania bona aemui amo o haduhua ranuna bae inua a?
EZK.34.19.english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

EZK.39.2.motu: lau ese baina haginimu kerehai bona baina lulumu lao, mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia amo baina mailaimu, baina hakaumu, Israel ororodia ituari-henidia ai;
EZK.39.2.english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.

EZK.20.14.motu: A lau ladagu bagunai na ḡaukarava, vairadiai na hakaudia lasi besedia vairadiai lau ladagu basine miro helaoreana.
EZK.20.14.english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

EZK.23.19.motu: To, ia ese ena ariara karadia e habada, hane-ulatona negana e laloa tao; una negana ai ia ese ariara karadia e karava Aigupto tanona ai;
EZK.23.19.english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.

EZK.22.4.motu: Oi na vada o kerere, vada o hahebubua rarana dainai; bona vada o miro, vada o kara kaivakukudia daidiai; emu nega vada o hakwadogia, vada e gwaurai henimu laḡanidia vada e ore. Taunabunai, hedunirai ḡauna ai vada na halaomu, bese idau-idau ediai, bona heḡonaḡonalai ḡauna, tano iboudiai ediai.
EZK.22.4.english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

EZK.23.45.motu: A ka a maoromaoro taudia ese bae hahemaoro henidia, heuda-hanai hahinedia bona rara ihahebubuna hahinedia davadia bae henidia; badina be idia na heudahanai hahinedia, bona rara na imadia ai.
EZK.23.45.english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

EZK.27.23.motu: Haran bona Kane bona Eden bona Asuru bona Kilimada taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva.
EZK.27.23.english: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

EZK.31.13.motu: Hegigi-dobina ai, atai manudia iboudiai na ia latanai bae noho, bona tano paka boromadia danu ia rigina latadiai.
EZK.31.13.english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

EZK.39.20.motu: Egu dabara ai, hosi bona hosi-gui taudia amo, goada-herea taudia bona tuari taudia idau-idau amo, bogamui do bae kunu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.39.20.english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’

EZK.13.20.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, emui mea ganadia, taunimanima laumadia o idoalaidiamu ḡaudia, na na inai henidiamu; imamui amo baina daredia oho, bona o idoadiamu laumadia na baina kahudia nege, manu na heheto.
EZK.13.20.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

EZK.4.6.motu: Unu dina ba haḡuḡurudia, bena nega iharuana ai ma ba eno dere, a ohemu idibana ai, bena Iuda iduhuna ena dika davana na latamu ai baine mia; dina hari-ahui na gwaurai henimumu, dina ta ta be laḡani ta a toadia.
EZK.4.6.english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

EZK.3.4.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena dekena baola, egu hereva na ba hamaorolaidia.
EZK.3.4.english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

EZK.5.10.motu: Taunabunai, umui bogaragimui ai tama ese natudia bae anidia, bona memero ese tamadia bae anidia; bona lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, bona hahidaosi ba roho mauri na lai kahadia iboudiai baina gigimui rohoroho.
EZK.5.10.english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

EZK.7.10.motu: A itaia, dinana binai! A itaia, ia na e maimu! Emu ai baine kau ḡauna na vada e kau; kara gageva-gageva vada e papa, hekokoroku vada e gara kau;
EZK.7.10.english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

EZK.11.2.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, kara havara e lalo hatamu, bena hahealo herevadia dikadia ina hanua lalonai taunimanima e hamaorolaidiamu taudia bini.
EZK.11.2.english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

EZK.21.10.english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter.

EZK.22.8.motu: Egu ḡau helaḡadia vada o dadaraidia; egu dina helaḡadia vada o hamirodia.
EZK.22.8.english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

EZK.37.11.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ini turia na Israel besena idoinai. A itaia, idia na e tomu, Turiamai vada e kakoro, emai helaro vada e boio; vada e negemai daure.
EZK.37.11.english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

EZK.47.2.motu: Bena ia ese mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lasi, murimuri kahana ai e hakaugu heḡeḡe ela bona murimuri kahana ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna; ranu na diho kahana amo e lasiva.
EZK.47.2.english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

EZK.14.10.motu: Bena davadia bae hua; peroveta tauna davana bona henanadai tauna davana bae heḡereḡere;
EZK.14.10.english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

EZK.6.13.motu: Bena edia mase taudia na edia kaivakuku bogaragidiai bae hekida diho, edia ihaboulaina patadia hegeḡemadai ai, bona ororo latalatadia iboudiai latadiai, bona ororo badadia iboudiai doridia ai, bona au mauridia iboudiai bona oak audia urumo-urumodia iboudiai henudiai, muramura mai bonadia edia kaivakuku e gabu henidia gabudia iboudiai lalodiai; una negana ai ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.6.13.english: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

EZK.40.7.motu: Ohe daiutudia danu latadiai na hahetoho sirihona auta, bona lababadia danu hahetoho sirihona auta. Daiutu padadia na kiubit ima. Ikoukou raka-vareaina, ikoukou dehena laloma kahana ai, na hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
EZK.40.7.english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

EZK.3.10.motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, na herevalai henimumu herevadia iboudiai na lalomu ai bavabi dae, bona taiamu amo ba hakala henidia.
EZK.3.10.english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

EZK.7.9.motu: Basina hageremu bona basina bogamu hisi; emu kara davadia baina henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia na doini bogaragimu ai mimia negana ai. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova, herahu-mase Diravana.
EZK.7.9.english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.

EZK.20.11.motu: Egu taravatu na henidia, bona egu hahedua herevadia ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia na na hamaorolaidia.
EZK.20.11.english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

EZK.4.11.motu: Ba inua ranuna danu ba hahetohoa, ranu hini ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa tamona ba inua; dina ta ai nega tamona mo ranu ba inu.
EZK.4.11.english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

EZK.10.6.motu: Bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna e hagania eto “Lahi na e hegiro-hegiromu ava-keikeidia padadia amo bavabia, kerubi bogaragidiai” negana ai, ia na ela, ava-keikei ta badibadinai e gini.
EZK.10.6.english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

EZK.5.11.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Taunabunai na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui ese egu gabu helaḡana na emui ḡau dika-hereadia bona emui kara dikarohorohodia amo vada o hamiroa dainai, momokani lau ese baina negemui daure; basina hageremui bona basina bogamui hisi.
EZK.5.11.english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

EZK.4.14.motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, a itaia, lau na sibogu asina hahemiro; merogu negana amo ema bona hari ina nega sibona e mase kava ḡauna ta eiava uda boromadia ese e darea ḡauna ta asina ania, bona vamu bodagana taina na nega ta ai udugu ai se vareai.
EZK.4.14.english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

EZK.37.5.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini turia na ini e hereva henidiatomamu: A itaia, baina hahoho henimui, bena ba mauri.
EZK.37.5.english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

EZK.23.25.motu: Bena egu badu na baina siai henimu, edia badu ḡaraḡara ai bae kara henimu totona. Idia ese udu-baubaumu bona taiamu bae utudia oho, bona emu roho-mauri taudia na dare ai bae mase. Idia ese natumu mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bae dabaidia tao, bona emu roho mauri taudia na lahi ese baine aradia ore.
EZK.23.25.english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

EZK.46.21.motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lasi, murimuri kahana maḡuna ala, bena e hakaugu lao, maḡu daigunina haniosi a lao heni; maḡu daigunina ta ta na mai maḡumaḡudia.
EZK.46.21.english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

EZK.2.5.motu: Bena bema kamonai eiava basiema kamonai (badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena), to vada bae diba peroveta tauna ta na idia bogaragidiai vada ema.
EZK.2.5.english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

EZK.22.10.motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese tamadia edia geda e hamirodiamu; oi lalomu ai hahine na edia rara-kara dinadia ai e hahemaraidiamu.
EZK.22.10.english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.

EZK.43.14.motu: badina, tano ai, amo ela bona henu digina, kiubit rua, bona lababana na kiubit tamona; bona digi maraḡina amo ela bona digi badana, kiubit hani, bona lababana na kiubit tamona.
EZK.43.14.english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

EZK.14.21.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Matona, Ierusalem baina hahemaoro henia, egu hahehisi karadia haniosi, dare bona doe bona uda boromadia dikadia bona dai-hanai goreredia, na ia latanai baina siaidia taunimanima bona mauri ḡaudia ihamasedia totona, negana ai, ia na ede baine heto!
EZK.14.21.english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

EZK.1.7.motu: Aedia na mamaoro-mamaoro; aedia palapaladia lalodia na boromakau natuna aena palapalana lalona na heto; bona e kimore-kimore, aun laboralabora na heto.
EZK.1.7.english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

EZK.28.10.motu: Asie peritomedia taudia edia mase ai ba mase,
EZK.28.10.english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised

EZK.26.19.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hanua ahutuna ai baina halaomu, asie noholaidiamu hanuadia heḡereḡeredia, bona gadobada ai baina hamutumu bena ranu badadia ese bae habubunimu;
EZK.26.19.english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

EZK.23.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, hahine rarua e nohova, hahine tamona natuna.
EZK.23.2.english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

EZK.40.48.motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lao, dubu dehena ala. Ia ese dehe ihua-ihuana e hahetohodia; idia na kiubit ima, ohe kahana kahana ai. Ikoukou lababana na kiubit gwauta-hani; bona ikoukou ohena habadia na kiubit toi, ohe kahana kahana ai.
EZK.40.48.english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

EZK.3.17.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, lau ese Israel besena igimana tauna ai vada na halaomu; lau udugu herevana ta ba kamonai negadia iboudiai na lau ladagu ai do ba sisiba henidia.
EZK.3.17.english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

EZK.42.16.motu: Mairiveina kahana na hahetoho sirihona amo e hahetohoa; ia na kiubit sinahu-ima, hahetoho sirihona ai.
EZK.42.16.english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

EZK.38.11.motu: baoto, Lau ese asi maḡudia hanuadia tanona baina tuari henia; unu asi reḡereḡedia e noho namonamomu, edia ruma na asi maḡudia, asi auridia, asi ikoukoudia, taudia na baina daedia;
EZK.38.11.english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

EZK.28.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.28.1.english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK.31.17.motu: Idia danu ia ida mase gabuna ai bae diho, dare ai e mase taudia ida; oibe, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai ia ikerukeruna ai e nohova taudia na bae mase.
EZK.31.17.english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

EZK.21.3.motu: Israel tanona ba hereva henia, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese oi na inai henimumu; egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo baina veria lasi, bena kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na oiemu amo baina utudia oho.
EZK.21.3.english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

EZK.36.20.motu: A bese idau-idau ediai e kau, bena e kau gabudia iboudiai lalodiai idia ese lau ladagu helaḡana e hamiroa; badina be taunimanima ese e herevalaidia, eto, Ina na Iehova ena orea taudia, ḡau tamona iena tano amo e harakadia lasi.
EZK.36.20.english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are Yahweh’s people, and have left his land.’

EZK.36.30.motu: Au huahuadia bona uma anianidia baina hahohodia; bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai basio hemarai lou, hitolo dainai.
EZK.36.30.english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

EZK.36.27.motu: Egu lauma na lalomui ai baina atoa; egu taravatu lalodiai baina harakamui; bona egu hahemaoro herevadia ibadinadia ai baina hamanadamui.
EZK.36.27.english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

EZK.43.10.motu: Taunimanima nahma e, dubu ita-itana bona ilalo-hatana na Israel besena taudia ba hamaorolaidia, edia kara havara hemaraidia bae hemarai helaoreana.
EZK.43.10.english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

EZK.34.10.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia na inai henidiamu; egu mamoe na ediai baina gwaurai; mamoe iubudia ai baina hadokodia; mamoe ireḡudia taudia na sibodia basie heubu lou. Egu mamoe na ududia amo baina rauadia, adia aniani ai basie halaodia.
EZK.34.10.english: The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

EZK.46.23.motu: Laloma kahadia ai, hari maḡumaḡu haniosi hegegemadai ai, na nadi palakadia ere ta, bona unu ere henudiai na rahurahu.
EZK.46.23.english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

EZK.18.14.motu: A ina tau ese natuna maruanena ta bema havaraia; bena natuna ese tamana ena kara dika iboudiai bema itadia, bena bema gari, bona unu kara heḡereḡeredia ai basinema kara,
EZK.18.14.english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

EZK.3.27.motu: A baina hereva henimu negana ai, udumu do baina hahaḡaia, bena ba hereva henidia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamnu”. Kamonai e uramu tauna na baine kamonai; bona kamonai se uramu tauna na basine kamonai; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
EZK.3.27.english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

EZK.39.8.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, A itaia, ia na e maimu, vada be kaumu. Lau ese vada na herevalaia dinana bunai.
EZK.39.8.english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord Yahweh. “This is the day about which I have spoken.

EZK.13.7.motu: Ena be lau asina hereva to umui oto “Iehova ini e gwau tomamu” negadia iboudiai na o mata hanai koikoi bona o bagu haoro koikoi ani?
EZK.13.7.english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”

EZK.42.1.motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lao, laloma maḡuna lalonai, mirigini kahana ai, ela bona dubu maḡuna bona mirigini kahana rumana e vaira henidia daiutudia.
EZK.42.1.english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

EZK.12.20.motu: E noholaidiamu hanuadia na bae vahu, bona tano na tano ḡaḡaena ai baine hahelao; bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
EZK.12.20.english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

EZK.36.10.motu: Bena lau ese taunimanima baina hahutumadia latamui ai, Israel besena idoinai, oibe, idoinai; hanua bae noholaidia, bona e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia ma bae haginidia lou.
EZK.36.10.english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

EZK.16.29.motu: Emu ariara karadia o habada danu, Kaldea tanona ena hoihoi gabudia ai; a lalomu na dounu se heḡereḡere.
EZK.16.29.english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

EZK.27.32.english: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you,

EZK.1.16.motu: Unu ava-keikei ita-itadia bona ikaradia dalana na iniheto: ita-itadia na krusolito ena kiama-kiama na heto; haniosi oromadia na heheḡeḡereḡere, ikaradia dalana be e hekara ava-keikeina ta ava-keikeina ta lalonai na heto.
EZK.1.16.english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

EZK.17.23.motu: Israel ororona dorina ai baina hadoa, rigina bae tubu bona huahuana bae dobi bona sida auna herea-daena ai bainela totona; bena ia henunai mauri ḡaudia idau-idau bae noho; bona ia rigina ikerukerudia ai manu idau-idau ese edia ruma bae kara.
EZK.17.23.english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

EZK.10.16.motu: Bena kerubi e laova negadia ai na hari ava-keikei danu idia badibadidiai e laova; bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro, tano amo bae roho isi totona, negadia ai, hari ava-keikei na idia badibadidia amo asie hekei oho.
EZK.10.16.english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

EZK.21.20.motu: Dare ena mai dalana toana ba karaia; Raba, Amono taudia edia hanua, bona Iuda, bona Ierusalem, hanua mai maguna, baine mai henidia.
EZK.21.20.english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

EZK.7.18.motu: Puse dabuadia e riomu, gari ese e hahonudiamu; iboudiai vairadia e hemaraimu, iboudiai kwaradia e naudiamu.
EZK.7.18.english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

EZK.37.1.motu: Iehova imana na latagu ai, bena ia ese Iehova ena Lauma amo e abigu, e laohaigu, koura ta ai e atogu diho; una koura na turia ai e honu.
EZK.37.1.english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

EZK.31.16.motu: Mase gabuna ai baina negea dobi, guri ai e dihomu taudia ida, negana ai, lau ese bese idau-idau baina haheude-heudedia, ena moru guruna amo; bona Eden audia iboudiai, Lebanon audia namo-hereadia, ena abi-hidi audia, ranu e inumu ḡaudia iboudiai, na tauhalo bae davaria, mase gabuna ai.
EZK.31.16.english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

EZK.20.12.motu: Ina danu, egu dina helaḡadia na henidia, toa ai baela, lau bona Idia padamai ai, idia na bae diba lau Iehova ese na hahelagadiamu helaoreana.
EZK.20.12.english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

EZK.33.6.motu: A gima tauna ese dare ena mai bema itaia, to kibi basinema hiriria, bena taunimanima na basiema diba, bena dare na bema mai, idia ta bema alaia; una tau na ena dika ai baine mase, a ia rarana davana na gima tauna enai baina gwauraia.
EZK.33.6.english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

EZK.13.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.13.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.40.22.motu: Ena gaba-mauru, ena dehe bona ena pamu audia laulaudia edia bada na hari mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna ena heḡereḡeredia. Vadavada moi-kaudia auhitu amo e dae henia; bona dehena na ena laloma kahana ai.
EZK.40.22.english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

EZK.22.12.motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese dava e abimu, rara ihahebubuna totona; heatokau monidia o abimu, bona gvaurai-lagau karadia ai dekemu taudia o dadihaidia; vada o lalogu boio. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.22.12.english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.23.21.motu: Unuheto hane-ulato ai Aigupto taudia ese kememu e rosia bona ratamu e ḡiḡi negana ai lebulebu karadia o karava na oi ese o lalodia tao, mai lalo-hekisehekisemu ida.
EZK.23.21.english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.

EZK.20.15.motu: Ina danu, tano ḡaḡaena ai na gwau henidia hamata, baina henidia nato tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, tano herea-daena, tano iboudiai e hereadiamu ḡauna, lalonai basina hakaudia vareai;
EZK.20.15.english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,

EZK.16.4.motu: Emu vara na iniheto: emu vara dinana ai hudomu varona asie utua, ranu ai asie hurimu, ba ḡoevaḡoeva totona, damena amo asie dahumu, dabua amo asie tarumu.
EZK.16.4.english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

EZK.34.28.motu: Idia na bese idau-idau damudia ai basie hahelao lou, bona uda boromadia ese basie anidia lou; idia bae noho namonamo, bona tau ta ese basine hagaridia.
EZK.34.28.english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

EZK.27.31.motu: Oi daimu ai huidia e naudiamu,
EZK.27.31.english: They will make themselves bald for you,

EZK.40.10.motu: Mairiveina kahana ikoukouna ohena kahana kahana na daiutu toi toi amo; toiosi edia bada na heḡereḡere; bona ohe kahana kahana ihua-ihuadia edia bada danu heḡereḡere.
EZK.40.10.english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

EZK.43.18.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hahedua herevadia, ihaboulaina patana ena, bini. Ḡole-oho bouboudia na latanai bae hahelaḡadia bona rara bae nevarilaia totona bae haginia dinana ai,
EZK.43.18.english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

EZK.39.26.english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid

EZK.11.19.motu: Bena lalodia na baina hatamonadia, bona lauma matamatana na idia lalodiai baina atoa; lalo-auka na idia lalodia amo baina abia oho, Ialo-manada baina henidia.
EZK.11.19.english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

EZK.18.28.motu: E helalo bena ena kara kerere iboudiai amo e raka oho dainai, ia na momokani do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
EZK.18.28.english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

EZK.13.12.motu: bena haba baine heḡiḡi dobi negana ai, haida ese bae nanadaimu, baeto “O dahulaia ahuna be edeseni ai?” ani?
EZK.13.12.english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

EZK.7.23.english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

EZK.16.54.motu: bena ihahemaraimu ba huaia bona emu kara iboudiai daidiai ba hemarai, bena idia taudia ihalodia hahinemu ai baola.
EZK.16.54.english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

EZK.38.14.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba peroveta, Gog ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Una dina ai egu bese Israel e noho namonamomu negana ai, oi na ba tore isi,
EZK.38.14.english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?

EZK.24.15.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
EZK.24.15.english: Also Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.48.34.motu: Lahara kahana ai (ia danu ena lata na kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima) ikoukou toi bae mia, Gad ena ikoukou, Asere ena ikoukou, bona Napatali ena ikoukou.
EZK.48.34.english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

EZK.14.20.motu: ena be Noa bona Daniel bona Iobu na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba, a idia tatoiosi sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua, edia kara maoromaoro daidiai.
EZK.14.20.english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

EZK.7.5.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Dikadika ta murinai na dikadika ma ta! A itaia, ia na vada e maimu.
EZK.7.5.english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

EZK.15.6.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Uda audia bogaragidiai vine auna na lahi auna ai vada e halaoa heḡereḡerena ai, Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na unu baina kara henidia toma.
EZK.15.6.english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

EZK.17.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, henanadai hepuina ba gwauraia, bona hereva heḡereḡerena ta na Israel besena ba gwaurai henia.
EZK.17.2.english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

EZK.3.1.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorugu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, na dudui henimu ḡauna na bavania; ina pepa helokuna bavania, bena baola, Israel taudia ba hereva henidia.
EZK.3.1.english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

EZK.38.8.motu: Dina hoho muridiai bae haheboumui; bena laḡani gabedia ai tuari ena hahedika amo vada e hanamoa lou tanona, bese loḡora bogaragidia amo taunimanima na Israel ororodia ai vada e haboudia tanona, vada e vahu loulou tanona, na umui ese do ba tuari henia. Ena taunimanima na bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo e hakaudia lasi, bona harihari idia iboudiai na e noho namonamomu.
EZK.38.8.english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

EZK.37.6.motu: Varovaro na latamui ai baina atodia, bona hidiomui baina hadudu, bona kopi amo baina govamui; bena baina hahoho henimui, bena ba mauri. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.37.6.english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

EZK.16.45.motu: Sinamu ese adavana bona natuna e dadaraidia, bona oi na ia natuna hahinena; tadikakamu ese adavadia bona natudia e dadaraidia, bona oi na idia tadikakadia. Sinamu na Hiti hahinena; tamamu na Amoro tauna.
EZK.16.45.english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

EZK.25.3.motu: Amono taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be umui oto “Aha” egu gabu helaḡana latanai, bona Israel tanona latanai, e havahua negana ai, bona Iuda besena latanai, dauhai e hanohoa negana ai;
EZK.25.3.english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

EZK.46.14.motu: Daba ta ta amo danu ia ese flaoa boubouna baine heni; efa ta baine karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta baine heni, bona dehoro hini ta baine karoaia, karoa toi, bena karoa ta baine heni, flaoa ikuilaina; una na flaoa boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena. Ḡole-oho bouhouna, bae heni loulou ḡauna, haheḡanina bunai.
EZK.46.14.english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

EZK.20.28.motu: Badina be na gwau hamatalaia baina henidia nato tanona lalonai na hakaudia vareai negana ai, idia ese ororo latana ta eiava rauna urumona auna e itaia negadia iboudiai na edia boubou ḡaudia na unuseni ai e hahelaḡadia, bona edia herahia karadia amo danu e habadugu. Unuseni ai taunimanima lalodia ihanamodia bonadia e hadaedia, bona unuseni ai danu edia inuinu bouboudia ududia ahudia e bubu nege.
EZK.20.28.english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.

EZK.43.26.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai boubou karadia bae kara, dika na ihaboulaina patana amo iabi-ohona bona ihaḡoevana totona; unu amo ba hahelaḡaia.
EZK.43.26.english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

EZK.20.7.motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ibouboumui ai, ḡau dika-rohorohodia, matamui ese e moalelaimu ḡaudia, na ba negedia daure, Aigupto kaivakukudia ediai basio hahemiro. Lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
EZK.20.7.english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’

EZK.36.35.motu: Bena idia na baeto, Hari e vahu tanona na Ede imeana heḡereḡerena ai vada ela; bona e havahudia, e habuadia tari, e ḡiḡidia dobi hanuadia na haida ese e noholaidiamubona e maḡudiamu.
EZK.36.35.english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

EZK.21.7.motu: Bena idia ese bae hereva henimu, baeto “Dahaka dainai o ḡanaḡanamu?” negana ai, baoto “Ini hari daidiai. Baine kau negana ai, dara iboudiai bae doko, bona ima iboudiai bae manoka, lauma iboudiai bae daure, bona tui iboudiai bae manoka-manoka ranu na heto. A ilaia, ia na e maimu, bona karana na baine ḡuḡuru”. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.21.7.english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.17.12.motu: Harihari ene daḡedaḡe besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ini ḡau anidia na asi dibamui a? Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, A itaia, Babulono pavapavana na Ierusalem ela, hanua pavapavana bona lohiana verina Babulono e hakaudia mai.
EZK.17.12.english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

EZK.40.47.motu: Bena ia ese maḡu e hahetohoa: ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta bona ena lababa na kiubit sinahu-ta; kahana haniosi na heḡereḡere. Ihaboulaina patana na dubu vairanai.
EZK.40.47.english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

EZK.27.3.motu: Turo, davara raka-lasi ai e miamu hanuana, kone tanodia momo taudia edia hoihoi gabuna, ba hereva henia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:
EZK.27.3.english: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord Yahweh says:

EZK.47.15.motu: Tano hetoana binai: mirigini kahana ai, Davara Badana amo baine hematama, bena Hetelono amo bainela ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina, bena Sedad
EZK.47.15.english: “This shall be the border of the land:

EZK.38.13.motu: Sieba bona Dedan, bona Tarasisi ena hoihoi taudia bona hanuana iboudiai, ese bae nanadaimu, baeto, Oi na kohu idadidia totona vada oma a? Emu hutuma vada o haheboudia, ba dadi kohudia bae hua lao, silver bona gold bae huadia lao bona boromakau bona kohu bae laohaidia, ḡau momo herea bae dadi totona a?
EZK.38.13.english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’

EZK.45.22.motu: Una dina ai, hanua pavapavana ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta baine heni, dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡauna, ia bona tano taudia iboudiai daidiai.
EZK.45.22.english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

EZK.47.1.motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lou, dubu iduarana ai; bena na itaia, ranu na dubu raka-vareaina henuna amo e lasiva, mairiveina kahana ai, (badina be dubu na mairiveina kahana e vaira henia); bona dubu raka-vareaina diho kahana henuna amo danu ranu e lasiva, ihaboulaina patana diho kahana ai.
EZK.47.1.english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

EZK.7.6.motu: Dokona vada e kau, dokona korikori vada e kau; anina na emu ai vada hedinarai. A itaia, ia na e maimu!
EZK.7.6.english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

EZK.44.27.motu: A gabu helaḡana, laloma maḡuna ai, lalonai baine raka vareai, gabu helaḡana ai kara helaḡadia baine kara totona, una dina ai ia ese ena kara dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡauna na baine hahelaḡaia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.44.27.english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.23.5.motu: Ohola na lau adavagu negana ai, ia ese ariara karadia e karava; e ura heniava taudia, Asuria taudia, na e mata dika henidiava.
EZK.23.5.english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

EZK.45.20.motu: Hua dinana ihahituna ai danu unu ba kara toma, kara-rea eiava mata-lahui dainai vada e kara dika tauna bagunai; unu amo dubu ba haḡoevaia.
EZK.45.20.english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

EZK.48.32.motu: Laurabada kahana ai (ia danu ena lata na kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima), ikoukou toi bae mia, Iosef ena ikoukou, Beniamina ena ikoukou, bona Dan ena ikoukou.
EZK.48.32.english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

EZK.23.7.motu: Ia ese e kara lebulebu henidia; iboudiai na Asuria taudia ḡoeva-daedia; bona e mata dika henidia taudia iboudiai edia kaivakuku iboudiai ediai e hahemiro.
EZK.23.7.english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.

EZK.32.10.motu: Bese momo baina hagaridia taku oi bagumu ai, bona edia pavapava bae heude-heude oi daimu ai, egu dare baina hahelado henidia negana ai; bae heude-heude loulou, ta ta ena mauri ena mauri bagudiai, emu moru dinana ai.
EZK.32.10.english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you,

EZK.26.9.motu: Ena vaḡoma amo maḡumu baine hamakohidia, bona ena ira amo kohoromu baine hagaridia.
EZK.26.9.english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

EZK.20.49.motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, idia ese e herevalaigumu, e tomu “Ia na sivarai heḡereḡeredia igwauraidia tauna ani?”
EZK.20.49.english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”

EZK.37.21.motu: ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Israel taudia na bogaragidiai vada ela besedia edia amo ma baina abidia, kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, edia tano korikori lalonai baina hakaudia vareai.
EZK.37.21.english: Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

EZK.40.16.motu: Ikoukou heḡeḡemadai ai na gaba-mauru haida; ihua-ihua padadia na hahaga murimuri kahadia ai bona i'iora laloma kahadia at; bona dehe danu mai gaba-mauruna laloma kahana hegegemadai ai. Ihua-ihua ai be pamu audia laulaudia.
EZK.40.16.english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

EZK.4.17.motu: Unu baina kara toma, bena aniani ai bona ranu ai bae dabu, bae heroha heheni mai kudou-hetahadia ida, bona edia dika davadia daidiai taudia bae varoda.
EZK.4.17.english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

EZK.45.1.motu: Tano ba haria negana ai, tano kahana ba gwauraia hidi Iehova ena, kaha helaḡana ai bainela. Ena lata na kiubit gerebu rua daha ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu rua; ia na baine helaḡa ela bona hetoana idoinai.
EZK.45.1.english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

EZK.16.60.motu: ḡau tamona, egu gwauhamata, eregabemu negana ai oi ida ta hegwau hamata heheni ḡauna, baina laloa toa, bona oi ida mia-hanaihanai gwauhamatana ta baita haginia tutuka-tutuka.
EZK.16.60.english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

EZK.5.5.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem binai, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai vada na atoa, tano idau-idau ese e ḡeḡea daemu.
EZK.5.5.english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

EZK.14.13.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, tano ta ese ena hebeatai karadia amo baine kara dika henigu, bena lau ese imagu na ia ihadikana totona baina toia roro bona ena mauri anianina baina abia oho, bona doe na ia latanai baina siaia, bona taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ia lalonai baina hamasedia, negana ai,
EZK.14.13.english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

EZK.48.10.motu: Tano helaḡana inogodia bini: hahelaḡa taudia edia inogo ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima murigini kahana ai, ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta lahara kahana ai bona kiubit gerebu-ta laurabada kahana ai, bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima diho kahana ai. Iehova en: gabu helaḡana na ia bogaraginai.
EZK.48.10.english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

EZK.8.12.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel tau-badadia na dibura ai ede e kara tomamu, ta ta ena laulau daiutuna ena laulau daiutuna lalodiai, vada o itaia a? Badina be idia na e tomu “Iehova ese se itadamu; Iehova ese tano vada e rakatania”.
EZK.8.12.english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’”

EZK.20.40.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Badina be egu ororo helaḡana ai, Israel ororona dorina ai, unuseni ai Israel besena idoinai, ena taunimanima iboudiai, ese lau isiaigu bae lao heni una tano ai. Unuseni ai baina abidia dae; unuseni ai emui harihari ḡaudia bona emui herahia ḡaudia herea-daedia na emui ai baina gwaurai, bona emui boubou ḡaudia helaḡadia danu.
EZK.20.40.english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

EZK.31.10.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be ia na e tubu daga dae ela bona dorina na ori lalodiai, bona lalona ese ena lata e heaḡilaia,
EZK.31.10.english: “Therefore thus said the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

EZK.48.27.motu: Sebulun ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Gad ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.27.english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

EZK.30.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a peroveta, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ini e gwau tomamu:
EZK.30.2.english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:

EZK.34.11.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau sibogu ese egu mamoe baina tahudia ela bona baina davaridia.
EZK.34.11.english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

EZK.19.5.motu: Leona hahinena e diba vada e baia,
EZK.19.5.english: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited,

EZK.6.14.motu: Lau ese imagu baina toia roro, idia ihadikadia totona, tano baina habuaia tari bona baina havahua, edia noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai, tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Ribla. Bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.6.14.english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

EZK.9.2.motu: Bena na itaia, tatau tauratoi na atai ikoukouna, mirigini kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna, kahana amo ema, ta ta mai edia ala-ala ḡaudia imadia ai. Ma tau ta danu idia ida ema; ia na dabua aukana e hahedokilaia, toretore ḡaudia vainana danu e daharaia. Bena idia na e raka vareai, ihaboulaina patana, auri labora-labora ḡauna, badibadinai e gini.
EZK.9.2.english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

EZK.46.20.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Gabuna binai hahelaḡa taudia ese kerere bona kara dika iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia na bae nadudia, bona flaoa bouboudia ḡaudia na bae gabudia; murimuri kahana maḡuna ai basie lasilaidia, taunimanima na helaḡa siahuna bae henidia hanai na garina.
EZK.46.20.english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

EZK.10.9.motu: Bena na roha lao, ava-keikei hani na itadia unu kerubi badibadidiai; ava-keikei ta ta kerubi ta ta badibadidiai. Hari ava-keikei ita-itadia na krusolito nadidia kiama-hamadia na heheto.
EZK.10.9.english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

EZK.28.6.motu: Una dainai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.23.49.motu: Bena emui lebulebu davana do bavabia, bona emui kara dika ai kaivakuku o toma henidia diho na davadia bavabi; bena vada ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
EZK.23.49.english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.33.12.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese emu bese taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Kara maoromaoro tauna ena kara maoromaoro ese basine hamauria, baine kerere negana ai; bona kara dika tauna ena kara dika ese basine haketoa, ena kara dika amo baine raka siri negana ai. Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro dainai basine mauri, baine kara dika negana ai.
EZK.33.12.english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

EZK.10.12.motu: Isedia auridia kuborodia bona ito'o-tao auridia bona ava-keikei na mata ai e honu, kerubi hahaniosi ava-keikeidia bunu.
EZK.10.12.english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

EZK.47.18.motu: Laurabada kahana ai, hetoa na Hasara-enono amo baine hematama, Haurana bona Damasko padadia amo bainela; bena Ioridane sinavaina amo bainela, Gilead bona Israel tanodia padadia amo, ela bona laurabada kahana davarana, ela bona Tamara. Laurabada kahana hetoana bunai.
EZK.47.18.english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

EZK.5.1.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, dare ganona ta bavabia, kwaramu inauna ḡauna ai ba halaoa, kwaramu ba naua bona aukimu huina bavabia; bena metau ihahetohona ḡauna bavabia, hui ba karoa, karoa toi.
EZK.5.1.english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

EZK.34.25.motu: Lau idia ida baia herohemaino; uda boromadia na tano amo baina luludia lasi, bena tano ḡaḡaena ai bae noho namonamo bona uda ai bae mahuta.
EZK.34.25.english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

EZK.35.9.motu: Baina habuamu tari hanaihanai, bona emu hanua na haida ese basie noholaidia. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.35.9.english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.19.13.motu: Harihari ia na tano ḡaḡaena ai vada e hehado hanai,
EZK.19.13.english: Now it is planted in the wilderness,

EZK.37.9.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, laḡa ba peroveta henia, laḡa ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Laḡa e, lai haniosi kahadia amo baoma, ini vada e aladia mase taudia na ba hahoho henidia, bena bae mauri.
EZK.37.9.english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

EZK.39.3.motu: bena emu peva na imamu laurina amo baina pataia oho, bona emu diba na imamu idibana amo baina hamorudia.
EZK.39.3.english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
