EZK.18.16.motu: tau ta basinema kara dika henia, abitorehai toana basinema abia, kohu basinema dadi, a hitolo taudia bema ubudia bona asi dabuadia taudia bema hadabualaidia,

EZK.16.31.motu: hanua ariaradia iboudiai dokodia ai emu kalaga o haginidia, bona ruma ariaradia iboudiai lalodiai emu pata helaḡadia o kara. Ḡau tamona oi na dia ariara hahinena heḡereḡerena, badina be henitaomu o dadaraiamu.
EZK.16.31.english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

EZK.16.47.motu: Ḡau tamona, oi lalomu na se heḡereḡere idia edia dala ai ba raka, eiava idia edia kara dika-rohorohodia heḡereḡeredia ai ba kara; asi vanahana oiemu kara mirodia ese idia edia kara mirodia e hereadia, emu dala iboudiai lalodiai.
EZK.16.47.english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

EZK.24.17.motu: Ba hahodi, to basio ḡanaḡana; mase taina basio tai. Dabua na kwaramu ba kumilaia, bona tamaka na aemu ai ba kara; udumu basio ḡovaia, bona basio ani helaḡa.
EZK.24.17.english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

EZK.37.2.motu: Bena bogaragidiai e hakaugu eva-eva; na itadia, idia na momo herea una koura ai, bona idia na kakakoro.
EZK.37.2.english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

EZK.42.2.motu: Hari mirigini kahana rumana ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta bona ena lalaba na kiubit imahui.
EZK.42.2.english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

EZK.33.15.motu: bema kara dika tauna ese gwauhamata davana ma bema haloua bona vada e dadi ḡaudia bema heni lou, bona mauri haheganidia ai bema raka bona basinema kara havara, bena ia na do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
EZK.33.15.english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

EZK.41.13.motu: Bena ia ese dubu e hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta; bona maḡu mai rumana ida edia lata na kiubit sinahu-ta;
EZK.41.13.english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

EZK.17.21.motu: Ena abi-hidi tuari taudia na dare ai bae mase, bona roho-mauri taudia na lai kahadia iboudiai bae pere rohoroho; bena ba diba, lau Iehova vada na hereva.
EZK.17.21.english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’

EZK.27.17.motu: Iuda bona Israel tanona taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva; idia ese uit, olive, suke huahuadia matamatadia, bada-ranuna, dehoro bona muramura mai bonana e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.17.english: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

EZK.16.52.motu: Oi danu ihahemaraimu na ba huaia, badina be tadikakamu ihahemaorohenidia metauna vada o haragaia; badina be emu kara dika ai emu kara dika-rohorohodia ese idia edia e hereadia dainai, idia na taidia mamaoro, a oi na dika vaitani. Taunabunai, oi danu ba hemarai, ihahemaraimu ba huaia, badina be tadikakamu oromadia na kara maoromaoro hahinedia oromadia heḡereḡeredia ai vada o halaodia.
EZK.16.52.english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

EZK.34.13.motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaudia lasi, bona tano idau-idau lalodia amo baina gogodia, edia tano korikori lalonai baina hakaudia vareai. Bena Israel ororodia ai baina ubudia, ranu-lohilohi gabudia badibadidiai, bona taunimanima ese tano ai e noholaimu gabudia iboudiai lalodiai danu.
EZK.34.13.english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

EZK.24.16.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, mata-kunumai tamona ai oi matamu ihamoalena baina abia oho, ḡau tamona lalomu basine hisihisi bona basio tai, bona iruru-matamu basie diho.
EZK.24.16.english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

EZK.8.11.motu: Unu laulau vairadiai Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahui e gini, bona Iaasania Safana na bogaragidiai e gini. Idia ta ta mai edia gida keberedia imadia ai, bona muramura mai bonana, e gabua ḡauna, kwalahuna e daeva, ori na heto.
EZK.8.11.english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

EZK.46.18.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena orea taudia ahudia taina basine abia diba, ahudia amo basine luludia lasi; ia ese natuna ahudia baine henidia, ia sibona ahuna amo, taunabunai egu orea taudia ta ena ḡau basine heabi oho.
EZK.46.18.english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

EZK.21.12.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a tai, a tai lolololo. Badina be ia na egu bese ihadikana bona Israel lohiadia iboudiai ihadikadia ḡauna; idia na egu bese taudia ida vada e heni, dare ena. Taunabunai, mamumu ba pata.
EZK.21.12.english: Cry and wail, son of man;

EZK.48.28.motu: Gad ena tano ohena ai, diho kahana ai, hetoa na Tamara amo bainela, ela bona Meribatakade ranu gabudia bena Aigupto Dokana amo bainela, ela bona Davara Badana.
EZK.48.28.english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

EZK.26.15.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ese Turo na ini e hereva henia tomamu: Ba moru negana ai na bae bero taudia bae ganaḡana, bona ala-ala na baine bada bogaragimu ai; una negana ai kone tanodia na basie heude-heude a?
EZK.26.15.english: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

EZK.33.28.motu: Tano na baina havahua, tano ḡaḡaena ai bainela; ena siahu, e heaḡilaiamu ḡauna, na baine ore; Israel ororodia bae ḡaḡae vaitani dainai ta ese basine rakadia hanai.
EZK.33.28.english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

EZK.37.8.motu: Na itadia negana ai, idia na mai varovarodia, bona hidio ese e hadududia ahu, bona kopi ese e ḡovadia, a dounu asi laḡadia.
EZK.37.8.english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

EZK.42.14.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia na gabu helaḡana ai bae raka vareai negadia ai, idia na unu amo basie raka lasi murimuri kahana maḡuna ai ela bona kara helaḡadia ikaradia totona e hahedokilai dabuadia na unuseni ai bae dokidia oho bona bae atodia guna, badina be unu dabua na hehelaga. Idia ese dabua idaudia bae dokilaidia guna, bena hanua taudia edia gabu bae raka henia kahi.
EZK.42.14.english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

EZK.14.23.motu: Idia ese taumu bae haloa, edia dala bona edia kara ba ita negana ai; bona ba diba Ierusalem lalonai na kara karadia iboudiai na dia asi badina asina karadia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.14.23.english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.17.20.motu: Egu huo baina otoa, ia iabina, bona egu idoa ai baina idoaia; bena Babulono baina laohaia, unuseni ai baina hahemaoro henia, ena koikoi karadia egu ai e kara na baina hahemaorolai.
EZK.17.20.english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

EZK.26.3.motu: una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Turo e, a itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu. Bese momo baina mailaidia oi ihadikamu, davara ese hurehurena na e mailaidiamu na heto.
EZK.26.3.english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

EZK.46.13.motu: Dina ta ta amo ia ese mamoe natuna ta, laḡani tamona ḡauna asi bebeka-bebekana, baine heni, ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena; daba daba iboudiai ia ese baine heni.
EZK.46.13.english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

EZK.37.25.motu: Senemui ese e noholaia tanona, egu hesiai tauna Iakob na henia tanona, lalonai bae noho; idia bona natudia bona garadia na unuseni ai bae noho, ela bona hanaihanai; bona egu hesiai tauna David ese baine pavapavadia hanaihanai.
EZK.37.25.english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

EZK.22.26.motu: Ena hahelaḡa taudia ese egu taravatu vada e tataia utu, bona egu ḡau helaḡadia vada e hamirodia; ḡau helaḡadia bona ḡau asi helaḡadia asie ha-idaudia, bona ḡau mirodia bona ḡau ḡoevaḡoevadia vada e hatamonadia; bona egu dina helaḡadia asie badinadia; unu amo idia ese lau ladagu vada e hamiroa.
EZK.22.26.english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.

EZK.1.8.motu: Hanidia henudiai, kahadia haniosi ai, imadia na mimia, taunimanima imadia na heheto. Hahaniosi vairadia bona anidia na iniheto:
EZK.1.8.english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

EZK.16.7.motu: tano paka avana na heto ba tubu. Bena o bada oho bada oho, taumu e lata, hane-ulato ai ola; ratamu e hekara, huimu e lata; ḡau tamona gagaemu ai o nohova, asi dabuamu.
EZK.16.7.english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

EZK.9.6.motu: iahu bavaladia mase, bona uhau, ulato, memero, kekeni, bona hahine danu; a baguna mai toana tauna ta basio daua toho. Egu gabu helaḡana amo ba matamaia. Taunabunai idia ese unu hanua tau-badadia dubu vairanai nohodia ediai e matamaia.
EZK.9.6.english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.”

EZK.10.21.motu: Idia ta ta vairadia na hani hani amo, bona hanidia danu na hani hani amo, bona hanidia henudiai na ḡau haida, ita-itadia na taunimanima imadia hetomadia.
EZK.10.21.english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

EZK.33.13.motu: Ena be kara maoromaoro tauna na hamaoroamu ia na do baine mauri, to ena kara maoromaoro bema abidadama henia bena bema kara havara, bena ena kara maoromaorodia ta basine helalo tao, a ia na ena kara havara ai baine mase.
EZK.33.13.english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

EZK.30.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.30.1.english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

EZK.36.24.motu: Badina be bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina abimui, bona tano iboudiai lalodia amo baina gogomui, bena emui tano korikori ai baina hakamui vareai.
EZK.36.24.english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

EZK.25.13.motu: una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese imagu na baina toia roro, Edom ihadikana, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia na iena amo baina negedia daure. Baina havahua; bena Teman amo ela bona Dedan idia na dare ai bae mase.
EZK.25.13.english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

EZK.41.8.motu: Na itaia danu, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai na patapata ta. Hari ohe kahana kahana daiutudia badidia na e hahetohodia, idia na hahetoho sirihona idoi ta, kiubit badadia tauratoi heḡereḡerena.
EZK.41.8.english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

EZK.24.19.motu: Bena taunimanima ese e nanadaigu, eto, Ini ḡau anidia emai ai, bona ini o kara karadia anidia, basio hamaoromai a?
EZK.24.19.english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

EZK.47.3.motu: Mairiveina kahana ma ala; ia na mai ena hahetoho varona imana ai, bena kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo e hakaugu hanai; aemai ganaganadia ai e raro.
EZK.47.3.english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

EZK.45.9.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel pavapavadia e, vadaeni! Daḡedaḡe bona hahehisi karadia ba negedia; hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona kara maoromaoro ba kara; egu orea taudia ilulu-lasidia ba hadokoa. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.45.9.english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.30.12.motu: Lau ese Nilo sinavaina baina hakororoa,
EZK.30.12.english: I will make the rivers dry,

EZK.31.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, mai ena hutuma ida, ba hamaorodia, baoto:
EZK.31.2.english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude:

EZK.24.1.motu: Laḡani ihataurahani-tana huana ihagwautana dinana ihagwautana lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.24.1.english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.39.10.motu: taunabunai idia ese au na tano paka ai basie abi eiava uda ai basie utu, badina be edia lahi na unu tuari ḡaudia amo bae raku; edia ḡau e dadi taudia ediai ḡau ma bae dadi, bona edia kohu e abi oho taudia ediai kohu ma bae abi oho. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.39.10.english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.16.35.motu: Taunabunai, ariara hahinemu e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.

EZK.3.16.motu: Dina hitu e ore ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.3.16.english: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.23.46.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tuari oreana ba hakaua mai, gari ihavarana ḡauna ai bona dadidadi ḡauna ai ba halaodia.
EZK.23.46.english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.

EZK.21.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.21.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.20.16.motu: badina be egu hahedua herevadia e dadaraidia, bona egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, bona egu dina helaḡadia e hamirodia; badina be lalodia ese edia kaivakuku e lalo tao.
EZK.20.16.english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

EZK.48.31.motu: ikoukou toi bae mia, Ruben ena ikoukou, Iuda ena ikoukou, bona Levi ena ikoukou. Hanua ikoukoudia na Israel iduhudia ladadia bae nemaidia.
EZK.48.31.english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

EZK.16.13.motu: Gold bona silver amo unu na haheralaimu toma; emu dabua na dabua aukadia ḡoeva-daedia bona dabua manoka-manokadia bona dabua mai heraheradia; amu aniani na flaoa namo-hereana bona bada-ranuna bona dehoro. Hairaimu e bada e laova, ela bona oromamu na pavapava hahinena na heto.
EZK.16.13.english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

EZK.14.1.motu: A Bena Israel tau-badadia haida na dekegu ema, lau vairagu ai e helai.
EZK.14.1.english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

EZK.12.28.motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hereva iboudiai na ta basine halahe, a na gwauraiamu herevana anina do baine vara. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.12.28.english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

EZK.28.11.motu: Iehova ena hereva ma ta egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.28.11.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.40.1.motu: Dauhai e hanohomai laḡanina iharuahui-imana matamana ai, hua dinana ihagwautana ai, hanua badana e hadarerea murinai laḡani gwauta-hani vada e lao bubuni ai, una dina lalonai Iehova imana na vada latagu ai;
EZK.40.1.english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

EZK.33.10.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Umui vada oto “Emai kerere bona emai kara dika na latamai ai, bena unu daidiai taumai e varoda-varodamu; ede baia mauri toma?”
EZK.33.10.english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

EZK.31.12.motu: Idau taudia, hahegari herea besena, ese baine utua, bena baine rakatania. Ia rigina na ororo ai bona koura iboudiai lalodiai bae moru; rigina haida na kwaidudia ai bae mia, tano ena koupa iboudiai lalodiai; tanobada besedia iboudiai na ia ikerukeruna amo bae raka lasi, bae rakatania.
EZK.31.12.english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

EZK.11.8.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Dare garina vada o gari; bena lau ese dare na latamui ai baine mailaia.
EZK.11.8.english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.14.19.motu: Eiava dai-hanai gorerena na una tano latanai bama siaia, bona egu badu ḡaraḡara na ia latanai bama bubua, rara ihahebubuna ai, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ihamasedia totona, negana ai,
EZK.14.19.english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

EZK.11.22.motu: Bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro, mai ava-keikeidia idia badibadidiai, bona Israel Diravana hairaina na idia daediai.
EZK.11.22.english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

EZK.15.3.motu: Ḡau ta ikaralaina auna na iena amo e abiamu a? Iena amo ikoko ta e karaiamu bena una ikoko ai ḡau ta e taua daemu a?
EZK.15.3.english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

EZK.36.18.motu: Taunabunai egu badu na latadiai na bubua, idia ese rara na tano ai vada e hahebubua bona tano na kaivakuku amo e hamiroa davana.
EZK.36.18.english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

EZK.41.7.motu: Hari ohe kahana kahanil daiutudia lababadia na e bada e laova, henu erena amo ela bona atai erena, to-tao ḡaudia na henu erena amo ela bona atai erena e bada e laova heḡereḡerena, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai. Dubu ohena ai vadavada ta e daeva, unu amo taunimanima na henu erena amo e dara daeva ela bona bogaragi erena, bona bogaragi erena amo e dara daeva ela bona atai erena.
EZK.41.7.english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

EZK.39.1.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Gog latanai ba peroveta, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Gog e, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana, lau ese na inai henimumu;
EZK.39.1.english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

EZK.45.6.motu: Vada o gwauraia hidi, kaha helaḡana ai o halaoa, tanona badibadinai, hanua tanona ba duanaia, ena lababa na kiubit daha-ima bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima; ia na Israel besena idoinai ese baine ḡaunaia.
EZK.45.6.english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

EZK.12.22.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, emui hereva lada-isina be dahaka? Israel tanona o herevalaiamu, o tomu “Nega na e daudaumu bona mata-hanai iboudiai anidia asie varamu”, ani?
EZK.12.22.english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

EZK.32.3.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.45.11.motu: Efa bona bata anidia bae heḡereḡere; bata gwauta na homere ta heḡereḡerena, bona efa gwauta na homere ta heḡereḡerena. Hahetoho ḡaudia iboudiai ibadidia na homere.
EZK.45.11.english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

EZK.18.7.motu: ta na basinema hahisia, a abitorehai tauna ena abitorehai toana bema henia lou; kohu basinema dadi; hitolo taudia bema ubudia bona asi dabuadia taudia bema hadabualaidia;

EZK.22.24.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Oi na asie haḡoevaia tanona, eiava latanai badu dinana ai medu se diho tanona.
EZK.22.24.english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’

EZK.12.6.motu: Idia vairadiai laolao kohuna na bavabia isi paḡamu ai, bena dibura ai ba huaia lasi; vairamu ba ḡovaia, tano basio itaia helaoreana; badina be lau ese toa ta ai vada na halaomu, Israel besena enai.
EZK.12.6.english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

EZK.3.11.motu: Aola, dauhai e hanohodia taudia, emu bese taudia, dekediai, bena ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”; bena bae kamonai eiava kamonai basie ura.
EZK.3.11.english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

EZK.32.7.motu: Baina habuamu tari negana ai guba baina ḡovaia ahu,
EZK.32.7.english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens

EZK.16.23.motu: Bena emu kara dika iboudiai muridiai, (Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Madi, ihabaimu!),
EZK.16.23.english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—

EZK.27.13.motu: Iavan bona Tubal bona Mesek taudia na emui ai e hoihoiva taunimanima bona auri labora-labora ḡaudia na e henimui, emui hoihoi ḡaudia davadia.
EZK.27.13.english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

EZK.40.34.motu: Ia dehena ese murimuri kahana maḡuna e vaira henia. Ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia, ta ohena ta ai, ma ta ohena ta ai. Vadavada moi-kaudia taurahani amo e dae henia.
EZK.40.34.english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

EZK.28.26.motu: Una tano lalonai bae noho namonamo; ruma bae haginidia bona vine imeadia bae hado. Lau ese dekedia taudia, vada e dadaraidia taudia, iboudiai baina hahemaoro henidia negana ai, idia na bae noho namonamo. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova, edia Dirava.
EZK.28.26.english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”

EZK.25.6.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be imamui vada o tutu bona aemui vada o pana, bona emui badu lalonai Israel tanona ihadikana o moalelaia,
EZK.25.6.english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

EZK.17.8.motu: ma e hadoa hanai, tano namona ai, ranu momo gabuna ai, gavena bae tubu bona hu huana bae dobi bona vine auna herea-daena ai bainela totona.
EZK.17.8.english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

EZK.45.13.motu: Boubou ḡaudia na ini ba heni toma: uit homere ta lalona amo efa ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta ba heni; bona bali homere ta lalona amo efa ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta ba heni;
EZK.45.13.english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

EZK.8.1.motu: Laḡani ihatauratoina huana ihatauratoina dinana iha-imana lalonai, lau ese egu ruma ai na helaiva; bena Iuda tau-badadia na lau vairagu ai e helaiva ai na Ḡaubada Iehova ese imana na lau latagu ai e atoa kau.
EZK.8.1.english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

EZK.25.10.motu: Una tano, Amono taudia ida, na mairiveina kahana taudia baina henidia, edia ai bae halaoa, bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai ta ese basine laloa tao lou;
EZK.25.10.english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

EZK.47.7.motu: Lougu ai, au momo herea na itadia sinavai isena kahana kahana ai.
EZK.47.7.english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

EZK.17.4.motu: Ia ese dorina rigirigina e bitua kwaidu, hoihoi tanona e laohaia, hoihoi taudia edia hanua lalonai e hadoa.
EZK.17.4.english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

EZK.40.24.motu: Bena ia ese diho kahana ma e hakaugu lao; bena ikoukou ma ta na itaia diho kahana ai. Ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe e hahetohodia; edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
EZK.40.24.english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

EZK.32.30.motu: Mirigini kahana lohiadia iboudiai na unuseni ai, bona Sidono taudia iboudiai danu. Idia na e aladia mase taudia ida nda e hemarai heboumu, edia goada ese e havaraia hahegarina idoinai dainai. Idia na do se haheperitome ai e hekuremu, dare ai e mase taudia ida; idia na guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu.
EZK.32.30.english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

EZK.28.19.motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e dibamu taudia iboudiai na
EZK.28.19.english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you.

EZK.44.16.motu: Idia danu egu gabu helaḡana lalonai bae raka vareai, bona egu pata bae raka henia kahi, isiaigu bae lao heni bona egu hahedua bae badinadia totona.
EZK.44.16.english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

EZK.22.7.motu: Oi lalomu ai tama bona sina na e hahemataidiamu; oi bogaragimu ai noho hedoa tauna na gwaurai-lagau karadia amo e hahisiamu; oi lalomu ai ihareha bona vabu e kara dika henidiamu.
EZK.22.7.english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.

EZK.39.24.motu: Edia miro bona edia kerere heḡereḡeredia ai na kara henidia, bona vairagu na edia amo na hunia.
EZK.39.24.english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

EZK.31.5.motu: Taunabunai ia na e tubu daga dae,
EZK.31.5.english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field;

EZK.14.2.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.14.2.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.41.22.motu: ita-itana na pata helaḡana, au amo e karaia ḡauna; harana latana na kiubit toi, bona latana bona lababana na kiubit rua. Daigunina bona badina bona habahabana na au amo e kara. Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na Iehova vairanai e miamu patana.
EZK.41.22.english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”

EZK.5.12.motu: Emui orea lalona amo kaha ta be dai-hanai gorerena amo bae mase bona doe amo bae ore bogaragimui ai; ma kaha ta na dare amo bae mase emui orea hegegemadai ai; ma kaha ihatoina na lau ese lai kahadia iboudiai baina ḡiḡidia rohoroho; bona idia muridiai dare na pauana amo baina veria lasi.
EZK.5.12.english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

EZK.20.29.motu: (Na hamaorodia, nato, Atai gabuna o lao heniamu be edena? Taunabunai, ia ladana e hatoamu Bama, ema bona ina dina.)
EZK.20.29.english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’

EZK.24.2.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ina dina, hari ina dina, ladana ba torea; Babulono pavapavana ese Ierusalem vada e koua heḡeḡe, hari ina dina ai.
EZK.24.2.english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

EZK.32.8.motu: Guba diaridia iboudiai na oi daemu ai baina hadiburadia,
EZK.32.8.english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you,

EZK.32.18.motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Aigupto ena orea taudia hutuma taidia ba tai, bona ba siaidia diho, idia bona bese herea-daedia hahinedia danu, mase gabuna ai bae diho, guri ai vada e diho taudia dekediai.
EZK.32.18.english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

EZK.43.16.motu: Hari rahurahu ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, lalana kiubit gwauta-rua bona lababana danu kiubit gwauta-rua.
EZK.43.16.english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

EZK.39.21.motu: Lau hairaigu na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hahedinaraia; bena bese iboudiai ese egu hahemaoro karana bona imagu, latadiai na atoa ḡauna, bae itadia.
EZK.39.21.english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.

EZK.6.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto
EZK.6.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.7.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.7.1.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.10.15.motu: Hari kerubi na e dae ela; idia na unu mauri ḡaudia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itadia ḡaudia.
EZK.10.15.english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

EZK.42.18.motu: Ma kahana ela, diho kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
EZK.42.18.english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

EZK.11.18.motu: Bena unu baela negana ai, idia ese ḡau dika-hereadia iboudiai bona ena kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai na iena amo bae abidia oho.
EZK.11.18.english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

EZK.12.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
EZK.12.1.english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

EZK.7.15.motu: Murimuri ai na dare; laloma ai na dai-hanai gorerena bona doe. Tano paka ai e nohomu tauna na dare ai e masemu; hanua ai e nohomu tauna na doe bona dai-hanai gorerena ese e hamaseamu.
EZK.7.15.english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

EZK.36.31.motu: Bena emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dia nanamo ba lalodia tao, bena sibomui ba hedadarai, emui kara havara bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia daidiai.
EZK.36.31.english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

EZK.19.14.motu: Lahi na ia badina amo vada e dae,
EZK.19.14.english: Fire has gone out of its branches.

EZK.42.19.motu: Ma kahana ela, lahara kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
EZK.42.19.english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

EZK.42.20.motu: Ia ese kaha haniosi e hahetohodia. Magu ta ese e ḡegea ahu, ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit sinahu-ima; una maḡu ese tano helaḡana bona tano uhuḡaina e kaharuadiava.
EZK.42.20.english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

EZK.40.6.motu: Bena mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna idae-lao-henina ai, vadavadana amo e dae; bena ikoukou raka-vareaina e hahetohoa, lababana na hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
EZK.40.6.english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

EZK.12.7.motu: Bena e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena ai na karaia. Dina ai egu laolao kohuna na lasilaia, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena kohu na heto; bona adorahi ai lau sibogu imagu amo ruma habana na hamaurua, dibura ai na rau lasi, egu laolao kohuna na paḡagu ai na huaia lao, idia vairadiai.
EZK.12.7.english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

EZK.46.12.motu: tlanua pavapavana ese ena ura-kwalimu ai boubou ḡauna bema heni, ḡole-oho boubouna eiava maino bouboudia, ena ura-kwalimu ḡauna Iehova ena; bena baine heni negana ai mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ikoukouna na bae kehoa iena. Bena ia ese ena ḡole-oho boubouna eiava ena maino bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, dina helaḡa ai heḡereḡerena. Bena ia na baine raka lasi; bena baine raka lasi murinai ikoukou na bae koua.
EZK.46.12.english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to Yahweh, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

EZK.40.30.motu: Dehe haida ma e ḡegea dae, latadia na kiubit ruahui-ima bona lababadia na kiubit ima.
EZK.40.30.english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

EZK.18.9.motu: egu taravatu daladia ai bema raka bona egu hahedua herevadia bema badinadia ḡoevaḡoeva: una tau na kara maoromaoro tauna; momokani ia na do baine mauri. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.

EZK.20.26.motu: bona sibodia edia herahia ḡaudia amo na hamirodia; badina be na koidia, natudia roboadia iboudiai na ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai bae halaodia, baina hagaridia totona. Unu na kara toma, idia na bae diba lau na Iehova helaoreana.
EZK.20.26.english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahweh.”’

EZK.32.31.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Farao ese baine itadia negana ai, ia na sibona tauhalo baine davaria, ena orea taudia hutuma daidiai; oibe, Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai, dare ai e mase taudia, daidiai.
EZK.32.31.english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.2.9.motu: Bena na roha lao, ima ta na itaia, e hetoi roro henigu, bona lalonai na pepa mai revarevana helokuna ta.
EZK.2.9.english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

EZK.30.13.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

EZK.13.15.motu: Egu badu ḡaraḡara na unu baina bubua ore toma, haba latanai, bona ahu amo e dahua taudia latadiai; bena baina hamaoromu, bainato, Haba na lasihia, ahu amo e dahua taudia danu lasihidia;
EZK.13.15.english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

EZK.33.30.motu: A, taunimanima natuna e, oiemu bese taudia ese ruma habadia badibadidiai bona ruma iduaradia ai oi e hereva heboulaimumu, e hereva hehenimu, ta ta ese tadikakana tadikakana e hamaorodiamu, e tomu, Aoma, Iehova ena amo e maimu herevana be dahaka vada ba kamonai.
EZK.33.30.english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.’

EZK.13.14.motu: Umui ese ahu amo o dahua habana na lau ese baina ḡiḡia dobi tano ai, bena ia badina bae hedinarai. Baine heḡiḡi dobi negana ai, umui ese ia bogaraginai ba mase; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.13.14.english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.42.8.motu: Badina be murimuri kahana maḡuna daiutudia edia lata na kiubit imahui, a dubu e vaira heniava daiutudia edia lata na kiubit sinahu-ta.
EZK.42.8.english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

EZK.18.15.motu: ororo ai basinema aniani, eiava Israel besena kaivakukudia basinema gaga dae henidia, dekena tauna adavana basinema kara miro henia,
EZK.18.15.english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains,

EZK.6.8.motu: A umui haida na maurimui ai baina rakatanimui. Dare amo bae roho mauri taudia haida na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai bae noho, bona tano idau-idau ai ba karoho rohoroho negana ai,
EZK.6.8.english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

EZK.12.3.motu: badina be idia na gwauedeede besena. Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena laolao kohuna heḡereḡerena ai bavabia heḡaeḡae, bena dina ai dauhai bae hanohoa tauna heḡereḡerena ai ba raka lasi idia vairadiai; dauhai bae hanohoa launa na heto emu gabu amo baola, ela bona ma gabu ta, idia vairadiai. Ena be idia na gwau-edeede besena, to readia lalodia bae parara.
EZK.12.3.english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

EZK.39.16.motu: (Hanua ta ladana Hamona na unuseni ai danu.) Tano na unu bae haḡoevaia toma.
EZK.39.16.english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

EZK.33.32.motu: A itaia, idia ediai oi na lalokau anedia e abimu tauna na heto, gadona na namo-herea, bona gitara e hataia ḡoevaḡoevamu; badina be emu hereva bae kamonai, to karana basie karaia.
EZK.33.32.english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

EZK.6.4.motu: Emui ihaboulaina patadia bae vahu, emui muramura mai bonadia patadia bae heḡiḡi dobi, emui mase taudia na emui kaivakuku vairadiai baina tahodia dobi.
EZK.6.4.english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

EZK.27.36.motu: Bese idau-idau edia hoihoi taudia ese e nuku henimumu;
EZK.27.36.english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you.

EZK.18.11.motu: bona ini ḡaukara iboudiai basiema kara, a ororo ai bema aniani, dekena tauna adavana bema kara miro henia,
EZK.18.11.english: or who does not do any of those things

EZK.34.27.motu: Huahua audia huahuadia na bae dobi, tano anidia na bae habada, bona tano taudia na edia tano ai bae noho namonamo, bena edia gadea baina hamotudia bona e ḡuidia taudia imadia amo baina hamauridia negana ai, idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.34.27.english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

EZK.41.3.motu: Bena ia ese laloma daiutuna ai e raka vareai, raka-vareaina ihua-ihuana e hahetohodia, kiubit rua; bona raka-vareaina lababana, kiubit tauratoi; bona raka-vareaina ohena habadia, kiubit hitu.
EZK.41.3.english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

EZK.17.5.motu: Bena tano uhena e abia, tano namona ai e hadoa, ranu momo gabuna ai. E hadoa arabimi rigirigina na heto,
EZK.17.5.english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

EZK.33.4.motu: una negana ai ta ese kibi reḡena bema kamonai to bema noho hedavauhe, bena dare na bema mai, ena maun bema abia oho; ia rarana na ia sibona kwarana ai baine mia.
EZK.33.4.english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

EZK.3.12.motu: Bena Lauma ese e abigu isi; bona Iehova hairaina na gabuna amo e tore isi negana ai tano-laga badana reḡena na murigu kahana ai na kamonai;
EZK.3.12.english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”

EZK.24.18.motu: Taunabunai, daba ai lau ese taunimanima na hereva henidia, bena adorahi ai adavagu na e mase. Bena daba rerena ai, e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena ai na kara.
EZK.24.18.english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

EZK.24.20.motu: Bena na haere henidia, nato, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.24.20.english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.41.4.motu: Daiutu e hahetohoa, ena lata bona ena lababa na kiubit ruahui, dubu durana kahana ai. Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na gabu helaḡa-hereana.
EZK.41.4.english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

EZK.47.20.motu: Lahara kahana ai, hetoa na Davara Badana, ela bona Hamat rakavareaina hevaira-hehenina. Lahara kahana hetoana bunai.
EZK.47.20.english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

EZK.18.27.motu: Ina danu, kara dika tauna ese ena kara dika baine rakatania bena taravatu lalonai baine ḡaukara bona baine kara maoromaoro, ia ese ena mauri baine rauaia.
EZK.18.27.english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

EZK.38.4.motu: baina haginimu kerehai, igau na aukimu ai baina ḡau, bena baina verimu lasi; bona emu tuari oreana idoinai danu, hosi bona hosi-gui taudia, iboudiai na mai edia tuari dabuadia, tau-anidia iḡovalai-ḡuḡurudia ḡaudia, orea bada-hereana, iboudiai na mai edia keme auridia bona kesi, bona mai edia dare imadia ai.
EZK.38.4.english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

EZK.23.42.motu: Hutuma edia moale reḡedia na taiana ai; bona gunika taudia na tano ḡaḡaena amo e hakaudia mai, kekero taudia; bena vaḡivaḡi na hahine imadia ai e atodia, bona havava ḡaudia mai hairaidia na kwaradia e havavalaidia.
EZK.23.42.english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

EZK.10.10.motu: Haniosi ita-itadia na heḡereḡere; oromadia na tamona, ava-keikei ta ava-keikei ta lalonai na heto.
EZK.10.10.english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

EZK.48.9.motu: Iehova ena ba gwauraia hidi tanona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-rua.
EZK.48.9.english: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

EZK.18.6.motu: ororo ai basinema aniani eiava Israel besena kaivakukudia basinema gaga dae henidia; dekena tauna adavana basinema kara miro henia eiava hahine ta na ena rara-kara dinadia ai basinema raka kahi henia;
EZK.18.6.english: and has not eaten on the mountains,

EZK.38.15.motu: emu gabu, mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia, amo baoma, oi bona bese momo oi ida, iboudiai na hosi ai bae gui, hutuma bada-herea, tuari oreana mai goadana.
EZK.38.15.english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

EZK.7.17.motu: Ima iboudiai na e mamanomu; tui iboudiai na e heroḡe-herogemu, ranu na heto.
EZK.7.17.english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

EZK.19.3.english: She brought up one of her cubs.

EZK.48.15.motu: Orena miana, ena lababa na kiubit daha-ima bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, na hanua ena, ruma bona gabiruma tanodia. Ilanua badana na bogaraginai baine gini.
EZK.48.15.english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

EZK.29.3.motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu
EZK.29.3.english: Speak and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:

EZK.6.7.motu: E aladiamu taudia na bogaragimui ai bae hekida diho; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.6.7.english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.16.12.motu: Gadei ta na udu-baubaumu ai na atoa, bona haida danu taiamu ai; bona havava ḡauna ta mai hairaina na kwaramu na havavalaia.
EZK.16.12.english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

EZK.35.6.motu: una dainai, (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena ai lau ese baina haheḡaeḡaemu rara ena, bona rara ese baine hahavamu; badina be rara vada o hahebubua, una dainai rara ese baine hahavamu.
EZK.35.6.english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

EZK.48.26.motu: Isakara ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Sebulun ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.26.english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

EZK.17.18.motu: Badina be gwauhamata helaḡana e dadaraia bona taravatu e tataia utu, bona imana e dudui heni to ini kara iboudiai e kara, dainai ia na basine roho mauri.
EZK.17.18.english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

EZK.31.1.motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-tana huana ihatoina dinana ginigunana ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.31.1.english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.16.25.motu: Hanua ariarana iboudiai dokodia ai emu pata helaḡadia o haginidia; hairaimu vada o lebulebulaia, raka-hanai tataudia ediai sibomu o hehoihoilai, emu ariara karadia o habada.
EZK.16.25.english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

EZK.48.8.motu: Iuda ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, tano ta ba gwauraia hidi. Ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, ena lata na unu iduhu ahudia ta heḡereḡerena, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana; ia bogaraginai na gabu helaḡana.
EZK.48.8.english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

EZK.34.17.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: egu seri e, a itaia, lau na mamoe padadiai na hahemaoromu, bona mamoe mamaruanedia bona nani mamaruanedia padadiai.
EZK.34.17.english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

EZK.31.8.motu: Dirava ena imea sida-audia ese asie hereaia,
EZK.31.8.english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it.

EZK.3.14.motu: Lauma ese e abigu isi, dauha e laohaigu; laumagu siahuna iditana ai nala, badina be Iehova imana na auka, lau latagu ai.
EZK.3.14.english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.

EZK.5.8.motu: una dainai (Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu) a itaia, lau ese na inai henimuimu, bona hahemaoro karadia baina kara umui bogaragimui ai, bese idau-idau vairadiai.
EZK.5.8.english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

EZK.21.29.motu: Idia ese oi daimu ai e mata hanai koikoimu bona e bagu haoro koikoimu lalonai, una dare na kara dika taudia, e hahemiro taudia, aiodia ai baine heato; edia dina vada e kau, davadia bae abi vaitani.
EZK.21.29.english: while they see for you false visions,

EZK.5.14.motu: Ina danu: lau ese baina hadoemui, bona hesivarai ḡauna ai baina halaomui, e ḡeḡemui ahumu besedia bogaragidiai bona raka-hanai taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
EZK.5.14.english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

EZK.32.23.motu: Edia gara na guri dobu-masemasena ai e miamu, bona ena orea ese ena gara e ḡeḡea daemu; iboudiai, gunaguna mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari karadia e karava taudia, na dare ai vada e mase.
EZK.32.23.english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

EZK.44.17.motu: Laloma maḡuna ikoukoudia lalodiai bae raka vareai negana ai, idia ese dabua auka hahedokidia bae dokilai; Inamoe huidia dabuadia basie hahedohlai, laloma maḡuna ikoukoudia ai bona maḡu lalonai kara helaḡadia bae kara negadia ai.
EZK.44.17.english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

EZK.24.8.motu: Egu badu ihavarana bona dava iabina totona, ia ese e hahebubua rarana na lau ese nadi latanai vada na atoa, basine hetahuni helaoreana.
EZK.24.8.english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance,

EZK.17.19.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani egu gwauhamata helaḡana, e dadaraia ḡauna, bona egu taravatu, e tataia utu ḡauna, davadia na ia tubuana ai baina kara.
EZK.17.19.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

EZK.28.9.motu: Ena be oi na taunimanima mo, dia dirava,
EZK.28.9.english: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’?

EZK.20.23.motu: Ina danu, tano ḡaḡaena ai na gwau henidia hamata, nato, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hakarohodia bona tano idau-idau ai baina hakarohodia rohoroho;
EZK.20.23.english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,

EZK.30.18.motu: Tehafenehe ai dina na baine dibura,
EZK.30.18.english: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself,

EZK.21.15.motu: Bena daradia na bae doko bona hutuma na edia ikoukou iboudiai lalodiai bae hekida diho totona, lau ese dare kimore-kimorena vada na heni; ia na kevaru na heto e kevaru-kevarumu; vada e hakimore-kimorea, ala-ala totona.
EZK.21.15.english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates,

EZK.25.17.motu: Lau ese hahedava-heni badana baina karaia idia latadiai; mai badugu ida davadia baina henidia. Bena egu hahedava-heni na latadiai baina atoa negana ai, idia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.25.17.english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

EZK.16.48.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, tadimu Sodoma bona natuna hahinena edia kara na oi bona natumu hahinedia edia kara ida asie heḡereḡere.
EZK.16.48.english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

EZK.23.28.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese o inai henidiamu taudia, mai hedadaraimu ida o rakatanidia taudia, imadia ai baina atomu;
EZK.23.28.english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

EZK.48.5.motu: Manase ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Efraim ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.5.english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

EZK.11.21.motu: A lalodia ese edia ḡau dika-hereadia bona edia kara dika-rohorohodia e ura henidiamu taudia be lau ese edia kara davadia na tubuadia ai baina haloudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.11.21.english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

EZK.41.21.motu: Dubu iduarana ihua-ihuadia na kaha haniosi heḡereḡere audia. Gabu helaḡana vairanai na ḡau ta,
EZK.41.21.english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

EZK.41.25.motu: Dubu iduaradia kopidia ai kerubi bona pamu audia laulaudia na e hekoro, haba ai e hekoro na heto. Bona murimuri ai dehe na mai guhina, au-reireidia amo e karaia.
EZK.41.25.english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

EZK.45.4.motu: Una tano na tano helaḡana ai bainela; ia na hahelaḡa taudia, dubu helaḡana ai kara helaḡadia e karamu bona Iehova isiaina ilaohenina totona e raka henia kahimu taudia edia; edia ruma gabudia tanona, bona dubu helaḡana tanona helaḡana ai bainela.
EZK.45.4.english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to Yahweh. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

EZK.48.23.motu: Iduhu oredia na iniheto: laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Beniamina ahuna, ahu ta.
EZK.48.23.english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

EZK.16.6.motu: Bena na rakamu hanai negana ai na itamu, rara ai o hekure, bena rara ai hekuremu ai na hereva henimu, nato, Ba mauri,
EZK.16.6.english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

EZK.29.8.motu: Una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, dare na latamu ai baina mailaia, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡauna na oiemu amo baina negedia daure;
EZK.29.8.english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.

EZK.33.21.motu: Emai noho-hedoa laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana huana ihagwautana dinana iha-imana lalonai, Ierusalem amo e heau mauri tauna ta na dekegu ema, eto, Hanua na vada e darere.
EZK.33.21.english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

EZK.20.10.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi, bena tano ḡaḡaena ai na hakaudia vareai.
EZK.20.10.english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

EZK.10.18.motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na dubu raka-vareaina amo e raka lasi, kerubi daediai e miava.
EZK.10.18.english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

EZK.16.42.motu: Unu amo egu badu ḡaraḡara baina haḡuḡurua latamu ai, bona egu vaḡeḡe ese baine rakatanimu; lalogu na baine keru, basina badu lou.
EZK.16.42.english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

EZK.11.9.motu: Ia bogaragina amo baina hakaumui lasi, bona idau taudia imadia ai baina atomui, bona hahemaoro karadia baina kara henimui.
EZK.11.9.english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

EZK.16.34.motu: Taunabunai, emu ariara karadia lalodiai oi na idau, dia hahine haida heḡereḡeredia. Ta se noimu ia ida ba eno bou; oi ese henitaona o henia, a haida ese henitaomu se henimu. Una dainai oi na idau.
EZK.16.34.english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

EZK.20.13.motu: A Israel besena ese e daḡedaḡe henigu, tano ḡaḡaena ai; egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, a egu hahedua herevadia, ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia, na e dadaraidia, bona egu dina helaḡadia na e hamirodia herea.
EZK.20.13.english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.

EZK.20.8.motu: A idia ese e daḡedaḡe henigu, asie kamonai henigu; ḡau dika-rohorohodia, matadia ese e moalelaiva ḡaudia, na dia iboudiai ese asie negedia daure, bona Aigupto kaivakukudia asie rakatanidia.
EZK.20.8.english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

EZK.31.11.motu: una dainai lau ese bese idau-idau edia siahu-herea tauna imana ai baina atoa; ia ese ena kara dika davana baine henia. Lau ese vada na negea daure.
EZK.31.11.english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

EZK.37.20.motu: Hari latadiai revareva vada o tore audia na idia vairadiai ui imamu ai bae mia negana ai,
EZK.37.20.english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

EZK.13.21.motu: Emui heḡova ahu mukodia danu baina daredia oho, bona egu bese taudia na imamui amo baina rauadia, bena egu orea taudia na imamui ai basie noho, umui damumui ai basiela. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.13.21.english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

EZK.1.1.motu: Laḡani ihatoi-ahuina ai, hua ihahanina dinana iha-imana ai, lau na dauhai e hanohodia taudia bogaragidiai, sinavai ladana Kebara isena ai. Bena guba e parara; bena Dirava na mata hanailaia.
EZK.1.1.english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

EZK.16.14.motu: Sivaraimu danu e hehari piu, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, hairaimu na bada herea dainai; badina be hairaimu na ḡoeva-dae, lau ese na hahairaimu dainai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.14.english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.22.23.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
EZK.22.23.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

EZK.32.5.motu: Oi hidiomu na ororo ai baina hapetapetalaia,
EZK.32.5.english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains,

EZK.40.19.motu: Bena ia ese hari henu ikoukouna ena laloma kahana bona laloma maḡuna ena murimuri kahana padadia e hahetohoa; padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
EZK.40.19.english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

EZK.40.25.motu: Gaba-mauru ese ia bona ia dehena e haheḡeḡedia dae, unu haida edia gaba-mauru heḡereḡeredia; ia latana na kiubit imahui bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
EZK.40.25.english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

EZK.34.3.motu: Umui ese digara o animu, bona mamoe huidia dabuadia o hahedokilaimu, bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia o aladiamu; a mamoe na asio ubudiamu.
EZK.34.3.english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

EZK.16.15.motu: A oi ese hairaimu o abidadama henia, bena ariara hahinena ai ola harimu badana dainai, raka-hanai taudia ida o lebulebu.
EZK.16.15.english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

EZK.37.13.motu: Egu bese e, emui guri baina kehodia bona emui guri amo baina hatoremui isi negana ai, vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
EZK.37.13.english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

EZK.40.3.motu: Unuseni ai e haginigu diho negana ai, tau ta na itaia, ita-itana na auri labora-labora na heto, mai ena hahetoho varona bona ena hahetoho sirihona imana ai. Ia na ikoukou ai e gini.
EZK.40.3.english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

EZK.14.17.motu: Eiava dare na una tano latanai bama mailaia, bama toma “Dare na tano amo baine hanai”, bena taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ia lalonai bama hamasedia, negana ai,
EZK.14.17.english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

EZK.23.23.motu: Babulono taudia bona Kaldea taudia iboudiai, Pekodo bona Soa bona Koa taudia, bona Asuria taudia iboudiai idia ida, iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia bona hekwara taudia bona tuari biagudia, lohia taudia bona tuari taudia, iboudiai danu hosi gui taudia.
EZK.23.23.english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

EZK.23.47.motu: Bena hari tuari oreana taudia ese nadi amo bae hododia bona edia date amo bae aladia mase; natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu bae aladia mase, bona edia ruma bae doudia.
EZK.23.47.english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

EZK.12.10.motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hereva Inetauna na Ierusalem lohiana dainai, bona Israel besena taudia ia lalonai e nohomu iboudiai daidiai.
EZK.12.10.english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

EZK.16.33.motu: Tatau ese ariara hahinedia iboudiai na harihari ḡaudia e henidiamu; a oi ese emu harihari gsudia na e ura henimuva taudia iboudiai o henidiava, henitaodia o henidiava, kaha idau-idau iboudiai amo emu ariara karadia ikaradia bae vasi totona.
EZK.16.33.english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

EZK.21.26.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Kwara dabuana ba ruhaia oho, kwara ivavalaina ḡauna ba kokia oho; harihari e miamu ḡaudia na basie mia; henu ai e miamu ḡauna na ba hadaea, atai ai e miamu ḡauna na ba hadihoa.
EZK.21.26.english: the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

EZK.29.13.motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Laḡani hari-ahui bae ore, bena Aigupto taudia na bogaragidiai vada e karoho besedia lalodia amo ma baina gogodia;
EZK.29.13.english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

EZK.39.5.motu: tano paka ai do ba hekida diho, badina be lau, Ḡaubada Iehova, vada na hereva.
EZK.39.5.english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.

EZK.34.20.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau henidia tomamu: A itaia, lau sibogu na mamoe mai digaradia bona mamoe varodadia padadiai baina hahemaoro.
EZK.34.20.english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

EZK.16.50.motu: Idia na e hekokorokuva, kara dika-rohorohodia na lau vairagu ai e karava; taunabunai edia kara na itaia negana ai na na abidia oho.
EZK.16.50.english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

EZK.1.19.motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia e loava negadia ai hari ava-keikei na idia ida e loa hebouva; bona mauri ḡaudia na tano amo e daeva negadia ai hari ava-keikei danu e dae e laova.
EZK.1.19.english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

EZK.16.58.motu: Emu lebulebu bona emu kara dika-rohorohodia davadia metauna o huaiamu. Iehova na e herevamu.
EZK.16.58.english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.

EZK.28.15.motu: Oi na asi emu kerere, emu dala iboudiai lalodiai,
EZK.28.15.english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created,

EZK.38.6.motu: Gomere mai ena hutuma idoinai ida; Bete-togarama danu mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia amo, mai ena hutuma idoinai ida; bese momo na oi ida.
EZK.38.6.english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

EZR.10.15.motu: Ionatan Asahele bona lahaseia Tikva sibodia ese una hereva e utua, bona Mesulama bona Sabetai, Levi tauna, ese e durudia.
EZR.10.15.english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

EZR.2.16.motu: Atere garana (unu na Hesekia garana), taurahanita-ahui taurahani;
EZR.2.16.english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

EZR.8.14.motu: Bigvai garana amo: Utai bona Sakuru, bona tatau hitu-ahui idia ida.
EZR.8.14.english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

EZR.4.15.motu: bena senemu sisigadia bukana ai bae hetahu. Una sisiga bukana ai ba davaria bona ba diba, ina hanua na daḡedaḡe hanuana, pavapava bona basileia ihadikadia ḡauna. Nega gunadia amo taravatu idadaraina karadia vada e tubu ia lalonai; una dainai ina hanua na e habuaia tari.
EZR.4.15.english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

EZR.7.28.motu: ia ese danu hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia vairadiai bona hanua pavapavana ena heitatao taudia mai siahudia vairadiai ena hebogahisi vada e henigu. Lau na boga auka, badina be Iehova, egu Dirava, imana na latagu ai; bena Israel tau-badadia na haboudia, lau ida baia dae lao totona.
EZR.7.28.english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to Yahweh my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.

EZR.2.19.english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.

EZR.9.13.motu: Ina idoinai na ai latamai ai vada e kau, emai kara dikadia bona emai kerere bada-hereadia daidiai; a oi, emai Dirava, ese mata-hakani sisina mo vada o henimai, dia emai kara dika davadia korikori, bona ina kwabukwabumai o hanohomai;
EZR.9.13.english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

EZR.10.5.motu: Bena Esera e tore isi, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia igunalaidia taudia, bona Israel idoinai, e haduadia, bae gwau hamata, e gwauraia heḡereḡerena ai bae kara. Taunabunai idia na e gwau hamata.
EZR.10.5.english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

EZR.5.6.motu: Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai mai bamona, lohia haida Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana ai e nohova taudia, ida edia revareva, King Darauese enai e siaia ḡauna, herevadia bini.
EZR.5.6.english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

EZR.2.25.motu: Kiriat-arimi bona Kefira bona Beroto taudia, sinahu-hitu hari-ahui toi;
EZR.2.25.english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

EZR.9.2.motu: Badina be natudia hahinedia haida vada e abidia, idia adavadia bona natudia adavadia ai e halaodia; una kara amo bese helaḡana na ini tano taudia ida vada e hebulo; bona ina hebeatai karana ai heitatao taudia bona hanua tau-badadia vada e guna.
EZR.9.2.english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

EZR.6.7.motu: Hari Dirava ena dubu ḡaukarana aine hekara; Iuda lohiadia bona tau-badadia ese hari Dirava ena dubu na gabuna korikorina ai bae haginia.
EZR.6.7.english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

EZR.4.6.motu: Bena Ahasuero e lohia matama negana ai, idia ese hahebade pepana e torea, Iuda bona Ierusalem inoholaidia taudia ihahebadelaidia.
EZR.4.6.english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

EZR.7.24.motu: Ai na a hadibamuimu danu, hahelaḡa taudia, eiava Levi taudia, eiava ane-abi taudia, eiava ikoukou igimadia taudia, eiava gabu helaḡana ena hesiai taudia, eiava hari Dirava ena dubu ena hesiai taudia haida, na ta ena amo heaiva monidia eiava kohu davadia eiava tax monidia basio abi.
EZR.7.24.english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

EZR.2.2.motu: Idia na Serubabele bona lesua bona Nehemia bona Seraia bona Reelaia bona Morodekai bona Bilsan bona Mispara bona Bigvai bona Rehumu bona Baanaha ida ela.
EZR.2.2.english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah.

EZR.10.10.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Esera na e tore isi, e hereva henidia, eto, Umui na vada o kara kerere, idau hahinedia vada o adavadia, unu amo Israel ena kerere vada o habadaia.
EZR.10.10.english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

EZR.10.19.motu: Idia na e gwau hamata, adavadia bae hadihodia; edia kara dika boubouna na mamoe maruanena ta edia seri amo, edia kara dika irohona.
EZR.10.19.english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

EZR.7.9.motu: Badina be hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai ia na Babulono tanona amo e dae lao matama, bona hua iha-imana dinana gini-gunana ai Ierusalem ai e kau, badina be ena Dirava imana namona na ia latanai.
EZR.7.9.english: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.

EZR.2.42.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia garadia: Salumu garana, Atere garana, Talmon garana, Akubu garana, Hatita garana, Sobai garana. Iboudiai na sinahu-ta toi-ahui taurahani-ta.
EZR.2.42.english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

EZR.2.30.english: The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

EZR.4.21.motu: Taunabunai ba hahedua, unu tatau ese edia ḡaukara bae hadokoa, bona hanua na basie haginia lou, ela bona lau ese hahedua herevana ta ma baina gwauraia.
EZR.4.21.english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

EZR.2.49.motu: Usa garana, Pasea garana, Besai garana,
EZR.2.49.english: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

EZR.5.15.motu: bona e hamaoroa, eto, Ini ḡau avabidia, baola, Ierusalem dubuna lalonai ma bavatodia; bona Dirava ena dubu na gabuna korikori ai ma bae haginia lou.
EZR.5.15.english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’

EZR.8.25.motu: Bena silver bona gold bona ḡau idau-idau, hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia bona ena lohia taudia ida, bona Israel taudia unuseni ai vada e hebou danu, edia herahia ḡaudia vada e heni eda Dirava ena dubu ḡaudia, na hahetoho, na henidia hagau-hagau.
EZR.8.25.english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

EZR.6.13.motu: Bena King Darauese ese e siaia herevana heḡereḡerena, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamodia ida, ese King Darauese ena hahedua ḡaudia na e karadia balaheni.
EZR.6.13.english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.

EZR.7.3.motu: Ahitubu na Amaria natuna, Amaria na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Meraioto natuna,
EZR.7.3.english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

EZR.7.2.motu: Hilkia na Salumu natuna, Salumu na Sadok natuna, Sadok na Ahitubu natuna,
EZR.7.2.english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

EZR.2.26.motu: Rama bona Geba taudia, sinahu-tauratoi ruahui ta;
EZR.2.26.english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

EZR.7.27.motu: Iehova, ita seneda edia Dirava, aita hanamoa, badina be ia ese kara unuhetomana na hanua pavapavana lalona ai e havaraia, Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihahairaina;
