EZR.7.27.english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem;

EZR.2.51.motu: Bakabuku garana, Hakufa garana, Harahuru garana,
EZR.2.51.english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

EZR.10.12.motu: Bena hebou taudia iboudiai e haere, e hereva badabada, eto, Momokani, emu hereva heḡereḡerena do baia karaia.
EZR.10.12.english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

EZR.4.7.motu: Aratasasta e lohiava negana ai, Bisilama bona Mitredata bona Tabele mai bamodia oredia ida ese Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavana, e tore henia. Edia revareva be Aram revarevadia bona gadona amo e torea.
EZR.4.7.english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

EZR.8.20.motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia sinahu-rua ruahui danu e hakaudia mai; unu na David bona ena heitatao taudia ese e gwauraidia, Levi taudia isiaidia bae lao heni. Ini iboudiai na ladadia e hegwaurai.
EZR.8.20.english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

EZR.4.8.motu: Rehumu, tuari oreana biaguna, bona Simisai, itorena tauna, ese Ierusalem ihadikana revarevana ta na King Aratasasta e tore henia.
EZR.4.8.english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

EZR.1.5.motu: Bena Iuda bona Beniamina iduhu kwaradia na e tore isi, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia danu, Dirava ese vada e rohedia taudia iboudiai, Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai bae haginia lou totona;
EZR.1.5.english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.

EZR.4.18.motu: Dekemai o siaia mai revarevana na vairagu ai vada e duahia hedinarai.
EZR.4.18.english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

EZR.5.3.motu: Una negana ai, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamodia ida, na idia dekediai e kau, e hereva henidia, eto, Daika ese hahedua e henimui, ina dubu ba haginia lou bona maḡuna ba ha-ahua?
EZR.5.3.english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”

EZR.8.34.motu: Iboudiai na e hagaudia bona e hahetohodia, bona iboudiai metaudia e tore.
EZR.8.34.english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

EZR.9.12.motu: Taunabunai, natumui hahinedia na idia natudia mamaruanedia basio henidia, bona idia natudia hahinedia na basio abidia, natumui mamaruanedia edia, bona edia maino eiava noho-namo daladia na nega ta basio tahua; bena ba goada, tano anidia bavani, bona ba rakatani dihimui edia, ela bona hanaihanai.
EZR.9.12.english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

EZR.8.1.motu: King Aratasasta ena lohia negana ai lau ida Babulono tanona amo a dae ala taudia edia iduhu kwaradia bona edia uru ladadia bini.
EZR.8.1.english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

EZR.10.8.motu: bona dina toi lalodiai tau ta basinema mai, bena heitatao taudia bona hanua tau-badadia na bae hahedua, ena kohu baine heabi oho, bona ia danu noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia edia hebou lalona amo bae gwaua tao.
EZR.10.8.english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

EZR.2.70.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona taunimanima haida na Ierusalem ai bona hetabira tanodia ai e nohova; ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona dubu ena hesiai taudia na edia hanua lalodiai e nohova. Israel taudia iboudiai danu edia hanua lalodiai e nohova.
EZR.2.70.english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

EZR.10.9.motu: Bena Iuda bona Beniamina taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem ai e hebou, dina toi lalodiai; dina na hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahuina. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na hanua ariarana ai e helai, Dirava ena dubu vairanai, e heude-heudeva, una kara dainai bona medu e diho badabadava dainai.
EZR.10.9.english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

EZR.10.30.motu: Pahatamoab natuna bogaragidia amo: Adna, Kelala, Benaia, Maaseia, Matania, Besalele, Binui, Manase.
EZR.10.30.english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

EZR.5.1.motu: Peroveta taudia Hagai bona Sekaria Ido ese Iuda taudia, Iuda ai bona Ierusalem ai, e haroro henidia, Israel Diravana, idia e biagudia Diravana, ladana ai.
EZR.5.1.english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

EZR.2.61.motu: Hahelaga taudia garadia danu: Habaia garana, Hakoso garana, Barasilai garana (una tau ese Barasilai tau Gilead natuna hahinedia ta e adavaia, bena idia ladadia ta ai e henemai).
EZR.2.61.english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

EZR.4.1.motu: A Iuda bona Beniamina taudia inaidia na e kamonai hari noho-hedoa amo vada e lou mai taudia ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu e haginiava;
EZR.4.1.english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to Yahweh, the God of Israel,

EZR.7.15.motu: bona hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia ida edia herahia ḡaudia, silver bona gold, idia ese Israel Diravana, Ierusalem ai e nohomu, vada e henia ḡaudia na oi ese ba laohai;
EZR.7.15.english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

EZR.6.6.motu: Taunabunai, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamomui Sinavai Badana enekahana ai e nohomu lohiadia ida, umui na dauhai a noho.
EZR.6.6.english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.

EZR.8.11.motu: Bebai garana amo: Sekaria Bebai, bona tatau ruahui-taurahani ia ida.
EZR.8.11.english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

EZR.4.3.motu: A Serubabele bona lesua bona iduhu lohiadia oredia Israel ai ese e haere henidia, eto, Umui na asi emui ḡaukara ai emai ai, emai Dirava ena dubu ihaginina ai; a ai sibomai ese baia haginia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena, King Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, vada e haḡanimai heḡereḡerena.
EZR.4.3.english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

EZR.1.8.motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ese e abidia lasi, moni inarina tauna Mitredata imana ai e atodia; bena una tau ese e hagaudia, Iuda lohiana Sesebasara e henia.
EZR.1.8.english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

EZR.2.5.english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

EZR.2.65.motu: bona edia hesiai tataudia bona hahinedia danu daha-hitu sinahu-toi toi-ahui hitu; edia ane-abi tataudia bona hahinedia danu na sinahu-rua.
EZR.2.65.english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

EZR.4.24.motu: Bena Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai iḡaukaralaina e doko vaitani, ela bona Darauese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuana.
EZR.4.24.english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

EZR.8.35.motu: Una negana ai, abi-mauri taudia, edia noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia, ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na e hahelaḡadia, Israel Diravana ena: boromakau mamaruanedia gwauta-rua Israel idoinai dainai, bona mamoe mamaruanedia taurahanita-ahui tauratoi bona mamoe natudia hitu-ahui hitu; bona nani mamaruanedia g vauta-rua danu, kara dika boubouna ḡaudia. Ina idoinai na ḡole-oho boubouna Iehova ena.
EZR.8.35.english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

EZR.7.20.motu: Bona dahaka ḡau dahaka ḡau ai o dabumu, emu Dirava ena dubu ena, bavabi, bena hanua pavapavana ena moni amo davadia do ba kara.
EZR.7.20.english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.

EZR.2.33.motu: Lod bona Hadidi bona Ono taudia, sinahu-hitu ruahui ima;
EZR.2.33.english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

EZR.8.26.motu: Na hahetoho bona idia imadia ai na ato gaudia bini: silver talent sinahu-tauratoi imahui, bona silver ḡaudia talent sinahu-ta davana; bona gold talent sinahu-ta,
EZR.8.26.english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

EZR.10.6.motu: Bena Esera na Dirava ena dubu vairana amo e raka oho, lehohanan Eliasibi ena daiutu ela, unuseni ai e noho rani; aniani se ani, ranu se inu; badina be noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia edia hebeatai e tailaia.
EZR.10.6.english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

EZR.3.11.motu: Bena ane e abi hadava-hadava, Iehova e imodaia bona e hahenamo henia, eto,
EZR.3.11.english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.

EZR.5.13.motu: Ḡau tamona, Kurese, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ginigunana ai, hanua pavapavana ese hahedua herevana e gwauraia, ina Dirava ena dubu baia haginia lou eto.
EZR.5.13.english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

EZR.7.8.motu: Ia be hua iha-imana lalonai Ierusalem ai e kau, hanua pavapavana ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai.
EZR.7.8.english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

EZR.7.18.motu: Bena silver bona gold oredia na oi mai tadikakamu ida emui lalo-hadai bona emui Dirava ena ena ura heḡereḡeredia ai ba gaukaralai.
EZR.7.18.english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.

EZR.5.4.motu: Ma e nanadaidia, eto, Ina ruma e haginiamu taudia ladadia be daidia?
EZR.5.4.english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.

EZR.8.8.motu: Sefatia garana amo: Sebadia Mikael, bona tatau taurahani-ahui ia ida.
EZR.8.8.english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

EZR.2.9.english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

EZR.2.54.english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

EZR.7.22.motu: ela bona silver talent sinahu-ta bona uit koro sinahu-ta bona vine ranuna bata sinahu-ta bona damena asi hahetohona.
EZR.7.22.english: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

EZR.2.21.english: The children of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.

EZR.10.25.motu: Israel besena amo: Paroso natuna bogaragidia amo: Ramia, Isia, Malkia, Miamini, Eleasara, Hasabia, Benaia.
EZR.10.25.english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

EZR.5.2.motu: Bena Serubabele Sealtiele bona lesua losadak na e tore isi, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihagini-louna e matamaia; Dirava ena peroveta taudia na idia ida, e durudiava.
EZR.5.2.english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

EZR.3.9.motu: Bena Iesua, mai natuna bona varavarana ida, bona Kadmiele mai natuna, Iuda vevena taudia, ida, ese Dirava ena dubu ai e ḡaukarava taudia na e itadia tao hebou, Henadab natuna bona Levi taudia mai natudia bona varavaradia ida.
EZR.3.9.english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

EZR.4.23.motu: King Aratasasta ena revareva herevadia na Rehumu bona itorena tauna Simisai mai bamodia ida vairadiai e duahi hedinarai; bena idia na Iuda taudia Ierusalem ai dekedia ela haraḡa, bona mai goadadia bona mai siahudia ida edia ḡaukara ai e hadokodia.
EZR.4.23.english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

EZR.6.14.motu: Bena Iuda tau-badadia ese dubu e haginia, bona edia ḡaukara anina e tubu, peroveta tauna Hagai bona Sekaria Ido edia haroro herevadia daidiai. Dubu ihaginina e haḡugurua, Israel Diravana ena haheḡani bona Kurese bona Darauese bona Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavadia, edia hahedua daidiai.
EZR.6.14.english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

EZR.8.36.motu: Idia ese hanua pavapavana ena hahedua pepadia na hanua pavapavana ena tuari biagudia bona Sinavai Badana inikahana basileiana lohiadia e henidia; bena idia ese taunimanima bona Dirava ena dubu e durudia.
EZR.8.36.english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.

EZR.4.19.motu: Bena na hahedua, bena vada e hetahu; vada e davaria una hanua ese nega gunadia amo hanua pavapavadia vada e tuari henidia, bona ia lalonai daḡedaḡe bona taravatu idadaraina karadia vada e kara.
EZR.4.19.english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

EZR.2.4.english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

EZR.9.5.motu: Bena adorahi boubouna negana ai, lau na egu anivaga amo na tore isi, mai dabuagu bona hahedokigu hedaredia ida; bena tuigu na hadai, imagu na Iehova, egu Dirava, na toi roro henia,
EZR.9.5.english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Yahweh my God;

EZR.9.15.motu: Iehova e, Israel Diravana, oi na maoromaoro, badina be ai na kwabukwabumai, a roho mauri taumai, ina dina ai. O itaiamu, ai na oi vairamu ai mai emai kerere; badina be asi tauna ta oi vairamu ai baine gini diba, ina kara dainai.
EZR.9.15.english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”

EZR.8.12.motu: Asgada garana amo: Iohanan Hakatan, bona tatau sinahu-ta gwauta ia ida.
EZR.8.12.english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

EZR.6.10.motu: bena idia ese boubou ḡaudia namodia na bae hahelaḡadia guba Diravana ena, bona bae guriḡuri, hanua pavapavana mai natuna ida edia mauri daidiai.
EZR.6.10.english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

EZR.8.4.motu: Pahata-moab garana amo: Eliehoenai Serahia, bona tatau sinahu-rua ia ida.
EZR.8.4.english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

EZR.4.14.motu: Ai ese pavapava ena ruma damenana a animu dainai, dia namo ai ese hanua pavapavana ihahemaraina baia itaia; taunabunai ina hereva a siaia vasimu, oi pavapava taumu ihadibamu,
EZR.4.14.english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

EZR.4.9.motu: Rehumu, tuan oreana biaguna, bona Simisai, itorena tauna, mai bamodia oredia ida, hahemaoro taudia, lohia taudia, heitatao taudia, bona Parasa bona Ereke bona Babulono bona Susa taudia (unu na Elam taudia),
EZR.4.9.english: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

EZR.2.48.motu: Resini garana, Nekoda garana, Gasama garana,
EZR.2.48.english: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

EZR.8.7.motu: Elam garana amo: Iesaia Atalia, bona tatau hitu-ahui ia ida.
EZR.8.7.english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

EZR.3.3.motu: Ihaboulaina patana na ena gabu ai e haginia, badina be gari ese e butudia tao, unu tano taudia daidiai; bena ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na ia latanai e hahelaḡadia Iehova ena, daba ai bona adorahi ai.
EZR.3.3.english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

EZR.7.12.motu: Aratasasta, pavapava edia pavapava, vada e torea revarevana, hahelaḡa tauna Esera, guba Diravana ena taravatu itorena tauna, enai.

EZR.2.55.motu: Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia: Sotai garana, Hasoferete garana, Peruda garana,
EZR.2.55.english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

EZR.5.7.motu: Idia ese sivarai e torea, ia dekena e siaia, eto:
EZR.5.7.english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written:

EZR.6.12.motu: Ina hereva baine ha-idaua, eiava hari Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai baine ḡigia dobi, pavapavana eiava besena na una gabu ai ladana vada e hanohoa Diravana ese baine hadarerea. Lau Darauese na haheduamu; ba karaia balaheni.
EZR.6.12.english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

EZR.4.2.motu: bena idia ese Serubabele bona iduhu kwaradia dekedia ela, e hereva henidia, eto, Mani emui kara ai na umui ida dubu baita haginia hebou; badina be ai ese emui Dirava a toma henia dihomu, umui heḡereḡeremui, bona a bouamu danu, Esarahadon, Asuria pavapavana, ese e mailaimai bona ina gabu ai e hanohomai negana amo ema bona harihari.
EZR.4.2.english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

EZR.2.56.motu: Iaala garana, Darakono garana, Gidele garana,
EZR.2.56.english: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

EZR.2.8.english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.

EZR.8.28.motu: Bena na hereva henidia, nato, Umui na hehelaḡa Iehova ena, bona ini ḡau danu hehelaḡa, bona hari silver bona gold na herahia ḡaudia, lalo-namo ai e heni, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ena.
EZR.8.28.english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

EZR.5.14.motu: Bona gold bona silver gaudia, una Dirava ena dubu kohudia, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem dubuna amo vada e abi lasi bona Babulono dubuna ai vada e vareailai ḡaudia, na King Kurese ese Babulono dubuna amo e abi lasi, tau ta ladana Sesebasara e henia. Ia ese una tau na lohia tauna ai e halaoa;
EZR.5.14.english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

EZR.10.24.motu: Ane-abi oreana amo: Eliasibi. Ikoukou igimadia oreana amo: Salumu, Telem, Uri.

EZR.1.2.motu: Haheḡani na binai. Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Iehova, guba Diravana, ese tanobada basileiadia iboudiai vada e henigu, bona vada e haḡanigu ena dubu auta baina haginia Ierusalem ai, Iuda tanona ai.
EZR.1.2.english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

EZR.2.43.motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia: Siha garana, Hasufa garana, Tabaoto garana,
EZR.2.43.english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

EZR.2.36.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia: Iedaia (Iesua ena iduhu tauna) garana, sinahu-taurahanita hitu-ahui toi;
EZR.2.36.english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

EZR.4.16.motu: Oi pavapava taumu a hadibamumu, ina hanua bema gini lou bona maḡuna bema ore negana ai, oi na asi emu ḡau ta, Sinavai Badana inikahana basileiana idoinai lalonai.
EZR.4.16.english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

EZR.10.34.motu: Bani natuna bogaragidia amo: Maadai, Amram, Uele,
EZR.10.34.english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

EZR.2.66.motu: Edia hosi na sinahu-hitu toi-ahui tauratoi; edia doniki badadia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima;
EZR.2.66.english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

EZR.2.6.motu: Pahatamoab garana (unu na Iesua bona Ioab garadia), daha-rua sinahu-taurahani gwauta-rua;
EZR.2.6.english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

EZR.7.7.motu: Bena King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai, Israel taudia haida danu Ierusalem e dae lao, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia haida, bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia, bona gabu helaḡana ena hesiai taudia.
EZR.7.7.english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

EZR.6.11.motu: Lau na haheduamu danu, tau ta ese ina haheḡani bema ha-idaua, bena au ta iena ruma amo bae raḡaia, bona una tau na una au ai bae gwadaia uru, bena ena ruma na boromakau taḡena ihabouna gabuna ai bae halaoa.
EZR.6.11.english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

EZR.2.44.motu: Kero garana, Siaha garana, Padono garana,
EZR.2.44.english: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

EZR.9.4.motu: Mai dara-dokogu ai na helaiva ai, noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia edia gwau hebeatai dainai Israel Diravana ena hereva bagudiai kudoudia e hetaha taudia na dekegu ai e hebou, ela bona adorahi boubouna negana.
EZR.9.4.english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

EZR.9.9.motu: Badina be ai na iḡui taumai; ḡau tamona emai Dirava ese emai igui ai se rakatanimai, a vada e bogamai hisi Parasa pavapavadia vairadiai, emai goada taidia ma baine hamatamata, bena emai Dirava ena dubu baia haginia lou, bona ena dika gabudia baia banidia, bona imaḡu-ahumai ai bainela, Iudea ai bona Ierusalem ai.
EZR.9.9.english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

EZR.10.7.motu: Bena hahedua na Iuda bona Ierusalem idoinai lalodiai e gwauraia hedinarai, noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia na Ierusalem ai bae hebou;
EZR.10.7.english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

EZR.9.3.motu: Una hereva na kamonai negana ai, egu dabua bona egu hahedoki badana na dare, bona kwaragu bona aukigu huidia na rakasidia, bena na helai diho, daragu e doko.
EZR.9.3.english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.

EZR.2.12.motu: Asgada garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua ruahui rua;
EZR.2.12.english: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

EZR.2.31.motu: Elam ma ta taudia, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
EZR.2.31.english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

EZR.8.24.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia badadia gwauta-rua na gwauraidia hidi: Serebia bona Hasabia, bona varavaradia gwauta idia ida.
EZR.8.24.english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

EZR.4.20.motu: Pavapava herea-daedia ese Ierusalem vada e lohiaia; Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana idoinai ese heaiva bona kohu davadia bona tax na idia e henidia.
EZR.4.20.english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

EZR.2.45.motu: Lebana garana, Hagabaha garana, Akubu garana,
EZR.2.45.english: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

EZR.10.31.motu: Harimi natuna bogaragidia amo: Eliesere, Isihia, Malkia, Semaia, Simeon,
EZR.10.31.english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

EZR.7.11.motu: King Aratasasta ese revareva ta Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, Iehova ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu Israel latanai mai dibana tauna, e henia. E henia revarevana herevadia bini:
EZR.7.11.english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of Yahweh’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:

EZR.9.1.motu: Unu ḡaukara muridiai, heitatao taudia na lau dekegu ema, eto, Israel taudia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na ini tano taudia, kara dika-herea taudia, Kanaan bona Hiti bona Perisi bona Iebusu bona Amono bona Moab bona Aigupto bona Amoro taudia, edia amo do asie raka oho.
EZR.9.1.english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

EZR.9.10.motu: A harihari, emai Dirava e, ina murinai ai na ma dahaka baia gwaurai? Badina be emu haheḡani vada a dadaraidia.
EZR.9.10.english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

EZR.7.23.motu: Dahaka dahaka guba Diravana ese baine haganilai, vada ba kara ḡuguru, guba Diravana ena dubu ena, iena badu na hanua pavapavana mai natuna ida edia basileia latanai baine kau na garina.
EZR.7.23.english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

EZR.10.33.motu: Hasumu natuna bogaragidia amo: Matenai, Matata, Sabada, Elifelete, Ieremai, Manase, Simei.
EZR.10.33.english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

EZR.6.17.motu: Idia ese boromakau mamaruanedia sinahu-ta bona mamoe mamaruanedia sinahu-rua bona mamoe natudia sinahu-hani na boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia, hari Dirava ena dubu ihahelagana totona; bona nani mamaruanedia gwauta-rua e hahelaḡadia Israel idoinai ena kara dika boubouna ḡaudia, Israel ena iduhu gwauta-ruaosi ihaheḡereḡeredia.
EZR.6.17.english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

EZR.2.39.english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

EZR.7.6.motu: Hari Esera na Babulono amo e dae lao. Ia be itorena tauna ta, Mose ena taravatu, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese e heni ḡauna, dibana herea. Hanua pavapavana ese iena ura idoinai e henia, badina be Iehova, ena Dirava, imana na ia latanai.
EZR.7.6.english: this Ezra went up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahweh, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to Yahweh his God’s hand on him.

EZR.2.50.motu: Asna garana, Meunimi garana, Nefisimi garana,
EZR.2.50.english: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,

EZR.2.23.english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

EZR.2.60.motu: Delaia garana, Tobia garana bona Nekoda garana, sinahu-tauratoi imahui rua.
EZR.2.60.english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

EZR.10.16.motu: Bena noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia na unu e kara toma. Hahelaḡa tauna Esera ese tatau haida e abidia hidi, iduhu kwaradia iduhu ta ta ai; bona ta ta ladadia e hato. Hua ihagwautana dinana gini-gunana ai e hebou matama, una kara bae tahua totona;
EZR.10.16.english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

EZR.10.18.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia natudia bogaragidia amo e davaridia idau hahinedia vada e adavadia, taudia bini: Maaseia, Eliesere, laribi, Gedalia. Ini na Iesua Iosadak mai tadikakana ida natudia.
EZR.10.18.english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women:

EZR.6.18.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia e hididia, edia orea ta ta ai, bona Levi taudia danu unu e karadia toma, Ierusalem ai, Dirava isiaina ilaohenina totona, Mose ena buka ai e hetore heḡereḡerena.
EZR.6.18.english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

EZR.3.13.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima asie diba maoro dahaka reḡe, moale eiava taunimanima edia taitai reḡedia; badina be taunimanima na e lolo badabada, bona reḡena na dauhai danu e kamonaiva.
EZR.3.13.english: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.

EZR.8.13.motu: Adonikama garana amo haida na gabeai ema: Elifelete bona Ieuele bona Semaia, bona tatau tauratoi-ahui idia ida.
EZR.8.13.english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

EZR.7.25.motu: Oi danu, Esera e, emu Dirava ena aonega, imamu ai e miamu ḡauna, heḡereḡerena ai, hahemaoro taudia maraḡidia bona badadia ba duanaidia; idia ese Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana taudia. emu Dirava ena taravatu mai dibadia taudia, iboudiai na bae hahemaoro henidia. A asi dibadia taudia ba hadibadia.
EZR.7.25.english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.

EZR.7.13.motu: Lau vada na hahedua, Israel taudia eiava edia hahelaḡa taudia eiava Levi taudia egu basileia lalonai daika daika ena urakwalimu dainai Ierusalem lao e uramu na oi ida baola.
EZR.7.13.english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.

EZR.2.57.motu: Sefatia garana, Hatili garana, Pokerete-hasabaimi garana bona Ami garana.
EZR.2.57.english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

EZR.2.59.motu: Ini na Tele-mela bona Tele-harasa bona Kerubu bona Adana bona Imere amo ema taudia, a edia iduhu bona senedia ladadia ihamomokanidia asi dibadia, idia na Israel besena eiava lasi:
EZR.2.59.english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

EZR.9.7.motu: Senemai negana amo ema bona ina dina, ai na vada a kerere dikadika; bona emai kara dika daidiai ai bona emai pavapava bona emai hahelaḡa taudia na tano haida pavapavadia imadia ai vada e atomai, bona dare bona abi-mauri bona dadidadi bona hemarai bada-herea ediai vada o negemai, ina dina heḡereḡerena ai.
EZR.9.7.english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

EZR.4.22.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ina kara ai basio manoka. Anina be dahaka ina hekwakwanai ḡauna na baine tubu badabada, hanua pavapavana ihadikalaina.
EZR.4.22.english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

EZR.10.22.motu: Pasahuru natuna bogaragidia amo: Elioenai, Maaseia, Ismael, Netanele, Iosabad, Elasa.
EZR.10.22.english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

EZR.10.27.motu: Satu natuna bogaragidia amo: Elioenai, Eliasibi, Matania, Ieremoto, Sabada, Asisa.
EZR.10.27.english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

EZR.4.4.motu: Bena tano taudia ese Iuda taudia lalodia e ani bona e hagaridia, una ḡaukara ai;
EZR.4.4.english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

EZR.2.34.english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

EZR.3.12.motu: A hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona iduhu kwaradia loḡora, tau burukadia, dubu gunana e itaia taudia na e tai lolololo, ina dubu badina e hadaia e itaia negana ai; a hutuma na moale dainai e lolo badabada.
EZR.3.12.english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,

EZR.5.10.motu: Bena ladadia a henanadailai, oi ihadibalaimu, idia ikwaradia taudia ladadia baia tore ato.
EZR.5.10.english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

EZR.7.5.motu: Buki na Abisua natuna, Abisua na Fineha natuna, Fineha na Eleasara natuna, Eleasara na Aaron, hahelaḡa tauna badana, natuna.
EZR.7.5.english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

EZR.10.21.motu: Harimi natuna bogaragidia amo: Maaseia, Elia, Semaia, Iehiele, Usia.
EZR.10.21.english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

EZR.7.19.motu: Hari emu Dirava ena dubu gaukaradia ikaralaidia ḡaudia vada a henimui na ba laohai, Ierusalem Diravana vairanai bavato.
EZR.7.19.english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

EZR.1.4.motu: Bona edena gabu edena gabu ai doini e noho hedoamu taudia ta ta na unu e nohomu gabudia taudia ese bae durudia, silver bona gold bona kohu bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia bae henidia, bona lalo-namo herahiadia danu, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ena.
EZR.1.4.english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

EZR.2.41.motu: Ane-abi taudia: Asaf garana, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani.
EZR.2.41.english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

EZR.3.10.motu: Ruma-hagini taudia ese Iehova ena dubu badina e hadaia negana ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese edia dabua helaḡadia e hahedokilai, bena mai kibidia ida e raka kahira, bona Levi taudia, Asaf garana, mai edia botabota auridia ida, e raka ela, Iehova ihanamolaina totona, David, Israel pavapavana, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
EZR.3.10.english: When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

EZR.6.19.motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai, hari noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia ese lagau-hanai ariana e karaia.
EZR.6.19.english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

EZR.2.47.motu: Gidele garana, Gahara garana, Re-aia garana,
EZR.2.47.english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

EZR.6.2.motu: Bena Ekebatana, Media basileiana ena hanua badana, Ialonai pepa ta e davaria; una pepa ai e tore herevadia bini:
EZR.6.2.english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

EZR.10.11.motu: Taunabunai, emui kerere na Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vairanai ba gwaurai hedinarai, bona iena ura be karaia: ina tano taudia bona idau hahinedia edia amo ba raka oho.
EZR.10.11.english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

EZR.2.11.english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

EZR.1.7.motu: Hanua pavapavana Kurese ese danu Iehova ena dubu kohudia, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem amo e laohai bona ena dirava edia dubu ai e ato ḡaudia, na e abidia lasi.
EZR.1.7.english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of Yahweh’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

EZR.6.4.motu: Nadi ere toi bona au ere ta bae kara. Davana na pavapava ena moni amo ba heni.
EZR.6.4.english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

EZR.10.26.motu: Elam natuna bogaragidia amo: Matania, Sekaria, Iehiele, Abdi, Ieremoto, Elia.
EZR.10.26.english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

EZR.5.16.motu: Bena hari Sesebasara na ema, bona Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai badina e hadai. Bena una negana ema bona hari, ihaginina vada a ḡaukaralaia, to do se ore.
EZR.5.16.english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

EZR.2.7.motu: Elam garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
EZR.2.7.english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

EZR.7.14.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia hahituosi ese vada e siaimumu, Iuda bona Ierusalem henanadaidia ba kara, emu Dirava ena taravatu, oi imamu ai e miamu ḡauna heḡereḡerena;
EZR.7.14.english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

EZR.2.63.motu: Hanua lohiana ese e hamaorodia, idia na aniani helaḡa-hereana basie ania, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna ta ese Urim bona Tumim ediai baine henanadai.
EZR.2.63.english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

EZR.2.35.english: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

EZR.10.14.motu: Emai heitatao taudia ese hebouna bae abia; emai hanua lalodiai idau hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia iboudiai na bae hegwaurai hidi negadia ai baema, bona hanua tau-badadia bona hahemaoro taudia danu idia ida, hanua iboudiai amo, ela bona eda Dirava ena badu ḡaraḡara ina kara dainai na ita eda amo baine heabi oho.
EZR.10.14.english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

EZR.8.3.motu: ia be Sekania natuna ta. Paroso garana amo: Sekaria; ia ida tatau sinahu-ta imahui ladadia e hetore.
EZR.8.3.english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

EZR.4.13.motu: Oi pavapava taumu ba diba, ina hanua na bema haginia lou bona maguna bema ha-orea, bena idia ese heaiva eiava kohu davadia eiava tax basie heni, bena oi pavapava taumu emu taḡa na baine maraḡi.
EZR.4.13.english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

EZR.3.7.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese nadi iḡaukaralaidia taudia bona kamuta taudia na moni e henidia; bona aniani bona inuinu ḡaudia bona dehoro na Sidono bona Turo taudia e henidia, sida audia na Lebanon amo bae lasilaidia kone ai bona lopa ai bae atodia na davana, Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena gwau-maoro heḡereḡerena.
EZR.3.7.english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

EZR.10.20.motu: Imere natuna bogaragidia amo: Hanani bona Sebadia.
EZR.10.20.english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

EZR.6.16.motu: Bena Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia oredia, ese hari Dirava ena dubu ihahelaḡana karadia e kara, mai moaledia ida.
EZR.6.16.english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

EZR.8.9.motu: Ioab garana amo: Obadia Iehiele, bona tatau sinahu-rua gwauta-taurahani ia ida.
EZR.8.9.english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

EZR.2.67.motu: edia kamelo na sinahu-hani toi-ahui ima; bona edia doniki maraḡidia na daha-tauratoi sinahu-hitu ruahui.
EZR.2.67.english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

EZR.8.18.motu: Bena eda Dirava imana namona na ai latamai ai dainai, idia ese lalo-maoro tauna ta, Mali, Levi Israel natuna, garana ta, e hakaua mai. Una tau ladana na Serebia; ia na natuna bona varavarana ida ema, tatau gwauta-taurahani.
EZR.8.18.english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

EZR.2.28.motu: Betele bona Ai taudia, sinahu-rua ruahui toi;
EZR.2.28.english: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.

EZR.7.17.motu: Taunabunai, ina moni ba gaukaralaia balaheni, boromakau mamaruanedia bona mamoe mamaruanedia bona mamoe natudia, mai edia flaoa boubouna ḡaudia bona inuinu boubouna ḡaudia ida, na ba hoi, bena emui Dirava ena dubu ena ihaboulaina patana Ierusalem ai latanai ba hahelaḡadia.
EZR.7.17.english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

EZR.2.69.motu: Edia taḡa heḡereḡerena idia ese una ḡaukara idurulaina monina e heni, gold darikidia gerebu-tauratoi daha-ta, bona silver minadia daha-ima, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki sinahu-ta.
EZR.2.69.english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

EZR.3.8.motu: Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai e lou henia laḡanina iharuana huana iharuana lalonai, Serubabele Sealtiele bona lesua losadak na e ḡaukara matama, tadikakadia oredia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia, bona abi-mauri amo Ierusalem vada e lou henia taudia iboudiai ida. Idia ese laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia Levi oreana lalonai e duanaidia, idia ese Iehova ena dubu ḡaukarana bae itaia tao.
EZR.3.8.english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of Yahweh’s house.

EZR.4.12.motu: Harihari oi, pavapava taumu, ba diba, hari Iuda taudia oiemu amo dekemai ema na Ierusalem vada ela. Idia ese una daḡedaḡe bona kara dika hanuana ma e haginia loumu; maḡu na be ha-oreamu, bona ruma badidia e banidia.
EZR.4.12.english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

EZR.4.10.motu: bona lohia badana bona herea-daena Osonopara ese e laohaidia Samaria hanuadia bona Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana orena lalodiai e hanohodia besedia oredia, ese revareva e torea.
EZR.4.10.english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

EZR.8.6.motu: Adini garana amo: Ebed Ionatan, bona tatau imahui ia ida.
EZR.8.6.english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

EZR.2.13.english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.

EZR.10.29.motu: Bani natuna bogaragidia amo: Mesulama, Maluku, Adaia, lasub, Seala, Ieremoto.
EZR.10.29.english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

EZR.10.28.motu: Bebai natuna bogaragidia amo: Iehohanan, Hanania, Sabai, Atalai.
EZR.10.28.english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

EZR.5.11.motu: Bena idia ese e haere henimai, eto, Ai na guba bona tanobada Diravana ena hesiai taudia, bona laḡani momo vada e lao bubuni Israel pavapavana badana ta ese e haginia bona e ha-orea dubuna na ai ese ma a haginia loumu.
EZR.5.11.english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

EZR.8.31.motu: Bena hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-ruana ai, ai na Ahava sinavaina amo a raka oho, Ierusalem baiala totona. Eda Dirava imana na latamai ai, bena ia ese inai taudia imadia amo bona dala ai e bani henimai taudia edia amo e hamaurimai.
EZR.8.31.english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

EZR.6.3.motu: King Kurese ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana lalonai, King Kurese ese hahedua herevana ta e gwauraia, eto, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai herevana binai: dubu na bae haginia lou, boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiamu bona ḡole-oho boubou gaudia e laohaidiamu gabuna; harana latana na kiubit tauratoi-ahui bona lababana danu kiubit tauratoi-ahui, unu bae haginia toma.
EZR.6.3.english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits;

EZR.8.33.motu: Dina ihahanina ai, eda Dirava ena dubu lalonai, hari silver bona gold bona ḡau idau-idau na e hahetohodia, hahelaḡa tauna Meremoto Uria imana ai e atodia. Ia ida be Eleasara Fineha, bona Levi taudia Iosabad Iesua bona Noadia Binui.
EZR.8.33.english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

EZR.2.10.english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.

EZR.2.52.motu: Basalutu garana, Mehida garana, Harasa garana,
EZR.2.52.english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

EZR.4.17.motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena haere e siaia. Haere na binai:
EZR.4.17.english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River:

EZR.2.14.english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

EZR.7.26.motu: Daika ese emu Dirava ena taravatu bona hanua pavapavana ena taravatu basine badinaia, hahemaoro aukana na ia latanai bae karaia, bena baine mase, eiava tano amo baine raka oho, eiava ena kohu bae heabi oho, eiava dibura rumana ai baine hekou ahu.
EZR.7.26.english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

EZR.2.37.english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

EZR.10.13.motu: A taunimanima na hutuma, bona ina na medu momo negana; ai na murimuri ai basia gini diba. Bona ina na dia dina tamona eiava dina rua ḡaukarana; badina be ai na vada a kerere bada ina kara ai.
EZR.10.13.english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

EZR.10.43.motu: Nebo natuna bogaragidia amo: Ieiele, Matitia, Sabada, Sebina, Iadai, Ioel, Benaia.
EZR.10.43.english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

EZR.3.2.motu: Bena Iesua Iosadak, mai bamona hahelaḡa taudia ida, bona Serubabele Sealtiele, mai varavarana ida, e tore isi, Israel Diravana ena ihaboulaina patana e larebaia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na ia latanai bae hahelaḡadia totona, Dirava ena tau Mose ena taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena.
EZR.3.2.english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

EZR.10.1.motu: Esera e ḡuriḡuriva bona dika e gvaurai hedinaraiva, e taitaiva bona Dirava ena dubu vairanai e goru dihova, Ialonai hegogo bada-hereana, tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, israel idoinai amo na ia dekenai e hebou; badina be taunimanima na e tai dikadikava dainai.
EZR.10.1.english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

EZR.6.9.motu: Bona dahaka ai e dabumu, boromakau natudia mamaruanedia eiava mamoe mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia guba Diravana iboulaina; bona uit bona damena bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, hahelaḡa taudia Ierusalem ai edia dabu heḡereḡeredia, na dina ta ta amo ba henidia, basio reaia;
EZR.6.9.english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

EZR.1.9.motu: Ihagaudia bini: gold naudia toi-ahui, silver naudia daha-ta, kaia ruahui taurahani-ta,
EZR.1.9.english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

EZR.8.32.motu: Ai na Ierusalem ai a kau, bena dina toi unuseni ai a noho.
EZR.8.32.english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

EZR.3.1.motu: Hua ihahituna e kau negana ai, Israel taudia na hanua lalodiai e nohova. Bena taunimanima na Ierusalem ela, e hegogo hebou, tau tamona na heto.
EZR.3.1.english: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

EZR.5.8.motu: Pavapava taumu vada ba diba, ai na Iuda basileiana ala, Dirava badana ena dubu enai. Ia na nadi bada-hereadia amo e haginia bona au na haba ai heheato; ina ḡaukara na e goadalaiamu, bona idia imadia ai anina e varamu.
EZR.5.8.english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

EZR.5.12.motu: A senemai ese guba Diravana e habadua dainai, ia ese Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, tau Kaldea, imana ai e atodia; bena una tau ese ina dubu e ḡiḡia dobi, bona taunimanima na Babulono kahana e laohaidia.
EZR.5.12.english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.

EZR.6.22.motu: Dina hitu lalodiai idia ese se hatubua flaoana ariana e karaia, mai moaledia ida, badina be Iehova ese vada e hamoaledia, bona Asuria pavapavana lalona vada e haloua idia ediai, taunabunai ia ese Dirava, Israel Diravana, ena dubu iḡaukaralaina ai e durudia.
EZR.6.22.english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because Yahweh had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.

EZR.9.6.english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

EZR.1.11.motu: Gold bona silver ḡaudia iboudiai na daha-ima sinahu-hani. Ini iboudiai na Sesebasara ese e daelaidia, e laohaidia idau gabu ai e hanohodia taudia na Babulono amo Ierusalem e hakaudia dae lao negana ai.
EZR.1.11.english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

EZR.8.19.motu: Hasabia danu e hakaua mai, bona ia ida Merari garana tauna ta ladana lesaia, bona varavarana mai natudia ida, tatau ruahui.
EZR.8.19.english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

EZR.7.16.motu: bona silver bona gold idoinai, Babulon tanona iboudiai ba davari gaudia, bona taunimanima bona hahelaḡa taudia edia herahia gaudia, mai lalo-namodia ida vada e gwaurai hamata edia Dirava, Ierusalem ai e nohomu Diravana, ena dubu ena.
EZR.7.16.english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

EZR.9.8.motu: A harihari nega kwadogi ai Iehova, emai Dirava, ese vada e hanamomai, ai kwabukwabumai vada e hanohomai, bona emai hekamo-kau gabuna vada e henimai ena gabu helaḡana lalonai, emai Dirava ese matamai baine hadiaridia bona emai igui ai taina baine hagoadamai totona.
EZR.9.8.english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.

EZR.2.32.english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

EZR.5.17.motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana lalona bema heḡereḡere, pavapava edia pepa e haboumu rumadia Babulono ai lalodiai bae hetahu, bae diba, King Kurese ese hahedua pepana ta e karaia, ina Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihagini-louna e hahedualaia eiava lasi. Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena ura baine hadibalaimai ina kara ai.
EZR.5.17.english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”

EZR.6.5.motu: Ina danu, Dirava ena dubu ena gold bona silver ḡaudia Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem dubuna lalona amo e abi bona Babulono e mailai ḡaudia, na bae heni lou, Ierusalem dubuna bae laohai, bena ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai ma bae ato lou. Dirava ena dubu lalonai bavatodia.
EZR.6.5.english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.

EZR.8.5.motu: Satu garana amo: Sekania lahasiel, bona tatau sinahu-toi ia ida.
EZR.8.5.english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

EZR.2.3.motu: Paroso garana, daha-rua sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua;
EZR.2.3.english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

EZR.8.10.motu: Bani garana amo: Selomiti Iosifia, bona tatau sinahu-ta tauratoi-ahui ia ida.
EZR.8.10.english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

EZR.7.21.motu: Ina danu, lau King Aratasasta ese moni inarina taudia iboudiai Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lalonai, na haḡanimuimu: dahaka dahaka hahelaḡa tauna Esera, guba Diravana ena taravatu itorena tauna, ese emui ai baine gwaurai, vada ba kara balaheni,
EZR.7.21.english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,

EZR.7.1.motu: Una murinai, Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavana, e lohiava negana ai, Esera na e dae lao. Una Esera na Seraia natuna, Seraia na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Hilkia natuna,
EZR.7.1.english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

EZR.2.18.english: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.

EZR.2.64.motu: Hegogo idoinai be taunimanima gerebu-hani daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui;
EZR.2.64.english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

EZR.8.30.motu: Taunabunai hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ese silver bona gold bona ḡau idau-idau metaudia idoinai e abi, eda Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai bae laohai totona.
EZR.8.30.english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

EZR.10.17.motu: ela bona hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai idau hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia iboudiai e davaridia vaitani.
EZR.10.17.english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

EZR.10.2.motu: Bena Sekania, Iehiele natuna, (ia na Elam natuna ta), ese Esera e hereva henia, eto, Eda g vauhamata eda Dirava enai vada ta hamakohia, idau hahinedia ina tano besedia amo vada ta adavadia; ḡau tamona, ena be unu vada ta kara toma to Israel na doini mai ena helaro.
EZR.10.2.english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

EZR.7.10.motu: Badina be Esera ese lalona vada e hadaia, ia ese Iehova ena taravatu baine haeroa bona karana baine karaia, bona ena taravatu bona ena hahedua herevadia na Israel ai baine hahedibalai.
EZR.7.10.english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

EZR.3.5.motu: Una murinai idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia loulouva, hua matamata bouboudia bona Iehova ena aria negadia korikoridia bouboudia, bona ta ta edia lalo-namo bouboudia, Iehova e heni ḡaudia, iboudiai danu.
EZR.3.5.english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of Yahweh that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to Yahweh.

EZR.3.6.motu: Hua ihahituna dinana gini-gunana ai idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia matama, Iehova ena. A Iehova ena dubu badina na do asie hadaia.
EZR.3.6.english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh; but the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was not yet laid.

EZR.3.4.motu: Bona kalaga ariana e karaia, e torea heḡereḡerena, bona dina ta ta amo ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia hahidaosi e hahelaḡadia, taravatu ese dina ta ta ahudia e gwaurai heḡereḡerena.
EZR.3.4.english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

EZR.6.20.motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na sibodia vada e hahegoeva hebou; idia iboudiai na goḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva. Taunabunai idia ese lagau-hanai mamoedia e ala mase, noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia iboudiai edia, bona bamodia hahelaḡa taudia edia, bona idia sibodia edia.
EZR.6.20.english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

EZR.9.11.motu: Unu haheḡani na emu hesiai peroveta taudia edia amo o henimai, oto, O raka vareaimu bona bo ḡaunaiamu tanona na miro, tano taudia edia kara mirodia daidiai; edia kara dika-hereadia ese edia miro amo vada e hahonua, duduna ela bona duduna.
EZR.9.11.english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.

EZR.8.16.motu: Bena Eliesere, Ariele, Semaia, Elnatan, Iaribi, Elnatan, Natan, Sekaria bona Mesulama, orea igunalaina taudia, bona loiaribi bona Elnatan, lalo-parara taudia, na boiridia;
EZR.8.16.english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

EZR.5.5.motu: A Iuda tau-badadia na edia Dirava ese e raraidia tao, bena asie hadokodia, ela bona harina na Darauese enai baine kau, bena iena haere na revareva amo bae davaria.
EZR.5.5.english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

EZR.6.1.motu: Bena King Darauese e hahedua; bena Babulono tanona ai e hetahu, basileia pepadia e habou rumadia lalodiai.
EZR.6.1.english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.

EZR.2.1.motu: Iuda tanona taudia bini, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese vada e abidia mauri, Babulono tanona vada e laohaidia, bena edia noho-hedoa amo ma e dae lao. Idia na Ierusalem bona Iuda e lou lao, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela.
EZR.2.1.english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

EZR.6.8.motu: Ina danu na haganimuimu, ene Iuda tau-badadia na ini ba durudia toma, hari Dirava ena dubu ihagini-louna ai: davana idoinai na ene tatau ba henidia ḡuḡuru haraḡa, pavapava ena moni, hari Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana ena heaiva ḡauna, amo.
EZR.6.8.english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

EZR.6.15.motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina ihatauratoina ai, hua ladana Adara ena dina ihatoina ai, una dubu e haḡuḡurua.
EZR.6.15.english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

EZR.1.1.motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva Ieremia uduna amo e gwauraia na anina baine vara totona Iehova ese Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, e rohea; bena ia ese haheḡani ta e gwauraia ena basileia idoinai laionai, bona e torea danu.
EZR.1.1.english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

EZR.2.58.motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia na sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui rua.
EZR.2.58.english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

EZR.10.4.motu: A tore isi, badina be ina na oiemu ḡaukara, bona ai na oi ida; ba goada, ba karaia.
EZR.10.4.english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

EZR.2.27.english: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

EZR.2.38.motu: Pasahuru garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua hari-ahui hitu;
EZR.2.38.english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

EZR.6.21.motu: Israel taudia noho-hedoa amo vada e lou ese e ani, bona idia ida e hebou bona una tano taudia edia kara mirodia vada e rakatani, Iehova, Israel Diravana, bae toma henia diho totona, taudia iboudiai danu.
EZR.6.21.english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, ate,

EZR.2.40.motu: Levi taudia: lesua bona Kadmiele garadia (idia na Hodavia garana), hituahui hani.
EZR.2.40.english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

EZR.8.23.motu: Taunabunai ai na a anivaga, bona eda Dirava unu a noia toma; bena ia ese emai noinoi e hakala henia.
EZR.8.23.english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

EZR.8.2.motu: Fineha garana amo: Geresom. Itamara garana amo: Daniel. David garana amo: Hatusu;
EZR.8.2.english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom.

EZR.2.46.motu: Hagaba garana, Samalai garana, Hanana garana,
EZR.2.46.english: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

EZR.2.17.english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.

EZR.10.44.motu: Ini iboudiai ese idau hahine e adavadia, bena mai natudia ida e hadihodia.
EZR.10.44.english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

EZR.8.17.motu: bena na siaidia lao, Ido, gabu ladana Kasifia ikwarana tauna dekenai, bona na hamaorodia, hari Ido bona tadikakana, dubu ena hesiai taudia, ede bae hereva henidia toma, gabu ladana Kasifia ai. Herevana binai: idia ese eda Dirava ena dubu ena hesiai taudia na dekemai ai bae siaidia mai. I
EZR.8.17.english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

EZR.8.15.motu: Ahava e aru laomu sinavaina badinai na haboudia, bona dina toi unuseni ai a taruha. Taunimanima bona hahelaḡa taudia na nenedia negana ai, asi tauna ta unuseni ai Levi garana amo.
EZR.8.15.english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

EZR.8.22.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana inoina na hemarai, emai raka dalana ai tuari taudia bona hosi-gui taudia oreana ta ese inaimai edia amo baine gimamai: badina be ai ese hanua pavapavana vada a hamaoroa, ato “Emai Dirava imana na namo, ia e tahuamu taudia iboudiai latadiai, bona ena badu siahuna ese iena amo e raka ohomu taudia na e inai henidiamu”.
EZR.8.22.english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

EZR.4.5.motu: bona hahealo taudia haida davadia e kara, edia ura ḡaukarana bae laoa ahu, Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena dina iboudiai, ela bona Darauese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia negana.
EZR.4.5.english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

EZR.4.11.motu: E siaia revarevana lalonai e tore herevadia bini:
EZR.4.11.english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent:

EZR.1.3.motu: Daika daika umui bogaragimui ai na iena bese tauna, Iehova, ia ena Dirava, ese baine bamoa. Ia na Ierusalem, Iuda tanona ai, baine dae lao, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu baine haginia lou. Ia na Ierusalem ai e nohomu Diravana.
EZR.1.3.english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

EZR.2.62.motu: Unu na ladadia e tahu, uru ladadia bukadia ai, to asie davaridia; una dainai hahelaḡa dagina amo e atodia tabe, idia na dia ḡoḡoeva dainai.
EZR.2.62.english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

EZR.2.68.motu: Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai e kau negana ai, iduhu kwaradia haida ese lalo-namo herahiadia e heni, Dirava ena dubu ena, gabuna korikorina ai baine gini helaoreana.
EZR.2.68.english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

EZR.7.4.motu: Meraioto na Serahia natuna, Serahia na Usisi natuna, Usisi na Buki natuna,
EZR.7.4.english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

EZR.10.3.motu: Taunabunai, ita ese eda Dirava aita gwau henia hamata, ini hahine iboudiai mai natudia ida, baita hadihodia, egu lohia, bona eda Dirava ena haheḡani dainai kudoudia e hetahamu taudia, edia hahealo heḡereḡerena; bena karana baita karaia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
EZR.10.3.english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

EZR.9.14.motu: mato, ai na emu haheḡani baia tata utu lou, bona hari kara dika-hereadia e karamu taudia ida ma baia headava hanai a? Basioma badu henimai ela bona boma habuamai tari, bena kwabukwabuna ta eiava roho-maurina ta basinema noho, a?
EZR.9.14.english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?

EZR.8.27.motu: bona gold kibokibodia, davadia na dariki daha-ta; bona auri labora-labora namo-hereana bona kimore-kimorena, davana na gold davana ida heḡereḡere, ḡaudia rua.
EZR.8.27.english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

EZR.2.53.motu: Barako garana, Sisera garana, Tema garana,
EZR.2.53.english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

EZR.10.23.motu: Levi oreana amo: Iosabad, Simei, Kelaia (ladana ta Kelita), Petahia, Iuda, Eliesere.
EZR.10.23.english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

EZR.5.9.motu: Bena ai ese unu tau-badadia na ini a nanadaidia toma, ato, Daika ese hahedua e henimui, ina dubu ba haginia bona maḡuna ba ha-ahua?
EZR.5.9.english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

EZR.8.21.motu: Bena anivaga ta na gwauraia, hari Ahava sinavaina badibadinai, eda Dirava vairanai baia hahemanau bona dala maoromaorona ta iena amo baia tahua, ai emai bona natumai edia bona emai ḡau iboudiai ediai.
EZR.8.21.english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

EZR.1.6.motu: bona dekedia taudia iboudiai ese silver ḡaudia bona gold bona kohu bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia bona dava-bada ḡaudia na e henidia, mai edia lalo-namo herahiadia iboudiai ida.
EZR.1.6.english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

EZR.2.15.english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

EZR.8.29.motu: Ba gimadia bona ba baladia heni, ela bona hahelaḡa taudia badadia bona Levi taudia bona Israel iduhu kwaradia vairadiai ba hahetohodia, Ierusalem ai, Iehova ena dubu daiutudia lalodiai.
EZR.8.29.english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”

EZR.1.10.motu: gold kibokibodia toi-ahui, silver kibokibodia idaudia sinahu-hani gwauta, bona ma ḡau idau-idau daha-ta danu.
EZR.1.10.english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

GAL.3.14.motu: Taunabunai, Abraham e hanamolaia hahenamona na bese idau-idau taudia ese Keriso Iesu dainai do bae davaria; bona ita ese kamonai dainai e gwauraia hamata Laumana baita abia.
GAL.3.14.english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

GAL.3.8.motu: Buka Helaḡa danu vada e gwauraia guna, Dirava ese bese idau-idau taudia kamonai dainai maorodia baine gwaurai; bena sivarai namo Abraham e henia guna, eto,
GAL.3.8.english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” + 3:8 Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18

GAL.4.1.motu: Lau na tomamu tau ta dihina, ena be ia na ḡau iboudiai biagudia, to merona negana ai ia be hesiai merona na heto;
GAL.4.1.english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

GAL.5.19.motu: Tau-anina ena kara na hehedinararai. Gaudia bini: heuda-hanai, kara mirodia, mata-bodaga,
GAL.5.19.english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

GAL.2.17.motu: A ita na Keriso dainai maoroda igwauraidia ta tahuamu negana ai ta kara dikamu, unu amo Keriso na kara dika ikahalaina tauna ai e laomu a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
GAL.2.17.english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

GAL.3.21.motu: O, taravatu ese Dirava ena gwauhamata e laoa ahumu a? Lasi vaitani. Badina be taravatu bema mai siahuna mauri ihavarana, kara maoromaoro na taravatu amo bema vara.
GAL.3.21.english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

GAL.6.17.motu: Ina murinai, tau ta ese basine hamareregu, badina be biagugu Iesu ena kipara na kopigu ai e miamu.
GAL.6.17.english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

GAL.2.18.motu: Badina be na kurea dobi ḡauna bama haginia lou, lau na kara havara taugu ai bama lao.
GAL.2.18.english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

GAL.4.11.motu: Lau na umui daimui ai na garimu, vada na hekwarahilaimui kava na garina.
GAL.4.11.english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

GAL.3.24.motu: Taunabunai, taravatu na hereḡu tauna na heto, ema bona Keriso eme kau, kamonai dainai maoroda bae gwaurai helaoreana.
GAL.3.24.english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

GAL.4.22.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ini e torea loma: Abraham natuna na rarua; ta be hesiai hahinena natuna, a ta be ura-kwalimu hahinena natuna.
GAL.4.22.english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

GAL.2.8.motu: Badina be Petro na peritome taudia edia aposetolo ai e halaoa Tauna ese lau danu bese idau-idau taudia edia aposetolo ai e halaogu.
GAL.2.8.english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
