GAL.6.5.motu: Badina be ta ta ena maduna ena maduna bae hua.
GAL.6.5.english: For each man will bear his own burden.

GAL.1.4.motu: Ia ese sibona e heni, eda kara dika daidiai, ina tanobada ena dika amo baine hamaurida helaoreana, Tamada Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena.
GAL.1.4.english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

GAL.4.21.motu: Umui taravatu henunai ba noho o tomu taumui, ba hamaorogu, taravatu asio kamonai heniamu a?
GAL.4.21.english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

GAL.4.20.motu: Harihari umui dekemui ai bama noho, ere idauna ai bama hereva, bema namo; badina be lalogu na e hekwarahimu umui daimui ai.
GAL.4.20.english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

GAL.4.7.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava dainai oi na dia hesiai tauna, to natuna; bona dia natuna mo, to dihina danu.
GAL.4.7.english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

GAL.4.24.motu: Una na hereva heḡereḡerena: unu hahine raruosi na herohemaino ruaosi heḡereḡeredia. Ta be Sinai ororona amo ema, hesiai memerodia e havaradia: una na Hagara.
GAL.4.24.english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

GAL.1.3.motu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo avabi.
GAL.1.3.english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

GAL.5.17.motu: Tau-anina ese laumal baine laoa ahu e tomamu, bonalauma ese tau-anina baine laoa ahu e tomamu; badina be ruaosi e heinai hehenimu. Una dainai emui ura karadia asio karamu.
GAL.5.17.english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

GAL.3.19.motu: Benaini, taravatu be dahaka? Kara havara dainai e haginia, baine mia ela bona e gwauraia hamata garana baine vara; aneru ese e gwauraia, herohemaino tauna ese e mailaia.
GAL.3.19.english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

GAL.3.25.motu: A harihari kamonai vada eme kau, taunabunai ita na dia tau ta ena hereḡu ai.
GAL.3.25.english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

GAL.1.22.motu: A Keriso ena ekalesia taudia Iudea ai na vairagu asi dibadia,
GAL.1.22.english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

GAL.3.22.motu: A Buka Helaḡa ese taunimanima iboudiai kara dika ai vada e koudia, Iesu Keriso iabiabiraina gwauhamatana na kamonai taudia ese bae abia helaoreana?
GAL.3.22.english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

GAL.1.20.motu: Dirava hari dibana ini na tore henimuimu herevadia na dia koikoi.
GAL.1.20.english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

GAL.1.10.motu: Lau ese taunimanima ihamoaledia na tahuamu eiava Dirava ihamoalena na tahuamu a? Taunimanima lalodia ihanamodia na tahuamu a? Lau ese taunimanima bama hamoaledia, Keriso isiaina basinama lao heni.
GAL.1.10.english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

GAL.1.14.motu: Iuda taudia edia ḡuriḡuri karadia ai egu uru taudia bona egu bese taudia na hereadiava; sene karadia na goadalai dikadikava.
GAL.1.14.english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

GAL.3.7.motu: Benaini, vada na diba, kamonai taudia na Abraham natuna ai baela.
GAL.3.7.english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

GAL.3.29.motu: Umui Keriso ena dainai, umui danu Abraham garana bona gwauhamata dihina.
GAL.3.29.english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

GAL.6.2.motu: Umui ta ta emui maduna ba hehua heheni; unu amo Keriso ena haheḡani ba badinaia.
GAL.6.2.english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

GAL.1.17.motu: Bona aposetolo-gunadia Ierusalem ai danu dekedia asinala, a Arabia nala, bena Damasko na lou henia.
GAL.1.17.english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

GAL.4.31.motu: Benaini, varavaragu e, ita na dia hesiai hahinena natuna; ita be urakwalimu hahinena natuna.
GAL.4.31.english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

GAL.5.6.motu: Badina be Iesu Keriso enai peritome bona asi peritome ruaosi na asi anidia, a abidadama mo, uraheni ai e ḡaukaramu.
GAL.5.6.english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

GAL.4.15.motu: Emui hahenamo be edeseni ai? Lau dibagu una negana ai, bema mai dalana, umui ese matamui boma vai lasi, boma henigu.
GAL.4.15.english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

GAL.6.6.motu: E hadibadia taudia ese edia ḡau namodia ai hahediba tauna bae ahulaia.
GAL.6.6.english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

GAL.4.6.motu: Bona umui na ia natuna dainai, Dirava ese Natuna ena Lauma ita laloda ai vada eme siaia; bena e lolomu, e tomu, “Aba e, Tamamai e”.
GAL.4.6.english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

GAL.4.17.motu: Idia ese e ura henimuimu, to lalodia na dia mamaoro; e uramu ai emai amo bae laimui oho, bena umui ese idia ba ura henidia.
GAL.4.17.english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

GAL.6.13.motu: Idia ese peritome e abiamu, ḡau tamona taravatu asie badinaiamu; to e uramu umui hari peritome bavabia, taumui bae heaḡilai helaoreana.
GAL.6.13.english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

GAL.6.7.motu: Basio laloa kerere: Dirava na basita koia diba. Taunimanima e hadomu ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia mo bae abi.
GAL.6.7.english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

GAL.2.12.motu: Badina be haida Iakobo ena amo do asiela negana ai, ia na idau bese taudia ida e aniani hebouva; a idia ela negana ai, ia e raka muri, idau bese taudia edia amo e raka oho, peritome taudia garidia.
GAL.2.12.english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

GAL.1.18.motu: Laḡani toi e ore, bena Petro itana Ierusalem nala, boi gwauta-ima ia ida a nohova.
GAL.1.18.english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

GAL.3.16.motu: Benaini, gwauhamata na Abraham mai garana ida edia. Asineto “Garamu loḡora ida”. Hutuma se gwauraidia; a tamona mo e gwauraia, eto “Garamu idat”. Una na Keriso.
GAL.3.16.english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, + 3:16 Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 24:7 which is Christ.

GAL.5.5.motu: A ai ese kara maoromaoro helarona a nariamu, Lauma ikamonai-henina dainai.
GAL.5.5.english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

GAL.3.17.motu: Egu lalo-hadai binai: Dirava ena gwauhamata gunana na laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui muridiai e vara taravatuna ese se taoa tari, asi anina ḡauna ai se halaoa.
GAL.3.17.english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

GAL.1.9.motu: Hata vada na gwauraia, harihari ma na gwauraia loumu, Ḡau ta ese sivarai idauna baine harorolai henimui, dia o abia dae gunava heḡereḡerena, ia na baine baia.
GAL.1.9.english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

GAL.2.11.motu: A Pelro na Antioka ela negana ai, lau ese na gwau henia, badina be ia na e kerere.
GAL.2.11.english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

GAL.2.13.motu: Iuda taudia oredia danu ia ida unu e koikoi tomava; bona Banaba danu edia koikoi ese e hahekwakwanaia.
GAL.2.13.english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

GAL.5.20.motu: kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia, babalau, heai, heatu, mama, badu, gogosi, heiri-heiri, hahediba koikoi herevadia,
GAL.5.20.english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

GAL.3.23.motu: A Iesu iabiabiraina do sema negana ai, taravatu ese e dogoda tao, e kouda ahu, ema bona do baine hedinarai abidadamana e kau.
GAL.3.23.english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

GAL.3.15.motu: Varavaragu e, taunimanima edia kara na gwauraimu: tau ta baine gwauhamata, bena ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania; basine taoa tari, bona basine ha-idaua.
GAL.3.15.english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

GAL.2.16.motu: a ai dibamai tau ta taravatu ibadinana dainai maorona basie gwauraia, a Iesu Keriso ikamonai-henina mo dainai. Taunabunai, ita ese Keriso Iesu ta kamonai henia, bena maoroda bae gwaurai, Keriso ikamonai-henina dainai, dia taravatu ibadinana dainai; badina be taravatu ibadinana dainai tau ta maorona basie gwauraia.
GAL.2.16.english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

GAL.6.12.motu: Ina tanobadl ena hahenamo bae abia urana e uramu taudia ese e haḡanimuimu, peritome bavabia e tomu, badina korikori be Keriso ena satauro dainai taunimanima ese bae daḡedaḡe henidia na garina.
GAL.6.12.english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

GAL.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, aposetolo taugu, (dagi na dia taunimanima edia amo eiava tau ta dainai asina abia, to Keriso dainai, bona Tamada, Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana, dainai na abia),
GAL.1.1.english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

GAL.4.23.motu: Hesiai hahinena natuna na tau-anina ena kara ai e vara, a ura-kwalimu hahinena natuna na gwau-hamata dainai e vara.
GAL.4.23.english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

GAL.1.23.motu: harigu mo e kamonai, eto “Gunaguna e daḡedaḡe henidava tauna ese sivarai namo e harorolaiamu; eda abidadama baine ha-orea e tomava, a harihari e harorolaiamu”.
GAL.1.23.english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

GAL.5.4.motu: Taravatu ibadinana dainai maoromui bae gwaurai o tomu taumui na asi ahumui Keriso enai; Dirava ena harihari-bada vada o morutania.
GAL.5.4.english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

GAL.2.19.motu: Badina be taravatu dainai vada na mase taravatu enai, Dirava enai baina mauri helaoreana.
GAL.2.19.english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

GAL.5.21.motu: heḡahusi, kekero, lebulebu; bona kara unuhetomadia iboudiai. Na hamaoromuiva, bona harihari ma na hamaoromui loumu, unu e kara tomamu taudia ese Dirava ena basileia basie abia.
GAL.5.21.english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

GAL.3.5.motu: Lauma e henimuimu bona bogaragimui ai hoa karadia e karamu Diravana ese taravatu ibadinana dainai eiava sivarai namo iabi-daena dainai e karamu a?
GAL.3.5.english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

GAL.3.11.motu: Bona tau ta taravatu dainai maorona basie gwauraia Dirava vairanai; ina na eme hedinarai, badina be kamonai dainai kara maoromaoro tauna baine mauri.
GAL.3.11.english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” + 3:11 Habakkuk 2:4

GAL.6.18.motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada lalomui ai baine mia. Amen.
GAL.6.18.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

GAL.2.4.motu: Varavara koikoidia haida e vareai hehuni, emai ura-kwalimu Keriso Iesu ena amo bae hasinadoa, bena bae ḡuimai lou eto.
GAL.2.4.english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

GAL.6.10.motu: Taunabunai, dala baita davaria negadia ai, taunimanima iboudiai baita kara namo henidia; a ekalesia taudia na baita hanamodia herea.
GAL.6.10.english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

GAL.4.5.motu: taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia baine hamauridia bona ita na ia natuna ai baitala totona.
GAL.4.5.english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

GAL.6.14.motu: A lau ese ḡau ta basina heaḡilaia, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena satauro mo sibona; ia bagunai tanobada vada e hasatauroa egu ai, bona lau vada e hasataurogu tanobada enai.
GAL.6.14.english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

GAL.3.28.motu: Badina be umui na dia Iuda taumui, dia Helene taumui, dia hesiai taumui, dia ura-kwalimu taumui, dia mamaruane, dia hahine; a ibouboumui ai tamona mo, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
GAL.3.28.english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

GAL.1.12.motu: Taunimanima edia amo asina abia; idia ese asie hadibagu; a Iesu Keriso ese lalogu ai e hahedinaraia.
GAL.1.12.english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

GAL.3.4.motu: Hisi diaḡau o aniva na asi anidia a? Reana mai anina.
GAL.3.4.english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

GAL.5.13.motu: Varavaragu e, vada e boirimui, ura-kwalimu taudia ai baola. Ḡau tamona, emui ura-kwalimu na tau-aninlui ihamoaledia ḡauna ai basio halaoa; a lalokau dainai ta ta isiaimui ba helao heheni.
GAL.5.13.english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

GAL.1.24.motu: Bena lau daigu ai idia ese Dirava e hanamoa.
GAL.1.24.english: So they glorified God in me.

GAL.5.16.motu: A lau na tomamu, Lauma ena dala ai ba raka, bena tau-anina ena ura basio karaia.
GAL.5.16.english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

GAL.4.19.motu: Natugu e, hisi na animu, hekamonai hisidia na heto, ela bona Keriso na lalomui ai baine vara.
GAL.4.19.english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

GAL.2.9.motu: Taunabunai, Iakobo bona Petro bona Ioane (idia be ekalesia duna e gwauraidiava taudia) vada dibadia harihari-bada lau danu vada e henigu. Bena idia ese lau bona Banaba imamai e abi, hetura toana; ai raruosi bese idau-idau taudia dekedia baiala eto, a idia be peritome taudia dekedia baela;
GAL.2.9.english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

GAL.4.14.motu: Ḡau tamona asio dadaraigu bona asio ihi-ihiraigu egu gorere daimai: o abigu dae, Dirava ena aneru na heto, eiava Keriso Iesu na heto.
GAL.4.14.english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

GAL.4.29.motu: A unu dinadia ai heḡereḡerena tau-anina ena kara ai e vara merona ese Lauma ena amo e vara merona e daḡedaḡe heniava, harihari danu unu mo heto.
GAL.4.29.english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

GAL.3.20.motu: Herohemaino na dia kaha tamona basine herohemaino; a Dirava be tamona.
GAL.3.20.english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

GAL.3.2.motu: Ina mo ba hamaorolaigu: taravatu ibadinana dainai eiava sivarai namo iabi-daena dainai Lauma o abia?
GAL.3.2.english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

GAL.5.7.motu: Umui na gunaguna o heau namonamova. Daika ese e laomui ahu, bena hereva momokani asio badinaia a?
GAL.5.7.english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

GAL.2.6.motu: A haridia namodia taudia (edia dagi na herevana, asina laloamu; Dirava ese taunimanima toadia se lalomu) ḡau matamatana ta asie henigu.
GAL.2.6.english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

GAL.2.5.motu: To ai na asia manoka, bona hora ta ai asia kamonai henidia, lasi ona lasi vaitani; sivarai namo ena hereva momokani dekemui ai bae mia helaoreana.
GAL.2.5.english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

GAL.2.2.motu: Lalogu ai e hedinarai herevana dainai nala. Haridia namodia taudia ida sibomai a hebouva, bena lau ese sivarai namo bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai na harorolaiamu herevana na hamaorolaidia, egu ḡaukara na karaiava bona na karaiamu bema asi anina na garina.
GAL.2.2.english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

GAL.4.16.motu: Be, hereva momokani na hamaoromuimu dainai, inaimui ai vada nala a?
GAL.4.16.english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

GAL.5.1.motu: Keriso ese vada e ruhada nege, ura-kwalimu tauda ai baitala: ba gini tutuka-tutuka, bae ḡuimui lou na garina.
GAL.5.1.english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

GAL.5.9.motu: Hatubu muramurana sina taina ese taba idoinai e hatubuamu.
GAL.5.9.english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

GAL.5.23.motu: manau boga-auka; kara unuhetomadia na asi taravatudia.
GAL.5.23.english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

GAL.1.11.motu: Varavaragu e, na hamaoromuimu, sivarai namo na harorolaiamu na dia taunimanima edia.
GAL.1.11.english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

GAL.3.6.motu: Abraham heḡereḡerena: ia ese Dirava e abidadama henia, bena maorona e gwauraia.
GAL.3.6.english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.” + 3:6 Genesis 15:6

GAL.5.11.motu: Varavaragu e, peritome doini bama harorolaia, doini e daḡedaḡe henigumu badina be dahaka? Unu bema heto, satauro ena hekwakwanai bema lasi.
GAL.5.11.english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

GAL.2.10.motu: ḡau tamona, ogoḡami taudia baia lalodia eto. Karana bina vada na goadalaiamu.
GAL.2.10.english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

GAL.3.1.motu: Galatia taumui e, kavakava taumui, daika ese ena mea amo e koimuimu? Umui vairamui ai vada eme hedinarai: Iesu Keriso e hasatauroa
GAL.3.1.english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

GAL.4.25.motu: Hari Hagara be Sinai ororona ladana ta, Arabia tanona ai: ia na ina harihari e miamu Ierusalemana heḡereḡerena; mai natuna ida hesiai iḡuidia ai e nohomu.
GAL.4.25.english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

GAL.2.14.motu: A lau ese na itadia, idia na asie raka maoromaoro, bona sivarai namo ena hereva asie badinaia, bena Petro na gwau henia, idia iboudiai vairadiai, nato “Oi na tau luda, a idau bese taudia heḡereḡeredia o nohomu, dia Iuda taudia heḡereḡeredia; matona, idau bese taudia o haḡanidiamu, Iuda taudia heḡereḡeredia bae noho o tomu”.
GAL.2.14.english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

GAL.3.3.motu: Umui na kakava a? Lauma enai o matamaia, a tau-anina enai o haḡuḡuruamu a?
GAL.3.3.english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

GAL.2.20.motu: Lau na Keriso ida vada e hasataurogu; ḡau tamona, na maurimu, a dia lau, to Keriso hari lau lalogu ai e maurimu. Bona egu mauri, tau-anigu ai na maurimu, na Dirava Natuna na abidadama heniamu dainai na maurimu. Ia ese e ura henigu bona sibona e heni, lau daigu ai.
GAL.2.20.english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

GAL.5.10.motu: Lau na Lohiabada ladana ai na abidadama henimuimu, lalomui basio hadai idau; a e haraivamuimu tauna ese gwauna do baine huaia.
GAL.5.10.english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

GAL.2.7.motu: A sivarai namo Petro e henia, e peritomedia taudia baine harorolai henidia, heḡereḡerena sivarai namo lau e henigu, asie peritomedia taudia baina harorolai henidia.
GAL.2.7.english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

GAL.3.12.motu: Bona taravatu na kamonai amo se varamu, a ikarana tauna hari ena kara dainai baine mauri.
GAL.3.12.english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” + 3:12 Leviticus 18:5

GAL.1.8.motu: A ai ese, eiava guba aneruna ese, sivarai idauna baiama harorolaia, dia a harorolaia gunava ḡauna heḡereḡerena ai baiama baia.
GAL.1.8.english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

GAL.4.13.motu: Dibamui lau na nega gunana ai gorere dainai sivarai namo na harorolai henimui.
GAL.4.13.english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

GAL.4.26.motu: A atai ai e miamu Ierusalemana na urakwalimu hanuana; ita sinada bunai.
GAL.4.26.english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

GAL.1.19.motu: Aposetolo idaudia haida asina itadia, lakobo, Lohiabada tadina, mo sibona.
GAL.1.19.english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

GAL.5.22.motu: A Lauma huahuana binai: lalokau, moale, maino, haheauka, hebogahisi, kara maoromaoro, hereva ibadinana,
GAL.5.22.english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

GAL.6.11.motu: Mani egu revareva ba itaia, vada na torea badabada.
GAL.6.11.english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

GAL.6.3.motu: Badina be ta sibona baineto “Lau na namo”, a ḡau be dia namo, sibona e hekoimu.
GAL.6.3.english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

GAL.6.16.motu: Ini e raka tomamu taudia latadiai bona Dirava ena Israel latanai maino bona hebogahisi bae mia.
GAL.6.16.english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

GAL.5.14.motu: Badina be taravatu idoinai na hereva tamona ai e haboua. Herevana binai: Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena.
GAL.5.14.english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” + 5:14 Leviticus 19:18

GAL.1.16.motu: ia Natuna lau lalogu ai e hahedinaraia, idau bese taudia bogaragidiai ia baina harorolaia helaoreana: una negana ai lau na tau ta ida asia henega.
GAL.1.16.english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

GAL.1.13.motu: Gunaguna na karava karadia sivaraidia vada o kamonai, Iuda taudia edia orea ai na nohova ai na Durava ena ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava, na hadikaiava.
GAL.1.13.english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

GAL.4.8.motu: Gunaguna, Dirava asi dibamui negana ai, umui ese dirava koikoidia isiaidia o lao heniva.
GAL.4.8.english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

GAL.5.2.motu: Ba Ialoa: lau Paulo ese na hamaoromuimu, na tomu, peritome boma abia, ahumui bema lasi Keriso enai.
GAL.5.2.english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

GAL.4.3.motu: Ita danu unuheto: maraḡida negadia ai tanobada ena ḡaruḡaru herevadia ese hesiai iḡuidia ai e dogoda taova;
GAL.4.3.english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

GAL.4.10.motu: Dina bona hua bona aria negadia bona laḡani o badinamu.
GAL.4.10.english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

GAL.3.9.motu: Taunabunai, kamonai taudia na Abraham, kamonai tauna, ida bae namo bou.
GAL.3.9.english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

GAL.1.7.motu: Ḡau tamona dia sivarai idauna, a haida ese e haturiamuimu, bona e uramu danu Keriso ena sivarai namo bae hagagevaia.
GAL.1.7.english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

GAL.2.15.motu: Ai be Iuda taumai korikori, dia kara dika taudia idau bese amo;
GAL.2.15.english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

GAL.5.24.motu: Keriso Iesu ena orea taudia ese tau-anidia, mai edia hekise-hekise bona edia ura dikadia ida, vada e hasataurodia.
GAL.5.24.english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

GAL.3.13.motu: Taravatu ena hahedika amo Keriso ese vada e hamaurida; ia be dika tauna ai ela, ita iboloda. Badina be Buka Helaḡa ai vada e torea, eto, Au ai e taudia dae taudia iboudiai vada e dika.
GAL.3.13.english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” + 3:13 Deuteronomy 21:23

GAL.3.27.motu: Badina be Keriso ladana ai e bapatisomui taumui iboumui ai ese Keriso vada o hahedokilaia.
GAL.3.27.english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

GAL.1.2.motu: bona e bamogu taudia iboudiai, Galatia ekalesia oreadia taumui a tore henimuimu, atomu,
GAL.1.2.english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

GAL.4.12.motu: Varavaragu e, na nolmuimu, umui lau ida baita heḡereḡere, badina be lau na umui ida vada na heḡereḡere. Umui ese asio hadikagu.
GAL.4.12.english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

GAL.6.15.motu: Badina be peritome bona asi peritome na asi anidia; a vara matamata hari.
GAL.6.15.english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

GAL.1.21.motu: Unu amo Suna bona Kilikia kahadia nala.
GAL.1.21.english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

GAL.6.1.motu: Varavaragu e, tau ta kerere ese baine butua tao, umui lauma ikamonaina taumui ese ba hakaua lou, mai manaumui ida. Nahuamu danu ba tohoa, hedibaḡani ese oi danu baine butumu tao na garina.
GAL.6.1.english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

GAL.5.26.motu: Basita hekokoroku; basita heai heheni; basita heḡahusi heheni.
GAL.5.26.english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

GAL.2.21.motu: Dirava ena harihari-bada na asina dadaraiamu; badina be kara maoromaoro na taravatu amo bema vara, Keriso ena mase bema asi anina.
GAL.2.21.english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

GAL.4.18.motu: Kara namo iura-henina dainai ba ura henigu na nega idoidiai namo, dia dekemui ai na nohomu negadia ai mo.
GAL.4.18.english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

GAL.3.10.motu: Taravatu ibadinana e abidadama heniamu taudia iboudiai na heuduguirai henunai e nohomu, badina be ini e torea toma: Taravatu bukana ai e tore herevadia iboudiai basie badina taudia na bae uduguiraidia.
GAL.3.10.english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” + 3:10 Deuteronomy 27:26

GAL.4.30.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ede e torea toma?
GAL.4.30.english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” + 4:30 Genesis 21:10

GAL.4.2.motu: ia na hahediba taudia bona heregu taudia henudiai, ela bona tamana ese e gwauraia guna negana baine kau.
GAL.4.2.english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

GAL.1.15.motu: A sinagu bogana amo e hahelagagu bona ena harihari-bada ai e boirigu Diravana ese ena ura negana ai
GAL.1.15.english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

GAL.3.18.motu: Ahu iabina bema taravatu dainai, gwauhamata bema herevana; a Dirava ese gwauhamata amo Abraham e henia.
GAL.3.18.english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

GAL.4.4.motu: a nega vada e ḡuḡuru, Dirava ese ia Natuna e siaia, hahine bogana ai e vara, taravatu henunai danu e vara,
GAL.4.4.english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

GAL.4.28.motu: Varavaragu e, umui na gwauhamata memeromui, Isaak heḡereḡerena.
GAL.4.28.english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

GAL.2.3.motu: Bamogu ta, Tito, na Helene tauna, to iperitomena asie haḡanilaia.
GAL.2.3.english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

GAL.5.12.motu: Lau na uramu e haraivamuimu taudia na sibodia bema heutu oho.
GAL.5.12.english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

GAL.5.25.motu: Lauma dainai ta maurimu; taunabunai, Lauma dainai baita raka.
GAL.5.25.english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

GAL.4.9.motu: A harihari umui na Dirava dibamui, Dirava danu dibana umui. Matona, tanobada ena ḡaruḡaru herevadia mamoka-manokadia bona kavakavadia ma o lou henidiamu, bae dogomui tao luo o tomu a?
GAL.4.9.english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

GAL.5.15.motu: A ba hekori heheni bona ba heani heheni nahuamui ba loho, sibomui ba haheore na garina.
GAL.5.15.english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

GAL.5.3.motu: Momokani, na hamaoromui loumu, na tomu, peritome bae abia taudia ese taravatu karadia iboudiai bae badina.
GAL.5.3.english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

GAL.3.26.motu: Badina be umui iboumui ai be Dirava natuna, Keriso Iesu o abiabiraiamu dainai.
GAL.3.26.english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

GAL.1.6.motu: Lau na hoamu, badina be umui ese Keriso ena harihari-bada lalonai na boirimui taugu vada o rakatanigu haraga, sivarai idauna o lao heniamu.
GAL.1.6.english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

GAL.2.1.motu: Laḡani gwauta-hani e ore murinai Ierusalem nala; Banaba bona Tito ese e bamogu.
GAL.2.1.english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

GAL.6.4.motu: Ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara bae diba, a bamona ena basine diba, unu amo sibona ena ḡaukara baine heaḡilaia.
GAL.6.4.english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

GAL.1.5.english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

GAL.5.8.motu: Lalo-ani herevadia na dia e boirimui tauna ena amo se vasi.
GAL.5.8.english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

GAL.5.18.motu: A lauma ese baine hakaumui negana ai, umui na dia taravatu henunai.
GAL.5.18.english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

GAL.6.9.motu: Kara namo ikarana basita hesikulaia; badina be bema ita basita manoka, bena nega namona ai huahuada baita abi.
GAL.6.9.english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

GAL.6.8.motu: Tau-anina ena e hadoamu tauna ese tau-anina ena mase baine abia. Lauma ena e hadoamu tauna ese Lauma ena mauri hanaihanai baine abia.
GAL.6.8.english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

GEN.2.7.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese taunimanima tano ḡahuna amo e karaia, mauri laḡana ia uduna matudia ai e hahoho dobi, taunimanima na mauri tauna ai e halaoa.
GEN.2.7.english: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

GEN.11.6.motu: Iehova eto, Idia na bese tamona, iboudiai danu edia gado tamona; ina na idia ese eme karaia matama, gabeai ḡau ta ikarana ma bae ura, daika ese baine laodia ahu?
GEN.11.6.english: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

GEN.37.20.motu: aita alaia mase, ini guri asi ranudia ta ai baita negea dobi; bena baitato “Uda boromana ta ese e alaia mase”; unu amo baita itaia, ena nihi anidia be dahaka.
GEN.37.20.english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

GEN.3.14.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese gaigai e gwau henia, eto, Unu vada o kara toma dainai, emu dika davana be boromakau iboudiai bona uda boromadia iboudiai edia dika davadia baine hereadia: kopamu ai do ba rau, tano ḡahuna bavania, emu mauri dinadia iboudiai.
GEN.3.14.english: Yahweh God said to the serpent,

GEN.26.17.motu: Bena Isaak na e raka oho, Gerara kourana ai e taruha, unuseni ai e nohova.
GEN.26.17.english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

GEN.47.22.motu: Ḡau tamona hahelaḡa taudia edia tano ia ese se abi, badina be hahelaḡa taudia na Farao ese e ubudiava; taunabunai Farao ena heubu ḡaudia dekediai mimia dainai idia be edia tano bae hoi na asi badina.
GEN.47.22.english: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

GEN.43.31.motu: Bena vairana e huria, e raka lasi, e haheauka, eto, Aniani a dabaraia.
GEN.43.31.english: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

GEN.11.9.motu: Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Babel; badina be unuseni ai Iehova ese taunimanima edia gado e ha-idaua, bona unu amo ia ese e hakarohodia rohoroho, tanobada kahadia idoidiai.
GEN.11.9.english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

GEN.27.46.motu: Bena Rebeka ese Isaak e hereva henia, eto, Name hesiku ini Hiti hahinedia daidiai. Iakob ese ini Hiti taudia natudia ina tano ai e nohomu ta baine adavaia, egu noho ede baine heto?
GEN.27.46.english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

GEN.11.18.motu: Peleg ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Reu e havaraia.
GEN.11.18.english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

GEN.25.1.motu: Abraham ese hahine ta ma e adavaia, ladana na Ketura.
GEN.25.1.english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

GEN.44.33.motu: Taunabunai na noimumu, lau ese emu hesiai tauna ai bainala, ina mero ibolona, a ia ese kakana ida bae lou lao.
GEN.44.33.english: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

GEN.42.16.motu: Umui emui amo ta ba siaia, tadimui baine hakaua mai; a orena be dibura rumana ai ba noho. Unu amo baina dibamui, emui hereva be momokani eiava lasi. Bema lasi, umui na momokani hasinadoa taumui.
GEN.42.16.english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

GEN.14.1.motu: Amarafel ese Sinara tanona e lohiaia, Ariok ese Elasara tanona e lohiaia, Kedoralaomere ese Elam tanona e lohiaia bona Tidala ese Goimi tanona e lohiaia negana ai,
GEN.14.1.english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

GEN.22.4.motu: Dina ihatoina ai Abraham ese matana e roha isi, gabuna na dauhai e itaia.
GEN.22.4.english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

GEN.24.37.motu: Bena biagugu ese e haduagu baina gwau hamata; eto “Natugu adavana na Kanaan taudia, bogaragidiai na noho hedoamu taudia, natudia ulatodia ta basio abia,
GEN.24.37.english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

GEN.3.8.motu: Bena raruosi ese Dirava Iehova gadona e kamonai, ia na dina kerumana ai imea lalonai e loava; bena Adam mai adavana ida Dirava Iehova vairana amo e komu, imea audia muridiai.
GEN.3.8.english: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

GEN.32.15.motu: kamelo toi-ahui mai natudia ida; boromakau hahinedia hari-ahui; boromakau mamaruanedia gwauta; doniki ruahui; bona doniki natudia gwauta.
GEN.32.15.english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

GEN.35.16.motu: Idia na Betele amo eha laolao, ela Efrata vada e kahirakahira, bena Rahela e hekamonai, hisina vada e bada.
GEN.35.16.english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

GEN.36.16.motu: bona Kora bona Gatam bona Amalek e havaradia: ini iboudiai na Edom tanona lohiadia, Elifasa, Ada natuna, ese e havaradia.
GEN.36.16.english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

GEN.30.7.motu: Rahela ena hesiai hahinena Bilha ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ihararuana e abia.
GEN.30.7.english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

GEN.36.28.motu: Disan natuna na Usu bona Aran.
GEN.36.28.english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

GEN.37.19.motu: E hereva heheni, eto O itaia, hari nihi tauna vada e maimu;

GEN.7.19.english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

GEN.38.6.motu: Iuda ese hane-ulato ta davana e heni, natuna roboana Ere adavanaai bainela; ia ladana na Tamara.
GEN.38.6.english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

GEN.44.28.english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

GEN.12.2.motu: Lau ese bese badana ai baina halaomu; baina hanamomu, ladamu baina imodaia, hahenamo tauna ai baola.
GEN.12.2.english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

GEN.6.22.motu: Bena Noa na unu e kara toma, Dirava ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
GEN.6.22.english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

GEN.25.30.english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

GEN.41.17.english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

GEN.33.20.motu: Unuseni ai boubou patana ta e larebaia, ladana e hatoa El-Elohe-Israel.
GEN.33.20.english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

GEN.7.20.motu: ororo doridia ai ranu ena dobu na roha hani mai kahana.
GEN.7.20.english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

GEN.25.6.motu: A adavana oredia natudia na maurina ai e harihari henidia, bena e siaidia karoho, mairiveina kahana ai bae hanoho.
GEN.25.6.english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

GEN.41.24.motu: Bena uit dikadia ese uit namodia e anidia ore. Lau ese babalau taudia vada na hamaorolaidia, to anina ihahedinaraina na ta asi dibana.
GEN.41.24.english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

GEN.40.3.motu: dibura rumana ai e koudia, hegima taudia biagudia imana ai, Iosef e nohova gabuna ai.
GEN.40.3.english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

GEN.11.29.english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

GEN.13.17.motu: A tore isi, ina tano ba rakaia hanai, latana amo, lababana amo; badina be lau ese baina henimu.
GEN.13.17.english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

GEN.27.2.motu: Isaak ma eto, Ame itagu, vada name buruka, egu mase dinana na asi dibagu.
GEN.27.2.english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

GEN.48.3.motu: Bena Iakob ese Iosef e hereva henia, eto, Siahu-idoinai Diravana ese Lusu ai, Kanaan tanona ai, e hahedinarai henigu bona e hanamogu,
GEN.48.3.english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

GEN.3.15.motu: Lau ese oi bona hahine baina haheinai hehenimui, oi garamu bona ia garana danu baina haheinai hehenidia. Ia ese oi kwaramu baine huaria, bona oi ese ia aena geduna ba tutua.
GEN.3.15.english: I will put hostility between you and the woman,

GEN.20.2.motu: Bena Abraham ese Sara e herevalaia, eto, Ia na taihugu. Bena Abimelek, Gerara pavapavana, ese e abia.
GEN.20.2.english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

GEN.27.16.motu: nani natudia kopidia danu imana ruaosi bona aiona e havavalai.
GEN.27.16.english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

GEN.29.22.motu: Bena Laban ese una gabu taudia iboudiai e haboudia, aria e karaia.
GEN.29.22.english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

GEN.35.20.motu: Bena Iakob ese nadi pupuna ta e haginia ena gara latanai; ladana na doini e hatoamu “Rahela ena gara pupuna” ema bona harihari.
GEN.35.20.english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

GEN.23.10.motu: Hari Efron na Hiti taudia bogaragidiai e helaiva. Bena Efron, Hiti tauna, ese Abraham e haere henia, Hiti taudia vairadiai bona ena hanua taudia iboudiai vairadiai, eto,
GEN.23.10.english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

GEN.36.8.motu: Taunabunai, Esau na Seiri ororodia ai eha noho. Esau na Edom.
GEN.36.8.english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

GEN.31.33.motu: Taunabunai Laban ese Iakob ena dabua rumana ai e tahu, bona Lea ena dabua rumana ai, bona hesiai hahinedia raruosi edia dabua rumadia ai, to ḡau ta se davaria. Bena Rahela ena dabua rumana ai e raka vareai.
GEN.31.33.english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

GEN.41.38.motu: Bena Farao ese ena hesiai taudia e hereva henidia, eto, Edeseni ai tau ta baita davaria ina tau heḡereḡerena: Dirava ena Lauma be ia lalonai ani?
GEN.41.38.english: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

GEN.3.6.motu: Hahine ese e itaia, una au huahuana be aniani ḡauna namona, ita-itana danu namo, bona lalo-parara ihavarana ḡauna; bena ia ese e abia, adavana danu e henia, ia danu e ania.
GEN.3.6.english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

GEN.30.12.motu: Bena Lea ena hesiai hahinena Silpa ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ihararuana e abia.
GEN.30.12.english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

GEN.11.14.motu: Sela ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Ebere e havaraia.
GEN.11.14.english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

GEN.17.25.motu: Natuna Ismael ena mauri laḡanidia na gwauta toi, e peritomea negana ai.
GEN.17.25.english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

GEN.10.10.motu: Matamana ai ena basileia na Babel bona Ereke bona Akad bona Kalne, Sinara tanona ai.
GEN.10.10.english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

GEN.50.7.motu: Bena Iosef e tore isi tamana igurina ela. Farao ena hesiai taudia bona ena ruma lohiadia iboudiai ese e bamoa, bona Aigupto lohiadia iboudiai,
GEN.50.7.english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

GEN.40.7.motu: Bena ia ese hari Farao ena hesiai taudia, ia ida e dibura hebouva taudia, e nanadaidia, eto, Badina be dahaka vairamui o huamu?
GEN.40.7.english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

GEN.1.2.motu: Tanobada na asi oromana bona asi anina; dibura danu gadobada vada e gorua ahu. Bena Dirava laumana na gado kopina ai e loava.
GEN.1.2.english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

GEN.2.23.motu: Bena Adam eto, Ina na turiagu turiana bona hidiogu hidiona: ladana bae hatoa Hahine, badina be Tau ena amo vada e abia lasi.

GEN.33.14.motu: Taunabunai, egu lohia e, oi na emu hesiai tauna ba gunalaigu; a lau na baina raka metaira-metaira, egu seri bona natugu edia goada heḡereḡerena, ela bona Seiri ai egu lohia baina vasi henimu.

GEN.24.67.motu: Bena Isaak ese Rebeka e hakaua lao, sinana Sara ena dabua rumana ai e hakaua vareai, e adavaia. Bena ia iura-henina ese lalona e hamarumarua, sinana taina e taiva negadia ai.
GEN.24.67.english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

GEN.45.12.motu: O itaia: umui matamui ese vada e itaia, bona tadigu Beniamina danu matana vada e itaia, ini hereva na lau udugu amo vada e lasi.

GEN.20.17.motu: Bena Abraham ese Dirava e ḡuria; bena Dirava ese Abimelek e hamauria, bona adavana bona ena hesiai hahinedia danu e hamauridia, bena natudia e havaradia.

GEN.47.28.motu: Iakob na laḡeni gwauta-hitu Aigupto ai e nohova: ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta hari-ahui hitu.

GEN.29.19.motu: Laban eto, Oi baina henimu be namo, idau tauna ta baina henia na dika; dekegu ai ba noho.

GEN.49.18.motu: Iehova e, emu hahemauri vada na nariamu.

GEN.50.13.english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

GEN.37.25.english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

GEN.24.4.motu: a egu tano korikori baola, varavaragu dekediai, unuseni ai natugu Isaak adavana bavabia.
GEN.24.4.english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

GEN.43.6.motu: Bena Israel eto, Edeheto umui ese lau o hadikagu, tadimui herevana o hahedinaraia?

GEN.49.11.motu: Ena doniki na vine auna ai baine mataia,
GEN.49.11.english: Binding his foal to the vine,

GEN.31.40.english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

GEN.22.18.motu: oi garamu daidiai tanobada besedia iboudiai baina hanamodia, badina be oi ese lau eregu o kamonai.
GEN.22.18.english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

GEN.19.2.motu: eto, Egu lohia e, lau, emui hesiai tauna, egu ruma ai mani a dae kau, ba noho rani, aemui danu ba huri; bena daba ai ba tore isi, emui dala ai ba raka. Idia eto, Lasi; hanua ariarana ai baia noho rani.
GEN.19.2.english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.”

GEN.28.3.motu: Bena Siahu-idoinai Diravana ese baine hanamomu, besemu baine havaraia bona baine habadaia, bese bada-hereana ai baola.
GEN.28.3.english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

GEN.34.21.motu: Ini taunimanima na maino e uramu; taunabunai eda tano ai bae noho baine namo: bae hoihoi bona bae biru, badina be tano na bada. Natudia ulatodia baita adavadia, bona natuda ulatodia baita henidia.
GEN.34.21.english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

GEN.26.8.motu: Nega daudau unu e noho tomava, bena dina ta Abimelek, Filistia pavapavana, gabamauru amo e igo lasi, Isaak adavana Rebeka ida e itadia, e sihari.
GEN.26.8.english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

GEN.27.34.english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

GEN.21.19.motu: Bena Dirava ese matana e hapapa; bena ia ese ranu gurina ta e itaia; bena nani kopina e hahonua, mero na ranu e ha-inulaia.

GEN.14.9.motu: idia laima-osi ese Kedoralaomere, Elam pavapavana, bona Tidala, Goimi pavapavana, bona Amarafel, Sinara pavapavana, bona Ariok, Elasara pavapavana, hahaniosi na e tuari henidia.
GEN.14.9.english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

GEN.3.3.motu: to Dirava eto “Imea bogaraginai e ginimu auna huahuana basio ania bona basio daua toho, ba mase na garina”.
GEN.3.3.english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

GEN.11.5.motu: Bena Iehova e diho, hanua bona kohoro Adam besena ese e latebaia baine itaia eto.
GEN.11.5.english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

GEN.24.46.motu: Bena ena hodu e atoa diho haraḡa, eto “A inua, bena emu kamelo edia ranu danu baina utua”.
GEN.24.46.english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

GEN.19.19.motu: Mani a itagu, emui hesiai tauna; vada o harihari henigu bona vada o bogagu hisi bona vada o hamaurigu. A lau na asi goadagu ororo baina heau henidia, hahedika ese baine ḡavagu tao, bena baina mase.
GEN.19.19.english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

GEN.33.1.motu: Bena Iakob na e gaga isi, Esau e itaia, ena orea taudia sinahuhaniosi ida e maiva. Bena ia ese natuna e hididia, Lea natuna bona Rahela natuna bona hesiai hahinedia natudia;
GEN.33.1.english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

GEN.23.7.motu: Bena Abraham e tore isi, una tano taudia, Hiti taudia, vairadiai e igo diho;
GEN.23.7.english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

GEN.30.27.motu: Laban eto, Na noimumu, mani emu kara basio raka oho; badina be lalogu vada eme parara Iehova ese vada e hanamogu oi daimu ai.
GEN.30.27.english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

GEN.5.2.motu: Maruane bona hahine e karadia, ladadia e hato Taunimanima; e karadia dinana ai danu e hanamodia.
GEN.5.2.english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

GEN.49.4.motu: To oi na ranu na heto, taunabunai oi na basio herea,
GEN.49.4.english: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel,

GEN.6.2.motu: Bena Dirava natuna verina ese taunimanima natudia hahinedia e itadia, i'itadia, nanamo; bena e ura henidia ulatodia na e adavadia.
GEN.6.2.english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

GEN.9.13.motu: egu kevau dagadaga ai na atoamu, taravatu toana ai bainela, lauegu bona tanobada ena.
GEN.9.13.english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

GEN.30.17.motu: Bena Dirava ese Lea e hakala henia; bena e rogorogo, e mara, mero iha-imana e abia, Iakob ena.
GEN.30.17.english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

GEN.21.22.motu: Una negana ai Abimelek bona Fikol, ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese Abraham e hamaoroa, eto, Vada name diba Dirava ese e bamomumu emu kara iboudiai lalodiai.
GEN.21.22.english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

GEN.44.9.motu: A boma davaria oi isiaimu ilao-henina taumai ta unu vada e kara toma, ia na baine mase, bona ai be biagumui ena hesiai taudia ai baiala.
GEN.44.9.english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

GEN.1.11.motu: Dirava ma eto, Tanobada ai rei aine vara, bona ava idau-idau mai nadinadidia, bona huahua audia danu mai huahuadia, huahua idau-idaudia mai nadinadidia. Bena unu e vara toma:
GEN.1.11.english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

GEN.6.13.motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa e hereva henia, eto, Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai dokodia be lau vairagu ai vada eme kau; badina be idia daidiai tanobada na daḡedaḡe ai veda eme honu honu dae, taunabunai, lau ese baina habuadia tari tanobada ai.
GEN.6.13.english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

GEN.36.23.motu: Sobal natuna na Alavan bona Manahata bona Ebal bona Sefo bona Onam.
GEN.36.23.english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

GEN.42.33.motu: Bena una tano lohiana eto “Ini amo baina diba umui na hereva momokani taumui eiava lasi: umui ta baina dogoa tao iniseni ai, a orena be uit ba laohaia, varavaramui adia;
GEN.42.33.english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

GEN.29.6.motu: Ma e nanadaidia lou, eto, Ia be namo a? Idia eto, I, vada namo; natuna kekenina Rahela mani a itaia, ena mamoe serina e hakaua maimu.
GEN.29.6.english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?”

GEN.11.20.motu: Reu ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese Serug e havaraia.
GEN.11.20.english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

GEN.17.19.motu: A Dirava ese Abraham e haere henia, eto, Lasi, adavamu Sara ese natumu ta baine havaraia, ladana ba hatoa Isaak. Egu taravatu baina badinaia ienai bona murinai bae vara garana ediai, ela bona hanaihanai.
GEN.17.19.english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

GEN.47.26.motu: Unuhetomana Iosef ese taravadia e atua, hari taravatu na doini mia ema bona harihari: karoa ima lalodiai karoa ta be Farao ena. Ḡau tamona, hahelaḡa taudia edia tano ia ese se abi.
GEN.47.26.english: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

GEN.48.14.motu: Bena Israel na imana idibana e haroroa, Efraim, tau-muritai, tubuana ai e atoa kau, bona imana laurina e haroroa, Manase, tau-guna tubuana ai e atoa kau. Mai ena laio-hadai dainai imana ruaosi unu e toiroro hanai toma.
GEN.48.14.english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

GEN.26.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese ienai e hedinarai, eto, Aigupto basiola; baina hadibalaimu tanona ai ba noho.
GEN.26.2.english: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

GEN.47.12.motu: Bena Iosef ese tamana bona tadikakana bona tamana ena orea taudia iboudiai e ubudia, ruma ta ta taudia adia e henidia.
GEN.47.12.english: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.

GEN.50.1.motu: Iosef na tamana vairanai e igo diho, e tai, bona e harahua.
GEN.50.1.english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

GEN.41.42.motu: Bena Farao ese ia imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina imana amo e abia, Iosef imana kwakikwakina ai e toia vareai; dabua namo-hereadia danu e hahedokilai, bona gold agevana na aiona ai e atoa kau.
GEN.41.42.english: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

GEN.10.3.motu: Gomere natuna bini: Asakena bona Rifat bona Togarama.
GEN.10.3.english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

GEN.36.7.motu: Badina be raruosi edia taḡa na bada herea dainai tano na dia heḡereḡere idia raruosi bona edia seri idoidiai bae noholaia.
GEN.36.7.english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

GEN.6.10.motu: Noa ese natuna mamaruanedia tatoi e havaradia: Sem bona Ham bona Iafet.
GEN.6.10.english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

GEN.2.13.motu: Sinavai iharuana ladana na Gihon: una sinavai be Etiopia tanona e arua heḡeḡe.
GEN.2.13.english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

GEN.8.4.motu: ela bona hua ihahituna ena dina ihagwauta-hituna ai lagatoi e kuia kau Ararat ororona ai.
GEN.8.4.english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

GEN.15.9.motu: Iehova eto, Boromakau hahinena ta bavabia, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona nani hahinena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona mamoe maruanena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona kerea ta bona pune natuna ta.
GEN.15.9.english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

GEN.47.21.motu: Taunimanima danu e abidia, Aigupto hanuadia iboudiai, atai ela bona henu, hesiai taudia ai e halaodia.
GEN.47.21.english: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

GEN.48.10.motu: Israel vada e buruka dainai ia matana vada e valahuvalahu, ḡau se ita ḡoeva. Taunabunai e boiridia, bae raka henia kahi; bena e harahudia bona e rosidia.
GEN.48.10.english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

GEN.12.3.motu: Oi bae hanamomu taudia na baina hanamodia, a oi baine hadikamu tauna na baina hadikaia. Oi daimu ai tanobada besedia idoidiai do bae namo.
GEN.12.3.english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

GEN.31.3.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Iakob e hamaoroa. eto, Tubumu tamamu edia tano ba lou henia, varavaramu dekedia baola: lau ese baina bamomu.
GEN.31.3.english: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

GEN.44.3.motu: Daba ai, hari tatau mai edia doniki e siaidia lao.
GEN.44.3.english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

GEN.11.21.motu: Serug e vara murinai, Reu na laḡani sinahu-rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.21.english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.44.1.motu: Bena Iosef ese ena ruma ireḡuna tauna e haduaia, eto, Ini tatau edia puse aniani ai ba hahonu, bae honu namonamo, bona edia moni danu edia puse ududia ai ba uda.
GEN.44.1.english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

GEN.32.1.motu: Iakob na ena dala ai ela, bena Dirava ena aneru loḡora ida e hedavari.
GEN.32.1.english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

GEN.35.24.english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

GEN.3.13.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese hahine e gwau henia, eto, Ina na dahaka vada o karaia? Hahine na eto, Gaigai ese e koigu, bena na ania.
GEN.3.13.english: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?”

GEN.49.22.motu: Iosef na au rigina mai huahuana na heto,

GEN.5.26.motu: bena Lamek e vara murinai Metusela na laḡani sinahu-hitu taurahani-ahui rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.26.english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.25.27.motu: Memero raruosi na e bada oho bada oho. Esau na labana tauna mai aonegana, bona loaloa tauna; a Iakob na manada tauna bona konenoho tauna.
GEN.25.27.english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

GEN.31.20.motu: bona Iakob na e heau hehuni, Laban tau Suria se hadibaia guna.
GEN.31.20.english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

GEN.40.17.motu: bena atai boseana lalonai na flaoa e gabu ḡaudia idau-idau mimia, Farao ana, a manu haida e roho ema, e ani.
GEN.40.17.english: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

GEN.44.27.motu: Bena tamamai eto “Umui dibamui adavagu ese memero rarua e abidia;
GEN.44.27.english: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

GEN.38.20.motu: Iuda ese turana Hira e siaia, nani natuna baine laohaia, bona toa gaudia hahine vada e henia ma baine abi lou. To ia na lasihia.
GEN.38.20.english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

GEN.3.7.motu: Bena raruosi matadia e papa, vada e diba idia na ḡaḡaedia mo nonoho; bena idia ese suke raudia e turi hebou, edia riorio ḡaudia e kara.
GEN.3.7.english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

GEN.26.28.motu: Idia eto, Lalomai vada e parara Iehova ese vada e bamomu, taunabunai ai na a tomu: baita herohemaino bona baita gwau hamata heheni,
GEN.26.28.english: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

GEN.48.13.motu: Bena Iosef ese raruosi e abidia; imana idibana amo Efraim e abia, Israel laurina kahana ai e atoa, bona imana laurina amo Manase e abia, Israel idibana kahana ai e atoa.
GEN.48.13.english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

GEN.24.20.motu: Bena ena hodu ranuna orena na dihu-lata lalonai e seia, bena ranugurina ma e loulou henia ela bona kamelo iboudiai e ha-inulaidia vaitani.
GEN.24.20.english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

GEN.24.49.motu: Benaini, mani a hereva, biagugu ba bogaia hisi bona ihanamona karana ba karaia, eiava lasi; bena baina diba ede baina raka toma, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo.
GEN.24.49.english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

GEN.50.10.motu: Atad ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai e kau, Ioridane unukahanai; unuseni ai Iakob igurina karadia e kara, mai lalo-hisihisidia bona mai taidia ida. Idia ese dina hitu tamadia e tailaia.
GEN.50.10.english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

GEN.9.14.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese dagadaga tanobada baina hadagahulaia negana ai na kevau be dagadaga ai ba itaia.
GEN.9.14.english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

GEN.44.19.motu: Egu lohia e, emu hesiai taudia o nanadaimai, oto, “Tamamui eiava tadimui nonoho a?”
GEN.44.19.english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

GEN.32.9.motu: Bena Iakob e ḡuriḡuri, eto, Tubugu Abraham ena Dirava, tamagu Isaak ena Dirava, Iehova e, oi ese o haduagu, oto “Emu tano ba lou henia, varavaramu dekedia baola, bena baina hanamomu”.
GEN.32.9.english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

GEN.9.7.motu: Benaini, besemui ba havaraida, bae hutuma; tanobada ai bae vara rohoroho, hae hutuma bada.
GEN.9.7.english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

GEN.30.35.motu: Una dina ai ia ese nani mamaruanedia mai toutoudia bona mai revarevadia, bona nani hahinedia mai toutoudia bona mai revarevadia, bona mamoe koremadia, iboudiai e hakaudia siri, natuna e henidia, bae reḡudia.
GEN.30.35.english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

GEN.1.19.motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihahanina.
GEN.1.19.english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

GEN.37.13.motu: Bena Israel ese Iosef e hereva henia, eto, Kakamu na Sekem ai seri e reḡudiamu ani? Aoma, aina siaimu dekediai. Iosef e haere, eto, Lau o ina.
GEN.37.13.english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

GEN.44.5.motu: Biagugu ena kehere, ena inuinu bona ena baguhaoro ḡauna, vada o henaoa. Umui vada o kerere dikadika”.
GEN.44.5.english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

GEN.41.48.motu: Unu laḡani hitu lalodiai Iosef ese aniani idoinai e haboua, hanua hanua rogedia ai. Hanua ta ta umadia anianidia na unu hanua ta ta rogedia ai e habou.
GEN.41.48.english: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

GEN.4.22.motu: A Sila na e mara, Tubala-Kain e abia: ia na auri-laboralabora bona auri iḡaukaralaidia tauna ai ela. Hari Tubala-Kain taihuna ladana na Naamaha.
GEN.4.22.english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

GEN.4.18.motu: Enok natuna na Irad. Irad ese Mehuiael e havaraia, bona Mehuiael ese Metusael e havaraia, bona Metusael ese Lamek e havaraia.
GEN.4.18.english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

GEN.46.31.motu: Bena Iosef ese tadikakana bona tamana ena orea taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Lau bainala, Farao baina hamaorolaia, bainato “Tadikakagu bona tamagu ena orea taudia na Kanaan tanona amo vada ema, lau dekegu ai.
GEN.46.31.english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

GEN.23.14.motu: Bena Efron ese Abraham e haere henia, eto,
GEN.23.14.english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

GEN.17.15.motu: Dirava ese Abraham ma e hamaoroa, eto, Adavamu Sarai ladana basio hatoa lou “Sarai”, a ladana ba hatoa “Sara”.
GEN.17.15.english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

GEN.30.25.motu: Iosef e vara murinai, Iakob ese Laban e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a kahugu nege, egu gabu korikori bainala, egu tano korikori baina lou henia.
GEN.30.25.english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

GEN.42.31.motu: A ia ese a hamaoroa, ato “Ai na hereva momokani taumai, dia hasinadoa;
GEN.42.31.english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

GEN.29.27.motu: Ina hahine ariana purana baine ore, murinai tadina danu baia henimu; davana be laḡani hitu ma isiaigu ba lao heni.
GEN.29.27.english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

GEN.33.19.motu: Bena e taruha henia tanona na Hamoro, Sekem e hadaia tauna, natuna edia amo e hoia, davana na silver monidia sinahu-ta.
GEN.33.19.english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

GEN.14.20.motu: Dirava Herea Mikamika danu aita imodaia, badina be ia ese oi inaimu na imamu ai vada e atodia kau. Bena Abram ese e abi kohudia iboudiai e karoadia, karoa gwauta; bena karoa ta Melkisedek e henia.
GEN.14.20.english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.”

GEN.41.23.motu: gabeai ta ma e tubu anina hitu, didika bona mamaraḡi, lai mairiveina ese e hamarai ḡaudia.
GEN.41.23.english: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

GEN.9.17.motu: Dirava ese Noa ma e hamaoroa, eto, Lauegu ai bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai ediai na atuamu taravatuna toana binai.
GEN.9.17.english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

GEN.26.19.motu: Isaak ena hesiai taudia danu koura ai guri e ḡei, bona ranu e lohilohiva gabuna ta e davana.
GEN.26.19.english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

GEN.37.36.motu: A Midian taudia ese Iosef e hoia Aigupto ai, Potifara, Farao ena tuari oreana biaguna ta, enai.
GEN.37.36.english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

GEN.49.17.motu: Dan na gaigai dala isena ai na heto,
GEN.49.17.english: Dan will be a serpent on the trail,

GEN.41.9.motu: Bena vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna ese Farao e hamaoroa, eto, Lau ese egu kerere hari name laloa.
GEN.41.9.english: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

GEN.37.28.motu: Hari hoihoi taudia na Midian amo e raka hanai; bena Iosef kakana ese guri amo e veria dae, Ismael taudia ediai e hoia, silver monidia ruahui davana. Bena idia ese e hakaua lao, Aigupto e laohaia.
GEN.37.28.english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

GEN.4.2.motu: Ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, tadina Abel e abia. Abel na mamoe ireḡudia tauna a Kain na biru tauna.
GEN.4.2.english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

GEN.37.22.motu: basita alaia mase, a guri ta ai baita tahoa dobi. Unu e gwau toma badina ena lalo-hadai be idia imadia amo baine hamauria, tamana baine henia lou eto.
GEN.37.22.english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

GEN.5.8.motu: Set ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta gwautarua: bena e mase.
GEN.5.8.english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

GEN.37.34.motu: Bena Iakob ese ena dabua e darea, guma dabuana e rioa, natuna itailaina e tai boi tai rani ela dina hoho.
GEN.37.34.english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

GEN.46.27.motu: Bona Iosef ese Aigupto ai e abidia memerodia be rarua. Iakob ena iduhu taudia Aigupto ela iboudiai be hitu-ahui.
GEN.46.27.english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

GEN.47.4.motu: Bena idia ese Farao e noia, eto, Ai na vada ama, ina tano ai baia noho a tomamu, badina be Kanaan tanona na asi reina emai seri bae ania. Mani emu kara a hereva, emu hesiai taudia na Gosen tanona ai baia noho.
GEN.47.4.english: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”

GEN.42.38.motu: A Iakob eto, Natugu basina kahua nege, basio laohaia; badina be kakana korikori vada e mase, ia mo sibona dekegu ai e nohomu. Dala ai dika ta ienai bema kau, lau buruka taugu na umui daimui ai mase gabuna bama lao henia mai lalo-hisihisigu ida.
GEN.42.38.english: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”

GEN.19.22.motu: Ba lao henia haraḡa; badina be ḡau ta basina karaia diba ela bona oi na unuseni ai ba kau. Una dainai una hanua ladana e hatoa Soara.
GEN.19.22.english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

GEN.24.51.motu: A itaia, Rebeka na vairamu ai gini: avabia, ba hakaua lao, biagumu natuna baine adavaia, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
GEN.24.51.english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

GEN.5.6.motu: Set ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta dikoana ima negana ai, ia ese Enos e havaraia;
GEN.5.6.english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

GEN.27.33.motu: Bena Isaak kudouna e hetaha, eto, Hari tau be daika, vamu eha abia, e mailaia dekegu ai, oi do toma ai na ania ore, bona vada na hanamoa danu? Momokani, ia ese hahenamo anina do baine abia.
GEN.27.33.english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

GEN.24.11.motu: Bena adorahi ai, hahine na ranu utu ela negana ai, ia ese kamelo e hahekuredia ranu gurina badibadinai, una hanua murimurina kahana ai.
GEN.24.11.english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

GEN.37.16.motu: Iosef na e haere, eto, Lau na kakagu na tahudiamu; mani emu kara ba hadibagu, idia na edeseni ai edia seri e reḡudiamu.
