GEN.37.16.english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

GEN.14.21.motu: Bena Sodoma pavapavana ese Abram e hamaoroa, eto, Abi-mauri taudia lau ba henigu, a kohu be oi ese bavabi.
GEN.14.21.english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

GEN.16.6.motu: A Abram ese Sarai e haere henia, eto, Hahine na oi imamu ai; emu ura heḡereḡerena ba kara henia. Bena Sarai ese e daḡedaḡe henia, ela bona hahine na e heau.
GEN.16.6.english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

GEN.13.11.motu: Bena Lot na Ioridane kourana idoinai e abia hidi, mairiveina kahana ela. Idia raruosi na e haheparara.
GEN.13.11.english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

GEN.19.28.motu: e roha lao, Sodoma bona Gomora bona taora idoinai e ita, una tano idoinai ai kwalahu e daeva, amu kwalahuna na heto.
GEN.19.28.english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

GEN.22.17.motu: lau ese baina hanamomu badabada, oi garamu baina hahutumadia, guba hisiudia bona kone mirina na heheto; oi garamu ese bae inai henidia taudia edia tano bae abihaidia,
GEN.22.17.english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

GEN.17.23.motu: Bena Abraham ese natuna Ismael e abia, bona ena hesiai tataudia iboudiai, ena ruma ai e vara taudia bona e hoidia taudia danu, e abidia, iboudiai e peritomedia una dina ai, kopidia e ivadia, Dirava ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
GEN.17.23.english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

GEN.17.1.motu: Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahanai-ta-ahui taurahani-ta negana ai, Iehova ese ienai e hedinarai, e hereva henia, eto, Lau na Siahu Diravana; lau vairagu ai ba raka mai maoromaoromu ida;
GEN.17.1.english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

GEN.27.4.motu: bena vamu namona lalogu ese e ura heniamu heḡereḡerena na ba nadua, dekegu ba mailaia; baina ania, bena do basina mase ai baina hanamomu guna.
GEN.27.4.english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

GEN.27.37.motu: Isaak ese Esau e haere henia, eto, Inai! Oi biagumu ai vada na halaoa, bona tadikakana iboudiai vada na henia, ena hesiai taudia ai baela; uit bona vine ranuna danu vada na gwaurai iena. Natugu e, dahaka baina karaia oiemu ai?
GEN.27.37.english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

GEN.6.21.motu: Aniani ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai danu bavabi kau, oiamu bona idia adia.
GEN.6.21.english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

GEN.20.15.motu: Abimelek danu eto, A itaia, egu tano idoinai na oi vairamu ai; emu ura gabuna ba noholaia.
GEN.20.15.english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

GEN.46.13.motu: Isakara natuna be Tola bona Puva bona Iobo bona Simron.
GEN.46.13.english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

GEN.9.19.motu: Noa natuna tatoiosi bunu; tanobada besedia iboudiai na idia tatoiosi ese e havaradia.
GEN.9.19.english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

GEN.48.16.motu: Dika iboudiai amo vada e hamaurigu aneruna,
GEN.48.16.english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads,

GEN.40.16.motu: Flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna vada e diba hari nihi anina be namo, bena ia ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Lau danu na nihi; egu nihi lalonai flaoa boseadia toi kwaragu ai na ato, na oradia loaloa;
GEN.40.16.english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

GEN.32.12.motu: A oi vada oto “Momokani, lau ese baina hanamomu, bona garamu baina hahutumadia kone mirina na heto, asi iduahidia”.
GEN.32.12.english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

GEN.20.16.motu: Ia ese Sara danu e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, silver monidia daha-ta oi taihumu vada na henia, emu hemarai iabi-ohona taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai; iboudiai vairadiai bae gwauraimu maoro.
GEN.20.16.english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

GEN.1.20.motu: Dirava ma eto, Mauri ḡaudia momo davara ai ae vara, bona manu tanobada daenai ae roho guba henunai.
GEN.1.20.english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

GEN.44.32.motu: Badina belau ese tamagu na gwau henia hamata, ina mero bagunai, nato “Basina hakaua lou dekemu ai mai maurina ida, kerere na lau latagu ai baine mia ela bona hanaihanai”.
GEN.44.32.english: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

GEN.45.3.motu: Bena Iosef ese tadikakana e hereva henidia, eto, Lau binai Iosef, Tamagu na dounu e mauri nohomu eiava? A tadikakana na ihaere-henina asi dibadia, badina be kudoudia e hetaha.
GEN.45.3.english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?”

GEN.28.1.motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e boiria, e hanamoa, e hagania, eto, Kanaan taudia natudia ta basio adavaia;
GEN.28.1.english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

GEN.45.18.motu: tamamui bona varavaramui bavabidia, ba hakaudia mai dekegu ai; lau ese Aigupto tanona ena ḡau namodia baina henimui, bona ina tano digarana do bavania”.
GEN.45.18.english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

GEN.27.9.motu: Aola, nani serina ai nani natudia namodia rua bavabi, dekegu ba mailai; bena lau ese vamu namona ai baina halao tamamu ana, ia ese e ura heniamu ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
GEN.27.9.english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

GEN.44.25.motu: Bena tamamai eto “A lou lao, ada aniani taina ma bavabia”.
GEN.44.25.english: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

GEN.47.5.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Tamamu bona tadikakamu na dekemu vada ema.
GEN.47.5.english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

GEN.35.29.motu: Bena Isaak na laumana e heni dae, vada e mase, tubu tama dekediai eha hebou. Ia na tau buruka; ena mauri vada e daudau herea. Ia natuna raruosi, Esau bona Iakob, ese e guria.
GEN.35.29.english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

GEN.20.9.motu: Bena Abimelek ese Abraham e boiria, eto, Ede vada o karamai toma? Ede na hadikamu toma dainai lau bona egu basileia ini vada o hakereremai toma? Hegwau-tao karana ta vada o kara henigu.
GEN.20.9.english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

GEN.48.4.motu: eto “Momokani lau ese besemu baina havaraia, baina hahohomu, bese bada-hereana ai bainahalaomu; ina tano danu oi garamu baina henidia, edia tano ai bainela, ela bona hanaihanai”.
GEN.48.4.english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

GEN.17.11.motu: kopimui bae ivadia, eda taravatu toana.
GEN.17.11.english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

GEN.11.19.motu: Reu e vara murinai, Peleg na laḡani sinahu-rua dikoana taurahani-ta e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.19.english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.9.4.motu: ḡau tamona, hidio mai rarana basio ania, badina be rara na mauri badina.
GEN.9.4.english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

GEN.5.24.motu: ia na Dirava ida e hebamo heheniva, murinai tau ta ese se itaia lou, badina be Dirava ese e abia.
GEN.5.24.english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

GEN.9.16.motu: Kevau na dagadaga ai baine hedinarai, bena baina itaia negana ai, hari mia-hanaihanai taravatuna, lau Dirava bona tanobada ena mauri ḡaudia iboudiai padadai, baina laloa tao.
GEN.9.16.english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

GEN.41.53.motu: Madinamo laḡanidia hituosi vada e ore Aigupto ai,
GEN.41.53.english: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

GEN.31.34.motu: Rahela ese hari dirava laulaudia vada e abi, kamelo e hua modadia ai vada e huni, bena moda latadiai e helai. Bena Laban ese dabua rumana ai e tahu malaka-malaka, a ḡau ta se davaria.
GEN.31.34.english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

GEN.26.15.motu: Bena ranu guridia iboudiai Abraham ena nega ai ena hesiai taudia ese e ḡei na Filistia taudia ese e tahuni.
GEN.26.15.english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

GEN.50.9.motu: Haida be kariota ai e gui, haida be hosi ai: hutuma bada ia ida ela.
GEN.50.9.english: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.

GEN.41.1.motu: Laḡani rua vada e lao bubuni, bena Farao e nihi. Ena nihi ai ia na sinavai badana isena ai e gini.
GEN.41.1.english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

GEN.13.1.motu: Abram ese Aigupto tanona e rakatania, ia mai adavana ida. Ena kohu idoinai e laohaia; Lot danu e hakaua lao. Idia na diho kahana amo e lou.
GEN.13.1.english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

GEN.31.5.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Vada na itaia, tamamui ese vairana e huaiamu bona lalona e idaumu egu ai; a tamagu ena Dirava ese vada e bamogu.
GEN.31.5.english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

GEN.16.1.motu: Sarai, Abram adavana, vada e gabani, natuna ta se havaraia iena. Ia na mai ena hesiai hahinena ta, hane Aigupto, ladana be Hagara.
GEN.16.1.english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

GEN.28.12.motu: Bena e nihi: ena nihi ai vadavada e itaia, tano amo e dae ela bona guba, bona Dirava ena aneru loḡora unu amo e dae e diho.
GEN.28.12.english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

GEN.3.17.motu: Adam danu e gwau henia, eto, Adavamu erena o kamonai, bena na haduamu basio ania nato huahuana vada o ania, una dainai tano vada baine dika oi bagumu ai. Tano anina bavania mai hekwarahimu ida emu mauri dinadia iboudiai.

GEN.47.25.motu: Bena idia ese e haere henia, eto, Momokani, oi ese vada o hamaurimai; oi baia imodaimu bona Farao isiaina baia lao heni.
GEN.47.25.english: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

GEN.25.34.motu: Bena Iakob ese flaoa bona vasiahu e henia; bena ia na e aniani, e inuinu danu. Bena e tore isi, e raka lasi. Esau ese ena roboa ahuna unu e dadaraia toma.
GEN.25.34.english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

GEN.5.1.motu: Adam besena karoana binai. Dirava ese taunimanima e karaia dinana ai ia ese Dirava ida-idana ai e karaia.
GEN.5.1.english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

GEN.41.12.motu: Tau eregabe ta be dekemai ai, ia na tau Heberu, dibura rumana igimana tauna ena hesiai merona. Bena ai raruosi emai nihi a hamaorolaia; bena anidia ia ese e hadibamai, ta ta ena nihi ena nihi anidia.
GEN.41.12.english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

GEN.16.8.motu: Ia eto, Hagara, Sarai ena hesiai hahinemu, ede amo oma bona ede bo laomu? Hahine na e haere, eto, Biagugu hahinena Sarai vairana amo vada na heau.
GEN.16.8.english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?”

GEN.42.36.motu: Bena tamadia Iakob ese e gwau henidia, eto, Natugu na egu amo vada o abidia oho: Iosef vada e boio; Simeon vada e boio; harihari Beniamina danu bavabia oho o tomu; ini hisihisi iboudiai na lau mo latagu ai.
GEN.42.36.english: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

GEN.50.5.motu: tamagu e haduagu dainai na gwau henia hamata. Ia eto “Baina mase negana ai, vada na heḡaeḡaelai garana ai ba gurigu, Kanaan tanona ai”. Taunabunai, ba kahugu nege, tamagu do baina guria, bena ma baina lou mai.
GEN.50.5.english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

GEN.21.26.motu: Bena Abimelek eto, Asi dibagu daika ese unu e kara toma; oi ese so hamaorogu bona asi dibagu ema bona hari dina.
GEN.21.26.english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

GEN.4.25.motu: Bena Adam na adavana ida ma e eno bou: bena hahine e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Set: eto, Dirava ese natugu ta vada eme henigu, Abel Kain ese e alaia mase tauna, ibolona.
GEN.4.25.english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

GEN.1.28.motu: Bena Dirava ese e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, ba hutuma; tanobada ba hahonua bona ba biagua; davara gwarumedia bona atai manudia bona mauri ḡaudia tanobada ai e loamu iboudiai ba biagudia.
GEN.1.28.english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

GEN.15.15.motu: Oi be tubu tama dekedia do baola mai mainomu ida: burukamu ai ba mase, bena bae gurimu.
GEN.15.15.english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

GEN.43.13.motu: Tadimui danu ba hakaua lao, una tau do ba lou henia.
GEN.43.13.english: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.

GEN.50.22.motu: Taunabunai, Iosef bona tamana ena iduhu taudia iboudiai na Aigupto ai ma e nohova. Iosef ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta dikoana gwauta.
GEN.50.22.english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

GEN.36.36.motu: Hadad e mase; bena Samula tau Masareka ese gabuna e abia.
GEN.36.36.english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

GEN.42.24.motu: Bena ia na e raka siri, e tai; gabeamo e lou henidia, e hereva henidia. Bena ia ese Simeon e abia, gadea amo e ḡuia idia vairadiai.
GEN.42.24.english: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

GEN.36.10.motu: Esau natuna mamaruanedia bini: Elifasa, Esau adavana Ada natuna; bona Reuele, Esau adavana Basemata natuna.
GEN.36.10.english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

GEN.39.15.motu: bena gadogu e kamonai negana ai ena dabua na imagu ai e rakatania, e heau lasi.
GEN.39.15.english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

GEN.31.52.motu: Ini nadi anidia binai bona ina pupuna anina binai: lau ese ini nadi basina rakadia hanai, oi ihadikamu, bona oi ese ini nadi bona ina pupuna basio rakadia hanai, lau ihadikagu.
GEN.31.52.english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

GEN.36.15.motu: Hanua lohiadia Esau ena amo e vara ladadia bini: Elifasa, Esau natuna roboana, ese Teman bona Omara bona Sefo bona Kena,
GEN.36.15.english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

GEN.41.35.motu: Madi-namo laḡanidia anianidia iboudiai bae habou, Farao imana ai, bae mia, hanua hanua lalodiai.
GEN.41.35.english: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

GEN.42.34.motu: bena tadimui tau-muritai tauna ba hakaua mai dekegu ai, bena bainadiba umui be hereva momokani taumui; bena tadikakamui na baina henimui lou, bona ina tano ai ba hoihoi danu”.
GEN.42.34.english: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

GEN.34.10.motu: Bogaragimai ai ba noho: ai emai tano na umui emui tano ai bainela; iniseni ai ba biru, ba hoihoi, ba hanua.
GEN.34.10.english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

GEN.32.5.motu: lau na mai egu boromakau bona doniki bona mamoe bona nani bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia; bena ihamaorolaimu herevana egu lohia emu ai name siaia vasi, oi vairamu ai hebogahisi baina davaria totona”.
GEN.32.5.english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

GEN.6.4.motu: Una dinadia ai taunimanima ḡaḡau-babadadia tanobada ai e nohova. Dirava natuna verina ese taunimanima natudia hahinedia e adavadia negadia ai na natudia e havaradia: unu na taunimanima ḡaḡau-babadadia nega gunadia ai e nohova; sivaraidia danu babada.
GEN.6.4.english: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

GEN.27.29.motu: Taunimanima ese oi isiaimu bae lao heni,

GEN.42.35.motu: Bena uit na edia puse amo e bubua negana ai, ta ta edia moni e davari edia puse ai; bena idia bona tamadia moni e itaia ai e gari dikadika.
GEN.42.35.english: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

GEN.44.10.motu: Bena ia eto, Benaini, ini baita kara toma: ena puse ai baina davaria tauna be egu hesiai tauna ai bainela, a orena be baina kahumui nege.
GEN.44.10.english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

GEN.37.30.motu: tadina dekedia e lou lao, eto, Mero na lasihia; lau na ede baina kara toma?
GEN.37.30.english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

GEN.24.57.motu: Bena idia eto, Hane-ulato aita boiria, ia baine hereva.
GEN.24.57.english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

GEN.2.9.motu: Dirava Iehova ese au danu tano ai e havaradia, ita-itadia bona ianidia nanamo audia iboudiai; mauri auna danu imea bogaraginai, namo bona dika idibaladia auna danu.
GEN.2.9.english: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

GEN.18.21.motu: harihari vada baina diho, baina itadia, edia kara na unu haridia dikadia egu ai vada e kau heḡereḡeredia eiava lasi: baina diba ḡoevaḡoeva.
GEN.18.21.english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

GEN.12.5.motu: Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-ahui ima, Haran e rakatania negana ai. Abram ese adavana Sarai bona vavana Lot e hakaudia lao, edia kohu iboudiai bona edia hesiai memerodia Haran ai e davaridia danu e laohaidia; e tore tore isi, Kanaan tanona baela eto. Bena Kanaan tanona ai e kau.
GEN.12.5.english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

GEN.10.27.motu: bona Hadoram bona Usala bona Dikila

GEN.29.21.motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban e hamaoroa, eto, Adavagu a henigu, badina be egu nega vada e ore, taunabunai aina adavaia na tomamu.
GEN.29.21.english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

GEN.15.18.motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Abram e gwau henia hamata, eto, Lau ese ina tano na oi garamu vada na henidia, Aigupto sinavaina amo ela bona sinavai badana, ladana na Eufrate:
GEN.15.18.english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

GEN.29.25.motu: Daba e rere, bena Iakob ese hahine na e itaia, Lea mo. Bena ia ese Laban e gwau henia, eto, Ede vada o karagu toma? Isiaimu asina lao heni Rahela iabina totona a? Dahaka dainai o koigu?
GEN.29.25.english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

GEN.3.24.motu: Ia ese Adam e lulua lasi; bena Moale imeana mairiveina kahana ai kerubi e haginidia, bona lahi darena e atoa, una dare matana e hegiro hanaihanaiva, mauri auna ilao-henina dalana e laoa ahu.
GEN.3.24.english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

GEN.18.23.motu: Bena Abraham na e raka kahira, e nanadaia, eto, O, kara maoromaoro taudia na kara dika taudia ida ba habuadia tari hebou a?
GEN.18.23.english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

GEN.10.4.motu: Iavan natuna bini: Elisa bona Tarasisi; bona Kitim besena bona Dodanim besena danu ia ese e havaradia.
GEN.10.4.english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

GEN.36.11.motu: Elifasa natuna na Teman bona Omara bona Sefo bona Gatam bona Kena.
GEN.36.11.english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

GEN.42.37.motu: Bena Ruben ese tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Beniamina basina hakaua lou dekemu ai, lau natugu raruosi bavaladia mase. Lau imagu ai ba siaia, bena lau ese ma baina mailaia mai maurina ida.
GEN.42.37.english: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

GEN.39.18.motu: bena na lolo negana ai ia ese ena dabua e rakatania, e heau lasi.
GEN.39.18.english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

GEN.25.2.motu: Natudia ia bogana amo e vara ladadia bini: Simuran bona Iokosan bona Medan bona Midian bona Isabak bona Sua.
GEN.25.2.english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

GEN.34.19.motu: hari tauhau na se halahe, edia ura mo e karaia, badina be Iakob natuna ulatona e moalelaia bada; tamana ena ruma ai danu ia sibona herea.
GEN.34.19.english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

GEN.1.8.motu: Dirava ese una ḡau ladana e hatoa Guba. Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina iharuana.
GEN.1.8.english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

GEN.2.2.motu: Dina ihahituna ai, Dirava ese ena ḡaukara idoidiai e hadokodia: dina ihahituna ai ia ese ena ḡaukara iboudiai e ato diho, e laḡa ani.
GEN.2.2.english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

GEN.2.10.motu: Eden imeana amo sinavai ta e aru ela, imea e hapariparia; e aru parara, sinavai hani ai ela.
GEN.2.10.english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

GEN.1.22.motu: Bena Dirava ese e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, ba hutuma, davara idoidiai bae honu honu dae; manu danu bae vara rohoroho tanobada ai.
GEN.1.22.english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

GEN.2.19.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese tano amo tanobada boromadia iboudiai e karadia, bona atai manudia iboudiai danu. Bena ia ese hari tau, Adam, vairanai e hakaudia, baine diba ia ese ladadia ede baine hato toma: mauri ḡaudia iboudiai ta ta Adam ese ladadia e hato.
GEN.2.19.english: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

GEN.3.11.motu: Dirava Iehova eto, Daika ese e hamaorumu oi na ḡaḡaemu mo noho? Lau na haduamu basio ania nato huahuana vada o ania a?
GEN.3.11.english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

GEN.47.13.motu: Tano idoinai doe na bada herea; taunabunai Aigupto idoinai bona Kanaan idoinai aniani na lasi vaitani.
GEN.47.13.english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

GEN.48.9.motu: Iosef ese tamana e haere henia, eto, Ini be lau natugu, Dirava ese vada e henigu ina tano ai. Tau buruka eto, Bae raka kahira, bena baina hanamodia.
GEN.48.9.english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.”

GEN.30.30.motu: Lau do asinama negana ai oi na vada o ogoḡami, harihari vada o taḡa; lau nama ema bona hari Iehova ese vada e hanamomu. A edena nega ai adavagu bona natugu ihataḡadia baina ḡaukara matama a?
GEN.30.30.english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

GEN.31.16.motu: Taḡa idoinai Dirava ese tamamai ena amo vada e abihaia na ai emai bona natumai edia; taunabunai, Dirava ese vada e hamaoromu heḡereḡerena vada ba karaia.
GEN.31.16.english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

GEN.17.10.motu: Ba badinaia, bona murimu ai bae badinaia. taravatuna binai: emui maruane iboudiai bae peritomedia,
GEN.17.10.english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

GEN.31.28.motu: A oi ese o laogu ahu, natugu asina harahudia. Vada o kara kava.
GEN.31.28.english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

GEN.30.8.motu: Bena Rahela eto, Kakagu ida a hedaverai, vada na kwalimu. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Napatali.
GEN.30.8.english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

GEN.39.20.motu: Bena Iosef biaguna ese Iosef e dabaia tao, dibura rumana ai e koua, hanua pavapavana ena iḡui taudia e koudia gabuna ai. Bena dibura rumana ai e nohova.
GEN.39.20.english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

GEN.49.23.motu: Peva taudia ese vada e hahisia,
GEN.49.23.english: The archers have severely grieved him,

GEN.42.17.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese dibura rumana ai e koudia, dina toi.
GEN.42.17.english: He put them all together into custody for three days.

GEN.18.17.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Egu kara na Abraham ena amo baina hunia, namo eiava?
GEN.18.17.english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

GEN.30.43.motu: Taunabunai, Iakob ena taḡa e bada e laova: ena seri e hutumava; ena hesiai hahinedia bona ena hesiai taudia bona ena kamelo bona ena doniki danu hutuma herea.
GEN.30.43.english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

GEN.31.45.motu: Bena Iakob ese nadi ta e abia, e haginia, pupuna ai e halaoa.
GEN.31.45.english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

GEN.15.7.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henia lou, eto, Lau Iehova ese Uru, Kaldea hanuana, amo na hakaumu lasi, ina tano baina henimu halaoreana, emu tano korikori ai bainela.
GEN.15.7.english: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

GEN.41.30.motu: gabeamo doe laḡanidia hitu do bae gini dae, madinamo idoinai Aigupto tanona ai do bae laloa boio, badina be doe baine bada herea.
GEN.41.30.english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

GEN.19.7.motu: bena e hamaorodia, eto, Tadikakagu e, ina kara dikana basio karaia.
GEN.19.7.english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

GEN.11.25.motu: Tera e vara murinai, Nahoro na laḡani sinahu-ta gwauta taurahani-ta e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.25.english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.22.13.motu: Bena Abraham ese matana e roha isi, e roha muri, mamoe maruanena ta doana au ai e hedoa dae e itaia. Bena Abraham na ela, mamoe maruanena e abia, boubou ḡauna ai e halaoa, natuna ibodohilaina.
GEN.22.13.english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

GEN.4.5.motu: a Kain ena boubou ḡauna se hagerea. Kain na e badu dikadika, bena vairana e huaia.
GEN.4.5.english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

GEN.19.12.motu: Bena hari raruosi ese Lot e nanadaia, eto, Varavaramu iboudiai bini eiava? Bema ravamu eiava natumu mamaruanedia eiava natumu hahinedia haida ina hanua ai nonoho, ina gabu amo ba hakaudia lasi.
GEN.19.12.english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

GEN.23.15.motu: Ḡauka e, a kamonai: una tano davana na silver sekeledia sinahuhani. Ita raruosi padadai una na ḡau ta a? Emu mase unuseni ai ba guria.
GEN.23.15.english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

GEN.2.3.motu: Bena Dirava ese dina ihahituna e hanamoa bona e hahelaḡaia: badina be una dina ai ena ḡaukara iboudiai e ato diho, e laḡa ani.
GEN.2.3.english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

GEN.10.17.motu: bona Hivi bona Araka bona Sini
GEN.10.17.english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

GEN.29.9.motu: Ia idia ida dounu e herevava ai, Rahela na e kau, tamana ena mamoe serina e hakaudia, badina be ia ese e reḡudiava.
GEN.29.9.english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

GEN.27.26.motu: Bena tamana Isaak ese e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, mani a raka kahi mai, ame harahugu.
GEN.27.26.english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

GEN.8.5.motu: Ranu ma e maraḡi e laova, ela bona hua ihagwautana ena dina gini-gunana ai ororo doridia e hedinarai.
GEN.8.5.english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

GEN.24.43.motu: ini boma hamomokania toma: ina ranu gabuna ai na nohomu ai hane-ulato ta ranu utu bainema bena baina hereva henia, bainato “Emu hodu ranuna kuri ta a henigu, aina inua”, bena ia baineto
GEN.24.43.english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

GEN.18.5.motu: Aniani taina danu mani aina mailaia, taumui ihagoadadia; gabeamo emui dala ai do ba raka. Lau, emui hesiai tauna, egu ai vada o kau badina korikori binai. Idia eto, Emu hereva heḡereḡerena vada ba karaia.
GEN.18.5.english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.”

GEN.1.4.motu: Dirava ese diari e itaia, vada e namo; bena Dirava ese diari bona dibura e haridia.
GEN.1.4.english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

GEN.24.7.motu: Iehova, guba Diravana, ese tamagu ena ruma amo e abigu oho, egu tano korikori amo e hakaugu lasi, bona e gwau henigu hamata, eto “Ina tano na oi garamu baina henidia”; bena ia ese ena aneru oi vairamu ai baine siaia, bena natugu adavana una tano ai do bavabia.
GEN.24.7.english: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

GEN.31.26.motu: Bena Laban ese Iakob e gwau henia, eto, Badina be dahaka o heau hehuni, natugu hahinedia danu abimauri hahinedia na heheto o heaulaidia?
GEN.31.26.english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

GEN.37.17.motu: Hari tau eto, Ini amo vada e raka oho; badina be edia hereva na kamonai, eto, “Ita na Dotan baitala”. Taunabunai Iosef ese e ḡavadia ela, Dotan ai e ḡavadia tao.
GEN.37.17.english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’”

GEN.32.31.motu: Bena Penuel e rakaia hanai ai daba e rere, ia na aena e heride.
GEN.32.31.english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

GEN.27.45.motu: Ia na do baine laloa boio ede o karaia toma, bena ena badu do baine ore; una negana ai hereva baina siaia, bena ba lou mai. Umui raruosi dina tamona egu ai ba boio anina be dahaka?
GEN.27.45.english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

GEN.21.7.motu: Ma eto, Daika ese Abraham bema hamaoroa, bema toma Sara ese natuna baine ubua? Gau tamona, iahuna ai natuna vada na henia.
GEN.21.7.english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

GEN.37.4.motu: A kakana ese e itaia, tamadia ese Iosef e lalokau henia bada, idia e lalokau henidia maraḡi; bena idia ese e inai henia, hereva namona ta asie gwaurai henia.
GEN.37.4.english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

GEN.31.14.motu: Bena Rahela bona Lea ese e haere henia, eto, Ai ahumai be dahaka tamamai ena ruma ai? Ai na dia ia dihina.
GEN.31.14.english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

GEN.30.10.motu: Bena Lea ena hesiai hahinena Silpa e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia.
GEN.30.10.english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

GEN.14.22.motu: A Abram ese Sodoma pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Lau ese Iehova, Herea Mikamika Diravana, guba bona tanobada ikaradia Diravana, vada na gwvau henia hamata,
GEN.14.22.english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

GEN.18.12.motu: Taunabunai, Sara na e kiri, eto, Egu nega vada e ore, bona adavagu danu vada e buruka, be, moale baina davaria diba a?
GEN.18.12.english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

GEN.37.35.motu: Bena natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia iboudiai na ihamarumaruna totona e lao henia, a ia na tauhalo se ura. Ia na e tai lolololo, eto, Natugu baina lao henia mase gabuna ai mai taigu ida. Tamana ese unu e tailaia toma.
GEN.37.35.english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

GEN.24.56.motu: A ia eto, Asio rugu: Iehova ese egu laolao anina vada e havaraia; mani a kahugu nege, biagugu baina lou henia.
GEN.24.56.english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

GEN.49.16.motu: Dan be ena orea taudia baine hahemaoro henidia,

GEN.50.20.motu: Umui emui lalo-hadai be ba hadikagu o tomova, to Dirava ese anina namona e havaraia; anina na hari dina ai o itaiamu taunimanima hutuma vada na hamauridiamu.
GEN.50.20.english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

GEN.40.19.motu: Dina toi baela, bena Farao ese dibura rumana amo baine abimu, au ta ai baine taumu dae, bena manu bae roho mai, tau-animu bae ania.
GEN.40.19.english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

GEN.46.20.motu: Iosef ese natuna rarua, Manase bona Efraim, na Aigupto tanona ai e abidia, Ono ena hahelaḡa tauna Potifera natuna Asenat bogana amo.
GEN.46.20.english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

GEN.22.10.motu: Bena Abraham ese imana e toia roro, kaia e abia, natuna vada aine alaia mase eto.
GEN.22.10.english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

GEN.16.12.motu: Ia na raka edea tauna ai bainela; ia ese taunimanima iboudiai baine inai henidia, bona taunimanima iboudiai ese ia bae inai henia. Ia na tadikakana edia noho gabudia mairiveina kahana ai baine noho.
GEN.16.12.english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

GEN.5.32.motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ima negana ai, ia ese Sem bona Ham bona Iafet e havaradia.
GEN.5.32.english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

GEN.44.26.motu: Bena ai ato “Tadimai tau-muritai na ai ida baiala be vada baiala; badina be tadimai na ai ida basiala, una tau vairana basia itaia lou”.
GEN.44.26.english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

GEN.37.31.motu: Bena idia ese Iosef ena hahedoki e abia, nani natuna ta e alaia, rarana amo hahedoki e hamiroa.
GEN.37.31.english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

GEN.23.6.motu: Ḡauka e, oi na lohia badana, ai bogaragimai ai; emai gara gabudia ai gabu herea-daena ta bavabia, emu mase ba guria; ai ta ese ena gara gabuna basine rua oiemu ai.
GEN.23.6.english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

GEN.31.53.motu: Abraham ena Dirava, Nahoro ena Dirava, tamadia ena Dirava danu, ia ese baine hahemaoro henida. Bena Iakob na ia tamana Isaak ese e gari henia Diravana ladana ai e gwau hamata.
GEN.31.53.english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

GEN.10.14.motu: bona Patarusim bona Kasaluhim bona Kaftorim. Filistia taudia na Kasaluhim besena amo e vara.
GEN.10.14.english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

GEN.21.15.motu: Ranu na nani kopina na vada e ore ai, ia ese mero maraḡina e abia, au maraḡina ta henunai e atoa diho;
GEN.21.15.english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

GEN.26.29.motu: oi ese basio hadikamai, ai he ḡereḡeremai, emu ai asia dau kau, kara namodia mo a kara henimu, bona mai mainomu ida a siaimu, harihari Iehova ese e hanamomumu.
GEN.26.29.english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”

GEN.16.4.motu: Bena ia na Hagara ida e eno bou. Bena hahine na e rogorogo; bena dibana vada e rogorogo dainai ia ese biaguna hahinena se matauraia.
GEN.16.4.english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

GEN.25.3.motu: Iokosan ese Seba bona Dedan e havaradia. Dedan ese Asuri bona Letusi bona Leumi besedia e havaradia.
GEN.25.3.english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

GEN.38.22.motu: Taunabunai, ia na Iuda dekena e lou lao, eto, Asina davaria, bona una gabu taudia e tomu ariara hahinena ta lasi unuseni ai.
GEN.38.22.english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

GEN.17.3.motu: Bena Abram na tano ai e goru diho; bena Dirava ese e hereva henia, eto,
GEN.17.3.english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

GEN.24.3.motu: Iehova, guba Diravana bona tanobada Diravana, ladana ai ba gwau hamata, natugu Isaak adavana na ini Kanaan taudia, bogaragidiai na noho hedoamu taudia, natudia ulatodia ta basio abia;
GEN.24.3.english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

GEN.29.34.motu: Ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Harihari adavagu ida baia hahebou, badina be memero tatoi vada na heni. Bena ladana e hatoa Levi.
GEN.29.34.english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

GEN.42.11.motu: Ai na tau tamona natuna, hereva momokani taumai; asia hasinadoamu.
GEN.42.11.english: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

GEN.50.19.motu: A Iosef eto, Basio gari; lau be Dirava ibolona a?
GEN.50.19.english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

GEN.13.9.motu: Tano idoinai na oi vairamu ai mia, ani? Mani emu kara, egu ai ba raka siri; oi na lauri kahana boma lao, lau be idiba kahana bama lao; eiava oi na idiba kahana boma lao, lau be lauri kahana bama lao.
GEN.13.9.english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

GEN.20.5.motu: Hari tau ese e hamaorogu, eto “Ina na lau taihugu”, ani? Bona hahine ese danu e hamaorogu, eto “Ia na lau taihugu”. Mai lalogu maoromaorona bona mai imaḡu ḡoevaḡoevadia ida ina kara vada na karaia.
GEN.20.5.english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

GEN.41.55.motu: Bena Aigupto tanona idoinai taunimanima e hitolodiava ai idia ese Farao e tai henia, aniani baine henidia. Bena Farao ese e hamaorodia, eto, Iosef dekena aola, ia ede baine hamaoromui toma vada ba karaia.
GEN.41.55.english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

GEN.14.14.motu: Abram na e kamonai, vavana vada e abia mauri, bena ia ese ena hesiai taudia, ena taruha ai e nohova taudia, e haboudia, tuari ḡaudia e henidia, una tuari oreana muridia amo e hakaudia lao, ela bona Dan.
GEN.14.14.english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

GEN.21.14.motu: Daba matana ai Abraham na e tore isi, lagwa e abia, bona ranu danu nani kopina ai, Hagara e henia; ia na paḡana ai e atoa, bona mero danu; bena e siaia lao. Bena hahine na vada ela, Bere-sieba tano ḡaḡaena ai ehaloa.
GEN.21.14.english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

GEN.11.4.motu: Bena idia ma eto, Mani hanua ta aita hadaia, bona kohoro ta danu, kohoro dorina na guba ai baine kau; unu amo harida baita hadaea, tanobada kopina ai biata loa eva-eva na garina.
GEN.11.4.english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

GEN.9.9.motu: Lau o ina, egu taravatu umui bona murimui bae vara garamui na henimuimu;
GEN.9.9.english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

GEN.50.11.motu: Una tano taudia, Kanaan taudia, ese edia lalo-hisihisi e itaia, Atad ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai, bena idia eto, Aigupto taudia edia taitai na bada herea. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Abele-misraim: ia na Ioridane unukahanai.
GEN.50.11.english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

GEN.34.15.motu: To ini baia kara henimui toma: bema umui ese emui maruane iboudiai ba peritomedia, ai bamomai,
GEN.34.15.english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

GEN.47.16.motu: Iosef eto, Emui boromakau a henigu; lau na uit baina henimui, emui boromakau davadia, asi emui moni dainai.
GEN.47.16.english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

GEN.18.32.motu: Ma eto, Ḡaubada e, basio badu, ina nega tamona mo ma baina noinoi: gwauta hona bema noho, ede bema heto? Iehova eto, Gwauta daidiai baina bogaia hisi.
GEN.18.32.english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?”

GEN.32.21.motu: Taunabunai, unu hesiai taudia ese herahia ḡaudia e gunalai, a Iakob na una hanuaboi taruha ai e noho, ena orea taudia ida.
GEN.32.21.english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

GEN.39.4.motu: ena hesiai ḡaukaradia danu vada e ita, vada e namo herea. Bena ia ese ena ruma ita-taona tauna ai e halaoa, ena kohu idoinai baine reḡua.
GEN.39.4.english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

GEN.33.11.motu: Taunabunai egu herahia ḡaudia bavabi dae, bona egu hahenamo danu; badina be Dirava ese vada e hanamogu badabada, mai dinagu vada nama. Bena e noia goada dainai vada e abi.
GEN.33.11.english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

GEN.14.3.motu: Ini iboudiai na Sidim kourana ai e tuari: tadi gohuna be unuseni ai.
GEN.14.3.english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

GEN.36.19.motu: Esau natuna bunu, bona Edom lohiadia bunu.
GEN.36.19.english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

GEN.42.12.motu: A ia ese ma e gwau henidia, eto, Lasi, tano ena manoka itana totona oma.
GEN.42.12.english: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

GEN.14.19.motu: Ia ese Abram e hanamoa, eto, Dirava Herea Mikamika, guba bona tanobada ikaradia Diravana, ena hahenamo be Abram latanai baine mia;
GEN.14.19.english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

GEN.20.3.motu: Bena Dirava ese Abimelek e hahedinarai henia nihi ai, eto, A kamonai: oi na mase tauna, hari o abia hahinena dainai, badina be ia na tau ta adavana.
GEN.20.3.english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

GEN.34.29.motu: natudia maraḡidia danu bona adavadia e abidia mauri. Edia ruma kohudia e ha-ore, bena ruma e doudia.
GEN.34.29.english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

GEN.31.32.motu: A emu dirava laulaudia na daika dekenai ba davaridia, ia na baine mase. Ai vairamai ai emu a tahu, bavabi. Badina be Iakob na asi dibana Rahela ese e abidia.
GEN.31.32.english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

GEN.34.26.motu: Hamoro bona natuna Sekem danu dare amo e aladia mase. Daina danu Sekem ena ruma amo e hakaua diho, bena ela.
GEN.34.26.english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

GEN.47.27.motu: Israel be Aigupto taudia bogaragidiai e nohova, Gosen ai. Unuseni ai idia na kohu momo e habouva; e hutuma e laova, bona edia taḡa e bada e laova.
GEN.47.27.english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

GEN.27.5.motu: Hari Isaak ena hereva natuna Esau e hamaorolaia na Rebeka danu e kamonai. Bena Esau na eha labana, dia ta baine alaia, baine mailaia eto.
GEN.27.5.english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

GEN.5.31.motu: Lamek ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui hitu: bena e mase.
GEN.5.31.english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

GEN.2.20.motu: Taunabunai, Adam ese boromakau iboudiai ladadia e hato, bona atai manudia bona tanobada danu; a Adam na asi bamona ta ia baine durua.
GEN.2.20.english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

GEN.28.13.motu: Iehova na dorina ai e gini, eto, Lau na Iehova, tubumu Abraham ena Dirava, tamamu Isaak ena Dirava danu: lau ese ina o mahutalaiamu tanona oi baina henimu, oi garamu danu baina henidia.
GEN.28.13.english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

GEN.43.33.motu: Bena edia helai gabudia vada e henidia ia vairanai; edia vara heḡereḡeredia, tau-roboana ela bona tau-muritai. Taunabunai e heita heheni, bona e hoa.
GEN.43.33.english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.

GEN.26.23.motu: Unu amo ia na Bere-sieba ela.
GEN.26.23.english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

GEN.27.36.motu: Esau eto, Ia ladana e hatoa Iakob na mai anina ani? Badina be nega rua vada e bologu: roboa ahuna e abia guna, harihari ihanamogu danu vada e abia. Hahenamo ta dia mia lauegu a?
GEN.27.36.english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

GEN.46.15.motu: Ini iboudiai bona natuna hahinena Daina be Lea natuna bona tubuna, Iakob ese iena amo e abidia Padan-aram ai. Iboudiai be toi-ahui toi.
GEN.46.15.english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

GEN.9.28.motu: Utu-utu badana murinai Noa na laḡani sinahu-toi imahui e mauri nohova.
GEN.9.28.english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

GEN.19.25.motu: Unu hanua ruaosi, bona una taora idoinai, bona hanua taudia, bona taora ai e vara ḡaudia, ibouboudiai ia ese a habuadia tari.
GEN.19.25.english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

GEN.10.31.motu: Ini iboudiai, mai edia iduhu idau-idau bona edia gado idau-idau bona edia tano idau-idau bona edia bese idau-idau na Sem ena amo e vara.
GEN.10.31.english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

GEN.28.17.motu: Bena kudouna e hetaha, eto, Ina gabu na mai garina; Dirava ena ruma binai; guba iduarana binai.
GEN.28.17.english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

GEN.30.21.motu: Una murinai ia ese natuna kekenina ta e abia, bena kekeni ladana e hatoa Daina.
GEN.30.21.english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

GEN.18.1.motu: Iehova ese Abraham enai ma e hedinarai lou, Mamare ena au Helaḡadia badidiai. Negana be dina tubua, bona ia na ena dabua kalagana iduarana ai e helaiva.
GEN.18.1.english: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

GEN.32.13.motu: Una hanuaboi ia na unuseni ai e taruha; bena ena kohu amo herahia gaudia e abi, kakana Esau ena.
GEN.32.13.english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

GEN.14.15.motu: Hanuaboi ai ena orea e hapararaia, kahana kahana amo e tuari henidia, e hadareredia, e hahavadia ela bona Hoba, Damasko mirigini kahana ai.
GEN.14.15.english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

GEN.49.25.motu: Tamamu ena Dirava bunai: ia ese baine durumu,
GEN.49.25.english: even by the God of your father, who will help you,

GEN.12.15.motu: Farao ena lohia taudia ese danu e itaia, bena idia ese Farao vairanai e heatolaia. Bena e hakaua dae Farao ena ruma ai.
GEN.12.15.english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

GEN.24.33.motu: Bena aniani e dabaraia ia vairanai; to ia eto, Basina aniani ela bona egu laolao badina aina gwauraia guna. Idia eto, A hereva.
GEN.24.33.english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.”

GEN.25.13.motu: Ismael garana ladadia bini: natuna roboana na Nebaioto; ia murinai e vara taudia be Kedara bona Adabeel bona Mibisam
GEN.25.13.english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

GEN.24.36.motu: Biagugu adavana Sara na burukana ai natuna e abia; bena Abraham ese ia dihina ai vada e halaoa.
GEN.24.36.english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

GEN.48.7.motu: A lau be Padan amo nama negana ai Rahela na dala ai e mase, Kanaan tanona Efrata ai do asita kau ai. Bena Efrata dalana badinai na guria: una gabu ladana ta be Betelehem.
GEN.48.7.english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

GEN.23.16.motu: Abraham ese Efron ena hereva e kamonai, Hiti taudia vairadiai tano davana unu e gwauraia toma, bena silver sekele dia sinahu-hani, idia edia sekeleheḡereḡeredia, e henia.
GEN.23.16.english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

GEN.24.24.motu: Hane-ulato na e haere, eto, Lau na Betuel natuna; tubugu hahinenana Milka, Nahoro adavana.
GEN.24.24.english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

GEN.43.8.motu: Bena Iuda ese tamana Israel e noia, eto, Mero na ba siaia, baia tore isi, baiala; unu amo baita mauri, basita mase, oi bona natumai maraḡidia danu.
GEN.43.8.english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

GEN.15.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese Abram e hereva henia, eto, Ba diba ḡoevaḡoeva: garamu be sinahu-hani idau tano ai bae noho, daḡedaḡe taudia isiaidia bae lao heni;
GEN.15.13.english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

GEN.49.2.motu: Iakob natuna e, a raka kahira,
GEN.49.2.english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob.

GEN.18.9.motu: Bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, Adavamu Sara be edeseni ai? Ia eto, Ia na dabua kalagana lalonai.
GEN.18.9.english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?”

GEN.38.4.motu: ma ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Onan;
GEN.38.4.english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

GEN.10.25.motu: Ebere natuna mamaruanedia na rarua. Ta ladana na Peleg, badina be iena nega ai tanobada besedia na e haheparara. Tadina ladana na Iokotan.
GEN.10.25.english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

GEN.14.11.motu: Bena pavapava hahaniosi ese kohu idoinai bona aniani idoinai e dadi ore, Sodoma ai bona Gomora ai; bena e raka oho.
GEN.14.11.english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

GEN.36.40.motu: Esau besena edia hanua lohiadia, ta ta mai edia iduhu bona mai edia hanua, ladadia bini: Timna; Alava; Ietete;
GEN.36.40.english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

GEN.30.1.motu: Rahela na gabani, una dainai ia ese kakana e mama henia. Bena ia ese Iakob e gwau henia, eto, Natugu basio henigu vada baina mase.
GEN.30.1.english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

GEN.40.13.motu: Dina toi baela, bena Farao ese baine abimu dae, dagimu baine henimu lou; bena Farao ena kehere na imana ai do bavatoa, gunaguna ena vine ranuna iseina memerodia o reḡudiava negana ai heḡereḡerena.
GEN.40.13.english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

GEN.46.26.motu: Iakob ida Aigupto ela taunimanimadia iboudiai, ia ese e havaradia taudia, be tauratoi-ahui tauratoi; a ravana be se duahidia.
GEN.46.26.english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

GEN.24.53.motu: Bena ia ese herahera ḡaudia, gold ḡaudia bona silver gaudia bona dabua e hulala, Rebeka e henia; taihuna bona sinana danu herahia ḡaudia namo-hereadia e henidia.
GEN.24.53.english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

GEN.1.25.motu: Bena Dirava ese tanobada boromadia idau-idau bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, ta ta ena bese ena bese ai. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
GEN.1.25.english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

GEN.32.18.motu: Bena oi ese ba haere henia, baoto “Ini na emu hesiai tauna Iakob ena, ena herahia ḡaudia lohia taumu Esau emu; ia danu murimai ai e maimu”.
GEN.32.18.english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

GEN.15.12.motu: Dina e diho, bena Abram matana e mahuta, bona gari bada ese e butua tao.
GEN.15.12.english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

GEN.32.27.motu: Bena hari tau eto, Oi ladamu be daika? Ia na e haere, eto, Ladagu na Iakob.
GEN.32.27.english: He said to him, “What is your name?”

GEN.29.23.motu: Hanua e boi, bena ia ese natuna Lea e hakaua vareai Iakob dekenai; bena Iakob ese e adavaia
GEN.29.23.english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

GEN.32.10.motu: Emu hebogahisi karadia iboudiai emu hesiai tauna egu ai o kara, bona emu gwau-hamata herevadia emu hesiai tauna egu ai o hamomokani, lau na dia heḡereḡere; badina be imagu mai itotohina mo ina Ioridane sinavaina na hanai nala, a harihari mai orea rua ida vada na lou mai.
GEN.32.10.english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

GEN.41.25.motu: Bena Iosef ese Farao e hamaoroa, eto, Farao ena nihi be tamona mo; Dirava ese ena kara ta baine karaia e tomu be Farao vada e hamaorolaia guna.
GEN.41.25.english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

GEN.46.29.motu: Bena Iosef ese ena kariota e heḡaeḡaelaia, Gosen ela, tamana ida bae hedavari; enai e kau, bena aiona ai e hegagiu dae, e tai.
GEN.46.29.english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

GEN.21.6.motu: Bena Sara eto, Dirava ese egu kiri badina vada e havaraia; harina bae kamonai taudia iboudiai na lau ida baia kiri hebou.
GEN.21.6.english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

GEN.11.1.motu: Tanobada idoinai taunimanima iboudiai gadodia be tamona, eredia danu heḡereḡere.
GEN.11.1.english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

GEN.7.14.motu: Boroma bona horomakau idau-idau danu, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau, bona manu idau-idau, e gui kau;
GEN.7.14.english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

GEN.46.28.motu: Iakob ese Iuda e siaia guna, Gosen bainela, Iosef baine hadibaia. Bena Gosen ai e lasi.
GEN.46.28.english: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

GEN.6.8.motu: A Noa be Iehova ese e lalo namo heniava.
GEN.6.8.english: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

GEN.49.28.motu: Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi bini; tamadia ena hahenamo herevadiabini. ta ta e hanamolaidia.
GEN.49.28.english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

GEN.10.8.motu: Kusu ese danu Nimrod e havaraia; ia na lohia tauna gini-gunana tanobada ai.
GEN.10.8.english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

GEN.35.1.motu: Dirava ese Iakob e hamaoroa, eto, Betele baola, unuseni ai ba ha noho; unuseni ai danu kakamu Esau o heautania negana ai e hahedinarai henimu Diravana ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia.
GEN.35.1.english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

GEN.35.9.motu: Dirava ese Iakob ma e hahedinarai henia lou, Padan-aram amo ema negana ai, e hanamoa, eto,
GEN.35.9.english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

GEN.10.24.motu: Afasad ese Sela e havaraia, bona Sela ese Ebere e havaraia.
GEN.10.24.english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

GEN.21.32.motu: Taunabunai, idia raruosi na Bere-sieba ai e herohemaino; bena Abimelek bona Fikol, ena tuari oreana biaguna, e lou lao, Filistia tanona ela.
GEN.21.32.english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

GEN.17.12.motu: Uru iboudiai lalodiai, vara matamata mamaruanedia edia vara dinadia bae taurahani ai na bae peritomedia, umui emui ai bae vara memerodia, bona emui hesiai hahinedia ese emui ruma ai bae havaradia memerodia, idau bese memerodia edia bese taudia ediai ba hoidia danu bae peritomedia.
GEN.17.12.english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

GEN.43.20.motu: e hamaoroa, eto, Ḡauka e, nega gini-gunana ama, aniani ihoina moama;
GEN.43.20.english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

GEN.34.22.motu: To idia lalodia bae heḡereḡere bogaragidai bae noho bona ita ida bese tamona ai baitala dalana na tamona mo: ita bogaragidai maruane iboudiai baita peritomedia, idia e karamu heḡereḡerena.
GEN.34.22.english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

GEN.37.23.motu: Taunabunai, Iosef na kakana dekediai e kau ai, idia ese e dabaia tao, ena hahedoki namo-hereana e dokia oho,
GEN.37.23.english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

GEN.27.30.motu: Isaak ese Iakob ihanamona e hadokoa, Iakob danu Isaak vairana amo e raka lasi, asi vanahana kakana Esau na labana amo e lasi.
GEN.27.30.english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

GEN.40.11.motu: Farao ena kehere na imagu ai, bena vine huahuadia na abi, bena na gigi, ranuna na Farao ena kehere ai e diho. Bena kehere na Farao imana ai na atoa.
GEN.40.11.english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

GEN.37.18.motu: A ia na dounu dauhai, idia ese e itaia; bena ia do se raka henidia kahi ai idia vada e henega bou, bae alaia mase eto.
GEN.37.18.english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

GEN.44.13.motu: Bena edia dabua e dare, edia doniki madunadia dorudia ai ma e ato kau, hanua e lou lao.
GEN.44.13.english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

GEN.30.2.motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela e badu henia, eto, Lau Dirava a? Ia ese mero emu ai e ruamu.
GEN.30.2.english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

GEN.1.16.motu: Dirava ese diari badadia rua e kara: badana ese dina baine lohiaia, bona maraḡina ese hanuaboi baine lohiaia eto. Hisiu danu e kara.
GEN.1.16.english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

GEN.25.16.motu: Ismael natudia bunu: ladadia bunu edia hanua bona edia taruha ladadia e hato; idia gwautararuosi na hanua ta ta e halohiadia.
GEN.25.16.english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

GEN.27.6.motu: Bena Rebeka ese natuna Iakob e hereva henia, eto, Tamamu ese kakamu Esau e hamaorolaia herevana na kamonai;
GEN.27.6.english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

GEN.31.21.motu: Ia na ela, ena orea taudia bona ena kohu idoinai danu e laohai, sinavai e hanaia, Gilead ororodia dalana ai ela.
GEN.31.21.english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

GEN.35.27.motu: Iakob na tamana Isaak dekena ela, Mamare ai, hanua ladana Araba. Una hanua ladana ta be Heberon; Abraham bona Isaak edia noho gabuna bunai.
GEN.35.27.english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

GEN.24.47.motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato “Oi be daika natuna?” Bena ia e haere, eto “Lau na Betuel natuna; tubugu na Nahoro bona ia adavana Milka”. Bena gadei na udu-baubauna ai na atoa, bona vaḡivaḡi imana ai.
GEN.24.47.english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

GEN.34.28.motu: Edia mamoe bona edia boromakau bona edia doniki bona edia ruma kohudia bona adia uma anidia idoidiai e abihaidia;
GEN.34.28.english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

GEN.45.1.motu: Iosef na badibadinai e gini taudia vairadiai lalona iha-aukana asi dibana; bena e lolo, eto, Taunimanima iboudiai na vairagu ai bae raka lasi. Bena asi tauna ta dekediai Iosef ese tadikakana e hahedinarai henidia, ia be daika.
GEN.45.1.english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

GEN.12.7.motu: Bena Iehova na Abram vairanai e hedinarai, eto, Lau ese ina tano na oi garamu baina henidia. Bena Abram ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena, Iehova ese ia vairanai e hedinarai gabuna ai.
GEN.12.7.english: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.”

GEN.41.46.motu: Iosef ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui, ia Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, vairanai e gini negana ai. Bena Iosef na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi, Aigupto tanona idoinai e rakaia hanai.
GEN.41.46.english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

GEN.30.37.motu: Bena Iakob ese au rigidia matamatadia e utu, kopidia kahadia e nege, kahadia mimia, ita-itadia revareva na heheto.
GEN.30.37.english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

GEN.4.17.motu: Bena Kain na adavana ida e eno bou; bena hahine na e rogorogo, e mara, Enok e abia. Bena Kain ese hanua ta e hadaia, una hanua ladana e hatoa Enok, natuna ladana heḡereḡerena.
GEN.4.17.english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

GEN.3.4.motu: Gaigai ese hahine e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, umui na basio mase:
GEN.3.4.english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

GEN.42.23.motu: Idia na asi dibadia Iosef na edia hereva anidia dibana, badina be ia na gado-hanai tauna uduna amo mo vada e hereva henidia.
GEN.42.23.english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

GEN.37.32.motu: Bena hari hahedoki na tamadia dekena e laohaia, eto, Ina na ai ese a davaria; a itaia, ina na natumu ena hahedoki eiava?
GEN.37.32.english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

GEN.6.17.motu: Badina be lau e e utu-utu badana tanobada baina ha-utua dae, mauri ḡaudia iboudiai guba henuna amo ihabua-taridia; ḡau iboudiai tanobada ai do bae mase ore.
GEN.6.17.english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

GEN.34.6.motu: Bena Hamoro, Sekem tamana, e lasi, Iakob ida bae hereva-hereva eto.
GEN.34.6.english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

GEN.32.20.motu: Ma baoto “Emu hesiai tauna Iakob na murimai ai e maimu”. Ia na lalona ai eto: Egu herahia ḡaudia amo ena badu baina laoa ahu guna, gabeai ia vairanai baina hedinarai negana ai reana baine abigu dae.
GEN.32.20.english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

GEN.31.19.motu: Una negana ai Laban na ena mamoe huidia iutudia ela. Bena Rahela ese tamana ena dirava laulaudia e henao;
GEN.31.19.english: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

GEN.46.7.motu: natuna mamaruanedia bona tubuna mamaruanedia, natuna hahinedia bona tubuna hahinedia, bona varavarana ibouboudiai. Iboudiai Aigupto e laohaidia.
GEN.46.7.english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

GEN.4.21.motu: Ia tadina ladana na Iubal: ia na gitara bona ivilikou e hataimu taudia senedia.
GEN.4.21.english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

GEN.29.3.motu: mamoe seridia idoidiai e hegogo unuseni ai, bena idia ese nadi na guri iduarana amo e kurea oho, mamoe seridia e ha-inulaidia, bena nadi na guri iduarana ai ekurea lou ena gabu ai.
GEN.29.3.english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

GEN.30.11.motu: Bena Lea eto, Egu madinamo negana binai. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Gad.
GEN.30.11.english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

GEN.18.27.motu: Bena Abraham ma e hereva, eto, Lau na ḡahu kavakava mo, to lalogu vada na ha-aukaia Ḡaubada iherevahenina:
GEN.18.27.english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

GEN.14.16.motu: Kohu idoinai e abia lou, bona vavana Lot mai ena kohu ida, bona hahine, bona hanua taudia loḡora.
GEN.14.16.english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

GEN.8.16.motu: Laḡatoi amo ba diho mai adavamu ida, bona natumu mai adavadia ida.
GEN.8.16.english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

GEN.40.14.motu: A oiemu dala baine namo negana ai ba lalogu, ani? Ba bogagu hisi, Farao ba hereva henia daigu ai, ina dibura rumana amo ba hakaugu lasi.
GEN.40.14.english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

GEN.49.6.motu: Laumagu e, edia kara hehunidia ai basio raka vareai,
GEN.49.6.english: My soul, don’t come into their council.

GEN.27.31.motu: Ia danu vamu namona e nadua, tamana dekena e laohaia, tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu e, a helai tore, natumu egu vamu avania, bena ba hanamogu.
GEN.27.31.english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

GEN.45.25.motu: Taunabunai idia na Aigupto e toretania, Kanaan tanona ela, tamadia Iakob dekenai.
GEN.45.25.english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

GEN.7.21.motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai e mase, manu bona boromakau bona boroma idau-idau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona taunimanima;
GEN.7.21.english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

GEN.6.14.motu: A oi na sida audia amo lagatoi auta ba karaia; ia lalonai daiutu ba kara; bona lalona bona murina ba demadia ahu.
GEN.6.14.english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

GEN.48.18.motu: Iosef eto, Tamagu e, dia eneheto, badina be ina na tau-guna; imamu idibana be ia tubuana ai bavatoa kau.
GEN.48.18.english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

GEN.32.32.motu: Badina bunai Israel besena taudia na mamu varovarodia asie animu ema bona harihari: badina be Iakob mamuna varovarona e daua toho bena aena e heride.
GEN.32.32.english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

GEN.31.54.motu: Bena Iakob ese Dirava e boua una ororo ai, bona ena orea taudia e haduadia, bae aniani. Taunabunai, e aniani, bona ororo ai e noho rani.
GEN.31.54.english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

GEN.34.31.motu: A idia e haere, eto, Be, taihumai na ariara hahinena ai e halaoa namo eiava?
GEN.34.31.english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

GEN.41.43.motu: E haduaia danu, kariota iharuana, iena kariota murinai e heauva ḡauna, latanai baine gui. Haida danu ia vairanai e heau, e boiboi, eto, Dala a lailaia. Unuhetomana ia ese Aigupto tanona idoinai lohiana ai e halaoa.
