GEN.41.43.english: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

GEN.17.2.motu: taravamu aina atua raruosi eda, bona garamu baina hahutumadia.
GEN.17.2.english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

GEN.24.21.motu: Hari hesiai tauna ese e raraia tao, se hereva, baine diba eto, Iehova ese ena laolao anina vada e havaraia eiava.
GEN.24.21.english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

GEN.47.23.motu: Bena Iosef ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, Hari dina ai umui vada na hoimui bona emui tano vada na hoi. Uhe bini, vada ba hado.
GEN.47.23.english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

GEN.40.10.motu: rigina na toi. Bena e gara kau, burena e vara, huahuana e dobi.
GEN.40.10.english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

GEN.19.32.motu: Aitala, tamada na vine ranuna amo baita hakekeroa, bena ia ida baita eno bou, tamada ena amo natuda baita abidia.
GEN.19.32.english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

GEN.27.21.motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, mani a raka kahi mai, baina darahumu oi na momokani lau natugu Esau eiava lasi.
GEN.27.21.english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

GEN.31.37.motu: Egu kohu idoinai vada o tahu vaitani, emu o davaria be edena? Lauegu orea taudia bona oiemu orea taudia vairadiai ba vaia dae, bena ita raruosi bae hahemaoro henida.
GEN.31.37.english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

GEN.31.38.motu: Laḡani ruahui dekemu ai na noho; emu mamoe bona emu nani hahinedia asie mara dika, emu nani mamaruanedia danu ta asina abia, asina ania.
GEN.31.38.english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

GEN.26.26.motu: Abimelek na Gerara amo ema, ia bona turana ta Ahusata bona ena tuari oreana biaguna Fikol, tatoiosi Isaak dekena ema.
GEN.26.26.english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

GEN.37.8.motu: Bena kakana ese e gwau henia, eto, Oi na ai emai pavapava ai baola a? Oi ese ai ba halohiamai a? Bena ena nihi bona ena hereva daidiai edia badu ienai vada e bada e laova.
GEN.37.8.english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

GEN.29.24.motu: Laban ese danu ena hesiai hahinena Silpa na Lea e henia, ena hesiai hahinena ai bainela.
GEN.29.24.english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

GEN.49.26.english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors,

GEN.10.1.motu: Noa natuna tatoisi, Sem bona Ham bona Iafet, garadia bini, utu-utu badana murinai e havaradia.
GEN.10.1.english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

GEN.43.3.motu: Bena Iuda ese e haere henia, eto, Una tau ena hereva na auka, eto “Tadimui basio hakaua mai, lau vairagu basio itaia”.
GEN.43.3.english: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

GEN.7.13.motu: Una dina ai Noa mai adavana ida, bona natuna tatoiosi, Sem bona Ham bona Iafet, mai adavadia ida, lagatoi ai e gui.
GEN.7.13.english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

GEN.14.23.motu: dabua varona ta eiava tamaka varona ta oiemu ai basina abia, gabeamo baoto “Lau ese Abram ena taḡa na henia” na garina.
GEN.14.23.english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

GEN.45.7.motu: Dirava ese e siaigu, baina gunalaimui, umui baina hamaurimui bona besemui baina hamauridia helaoreana, bena bese badana ai baola.
GEN.45.7.english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

GEN.37.1.motu: Iakob ese tamana e noholaia tanona ma e noholaia, Kanaan tanona.
GEN.37.1.english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

GEN.1.29.motu: Dirava ma eto. A itaia, mai nadinadidia avadia bona mai huahuadia audia vada na henimui, amui aniani;
GEN.1.29.english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

GEN.28.2.motu: Padan-aram baola, tubumu Betuel ena ruma ai ba dae kau, vavamu Laban natuna kekenidia ta bavadavaia.
GEN.28.2.english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

GEN.37.27.motu: Ini Ismael taudia ediai aita hoia. Imada na ienai basita dau kau, badina be ia na tadida korikori. Bena tadikakana ese ena hereva e abia dae.
GEN.37.27.english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

GEN.17.9.motu: Dirava ese Abraham ma e hamaoroa, eto, Oi danu egu taravatu do ba badinaia, oi bona murimu ai bae vara garamu ela bona uru idoidiai.
GEN.17.9.english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

GEN.5.21.motu: Enok ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Metusela e havaraia.
GEN.5.21.english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

GEN.4.3.motu: Nega ta ai Kain ese tano anidia e mailai, Iehova ena boubou ḡauna ai baine halaoa eto.
GEN.4.3.english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

GEN.50.16.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese hereva ta e siaia Iosef dekenai, eto, Tamamu do se mase ai e haḡanimai, eto
GEN.50.16.english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

GEN.20.1.motu: Una negana ai, Abraham na e tore isi, eha laolao, diho kahana ela, Gerara ai e noho, Kade bona Suru padadiai.
GEN.20.1.english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

GEN.16.7.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ta ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e davaria, ranu gurina ta badibadinai. Una ranu gurina na Suru dalana ai.
GEN.16.7.english: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

GEN.29.15.motu: Bena Laban ese Iakob e hereva henia, eto, Oi na varavaragu dainai isiaigu ba lao heni asi davamu a? Ame hamaorogu, davamu be dahaka?
GEN.29.15.english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

GEN.12.17.motu: A Iehova ese hisihisi dikadia amo Farao mai ena ruma taudia ida e hahisidia, Sarai, Abram adavana, dainai.
GEN.12.17.english: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

GEN.41.36.motu: Una aniani na roge ai baine mia ela bona doe laḡanidia hituosi na Aigupto ai bae gini dae; bena ina tano taunimanimadia na basie hitolo mase.
GEN.41.36.english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

GEN.21.34.motu: Bena Abraham na nega daudau Filistia tanona ai e noho hedoa.
GEN.21.34.english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

GEN.41.29.motu: Laḡani hitu be gini daemu, Aigupto tanona idoinai baine madinamo;
GEN.41.29.english: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

GEN.3.18.motu: Au giniginidia bona ava ḡiniḡinidia danu tano ai bae vara oiemu ai. Tanobada avadia anidia do bavani.
GEN.3.18.english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you;

GEN.18.4.motu: Mani ranu taina ae mailaia, aemui bae huri, bena ina au ikerukeruna ai lagamui bavani.
GEN.18.4.english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

GEN.5.4.motu: Set e vara murinai Adam ma laḡani sinahu-taurahani e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.4.english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.24.44.motu: “Mani a inua, bona emu kamelo edia ranu danu baina utua”, baina diba hane-ulatona bunai, Iehova ese vada e abia hidi biagugu natuna baine adavaia ulatona.
GEN.24.44.english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

GEN.32.24.motu: A Iakob na sibona noho, bena tau ta na ia ida e hedaverai ela bona daba e kinia.
GEN.32.24.english: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

GEN.34.5.motu: Iakob na harina e kamonai Sekem ese natuna Daina vada e hahemaraia, a natuna mamaruanedia ese taora ai seri e reḡudiava, bena Iakob ese hereva ta se gwauraia ela bona idia ema.
GEN.34.5.english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

GEN.39.12.motu: Bena hahine ese ena dabua e dogoa tao, e veria, eto, Aoma, aita eno bou. A ia ese ena dabua na hahine imana ai e rakatania, ruma amo e heau lasi.
GEN.39.12.english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!”

GEN.35.15.motu: Bena una Dirava ese e hereva henia gabuna ladana e hatoa Betele.
GEN.35.15.english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

GEN.13.14.motu: Bena Lot e raka oho murinai Iehova ese Abram e hereva henia, eto, A gaga isi; o ginimu gabuna ai ba roha roha, mirigini kahana ai, diho kahana ai, mairiveina kahana ai, tahodiho kahana ai.
GEN.13.14.english: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

GEN.17.26.motu: Abraham mai natuna Ismael ida dina tamona ai e peritomedia.
GEN.17.26.english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

GEN.13.3.motu: Diho kahana amo e laolao ela, Betele ai e kau, ena taruha gabuna gunana ai ma e taruha, Betele bona Ai padadiai;
GEN.13.3.english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

GEN.26.16.motu: Bena Abimelek ese Isaak e hamaoroa, eto, Ai emai amo a raka oho, badina be vada o hereamai.
GEN.26.16.english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

GEN.24.5.motu: Bena una hesiai tauna e haere henia, eto, O, hane-ulato na reana lalona basine heḡereḡere lau baine bamogu ina tano baiama; unu bema heto, oi natumu bama hakaua lao, o rakatania tanona baiala, namo eiava?
GEN.24.5.english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

GEN.21.28.motu: Bena Abraham ese mamoe natudia hitu e abidia, kaha ta ai e atodia tabe.
GEN.21.28.english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

GEN.43.12.motu: Moni ikumidia rua rua danu bavabi kau; emui puse ai e uda lou monidia danu ba loulai, badina be e uda taudia na e kerere readia.
GEN.43.12.english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

GEN.23.9.motu: ia ese Makapela kohuana, ena tano hetoana ai, bema henigu. Davana korikori baina henia, egu gara gabuna ai baina halaoa.
GEN.23.9.english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

GEN.35.12.motu: Abraham bona Isaak na henidia tanona oi baina henimu, bona oi garamu murimu ai bae vara danu baina henidia.
GEN.35.12.english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

GEN.21.31.motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Bere-sieba, badina be raruosi unuseni ai e gwau hamata heheni.
GEN.21.31.english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

GEN.38.30.motu: Bena kakana e vara; ia ladana e hatoa Sera.
GEN.38.30.english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

GEN.14.13.motu: Bena e heau mauri tauna ta ela, Abram, Heberu tauna, e hamaoroa. Ia na Mamare, Amoro tauna, Eskol bona Anere kakadia, ena au helaḡadia badibadi-diai e nohova, bona idia tatoiosi ida e hetura.
GEN.14.13.english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

GEN.35.21.motu: Israel ma e laolao, kohoro ladana Mamoe Kohorona unukahana ai e taruha.
GEN.35.21.english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

GEN.24.48.motu: Bena na igo diho, Iehova, biagugu ena Dirava, na imodaia, badina be ia ese e hakaugu maoro, biagugu tadina tubuna baina abia ia natuna baine adavaia helaoreana.
GEN.24.48.english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

GEN.47.18.motu: Una l=agani e ore, bena laḡani iharuana ma e lou mai ia dekenai, eto, Lohia taumu e, ai na asia koimumu: emai moni vada e ore, emai boromakau iboudiai vada o abi; ḡau ta dia mia baia henimu, tau-animai bona emai tanomo vadaeni.
GEN.47.18.english: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

GEN.29.2.motu: Bena ranu gurina ta e itaia taora ai, mamoe seridia toi na badibadinai hehekure, badina be una ranu na mamoe seridia e hainulaidia. Nadi badana ta ai guri iduarana e koua ahu;
GEN.29.2.english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

GEN.49.3.motu: Ruben, oi na natugu roboana, egu goada anina roboana,
GEN.49.3.english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength,

GEN.1.30.motu: tanobada boromadia iboudiai danu, bona atai manudia iboudiai, bona mauri ḡaudia tanobada ai e loamu iboudiai, na ava raudia vada na henidia, adia aniani. Bena unu e vara toma.
GEN.1.30.english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

GEN.2.25.motu: Idia raruosi, Adam mai adavana ida, na asi edia riorio ḡaudia, to asie hemaraiva.
GEN.2.25.english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

GEN.24.6.motu: Abraham ma eto, Lasi vaitani, natugu na basio laohaia, una tano na basinela.
GEN.24.6.english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

GEN.23.18.motu: Abraham ena tano korikori ai ela. Hiti taudia vairadiai bona ena hanua lalonai e hebouva taudia iboudiai vairadiai e hoia.
GEN.23.18.english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

GEN.37.29.motu: Gabeamo Ruben na guri e lou henia, a Iosef na lasihia. Bena ena dabua e darea,
GEN.37.29.english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

GEN.50.3.motu: Dina hari-ahui vada ela, muramura taudia edia ḡaukara dinadia; bena dina hitu-ahui e tailaia, Aigupto taudia ese.
GEN.50.3.english: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

GEN.14.12.motu: Lot, Abram vavana, Sodoma ai e nohova; bena idia ese ia danu e abia mauri, e laohaia, mai ena kohu idoinai.
GEN.14.12.english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

GEN.44.16.motu: Bena Iuda eto, Egu lohia e, ede baia hereva henimu toma? Ede baia maoro toma oi vairamu ai? Dirava ese emu hesiai taudia emai kerere vada e hahedinaraia; harihari ai na oi imamu ai, ai bona ena puse ai emu kehere e davaria tauna danu.
GEN.44.16.english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

GEN.24.41.motu: Unu amo emu gwauhamata baine heruha, varavaragu dekediai ba kau negana ai; a idia na hane-ulato bema rua basiema henimu negana ai danu emu gwauhamata bema heruha”.
GEN.24.41.english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

GEN.24.54.motu: Bena ia mai bamona ida e aniani, e inuinu, bena e mahuta. Daba ai e tore isi, eto, Mani a kahugu nege, biagugu baina lou henia.
GEN.24.54.english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

GEN.31.23.motu: Bena ia ese varavarana e haboudia, dina hitu Iakob e ḡavaia, ela bona Gilead ororodia ai e ḡavaia tao.
GEN.31.23.english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

GEN.29.5.motu: Ma e nanadaidia lou, eto Umui na Laban, Nahoro natuna, dibamui eiava? Idia eto, Dibamai.
GEN.29.5.english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?”

GEN.39.2.motu: A Iehova ese Iosef e haḡerea, bena vada e namo: ia ese biaguna, Aigupto tauna, ena ruma ai e nohova.
GEN.39.2.english: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

GEN.34.7.motu: A Iakob natuna mamaruanedia na harina e kamonai, bena taora amo e lasi mai lalo-hisihisidia bona mai badudia ida; badina be una tau ese Israel vada e hahemaraia, Iakob natuna Daina vada e ḡaḡaia, dainai.
GEN.34.7.english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

GEN.43.15.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese herahia e abi kau, tamadia ena hereva heḡereḡerena, bona moni ikumidia rua rua amo, bona Beniamina danu e hakaua. Bena e tore isi, Aigupto tanona ela, Iosef vairanai e gini.
GEN.43.15.english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

GEN.43.27.motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Umui be edeheto? Tamamui danu namo a, hari tau buruka vanegai sivaraina o gwauraia; ia dounu mauri eiava?
GEN.43.27.english: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

GEN.25.18.motu: Edia tano na Havila ela bona Suru, Aigupto mairiveina kahana ai; tadikakadia iboudiai idia mo mairiveina kahana korikori ai e nohova.
GEN.25.18.english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

GEN.31.13.motu: Lau binai, Betele Diravana: unuseni ai oi ese boubou nadina dehoro o horolaia, bona o gwau henigu hamata. Benaini, a tore isi, ina tano amo ba raka lasi, o vara gabuna ba lou henia.”
GEN.31.13.english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

GEN.47.14.motu: Moni idoinai Aigupto ai bona Kanaan ai na uit ihoilaina ai e ore, idoinai Iosef mo imana ai. Bena ia ese Farao ena ruma ai e haboua.
GEN.47.14.english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

GEN.41.52.motu: A tau muritai ladana e hatoa Efraim; eto, Hisi na ani tanona ai Dirava ese besegu vada e henigu.
GEN.41.52.english: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

GEN.30.13.motu: Bena Lea eto, Na moalemu; hahine iboudiai danu bae hanamogu. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Asere.
GEN.30.13.english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

GEN.46.11.motu: Levi natuna be Gereson bona Kohat bona Merari.
GEN.46.11.english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

GEN.24.60.motu: Idia ese Rebeka e hanamoa, eto, Taihumai e, daha daha oiemu amo bae vara: oi garamu ese inaidia do bae hadareredia.
GEN.24.60.english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

GEN.19.27.motu: Una daba ai Abraham e tore isi, Iehova ida e hereva-hereva gabuna e raka henia;
GEN.19.27.english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

GEN.14.6.motu: Hori taudia danu edia ororo, ladana Seiri, ai e hadareredia, bona e hahavadia lao ela bona El-paran, tano ḡaḡaena badinai.
GEN.14.6.english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

GEN.5.27.motu: Metusela ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta tauratoi-ahui taurahani-ta: bena e mase.
GEN.5.27.english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

GEN.25.7.motu: Abraham ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-ta hituahui ima.
GEN.25.7.english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

GEN.49.5.motu: Simeon bona Levi na boga tamona amo;

GEN.42.26.motu: Bena edia puse na edia doniki dorudia ai e ato kau, e raka lao.
GEN.42.26.english: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

GEN.43.22.motu: Bona moni haida danu vada a mailai, aniani ihoilaina. A asi dibamai daika ese emai moni na e uda lou emai puse ai.
GEN.43.22.english: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

GEN.25.22.motu: Hekapa na ia bogana ai e hedavelai; bena ia eto, Ini e karagu tomamu be ede baina heto? Bena Iehova enai e henanadai.
GEN.25.22.english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

GEN.41.54.motu: bena doe laḡanidia gini-gunana vada e gini dae, Iosef ena hereva heḡereḡerena. Bena tano idau-idau iboudiai lalodiai taunimanima e hitolodiava; a Aigupto ai aniani na mia.
GEN.41.54.english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

GEN.45.11.motu: Lau ese baina narimui, bena oi bona emu orea taudia iboudiai basio hitolo. Badina be doe laḡanidia ima na do mimia”.
GEN.45.11.english: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

GEN.43.7.motu: Idia eto, Una tau ese e nanadaimai malakamalaka, eda iduhu herevadia e nanadailai, eto, “Tamamui dounu e mauri nohomu?” bona “Tadimui ta noho?” Bena ai ese a haere henia. Ede baiama diba toma ia baineto “Tadimui ba hakaua mai” a?
GEN.43.7.english: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

GEN.10.26.motu: Iokotan natuna bini: Alamodad bona Selefe bona Hasaramavete bona Iera
GEN.10.26.english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

GEN.7.11.motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanina ihasinahu-tauratoina, hua iharuana, hua dinana ihagwauta-hituna, abata bada-hereana e lasi bona medu bada-hereana e diho matama.
GEN.7.11.english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

GEN.11.24.motu: Nahoro ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui taurahani-ta negana ai ia ese Tera e havaraia.
GEN.11.24.english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

GEN.9.1.motu: Dirava ese Noa mai natuna ida e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, bae vara rohoroho, tanobada bae hahonua.
GEN.9.1.english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

GEN.24.25.motu: Ma eto, Uit momona bona rei kakoro momo dekemai ai mimia, emui mahuta gabuna ta danu mia.
GEN.24.25.english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

GEN.41.19.motu: Gabeamo boromakau idaudia hitu ma e dae, taudia didika bona vavaroda-vavaroda, Aigupto tanona idoinai boromakau dikadia unuhetomadia na hata asina itadia.
GEN.41.19.english: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

GEN.42.10.motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Ḡaubada e, lasi, dia unuheto; ai na oi isiaimu ilao-henina taumai, aniani ihoina totona ama.
GEN.42.10.english: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

GEN.40.5.motu: Unu tatau raruosi na hanuaboi tamona ai e nihi: Farao ena vine ranuna iseina memerodia iregudia tauna bona ena flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna na ta ta ena nihi ena nihi e nihirai, dibura rumana ai.
GEN.40.5.english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

GEN.36.13.motu: Reuele natuna bini: Nahata bona Sera bona Sama bona Misa. Idia na Esau adavana Basemata tubuna.
GEN.36.13.english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

GEN.16.14.motu: Taunabunai una ranu gurina ladana e hatoa Mauri bona Mata-hanai Gurina: ia na Kade bona Bered padadiai.
GEN.16.14.english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

GEN.29.1.motu: Iakob na e raka lao, ela bona mairiveina kahana taudia edia tano ai eha kau.
GEN.29.1.english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

GEN.29.17.motu: Lea matana na dika, a Rahela na hane namo, mai hairaina.
GEN.29.17.english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

GEN.27.19.motu: Iakob ese tamana e haere henia, eto, Lau binai Esau, natumu roboana, emu hahedua vada na badinaia; a helai tore, dia vada na alaia be bavania, bena ba hanamogu.
GEN.27.19.english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

GEN.38.10.motu: Una kara dikana dainai Iehova ese e badu henia, e alaia mase, kakana bamona.
GEN.38.10.english: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.

GEN.25.26.motu: Gabeai tadina e vara, bena ia imana ese Esau aena geduna e dogoa tao; bena ladana e hatoa Iakob. Isaak ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui, idia raruosi e vara negana ai.
GEN.25.26.english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

GEN.45.26.motu: E hamaoroa, eto, Iosef e maurimu, Aigupto tanona idoinai e lohiaiamu. Bena Iakob laumana e daure, edia hereva se abia dae.
GEN.45.26.english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

GEN.24.27.motu: eto, Iehova, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava, na imodaiamu; ena hebogahisi bona ena momokani biagugu enai vada e hesiriumu, taunabunai ia ese egu dala ai vada e hakaugu maoro, ema bona biagugu varavarana edia ruma.
GEN.24.27.english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

GEN.12.11.motu: Bena Aigupto vada e kahira ai, ia ese adavana Sarai e hereva henia, eto, Momokani, oi na hane namo:
GEN.12.11.english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

GEN.46.8.motu: Israel garana, Aigupto ela taudia, ladadia bini, Iakob mai natuna iboudiai ida.
GEN.46.8.english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

GEN.24.42.motu: Bena hari dina ai ranu gabuna ai na kau, bena na ḡuriḡuri, nato: Iehova e, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava, boma ura egu laolao anina namona boma havaraia,
GEN.24.42.english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

GEN.23.20.motu: Una tano bona una kohua be Abraham ese e abi vaitani, Hiti taudia edia amo.
GEN.23.20.english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

GEN.15.4.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva enai ma e kau, eto, Ina tau na dia oi dihimu; natumu adorana do baine vara, dihimu ai bainela.
GEN.15.4.english: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

GEN.4.13.motu: Bena Kain ese Iehova e hamaoroa, eto, Egu dika davana na metau herea; egu haheauka basine heḡereḡere.
GEN.4.13.english: Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

GEN.24.18.motu: Hane-ulato na eto, Ḡauka e, a inua. Bena ranu e seia, e ha-inulaia.
GEN.24.18.english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

GEN.33.8.motu: Esau ma e henanadai, eto, Unu seri iboudiai dala ai na itadia be edeheto? Iakob na e haere, eto, Una na herahia ḡauna, egu lohia vairamu ai baina mauri helaoreana.
GEN.33.8.english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?”

GEN.18.14.motu: Be, hoa karana ta mia Iehova basine karaia diba, a? Laḡani vairai, vada na gwauraia hamata negana ai, do baina lou henimu, bena Sara ese natuna baine abia.
GEN.18.14.english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

GEN.7.23.motu: Tano kopina ai e mauriva ḡaudia iboudiai na e hebua tari, taunimanina bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona atai manudia. Noa mo sibona, bona ia ida lagatoi ai e nohova ḡaudia, vada e mauri.
GEN.7.23.english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

GEN.9.5.motu: Umui raramui danu, emui mauri badina, davana baina abia: boroma enai baina abia eiava taunimanima enai baina abia; taunimanima enai tadikakana rarana davana baina abia.
GEN.9.5.english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

GEN.28.14.motu: Oi garamu danu bae hutuma, tano ḡahuna na heto, tahodiho kahana ai bona mairiveina kahana ai bona mirigini kahana ai bona diho kahana ai do bae pere rohoroho; oi daimu ai bona garamu daidiai tanobada iduhudia idoidiai bae namo.
GEN.28.14.english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

GEN.14.17.motu: Kedoralaomere mai bamona ida e hadareredia, bena e lou ai na Sodoma pavapavana ida e hedavari Save kourana ai (Pavapava ena Koura).
GEN.14.17.english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

GEN.2.4.motu: Guba bona ikaradia herevadia bini: ihavaradia negana ai Dirava Iehova ese tanobada bona guba e karava dinana ai,
GEN.2.4.english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made the earth and the heavens.

GEN.9.6.motu: Taunimanina baine alaia mase tauna na taunimanima ese bae alaia mase; badina be Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia, ia ida-idana.
GEN.9.6.english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

GEN.24.63.motu: Adorahi ta taora ai eha loaloa, dina kerekerena ai, bena e roha isi, kamelo e maiva e itadia.
GEN.24.63.english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

GEN.48.19.motu: A tamana na se ura, eto, Natugu e, mai dibagu na karaiamu: momokani, ia be bese badana ta baine havaraia, to tadina ese baine hereaia, bese bada-hereanabaine havaraia.
GEN.48.19.english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

GEN.30.23.motu: E mara, mero ta e abia: bena eto, Dirava ese egu hemarai vada e abia oho.
GEN.30.23.english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

GEN.23.8.motu: e hamaorodia, eto, Lalomui bema heḡereḡere egu mase iniseni ai bama guria, Efron Sohara boma noia daigu ai:
GEN.23.8.english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

GEN.24.10.motu: Bena una hesiai tauna na biaguna ena kamelo gwauta e abidia, bona kohu namodia haida danu, biaguna ena, e abi. Bena e tore isi, eha laolao, Mesopotamia tanona ela, hanua ta ladana Nahoro ai eha kau.
GEN.24.10.english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

GEN.37.33.motu: E itaia, bena eto, Ina na natugu ena hahedoki; uda boromana ta ese vada e alaia mase; momokani, Iosef vada e mase.
GEN.37.33.english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

GEN.36.20.motu: Seiri tau Hori natuna una tano ai e nohova ladadia bini: Lotan bona Sobal bona Sibeon bona Ana
GEN.36.20.english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

GEN.39.23.motu: Dibura rumana igimana tauna ese ḡau ta se laloa ena hereḡu ai; badina be Iehova ese Iosef e hagerea, bona ena ḡaukara iboudiai anidia e havara.
GEN.39.23.english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.

GEN.50.6.motu: Bena Farao eto, Vada aola, tamamu ba guria, emu gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena.
GEN.50.6.english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

GEN.15.14.motu: a isiaina bae lao heni besena lau ese baina hahemaoro henia; bena ia bogaragina amo bae raka lasi, mai edia taḡa.
GEN.15.14.english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

GEN.33.10.motu: Iakob eto, Lasi, bema lalomu vada eme namo egu ai, bavabi, egu lalokau toana; badina be oi vairamu vada na itaia, Dirava vairana bama itaia heḡereḡerena, bona vada o lalo namo henigu.
GEN.33.10.english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

GEN.2.15.motu: Dirava Iehova ese hari tau e abia, Eden imeana ai e atoa, ia ese baine biru henis bona baine reḡua.
GEN.2.15.english: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

GEN.6.11.motu: Tanobada na dika, Dirava vairanai: tanobada idoinai daḡedaḡe ai e honu honu dae.
GEN.6.11.english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

GEN.26.33.motu: Bena una ranu gabuna ladana e hatoa Siba, taunabunai una hanua ladana na Bere-sieba ema bona harihari.
GEN.26.33.english: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

GEN.41.51.motu: Roboana na Iosef ese ladana e hatoa Manase; eto, Dirava ese egu hekwarahi bona tamagu ena ruma ilalolaidia na egu amo vada e abi oho.
GEN.41.51.english: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

GEN.5.10.motu: bena Kenan e vara murinai Enos na laḡani sinahu-taurahani gwauta-ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.10.english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.26.12.motu: Isaak ese aniani e hado matama una tano ai, bena una laḡani tamona lalonai anidia sinahu sinahu e abi; badina be Iehova ese e hanamoa.
GEN.26.12.english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

GEN.48.17.motu: A Iosef na e itaia tamana ese imana idibana Efraim tubuana ai e atoa kau, bena lalona e hekwakwanai. Bena tamana imana e abia, Manase tubuana ai baine atoa kau eto.
GEN.48.17.english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

GEN.33.3.motu: A ia na e raka guna, nega hahitu tano ai e goru diho, ela bona kakana e raka henia kahi.
GEN.33.3.english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

GEN.1.24.motu: Dirava ma eto, Tanobada ese mauri ḡaudia idau-idau baine havaradia, boromakau, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia, bona tanobada boromadia idau-idau ta ta ena bese ai. Bena unu e vara toma.
GEN.1.24.english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

GEN.9.3.motu: E maurimu bona e loamu ḡaudia iboudiai na amui vamu; aniani avadia vada na henimui heḡereḡerena, ini danu na henimuimu, amui;
GEN.9.3.english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

GEN.7.10.motu: Bena dina hitu e ore murinai, utu-utu badana na tanobada idoinai e utua dae.
GEN.7.10.english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

GEN.25.32.motu: Esau eto, Be, mokona ba masemu, roboa ahuna ese ede baine hanamogu toma?
GEN.25.32.english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

GEN.24.17.motu: Bena hari hesiai tauna e heau ela, e hereva henia, eto, Emu hodu ranuna kuri ta mani aina inua.
GEN.24.17.english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

GEN.31.1.motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban natuna mamaruanedia edia maumau e kamonai: idia na e maumau, eto “Iakob ese tamamai ena kohu idoinai vada e abihaia, unu amo ena taḡa idoinai vada e abi”.
GEN.31.1.english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

GEN.21.11.motu: Bena Abraham lalona e hisihisi bada, natuna dainai.
GEN.21.11.english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

GEN.41.49.motu: Taunabunai, Iosef ese uit e habou, kone mirina na heto, ela bona iduahina e hadokoa, badina be asi iduahina dalana.
GEN.41.49.english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

GEN.50.26.motu: Taunabunai Iosef na e mase: ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta dikoana gwauta. Bena idia ese ia tau-anina e haḡoevaia, muramura e karalaia, bena maua ai e udaia, Aigupto ai.
GEN.50.26.english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

GEN.36.42.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

GEN.46.10.motu: Simeon natuna be Iemuel bona Iamin bona Ohad bona Iakin bona Sohara bona Saul. Saul be hane Kanaan natuna.
GEN.46.10.english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

GEN.29.14.motu: Bena Laban ese e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, oi na turiagu turiana bona hidiogu hidiona. Taunabunai, Iakob na ia ida e noho, hua tamona.
GEN.29.14.english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

GEN.5.13.motu: bena Mahalalel e vara murinai Kenan na laḡani sinahu-taurahani hari-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.13.english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

GEN.47.3.motu: Bena Farao ese e nanadaidia, eto, Emui ḡaukara be dahaka? Idia eto, Ai oi isiaimu ilao-henina taumai be mamoe ireḡudia taumai, senemai bamodia.
GEN.47.3.english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?”

GEN.7.2.motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai bavabidia: ḡoevaḡoevadia na hitu hitu amo bavabidia, maruane hitu hahine hitu, unu bavabidia toma; a asi ḡoevaḡoevadia na rua rua amo, maruane ta hahine ta bavabidia.
GEN.7.2.english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

GEN.41.4.motu: Bena hari boromakau varoda-varodadia hituosi ese boromakau mai digaradia hituosi e anidia ore. Bena Farao na e noga.
GEN.41.4.english: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

GEN.13.7.motu: Bena Abram ena boromakau ireḡudia taudia na Lot ena boromakau ireḡudia taudia ida e heai. Una negana ai Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia na una tano ai e nohova.
GEN.13.7.english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

GEN.36.6.motu: Esau ese adavana tatoiosi bona natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, bona ena orea taudia iboudiai, bona ena boromakau bona ena seri iboudiai bona ena kohu idoidiai Kanaan ai e habou, e abidia, tadina Iakob e rakatania, Seiri tanona ela.
GEN.36.6.english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

GEN.3.2.motu: Bena hahine ese gaigai e haere henia, eto, Imea audia huahuadia baia ani;
GEN.3.2.english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

GEN.12.9.motu: Ma eha laolao, diho kahana ela.
GEN.12.9.english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

GEN.33.12.motu: Bena Esau eto, Mani aita laolao hebou; lau na vairai baina raka.
GEN.33.12.english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

GEN.42.14.motu: A Iosef eto, Vada na hereva, ani, umui be hasinadoa taumui.
GEN.42.14.english: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

GEN.30.16.motu: Adorahi ai, Iakob na uma amo e lasi, bena Lea na vairana ela, eto, Hari hanuaboi raruosi baita eno bou, natugu ena dudai na heni davadia. Bena una hanuaboi idia raruosi e eno bou.
GEN.30.16.english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.”

GEN.39.16.motu: Bena hahine na hari dabua e dogoa tao ela bona Iosef biaguna ema.
GEN.39.16.english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

GEN.42.18.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, Iosef ese e hereva henidia, eto, Ini ba kara toma, bena ba mauri; badina be lau danu Dirava garina na garimu.
GEN.42.18.english: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

GEN.31.29.motu: Harihari, lau na mai siahugu bama hadikamu; ḡau tamona, tamamu ena Dirava ese boi hanuaboi e hahedinarai henigu, eto, “Iakob basio hereva henia, hereva namona eiava hereva dikana.”
GEN.31.29.english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

GEN.45.2.motu: Ḡau tamona, e tai lolololo dainai Aigupto taudia bona Farao ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ena tai e kamonai.
GEN.45.2.english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

GEN.11.30.english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

GEN.13.16.motu: Oi garamu na tano ḡahuna na heto baina hahutumadia; taunabunai, tau ta tano ḡahuna dimura-dimuradia iduahidia bema diba, ia na oi garamu iduahidia bema diba.
GEN.13.16.english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

GEN.27.44.motu: nega taina ia dekenai ba noho, ela bona kakamu lalona baine keru.
GEN.27.44.english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

GEN.31.17.motu: Bena Iakob ese adavana raruosi bona natuna iboudiai na kamelo ai e hahelaidia kau;
GEN.31.17.english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

GEN.22.3.motu: Daba matana ai, Abraham na e tore isi, ena doniki e abia, ena hesiai memerodia rarua bona natuna Isaak danu e abidia. Boubou lahina audia e siri vaitani, bena e tore isi, Dirava ese e gwauraia gabuna ela.
GEN.22.3.english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

GEN.3.9.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam e boi henia, eto, Oi na edeseni ai?
GEN.3.9.english: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

GEN.42.19.motu: Bema umui na hereva momokani taumui, umui ta ese dibura rumana ai baine noho, a orena be vada baola, uit ba laohaia, varavaramui adia.
GEN.42.19.english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

GEN.24.65.motu: hesiai tauna e nanadaia, eto, Una taora ai e maimu tauna be daika? Hesiai tauna eto, Biagugu bunai. Bena Rebeka ese dabua ta e abia, vairana e govaia ahu.
GEN.24.65.english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?”

GEN.1.14.motu: Dirava ma eto, Diari ae vara guba ai, dina bona hanuaboi bae haridia, bona toa ai baela, guitau bona lahara toadia, bona dina toadia, bona laḡani toadia.
GEN.1.14.english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

GEN.18.16.motu: Bena hari tatoiosi e tore isi, Sodoma dalana ai e raka; bona Abraham ese dala ai e bamodia.
GEN.18.16.english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

GEN.49.10.motu: Lohia auna na Iuda ena amo basie abia oho,
GEN.49.10.english: The scepter will not depart from Judah,

GEN.21.4.motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, Abraham ese natuna Isaak e peritomea, Dirava ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
GEN.21.4.english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

GEN.21.33.motu: A Abraham ese au helaḡana ta e hadoa Bere-sieba ai, bona Iehova, Noho-hanaihanai Diravana, ladana e hahanea.
GEN.21.33.english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

GEN.19.38.motu: Hane muritai danu mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Ben-ami; Amono besena taudia iboudiai ema bona harihari senedia na ia.
GEN.19.38.english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

GEN.8.8.motu: Pune ta danu e harohoa, baine diba ranu na tanobada kopina ai vada e maraḡi eiava lasi.
GEN.8.8.english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

GEN.36.31.motu: Hanua pavapavadia haida ese Edom tanona e lohiaia, Israel taudia na do asi edia pavapava negadia ai. Ladadia bini:
GEN.36.31.english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

GEN.11.22.motu: Serug ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Nahoro e havaraia.
GEN.11.22.english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

GEN.21.25.motu: A Abraham ese Abimelek e gwau henia, Abimelek ena hesiai taudia ese ranu gurina ta e abia havara dainai.
GEN.21.25.english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

GEN.7.22.motu: tano kaukauna ai e mauri nohova ḡaudia, ududia ai mai edia mauri laḡana ḡaudia, ibouboudiai e mase ore.
GEN.7.22.english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

GEN.3.16.motu: Hahine danu e gwau henia, eto, Emu rogorogo hisina lau ese baina habadaia; hisihisi ai ba mara, to adavamu ba ura henia, ia ese biagumu ai bainela.

GEN.30.40.motu: Ini nani bona mamoe natudia Iakob ese e abidia hidi, iena seri ida e haboudia, Laban ena seri ai se atodia.
GEN.30.40.english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

GEN.19.30.motu: Bena Lot na Soara e rakatania, ororo e dara dae, unuseni ai e nohova, natuna ulatodia raruosi ida; badina be Soara ai baine noho na garina e gariva. Ia mai natuna ulatodia raruosi ida kohua ta ai e nohova.
GEN.19.30.english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

GEN.36.27.motu: Esere natuna na Bilhan bona Saavan bona Akan.
GEN.36.27.english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

GEN.29.32.motu: Bena Lea na e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; ladana e hatoa Ruben: badina be ia eto, Iehova ese egu lalo- hisihisi vada e haḡerea; harihari adavagu ese baine ura henigu.
GEN.29.32.english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

GEN.41.6.motu: Idia muridiai uit tuhutuhuna ta amo anidia hitu ma e tubu, unu uit anidia be didika bona mamaraḡi, lai mairiveina ese e hamarai ḡaudia.
GEN.41.6.english: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

GEN.30.36.motu: Bena e siaidia lao, dauhai bae noho, dina toi rakadia heḡereḡerena. A Laban ena seri oredia Iakob ese e reḡudia.
GEN.30.36.english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

GEN.1.27.motu: Bena Dirava ese taunimanima e karaia, ia heida-idana, Dirava ida-idana e karaia: maruane bona hahine e karadia.
GEN.1.27.english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

GEN.19.20.motu: A una hanua na kahirakahira, baina heau henia diba; ia danu hanua maraḡina mo. Mani emui kara unu bainala. Ia na hanua maraḡina ani? Bena mauri baina davaria.
GEN.19.20.english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

GEN.24.55.motu: A hane-ulato taihuna bona sinana eto, Hane-ulato na mani dekemai ai baine noho pura ta eiava dina gwauta, bena bainela.
GEN.24.55.english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

GEN.29.26.motu: Laban na e haere, eto, Ai emai kara iniseni ai be hane-muritai asia haheadavaia gunamu, a hane-guna e headava gunamu.
GEN.29.26.english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

GEN.26.1.motu: Doe bada e vara una tano ai, Abraham ena nega ai heḡereḡerena. Bena Isaak e tore isi, Gerara ela, Abimelek, Filistia pavapavana, dekena.
GEN.26.1.english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

GEN.28.6.motu: Esau vada e diba Isaak ese Iakob vada e hanamoa bona vada e siaia lao, Padan-aram ai baine headava: vada e diba danu e hanamoa negana ai e haḡania, eto “Kanaan taudia natudia ta basio adavaia”;
GEN.28.6.english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

GEN.26.34.motu: Esau ena mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui, bena e headava, hahine rarua e abidia: Iuditi, Be-eri tau Hiti natuna, bona Basemata, Elon tau Hiti natuna.
GEN.26.34.english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

GEN.19.31.motu: Bena hane guna ese tadina e hamaoroa, eto, Tamada e burukamu, bona asi tauna ta tanobada ai baine adavada tanobada ena kara heḡereḡerena.
GEN.19.31.english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

GEN.1.13.motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihatoina.
GEN.1.13.english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

GEN.24.61.motu: Bena Rebeka bona ena hesiai hahinedia e tore isi, kamelo ai e gui, hesiai tauna ida ela. Hari hesiai tauna ese Rebeka e hakaua lao.
GEN.24.61.english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

GEN.5.28.motu: Lamek ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese natuna ta e havaraia,
GEN.5.28.english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

GEN.2.11.motu: Ginigunana ladana na Pison; ia be havila tanona e arua heḡeḡe: una tano ai gold e davariamu,
GEN.2.11.english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

GEN.2.12.motu: gold namo-hereana; bedolak bona onuku nadidia danu unuseni ai.
GEN.2.12.english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

GEN.19.14.motu: Bena Lot e raka lasi, ela, ravana, ia natuna hahinedia haida adavadia, e hereva henidia, eto, A tore tore isi, ina gabu aita rakatania, badina be Iehova ese ina hanua baine habuaia tari. To ravana banava ia e hevaseha henidia eto.
GEN.19.14.english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!”

GEN.41.10.motu: Farao ese ena hesiai taudia e badu henidia negana ai na lau bona flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna raruosi dibura rumana igimana tauna imana ai o atomai.
GEN.41.10.english: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

GEN.10.9.motu: Ia danu hetaraki tauna mai goadana Iehova vairanai; una dainai taunimanima edia hereva ta e tomu “Hetaraki tauna mai goadana Iehova vairanai, Nimrod bamona”.
GEN.10.9.english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

GEN.44.12.motu: Bena hari tau ese e hetahu, tau guna enai itahuna e matamaia, ela bona tau-muritai enai e hadokoa. Kehere na Beniamina ena puse ai e davaria.
GEN.44.12.english: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

GEN.27.24.motu: Bena Isaak eto, Momokani, oi na natugu korikori Esau ani? Ia eto. Oibe.
GEN.27.24.english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?”

GEN.43.10.motu: Basiama halahe, ina laolao iharuana harihari baiama haḡuḡurua.
GEN.43.10.english: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”

GEN.42.9.motu: Bena Iosef ese ena nihi ai idia e nihiraidia e helalolai une. Bena e gwau henidia, eto, Umui na hasinadoa taumui; ina tano ena manoka itana oma.
GEN.42.9.english: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

GEN.46.2.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai Dirava ese nihi ai Israel e hereva henia, eto, Iakob e, Iakob e! Ia eto, Lau o ina.
GEN.46.2.english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!”

GEN.49.33.motu: Iakob ese natuna ihaḡanidia e hadokoa, bena ena mahuta patana ai e hekure diho, laumana e heni dae, tubu tama dekedia ela.
GEN.49.33.english: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.

GEN.9.20.motu: Unu dinadia ai Noa eha biru, vine imeana e hadoa.
GEN.9.20.english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

GEN.40.8.motu: Idia eto, Ai na vada a nihi, bona asi tauna ta ese emai nihi anidia baine hahedinarai. Bena Iosef eto, Nihi anidia ihahedinaraidia na Dirava mo sibona: emui nihi mani a gwaurai hedinarai.
GEN.40.8.english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.”

GEN.50.17.motu: “Iosef ba hamaoroa, baoto ‘Kakamu edia kerere bona edia kara dika oiemu ai ba lalo nege’; taunabunai ai a noimumu, tamamu ena Dirava isiaina ilao-henina taumai emai dika ba gwau tao”. Ina hereva e kamonai ai, Iosef na e tai.
GEN.50.17.english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

GEN.28.5.motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e siaia lao. Ia na Padan-aram ela, Laban Betuel, tau Suria, dekenai. Una Laban na Rebeka taihuna; Rebeka na Iakob bona Esau sinadia.
GEN.28.5.english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

GEN.46.14.motu: Sebulun natuna be Sered bona Elon bona Ialeel.
GEN.46.14.english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

GEN.2.14.motu: Sinavai ihatoina ladana na Tigris: ia be Asuria tanona mairiveina kahana amo e aru Iaomu. Sinavai ihahanina na Eufrate.
GEN.2.14.english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

GEN.3.10.motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Gadomu imea lalonai na kamonai, bena vada na gari, badina be ḡaḡaegu mo na noho, taunabunai na komu.
GEN.3.10.english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

GEN.11.16.motu: Ebere ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui hani negana ai, ia ese Peleg e havaraia.
GEN.11.16.english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

GEN.7.9.motu: iboudiai na rua rua amo, maruane bona hahine, Noa ida e gui kau lagatoi ai, Dirava ese Noa e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
GEN.7.9.english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

GEN.13.2.motu: Abram ena boromakau na momo herea, ena silver bona ena gold danu momo herea.
GEN.13.2.english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

GEN.2.16.motu: Dirava Iehova ese hari tau e haduaia, eto, Imea audia iboudiai huahuadia bavani, emu ura heḡereḡerena;
GEN.2.16.english: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

GEN.22.1.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Dirava ese Abraham e diba-ḡania, eto, Abraham e! Ia eto, Lau o ina.
GEN.22.1.english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!”

GEN.41.21.motu: ḡau tamona, e anidia ore murinai tau ta basinema diba idia ese vada e anidia, badina be idia na dounu varoda-varoda. Bena na noga.
GEN.41.21.english: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

GEN.37.2.motu: Iakob garana herevadia bini: Iosef ena mauri laḡanidia na gwautahitu, bena nega ta seri e reḡuva, ia kakana, tamana adavana Bilha bona Silpa natudia, ida. Bena Iosef na tamana dekena ela, kakana e habadelaidia.
GEN.37.2.english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

GEN.24.31.motu: Bena e hereva henia, eto, Iehova ese vada e hanamomu taumu e, mani a dae kau. Dahaka dainai murimuri ai o nohomu? Badina be egu ruma vada na lailaia, bona kamelo edia gabu danu.
GEN.24.31.english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

GEN.24.16.motu: Ia na haneulato rami-hebou namo-hereana: tau ta ese do se adavaia. Ia na guri ela, ena hodu e hahonua, ma ema.
GEN.24.16.english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

GEN.18.7.motu: Bena e heau lao, ena boromakau serina ai boromakau natuna ta, hidiona manoka-manokana bona mai digarana ḡauna, e abia, ena hesiai tauna ta e henia; bena ia ese e nadua haraḡa-haraḡa.
GEN.18.7.english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

GEN.50.8.motu: bona Iosef varavarana iboudiai, bona ena ruma taudia, bona tamana ena ruma taudia. Natudia maraḡidia bona edia mamoe seridia bona edia horomakau seridia mo e rakatanidia Gosen tanona ai.
GEN.50.8.english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

GEN.19.5.motu: Bena idia ese Lot e boi henia, eto, Hari hanuaboi emu ruma ai e dae kau taudia be edeseni ai? Ba hakaudia lasi; baia dibadia.
GEN.19.5.english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

GEN.31.12.motu: Ma eto “A itadia, mamoe bona nani hahinedia e harogorogodiamu mamaruanedia iboudiai na mai toutoudia eiava mai revarevadia eiava koremadia: badina be Laban ena kara iboudiai oiemu ai e karamu vada na ita vaitani.
GEN.31.12.english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

GEN.27.15.motu: Bena Rebeka ese natuna roboana Esau ena dabua namona ta ruma ai mia na e abia, natuna tau-muritai Iakob e hadokilaia;
GEN.27.15.english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

GEN.28.20.motu: Bena Iakob e gwau hamata, eto, Bema Dirava ese baine bamogu, ina na rakalaiamu dalana ai baine gimagu, aniani baine henigu bona dabua danu,
GEN.28.20.english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

GEN.48.11.motu: Bena Israel ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Lau banava nato oi vairamu basina itaia lou, to Dirava ese e bogagu hisi dainai oi bona natumu vada na itamui.
GEN.48.11.english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

GEN.46.9.motu: Ruben be Iakob natuna roboana. Ruben natuna be Hanok bona Palu bona Hesron bona Karami.
GEN.46.9.english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

GEN.36.25.motu: Ana natuna bini: maruanena ta ladana na Dison, bona hahinena ta ladana na Oholibama.
GEN.36.25.english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

GEN.25.31.motu: Iakob eto, Emu roboa ahuna na a henigu, aniani davana.
GEN.25.31.english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

GEN.39.21.motu: A Iehova ese Iosef e haḡerea, e bogaia hisi, dibura rumana igimana tauna lalona e hanamoa ia enai.
GEN.39.21.english: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

GEN.41.37.motu: Farao mai ena hesiai taudia ida ese una hereva e abia dae.
GEN.41.37.english: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

GEN.1.3.motu: Dirava eto, Diari aine vara. Bena diari na e vara.
GEN.1.3.english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

GEN.43.2.motu: Aigupto amo e mailaia uitina vada e ania ore, bena tamadia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Ma baola, aniani taina ba ha hoia ada.
GEN.43.2.english: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

GEN.27.39.motu: Bena tamana Isaak ese e haere henia, eto,

GEN.7.5.motu: Bena Iehova ona hahedua iboudiai na Noa ese e kara ḡuḡuru.
GEN.7.5.english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

GEN.27.8.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, eregu ba kamonai, baina haduamu heḡereḡerena mo ba karaia.
GEN.27.8.english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

GEN.31.55.motu: Daba ai Laban e tore isi, tubuna mai sinadia ida e harahudia bona e hanamodia. Bena e rakatanidia, ena hanua e lou henia.
GEN.31.55.english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

GEN.23.11.motu: Ḡauka e, lasi; una tano mai kohuana ida baina henimu; egu bese taudia iboudiai vairadiai vada baina henimu, emu mase iguridia gabuna ai bainela.
GEN.23.11.english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

GEN.35.11.motu: Bena Dirava ese e hamaoroa, eto, Lau na Siahu-idoinai Diravana: natumu ba havaradia, garamu bae hutuma; bese momo oiemu amo bae vara, bona hanua pavapavadia danu.
GEN.35.11.english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

GEN.41.34.motu: Farao na unu baine kara toma, bona tano ita-taona taudia baine gwauraidia danu: unu madinamo laḡanidia ai aniani ḡaudia iboudiai ina Aigupto tanona ai bae karoadia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta roge ai bae haboua.
GEN.41.34.english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

GEN.10.12.motu: bona Resene, Nineve bona Kala padadiai: ia na hanua bada-hereana.
GEN.10.12.english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

GEN.27.13.motu: Sinana eto, Heuduguirai na lau latagu ai baine mia: lau eregu a kamonai, aola, bavabi, dekegu ba mailai.
GEN.27.13.english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

GEN.28.21.motu: ela bona tamagu ena ruma baina lou henia mai mainogu ida: unu baine karagu toma be Iehova na egu Dirava ai baina halaoa;
GEN.28.21.english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

GEN.47.2.motu: Bena kakana laima e hakaudia vareai, Farao vairanai.
GEN.47.2.english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

GEN.22.20.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Abraham ese hari ta e kamonai, tadina Nahoro adavana Milka ida natudia vada e vara.
GEN.22.20.english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

GEN.30.32.motu: Hari dina ai emu seri ba hididia, mamoe mai toutoudia eiava mai revarevadia bona mamoe koremadia bona nani mai toutoudia eiava mai revarevadia iboudiai baina hakaudia siri: lau davagu bunu.
GEN.30.32.english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

GEN.37.11.motu: Bena kakana e badu dikadika, a tamana ese ena hereva e lalo tao.
GEN.37.11.english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

GEN.30.41.motu: Bena nani bona mamoe hahinedia mai goadadia e rogorogova negadia ai, Iakob ese hari rigi vairadiai e hagini, ranu gabudia ai, rigi i'itadia ai bae rogorogo totona.
GEN.30.41.english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

GEN.15.1.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Iehova ena hereva na Abram enai e kau, mata hanai ai. Iehova eto, Abram, basio gari, lau na oiemu kesi, ahumu danu baine bada.
GEN.15.1.english: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

GEN.15.8.motu: Abram eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, ede baina diba toma ina na egu tano korikori ai bainela?
GEN.15.8.english: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

GEN.50.18.motu: Bena kakana ela ia vairanai e goru diho, eto, Momokani, ai na oiemu hesiai taudia.
GEN.50.18.english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

GEN.34.16.motu: ai ese natumai ulatodia baia henimui bona natumui ulatodia baia abidia, bena bogaragimui ai baia noho, bese tamona ai baitala.
GEN.34.16.english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

GEN.20.7.motu: Taunabunai, una tau adavana ba henia lou, badina be ia na peroveta tauna; bena ia ese oi daimu ai baine ḡuriḡuri. bena ba mauri. A basio henia lou, ba diba momokani vada ba mase, oi bona emu ruma taudia iboudiai.
GEN.20.7.english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

GEN.5.15.motu: Mahalalel ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Iared e havaraia;
GEN.5.15.english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

GEN.11.23.motu: Nahoro e vara murinai, Serug na laḡani sinahu-rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.23.english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.21.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese Sara e vadivadi henia bona ena gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena e kara henia.
GEN.21.1.english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

GEN.12.8.motu: Bena ia ese una gabu e rakatania, ororo ta, Betele mairiveina kahana ai, ela, unuseni ai e taruha; Betele na tahodiho kahana ai, Ai na mairiveina kahana ai. Unuseni ai danu ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena. bona Iehova ladana e hahanea.
GEN.12.8.english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.

GEN.31.44.motu: Aoma, aita herohemaino; eda herohemaino ese baine hahemaoro henida.
GEN.31.44.english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

GEN.39.17.motu: Bena ma e hamaoroa, eto, Ina Heberu tauna eda ruma ai o abia dae, eda hesiai ilao-henina, na egu ai e raka vareai, baine hakavakavagu eto;
GEN.39.17.english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

GEN.30.31.motu: Bena Laban eto, Dahaka baina henimu? Iakob eto, Ḡau ta basio henigu, to egu ura bavabia dae, bena emu seri ma baina reḡudia.
GEN.30.31.english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?”

GEN.35.19.motu: Unuhetomana Rahela e mase, bena Efrata dalana badinai e guria. Una Efrata ladana ta be Betelehem.
GEN.35.19.english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

GEN.42.3.motu: Bena Iosef kakana gwauta-osi Aigupto ela, uit ihoina;
GEN.42.3.english: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

GEN.3.21.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese boromakau kopidia amo hahedoki dabuadia e kara, Adam ena bona adavana Heva ena, raruosi e hadabualaidia.
GEN.3.21.english: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

GEN.24.12.motu: Bena e ḡuriḡuri, eto, Iehova e, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava e, na noimumu, hari ina dina ai egu ḡaukara ba hanamoa, bona biagugu Abraham ba bogaia hisi.
GEN.24.12.english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

GEN.45.15.motu: Bena Iosef ese kakana iboudiai e harahudia, bona e rosidia mai taina ida. Gabeamo tadikakana ia ida vada e hereva-hereva, asi edia gari.
GEN.45.15.english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

GEN.11.12.motu: Afasad ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Sela e havaraia.
GEN.11.12.english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

GEN.31.50.motu: Natugu ba daḡedaḡe henidia, eiava hahine haida ma bavabidia, tau ta ese basine itamu, to Dirava ese baine hahemaoro henida.
GEN.31.50.english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

GEN.17.18.motu: Bena Abraham ese Dirava e noia, eto, Ismael na oi vairamu ai bema noho bema namo.
GEN.17.18.english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

GEN.24.62.motu: Una negana ai Isaak na diho kahana ai e nohova; bena tano gagaena ai eha laolao, ranu gurina ta, ladana Bere-lahai-roi, ela.
GEN.24.62.english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

GEN.34.27.motu: Bena Iakob natuna mamaruanedia na ela, Sekem taudia masedia ai e davaridia, bena hanua e habuaia tari, taihudia e hahemaraia dainai.
GEN.34.27.english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

GEN.38.5.motu: ma ihatatoina e abia, ladana e hatoa Sela. Una mero e vara negana ai, hahine na Kesib ai e nohova.
GEN.38.5.english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

GEN.24.39.motu: Bena biagugu na hamaoroa, nato “O hane-ulato na basine bamogu reana, bena ede baina heto?”
GEN.24.39.english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

GEN.29.7.motu: Iakob eto, Dina tubua binai, boromakau ihaboudia negana be dohore; mamoe seridia boma ha-inudia, boma lao, adia boma henidia.
GEN.29.7.english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

GEN.24.38.motu: a tamagu ena ruma baola, varavaragu bogaragidiai natugu adavana bavabia”.
GEN.24.38.english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

GEN.17.20.motu: A Ismael ome gwauraia herevana vada na kamonai; benaini, vada na hanamoamu, ia besena baine vara, garana bae hutuma; lohia gwauta-rarua ia ese baine havaradia, bese badana ai baina halaoa.
GEN.17.20.english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

GEN.18.26.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Sodoma lalonai kara maoromaoro taudia imahui baina davaridia, hanua idoinai baina bogaia hisi idia daidiai.
GEN.18.26.english: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

GEN.30.5.motu: Bena Bilha na e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia.
GEN.30.5.english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

GEN.35.25.motu: Rahela ena hesiai hahinena Bilha natuna: Dan bona Napatali.
GEN.35.25.english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

GEN.24.14.motu: Na noimumu, hane-ulato ta baina hamaoroa, bainato “Emu hodu bavatoa diho, ranu kuri ta ba henigu, baina inua”, bena ia baineto “Madi ba inua; emu kamelo danu baina ha-inulaidia”, haneulatona bunai oiemu. abi-hidi ulatona, emu hesiai tauna Isaak ba henia ulatona mo. Unu amo baina diba oi na biagugu vada o bogaia hisimu.
GEN.24.14.english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

GEN.27.40.motu: To emu dare goadana ai ba mauri.
GEN.27.40.english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother.

GEN.21.18.motu: A tore isi, mero na avabia isi, imamu ai ba dogoa tao, badina be lau ese bese badana ai baina halaoa.
GEN.21.18.english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

GEN.43.19.motu: Taunabunai idia na Iosef ena hesiai tauna dekena ela, ruma iduarana ai;
GEN.43.19.english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

GEN.22.12.motu: Ia eto, Imamu mero latanai asio atoa kau, kara ta danu asio karaia ienai; badina be lau harihari name diba oi ese Dirava garina o garimu; badina be natumu vara-edeana egu ai to ruava.
GEN.22.12.english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

GEN.41.33.motu: Namona binai: Farao ese lalo-parara bona aonega tauna ta baine tahua, Aigupto tanona biaguna ai baine halaoa.
GEN.41.33.english: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

GEN.49.12.motu: Matana bae kakakaka, vine ranuna na heto,
GEN.49.12.english: His eyes will be red with wine,

GEN.48.12.motu: Bena Iosef ese memero raruosi na tubudia tuina padadia amo e abidia, bena ia na tano ai e goru diho.
