GEN.48.12.english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

GEN.3.23.motu: Taunabunai Dirava Iehova ese Moale imeana lalona amo e lulua lasi, tano amo e vara tanona baine biru henia.
GEN.3.23.english: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

GEN.39.10.motu: A hahine ese dina ta ta amo Iosef lalona e ania, raruosi bae eno bou eto; to ia ese se kamonai heniava.
GEN.39.10.english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

GEN.11.8.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese e hakarohodia rohoroho, tanobada kahadia idoidiai; edia hanua ilarebana danu e hadokoa.
GEN.11.8.english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

GEN.19.26.motu: A Lot adavana e roha muri, bena ia na damena nadina ai e hahelao.
GEN.19.26.english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

GEN.33.4.motu: Bena Esau na e heau ela, e rosia, e harahua; bena raruosi na e taitai.
GEN.33.4.english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

GEN.12.14.motu: Taunabunai, Abram na Aigupto ai e kau negana ai, Aigupto taudia ese hahine na e itaia, ia na hane namo.
GEN.12.14.english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

GEN.31.39.motu: Uda boromadia ese e habero ḡaudia danu asina vasilai; sibogu ibolodia na heni. Henao taudia ese dina ai e henao eiava hanuaboi ai e henao ḡaudia danu davadia lauegu amo o gwaurai.
GEN.31.39.english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

GEN.1.9.motu: Dirava ma eto, Guba henunai e miamu ranudia na ae hahebou, gabu tamona ai, tano kaukauna baine hedinarai. Bena unu e vara toma.
GEN.1.9.english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

GEN.36.9.motu: Esau garana bini: ia na Edom besena, Seiri ororodia ai e nohomu besena, ihavarana tauna.
GEN.36.9.english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

GEN.36.30.motu: bona Dison bona Esere bona Disan. Hori lohiadia bunu, Seiri tanona e lohiaia taudia.
GEN.36.30.english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

GEN.27.1.motu: Isaak na vada e ḡauka, matana danu e valahu-valahu, ḡau ta seitaia ḡoeva. Bena ia ese natuna roboana Esau e boiria, eto, Natugu o! Esau eto, Lau o ina.
GEN.27.1.english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?”

GEN.7.7.motu: Bena Noa bona natuna bona adavana bona ravana hahinedia laḡatoi ai e gui, utu-utu dainai.
GEN.7.7.english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

GEN.47.8.motu: Farao ese e nanadaia, eto, Emu mauri laḡanidia be hida?
GEN.47.8.english: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”

GEN.2.6.motu: A varahu be tanobada amo eme dae, tano kopina idoinai vada eme hapariparia.
GEN.2.6.english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

GEN.12.6.motu: Abram ese tano e rakaia hanai ela Sekem, ela bona au helaḡana ladana More. Una negana ai Kanaan taudia na dounu e nohova una tano ai.
GEN.12.6.english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

GEN.6.12.motu: Dirava ese tanobada e itaia, vada e dika rohoroho; badina be taunimanima iboudiai ese edia kara vada e hadika tanobada ai.
GEN.6.12.english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

GEN.47.11.motu: Bena Iosef ese tamana bona tadikakana edia gabu e lailaia bona edia tano e henidia, Aigupto tanona namo-hereana ta ai, ladana Ramese, Farao ena hahedua heḡereḡerena.
GEN.47.11.english: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

GEN.7.8.motu: Mauri ḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia bona asi ḡoevaoḡoevadia, bona manu, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia,
GEN.7.8.english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

GEN.11.11.motu: Afasad e vara murinai, Sem na laḡani sinahu-ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.11.english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.27.35.motu: Tamana eto, Tadimu vada ema, mai ena koikoi, ihanamomu vada e dadia.
GEN.27.35.english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

GEN.9.21.motu: Bena vine ranuna e inua, e kekero; bena ena kalaga ai e hekure, asi dabuana.
GEN.9.21.english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

GEN.19.4.motu: Idia na do asie hekure ai, hanua taudia kikina-badana, hari Sodoma taudia, hanua kahadia iboudiai amo e heau bou heau bou ela, ruma na e ginia hegege.
GEN.19.4.english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

GEN.24.50.motu: Bena Laban bona Betuel e haere, eto, Ina na Iehova ena amo; ai na basia haere henimu diba, basiato “Oibe” eiava “Lasi.”
GEN.24.50.english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

GEN.29.8.motu: Idia nae haere, eto, Lasi: mamoe seridia iboudiai bae hegogo guna, bena guri iduarana nadina baia kurea oho, bona mamoe seridia baia ha-inudia.
GEN.29.8.english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

GEN.29.20.motu: Taunabunai, Iakob ese Laban isiaina e lao heni laḡani hitu, Rahela iabina totona; a lalona e tomava dina gadoi mo na heheto, badina be ia ese Rahela e ura henia lalo-dikava.
GEN.29.20.english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

GEN.34.12.motu: Ena be davana ba habadaia herea, to vada baina henimui; ḡau tamona, hane-ulato na ba henigu, baina adavaia.
GEN.34.12.english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

GEN.36.33.motu: Ia e mase; bena Iobab, Sera tau Bosra natuna, ese gabuna e abia.
GEN.36.33.english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

GEN.29.10.motu: Iakob ese vavana Laban natuna kekenina Rahela e itaia, vavana Laban ena mamoe serina e hakaua mai, bena ia na e raka kahira, nadi guri iduarana amo e kurea oho, vavana Laban ena mamoe serina e ha-inudia.
GEN.29.10.english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

GEN.41.40.motu: Una dainai, oi ese egu ruma ba halohiaia, egu basileia idoinai oi eremu bae kamonai; lau hanua pavapavana taugu mo ese oi baina hereamu.
GEN.41.40.english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

GEN.12.10.motu: Una tano ai doe vada e vara dainai, ia na diho kahana ma ela, Aigupto ai baine hanoho eto, badina be doe na bada herea.
GEN.12.10.english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

GEN.36.4.motu: Ada ese mero ta e abia, ladana Elifasa; bona Basemata ese mero ta e abia, ladana Reuele;
GEN.36.4.english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

GEN.1.7.motu: Bena Dirava ese ḡau ta e karaia, henu ranudia bona atai ranudia ihididia. Bena unu e vara toma.
GEN.1.7.english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

GEN.18.3.motu: eto, Ḡauka e, boma lalo namo henigu, lau, emu hesiai tauna, basioma rakagu hanai.
GEN.18.3.english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

GEN.27.38.motu: Bena Esau ese tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu e, emu hahenamo be tamona mo a? Tamagu e, lau danu ame hanamogu. Bena Esau e tai dikadika.
GEN.27.38.english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

GEN.41.8.motu: Daba ai kudouna e hetaha; bena ia na e hesiai, Aigupto ai babalau taudia iboudiai bona aonega taudia iboudiai e boiridia. Bena Farao ese ena nihi e hamaorolaidia, to idia iboudiai na anidia igwauraidia asi dibadia.
GEN.41.8.english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

GEN.11.10.motu: Sem garana bini. Sem ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu ta negana ai, ia ese Afasad e havaraia, utu-utu badana laḡani rua vada e kororo murinai.
GEN.11.10.english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

GEN.37.10.motu: Ia ese tamana bona kakana unu e hamaorodia toma; bena tamana e gwaugwau, eto, Emu nihi anina be dahaka a? Lau bona sinamu bona kakamu ese oi baia toma henimu diho a?
GEN.37.10.english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

GEN.14.7.motu: Bena e lou ema bona En-mispat (ladana ta be Kade); bena Amalek taudia edia tano e havahua, bona Amoro taudia Hasasono-tamara ai e nohova edia tano danu.
GEN.14.7.english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

GEN.1.12.motu: rei e vara tanobada ai, bona ava idau-idau mai nadinadidia, bona huahua audia mai huahuadia, huahua idau-idaudia mai nadinadidia. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
GEN.1.12.english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

GEN.44.15.motu: Bena Iosef ese e gwau henidia, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? Umui asio laloa lau na bagu-haoro taugu a?
GEN.44.15.english: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

GEN.10.11.motu: Una tano amo e raka lasi, Asuria ela, Nineve hanuana e hadaia, ariarana mai lababadia e kara. Kala hanuana danu e hadaia,
GEN.10.11.english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

GEN.10.15.motu: Kanaan natuna bini: Sidono, tau roboana, bona Het.
GEN.10.15.english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

GEN.46.17.motu: Asere natuna be Imna bona Isva bona Isvi bona Beria, taihudia Sera ida. Beria natuna be Hebere bona Malkiel.
GEN.46.17.english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

GEN.11.31.motu: Tera ese natuna Abram bona tubuna Lot, Haran natuna, bona ravana Sarai, Abram adavana, e abidia, Kaldea taudia edia hanua, Uru, amo e hakaudia lasi, Kanaan tanona baela eto. Bena gabu ta ai e kau, ladana Haran, unuseni ai e noho.
GEN.11.31.english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

GEN.19.8.motu: A itaia, natugu raruosi nonoho, ulato rami-hebou: mani aina hakaudia lasi emui ura heḡereḡerena ba kara henidia. A ini raruosi basio hadikadia, badina be egu guhi metaina ai e nohomu.
GEN.19.8.english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

GEN.33.17.motu: A Iakob na Sukoto ela; unuseni ai ia ese ruma auta e hadaia iena, bona kalaga haida e hadai ena boromakau edia. Una dainai gabu ladana e hatoa Sukoto.
GEN.33.17.english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

GEN.49.7.motu: Edia daḡedaḡe na uduguiraiamu, badina be vada e idita;
GEN.49.7.english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce;

GEN.25.23.motu: Bena Iehova ese e haere henia, eto,

GEN.47.10.motu: Bena Iakob ese Farao e hanamoa, bena e rakatania.
GEN.47.10.english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

GEN.21.30.motu: Abraham e haere, eto, Ini egu mamoe natudia hituosi avabi, lau ese ina ranu gurina na ḡeia toana.
GEN.21.30.english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

GEN.35.23.motu: Iakob natuna mamaruanedia na gwauta-rarua. Lea natuna: Ruben, Iakob natuna roboana, bona Simeon bona Levi bona Iuda bona Isakara bona Sebulun.
GEN.35.23.english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

GEN.17.16.motu: Lau ese baina hanamoa, natumui ta baine vara: momokani, baina hanamoa, ia na bese idau-idau sinadia ai bainela; hanua pavapavadia ia ese baine havaradia.
GEN.17.16.english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

GEN.13.12.motu: Abram na Kanaan tanona ai e noho; bona Lot na taora hanuadia ela, Sodoma kahana ai e taruha.
GEN.13.12.english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

GEN.16.15.motu: Bena Hagara na e mara, mero ta e abia, Abram ena; bena Abram ese natuna, Hagara ese e havaraia merona, ladana e hatoa Ismael.
GEN.16.15.english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

GEN.21.21.motu: Ia na Paran tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova; bena sinana ese Aigupto hane-ulatona ta e abia, ia baine adavaia.
GEN.21.21.english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

GEN.37.12.motu: Nega ta kakana na Sekem ela, tamadia ena seri ireḡudia.
GEN.37.12.english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

GEN.24.58.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Rebeka e boiria, bena e nanadaia, eto, Lalomu vada eme heḡereḡere a, ina tau ida ba raka? Ia eto, Vada e heḡereḡere.
GEN.24.58.english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?”

GEN.25.10.motu: Tanona bunai Abraham ese Hiti taudia edia amo e abia. Unuseni ai Abraham e guria, adavana Sara ida.
GEN.25.10.english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

GEN.10.21.motu: Sem danu, Iafet kakana, Ebere natuna tamadia, natuna mamaruanedia haida ma e havaradia.
GEN.10.21.english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

GEN.1.23.motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina iha-imana.
GEN.1.23.english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

GEN.8.18.motu: Bena Noa na e diho, ia bona natuna bona adavana bona ravana.
GEN.8.18.english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

GEN.19.21.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Emu noinoi tamona binai ma na abia daemu; hari o noilaiamu hanuana na basina habuaia tari.
GEN.19.21.english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

GEN.22.24.motu: Ena hesiai hahinena Reuma ese danu natuna e havaradia: ladadia na Teba bona Gaham bona Tahasa bona Maaka.
GEN.22.24.english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

GEN.31.27.motu: Dahaka dainai o heau hehuni, so hadibagu? Boma hadibagu, bena bama kahumu nege mai moale karadia bona mai moale anedia ida, oibe, mai gaba reḡedia bona mai gitara reḡedia ida.
GEN.31.27.english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

GEN.36.24.motu: Sibeon natuna na Aia bona Ana. Hari Ana na ranu e lohilohimu gabudia e davaridia tano ḡaḡaena ai, tamana Sibeon ena doniki e reḡudiava negana ai.
GEN.36.24.english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

GEN.44.21.motu: Bena oi ese o haḡanimai, oto “Ba hakaua mai, lau baina itaia”.
GEN.44.21.english: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

GEN.50.4.motu: Taitai dinadia vada e ore, bena Iosef ese Farao ena ruma taudia e noidia, eto, Boma ura henigu, Farao boma hereva henia, boma hamaoroa,
GEN.50.4.english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

GEN.29.28.motu: Iakob na unu e kara toma: dina hitu e ore, bena Laban ese natuna Rahela e henia, baine adavaia.
GEN.29.28.english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

GEN.4.8.motu: Bena Kain ese tadina Abel e hereva henia, eto, Aitala uma. Bena raruosi na uma ai e nohova negana ai Kain ese tadina Abel e heatu henia, e alaia mase.
GEN.4.8.english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

GEN.41.13.motu: Taunabunai, nihi anidia ia ese e gwaurai vada e momokani: lau be o halougu egu dagi ai, a bamogu be e taua dae ela bona e mase.
GEN.41.13.english: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

GEN.1.1.motu: Matamana negana ai na Dirava ese guba bona tanobada e karadia.
GEN.1.1.english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

GEN.43.23.motu: Bena hari hesiai tauna eto, Maino avabia, basio gari; emui Dirava, tamamui danu ena Dirava, ia ese emui puse e hatagadia; emui moni na lau ese na abi. Bena ia ese Simeon e hakaua lasi dekediai.
GEN.43.23.english: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

GEN.35.5.motu: Bena edia laolao ela; bona hanua hanua taudia ese Dirava garina e gariva dainai idia ese Iakob natuna asie tuari henidia
GEN.35.5.english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

GEN.24.2.motu: Bena Abraham ese ena hesiai tauna badana, ena kohu idoinai e reḡuava tauna, e haduaia, eto, Imamu na mamugu ai bavatoa kau,
GEN.24.2.english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

GEN.24.8.motu: A hane-ulato bema gwau edeede, basinema bamomu, emu gwau-hamata bema heruha. Ḡau tamona, natugu na basio laohaia, unu basiola.
GEN.24.8.english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

GEN.11.17.motu: Peleg e vara murinai, Ebere na laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.17.english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.47.19.motu: Ai na oi vairamu ai baia mase bona emai uma bae vahu a? Ai bavabimai, emai tano danu bavabi, aniani ba henimai. Bena ai bona emai tano ese Farao isiaina baia lao heni. Uhe danu ba henimai, bena emai tano na basine vahu.
GEN.47.19.english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

GEN.1.31.motu: Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia iboudiai e itadia, nanamo heherea. Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihatauratoina.
GEN.1.31.english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

GEN.30.15.motu: A Lea ese e gwau henia, eto, Adavagu o henaoa na ḡau pipikina a? Matona natugu ena dudai ba dadi o tomu. Bena Rahela eto, Natumu ena dudai ba henigu, bena hari hanuaboi adavada ida ba eno bou.
GEN.30.15.english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?”

GEN.45.14.motu: Bena ia na tadina Beniamina aiona ai e hegagiu dae mai taina ida; Beniamina danu ia aiona ai e hegagiu dae, vada e hetai heheni.
GEN.45.14.english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

GEN.29.13.motu: Laban ese vavana Iakob harina e kamnonai, bena ia e heau ela, e rosia, e harahua; bena ena ruma e hakaua lao. Bena Iakob ese hari idoidiai Laban e hamaorolaia.
GEN.29.13.english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

GEN.43.17.motu: Bena hesiai tauna na Iosef ena hereva heḡereḡerena e hakaudia lao, Iosef ena ruma ai e hakaudia vareai.
GEN.43.17.english: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

GEN.25.11.motu: Abraham ena mase murinai, Dirava ese natuna Isaak e hanamoa. Isaak na Bere-lahai-roi ranu gurina badibadinai e nohova.
GEN.25.11.english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

GEN.16.10.motu: Iehova ena aneru ma eto, Oi garamu lau ese baina hahutumadia, basie duahidia diba.
GEN.16.10.english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

GEN.22.11.motu: A Iehova ena aneru na guba amo e boi dobi, eto, Abraham e, Abraham e! Ia na e haere, eto, Lau o ina.
GEN.22.11.english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!”

GEN.18.33.motu: Iehova na Abraham ida e hereva-hereva vaitani, bena ena dala e raka lao, a Abraham na ena noho gabuna e lou henia.
GEN.18.33.english: Yahweh went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

GEN.48.21.motu: Bena Israel ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Egu mase vada eme kahikahi; a Dirava ese baine bamomui, bona baine hakaumui lou, tubu tama edia tano ba lou henia.
GEN.48.21.english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

GEN.33.16.motu: Taunabunai Esau na una dina ai e lou, Seiri dalana ai e lou ela.
GEN.33.16.english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

GEN.6.6.motu: Bena Iehova e helalo, taunimanima e havaradia tanobada ai dainai; lalona e hisihisi danu.
GEN.6.6.english: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

GEN.17.21.motu: A egu taravatu na Isaak enai baina badinaia, merona bunai Sara ese baine abia, laḡani vairai.
GEN.17.21.english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

GEN.32.4.motu: E haduadia, eto, Egu lohia Esau ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto “Emu hesiai tauna Iakob na e tomu: lau na Laban ida vada na noho ema bona hari;
GEN.32.4.english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

GEN.2.18.motu: Dirava Iehova ma eto, Hari tau na sibona baine noho na dia namo; lau ese ia bamona aina karaia.
GEN.2.18.english: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

GEN.22.2.motu: Dirava eto, Oi natumu bavabia, natumu vara-edeana, o lalokau heniamu merona, Isaak. Moria tanona baola, bena baina hamaorolaimu ororona dorina ai boubou ḡauna ai, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna ai, ba halaoa.
GEN.22.2.english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

GEN.35.10.motu: Oi ladamu na Iakob, a ladamu basie hatoa lou Iakob; harihari bainela ladamu bae hatoa Israel. Taunabunai, ladana e hatoa Israel.
GEN.35.10.english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

GEN.44.18.motu: Bena Iuda na e raka henia kahi, eto, Mani emu kara lau binai emu hesiai tauna na biagugu baina hereva henimu; mani emu kara emu badu do baine keruma emu hesiai tauna egu ai: badina be oi na Farao heḡereḡerena.
GEN.44.18.english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

GEN.20.4.motu: A Abimelek na hahine do se raka henia kahi. Bena ia eto, Ḡaubada e, kara maoromaoro besena ba hamasea a?
GEN.20.4.english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

GEN.14.18.motu: Bena Melkisedek, Salem pavapavana, Dirava Herea Mikamika ena hahelaḡa tauna, ese flaoa bona vine ranuna e laohai, e dabara.
GEN.14.18.english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

GEN.47.17.motu: Taunabunai edia boromakau e laohai Iosef dekenai; bena ia ese aniani e henidia, edia hosi bona edia mamoe bona edia boromakau bona edia doniki davadia.
GEN.47.17.english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

GEN.46.32.motu: Idia be mamoe bona boromakau ireḡudia taudia, edia mamoe seridia bona edia boromakau seridia bona edia kohu idoinai vada e mailai”.
GEN.46.32.english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

GEN.7.15.motu: mauri ḡaudia ibouboudiai rua rua amo, Noa ida lagatoi ai e gui,
GEN.7.15.english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

GEN.10.28.motu: bona Obala bona Abimael bona Seba

GEN.20.6.motu: Bena Dirava ese nihi ai e haere henia, eto, Lau dibagu oi na mai lalomu maoromaorona ida vada o karaia. Lau danu vada na rumu, vairagu ai ba kerere na garina; una dainai na laomu ahu, so raka henia kahi.
GEN.20.6.english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

GEN.28.9.motu: Taunabunai, Esau na Ismael dekena ela, Ismael Abraham natuna kekenina Mahalata, Nebaioto taihuna, e adavaia; ḡau tamona, adavana gunadia raruosi nonoho.
GEN.28.9.english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

GEN.37.24.motu: e laohaia, guri ta ai etahoa dobi. Una guri na asi ranuna.
GEN.37.24.english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

GEN.7.17.motu: Dina hari-ahui lalodiai utu-utu na tanobada idoinai e utua daeva, e bada e laova, a lagatoi e keni dae atai ai.
GEN.7.17.english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

GEN.8.12.motu: Dina hitu ma e noho; bena pune ma e harohoa; bena ia na vada se lou lagatoi ai, lasi vaitani.
GEN.8.12.english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

GEN.28.16.motu: Iakob na mahuta amo e noga, bena eto, Momokani, Iehova na iniseni ai, to asi dibagu.
GEN.28.16.english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

GEN.27.32.motu: Tamana Isaak ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi be daika? Ia e haere, eto, Lau binai natumu roboana Esau.
GEN.27.32.english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?”

GEN.25.25.motu: E vara guna merona na mia kakakaka, derana danu momo, dabua huika-huika na heto; ia ladana e hatoa Esau.
GEN.25.25.english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

GEN.17.13.motu: Emui ruma ai bae vara memerodia bona ba hoidia memerodia, iboudiai ba peritomedia: unu amo egu taravatu toana na kopimui ai baine mia, badina be ia na mia-hanaihanai taravatuna.
GEN.17.13.english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

GEN.31.11.motu: Bena egu nihi ai Dirava ena aneru ta ese e hereva henigu, eto “Iakob”. Lau nato “Lau o ina.”
GEN.31.11.english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

GEN.47.1.motu: Bena Iosef na Farao dekena ela, eto, Tamagu bona tadikakagu na Kanaan tanona amo vada ema, mai edia mamoe seridia bona edia boromakau seridia bona edia kohu idoinai. Idia na harihari Gosen tanona ai.
GEN.47.1.english: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

GEN.18.8.motu: Bena bata bona rata e abi, bona ena mero ese e nadua boromakauna; bena hari tatoiosi vairadiai e dabara, au ikerukeruna ai, bona badibadidiai e gini ela bona vada e aniani vaitani.
GEN.18.8.english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

GEN.20.10.motu: Abimelek ese Abraham ma e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai ina kara vada o karaia?
GEN.20.10.english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

GEN.39.11.motu: Nega ta, ia na ruma lalonai e raka vareai; ruma na asi tauna.
GEN.39.11.english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

GEN.32.22.motu: Malokihi ai e tore isi, adavana raruosi bona ena hesiai hahinedia raruosi bona natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-ta-osi e abidia, sinavai maraḡina ladana Iabok bae turu hanai.
GEN.32.22.english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

GEN.5.7.motu: bena Enos e vara murinai Set na laḡani sinahu-taurahani dikoana hitu e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.7.english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.18.6.motu: Bena Abraham na dabua kalagana ai e heau vareai, Sara e hamaoroa, eto, Flaoa irau autoi avabi, ba kuia, ataga ba gabu.
GEN.18.6.english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

GEN.43.4.motu: Taunabunai, tadimai ba siaia, ai ida baiala, aniani baia ha hoia amu;
GEN.43.4.english: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

GEN.31.31.motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban e haere henia, eto, Na gari, nato natumu na egu amo ba dadidia oho readia.
GEN.31.31.english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

GEN.3.5.motu: Dirava vada dibana raruosi bavania dinana ai na matamui bae papa, bena Dirava ida ba heḡereḡere, namo bona dika ba diba.
GEN.3.5.english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

GEN.2.17.motu: a namo bona dika idibalaidia auna huahuana una mo basio ania; badina be ia bavania dinana ai oi na ba mase vaitani.
GEN.2.17.english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

GEN.36.17.motu: Esau natuna Reuele natuna bini: Nahata bona Sera bona Sama bona Misa. Idia na hanua lohiadia Reuele ai, Edom tanona ai; idia danu Esau adavana Basemata tubuna.
GEN.36.17.english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

GEN.45.6.motu: Badina be ini laḡani rua be doe laḡanidia, a doe laḡanidia ima do mimia, unu laḡani lalodiai tano basie ruaia bona uit basie utua.
GEN.45.6.english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

GEN.49.1.motu: Bena Iakob ese natuna e boiridia, eto, Iboumui ai ba hebou, emui ai dahaka dahaka nega gabedia ai baine vara na baina hamaorolaimui.
GEN.49.1.english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

GEN.32.25.motu: Hari tau na dibana ia na basine kwalimu diba, bena ia ese Iakob mamuna varovarona e daua toho; taunabunai Iakob aena e heride, ia na hari tau ida e hedaverai negana ai.
GEN.32.25.english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

GEN.35.2.motu: Taunabunai, Iakob ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e haduadia, eto, Dirava idaudia dekemui ai mimia vada a negedia, ba haheḡoeva, dabua ḡoevadia ba rio;
GEN.35.2.english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

GEN.4.15.motu: Bena Iehova ese Kain e hamaoroa, eto, Kain baine alaia tauna na davana bae henia hahitu. Bena Iehova ese Kain enai toa ta e atoa, lau ta ese idavarina negana ai bema alaia na garina.
GEN.4.15.english: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

GEN.5.16.motu: bena Iared e vara murinai Mahalalel na laḡani sinahu-taurahani toi-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.16.english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.11.27.motu: Tera garana bini: Tera ese Abram bona Nahoro bona Haran e havaradia. Haran ese Lot e havaraia.
GEN.11.27.english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

GEN.27.42.motu: Haida ese Esau ena hereva Rebeka e hamaorolaia, bena Rebeka ese natuna tau-muritai Iakob e boiria, e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, kakamu Esau ese lalona e hadaiamu, baine alamu mase e tomu.
GEN.27.42.english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

GEN.26.31.motu: Daba ai e gwau hamata heheni. Bena Isaak ese e siaidia lao, mai mainodia ida ela.
GEN.26.31.english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

GEN.3.22.motu: Bana Dirava Iehova eto, Taunimanima a itaia, ia na lau heḡereḡeregu ai vada ela, namo bona dika baine diba; readia ia ese imana ma baine toia roro, mauri auna huahuana baine abia, baine ania, bena baine mauri hanai-hanai.
GEN.3.22.english: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

GEN.18.15.motu: Bena Sara e heḡore, eto, Lau na asina kiri. Badina be ia na e gari. A ia eto, Lasi, oi na o kiri.
GEN.18.15.english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid.

GEN.15.3.motu: Abram ma eto, Natugu ta so henigu dainai, hesiai merona egu ruma ai e vara na dihigu ai bainela.
GEN.15.3.english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

GEN.18.2.motu: Ia na e gaga isi, tatau tatoi e itadia, ia vairanai gigini; e itadia negana ai, ia na ena dabua kalagana iduarana amo e heau lasi, tano ai e goru diho,
GEN.18.2.english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

GEN.43.29.motu: Bena ia matana e roha isi, tadina Beniamina e itaia, ia sinana natuna; bena eto, Tadimu tau-muritai benai a, vanegai sivaraina o gwauraia merona? Ma eto, Natugu e, Dirava ese baine bogamu hisi.
GEN.43.29.english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

GEN.43.5.motu: a basio siaia, ai na basiala, badina be una tau eto “Tadimui basio hakaua mai, lau vairagu basio itaia”.
GEN.43.5.english: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

GEN.14.2.motu: idia hahaniosi eha tuari, Bera, Sodoma pavapavana, bona Birisa, Gomora pavapavana, bona Sinab, Adma pavapavana, bona Semebere, Seboimi pavapavana, bona Bela (ladana ta be Soara) pavapavana, e tuari henidia.
GEN.14.2.english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

GEN.34.13.motu: A Iakobo natuna mamaruanedia na e haere koikoi, Sekem, tamana Hamoro ida, e dibaḡanidia, taihuna Daina vada e hahemaraia dainai.
GEN.34.13.english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

GEN.45.23.motu: Herahia ḡaudia danu e siai, tamana ena: doniki gwauta Aigupto kohudia namodia e hua, bona doniki hahinedia gwauta uit bona flaoa bona aniani haida danu e hua, tamana ena dala lakwana.
GEN.45.23.english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

GEN.42.5.motu: Taunabunai, Israel natuna na taunimanima loḡora ida uit ihoina ela; badina be doe na bada Kanaan tanona ai.
GEN.42.5.english: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

GEN.50.15.motu: Tamadia ena mase murinai, Iosef kakana na e hereva heheni, eto, Readia Iosef lalona ma baine dika ita edai, bena a kara dika henia karadia davadia do baine henida.
GEN.50.15.english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”

GEN.27.11.motu: Bena Iakob ese sinana Rebeka e haere henia, eto, Kakagu Esau na tauna mai derana, a lau kopigu be manada.
GEN.27.11.english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

GEN.49.20.motu: Asere ena tano ai uit momo baine vara,

GEN.24.40.motu: Bena ia eto “Iehova, vairanai na rakamu Diravana, ese ena aneru baine siaia, baine bamomu bona emu dala baine lailaia; bena varavaragu bona tamagu ena ruma taudia bogaragidiai natugu adavana do ba davaria.
GEN.24.40.english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

GEN.11.2.motu: Nega ta, mairiveina kahana amo e laolaova ai, idia ese taora ta e davaria, Sinara kahana ai, bena unuseni ai e nohova.
GEN.11.2.english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

GEN.25.29.motu: Dina ta Iakob ese aniani e nadua; bena Esau na gunika amo e lasi mai manorina ida.
GEN.25.29.english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

GEN.24.30.motu: Ia ese taihuna Rebeka ena gadei bona imana vaḡivaḡidia e ita, bena e raka lasi, hari ranu gabuna ai ena kamelo e naridiava tauna dekena ela.
GEN.24.30.english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

GEN.33.2.motu: hesiai hahinedia mai natudia ida vairai bae raka, idia muridiai Lea mai natuna ida, ma idia muridiai Rahela mai natuna Iosef ida.
GEN.33.2.english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

GEN.31.49.motu: Ma ladana ta be Mispa; badina be ia eto, Basita heita heheni negadia ai Iehova ese baine gimada.
GEN.31.49.english: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

GEN.7.6.motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu tauratoi negana ai, utu-utu badana ese tanobada idoinai e utua dae.
GEN.7.6.english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

GEN.4.16.motu: Bena Kain na Iehova vairana amo e raka lasi, Nod tanona ai eha noho, Eden mairiveina kahana ai.
GEN.4.16.english: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

GEN.36.43.motu: Magdiel; Iram: Edom lohiadia bunu, ta ta ese ena hanua ena hanua e halohiadia. A Edom besena ihavarana tauna be Esau.
GEN.36.43.english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

GEN.25.5.motu: Abraham ese Isaak na ia dihina ai e halaoa.
GEN.25.5.english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

GEN.4.26.motu: Bena Set ese natuna e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Enos. Una negana ai taunimanima ese Iehova ladana e hahanea matama.
GEN.4.26.english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.

GEN.17.24.motu: Abraham ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ta-ahui taurahanita, e peritomea negana ai.
GEN.17.24.english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

GEN.21.20.motu: Dirava ese mero na e reḡua. Ia na e bada oho bada oho, tano ḡaḡaena ai eha noho; ia na taraki-taraki e diba ḡoeva.
GEN.21.20.english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

GEN.2.8.motu: Dirava Iehova ese imea ta e karaia, ladana Eden, mairiveina kahana ai, bena vada e karaia tauna unuseni ai e atoa, baine noho.
GEN.2.8.english: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

GEN.31.7.motu: Tamamui ese vada e koigu, nega gwauta davagu vada e ha-idaua, a Dirava ese e laoa ahu dainai ia ese se hadikagu.
GEN.31.7.english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

GEN.35.17.motu: Ena hekamonai hisidia vada e bada herea ai, hegwaroto hahinena ese e hamaoroa, eto, Basio gari; mero ta do bavabia.
GEN.35.17.english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

GEN.31.36.motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban e badu henia, e gwau henia, eto, Egu kerere be dahaka, egu dika be dahaka, bena oi ese daidiai o havagu mai badumu ida?
GEN.31.36.english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

GEN.50.14.motu: Bena tamana e guria murinai, Iosef, mai tadikakana bona mai bamona ida, e lou lao, Aigupto ela.
GEN.50.14.english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

GEN.42.22.motu: Bena Ruben eto, Lau na hamaoromui, ani, nato “Mero na basio hadikaia”, to umui na asio kamonai, harihari ia rarana na ita latadai.
GEN.42.22.english: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

GEN.9.12.motu: Dirava ma eto, Egu taravatu na henimuimu, lauegu bona umui emui danu, mauri ḡaudia umui ida nonoho iboudiai edia danu, ela bona uru iboudiai, toana binai:
GEN.9.12.english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

GEN.41.47.motu: Bena madinamo laḡanidia hituosi lalodiai uma anidia vada e bada herea.
GEN.41.47.english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

GEN.38.9.motu: Bena Onan dibana mero na basie gwauraia ia natuna dainai ia na hahine enai e raka vareai, a gau be tano ai e hahebubua, natuna ta basine vara helaoreana.
GEN.38.9.english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

GEN.4.11.motu: Harihari ela, uduna e haḡaia tadimu rarana imamu amo e abia tanona ese baine hadikamu.
GEN.4.11.english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

GEN.42.27.motu: Adorahi ai e taruha, bena ta ese ena puse e kehoa, ena doniki baine ubua eto; bena ena moni e itaia, puse uduna ai.
GEN.42.27.english: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

GEN.11.15.motu: Ebere e vara murinai Sela na laḡani sinahu-hani dikoana toi e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.15.english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.32.8.motu: eto, Esau ese orea ta baine davaria bena baine habuaia tari reana, a orea ta ma baine mauri.
GEN.32.8.english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

GEN.44.34.motu: Badina be ede baina haheauka toma, tamagu dekena baina lou lao a mero basina hakaua lao, bena dika tamagu enai baine vara be baina itaia?
GEN.44.34.english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

GEN.47.29.motu: Ena mase vada e kahira-kahira ai, ia ese natuna Iosef e boiria, e hereva henia, eto, Boma lalokau henigu, imamu na mamugu ai boma atoa kau, boma gwau hamata, Aigupto ai basio gurigu,
GEN.47.29.english: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

GEN.22.15.motu: Iehova ena aneru ese Abraham ma e hereva henia lou, guba amo ma e boi dobi,
GEN.22.15.english: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

GEN.23.17.motu: Taunabunai Efron ena tano Makapela ai, Mamare badinai, mai kohuana bona mai auna iboudiai na
GEN.23.17.english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

GEN.8.22.motu: Tanobada baine mia negadia ai na hadohado bona ḡeiḡei, keru bona sioahu, lahara bona guitau, dina bona boi, basie doko.
GEN.8.22.english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

GEN.27.18.motu: Iakob na tamana dekena ela, eto, Tamagu e! Ia na e haere, eto, Lau o ina: natugu e, oi be daika?
GEN.27.18.english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?”

GEN.44.14.motu: Iuda mai tadikakana ida Iosef ena ruma ai e gini dae negana ai, Iosef na do ruma ai, bena idia ese ia vairanai e goru goru diho.
GEN.44.14.english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

GEN.14.5.motu: Bena laḡani ihagwauta-hanina ai Kedoralaomere bona ia e duruava lohiadia na e tore isi, Refaim taudia na Astaroto-karanaimi ai e hadareredia, bona Susim taudia na Ham ai e hadareredia, bona Emim taudia na Savekiriataimi ai e hadareredia,
GEN.14.5.english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

GEN.50.12.motu: Bena natuna na iena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia:
GEN.50.12.english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

GEN.46.16.motu: Gad natuna be Sifion bona Hagi bona Suni bona Esbon bona Eri bona Arodi bona Areli.
GEN.46.16.english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

GEN.21.10.motu: Bena ia ese Abraham e hamaoroa, eto, Hesiai hahinena mai natuna ida a luludia, badina be ina hesiai hahinena natuna na oi dihimu ai basinela, natugu Isaak ida.
GEN.21.10.english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

GEN.12.20.motu: Bena Farao ese ena hesiai taudia e haduadia, bae hakaua lao; bena e hakaua ela, ia mai adavana mai ena kohu idoinai ida.
GEN.12.20.english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

GEN.38.26.motu: Bena Iuda ese e gwauraia hedinarai, eto, Iena kara maoromaoro ese lauegu e hereaiamu, badina be natugu Sela ida asina haheadavadia. Bena ia ida se eno bou lou.
GEN.38.26.english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.”

GEN.9.18.motu: Noa natuna mamaruanedia, lagatoi amo e raka lasi taudia, ladadia na Sem bona Ham bona Iafet. Ham na Kanaan tamana.
GEN.9.18.english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

GEN.42.6.motu: Iosef na tano idoinai lohiana, taunabunai taunimanima iboudiai ia dekena ela, uit e hoia. Iosef kakana danu ia dekena ela, ia vairanai e goru diho.
GEN.42.6.english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

GEN.24.35.motu: Iehova ese biagugu vada e hanamoa badabada, lohia badana ai vada e halaoa; mamoe seridia bona boromakau seridia vada e henia, bona silver bona gold, bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia, bona kamelo bona doniki.
GEN.24.35.english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

GEN.38.14.motu: bena ia ese ena vabu dabuadia e doki oho, vairana na dabua amo e ḡovaia, ela, Timuna dalana isena ai e helai dala katakata ai. Badina be ia vada e diba hari Sela vada e tauhau, a tamana na se haheadavadia.
GEN.38.14.english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

GEN.31.4.motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela bona Lea e boiridia, dekena baela, taora ai ena seri e reḡudiava gabuna ai.
GEN.31.4.english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

GEN.32.29.motu: Bena Iakob ese e nanadaia, eto, Mani emu kara, oi ladamu ba hadibagu. Hari tau elo, Badina be dahaka lau ladagu o henanadailaiamu? Bena ia ese e hanamoa.
GEN.32.29.english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.”

GEN.24.29.motu: Hari Rebeka na mai taihuna ta, ladana na Laban; bena ia na e raka lasi haraḡa, una tau dekena ela, ranu gabuna ai.
GEN.24.29.english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

GEN.36.1.motu: Esau garana bini. Ia ladana ta be Edom.
GEN.36.1.english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

GEN.50.21.motu: Tauna-bunai, basio gari; umui baina ubumui, bona natumui danu baina ubudia. Bena hereva namodia amo lalodia e hamarumarudia.
GEN.50.21.english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

GEN.7.1.motu: Iehova ese Noa e hamaoroa, eto, Emu ruma taudia iboudiai lagatoi lalonai ba hakaudia vareai, badina be vada na itamu, ina uru ai oi sibomu kara maoromaoro taumu.
GEN.7.1.english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

GEN.11.13.motu: Sela e vara murinai, Afasad na laḡani sinahu-hani dikoana toi e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.11.13.english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.19.3.motu: To e noidia goadagoada, bena idia na ia ida e dae kau, ena ruma ai e raka vareai. Bena ia ese aniani e nadua, bona flaoa kavakava, se hatubua ḡauna, e gabua, e dabara, bena raruosi e ani.
GEN.19.3.english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

GEN.21.5.motu: Abraham ena maun laḡanidia na sinahu-ta, natuna Isaak e vara negana ai.
GEN.21.5.english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

GEN.27.23.motu: Ia na toana asi dibana, badina be imana na huika-huika, kakana Esau imana na heto; taunabunai ia ese e hanamoa.
GEN.27.23.english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

GEN.49.15.motu: E itaia ena laḡa-ani be namo,
GEN.49.15.english: He saw a resting place, that it was good,

GEN.50.24.motu: Bena Iosef ese tadikakana e hamaorodia, eto, Egu mase negana vada eme kau: a Dirava ese baine lalomui, bona ina tano amo baine hakaumui lasi, ela bona ena gwau-hamata ai Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e heni tanona.
GEN.50.24.english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

GEN.12.18.motu: Bena Farao ese Abram e boiria, e gwau henia, eto, Ede vada o karagu toma? Dahaka dainai oi so hamaorogu ia na oi adavamu?
GEN.12.18.english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

GEN.41.41.motu: Farao ese Iosef ma e hereva henia, eto, A kamonai lau ese Aigupto tanona idoinai lohiana ai name halaomu.
GEN.41.41.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

GEN.20.8.motu: Taunabunai Abimelek na daba vaburana ai e tore isi, ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e boiridia, unu ḡau e hamaoro-laidia: bena gari ese e butudia tao.
GEN.20.8.english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

GEN.36.2.motu: Esau adavana na Kanaan hahinedia: Ada, Elon tau Hiti natuna; bona Oholibama, Ana natuna, Sibeon tau Hivi tubuna;
GEN.36.2.english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

GEN.25.15.motu: bona Hadad bona Tema bona Ieturu bona Nafisi bona Kedema.
GEN.25.15.english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

GEN.5.30.motu: Noa e vara murinai Lamek na laḡani sinahu-ima taurahani-ta-ahui ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.30.english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.22.6.motu: Bena Abraham ese boubou lahina audia e abi, natuna paḡana ai e ato kau, bona lahi bona kaia imana ai e abi; bena raruosi e raka hebou.
GEN.22.6.english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

GEN.18.25.motu: Kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na basio aladia bou ani? Kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia ahudia bae tamona na dia oiemu kara ani? Tanobada idoinai ihahemaoro-henina Diravana basine kara maoromaoro a?
GEN.18.25.english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

GEN.41.2.motu: Bena boromakau hitu sinavai badana amo e dae, taudia nanamo bona mai digaradia, sinavai isena ai e anianiva.
GEN.41.2.english: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

GEN.42.1.motu: Iakob ese harina e kamonai Aigupto be mai uitina, bena ia ese natuna e gwau henidia, eto, Badina be dahaka o herarai hehenimu?
GEN.42.1.english: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

GEN.48.6.motu: A idia muridiai bae vara memerodia na oi natumu; kakadia bae nemaidia bona ahudia bae abi.
GEN.48.6.english: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

GEN.42.21.motu: Bena idia na e hereva heheni, eto, Momokani, ita na vada ta kerere tadida dainai; badina be ena taitai ta kamonai, to ena noinoi asita abia dae; una dainai ina hekwarahi na ita edai vada e kau.
GEN.42.21.english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

GEN.34.30.motu: Bena Iakob ese Simeon bona Levi e gwau henidia, eto, Hekwarahi egu ai vada o havaraia, bona ladagu vada o hadikaia ina tano taudia, Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia, bogaragidiai. Bena ita na dia hoho dainai idia na bae hebou, bae tuari henigu; bena lau bona egu ruma taudia iboudiai baita mase ore.
GEN.34.30.english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

GEN.2.5.motu: uda audia ta be tanobada ai do we miava, aniani avadia ta do se vara; badina be Dirava Iehova ese medu tanobada ai do se hadihoa, asi tauna danu tano ibiru-henina.
GEN.2.5.english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

GEN.6.18.motu: A taravagu oiemu ai baina atua, baina hamomokania; oi ma lagatoi ai ba gui, oi bona natumu bona adavamu bona ravamu hahinedia.
GEN.6.18.english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

GEN.9.8.motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa mai natuna ida ma e hereva henidia, eto,
GEN.9.8.english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

GEN.45.28.motu: Bena Israel eto, Vadaeni, natugu Iosef dounu e maurimu; lau na do basina mase ai baina ha itaia.
GEN.45.28.english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

GEN.49.31.motu: Unuseni ai Abraham mai adavana Sara ida e guridia, unuseni ai Isaak mai adavana Rebeka ida e guridia; unuseni ai danu Lea na guria.
GEN.49.31.english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

GEN.8.14.motu: Hua iharuana ena dina iharuahui-hituna ai tanobada e kaukau vaitani.
GEN.8.14.english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

GEN.28.19.motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Betele; a una gabu ladana gunana be Lusu.
GEN.28.19.english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

GEN.38.17.motu: Ia eto, Nani natuna ta baina henimu. Hahine na eto, Toana be dahaka ba henigu ela bona ba siaia?
GEN.38.17.english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.”

GEN.27.41.motu: Esau ese Iakob e inai henia, tamana ena hahenamo dainai; bena lalona ai eto, Tamagu itai-taina dinadia be kahikahi; unu muridiai tadigu Iakob baina alaia mase.
GEN.27.41.english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

GEN.39.1.motu: Iosef na Aigupto e laohaia, unuseni ai Aigupto tauna ta, lohia ta Farao ena ruma ai, ladana Potifara, ese e hoia, hari Ismael taudia, e hakaua lao taudia, edia amo.
GEN.39.1.english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

GEN.32.16.motu: Ini iboudiai ena hesiai taudia e henidia, ta ta ena seri ena seri ai. Bena ia ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui ba raka guna, seri ta ta mai padadia ida ba hakaudia lao.
GEN.32.16.english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

GEN.42.29.motu: Kanaan tanona ai e kau, tamadia Iakob dekenai. Bena edia laolao sivaraina e hamaorolaia, eto,
GEN.42.29.english: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

GEN.19.1.motu: Aneru raruosi na Sodoma ai e kau, dina kerekerena ai. Lot na hanua ikoukouna ai e helai, bena e itadia negana ai na vairadiai e heau, tano ai e goru diho,
GEN.19.1.english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

GEN.46.19.motu: Iakob adavana Rahela natuna bini: Iosef bona Beniamina.
GEN.46.19.english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

GEN.8.6.motu: Dina hari-ahui ma e ore, bena Noa ese lagatoi gaba-mauruna e kehoa, mukou ta e harohoa;
GEN.8.6.english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

GEN.33.9.motu: A Esau eto, Tadigu e, lauegu na davana, oiemu hari ba dogo tao.
GEN.33.9.english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

GEN.48.8.motu: Bena Israel ese Iosef natuna e haḡeredia, eto, Ini be daidia?
GEN.48.8.english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

GEN.28.8.motu: Bena Esau lalona e parara tamana Isaak na Kanaan hahinedia se ura henidiava.
GEN.28.8.english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

GEN.38.11.motu: Bena Iuda ese ravana Tamara e hamaoroa, eto, Do ba lou lao, tamamu ena ruma ai ba noho vado, ela bona natugu Sela baine bada. Ena lalo-hadai korikori be Sela danu baine mase, kakana heḡereḡeredia. Taunabunai, Tamara na e lou lao. tamana ena ruma ai e nohova.
GEN.38.11.english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

GEN.49.32.motu: Kohuana bunai, mai imeana, na Hiti taudia edia amo e hoia.
GEN.49.32.english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

GEN.8.2.motu: Ranu e lohi lohi daeva gabudia bona guba iduaradia danu e kou ahu, guba amo e dihova meduna danu e hadokoa.
GEN.8.2.english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

GEN.26.27.motu: Bena Isaak ese e hereva henidia, eto, O inai henigu bona o lulugu: harihari lau dekegu vada oma badina be dahaka?
GEN.26.27.english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

GEN.39.13.motu: Hahine na e itaia, ena dabua na ia imana ai vada e rakatania, vada e heau lasi:
GEN.39.13.english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

GEN.36.22.motu: Lotan natuna na Hori bona Heman; Lotan taihuna na Timna.
GEN.36.22.english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

GEN.41.57.motu: Bena tano idau-idau iboudiai amo e hesiai ela, Aigupto ai aniani e hoi, Iosef dekenai; badina be doe na bada herea, tanobada idoinai.
GEN.41.57.english: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

GEN.4.7.motu: Boma kara namo, basinama abimu dae a? Basioma kara namo, kara havara be iduara badinai e narimumu; e ura henimumu, to oi ese ba hadarerea.
GEN.4.7.english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

GEN.26.35.motu: A Isaak bona Rebeka lalodia na e hekwarahi unu hahine daidiai.
GEN.26.35.english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

GEN.37.9.motu: Ma e nihi lou, bena ena nihi na kakana e hamaorolaidia, eto, Vada na nihi lou, bena egu nihi ai dina bona hua bona hisiu gwauta-taese e toma henigu diho.
GEN.37.9.english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

GEN.17.17.motu: Bena Abraham na tano ai e goru diho, to lalona ai e kiri, eto, Ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta tauna ese natuna baine havaraia a? Sara danu ena mauri laḡanidiana taurahani-ta-ahui be baine mara a?
GEN.17.17.english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

GEN.24.15.motu: Ena ḡuriḡuri do se ore ai, hane-ulato ta ladana Rebeka ena hodu e ehea ema. Ia na Betuel natuna; tubuna hahinena na Milka, Abraham tadina Nahoro adavana.
GEN.24.15.english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

GEN.42.20.motu: Bena ba lou mai, tadimui ba hakaua mai dekegu ai; unu amo baina diba emui hereva na momokani, bena basio mase. Unu ba kara toma.
GEN.42.20.english: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.”

GEN.17.4.motu: Lau ese taravamu na atuamu: bese diaḡau do ba havaradia lau daigu ai.
GEN.17.4.english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

GEN.21.16.motu: bena taina e raka lao, diba bema kinoa heḡereḡerena; bena tano ai e helai diho, e tai dikadika, eto, Mero ena mase basina itaia.
GEN.21.16.english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

GEN.6.3.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Lau laumagu na taunimanima lalodiai basine noho hanaihanai, badina be idia na hidio kavakava mo: edia mauri laḡanidia bae sinahu-ta ruahui hona.
GEN.6.3.english: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

GEN.31.48.motu: Bena Laban eto, Hari dina ai ina nadi senuna ese e hahemaoro henidamu. Una dainai ladana na Galeed.
GEN.31.48.english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

GEN.19.13.motu: Badina be ina gabu baia habuaia tari, badina be haridia dika-hereadia na Iehova enai vada e kau, taunabunai Iehova ese vada e siaimai, baia habuaia tari.
GEN.19.13.english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

GEN.19.17.motu: E hakaudia lasi, bena eto, Ba heau mauri, basio roha muri, taora ai basio halahe. Ororo ba heau lao, ba mase na garina.
GEN.19.17.english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

GEN.25.28.motu: Isaak ese Esau e lalokau heniava, badina be ena labana damudia e aniva; a Rebeka ese Iakob e lalokau heniava.
GEN.25.28.english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

GEN.36.12.motu: Elifasa, Esau natuna, ese danu hahine ta ladana Timna e adavaia; hari Timna ese mero ta e abia, ladana Amalek: ini iboudiai na Esau adavana Ada tubuna.
GEN.36.12.english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

GEN.23.12.motu: Bena Abraham ese una gabu taudia vairadiai e igo diho.
GEN.23.12.english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

GEN.19.6.motu: Bena Lot na iduara amo e raka lasi bona iduara e koua ia murinai;
GEN.19.6.english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

GEN.28.18.motu: Daba matana ai Iakob e tore isi, ena hekwina nadina e haginia, pupuna ai e halaoa, latanai dehoro e seia.
GEN.28.18.english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

GEN.30.26.motu: Adavagu bona natugu ba henigu, badina be idia daidiai oi isiaimu vada na lao heni. A kahugu nege; egu hekwarahi emu hesiai ilao-henina ai vada dibamu.
GEN.30.26.english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

GEN.1.15.motu: Guba ai bae diari, tanobada bae hadiaria. Bena unu e vara toma.
GEN.1.15.english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

GEN.38.13.motu: Tamara ese ravana harina e kamonai, ia na mamoe huidia iutudia totona Timuna e laova;
GEN.38.13.english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

GEN.23.19.motu: Bena Abraham ese ia adavana Sara e guria, Makapela kohuana lalonai, Mamare badinai. Una gabu na Heberon, Kanaan tanona ai.
GEN.23.19.english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

GEN.8.15.motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa e hereva henia, eto,

GEN.6.9.motu: Noa sivaraina binai: Noa na kara maoromaoro tauna, ena uru ai e kara namo ḡuḡuruva. Ia na Dirava ida e havamo heheniva.
GEN.6.9.english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

GEN.49.27.motu: Beniamina na uda sisiana vamu e tahuamu na heto,

GEN.11.26.motu: Tera ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-hitu negana ai, ia ese Abram bona Nahoro bona Haran e havaradia.
GEN.11.26.english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

GEN.17.6.motu: Garamu lau ese baina hahutumadia, bese idau-idau do ba havaradia, hanua pavapavadia danu oiemu amo bae vara.
GEN.17.6.english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

GEN.15.5.motu: Bena e hakaua lasi murimuri ai, eto, A gaga dae, guba ba itaia, hisiu ba duahidia diba eiava lasi: oi garamu danu unu bae hutuma toma.
GEN.15.5.english: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

GEN.44.24.motu: Bena emu hesiai tauna, ai tamamai, dekena a lou lao, lohia taumu emu hereva a hamaorolaia.
GEN.44.24.english: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

GEN.10.6.motu: Ham natuna bini: Kusu bona Misraim bona Put bona Kanaan.
GEN.10.6.english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

GEN.21.8.motu: Mero na e bada oho bada oho ela bona rata e negea; bena Abraham ese aria badana e karaia, Isaak ese rata e negea dinana ai.
GEN.21.8.english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

GEN.24.59.motu: Taunabunai taihudia Rebeka, mai ena hesiai hahinena ida e kahudia nege, Abraham ena hesiai tauna mai bamona ida danu.
GEN.24.59.english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

GEN.30.34.motu: Bena Laban eto, Emu hereva heḡereḡerena, unu baita kara toma.
GEN.30.34.english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

GEN.7.4.motu: Badina be dina hitu bae ore murinai lau ese medu baina hadihoa tanobada ai, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui, mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai vada na karadia ihabua-taridia totona.
GEN.7.4.english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

GEN.20.18.motu: Badina be Iehova ese Abimelek ena ruma hahinedia iboudiai vada e hagabanidia, Sara, Abraham adavana, dainai.
GEN.20.18.english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

GEN.19.11.motu: A ariara ai e gini hebouva taudia kikina-badana na matadia e hakepuludia; bena iduara e tahua malakamalaka ela bona e hesiku.
GEN.19.11.english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

GEN.33.18.motu: Unuhetomana Iakob na mai maurina ida Padan-aram amo ema, Sekem hanuana ai e lasi, Kanaan tanona ai; bena hanua badinai e taruha.
GEN.33.18.english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

GEN.49.29.motu: Bena ia ese e haḡanidia, eto, Tubu tama dekedia ba laomu: tubugu bona tamagu badibadidiai ba gurigu, nadi kohuana ai, Efron tau Hiti ena tano ai.
GEN.49.29.english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

GEN.20.13.motu: A Dirava ena hahedua dainai, tamagu ena ruma na rakatania negana ai lau ese na hamaoroa, nato, Ini ba bogagu hisi toma: baita lao heni gabudia iboudiai ba herevalaigu, baoto “Ia na lau taihugu”.
GEN.20.13.english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

GEN.26.24.motu: Bena una hanuaboi Iehova na ienai e hedinarai, eto, Lau na tamamu Abraham ena Dirava: basio gari, badina be lau ese na bamomumu; baina hanamomu bona garamu baina hahutumadia, egu hesiai tauna Abraham dainai.
GEN.26.24.english: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

GEN.38.23.motu: Bena Iuda eto, Egu ḡau ia dekenai bae mia, baita hemarai garina; nani natuna na siaia, to hahinena na so davaria.
GEN.38.23.english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

GEN.26.30.motu: Bena Isaak ese aria e karaia: iboudiai e aniani hebou bona e inuinu hebou.
GEN.26.30.english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

GEN.19.33.motu: Bena una hanuaboi vine ranuna amo tamadia e hakekeroa, bena hane guna na ia ida e eno bou; a ia be ena hekure negana bona ena toreisi negana asi dibana.
GEN.19.33.english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

GEN.22.19.motu: Bena Abraham na ena hesiai memerodia raruosi dekedia e lou lao; hahaniosi e lou ela Bere-sieba, Abraham ena noho gabuna bunai.
GEN.22.19.english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

GEN.38.8.motu: Bena Iuda ese Onan e haduaia, eto, Vabu enai ba raka vareai, bavadavaia, natuna ba havaraia, kakamu ena.
GEN.38.8.english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

GEN.4.6.motu: A Iehova ese Kain e gwau henia, eto, Badina be dahaka o badumu? Dahaka dainai vairamu o huaiamu?
GEN.4.6.english: Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

GEN.41.14.motu: Bena Farao e hesiai, Iosef eha boiria. Bena idia ese dibura rumana amo e hakaua lasi haraḡa-haraḡa; ia ese aukina huina e abia bona ena dabuae boloa, bena Farao dekenai e raka vareai.
GEN.41.14.english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

GEN.34.2.motu: Bena una tano lohiana, Hamoro, tau Hivi, natuna Sekem ese e ḡahusia, bena e rosia, e ḡaḡaia.
GEN.34.2.english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

GEN.43.16.motu: Iosef ese Beniamina e itaia, bena ena hesiai tauna e haduaia, eto, Ini tatau na ba hakaudia lao egu ruma lalonai; aniani danu ba dabaraia, badina be dina tubua ai idia na lau ida baia aniani hebou.
GEN.43.16.english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

GEN.31.25.motu: Bena Laban ese Iakob e lasia tao. Iakob na ororo ai vada e taruha; bena Laban mai varavarana ida danu Gilead ororodia ai e taruha.
GEN.31.25.english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

GEN.44.8.motu: O itaia, emai puse ududia ai a davari monidia na a henimu lou, Kanaan amo a lou mai negana ai: benaini, dahaka dainai biagumu ena ruma ai silver eiava gold baiama henao?
GEN.44.8.english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

GEN.19.29.motu: Unuhetomana, taora hanuadia e habua tari negana ai, Dirava ese Abraham e laloa, bona Lot e hamauria, e noho kau heni hanuadia e habua tari negana ai.
GEN.19.29.english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

GEN.16.5.motu: Bena Sarai ese Abram e gwau henia, eto, Oiemu kerere ese vada e hadikagu; egu hesiai hahinena na henimu, bavadavaia, a dibana vada e rogorogo dainai ia na se matauraigumu: Iehova ese ita raruosi baine hahemaoro henida.
GEN.16.5.english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”
