GEN.38.19.motu: Hahine na e tore isi, ela, vairana e ḡovalaia dabuana e negea, ena vabu dabuadia e doki lou.
GEN.38.19.english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

GEN.22.8.motu: Abraham e haere, eto, Natugu e, mamoe lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna na Dirava sibona ena amo baita abia. Bena raruosi ma e raka lao.
GEN.22.8.english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

GEN.34.14.motu: E hamaorodia, eto, Taihumai na se peritomea tauna baia henia na taravatu, bona hemarai ihavarana karana emai ai.
GEN.34.14.english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

GEN.48.1.motu: Ini ḡau muridiai, Iosef na harina e kamonai tamana vada e gorere; bena ia ese natuna raruosi, Manase bona Efraim, e hakaudia lao.
GEN.48.1.english: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

GEN.36.41.english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

GEN.8.9.motu: To pune na ena roho-kau gabuna ta se davaria, bena Noa dekena e lou lao lagatoi ai, badina be ranu ese tanobada kopina idoinai vada e habubunia. Bena Noa ese imana e toia roro, lagatoi lalonai e abia vareai.
GEN.8.9.english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

GEN.38.27.motu: Ena mara negana vada e kahira-kahira, vada e diba hekapa na bogana ai.
GEN.38.27.english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

GEN.5.12.motu: Kenan ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-ahui negana ai, ia ese Mahalalel e havaraia;
GEN.5.12.english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

GEN.9.15.motu: Bena egu taravatu baina laloa, lauegu, umui emui bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai edia danu: utu-utu badana ta basina ha-utua dae lou, mauri ḡaudia basina habuadia tari lou.
GEN.9.15.english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

GEN.10.18.motu: bona Aravada bona Semara bona Hamat. Gabeamo Kanaan iduhudia na e karoho, kaha idau-idau ai eha noho;
GEN.10.18.english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

GEN.14.8.motu: Bena Sodoma pavapavana bona Gomora pavapavana bona Adma pavapavana bona Seboimi pavapavana bona Bela (ladana ta be Soara) pavapavana e tore isi, Sidim kourana ela, tuari totona;
GEN.14.8.english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

GEN.43.9.motu: Lau ese do baina naria; lau dekegu ai ba tahua. Basinama loulaia dekemu ai, vairamu ai basinama hakaua, kerere na lau latagu ai bema mia hanaihanai.
GEN.43.9.english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;

GEN.34.23.motu: Gabe amo edia seri bona edia kohu bona edia boromakau iboudiai na iseda ai baita halao, ani? Idia ida baita herohemaino, bena bogaragidai do bae noho.
GEN.34.23.english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

GEN.45.19.motu: Ma ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ini ba kara toma: ina Aigupto tanona ai rerue bavabi, ba laohai, natumui bona adavamui ba udadia, ba mailaidia, bona tamamui danu.
GEN.45.19.english: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

GEN.11.3.motu: Bena idia na e hereva heheni, eto, Mani raro nadidia aita kara, aita tunu namonamo. Bena idia ese e tunu rarodia e abi, nadi ai e halao, bona rarokaka ta e abia, hekamo ḡauna ai e halaoa.
GEN.11.3.english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

GEN.28.22.motu: ina nadi pupuna danu hari name haginia na Dirava ena ruma ai bainela. Ba henigu ḡaudia idoidiai danu baina karoa, karoa gwauta, karoa ta oi baina henimu.
GEN.28.22.english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

GEN.14.4.motu: Laḡani gwauta-rua idia ese Kedoralaomere isiaina e lao heniava, a laḡani ihagwauta-toina ai idia na e gwau edeede.
GEN.14.4.english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

GEN.8.17.motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai oi dekemu ai danu ba rakalaidia lasi, manu bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai. Bae vara rohoroho, bae mara momomomo, bae hutuma.
GEN.8.17.english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

GEN.10.29.motu: bona Ofiri bona Havila bona Iobab. Ini iboudiai na Iokotan natuna.
GEN.10.29.english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

GEN.27.27.motu: Bena ia na e raka kahi, e harahua. Isaak ese ena dabua bonana e kamonai, bena e hanamoa, eto,
GEN.27.27.english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said,

GEN.24.22.motu: Bena ena kamelo na ranu e inu vaitani murinai, ia ese gold gadeina ta, metauna na sekele kahana, bona gold vaḡivaḡidia rua, metaudia na sekele gwauta, e vai.
GEN.24.22.english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

GEN.24.9.motu: Bena hesiai tauna ese imana na Abraham mamuna ai e atoa kau, e gwau henia hamata, unu baine kara toma eto.
GEN.24.9.english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

GEN.26.25.motu: Bena boubou patana ta unuseni ai e larebaia, bona Iehova ladana e hahanea. Unuseni ai danu e taruha, bona ena hesiai taudia ese ranu gurina e ḡeia.
GEN.26.25.english: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

GEN.5.14.motu: Kenan ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta bona gwauta: bena e mase.
GEN.5.14.english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

GEN.7.3.motu: Atai manudia idau-idau danu bavabidia, maruane hitu hitu amo, hahine hitu hitu amo, besedia na tanobada ai do bae vara lou helaoreana.
GEN.7.3.english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

GEN.34.18.motu: Hamoro bona natuna Sekem na edia hereva e kamonai, bena raruosi e moale;
GEN.34.18.english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

GEN.10.7.motu: Kusu natuna bini: Seba bona Havila bona Sabata bona Raama bona Sabateka. Raama natuna bini: Seba bona Dedan.
GEN.10.7.english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

GEN.30.4.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese ena hesiai hahinena Bilha na Iakob e henia, bena ia ese e adavaia.
GEN.30.4.english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

GEN.8.3.motu: Ranu na metaira-metaira tano amo e louva, e maraḡi e laova,
GEN.8.3.english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

GEN.36.37.motu: Samula e mase: bena Saul na sinavai isena hanuana ladana Rehoboto amo ema, gabuna e abia.
GEN.36.37.english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

GEN.24.13.motu: Ame itagu, lau binai ranu gurina badibadinai na nohomu; a hanua ulatodia na ranu utu be maimu.
GEN.24.13.english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

GEN.32.3.motu: Una negana ai Iakob ese ena hesiai taudia e siaidia guna, kakana Esau dekena baela, Seiri tanona ai: Edom ena tano bunai.
GEN.32.3.english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

GEN.32.11.motu: Na noimumu, kakagu Esau imana amo ba hamaurigu; badina be na garimu, ia na bainema, baine tuari henigu, natugu mai sinadia ida baine aladia mase.
GEN.32.11.english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

GEN.24.52.motu: Abraham ena hesiai tauna una hereva e kamonai, bena tano ai e goru diho, Iehova e imodaia.
GEN.24.52.english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

GEN.13.6.motu: Taunabunai una tano na dia heḡereḡere idia raruosi gabu tamona ai bae noho hebou, badina na edia kohu na momo bona gabu na dia bada.
GEN.13.6.english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

GEN.32.6.motu: Hesiai taudia na e lou ema, eto, Ai na kakamu Esau ida a hedavari, ia na dekemu e maimu, ena orea taudia sinahu-hani ida.
GEN.32.6.english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

GEN.36.3.motu: bona Basemata, Ismael natuna, Nebaioto taihuna.
GEN.36.3.english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

GEN.31.15.motu: Ai na idau taudia na heheto ienai, ani? Badina be davamai vada e abi bona vada e hapetapetalai.
GEN.31.15.english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

GEN.4.24.motu: Kain dainai dava bae henia hahitu e tomu;
GEN.4.24.english: If Cain will be avenged seven times,

GEN.4.4.motu: Abel danu ena mamoe serina roboadia mai digaradia e mailaidia. Bena Iehova ese Abel ena boubou ḡauna e haḡerea,
GEN.4.4.english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

GEN.19.9.motu: A idia eto. A gini siri. Ma eto, Ina tau sibona ema, bogaragidai e noho hedoamu: matona. baine hahemaoro henida e tomu. Harihari idia baia hadikadia maraḡi, a oi baia hadikamu bada. Bena idia ese Lot e doria siri, iduara bae taraia patapata eto.
GEN.19.9.english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

GEN.38.15.motu: Bena Iuda ese e itaia, banava ia na ariara hahinena eto, badina be vairana vada e ḡovaia.
GEN.38.15.english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

GEN.49.30.motu: Kohuana bunai Makapela imeana ai, Mamare kahana ai, Kanaan tanona ai; Abraham ese Efron tau Hiti ena amo e hoia, ena gara gabuna ai bainela.
GEN.49.30.english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

GEN.46.5.motu: Bena Iakob ese Bere-sieba e toretania. Israel natudia ese tamadia Iakob bona natudia maraḡidia bona adavadia e abidia, Farao ese e henidia reruedia ai e udadia, e laohaidia.
GEN.46.5.english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

GEN.29.35.motu: Ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Harihari Iehova aina imodaia. Bena ladana e hatoa Iuda. Una murinai ia na se rogorogo lou.
GEN.29.35.english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

GEN.20.12.motu: Bona ina danu, ia na momokani lau taihugu: tamamai na tamona, a sinamai be idau; bena raruosi a headava.
GEN.20.12.english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

GEN.26.21.motu: Bena guri ta ma e ḡeia, to una danu e heatulaia, taunabunai ladana e hatoa Sitina.
GEN.26.21.english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

GEN.5.18.motu: Iared ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta tauratoi-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese Enok e havaraia;
GEN.5.18.english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

GEN.46.4.motu: Lau ese baina bamomu ela bona Aigupto, ma baina hakaumu lou; bona ba mase negana ai Iosef ese matamu baine hakapua.
GEN.46.4.english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

GEN.8.1.motu: Dirava ese Noa e laloa tao, bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai bona boromakau ia ida lagatoi ai e gui danu e lalodia tao. Bena Dirava ese lai ta e siaia tanobada ai; bena ranu na e kororo.
GEN.8.1.english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

GEN.41.31.motu: Taunimanima ese madinamo negana na basie laloa une, doe bada lalonai bae dabu vaitani dainai.
GEN.41.31.english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

GEN.26.32.motu: Una dina ai Isaak ena hesiai taudia ia dekena ela, guri e geia herevana e hamaorolaia, eto, Ranu vada a davaria.
GEN.26.32.english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

GEN.19.16.motu: E halahe, bena raruosi ese ia imana bona adavana imana bona natuna ulatodia raruosi imadia e abi, hanua murimurinai e hakaudia lasi; badina be Iehova ese e bogaia hisi.
GEN.19.16.english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

GEN.35.4.motu: Bena idia ese edia dirava idaudia bona taiadia gadeidia na Iakob e henia. Iakob ese e abidia, au helaḡana Sekem ai henunai e guridia.
GEN.35.4.english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

GEN.44.31.motu: ia baine itamai mero na lasihia negana ai ia na baine mase; oibe tamamai tau-buruka na mase gabuna bainela mai lalo-hisihisina ida.
GEN.44.31.english: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

GEN.41.11.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai raruosi a nihi, ta ta ena nihi ena nihi na mai anidia.
GEN.41.11.english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

GEN.31.42.motu: Tamagu ena Dirava, Abraham ena Dirava, Isaak ese e gari heniamu Diravana, basinema bamogu, oi na harihari ima-kavakava boma lulugu. A Dirava ese egu hekwarahi vada e itaia bona imagu ḡaukaradia vada e nene, bena boi hanuaboi e gwaumu tubu.
GEN.31.42.english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

GEN.5.29.motu: ladana e hatoa Noa. Ia eto, Iehova ese vada e hadikaia tanona amo ina mero ese baine harohoda mauri, imada ḡaukaradia bona eda hekwarahi amo baita laḡa ani.
GEN.5.29.english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

GEN.33.15.motu: Bena Esau eto, Benaini, egu orea taudia haida bavabidia, bae bamomu. A Iakob eto, Una na herevana; egu lohia lalomu vada e namo egu ai vada davana.
GEN.33.15.english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.”

GEN.21.23.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ladana ai ba gwau henigu hamata, oi na basio koigu, bona natugu bona tubugu basio koidia; a lau ese vada na kara namo henimu heḡereḡerena oi danu lau ba kara namo henigu bona ina o noholaiamu tanona danu ba kara namo henia.
GEN.21.23.english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

GEN.21.13.motu: A hesiai hahinena natuna danu bese badana ai baina halaoa, badina be ia na oi natumu.
GEN.21.13.english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

GEN.40.6.motu: Daba ai, Iosef na e raka vareai, idia raruosi dekediai, bena toadia e ita, lalodia e hisihisiva.
GEN.40.6.english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

GEN.10.2.motu: Iafet natuna bini: Gomere bona Magog bona Madai bona Iavan bona Tubal bona Mesek bona Tira.
GEN.10.2.english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

GEN.18.18.motu: Badina be Abraham na bese badana bona goadana ai bainela, bona tanobada besedia iboudiai na ia dainai hahenamo bae abia.
GEN.18.18.english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

GEN.32.26.motu: Bena hari tau eto, A kahugu nege, badina be daba vada e kinia. A Iakob eto, Lau na basina kahumu nege ela bona oi ese ba hanamogu.
GEN.32.26.english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.”

GEN.41.44.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Lau binai Farao; oi basio hereva negana ai tau ta ese kara ta basine karaia ina Aigupto tanona idoinai.
GEN.41.44.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

GEN.19.18.motu: Bena Lot ese e noidia, eto, Egu lohia e, dia unuheto.
GEN.19.18.english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

GEN.29.18.motu: Iakob ese Rahela e ura henia; taunabunai ia eto, Laḡani hitu isiaimu baina lao heni, natumu hane-muritai Rahela iabina totona.
GEN.29.18.english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

GEN.30.42.motu: A manokadia e rogorogova negadia ai, hari rigi se hagini vairadiai. Taunabunai, nani bona mamoe manokadia na Laban ena seri ai, a goadadia na Iakob ena seri ai.
GEN.30.42.english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

GEN.18.30.motu: Ma eto, Ḡaubada e, baina noinoi lou basio badu ani? Toi-ahui bema noho ede bema heto? Iehova eto, Toi-ahui baina davaridia, basina habuaia tari.
GEN.18.30.english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?”

GEN.48.2.motu: Bena haida ese Iakob e hamaoroa, eto, Natumu Iosef na oi i'itamu e maimu. Bena Israel na e haheauka, ena mahuta patana ai e helai tore.
GEN.48.2.english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

GEN.38.7.motu: A hari Ere, Iuda natuna roboana, na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, bena Iehova ese e alaia mase.
GEN.38.7.english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.

GEN.1.18.motu: dina bona hanuaboi bae lohiadia bona diari bona dibura bae hididia totona. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
GEN.1.18.english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

GEN.44.2.motu: Bona egu kehere, hari silver ḡauna, taumuritai ena puse uduna ai ba udaia, bona ena uit ihoilaina monina danu. Bena ia ese Iosef ena hereva heḡereḡerena e karaia.
GEN.44.2.english: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

GEN.27.7.motu: ia eto “Dia ta ba mailaia, vamu namona ba nadua lauagu; baina ania, bena do basina mase ai Iehova vairanai baina hanamomu guna”.
GEN.27.7.english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’

GEN.36.18.motu: Esau adavana Oholibama natuna bini: Ieusu bona Ialam bona Kora. Ini na hanua lohiadia, Esau adavana Oholibama, Ana natuna, ese e abidia.
GEN.36.18.english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

GEN.32.2.motu: Iakob ese e itadia, bena eto, Ina na Dirava ena tuari oreana: taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoa Mahanaim.
GEN.32.2.english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

GEN.18.11.motu: Una negana ai Abraham bona Sara vada e buruka herea, bona Sara ena nega vada e hanaia.
GEN.18.11.english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

GEN.16.11.motu: Iehova ena aneru ma e hamaoroa lou, eto, Benaini, vada o rogorogomu; mero ta bavabia, ladana ba hatoa Ismael, badina be Iehova ese emu tai vada e kamonai.
GEN.16.11.english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

GEN.25.24.motu: Ena mara negana e gini dae, bena memero rarua e vara hekapa.
GEN.25.24.english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

GEN.45.4.motu: Bena Iosef ese tadikakana ma e hamaorodia, eto, Mani a raka kahi mai. Bena idia na e raka henia kahi. Ia ma eto, Lau binai tadimu Iosef, vada o hoigu, bena Aigupto nama.
GEN.45.4.english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.”

GEN.18.10.motu: Bena idia ta eto, Laḡani vairai do baina lou henimu, bena adavamu Sara baine mara, mero ta baine abia. Sara na dabua kalagana iduarana murinai gini, bena ia ese una hereva e kamonai.
GEN.18.10.english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.”

GEN.10.20.motu: Ini iboudiai, mai edia iduhu idau-idau bona edia gado idau-idau bona edia tano idau-idau bona edia bese idau-idau na Ham ena amo e vara.
GEN.10.20.english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

GEN.34.3.motu: To ia ese Iakob natuna Daina e ura henia lalodika, mai lalona idoinai, bena ia lalona ihamarumaruna herevadia e gwaurai heniava.
GEN.34.3.english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

GEN.42.30.motu: Una tano lohiana ese e daḡedaḡe henimai, dibura rumana ai e koumai, eto ai na hasinadoa taumai.
GEN.42.30.english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

GEN.32.28.motu: Hari tau ma eto, Harihari ela oi ladamu na dia Iakob; oi ladamu na Israel, badina be Dirava ida vada o goada helulu bona taunimanima ida danu, bona vada o kwalimu.
GEN.32.28.english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

GEN.26.13.motu: Ia na taḡa tauna ai ela, ena taḡa danu e bada e laova;
GEN.26.13.english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

GEN.36.29.motu: Hori lohiadia bini: Lotan bona Sobal bona Sibeon bona Ana
GEN.36.29.english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

GEN.22.14.motu: Bena Abraham ese una gabu ladana e hatoa Iehova-ire; bena unu e gwauraia toma ema bonaharihari e tomu, Ororo dorina ai Iehova ese baine haḡeregu.
GEN.22.14.english: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

GEN.40.9.motu: Bena vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna ese ena nihi Iosef e hahedinarai henia, eto, Egu nihi ai vine auna ta na itaia;
GEN.40.9.english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

GEN.13.8.motu: Bena Abram ese Lot e hamaoroa, eto, Mani ita raruosi basita heai, eda boromakau ireḡudia taudia danu basie heai, badina be ita na varavara.
GEN.13.8.english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

GEN.21.27.motu: Bena Abraham ese mamoe bona boromakau e abidia, Abimelek e henia; bena idia raruosi e herohemaino.
GEN.21.27.english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

GEN.26.14.motu: ena mamoe bona ena boromakau na hutuma herea, ena hesiai taudia danu hoho. Bena Filistia taudia ese e vaḡeḡe henia.
GEN.26.14.english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

GEN.30.29.motu: Iakob ese e haere henia, eto, Ede na hekwarahi tomava emu hesiai ilao-henina ai vada o itaia; dibamu danu emu seri vada e hutuma lau imagu ai.
GEN.30.29.english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

GEN.24.32.motu: Bena una hesiai tauna na ruma ai e raka vareai. A Laban ese kamelo edia maduna e ruha, bena uit momona bona rei kakoro e henidia; bona hesiai tauna ranu e henia, ia mai bamona ida aedia bae huri.
GEN.24.32.english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

GEN.30.3.motu: Hahine na eto, Egu hesiai hahinena Bilha binai: ia dekenai ba raka vareai; bena lau tuigu ai baine mara, iena amo natugu baina abia.
GEN.30.3.english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

GEN.25.9.motu: Bena ia natuna raruosi, Isaak bona Ismael, ese e abia, Makapela kohuana ai e guria: una kohua na Mamare kahana ai, Efron Sohara, Hiti tauna, ena tano ai.
GEN.25.9.english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

GEN.36.14.motu: Esau adavana Oholibama, Ana natuna, Sibeon tubuna, natuna bini: Ieusu bona Ialam bona Kora.
GEN.36.14.english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

GEN.40.15.motu: Badina be momokani lau na Heberu taudia edia tano ai e abigu mauri; iniseni ai danu kerere ta asina karaia, a dibura rumana ai e kougu kava.
GEN.40.15.english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

GEN.4.1.motu: Adam na adavana Heva ida e eno bou: bena Heva e rogorogo, e mara, Kain e abia; eto, Tau ta Iehova ena amo vada name abia.
GEN.4.1.english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”

GEN.41.32.motu: Farao na harua e nihi, badina be Dirava ese ina ḡau vada e gwauraia, bona asi vanahana ia ese baine havaraia.
GEN.41.32.english: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

GEN.31.46.motu: Iakob ese danu ena orea taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Nadi a gogo. Unu e kara toma, bena una nadi senuna latanai e aniani hebou.
GEN.31.46.english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

GEN.49.8.motu: Iuda e, tadikakamu ese bae imodaimu,

GEN.12.13.motu: Benaini, baoto oi na lau taihugu, bena oi daimu ai baina namo bona baina mauri danu.
GEN.12.13.english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

GEN.10.22.motu: Sem natuna bini: Elam bona Asuru bona Afasad bona Lud bona Aram.
GEN.10.22.english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

GEN.18.22.motu: Bena hari raruosi na e raka oho, Sodoma dalana ai ela; a Abraham na dounu Iehova vairanai gini.
GEN.18.22.english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

GEN.6.19.motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai idau-idau rua amo lagatoi ai ba hakaudia vareai, idia danu bae mauri; maruane ta, hahine ta, unu bavabidia toma.
GEN.6.19.english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

GEN.18.24.motu: Bema kara maoromaoro taudia imahui nonoho una hanua ai, ba habuaia tari a? Basio bogaia hisi, unu kara maoromaoro taudia imahui daidiai a?
GEN.18.24.english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

GEN.44.20.motu: Bena a haere henimu, ato “Tamamai burukana e nohomu, bona mero ta, tau-badana ai e abia; una mero kakana vada emase, sinana natuna tamona mo na ia, una dainai tamamai ese e lalokau henia badamu”.
GEN.44.20.english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

GEN.26.20.motu: Bena Gerara seridia ireḡudia taudia na Isaak ena seri ireḡudia taudia ida e heatu, eto, Ina na ai emai ranu. Taunabunai, ia ese una ranu gabuna ladana e hatoa Esek, badina be e heatulaia,
GEN.26.20.english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

GEN.15.21.motu: Amoro taudia edia tano, Kanaan taudia edia tano, Girigasa taudia edia tano, bona Iebusu taudia edia tano.
GEN.15.21.english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

GEN.18.29.motu: Ia na ma eto, Readia hari-ahui nonoho dahaka. Iehova eto, Hari-ahui daidiai baina bogaia hisi.
GEN.18.29.english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?”

GEN.4.14.motu: A laloa, oi ese hari dina ai tanobada kopina amo vada o lulugu oho, vairamu danu egu amo vada o hunia. Lau na heau bona loa kava taugu ai bainala tanobada ai; taunabunai, baine davarigu tauna ese baine alagu mase.
GEN.4.14.english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

GEN.31.2.motu: Iakob danu e itaia. Laban vairana e huaia ienai.
GEN.31.2.english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

GEN.36.26.motu: Dison natuna na Hemudan bona Eseban bona Itiran bona Keran.
GEN.36.26.english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

GEN.1.5.motu: Dirava ese diari ladana e hatoa Dina; dibura ladana e hatoa Boi. Ado e rahi daba e rere, dina gini-gunana.
GEN.1.5.english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

GEN.37.3.motu: Israel ese hari Iosef e lalokau henia bada, natuna orena e lalokau henidia maraḡi; badina be burukana ai e havaraia. Bena ia ese hahedoki namohereana ta e henia.
GEN.37.3.english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

GEN.46.22.motu: Ini iboudiai be Rahela natuna bona tubuna, Iakob ese iena amo e abidia. Iboudiai be gwauta-hani.
GEN.46.22.english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

GEN.47.31.motu: Bena Iakob eto, A gwau hamata. Bena Iosef ese e gwau henia hamata. Bena Israel na ena mahuta patana duna badina ai e ḡuriḡuri.
GEN.47.31.english: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

GEN.22.16.motu: eto, Iehova na e tomu: sibogu ladagu ai vada na gwau hamata, ini vada o kara toma dainai, natumu vara-edeana, o lalokau heniamu merona, egu ai so rua dainai,
GEN.22.16.english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

GEN.48.22.motu: Oi ahumu danu name henimu, tadikakamu iboudiai ahudia e hereadiamu: Sekem bunai, Amoro taudia edia amo na abia, egu dare bona egu peva goadadia ai.
GEN.48.22.english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

GEN.42.25.motu: Bena Iosef e hahedua, edia puse na uit amo bae hahonu, bona ta ta edia moni edia puse ai bae uda lou, bona dala lakwana danu bae henidia. Bena unu e kara toma.
GEN.42.25.english: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

GEN.24.19.motu: Ma eto, Ranu ma aina utu, emu kamelo baina ha-inulaidia.
GEN.24.19.english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

GEN.28.11.motu: Bena gabu ta ai e kau, unuseni ai baine noho rani eto, badina be dina vada e diho. Bena una gabu nadidia ta e abia, ena ikwina; bena e hekure diho, e mahuta.
GEN.28.11.english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

GEN.47.9.motu: Iakob e haere, eto, Egu laolao laḡanidia ina tanobada ai na sinahuta toi-ahui; egu mauri laḡanidia na dia hoho bona mai hisihisidia, dia tamagu bona tubugu heḡereḡeredia, idia edia laolao laḡanidia tanobada ai na hoho.
GEN.47.9.english: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

GEN.35.7.motu: Unuseni ai ia ese boubou patana ta e larebaia, ladana e hatoa El-betele; badina be una gabu ai Dirava ese e hahedinarai henia, ia ese kakana e heautania negana ai.
GEN.35.7.english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

GEN.41.45.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef ladana e hatoa Safenat-panea; Asenat danu e henia, baine adavaia; una Asenat na Ono ena hahelaḡa tauna, ladana Potifera, natuna. Bena Iosef na Aigupto tanona idoinai e rakaia hanai.
GEN.41.45.english: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

GEN.19.24.motu: Bena Iehova ese nadi siahudia bona lahi na guba amo e hadiho, Sodoma bona Gomora latadiai.
GEN.19.24.english: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

GEN.34.9.motu: Beseda bae hatamona: umui ese natumui ulatodia ba henimai, emai ai bae headava; ai danu natumai ulatodia baia henimui, emui ai bae headava.
GEN.34.9.english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

GEN.21.2.motu: Bena Sara e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia Abraham ena, edia ḡauka negana ai, Dirava ese e gwauraia guna heḡereḡerena.
GEN.21.2.english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

GEN.22.23.motu: Hari Betuel na Rebeka tamana. Taurahaniosi bini Abraham tadina Nahoro, adavana Milka ida, natudia.
GEN.22.23.english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

GEN.25.19.english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

GEN.4.20.motu: Ada e mara, Iabal e abia: ia na dabua kalagadia ai e nohomu bona boromakau e reḡudiamu taudia senedia.
GEN.4.20.english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

GEN.30.33.motu: Nega gabedia ai vada ba dibagu, maoro eiava kerere: egu seri ai nani haida asi toutoudia asi revarevadia eiava mamoe kurokurodia ba davaridia, henao taugu ba gwauraigu.
GEN.30.33.english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

GEN.5.17.motu: Mahalalel ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani taurahani-ta-ahui ima: bena e mase.
GEN.5.17.english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

GEN.9.10.motu: mauri ḡaudia iboudiai danu umui ida nonoho na henidiamu, manu bona bokomakau bona tanobada boromadia iboudiai na henidiamu, lagatoi amo e raka lasi ḡaudia iboudiai.
GEN.9.10.english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

GEN.44.30.motu: Taunabunai, emu hesiai tauna lau tamagu dekena bama lou lao, a mero basinama hakaua lao, bena ia bona hari mero na e kara mauri tamona na heto dainai
GEN.44.30.english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

GEN.36.5.motu: bona Oholibama ese memero tatoi e abidia, ladadia na Ieusu bona Ialam bona Kora: Esau natuna bunu, Kanaan tanona ai e vara.
GEN.36.5.english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

GEN.39.3.motu: Bena biaguna ese e itaia, Iehova ese e bamoava bona ena kara iboudiai anidia e havara;
GEN.39.3.english: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.

GEN.41.22.motu: Bena egu nihi ta ai, uit tuhutuhuna tamona na itaia, e tubu mai anina hitu, babada bona nanamo;
GEN.41.22.english: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

GEN.24.28.motu: Bena hane-ulato na e heau ela, unu ḡau haridia na sinana ena rumataudia e hamaorolaidia.
GEN.24.28.english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

GEN.36.32.motu: Bela Beoro na Edom pavapavana, ena hanua badana ladana na Dinihaba.
GEN.36.32.english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

GEN.42.13.motu: Idia ma eto, Ai na oi isiaimu ilao-henina taumai, tadikaka gwauta-rarua, tau tamona natuna Kanaan ai; a tau-muritai be harihari tamamai dekenai, bona ta be vada e mase.
GEN.42.13.english: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

GEN.26.6.motu: Taunabunai Isaak be Gerara ai e nohova.

GEN.2.1.motu: Unuhetomana guba bona tanobada mai anidia vada e kara ḡuḡuru.
GEN.2.1.english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

GEN.5.25.motu: Metusela ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui hitu negana ai, ia ese Lamek e havaraia;
GEN.5.25.english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

GEN.48.20.motu: Taunabunai ia ese e hanamodia una dina ai, eto,
GEN.48.20.english: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

GEN.15.19.motu: Kene taudia edia tano, Kenisi taudia edia tano, Kadamono taudia edia tano,
GEN.15.19.english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

GEN.32.23.motu: Ia ese e abidia, e siaidia hanai, ena kohu idoinai danu e hanailai.
GEN.32.23.english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

GEN.19.35.motu: Bena una hanuaboi danu idia ese tamadia e hakekeroa; bena hane muritai na ia ida e eno bou; a ia be ena hekure negana bona ena tore isi negana asi dibana.
GEN.19.35.english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

GEN.12.4.motu: Bena Abram na vada ela, Iehova ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena; Lot danu ia ida ela.
GEN.12.4.english: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

GEN.5.11.motu: Enos ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta dikoana ima: bena e mase.
GEN.5.11.english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

GEN.43.28.motu: Idia na e haere, eto, Emu hesiai tauna ai tamamai be namo, dounu e mauri nohomu. Bena idia na e igo diho, e hanamoa.
GEN.43.28.english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

GEN.31.47.motu: Bena Laban ese una gabu ladana e hatoa legara-sahaduta; a Iakob ese ladana e hatoa Galeed.
GEN.31.47.english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

GEN.24.64.motu: Rebeka danu e roha isi, Isaak e itaia; bena ena kamelo amo e diho,
GEN.24.64.english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

GEN.40.12.motu: Bena Iosef eto, Emu nihi anina binai: vine rigi toiosi be dina toi.
GEN.40.12.english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

GEN.48.5.motu: Harihari oi natumu raruosi, oi dekemu do asinama negana ai ina Aigupto ai e vara memerodia na lau natugu ai baela; Ruben bona Simeon na lau natugu heḡereḡerena, idia danu lau natugu ai baela.
GEN.48.5.english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

GEN.50.25.motu: Bena Iosef ese Israel natudia e haḡanidia, bae gwau hamata. Ia eto, Dirava ese ena gwau-hamata baine hamomokania; una negana ai lau turiagu na ini amo ba laohaidia.
GEN.50.25.english: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

GEN.15.16.motu: A idia be uru ihahanina ai ina tano bae lou henia, badina be Amoro taudia ese edia kara havara do asie haḡuḡuru.
GEN.15.16.english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

GEN.25.14.motu: bona Misima bona Duma bona Masa

GEN.7.16.motu: maruane hahine ida e gui kau, Dirava ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. Bena Iehova ese lagatoi ai e koudia ahu.
GEN.7.16.english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

GEN.33.13.motu: A Iakob eto, Egu lohia dibana natugu na mamaraḡi; egu mamoe hahinedia bona egu boromakau hahinedia haida na mai bogadia, bena dina tamona mo bae luludia haraḡa-haraḡa vada bae mase ore.
GEN.33.13.english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

GEN.13.13.motu: A Sodoma taudia na didika, Iehova vairanai e kara havara.
GEN.13.13.english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

GEN.38.21.motu: Bena ia ese una gabu taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Hari ariara hahinena dala katakata ai e helaiva be edeseni ai? Idia eto, Ariara hahinena ta lasi iniseni ai.
GEN.38.21.english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?”

GEN.35.28.motu: Hari Isaak ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui.
GEN.35.28.english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

GEN.7.12.motu: Una medu na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui e dihova.
GEN.7.12.english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

GEN.42.32.motu: ai na tadikaka gwauta-rarua, tau tamona natuna, a ta vada e mase, bona taumuritai be tamamai dekenai, Kanaan tanona ai.”
GEN.42.32.english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

GEN.3.19.motu: Vairamu varahuna ai bavaniani ela bona tano ba lou henia, badina be tano amo oma. Oi na tano ḡahuna: tano ḡahuna danu do ba lou henia.
GEN.3.19.english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground,

GEN.44.7.motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Dahaka dainai ḡaubada na unu e gwau tomamu? Emu hesiai taudia na unu asia kara toma.
GEN.44.7.english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

GEN.43.32.motu: Bena aniani e dabaraia, pata ta ai Iosef ana, pata ta ai idia adia, bona ma pata ta ai Aigupto taudia adia. Badina be Aigupto taudia na Heberu taudia ida basie aniani hebou, mai edia taravatu dainai.
GEN.43.32.english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

GEN.12.16.motu: Bena Farao ese Abram e kara namo henia, hahine dainai: mamoe bona boromakau bona doniki bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia bona kamelo e henia momomomo.
GEN.12.16.english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

GEN.30.28.motu: Davamu a gwauraia, bena baina henimu.
GEN.30.28.english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

GEN.27.28.motu: Taunabunai guba hununa Dirava ese baine henimu,
GEN.27.28.english: God give you of the dew of the sky,

GEN.6.5.motu: Iehova ese taunimanima edia kara havara e itaia, vada e bada herea tanobada ai, edia lalo-hadai iboudiai danu didika.
GEN.6.5.english: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

GEN.43.21.motu: to emai taruha gabuna ai a kau, emai puse a keho, bena emai moni a ita, ta ta ena puse ena puse ai e heuda, emai moni idoinai; harihari vada a mailai, baia heni lou a tomu.
GEN.43.21.english: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

GEN.45.27.motu: A idia ese Iosef ena hereva iboudiai e hamaorolaia; bena Iakob ese Iosef e siai reruedia e itadia ai, ia laumana ma e mauri lou.
GEN.45.27.english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

GEN.38.3.motu: Una hahine e mara, mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Ere;
GEN.38.3.english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

GEN.12.19.motu: Edeheto o koigu, oto ia na oi taihumu; bena na adavaia? Vadaeni, adavamu binai: bavabia, ba raka oho.
GEN.12.19.english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

GEN.38.24.motu: Hua toi vada ela, bena Iuda ese harina e kamonai ia ravana Tamara na mai bogana. Bena ia eto, A hakaua lasi, lahi ai do baine mase.
GEN.38.24.english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.”

GEN.4.19.motu: Lamek e hodara: adavana ta ladana na Ada, ma ta ladana na Sila.
GEN.4.19.english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

GEN.48.15.motu: Bena ia ese Iosef e hanamoa, eto,

GEN.40.21.motu: Bena vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna ena dagi e henia lou; ia ese kehere Farao imana ai ma e atoa.
GEN.40.21.english: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

GEN.13.18.motu: Bena Abram na ena dabua kalagana e lokua, e tore isi, ela, Heberon ai e taruha, Mamare ena au helaḡadia badidiai. Unuseni ai ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena.
GEN.13.18.english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

GEN.38.16.motu: Bena ia ese e hereva henia, eto, Mani aita eno bou. Ia na asi dibana hahine na ia ravana. Bena hahine na eto, Davagu be dahaka ba henigu?
GEN.38.16.english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law.

GEN.42.7.motu: Iosef ese kakana e itadia negana ai, ia lalona vada e parara idia be daidia, to e hereva henidia idau tauna na heto, e gwau henidia, eto, Umui be ede amo oma? Idia eto, Kanaan tanona amo ama, aniani ihoina totona.
GEN.42.7.english: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?”

GEN.12.12.motu: lau na tomamu Aigupto taudia bae itamu negana ai, idia baeto “Ina na ia adavana”, bena lau bae alagu mase bona oi bae abimu mauri.
GEN.12.12.english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

GEN.18.19.motu: Badina be vada na abia hidi, ia ese natuna bona garana do baine reḡudia, idia na Iehova ena dala ai bae raka, bona kara namodia bona maoromaorodia bae kara, Iehova ese ena gwauhamata Abraham enai baine hamomokania helaoreana.
GEN.18.19.english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

GEN.8.11.motu: Adorahi ai pune na e lou ela dekenai, uduna ai be olive rauna ta, ia ese vada e koria utu ḡauna; bena Noa vada e diba ranu na tanobada ai vada e maraḡi.
GEN.8.11.english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

GEN.22.9.motu: Raruosi na Dirava ese e gwauraia gabuna ai e kau: unuseni ai Abraham ese boubou patana e larebaia, au pata latanai e lakwaia; bena natuna Isaak e hiria, boubou patana ai e atoa kau, au latadiai.
GEN.22.9.english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

GEN.34.4.motu: Bena Sekem ese tamana Hamoro e hamaoroa, eto, Ina hane-ulato bavabia, baina adavaia.
GEN.34.4.english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

GEN.7.24.motu: Ranu ese tanobada e habubunia ela bona dina sinahu-ta imahui.
GEN.7.24.english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

GEN.6.20.motu: Manu idau-idau, boromakau idau-idau, tano ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau, rua rua amo bae vasi, vada bae mauri.
GEN.6.20.english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

GEN.45.5.motu: Lalomui basie hisihisi, bona basio hebadu heheni, o hoigu bona ini nama dainai; badina be Dirava ese e siaigu baina gunalaimui, ihamaurimui totona.
GEN.45.5.english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

GEN.1.17.motu: Dirava ese guba ai e atodia, tanobada bae hadiaria totona;
GEN.1.17.english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

GEN.32.30.motu: Bena Iakob ese una gabu ladana e hatoa Peniel; eto, Dirava vada na itaia, raruosi vada ame hegaga heheni, to vada na maurimu.
GEN.32.30.english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

GEN.5.22.motu: Metusela e vara murinai Enok na Dirava ida e hebamo heheniva ela bona laḡani sinahu-toi e ore; natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu e havaradia.
GEN.5.22.english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

GEN.40.23.motu: A hari vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna ese Iosef se laloa tao; e laloa boio.
GEN.40.23.english: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

GEN.43.1.motu: Tano idoinai hitolo na bada herea.
GEN.43.1.english: The famine was severe in the land.

GEN.14.24.motu: Egu memero adia aniani mo ba henigu; a kohu be e bamogu taudia tatoiosi, Anere bona Eksol bona Mamare, ahudia ba henidia, vadaeni.
GEN.14.24.english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

GEN.40.20.motu: Dina ihatoina be Farao ena vara dinana, bena ia ese aria ta e karaia, ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e vavedia; hari vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna bona flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna danu e vavedia.
GEN.40.20.english: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

GEN.30.18.motu: Bena Lea eto, Egu hesiai hahinena na adavagu na henia davana binai, Dirava ese vada e henigu. Bena natuna ladana e hatoa Isakara.
GEN.30.18.english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

GEN.47.20.motu: Taunabunai, Iosef ese Aigupto tanodia iboudiai e abi, Farao ena; badina be Aigupto taudia iboudiai ta ta ena tano ena tano e hoi, aniani davana, edia hitolo na bada dainai. Unuhetomana tano idoinai na Farao ena tano ai ela.
GEN.47.20.english: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

GEN.17.5.motu: Ladamu danu basie hatoa lou “Abram”, a ladamu bae hatoa “Abraham”, badina be bese diaḡau ihavaradia tauna ai vada na halaomu.
GEN.17.5.english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

GEN.24.23.motu: E nanadaia, eto, Oi be daika natuna? Tamamu ena ruma na mai gabuna, ai baia noho, eiava?
GEN.24.23.english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

GEN.44.11.motu: Bena ta ta ena puse ena puse e abi dobi haraḡa, e ruha.
GEN.44.11.english: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

GEN.4.23.motu: Bena Lamek ese adavana raruosi e hereva henidia, eto,

GEN.46.21.motu: Beniamina natuna bini: Bela bona Bekere bona Asbel bona Gera bona Naaman bona Ehi bona Ros bona Mupim bona Hupim bona Arad.
GEN.46.21.english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

GEN.27.25.motu: Bena Isaak eto, Mani a mailaia dekegu ai, natugu emu vamu baina ania, bena baina hanamomu. Taunabunai, ia ese e mailaia, bena e ania; vine ranuna danu e mailaia, bena e inua.
GEN.27.25.english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.”

GEN.45.22.motu: Ta ta edia hahedoki toi toi danu e henidia, a Beniamina na silver monidia sinahu-toi e henia bona hahedoki ima.
GEN.45.22.english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

GEN.30.9.motu: Lea vada e diba ia na basine rogorogo; bena ia ese ena hesiai hahinena Silpa e abia, Iakob e henia, baine adavaia.
GEN.30.9.english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

GEN.15.6.motu: Bena Abram ese Iehova e abidadama henia; una dainai maorona e gwauraia.
GEN.15.6.english: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

GEN.16.13.motu: Bena hahine ese Iehova, e hereva henia Diravana, ladana e hahanea, eto, Vada o ha=eregumu Diravamu! Badina be ia eto, Tano ḡaḡaena ai vada na mata hanai, e hahedinarai henigu Diravana vada na itaia.
GEN.16.13.english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

GEN.24.26.motu: Bena hari hesiai tauna e igo diho, Iehova e imodaia,
GEN.24.26.english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

GEN.34.8.motu: A Hamoro ese e hamaorodia, eto, Natugu Sekem ese oi natumu e ura henia lalodikamu; mani emu kara ba henia, baine adavaia.
GEN.34.8.english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

GEN.44.22.motu: Bena ai ese a haere henimu, ato “Tamana na basine kahua nege; badina be ia bema raka oho, tamana bema mase”.
GEN.44.22.english: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

GEN.27.14.motu: Bena ia ese eha abidia, sinana dekena e mailai. Bena sinana ese vamu namona e nadua, tamana ese e ura henia ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
GEN.27.14.english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

GEN.34.11.motu: Sekem ese danu hane-ulato tamana bona taihuna e hereva henidia, eto, Egu noinoi boma abia dae, hane-ulato davana boma gwauraia, bena bama henimui.
GEN.34.11.english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

GEN.10.32.motu: Noa natuna garadia bini, edia uru ai bona edia bese ai: idia edia amo tanobada besedia iboudiai e vara, utu-utu badana murinai.
GEN.10.32.english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.

GEN.42.2.motu: Ma eto, Vada na kamonaimu Aigupto be mai uitina; baola, unuseni ai ita ada ba hoia, baita mauri helaoreana; bena basita mase.
GEN.42.2.english: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

GEN.45.8.motu: Taunabunai dia umui, a Dirava ese e siaigu iniseni ai. Ia ese vada e karagu lau be Farao tamana na heto, ena ruma idoinai biaguna ai bona Aigupto tanona idoinai lohiana ai vada e halaogu.
GEN.45.8.english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

GEN.39.9.motu: Tau ta se hereagumu ina ruma ai; egu ai ḡau ta se ruamu, oi mo e rumumu, badina be oi na ia adavana. Ina kerere badana baina karaia, Dirava vairanai baina kara havara, be edeheto?
GEN.39.9.english: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

GEN.42.8.motu: Iosef be kakana dibana, to idia asi dibadia ia.
GEN.42.8.english: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

GEN.11.7.motu: Aina diho, edia gado baina ha-idaua, bena edia hereva na basie hediba heheni.
GEN.11.7.english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

GEN.30.39.motu: unu rigi vairadiai; una dainai natudia e havaradia, kopidia na mai revarevadia.
GEN.30.39.english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

GEN.32.7.motu: Bena Iakob na e gari dikadika, kudouna e hetaha. Bena ena orea taudia bona ena mamoe, ena nani, ena boromakau, ena kamelo danu, orea rua ai e hididia.
GEN.32.7.english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

GEN.34.20.motu: Bena Hamoro, natuna Sekem ida, edia hanua ikoukouna ela, edia hanua taudia e hereva henidia, eto,
GEN.34.20.english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

GEN.45.9.motu: Benaini, vada aola haraḡa-haraḡa tamagu dekenai, ba hamaoroa, baota “Natumu Iosef e tomu: Dirava ese Aigupto tanona idoinai lohiana ai vada e halaogu; lau dekegu baoma, basio halahe.
GEN.45.9.english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

GEN.32.17.motu: Bena baine raka guna tauna e haduaia, eto, Kakagu Esau ida ba hedavari negana ai, ia baine henanadai, baineto “Oi na daika ena hesiai tauna? Ede bo laomu? Ina seri be daika ena?”
GEN.32.17.english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

GEN.23.1.motu: Sara ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-ta ruahui hitu.
GEN.23.1.english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

GEN.19.10.motu: To unu raruosi na ruma lalona amo imadia e toi roro, Lot e veria vareai, bena iduara e koua ahu.
GEN.19.10.english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

GEN.26.11.motu: Bena Abimelek ese ena hanua taudia taravadia e atu, eto, Isaak enai baine dau kau eiava adavana enai baine dau kau tauna na baine mase.
GEN.26.11.english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

GEN.17.7.motu: Taravamu na atuamu be lau ese baina badinaia ita raruosi eda, bona garamu murimu ai bae vara edia, ela bona uru iboudiai, baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna: emu Dirava ai bona murimu ai bae vara garamu edia Dirava ai do bainala.
GEN.17.7.english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

GEN.31.35.motu: Bena hahine ese tamanae hereva henia, eto, Ḡauka, basio badu; vairamu ai asina tore isi, badina be vaia hahine emai kara e goreregumu. Taunabunai e hetahu mase, to ena dirava laulaudia se davaridia.
GEN.31.35.english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

GEN.34.25.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, taudia hisidia e dai lasi, bena Iakob natuna rarua, Simeon bona Levi, hari Daina taihuna, ese edia dare e abi, hanua ai e raka vareai, bena mamaruanedia ibouboudiai e aladia mase;
GEN.34.25.english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

GEN.8.13.motu: Laḡani sinahu-tauratoi dikoana ta, hua gini-gunana ena dina gini-gunana ai, ranu na e kororo vaitani tanobada ai. Bena Noa ese lagatoi e kehoa, tanobada kopina e itaia, vada e kaukau.
GEN.8.13.english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

GEN.21.3.motu: Bena Abraham ese natuna, Sara e abia merona, ladana e hatoa Isaak.
GEN.21.3.english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

GEN.17.8.motu: Oi ese o noholaia hedoa-hedoamu tanona na oi bona murimu ai bae vara garamu danu baina henimui, Kanaan tanona idoinai na umui emui ela bona hanaihanai: lau na emui Dirava ai bainala.
GEN.17.8.english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

GEN.4.12.motu: Harihari ela, ba biru negadia ai na tano ese anina basine henimu. A oi na heau bona loa kava tauna ai do baola tanobada ai.
GEN.4.12.english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”

GEN.25.4.motu: Midian ese Efa bona Efere bona Hanok bona Abida bona Eldaha e havaradia. Ini iboudiai na Ketura garana.
GEN.25.4.english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

GEN.41.7.motu: Bena hari uit anidia dikadia ese uit anidia namodia e anidia ore. Bena Farao na e noga, vada e diba nihi mo.
GEN.41.7.english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

GEN.25.21.motu: Isaak ese Iehova e noia, adavana dainai, badina ia na gabani. Iehova ese ena noinoi e kamonaia; bena Rebeka e rogorogo.
GEN.25.21.english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

GEN.35.14.motu: Bena Iakob ese nadi ta e haginia, pupuna ai e halaoa, Dirava ida e hereva gabuna ai, vine ranuna na latanai e seia, ena boubou, bona dehoro danu latanai e seia.
GEN.35.14.english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

GEN.2.24.motu: Badina bunai tau ese tamana sinana baine rakatanidia, adavana baine badinaia, raruosi na anidia tamona ai baela.
GEN.2.24.english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

GEN.6.16.motu: Gaba-maurana ba karaia, ena dobu roha kahana mo; iduara danu ba karaia ohena ai, ere danu bae toi, ta henu ai, ma ta ia daenai, ma ihatoina danu iharuana daenai.
GEN.6.16.english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

GEN.22.7.motu: Bena Isaak ese tamana Abraham e hereva henia, eto, Tamagu e! Tau na e haere, eto, Natugu e, lau o ina. Mero na eto, Lahi bona au bini, a mamoe, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna, be edeseni ai?
GEN.22.7.english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?”

GEN.22.5.motu: Bena Abraham ese ena memero e hamaorodia, eto, Umui raruosi doniki ida ba noho iniseni ai, a lau be ina mero ida baiala, raruosi baia toma diho, gabeai baia lou mai dekemui ai.
GEN.22.5.english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

GEN.38.2.motu: Unuseni ai ia ese Kanaan tauna ta, ladana Sua, natuna ulatona e itaia; bena e adavaia.
GEN.38.2.english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

GEN.9.22.motu: Bena Ham, Kanaan tamana, ese tamana na ḡaḡaena mo e itaia; bena e raka lasi, tadikakana raruosi e hamaorodia.
GEN.9.22.english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

GEN.46.18.motu: Ini na hesiai hahinena Silpa natuna; Laban ese natuna Lea e henia hahinena bunai. Iakob ese natuna bona tubuna gwauta-tauratoi iena amo e abidia.
GEN.46.18.english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

GEN.26.18.motu: Bena ranu guridia, tamana Abraham ena nega ai e ḡei bena Filistia taudia ese e tahuni, ia ese ma e gei lou; bona ladadia, tamana ese e hato heḡereḡeredia, ia ese ma e hato lou.
GEN.26.18.english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

GEN.33.5.motu: Bena Esau na e gaga isi, hari hahine mai natudia ida e itadia, bena eto, Idia be daidia? Iakob e haere, eto, Natugu bunu, Dirava ese emu hesiai tauna vada e bogagu hisi, vada e henigu.
GEN.33.5.english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?”

GEN.21.9.motu: Bena Sara ese Hagara, hane Aigupto, natuna, Abraham ese e havaraia merona, e itaia, ia ese Isaak e kirikirilaia.
GEN.21.9.english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

GEN.40.2.motu: Bena Farao ese ena hesiai taudia raruosi, hari vine ranuna iseina memerodia bona flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia taudia, na e badu henidia,
GEN.40.2.english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

GEN.37.21.motu: A Ruben na unu hereva e kamonai, bena ia ese idia imadia amo e hamauria, eto, Lasi, ena mauri basita abia oho,
GEN.37.21.english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

GEN.5.20.motu: Iared ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta tauratoi-ahui rua: bena e mase.
GEN.5.20.english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

GEN.39.19.motu: Ruma tauna ese adavana ena hereva e kamonai, ena hesiai tauna unu vada e kara toma eto, bena e badu dikadika.
GEN.39.19.english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

GEN.39.22.motu: Bena dibura rumana igimana tauna ese dibura taudia iboudiai na Iosef henunai e atodia, edia ḡaukara iboudiai Iosef ese e reḡudia.
GEN.39.22.english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

GEN.23.13.motu: Bena Abraham ese Efron e hereva henia, una gabu taudia vairadiai, eto, Mani a hakala henigu: una tano davana mani aina henimu; avabia, bena egu mase unuseni ai baina guria.
GEN.23.13.english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

GEN.19.36.motu: Taunabunai Lot natuna ulatodia raruosi na tamadia ese e harogorogodia.
GEN.19.36.english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

GEN.37.6.motu: E hamaorodia eto, Egu nihi mani aina hamaorolaimui.
GEN.37.6.english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

GEN.45.13.motu: Taunabunai, hairaigu idoinai Aigupto ai, bona o ita ḡaudia iboudiai danu, tamagu ba hamaorolaia; bena tamagu ba hakaua mai haraḡa.
GEN.45.13.english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

GEN.13.5.motu: Lot danu, Abram e bamoa tauna, ena mamoe bona ena boromakau na momo, ena dabua kalagadia danu momo.
GEN.13.5.english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

GEN.9.2.motu: Tanobada boromadia iboudiai bona atai manudia iboudiai bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai bona davara gwarumedia iboudiai ese garimui bae gari; umui ese danu ba biagudia.
GEN.9.2.english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

GEN.37.14.motu: Ma e hamaoroa, eto, Vada aola, ba itadia, kakamu be nanamo eiava, bona seri na edeheto; bena ma baoma, ba hadibagu. Bena e siaia; Heberon kourana amo e lasi, Sekem ai e kau.
GEN.37.14.english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

GEN.4.10.motu: Iehova ma eto, Dahaka vada o karaia? Tadimu rarana gadona na tano amo vada e tai henigumu.
GEN.4.10.english: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

GEN.41.15.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef e hereva henia, eto, Vada na nihi, to nihi anina ihahedinaraina be asi tauna; a harimu vada na kamonai, nihi anidia ihahedinaraidia na mai dibamu.
GEN.41.15.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

GEN.46.6.motu: Edia boromakau danu, bona edia kohu idoinai, Kanaan tanona ai e abi, vada e laohai, ela Aigupto ai e lasi. Iakob mai ena iduhu idoinai ela:
GEN.46.6.english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

GEN.26.10.motu: Bena Abimelek eto, Oi na ede vada o karamai toma? Tau ta oi adavamu ida bema eno bou, iboumai ai baiama kerere oi daimu ai.
GEN.26.10.english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

GEN.27.17.motu: Bena hari vamu bona flaoa e dabara, natuna Iakob e henia.
GEN.27.17.english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

GEN.27.3.motu: Taunabunai na noimumu, emu diba pauana bona emu peva bavabi, ba ha labana, dia ta bavalaia lauagu;
GEN.27.3.english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

GEN.21.17.motu: Dirava ese mero gadona e kamonai, bena Dirava ena aneru ta ese guba amo Hagara e boi henia, eto, Hagara e, oi na edeheto? Asio gari, badina be Dirava ese mero gadona vada e kamonai.
GEN.21.17.english: God heard the voice of the boy.

GEN.40.1.motu: Ini ḡau muridiai, vine ranuna iseina memerodia ireḡudia tauna bona flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna Farao ena ruma ai na raruosi ese Farao e habadua.
GEN.40.1.english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

GEN.9.23.motu: Bena Sem bona Iafet ese dabua ta e abia, paḡadia ai e idia roro, e rakalaia muri, asie roha kerehai, ela tamadia e tarua, ḡaḡaena mo bae itaia na garina.
GEN.9.23.english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

GEN.6.1.motu: Nega vada e gini dae taunimanima vada e hutuma tanobada ai, natudia hahinedia danu vada e havaradia.
GEN.6.1.english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

GEN.8.20.motu: Bena Noa ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia Iehova ena; bena boroma ḡoevaḡoevadia bona manu ḡoevaḡoevadia iboudiai edia amo hidaosi e abidia, pata latanai e aladia, lahi ai e haḡoledia oho.
GEN.8.20.english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

GEN.34.17.motu: A bema emai hereva basio abia dae, basio peritome, ai na hane-ulato baia abia, baiala.
GEN.34.17.english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

GEN.40.18.motu: Bena Iosef eto, Emu nihi anina binai: bosea toiosi be dina toi.
GEN.40.18.english: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

GEN.1.26.motu: Bena Dirava ma eto, Taunimanima aina karaia, lau laulaugu bona lau heida-idagu; davara gwarumedia bona atai manudia bona boromakau bona tanobada idoinai tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai ia ese baine biagudia.
GEN.1.26.english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

GEN.45.17.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef e hamaoroa, eto, Tadikakamu ba hamaorodia, baoto “Emui kohu be emui doniki dorudia ai bavato kau, Kanaan tanona ba lou lao,
GEN.45.17.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

GEN.34.1.motu: Iakob bona Lea natudia hahinena Daina na eha loaloa, una tano hahinedia i'igo-itadia ela.
GEN.34.1.english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

GEN.39.5.motu: Bena ena ruma ita-taona bona ena kohu ireḡuna tauna ai e halaoa dinana amo Iehova ese Aigupto tauna e hanamoa, Iosef dainai: Iehova ena hahenamo na ena ruma latanai bona ena uma latadiai e miava.
GEN.39.5.english: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. Yahweh’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

GEN.47.24.motu: Bena uit ba utua negana ai, ba karoa, karoa ima; karoa ta Farao ba henia, a karoa hani be emui hadohado bona amui aniani ḡaudia, emui ruma taudia bona natumui maraḡidia iubulaidia.
GEN.47.24.english: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

GEN.18.28.motu: readia kara maoromaoro taudia hariahui ima mo nonoho; o, hanua idoinai ba habuaia tari, ima mo lasi dainai a? Iehova eto, Hari-ahui ima baina davaridia, hanua na basina habuaia tari.
GEN.18.28.english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?”

GEN.24.66.motu: Bena hesiai tauna ese ena kara idoinai Isaak e hamaorolaia.
GEN.24.66.english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

GEN.31.6.motu: Umui danu dibamui lau ese tamamui isiaina vada na lao heni mai goadagu idoinai.
GEN.31.6.english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

GEN.13.15.motu: Badina be o itaiamu tanona idoinai baina henimu, bona oi garamu baina henidia ela bona hanaihanai.
GEN.13.15.english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

GEN.36.34.motu: Iokab e mase; bena Husam na Teman tanona amo ema, gabuna e abia.
GEN.36.34.english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

GEN.38.29.motu: A mero na imana ma e veria vareai, bena tadina e vara guna. Hegwaroto hahinena na eto, Oi na dala vada o lailaia. Bena ladana e hatoa Perese.
GEN.38.29.english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

GEN.35.18.motu: Laumana ese e rakatania horana ai (badina be ia na una negana ai e mase), ia ese mero ladana e hatoa Benoni. Bena hahine na e mase. A tamana ese mero ladana e hatoa Beniamina.
GEN.35.18.english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

GEN.21.12.motu: A Dirava ese Abraham e hereva henia, eto, Lalomu basine hisihisi ina mero dainai bona emu hesiai hahinena dainai. Sara ena hereva iboudiai bavabi dae, badina be Isaak ena amo oi besemu do baine vara.
GEN.21.12.english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

GEN.44.17.motu: A Iosef eto, Lasi, unu basina karamui toma; egu kehere e abia tauna hari egu hesiai tauna ai bainela, a umui be tamamui dekena ba lou lao mai mainomui ida.
GEN.44.17.english: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
