GEN.50.2.motu: Bena Iosef ese ena hesiai taudia haida, muramura ḡaukaradia mai dibadia taudia, e haduadia, tamana tau-anina bae haḡoevaia, muramura mai bonadia amo bae dahua, bona dabua aukana bae kumilaia. Bena unu e kara toma.
GEN.50.2.english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

GEN.8.7.motu: una mukou e roho eva-eva ela bona ranu tanobada amo e kororo vaitani.
GEN.8.7.english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

GEN.21.29.motu: Abimelek ese Abraham e nanadaia, eto, Ene mamoe natudia hitu kaha ta ai o atodia tabe be dahaka?
GEN.21.29.english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

GEN.38.25.motu: E hakaua lasi, bena ia ese hereva e siaia ravana enai, eto, Ini ḡau biagudia ese e harogorogogu; mani a hereva, ina ima-kwakikwaki vaḡivaḡina, ina gana, ina itotohi be daika ena?
GEN.38.25.english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

GEN.5.5.motu: Adam ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta toi-ahui: bena e mase.
GEN.5.5.english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

GEN.43.24.motu: Bena una hesiai tauna ese ena ruma lalonai e hakaudia vareai, aedia ihurilaidia ranuna e henidia, bona edia doniki danu e ubudia.
GEN.43.24.english: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

GEN.42.15.motu: A baina dibamui: Farao maurina ai na herevamu, ini amo basio raka oho ela bona tadimui bainema.
GEN.42.15.english: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

GEN.31.51.motu: Laban ese Iakob ma e hereva henia, eto, Ini nadi bona ina pupuna na ita raruosi padadai vada na hagini.
GEN.31.51.english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

GEN.43.18.motu: Bena hari tatau e gari dikadika, Iosef ena ruma ai e hakaudia vareai dainai. Idia na e hereva heheni, eto, Nega gini-gunana ai moni euda lou eda puse ai dainai; ia na ihabadelaida dalana e tahuamu, bena baine ḡuida, ena hesiai ai baine halaoda, eda doniki danu baine abidia iena.
GEN.43.18.english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

GEN.31.8.motu: Ia eto “Mai toutoudia na oiemu”, bena seri idoinai ese mai toutoudia ḡaudia mo e havaradia; ma eto “Mai revarevadia na oiemu”, bena seri idoinai ese mai revarevadia ḡaudia mo e havaradia.
GEN.31.8.english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

GEN.27.10.motu: Bena vada ba laohaia tamamu dekenai; baine ania bena do basine mase ai baine hanamomu.
GEN.27.10.english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

GEN.31.41.motu: Laḡani ruahui emu ruma ai na nohova: laḡani gwauta-hani isiaimu na lao heni, natumu raruosi davadia, ma laḡani tauratoi emu seri davadia. Nega gwauta davagu o ha-idaua.
GEN.31.41.english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

GEN.45.21.motu: Bena Israel natuna ese iena hereva e badina; bona Iosef ese rerue bona dala lakwana e henidia, Farao ena hahedua heḡereḡerena.
GEN.45.21.english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

GEN.41.16.motu: Iosef ese Farao e haere henia, eto, Dia lau, a Dirava ese Farao baine haere henia, maino herevana ai.
GEN.41.16.english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

GEN.41.20.motu: Bena boromakau dikadia mai varoda-varodadia ese boromakau mai digaradia hituosi e dae guna ḡaudia na e anidia ore;
GEN.41.20.english: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

GEN.1.21.motu: Bena Dirava ese lakara-donodono bona rui bona davara ai e maurimu bona e reremu ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, bona roho manudia iboudiai danu. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
GEN.1.21.english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

GEN.26.7.motu: A una gabu taudia ese ia adavana e nanadailaia, bena ia eto, Ia na taihugu. “Ia na adavagu” baineto na e gari, badina be ia eto, Ina gabu taudia na bae alagu mase readia, Rebeka dainai, badina ia na hahine namo-hereana.
GEN.26.7.english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

GEN.29.4.motu: Bena Iakob ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Varavaragu e, ede amo oma? Idia eto, Ai be Haran taumai.
GEN.29.4.english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?”

GEN.31.43.motu: Bena Laban ese e haere henia, eto, Ini hahine na lau natugu; ini memero na lau tubugu; ini seri na lauegu seri; o itamu ḡaudia iboudiai na lauegu. Ma dahaka aina karaia hari dina ai, ini natugu bona tubugu ihanamodia?
GEN.31.43.english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

GEN.25.17.motu: Ismael ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahuta toi-ahui hitu. E mase, varavarana ediai eha hebou.
GEN.25.17.english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

GEN.43.34.motu: Bena Iosef ese aniani iena pata amo e abia, e siaia dekediai, a Beniamina ana ha-ima e siaia. Vine ranuna danu ia ida e inu hebou.
GEN.43.34.english: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

GEN.9.24.motu: Noa ena kekero amo e noga, bena e diba natuna ihararuana ede vada e karaia toma. Bena eto,
GEN.9.24.english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

GEN.29.11.motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela e harahua, bona e tai danu mai gao badana ida.
GEN.29.11.english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

GEN.30.24.motu: Bena ladana e hatoa Iosef; eto, Iehova ese ma ta bema henigu bema namo.
GEN.30.24.english: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

GEN.27.20.motu: Bena Isaak ese natuna e nanadaia, eto, Natugu e, ede o davaria haraḡa-haraḡa toma? Ia e haere, eto, Badina be Iehova emu Dirava ese e durugu.
GEN.27.20.english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?”

GEN.33.6.motu: Bena hari hesiai hahinedia mai natudia ida e raka kahira, tano ai e goru goru diho.
GEN.33.6.english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

GEN.37.26.motu: Bena Iuda ese tadikakana e hamaorodia, eto, Tadida baita alaia bona ena mase baita hunia anina be dahaka?
GEN.37.26.english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

GEN.35.3.motu: Betele baitala, unuseni ai egu dika dinana ai e haere henigu bona egu dala iboudiai lalodiai e bamogu Diravana ena ihaboulaina patana baina larebaia.
GEN.35.3.english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

GEN.3.1.motu: Gaigai ena aonega ese Dirava Iehova e kara boromadia iboudiai edia aonega e hereadia. Ia ese hahine e nanadaia, eto, Momokani Dirava eto umui na imea audia ta huahuana basio ani a?
GEN.3.1.english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

GEN.24.45.motu: Bena dounu na ḡuriḡuriva ai, Rebeka na hodu e ehea ema; e diho ela, guri ai ranu e utua. Bena na hamaoroa, nato “Mani emu kara, ranu kuri ta a henigu, aina inua”.
GEN.24.45.english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

GEN.16.3.motu: Taunabunai, Abram na laḡani gwauta Kanaan tanona ai vada e noho negana ai, Sarai ese ena hesiai hahinena Hagara, hane Aigupto, e abia, adavana Abram e henia, baine adavaia.
GEN.16.3.english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

GEN.19.34.motu: Daba ai, hane guna ese tadina e hamaoroa, eto, Boi hanuaboi lau na tamagu ida na eno bou; hari hanuaboi ma baita hakekeroa lou, bena oi danu ia ida ba eno bou; bena ita raruosi na tamada ena amo natuda baita abidia.
GEN.19.34.english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

GEN.3.20.motu: Bena Adam ese adavana ladana e hatoa Heva badina be ia na mauri taudia iboudiai sinadia.
GEN.3.20.english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

GEN.44.23.motu: Bena oi ese o hamaoromai, oto “Tadimui tau-muritai basio hakaua mai, lau vairagu basio itaia lou”.
GEN.44.23.english: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

GEN.40.22.motu: A flaoa igabuna memerodia ireḡudia tauna na e taua dae ela bona e mase, Iosef ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
GEN.40.22.english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

GEN.11.32.motu: Tera ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahurua dikoana ima Tera na Haran ai e mase.
GEN.11.32.english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

GEN.50.23.motu: Iosef ese Efraim tubuna e itadia, bona Makiri Manase natuna danu ia tuina ai e helai.
GEN.50.23.english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

GEN.36.21.motu: bona Dison bona Esere bona Disan: Hori lohiadia bunu, Seiri ese e havaradia Edom tanona ai.
GEN.36.21.english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

GEN.27.12.motu: Readia tamagu ese baine darahugu, baine dibagu koikoi taugu, bena baine uduguiraigu, basine hanamogu.
GEN.27.12.english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

GEN.20.11.motu: Bena Abraham e haere, eto, Badina be na laloa nato ina gabu ai Dirava imatauraina na lasi, bena adavagu dainai bae alagu nato.
GEN.20.11.english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

GEN.46.1.motu: Israel na eha laolao, ena kohu idoinai e abi kau, Bere-sieba ai e kau, unuseni ai tamana Isaak ena Dirava e boua.
GEN.46.1.english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

GEN.46.24.motu: Napatali natuna be Iaseel bona Guni bona Iesere bona Silem.
GEN.46.24.english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

GEN.16.16.motu: Hagara ese Ismael e havaraia negana ai, Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahaniahui tauratoi.
GEN.16.16.english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

GEN.23.4.motu: Lau na umui bogaragimui ai na noho hedoamu; tano ta mani a henigu, egu gara gabuna ai bainela, unuseni ai egu mase baina guria.
GEN.23.4.english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

GEN.38.18.motu: Ia ma eto, Dahaka bavabia o tomu? Hahine na eto, Imamu kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina bona emu gana bona emu itotohi. E henia, bena raruosi e eno bou; gabeai hahine na e rogorogo.
GEN.38.18.english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?”

GEN.38.12.motu: Nega taina vada ela, bena Sua natuna, hari Iuda e adavaia hahinena, na e mase. Bena Iuda ena lalo-hisihisi e ore ai, ia na e tore isi, Timuna ela; ena mamoe huidia e utu gabuna bunai. Ia turana Hira, tau Adulama, ese e bamoa.
GEN.38.12.english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

GEN.30.14.motu: Uit iutuna negana ai, Ruben na ela, au-huahua ladana dudai haida e davaridia. bena e abi, sinana Lea dekena e laohai. Bena Rahela ese e noia, eto, Natumu ena dudai haida mani a henigu.
GEN.30.14.english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

GEN.17.14.motu: A maruane ta basiema peritomea, ia na asi ahuna ena bese ai; ia na egu taravatu itata-utuna tauna.
GEN.17.14.english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

GEN.28.4.motu: Dirava ese Abrahame henia hahenamona oi danu baine henimu, oi garamu baine henidia danu, o noholaia hedoamu tanona, Dirava ese Abraham e henia tanona bavabia, emu tano korikori ai bainela.
GEN.28.4.english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

GEN.30.19.motu: Lea ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, mero ihatauratoina e abia, Iakob ena.
GEN.30.19.english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

GEN.30.20.motu: Bena ia eto, Dava namona Dirava ese vada e henigu; harihari adavagu na dekegu ai baine noho tari, badina be natuna mamaruanedia tauratoi vada na henia. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Sebulun.
GEN.30.20.english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

GEN.47.6.motu: Aigupto tanona idoinai be vairamu ai; gabu namo-hereana ta ba henidia, bae noholaia. Gosen tanona ai do bae noho, bona bema goada taudia haida idia bogaragidiai, egu boromakau ireḡudia taudia ai ba halaodia.
GEN.47.6.english: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

GEN.27.43.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, eregu a kamonai: a tore isi haraḡa, Haran baola, taihugu Laban dekenai;
GEN.27.43.english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

GEN.1.10.motu: Dirava ese tano kaukauna ladana e hatoa Tanobada; bona ranu na edia gabu ai e hahebou ladadia e hato Davara. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
GEN.1.10.english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

GEN.45.20.motu: A emui kohu basio laloa, badina be ina Aigupto tanona ena kohu namodia na bavabi emui”.
GEN.45.20.english: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”

GEN.29.30.motu: Bena Iakob e raka vareai Rahela dekenai; ia ese Rahela e ura henia bada, a Lea e ura henia maragi. Ia ese Laban isiaina ma e lao heni, laḡani hitu.
GEN.29.30.english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

GEN.31.9.motu: Unuhetomana Dirava ese tamamui ena seri iena amo vada e abi oho, lau vada e henigu.
GEN.31.9.english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

GEN.46.30.motu: Bena Israel ese Iosef e hereva henia, eto, Harihari aina mase be namo, badina be mai maurimu ida vada na davarimu lou.
GEN.46.30.english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

GEN.5.19.motu: bena Enok e vara murinai Iared na laḡani sinahu-taurahani e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
GEN.5.19.english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

GEN.37.15.motu: Bena tau ta ese e itaia, taora ai e loa eva-eva, bena e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka o tahuamu?
GEN.37.15.english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

GEN.6.7.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Taunimanima, na karaia ḡauna, na tanobada kopina amo baina abia oho; oibe, taunimanima bona boroma bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona atai manudia danu; badina be na helalomu, na havaridia dainai.
GEN.6.7.english: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

GEN.31.10.motu: Mamoe bona nani hahinedia e rogorogova negana ai na na nihi, egu nihi ai na itadia, mamarauendia mai toutoudia bona mai revarevadia bona koremadia mo ema, hahine dekediai.
GEN.31.10.english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

GEN.26.9.motu: Bena ia ese Isaak e gwau henia, eto, Lalogu vada eme parara, hahine na oi adavamu. Dahaka dainai oi oto “Ia na taihugu”. Isaak e haere henia, eto, Badina be na gari, haida ese ia dainai bae alagu mase na garina.
GEN.26.9.english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?”

GEN.40.4.motu: Bena hegima taudia biagudia ese Iosef e hamaoroa, baine naridia; bena ia ese raruosi e naridia. Idia na nega taina daudau dibura rumana ai e nohova.
GEN.40.4.english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

GEN.41.27.motu: Boromakau hituosi dikadia mai varoda-varodadia gabeai e dae ḡaudia be laḡani hitu, bona uit anidiadikadia hituosi, lai mairiveina ese e hamarai ḡaudia, idia danu laḡani hitu, doe laḡanidia.
GEN.41.27.english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

GEN.6.15.motu: Ini ba karaia toma: latana na roha hitu-ahui ima; lababana roha gwauta-rua mai kahana; bona harana ena lata na roha hitu mai kahana.
GEN.6.15.english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

GEN.22.21.motu: Tau guna ladana na Usu; ia tadina be Busu bona Kemuel, Aram tamana,
GEN.22.21.english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

GEN.26.4.motu: Oi garamu danu baina hahutumadia, guba hisiudia na heheto bae hutuma; oi garamu daidiai tanobada besedia iboudiai bae namo;
GEN.26.4.english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

GEN.31.24.motu: A Dirava ese Laban tau Suria nihi ai e hahedinarai henia, eto, Iakob basio hereva henia, hereva namona eiava hereva dikana.
GEN.31.24.english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

GEN.24.34.motu: Bena ia eto, Lau na Abraham ena hesiai tauna.

GEN.33.7.motu: Lea danu natuna ida e raka kahira, bona Rahela mai natuna Iosef ida danu, bena idia danu e goru goru diho.
GEN.33.7.english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

GEN.42.4.motu: a Beniamina, Iosef tadina, na Iakob ese e rua, kakana ida basinela; badina be ia eto, Dika ese bema butua tao na garina.
GEN.42.4.english: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

GEN.47.15.motu: Bena Aigupto ai bona Kanaan ai moni e ore vaitani murinai Aigupto taudia na Iosef dekena ela, eto, Aniani a henimai; oi o uramu ai na oi vairamu ai baia mase a? Ai na asi emai moni.
GEN.47.15.english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

GEN.5.3.motu: Adam ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese natuna ta e havaraia, ia ida-idana ai bona ia heḡereḡerena ai; bena ladana e hatoa Set.
GEN.5.3.english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

GEN.5.23.motu: Enok ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui ima;
GEN.5.23.english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

GEN.16.2.motu: Bena Sarai ese Abram e hamaoroa eto, Dibamu Iehova ese natumu ta se henigu; na noimumu, egu hesiai hahinena avabia; readia natugu ta iena amo baina abia. Bena Abram ese Sarai ena hereva e abia dae.
GEN.16.2.english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

GEN.20.14.motu: Bena Abimelek ese mamoe bona boromakau bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia na Abraham e henia; bena ia adavana Sara e henia lou.
GEN.20.14.english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

GEN.41.18.motu: bena boromakau hitu na sinavai amo e dae, taudia nanamo bona mai digaradia, bena sinavai isena ai e anianiva.
GEN.41.18.english: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

GEN.23.3.motu: Bena Abraham na mase rumana amo e diho, Hiti taudia e hamaorodia, eto,
GEN.23.3.english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

GEN.7.18.motu: Utu-utu na e bada e laova; a lagatoi na ranu kopina ai e hureva.
GEN.7.18.english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

GEN.35.8.motu: Una negana ai, Rebeka ena hesiai hahinena, ladana Debora, Rebeka e vara negana amo isiaina e lao heniva hahinena, vada e mase. Bena Betele ai e guria, au helaḡana henunai; una gabu ladana e hatoa Alono-bakutu.
GEN.35.8.english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

GEN.29.16.motu: Hari Laban na mai natuna kekenidia rarua, vara guna ladana na Lea, tadina ladana be Rahela.
GEN.29.16.english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

GEN.35.26.motu: Lea ena hesiai hahinena Silpa natuna: Gad bona Asere. Iakob natuna mamaruanedia, Padan-aram ai e abidia, ladadia bunu.
GEN.35.26.english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

GEN.8.21.motu: Bena Iehova ese bonana namona e kamonai negana ai, ia eto, Tanobada na basina hadikaia lou taunimanima daidiai, badina be edia lalo-hadai be didika, maraḡidia negadia ela; mauri ḡaudia iboudiai danu basina aladia ore lou, vanegai na aladia na heto.
GEN.8.21.english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

GEN.19.23.motu: Dina e taolara ai Lot na Soara ai e kau.
GEN.19.23.english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

GEN.4.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese Kain e nanadaia, eto, Tadimu Abel be edeseni ai? Ia na e haere, eto, Lau na asi dibagu; be, lau na tadigu igimana tauna a?
GEN.4.9.english: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?”

GEN.13.10.motu: Bena Lot na e gaga isi, Ioridane kourana e itaia, idoinai mai ranuna: Iehova ese Sodoma bona Gomora do se habua tari negana ai una tano na Iehova ena imea na heto, eiava Aigupto tanona, Soara dalana ai e laomu, na heto.
GEN.13.10.english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

GEN.34.24.motu: Hanua taudia iboudiai ese Hamoro bona natuna Sekem edia hereva e abia dae; bena maruane iboudiai e peritomedia.
GEN.34.24.english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

GEN.2.21.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam e hamahutaia hedavauhe. Bena ruduna turiana ta e abia lasi, turia gabuna be hidio ai e daia ahu.
GEN.2.21.english: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

GEN.31.18.motu: ena seri iboudiai bona ena kohu idoinai Padan-aram ai e habou danu e siaidia guna; bena e heḡaeḡae, Kanaan tanona bainela, tamana Isaak dekenai.
GEN.31.18.english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

GEN.44.6.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese e lasidia tao, bena unu e gwau henidia toma.
GEN.44.6.english: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

GEN.41.28.motu: Farao hari na hamaoroa heḡereḡerena, Dirava ese ena kara ta baine karaia e tomu be Farao vada e hamaorolaia guna.
GEN.41.28.english: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

GEN.32.19.motu: Ihararuana danu unu e haduaia toma, bona ihatatoina, bona idia muridiai seri ta ta bae hakaudia taudia, hahedua tamona e henidia, eto, Esau ida ba hedavari negana ai ini ba hereva henia toma.
GEN.32.19.english: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

GEN.12.1.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Abram e hamaoroa, eto, Emu tano bona varavaramu bona tamamu ena ruma ba rakatanidia, lau ese baina hamaorolaimu tanona baola.
GEN.12.1.english: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

GEN.42.28.motu: Bena ia ese tadikakana e hamaorodia, eto, Egu moni vada e haloua, ḡauna na egu puse ai. Bena kudoudia e hetaha, gari ese e butudia tao, e hereva heheni, eto, Dirava na ede vada e karada toma?
GEN.42.28.english: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

GEN.29.33.motu: Ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Iehova vada e kamonai adavagu vada e dadaraigumu, una dainai ina mero danu vada e henigu. Bena ladana e hatoa Simeon.
GEN.29.33.english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

GEN.46.25.motu: Ini be hesiai hahinena Bilha natuna; Laban ese natuna Rahela e henia hahinena bunai. Iboudiai be hahitu.
GEN.46.25.english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

GEN.15.2.motu: Bena Abram eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, dahaka ba henigu? Lau na asi natugu; dihigu be hari Eliesere, Damasko tauna.
GEN.15.2.english: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

GEN.8.19.motu: Boroma idoudiai danu bona manu iboudiai, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai, ibouboudiai na lagatoi amo e didi didi lasi.
GEN.8.19.english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

GEN.37.5.motu: Hari Iosef na e nihi, bena ena nihi na kakana e hamaorolaidia; una dainai idia ese e inai henia lalodika.
GEN.37.5.english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

GEN.2.22.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam ena amo e abia lasi turiana na hahine ta e karalaia, Adam dekena e laohaia.
GEN.2.22.english: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

GEN.38.28.motu: Bena e mara negana ai, mero ta imana e toia lasi, bena hegwaroto hahinena ese varo kakakakana ta imana ai e kwatua, eto, Roboana binai.
GEN.38.28.english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

GEN.46.34.motu: Una negana ai umui ba haere, baoto “Ai oi isiaimu ilao-henina taumai na meromai negana amo boromakau vada e reḡudia, senemai bamodia”. Unu amo Gosen bavabia diba, emui tano ai ba halaoa; badina be Aigupto taudia ese seri ireḡudia taudia e dadaraidiamu.
GEN.46.34.english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

GEN.28.15.motu: Lau ese baina bamomu, ba lao heni gabudia iboudiai baina gimamu, bona baina hakaumu lou ina tano ba lou henia; lau basina rakatanimu ela bona na herevalai henimu karadia na baina kara ḡuḡuru.
GEN.28.15.english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

GEN.22.22.motu: bona Kesed bona Haso bona Pilidasa bona Idilapa bona Betuel.
GEN.22.22.english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

GEN.46.12.motu: Iuda natuna be Ere bona Onan bona Sela bona Perese bona Sera; a Ere bona Onan be Kanaan tanona ai e mase. Perese natuna be Hesron bona Hamulu.
GEN.46.12.english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

GEN.13.4.motu: gunaguna ihaboulaina patana e larebaia gabuna bunai. Unuseni ai Abram ese Iehova ladana e hahanea.
GEN.13.4.english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.

GEN.10.30.motu: Edia tano na Mesa amo e laomu, mairiveina ororona ladana Sefara kahana ai.
GEN.10.30.english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

GEN.29.31.motu: Iakob ese Lea e dadaraia dainai Iehova ese e bogaia hisi, natuna e henia; a Rahela na gabani.
GEN.29.31.english: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

GEN.46.3.motu: Ma eto, Lau be Dirava, tamamu ena Dirava: Aigupto baola, basio gari, badina be unuseni ai bese badana ai baina halaomu.
GEN.46.3.english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

GEN.15.10.motu: Ini iboudiai e abi, e ivadia parara, ahu rua ai e habou, a manu na se ivadia.
GEN.15.10.english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

GEN.46.33.motu: Bena Farao ese baine boirimui bona baine nanadaimui, baineto “Emui ḡaukara be dahaka?”
GEN.46.33.english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

GEN.44.4.motu: Hanua e rakatania, a do asie raka daudau ai, Iosef ese ena ruma ireḡuna tauna e haduaia, eto, A tore isi, a ḡavadia; ba lasidia tao negana ai ba gwau henidia, baoto “Badina be dahaka umui ese namo dika vada o davalaia a?
GEN.44.4.english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

GEN.44.29.motu: A harihari ina ta danu egu ai bavabia oho, bena dika ta ienai baine kau, lau buruka taugu na umui daimui ai mase gabuna bainala mai lalo-hisihisigu ida”.
GEN.44.29.english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

GEN.43.25.motu: Bena edia herahia e heḡaeḡaelai, Iosef dina tubua ai bainema bae henia eto, badina be vada e diba idia na unuseni ai bae aniani.
GEN.43.25.english: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

GEN.5.9.motu: Enos ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ta-ahui negana ai, ia ese Kenan e havaraia;
GEN.5.9.english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

GEN.41.39.motu: Bena Farao ese Iosef e hereva henia, eto, Dirava ese ina idoinai vada e hahedinarai henimu, bona asi tauna ta mai ena lalo-parara bona mai ena aonega oi heḡereḡeremu.
GEN.41.39.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

GEN.3.12.motu: Adam e haere, eto, Vada o henigu baine bamogu hahinena ese una au huahuana e henigu, bena na ania.
GEN.3.12.english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

GEN.10.13.motu: Misraim ese e havaradia besedia bini: Ludim bona Anamim bona Lehabim bona Napatuhim
GEN.10.13.english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

GEN.23.2.motu: Sarana Kiriat-araba ai eha mase: una hanua na Kanaan tanona ai, ladana ta be Heberon. Abraham na ruma ai e raka vareai, Sara taina e tai.
GEN.23.2.english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

GEN.26.3.motu: Ina tano ai ba noho, bena lau baina bamomu bona baina hanamomu; badina be ini tano idoidiai oi baina henimu bona oi garamu baina henidia, oi tamamu Abraham na gwau henia hamata heḡereḡerena.
GEN.26.3.english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

GEN.10.23.motu: Aram natuna bini: Usu bona Hulu bona Getere bona Masa.
GEN.10.23.english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

GEN.28.10.motu: Iakob ese Bere-sieba e rakatania, Haran dalana ai e raka.
GEN.28.10.english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

GEN.43.26.motu: Iosef e raka vareai, bena e haḡaeḡaelai ḡaudia vada e henia, bona e goru goru diho tano ai, ia vairanai.
GEN.43.26.english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

GEN.19.37.motu: Bena hane guna na mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Moab; Moab besena taudia iboudiai ema bona harihari senedia na ia.
GEN.19.37.english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

GEN.39.14.motu: bena ia ese ruma taudia e boiridia, e hamaorodia, eto, O itaia, ia ese ina Heberu tauna vada e abia dae, ita ihakavakavada. Ia na lau dekegu ai e raka vareai, baia eno bou eto: na lolo,
GEN.39.14.english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

GEN.15.17.motu: Dina e kerekere, hanua e boi; bena Abram ese lahi mai kwalahuna e itaia, e kara kede na heto, unu vamu ahu rua padadiai.
GEN.15.17.english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

GEN.45.24.motu: Bena ia ese tadikakana e siaidia lao, eto, Dala ai basio heiri-heiri.
GEN.45.24.english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

GEN.29.29.motu: Laban ese danu ena hesiai hahinena Bilha na Rahela e henia, ena hesiai hahinena ai bainela.
GEN.29.29.english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

GEN.43.14.motu: Siahu-idoinai Diravana ese baine bogamui hisi una tau vairanai baine durumui, bena ia ese tadikakamui ta baine ruhaia nege, bona Beniamina danu baine haloua. A natugu na egu ai bae boio, vadaeni, vada bae boio.
GEN.43.14.english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

GEN.35.13.motu: Bena Dirava ese ia e rakatania, e hereva henia gabuna danu e rakatania.
GEN.35.13.english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

GEN.31.30.motu: Harihari tamamu ena ruma o ura henia lalo-dikamu dainai vada bo laomu; to dahaka dainai egu dirava laulaudia o henaodia?
GEN.31.30.english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

GEN.39.6.motu: Ena ḡau idoidiai Iosef imana ai e ato: ḡau ta se laloa, ana aniani vairanai e dabaraia mo, vadaeni.
GEN.39.6.english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate.

GEN.14.10.motu: Una Sidim kourana na mai kopukopuna, bena Sodoma pavapavana bona Gomora pavapavana e darere negana ai e heau, kopukopu ai eha heau kau, eha mase. A taunimanima oredia na ororo ai e heau mauri.
GEN.14.10.english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

GEN.24.1.motu: Abraham vada e buruka: ena mauri laḡanidia na diaḡau. Bona Iehova ese vada e harihari henia, ḡau momo momo vada e henia.
GEN.24.1.english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

GEN.26.5.motu: badina be Abraham ese lau eregu e kamonai, egu hahedua, egu haheḡani, egu taravatu, iboudiai e badinadiava.
GEN.26.5.english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

GEN.32.14.motu: Gaudia bini: nani hahinedia sinahu-ruabona nani mamaruanedia ruahui; mamoe hahinedia sinahu-rua bona mamoe mamaruanedia ruahui;
GEN.32.14.english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

GEN.26.22.motu: Unu amo ma e raka oho bena guri ta ma e ḡeia. Una na asie heatulaia; taunabunai ladana e hatoa Rehoboto; badina be ia eto, Iehova ese gabu ta vada e lailaia eda, iniseni ai baita noho namonamo.
GEN.26.22.english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

GEN.30.22.motu: Una negana ai Dirava ese Rahela e haḡerea, ena noinoi e abia dae; Bena ia danu e rogorogo.
GEN.30.22.english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

GEN.41.26.motu: Boromakau namodia hituosi be l=agani hitu, bona uit anidia namodia hituosi be laḡani hitu: nihi na tamona mo.
GEN.41.26.english: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

GEN.18.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese Abraham e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai Sara e kirimu, e tomu “Burukagu ai natugu ta baina abia a”?
GEN.18.13.english: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

GEN.39.8.motu: A Iosef na se ura; e haere henia, eto, Vada o itaia, biagugu na egu ḡaukara ruma ai se itaia taomu, ena kohu idoinai danu lau imagu ai vada e atoa.
GEN.39.8.english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

GEN.36.35.motu: Husam e mase; bena Hadad Bedad, Moab taorana ai Midian taudia e hadareredia tauna, ese gabuna e abia; iena hanua badana ladana na Aviti.
GEN.36.35.english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

GEN.10.19.motu: edia tano na Sidono amo e laomu ela bona Gasa, Gerara kahana ai, bona Lasa, Sodoma bona Gomora bona Adma bona Seboimi kahadia ai.
GEN.10.19.english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

GEN.11.28.motu: Tamana Tera do se mase negana ai, Haran e mase guna, e vara gabuna ai, Uru, Kaldea taudia edia hanua ta, unuseni ai eha mase.
GEN.11.28.english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

GEN.8.10.motu: Ia na dina hitu ma e noho; bena pune na lagatoi amo ma e harohoa.
GEN.8.10.english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

GEN.1.6.motu: Dirava ma eto, Ḡau ta aine vara gadobada daenai, ranu baine haridia.
GEN.1.6.english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

GEN.43.30.motu: Bena Iosef lalona e manoka: tadina e bogaia hisi bada dainai ia na e raka vareai ena daiutu lalonai, unuseni ai e tai.
GEN.43.30.english: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

GEN.9.11.motu: Egu taravatu lau ese baina badinaia umui emui ai: mauri ḡaudia na utu-utu ta ese basine aladia lou; utu-utu badana ta basine utua dae lou, tanobada basine hadikaia lou.
GEN.9.11.english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

GEN.30.6.motu: Bena Rahela eto, Dirava ese vada e hahemaoro henigu, egu noinoi vada e abia dae, natugu vada e henigu. Bena ladana e hatoa Dan.
GEN.30.6.english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

GEN.38.1.motu: Nega ta Iuda ese tadikakana e rakatanidia, ela, Adulama tauna ta, ladana Hira, dekenai e nohova.
GEN.38.1.english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

GEN.25.33.motu: Iakob eto, A gwau hamata guna. Bena Esau e gwau hamata, roboa ahuna Iakob e henia, aniani davana.

GEN.37.7.motu: Egu nihi ai ita na uma ai, uit ta ḡui; bena lauegu iḡui na e gini tore, a umui emui iḡui ese e ginia heḡeḡe, lauegu iḡui e toma henia diho.
GEN.37.7.english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

GEN.25.12.motu: Ismael garana bini: ia na Abraham natuna, Sara ena hesiai hahinena Hagara, Aigupto hahinena, bogana amo.
GEN.25.12.english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

GEN.39.7.motu: Bena nega ta ia biaguna adavana ese e ḡahusia, bena e hamaoroa, eto, Aita eno bou.
GEN.39.7.english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

GEN.36.39.motu: Baal-hanana e mase; bena Hadara ese gabuna e abia. Iena hanua badana ladana na Pau. Adavana ladana be Mehetabel; ia na Matared natuna, tubuna be Mesahab.
GEN.36.39.english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

GEN.21.24.motu: Bena Abraham eto, Vada baina gwau hamata.

GEN.25.20.motu: Isaak ena vara laḡanidia na hari-ahui negana ai, ia ese Rebeka, Betuel tau Suria natuna, Laban tau Suria taihuna, e adavaia. Betuel na Padan-aram tauna.
GEN.25.20.english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

GEN.43.11.motu: Bena tamadia Israel ese e haere henidia, eto, Bema dala idauna ta lasi, ini ba kara toma: eda tano anidia namo-hereadia bavabi kau, emui maduna ai, muramura mai bonadia, bada ranuna, aniani ihanamodia muramuradia, au-huahuadia aukadia, una tau ena.
GEN.43.11.english: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

GEN.9.29.motu: Ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta imahui: bena e mase.
GEN.9.29.english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

GEN.45.10.motu: Gosen tanona ai do ba noho, lau badibadigu ai: oi bona natumu bona tubumu bona emu mamoe seridia bona emu boromakau seridia bona emu ḡau idoidiai.
GEN.45.10.english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

GEN.15.11.motu: Bena galo na unu vamu ai e roho kau, to Abram ese e luludia.
GEN.15.11.english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

GEN.17.22.motu: Dirava ese ena hereva e hadokoa, bena ia ese Abraham e rakatania.
GEN.17.22.english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

GEN.28.7.motu: e diba danu Iakob na tamana sinana eredia vada e kamonai, Padan-aram ela.
GEN.28.7.english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

GEN.41.5.motu: Ma e mahuta lou, e nihi. Ena nihi iharuana ai ia ese uit tuhutuhuna tamona amo anidia hitu e tubu e itadia, unu uit anidia be nanamo bona babada.
GEN.41.5.english: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

GEN.45.16.motu: Ini ḡau haridia na Farao ena ruma ai e piua, ena ruma taudia iboudiai na e kamonai Iosef tadikakana vada ema. Bena Farao mai ena hesiai taudia iboudiai vada e moale.
GEN.45.16.english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

GEN.10.16.motu: E havaradia besedia danu bini: Iebusu bona Amoro bona Girigasa
GEN.10.16.english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

GEN.17.27.motu: Ena ruma tataudia iboudiai danu, ena ruma ai e vara taudia bona bese idau edia amo e hoidia taudia, iboudiai na ia ida e pentomedia nega tamona ai.
GEN.17.27.english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

GEN.35.22.motu: Una tano ai e nohova negana ai Ruben na tamana ena hesiai hahinena Bilha ida e eno bou; bena Israel ese harina e kamonai.
GEN.35.22.english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it.

GEN.27.22.motu: Bena Iakob na tamana Isaak dekena e raka kahi lao. Ia ese e darahua, bena eto, Gado be Iakob gadona, a ima be Esau imana.
GEN.27.22.english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

GEN.31.22.motu: Dina ihatoina ai Laban na Iakob ena heau harina e kamonai.
GEN.31.22.english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

HAB.1.15.motu: Ia ese kimai ai e veridiamu,
HAB.1.15.english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

HAB.2.3.motu: Badina be mata-hanai na doini ena nega e nariamu,
HAB.2.3.english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

HAB.3.2.motu: Iehova e, oi harimu vada na kamonai;
HAB.3.2.english: Yahweh, I have heard of your fame.

HAB.2.20.motu: A Iehova na ena dubu helaḡa lalonai e nohomu;
HAB.2.20.english: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

HAB.1.11.motu: Lai na heto e heau hanaimu e laomu,
HAB.1.11.english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

HAB.3.8.motu: Iehova e, emu hosi ai o gui negana ai,
HAB.3.8.english: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers?

HAB.3.4.motu: Ia kiama-kiamana na diari na heto,
HAB.3.4.english: His splendor is like the sunrise.

HAB.2.17.motu: Lebanon idagedaḡe henina ese baine habubunimu,
HAB.2.17.english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

HAB.1.13.english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

HAB.1.1.motu: Dirava ena hereva metauna, peroveta tauna Habakuku ese e matahanailaia.
HAB.1.1.english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

HAB.2.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese e haere henigu, eto:
HAB.2.2.english: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

HAB.2.12.english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

HAB.2.14.motu: Badina be tanobada na Iehova hairaina idiba-maorona amo baine honu,
HAB.2.14.english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

HAB.3.19.english: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength.

HAB.2.13.motu: A itaia, ina na Iehova Sabaota ena amo, ani?
HAB.2.13.english: Behold, isn’t it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

HAB.3.12.motu: Mai badumu ida tanobada o dagaia tao,
HAB.3.12.english: You marched through the land in wrath.

HAB.1.14.motu: Badina be oi ese taunimanima na o karadiamu,
HAB.1.14.english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

HAB.1.5.motu: Bese bogaragidiai ba roharoha, ba itaia;
HAB.1.5.english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

HAB.1.12.motu: Iehova e, egu Dirava, egu Helaḡa Diravana,
HAB.1.12.english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

HAB.3.11.motu: Dina bona hua na edia ḡabu ai e gini, asie marere,
HAB.3.11.english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky

HAB.1.17.motu: Matona, ia ese ena reke anina baine bubua loulou a?
HAB.1.17.english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

HAB.2.6.motu: Ini iboudiai ese ia bae ḡonaḡonalaia, ani; bae ihi-ihiraia mai kiridia ida, baeto:
HAB.2.6.english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

HAB.2.7.motu: Emu ai e abi torehai taudia na basie tore isi taku a?
HAB.2.7.english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

HAB.1.2.motu: Iehova e, baina boi henimu, ba durugu totona;
HAB.1.2.english: Yahweh, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

HAB.3.10.motu: Ororo ese e itamu, bena e lagava,
HAB.3.10.english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid.

HAB.1.4.english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

HAB.3.15.motu: Emu hosi aedia amo davara o moimoilaia,
HAB.3.15.english: You trampled the sea with your horses,

HAB.2.15.motu: Dekena taudia na ena badu keherena amo e ha-inudiamu
HAB.2.15.english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

HAB.3.13.motu: Emu bese ihamaurina totona o raka lasi,
HAB.3.13.english: You went out for the salvation of your people,

HAB.1.9.motu: Iboudiai na kara daḡedaḡe totona e maimu;
HAB.1.9.english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

HAB.2.11.motu: Badina be nadi na maḡu amo baine lolo,
HAB.2.11.english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

HAB.3.9.motu: Emu peva na pauana o veria oho,

HAB.3.18.motu: to lau ese Iehova baina moalelaia,
HAB.3.18.english: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.

HAB.3.16.motu: Lau na kamonaimu, bena taugu e heude-heudemu,
HAB.3.16.english: I heard, and my body trembled.

HAB.1.10.english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

HAB.2.19.motu: Au ḡauna e haḡaniamu, e tomu “A noga”,
HAB.2.19.english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

HAB.2.8.motu: Badina be oi ese basileia momo vada o dadihaidia,
HAB.2.8.english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

HAB.2.18.english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

HAB.1.16.motu: Taunabunai ia ese ena reke e bouamu,
HAB.1.16.english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

HAB.2.16.motu: Dia hairai amo to hedadarai amo do ba honu;
HAB.2.16.english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

HAB.2.1.motu: Lau na baina gini, baina gima,
HAB.2.1.english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

HAB.3.14.motu: Ena tuari taudia kwaradia o tarakidia uru;
HAB.3.14.english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears.

HAB.3.17.motu: Ena be suke auna basine burea,
HAB.3.17.english: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish,

HAB.2.10.motu: Emu ruma ihahemaraina dalana vada o laloa hata;
HAB.2.10.english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

HAB.3.7.motu: Kusana kalagadia na hisihisidia ai na itadia,
HAB.3.7.english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction.

HAB.3.1.motu: Peroveta tauna Habakuku ena ḡuriḡuri anena; ane gadona ladana be Shigionoth.
HAB.3.1.english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

HAB.2.5.motu: Ina danu, vine ranuna na mai ena hekoi,
HAB.2.5.english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

HAB.1.7.motu: Idia ese gari bona kudou-hetaha e havaradiamu,
HAB.1.7.english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

HAB.1.8.motu: Edia hosi ese taiga e hereadiamu edia heau ai,
HAB.1.8.english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

HAB.1.6.motu: Badina be, a itaia, Kaldea taudia na hatoredia isimu,
HAB.1.6.english: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

HAB.2.4.motu: A itaia, lalona na dia maoro tauna na baine moru,
HAB.2.4.english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

HAB.2.9.motu: Ena ruma na dala dikadia amo e hanamoamu tauna, madi ihabaina!
HAB.2.9.english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

HAB.3.6.motu: Ia e gini, tanobada e hahetohoa;
HAB.3.6.english: He stood, and shook the earth.

HAB.1.3.motu: Badina be dahaka kara kereredia o haheitalaigumu?
HAB.1.3.english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

HAG.2.15.motu: Mani emui kara ba haeroa, hari ina dina amo bainela dahaka baine vara. Iehova ena dubu ai nadi ta na nadi ta latanai do se heato kau negana ai,
HAG.2.15.english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

HAG.2.12.motu: Tau ta ese vamu helaḡana na ena dabua gevena ai baine abia kau, bena ena dabua na ilaoa eiava vasiahu eiava vine ranuna eiava dehoro eiava aniani ḡauna ta enai baine kau, una ḡau baine helaḡa a? Hahelaḡa taudia eto, Lasi.
HAG.2.12.english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’”

HAG.1.15.motu: hua ihatauratoina dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai.
HAG.1.15.english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

HAG.1.2.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ini taunimanima na e tomu Iehova ena dubu ihagini-louna negana na do se kau.
HAG.1.2.english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be built.’”

HAG.2.4.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Ḡau tamona, Serubabele e, harihari a boga auka! Hahelaḡa tauna badana, Iosua lehosadak e, a boga auka! Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A gaukara, badina be lau na umui ida,
HAG.2.4.english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

HAG.2.16.motu: emui noho na edeheto? Ta ese irau ruahui isenudia e lao henia negana ai, gwauta hona mo mimia; ta ese vine ranuna e haboua gabuna ela, hodu imahui baine utu eto, a ruahui hona mimia.
HAG.2.16.english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

HAG.2.8.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Silver na lauegu, bona gold na lauegu.
HAG.2.8.english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

HAG.1.4.motu: Ina na emui ruma hairaidia lalodiai o nohomu negana a? A ina dubu be heḡiḡi-dobina ai mia.
HAG.1.4.english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

HAG.1.14.motu: Bena Iehova ese Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai na lalodia e hasiahudia; bena idia na ela, Iehova Sabaota, edia Dirava, ena dubu e ḡaukaralaia,
HAG.1.14.english: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,

HAG.1.6.motu: Emui hadohado na bada, to emui taboro anina na maragi; o anianimu, to bogamui asie kunumu; ranu o inumu, to gadomui asie doromu; dabua o hahedokilaimu, to ta tauna se lomu. Moni ḡaukaradia e karamu tauna ese ena ḡaukara davana e abiamu, bena puse mai matumatuna lalonai e udaiamu.
HAG.1.6.english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

HAG.1.5.motu: Taunabunai Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka dahaka emui ai vada e vara na ba haeroa.
HAG.1.5.english: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

HAG.2.7.motu: bona bese iboudiai baina haheude-heudedia, bena bese iboudiai edia taḡa na bae siaidia mai, bena ina dubu na baina hahairaia ḡuḡuru. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
HAG.2.7.english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

HAG.1.10.motu: Una dainai guba daemui ai ese hunu vada e rua, bona tano ese anina vada e rua.
HAG.1.10.english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

HAG.2.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Ina dubu hairaina gabena ese hailaina gunana baine hereaia, bena ina gabu ena noho-namo baina habadaia. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
HAG.2.9.english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

HAG.1.12.motu: Bena Serubabele Sealtiele bona hahelaḡa tauna badana, Iosua Iehosadak, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai ese Iehova, edia Dirava, gadona bona peroveta tauna Hagai, Iehova, edia Dirava, ese e siaia tauna, ena hereva danue kamonai; bena taunimanima na Iehova vairanai e gari.
HAG.1.12.english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.

HAG.2.5.motu: Aigupto amo o raka lasi negana ai na henimui gwauhamatana heḡereḡerena. Egu Lauma na bogaragimui ai e nohomu; basio gari.
HAG.2.5.english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

HAG.2.6.motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Asi vanahana guba bona tanobada bona davara bona tano kaukauna baina haheude-heudedia lou;
HAG.2.6.english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

HAG.2.17.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Umui na rahumui mase, bona emui ḡaukara anidia na hogohogo bona valavala bona medu-hetarina amo na hadikadia, ḡau tamona umui na asio lou henigu.
HAG.2.17.english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

HAG.2.20.motu: Iehova ena hereva na nega iharuana Hagai enai ma e kau, hua dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, eto,
HAG.2.20.english: Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

HAG.2.2.motu: Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai ba hereva henidia, baoto,
HAG.2.2.english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

HAG.2.14.motu: Bena Hagai eto, Iehova na e tomu: Ina bese bona ina basileia na unuheto lau vairagu ai; bona imadia ḡaukaradia iboudiai danu unuheto; bona unuseni ai e henimu herahiana na mai mirona.
HAG.2.14.english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

HAG.2.3.motu: Daika daika doini nonoho umui bogaragimui ai ese ina dubu na ena hairai gunana ai e itaia? Harihari be ede o itaia tomamu? Umui vairamui ai ina na dia ḡau ta ani?
HAG.2.3.english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

HAG.2.21.motu: Serubabele, Iuda lohiana, ba hereva henia, baoto: Lau ese guba bona tanobada ba haheude-heudeamu,
HAG.2.21.english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

HAG.2.13.motu: Hagai ma eto, Tau ta bema miro, tau-ani masena ta e daua toho dainai, bena una tau ese unu aniani ḡaudia ta bema daua toho; una ḡau baine miro a? Hahelaḡa taudia eto, Baine miro.
HAG.2.13.english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?”

HAG.2.18.motu: Ina dina, hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahui-hanina, amo bainela, do ba haeroa. Iehova ena dubu badidia nadidia na gabudia ai e atodia ema bona hari danu ba haeroa.
HAG.2.18.english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

HAG.2.1.motu: Hua ihahituna dinana iharuahui-tana ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai enai e kau, eto:
HAG.2.1.english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

HAG.1.7.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka dahaka emui ai vada e vara na ba haeroa.
HAG.1.7.english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

HAG.2.23.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Serubabele e, egu hesiai tauna, Sealtiele natuna, una dina ai lau ese baina abimu. Iehova na e tomu, Lau ese ima-kwakikwaki vagivagina, toa ḡauna, heḡereḡerena ai baina halaomu, badina be vada na abimu hidi. Iehova Sabaota unu e gwau tomamu.
HAG.2.23.english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

HAG.1.3.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai ena amo e kau, eto,
HAG.1.3.english: Then Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

HAG.1.11.motu: Lau ese doe vada na gwauraia, taora bona ororo latadiai, bona uit bona vine ranuna bona dehoro bona tano anidia iboudiai latadiai, bona taunimanima bona boromakau bona edia hekwarahi idoinai latadiai.
HAG.1.11.english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

HAG.2.11.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Hahelaḡa taudia ba nanadaidia, bena bae hereva maoro. Baoto,
HAG.2.11.english: “Yahweh of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

HAG.1.9.motu: Ḡau momo o tahu, matogana, sisina mo o davaria; bena o mailaia negana ai lau ese na hiriria oho. Iehova Sabaota na e henanadaimu, e tomu, Dahaka dainai? Badina be egu dubu na e heḡiḡi dobimu, a umui ese ta ta ena ruma ena ruma o ḡaukaralaidiamu.
HAG.1.9.english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

HAG.2.19.motu: Uhe na roge ai doini mimia eiava? Vine bona suke bona rimono bona olive audia na do asi huahuadia a? Hari ina dina amo bainela, lau ese baina hanamomui.
HAG.2.19.english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

HAG.1.13.motu: Bena Hagai, Iehova ena gwaukau tauna, ese Iehova ena gwaukau herevana na taunimanima e hamaorolaidia, eto, Iehova na e tomu: Lau na umui ida.
HAG.1.13.english: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.

HAG.2.10.motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahui-hanina ai Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai enai e kau, eto,
HAG.2.10.english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

HAG.2.22.motu: bona basileia teronodia danu ba tahodia dobimu; bese idau-idau basileiadia edia goada ba ha-oreamu, bona kariota mai taudia ida ba hahebubudiamu; hosi bona hosi-gui taudia na bae mase, ta ta bamona bamona edia dare ai.
HAG.2.22.english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

HAG.1.8.motu: Ororo ai ba dara dae, au ba mailai, dubu ba haginia, baina moalelaia bona mai hairaigu ida baina hedinarai helaoreana. Iehova na e herevamu.
HAG.1.8.english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.

HAG.1.1.motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihatauratoina dinana gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai ena amo e hedinarai, Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, ediai e kau, eto,
HAG.1.1.english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

HEB.12.21.motu: Bona ita-itana na mai garina dainai Mose eto, Name gari, name heudeheude.
HEB.12.21.english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.” + 12:21 Deuteronomy 9:19

HEB.6.12.motu: Basio hesiku; a edia abidadama bona edia habeauka daidiai ahudia vada e abi taudia do ba haḡoidia.
HEB.6.12.english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

HEB.7.4.motu: Una tau ba haeroa, ede e herea tomava. Seneda Abraham ese tuari ai e abi kohudia e karoadia, karoa ihagwautana e henia.
HEB.7.4.english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

HEB.13.18.motu: Ba ḡuriḡuri ai emai; badina be ai a tomamu lalomai be ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva, bona a uramu ḡau idoidiai baia kara maoromaoro.
HEB.13.18.english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

HEB.10.33.motu: Nega haida e lodu henimui bona e daḡedaḡe henimui; ma nega haida unu e karadia toma taudia na o bamodia.
HEB.10.33.english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

HEB.12.12.motu: Taunabunai, imamui eme heveri ba toi roro, bona aemui eme pada ba hahedai.
HEB.12.12.english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees, + 12:12 Isaiah 35:3

HEB.12.14.motu: Maino ba ḡavaia, taunimanima iboudiai ida; kara helaḡa danu, badina be basine abia tauna na Lohiabada basine itaia.
HEB.12.14.english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

HEB.2.6.motu: Buka itorena tauna ta vada e hereva, eto,
HEB.2.6.english: But one has somewhere testified, saying,

HEB.13.21.motu: ḡau namodia idoidiai baine hanamolaimui ḡuḡuru; bena umui ese iena ura ba kara, bona ia ese e moalelaimu ḡaudia na umui lalomui ai baine havara, Iesu Keriso dainai. Ia baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen.
HEB.13.21.english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

HEB.2.13.english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” + 2:13 Isaiah 8:18

HEB.2.3.motu: ita na ede baitama roho mauri toma, hahemauri unu-badana baitama dadaraia negana ai? Hahemauri bunai Lohiabada ese e gwauraia guna; bena iena amo e kamonai taudia ese vada e hamomokania ita eda.
HEB.2.3.english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

HEB.6.13.motu: Badina be Dirava ese Abraham e gwau hamata henia negana ai, ta ese ia se hereaia dainai ia sibona ladana ai e gwau hamata,
HEB.6.13.english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

HEB.13.12.motu: Unuhetomana Iesu danu ikoukou murimurinai e mase, ia sibona rarana amo bese taudia baine hahelaḡadia helaoreana.
HEB.13.12.english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

HEB.11.5.motu: Abidadama dainai, Enok na tanobada amo e heabi oho, mase asi dibana; asie davaria, badina be Dirava ese e abia oho. A do se heabi oho negana ai vada e gwauraia, Dirava ihamoalena tauna.
HEB.11.5.english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

HEB.3.8.motu: Lalomui basio ha-auka, Dirava o dadaraia negana ai na heto,
HEB.3.8.english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion,

HEB.10.27.motu: a hahemaoro inarina mo mia, mai gari-badana ida, bona lahi danu mia, Dirava inaina baine aradia ore.
HEB.10.27.english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

HEB.10.14.motu: Badina be boubou ḡauna tamona amo ia ese e hahelaḡadiamu taudia na vada e haḡoevadia ḡuḡuru ela hanaihanai.
HEB.10.14.english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

HEB.4.2.motu: Badina be sivarai namo vada e harorolai henida, idia heḡereḡeredia; to e kamonai herevadia ese asie hanamodia, badina be e kamonai taudia ese asie abi dae.
HEB.4.2.english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

HEB.2.8.motu: Ḡau iboudiai ia aena henunai vada o atodia, ia ese baine biagudia.
HEB.2.8.english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” + 2:8 Psalms 8:4-6

HEB.7.13.motu: Badina be ini e herevalaia tomamu tauna na ena iduhu na idau; bona iena iduhu tauna ta ese pata helaḡana gaukaradia do se kara.
HEB.7.13.english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

HEB.2.9.motu: A nega sisina mo aneru ese e hereaia tauna, Iesu, harihari ta itaiamu, mase hisihisina dainai hairai mai hemataurai ida kwarana vada e havavalaia; Dirava ena harihari-bada ai mase mamina e abia, taunimanima iboudiai daidiai.
HEB.2.9.english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

HEB.7.11.motu: Eda bese taudia ese Levi iduhuna hahelaḡa taudia edia amo taravatu e abia; ḡau tamona hahenamo ḡoeva-daena na idia edia amo bema vara, hahelaḡa tauna idauna ta, dia Aaron ena iduhu tauna a Melkisedek ena orea tauna, bema gini anina be dahaka?
HEB.7.11.english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

HEB.10.21.motu: Ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, Dirava ena ruma ita-taona.
HEB.10.21.english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

HEB.7.1.motu: Hari Melkisedek na Salem pavapavana bona Herea Mikamika Diravana ena hahelaḡa tauna. Ia na Abraham ida e hedavari, Abraham ese hanua pavapavadia iala-masedia amo e lou negana ai, bena e hanamoa.
HEB.7.1.english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

HEB.12.27.motu: Una hereva “nega gabena” anina binai: haine haheude-heude ḡaudia baine abi oho, e kara ḡaudia bunu; a basie heude-heude ḡaudia na do bae mia.
HEB.12.27.english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

HEB.9.27.motu: Taunimanima edia mase na tamona, murinai hahemaoro bae abia;
HEB.9.27.english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

HEB.12.20.motu: badina be asi edia haheauka una hahedua bae badinaia, eto, Mauri ḡauna ta ororo ai baine kau, nadi ai ba hodoa mase.
HEB.12.20.english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”. + 12:20 Exodus 19:12-13

HEB.6.2.motu: bapatiso herevadia; ima tubua ai ato kau herevadia; mase ihatore-isidia herevadia; mia hanaihanai hahemaorona herevadia.
HEB.6.2.english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

HEB.6.16.motu: Badina be taunimanima ese herea tauna ladana ai e gwau hamatamu; bena hereva ihamomokanilaina gwauhamatana ese edia hepapahuahu idoinai e hadokoamu.
HEB.6.16.english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

HEB.9.8.motu: Ini amo Lauma Helaḡa ese e hadibadiamu: Helaḡa Herea gabuna iraka-vareaina dalana do se hekeho, murimuri daiutuna dounu gini negana ai.
HEB.9.8.english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

HEB.3.9.motu: Una negana ai senemui ese e tohoguva,
HEB.3.9.english: where your fathers tested me and tried me,

HEB.11.31.motu: Abidadama dainai, Rahaba, mata-bodaga hahinena, na gwau-edeede taudia ida se mase, hasinadoa taudia maino ai e abidia dae dainai.
HEB.11.31.english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

HEB.11.17.motu: Abidadama dainai, hedibaḡani negana ai, Abraham ese Isaak e abia, boubou ḡauna ai e halaoa. Oibe, hari gwauhamata e abia daeva tauna ese natuna vara-edeana na boubou ḡauna ai baine halaoa eto.
HEB.11.17.english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

HEB.10.1.motu: Taravatu na ḡau namodia bae vara laulaudia mo, dia ḡau korikoridia. Idia ese hari boubou ḡaudia laḡani laḡani e hahelaḡamu. To taravatu na asi goadana ia ese e raka kahi maimu taudia baine hanamodia ḡuḡuru.
HEB.10.1.english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

HEB.9.15.motu: Taunabunai, ia na taravatu matamatana ena herohemaino tauna; taravatu gunana vada e tataia utu taudia na mase ta ai e hamauridiamu, bona e boiridia taudia na mia-hanaihanai ahudia e henidiamu, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena.
