HEB.9.15.english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

HEB.6.20.motu: unuseni ai e gunalaida tauna, Iesu, vada e raka vareai guna ita daidai, hahelaḡa tauna badana Melkisedek ena orea ai vada e hahelao, ela bona hanaihanai.
HEB.6.20.english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

HEB.11.8.motu: Abidadama dainai, Abraham ese boiboi e hakala henia, e boiria ena hanua baine rakatania, gabu ta bainela, baine abia ia ahuna, negana ai. Bena e raka lasi; ede bainela na asi dibana.
HEB.11.8.english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

HEB.10.24.motu: Baita helalolai heheni, bena baita hahealo heheni, Ialokau bona kara namodia baita havara.
HEB.10.24.english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

HEB.10.34.motu: Badina be e ḡuidia taudia o bogadia hisi, bona emui kohu e dadi negadia ai edia kara o abi dae mai moalemui ida; badina be dibamui emui kohu namo-hereana na mia hanaihanai.
HEB.10.34.english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

HEB.13.3.motu: Dibura rumadia ai e hekoumu taudia ba lalodia, umui danu idia idla bema koumui hebou na heto. E hahisidiamu taudia danu ba lalodia, badina be umui danu mai tau-animui.
HEB.13.3.english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

HEB.13.15.motu: Taunabunai, ia dainai daba daba idoidiai Dirava iheatolaina na eda boubou ḡauna ai baita haloa; ududa bibinadia ese ia ladana bae imodaia.
HEB.13.15.english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God + 13:15 Psalms 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

HEB.11.24.motu: Abidadama dainai Mose, tauna e lo ai, Farao natuna hahinena dihina bae gwauraia na e dadaraia;
HEB.11.24.english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

HEB.8.5.motu: Idia edia ḡaukara na guba ai e karamu ḡaukarana ihaheḡereḡerena bona laulauna mo. Dirava ese Mose e tamanua na heto, ḡuriḡuri kalagana baine karaia negana ai; eto, Nahuamu ba tohoa, ḡau iboudiai ba kara, ororo ai na haheitalaimu ḡaudia oromadia heḡereḡedia.
HEB.8.5.english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” + 8:5 Exodus 25:40

HEB.9.21.motu: Unuhetomana danu ia ese ḡuriḡuri kalagana bona helaḡa ḡaudia iboudiai rara ai e nevaridia.
HEB.9.21.english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

HEB.2.11.motu: Badina be hahelaḡa tauna bona e hahelaḡadia taudia na iduhu tamona; una dainai ia na asi ena hemarai ia tadina baine gwauraidia.
HEB.2.11.english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

HEB.11.4.motu: Abidadama dainai, Abel ese boubou ḡauna namona e hahelaḡaia, Kain ena e hereaia; bena Dirava ese ena herahia ḡauna e abia dae bona kara maoromaoro tauna e gwauraia. E mase, to ena abidadama dainai ia na doini e herevamu.
HEB.11.4.english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

HEB.11.13.motu: Idia iboudiai abidadama ai e mase; gwauhamata anina asie abia, a dauha amo e itaia bona e abia dae; sibodia danu e hegwaurai, idia na idau taudia bona noho-hedoahedoa taudia ina tanobada ai.
HEB.11.13.english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

HEB.3.14.motu: Badina be ita na Keriso bamona, una dainai eda heabidadama baita badinaia tarikatarika, matamana amo ela bona dokona.
HEB.3.14.english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

HEB.6.11.motu: A ai na a ura badamu umui iboumui ai ene ba goada toma, ela bona dokona ai emui helaro ba hagugurua.
HEB.6.11.english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

HEB.6.18.motu: Unu ḡau ruaosi na basie idau, bona unu ḡau ruaosi ai danu Dirava ese basine koida diba. Taunabunai ita na hahedika vada ta heautania, bona goada vada davaria, ita ese vairadai enle hure helarona baita kahua tao.
HEB.6.18.english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

HEB.1.11.motu: Idia na bae puki, a oi na o noho hanaihanaimu;
HEB.1.11.english: They will perish, but you continue.

HEB.9.19.motu: Badina be Mose ese taravatu ena haheḡani iboudiai na bese taudia iboudiai e herevalai henidiava; bena boromakau natudia raradia bona nani raradia bona ranu e abi, mamoe huina kakakakana bona husopo danu e abi, bena buka bona bese taudia iboudiai e nevarilaidia,
HEB.9.19.english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

HEB.11.38.motu: Tanobada na asi ena namo, idia na latanai bae noho. Tano ḡaḡaedia ai bona ororo ai e loava; kohua ai bona guri ai e nohova.
HEB.11.38.english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

HEB.7.24.motu: a ina hahelaḡa tauna na e noho hanaihanaimu, asi ibolona.
HEB.7.24.english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

HEB.3.6.motu: A Keriso ese Dirava ena bese e biagua mai kamonaina ida, badina be ia na natuna dainai. lta na iena bese, eda haheauka bona eda helaro moaledia ta badinamu dainai.
HEB.3.6.english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

HEB.10.12.motu: A Keriso ese boubou ḡauna tamona vada e hahelaḡaia, kara dika iabi-ohodia; bena Dirava idibana kahana ai vada e helai diho.
HEB.10.12.english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

HEB.7.23.motu: Ina danu: unu hahelaḡa taudia na hutuma, badina be mase ese e butudia taova, edia dagi ai basie noho hanaihanai;
HEB.7.23.english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

HEB.7.8.motu: Harihari, bae mase taudia ese kohu e karoadiamu, karoa ihagwautadia e abimu; a una negana ai, sivaraina e piuamu doini e maurimu e tomamu tauna ese e abiva.
HEB.7.8.english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

HEB.8.1.motu: Ai ese vada ame gwaurai herevadia anidia bini: ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, Herea Mikamika Diravana ena terono idibana kahana ai vada e helaimu, guba ai.
HEB.8.1.english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

HEB.11.20.motu: Abidadama dainai Isaak ese Iakob bona Esau e hanamodia, gabeai bae vara ḡaudia e gwaurai.
HEB.11.20.english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

HEB.11.29.motu: Abidadama dainai, eda bese taudia ese Davara Kakakakana e rakaia hanai, tano kaukauna ai bema raka na heto; a Aigupto taudia na unu bae kara toma eto negana ai e dono mamase.
HEB.11.29.english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

HEB.13.14.motu: Badina be iniseni ai ita na asi eda mia-hanaihanai hanuana, a mia-hanaihanai hanuana, gabeai baine hedinarai ḡauna, ta tahuamu.
HEB.13.14.english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

HEB.8.12.motu: Badina be edia kara dikadia lalodiai baina bogadia hisi,
HEB.8.12.english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness.

HEB.13.16.motu: Kara namo bona kohu iharina na basio rea, badina be Dirava ese helaḡa karadia enehetomadia e moalelaimu.
HEB.13.16.english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

HEB.10.16.motu: Lohiabada na e gwaumu: Unu dina muridiai,
HEB.10.16.english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them

HEB.4.12.motu: Badina na Dirava ena hereva na e maurimu, bona mai siahuna; ia ganona ese isena rua mai ganodia darena e hereaiamu. E hegwadamu ela bona dara bona Iauma e hapararadiamu, bona garugaru bona turia haradia danu e hapararadiamu. Eda lalo-hadai bona eda ura ia na dibana herea.
HEB.4.12.english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

HEB.9.5.motu: Maua daenai hairai kerubidia ese hebogahisi teronona e hakerukeruava. To unu ḡau harihari basia herevalai hagau-hagau diba.
HEB.9.5.english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

HEB.13.8.motu: Iesu Keriso na varani bona harihari dia idau, bona basine idau ela bona hanaihanai.
HEB.13.8.english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

HEB.11.19.motu: Badina be ia na e haeroa, Dirava na mai siahuna mase amo baine hatorea isi eto. Bena e abia lou, mase amo bema abia lou na heto.
HEB.11.19.english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

HEB.4.8.motu: Badina be Iosua ese laḡa-ani bema henidia, Dirava ese nega daudau murinai dina ta ma basinema herevalaia.
HEB.4.8.english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

HEB.2.15.motu: bona edia mauri dinadia iboudiai mase garina ese e ḡuidiamu taudia baine ruhadia nege helaoreana.
HEB.2.15.english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

HEB.5.2.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana ese lalo-duhu taudia bona kerere taudia e bogadia hisimu, badina be ia danu manoka-manoka ese e butua taomu;
HEB.5.2.english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

HEB.6.15.motu: Bena Abraham e haheauka taritariva ela bona gwauhamata anina e davaria.
HEB.6.15.english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

HEB.7.5.motu: Momokani, Levi natuna haida ese danu hahelaḡa dagina e abia, bena mai siahudia ida taunimanima edia kohu e karoadia, karoa ihagwautadia bae abi, taravatu heḡereḡerena. Ena be varavaradia, Abraham besena taudia, to e abi.
HEB.7.5.english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

HEB.2.7.motu: Oi ese o karaia, aneru ese sisina mo ia e hereaiamu;
HEB.2.7.english: You made him a little lower than the angels.

HEB.1.13.motu: A edena nega ai ia ese aneru ta e hereva henia, eto,
HEB.1.13.english: But which of the angels has he told at any time,

HEB.1.2.motu: a ini dina dokodia ai ia Natuna ena amo ita vada e hereva henida. Natuna bunai ḡau iboudiai vada e henia, ia ahuna; iena amo danu tanobada idoinai vada e kara.
HEB.1.2.english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

HEB.9.13.motu: Badina be nani raradia bona boromakau maruanedia raradia bona boromakau natudia lahi ese e ḡole oho kahudia amo na dika taudia bema ḡiḡidia tao, bena tau-anidia bema ḡoevaḡoeva;
HEB.9.13.english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

HEB.12.6.motu: Badina be Lohiabada ese e ura heniamu tauna matana e hakanimu,
HEB.12.6.english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines,

HEB.7.26.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana unuhetomana vada e namo ita eda: helaḡa tauna, asi ena dika, asi bebeka-bebekana, asi ahuna kara dika taudia ediai, guba doriva-dorivana ai vada e dae.
HEB.7.26.english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

HEB.8.6.motu: A harihari Keriso ese hereḡu dagina hereana vada e abia, dagi gunadia e hereadiamu; ina na iena herohemaino ese taravatu gunana e hereaiamu heḡereḡerena, badina be gwauhamata hereadia latadiai e hadaia dainai.
HEB.8.6.english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

HEB.10.30.motu: Badina be ita dibada daika eto “Dava ikarana be lau; lau ese dava baina heni”. Ma eto “Lohiabada ese ena bese taudia baine hahemaoro henidia”.
HEB.10.30.english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. + 10:30 Deuteronomy 32:35 Again, “The Lord will judge his people.” + 10:30 Deuteronomy 32:36; Psalms 135:14

HEB.9.28.motu: unuhetomana Keriso danu nega tamona boubou ḡauna ai vada e halaoa, hutuma edia kara dika ihuadia. Ma baine hedinarai lou, dia kara dika ihamaoromaorona totona, a mai helarodia ida e nariamu taudia ihamauridia.
HEB.9.28.english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

HEB.5.5.motu: Unuhetomana danu, Keriso na sibona se heimodai, hahelaḡa tauna badana dagina se abia, to dagi e henia Diravana eto,
HEB.5.5.english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him,

HEB.5.11.motu: Emai hereva momo mimia, ia herevana; ḡau tamona anidia igwauraidia na metau, badina be umui taiamui vada e kudima.
HEB.5.11.english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

HEB.7.16.motu: ena dagi danu vada e henia, dia tau-anina taravatuna ibadinana totona, a mauri hanaihanai siahuna ai.
HEB.7.16.english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

HEB.7.10.motu: badina be ia na tamana tau-anina ai, Melkisedek na tamana ida e hedavari negana ai.
HEB.7.10.english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

HEB.11.27.motu: Abidadama dainai, ia ese Aigupto e rakatania, hanua pavapavana ena badu garina se gariva; badina be ia na e haheauka, asita itaiamu Diravana vada e itaia na heto.
HEB.11.27.english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

HEB.7.9.motu: Bona e kara Levi, karoa ihagwautadia iabidia tauna, ese danu ena kohu karoana ihagwautana e henia na heto, Abraham dainai;
HEB.7.9.english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

HEB.7.21.motu: Idia na hahelaḡa taudia ai e halaodiava na asi edia gwauhamata, a ia na mai gwauhamatana ida hahelaḡa tauna ai e halaoa. E gwau hamata Diravana ese e hereva henia, eto,
HEB.7.21.english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him,

HEB.9.23.motu: Benaini, guba ḡaudia ihaheḡereḡeredia ḡaudia na ini helaḡa karadia amo e haḡoeva, a guba ḡaudia korikori na boubou namodia amo bae haḡoeva.
HEB.9.23.english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

HEB.5.13.motu: Rata inu merona na kara maoromaoro herevana asi dibana, badina be ia na karukaru.
HEB.5.13.english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

HEB.12.24.motu: bona Iesu dekenai, ia na taravatu matamatana ena herohemaino tauna; bona vada e nevarilaia rarana enai, ena hahenamo ese Abel rarana ena e hereaiamu.
HEB.12.24.english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, + 12:24 Jeremiah 31:31 and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

HEB.12.25.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, e hereva henimuimu tauna ba dadaraia na garina. Badina be tanobada ai e sisiba henidia tauna e dadaraia taudia na asi edia roho mauri dalana; benaini, ita na guba amo e sisiba henidamu tauna baita dadaraia, ede baita roho mauri tonma?
HEB.12.25.english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

HEB.7.20.motu: Bona ina na mai gwauhamata helaḡana.
HEB.7.20.english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

HEB.11.9.motu: Abidadama dainai gwauhamata tanona ai e noho hedoa-hedoava, Isaak bona Iakob ida kalaga ai e nohova; idia raruosi danu ia ida gwauhamata dihina taudia.
HEB.11.9.english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

HEB.7.2.motu: Abraham ese danu kohu e karoa, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ia e henia. Ia ladana gunana anina be Kara Maoromaoro Lohiana. Ma ladana ta Salema Pavapavana, anina be Maino Lohiana.
HEB.7.2.english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

HEB.3.13.motu: A daba daba idoidiai ba hahealo heheni, doini “Hari dina” ta gwauraiamu negana ai, kara dika ena koikoi ese lalomui baine ha-auka na garina.
HEB.3.13.english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

HEB.10.39.motu: A ita na dia raka-kerehai tauda, dia boio tauda; ita na kamonai tauda, laumada na do bae mauri.
HEB.10.39.english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

HEB.3.5.motu: Mose ese Dirava ena bese idoinai lalonai hesiai ḡaukarana e karaia ḡoevaḡoeva mai kamonaina ida, do bae gwaurai ḡaudia ihahedinaraidia.
HEB.3.5.english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

HEB.7.7.motu: A dibada vaitani, dagi maraḡina tauna na dagi badana tauna ese e hahenamo heniamu.
HEB.7.7.english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

HEB.4.3.motu: Badina be ita kamonai tauda na ena laḡa-ani ai ta raka vareaimu; ena hereva heḡereḡerena, eto,
HEB.4.3.english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” + 4:3 Psalms 95:11 although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

HEB.5.10.motu: Badina be Dirava ese e gwauraia, hahelaḡa tauna badana, Melkisedek ena orea ai.
HEB.5.10.english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

HEB.9.4.motu: Ia lalonai pata helaḡana ta gold ai e karaia, muramura mai bonana patana bunai; bona taravatu mauana ta danu gold ai e havavaia heḡeḡe; bona maua lalonai be gold kibona auta, anina be mana; bona Aaron ena itotohi, e gara kau ḡauna; bona taravatu nadidia danu una maua lalonai.
HEB.9.4.english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

HEB.9.17.motu: ena kohu iharidia herevadia na mai siahudia ena mase dainai, a ena mauri negana ai idia na asi siahudia.
HEB.9.17.english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

HEB.11.35.motu: Hahine ese danu edia mase taudia e davaridia lou, e tore isi lou dainai. Haida na e dadabadia maseva; a mauri e dadaraia, tore-isi-lou namo-hereana bae abia helaoreana.
HEB.11.35.english: Women received their dead by resurrection. + 11:35 1 Kings 17:17-23; 2 Kings 4:32-37 Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

HEB.1.14.motu: Ḡau tamona, idia iboudiai na hesiai laumadia, ani? Mauri bae abia taudia isiaidia ilaohenidia totona e siaidiamu.
HEB.1.14.english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

HEB.7.3.motu: Ia na asi tamana, asi sinana, asi iduhuna, asi ena vara dinana, asi ena mauri dokona; a Dirava Natuna ihaḡoina ai vada e halaoa, hahelaḡa tauna, e noho hanaihanaimu.
HEB.7.3.english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

HEB.10.3.motu: A unu boubou lalodiai idia ese laḡani ta ta amo edia kara dika e helalolai loulou.
HEB.10.3.english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

HEB.9.16.motu: Badina be tau ta dihina ese ahudia basie abi ela bona una tau baine mase momokani;
HEB.9.16.english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

HEB.4.16.motu: Benaini, hebogahisi teronona baita raka henia kahi, asi eda gari; bena baine bogada hisi, bona harihari-bada, eda dabu negadia ai baine kahada hariharina, baita abia.
HEB.4.16.english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

HEB.12.8.motu: Natu iboudiai matadia e hakanimu: bema oi na lasi, oi na ariara merona, dia natu-adora.
HEB.12.8.english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

HEB.10.7.english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me)

HEB.13.22.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na noimuimu, egu hahealo herevadia bavabi dae, badina be hereva dia hoho vada name tore henimui.
HEB.13.22.english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

HEB.10.32.motu: Nega gunadia ba helalolai: Ialomui e diariva murinai hisihisi momo ese e butumui taova, a o haheaukava.
HEB.10.32.english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

HEB.12.10.motu: Badina be idia ese dina dia hoho ai matadia e hakaniva, edia ura heḡereḡerena; a ia ese matada e hakanimu ita ihanamoda, ia ida baita helaḡa hebou helaoreana.
HEB.12.10.english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

HEB.8.7.motu: Badina be taravatu gunana bema asi kererena, iharuana bema asi badina.
HEB.8.7.english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

HEB.8.10.motu: Lohiabada ma e gwaumu: unu dina muridiai,
HEB.8.10.english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel

HEB.12.2.motu: Iesu baita raraia tao; ia ese eda abidadama e havaraiamu bona e haḡuḡuruamu; ia danu vairanai e hure moalena dainai satauro e haheaukalaia, hemaraina se laloa, bena Dirava ena terono idibana kahana ai vada e helaimu.
HEB.12.2.english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

HEB.10.36.motu: Badina be emui haheauka badina binai: Dirava ena ura ba karaia ḡuḡuru, bena gwauhamata anina do bavabia.
HEB.10.36.english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

HEB.9.1.motu: Taravatu gunana na mai ena toma-diho haheḡanidia bona mai ena dubu tanobada ai.
HEB.9.1.english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

HEB.6.3.motu: Dirava baine ura, ini na bae mia.
HEB.6.3.english: This will we do, if God permits.

HEB.8.9.motu: Dia senedia ida na karaia taravatuna heḡereḡerena,
HEB.8.9.english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers

HEB.1.8.motu: A Natuna e gwauraiamu, e tomu,
HEB.1.8.english: But of the Son he says,

HEB.13.7.motu: Ihakaumui taudia, Dirava ena hereva vada e hadibalaimui taudia, na ba lalodia; edia kara anina ba haeroa, bena edia abidadama ba haḡoia.
HEB.13.7.english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

HEB.10.17.english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.” + 10:17 Jeremiah 31:34

HEB.12.5.motu: Hahealo herevadia vada o lalo boio a, tamana ese natuna e sisiba henidiamu na heto e sisiba henimuimu, e tomu,
HEB.12.5.english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children,

HEB.10.23.motu: Eda helaro herevadia baita kahu tarika-tarika, basita raivaraiva, badina be e gwaurai hamata tauna ena gwauhamata na momokani.
HEB.10.23.english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

HEB.10.22.motu: Taunabunai, baita raka kahira mai laloda momokanidia ida bona mai kamonai lava-daena ida. Laloda na vada eme nevari; lalo-hadai dikadia vada eme heabi oho, tau-anida danu ranu negari-negari ai vada eme hehuri ḡoevaḡoeva.
HEB.10.22.english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

HEB.13.19.motu: Lau na noinoi henimuimu, unu ba kara toma, bena ma baina vasi haraḡa-haraḡa.
HEB.13.19.english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

HEB.2.16.motu: Momokani, ia na dia aneru se kahadia, a Abrahamgarana hari.
HEB.2.16.english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

HEB.9.25.motu: Bona ia na se raka vareai sibona boubou ḡauna ai bainela loulou, hahelaḡa tauna badana na heto, ia ese laḡani ta ta amo Helaḡa Herea gabuna lalonai e raka vareai, rara e vareailaia, to dia ia rarana.
HEB.9.25.english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

HEB.7.17.motu: Badina be ini e gwauraia tomamu:

HEB.9.14.motu: o Keriso rarana, Noho-hanaihanai Laumana dainai sibona Dirava e henia tauna rarana, asi bebeka-bebekana tauna rarana, siahuna basinema herea a, umui lalomui mase karadia amo bema haḡoeva, bona Mauri Diravana ena hesiai taudia ai bema halaomui ani?
HEB.9.14.english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

HEB.12.23.motu: hegogo badana, natu roboadia, ladadia guba ai e hetore taudia edia ekalesia e moale heboumu gabuna, taunimanima iboudiai edia Hahemaoro Diravana dekenai, kara maoromaoro ai vada e ḡoeva-dae taudia laumadia dekediai;
HEB.12.23.english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

HEB.2.10.motu: Ina na diaḡau namona, ena, bona ena amo, ḡau iboudiai e havaramu Diravana na, ia natuna loḡora hairai ai bema hakaudia vareai totona ese, edia Hahemauri Tauna na hisihisi amo bema hahereaia dae.
HEB.2.10.english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

HEB.3.16.motu: Daidia gadona e kamonai, to ena badu e havaraia? Mose ese Aigupto amo e hakaudia lasi taudia iboudiai, ani?
HEB.3.16.english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

HEB.12.22.motu: A umui vada o raka henia kahi gabuna be Siona ororona, Mauri Diravana ena hanua, guba Ierusalemana; aneru diaḡau duahi-duahi e heboumu gabuna;
HEB.12.22.english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

HEB.5.1.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia badadia iboudiai na taunimanima bogaragidia amo e abidia hidimu, taunimanima daidiai Dirava bae boua, herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia bae hahelaḡa, dika iabi-ohodia.
HEB.5.1.english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

HEB.11.39.motu: Ini iboudiai, ena be edia abidadama ese vada e hamomokanidia, to gwauhamata anidia asie abiva;
HEB.11.39.english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

HEB.7.15.motu: Ina na tame diba ḡoevaḡoeva, badina be hahelaḡa tauna idauna ta vada e vara, Melkisedek ihaḡoina;
HEB.7.15.english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

HEB.11.16.motu: To idia ese tano namo-hereana e hekisehekise heniamu; ia na guba ai. Taunabunai, Dirava na se hemaraimu edia Dirava bae gwauraia; badina be hanua ta ia ese vada e abia heḡaeḡae idia edia.
HEB.11.16.english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

HEB.11.18.motu: Merona bunai vada e herevalaia, eto, Isaak ena amo oi garamu do bae vara.
HEB.11.18.english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,” + 11:18 Genesis 21:12

HEB.1.4.motu: Ia ese aneru vada e hereadia, vada e henia ladana ese idia ladadia e hereadiamu heḡereḡerena.
HEB.1.4.english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

HEB.2.1.motu: Una dainai, ta kamonai herevadia nahuadia baita toho, nega ta baita huretani garina.
HEB.2.1.english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

HEB.7.19.motu: bona ḡau ta se haḡuḡurua. A helaro matamatana bona namo-hereana ese ia gabuna vada eme abia: unu amo Dirava ta raka henia kahimu.
HEB.7.19.english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

HEB.8.2.motu: Ia na helaḡa ḡaudia bona ḡuriḡuri kalagana korikori ireḡudia tauna: una kalaga na taunimanima ese asie taruhaia, a Lohiabada ese e taruhaia.
HEB.8.2.english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

HEB.10.38.motu: A kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kamonai dainai do baine mauri;
HEB.10.38.english: But the righteous one will live by faith.

HEB.6.1.motu: Badina bunai, Keriso ena hereva badidia baita rakatani, huahuadia baita ḡava. Badidia bini basita hagini loulou: kara asi anidia ihelalolai-kerehaidia; Dirava ibadinana;
HEB.6.1.english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

HEB.2.2.motu: Badina be aneru ese e gwaurai herevadia bema momokani, bona kara havara iboudiai bona gwau-edeede iboudiai bema mai davadia korikoridia,
HEB.2.2.english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

HEB.11.11.motu: Abidadama dainai Sara, ena be hane badana, to goada e davaria baine rogorogo; badina be e gwau henia hamata Diravana na ia ese e abidadama henia.
HEB.11.11.english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

HEB.10.15.motu: Lauma Helaḡa danu vada e hadibalaida; badina be ia eto,
HEB.10.15.english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

HEB.11.12.motu: Taunabunai tau ta, mase tauna na heto, ena amo bese badana vada e vara; una bese taudia na guba hisiudia heḡereḡeredia eiava kone rariana na heto, diaḡau duahi-duahi.
HEB.11.12.english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

HEB.11.21.motu: Abidadama dainai, Iakob ena mase vada e kahira-kahira, bena ia ese Iosef natuna raruosi e hanamodia; e loma diho danu, ena itotohi kwarana ai e goru kau.
HEB.11.21.english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

HEB.11.26.motu: Ia na e haeroa, Keriso dainai bae lodu henia na ḡau badana, Aigupto taudia edia taḡa e hereaia eto; badina be davana mo e haḡerea.
HEB.11.26.english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

HEB.12.15.motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ta ese Dirava ena harihari-bada baine reaia na garina; eiava ramu iditana ta baine kobo na garina, bena baine haturiamui, bona hutuma baine hadikadia;
HEB.12.15.english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

HEB.9.24.motu: Badina be Keriso vada e raka vareai dubuna na dia taunimanima imadia amo e karaia ḡauna dubu korikorina ihaheḡereḡerena, a guba ai vada e raka vareai, Dirava vairanai e hedinaraimu ita daidai.
HEB.9.24.english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

HEB.12.28.motu: Taunabunai, se heude-heudemu basaeiana na tame abia dainai, Dirava baita hanamoa, bona baita toma henia diho mai hematauraida ida bona mai garida ida, ia ihamoalena.
HEB.12.28.english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

HEB.9.20.motu: eto “Ina na Dirava ese vada e haḡanilaimui taravatuna rarana”.
HEB.9.20.english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.” + 9:20 Exodus 24:8

HEB.9.12.motu: E raka hanai, Helaḡa Herea gabuna ai e raka vareai vaitani, nega tamona mo; dia nani bona boromakau natudia raradia a ia sibona rarana e vareailaia, hahemauri hanaihanai e havaraia.
HEB.9.12.english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

HEB.12.9.motu: Ina danu: tamada ina tanobada ai ese matada e hakanimu, bena ta matauraidiamu; matona, laumada Tamadia na basita matauraia a, bena baita mauri?
HEB.12.9.english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

HEB.10.9.motu: Ma eto, Lau o ina, emu ura ikarana nama. Gini-gunana e abia ohomu, iharuana baine haginia helaoreana.
HEB.10.9.english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

HEB.12.17.motu: Badina be umui na dibamui, ia na gabeai hahenamo iabina e urava, to vada e dadaraia; ena be mai iruru-matana ida helalo-kerehai dalana e tahua, to se davaria.
HEB.12.17.english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

HEB.1.6.motu: Ma Natuna roboana tanobada ai e mailaia negana ai, ia eto,
HEB.1.6.english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.” + 1:6 Deuteronomy 32:43 LXX

HEB.6.10.motu: Badina be Dirava na asi ena kara gageva-gageva; emui ḡaukara bona emui lalokau ia ladana dainai vada o hahedinarai, helaḡa taudia o durudiava bona o durudiamu, ia ese basine lato boio.
HEB.6.10.english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

HEB.7.28.motu: Badina be taravatu ese manoka-manoka taudia na hahelaḡa taudia ai e halaodiava; a gwauhamata herevana, taravatu e gabelaia ḡauna, ese Natuna na hahelaḡa tauna badana ai vada e halaoa. Ia eme ḡoeva dae ela bona hanaihanai.
HEB.7.28.english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

HEB.10.28.motu: Tau ta ese Mose ena taravatu e tataia utumu, bena dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi ese e gwauraia hedinaraimu, una tau na baine mase, basie bogaia hisi.
HEB.10.28.english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

HEB.10.29.motu: Ede o laloa tomamu? Dirava Natuna vada e moia tao; bona herohemaino rarana, e hahelaḡaia ḡauna, na asi ena helaḡa ḡauna ai vada e halaoa; bona Harihari-bada Laumana vada e taoa tari tauna, na davana ede baine bada toma?
HEB.10.29.english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

HEB.2.4.motu: Bona Dirava danu vada e hahedinaraia, toa ai, hoa karadia ai, siahu karadia idau-idau ai, bona Lauma Helaḡa ena herahia ai, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
HEB.2.4.english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

HEB.9.9.motu: Una na hereva heḡereḡerena, ina nega ena. Herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia vada e hahelagamu, ḡau tamona idia na asi siahudia toma-diho tauna lalona ihaḡoevana.
HEB.9.9.english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

HEB.11.6.motu: A asi ena abidadama tauna na Dirava ihamoalena asi dibana. Badina be Dirava iraka-heni-kahina e uramu tauna ese baine abia dae guna Dirava na e maurimu, bona ia e tahuamu taudia davadia namodia baine henidia.
HEB.11.6.english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

HEB.3.2.motu: E siaia Diravana na ia ese e kamonai henia, Mose ese Dirava ena bese lalonai e kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
HEB.3.2.english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

HEB.6.5.motu: bona Dirava ena hereva namona bona mauri gabena siahuna e mami tohova,
HEB.6.5.english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

HEB.5.3.motu: una dainai, ia ese boubou ḡaudia baine hahelaḡa, dia taunimanima mo edia kerere daidiai, a ia sib-ona ena kerere daidiai danu.
HEB.5.3.english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

HEB.6.6.motu: taudia na bema keto, idia na basiema helalo kerehai lou diba; badina be idia sibodia ese Dirava Natuna vada e hasatauroa lou bona taunimanima vairadiai vada e hahemaraia.
HEB.6.6.english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

HEB.2.18.motu: Ia na hedibaḡani e mamiamu taudia idurudia mai dibana, badina be ia sibona ese hisihisi bona hedibaḡani mamidia e abi dainai.
HEB.2.18.english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

HEB.7.14.motu: Badina be tame diba eda Lohiabada be Iuda iduhuna amo e vara, a Mose ese hahelaḡa taudia haida una iduhu ai se gwauraidia.
HEB.7.14.english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

HEB.13.17.motu: Ihakaumui taudia ba kamonai henidia bona ba matauraidia. Badina be idia ese umui laumamui e gimadiamu, edia kara anidia bae gwaurai hedinarai taudia na heheto. Unu bae kara toma mai moaledia ida baine namo; a mai ḡanaḡanana ida bae karaia negana ai na emui ai anina taina basine vara.
HEB.13.17.english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

HEB.4.14.motu: Ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, guba ai vada e raka hanai; ia na Iesu, Dirava Natuna. Taunabunai, ia iabi-daena baita kahua tao.
HEB.4.14.english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

HEB.4.1.motu: Ena gwauhamata na doini mia, ena laḡa-ani ai baita raka vareai eto; to eda gari na umui haida bae itamu o ḡava tuna.
HEB.4.1.english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

HEB.13.5.motu: Lalomui ai moni basio hekisehekise henia, a dekemui ai mimia ḡaudia na bavabi, asi karikarimui; badina be Dirava eto, Lau na basina negemu bona basina rakatanimu, lasi ona lasi vaitani.
HEB.13.5.english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” + 13:5 Deuteronomy 31:6

HEB.4.4.motu: Badina be buka ta ai dina ihahituna e herevalaia, eto, Dirava na dina ihahituna ai ena ḡaukara iboudiai amo e laḡa ani.
HEB.4.4.english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;” + 4:4 Genesis 2:2

HEB.2.5.motu: Badina be mauri gabena, ai ese a herevalaiamu, na dia aneru se henidia bae biagua.
HEB.2.5.english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

HEB.11.32.motu: Ma dahaka aina gwauraia? Badina be asi egu nega Gideon bona Barak bona Samson bona Iefeta bona David bona Samuel bona peroveta taudia baina herevalaidia.
HEB.11.32.english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

HEB.12.3.motu: Kara dika taudia ese e inai henia, a ia ese e haheauka henidia. Una na ba haeroa, lalomui bae hesiku na garina, laumamui bae manori na garina.
HEB.12.3.english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

HEB.4.11.motu: Una dainai, una laḡa-ani ai baita raka vareai toho mai goadada ida, tau ta ese gwau-deede taudia baine haḡoidia bena baine keto na garina.
HEB.4.11.english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

HEB.6.7.motu: Badina be e diho louloumu medudia e inumu, bona aniani ḡaudia namodia e havaramu uma taudia edia, tanona ese Dirava ena hahenamo e abiamu.
HEB.6.7.english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

HEB.11.1.motu: Abidadama na ta laromu ḡaudia ihamomokanidia; bona abidadama dainai, asita daradaramu asita itadia ḡaudia ediai.
HEB.11.1.english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

HEB.11.30.motu: Abidadama dainai, Ieriko maḡuna na dina hitu e rakaia heḡeḡe, bena e keto.
HEB.11.30.english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

HEB.6.8.motu: A au ginigini bona ava ḡiniḡini e havaramu tanona ese hedadarai bona heuduguirai e abimu; dokona ai lahi ese baine ara ore.
HEB.6.8.english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

HEB.3.12.motu: Varavaragu e, nahuamui ba toho, ta ese lalona baine hadaia kerere, asi ena kamonai, bena Mauri Diravana baine rakatania na garina.
HEB.3.12.english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

HEB.10.18.motu: A unu kara bae gwaudia tao, kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia bae hahelaḡa na asi badina.
HEB.10.18.english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

HEB.11.33.motu: Idia ese abidadama dainai tanobada basileiadia e hadarerediava; kara maoromaoro e karava; gwauhamata e abiva; leona ududia e kouva;
HEB.11.33.english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, + 11:33 Daniel 6:22-23

HEB.13.20.motu: Maino Diravana, mamoe ireḡudia tauna badana, Iesu Keriso, miahanaihanai herohemainona rarana dainai mase amo e hatorea isi lou Diravana, ese
HEB.13.20.english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

HEB.8.8.motu: A Dirava ese kereredia e gwaurai, eto,
HEB.8.8.english: For finding fault with them, he said,

HEB.9.11.motu: A Keriso ema, vada e vara ḡaudia namodia edia hahelaḡa tauna badana. Bena ḡuriḡuri kalagana bada-hereana bona namo-hereana amo e raka hanai, dia taunimamima imadia e karaia ḡauna bona dia ina tanobada gauna.
HEB.9.11.english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

HEB.11.23.motu: Abidadama dainai, Mose e vara negana ai na tamana sinana ese hua toi e huniava, badina be e itaiava ia na raho-namo merona; hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani danu garina asie gariva.
HEB.11.23.english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

HEB.7.12.motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia bae idau, taravatu danu baine idau.
HEB.7.12.english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

HEB.1.5.motu: Edena nega ai Dirava ese aneru ta e hereva henia, eto,
HEB.1.5.english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time,

HEB.11.7.motu: Abidadama dainai Noa ese do se ita ḡaudia Dirava ese e sisibalai henia guna, bena Noa ese Dirava e kamonai henia, lagatoi auta e karaia. ena ruma taudia ihamauridia helaoreana. Unu amo ia ese tanobada e hahemaoro henia, bona abidadama amo e varamu kara maoromaorona na ia ahuna korikori ai e halaoa.
HEB.11.7.english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

HEB.13.9.motu: Hahediba herevadia idau-idau basie hakaumui kerere; badina be ina na namo, Dirava ena harihari-bada ese laloda baine ba-auka, dia aniani ḡaudia ese; unu ḡau ese e badinava taudia asie hanamodiava.
HEB.13.9.english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

HEB.12.19.motu: dia kibi reḡena bona gado. Una gado erena e kamonai taudia e noinoi, basine hereva henidia lou eto,
HEB.12.19.english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

HEB.4.7.motu: Una dainai ia ese dina ta ma e abia hidi, “Hari dina” e gwauraia; bena nega daudau vada e lao bubuni David ese ena hereva ma e gwauraia loumu, e tomu,
HEB.4.7.english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said),

HEB.12.16.motu: eiava bogaragimui ai tau ta baine heuda hanai na garina; eiava Dirava basine matauraia, Esau heḡereḡerena, ia ese Dirava se matauraia a ena roboa ahuna na nau tamona e hoilaia.
HEB.12.16.english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

HEB.1.1.motu: Hereva taidia taidia amo, idau dala idau dala ai, Dirava, ese idau nega ai peroveta taudia ududia amo seneda e hereva henidiava;
HEB.1.1.english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

HEB.4.6.motu: Benaini, haida do bae raka vareai; to sivarai namo e harorolai henidia guna taudia na edia gwau-edeede dainai asie raka vareai.
HEB.4.6.english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

HEB.11.3.motu: Abidadama dainai ita dibada Dirava ena hereva ese tanobada e karaia, bena ta itamu ḡaudia be asita itamu ḡaudia amo vada e vara.
HEB.11.3.english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

HEB.10.6.motu: Lahi ese e gole oho ḡaudia bona kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia so moalelaimu.
HEB.10.6.english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

HEB.3.1.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu helaḡamui e, umui danu Dirava ena boiboi ai e lalomui kau taumui, Iesu ba haeroa. Eda kamonai ai, ia na Dirava ese e siaia, eda hahelaḡa tauna badana.
HEB.3.1.english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

HEB.11.36.motu: Ma haida e ḡonaḡonalaidiava, e kwadidiava, e ḡuidiava, dibura rumadia ai e koudiava.
HEB.11.36.english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

HEB.5.14.motu: A aniani korikori be taudia vada e lo taudia adia; idia na lalodia vada eme manada, namo bona dika toadia na mai dibadia.
HEB.5.14.english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

HEB.10.20.motu: Ia ese dala matamatana, mauri dalana, vada e kehoa ita eda; seseahu e hanaiamu, ia tau-anina bunai.
HEB.10.20.english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

HEB.12.26.motu: Una negana ai ia gadona ese tanobada e haheude-heudea; a harihari eme gwau hamata, e tomu, Nega gabena ai dia tanobada mo to guba danu baina haheude-heudea.
HEB.12.26.english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.” + 12:26 Haggai 2:6

HEB.10.35.motu: Taunabunai, emui boga auka basio negea; ia davana baine bada.
HEB.10.35.english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

HEB.3.18.motu: Ma daidia ia ese e gwau henidia hamata, ena laḡa-ani ai basie raka vareai eto? Cwau-edeede taudia, ani?
HEB.3.18.english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

HEB.11.25.motu: ia na Dirava ena bese taudia ida bae dika bou e ura bada, kara dika moaledia, asie mia daudau ḡaudia, e ura maraḡi.
HEB.11.25.english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

HEB.13.6.english: So that with good courage we say,

HEB.11.22.motu: Abidadama dainai Iosef danu, ena mauri dokona ai, Israel besena edia raka lasi e gwauraia guna, bona ia turiana e hahedualai.
HEB.11.22.english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

HEB.1.3.motu: Ia bunai Dirava hairaina diari-diarina bona anitarana ihaheḡereḡerena; ia bunai ḡau iboudiai e abi isimu, ena siahu herevadia amo; ia sibona ese eda kara dika e haḡoeva vaitani, bena Herea Mikamika idibana kahana ai vada e helai, guba ai.
HEB.1.3.english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

HEB.13.23.motu: Ba diba, varavarada Timoteo vada e ruhaia nege. Ia bema mai haraḡa, raruosi baiama vasi itamui.
HEB.13.23.english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

HEB.6.17.motu: Unuhetomana, Dirava na e urava gwauhamata dihina taudia bae diba ḡoevaḡoeva iena Ialo-hadai basine idau; una negana ai ia ese hereva helaḡana amo e gwau hamata henidia.
HEB.6.17.english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

HEB.6.19.motu: Una helaro na laumada dogona na heto, se idaumu bona se mareremu, seseahu unukahanai e vareaimu;
HEB.6.19.english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

HEB.9.7.motu: A laloma daiutuna be hahelaḡa tauna badana mo sibona laḡani ta lalonai nega tamona e raka vareai, rara e vareailaia, e hahelaḡaia, ia sibona dainai, bona bese taudia edia kara kerere-kerere daidiai.
HEB.9.7.english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

HEB.9.26.motu: Unu bema heto, Keriso na nega diaḡau bema hisihisi, tanobada matamana ema bona harihari. A ia be nega tamona, ina nega dokona ai, vada eme hedinarai, sibona boubou ḡauna ai vada ela, dika iabiohona.
HEB.9.26.english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

HEB.13.10.motu: Ita na mai eda pata helaḡana, a ḡuriḡuri kalagana ena hahelaḡa taudia na unu amo basie aniani diba.
HEB.13.10.english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

HEB.3.17.motu: Bona laḡani hari-ahui e badu henidiava taudia be daidia? Kara dika taudia, tano ḡaḡaena ai e mase ore, ani.
HEB.3.17.english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

HEB.4.5.motu: Ma ina gabu ai eto, Egu laḡaani ai basie raka vareai.
HEB.4.5.english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” + 4:5 Psalms 95:11

HEB.8.13.motu: Taravatu matamatana iherevalaina ai, ia ese gunana na vada e ore ḡauna ai e halaoa. Bona siahuna e ore ḡauna, ḡau gunana, vada be pukimu.
HEB.8.13.english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

HEB.4.9.motu: Taunabunai, dina helaḡa ena laḡa-ani na doini mia, Dirava ena orea taudia edia.
HEB.4.9.english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

HEB.1.12.motu: Hetaru dabuana na heto oi ese ba loku, vada bae idau;
HEB.1.12.english: You will roll them up like a mantle,

HEB.4.10.motu: Badina be ena laḡa-ani ai e raka vareaimu tauna ese ena ḡaukara amo e laḡa animu, Dirava ese iena ḡaukara amo e laga aniva na helo.
HEB.4.10.english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

HEB.7.25.motu: Badina bunai ia na mai goadana, ia bagunai Diravana e raka henia kahimu taudia baine hamauridia ḡuḡuru, badina be e noho hanaihanaimu, bona ita daidai e noinoi hanaihanaimu.
HEB.7.25.english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

HEB.9.6.motu: Unu ḡau be unu e seu toma; bena hahelaḡa taudia na murimuri daiutuna lalonai e raka vareai loulou, boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia.
HEB.9.6.english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

HEB.9.2.motu: Badina be ḡuriḡuri kalagana e karaia, murimuri daiutuna ai be lamepa iato-kauna ḡau bona pata bona Dirava vairanai e atoa flaoana; una na gabu helaḡana e gwauraia.
HEB.9.2.english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

HEB.10.2.motu: Bema mai goadana, boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia na bema doko, ani? Badina be toma-diho taudia bema ḡoeva vaitani, idia na kara dika basiema lalo lou.
HEB.10.2.english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

HEB.3.19.motu: Taunabunai vada tame diba, asi edia kamonai dainai asie raka vareai.
HEB.3.19.english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

HEB.3.10.motu: Badina bunai, una uru na badu heniava,
HEB.3.10.english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation,

HEB.8.4.motu: Tanobada ai bema noho, ia na hahelaḡa tauna ai basinema lao; badina be hahelaḡa taudia haida nonoho, idia ese boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡamu, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
HEB.8.4.english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

HEB.10.25.motu: Eda hegogo karadia danu basita nege, haida ese e nege heḡereḡerena, a baita hahealo heheni; oibe, ina kara baita habadaia, badina be, o itaiamu, dina badana eme kahikahi.
HEB.10.25.english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

HEB.10.10.motu: Una ura ese vada e hahelaḡada, Iesu Keriso tau-anina nega tamona mo boubou ḡauna ai vada e halaoa dainai.
HEB.10.10.english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

HEB.10.8.motu: Ena hereva gini-gunana eto, Helaḡa karadia bona boubou ḡaudia bona lahi ese e ḡole oho ḡaudia bona kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia so uramu bona so moalelaimu. Ḡau tamona idia ese taravatu heḡereḡerena ai vada e hahelaḡamu.
HEB.10.8.english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

HEB.12.29.motu: Badina be ita eda Dirava na lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka.
HEB.12.29.english: for our God is a consuming fire. + 12:29 Deuteronomy 4:24

HEB.11.14.motu: Unu e hereva tomamu taudia na edia hereva anina eme hedinarai: idia ese edia tano korikori e tahuamu.
HEB.11.14.english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

HEB.10.5.motu: Taunabunai, Keriso na tanobada ema, eto,
HEB.10.5.english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says,

HEB.5.9.motu: ela bona e namo ḡuḡuru; bena ia ikamonai-henina taudia iboudiai edia mauri hanaihanai ihavarana tauna ai ela.
HEB.5.9.english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

HEB.10.11.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai dina ta ta amo e ginimu, helaḡa karadia e karamu, boubou ḡaudia tamodia e hahelaḡa louloumu. Ḡau tamona, unu helaḡa ḡaudia ese kara dika basie abi oho diba.
HEB.10.11.english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

HEB.5.12.motu: Nega vada eme gini dae, umui na hahediba taumui ai boma lao, to doini o dabumu; ta ese Dirava ena hereva badidia bema hadibalaimui lou bema namo. Umui na doini rata inu memerodia na heheto; aniani korikori ianidia na asi goadamui.
HEB.5.12.english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

HEB.13.1.motu: Heura-heheni na bogaragimui ai baine hesiriu.

HEB.13.11.motu: Badina be mauri ḡaudia raradia na hahelaḡa tauna badana ese Helaḡa Herea gabuna ai e vareailaia, kara dika iabi-ohodia, a tau-anidia na taruha murimurinai e ḡole oho.
HEB.13.11.english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. + 13:11 Leviticus 16:27

HEB.13.4.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai es headava bae matauraia, mahuta gedana basie hadikaia; badina be Dirava ese herahe-dadi taudia bona heudahanai taudia do baine hahemaoro henidia.
HEB.13.4.english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

HEB.13.24.motu: Ihakaumui taudia iboudiai bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai ba hanamodia. Italia taudia ese e hanamomuimu.
HEB.13.24.english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

HEB.13.25.motu: Harihari-bada be iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
HEB.13.25.english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

HEB.5.8.motu: Ena be ia na Dirava Natuna to hisihisi ese Dirava ikamonai-henina e hadibaiava,
HEB.5.8.english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

HEB.9.22.motu: Oibe; taravatu henuna ḡaudia momo herea rara ese e haḡoevadiamu; bona rara basinema hebubu, dika igwau-taodia bema lasi.
HEB.9.22.english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

HEB.3.7.motu: Badina bunai Lauma Helaḡa na e tomu,
HEB.3.7.english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says,

HEB.3.3.motu: A ia ese hairai badana vada e abia, Mose ese hairai maraḡina e abia. Una danu namo; heḡereḡerena be ruma ikarana tauna e matauraia badamu, a e karaia rumana e matauraia maraḡimu.
HEB.3.3.english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

HEB.6.9.motu: A lalokau e, ena be ini a hereva tomamu, to lalomai e tomamu hahemauri badina ḡaudia namodia na lalomui ai vada mimia.
HEB.6.9.english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

HEB.8.3.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia badadia iboudiai vada e duanaidia, herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia bae boudia; taunabunai, ina hahelaḡa tauna badana danu mai ena herahia ḡauna.
HEB.8.3.english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

HEB.11.28.motu: Abidadama dainai ia ese Lagau Hanai karana e badinaia, rara danu e nevari, ala-ala aneruna ese memero roboadia basine aladia mase helaoreana.
HEB.11.28.english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

HEB.9.3.motu: Seseahu iharuana lalonai be Helaḡa Herea daiutuna ta e gwauraia hidi.
HEB.9.3.english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

HEB.12.4.motu: Umui na kara dika ilao-ahuna o goada-laiamu; to do asio laoa ahu ela bona raramui e hebubu.
HEB.12.4.english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

HEB.10.26.motu: Badina be hereva momokani vada ta diba vaitani murinai ma baita kara havara, boubou ḡauna ta dia mia eda kara dika iabi-ohodia;
HEB.10.26.english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

HEB.12.13.motu: Aemui edia dala maoromaorodia ba kara, bena ae-hedairike na basine heride, a baine namo.
HEB.12.13.english: and make straight paths for your feet, + 12:13 Proverbs 4:26 so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

HEB.6.4.motu: Gunaguna lalodia e diariva, bona guba hariharina e mamia tohova, bona Lauma Helaḡa enai ahudia e abiva,
HEB.6.4.english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

HEB.7.18.motu: Benaini, taravatu gunana vada eme heabi oho, badina be ia na manokamanoka bona asi anina,
HEB.7.18.english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

HEB.6.14.motu: eto, Momokani baina hanamomu, garamu danu baina hahutumadia.
HEB.6.14.english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” + 6:14 Genesis 22:17

HEB.2.17.motu: Una dainai ia na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai tadina ida e heḡereḡere, hahelaḡa tauna badana ai bainela, mai ena hebogahisi bona mai ena kara maoromaoro Dirava ena ḡaukara lalonai, taunimanima edia dika iabi-ohona.
HEB.2.17.english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

HEB.13.13.motu: Taunabunai, ita na ia dekena baitala, taruha murimurinai, ia hemaraina danu baita huaia.
HEB.13.13.english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

HEB.11.2.motu: Badina be edia abidadama daulai Dirava ese sene taudia e hanamodiava.
HEB.11.2.english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

HEB.7.6.motu: A ia, ena be dia idia edia iduhu tauna, to Abraham ena kohu karoana ihagwautana e abia, bona Dirava ese e gwau hamata henia tauna na ia ese e hahenamo henia.
HEB.7.6.english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

HEB.5.4.motu: Bona tau ta ese ina dagi namona sibona se abiamu; a Dirava ese e boiriamu, Aaron e boiria heḡereḡerena.
HEB.5.4.english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

HEB.4.13.motu: Mauri ḡauna ta ia vairana amo basine hehuni diba; ḡau iboudiai na ia, e hahemaoro henidamu Diravana, vairanai hehedinararai.
HEB.4.13.english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

HEB.11.34.motu: Iahi siahuna e habodoava; dare matana amo e roho mauriva; manoka-manoka e negeava, goada e abiava; tuari ai e kwalimuva, inai taudia edia tuari oreadia e hahavadia.
HEB.11.34.english: quenched the power of fire, + 11:34 Daniel 3:1-30 escaped the edge of the sword, + 11:34 1 Kings 19:1-3; 2 Kings 6:31—7:20 from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

HEB.10.31.motu: Mauri Diravana imana ese baine butuda tao na mai garina.
HEB.10.31.english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

HEB.12.1.motu: Taunabunai, herarai taudia hutuma bada ese e ḡeḡeda ahumu dainai, e hametaudamu ḡaudia idoidiai bona e kahuda taomu karadia dikadia baita ato tabe, bena heau-helulu vairadai e hure na baita heau mai haheaukada ida.
HEB.12.1.english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

HEB.12.7.motu: Benaini, mata hakani ai ba haheauka; Dirava ese e karamui natu-adora heḡereḡeredia. Badina be edena mero na tamana ese matana se hakaniamu?
HEB.12.7.english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

HEB.1.9.motu: Kara maoromaoro vada o ura henia,
HEB.1.9.english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity;

HEB.5.6.motu: Ia danu ma e hereva, eto,
HEB.5.6.english: As he says also in another place,

HEB.11.15.motu: Badina be e rakatania tanona bema laloa, reana edia lou dalana bema davaria.
HEB.11.15.english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

HEB.5.7.motu: Ia tanobada ai e nohova dinadia ai, Iesu ese mase amo baine hamauria diba Diravana na e ḡuriava bona e noiava, mai taina bona mai irurumatana ida; bena Dirava garina e gariva dainai ena noinoi ḡauna e abia.
HEB.5.7.english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

HEB.3.11.motu: Bena egu badu ai na gwau hamata,
HEB.3.11.english: As I swore in my wrath,

HEB.4.15.motu: Badina be eda hahelaḡa tauna badana na dia eda manoka-manoka mamina iabina asi dibana tauna. Ḡau iboudiai ese ia e dibaḡaniava, ita e dibaḡanidamu heḡereḡerena; to ia na asi ena kara dika.
HEB.4.15.english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

HEB.9.10.motu: Badina be edia siahu badidia be ini mo; aniani gaudia, inuinu ḡaudia, digu karadia haida, tau-anina taravatudia; e hagini, taunimanima ese bae badina ela bona hahematamata negana.
HEB.9.10.english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

HEB.7.27.motu: Ia na dia unu hahelaḡa taudia badadia na heheto: idia ese daba iboudiai boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiava, guna idia sibodia edia dika irohodia, gabe amo hanua taudia edia dika irohodia. A ia ese nega tamona boubou ḡauna e hahelaḡaia vaitani, ia sibona boubou ḡauna ai e hahelao negana ai.
HEB.7.27.english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

HEB.10.19.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, asi eda daradara Helaḡa Herea gabuna lalonai baita raka vareai, Iesu rarana dainai.
HEB.10.19.english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

HEB.12.11.motu: Ina harihari mata hakani na asi ena moale bona mai ena hisihisi; a gabeamo vada e hamanadadia taudia ediai huahuana do baine dobi, kara maoromaoro ena maino.
HEB.12.11.english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

HEB.10.13.motu: Una negana ema vada e henarimu, ela bona ia inaina na aena ihadaidia ḡaudia ai baine halaodia.
HEB.10.13.english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

HEB.9.18.motu: Unuhetomana, taravatu gunana danu rara ese e hamomokania.
HEB.9.18.english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

HEB.11.40.motu: badina be Dirava ese ḡau namo-hereana vada e seua, idia sibodia ese basie abia, a idia ita ida ese baita abia hebou, baine hanamoda ḡuḡuru.
HEB.11.40.english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

HEB.7.22.motu: Taunabunai, Iesu na herohemaino matamatana ihamomokanina.
HEB.7.22.english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

HEB.12.18.motu: Umui vada o raka henia kahi gabuna na dia ba daua toho ḡauna, dia lahi hururu-hururuna, dia dibura bona dagadaga bona lahi badana,
HEB.12.18.english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

HEB.10.4.motu: Badina be boromakau mamaruanedia raradia bona nani raradia ese kara dika basie abi oho diba.
HEB.10.4.english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

HEB.11.37.motu: Nadi ai e hododia maseva, e iridia utuva, dare ai e aladia maseva. Mamoe kopidia bona nani kopidia e riova, e loava; e ogoḡamiva; e hisihisiva; taunimanima ese e hadikadiava.
HEB.11.37.english: They were stoned. + 11:37 2 Chronicles 24:20-21 They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. + 11:37 Jeremiah 26:20-23; 1 Kings 19:10 They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

HEB.8.11.english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen

HEB.3.4.motu: Badina be ruma iboudiai na mai ikaradia taudia, a ḡau iboudiai ikaradia be Dirava.
HEB.3.4.english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

ISA.41.12.english: You will seek them, and won’t find them,

ISA.37.21.english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

ISA.41.27.motu: Siona vada na gwaurai henia guna, q2 sivarai namo igwauraina tauna ta Ierusalem na heniamu.
ISA.41.27.english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’

ISA.5.14.motu: Una dainai Mase Gabuna e gadomu,
ISA.5.14.english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire,

ISA.24.22.english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

ISA.40.9.motu: Sivarai namona Siona o gwaurai heniamu taumu e,
ISA.40.9.english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain.

ISA.45.20.motu: Basileia kwabukwabumui e, a hegogo mai;

ISA.44.18.motu: Idia na asi dibadia, lalodia na asie pararamu; badina be ia ese matadia vada e hakapudia, bena basie itaia diba, bona lalodia vada e haduhudia, bena lalodia na basie parara diba.
ISA.44.18.english: They don’t know, neither do they consider,

ISA.32.10.english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women;

ISA.1.10.english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom!

ISA.19.11.english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

ISA.51.7.english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness,

ISA.22.14.motu: Iehova Sabaota ese vada e hahedinarai henigu,
ISA.22.14.english: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

ISA.65.13.motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

ISA.51.11.motu: Iehova ese vada e davalaidia taudia na bae lou mai,
ISA.51.11.english: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return,

ISA.26.7.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna ena raka dalana na e hedaga maoro;
ISA.26.7.english: The way of the just is uprightness.

ISA.29.6.motu: Iehova Sabaota ese baine vadivadi henimu taku,
ISA.29.6.english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

ISA.63.8.motu: Badina be ia eto “Momokani idia na lauegu bese,
ISA.63.8.english: For he said, “Surely, they are my people,

ISA.5.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota ena gwauhamata na kamonai, eto:
ISA.5.9.english: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate,

ISA.48.11.motu: Lau sibogu daigu ai na karaiamu, lau sibogu daigu ai,

ISA.3.1.motu: A itaia, Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese
ISA.3.1.english: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support,

ISA.33.24.motu: bona hanua tauna ta basineto “E goreregumu”.
ISA.33.24.english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.”

ISA.21.4.motu: Daragu e dokomu, gari ese e butugu taomu;
ISA.21.4.english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

ISA.59.17.motu: Kara maoromaoro na e dokia, kemena aurina,
ISA.59.17.english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate,

ISA.61.10.motu: Lau ese Iehova baina moalelaia bada,
ISA.61.10.english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh!

ISA.46.11.motu: Kasiri aniani manuna ta mairiveina kahana amo na boiria,
ISA.46.11.english: I call a ravenous bird from the east,

ISA.26.16.motu: Iehova e, hisihisi ai oi e tahumu;
ISA.26.16.english: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you.

ISA.3.4.motu: Memero na edia lohia ai baina halaodia,
ISA.3.4.english: I will give boys to be their princes,

ISA.22.11.motu: Ranu ihabouna gabunana maḡu ruaosi padadiai o karaia, gohu gunana ranuna ihabouna. A ikarana tauna asio haḡerea, bona idau nega ai e laloa hata tauna na asio kamonai henia.
ISA.22.11.english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

ISA.54.3.motu: Badina be umui na ba pere rohoroho, idiba kahana ai bona lauri kahana ai,
ISA.54.3.english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left;

ISA.42.25.motu: Taunabunai ia ese ena badu ḡaraḡarana na ia latanai e bubua,
ISA.42.25.english: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him,

ISA.1.29.motu: Badina be oak audia, o moalelaiva ḡaudia, daidiai ba hemarai,
ISA.1.29.english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired,

ISA.6.9.motu: Bena ia eto, Aola, ina bese ba hamaoroa, baoto:
ISA.6.9.english: He said, “Go, and tell this people,

ISA.43.9.english: Let all the nations be gathered together,

ISA.20.1.motu: Tuari lohiana Saragono, Asuria pavapavana ese e siaia mai tauna, na Asdod ema, e tuari henia, bena e abia.
ISA.20.1.english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

ISA.23.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota ese e lalo hadailaia,
ISA.23.9.english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

ISA.45.2.motu: Lau na oi vairamu ai bainala,

ISA.30.21.motu: Bona idibamui kahana ai eiava laurimui kahana ai ba raka siri negana ai, taiamui na hereva ta murimui kahana amo bae kamonai, baineto, Dalana binai, ia lalonai ba raka.
ISA.30.21.english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

ISA.23.6.english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

ISA.14.13.english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

ISA.62.2.motu: Basileia idau-idau ese oi igwaurai-maoromu bae itaia,
ISA.62.2.english: The nations will see your righteousness,

ISA.9.7.motu: Ena heregu ihabadana bona maino daladia
ISA.9.7.english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

ISA.28.21.motu: Badina be Iehova baine tore-isi, Perasimi ororona ai heḡereḡerena;
ISA.28.21.english: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

ISA.9.1.motu: A hisihisi ese e gugubaiava hahinena na vabura ai basinela. Nega gunana ai ia ese Sebulun bona Napatali tanodia na hedadarai gabudia ai e halaodia; a nega gabena ai ia ese davara dalana, loridane sinavaina unukahana tanona, bese idau-idau edia Galilea, baine hahairaia.
ISA.9.1.english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

ISA.66.21.motu: Iehova ma e tomu, Haida danu baina abidia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ai baina halaodia.
ISA.66.21.english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says Yahweh.

ISA.43.12.english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown,
