ISA.61.3.motu: Vada e siaigu, Siona ai e taitaimu taudia iboudiai na
ISA.61.3.english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion,

ISA.45.18.motu: Badina be Iehova, guba ikarana Diravana,
ISA.45.18.english: For Yahweh who created the heavens,

ISA.54.12.motu: kogemu na kadakodo nadidia amo baina kara,
ISA.54.12.english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies,

ISA.39.3.motu: Bena peroveta tauna Isaia na King Hesekia dekena ema, e nanadaia, eto, Unu tatau na dahaka e gwaurai? Bona ede amo oi dekemu ema? Hesekia eto, Gabu daudau amo vada ema, Babulono amo.
ISA.39.3.english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?”

ISA.51.5.motu: Egu haheroho-mauri na e kahi mai haraḡamu,

ISA.23.13.motu: Kaldea tanona a itaia; besena bunai, dia Asuria. Turo na uda boromadia edia gabu ai bae halaoa eto. Idia ese tano na hanuana e lareba henia: ena lohia rumadia e haheḡiḡidia dobi, bona hanuana e habuaia tari.
ISA.23.13.english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

ISA.41.15.motu: A itaia, lau ese uit ikwadilaina auna ai baina halaomui,
ISA.41.15.english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth.

ISA.54.4.motu: Basio gari, badina be oi na basio hemarai;
ISA.54.4.english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed.

ISA.33.8.motu: Laolao daladia na e mia ḡaḡaemu;

JAS.4.15.motu: Matona, boma toma “Lohiabada baine ura, ita na baita mauri, ini unu baita kara toma”.
JAS.4.15.english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

JAS.4.5.motu: Eiava lalomui ai o tomamu revareva helaḡana na e gwau kavamu a? E tomamu, Laloda ai e hanohoa laumana ese e ura henida lalo-dikamu.
JAS.4.5.english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

JAS.1.9.motu: Ekalesia tauna ogoḡamina baine moale, Dirava ese baine abia isi negana ai.
JAS.1.9.english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

JAS.5.11.motu: Ta tomamu haheauka taudia na nanamo, ani? Iobu ena haheauka harina vada o kamonai, bona Lohiabada ena kara vada o itaia, ena hegbogahisi bona ena hariharibada vada e bada herea.
JAS.5.11.english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

JAS.1.8.motu: badina be lalo rua tauna na ena kara iboudiai asie gini tutuka-tutukamu.
JAS.1.8.english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

JAS.2.5.motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, a kamonai. Dirava ese tanobada ai e ogoḡamimu taudia vada e abidia hidimu ani? Edia taḡa na edia abidadama; bona ahudia na vada e gwauraia hamata basileiana, e ura heniamu taudia na baine henidia e tomamu, ani?
JAS.2.5.english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

JAS.3.2.motu: Badina be ita iboudai ta hekwakwanai louloumu; tau ta ena hereva ai se hekwakwanaimu, ia na ḡoeva-dae tauna, tau-anina ireḡuna na mai dibana.
JAS.3.2.english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

JAS.1.1.motu: Lau Iakobo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna bona Iesu Keriso ena danu, veve gwauta-rarua taumui, idau tano idau tano ai o noho hedoa-hedoamu, na hahenamo henimuimu.
JAS.1.1.english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

JAS.2.8.motu: Benaini, haheḡani herea-daena ba badinaia, buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto “Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena”. Unu ba kara toma, vada ba namo.
JAS.2.8.english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” + 2:8 Leviticus 19:18 you do well.

JAS.3.5.motu: Unuhetomana, mala be ḡau maragina, to e heaḡi badamu. Lahi danu ba haeroa, ia na maraḡi to uda badana e araiamu.
JAS.3.5.english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

JAS.1.17.motu: harihari ḡaudia namodia iboudiai bona herahia ḡaudia ḡoeva-daedia iboudiai na atai amo e maimu, diari idoidiai ihavaradia Diravana ena amo e dihomu; iena diari na se idaumu bona se kerekeremu.
JAS.1.17.english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

JAS.5.5.motu: Umui na tanobada ai o mauri nohomu mai namomui ida, bona o kara lebulebumu; bona bogamui vada e kunumu ala-ala dinana ai.
JAS.5.5.english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

JAS.5.12.motu: A varavaragu e, herea-daena binai: hereva metaudia amo basio gwau hamata; guba eiava tanobada eiava idau ḡau ta ladana ai basio gwau hamata; guba eoiaba tanpobada eioava idau ḡau ta ladana ai basio gwau hamata. A emui “oibe” baine oibe, bona emui “lasi” baine lasi, baine hahemaoro henimui na garina.
JAS.5.12.english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

JAS.1.14.motu: A taunimanima ta sibona ena ura dikadia ese lalona e aniamu bona e koiamu.
JAS.1.14.english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

JAS.1.3.motu: Dibamui, emui abidadama itohona ese haheauka e havaraiamu.
JAS.1.3.english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

JAS.5.17.motu: Elia na taunimanima mo, ila bamoda; to ia na e ḡuriḡuri goadagoadava medu basine diho, bena medu na tanobada latanai se dihova, laḡani toi hua tauratoi lalodiai.
JAS.5.17.english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

JAS.1.4.motu: A haheauka ese ena ḡaukara baine haḡuḡurua baine namo, bena ba ḡoeva dae bona ba namo ḡuḡuru, ḡau ta ai basio dabu.
JAS.1.4.english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

JAS.5.18.motu: Ma e ḡuriḡuri louva, bena medu na guba amo e dihova, bona tano ese anina e havaraiava.
JAS.5.18.english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

JAS.1.6.motu: To abidadama ai baine noinoi, basine daradara; badina be daradara tauna na davara hurehurena na heto, lai ese e hohoamu bona e haginiamu.
JAS.1.6.english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

JAS.2.17.motu: Unuhetomana, kamonai asi ena kara vada e mase, badina be sibona.
JAS.2.17.english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

JAS.3.3.motu: Hosi ududia ai idogotaodia auridia ta atomu, bae kamonai henida helaoreana; bena taudia idoidiai ta hatatadia kerehaimu.
JAS.3.3.english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

JAS.2.6.motu: To umui ese ogoḡami tauna vada o hahemaraia. Taḡa taudia ese e daḡedaḡe henimuimu ani? Hahemaoro gabudia ai e dabuimui vareaimu ani?
JAS.2.6.english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

JAS.2.12.motu: Ba hereva bona ba kara, ura kwalimu taravatuna ese baine hahemaoro henidia taudia na heheto.
JAS.2.12.english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

JAS.4.6.motu: A ia ese ena harihari-bada e heni louloumu. Una dainai ma e tomamu, Dirava ese hekokoroku taudia e laodia ahumu, a manau taudia na e harihari henidiamu.
JAS.4.6.english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” + 4:6 Proverbs 3:34

JAS.1.26.motu: Tau ta lalona ai baineto ia na Dirava ibadinana tauna, to malana se dogoa taomu a sibona lalona e hekoimu, una tau ena Dirava ibadinana na asi anina.
JAS.1.26.english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

JAS.3.17.motu: A atai amo e maimu aonegana toana gini-gunana be ḡoevaḡoeva, murinai maino, gado-namo, lalomanada. Ia na hebogahisi bona huahua namodia amo e honumu. Ia na asi ena daradara bona asi ena dibaka.
JAS.3.17.english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

JAS.2.18.motu: A tau ta baineto “Oi na mai emu kamonai, a lau be mai egu kara”. Emu kamonai asi karana ba hamaorolaigu, a lau be egu kamonai na egu kara amo baine haheitalaimu.
JAS.2.18.english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

JAS.3.13.motu: Daika na bogaragimui ai e aonegamu bona lalona e pararamu? Ia ese ena mauri namona na ena kara ai baine hahedinaraia, aonega korikori manauna ai.
JAS.3.13.english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

JAS.5.7.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, ba haheauka, ela bona Lohiabada na baine gini dae. A laloa: biru tauna ese ena biru anina e nariamu mai haheaukana ida, ela hona medu gunana bona medu gabena bae hapariparia.
JAS.5.7.english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

JAS.2.11.motu: Badina be “Basio heuda hanai” eto tauna na ma e hereva, eto “Basio ala-ala”. Benaini, oi na basioma heuda hanai, a tau ta boma alaia, oi na taravatu boma tataia utu.
JAS.2.11.english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” + 2:11 Exodus 20:14; Deuteronomy 5:18 also said, “Do not commit murder.” + 2:11 Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17 Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

JAS.2.10.motu: Badina be taravatu idoinai e badinaiamu a kara tamona ai e hekwakwanaimu tauna ese taravatu idoinai e tataia utumu.
JAS.2.10.english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

JAS.3.14.motu: A vaḡeḡe dikadia bona heiri-heiri na lalomui ai bema mia, basioma heaḡi bona hereva momokani basioma hagagevaia.
JAS.3.14.english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

JAS.5.3.motu: Emui gold bona emui silver vada e hogohogomu; edia hogohogo ese baine hahemaoro henimui, hidiomui baine ani, lahi na heto. Emui kohu vada o haboumu, dina gabedia ḡaudia.
JAS.5.3.english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

JAS.1.24.motu: e itaiamu, bena e raka ohomu, asi kaimana e helalo boiomu ia be edeheto.
JAS.1.24.english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

JAS.2.4.motu: umui ese taunimanima basioma ha-idaudia a? Basioma hahemaoro kerere a?
JAS.2.4.english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

JAS.2.25.motu: Unuhetomana danu, Rahaba, ariara hahinena, na ena kara daidiai maorona e gwauraia ani; badina be ia ese hasinadoa taudia e abidia dae, bona idau dala amo e siaidia lao.
JAS.2.25.english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

JAS.4.9.motu: Ba dara doko, ba lalo hisihisi, ba taitai. Emui kiri na lalo-hisihisi ai bainela; emui moale na dara-doko ai bainela.
JAS.4.9.english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

JAS.3.18.motu: Kara maoromaoro anina be maino ai e hadoamu, herohemaino taudia ediai.
JAS.3.18.english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

JAS.1.22.motu: Hereva ibadinana taumui ai baola; bema hereva ikamonaina taumui mo, una be sibomui o hekoimu.
JAS.1.22.english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

JAS.1.2.motu: Varavaragu e, hedibaḡani ese bae butumui tao negadia ai na lalomui baeto ene na moale mo.
JAS.1.2.english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

JAS.2.19.motu: Oi na o abi daemu Dirava korikori be tamona. Una na namo. To lauma dikadia danu unu e abi dae tomamu, bona deradia e talamu.
JAS.2.19.english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

JAS.5.15.motu: Bena abidadama ḡuriḡurina dainai gorere tauna do baine mauri; Lohiabada ese baine hatorea isi, bona ena kara dika baine gwau tao.
JAS.5.15.english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

JAS.4.2.motu: O ura lalo-dikamu, to asio abimu, bena o ala-alamu. O hekise-hekisemu, to asio davarimu, bena o heatumu bona o tuarimu. Asio abimu, badina be asio noinoimu.
JAS.4.2.english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

JAS.1.11.motu: Badina be dina e tata dae rohamu, e ḡaraḡaramu, rei e hamaraiamu; bena huahuana e hehuhumu, bona ita-itana namona e oremu. Taḡa tauna danu unu baine lao bubuni toma.
JAS.1.11.english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

JAS.5.16.motu: Taunabunai, emui kara dika ba hahedinarai heheni, bona ta ta bamomui daidiai ba ḡuriḡuri; bena ba mauri. Kara maoromaoro tauna ena ḡuriḡuri ese anina e havaraiamu mai siahuna Ida.
JAS.5.16.english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

JAS.2.16.motu: bena umui ta ese boma hamaoroa, boma toma “Mai mainomu ida aola, ba hegana, ba boga kunu”, a tau-anidia ai e dabumu ḡaudia na basioma henidia, anina be dahaka?
JAS.2.16.english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

JAS.3.7.motu: Badina be mauri ḡaudia iboudiai, e rakamu ḡaudia bona e rohomu ḡaudia bona e raumu ḡaudia bona davara gaudia, taunimanima na ihamanadadia mai dibadia, bona vada e hamanadadia.
JAS.3.7.english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

JAS.3.15.motu: Una na dia atai amo e maimu aonegana, a tanobada ḡauna, tau-anina ena, lauma dikadia edia.
JAS.3.15.english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

JAS.1.18.motu: Sibona ena ura dainai ia ese ena hereva momokani amo e havarada, e havaradia ḡaudia anidia roboadia na heheto.
JAS.1.18.english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

JAS.4.1.motu: Tuari bona heatu bogaragimui ai be ede amo e varamu? Ini amo e varamu: emui ura dikadia na taumui reḡedia ai e tuarimu, ani?
JAS.4.1.english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

JAS.5.4.motu: A kamonai: emui uma anidia e utu taudia davadia o abihaidia na e lolomu; bona iutudia taudia edia taitai na Iehova Sabaota taiana ai vada e vareai.
JAS.5.4.english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

JAS.5.19.motu: Varavaragu e, ta umui bogaragimui ai hereva momokani dalana amo baine raka siri, bena ta ese baine haloua,
JAS.5.19.english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

JAS.4.17.motu: Taunabunai, kara namo ikarana mai dibana to se karaiamu tauna na kara dika tauna.
JAS.4.17.english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

JAS.5.13.motu: Bogaragimui ai ta hisi e animu a? Baine ḡuriḡuri. Ta e moalemu a? Ane baine abi.
JAS.5.13.english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

JAS.4.13.motu: Umui haida o gwaumu “Hari dina eiava kerukeru una hanua baitala, unuseni ai laḡani ta baita noho, baita hoihoi, eda moni baita habou”.
JAS.4.13.english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

JAS.4.10.motu: Lohiabada vairanai ba hahemanau, bena ia ese baine abimui dae.
JAS.4.10.english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

JAS.2.23.motu: Bena buka ai e torea herevana vada e momokani; eto, Abraham ese Dirava e abiabiraia, bena kara maoromaoro tauna e gwauraiava. Bena e gwauraia, Dirava turana.
JAS.2.23.english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” + 2:23 Genesis 15:6 and he was called the friend of God.

JAS.5.14.motu: Bogaragimui ai ta e gorereamu a? Ekalesia ita-taona taudia baine boiridia, bena idia ese ia dainai bae ḡuriguri, bona dehoro bae horolaia, Lohiabada ladana ai.
JAS.5.14.english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

JAS.3.9.motu: Iena amo Lohiabada, ita Tamada, ta hanamoamu; iena amo danu Dirava heida-idaua ai e karadiamu taudia ta uduguiraidiamu.
JAS.3.9.english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

JAS.5.9.motu: Varavaragu e, basio hemaumau heheni, hahemaoro tauna ese baine hahemaoro henimui na garina; a itaia, ia na iduara vairanai vada e ginimu.
JAS.5.9.english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

JAS.3.10.motu: Udu tamona amo hahenamo bona heuduguirai e lasimu. Varavaragu e, una na dia namo.
JAS.3.10.english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

JAS.2.7.motu: Lada namona vada e nemailaimui na idia ese e ere dika heniamu ani?
JAS.2.7.english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

JAS.4.4.motu: Heuda-hanai taumui e! Heuda-hanai hahinemui e! Asi dibamui tanobada iura-henina na Dirava i'inai-henina a? Taunabunai, tanobada e hetura heniamu tauna na Dirava inaina.
JAS.4.4.english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

JAS.2.14.motu: Varavaragu e, tau ta baineto ia be kamonai tauna, to asi ena kara, anina be dahaka? Kamonai ese baine hamauria diba a?
JAS.2.14.english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

JAS.4.8.motu: Dirava ba raka henia kahi, bena ia ese danu baine raka henimui kahi. Kara dika taumui e, imamui ba huri. Lalo rua taumui e, lalomui ba haḡoevadia.
JAS.4.8.english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

JAS.3.16.motu: Badina be vaḡeḡe bona heiri-heiri e miamu gabuna ai, heloḡo-heloḡo bona kara dika idoinai e miamu.
JAS.3.16.english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

JAS.5.8.motu: Umui danu ba haheauka; lalomui na bae goada balaheni, badina be Lohiabada maina be kahira-kahira.
JAS.5.8.english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

JAS.5.2.motu: Emui kohu na vada e houka-houkamu, bona emui dabua na pitopito ese vada e animu.
JAS.5.2.english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

JAS.2.2.motu: Badina be tau ta emui dubu ai bema dae kau, imana kwakikwakidia vaḡivagidia na gold bona ena dabua danu hereadae, ma ogoḡami tauna ta danu ena dabua dikana ida bema dae kau,
JAS.2.2.english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

JAS.1.13.motu: Hedibaḡani ai ta basineto “Dirava ese e dibaḡanigumu”; badina be dika na Dirava idibaḡanina asi dibana, bona Dirava ese danu tau ta se dibaḡaniamu.
JAS.1.13.english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

JAS.2.9.motu: A taunimanima oromadia ba lalo, vada ba kara dika, taravatu enai ba kerere.
JAS.2.9.english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

JAS.4.7.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava isiaina ba lao heni. Diabolo ba ginia ahu, bena ia ese baine heautanimui.
JAS.4.7.english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

JAS.1.21.motu: Taunabunai, miro idoinai bona lalohadai dikadia lalomui ai e tubumu ba nege daure; bona lalonlui ai vada e hadoa herevana, laumamui baine hamauridia diba ḡauna, bavaabia dae, mai manaumui ida.
JAS.1.21.english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

JAS.2.22.motu: O itaiamu: ena kamonai bona ena kara e ḡaukara hebouva; bena ena kara ese ena kamonai e haḡuḡuruava, ani?
JAS.2.22.english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

JAS.1.19.motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, ina na dibamui. A ta ta hereva ikamonaina ai baine haraḡa, hereva igwauraina ai baine halahe, badu ai danu baine halahe.
JAS.1.19.english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

JAS.3.1.motu: Varavaragu e, umui hutuma hahediba ai basiola, badina be ai hahediba taumai ihahemaoro-henimai baine auka.
JAS.3.1.english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

JAS.4.11.motu: Varavaragu e, basio ere dika heheni. Tau ta ese varavarana e ere dika heniamu eiava e hahemaoro heniamu, ia ese taravatu danu e ere dika heniamu bona e hahemaoro heniamu. A oi ese taravatu ba hahemaoro henia, oi na dia taravatu ibadinana tauna, a hahemaaro tauna.
JAS.4.11.english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

JAS.1.25.motu: A tau ta taravatu ḡoeva-daena, ura kwalimu taravatuna, baine itaia tao bona henunai baine noho, basine kamonai mo a karana danu baine karaia, una tau be hahenamo baine abia ena ḡaukara ai.
JAS.1.25.english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

JAS.1.27.motu: Dirava ibadinana ḡoevaḡoevana bona asi bebeka-bebekana Tamada Dirava vairanai be iniheto: ihareha bona vabu baita igodia ita edia hisihisi ai, bona siboda baita hegima, tanobada mirona ese basine hamiroda.
JAS.1.27.english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

JAS.1.23.motu: Badina be tau ta hereva baine kamonai to basine badinaia, ia na hevarivari ai sibona vairana heida-idana e itaiamu tauna na heto;
JAS.1.23.english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

JAS.4.16.motu: A harihari emui hekokoroku o heaḡi-laiamu; heaḡi unuhetomana idoinai be dika.
JAS.4.16.english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

JAS.4.12.motu: Tarava iatuna tauna bona hahemaoro tauna be tamona mo: ia na mai siahuna baine hahemauri bona baine hahemase. A oi be daika, dekemu tauna na o hahemaoro heniamu?
JAS.4.12.english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

JAS.3.8.motu: A mala ihamanadana na tau ta asi dibana; e raivaraivamu mai dikana ida, mase muramurana amo e honumu.
JAS.3.8.english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

JAS.1.20.motu: Badina be taunimanima edia badu ese Dirava ena kara maoromaoro se havaraiamu.
JAS.1.20.english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

JAS.3.4.motu: Lagatoi danu ba ita, idia na babada, bona lai badadia ese e odamu, to tari maraḡi-maraḡina ese e tarimu, tari tauna ena ura gabuna baela.
JAS.3.4.english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

JAS.5.1.motu: Taḡa taumui e, a taitai, a tai lolo-lolo, dara-doko emui ai be kaumu dainai.
JAS.5.1.english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

JAS.4.3.motu: Eiava o noinoimu, to asio abimu, badina be o noinoi kereremu; emui lalo-hadai be bavabi ḡaudia na emui ura dikadia ai ba petapetalai.
JAS.4.3.english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

JAS.3.11.motu: Guri tamona amo ranu gaihona bona ranu iditana e lohi lohi daemu a?
JAS.3.11.english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

JAS.2.20.motu: Asi lalomu taumu e, asi dibamu kamonai asi ena kara na asi anina a?
JAS.2.20.english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

JAS.2.13.motu: Badina be asi ena hebogahisi tauna enai hahemaoro na asi ena hebogahisi. A hebogahisi ese hahemaoro e hereaiamu.
JAS.2.13.english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

JAS.1.15.motu: Bena ura dikadia na e rogorogomu, kara dikadia e havaramu, bona kara dikadia na e lomu, mase e abiamu.
JAS.1.15.english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

JAS.2.21.motu: Tamada Abraham ese natuna Isaak pata helaḡana ai e atoa kau negana ai, maorona e gwauraia ani, ena kara daidiai.
JAS.2.21.english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

JAS.1.7.motu: Una tau basine laloa ḡau ta Lohiabada ena amo baine abia;
JAS.1.7.english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

JAS.3.6.motu: Benaini, mala be lahi. Ia na kara dika idoinai e haboumu, tauda reḡedia bogaragidiai, bena tau-anida idoidiai e hadikamu. Ia na mauri idoinai iaralaina; ena lahi danu Gehena amo e abiamu.
JAS.3.6.english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

JAS.1.12.motu: Hedibaḡani ai e haheaukamu tauna be namo, badina be baine kwalimu negana ai ia ese mauri ena kwara-havava ḡauna baine abia, Dirava ese vada e gwauraia hamata ḡauna, ia bae ura henia taudia ese bae abia e tomamu.
JAS.1.12.english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

JAS.5.6.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna vada o revaia, bena vada o alaia mase; ia ese se laomui ahu.
JAS.5.6.english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

JAS.4.14.motu: A asi dibamui kerukeru dahaka baine vara. Badina be emui mauri be dahaka? Ranu varahuna mo, nega sisina mo e hedinaraimu, ma e boiomu.
JAS.4.14.english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

JAS.2.15.motu: Tadikaka-ta ta eiava taihuda ta bema asi ena dabua, eiava bema hitoloa mase;
JAS.2.15.english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

JAS.2.3.motu: bena dabua namodia e karamu tauna boma abia dae, boma toma “Mani ina gabu namona ai a helai”, a ogoḡami tauna boma hamaoroa, boma toma “Oi na unuseni ai a gini” eiava “Aegu badibadinai a helai”,
JAS.2.3.english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

JAS.2.26.motu: Badina be tau-anina asi laumana be vada e mase; unuhetomana kamonai asi ena kara be vada e mase.
JAS.2.26.english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

JAS.2.24.motu: Benaini, kara daidiai taunimanima be maorodia bae gwauraidia, dia kamonai mo dainai.
JAS.2.24.english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

JAS.5.10.motu: Varavaragu e, peroveta taudia, Lohiabada ladana ai e herevava taudia, edia hisi-ani bona edia haheauka ba haḡoidia.
JAS.5.10.english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

JAS.5.20.motu: ba diba ḡoevaḡoeva, kara dika tauna ena dala kererekererena amo baine haloua tauna ese laumana na mase amo baine harohoa mauri bona kara dika momo danu baine tahuni.
JAS.5.20.english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

JAS.1.10.motu: Bona taḡa tauna danu baine moale, Dirava ese baine hamorua negana ai; badina be rei huahuana na heto ia na baine lao bubuni.
JAS.1.10.english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

JAS.1.16.motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, sibomui basio hekoi;
JAS.1.16.english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

JAS.2.1.motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, hairai Lohiana, o abiabiraiamu; benaini, taunimanima oromadia basio lalo.
JAS.2.1.english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

JAS.1.5.motu: Umui ta aonega ai bema dabu, ia ese taunimanima iboudiai e henidia dudu kaumu bona se gwaugwaumu Diravana na baine noia, bena do baine henia.
JAS.1.5.english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

JAS.3.12.motu: Varavaragu e, suke auna ai olive huahuadia bae dobi a? Eiava vine auna ai suke huahuadia bae dobi a? Tadi danu ranu gaihona se havaraiamu.
JAS.3.12.english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

JDG.16.2.motu: Ta ese Gasa taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Samson na vada ema ina hanua. Bena idia ese hanua e koua heḡeḡe, ia e naria rani, hanua ikoukouna ai. Hanuaboi idoinai asi reḡereḡena e nohova, eto, Baita naria ela bona daba baine rere, bena baita alaia mase.
JDG.16.2.english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”

JDG.11.4.motu: Nega taina vada ela, Amono taudia ese Israel taudia e tuari henidia.
JDG.11.4.english: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

JDG.1.32.motu: Asere taudia na Kanaan taudia bogaragidiai e nohova una tano ai; asie luludia lasi.
JDG.1.32.english: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

JDG.21.11.motu: Ini ba kara toma: mamaruane iboudiai bona tatau ida vada e eno bou hahinedia iboudiai na bavaladia ore.
JDG.21.11.english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

JDG.18.21.motu: Edia dala ai ma e raka; natudia maraḡidia bona boromakau bona kohu na vairadiai e atodia.
JDG.18.21.english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.

JDG.9.14.motu: Bena au iboudiai ese au ginigini e hereva henia, eto, Oi hari emai pavapava ai baola. Bena au ginigini ese e haere henidia, eto,
JDG.9.14.english: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

JDG.16.15.motu: Hahine ma e hereva, Samson e gwau henia, eto, Edeheto oi na o tomu “Na ura henimumu”, a lalomu na so henigu? Nega hatoi vada o kirikirilaigu, bona do so hamaorogu emu goada e hereamu badina korikori be dahaka.
JDG.16.15.english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”

JDG.12.15.motu: Bena Abdon Hilele, tau Piratono, e mase; bena Piratono ai e guria, Efraim tanona ai. Una na Amalek taudia edia ororo ai.
JDG.12.15.english: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

JDG.1.9.motu: Una murinai Iuda taudia e hekei ela, Kanaan taudia e tuari henidia, ororo kahadia ai bona diho kahana ai bona taora kahadia ai.
JDG.1.9.english: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.

JDG.6.38.motu: Bena unu e vara toma: daba matana ai e tore isi, mamoe kopina e mutua, dihu ta na hunu ranuna amo e hahonua.
JDG.6.38.english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

JDG.9.10.motu: Bena au ese suke auna e hereva henia, eto, Oi hari emai pavapava ai baola.
JDG.9.10.english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

JDG.8.21.motu: Bena Sebaha bona Salmuna eto, Oi sibomu a tore isi, avalamai mase; tau ta be ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine kara. Bena Gideon e tore isi, Sebaha bona Salmuna e aladia mase. Bena edia kamelo aiodia iheralaidia mairidia e abi.
JDG.8.21.english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

JDG.10.17.motu: Bena Amono taudia na e hebou, bae tuari eto; bena Gilead ai e taruha. Israel taudia danu e hebou, Mispa ai e taruha.
JDG.10.17.english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

JDG.21.22.motu: A tamadia eiava taihudia na ai dekemai baema, bae hahebade, negana ai, ai ese baia hamarumarudia, baiato “Idia na emui harihari-bada ai mani ba henimai, badina be tuari ai asia abidia mauri, asia henidia bae adavadia, bona umui danu asio henidia: boma henidia, umui na harihari boma kerere”.
JDG.21.22.english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

JDG.19.27.motu: Daba ai biaguna e tore isi, ruma iduaradia e keho, ena laolao ai ma bainela eto; bena ena hahine e itaia, iduara vairanai e hekida diho, imana ruaosi na iduara raka-vareai ai heheato.
JDG.19.27.english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

JDG.18.18.motu: Unu laimaosi na Mika ena ruma ai e raka vareai, hari e koroa laulauna bona dabua helaḡana bona kaivakuku bona e havevea laulauna-e abi, negana ai hahelaḡa tauna ese e hereva henidia, eto, Dahaka o karamu?
JDG.18.18.english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

JDG.14.7.motu: Bena e diho ela, una hane-ulato ida e hereva-hereva; bena Samson ese e ura henia lalodikava.
JDG.14.7.english: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.

JDG.16.5.motu: Bena Filistia lohiadia na una hahine dekena ela, e hereva henia, eto, A koia, ba diba ena goada hereana na ede amo, bona edena dala amo baia hadarerea; bena baia ḡuia bona baia hamanadaia; bena silver monidia daha-ta sinahu-ta baia henimu.
JDG.16.5.english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”

JDG.17.8.motu: Una tau na Betelehem-luda amo e tore isi, eha laolao, ena noho gabuna ta baine tahua eto; bena ena laolao ai na Efraim ororodia ai e kau, bona Mika ena ruma ai e gini dae.
JDG.17.8.english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

JDG.1.35.motu: Amoro taudia na dounu e nohova Here ororona ai bona Aialono ai bona Saalbim ai, a Iosef taudia imadia vada e metau latadiai; idia ese Iosef taudia isiaidia e lao heni.
JDG.1.35.english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

JDG.2.16.motu: Bena Iehova ese hahemaoro taudia e duanaidia, bena unu hahemaoro taudia ese dadidadi taudia imadia amo e hamauridia.
JDG.2.16.english: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

JDG.3.21.motu: Bena Ehud ese ena dare na imana laurina ai e abia, idibala kahana amo e veria lasi, Eglon bogana e gwadaia.
JDG.3.21.english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

JDG.7.5.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese taunimanima na ranu gabuna e hakaudia lao. Bena Iehova ese Gideon e hamaoroa, eto, Maladia an-o ranu bae peta dae, sisia na heheto, taudia iboudiai na gabu ta ai bavatodia; a bae tui diho, ranu bae dodo, taudia ma gabu ta ai bavatodia.
JDG.7.5.english: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

JDG.9.35.motu: Bena Gaal Ebed na e raka lasi, hanua ikoukouna ai e gini. Bena Abimelek mai ena orea taudia ida na edia komu gabudia amo e tore isi.
JDG.9.35.english: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

JDG.9.31.motu: Bena ia ese gwaukau taudia haida e siaidia Abimelek dekenai, Aruma ai, eto, A kamonai, Gaal Ebed mai varavarana ida vada ema Sekem: bena idia ese hanua taudia lalodia e hadikamu emu ai.
JDG.9.31.english: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.

JDG.15.1.motu: Nega do se daudau, uit iutuna e matamaia, bena Samson ese nani natuna ta e abia, adavana e vadivadi henia. Ia eto, Lau na daiutu lalonai baina raka vareai, adavagu dekenai. A hahine tamana ese e rua.
JDG.15.1.english: But after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat. He said, “I will go in to my wife’s room.”

JDG.9.9.motu: A olive auna ese edia hereva e haloua, eto, Huahuagu digarana, Dirava bona taunimanima ihanamodia ḡauna, na baina rakatania, au baina biagudia a?
JDG.9.9.english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

JDG.13.20.motu: Bena lahi hururu-hururuna na ihaboulaina patana amo guba ai e dae ela negana ai, Iehova ena aneru na ihaboulaina patana lahina hururu-hururuna amo e dae ela. Manoa mai adavana ida e itaia, bena raruosi na tano ai e goru diho.
JDG.13.20.english: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

JDG.20.25.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na Gibea amo ma e raka lasi, dina iharuana ai, Israel taudia gerebu-ta daha-taurahani e aladia mase. Unu iboudiai na tuari taudia mai edia dare.
JDG.20.25.english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

JDG.1.33.motu: Napatali taudia ese danu Bete-semese taudia bona Bet-anata taudia asie luludia lasi. Idia ese Kanaan taudia bogaragidiai e nohova una tano ai; ḡau tamona idia ese Bete-semese bona Bet-anata taudia e abidia, edia hesiai taudia ai e halaodia.
JDG.1.33.english: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

JDG.3.18.motu: Ehud ese herahia na e henia vaitani, bena ia ese herahia e huaia taudia e siaidia lao.
JDG.3.18.english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

JDG.18.30.motu: Dan taudia ese Dirava laulauna, e koroa ḡauna, e haginia edia. Ionatan Geresom, Mose tubuna, mai garana ida, na Dan taudia edia hahelaḡa taudia ai ela, ela bona e ḡuidia dinana.
JDG.18.30.english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

JDG.15.12.motu: Idia ma eto, Baia ḡuimu bona Filistia taudia imadia ai baia atomu totona vada ama.
JDG.15.12.english: They said to him, “We have come down to bind you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines.”

JDG.5.6.motu: Samgara, Anata natuna, ena nega ai,
JDG.5.6.english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath,

JDG.5.17.motu: Gilead taudia na loridane unukahana ai e nohova;

JDG.18.9.motu: Laimaosi eto, A tore isi, aitala, aita tuari henidia; badina be ai ese una tano vada a itaia, biru tanona namo hereana. Umui ba noho kava a? Basio halahe, baola, una tano ai ba raka vareai bona bavabia, emui tano.
JDG.18.9.english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

JDG.20.3.motu: Bena Beniamina iduhuna taudia na harina e kamonai, Israel taudia na unu e hebou tomava Mispa ai.
JDG.20.3.english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”

JDG.5.20.motu: Hisiu na guba amo e tuari,
JDG.5.20.english: From the sky the stars fought.

JDG.21.15.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia e bogadia hisi, Iehova ese Israel besena vada e hapararaia dainai.
JDG.21.15.english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

JDG.7.15.motu: Gideon ese una nihi igwauraina bona anina ihahedinaraina e kamonai, bena ia na e toma diho. Bena Israel taruhana e lou henia, eto, A tore tore isi, badina be Iehova ese Midian ena orea idoinai na umui imamui ai vada e atodia.
JDG.7.15.english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for Yahweh has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

JDG.11.40.motu: laḡani ta ta amo Israel kekenidia ese dina hani Iefeta, tau Gilead, natuna kekenina taina e taiva.
JDG.11.40.english: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

JDG.15.3.motu: A Samson ese e hamaorodia, eto, Hari ina nega ai Filistia taudia baina hadikadia na asi kererena.
JDG.15.3.english: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”

JDG.9.22.motu: Abimelek ese Israel e lohiaia laḡani toi.
JDG.9.22.english: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

JDG.7.9.motu: Una hanuaboi Iehova ese ma e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, a hekei lao, edia taruha ai ba tuari henidia.
JDG.7.9.english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

JDG.11.14.motu: Bena Iefeta ese gwaukau taudia haida ma e siaidia, Amono pavapavana dekenai.
JDG.11.14.english: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

JDG.15.14.motu: Lehi ai e kau, bena Filistia taudia na iabina e raka lasi, mai lolodia ida. Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese e rohea badabada, bena imana e ḡuilai kwanaudia na siriho lahi ese e araiamu heḡereḡerena ai ela, bena ena igui na imana amo e moru.
JDG.15.14.english: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.

JDG.21.14.motu: Una negana ai Beniamina taudia na e lou. Bena hebou taudia ese hari Iabese-gilead hahinedia bogaragidia amo e hamauridia ulatodia na idia e henidia. To asie davana.
JDG.21.14.english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

JDG.15.7.motu: Bena Samson ese e hamaorodia, eto, Emui kara enehetomana dainai momokani davana do baina kara henimui, bena baina hadokoa.
JDG.15.7.english: Samson said to them, “If you behave like this, surely I will take revenge on you, and after that I will cease.”

JDG.18.25.motu: Bena Dan taudia ese e gwau henia, eto, Oi gadomu basine hedinarai ai bogaragimai ai, badu-haraḡa taudia haida ese bae alamui na garina, oiemu mauri bona dekemu taudia edia mauri bae boio na garina.
JDG.18.25.english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

JDG.9.54.motu: Bena ia ese eregabe tauna ta, ena kesi ihuana tauna, e boiria haraḡa-haraḡa, e hamaoroa, eto, Emu dare a veria lasi, bavalagu, taunimanima ese bae herevalaigu, baeto “Hahine ese e alaia mase”, na garina. Bena hari eregabe tauna ese e gwadaia; vada e mase.
JDG.9.54.english: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

JDG.16.27.motu: Hari ruma na tatau bona hahine e honu honu dae; Filistia lohiadia iboudiai danu unuseni ai. Bona tatau bona hahine daha-toi sisivana danu atai amo e roha dobi, Samson ikirikirilaina karadia e ita.
JDG.16.27.english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.

JDG.4.21.motu: Bena laele, Hebere adavana, ese ikoko ta e abia, bona lavu ta imana ai e abia, bena metaira-metaira Sisera e raka henia kahi, mahutana ai ibunina daena ai e kokoa uru, ikoko na tano ai e heholo; badina be tau boera dainai vada e hekure, vada e mahuta. Taunabunai vada e mase.
JDG.4.21.english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

JDG.21.17.motu: Ma eto, Beniamina taudia kwabukwabudia na ahudia bae abi baine namo, iduhu ta Israel bogaragina amo baine boio na garina;
JDG.21.17.english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

JDG.13.15.motu: Manoa ese Iehova ena aneru e hereva henia, eto, Mani emu kara, do baia dogomu tao, nani natuna ta baia heḡaeḡaelaia amu.
JDG.13.15.english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”

JDG.4.4.motu: Una negana ai peroveta hahinena ta, ladana Debora, Lapidoto adavana, ese Israel ai e hahemaorova.
JDG.4.4.english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

JDG.3.22.motu: Bena dare auauna danu bogana ai e vareai, anina na e hepuni vareai: dare na bogana amo se veria lasi, a tage na kununa amo e lasi.
JDG.3.22.english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

JDG.8.27.motu: Bena Gideon na una dabua e abia, hahedoki helaḡana ta e karaia, ena hanua, Ofra, lalonai e taua dae. Bena Israel taudia iboudiai ese una ḡau e toma henia diho; unu amo ia na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai ela, Gideon bona ena ruma taudia ediai.
JDG.8.27.english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

JDG.1.24.motu: Hasinadoa taudia ese tau ta hanua amo e raka lasi e itaia, bena e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara, hanua ivareaina dalana ba hadibamai, bena baia bogamu hisi.
JDG.1.24.english: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”

JDG.7.8.motu: Taunabunai, hodu na taunimanima imadia amo e abi, bona edia kibi danu; bena Gideon ese Israel oredia iboudiai e siaidia lou, ta ta ena kalaga ena kalaga ela; a sinahu-toiosi mo e dogodia tao. Midian taudia edia taruha na ia henunai, koura ai.
JDG.7.8.english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

JDG.9.6.motu: Bena Sekem taudia iboudiai bona Bete-milo taudia iboudiai na ela, Abimelek e abia dae, Sekem ena oak auna helaḡana badibadinai, edia pavapava ai e halaoa.
JDG.9.6.english: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

JDG.11.34.motu: Bena Iefeta na ena ruma e lou henia, Mispa ai. Bena ia natuna kekenina na ia dekena e raka lasi, imana mai tarekodia, bona mai mavaruna ida. Ia na natuna vara-edeana; asi natuna idauna ta, maruanena eiava hahinena.
JDG.11.34.english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

JDG.19.12.motu: A biaguna ese e haere henia, eto, Basita raka siri, ini idau taudia edia hanua ai basita raka vareai, badina be idia na dia Israel besena taudia. Aita raka hanai, Gibea baitala.
JDG.19.12.english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

JDG.9.24.motu: Unu amo Ierubu-baal natuna mamaruanedia hitu-ahui-osi ialadia bona raradia na tadikakadia Abimelek, e aladia mase tauna, latanai bona Sekem taudia, tadikakana ialadia ai e durua taudia, latadiai e kau.
JDG.9.24.english: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

JDG.14.13.motu: a anina na basioma hamaorolaigu diba, umui ese hahedoki toi-ahui, dabua aukana amo e kara ḡaudia, bona riorio dabuadia toi-ahui, boma henigu. Idia eto, Emu hereva hehunina ba gwauraia, baia kamonai.
JDG.14.13.english: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.”

JDG.8.1.motu: Efraim taudia ese Gideon e nanadaia, eto, Ede vada o karamai toma? Dahaka dainai Midian taudia o tuari henidia negana ai so boirimai? Idia ese e gwau henia dikadika.
JDG.8.1.english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

JDG.11.10.motu: Gilead tau-badadia ese lefeta ma e hereva henia, eto, Iehova na ita padadai, eda hereva e kamonaimu: momokani, oi o herevamu heḡereḡerena baia karaia.
JDG.11.10.english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”

JDG.1.19.motu: Iehova ese Iuda taudia e bamodiava, bena idia ese ororo kahadia iboudiai e abidia; a asi edia dala taora ai e nohova taudia bae luludia lasi, badina be idia na mai edia auri kariotadia.
JDG.1.19.english: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

JDG.13.21.motu: Iehova ena aneru ese Manoa mai adavana ida se hahedinarai henidia lou. Bena Manoa lalona e parara, una na Iehova ena aneru.
JDG.13.21.english: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.

JDG.14.16.motu: Bena Samson adavana na ia vairanai e tai, eto, O inai henigumu, so ura henigumu. Egu hanua taudia na hereva hehunina vada o henidia, a anina be so hadibagu.
JDG.14.16.english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.”

JDG.3.12.motu: Bena Israel taudia ma e kara havara lou, Iehova vairanai. Bena Iehova ese Eglon, Moab pavapavana, imana e ha-aukaia Israel taudia latadiai, idia ese Iehova vairanai vada e kara havara dainai.
JDG.3.12.english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

JDG.9.38.motu: Bena Sebulu ese e hereva henia, eto, Harihari udumu be edeseni ai, oi oto “Abimelek be daika, bona dahaka dainai ia isiaina baita lao heni?” O dadaraidia taudia bunu, ani? Harihari ba raka lasi, ba tuari henidia.
JDG.9.38.english: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

JDG.17.13.motu: Bena Mika eto, Harihari lau na dibagu Iehova ese baine hanamogu, badina be Levi tauna vada na abia, egu hahelaḡa tauna.
JDG.17.13.english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”

JDG.18.17.motu: bena hari hasinadoa taudia imaosi na ruma ai e dae kau, e raka vareai, e koroa laulauna bona dabua helaḡana bona kaivakuku bona e havevea laulauna e abi. A hahelaḡa tauna na ikoukou badibadinai e gini, tuari taudia sinahutauratoiosi ida.
JDG.18.17.english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

JDG.11.23.motu: Benaini, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese Amoro taudia edia tano na edia amo e abia oho, ena bese Israel e henia. Matona, oi ese bavabia a?
JDG.11.23.english: So now Yahweh, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

JDG.16.16.motu: Bena dina iboudiai ia ese lalona e ania, bona e nanadaia louIou, ela bona Samson darana e doko.
JDG.16.16.english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.

JDG.3.1.motu: Iehova ese se luludia lasi besedia bini, Israel besena baine tohoa, bona Israel taudia iboudiai Kanaan ai asie tuari na baine dibadia,
JDG.3.1.english: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

JDG.16.17.motu: Bena ia ese lalona anina idoinai e hahedinarai henia, eto, Nega hata kwaragu asie naua; badina be sinagu bogana amo lau vada na helaḡa, Dirava ena Nasiri tauna. A huigu bema utua, egu goada bema rakatanigu, bena bama manoka, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
JDG.16.17.english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”

JDG.6.39.motu: Bena Gideon ese Dirava ma e hereva henia, eto, Emu badu basine siahu egu ai; ina nega tamona amo baina hereva. Mani emu kara, ina nega tamona mo mamoe kopina amo ma baina diba. Mani emu kara, mamoe huina do baine kaukau, a ia badina tanona idoinai na hunu ese baine hapariparia.
JDG.6.39.english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

JDG.11.32.motu: Taunabunai, Iefeta na e hanai, Amono taudia e tuan henidia; bena Iehova ese ia imana ai e atodia.
JDG.11.32.english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahweh delivered them into his hand.

JDG.7.18.motu: Lau mai bamogu iboudiai ida emai kibi baia hiriri negana ai na umui danu emui kibi ba hiriri, edia taruha hegeḡemadai; bena ba lolo, baoto “Iehova bagunai bona Gideon bagunai”.
JDG.7.18.english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For Yahweh and for Gideon!’”

JDG.9.16.motu: Benaini, Ialomui korikori amo bona kara maoromaoro amo Abimelek o abia dae emui pavapava ai o halaoa readia; Ierubu-baal mai ena ruma taudia ida vada o kara namo henidia ia ese e kara namo henimuiva heḡereḡerena readia.
JDG.9.16.english: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

JDG.20.28.motu: bona Fineha Eleasara, Aaron tubuna, na una maua vairanai Iehova isiaina e lao heniva unu dinadia ai. Taunabunai idia ese e henanadai, eto, Tadikakamai Beniamina taudia ma baia tuari henidia lou, eiava vada baia hadokoa? Iehova eto, Ma baola; kerukeru umui imamui ai baina atodia.
JDG.20.28.english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?”

JDG.10.11.motu: Iehova ese Israel taudia e haere henidia, eto, Lau ese Aigupto taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Amono taudia bona Filistia taudia imadia amo na hamaurimui ani?
JDG.10.11.english: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

JDG.21.3.motu: eto, Iehova e, Israel Diravana, badina be dahaka ina kara vada e vara Israel ai, bena hari dina ai Israel ai iduhu ta na lasihia?
JDG.21.3.english: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

JDG.6.12.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese e hahedinarai henia, e hereva henia, eto, Goada-herea taumu e, Iehova na oi ida.
JDG.6.12.english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

JDG.19.20.motu: Tau buruka eto, Maino na emui ai baine mia; lau ese emui dabu ḡaudia iboudiai baina henimui; ḡau tamona, hanua ariarana ai basio noho rani.
JDG.19.20.english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

JDG.3.5.motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia ese Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia bogaragidiai e nohova.
JDG.3.5.english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

JDG.21.16.motu: Bena Israel tau-badadia eto, Tatau oredia adavadia ede baita davaridia toma? Badina be Beniamina hahinedia vada e mase ore.
JDG.21.16.english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

JDG.10.12.motu: Sidono taudia bona Amalek taudia bona Maono taudia ese danu e hahisimui; bena o tai henigu negana ai lau ese idia imadia amo danu na hamaurimui.
JDG.10.12.english: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

JDG.1.31.motu: Asere taudia ese danu Ako taudia bona Sidono taudia bona Alab taudia bona Aksib taudia bona Helba taudia bona Afik taudia bona Rehob taudia na asie luludia lasi.
JDG.1.31.english: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;

JDG.1.11.motu: Unu amo ma ela, Debiri taudia e tuari henidia. (Debiri ladana gunana na Kiriata-sefere).
JDG.1.11.english: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

JDG.9.42.motu: Kerukeru, hanua taudia ma e raka lasi, tano paka ela. Abimelek e kamonai,
JDG.9.42.english: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

JDG.19.10.motu: A Levi tauna na se ura unuseni ai baine mahuta. Ia na e tore isi, ela, Iebusu (una na Ierusalem ladana ta) vairanai e kau. Ia na mai ena donih rua, dorudia na mai helai-kau ḡaudia; ena hahine danu na ia ida.
JDG.19.10.english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

JDG.5.22.motu: Hosi aedia reḡedia vada e bada;
JDG.5.22.english: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing,

JDG.8.8.motu: Unu amo ma e dara dae, Penuel ela, hereva heḡereḡerena e noilaidia; bena Penuel taudia ese e haere henia, Sukoto taudia ese vada e haere henia heḡereḡerena.
JDG.8.8.english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

JDG.20.7.motu: Israel taumui iboumui ai, ba haeroa: emui lalo-hadai bona emui hahedua ba gwaurai hedinarai.
JDG.20.7.english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

JDG.16.28.motu: Bena Samson ese Iehova e ḡuria, eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, lau na noimumu, a lalogu; lau na noimumu, a hagoadagu, Dirava e, ina nega tamona mo, bena Filistia taudia davadia baina henidia, matagu ruaosi daidiai.
JDG.16.28.english: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

JDG.18.27.motu: Dan taudia na Mika ese e kara ḡaudia bona ena hahelaḡa tauna e abidia, ela, Laisi ai e kau, asie raivaraivava bona ḡau ta asie laioava taudia na dare amo e aladia mase, bona edia hanua e doua.
JDG.18.27.english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

JDG.17.1.motu: Tau ta Efraim ororodia ai e nohova, ladana na Mika.
JDG.17.1.english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

JDG.13.22.motu: Bena Manoa ese adavana e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, ita na baita mase, badina be Dirava vada ta itaia.
JDG.13.22.english: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”

JDG.11.7.motu: A Iefeta ese Gilead tau-badadia e haere henidia, eto, Umui ese o inai henigu, tamagu ena ruma amo o lulugu oho, ani? Dahaka dainai harihari, hekwakwanai emui ai vada e vara negana ai, lau dekegu vada oma?
JDG.11.7.english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”

JDG.20.21.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na Gibea amo e raka lasi, Israel taudia gerebu-rua daha-rua e aladia mase una dina ai.
JDG.20.21.english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

JDG.15.15.motu: Bena ia ese doniki aukina turiana matamatana ta e davaria, bena imana ai e abia, tatau daha-ta na una turia amo e aladia mase.
JDG.15.15.english: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.

JDG.19.21.motu: Taunabunai, ia ese ena ruma ai e hakaudia vareai, bona doniki na adia e henidia. Bena idia ese aedia e huridia; bena e aniani bona e inuinu.
JDG.19.21.english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

JDG.5.12.motu: A noga, a noga, Debora e!

JDG.8.26.motu: Hari gold gadeidia, ia ese e noilai ḡaudia, edia metau idoinai be sekele daha-ta sinahu-hitu. Ma ḡau haida be mairi bona ageva bona dabua kakakakadia, Midian pavapavadia edia hahedoki ḡaudia, bona edia kamelo aiodia ḡaudia danu.
JDG.8.26.english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

JDG.15.18.motu: Samson na e ranu mase, bena ia ese Iehova e boi henia, eto, Emu hesiai tauna imana amo ina hahemauri badana vada o havaraia. Harihari ranu-mase ese baine hamasegu, bena asie peritomedia taudia imadia ai baina kau a?
JDG.15.18.english: He was very thirsty, and called on Yahweh and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

JDG.21.2.motu: A Israel taudia na Betele ela, Dirava vairanai e helai boi, e tai dikadika,
JDG.21.2.english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

JDG.6.21.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese imana e toia roro, ena itotohi dorina amo vamu bona asie hatubua flaoana dikeadia e daudia toho; bena Iahi na nadi amo e ara, hari vamu bona dikea e ḡoledia oho. Bena Iehova ena aneru na ia vairana amo e puki oho.
JDG.6.21.english: Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh’s angel departed out of his sight.

JDG.9.3.motu: Bena sinana varavarana ese unu hereva iboudiai na Sekem taudia e hamaorolaidia, ia dainai; bena Sekem taudia lalodia e urava Abimelek murina amo bae raka, badina be idia na eto, Ia na ai varavaramai.
JDG.9.3.english: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

JDG.9.47.motu: Haida ese Abimelek e hamaoroa, Sekem kohorona taudia iboudiai na unuseni ai vada e hebou.
JDG.9.47.english: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

JDG.12.8.motu: Iefeta murinai Betelehem tauna ta ladana Ibisan ese Israel ai e hahemaoro.
JDG.12.8.english: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

JDG.6.30.motu: Bena hanua taudia ese loasa e hamaoroa, eto, Natumu ba hakaua lasi; ia na baine mase. Badina be ia ese Baal ena ihaboulaina patana vada e ḡiḡia dobi, bona au helaḡana ia badinai e giniva vada e hagaria.
JDG.6.30.english: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”

JDG.8.4.motu: Gideon na Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e kau, bena e hanaia, ia bona ena orea taudia sinahu-toi ia ida. Idia na taudia e manori, to dounu e gava.
JDG.8.4.english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

JDG.10.16.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese dirava idaudia e rakatanidia, Iehova isiaina e lao henia; bena ia ese Israel taudia edia hisihisi baduna e badu.
JDG.10.16.english: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

JDG.11.28.motu: A Amono pavapavana ese Iefeta ena gwaukau herevana se abia dae.
JDG.11.28.english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

JDG.20.23.motu: Israel taudia na e dae lao, Iehova vairanai e tai boi; bena idia ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Tadikakamai Beniamina taudia ma baia tuari henidia lou eiava? Iehova eto, A tuari henidia.
JDG.20.23.english: The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?”

JDG.6.11.motu: Iehova ena aneru na ela, oak auna ta henunai, Ofra ai, e helai. Una au be Ioasa, Abiesere tauna, ena. Una negana ai ia natuna Gideon na uit e kwadiava, vine ranuna itaolaina gabuna ai, Midian taudia edia amo baine hunia eto.
JDG.6.11.english: Yahweh’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

JDG.8.34.motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova, edia Dirava, inaidia e koudia heḡeḡe taudia imadia amo e hamauridia Diravana, na asie laloa tao;
JDG.8.34.english: The children of Israel didn’t remember Yahweh their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

JDG.1.27.motu: Manase taudia ese danu Bete-seana taudia, mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia ida, bona Taanak taudia, mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia ida, bona Doro taudia, mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia ida, bona Ibleam taudia, mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia ida, bona Megido taudia, mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia ida, asie luludia lasi; Kanaan taudia na dounu e nohova, una tano ai.
JDG.1.27.english: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

JDG.8.9.motu: Bena ia ese Penuel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Maino ai ma baina lou mai negana ai, ina kohoro baina ḡiḡia dobi.
JDG.8.9.english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

JDG.7.6.motu: Bena imadia amo ranu e kado bona maladia amo e peta dae taudia na sinahu toi; a oredia iboudiai na e tui diho, ranu e dodo.
JDG.7.6.english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

JDG.11.3.motu: Bena Iefeta ese tadikakana e heautanidia, tano ladana Tobo ai e nohova; unuseni ai kara havara taudia haida na ia ida e raka hebouva, bona dadidadi karadia e kara hebouva.
JDG.11.3.english: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.

JDG.16.25.motu: Lalodia vada e moale, bena eto, Samson a boiria, baia kirikirilaia. Taunabunai, idia ese Samson na dibura rumana amo e boiria, bena e kirikirilaia. Ruma au-tubuadia padadia ai e haginia.
JDG.16.25.english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;

JDG.13.9.motu: Bena Dirava ese Manoa gadona e kamonai: Dirava ena aneru ese una hahine ma e hahedinarai henia lou, ia na uma ai e nohova negana ai; a adavana Manoa na lasihia.
JDG.13.9.english: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.

JDG.15.13.motu: Samson eto, A gwau henigu hamata, umui na basio alagu. Idia ma eto, Lasi, baia ḡuimu mo, bena idia imadia ai baia atomu; basia alamu. Bena idia ese kwanau matamatadia rua amo e ḡuia, haga amo e hakaua lao.
JDG.15.13.english: They spoke to him, saying, “No, but we will bind you securely and deliver you into their hands; but surely we will not kill you.” They bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.

JDG.21.25.motu: Unu dinadia ai Israel na asi pavapavana; Israel taudia na ta ta ena lalo-hadai ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡeredia e kara.
JDG.21.25.english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

JDG.6.29.motu: Bena e henanadai heheni, eto, Ina na daika ese e karaia? E hetahu bona e henanadai, bena eto, Gideon loasa ese ina kara vada e karaia.
JDG.6.29.english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?”

JDG.8.12.motu: Sebaha bona Salmuna na e heau; bena Gideon ese e hahavadia. Ia ese Midian pavapavadia raruosi, Sebaha bona Salmuna, e abidia mauri; a edia tuari oreadia e hakarohodia.
JDG.8.12.english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

JDG.2.6.motu: Iosua ese Israel taudia e siaidia karoho, bena ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ela, edia tano iabidia totona.
JDG.2.6.english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

JDG.11.6.motu: Idia ese Iefeta e hereva henia, eto, Aoma, ba biagumai, bena Amono taudia baita tuari henidia.
JDG.11.6.english: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”

JDG.4.17.motu: Sisera na aena amo e heau, Iaele, Hebere tau Kene adavana, ena kalaga ela; badina be Iabin, Hasoro pavapavana, bona Hebere, tau Kene, ena iduhu vada e herohemaino.
JDG.4.17.english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

JDG.4.12.motu: Haida ese Sisera e hamaoroa, Barak Abinaom na Taboro ororona vada ela.
JDG.4.12.english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

JDG.20.24.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia ma e tuari henidia lou, dina iharuana ai.
JDG.20.24.english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

JDG.13.24.motu: Bena una hahine ese mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Samson. Mero na e bada oho bada oho; bona Iehova ese e hanamoa.
JDG.13.24.english: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.

JDG.16.19.motu: Bena hahine ese Samson e ura henia, ia mamuna ai baine mahuta; e mahuta, bena hahine ese tau ta e boiria, kwarana baine naua; bena huina ipanina hituosi e utu oho. Bena e hauraia matama, badina be ena goada vada e rakatania.
JDG.16.19.english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

JDG.16.24.motu: Bena taunimanima ese Samson e itaia negana ai, idia ese edia dirava e hanamoa; badina be idia eto, Ita inaida, eda tano e habuaia tari bona eda tano taudia hutuma e aladia mase tauna, na eda dirava ese ita imada ai vada e atoa.
JDG.16.24.english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”

JDG.11.36.motu: Kekeni na eto, Tamagu e, bema Iehova o gwau henia hamata, emu hereva heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henigu; badina be Iehova ese oi inaimu, Amono taudia, vada e hadareredia, oi daimu ai.
JDG.11.36.english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to Yahweh; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because Yahweh has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”

JDG.3.4.motu: Israel taudia itohodia totona e nohova: Israel taudia ese Iehova ena haheḡani, Mose uduna amo senedia e haḡanilaidia ḡaudia, na bae badinadia eiava lasi.
JDG.3.4.english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

JDG.18.24.motu: Ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Egu dirava laulaudia, na kara ḡaudia, o abi, o laohai, bona egu hahelaḡa tauna o hakaua lao. Egu ai e miamu ḡauna be dahaka? Matona, o tomamu “Emu lalo-hisihisi be dahaka?”
JDG.18.24.english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”

JDG.20.34.motu: Bena tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-ta Israel taudia iboudiai edia amo e abidia hidi na Gibea e tuari henia. Tuari na auka herea; Beniamina taudia danu lalodia asie parara edia darere negana na kahira-kahira.
JDG.20.34.english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

JDG.18.4.motu: Bena ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Mika ese ini vada e karagu toma: davagu vada e henigu, bena ena hahelaḡa tauna ai vada nala.
JDG.18.4.english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

JDG.14.2.motu: Bena e lou lao, tamana bona sinana e hamaorodia, eto, Filistia hane-ulatona ta na itaia, Timuna ai; avabia, na uramu baina adavaia.
JDG.14.2.english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife.”

JDG.11.19.motu: Una murinai Israel ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, Amoro taudia edia pavapava, dekenai. Israel ese e noia, eto, Mani emu kara emu tano baia rakaia hanai, emai tano baia lao henia.
JDG.11.19.english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’

JDG.2.20.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena badu ma e haḡaraḡaraia lou, Israel taudia ediai. Ia eto, Ina bese ese egu taravatu, senedia na gwaurai henidia taravatuna, vada e tataia utu bona eregu asie kamonai dainai,
JDG.2.20.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

JDG.14.3.motu: A tamana bona sinana ese e sisiba henia, eto, Hane-ulato namona ta lasi varavaramu bogaragidiai eiava eda bese idoinai ai, una dainai Filistia taudia, asie peritomedia taudia, bogaragidia amo adavamu bavabia a? A Samson ese tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Avabia egu, badina be na ura heniamu.
JDG.14.3.english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?”

JDG.6.26.motu: Bena ina haga-nadina latanai Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia namonamo. Bena hari boromakau maruanena iharuana na bavabia, ba hahelagaia, gole-oho boubouna ai bainela; hari au helaḡana danu ba rakua, unu rakuraku amo boubou ḡauna na ba haḡolea oho.
