JDG.6.26.english: Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

JDG.12.9.motu: Natuna mamaruanedia na toi-ahui, bona natuna hahinedia na toi-ahui. Natuna hahinedia toi-ahui-osi na idau iduhu taudia e henidia, bae adavadia; bona idau iduhu taudia natudia hahinedia toi-ahui danu e abidia, ia natuna mamaruanedia bae adavadia. Ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani hitu.
JDG.12.9.english: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.

JDG.13.17.motu: Bena Manoa ese Iehova ena aneru e nanadaia, eto, Ladamu be daika? Baiama diba, bena emu hereva anidia bae momokani negana ai, ai na baia imodaimu.
JDG.13.17.english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

JDG.19.4.motu: Bena ravana, hari hahine tamana, ese e dogoa tao, dina toi; taunabunai e aniani hebou, e inuinu hebou, bona e mahuta unuseni ai.
JDG.19.4.english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

JDG.10.3.motu: Ia murinai Iairi, tau Gilead. e tore isi, Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia laḡani ruahui-rua lalodiai.
JDG.10.3.english: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

JDG.8.5.motu: Bena ia ese Sukoto taudia e noidia, eto, Mani emu kara egu orea taudia na aniani ba henidia, badina be taudia vada e manori, bona Midian pavapavadia Sebaha bona Salmuna na ḡavadiamu.
JDG.8.5.english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

JDG.7.10.motu: A boma gari, emu hesiai tauna Pura ida ba hekei lao, taruha badibadinai;
JDG.7.10.english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

JDG.19.14.motu: Bena e raka lao, dala ai ela; Gibea vada e kahirakahira, bena dina vada e diho. Una Gibea na Beniamina iduhuna taudia edia hanua.
JDG.19.14.english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

JDG.16.1.motu: Samson na Gasa ela. Unuseni ai ariara hahinena ta e davaria, bena ia dekenai e raka vareai.
JDG.16.1.english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.

JDG.18.1.motu: Unu dinadia ai Israel na asi pavapavana. Unu dinadia ai danu Dan taudia na tano ta e tahuava, bae noholaia: badina be idia na Israel iduhudia bogaragidiai edia tano ta do asie davaria.
JDG.18.1.english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

JDG.5.16.motu: Dahaka dainai mamoe edia maḡu ai o halahe?
JDG.5.16.english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds?

JDG.19.2.motu: Una hahine vada e badu, bena e diho, tamana ena ruma e lou lao, Betelehem-luda ai; hua hani unuseni ai e nohova.
JDG.19.2.english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

JDG.8.18.motu: Bena ia ese Sebaha bona Salmuna e nanadaidia, eto, Taboro ororona ai o aladia mase taudia na edeseni ai? Idia na e haere, eto, Idia iboudiai na oi ida-idamu, oromadia na pavapava natuna na heheto.
JDG.8.18.english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?”

JDG.10.5.motu: Iairi e mase, bena Kamon ai e guria.
JDG.10.5.english: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

JDG.21.1.motu: Israel taudia na Mispa ai vada e gwau hamata guna, eto, Ita ese natuda hane-ulatona ta Beniamina tauna ta basita henia, basine adavaia.
JDG.21.1.english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

JDG.21.10.motu: Taunabunai, hebou taudia ese edia tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-ta daha-rua e siaidia lao, e haganidia, eto, Aola, Iabese-gilead taudia na dare isena amo bavaladia mase, hahine bona memero maraḡidia danu bavaladia mase.
JDG.21.10.english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

JDG.17.5.motu: Hari tau, Mika, na mai ena dubu; bena ia ese dabua helaḡana bona kaivakuku e kara; bena natuna maruanena ta e duanaia, ena hahelaḡa tauna ai bainela.
JDG.17.5.english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

JDG.2.18.motu: Iehova ese Israel taudia edia hahemaoro taudia e duanaidia negadia ai, ia ese una hahemaoro tauna enai e taova, bona ena hahemaoro dinadia iboudiai lalodiai ia ese Israel taudia na inaidia imadia amo e hamauridiava; badina be e daḡedaḡe henidia bona e hahisihisidia taudia daidiai e ḡanaḡanava negadia ai na Iehova ese e bogadia hisiva.
JDG.2.18.english: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

JDG.6.9.motu: Aigupto taudia imadia amo na hamaurimui, bona e daḡedaḡe henimui taudia iboudiai imadia amo, bona na luludia lasi vairamui ai, bona edia tano na henimui;
JDG.6.9.english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

JDG.18.7.motu: Bena hari tatau laimaosi e raka oho, Laisi ai e kau, Una gabu ai e nohova taudia e itadia, mai mainodia ida e nohova, Sidono taudia heḡereḡeredia, asie raivaraiva, ḡau ta asie laloa, bona tanobada ḡauna ta ai asie dabu; idia bona Sidono taudia padadia na daudau, bona idia na bese ta ida asie hoihoi.
JDG.18.7.english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.

JDG.10.2.motu: Ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani ruahui-toi lalodiai. Bena e mase; Samiri ai e guria.
JDG.10.2.english: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

JDG.3.24.motu: Ia e raka oho murinai, hesiai taudia na ema, guhi daiutuna iduaradia e itaia vada e hekou; bena eto, Reana mei daiutuna ai vada e vareai.
JDG.3.24.english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

JDG.3.31.motu: Ia murinai, Samgara Anata e tore isi; ia ese Filistia taudia sinahutauratoi na boromakau ikododia ḡauna amo e aladia mase. Ia ese danu Israel taudia e hamauridia.
JDG.3.31.english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

JDG.9.19.motu: A na tomu, bema lalomui korikori amo bona kara maoromaoro amo Ierubu-baal mai ena ruma taudia ida vada o kara henidia hari dina ai, Abimelek boma moalelaia, bona ia ese umui bema moalelaimui.
JDG.9.19.english: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

JDG.18.31.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese hari e koroa laulauna, Mika ese e karaia ḡauna, e haginia, Dirava ena dubu na Silo ai e miava negadia iboudiai.
JDG.18.31.english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.

JDG.9.15.motu: Bema lalomui korikori be ba horogu, emui pavapava ai ba halaogu, vada baoma, lau ikerukerugu ai laḡamui bavani; a bema lasi, Iahi na au ginigini amo baine vasi, Lebanon sida-audia baine aradia ore.
JDG.9.15.english: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

JDG.1.16.motu: Kene taudia, Mose ravana vevena, na Iuda taudia ida pamu audia hanuana vada e rakatania, Iuda tano-ḡaḡaena ai vada ela, Arada diho kahana ai; idia na ela, una gabu taudia ida e hanoho.
JDG.1.16.english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

JDG.21.12.motu: A Iabese-gilead taudia bogaragidiai rami-hebou ulatodia sinahu-hani e davaridia; bena Silo taruhana e laohaidia, Kanaan tanona ai.
JDG.21.12.english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

JDG.14.5.motu: Bena Samson na tamana sinana ida Timuna ela. Bena Timuna taudia edia vine imeadia ai e kau negana ai, leona natuna ta ese e ḡou henia.
JDG.14.5.english: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him.

JDG.1.5.motu: Una Besek ai idia ese Adoni-besek e davaria, bena e tuari henia, Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia e hadareredia.
JDG.1.5.english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

JDG.9.56.motu: Unuheto amo Dirava ese Abimelek ena kara dika davana e henia: una kara dika be tadikakana hitu-ahui-osi e aladia mase, unu amo tamana e hadikaia.
JDG.9.56.english: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

JDG.10.7.motu: Bena Iehova ena badu vada e siahu Israel taudia latadiai; e negedia daure, Filistia taudia imadia ai bona Amono taudia imadia ai.
JDG.10.7.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

JDG.9.4.motu: Bena idia ese silver monidia hitu-ahui na Baal-beriti ena dubu amo e abi, e henia. Unu moni amo Abimelek ese tatau dikadia haida, asi lalodia taudia, davadia e heni, ia murinai bae raka totona.
JDG.9.4.english: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

JDG.5.14.motu: Efraim amo ema, koura ai e hekei diho;
JDG.5.14.english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim,

JDG.4.14.motu: Bena Debora ese Barak e haḡania, eto, A tore isi, dinana binai Iehova ese Sisera na oi imamu ai be atoamu. Iehova na oi vairamu ai basinela a? Taunabunai Barak na Taboro ororona amo e hekei, mai ena tuari taudia gerebu-ta ida.
JDG.4.14.english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

JDG.8.14.motu: Bena ia ese Sukoto tau-eregabena ta e dabaia tao, e nanadaia. Han eregabe tauna ese Sukoto Iohiadia bona tau-badadia ladadia e tore, iboudiai na tatau hitu-ahui hitu.
JDG.8.14.english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

JDG.8.29.motu: Ierubu-baal Ioasa na e lou ela, ena ruma ai e nohova.
JDG.8.29.english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

JDG.5.31.motu: Iehova e, inaimu idoinai unu bae mase toma!
JDG.5.31.english: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh,

JDG.2.15.motu: Tuari ela negadia iboudiai Iehova imana ese e hadikadia, Iehova ese vada e sisiba henidia bona e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena. Edia noho na dika rohoroho.
JDG.2.15.english: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

JDG.7.11.motu: edia hereva ba kamonai, gabeamo imamu bae goada ba hekei lao, edia taruha ai ba tuari henidia. Bena ena hesiai tauna Pura ida e hekei lao, ela bona tuari taudia taruha isena ai e hegima gabuna ai.
JDG.7.11.english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

JDG.20.22.motu: A Israel taudia na e haheauka, tuari gabuna ai ma e gini lou, tuari dinana gini-gunana ai e gini heḡereḡerena.
JDG.20.22.english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

JDG.20.1.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai e raka lasi, ibouboudiai na mai lalodia tamona e hebou, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba, bona Gilead amo danu, Iehova vairanai e hebou Mispa ai.
JDG.20.1.english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

JDG.10.9.motu: Amono taudia ese danu Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, Iuda bona Beniamina bona Efraim iduhudia taudia e tuari henidia. Taunabunai, Israel taudia na daradia e doko.
JDG.10.9.english: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

JDG.13.19.motu: Taunabunai, Manoa ese nani natuna bona flaoa boubouna e abi, nadi latanai e hahelaḡaia, Iehova, hoa karadia e karamu Diravana, ena. Manoa mai adavana ida ese e itaia.
JDG.13.19.english: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.

JDG.6.40.motu: Una hanuaboi, Dirava ese unu e kara toma: mamoe huina na kaukau, a tano idoinai vada e paripari.
JDG.6.40.english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

JDG.4.19.motu: Sisera ese e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara ranu kuri ta a henigu, aina inua, badina be ranu e masegu. Hahine na rata kopi ta e kehoa, rata kuri ta e henia, bena e inua. Ma e tarua lou.
JDG.4.19.english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.”

JDG.21.21.motu: ba henari; bena Silo ulatodia bema raka lasi, mavaru ai bema mavaru, umui ese vine imeadia amo ba heau lasi, ta ta adavamui ba dabaidia tao, Silo ulatodia bogaragidia amo, bena Beniamina tanona baola.
JDG.21.21.english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

JDG.11.12.motu: Iefeta ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Amono pavapavana dekenai, eto, Emu badu egu ai be dahaka, bena egu tano ituari-henina vada oma a?
JDG.11.12.english: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

JDG.9.20.motu: A bema lasi, lahi na Abimelek ena amo baine vasi, Sekem taumui bona Bete-milo taudia baine aramui ore; bona lahi na Sekem taumui emui amo bona Bete-milo taudia edia amo baine lasi, Abimelek baine araia.
JDG.9.20.english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

JDG.20.37.motu: Una negana ai hanua e bani henia taudia e heau lasi haraḡa-haraḡa, Gibea e daea, bena idia ese hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia mase.
JDG.20.37.english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

JDG.9.32.motu: Taunabunai, hanuaboi ai baola, oi mai emu orea taudia ida, tano paka ai ba henari.
JDG.9.32.english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

JDG.13.2.motu: Tau ta Sora ai e nohova, ladana na Manoa; ia na Dan iduhuna tauna. Adavana vada e gabani, asi natuna.
JDG.13.2.english: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.

JDG.21.9.motu: Badina be hebou taudia e hagaudia negana ai, Iabese-gilead taudia na lasihidia, ta se hedinarai.
JDG.21.9.english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

JDG.2.5.motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Bokimi. Unuseni ai idia ese Iehova e boua.
JDG.2.5.english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.

JDG.11.38.motu: Ia eto, Aola. Bena e kahua nege, hua rua. Ia na mai bamona kekenidia ida ela, ororo ai e taitai, rami-hebouna ai baine mase dainai.
JDG.11.38.english: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

JDG.18.28.motu: Asi ihamauridia tauna ta, badina be Sidono na daudau, bona idia na bese ta ida asie hoihoi. Una gabu na Bete-rehob kourana ai. Bena idia ese hanua ma e hadaia lou, bena e noholaia.
JDG.18.28.english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

JDG.18.11.motu: Bena Dan taudia sinahu tauratoi, mai edia tuari ḡaudia imadia ai, Sora amo bona Estaol amo e raka lasi,
JDG.18.11.english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

JDG.3.15.motu: A Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia: bena Iehova ese ihamauridia tauna ta e abia hidi, Ehud Gera, Beniamina iduhuna tauna: ia na tau lauri. Israel taudia edia herahia ḡauna na ia imana ai e siaia, hari Eglon, Moab pavapavana, enai.
JDG.3.15.english: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

JDG.19.29.motu: Ena ruma lalonai e raka vareai, bena kaia e abia, ena hahine tau-anina e abia, e utua parara, rege gwauta-rua; bena e siaidia, Israel tanona idoinai.
JDG.19.29.english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

JDG.15.2.motu: Hari tamana eto, Lau na laloa oi ese vada o dadaraia vaitani, taunabunai oi bamomu na henia. A tadina danu hane namo; ia ese kakana e hereaiamu. Mani emu kara ia bavabia, kakana gabuna ai.
JDG.15.2.english: Her father said, “I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead.”

JDG.4.23.motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai Dirava ese Iabin, Kanaan pavapavana, e hadarerea, Israel taudia vairadiai.
JDG.4.23.english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

JDG.6.25.motu: Una hanuaboi, Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tamamu ena boromakau maruanena, boromakau maruanena iharuana, laḡani hitu ḡauna, bavabia, Baal ena ihaboulaina patana, tamamu ena, ba ḡiḡia dobi; bona au helaḡana, ia badinai gini, ba hagaria.
JDG.6.25.english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

JDG.5.18.motu: Sebulun taudia na edia mauri inegena asie gari,
JDG.5.18.english: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death;

JDG.19.16.motu: Tau buruka ta ena biru ḡaukarana amo ema, adorahi kahana ai; ia be Efraim ororodia amo ema Gibea ai e noho hedoava tauna; a hanua taudia na Beniamina taudia.
JDG.19.16.english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

JDG.20.32.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Vairadai vada e darere, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia. A Israel taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Aita heau, hanua amo baita veridia oho laolao daladia ai.
JDG.20.32.english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

JDG.20.2.motu: Hanua lohiadia iboudiai, Israel iduhudia iboudiai amo, danu e hebou, Dirava ena orea taudia vairadiai: idia na talau domaga-hani, aedia amo e rakava, mai edia dare.
JDG.20.2.english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

JDG.6.4.motu: e taruha, tano anidia e hadika, Israel tanona idoinai ela bona Gasa. Aniani ḡauna ta eiava mamoe ta eiava boromakau ta eiava doniki ta asie rakatania Israel ai.
JDG.6.4.english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

JDG.16.12.motu: Taunabunai, Delila ese kwanau matamatadia e abi, e guia, bena eto, Samson e, Filistia taudia na emu ai be kaumu. Hari e henari noho taudia na laloma daiutuna ai. A Samson ese imana e ḡuilai kwanaudia e hamotudia, turituri varodia na heheto.
JDG.16.12.english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.

JDG.18.6.motu: Mai mainomui ida aola; emui laolao na Iehova ese e itaia taomu.
JDG.18.6.english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”

JDG.6.23.motu: A Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Maino avabia; asio gari, oi na basio mase.
JDG.6.23.english: Yahweh said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

JDG.12.5.motu: Bena Gilead taudia na Ioridane sinavaina ena turu-hanai gabudia e abidia, e gimadia, Efraim taudia na basie hanai. Efraim taudia haida na e heau ema; bena idia ta eto “Mani emui kara baina turu hanai” negana ai, Gilead taudia ese e nanadaia, eto “Oi Efraim tauna a?” Bena ia eto “Lasi” negana ai,
JDG.12.5.english: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”

JDG.9.29.motu: Ina orea bama biagua, Abimelek bama abia oho. Oibe, Abimelek bama hamaoroa, bama toma “Emu tuari taudia ba hahohodia, bena ba raka lasi, ba tuari”.
JDG.9.29.english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

JDG.20.9.motu: A Gibea na ini baita karaia toma: mari amo baita diba, daika daika ese bae tuari henia.
JDG.20.9.english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

JDG.21.4.motu: Bena daba ai, idia na e tore isi haraḡa, boubou patana ta e larebaia, latanai ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia.
JDG.21.4.english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

JDG.3.26.motu: Idia na e henari nohova ai na Ehud ese vada e heau mauri, nadipupudia e hanaidia, Seira ela.
JDG.3.26.english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

JDG.9.30.motu: Sebulu, hanua lohiana, ese Gaal Ebed ena hereva e kamonai, bena e badu.
JDG.9.30.english: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

JDG.12.7.motu: Iefeta na Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani tauratoi. Bena Iefeta, tau Gilead, e mase; iena hanua ai e guna, Gilead ai.
JDG.12.7.english: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

JDG.16.22.motu: A kwarana huina ma e vara matama, e naua murinai.
JDG.16.22.english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

JDG.20.18.motu: Israel taudia na e tore isi, Betele ela, Dirava e nanadaia, eto, Edena iduhu bainela guna, Beniamina taudia baine tuari henidia? Iehova eto, Iuda iduhuna baine guna.
JDG.20.18.english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?”

JDG.16.4.motu: Una murinai Samson ese Soreke kourana hahinena ta e ura henia; hahine ladana na Delila.
JDG.16.4.english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

JDG.12.6.motu: idia ma eto “Aogwa Shibboleth”. Bena ia na eto “ Sibboleth”, badina be igwaurai-maorona na malana se heḡereḡere. Bena e dabaia tao, e alaia mase, Ioridane sinavaina ena turu-hanai gabudia ai. Una negana ai Efraim taudia gerebu-hani daha-ma e mase.
JDG.12.6.english: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

JDG.5.30.motu: Kohu namodia e abi, e hari, ani?
JDG.5.30.english: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder?

JDG.11.15.motu: Idia ese e hereva henia, eto, Iefeta na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel na Moab tanona bona Amono taudia edia tano asie dadi.
JDG.11.15.english: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

JDG.8.10.motu: Hari Sebaha bona Salmuna na Karakoro ai e nohova, mai edia tuari oreadia ida. Idia na tatau gerebu-ta daha-ima sisivana, mairiveina kahana taudia edia tuari oreana amo e roho mauri taudia. A dare e abi taudia domaga-ta gerebu-rua vada e mase.
JDG.8.10.english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

JDG.8.28.motu: Taunabunai, Midian vada e darere, Israel taudia vairadiai; idia na asie gaga isi lou. Bena tano na vada e maino, laḡani hariahui lalodiai, Gideon ena mauri dinadia ai.
JDG.8.28.english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

JDG.20.30.motu: Dina ihatoina ai, Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia ma e tuan henidia, Gibea vairanai ma e gini, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia.
JDG.20.30.english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

JDG.11.22.motu: Amoro taudia edia tano idoinai e abia, edia: Aranon sinavaina amo ela bona labok sinavaina, bona tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona londane sinavaina.
JDG.11.22.english: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

JDG.1.13.motu: Bena Otoniele, Kaleb tadina Kena natuna, ese e abia; bena Kaleb ese natuna kekenina Aksa na e heni; l, bena ia ese e adavaia.
JDG.1.13.english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

JDG.4.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iabin, Kanaan pavapavana, imana ai e atodia. Una tau na Hasoro Iohiana; ena tuari oreana biaguna na Sisera, Haroset-ha-goim ai e nohova tauna.
JDG.4.2.english: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

JDG.9.28.motu: Gaal Ebed eto, Abimelek be daika? Ita Sekem tauda danu daidia? Ita ese ia isiaina baita lao heni a? Ina lerubu-baal natuna, mai ena hesiai tauna Sebulu ida, ese Sekem tamana Hamoro garana isiaidia bema lao heni hari namo. Dahaka dainai ita ese ia isiaina baita lao heni?
JDG.9.28.english: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

JDG.13.7.motu: To, ia ese e hamaorogu, eto “Oi na ba rogorogo, mero ta bavabia; taunabunai vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana ta basio inua, bona ḡau mirona ta basio ania, badina be una mero na baine helaga Dirava ena, Nasiri oreana tauna, ena vara dinana amo, ela bona ena mase dinana”.
JDG.13.7.english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”

JDG.12.2.motu: Iefeta ese e haere henidia, eto, Lau bona egu orea taudia emai heai na bada, Amono taudia ida, bena na boirimui negana ai umui na asioma, idia imadia amo asio hamaurigu.
JDG.12.2.english: Jephthah said to them, “I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you didn’t save me out of their hand.

JDG.13.14.motu: vine anidia basine ani, vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana ta basine inua, bona ḡau mirona ta basine ania; na henia haheḡanidia iboudiai baine badinadia.
JDG.13.14.english: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”

JDG.11.16.motu: A Aigupto amo ema negana ai, Israel na tano ḡaḡaena amo ema, ema bona Davara Kakakakana, bona Kade ai e kau.
JDG.11.16.english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

JDG.3.10.motu: Iehova ena Lauma ese ia e rohea; bena ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia. Ma e tore isi, eha tuari; bena Iehova ese Kusan-risataimi, Mesopotamia pavapavana, na ia imana ai e atoa; bena ia ese e hadarerea.
JDG.3.10.english: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

JDG.3.11.motu: Taunabunai, tano na vada e maino, laḡani hari-ahui; una murinai Otoniele Kena e mase.
JDG.3.11.english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

JDG.6.20.motu: Dirava ena aneru ese e hamaoroa, eto, Vamu bona dikea na bavabi, ina nadi ai bavato, bena vasiahu na latadiai ba seia. Bena ia na unu e kara toma.
JDG.6.20.english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.”

JDG.20.15.motu: Una dina ai Beniamina taudia hanua hanua amo e hebou na tatau gerebu-rua daha-tauratoi mai edia dare; bona Gibea taudia edia tuari taudia mai goadadia be tatau sinahu-hitu.
JDG.20.15.english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

JDG.9.2.motu: Sekem taudia iboudiai lalodia bavani, baoto “Edena namo, Ierubu-baal natuna hitu-ahui-osi iboudiai ese bae halohiamui, eiava tamona ese?” Ba laloa danu, lau na umui turiamui bona umui hidiomui.
JDG.9.2.english: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

JDG.2.3.motu: Taunabunai, harihari na hamaoromuimu, na tomu, Basina luludia lasi vairamui ai: idia na inaimui ai baela, bona edia dirava ese bae idoamui.
JDG.2.3.english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

JDG.3.30.motu: Una dina ai Israel taudia ese Moab taudia e hadareredia vaitani; bena tano na vada e maino, laḡani taurahani-ahui lalodiai.
JDG.3.30.english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

JDG.17.11.motu: Bena Levi tauna lalona vada e heḡereḡere Mika dekenai baine noho; bena una tauhau na ia natuna heḡereḡeredia ai ela.
JDG.17.11.english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

JDG.4.6.motu: Ia ese hereva e siaia, Barak Abinaom na Napatali hanuana ta amo e boiria: una hanua ladana na Kede. E hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese se haḡanimu a? Aola, emu tuari oreana na Taboro ororona ai ba haboudia: gerebu-ta bavabidia Napatali iduhuna amo bona Sebulun iduhuna amo.
JDG.4.6.english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

JDG.9.36.motu: Gaal ese e itadia, bena ia ese Sebulu e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, taunimanima haida be ororo doridia amo e hekei e maimu. Sebulu ese e haere henia, eto, Ororo laulaudia o itadiamu, itaitadia na taunimanima na heheto.
JDG.9.36.english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.”

JDG.18.26.motu: Bena Dan taudia na edia laolao ela; a Mika vada e diba, idia edia goada ese iena goada e hereaiava; bena e lou, ena ruma e lou henia.
JDG.18.26.english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

JDG.6.8.motu: bena Iehova ese peroveta tauna ta e siaia, Israel taudia dekediai. Ia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na e tomu: Aigupto amo na abimui oho, iḡui rumana amo na hakaumui lasi;
JDG.6.8.english: Yahweh sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

JDG.6.24.motu: Bena Gideon ese ihaboulaina patana auta e larebaia unuseni ai, Iehova ena; ladana e hatoa Iehova-salom. Ia na doini mia, Ofra ai, Abiesere taudia edia tano ai, ema bona hari.
JDG.6.24.english: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

JDG.6.31.motu: A Ioasa ese e heai henidia taudia iboudiai e haere henidia, eto, Be, Baal dainai bavala-ala a? Ia ba durua o tomu a? Daika ese ia dainai baine ala-ala, una tau na daba do basine rere ai baine mase. Bema ia dirava ta, ia sibona baine ala-ala, ena ihaboulaina patana vada e heḡiḡi dobi dainai.
JDG.6.31.english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

JDG.6.16.motu: Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, A lau ese baina bamomu, bena Midian taudia ba hadareredia, tau tamona boma hadarerea na heto.
JDG.6.16.english: Yahweh said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

JDG.8.19.motu: Gideon eto, Idia na lau tadigu, lau sinagu natuna; Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena, boma hamauridia lau ese basinama alamui mase.
JDG.8.19.english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

JDG.1.29.motu: Efraim taudia ese danu Kanaan taudia Gesere ai e nohova na asie luludia lasi; Kanaan taudia na idia bogaragidiai e nohova Gesere ai.
JDG.1.29.english: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

JDG.11.26.motu: Israel na laḡani sinahu-toi Hesebon mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Aroere mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Aranon sinavaina isena hanuadia iboudiai, e noholai: dahaka dainai una negana ai asio abidia lou?
JDG.11.26.english: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

JDG.9.17.motu: Badina be tamagu na umui daimui ai e tuariva, ena mauri se laloava, Midian taudia imadia amo e hamaurimui;
JDG.9.17.english: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

JDG.20.36.motu: Taunabunai Beniamina taudia na lalodia e parara vada e darere.
JDG.20.36.english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

JDG.2.11.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova vairanai e kara havara, dirava idaudia, ladadia Baal, isiaidia e lao heni.
JDG.2.11.english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.

JDG.19.30.motu: Bena e itaia taudia iboudiai eto, Kara unuhetomana na nega hata se vara bona nega hata se hedinarai, Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi dinana amo ema bona hari ina dina. Ba haeroa, ba henegalaia, ba herevalaia.
JDG.19.30.english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

JDG.3.2.motu: bona uru ta ta ai Israel taudia do asi dibadia na baine hadibadia totona se luludia lasi.
JDG.3.2.english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

JDG.3.16.motu: Bena Ehud na dare ta e karaia, isena kahana kahana matadia e kara: ena lata be kiubit ta. Ia ese idiba kahana gabana ḡauna ai e atoa, bena ena rami amo e rioa tao.
JDG.3.16.english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

JDG.9.53.motu: Bena hahine ta ese uit iririlaina nadina ta e tahoa dobi, Abimelek kwarana ai, kwarana koukouna e hamakohia.
JDG.9.53.english: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

JDG.11.24.motu: Emu dirava Kemoso ese vada e henimu tanodia bavabi, ani, emu tano? A Iehova, emai Dirava, ese ai vairamai ai e luludia lasi taudia edia tano na ai ese baia abi, emai tano.
JDG.11.24.english: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever Yahweh our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.

JDG.3.3.motu: Besedia bini: Filistia lohiadia laima, hona Kanaan taudia iboudiai, bona Sidono taudia, bona Hivi taudia Lebanon ororodia ai e nohova, Baalheremon ororona amo ela bona Hamat ivareaina gabuna.
JDG.3.3.english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

JDG.20.31.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na ituari-henidia e raka lasi, hanua na e rakatania; bena nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia idia na e ala-ala matama, Israel taudia haida laolao daladia ai e aladia mase, Betele dalana ai bona Gibea dalana ai, bona tano paka ai danu haida e aladia mase. E aladia taudia na Israel taudia toi-ahui sisivana.
JDG.20.31.english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

JDG.9.41.motu: Bena Abimelek na Aruma ai ma e noho; a Sebulu ese Gaal mai varavarana ida e luludia lasi, Sekem ai basie noho.
JDG.9.41.english: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

JDG.1.28.motu: Gabeai, Israel taudia e goadava negana ai, idia ese Kanaan taudia e abidia, edia hesiai taudia ai e halaodia, a asie luludia lasi.
JDG.1.28.english: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

JDG.20.43.motu: Oibe, idia ese Beniamina taudia e ginidia ahu, bona e hahavadia lao, bona e aladia, Noha amo ela bona Gibea mairiveina kahana ai.
JDG.20.43.english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

JDG.6.37.motu: mani a itaia, lau na mamoe ta kopina, mai huina, uit ikwadina gabuna ai vada na lahaiamu: hunu na mamoe huina bema hapariparia a ia badina tanona idoinai bema kaukau, bama diba oi ese lau imagu amo Israel ba hamauria, emu hereva heḡereḡerena.
JDG.6.37.english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

JDG.13.1.motu: Israel taudia ma e kara havara, Iehova vairanai: bena Iehova ese Filistia taudia imadia ai e atodia, laḡani hari-ahui.
JDG.13.1.english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight; and Yahweh delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

JDG.16.10.motu: Bena Delila ese Samson ma e hereva henia, eto, O itaia, vada o kirikirilaigu bona vada o koigu; mani emu kara ba hamaorogu, ede bema ḡuimu toma.
JDG.16.10.english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”

JDG.3.28.motu: Ia ese danu e hamaorodia, eto, Murigu amo a raka, badina be Iehova ese inaimui Moab taudia na imamui ai vada e atodia. Taunabunai, idia na ia murina amo e diho ela, turu-hanai gabudia Ioridane sinavaina ai, Moab hevaira-hehenina ai, e ginidia ahu, tau ta basine turu hanai diba.
JDG.3.28.english: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

JDG.9.33.motu: Bena daba matana ai ba tore isi haraḡa, hanua ba heau henia; bena ia mai ena orea taudia ida bae raka lasi bae tuari henimui negana ai, emui goada heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henidia.
JDG.9.33.english: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”

JDG.9.45.motu: Una dina idoinai Abimelek ese hanua na e tuari henia: hanua na e abia, bona hanua taudia iboudiai na e aladia mase. Hanua na e haheḡiḡia dobi, bona damena e ḡiḡia rohoroho, hanua tanona idoinai.
JDG.9.45.english: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

JDG.16.6.motu: Bena Delila ese Samson e hereva henia, eto, Mani emu kara ba hamaorogu, emu goada na ede amo o abiamu; ede bema ḡuimu toma, bena bema hamanadamu.
JDG.16.6.english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”

JDG.11.33.motu: Bena ia ese e aladia, Aroere amo ela bona Miniti badibadinai. Hanua ruahui e abidia, ela bona Abele-keramim, mai ala-ala bada hereana ida. Taunabunai, Amono taudia vada e darere, Israel taudia vairadiai.
JDG.11.33.english: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

JDG.12.1.motu: Efraim taudia ese edia tuari gaudia e abi, e tore isi, e hanai, Safon ela, Iefeta e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai Amono taudia ituarihenidia totona o hanai negana ai na so boirimai, ai danu baiama lao? Ai na oiemu ruma baia doua, oi kwaramu ai.
JDG.12.1.english: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”

JDG.9.11.motu: A suke auna ese edia hereva e haloua, eto, Egu gaiho bona egu huahua namodia baina rakatanidia, au baina biagudia a?
JDG.9.11.english: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

JDG.1.23.motu: Iosef taudia ese haida e siaidia, Betele bae hasinadoa. (Una hanua ladana gunana be Lusu.)
JDG.1.23.english: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)

JDG.3.6.motu: Idia ese unu bese taudia natudia ulatodia e adavadia; bona idia natudia ulatodia na unu bese uhaudia e henidia, bae adavadia. Idia ese danu unu bese edia dirava isiaidia e lao heniva.
JDG.3.6.english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

JDG.13.16.motu: A Iehova ena aneru ese Manoa e haere henia, eto, Boma dogogu tao, to amui basina ania; a ḡole-oho boubouna boma heḡaeḡaelaia, vada ba hahelaḡaia Iehova ena. (Badina be Manoa lalona do se parara una na Iehova ena aneru).
JDG.13.16.english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to Yahweh.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was Yahweh’s angel.

JDG.7.2.motu: Iehova ese Gideon e hereva henia, eto, E bamomumu taudia na hutuma herea. Midian taudia na idia imadia ai bama atodia, Israel na lau vairagu ai bema hekokoroku, bema toma “Ai sibomai imamai amo vada a hahemauri”.
JDG.7.2.english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

JDG.18.23.motu: Idia ese Dan taudia e lolo henidia. Bena Dan taudia na e gini kerehai, Mika e nanadaia, eto, Emu lalo-hisihisi be dahaka? Ina orea ida oma badina be dahaka?
JDG.18.23.english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”

JDG.1.6.motu: A Adoni-besek e heau; bena idia ese e ḡavaia ela bona e abia mauri; bena imana sinabadadia bona aena sinabadadia e utudia oho.
JDG.1.6.english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

JDG.9.25.motu: Bena Sekem taudia ese e bani henia, ororo doridia ai; bona una dala amo e laolaova taudia iboudiai edia kohu e dadi. A haida ese Abimelek e hamaoroa.
JDG.9.25.english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

JDG.8.15.motu: Sukoto taudia dekediai e kau, bena e hereva henidia, eto, Sebaha bona Salmuna a itadia. Umui ese o hevaseha henigu, oto “Sebaha bona Salmuna vada o abidia mauri, una dainai emu orea taudia na edia manori ai baia ubudia a?”
JDG.8.15.english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

JDG.18.3.motu: Mika ena ruma badibadinai, idia ese hari Levi tauna eregabena gadona e kamonai, bena dibadia daika gadona, bena e raka siri, e nanadaia, eto, Daika ese e hakaumu mai iniseni ai? Ina gabu ai dahaka o karamu? Emu ḡaukara be dahaka iniseni ai?
JDG.18.3.english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

JDG.1.17.motu: Bena Iuda taudia na tadidia Simeon taudia ida ela, Kanaan taudia Sefata ai e nohova na e hadareredia, bona edia hanua e habuaia tari; taunabunai una hanua ladana e gwauraia Horoma.
JDG.1.17.english: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.

JDG.13.12.motu: Manoa ma eto, Emu hereva bae momokani negana ai, hari mero na ede baine noho toma, bona ede baine kara toma?
JDG.13.12.english: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”

JDG.17.2.motu: Ia ese sinana e hamaoroa, eto, Hari silver monidia daha-ta sinahu-ta oiemu amo e heabi-oho, bona daidiai oi ese heuduguirai herevana o gwauraia, bena lau danu na kamonai, ḡaudia na lau dekegu ai; lau ese na abidia. Bena sinana eto, Iehova ena hahenamo na natugu latanai baine mia.
JDG.17.2.english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.”

JDG.11.27.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese asina hadikamu, a oi hari o tuari henigumu bona o kara dika henigumu. Iehova, Hahemaoro Diravana, ese Israel taudia bona Amono taudia baine hahemaoro henidia, hari ina dina ai.
JDG.11.27.english: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May Yahweh the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

JDG.19.18.motu: Tau na e haere, eto, Ai na Betelehem-Iuda amo vada ama, gabu daudauna Efraim ororodia ai baia laomu. Lau na unu amo nama, Betelehem-Iuda nala; harihari egu ruma ba laomu, bena asi tauna ta vada e abigu dae ena ruma ai.
JDG.19.18.english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to Yahweh’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

JDG.19.17.motu: Tau buruka na e gaga dae, hari laolao tauna e itaia, hanua ariarana ai. Tau buruka eto, Oi na ede bo Iaomu, bona ede amo oma?
JDG.19.17.english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

JDG.6.22.motu: Bena Gideon lalona e parara una na Iehova ena aneru. Gideon na eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, madi ihabaigu! Badina be Iehova ena aneru ida vada a hevaira heheni.
JDG.6.22.english: Gideon saw that he was Yahweh’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh! Because I have seen Yahweh’s angel face to face!”

JDG.14.10.motu: Tamana ese una hane-ulato dekenai e kau; bena Samson ese aria ta e karaia, headava matamata taudia vaevae e karava heḡereḡerena.
JDG.14.10.english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.

JDG.2.12.motu: Idia ese Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi Diravana, e rakatania; dirava idaudia, bogaragidiai e nohova besedia edia dirava, muridia amo e raka bona e toma henidia diho; unu amo idia ese Iehova ena badu e havaraia.
JDG.2.12.english: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.

JDG.9.57.motu: Dirava ese danu Sekem taudia edia kara dika iboudiai idia kwaradia ai e haloudia, Iotam Ierubu-baal ena hahedika na idia latadiai e kau.
JDG.9.57.english: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

JDG.14.9.motu: Bena ia ese bada-ranuna na imana amo e pipitaia lasi, rakana ai e ania; bona tamana sinana ediai e kau negana ai taina vada e henidia, bena idia danu e ania. A se hamaorodia una bada-ranuna na leona tau-anina lalona amo e abia.
JDG.14.9.english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.

JDG.8.22.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Gideon e hereva henia, eto, Ba halohiamai: oi bona natumu bona tubumu danu bae halohiamai; badina be Midian taudia imadia amo vada o hamaurimai.
JDG.8.22.english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

JDG.20.12.motu: Bena Israel iduhudia iboudiai ese edia gwau-kau taudia e siaidia, Beniamina iduhuna taudia dekediai, eto, Ena kara dikana bogaragimui ai e vara anina be dahaka?
JDG.20.12.english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

JDG.1.4.motu: Bena Iuda na eha tuari. Bena Iehova ese Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia na idia imadia ai e atodia: gerebu ta e hadareredia Besek ai.
JDG.1.4.english: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

JDG.1.30.motu: Sebulun taudia ese danu Kitron taudia bona Nahalolo taudia na asie luludia lasi; Kanaan taudia na idia bogaragidiai e nohova bona isiaidia e lao heniva.
JDG.1.30.english: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.

JDG.3.13.motu: Hari Eglon ese Amono taudia bona Amalek taudia e haboudia; bena idia ese Israel taudia e hadareredia, pamu audia hanuana e abia.
JDG.3.13.english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

JDG.9.12.motu: Bena au ese vine e hereva henia, eto, Oi hari emai pavapava ai baola.
JDG.9.12.english: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

JDG.19.7.motu: Hari Levi tauna e tore isi, baine raka eto; a ravana ese e noia loulou, ela bona ma e hekure diho.
JDG.19.7.english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

JDG.6.5.motu: Edia boromakau e hakaudia vareai bona edia taruha e hagini. Idia na hutuma, kwadi na heheto; idia bona edia kamelo danu ta basinema duahidia diba; taunabunai ema negadia ai na tano anidia e ha-ore.
JDG.6.5.english: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.

JDG.4.18.motu: Bena laele na e raka lasi, Sisera e hedavari henia, e hamaoroa, eto, Gauka e, a raka vareai dekegu ai; basio gari. Taunabunai, ia na ia dekenai e raka vareai, kalaga lalonai: hahine na hetaru e abia, e tarua ahu.
JDG.4.18.english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

JDG.8.30.motu: Hari Gideon natuna mamaruanedia na hitu-ahui, ia natuna korikoridia, natu-adoradia; badina be adavana na momo.
JDG.8.30.english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

JDG.18.12.motu: ela, Kiriat-iearimi ai e taruha, Iuda tanona ai. Una dainai una gabu ladana e hatoa Mahane-dan, ema bona hari dina; ia na Kiriat-iearimi lahara kahana ai.
JDG.18.12.english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

JDG.20.19.motu: Daba ai, Israel taudia e tore isi, Gibea vairanai e taruha.
JDG.20.19.english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

JDG.21.13.motu: Bena hebou taudia iboudiai ese gwau-kau herevana e siaia, Beniamina taudia dounu Rimon haga-nadina ai e nohova dekediai, maino e gwauraia.
JDG.21.13.english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

JDG.7.22.motu: Kibi sinahu-toiosi e hiriri negana ai, Iehova ese tuari taudia e hadaradaradia, bena ta ta ena dare ena dare e abi, e heatu heheni. Tuari oreana e heau, ela bona Bete-sita, Serera kahana ai, ela bona Abele-mehola hetoana, Tabata badinai.
JDG.7.22.english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

JDG.16.18.motu: Delila lalona vada e parara ia na lalona anina idoinai vada e hahedinarai henia; bena ia ese Filistia lohiadia e boiridia, eto, Ina nega tamona ma baoma, badina be ia ese lalona anina idoinai vada e hahedinarai henigu. Bena Filistia lohiadia na dekena ema, moni danu imadia ai e mailai.
JDG.16.18.english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.

JDG.8.33.motu: Gideon e mase murinai, asi vanahana Israel taudia ma e raka muri, Kanaan taudia edia dirava e toma henidia diho; bona ta, ladana na Baalberiti, e abia, edia dirava ai e halaoa.
JDG.8.33.english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

JDG.18.16.motu: Hari Dan taudia sinahu-tauratoiosi mai edia tuari ḡaudia imadia ai, na ikoukou badibadinai e gini;
JDG.18.16.english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

JDG.18.22.motu: Mika ena ruma amo taina vada e raka daudau, bena Mika ena ruma badibadina rumadia taudia e hebou, ela, Dan taudia e ḡavadia tao.
JDG.18.22.english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.

JDG.1.2.motu: Iehova eto, Iuda ese baine gunalaimui; a itaia, tano na ia imana ai vada na atoa.
JDG.1.2.english: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

JDG.9.51.motu: Hanua lalonai na kohoro aukana ta; bena hanua taudia iboudiai, tatau bona hahine, na e heau vareai, e hekou ahu; bena kohoro guhina ai e dae.
JDG.9.51.english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

JDG.1.21.motu: A Beniamina taudia ese Iebusu taudia Ierusalem ai e nohova na asie luludia lasi; taunabunai, Iebusu taudia na Beniamina taudia ida vada e noho hebou Ierusalem ai, ema bona hari dina.
JDG.1.21.english: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

JDG.16.8.motu: Bena Filistia lohiadia ese peva maoradia matamatadia hitu, do asie kaukau ḡaudia, e henia; bena ia ese e ḡuia.
JDG.16.8.english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

JDG.20.10.motu: Israel iduhudia iboudiai lalodia amo, sinahu-ta amo gwauta baita abidia hidi, bona daha-ta amo sinahu-ta baita abidia hidi, bona gerebu-ta amo daha-ta baita abidia hidi. Idia na baela, aniani ḡaudia bae ha abi, ina orea taudia adia; bena Gibea ai bae kau negana ai, idia ese Gibea taudia edia kara havara iboudiai Israel bogaraginai vada e kara na davadia do bae henidia.
JDG.20.10.english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”

JDG.16.26.motu: Bena Samson ese imana amo e hakaua merona na e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara ruma au-tubuadia baina dau toho, ediai baina tabe kau.
JDG.16.26.english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”

JDG.1.15.motu: Ia ese e noia, eto, Emu herahia do ba henigu. Egu noho gabuna vada o henigu tano kaukauna ai, diho kahana ai; harihari ranu gabudia ma ba henigu. Taunabunai, Kaleb ese atai ranu gabudia bona henu ranu gabudia e henia.
JDG.1.15.english: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

JDG.20.16.motu: Ini iboudiai bogaragidiai na ima-lauri taudia mai goadadia sinahu-hitu; idia iboudiai na vilipopo amo nadi bema tahoa, hui autamona basiema reaia.
JDG.20.16.english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

JDG.16.9.motu: Tatau haida vada e hunidia, laloma daiutuna ai e henari noho. Bena ia eto, Samson e, Filistia taudia na emu ai be kaumu. A ia ese peva maoradia e hamotudia, varo haurahaurana lahi ai e kaumu bena e motumu na heto. Taunabunai, ena goada badina na dounu hehuni, tau ta asi dibana.
JDG.16.9.english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.

JDG.16.14.motu: Bena Samson mahutana ai Delila ese huina e pania, ipani hitu, bena ipani hituosi na e hatuava dabuana ai e hatu kau, bona gwada-tao ḡauna amo e daia tao. Bena ia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Samson e, Filistia taudia na emu ai be kaumu. Bena ena mahuta amo e noga, gwada-tao ḡauna bona dabua ihatulaina ḡau bona e hatuava dabuana na iboudiai e raḡadia oho.
JDG.16.14.english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.

JDG.11.29.motu: Iehova ena Lauma ese leieta e rohea, bena ia ese Gilead bona Manase tanodia e rakadia hanai, ela bona Mispa, Gilead tanona ai; unu amo Amono taudia e lao henidia.
JDG.11.29.english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.

JDG.20.13.motu: Hari kara havara taudia Gibea ai taodia ba tore, ai ese baia aladia mase, kara havara na Israel bogaraginai baine ore. A Beniamina taudia na tadikakadia Israel taudia eredia asie kamonai.
JDG.20.13.english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.”

JDG.11.21.motu: Bena Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese Sihon mai ena orea taudia iboudiai na Israel taudia imadia ai e atodia. Bena idia ese e hadareredia; taunabunai Israel taudia ese Amoro taudia, una tano ai e nohova taudia, edia tano idoinai e abia.
JDG.11.21.english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

JDG.14.18.motu: Bena dina ihahituna ai, dina do se diho, hanua taudia ese Samson e hamaoroa, eto,
JDG.14.18.english: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?”

JDG.18.5.motu: Idia ese ma e hereva henia, eto, Ai a noimumu, Dirava enai ba tahua bena baia diba, ina emai laolao harihari a matamaiamu be anina baine vara eiava? Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese e haere henidia, eto,
JDG.18.5.english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”

JDG.20.44.motu: Beniamina taudia gerebu-ta daha-taurahani e mase, iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia.
JDG.20.44.english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

JDG.5.27.english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay.

JDG.1.25.motu: Bena ia ese bae vareai dalana e haheitalaidia. Bena idia ese hanua e abia, hanua taudia na dare isena amo e aladia ore; a una tau mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida e kahudia nege.
JDG.1.25.english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

JDG.19.1.motu: Unu dinadia ai, Israel na asi pavapavana negana ai, Levi tauna ta Efraim ororodia ai e nohova, gabu daudau ai. Ia ese hesiai hahinena ta Betelehem-luda amo e abia, e adavaia.
JDG.19.1.english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

JDG.18.19.motu: Bena idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Eremu; udumu na imamu amo a koua; baitala, ai tamamai ai bona emai hahelaḡa tauna ai baola. Edena be namo: ba noho, ruma ta taudia edia hahelaḡa tauna, eiava, Israel iduhuna ta taudia edia hahelaḡa tauna ai baola?
JDG.18.19.english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”

JDG.6.28.motu: Hanua taudia na daba matana ai e tore isi, e itaia, Baal ena ihaboulaina patana vada e hegiḡi dobi, bona au helaḡana ia badinai vada e gari, bona hari boromakau maruanena iharuana vada e heḡole oho, ihaboulaina patana matamatana latanai.
JDG.6.28.english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

JDG.4.22.motu: Bena Barak ese Sisera e hahavaia negana ai, Iaele na e raka lasi, ia ida e hedavari, e hamaoroa, eto, Aoma; o tahuamu tauna baina haheitalaimu. Taunabunai ia na hahine ena kalaga ai e raka vareai, unuseni ai Sisera na masena ai e hekure, ikoko na dounu ibunina daena ai mia.
JDG.4.22.english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

JDG.21.19.motu: Taunabunai idia ma eto, Laḡani ta ta amo taunimanima ese Iehova ena aria ta e karaiamu Silo ai, Betele mirigini kahana ai, Betele amo Sekem e lao heniamu dalana mairiveina kahana ai, Lebona diho kahana ai.
JDG.21.19.english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

JDG.9.1.motu: Abimelek, Ierubu-baal natuna, na Sekem ela, sinana varavarana dekediai, idia bona sinana ena iduhu taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto,
JDG.9.1.english: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

JDG.13.13.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Manoa e hamaoroa, eto, Ina hahine na hamaorolaia herevadia iboudiai na ia ese baine lalo tao:
JDG.13.13.english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

JDG.15.9.motu: Filistia taudia na ela, Iuda ai e taruha, Lehi e koua heḡeḡe.
JDG.15.9.english: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

JDG.8.2.motu: Bena ia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Lauegu kara na oiemu kara ida ede baita hahegereḡeredia toma? Efraim ena vine momorudia ihaboudia be Abiesere ena taboro idoinai e hereaiamu ani?
JDG.8.2.english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

JDG.21.6.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese tadikakadia Beniamina taudia e bogadia hisi, eto, Hari dina ai iduhu ta na Israel amo vada e henege daure.
JDG.21.6.english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

JDG.8.35.motu: bona Ierubu-baal (una na Gideon) ena ruma taudia asie hanamodia, ia ese Israel e hanamoa davana asie kara.
JDG.8.35.english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

JDG.2.14.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena badu vada e ḡaraḡara Israel taudia ediai. Bena ia ese dadidadi taudia imadia ai e atodia; idia ese edia kohu e dadi ore. Inaidia heḡeḡemadai imadia ai e atodia kau, bena idia na asi goadadia inaidia bae laodia ahu.
JDG.2.14.english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

JDG.10.10.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Ai na vada a kara dika oi vairamu ai; badina be emai Dirava vada a rakatania, Baal isiaidia vada a lao heni.
JDG.10.10.english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

JDG.17.9.motu: Mika ese e nanadaia, eto, Ede amo oma? Ia e haere henia, eto, Lau na Levi taugu, Betelehem-luda amo vada nama; egu noho gabuna ta na tahuamu.
JDG.17.9.english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?”

JDG.12.3.motu: Lau na diba umui basio hamaurigu, bena egu mauri na imagu ai mia, bena na hanai, Amono taudia na tuari henidia; bena Iehova ese lau imagu ai e atodia. Be, dahaka dainai hari dina ai vada oma, ba tuari henigu o tomu?
JDG.12.3.english: When I saw that you didn’t save me, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me today, to fight against me?”

JDG.5.5.motu: Ororo na e laga Iehova vairanai,
JDG.5.5.english: The mountains quaked at Yahweh’s presence,

JDG.12.4.motu: Bena Iefeta ese Gilead taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Efraim taudia e tuari henidia. Gilead taudia ese Efraim taudia e ala-ala henidia, badina be unu Efraim taudia ese vada e gwau henidia, eto “Umui Gilead taumui na heau taumui, Efraim ena amo vada o heau, Efraim tanona ai bona Manase tanona ai o noho kavamu”.
JDG.12.4.english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”

JDG.15.17.motu: E hereva vaitani, bena hari doniki aukina turiana na imana amo e negea. Una gabu ladana e hatoa Ramata-lehi.
JDG.15.17.english: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.

JDG.11.39.motu: Hua rua e ore, bena kekeni ese tamana e lou henia. Bena tamana ese ena gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena ai e kara henia. Kekeni na tau ta ida do se eno bou. Una dainai kara ta vada e vara Israel ai:
JDG.11.39.english: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel

JDG.11.31.motu: bena mai kwalimugu ida Amono taudia ituarihenidia amo baina lou mai negana ai na egu ruma iduarana amo dekegu baine raka lasi guna ḡauna na Iehova ena: gole-oho boubouna ai baina halaoa.
JDG.11.31.english: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be Yahweh’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”

JDG.8.16.motu: Bena ia ese hanua tau-badadia e abidia, au ginigini, tano ḡaḡaena ḡaudia, bona ava ḡiniḡini, amo e dadabadia.
JDG.8.16.english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

JDG.2.1.motu: Iehova ena aneru ese Gilgal amo ela, ela bona Bokimi. Ia eto, Aigupto amo na hakaumui lasi, senemui na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona ai na hakaumui vareai. Na hamaoromui, nato “Eda herohemaino na lau ese basina hadikaia;
JDG.2.1.english: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

JDG.10.18.motu: Bena Gilead lohiadia e hereva heheni, eto, Daika ese Amono taudia baine tuari henidia matama? Una tau ese Gilead taudia iboudiai ikwaradia ai bainela.
JDG.10.18.english: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

JDG.5.13.motu: Goada taudia kwabukwabudia na tuari ela,
JDG.5.13.english: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down.

JDG.14.19.motu: Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese Samson e rohea; bena Askelono ela, hanua taudia toi-ahui e aladia mase, edia dabua e dadi; bena ela, hari hereva hehunina anina e gwauraia taudia dabua e henidia. Bena Samson na mai badu ḡaraḡarana ida tamana ena ruma e lou henia;
JDG.14.19.english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.

JDG.21.8.motu: Idia ma eto, Edena iduhu Israel ai na Iehova vairanai se hedinarai, Mispa ai? Bena vada e laloa, Iabese-gilead amo tau ta hebou gabuna sela.
JDG.21.8.english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

JDG.9.7.motu: Haida ese Iotam e hamaoroa, bena ia na ela, Gerisim ororona dorina ai e gini, e haroro badabada, eto, Sekem taumui e, egu hereva a kamonai, bena Dirava ese umui baine kamonai henimui.
JDG.9.7.english: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

JDG.4.7.motu: Bena lau ese Sisera, Iabin ena tuari oreana biaguna, mai ena kariota bona ena tuari taudia ida, baina koia, Kison sinavaina isena ai baine vasi; bona oi imamu ai baina atoa.
JDG.4.7.english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

JDG.6.35.motu: Ia ese gwaukau taudia danu e siaidia, Manase tanona idoinai, Manase taudia iboudiai e boiridia, ia murina amo baela. Ma gwaukau taudia haida danu e siaidia, Asere taudia bona Sebulun taudia bona liapatali taudia dekediai; bena idia na e tore isi, bamodia dekedia ela.
JDG.6.35.english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

JDG.9.18.motu: a umui ese hari dina ai tamagu ena ruma vada o tuari henia, natuna hitu-ahui osi na nadi tamona latanai vada o aladia mase, bona Abimalek, tamagu ena hesiai hahinena natuna, na Sekem taumui emui pavapava ai vada o halaoa, ia na varavaramui dainai.
JDG.9.18.english: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

JDG.13.10.motu: Bena hahine na e heau haraḡa, adavana e hamaoroa, eto, Vanegai dekegu ema tauna na vada eme lou henigu.
JDG.13.10.english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”

JDG.5.9.motu: Israel oreadia e hakaudia lasi taudia name imodaidia,
JDG.5.9.english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel,

JDG.20.14.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na hanua hanua amo ela, Gibea ai e hebou, Israel taudia oredia bae tuari henidia totona.
JDG.20.14.english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

JDG.3.27.motu: Unuseni ai e kau, bena kibi e hiriria Efraim ororodia ai; bena Israel taudia na ia ida ororo amo e hekei lao. Ia ese e gunalaidia.
JDG.3.27.english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

JDG.10.4.motu: Ia natuna mamaruanedia na toi-ahui: idia na doniki toi-ahui ai e loaloava. Edia hanua danu toi-ahui; ladadia e hatomu Havoto-iairi ema bona hari dina. Una hanua na Gilead tanona ai.
JDG.10.4.english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

JDG.7.19.motu: Malokihi ai, Gideon, e bamoa taudia sinahu-ta ida, taruha isena ai e kau, hegima negana iharuana ai hegini-dava taudia e atodia negana ai. Bena edia kibi e hiriri bona edia hodu e hamakohi.
JDG.7.19.english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

JDG.9.43.motu: bena ia ese ena tuari taudia e abidia, e haridia orea toi, tano paka ai e komu. E roha lao, hanua taudia e raka lasi ai e itadia, bena e tore isi, e ala-ala henidia.
JDG.9.43.english: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.

JDG.1.18.motu: Iuda danu Gasa mai tanona idoinai, bona Askelono mai tanona idoinai, bona Ekron mai tanona idoinai, e abidia.
JDG.1.18.english: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

JDG.9.49.motu: Taunabunai, idia iboudiai ta ta ena au ena au e raku, ena iḡui ena iḡui e hua, Abimelek murina amo e raka, edia au rakuraku na dubu habana badinai e ato kau. Bena idia ese dubu e ha-araia; taunabunai Sekem kohorona taudia iboudiai na lahi ai e mase. Idia na tatau bona hahine: iboudiai na daha ta sisivana.
JDG.9.49.english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

JDG.20.46.motu: Taunabunai, Beniamina taudia una dina ai e mase iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-ima; iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia, imadia na mai daredia.
JDG.20.46.english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

JDG.7.16.motu: Bena ia ese hari tatau sinahu-toiosi e haridia, orea toi, iboudiai kibi bona hodu e henidia, hodu lalodiai na kede.
JDG.7.16.english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

JDG.20.41.motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia na e gini kerehai; bena Beniamina taudia kudoudia e hetaha, badina be vada e diba vada be dareremu.
JDG.20.41.english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

JDG.12.13.motu: Ia murinai Abdon Hilele, Piratono tauna, na Israel ai e hahemaoro.
JDG.12.13.english: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

JDG.13.23.motu: A adavana ese e haere henia, eto, Iehova na iala-maseda bema ura, ia na ḡole-oho boubouna bona flaoa boubouna na ita imada amo basinema abia dae; ini kara iboudiai danu basinema haheitalaida, bona do bae vara ḡaudia basinema hamaorolaida.
