JDG.13.23.english: But his wife said to him, “If Yahweh were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”

JDG.11.17.motu: Una negana ai Israel ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Edom pavapavana dekenai, eto “Mani emu kara, emu tano baia rakaia hanai”, a Edom pavapavana na se kamonai. Ma hereva heḡereḡerena e siaia, Moab pavapavana dekenai; to ia danu se kamonai. Taunabunai, Israel na Kade ai e noho.
JDG.11.17.english: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

JDG.11.18.motu: Bena idia na ma e laolao, tano ḡaḡaena ai; Edom tanona bona Moab tanona murimuridia amo e raka, Moab tanona mairiveina kahana ai e kau, Aranon sinavaina unukahana ai e taruha. A Moab tanona ai asie raka vareai, badina be Aranon sinavaina na Moab tanona hetoana.
JDG.11.18.english: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

JDG.14.15.motu: Dina ihahanina, idia ese Samson adavana e hereva henia, eto, Adavamu lalona bavania, bena hari hereva hehunina anina ba hadibamai. Bema lasi, ai ese oi bona tamamu ena ruma na lahi amo baia dou. Iha-ogogamimai totona o vavemai a?
JDG.14.15.english: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”

JDG.13.11.motu: Bena Manoa e tore isi, adavana murina amo ela, una tau dekenai e kau; bena e hereva henia, eto, Ina hahine e hereva henia tauna na oi, a? Ia eto, Lau binai.
JDG.13.11.english: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?”

JDG.4.11.motu: Hebere, tau Kene, ese Kene taudia, Mose ravana Hobab garana, edia amo vada e raka oho, ena kalaga na dauhai e haginia, Sanamim oak auna badibadinai, Kede hanuana badinai.
JDG.4.11.english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

JDG.8.7.motu: Gideon eto, Matona, Iehova ese Sebaha bona Salmuna na imagu ai baine atodia negana ai, lau ese au ginigini tano ḡaḡaena amo baina abi, bona ava ḡinigini danu, bena unu amo baina dadabamui.
JDG.8.7.english: Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

JDG.14.1.motu: Samson na Timuna ela; bena Timuna ai ia ese Filistia hane-ulatona ta e itaia.
JDG.14.1.english: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

JDG.7.24.motu: Bena Gideon ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Efraim ororodia idoidiai ela, eto, A hekei mai, Midian taudia ba tuari henidia, bona ranu gabudia ela bona Bete-bara, bona Ioridane sinavaina danu, ba gimadia. Taunabunai, Efraim taudia iboudiai e boiridia, bena ranu gabudia e gimadia ela bona Bete-bara, bona Ioridane sinavaina danu.
JDG.7.24.english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

JDG.5.19.motu: Hanua pavapavadia na ema, e tuari,

JDG.9.40.motu: A Abimelek ese e hahavaia; Gaal na ia vairanai e heau. Hutuma na dala ai e keto, mai berodia, ela bona hanua ikoukouna.
JDG.9.40.english: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

JDG.4.1.motu: Ehud e mase murinai, Israel taudia ma e kara havara Iehova vairanai.
JDG.4.1.english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

JDG.4.5.motu: Ena kara be pamu auna ta, ladana Debora ena pamu auna, henunai e helaiva, Rama bona Betele padadiai, Efraim ororodia ai. Israel taudia na unua ela ia dekenai, baine hahemaoro henidia totona.
JDG.4.5.english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

JDG.6.14.motu: Bena Iehova ese e haḡerea, eto, Mai goadamu ida baola, Israel na Midian taudia imadia amo ba harohodia mauri. Asina siaimumu o tomu a?
JDG.6.14.english: Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

JDG.6.2.motu: Midian taudia ese Israel taudia e hadareredia; bena Midian dainai Israel taudia na ororo ai e nohova, guri ai bona kohua ai bona ororo doridia ai.
JDG.6.2.english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

JDG.6.17.motu: Gideon ma eto, Boma lalo namo henigu, toa ta boma haheitalaigu, bena bama diba oi na momokani o hereva henigumu.
JDG.6.17.english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

JDG.2.8.motu: A Iosua Nunu, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, na e mase; ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta dikoana gwauta.
JDG.2.8.english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

JDG.9.34.motu: Bena Abimelek mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida hanuaboi ai e tore isi, orea hani amo Sekem e bani henia.
JDG.9.34.english: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

JDG.6.3.motu: Badina be Israel taudia ese uhe e hado negadia ai, Midian taudia bona Amalek taudia bona mairiveina kahana taudia ese e tuari henidia;
JDG.6.3.english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

JDG.11.9.motu: Iefeta ese Gilead tau-badadia ma e haere henidia, eto, Boma hakaugu lao, bena Amono taudia baitama tuari henidia negana ai Iehova ese lau imagu ai bema atodia, lau na umui ikwaramui ai bainala a?
JDG.11.9.english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivers them before me, will I be your head?”

JDG.21.7.motu: E roho mauri taudia na adavadia ede baita henidia toma? Badina be Iehova vairanai vada ta gwau hamata, tato, natuda ulatodia basita henidia, basie adavadia.
JDG.21.7.english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

JDG.5.15.motu: Isakara lohiadia na Debora ida ema,
JDG.5.15.english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah.

JDG.18.15.motu: Bena idia na e raka siri, hari Levi tauna eregabena ena ruma ai e dae kau, Mika ena maḡu ai, e nanadaia, ia na edeheto.
JDG.18.15.english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.

JDG.10.15.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e hereva henia, eto, Ai na vada a kara havara. Oi sibomu emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ba kara henimai; ḡau tamona, ai a noimumu, hari dina ai ba hamaurimai.
JDG.10.15.english: The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

JDG.19.24.motu: O itaia, lau natugu hane-ulato rami-hebouna noho, bona iena hahine danu noho. Idia baina mailaidia dekemui ai; bavabidia, emui ura heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henidia; a ina tau na basio kara miro henia.
JDG.19.24.english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

JDG.1.1.motu: Iosua ena mase murinai Israel taudia ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Daika ese baine gunalaimai, Kanaan taudia baia tuari henidia negadia ai.
JDG.1.1.english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

JDG.15.19.motu: Bena Dirava ese Lehi kohuana e hapararaia; bena ranu e aru lasi. Samson e inua, bena laumana e lou henia, ma e goada lou. Taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoa En-hakore; ia na Lehi ai mia, ema bona hari dina.
JDG.15.19.english: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.

JDG.14.17.motu: Samson ese e haere henia, eto, Be, tamagu bona sinagu na asina hamaorodia, matona oi baina hamaoromu o tomu a? Aria dinadia hituosi iboudiai hahine na ia vairanai e taitai; bena dina ihahituna ai Samson ese e hamaoroa, badina be hahine na e gwau havara-havara. Bena ia ese ena hanua taudia e hamaorolaidia.
JDG.14.17.english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

JDG.3.20.motu: Bena Ehud na ia dekenai e raka vareai, daiutu kerumana ta ai sibona e helaiva ai. Ehud eto, Hereva ta Dirava ena amo vada na mailaia, emu. Bena Ḡaubada na e tore isi.
JDG.3.20.english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

JDG.11.37.motu: Bena kekeni ese tamana e noia, eto, Mani emu kara ini ba karagu toma: hua rua mo ba kahugu nege, bainala, mai bamogu kekenidia ida ororo ai baia loaloa, rami-hebougu ai baina mase taina baia tai.
JDG.11.37.english: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”

JDG.15.11.motu: Bena Iuda taudia daha-toi ese Etam hagana kohuana ela, Samson e gwau henia, eto, Oi asi dibamu Filistia taudia na eda lohia a? Ede vada o karamai toma? Ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Idia ese e karagu heḡereḡerena mo na kara henidia.
JDG.15.11.english: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave in Etam’s rock, and said to Samson, “Don’t you know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?”

JDG.14.20.motu: a Samson adavana na Samson bamona ta, headava negana ai e duruava tauna, e henia, ia ese e adavaia.
JDG.14.20.english: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.

JDG.3.19.motu: A ia be Gilgal nadi-pupudia amo e lou, eto, Ḡaubada e, hereva hehunina ta vada na mailaia emu. Ḡaubada eto “Eremui”; bena ena hesiai taudia iboudiai na ia vairana amo e raka lasi munmuri ai.
JDG.3.19.english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.”

JDG.4.10.motu: Bena Barak ese Sebulun taudia bona Napatali taudia e boiridia, Kede hanuana baela. Tuari taudia gerebu-ta ia murinai e raka; bona Debora danu ia ida ela.
JDG.4.10.english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

JDG.11.5.motu: Bena Amono taudia ese Israel taudia e tuari henidia negana ai, Gilead tau-badadia na Tobo ela, Iefeta bae hakaua lou eto.
JDG.11.5.english: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

JDG.16.21.motu: Bena Filistia taudia ese e dabaia tao, matana ruaosi e gibo lasi; bena Gasa e hakaua lao, unuseni ai auri labora-labora gadeadia amo e ḡuia. Bena dibura rumana lalonai ia ese flaoa iririlaina ḡauna e giroava.
JDG.16.21.english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.

JDG.9.37.motu: Gaal ma e hereva, eto, A itaia, taunimanima haida na bogaragi amo e maimu, bona orea ta danu be rohe taudia edia oak auna amo e maimu.
JDG.9.37.english: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”

JDG.12.10.motu: Bena Ibisan e mase; Betelehem ai e guria.
JDG.12.10.english: Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

JDG.11.30.motu: Iefeta ese Iehova e gwau henia hamata, eto, Amono taudia na lau imagu ai boma atodia,
JDG.11.30.english: Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

JDG.6.7.motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia Midian taudia daidiai;
JDG.6.7.english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh because of Midian,

JDG.4.13.motu: Bena Sisera ese ena kariota iboudiai e haboudia, auri kariotadia sinahu taurahani-ta, bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai danu, bena Haroset-ha-goim amo Kison sinavaina ela.
JDG.4.13.english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

JDG.19.15.motu: Bena dala amo e raka siri, hanua ai bae raka vareai, Gibea ai bae mahuta eto. Bena e raka vareai, hanua ariarana ai e helai diho, badina be asi tauna ta ese ena ruma e abidia dae, bae mahuta totona.
JDG.19.15.english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

JDG.21.23.motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na unu e kara toma, mavaru ulatodia e dabaidia tao, e adavadia, taudia hohodia heḡereḡeredia. Bena idia na ela, edia tano e lou henia, edia hanua e hadai lou, e noholaidia.
JDG.21.23.english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

JDG.6.33.motu: Una murinai Midian taudia iboudiai bona Amalek taudia bona mairiveina kahana taudia e hebou, Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, bena Iesrele kourana ai e taruha.
JDG.6.33.english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

JDG.20.38.motu: Israel taudia bona hanua e bani henia taudia na edia henega ai toa ta vada e gwauraia guna. Toana binai: lahi kwalahuna ori na heto hanua amo baine dae negana ai
JDG.20.38.english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

JDG.20.39.motu: Israel taudia na bae gini kerehai tuari ai.
JDG.20.39.english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

JDG.1.8.motu: Bena Iuda taudia ese Ierusalem e tuari henia, e abia, hanua taudia na dare amo e aladia ore, bena hanua e doua.
JDG.1.8.english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

JDG.10.6.motu: Israel taudia ma e kara havara Iehova vairanai, dirava idaudia e toma henidia diho: Baal, bona Astaroto, bona Suria taudia edia dirava, bona Sidono taudia edia dirava, bona Moab taudia edia dirava, bona Amono taudia edia dirava, bona Filistia taudia edia dirava. A idia ese Iehova e rakatania, ia isiaina asie lao heni.
JDG.10.6.english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned Yahweh, and didn’t serve him.

JDG.20.5.motu: Bena Gibea taudia na lau ihadikagu totona e tore isi, hanuaboi ai ruma na e koua heḡeḡe, bae alagu mase eto. A egu hahine na e abia bona e hahemaraia; bena vada e mase.
JDG.20.5.english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

JDG.14.4.motu: Tamana bona sinana na asi dibadia ina na Iehova ena amo; badina be ia ese Filistia taudia iheai-henidia dalana e tahuava. Una negana ai Filistia taudia ese Israel taudia e lohiadia.
JDG.14.4.english: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of Yahweh; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

JDG.5.10.motu: Doniki kurokurodia ai o guimu taumui, ba gwauraia, hedinarai,
JDG.5.10.english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys,

JDG.16.11.motu: Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Kwanau matamatadia, nega hata do asie ḡaukaralai ḡaudia, amo bema guigu, lau bama manoka, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
JDG.16.11.english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”

JDG.7.7.motu: Bena Iehova ese Gideon e hamaoroa, eto, Ranu e peta dae taudia sinahu-toiosi edia amo lau ese baina hamaurimui, bona Midian taudia na oi imamu ai baina atodia. Oredia iboudiai ba kahudia nege, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma baela.
JDG.7.7.english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”

JDG.9.26.motu: Una negana ai Gaal Ebed, varavarana ida, Sekem ai e hanoho; bena Sekem taudia ese e abidadama henia.
JDG.9.26.english: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

JDG.19.9.motu: Bena Levi tauna mai ena hahine bona mai ena hesiai tauna ida e tore isi, bae raka eto. A hahine tamana eto, O itaia, dina e ḡelomu; mani emu kara iniseni ai ba mahuta rani. O itaia, ado vada e rahi; iniseni ai ba noho, lalomu baine moale, ma kerukeru daba matana ai ba tore isi, emu laolao baola, emu ruma ba lou henia.
JDG.19.9.english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

JDG.7.25.motu: Midian lohiadia raruosi danu e abidia: Oreb na Oreb haga-nadina ai e alaia mase; bona Sebe na Sebe ena vine-ranuna itaolaina gabuna ai e alaia mase, Midian taudia e hahavadia negana ai. Bena Oreb bona Sebe kwaradia na Gideon dekena e laohaidia. Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai.
JDG.7.25.english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.

JDG.4.15.motu: Bena Iehova ese Sisera na dare amo e hadarerea, Barak vairanai; ia bona ena kariota iboudiai bona ena tuari oreana idoinai. A Sisera na ena kanota amo e diho, aena amo e heau.
JDG.4.15.english: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

JDG.9.50.motu: Bena Abimelek na Tebese ela, hanua na e koua heḡeḡe, bena e abia.
JDG.9.50.english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

JDG.9.46.motu: Sekem kohorona ai e nohova taudia iboudiai ese una hari e kamonai, bena idia na edia dirava ta, ladana El-beriti, ena dubu ai e didi vareai.
JDG.9.46.english: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

JDG.15.4.motu: Taunabunai Samson na ela, uda sisiadia maraḡidia sinahu-toi e abidia mauri; kede danu e abi. Bena hari uda sisiadia na rua rua amo e abidia, iudia e ḡuidia hebou bona kede e ḡui kau iudia ruaosi padadiai.
JDG.15.4.english: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the middle between every two tails.

JDG.11.1.motu: Iefeta, tau Gilead, na tuan tauna mai goadana; ḡau tamona, ia na ariara hahinena natuna. Iefeta tamana na Gilead.
JDG.11.1.english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.

JDG.7.17.motu: Bena e hamaorodia, eto, Lau ba itagu, ba tohotohogu; taruha isena ai baina kau ai, lau baina karaia heḡeregerena na umui danu ba karaia.
JDG.7.17.english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

JDG.19.5.motu: Dina ihahanina ai, idia na daba matana ai e tore isi, bena hari Levi tauna e heḡaeḡae, baine raka eto. A hahine tamana ese ravana e noia, eto, Mani bavaniani guna, taumu baine auka, bena ba raka.
JDG.19.5.english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

JDG.17.12.motu: Bena Mika ese una Levi tauna na e haginia: tauhau na Mika ena hahelaḡa tauna ai ela, bona ena ruma ai e nohova.
JDG.17.12.english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

JDG.8.20.motu: Bena ia ese natuna roboana letere e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, avaladia mase. A tauhau na ena dare se veria lasi; ia na e gari, badina be ia na dounu tauhau mo.
JDG.8.20.english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

JDG.2.9.motu: Ena tano korikori ai e guria, Timnata-here ai, Efraim ororodia ai, Gaasa ororona mirigini kahana ai.
JDG.2.9.english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

JDG.2.22.motu: idia edia amo Israel taudia baina tohodia, nahuadia bae toho, Iehova ena dala ai bae raka, tamadia e rakalaiava na heto, eiava lasi.
JDG.2.22.english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

JDG.14.14.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto,

JDG.5.7.motu: Hanua maraḡidia vada e vahu Israel ai,

JDG.2.2.motu: umui danu ina tano taudia ida basio herohemaino; edia ihaboulaina patadia ba ḡiḡidia dobi”. To umui ese egu haheḡani asio badinaia. Ede vada o kara toma?
JDG.2.2.english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

JDG.7.14.motu: Bena bamoma na e haere, eto, Ina na Gideon Ioasa, Israel tauna, ena dare; Dirava ese Midian mai ena orea idoinai ida ia imana ai vada e atodia.
JDG.7.14.english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

JDG.6.34.motu: A Iehova ena Lauma ese Gideon e rohea; bena ia ese kibi e hiriria, bona Ablesere taudia e boiridia, idia na ia murina amo baela.
JDG.6.34.english: But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

JDG.8.13.motu: Bena Gideon loasa na tuari amo e lou, Here ororona amo.
JDG.8.13.english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

JDG.14.6.motu: Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese e rohea badabada; bena ia ese leona e darea parara, nani natuna bema darea parara na heto. Ia na asi ena ḡau ta imana ai. A ia ese ena kara na tamana bona sinana se hamaorolaidia.
JDG.14.6.english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.

JDG.20.47.motu: A tatau sinahu-tauratoi e heau mauri, Rimon nadi-hagana ela, tano ḡaḡaena ai; idia na hua hani Rimon nadi-hagana ai e nohova.
JDG.20.47.english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

JDG.5.2.motu: Hahekau taudia ese Israel e hakaudia dainai,
JDG.5.2.english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel,

JDG.20.8.motu: Bena hebou taudia e tore isi, tau tamona na heto, eto, Ita ta ena kalaga basinela, bona ta ena ruma basine lou henia.
JDG.20.8.english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

JDG.21.18.motu: ḡau tamona, natuda ulatodia na basita henidia diba. Badina be Israel taudia vada e gwau hamata, eto, Beniamina tauna na hane-ulato ta baine henia, baine adavaia totona, tauna na do baine baia.
JDG.21.18.english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

JDG.8.11.motu: Bena Gideon na Noba bona logobeha mairiveina kahana ai e taruhava taudia edia dala amo ela, una tuari oreana e tuari henia, asie hegimava negana ai.
JDG.8.11.english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

JDG.4.20.motu: Sisera ma e hamaoroa, eto, Kalaga iduarana ai ba gini; bena tau ta bainema, baine nanadaimu, baineto “Iniseni ai tau ta noho a?”, oi na ba haere, baoto “Lasi”.
JDG.4.20.english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

JDG.20.42.motu: Taunabunai, idia na Israel taudia vairadia amo e lou, tano gaḡaena ela. A tuari ese e ḡavadia tao, bona hanua amo ema taudia ese edia dala e ginia ahu, bena dare amo e aladia ore.
JDG.20.42.english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

JDG.18.10.motu: Unu baola danu ḡau ta asie laloamu taudia ba davaridia unuseni ai. Tano na bada; momokani, Dirava ese imamui ai vada e atoa. Una gabu ai tanobada ḡauna ta ai basio dabu.
JDG.18.10.english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth.”

JDG.6.32.motu: Taunabunai, hari Gideon na una dina ai e nemaia Ierubu-baal (anina be “Baal ese baine ala-ala henia”), badina be ia ese Baal ena ihaboulaina patana e ḡiḡia dobi.
JDG.6.32.english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

JDG.7.4.motu: Bena Iehova ese Gideon ma e hamaoroa, eto, Taunumanima na doene hutuma. Ranu gabuna ba hakaudia lao, unuseni ai lau ese baina dibadia; bena ta baina herevalaia, bainato “Ina tau ese baine bamomu”, una tau na oi ida bainela, a ta baina herevalaia, bainato “Ina tau ese basine bamomu”, una tau na basinela.
JDG.7.4.english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

JDG.20.40.motu: A hari toa, lahi kwalahuna, e dae matama negana ai, Beniamina taudia e roha kerehai; madi, hanua idoinai kwalahuna e daeva guba ai.
JDG.20.40.english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

JDG.20.20.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia e tuari henidia, Gibea vairanai e gini.
JDG.20.20.english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

JDG.11.25.motu: Oi ese Balak Siporo, Moab pavapavana, o hereaiamu a? Nega ta ia ese Israel taudia e ala-ala henidia eiava e tuari henidia a?
JDG.11.25.english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

JDG.10.8.motu: Unu bese ese Israel taudia e moidia tao bona e hahisidia una laḡani lalonai. Laḡani gwauta-taurahani lalodiai, idia ese Israel taudia iboudiai Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Amoro taudia edia tano Gilead ai, e nohova na e hahisidia.
JDG.10.8.english: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

JDG.3.17.motu: Bena hari herahia na Eglon, Moab pavapavana, dekena e laohaia. Hari Eglon na tau-anina bada herea.
JDG.3.17.english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

JDG.3.7.motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia na e kara havara Iehova vairanai, Iehova edia Dirava e laloa boio, dirava ladadia Baal bona Aseroto isiaidia e lao heni.
JDG.3.7.english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

JDG.7.20.motu: Bena orea toiosi taudia ese edia kibi e hiriri bona edia hodu e hamakohi; bena kede na imadia lauridia ai e dudui isi, a kibi be imadia idibadia ai e abi, e hiriri. Bena e lolo, eto, Iehova ena dare bona Gideon ena.
JDG.7.20.english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!”

JDG.2.7.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova isiaina e lao heni, Iosua ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai, bona tau badadia, Iosua ena mase murinai dounu e mauri nohova bona Iehova ena siahu karadia Israel latanai e kara vada e ita taudia, edia mauri dinadia lalodiai danu.
JDG.2.7.english: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.

JDG.6.13.motu: Gideon ese e haere henia, eto, Egu lohia e, bema Iehova na ai ida, ini kara iboudiai na ede e vara toma ai emai ai? Ena hoa karadia, tamamai ese e hadibalaimai, eto “Iehova ese Aigupto amo se hakauda lasi a?” na edeseni ai? A harihari Iehova ese vada e negemai daure, Midian taudia imadia ai vada e atomai.
JDG.6.13.english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t Yahweh bring us up from Egypt?’ But now Yahweh has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

JDG.11.35.motu: Bena e itaia negana ai na ena dabua e darea, eto, Natugu o, madi ihabaigu! Vada o hahemaraigu; vada o hahekwakwanaigu. Badina be Iehova vada na gwau henia hamata, bena egu hereva na basina ha-idaua diba.
JDG.11.35.english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to Yahweh, and I can’t go back.”

JDG.21.5.motu: Israel taudia na eto, Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo edena iduhu Iehova vairanai asiema, ta hebouva negana ai? Badina be vada e gwau hamata mai hereva metauna ida, Mispa sela, Iehova vairanai se hebou, tauna na baine mase eto.
JDG.21.5.english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

JDG.5.25.motu: Ranu e noia negana ai, ia ese rata e henia;

JDG.6.36.motu: Bena Gideon ese Dirava e hereva henia, eto, Bema Israel na lau imagu amo ba hamauria, emu hereva heḡereḡerena,
JDG.6.36.english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

JDG.13.5.motu: badina be oi na ba rogorogo, mero ta bavabia. Kwarana na basio naua, badina be una mero na ena vara dinana amo baine helaḡa Dirava ena, Nasin oreana tauna. Ia ese Israel na Filistia taudia imadia amo baine hamauridia matama.
JDG.13.5.english: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”

JDG.15.16.english: Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men.”

JDG.3.29.motu: Una negana ai idia ese Moab taudia gerebu-ta sisivana e aladia mase, iboudiai na goada taudia bona tuari mai dibadia taudia; tau ta se roho mauri.
JDG.3.29.english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

JDG.6.19.motu: Taunabunai, Gideon na ena ruma lalonai e raka vareai, nani natuna ta e nadua, bona flaoa era ta amo asie hatubu dikeadia e gabu. Vamu na bosea ta ai e udaia, bona vasiahu na uro ta ai e abia kau, bena e laohai, oak auna henunai e helai tauna vairanai e dabaraia.
JDG.6.19.english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

JDG.19.13.motu: Ia ese ena hesiai tauna ma e hamaoroa, eto, Aoma, unu gabu ta aitala, Gibea ai eiava Rama ai baita mahuta.
JDG.19.13.english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

JDG.4.3.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia, baine durudia eto. Badina be una tau ena auri kariotadia na sinahu taurahani-ta; laḡani ruahui lalodiai ia ese Israel taudia e hahisidia bada.
JDG.4.3.english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

JDG.9.52.motu: Abimelek na e raka kahira, kohoro e tuari henia; kohoro iduarana e raka henia kahi, baine doua eto.
JDG.9.52.english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

JDG.20.6.motu: Taunabunai, hahine na na abia, tau-anina na utua parara, regena na siaidia, Israel taudia na edia tano ai vada e halaoa tanona idoinai: badina be idia na lebulebu karana bona hemarai karana vada e karaia, Israel bogaraginai.
JDG.20.6.english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

JDG.19.23.motu: A ruma biaguna na idia dekediai e raka lasi, eto, Varavaragu e, una kara dikana basio karaia. Ina tau na lauegu vadivadi; una kara mirona basio karaia.
JDG.19.23.english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

JDG.15.5.motu: Bena ia ese kede e ha-ara, bona uda sisiadia e kahudia nege, Filistia taudia edia uit umadia ai. Bena uit idoinai e ara ore, iḡui ai mimia ḡauna bona do asie utua ḡauna. Bona olive imeadia danu e ara.
JDG.15.5.english: When he had set the torches on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, and also the olive groves.

JDG.3.23.motu: Bena Ehud na e raka lasi murimuri ai, una daiutu iduarana na murimuri kahana ai e koua kunuka-kunuka.
JDG.3.23.english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

JDG.12.14.motu: Ia natuna mamaruanedia na hari-ahui, bona tubuna mamaruanedia na toi-ahui; idia na doniki hitu-ahui ai e loaloava. Ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani taurahani.
JDG.12.14.english: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.

JDG.20.29.motu: Taunabunai, Israel na edia tuari taudia haida e siaidia, Gibea bae bani henia.
JDG.20.29.english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

JDG.2.23.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese unu bese e hanohodia; se luludia lasi bona Iosua imana ai se atodia.
JDG.2.23.english: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

JDG.9.55.motu: Israel taudia ese e itaia, Abimelek e mase, bena iboudiai e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela.
JDG.9.55.english: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.

JDG.5.4.motu: Iehova e, Seiri amo o tore isi negana ai,
JDG.5.4.english: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir,

JDG.10.1.motu: Abimelek murinai, tau ta e tore isi, Israel e hamauria. Ia ladana na Tola; tamana na Pua, bona tubuna ladana na Dodo. Ia na Isakara tauna; ena hanua na Samiri, Efraim ororodia ai.
JDG.10.1.english: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

JDG.15.6.motu: Bena Filistia taudia eto, Ina kara na daika ese e karaia? Haida eto, Samson, Timuna tauna ravana, ese; badina be una tau ese Samson adavana e abihaia, bamona ta e henia. Bena Filistia taudia na ela, una hahine mai tamana ida na lahi amo e hamasedia.
JDG.15.6.english: Then the Philistines said, “Who has done this?”

JDG.19.8.motu: Dina iha-imana ai, ia na daba matana ai e tore isi, baine raka eto. A hahine tamana eto, Taumu do ba ha-aukaia ela bona adorahi. Taunabunai raruosi ma e aniani hebou.
JDG.19.8.english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

JDG.13.25.motu: Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese e rohea matama Mahane-dan ai, Sora bona Estaol padadiai.
JDG.13.25.english: Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

JDG.10.13.motu: Matona, vada o rakatanigu, dirava idaudia isiaidia vada o lao heni, taunabunai lau ese basina hamaurimui lou.
JDG.10.13.english: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

JDG.3.8.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena badu vada e siahu Israel taudia ediai; bena e negedia daure, Kusan-risataimi, Mesopotamia pavapavana, imana ai e atodia. Idia ese una tau isiaina e lao heniva, laḡani taurahani lalodiai.
JDG.3.8.english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

JDG.9.39.motu: Bena Gaal ese Sekem taudia e gunalaidia, vada e raka lasi, Abimelek e tuari henia.
JDG.9.39.english: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

JDG.1.20.motu: Bena Heberon na Kaleb e henia, Mose ena hereva heḡereḡerena; bena Kaleb ese Anak natuna tatoiosi na unu amo e luludia lasi.
JDG.1.20.english: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.

JDG.19.11.motu: Iebusu e raka henia kahi negana ai dina vada e kerekere; bena hesiai tauna ese biaguna e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara aita raka siri, ina Iebusu taudia edia hanua ai baita mahuta.
JDG.19.11.english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

JDG.17.7.motu: Tauhau ta Betelehem ai e nohova, Iuda tanona ai. Ia na Iuda iduhuna tauna; ia danu Levi tauna.
JDG.17.7.english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.

JDG.8.31.motu: Ma hahine ta Sekem ai danu e adavaia, iena amo danu mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Abimelek.
JDG.8.31.english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

JDG.1.36.motu: Amoro taudia edia tano hetoana na Akrabim gabaena amo e laova, Sela amo e dae ela.
JDG.1.36.english: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

JDG.7.23.motu: Bena Israel taudia na Napatali amo bona Asere amo bona Manase idoinai amo e boiridia; bena idia ese Midian taudia e hahavadia.
JDG.7.23.english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

JDG.19.19.motu: Ai na rei kakoro bona aniani vada a abi kau, emai doniki edia bona adia; flaoa bona vine ranuna danu a abi kau, lauagu bona ina hahine ana bona hari eregabe tauna emu hesiai taudia ida adia; ḡau ta ai basita dabu.
JDG.19.19.english: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”

JDG.21.24.motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia na e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela, edia iduhu heḡereḡeredia. Iboudiai na edia tano korikori e lou henidia.
JDG.21.24.english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

JDG.1.3.motu: Bena Iuda vevena ese Iuda kakana Simeon vevena e hamaorodia, eto, Ai baia abia tanona aitala, bena Kanaan taudia baita tuari henidia; gabeamo umui bavabia tanona baitala. Taunabunai, Simeon taudia na idia ida ela.
JDG.1.3.english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

JDG.6.6.motu: Taunabunai Israel vada e ogoḡami, Midian dainai. Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia.
JDG.6.6.english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.

JDG.11.20.motu: A Sihon ese Israel taudia se abidadama henidia, bae raka hanai momokani; taunabunai Sihon ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Iahasa ai e taruha, Israel taudia e tuari henidia.
JDG.11.20.english: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

JDG.1.14.motu: Bena hahine na adavana dekena ela, lalona e ania, tamana enai tano ta baine noia eto. Ma ela, bena ena doniki amo e diho negana ai, Kaleb ese e nanadaia, eto, Emu ura be dahaka?
JDG.1.14.english: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”

JDG.18.2.motu: Taunabunai Dan taudia na edia iduhu taudia edia amo goada taudia laima e siaidia, Sora amo bona Estaol amo, tano bae hasinadoa, kahana iboudiai bae ita totona. E hamaorodia, eto, Tano idoinai ba itaia.
JDG.18.2.english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!”

JDG.16.20.motu: Ia eto, Samson e, Filistia taudia na emu ai vada e kau. Bena Samson e noga, eto, Baina raka lasi, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia, ma baina roho mauri. Ia na do asi dibana Iehova ese vada e rakatania.
JDG.16.20.english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!”

JDG.16.3.motu: A Samson na e hekure ela bona malokihi: bena malokihi ai e tore isi, hanua ikoukouna mai audia ida bona mai ikahidia ida e raḡadia, paḡana ai e huadia lao, ela bona Heberon e vaira henia ororona dorina.
JDG.16.3.english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

JDG.9.8.motu: Nega ta au loḡora na e raka lasi, edia pavapava ta bae horoa eto. Bena idia ese olive auna e hereva henia, eto, Emai pavapava ai baola.
JDG.9.8.english: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

JDG.12.11.motu: Ia murinai, Sebulun tauna ta ladana Elon ese Israel ai e hahemaoro. Ia ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani gwauta.
JDG.12.11.english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

JDG.20.17.motu: Beniamina iduhuna taudia na unuhohodia; a Israel iduhudia oredia edia tatau na domaga hani mai edia dare. Unu iboudiai na tuari taudia.
JDG.20.17.english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

JDG.16.13.motu: Bena Delila ese Samson ma e hereva henia, eto, Vada o kirikirilaigu bona vada o koigu ema bona hari; a hamaorogu, ede bema ḡuimu toma. Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Huigu boma pania, ipani hitu, bena ipani hituosi na o hatuamu dabuana ai boma hatu kau, bona gwada-tao ḡauna amo boma daia tao, bena bama manoka, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
JDG.16.13.english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.”

JDG.9.27.motu: Idia na e vareai, edia vine imeadia anidia e gogo, bena e taolai. Bena aria e karaia; edia dirava ena dubu ai e raka vareai, e aniani bona vine ranuna e inua. Bena idia ese Abimelek e ḡonaḡonalaia.
JDG.9.27.english: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

JDG.20.33.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai na e tore isi, ela, Baal-tamara ai e gini heḡaeḡae; a Israel taudia hahidaosi hanua e bani henia taudia na edia komu gabuna, Geba lahara kahana, amo e heau lasi.
JDG.20.33.english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

JDG.9.13.motu: A vine ese edia hereva e haloua, eto, Egu vine ranuna, Dirava bona taunimanima na e hamoalediamu ḡauna, baina rakatania, au baina biagudia a?
JDG.9.13.english: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

JDG.12.12.motu: Bena Elon, tau Sebulun, e mase; Aialono ai e guria, Sebulun tanona ai.
JDG.12.12.english: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

JDG.2.10.motu: Una uru idoinai danu na tubu tama dekediai e hahebou. Bena uru matamatana ta e vara isi; idia na Iehova asi dibadia, bona Iehova ena kara Israel taudia ediai danu asi dibadia.
JDG.2.10.english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

JDG.13.8.motu: Bena Manoa ese Iehova e noia, eto, Ḡaubada e, lau na noimumu, Dirava ena tau oi ese o siaia ma bainema, baine hadibamai, hari baine vara merona na ede baia kara henia toma.
JDG.13.8.english: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”

JDG.20.11.motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia iboudiai na mai lalodia tamona e hebou, una hanua bae tuari henia totona.
JDG.20.11.english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

JDG.21.20.motu: Bena idia ese Beniamina taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Aola, vine imeadia ai ba komu,
JDG.21.20.english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

JDG.8.23.motu: A Gideon na e haere henidia, eto, Lau ese basina halohiamui, natugu danu basine halohiamui; Iehova ese baine halohiamui.
JDG.8.23.english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”

JDG.19.22.motu: Edia moale lalonai hanua taudia haida, lebulebu taudia, ema, ruma na e ginia heḡeḡe, bena iduara na e botabotaia. Bena idia ese ruma biaguna, hari tau buruka, na e hamaoroa, eto, Emu ruma ai e dae kau tauna na ba hakaua lasi, ai baia dibaia.
JDG.19.22.english: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”

JDG.3.25.motu: E henari mase, ela bona e daradara; bena daiutu iduarana do se kehoa dainai idia ese ki ta e abia, e kehoa, biagudia na mai masena ida reirei ai hekurena ai e davaria.
JDG.3.25.english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

JDG.1.12.motu: Kaleb eto, Kiriata-sefere baine tuari henia bona baine abia tauna na natugu kekenina Aksa baina henia, baine adavaia.
JDG.1.12.english: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”

JDG.17.6.motu: Unu dinadia ai Israel na asi pavapavana; Israel taudia na ta ta ena lalo-hadai ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡeredia e kara.
JDG.17.6.english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

JDG.20.35.motu: Bena Iehova ese Beniamina taudia e hadareredia Israel vairanai. Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia gerebu-rua daha-ima sinahu-ta e aladia mase una dina ai: iboudiai na tuari taudia mai edia dare.
JDG.20.35.english: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

JDG.13.3.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese e hahedinarai henia, e hereva henia, eto, Vada o gabani, asi natumu; a do ba rogorogo, mero ta bavabia.
JDG.13.3.english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

JDG.3.9.motu: A Israel taudia ese Iehova e tai henia, bena Iehova ese ihamauridia tauna ta e abia hidi, baine hamauridia totona. Tauna na Otoniele Kena: una Kena na Kaleb tadina.
JDG.3.9.english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

JDG.7.1.motu: Bena Ierubu-baal (una be Gideon) bona ia e bamoava taudia iboudiai na daba ai e tore isi, Harod ranu gabuna badinai e taruha. Midian taudia edia taruha na mirigini kahana ai, More ororona badina kourana ai.
JDG.7.1.english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

JDG.11.13.motu: Amono pavapavana ese Iefeta ena gwaukau taudia e haere henidia, eto, Badina be Israel na Aigupto amo ema, egu tano e dadia, Aranon sinavaina amo ela bona Iabok sinavaina bona Ioridane sinavaina; harihari una tano ba henigu lou, basio laogu ahu.
JDG.11.13.english: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

JDG.19.28.motu: Ia ese e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, aitala. A hahine na se haere. Bena doniki doruna ai e atoa kau. Bena una tau e tore isi, ena ruma ela.
JDG.19.28.english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

JDG.20.26.motu: Bena Israel taudia, tuari oreana idoinai, na ela, Betele ai e kau, bena e taitai. Idia na Iehova vairanai e helaiva, e vaga una dina ai, ela bona dina e diho. Bena ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova vairanai.
JDG.20.26.english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

JDG.14.11.motu: Hanua taudia ese e itaia, bena idia ese eregabe taudia toi-ahui e abidia hidi, ia bae bamoa.
JDG.14.11.english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

JDG.2.13.motu: Idia ese Iehova e rakatania, dirava ladadia Baal bona dirava ladadia Astaroto isiaidia e lao henidia.
JDG.2.13.english: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

JDG.19.25.motu: A hanua taudia na asie kamonai henia. Taunabunai, una Levi tauna ese ena hahine na e abia, e doria lasi idia dekediai. Idia ese e abia, e eno henia hanuaboi idoinai, ela bona daba e rere. Daba vaburana ai e kahua nege.
JDG.19.25.english: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.

JDG.7.21.motu: Ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai e gini, taruha e ginia heḡege. Bena tuari oreana idoinai e heau; e lolo dagu bona e heau karoho.
JDG.7.21.english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

JDG.18.14.motu: Bena hari tatau laimaosi, Laisi tanona e hasinadoa taudia, ese varavaradia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui dibamui a, ini ruma lalodiai na dabua helaḡana ta, bona kaivakuku, bona dirava laulaudia rua, e koroa ḡauna ta bona e havevea ḡauna ta? Taunabunai, harihari ba laloa ede ba kara toma.
JDG.18.14.english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”

JDG.19.26.motu: Daba e rere, bena hahine na ela, biaguna ena noho rumana iduarana ai e hekida diho, ela bona dina e dae.
JDG.19.26.english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

JDG.20.45.motu: Ma e kerehai, tano gaḡaena ai e heau, ela bona Rimon nadi-hagana. Daha-ima be laolao daladia ai e aladia mase; oredia ma e hahavadia ela bona Gidomo ai daha-rua ma e aladia mase.
JDG.20.45.english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

JDG.6.18.motu: Mani emu kara ini amo basio raka oho ela bona lau na baina lou mai, egu herahia ḡauna na oi vairamu ai baina hulala. Iehova eto, Baina noho ela bona oi na ba Iou mai.
JDG.6.18.english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.”

JDG.5.28.motu: Sisera sinana na e igo lasi,
JDG.5.28.english: “Through the window she looked out, and cried:

JDG.14.12.motu: Bena Samson ese toi-ahui-osi e hereva henidia, eto, Hereva hehunina ta harihari aina henimui, bena aria dinadia hituosi do basie ore ai na anina boma hamaorolaigu, lau ese hahedoki toi-ahui, dabua aukana amo e kara ḡaudia, bona riorio dabuadia toi-ahui, bama henimui;
JDG.14.12.english: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;

JDG.5.26.motu: Ikoko na imana ai e abia,
JDG.5.26.english: She put her hand to the tent peg,

JDG.17.3.motu: Bena Mika ese hari silver monidia daha-ta sinahu-ta na sinana e henia lou. Bena sinana eto, Ina silver na hahelaḡaiamu Iehova ena, natugu bagunai: e koroamu laulauna ta bona e haveveamu laulauna ta bae kara; taunabunai na henimu loumu.
JDG.17.3.english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

JDG.13.6.motu: Bena hahine na ela, adavana e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena tau ta dekegu ema, vairana na Dirava ena aneru vairana na heto. Bena na gari; asina nanadaia ede amo ema, bona ia na sibona se helada hato.
JDG.13.6.english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;

JDG.4.16.motu: Bena Barak ese kariota bona tuari taudia e hahavadia lao, ela bona Haroset-ha-goim. Sisera ena tuari taudia ibouboudiai na dare amo e aladia mase; ta se roho mauri.
JDG.4.16.english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

JDG.18.8.motu: Laimaosi na e lou lao; bena varavaradia Sora ai bona Estaol ai dekediai e kau negana ai, varavaradia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Emui laolao herevadia be dahaka dahaka?
JDG.18.8.english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”

JDG.18.13.motu: Unu amo idia ma e laolao, Efraim ororodia ela, Mika ena ruma ai e kau.
JDG.18.13.english: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

JDG.13.4.motu: Taunabunai nahuamu ba tohoa, vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana ta basio inua, bona ḡau mirona ta basio ania;
JDG.13.4.english: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;

JDG.15.8.motu: Bena ia ese e ala-ala henidia, hutuma e aladia mase; una murinai ia na ela, kohua ta ai e nohova, Etam hagana ai.
JDG.15.8.english: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.

JDG.11.8.motu: Gilead tau-badadia ese Iefeta ma e noia, eto, Ina dainai harihari vada ama: oi na ai ida baitala, Amono taudia baita tuari henidia, bena Gilead taumai iboumai ai ba halohiamai.
JDG.11.8.english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

JDG.9.5.motu: Bena ia ese tamana ena ruma Ofra ai ela, tadikakana hituahui-osi, Ierubu-baal natuna, e aladia mase, nadi tamona latanai. A taumuritai, ladana Iotam, e roho mauri; badina be ia na vada e komu.
JDG.9.5.english: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

JDG.5.3.motu: Pavapava e, a kamonai! Lohia e, a hakala!

JDG.17.10.motu: Bena Mika ese e hamaoroa, eto, Lau dekegu ai ba noho, tamagu ai bona egu hahelaḡa tauna ai baola; bena laḡani ta ta amo silver monidia gwauta gwauta amo baina henimu; emu dabua bona amu danu baina henimu.
JDG.17.10.english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.

JDG.5.11.motu: Ranu gabudia ai e kiri heboumu hahinedia gadodia a kamonai,
JDG.5.11.english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water,

JDG.20.4.motu: Bena hari Levi tauna, vada e alaia hahinena adavana, ese e haere henidia, eto, Lau na egu hahine ida Beniamina hanuana ta ladana Gibea ai a kau, unuseni ai baia mahuta ato.
JDG.20.4.english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

JDG.3.14.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Eglon, Moab pavapavana, isiaina e lao heni, laḡani gwauta-taurahani lalodiai.
JDG.3.14.english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

JDG.1.7.motu: Bena Adoni-besek eto, Pavapava hitu-ahui imadia sinabadadia bona aedia sinabadadia na utudia oho, bena egu pata henunai aniani momorudia e ani; lau ese na kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Iehova ese unu vada e kara henigu toma. Bena idia ese Ierusalem e laohaia: unuseni ai e mase.
JDG.1.7.english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

JDG.4.9.motu: Hahine na eto, Momokani baina bamomu; ḡau tamona una dala amo ihanamomu basio davaria, badina be Iehova ese Sisera na hahine ta imana ai baine atoa. Bena Debora e tore isi, Barak ida Kede hanuana ela.
JDG.4.9.english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

JDG.4.24.motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia edia kara e auka e laova Iabin, Kanaan pavapavana, enai, ela bona e habuaia tari.
JDG.4.24.english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

JDG.2.21.motu: lau ese Iosua na ina tano ai e masetanidia besedia basina luludia lasi vairadiai;
JDG.2.21.english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

JDG.9.48.motu: Bena Abimelek na Salmon ororona ai e dara dae, ia bona ena orea taudia iboudiai. Bena Abimelek ese ira auta e abia, au e raku; bena au rakuraku iḡui ta e abia isi, paḡana ai e huaia. Ena orea taudia danu ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Lauegu kara vada o itaia, heḡereḡerena mo ba karaia. A kara haraḡa.
JDG.9.48.english: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

JDG.18.20.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna lalona vada e moale; bena ia ese dabua helaḡana bona kaivakuku bona e koroa laulauna e abi, idia bogaragidiai ela.
JDG.18.20.english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.

JDG.11.2.motu: Gilead adavana ese danu natuna mamaruanedia haida e havaradia; bena e bada oho bada oho negana ai Gilead adavana natuna ese Iefeta e lulua oho, e gwau henia, eto, Oi na asi ahumu tamada ena ruma ai, badina be oi na idau hahinena natuna.
JDG.11.2.english: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”

JDG.10.14.motu: Aola, vada o abidia hidi diravadia ba tai henidia, idia ese emui hisihisi negana ai bae hamaurimui.
JDG.10.14.english: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

JDG.4.8.motu: Barak ese e haere henia, eto, Oi ba bamogu, vada bainala; a basio bamogu, lau na basinala.
JDG.4.8.english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

JDG.19.3.motu: Bena adavana e tore isi, ia murina amo ela, baine hamarumarua bena baine hakaua lao eto. Ena hesiai tauna bona doniki rua e laohaidia. Hahine ese tamana ena ruma ai e abia dae; bena tamana ese e itaia negana ai ia danu e abia dae mai moalena ida.
JDG.19.3.english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

JDG.16.29.motu: Bena Samson ese ruma bogaragina au-tubuadia ruaosi, ruma metauna e huaiava gaudia, e dogodia tao, bena imana idibana amo ta e rosia, ma imana laurina amo ta e rosia.
JDG.16.29.english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.

JDG.6.1.motu: Israel taudia ma e kara havara Iehova vairanai, bena Iehova ese Midian taudia imadia ai e atodia, ela bona laḡani hitu e ore.
JDG.6.1.english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

JDG.20.48.motu: Israel taudia na tuari amo e lou, Beniamina taudia ma e ala-ala henidia, taunimanima bona boromakau bona e davari ḡaudia iboudiai e habuadia tari; bona e davari hanuadia na e doudia.
JDG.20.48.english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.

JDG.2.19.motu: A hahemaoro tauna e mase negana ai, idia na e raka muri, e kara havara, tamadia edia kara havara e hereadia; dirava idaudia muridia amo e raka, isiaidia e lao heni bona e toma henidia diho; edia kara havara bona edia gwau daḡe asie rakatanidia.
JDG.2.19.english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

JDG.8.24.motu: Gideon ma e hereva henidia, eto, Mani emui kara egu noinoi binai: umui ta ta ese gold gadeidia tuari ai o abi vada ba henigu. (Taiadia na mai gadeidia, hadina be idia na Ismael taudia).
JDG.8.24.english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

JDG.17.4.motu: Taunabunai, Mika ese silver e abia, sinana e heni lou, negana ai, hahine ese silver monidia sinahu-rua e abi, silver iḡaukaralaiana tauna e henia; bena ia ese kahana e koroa, laulau ta e karaia, ma kahana e havevea, laulau ta e karaia; bena laulau na Mika ena ruma ai e miava.
JDG.17.4.english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

JDG.2.4.motu: Iehova ena aneru ese Israel taudia iboudiai unu e hereva henidia toma; bena iboudiai na e tai lolololo.
JDG.2.4.english: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

JDG.16.31.motu: Bena tadikakana bona ena iduhu taudia iboudiai na ela, e abia, e laohaia, tamana Manoa ena gara ai e guria, Sora bona Estaol padadiai. Ia ese Israel taudia vada e hahemaoro henidia, laḡani ruahui lalodiai.
JDG.16.31.english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

JDG.16.7.motu: Samson ese e haere henia, eto, Peva maoradia matamatadia hitu, do asie kaukau ḡaudia, amo bema ḡuigu, lau na bama manoka, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
JDG.16.7.english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”

JDG.8.25.motu: Idia na e haere, eto, Baia henimu mai moalemai ida. Bena dabua ta e lahaia, iboudiai ese tuari ai e abidia gadeidia na dabua ai e taho dobi.
JDG.8.25.english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

JDG.7.13.motu: Gideon e kau negana ai, tau ta ese ena nihi sivaraina na bamona ta e hamaorolaia, eto: A kamonai, lau na na nihi; egu nihi ai bali dikeana ta e hekei mai Midian taruhana ai, kalaga auta ai e tata kau, bena kalaga na e kohu, e heḡiḡi dobi tano ai.
JDG.7.13.english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

JDG.15.10.motu: Bena Iuda taudia eto, Dahaka dainai o tuari henimaimu? Idia eto, Ai na Samson baia abia mauri totona vada ama, ia ese vada e karamai heḡereḡerena baia kara henia.
JDG.15.10.english: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?”

JDG.20.27.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e nanadaia; badina be unu dinadia ai Iehova ena taravatu mauana na unuseni mia,
JDG.20.27.english: The children of Israel asked Yahweh (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

JDG.8.6.motu: A Sukoto lohiadia eto, Be, Sebaha bona Salmuna vada o abidia mauri, una dainai ai ese emu tuari taudia baia ubudia a?
JDG.8.6.english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

JDG.9.21.motu: Bena lotam e heau, Bere ela, unuseni ai e nohova, kakana Abimelek garina e gariva dainai.
JDG.9.21.english: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

JDG.8.32.motu: Gideon loasa e buruka herea, bena e mase. Tamana loasa ena gara ai e guria, Ofra ai: Abiesere taudia edia hanua bunai.
JDG.8.32.english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

JDG.6.15.motu: Gideon na e haere, eto, Ḡaubada e, Israel na ede baina harohodia mauri toma? O itaia, lauegu doḡoro na ogogami herea Manase ai, bona lau danu maraḡi herea tamagu egu ruma ai.
JDG.6.15.english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

JDG.13.18.motu: Iehova ena aneru eto, Dahaka dainai ladagu o nanadailaia? Ia na hoa ḡauna.
JDG.13.18.english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”

JDG.5.21.motu: Kison sinavaina ese e arudia lao,
JDG.5.21.english: The river Kishon swept them away,

JDG.1.10.motu: Iuda taudia danu ela, Kanaan taudia Heberon ai (una hanua ladana gunana be Kiriat-araba) e tuari henidia. Bena idia ese Sesai bona Ahiman bona Talmai e hadareredia.
JDG.1.10.english: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

JDG.6.10.motu: bena na hamaoromui, nato “Lau na Iehova, emui Dirava; Amoro taudia, edia tano ai o nohomu taudia, edia dirava na basio toma henidia diho”. A eregu asio kamonai.
JDG.6.10.english: I said to you, “I am Yahweh your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

JDG.16.23.motu: Filistia lohiadia na e hebou, edia dirava, ladana Dagon, bae boua, boubou bada-hereana, bona bae moale hebou totona. Badina be idia na eto, Iseda dirava ese inaida Samson na imada ai vada e atoa.
JDG.16.23.english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”

JDG.11.11.motu: Bena Iefeta na Gilead tau-badadia ida ela; bena Gilead taudia ese ikwaradia tauna bona edia lohia ai e halaoa. Iefeta ese ena hereva iboudiai na Iehova vairanai e gwaurai, Mispa ai.
JDG.11.11.english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before Yahweh in Mizpah.

JDG.15.20.motu: Samson ese Israel taudia e hahemaoro henidia, Filistia taudia edia nega ai, ela laḡani ruahui e ore.
JDG.15.20.english: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

JDG.6.27.motu: Taunabunai, Gideon ese ena hesiai taudia gwauta e abidia, Iehova ese vada e haḡania heḡereḡerena e karaia; to ena ruma taudia bona hanua taudia garidia e gariva dainai, ia na dina ai se karaia, a hanuaboi ai e karaia.
JDG.6.27.english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahweh had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

JDG.9.44.motu: Abimelek mai ena orea taudia ida e heau ela, hanua ikoukouna e gimaia; a orea rua be tano paka ai vada e raka lasi taudia na e ala-ala henidia, bona e aladia ore.
JDG.9.44.english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

JDG.2.17.motu: Ḡau tamona, idia ese edia hahemaoro taudia eredia asie kamonai; dounu dirava idaudia muridia amo e raka bona isiaidia e lao heni. Asi vanahana idia ese tamadia e rakalai daladia amo e raka siri; tamadia ese Iehova ena hahegani e badinadia, a idia ese asie badinadia.
JDG.2.17.english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

JDG.16.30.motu: Samson ma eto, Mani emu kara Filistia taudia ida baia mase hebou. Bena e igo diho mai goadana idoinai. Bena ruma na e kohu, bese lohiadia bona ruma ai e nohova taudia iboudiai latadiai. Taunabunai, Samson masena ai e aladia mase taudia na hutuma; a maurina ai e aladia mase taudia na gagadoi.
JDG.16.30.english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

JDG.19.6.motu: Taunabunai, tatau raruosi e ege diho, e aniani hebou bona e inuinu hebou. Bena hahine tamana ese ma e noia, eto, Mani emu kara do ba mahuta, lalomu baine moale.
JDG.19.6.english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

JDG.8.3.motu: Dirava ese Midian pavapavadia Oreb bona Sebe na umui imamui ai vada e atodia. Lau be dahaka na karaia oiemu kara heḡereḡerena? Unu e hereva toma, bena idia lalodia e keru, bona edia badu e doko.
JDG.8.3.english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

JDG.9.23.motu: Bena Dirava ese lauma dikana ta e siaia, Abimelek bona Sekem taudia padadiai. Bena Sekem taudia ese Abimelek e inai henia.
JDG.9.23.english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

JDG.5.29.motu: Ena aonega hahinedia ese e haere henia,

JDG.1.26.motu: Una tau na Hiti taudia edia tano ela, unuseni ai hanua ta e hadaia, ladana e hatoa Lusu; una hanua na unu e hatoa toma ema bona hari dina.
JDG.1.26.english: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

JDG.1.34.motu: Amoro taudia ese Dan taudia na e luludia lou ororo kahadia, bona e laodia ahu, taora ai basie diho.
JDG.1.34.english: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;

JDG.14.8.motu: Nega taina vada ela, ia na iabina e lou lao; bena e raka siri, una leona tau-anina baine itaia eto. E itaia, labolabo ese edia ruma vada e karaia leona tau-anina lalonai, bona edia bada-ranuna na mia.
JDG.14.8.english: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

JDG.7.3.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima ba hamaorodia, baoto “Gari bona kudou-hetaha tauna ese ena ruma baine lou henia”. Gideon na unu e tohodia toma; bena gerebu-rua daha-rua e lou, a gerebu ta e noho.
JDG.7.3.english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

JDG.7.12.motu: Midian taudia bona Amalek taudia bona mairiveina kahana taudia iboudiai na koura ai e taruha. Idia na hutuma herea, kwadi na heheto; edia kamelo danu asi iduahidia, kone mirina na heto.
JDG.7.12.english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

JDG.8.17.motu: Penuel kohorona danu e ḡiḡia dobi, bona hanua taudia e aladia mase.
JDG.8.17.english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

JDG.5.1.motu: Una dina ai Debora bona Barak Abinaom ese ane ta e abia, ini e abia toma:
JDG.5.1.english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

JDG.1.22.motu: Iosef vevena ese Betele e tuari henia; bena Iehova na idia ida.
JDG.1.22.english: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.

JDG.18.29.motu: Hanua ladana e hatoa Dan, senedia Dan, Israel natuna, inemaina. A gunaguna una hanua ladana na Laisi.
JDG.18.29.english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

JER.6.2.motu: Hane namo, aboni-noho hahinena, baine alaia,
JER.6.2.english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

JER.19.3.motu: Baoto: Iuda pavapavana hahidaosi bona Ierusalem inoholaina taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese dika badana ta ina gabu latanai baina havaraia; bena bae kamonai taudia iboudiai na taiadia bae hemai-hemai.
JER.19.3.english: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

JER.42.12.motu: Lau ese baina bogamui hisi; unu amo ia ese danu baine bogamui hisi, bona emui tano korikori ai baine hanohomui.
JER.42.12.english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

JER.20.7.motu: Iehova e, oi ese vada o dibaḡanigu,
JER.20.7.english: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded.

JER.24.1.motu: Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese lekonia, Iuda pavapavana Iehoiakim natuna, bona Iuda lohiadia bona ima karakara dibaka taudia bona awi igaukaralaidia taudia na Ierusalem ai e abidia bena gabu daudau ai, Babulono ai, e hanohodia murinai, Iehova ese ina mata-hanai ḡauna e haheitalaigu. Suke huahuadia bosea rua Iehova ena dubu vairanai heheato na itadia.
JER.24.1.english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before Yahweh’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

JER.2.2.motu: Aola, Ierusalem taudia vairatuhutuhudia ai ba hereva, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu:
JER.2.2.english: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says,

JER.50.6.motu: Egu bese taudia na boio mamoedia; ireḡudia taudia ese vada hakaudia kerere, ororo ai vada e harakadia siri; ororo badana amo ela bona ororo maraḡina vada ela, edia maḡu vada e reaia.
JER.50.6.english: My people have been lost sheep.

JER.50.26.motu: Kaha iboudiai amo ba tuari henia;
JER.50.26.english: Come against her from the farthest border.

JER.23.23.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Lau na gabu kahikahidia Diravana a dia gabu daudaudia Diravana a?
