JER.23.23.english: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh,

JER.11.17.motu: Iehova Sabaota, e hadomui Diravana, ese dika na latamui ai vada e gwauraia, badina be Israel besena bona Iuda besena vada e kara dika, bona vada e habadugu, muramura mai bonadia na Baal e gabu henia dainai.
JER.11.17.english: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

JER.37.1.motu: Sedekia Iosia, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese Iuda tanona pavapavana ai e halaoa tauna, na Iuda ai e lohiava, Konia Iehoiakim gabuna ai.
JER.37.1.english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

JER.30.17.english: For I will restore health to you,

JER.31.40.motu: Mase tau-anidia bona kahu kourana idoinai bona rei gabudia iboudiai ela bona Kidron dokadokana, ela bona Hosi Ikoukouna daigunina, mairiveina kahana ai, idoinai baine helaḡa Iehova ena. Ia na nega ta ai basine heraga eiava basine heḡiḡi dobi ela bona hanaihanai.
JER.31.40.english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to Yahweh. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”

JER.23.32.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Nihi koikoidia e perovetalaidiamu taudia na inai henidiamu, idia ese e gwauraidiamu, bona edia koikoi bona edia kavakava amo egu bese taudia e hakaudia kereremu, a lau ese asina siaidia bona asina haduadia. Taunabunai idia ese ina bese taudia edia namo sisina taina asie havaraia. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.23.32.english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says Yahweh, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says Yahweh.

JER.29.4.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ese Ierusalem amo vada e siaidla lao bena Babulono ai vada e hanohodia taudia na ini e hamaorodia tomamu:
JER.29.4.english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

JER.29.21.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ese Ahaba Kolaia bona Sedekia Maaseia, lau ladagu ai e peroveta henimui koikoimu taudia, na ini e herevalaidia tomamu: A itaia, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, imana ai baina atodia, bena ia ese umui vairamui ai baine aladia mase.
JER.29.21.english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.

JER.8.18.english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow!

JER.33.22.motu: Guba hisiudia na asi iduahidia bona kone miridia na asi ihahetohodia na heto, egu hesiai tauna David garana bona hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo garadia unu baina hahutumadia toma.
JER.33.22.english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

JER.15.19.motu: Taunabunai Iehova ini e gvau tomamu:

JER.33.12.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Ina gabu ḡaḡaena, asi tauna ta eiava asi ubu-ubu ḡauna ta gabuna, lalonai, bona hanuana iboudiai lalodiai, mamoe ireḡudia taudia, edia mamoe e halaḡa-anidiamu taudia, edia noho gabudia ma bae hekara lou.
JER.33.12.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

JER.6.13.english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness.

JER.18.23.motu: Ḡau tamona, Iehova e, edia kara iboudiai oi dibamu,
JER.18.23.english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me.

JER.50.42.motu: Idia ese peva bona io e abi kaumu;
JER.50.42.english: They take up bow and spear.

JER.35.11.motu: A Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, na tano idaena totona ema negana ai, ai ato “Aoma, Ierusalem aitala, Kaldea taudia bona Suria taudia edia tuari oreadia na garidia”. Taunabunai ai na Ierusalem ai a nohomu.
JER.35.11.english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”

JER.26.20.motu: Ma lau ta danu Iehova ladana ai e perovetava, ladana na Uria Semaia, Kiriat-iearimi tauna. Ia ese peroveta herevadia na ina hanua bona ina tano latadiai e gwaurai; ena hereva na Ieremia ena heḡereḡeredia.
JER.26.20.english: There was also a man who prophesied in Yahweh’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

JER.35.9.motu: bona ruma danu asia haginidia, asia noholaidia. Asi emai vine imeadia, asi emai uma, asi emai uhe;
JER.35.9.english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;

JER.32.29.motu: Kaldea taudia, ina hanua e tuari heniamu taudia, na baema, ina hanua na bae daea, bae doua; guhidia ai muramura mai bonana na Baal e gabu henia bona inuinu bouboudia na dirava idaudia e bubu henidia bena unu amo e habadugu rumadia danu bae dou.
JER.32.29.english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

JER.10.14.motu: Taunaimanima iboudiai na kakavakava bona asi aonegadia,
JER.10.14.english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge.

JER.11.12.motu: Bena Iuda hanuadia bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na baela, muramura mai bonadia e gabu henidiamu diravadia bae tai henidia, to edia hekwakwanai negana ai unu idia ese basie hamauridia diba.
JER.11.12.english: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

JER.23.27.motu: Idia na e laloamu edia nihi, e hesivarailai hehenimu ḡaudia, daidiai lau ladagu ilalo-taona na egu bese taudia lalodia amo bae abia oho, tamadia ese Baal dainai lau ladagu e laloa boio heḡereḡerena.
JER.23.27.english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.

JER.48.17.motu: Ia taina ba tai, o nohoa hegegemu taumui iboumui ai,
JER.48.17.english: All you who are around him, bemoan him;

JER.32.25.motu: A oi, Ḡaubada Iehova e, vada o hamaorogu, oto, Ena be hanua na Kaldea taudia imadia ai vada na atoa, to oi ese tano na moni amo ba hoia, kara ihamomokanina taudia danu bavabidia.
JER.32.25.english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

JER.31.30.motu: A ta ta na ena kara dika ena kara dika daidiai bae mase; vine huahuadia iditadia e animu taudia na sibodia isedia bae uri.
JER.31.30.english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

JER.49.32.english: Their camels will be a booty,

JER.3.11.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Kara hebeatai besena Israel ena kerere vada eme hedinarai na taina maraḡi, a koikoi besena Iuda ena kerere na bada.
JER.3.11.english: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

JER.38.25.motu: Hanua lohiadia bema kamonai lau na oi ida vada ta hereva-hereva, bena bae vasi, bae nanadaimu, baeto “A hamaoromai, hanua pavapavana ede o hamaoroa toma bona hanua pavapavana ese ede e hamaoromu toma; ḡau ta emai ai basio hunia, bena basia alamu mase”.
JER.38.25.english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

JER.50.34.motu: Ihamauridia Diravana na mai goadana; ia ladana na Iehova Sabaota. Ia ese edia gini-kau gabuna baine herevalaia, bena tanobada na laḡani baine henia, a Babulono inoholaina taudia na hekwarahi baine henidia.

JER.17.8.motu: Ia na ranu badinai e hadoamu auna na heto,
JER.17.8.english: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters,

JER.10.15.motu: Idia na asi anidia, haero-kerere ese e havaradia;
JER.10.15.english: They are vanity, a work of delusion.

JER.23.36.motu: A “Iehova ena maduna”, basio herevalaia lou, badina be maduna be taunimanima iboudiai ta ta ena hereva ena hereva; bona umui ese Mauri Diravana, Iehova Sabaota, iseda Dirava, ena hereva o hagagevadiamu.
JER.23.36.english: You will mention the message from Yahweh no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies, our God.

JER.48.30.english: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing;

JER.6.14.motu: Egu orea taudia berodia vada e haḡoevadia lamai-lamai,
JER.6.14.english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially,

JER.8.16.motu: Edia hosi edia hakoko na Dan amo e kamonaimu;
JER.8.16.english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan.

JER.17.7.motu: Iehova e abidadama heniamu tauna na namo;
JER.17.7.english: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh,

JER.42.7.motu: Dina gwauta e ore ai Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau.
JER.42.7.english: After ten days, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah.

JER.46.14.motu: Aigupto ai ba herevalaia, Migdol ai ba gwauraia,

JER.50.21.english: “Go up against the land of Merathaim,

JER.23.30.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Taunabunai, a itaia, lau ese peroveta taudia na inai henidiamu; idia ese egu hereva na bamodia edia amo e henaomu.
JER.23.30.english: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.

JER.16.11.motu: Una negana ai oi ese ba haere henidia, baoto, Iehova na e tomu: Badina be tamamui ese vada e rakatanigu, dirava idaudia muridia amo vada ela, isiaidia vada e lao heni, bona vada e toma henidia diho; lau vada e rakatanigu bona egu taravatu asie badinaia,
JER.16.11.english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says Yahweh, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.

JER.50.40.motu: Dirava ese Sodoma bona Gomora bona edia hetabira hanuadia na e habuadia tari negana heḡereḡerena ai, unuheto tau ta na unuseni ai basine noho, bona taunimanima natuna ta ese basine noho henia. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.50.40.english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh,

JER.2.33.motu: Nahuamu o tohoa namonamomu emu mata-bodaga karadia ai,
JER.2.33.english: How well you prepare your way to seek love!

JER.16.6.motu: Kikina-badana na ina tano ai bae mase; haida ese basie guridia; bona tau ta ese basine tailaidia, eiava basine tai hekakasi eiava kwarana basine naua, idia daidiai.
JER.16.6.english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.

JER.50.43.motu: Babulono pavapavana ese haridia e kamonai,
JER.50.43.english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them,

JER.25.26.motu: bona mirigini kahana pavapavadia iboudiai, gabu daudaudia bona kahikahidia, murina murina amo, bona tanobada basileiadia iboudiai tano kopina idoinai latanai danu. Idia muridiai, Babulono pavapavana ese baine inua.
JER.25.26.english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

JER.43.12.motu: Ia ese lahi ta baine ha-araia, Aigupto diravadia edia dubu ai; baine doudia bona abi-mauri ai baine laohaidia. Ia ese Aigupto tanona baine haḡoevaia, mamoe ireḡudia tauna ese ena dabua mai darurana e hagoevaiamu na heto. Bena unu amo ma baine raka oho mai mainona ida.
JER.43.12.english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

JER.41.15.motu: A Ismael Netania na Iohanan ena amo e roho mauri, tatau taurahani ida, bena Amono taudia dekedia ela.
JER.41.15.english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

JER.17.2.motu: bona natudia ese danu edia ihaboulaina patadia e lalodia taomu, bona edia au-tubua helaḡadia danu, au mauridia iboudiai badibadidiai, bona ororo doridia ai,
JER.17.2.english: Even their children remember their altars

JER.23.34.motu: Bona peroveta tauna eiava hahelaḡa tauna eiava bese taudia ta, “Iehova ena maduna” e herevalaiamu tauna, lau ese una tau mai ena ruma taudia ida na matadia baina hakanidia.
JER.23.34.english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.

JER.37.7.motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Iuda pavapavana, dekegu ai e siaimu ba nanadaigu totona tauna, na ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto, A itaia, Farao ena tuari oreana, oi idurumu totona ema ḡauna, na be lou laomu, edia tano korikori Aigupto ai.
JER.37.7.english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.

JER.38.5.motu: King Sedekia eto, A itaia, ia na umui imamui ai; badina be hanua pavapavana ese basine laomui ahu diba.
JER.38.5.english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”

JER.52.15.motu: Bena ogoḡami dikadika taudia haida, bona hanua taudia kwabukwabudia dounu hanua ai e nohova, bona Babulono pavapavana enai e heau hanai taudia, bona ima karakara dibaka taudia oredia, na Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese e ḡuidia, bena dauha e laohaidia.
JER.52.15.english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

JER.5.13.motu: Peroveta taudia na lai kavakava ai bae hahelao,
JER.5.13.english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

JER.35.16.motu: Ionadab Rekab garana ese senedia ena haheḡani vada e badinaia, a ina bese ese se kamonai henigu.
JER.35.16.english: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’

JER.3.3.motu: Taunabunai, batugu vada e helao ahu,
JER.3.3.english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

JER.2.16.motu: Ina danu, Memefisi bona Tapanese taudia ese
JER.2.16.english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

JER.51.27.motu: Pepe ba duduia isi tanobada ai,
JER.51.27.english: “Set up a standard in the land!

JER.29.1.motu: Peroveta launa Ieremia ena revareva, Ierusalem amo e siaia lao, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem amo Babulono e laohaidia unuseni ai e hanohodia taudia edia tau-badadia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai edia, revarevana herevadia bini.
JER.29.1.english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

JER.36.25.motu: Ena be Elnatan bona Delaia bona Gemaria ese hanua pavapavana e hereva henia goadagoada, pepa na basine doua, to ia ese se kamonai henidia.
JER.36.25.english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

JER.50.44.motu: A itaia, leona na mamoe maḡuna aukana ihadikana totona Ioridane udana amo e daemu na heto, lau ese iena amo baina haheaudia oho; bona baina abia hidi tauna na ia ikwarana tauna ai baina halaoa. Badina be daika na lau heḡereḡeregu? Daika ese baine boirigu? Edena mamoe ireḡudia tauna na lau vairagu ai baine gini diba?
JER.50.44.english: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion

JER.5.27.motu: Edia ruma na kara dibaka ai e honumu,
JER.5.27.english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

JER.9.21.motu: Badina be mase na eda ruma gaba-maurudia ai vada e dae vareai,
JER.9.21.english: For death has come up into our windows.

JER.16.2.motu: Hahine ta basio adavaia, bona natumu mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basio havaradia ina gabu ai.
JER.16.2.english: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”

JER.1.1.motu: Ieremia, Hilkia natuna, hahelaḡa taudia Anatoto ai, Beniamina tanona ai, e nohova edia orea tauna ta, ena hereva.
JER.1.1.english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

JER.15.18.motu: Dahaka dainai egu hisihisi na asi dokona,

JER.36.16.motu: Unu hereva iboudiai e kamonai negana ai, idia na mai garidia ida e heroha heheni. Bena idia ese Baruku e hamaoroa, eto, Ini-hereva iboudiai na hanua pavapavana do baia hamaorolaia.
JER.36.16.english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

JER.37.2.motu: A ia bona ena hesiai taudia bona tano taudia ese Iehova ena hereva, peroveta tauna Ieremia uduna amo e gwaurai ḡaudia, na asie kamonaidia.
JER.37.2.english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to Yahweh’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

JER.35.4.motu: Na hakaudia mai, Iehova ena dubu ai, Hanana Igdalia, Dirava ena tau, natuna edia daiutu lalonai. Una daiutu na lohia taudia edia daiutu badibadinai, bona Ma-aseia Salumu, dubu raka-vareaina igimana tauna, ena daiutu daenai.
JER.35.4.english: and I brought them into Yahweh’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

JER.25.21.motu: bona Edom bona Moab bona Amono garana,
JER.25.21.english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

JER.2.12.motu: Guba e, ina na ba dara-dokolaia,

JER.6.19.motu: Tanobada e, a kamonai! A itaia!

JER.6.1.english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

JER.10.23.motu: Iehova e, lau dibagu taunimanima ena dala na dia ia sibona lalona ai,
JER.10.23.english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself.

JER.14.20.motu: Iehova e, emai kara dika a gwaurai hedinaraimu,

JER.13.13.motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese ina tano inoholaina taudia iboudiai na baina hakekerodia vaitani - pavapava, David ena terono ai e helaimu taudia, bona hahelaḡa taudia, bona peroveta taudia, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia iboudiai.
JER.13.13.english: Then tell them, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

JER.52.26.motu: Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese e abidia, Babulono pavapavana dekena e laohaidia Ribla ai.
JER.52.26.english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

JER.48.24.motu: Kerioto, Bosra, bona Moab tanona hanuadia iboudiai, daudaudia bona kahikahidia, latadiai.

JER.8.6.motu: Vada na hakala, vada na kamonai,
JER.8.6.english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right.

JER.22.9.motu: Bena idia na bae haere, baeto, Badina be idia ese Iehova, edia Dirava, ena taravatu e rakatania, dirava idaudia e toma henidia dihova bona isiaidia e lao heniva.
JER.22.9.english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”

JER.15.4.motu: Lau ese hahegari ḡauna ai baina halaodia, tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ediai, Manase Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ese Ierusalem ai e karaia ḡauna dainai.
JER.15.4.english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

JER.41.2.motu: Ismael Netania bona hari tatau gwauta ia ida na e tore isi; bena idia ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, Babulono pavapavana ese tano ikwarana tauna ai e halaoa tauna, na dare amo e tutua gwada, e alaia mase.
JER.41.2.english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

JER.46.28.english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh,

JER.32.44.motu: Inoḡo na moni amo ba hoi, bona tano ibiagudia pepadia ai ladamui ba tore, bena ba koudia kunuka-kunuka, bona kara ihamomokanina taudh ese bae hamomokanidia, Beniamina tanona ai, bona Ierusalem hetabirana ai, bona Iuda hanuadia ai, bona ororo kahadia hanuadia bona taora hanuadia bona diho kahana hanuadia ai; badina be edia noho ma baina hanamoa lou. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.32.44.english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says Yahweh.

JER.11.1.motu: Ina hereva na Iehova ena amo ema, Ieremia enai:
JER.11.1.english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

JER.3.15.motu: Lau ese iregumui taudia baina henimui, na lalo namo henidiamu taudia; bena idia ese aonega bona lalo-parara amo bae ubumui.
JER.3.15.english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

JER.51.20.motu: Oi na egu gahi bona egu tuari ḡauna;
JER.51.20.english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war.

JER.5.14.motu: Taunabunai Dirava, Iehova Sabaota, na ini e gwau tomamu:
JER.5.14.english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

JER.50.8.motu: Babulono bogaragina amo ba heau lao, Kaldea taudia edia tano ba rakatania, nani mamaruanedia na edia seri matana ai e rakamu na heto.
JER.50.8.english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon!

JER.38.11.motu: Taunabunai, Ebede-melek ese unu tatau e abidia, bena pavapava ena ruma ela, habou-habou daiutuna ai maua ta lalona amo dabua seadia gunadia bona hahedoki, vada e dika ḡaudia, e abi; bena kwanau amo guri lalonai e tudia dobi, Ieremia enai.
JER.38.11.english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

JER.51.37.motu: Babulono na e heḡiḡi dobi hanuana ai bainela,

JER.24.7.motu: Lalodia na baina hapararadia, vada bae diba, lau na Iehova; bena idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala; badina be idia ese bae lou henigu, mai lalodia idoidiai ida.
JER.24.7.english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

JER.25.5.motu: eto, Iboumui ai ba helalo kerehai, ta ta emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dikadia amo ba raka oho; bena Iehova ese umui bona senemui nega gunadia amo ela bona hanaihanai vada e henimui tanona ai do ba noho;
JER.25.5.english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

JER.52.20.motu: Hari au-tubua ruaosi, bona nau badana, bona boromakau mamaruanedia laulaudia gwauta-ruaosi, auri labora-labora amo e kara bona nau badana henunai e ato ḡaudia, bona rerue, hanua pavapavana Solomon ese e kara Iehova ena dubu ena, auri labora-labora idia lalodiai metauna na asi ihahetohona.
JER.52.20.english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

JER.38.1.motu: Ieremia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorolaidia herevadia na Sefatia Matan, Gedalia Pasahuru, Iukala Selemia, bona Pasahuru Malkia na e kamonai. Ia eto,
JER.38.1.english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

JER.1.15.motu: Badina be Iehova na e tomu, A itaia, mirigini kahana basileiadia besedia iboudiai na boiridiamu; bena idia na baema, ta ta ese ena terono ena terono bae haginidia, Ierusalem ikoukoudia raka-vareaidia ai, bona e haheḡeḡea daemu maḡudia iboudiai hevaira-henidia ai, bona Iuda hanuadia iboudiai hevaira-henidia ai.
JER.1.15.english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh.

JER.44.30.motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Farao Hofra, Aigupto pavapavana, na inaina imadia ai bona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai baina atoa, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, na Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ana inai tauna bona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuava tauna, imana ai na atoa heḡereḡerena.
JER.44.30.english: Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”

JER.31.28.motu: Bena iragadia bona iḡiḡi-dobidia, ihadareredia, ihabua-taridia bona ihadikadia totona vada na itadia tao heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese ihaginidia bona ihadaidia totona vada na itadia tao. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.31.28.english: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says Yahweh.

JER.32.30.motu: Badina be Israel garana bona Iuda garana na kara dikadia mo vada e kara lau vairagu ai, merodia negadia amo, Israel garana imadia ḡaukaradia na lau ihabadugu karadia mo. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.32.30.english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

JER.48.27.motu: Israel na so kirikirilaia a? Henao taudia bogaragidiai o davaria, bena o herevalaia negadia iboudiai kwaramu o haladoladoa a?
JER.48.27.english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you?

JER.51.40.motu: Iala-masedia totona baina hakaudia hekei, mamoe natudia na heheto,
JER.51.40.english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter,

JER.13.8.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
JER.13.8.english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

JER.31.6.motu: Badina be dinana baine kau, gima taudia na bae boiboi,
JER.31.6.english: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry,

JER.51.54.motu: A kamonai! Taitai ta Babulono amo;
JER.51.54.english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon,

JER.31.23.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ma nega ta ini hereva na Iuda tanona ai bona ena hanua lalodiai bae gwaurai lou, edia noho ma baina hanamoa lou negana ai.
JER.31.23.english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘Yahweh bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’

JER.43.6.motu: tatau, hahine, memero, kekeni, hanua pavapavana natuna hahinedia, bona Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, dekenai e rakatanidia taudia iboudiai; bona peroveta tauna Ieremia bona Baruku Neria danu.
JER.43.6.english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

JER.5.26.motu: Badina be kara dika taudia na egu orea taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu;
JER.5.26.english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

JER.11.7.motu: Badina be senemui na sisiba henidia auka, Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi negana ai, na sisiba henidia loulou, asina hesiku, ema bona ina dina ai, nato, Lau gadogu ba kamonai.
JER.11.7.english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”

JER.49.15.motu: Badina be lau ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hamaraḡimu,

JER.51.3.motu: Peva tauna ese ena peva basine marea,

JER.32.33.motu: Idia ese vada e gini muri henigu, asie vaira henigu. Ena be na hadibadia havara-havara to idia ese hahediba herevadia na asie hakala henidia.

JER.42.10.english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

JER.7.16.english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

JER.3.25.english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice.”

JER.13.7.motu: Bena Eufrate sinavaina nala, tano na ḡeia, hari riorio dabuana na na hunia gabuna amo ma na abia. A na itaia, una norio dabuana vada e mouka-mouka; ia na negenege ḡauna mo.
JER.13.7.english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

JER.39.12.motu: Avabia, ba naria namonamo, basio hadikaia, a ia ese baine hamaorolaimui heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henia.
JER.39.12.english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

JER.39.13.motu: Taunabunai, Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, bona Nebusasabana, Rabsarisi tauna, bona Neregala-saresere, Rabmaga tauna, bona Babulono pavapavana ena tuari lohiadia badadia iboudiai na
JER.39.13.english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

JER.51.30.motu: Babulono ena tuari taudia ese tuari vada e hadokoa,
JER.51.30.english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting,

JER.36.1.motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina ai, ina hereva Iehova ena amo na Ieremia enai e kau, eto:
JER.36.1.english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

JER.28.16.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese tanobada kopina amo baina abimu oho; hari ina laḡani lalonai vada ba mase, badina be Iehova igwau-edeede-henina herevadia vada o gwaurai.
JER.28.16.english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’”

JER.29.12.motu: Bena ba hahanegu bona igurigu baoma; bena lau ese baina kamonai henimui.
JER.29.12.english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

JER.31.26.motu: Bena na noga, na roharoha; egu mahuta mamina vada e namo egu ai.
JER.31.26.english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

JER.50.28.motu: A hakala, idia na e heaumu, Babulono tanona amo e roho maurimu; Siona ai Iehova, eda Dirava, ena dava-heni, ena dubu idavalaina, na bae gwauraia hedinarai.
JER.50.28.english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon,

JER.2.19.motu: Emu kara dika ese matamu baine hakania,

JER.32.7.motu: A itaia, Hanamele, tamamu lahaina Salumu natuna, na baine vasi, baineto “Egu tano Anatoto ai, Beniamina tanona ai, ba hoia, badina be iabi-taona siahuna na oiemu ai”.
JER.32.7.english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

JER.43.4.motu: Taunabunai, Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai bona taunimanima iboudiai ese Iehova ena hereva, Iuda tanona inoholaina herevana, na asie badinaia.
JER.43.4.english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

JER.49.14.motu: Hari ta Iehova ena amo vada na kamonai,
JER.49.14.english: I have heard news from Yahweh,

JER.2.34.english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts.

JER.10.6.motu: Iehova e, oi na asi idaimu;
JER.10.6.english: There is no one like you, Yahweh.

JER.36.22.motu: Nega na hua ihataurahani-tana; hanua pavapavana na keru negana rumana ai e helaiva, bona lahi na rahurahu ai vada e ha-araia ia vairanai.
JER.36.22.english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

JER.51.28.motu: Bese idau-idau ba hahegaegaedia, bae tuari henia totona,

JER.17.21.motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Emui mauri nahuadia ba toho, Dina Helaga ai maduna ta basio huaia, eiava ini Ierusalem ikoukoudia amo basio vareailaia,
JER.17.21.english: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

JER.43.7.motu: Bena Aigupto tanona ai e kau; badina be Iehova gadona asie badinaia. Bena Tapanese ai e kau.
JER.43.7.english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.

JER.37.11.motu: Kaldea taudia edia tuari oreana na Ierusalem amo vada e raka oho, Farao ena tuari oreana e raka kahira negana ai.
JER.37.11.english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

JER.40.15.motu: Bena Iohanan Karea ese Gedalia e hereva henia hehuni Mispa ai, eto, Mani ainala, Ismael Netania baina alaia mase, bena tau ta basine diba. Anina be dahaka ia ese oi baine alamu mase, bena Iuda taudia oi dekemu ai vada e hebou na bae heau karoho, bena Iuda kwabukwabudia bae mase ore?
JER.40.15.english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

JER.32.11.motu: Bena hari tano ibiaguna pepana, e koua kunuka-kunuka ḡauna, bona ia ida-idana pepana ta, e hulala ḡauna, na abidia;
JER.32.11.english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

JER.11.4.motu: Taravatuna binai senemui na haḡanilaidia, Aigupto tanona, auri amuna, amo na hakaudia lasi negana ai, nato, Lau gadogu ba kamonai, bona na haḡanilaimuimu karadia iboudiai na ba. kara, unu amo umui na egu bese ai baola bona lau na emui Dirava ai bainala;
JER.11.4.english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

JER.19.5.motu: bona Baal ena atai gabudia vada e larebadia, natudia mamaruanedia na lahi ai bae haḡoledia, Baal ena gole oho boubou ḡaudia ai bae halaodia, totona; a lau ese una kara asina haheḡanilaia eiava asina hahedualaia, bona asina laloa davari.
JER.19.5.english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

JER.33.16.motu: Unu dinadia ai Iuda na baine mauri, bona Ierusalem baine noho namonamo. Bona ladana na ini bae hatoa toma: “Iehova na eda kara maoromaoro”.
JER.33.16.english: In those days Judah will be saved,

JER.37.9.motu: Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Sibomui basio hekoi, basioto “Kaldea taudia na momokani dauhai bae noho”; badina be idia na dauhai basie noho.
JER.37.9.english: “Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.

JER.2.23.motu: Ba hereva diba a, baoto “Lau na asina miro,
JER.2.23.english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled.

JER.7.34.motu: Bena Iuda hanuadia bona Ierusalem ariaradia lalodiai lau ese kiri bona moale reḡedia baina hadokodia, bona headava matamata tauna bona hahinena gadodia danu; badina be tano na baine mia ḡaḡae.
JER.7.34.english: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”

JER.37.4.motu: Una negana ai Ieremia na dounu taunimanima bogaragidiai e raka vareaiva e raka lasiva; badina be dibura rumana ai do asie koua.
JER.37.4.english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

JER.17.22.motu: bona Dina Helaga ai maduna ta na emui ruma amo basio huaia lasi. A Dina Helaḡa na ba hahelaḡaia, lau ese senemui na haḡanilaidia heḡereḡerena.
JER.17.22.english: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

JER.29.11.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Badina be egu lalo-hata ḡaudia emui ai na dibagu, ihanamomui ḡaudia, dia ihadikamui ḡaudia, nega vaira ḡaudia bona helaro ḡaudia.
JER.29.11.english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

JER.44.25.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Umui bona adavamui ese udumui amo vada o gwauraia bona imamui amo vada o karadia, oto “Ai na momokani emai gwauhamata karadia baia kara, guba pavapavana hahinena ena muramura mai bonaula baia gabua bona inuinu bouboudia baia bubu nege”. Benaini, emui gwauhamata ba hamomokanidia bona karadia ba kara.
JER.44.25.english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.”

JER.50.33.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Israel taudia na e hahisidiamu, bona Iuda taudia danu idia ida; e abidia mauri taudia iboudiai ese vada e dogodia tao tarika-tarika, ikahu-riegedia asie uramu.
JER.50.33.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together.

JER.51.6.english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon!

JER.29.29.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Sefania ese una revareva na peroveta tauna Ieremia vairanai e duahia.
JER.29.29.english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.

JER.52.11.motu: Ia ese danu Sedekia matana e hakepuludia, auri gadeadia amo e ḡuia. Bena Babulono pavapavana ese Babulono e laohaia, unuseni ai dibura rumana ai e koua ela bona ena mase dinana.
JER.52.11.english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

JER.15.3.motu: Iehova ma e tomu: Lau ese hahebua-tari ḡaudia hani baina duanaidia, bae biagudia: dare, iala-masedia totona; sisia, idaredia totona; bona atai manudia bona uda boromadia, iani-oredia bona ihabua-taridia totona.
JER.15.3.english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says Yahweh: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

JER.27.14.motu: Hari peroveta taudia, e tomu “Babulono pavapavana isiaina basio lao heni” taudia, na edia hereva basio kamonai; badina be idia ese koikoi herevana e perovetalai henimuimu.
JER.27.14.english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

JER.36.20.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese pepa na toretore tauna Elisama ena daiutu ai e atoa, bena hanua pavapavana ena maḡu lalonai e raka vareai, unu hereva iboudiai na hanua pavapavana e hamaorolaia.
JER.36.20.english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

JER.5.2.motu: Ena be e tomamu “Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena”,
JER.5.2.english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

JER.52.16.motu: A Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese ogoḡami dikadika taudia haida e rakatanidia, vine imeadia ireḡudia bona tano iruana taudia ai baela.
JER.52.16.english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

JER.29.25.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu; Revareva na oi sibomu ladamu ai vada o siai lao, Ierusalem ai e nohomu taudia iboudhi ediai, bona Sefania Maaseia, hahelaḡa tauna, enai, bona hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai ediai, oto:
JER.29.25.english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

JER.14.21.english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake.

JER.10.24.motu: Iehova e, egu kerere dodinai mo matagu ba hakania,

JER.10.19.english: Woe is me because of my injury!

JER.48.25.motu: Moab ena doa vada e utua oho, bona imana vada e kwaidu. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.48.25.english: The horn of Moab is cut off,

JER.25.18.motu: Ierusalem bona Iuda hanuadia, bona pavapavana bona lohiana iboudiai danu; idia na gabu ḡaḡaena bona e vahu gabuna ai bona si-dagu bona heuduguirai ḡauna ai baela, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena;
JER.25.18.english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

JER.30.7.motu: Madi, una dina na bada herea,
JER.30.7.english: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it!

JER.39.6.motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese Sedekia natuna mamaruanedia na ia vairanai e aladia mase, Ribla ai; Babulono pavapavana ese danu Iuda lohiadia iboudiai e aladia mase.
JER.39.6.english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

JER.50.45.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena lalo-hadai, Babulono ihadikana totona vada e haeroa, bona ena ura, Kaldea taudia edia tano ihadikana totona vada e laloa, na ba kamonai. Momokani, mamoe maraḡidia na edia mamoe serina amo bae dabuidia lao; momokani, edia magu mamoedia na bae gari taku, ediai vada e vara ḡauna dainai.
JER.50.45.english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh

JER.52.21.motu: Hari au-tubuadia ta ena lata na kiubit gwauta-taurahani; ena kuboro-heḡeḡe na kiubit gwauta-rua; kopina udunana na ima-kwakikwaki hani e haheboudia udunana heḡereḡerena; ia na auri kuborona lalona kohua.
JER.52.21.english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

JER.48.19.english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch.

JER.48.13.motu: Bena Moab ese Kemoso hemaraina baine hemarai, Israel iduhuna ese Betele, edia heabidadama, hemaraina e hemaraiva heḡereḡerena.
JER.48.13.english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh,

JER.3.18.motu: Unu dinadia ai Iuda besena na Israel besena ida bae tami hebou, bona mirigini tanona amo baema bou, senemui na henidia tanona na ma bae mai henia.
JER.3.18.english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

JER.35.18.motu: A Rekab iduhuna taudia na Ieremia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be senemui Ionadab ena haheḡani vada o badinaia, bona ena hahediba herevadia iboudiai vada o badinadia, bona e haganilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara,
JER.35.18.english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’

JER.4.4.motu: Iuda taumui bona Ierusalem inoholaina taumui e,
JER.4.4.english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

JER.26.7.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai na e kamonai, Ieremia ese unu hereva e gwaurai, Iehova ena dubu lalonai.
JER.26.7.english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in Yahweh’s house.

JER.51.23.motu: oiemu amo mamoe ireḡudia tauna mai ena mamoe serina ida baina huaridia patapata;
JER.51.23.english: With you I will break in pieces

JER.28.17.motu: Una laḡani lalonai, hua ihahituna ai, peroveta tauna Hanarua na e mase.
JER.28.17.english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

JER.29.8.motu: Badirla be Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui peroveta taudia bona emui bagu-haoro taudia bogaragimui ai e nohomu ese basie koimui, bona edia nihi sivaraidia basio kamonai;
JER.29.8.english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

JER.8.8.english: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us”?

JER.25.8.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hereva asio abidia dae dainai,
JER.25.8.english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

JER.18.20.english: Should evil be recompensed for good?

JER.20.6.motu: Bona oi Pasahuru, bona emu ruma inoholaina taudia iboudiai, na bae ḡuimui, oi bona turamu iboudiai, ediai vada o peroveta koikoi taudia, Babulono do baola, unuseni ai ba mase, unuseni ai bae gurimui.
JER.20.6.english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

JER.1.14.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Mirigini kahana amo dika baine daidaia dobi, ina tano e noholaiamu taudia iboudiai latadiai.
JER.1.14.english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

JER.26.3.motu: Readia bae kamonai, bona iboudiai ese ta ta ena dala dikana ena dala dikana bae rakatani; bena unu amo lau baina helalo kerehai, bona ihadikadia karana, edia kara dikadia daidiai vada na laloa hata ḡauna, na basina karaia.
JER.26.3.english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”

JER.19.11.motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina bese bona ina hanua na unu baina hamakohidia toma, uro ikarana tauna ena hoduhodu e hamakohiamu, asi ibanina, na heto. Mase taudia na Tofete ai bae guridia, badina be asi iguridia gabuna idauna ta.
JER.19.11.english: and shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

JER.30.21.english: Their prince will be one of them,

JER.38.20.motu: Ieremia eto, Idia imadia ai basie atomu. Iehova gadona hari na hamaorolaimumu na ba badinaia, bena ba namo, emu mauri na basie abia oho.
JER.38.20.english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.

JER.33.9.motu: Bena ina hanua na egu ai lada mai moalena, heimodai ḡauna bona hairai ḡauna ai bainela, tanobada besedia iboudiai vairadiai. Idia ese kara namo iboudiai, lau ese na kara henidiamu karadia, sivaraidia bae kamonai; idia na bae gari, taudia bae heude-heude, kara namo iboudiai bona noho-namo idoinai ina hanua baina karalai henia dainai.
JER.33.9.english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

JER.50.13.motu: Iehova ena badu dainai ta ese basine noholaia,
JER.50.13.english: Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited,

JER.51.5.motu: Badina be Israel bona Iuda edia Dirava,
JER.51.5.english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God,

JER.36.15.motu: Idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A helai diho, ba duahia. Taunabunai, Baruku ese e duahi henidia.
JER.36.15.english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.”

JER.48.42.motu: Moab na bae habuaia tari, basie gwauraia lou bese ta;
JER.48.42.english: Moab will be destroyed from being a people,

JER.51.55.motu: Badina be Iehova ese Babulono e havahuanu,

JER.22.1.motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ba diho lao, Iuda pavapavana ena ruma baola, unuseni ai ina hereva ba gwauraia,
JER.22.1.english: Yahweh said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:

JER.51.56.motu: badina be hahebua-tari tauna na Babulono enai vada e kau,
JER.51.56.english: For the destroyer has come on her,

JER.35.17.motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, hahedika Iuda bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia iboudiai latadiai vada na gwaurai ḡauna na ediai baina havaraia; badina be vada na hereva henidia to asie kamonai, vada na boi henidia to asie haere.
JER.35.17.english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”

JER.1.13.motu: Iehova ena hereva na nega iharuana ai egu ai e kau, eto, Dahaka o itaiamu? Bena lau nato, E daidaimu urona na itaiamu, bona lahi ihahemetaina na mirigini kahana ai.
JER.1.13.english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?”

JER.48.34.motu: Hesebon bona Eleale e taimu; gadodia e daemu ela bona Iahasa, bona Soara amo ela bona Horonaimi bona Eglata-selisia. Badina be Nimirimi ranudia vada e kororo.
JER.48.34.english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh,

JER.34.15.motu: Vanegai mo umui na o helalo kerehai, bena kara maoromaorona na lau vairagu ai vada o karaia, hekahu-nege o gwaurai hedinarai, ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ediai; bona lau vairagu ai o gwau hamata, lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna lalonai.
JER.34.15.english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;

JER.9.4.motu: Ta ta ese dekena tauna dekena tauna nahuadia bae toho,

JER.1.2.motu: Iehova ena hereva na ia dekenai e kau, Iosia Amon, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-toina lalonai;
JER.1.2.english: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

JER.23.7.motu: Iehova na e tomu, Taunabunai, negana vada e maimu, taunimanima na basie hereva lou, basieto “Iehova, Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena”,
JER.23.7.english: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

JER.21.5.motu: Lau sibogu ese baina tuari henumui mai imagu hetoi-rorona bona imagu goadana ida, badu ai bona daḡedaḡe ai bona badu-garagara bada-hereana ai.
JER.21.5.english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

JER.3.4.motu: Ina harihari vada o boi henigu, ani,
JER.3.4.english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

JER.27.2.motu: Iehova ese ini e hamaorogu toma, eto: Boromakau kopidia varodia bona boromakau madunadia ba kara, sibomu aiomu ai bavato.
JER.27.2.english: Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.

JER.9.7.motu: Taunabunai Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu:

JER.36.32.motu: Bena Ieremia ese pepa ta ma e abia, itorena tauna Baruku Neria e henia; bena Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, ese lahi ai e doua pepana herevadia iboudiai na Ieremia ese ma e gwaurai bona Baruku ese ma e tore; bona hereva unuhetomadia momo na idia latadiai ma e tore kau.
JER.36.32.english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.

JER.42.8.motu: Bena ia ese Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai, ia ida e nohova taudia, bona taunimanima iboudiai, asi dagidia bona mai dagibadadia taudia, na e boiridia, e hereva henidia,
JER.42.8.english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

JER.2.27.motu: Badina be idia ese au ta e hereva heniamu, e tomu
JER.2.27.english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’

JER.51.50.motu: Umui dare amo vada o roho mauri taumui e,
JER.51.50.english: You who have escaped the sword, go!

JER.38.15.motu: Ieremia ese Sedekia e haere henia, eto, Bama hamaoromu bena boma alagu mase ani? Bona bama hahealo henimu bena basioma kamonai henigu.
JER.38.15.english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”

JER.22.10.motu: Mase tauna basio tailaia bona basio lalo-hisihisilaia,

JER.15.1.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ena be Mose bona Samuel na vairagu ai bema gini, to lalogu basinema heḡereḡere ina bese taudia bama hageredia. Vairagu amo ba siaidia oho, ba kahudia nege!
JER.15.1.english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!

JER.6.18.english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

JER.4.31.motu: Badina be taitai ta na kamonai,
JER.4.31.english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

JER.48.28.english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock.

JER.4.22.motu: Badina be egu bese taudia na kakavakava,
JER.4.22.english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

JER.13.26.motu: Lau sibogu ese vairamu ramina baina abia isi,
JER.13.26.english: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face,

JER.33.24.motu: Ini taunimanima edia hereva so kamonai, eto “Iehova ese e abidia hidi iduhudia ruaosi vada e dadaraidia”, a? Unuheto, idia ese egu bese taudia vada e dadaraidia, bena harihari idia na dia bese ta idia vairadiai.
JER.33.24.english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”

JER.23.33.motu: Ina bese taudia ta, eiava peroveta tauna ta, eiava hahelaḡa tauna ta, ese baine nanadaimu, baineto “Iehova ena maduna be dahaka?”, negana ai oi na ba haere henia, baoto “Iehova na e tomu, Maduna na umui, bona baina negemui daure”.
JER.23.33.english: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says Yahweh.’

JER.12.17.motu: A bese ta basinema kamonai, bena lau ese baina dabuia lasi vaitani bona baina habuaia tari. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.12.17.english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says Yahweh.

JER.17.6.motu: Ia na au rabatarina tano kaukauna ai na heto;
JER.17.6.english: For he will be like a bush in the desert,

JER.6.22.english: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

JER.37.18.motu: Ieremia eto, Oibe. Ma eto, Babulono pavapavana imana ai bae atomu. Ieremia ese danu King Sedekia e hamaoroa, eto, Oi eiava emu hesiai taudia eiava ina bese taudia na ede vada na hadikamui toma dainai dibura rumana ai vada o kougu?
JER.37.18.english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

JER.49.21.motu: Edia moru reḡena dainai tanobada na baine heude-heude; edia tai reḡena na Davara Kakakakana isena ai bae kamonai.
JER.49.21.english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall;

JER.4.11.motu: Una negana ai ta ese ina bese bona Ierusalem hanuana baine hamaorodia, baineto, Lai siahuna na tano ḡaḡaena ororodia nemuka-nemukadia amo e maimu, egu bese natuna hahinena e toa heniamu, dia itapona eiava ihaḡoevana totona.
JER.4.11.english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

JER.2.25.motu: Aemu ba nari, asi tamakamu basio raka;

JER.13.18.motu: Hanua pavapavana mai sinana ida ba hamaorodia,
JER.13.18.english: Say to the king and to the queen mother,

JER.52.27.motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese e rahudia mamase, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai, e aladia mase. Taunabunai, Iuda taudia na e ḡuidia, edia tano amo e abidia oho, dauha e laohaidia.
JER.52.27.english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath.

JER.19.13.motu: Bena Ierusalem taudia edia ruma bona Iuda pavapavana hahidaosi edia ruma, guhidia ai muramura mai bonadia e gabu, dina bona hua bona hisiu iboudiai ediai, bona inuinu bouboudia e bubu, dirava idaudia ediai, rumadia na bae hamirodia, gabu ladana Tofete heḡereḡerena.
JER.19.13.english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

JER.31.1.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una negana ai, lau na Israel iduhudia iboudiai edia Dirava ai bainala, bona idia na lauegu bese taudia ai baela.
JER.31.1.english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

JER.32.41.motu: Idia ihanamodia karadia baina moalelaidia, bona heabidadama ai ina tano ai baina hadaidia, mai lalogu idoinai bona mai laumagu idoinai ida.
JER.32.41.english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

JER.49.29.motu: Edia dabua kalagadia bona edia mamoe seridia bae heabi oho,
JER.49.29.english: They will take their tents and their flocks.

JER.17.4.motu: Imamu na ahumu, na henimu ḡauna, amo do bavabia oho, bena baina siaimu, asi dibamu tanona ai inaimu isiaidia ba lao heni; badina be egu badu ai lahi ta vada e ara, bona baine ara hanaihanai.
JER.17.4.english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you.

JER.26.1.motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, e lohia matama negana ai, ina hereva na Iehova ena amo ema.
JER.26.1.english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from Yahweh:

JER.44.28.motu: Bena dare amo bae roho mauri taudia na Aigupto tanona amo bae lou lao, Iuda tanona baela, a gadoidia mo; bona Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia iboudiai, Aigupto tanona ema bena e noholaia taudia iboudiai, na bae diba daika ena hereva baine gini, lauegu eiava idia edia.
JER.44.28.english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

JER.51.57.motu: Ena lohia taudia bona ena aonega taudia baina hakekerodia,
JER.51.57.english: I will make her princes, her wise men,

JER.18.13.motu: Taunabunai Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu:

JER.29.3.motu: Ina revareva na Elasa Safana bona Gemaria Hilkia, Iuda pavapavana Sedekia ese Babulono e siaidia lao Babulono pavapavana Nebukadnesara dekenai taudia, imadia ai e siaia lao. Ini e torea toma:
JER.29.3.english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

JER.28.6.motu: Peroveta tauna Ieremia eto, Amen! Iehova unu baine kara toma baine namo. Iehova ese oiemu peroveta herevadia baine hamomokanidia, Iehova ena dubu kohudia iboudiai bona abi-mauri taudia danu na Babulono amo baine loulaidia ema bona ina gabu, una na baine namo.
JER.28.6.english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.

JER.31.17.motu: Nega vairai emu helaro ḡaudia bavabi (Iehova na e herevamu),
JER.31.17.english: There is hope for your latter end,” says Yahweh.

JER.30.10.english: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh.

JER.30.23.motu: A itaia, Iehova ena lai gubana!
JER.30.23.english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out,

JER.31.18.motu: Efraim ena ḡanaḡana vada na kamonai, eto
JER.31.18.english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus,

JER.39.4.motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona tuari taudia iboudiai ese e itadia negana ai, idia na e heau; hanuaboi ai hanua e rakatania pavapava ena uma-uma bogaragina amo, bena magu ruaosi padadia ikoukouna amo e raka lasi, Araba dalana ai ela.
JER.39.4.english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

JER.2.18.motu: Harihari Nilo sinavaina ranuna i'inuna totona Aigupto o laomu
JER.2.18.english: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor?

JER.30.20.motu: Natudia na bae noho, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia,
JER.30.20.english: Their children also will be as before,

JER.37.13.motu: Ia na Beniamina Ikoukouna ai, bena hegima tauna ta, ladana Iria, Selemia Hanania natuna, ese peroveta tauna Ieremia e dabaia tao, eto, Oi na Kaldea taudia ediai bo hanaimu.
JER.37.13.english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”

JER.4.13.motu: A itaia, ia na duba na heheto e tubu e maimu,
JER.4.13.english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

JER.15.17.motu: E moale hebouva taudia bogaragidiai asina helai,
JER.15.17.english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice.

JER.31.14.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia lalodia na ḡau namodia amo baina ubudia badabada,
JER.31.14.english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness,

JER.4.18.motu: Emu dala bona emu kara ese
JER.4.18.english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

JER.32.34.motu: Edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia na e haginidia, lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna lalonai, bae hamiroa totona.
JER.32.34.english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

JER.42.16.motu: bena o garilaiamu darena ese unuseni ai, Aigupto tanona ai, baina lasimui tao, bona o garilaiamu doena ese baine gavamui havara-havara ela bona Aigupto; bena unuseni ai ba mase.
JER.42.16.english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.

JER.27.8.motu: A bese ta eiava basileia ta ese hari Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, isiaina basinema lao heni, bona aiona na Babulono pavapavana ena maduna henunai basinema atoa, bena lau ese una bese davana baina henia, dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo, ela bona hari pavapava imana amo baina ha-orea. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.27.8.english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says Yahweh, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

JER.44.23.motu: Muramura mai bonadia o gabu dainai, bona Iehova o kara dika henia bona Iehova gadona asio badinaia bona ena taravatu bona ena hahedua herevadia bona ena haheḡani lalodiai asio raka dainai, ina dika na latamui ai vada e kau, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena.
JER.44.23.english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”

JER.7.8.motu: A itaia, umui ese hedibaḡani herevadia o abidadama henidiamu na asi anina.
JER.7.8.english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

JER.39.5.motu: A Kaldea tuari oreana ese e hahavadia; bena idia ese Sedekia e lasia tao Ieriko taoradia ai. E abia mauri, bena Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, dekena e laohaia, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai; bena ia ese ena kerere ahuna e gwauraia.
JER.39.5.english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

JER.12.10.motu: Mamoe ireḡudia taudia hutuma ese egu vine imeana vada e habuaia tari,
JER.12.10.english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard.

JER.33.13.motu: Ororo kahadia hanuadia ai bona taora hanuadia ai bona diho kahana hanuadia ai, bona Beniamina tanona ai bona Ierusalem hetabirana gabudia ai, bona Iuda hanuadia ai, mamoe seridia na iduahidia tauna imana henudia amo bae raka hanai. Iehova na e herevamu.
JER.33.13.english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says Yahweh.

JER.14.18.motu: Tano paka ai bama raka lasi,
JER.14.18.english: If I go out into the field,

JER.39.16.motu: Aola, Ebede-melek, tau Etiopia, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu hereva baina hamomokanidia, ina hanua ihadikana ai, baina hadikaia, basina hanamoa. Una dina ai egu hereva anidia do bae vara oi vairamu ai.
JER.39.16.english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

JER.2.30.motu: Natumui vada na hahisidia na asi anina,
JER.2.30.english: “I have struck your children in vain.

JER.8.10.motu: Taunabunai lau ese adavadia na haida baina henidia,
JER.8.10.english: Therefore I will give their wives to others

JER.41.18.motu: Kaldea taudia daidiai; badina be e gari henidia, badina be Gedalia Ahikama, Babulono pavapavana ese tano ikwarana tauna ai e halaoa tauna, na Ismael Netania ese vada e alaia mase.
JER.41.18.english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

JER.47.4.motu: badina be hahebua-tari dinana na e maimu,
JER.47.4.english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines,

JER.52.19.motu: bona bia bona gida keberedia bona dihu bona uro, bona lamepa patadia, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia, bona udu-ahudia keheredia. Gold ḡaudia bona silver ḡaudia na hari hegima oreana biaguna ese e laohai.
JER.52.19.english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

JER.19.12.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Lau ese ina gabu mai inoholaina taudia ida na unu baina karadia toma; ina hanua na Tofete heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa.
JER.19.12.english: This is what I will do to this place,” says Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.

JER.23.2.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese egu bese e reḡuamu taudia na ini e herevalaidia tomamu: Egu seri vada o hakarohodia rohoroho, vada o luludia oho, asio regudia. Iehova na e tomu, A itaia, lau ese emui kara dika davadia do baina henimui.
JER.23.2.english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says Yahweh.

JER.6.24.motu: Ita ese harina vada ta kamonai,
JER.6.24.english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

JER.9.1.english: Oh that my head were waters,

JER.9.20.motu: Hahine e! Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai,
JER.9.20.english: Yet hear Yahweh’s word, you women.

JER.26.8.motu: Iehova ese e haganilaia taunimanima iboudiai baine hamaorolaidia herevadia na Ieremia ese e gwaurai ore; bena hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai ese e dabaia tao, eto, Oi na ba mase.
JER.26.8.english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!

JER.36.3.motu: Readia Iuda iduhuna taudia na ihadikadia karadia iboudiai vada na lalo hata baina kara henidia nato herevadia bae kamonai, bena una dainai iboudiai ese edia dala dikadia bae rakatani, bena lau ese edia kara havara bona edia kara dika baina gwau tao.
JER.36.3.english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

JER.38.28.motu: Bena Ieremia na hegima taudia edia maḡu ai e nohova, ela-bona Ierusalem e abia dinana.

JER.23.8.motu: a baeto “Iehova, Israel garana na mirigini kahana tanona bona e luludia lao tanodia iboudiai lalodia amo e hakaudia lou mai Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena”. Bena idia na edia tano korikori ai bae noho.
JER.23.8.english: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”

JER.26.24.motu: A Ahikama Safana imana ese Ieremia e rauaia, una dainai hanua audia imadia ai asie atoa, bena asie alaia mase.

JER.26.6.motu: bena ina dubu na Silo heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa, bona ina hanua na heuduguirai ḡauna ai baina halaoa, tanobada besedia iboudiai ediai.

JER.17.14.motu: Iehova e, ba hanamogu, bena do baina namo;

JER.44.12.english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.
