JER.46.1.english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

JER.42.11.motu: Babulono pavapavana, o gari heniamu tauna, na garina basio gari. Iehova na e tomu, Basio gari henia, badina be lau na umui ida, baina hamaurimui bona ia imana amo baina harohomui mauri totona.
JER.42.11.english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says Yahweh, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

JER.4.7.motu: Leona na uda hedoma-hedomana vada e rakatania,
JER.4.7.english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

JER.37.10.motu: Badina be, ena be Kaldea taudia, e tuari henimuimu taudia, edia tuari oreana idoinai boma hadarerea, bona mai berodia taudia sibodia bema noho, ta ta ena kalaga ena kalaga ai, to idia na ben a tore isi, bena ina hanua na lahi ai bema doua.
JER.37.10.english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”

JER.41.6.motu: Bena Ismael Netania na Mispa amo e raka lasi mai taina ida, idia ihedavari-henidia totona. Idia ida e hedavari negana ai, ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Gedalia Ahikama dekenai ba raka vareai.
JER.41.6.english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”

JER.1.11.motu: Iehova ena hereva egu ai ma e kau, eto, Ieremia e, dahaka o itaiamu! Bena lau nato, Sakada auna rigina ta na itaiamu.
JER.1.11.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?”

JER.39.1.motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahani-tana huana ihagvautana lalonai, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, bona ena tuari oreana idoinai ese Ierusalem e daea bona e koua heḡeḡe;
JER.39.1.english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

JER.3.7.motu: Bena lau nato “Ina idoinai baine ha-orea murinai ia ese baine lou henigu”; a ia na se lou mai, tadikakana koikoina Iuda ese karana e itaia.
JER.3.7.english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

JER.5.30.motu: Hoa bada bona gari bada ḡauna ta na
JER.5.30.english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

JER.15.5.motu: Ierusalem e, daika ese baine bogamu hisi?
JER.15.5.english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem?

JER.41.14.motu: Taunabunai, Ismael ese e abidia mauri Mispa amo e laohaidia taudia iboudiai na e raka lou, Iohanan Karea dekena e lou lao.
JER.41.14.english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

JER.26.19.motu: Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona Iuda idoinai ese e alaia mase a? Ia ese Iehova garina e gari bona Iehova e noia baine lalo namo henia, ani? Bena Iehova na e helalo kerehai, dika idia latadiai vada e gwauraia na se havaraia, ani? A ita ese dika badana na ita siboda latadai baita hadihoamu.
JER.26.19.english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

JER.16.14.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Taunabunai ba itaia, dinadia na e maimu, taunimanima na basie hereva lou, basieto “Iehova; Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena”,
JER.16.14.english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that it will no more be said, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

JER.3.17.motu: Una negana ai Ierusalem na bae gwauraia Iehova ena terono; bona bese iboudiai na ienai bae hebou Iehova vairanai, Ierusalem ai; bona sibodia edia lalo-hadai dikadia iḡavadia ai basie hetoahu.
JER.3.17.english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

JER.22.14.motu: Ia na e tomu “Egu ruma badana auta baina haginia
JER.22.14.english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’

JER.32.26.motu: Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto:
JER.32.26.english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

JER.7.25.motu: Senemui na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi dinana amo ema bona ina dina, lau ese peroveta taudia, egu hesiai taudia, iboudiai na dina ta ta ai idia dekedia na siaidiava, asina hesiku;
JER.7.25.english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

JER.30.15.english: Why do you cry over your injury?

JER.51.60.motu: Ieremia ese dika idoinai Babulono latanai baine kau herevadia na buka ta ai e tore.
JER.51.60.english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

JER.9.12.motu: Daika ena aonega na bada, bena ina na dibana? Iehova uduna ese daika vada e hereva henia, bena ia ese baine gwauraia? Badina be dahaka tano vada e hebua tari bona vada e vahu, tano ḡaḡaena na heto, bena tau ta ese se rakaia hanaimu?
JER.9.12.english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?

JER.33.3.motu: Ba boi henigu, bena baina haere henimu, bona ḡau badadia, hehuni ḡaudia, do asi dibamu ḡaudia, na baina hamaorolaimu.
JER.33.3.english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

JER.41.4.motu: Gedalia iroromana dinana murina dinana ai, tau ta ese sivaraina do se kamonai negana ai,
JER.41.4.english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

JER.41.12.motu: idia ese edia orea taudia iboudiai e abidia, Ismael Netania ituari-henina ela; bena gohu badana Gibeon ai badibadinai e lasia tao.
JER.41.12.english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

JER.17.25.motu: bena pavapava haida, David ena terono ai e helaimu taudia, na ina hanua ikoukoudia amo bae heau vareai, kariota ai bona hosi latadiai, idia bona edia lohia taudia, Iuda taudia bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia; bena ina hanua na bae noholaia hanaihanai.
JER.17.25.english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.

JER.31.38.motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, nega na e maimu, hanua na bae haginia lou, Iehova ena, Hananele kohorona amo ela bona Daiguni Ikoukouna.
JER.31.38.english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

JER.24.9.motu: Lau ese hahegari ḡauna ai baina halaodia, tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ediai; idia na gvau-tora bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai bona hegonagonalai bona heuduguirai ḡaudia ai baela, baina luludia lao gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
JER.24.9.english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

JER.17.18.motu: E hahisihisigumu taudia na bae hahemaraidia,
JER.17.18.english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me,

JER.51.13.motu: Umui, sinavai momo badibadidiai o nohomu taumui e!
JER.51.13.english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures,

JER.27.9.motu: Una dainai, emui peroveta taudia eiava emui mari-abi taudia eiava emui nihi taudia eiava emui rohe taudia eiava emui mea taudia ese bema hamaoromui, bema toma “Babulono pavapavana isiaina basio lao heni”, umui ese basioma kamonai henidia.
JER.27.9.english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”

JER.2.11.motu: Bese ta, ena be edia dirava na dia momomokakani,
JER.2.11.english: Has a nation changed its gods,

JER.26.23.motu: Bena idia ese Uria na Aigupto amo e hakaua mai, King Iehoiakim dekenai; bena ia ese dare amo e alaia mase, bena tau-anina na hanua taudia edia gara gabuna ai e negea.
JER.26.23.english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

JER.18.14.motu: Lebanon snow-dia na Sirion hagadia amo e veve ohomu a?
JER.18.14.english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field?

JER.43.5.motu: A Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai ese Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia iboudiai, bese idau-idau iboudiai bogaragidiai e luludia lao bena ma e lou, Iuda tanona ai ma e nohova, taudia, na e abidia:
JER.43.5.english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

JER.52.7.motu: Una negana ai, hanua maguna e hamaurua. Ena be Kaldea taudia na hanua vada e koua heḡeḡe, to tuari taudia iboudiai na hanuaboi ai e heau, magu ruaosi padadia ikoukouna amo, hanua pavapavana ena uma-uma badibadinai; bena Araba kahana ela.
JER.52.7.english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

JER.3.2.motu: Ba gaga isi, ororo nemuka-nemukadia ba itadia!
JER.3.2.english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

JER.3.1.english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says Yahweh.

JER.50.18.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, Babulono pava- ! pavana bona ena tano na edia dika davadia ba henidiamu, Asuria pavapavana ena dika davana na henia heḡereḡerena.
JER.50.18.english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says:

JER.7.9.motu: Ba henao, ba roroma, ba heuda hanai, ba gwauhamata koikoi, muramura mai bonana ba gabua Baal enai, bona asio dibadia guna diravadia ba ḡavadia;
JER.7.9.english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

JER.34.1.motu: A Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, bona ena tuari oreana idoinai, bona tanobada basileiadia iboudiai, iena siahu henunai e nohova oreadia, bona bese idau-idau iboudiai, ese Ierusalem mai ena hanua iboudiai ida e tuari henidiava negana ai, Iehova ena hereva ta na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
JER.34.1.english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

JER.38.16.motu: Bena King Sedekia ese Ieremia e gwau henia hamata hehuni, eto, Iehova, laumada e karadia Diravana, na e maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau ese basina alamu mase eiava emu mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai basina atomu.
JER.38.16.english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As Yahweh lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”

JER.40.12.motu: bena Iuda taudia iboudiai na vada e luludia lao gabudia iboudiai amo ma e lou mai, Iuda tanona ema, Gedalia dekenai, Mispa ai. Bena idia ese vine ranuna bona au-huahua momo herea e habou.
JER.40.12.english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

JER.3.23.english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.

JER.37.3.motu: King Sedekia ese Iehukala Selemia bona hahelaḡa tauna Sefania Maaseia na peroveta tauna Ieremia dekena e siaidia lao, eto, Iehova, eda Dirava, na ai daimai ai ba ḡuria.
JER.37.3.english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.”

JER.46.7.motu: Ina be daika, Nilo sinavaina na heto e daemu,
JER.46.7.english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile,

JER.34.14.motu: “Laḡani tauratoi dokodia ai, iboumui ai ese tadikakamui Heberu taudia vada o hoidia bena laḡani tauratoi lalodiai isiaimui vada e lao heni taudia, vada ba ruhadia nege; isiaimui ilao-henina amo ba ruhadia nege”. A senemui ese asie kamonai henigu bona asie hakala henigu.
JER.34.14.english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.

JER.43.11.motu: Ia na bainema, Aigupto tanona baine havahuraia, dai-hanai gorerena enai vada e revadia taudia na dai-hanai gorerena amo baine hamasedia, bona abi-mauri enai vada e revadia taudia na abi-mauri ai baine siaidia lao, bona dare enai vada e revadia taudia na dare amo baine aladia mase.
JER.43.11.english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

JER.52.12.motu: Hua iha-imana dinana ihahituna ai (una na King Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahani-tana ai), Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, Babulono pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, na Ierusalem ai e raka vareai.
JER.52.12.english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

JER.33.5.motu: Kaldea taudia na e aru e maimu, bae tuari henidia, bona egu badu bona egu lalo-siahu ai baina rahudh mase taudia tau-anidia masedia amo bae hahonudia; badina be lau ese vairagu na ina hanua amo vada na hunia, edia kara dikadia iboudiai daidiai.
JER.33.5.english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,

JER.22.21.motu: Emu noho namo ai na hereva henimu,
JER.22.21.english: I spoke to you in your prosperity,

JER.2.7.motu: Lau ese aniani momo tanona lalonai na hakaumui vareai,
JER.2.7.english: I brought you into a plentiful land

JER.7.11.motu: Ina lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna na emui ita-ita ai dadidadi taudia edia kohua ai vada ela a? Iehova na e tomu, Lau sibogu ese vada na itaia.
JER.7.11.english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.

JER.34.22.motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, lau baina haheḡani, bena ma baina loulaidia mai, ina hanua ma baema; bena idia ese bae tuari henia, bae abia, lahi amo bae doua. Iuda hanuadia na baina havahudia, asi unoholaidia bae mia.
JER.34.22.english: Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

JER.44.14.motu: taunabunai, Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia Aigupto tanona inoholaina totona; ema taudia, na ta basine heau mauri eiava basine roho mauri eiava Iuda tanona, harihari e uramu bae lou henia, na basine lou lao; badina be basie lou lao, a heau mauri taudia ta ta mo.
JER.44.14.english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”

JER.17.26.motu: Bena taunimanima na Iuda hanuadia bona Ierusalem hegegemadaina hanuadia bona Beniamina tanona bona taora tanodia bona ororo tanodia bona diho kahana tanodia amo baema, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia bona boubou idau-idau ḡaudia bona naoa boubou ḡaudia bona muramura mai bonadia na bae mailai, bona hahenamo herahiadia danu bae mailai, Iehova ena dubu lalonai bae vareailai.
JER.17.26.english: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to Yahweh’s house.

JER.1.16.motu: Bona egu hahemaoro herevadia na idia latadiai baina gwaurai, edia kara dika iboudiai ikaradia ai e rakatanigu dainai. Idia ese muramura mai bonadia vada e gabu, dirava idaudia ediai, bona idia sibodia imadia amo e kara ḡaudia vada e toma henidia diho.
JER.1.16.english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness,

JER.48.29.motu: Moab ena heaḡi sivaraina vada ta kamonai;
JER.48.29.english: “We have heard of the pride of Moab.

JER.51.14.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ia sibona ladana ai vada e gwau hamata, eto:
JER.51.14.english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying,

JER.19.1.motu: Iehova ini e gwau toma: Aola, uro ikarana tauna ena hoduhodu ta ba hoia, bena hanua taubadadia haida bona hahelaḡa taudia badadia haida na bavabidia;
JER.19.1.english: Thus said Yahweh, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;

JER.52.31.motu: Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, ena iḡui ai e nohova laḡanina ihatoiahuihituna ai, hua ihagwauta-ruana dinana iharuahui-imana ai, Evil-merodak, Babulono pavapavana, e lohia matama. Bena ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai ia ese Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, e hagagaia isi, dibura rumana amo e hakaua lasi;
JER.52.31.english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

JER.26.22.motu: Bena King Iehoiakim ese tatau haida na Aigupto e siaidia lao; taudia be Elnatan Akaboro bona haida ia ida.
JER.26.22.english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.

JER.48.14.motu: Dahaka dainai o tomu “Ai na haheauka taumai
JER.48.14.english: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men,

JER.50.31.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova Sabaota na e tomu:
JER.50.31.english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies;

JER.34.17.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Asio kamonai henigu, hekahu-nege igwauraina ai, ta ta tadikakana tadikakana ediai, bona ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ediai; benaini, lau ese hekahu-nege na gwaurai henimuimu, dare bona dai-hanai gorerena bona doe na latamui ai na kahudia negemu, bona hahegari ḡauna ai baina halaomui tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ediai.
JER.34.17.english: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

JER.36.11.motu: Mikaia Gemaria Safana natuna, ese Iehova ena hereva iboudiai, pepa amo e duahi ḡaudia, na e kamonai negana ai,
JER.36.11.english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

JER.50.20.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Unu dinadia ai bona una nega ai, kara havara bae tahua Israel ai, to asi ḡauna; bona kara dika bae tahua Iuda ai, to basie davaria; badina be kwabukwabudia, baina rakatanidia taudia, na edia dika baina gwau tao.
JER.50.20.english: In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh,

JER.50.24.motu: Babulono e! Idoa na otoa, oi iabimu totona;
JER.50.24.english: I have laid a snare for you,

JER.20.16.motu: Una tau na Iehova ese e ḡiḡia dobi, se bogaia hisi, hanuana

JHN.12.5.english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

JHN.21.2.english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

JHN.1.2.english: The same was in the beginning with God.

JHN.9.40.english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

JHN.7.51.english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

JHN.12.17.english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

JHN.2.2.motu: Bona Iesu mai ena hahediba ida danu e vavedia, una anibou ela.
JHN.2.2.english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

JON.1.7.english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

JON.4.6.motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese au ta e abia, e hatubua, ela bona Iona daenai e mia, kwarana ihakerukeruna bona ena hisihisi ilao-ahuna totona. Taunabunai, Iona na e moale bada, una au dainai.
JON.4.6.english: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

JON.1.6.motu: Taunabunai lagatoi biaguna ema, e hamaoroa, eto, Mahuta taumu e, edeheto? A tore isi, emu dirava ba hahanea; reana una dirava ese baine laloda, bena basita mase.
JON.1.6.english: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”

JON.1.4.motu: Bena Iehova ese lai gubana e hatoaia, davara latanai; hurehure vada e bada herea, lagatoi na mokona e heroḡi rohoroho.
JON.1.4.english: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

JON.3.2.motu: A tore isi, hanua badana Nineve baola, lau ese baina henimu herevana ba gwaurai henia.
JON.3.2.english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

JON.3.8.motu: a taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡauna ese puse dabuadia bae hahedokilai, bena bae tai lolo-lolo, Dirava bae tai henia; oibe, iboudiai ese edia kara dika amo bae raka oho bona imadia edia daḡedaḡe karadia amo danu.
JON.3.8.english: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

JON.4.7.motu: Kerukeru, daba e rere, bena Dirava ese bubu ta e siaia lao, bena una bubu ese au e budua; bena hari au e marai.
JON.4.7.english: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.

JON.3.5.motu: Bena Nineve taudia ese Dirava e abiabiraia; idia na e anivaga e gwauraia bona puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, badana ela bona maraḡina.
JON.3.5.english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

JON.1.14.motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Iehova, e, ai ese a noimumu, ina tau ena mauri bagunai basia mase, bona asi kererena tauna rarana na ai latamai ai basio atoa kau; badina be, Iehova e, emu ura heḡereḡerena ai vada o karaia.
JON.1.14.english: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”

JON.4.11.motu: Matona, lau ese hanua badana Nineve, lalonai imadia idibadia be ededia bona lauridia be ededia asi dibadia taudia domaga-ta gerebu-rua bona boromakau momo herea danu e nohomu hanuana, basina bogaia hisi a?
JON.4.11.english: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”

JON.1.12.motu: Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Bavabigu, davara ai ba tahogu dobi; bena davara baine gaima emui ai; badina be lau dibagu, ina guba badana na lau daigu ai emui ai vada e kau.
JON.1.12.english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

JON.1.2.motu: A tore isi, hanua badana ladana Nineve baola, ba gwau henia; badina be edia kara dika na lau vairagu ai vada eme hedinarai.
JON.1.2.english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

JON.1.5.motu: Bena lagatoi taudia na e gari, ta ta ena dirava ena dirava e hahanedia; bena e negenege, lagatoi ihaharaḡana totona. A Iona na vada e diho, lagatoi tuana ai, unuseni ai vada e hekure, vada e mahuta.
JON.1.5.english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

JON.1.15.motu: Taunabunai idia ese Iona e abia, davara ai e tahoa dobi; bena davara na vada e gaima.
JON.1.15.english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

JON.1.3.motu: A Iona e tore isi, Tarasisi baine heau lao, Iehova vairana amo baine heau oho eto. Ia na e diho, Iopa ai, Tarasisi bainela lagatoina ta e davaria; dava e heni, bena e gui, idia ida Tarasisi baela, Iehova ena amo baine heau oho eto.
JON.1.3.english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

JON.2.1.motu: Bena Iona ese gwarume bogana amo Iehova, ena Dirava, e ḡuria,
JON.2.1.english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

JON.1.16.motu: Bena unu tatau ese Iehova e gari henia lalo-dika; idia ese boubou karadia e kara, Iehova ena, bona e gwau hamata danu.
JON.1.16.english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

JON.1.10.motu: Bena unu tatau na e gari dikadika, e hamaoroa, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? Badina be unu tatau vada e diba ia na Iehova vairana amo vada e heau oho, badina be ia ese vada e hamaorodia.
JON.1.10.english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.

JON.1.13.motu: Ḡau tamona, hari tatau na e bara hekwarahi, lagatoi na kone ai bae baraia diho totona; to asie heḡereḡere, badina be hurehure na vada e bada herea e laova idia vairadiai.
JON.1.13.english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

JON.1.8.motu: Bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, A hamaoromai, daika bagunai ina dika na latadai vada e kau? Oiemu ḡaukara be dahaka? Ede amo oma? Emu tano be edena? Oi na edena bese tauna?
JON.1.8.english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

JON.2.3.motu: Badina be dobu gabuna ai o tahogu dobi,
JON.2.3.english: For you threw me into the depths,

JON.2.9.motu: A lau ese oi baina boumu,
JON.2.9.english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving.

JON.3.3.motu: Taunabunai, Iona e tore isi, Nineve ela, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena. Hari Nineve na hauna bada-hereana, ena lababa na dina toi laolaona na heto.
JON.3.3.english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

JON.3.4.motu: Iona ese hanua lalonai e raka vareai matama, dina ta laolaona heḡereḡerena ela. Bena e haroro, eto, Dina hari-ahui bae ore, bena Nineve baine heḡiḡi dobi.
JON.3.4.english: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

JON.3.1.motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Iona enai ma e kau, nega iharuana, eto,
JON.3.1.english: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

JON.4.2.motu: Bena ia ese Iehova e ḡuria, eto, Iehova e, na noimumu, lau na dounu egu tano ai na nohova negana ai ini asina hereva toma a? Una dainai na ḡava, Tarasisi baina heau lao nato. Badina be lau vada na diba, oi na harihari-bada bona hebogahisi Diravana, badu ai o halahemu bona hebogahisi ai o honu honu daemu, bona kara dika amo o helalo kerehaimu.
JON.4.2.english: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

JON.4.8.motu: Dina e dae, bena Dirava ese lai siahuna ta mairiveina kahana amo e siaia lao, bona dina ese Iona kwarana e raraia ela bona tauna e manori. Bena mase e noinoilaia, eto, Baina mase be namo; baina mauri na dika.
JON.4.8.english: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

JON.2.8.motu: Kaivakuku asi anidia e matauraidiamu taudia ese
JON.2.8.english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

JON.4.4.motu: Bena Iehova eto, O badumu be namo a?
JON.4.4.english: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

JON.2.6.english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains.

JON.2.10.motu: Bena Iehova ese una gwarume e hereva henia; bena una gwarume ese Iona e kakaia lasi, tano kaukauna ai.
JON.2.10.english: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

JON.4.3.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova e, lau na noimumu, egu mauri avabia oho, badina be baina mase be namo, baina mauri na dika.
JON.4.3.english: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

JON.1.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva na Iona Amitai enai e kau, eto,
JON.1.1.english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

JON.4.10.motu: Bena Iehova eto, Hari au, oi so hekwarahilaia bona so hatubua ḡauna, hanuaboi ta ai e tubu ma hanuaboi ta ai e marai ḡauna, o bogaia hisimu.
JON.4.10.english: Yahweh said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

JON.3.7.motu: Bena ena hahedua herevana e gwauraia hedinarai bona e siaia lao, Nineve tanona idoinai, eto, Hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia edia haheḡani binai: Taunimanima eiava ubu-ubu ḡauna, boromakau serina eiava mamoe serina, ese ḡau ta basie ania; basie aniani bona ranu basie inu;
JON.3.7.english: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;

JON.4.1.motu: Una kara ese Iona lalona se hamoalea; ia na e badu.
JON.4.1.english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

JON.3.9.motu: Daika dibana, reana Dirava na baine helalo kerehai, bona ena badu-ḡaraḡara amo baine raka oho, bena ita na basita mase.
JON.3.9.english: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

JON.2.4.english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight;

JON.3.10.motu: Dirava ese edia kara e itaia, edia dala dikana amo ede e raka oho toma; bena Dirava ese baine hadikalaidia eto karana amo e helalo kerehai; bena se karaia.
JON.3.10.english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

JON.4.5.motu: Bena Iona na hanua amo e raka lasi, hanua mairiveina kahana ai e helai, unuseni ai ena kalaga auta e karaia. Bena ikerukeruna ai e helai, dahaka baine vara hanua badana enai baine itaia totona.
JON.4.5.english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

JOS.22.29.motu: Ai na Iehova asia gwau edeede henia, lasi vaitani. Iena amo asia raka oho, lasi vaitani. Ai na ihaboulaina patana asia Iarebaia, gole-oho bouboudia eiava flaoa bouboudia eiava boubou haida ihahelaḡadia, Iehova, eda Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana, ena dubu vairanai e ginimu ḡauna, latanai e karamu hegereḡerena.
JOS.22.29.english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

JOS.15.11.motu: Bena Ekron ororona mirigini kahana amo ela, e heḡeḡe lao, ela bona Sikerono; ma unu amo ela bona Baala ororona; bena kone ai e lasi, labnele ai.
JOS.15.11.english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

JOS.8.24.motu: Israel taudia na Ai taudia iboudiai, hari tano ḡaḡaena ai e havadia taudia, na e aladia ore, iboudiai na dare amo e aladia mase. Una murinai idia na Ai e lou ela, noho taudia ma dare amo e aladia ore.
JOS.8.24.english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

JOS.15.55.motu: Maono danu, bona Karamele bona Sifi bona luta,

JOS.2.6.motu: A hahine na ruma guhina ai vada e hakaudia, flax tuhutuhudia guhi ai e laha ḡaudia henudiai vada e hunidia.
JOS.2.6.english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

JOS.9.2.motu: bena mai lalodiai tamona e hebou, Iosua bona Israel taudia bae tuari henidia eto.
JOS.9.2.english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

JOS.19.14.motu: Mirigini kahana ai, hetoa na Hanaton amo ela, ela bona Iftahele kourana ai e hadoko.
JOS.19.14.english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

JOS.1.12.motu: Bena Iosua ese Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e hamaorodia, eto,
JOS.1.12.english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

JOS.21.21.motu: E henidia hanuadia be Sekem mai ena rei gabudia ida, Efraim ororodia ai, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Gesere mai ena rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.21.english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

JOS.8.12.motu: A taunimanima daha ima sisivana e abidia, Betele bona Ai padadiai bae bani henidia, Ai lahara kahana ai.
JOS.8.12.english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

JOS.15.43.motu: bona Ifta bona Asna bona Nesib,

JOS.15.18.motu: Raruosi e headava murinai, hahine na adavana ese lalona e ania, tamana baine noia, tano ta baine henia. Hahine na ena doniki amo e diho negana ai na Kaleb ese e nanadaia, eto, Emu ura be dahaka?
JOS.15.18.english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

JOS.24.4.motu: bona Isaak na Iakob bona Esau na henia. Esau na Seiri ororodia na henia, ena tano ai bainela; a Iakob mai natuna ida na Aigupto ela.
JOS.24.4.english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

JOS.11.10.motu: Una negana ai Iosua na e lou, hanua ta ladana Hasoro e abia, bona pavapavana na dare amo e alaia mase; badina be nega gunadia Hasoro ese unu basileia iboudiai e hereadiava.
JOS.11.10.english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

JOS.13.19.motu: bona Kiriataimi, bona Sibma, bona Seretesahara, una koura ororona ai;
JOS.13.19.english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

JOS.4.4.motu: Bena Iosua ese vada e abidia hidi taudia na iduhu ta ta amo ta ta e boiridia.
JOS.4.4.english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

JOS.9.27.motu: A una dina ai Iosua ese au-siri taudia bona ranu-utu taudia ai e halaodia, Israel taudia edia, bona Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ena, ema bona harihari, e heabi hidi gabuna ai.
JOS.9.27.english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.

JOS.17.3.motu: Selofehas, Hefere Gilead natuna, Makiri Manase lubuna, na asi natuna maruanena, hahine mo haida. Natuna hahinedia ladadia bini: Mahala bona Noa bona Hogla bona Milka bona Tirisa.
JOS.17.3.english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

JOS.15.31.motu: bona Siklag bona Madamana bona Sansana,

JOS.17.17.motu: Bena Iosua ese Iosef iduhuna taudia, Efraim taudia bona Manase taudia, ma e haere henidia, eto, Umui na hutuma, bona emui goada na herea; ahu tamona mo basio abia,
JOS.17.17.english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

JOS.7.7.motu: Bena Iosua eto, Inaio! Ḡaubada Iehova o! dahaka dainai ina bese taudia Ioridane sinavaina amo vada o hakaudia hanai? Amoro taudia imadia ai ba negemai bena bae habuamai tari totona a? Lalomai bema heḡereḡere Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai baiama noho bema namo.
JOS.7.7.english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

JOS.9.19.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai ese edia lohia e maumauraidia. A hebou ikwarana taudia iboudiai ese hebou taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Ai ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, ladana ai vada a gwau henidia hamata; harihari ita ese basita daudia toho diba.
JOS.9.19.english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

JOS.15.24.motu: bona Sifi bona Telem bona Bealoto,

JOS.9.23.motu: Taunabunai, heuduguirai herevana na latamui ai baina gwauraia: umui na hesiai iḡuidia ai ba noho; au ba siri bona ranu ba utu, egu Dirava ena ruma ena.
JOS.9.23.english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

JOS.8.3.motu: Taunabunai Iosua e tore isi, tuari taudia iboudiai ida; e heḡaeḡae, Ai hanuana baela. Iosua ese goada taudia gerebu toi e abidia hidi, hanuaboi ai e siaidia, bae guna.
JOS.8.3.english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

JOS.10.27.motu: Dina e diho, bena Iosua e hahedua, bena haida ese au amo e abidia dobi, Ialonai e komuva kohuana ai ma e tahodia vareai; bena nadi badadia e abi, kohua iduarana e kurea ahu. Unu e mia tomamu ema bona han dina.
JOS.10.27.english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

JOS.24.14.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova garina ba gari, ia isiaina ba lao heni mai momokanimui bona mai kamonaimui ida. Senemui ese Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai bona Aigupto ai e toma henidia diho diravadia ba rakatanidia, Iehova isiaina ba lao heni.
JOS.24.14.english: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

JOS.24.32.motu: Iosef turiana, Israel taudia ese Aigupto amo e mailaidia, na Sekem ai e guridia, Iakob ese Sekem tamana Hamoro ena amo e hoia tanona ai. Davana be silver monidia sinahu-ta e heni; bena Iosef garana edia tano ai ela.
JOS.24.32.english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

JOS.1.10.motu: Bena Iosua ese bese lohiadia e haduadia, eto,
JOS.1.10.english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

JOS.19.28.motu: bona Ebron bona Rehob bona Hamon bona Kana, ma ela bona hanua badana Sidono.
JOS.19.28.english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

JOS.15.42.motu: Libna danu, bona Etere bona Asana,

JOS.3.17.motu: A Israel taudia iboudiai tano kaukauna ai e raka hanaiva negana ai, hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na tano kaukauna ai e gini, Ioridane bogaraginai, ela bona bese idoinai Ioridane e rakaia hanai vaitani.
JOS.3.17.english: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

JOS.15.62.motu: bona Nibsan, damena hanuana, bona En-gedi: hanua tauratoi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.62.english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

JOS.18.16.motu: Unu amo ma ela, ela bona Hinom natuna ena koura e vaira henia ororona baditanona: una na Refaim kourana dokona, mirigini kahana ai. Ma unu amo e diho, Hinom kourana lalonai, Iebusu taudia edia ororo nesena diho kahana ai, ma e diho ela bona En-rogele.
JOS.18.16.english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

JOS.13.9.motu: Aroere amo, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura bogaragina hanuana amo bona Medeba taorana amo ela bona Dibon;
JOS.13.9.english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

JOS.19.48.motu: Dan taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia.
JOS.19.48.english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

JOS.15.26.motu: bona Amama bona Sema bona Molada,

JOS.21.36.motu: Ruben iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Besere bona lahasa, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.36.english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

JOS.4.20.motu: Hari nadi gwauta-ruaosi, Ioridane ai e abi ḡaudia, na Iosua ese e haginidia Gilgal ai.
JOS.4.20.english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

JOS.12.24.motu: Tirisa pavapavana, ta. Pavapava iboudiai na toi-ahui ta.

JOS.4.11.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai e raka hanai vaitani, bena maua helaḡana bona hahelaḡa taudia e hanai, taunimanima vairadiai.
JOS.4.11.english: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

JOS.10.22.motu: Bena Iosua eto, Kohua iduarana a kehoa, unu pavapava laimaosi ba hakaudia lasi, lau dekegu ai ba mailaidia.
JOS.10.22.english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

JOS.8.25.motu: Una dina ai e aladia mase taudia iboudiai na gerebu-ta daha-rua, tatau bona hahine; Ai taudia iboudiai bunu.
JOS.8.25.english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

JOS.12.15.motu: Libna pavapavana, ta; Adulama pavapavana, ta;

JOS.7.16.motu: Daba matana ai Iosua e tore isi, Israel taudia e hakaudia kahira, iduhu ta ta amo; bena luda iduhuna e heduanai.
JOS.7.16.english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

JOS.2.13.motu: tamagu bona sinagu bona taihugu bona tadikakagu bona edia iboudiai ba hamauridia, iboumai ai mase amo ba rauamai.
JOS.2.13.english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

JOS.21.33.motu: Gereson oreana taudia edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta-toi, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
JOS.21.33.english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

JOS.2.22.motu: Raruosi e raka lao, ororo kahadia ela, dina toi unuseni ai e nohova, ela bona e tahudia taudia vada e lou; badina be e tahudia taudia na dala idoinai e tahudia, to asie davaridia.
JOS.2.22.english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

JOS.23.1.motu: Nega daudau vada ela. Iehova ese Israel taudia na laḡa-ani e henidia, inaidia iboudiai e tuidia. Iosua vada e buruka, ena mauri laḡanidia na hoho.
JOS.23.1.english: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

JOS.21.32.motu: Napatali iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Kede, Galilea tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Hamoto-doro, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Karatan, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua toi.
JOS.21.32.english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

JOS.9.25.motu: Harihari ai na oi imamu ai; edena kara ba laloa namo bona maoro, unu ba karamai toma.
JOS.9.25.english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

JOS.9.18.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese asie aladia mase, badina be hebou ikwarana taudia ese vada e gwau henidia hamata, Iehova, Israel edia Dirava, ladana ai.
JOS.9.18.english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

JOS.9.22.motu: Bena Iosua ese e boiridia, e gwau henidia, eto, Dahaka dainai o koimai? Umui oto “Ai na gabu daudau amo vada ama”, a ḡau be gabu kahikahi ai o nohomu.
JOS.9.22.english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

JOS.23.11.motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho; Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia.
JOS.23.11.english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

JOS.4.5.motu: Bena Iosua ese e haḡanidia, eto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena taravatu mauana vairanai baola, Ioridane sinavaina bogaraginai; bena ta ta nadi ta ta bavabi isi, paḡamui ai ba hua, Israel iduhudia heḡereḡeredia.
JOS.4.5.english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

JOS.24.8.motu: Bena na hakaumui vareai, Amoro taudia edia tano Ialonai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; idia ese e tuan henimui, bena imamui ai na atodia. Edia tano o abia; lau ese umui vairamui ai na habuadia tari.
JOS.24.8.english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

JOS.22.28.motu: Emai lalo-hadai binai: kerukeru vanegai ai eiava ai garamai unu boma gwau henimai toma, ai na baiama haere, baiama toma “A itaia, ina na Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana idaidana; tamamai ese e larebaia, dia ḡole-oho bouboudia eiava boubou haida daidiai, a toa, ai bona umui padadai”.
JOS.22.28.english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

JOS.21.31.motu: bona Helkat, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Rehob, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.31.english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.8.5.motu: A lau be egu orea taudia ida hanua baia raka henia kahi. Bena hanua taudia bae raka lasi, vanegai heḡereḡerena, bae tuari henimai totona; a ai be idia vairadiai baia heau.
JOS.8.5.english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.

JOS.1.8.motu: Ina taravatu bukana herevadia na udumu ai bae mia; ia anina ba laloa boi, ba laloa rani. Unu amo ia lalonai e tore herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara; bena emu raka baine namo bona emu kara anidia bae namo.
JOS.1.8.english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

JOS.21.26.motu: Kohat oreana taudia oredia edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
JOS.21.26.english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

JOS.15.19.motu: Hahine na e haere henia, eto, Harihari ḡauna ta a henigu: egu noho gabuna vada o henigu diho kahana ai; harihari ranu gabudia danu henigu. Bena Kaleb ese ranu gabudia e henia, atai kahana ai bona hen kahana ai.
JOS.15.19.english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.”

JOS.24.23.motu: Iosua ma eto, Benaini, dirava idaudia bogaragimui ai mimia na ba negedia, bona lalomui ba hamanadadia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, enai.
JOS.24.23.english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

JOS.21.5.motu: a Kohat ena orea taudia oredia ese hanua gwauta mari amo e abidia, Efraim bona Dan iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana edia tano lalodiai.
JOS.21.5.english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

JOS.24.17.motu: Badina be Iehova, eda Dirava, ese ita bona tamada na Aigupto tanona amo bona iḡui rumana amo e hakauda lasi, bona unu toa badadia e karava ita vairadai, bona eda laolao dalana idoinai ai e hamauridava, edia tano ta rakadia hanai taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
JOS.24.17.english: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

JOS.6.26.motu: Una negana ai Iosua ese hereva aukana e henidia, eto, Ina hanua Ieriko baine hadaia lou tauna na Iehova ese baine uduguiraia. Ruma badidia baine hagini davana na natuna roboana baine mase, bona ikoukou baine hagini davana na natuna tau-muritai baine mase.
JOS.6.26.english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

JOS.13.28.motu: Gad iduhuna taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta amo bona edia hanua badadia bona maraḡidia ta ta amo e abi.
JOS.13.28.english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

JOS.21.13.motu: A hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena e henidia tanodia be hari Heberon mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Libna mai ena rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.13.english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

JOS.10.33.motu: Horama, Gesere pavapavana, ema, Lakisi taudia idurudia totona, a Iosua ese ia mai ena orea taudia iboudiai e hadareredia, e aladia ore.
JOS.10.33.english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

JOS.11.3.motu: Gwau-kau e siaia danu Kanaan taudia dekediai, mairiveina kahana ai bona lahara kahana ai, bona Amoro taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia dekediai, bona Iebusu taudia dekediai, ororo kahadia ai, bona Hivi taudia dekediai, Heremon ororona badi-tanona ai, Mispa tanona ai.
JOS.11.3.english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

JOS.5.10.motu: Israel taudia na Gilgal ai e nohova negana ai, idia ese lagau-hanai ariana e karaia. Hua dinana ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai e karaia, Ieriko taorana ai.
JOS.5.10.english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

JOS.9.10.motu: bona Amoro pavapavadia raruosi, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, Astaroto ai e nohova, na ede o karadia toma vada a kamonai.
JOS.9.10.english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

JOS.22.33.motu: Bena Israel taudia na e moale, una hereva dainai. Israel taudia ese Dirava e hanamoa, bona tuari herevadia, Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia edia tano bae habuaia tari herevadia, na e hadoko.
JOS.22.33.english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

JOS.17.10.motu: Diho kahana tanona na Efraim taudia edia; mirigini kahana tanona na Manase taudia edia. Hetoa na davara. Mirigini kahana ai na Asere taudia edia tano; mairiveina kahana ai na Isakara taudia edia tano.
JOS.17.10.english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

JOS.1.7.motu: Ḡau tamona, ba goada bona ba haheauka. Egu hesiai tauna Mose e henimu taravatuna idoinai ba badinaia bona karana ba karaia; iena amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai basiola; bena ba lao heni gabudia iboudiai emu kara anidia bae namo.
JOS.1.7.english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

JOS.13.21.motu: Taora hanuadia iboudiai na idia edia; bona Sihon, Amoro taudia edia lohia, Hesebon pavapavana, ena basielia idoinai. Una Sihon na Mose ese e hadarerea: ia bona Midian lohiadia, Evi bona Rekeme bona Suru bona Huru bona Reba. Una na Sihon ena basileia lohiadia, una tano e noholaia.
JOS.13.21.english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

JOS.7.1.motu: A Israel taudia na e revadia ḡaudia ediai e kerere; badina be Akan Karami, Sabdi Sera tubuna, luda iduhuna tauna, ese e gwaudia ahu ḡaudia haida e abi; taunabunai Iehova ena badu vada e siahu, Israel taudia latadiai.
JOS.7.1.english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against the children of Israel.

JOS.5.14.motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Lasi, lau na Iehova ena tuari oreana baina halohiaia totona nama. Bena Iosua na tano ai e goru diho, e toma henia diho, eto, Egu lohia ese ena hesiai tauna ede be haḡania tomamu?
JOS.5.14.english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.”

JOS.14.12.motu: Taunabunai, ina ororo tanona una dina ai Iehova ese e herevalaia na harihari ba henigu. Badina be una dina ai harina o kamonai Anakim taudia na unuseni ai, o kamonai danu edia hanua na babada bona mai maḡudia. Reana Iehova ese baine bamogu, bena baina luludia lasi, Iehova ena hereva hegereḡerena.
JOS.14.12.english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

JOS.24.28.motu: Bena Iosua ese idia iboudiai e siaidia karoho, ta ta ena tano ena tano baela.
JOS.24.28.english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

JOS.2.15.motu: Una hahine ena ruma na hanua maḡuna ai e hadaia; ia na maḡu latanai e nohova. Bena ia ese idia raruosi e abidia, gaba-mauru amo kwanau ai e tudia dobi.
JOS.2.15.english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

JOS.3.2.motu: Dina toi e ore murinai, bese lohiadia ese taruha bogaragina amo e raka hanai,
JOS.3.2.english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

JOS.19.41.motu: Edia tano bini: Sora; Estaol; Iri-semese;
JOS.19.41.english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

JOS.10.20.motu: Iosua bona Israel taudia ese vada e habuadia tari, ela bona hutuma bada vada e mase ore, ta ta mo hanua mai maḡudia lalodiai e heau vareai, bena e mauri.
JOS.10.20.english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

JOS.9.4.motu: bena hedibaḡani karana ta e karaia. Idia na aniani e habou, laolao taudia na heheto, puse gunadia bona vine-ranuna kopidia gunadia, vada e hedare ma e bani ḡaudia, na edia doniki dorudia ai e ato kau.
JOS.9.4.english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

JOS.8.14.motu: Ai pavapavana ese una kara e itaia, bena ia mai ena tuari taudia bona ena hanua taudia iboudiai na hanua amo e didi lasi, bena ia mai ena orea taudia, Ai hanuana taudia, e tore isi haraḡa, e didi lasi, Araba hekeidihona ela, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona; asi dibana orea ta be hanua murina kahana ai vada e komu.
JOS.8.14.english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

JOS.19.15.motu: Katata bona Nahalala bona Simron bona Idala bona Betelehem danu idia edia. Edia hanua iboudiai na gwauta-rua, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.15.english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

JOS.6.7.motu: Ia ese taunimanima danu e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, hanua ba rakaia hegeḡe; tuari taudia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai bae raka.
JOS.6.7.english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”

JOS.7.5.motu: toi-ahui tauratoi sisivana e aladia mase. Hanua ikoukouna amo e hahavadia lao, ela bona Sebarimi, bena hekei gabuna ai e aladia mase. Bena Israel taudia na kudoudia e hetaha, bona lalodia e manokamanoka ranu na heto.
JOS.7.5.english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

JOS.9.24.motu: Idia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Ai bini emu hesiai taudia na harina a kamonai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡania, ina tano taudia iboudiai baine aladia mase vairamui ai; taunabunai, ai na a gari dikadika, emai roho-mauri dalana a tahua, umui daimui ai. Bena ini a kara toma.
JOS.9.24.english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

JOS.15.63.motu: A Iuda taudia na asi goadadia Iebusu taudia, Ierusalem ai e nohova taudia, bae luludia lasi; taunabunai Iebusu taudia bona Iuda taudia na Ierusalem ai e noho heboumu ema bona harihari.
JOS.15.63.english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

JOS.21.43.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Israel taudia edia tano e henidia, senedia e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona idoinai e henidia: una tano e abia, edia tano, bena e noholaia.
JOS.21.43.english: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

JOS.24.27.motu: Bena Iosua ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, ina nadi na ita ihabadelaida toana ai vada ela; badina be Iehova ese e henida herevadia iboudiai na ina nadi ese vada e kamonai: taunabunai Iehova, emui Dirava, ba koia negana ai, ina nadi ese baine hahemaoro henimui.
JOS.24.27.english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

JOS.13.22.motu: Balaam Beoro danu, rohe tauna ta, Israel taudia ese dare amo e alaia mase, taunimanima loḡora ida.
JOS.13.22.english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

JOS.18.17.motu: Unu amo hetoa na e heḡege lao, mirigini kahana e lao toma, ela bona En-semese, ma unu amo ela, ela bona Geliloto, Adumimi dara-daena italaina; ma e diho ela, ela bona Bohan Ruben ena Nadi.
JOS.18.17.english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

JOS.22.31.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Fineha Eleasara ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Harihari ai na dibamai Iehova na ita bogaragidai, badina be umui na asio kara havara Iehova vairanai, a Israel na Iehova imana amo vada o hamauridia.
JOS.22.31.english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”

JOS.12.4.motu: Ma ta be Og, Basan pavapavana, Refaim tauna ta: ia na Astaroto ai bona Edrei ai e nohova.
JOS.12.4.english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

JOS.4.17.motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese hahelaḡa taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Ioridane sinavaina amo ba dae.
JOS.4.17.english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

JOS.23.3.motu: Vada o itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini bese ibolidiai ede vada e karadia toma umui daimui ai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai vada e tuari.
JOS.23.3.english: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.

JOS.15.51.motu: bona Gosen bona Holon bona Gilo: hanua gwauta-ta mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.51.english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

JOS.15.4.motu: bona unu amo Asamon ma e lao henia; bena Aigupto Dokana badibadinai kone ai e hadoko. Emui tano hetoana diho kahana ai bunai.
JOS.15.4.english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

JOS.5.5.motu: E raka lasi tataudia iboudiai be vada e peritomedia guna; a dala ai e vara, tano ḡaḡaena ai, tataudia, tamadia na Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai, na asie peritomedia.
JOS.5.5.english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

JOS.24.11.motu: Una murinai Ioridane sinavaina o hanaia, Ieriko ai o kau. Bena Ieriko taudia ese e tuari henimui; Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Girigasa taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia ese danu e tuari henimui; a lau ese umui imamui ai na atodia.
JOS.24.11.english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

JOS.12.12.motu: Eglon pavapavana, ta; Gesere pavapavana, ta;

JOS.3.8.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, taravatu mauana e huaiamu taudia, ba haḡanidia, baoto “Ioridane sinavaina ai ba diho ela bona ranu isena ai, bena ba gini”.
JOS.3.8.english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

JOS.15.52.motu: Arab danu, bona Duma bona Esan,

JOS.4.10.motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia, maua helaḡana e huaia taudia, na Ioridane bogaraginai e gini, ela bona Iehova ese Iosua e haduaia taunimanima baine haḡanilaidia karadia iboudiai vada e ore, Mose ena haheḡani iboudiai Iosua e henia heḡereḡeredia.
JOS.4.10.english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

JOS.8.26.motu: Badina be Iosua ese io imana ai se veria lou ela bona Ai taudia iboudiai vada e aladia ore.
JOS.8.26.english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

JOS.11.21.motu: Una negana ai Iosua na e tore isi, Anakim taudia e habuadia tari, ororo gabudia ai, Heberon ai, Debiri ai, Anab ai, Iuda ororodia iboudiai, bona Israel ororodia iboudiai; Iosua ese e aladia ore bona edia hanua e habuadia tari.
JOS.11.21.english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

JOS.18.1.motu: Israel besena taudia ibouboudiai na Silo ai e hebou, unuseni ai hebou kalagana e haginia: tano idoinai vada e darere idia vairadiai.
JOS.18.1.english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

JOS.11.7.motu: Taunabunai, Iosua mai ena tuari oreadia iboudiai na ediai e hedinarai taku Merom ranudia badidiai, bena e tuari henidia.
JOS.11.7.english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

JOS.22.13.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara natuna Fineha e siaia, Gilead tanona bainela, Ruben bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia dekediai.
JOS.22.13.english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

JOS.21.37.motu: bona Kedemoto bona Mefata, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.37.english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.22.22.motu: Dirava korikori na Iehova! Dirava korikori na Iehova! Ia dibana, bona Israel danu baine diba: bema Iehova a gwau edeede henia eiava vairanai a kara havara, hari dina ai basio hamaurimai.
JOS.22.22.english: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),

JOS.3.7.motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Hari dina ai baina imodaimu matama, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai, bena bae diba lau ese oi na bamomumu, Mose na bamoava heḡereḡerena.
JOS.3.7.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

JOS.1.4.motu: Tano ḡaḡaena bona ina Lebanon ororona amo ela bona sinavai badana ladana Eufrate, Hiti taudia edia tano idoinai ela bona Davara Badana dina e dihomu kahana ai na bavabia, emui tano.
JOS.1.4.english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

JOS.15.25.motu: bona Hasoro-hadata bona Kerioto-hesron (ladana ta be Hasoro),
JOS.15.25.english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

JOS.19.51.motu: Tanodia bunu, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia ese mari amo e hari Silo ai, Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai. Tano iharina na unu e haḡuḡurua toma.
JOS.19.51.english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

JOS.8.10.motu: Iosua na daba maraḡi ela, taunimanima e haboudia, bena idia bona Israel tau-badadia ida e dae ela, taunimanima vairadiai Ai ela.
JOS.8.10.english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

JOS.22.34.motu: A Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia ese una ihaboulaina patana ladana e hatoa Toa: idia eto, Badina be ia na toa, ita padadai, Iehova na Dirava toana.
JOS.22.34.english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”

JOS.6.20.motu: Taunabunai taunimanima na e lolo, bona kibi taudia na kibi e hiriri. Taunimanima ese kibi reḡedia e kamonai, bona ma e lolo lalodika. Bena hanua maḡuna e heḡigi dobi; taunimanima na maorodia ai e raka vareai, hanua e abia.
JOS.6.20.english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

JOS.20.8.motu: Bona Ioridane sinavaina unukahanai, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai, idia na Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ororo-taorana ai, Ruben taudia edia, bona Ramoto, Gilead tanona ai, Gad taudia edia, bona Golan, Basan tanona ai, Manase taudia edia, e abidia hidi.
JOS.20.8.english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

JOS.17.9.motu: Unu amo tano hetoana ma ela, ela bona sinavai maragina ladana Kana. Sinavai diho kahana hanuadia na Efraim taudia edia, Manase taudia edia hanua bogaragidiai. Manase taudia edia tano hetoana na sinavai mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona kone ai e hadoko.
JOS.17.9.english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

JOS.2.9.motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Lau na dibagu Iehova ese ina tano vada e henimui. Umui daimui ai gari ese e butumai taomu, bona ina tano taudia iboudiai kudoudia e hetahamu.
JOS.2.9.english: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

JOS.3.15.motu: ela bona taravatu mauana ihuana taudia aedia na sinavai ranuna ai e turu dobi. Hari Ioridane sinavaina ena kara be taboro negana ai abata e daeva.
JOS.3.15.english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

JOS.10.40.motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese tano idoinai e hadarerea: ororo kahadia bona diho kahana, taora bona ororo gabaedia, mai pavapavadia iboudiai ida; ta se hamauria. Mai laḡadia ḡaudia iboudiai e aladia ore, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
JOS.10.40.english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.

JOS.18.6.motu: Tano sivaraina ba torea, kaha hitu ai, bena revarevana na lau dekegu ai ba mailaia. Bena lau ese umui emui ai mari baina kara, Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai.
JOS.18.6.english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

JOS.8.9.motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese e siaidia, bena edia komu gabuna ela, Betele bona Ai padadiai, Ai lahara kahana ai. A Iosua na ena orea taudia ida e nohova una hanuaboi ai.
JOS.8.9.english: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.

JOS.10.14.motu: Nega ta dina hata Iehova ese tau ta unu se kamonai henia toma, guna eiava murinai; badina be Iehova ese Israel edia tuan ai e tuariva.
JOS.10.14.english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

JOS.24.31.motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova isiaina e lao heniva, Iosua ena maun dinadia iboudiai lalodiai, bona tau-badadia, Iosua ena mase murinai dounu e mauriva bona Iehova ena kara Israel taudia ediai na matadia amo e itava taudia, edia mauri dinadia lalodiai danu.
JOS.24.31.english: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.

JOS.17.12.motu: A Manase taudia na asi goadadia unu hanua bae abidia vaitani; Kanaan taudia ese una tano dounu e noholaia.
JOS.17.12.english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

JOS.9.12.motu: Amai flaoa binai, emai dala lakwana, dekemui baiama totona a tore isi dinana ai emai ruma amo a abia lasi mai siahu-siahuna ida. A itaia, harihari ia na vada eme auka, eme valavala danu.
JOS.9.12.english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

JOS.22.7.motu: Manase iduhuna kahana be Mose ese edia tano e henidia Basan ai, a iduhu kahana be Iosua ese edia tano e henidia, Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana ai, varavaradia badibadidiai. Bena Iosua ese e siaidia, edia noho gabudia baela, negana ai, ia ese e hanamodia,
JOS.22.7.english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

JOS.11.5.motu: Unu pavapava iboudiai na edia tuari oreadia e haboudia, ela, Merom ranudia badidiai e taruha, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona.
JOS.11.5.english: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

JOS.23.15.motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ena gwau-hamata namodia emui ai vada e momokani heḡereḡerena, Iehova ese ḡau dikadia danu latamui ai baine hadihodia diba, ela bona baine habuamui tari, ina tano namona, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona, lalona amo ba boio.
JOS.23.15.english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

JOS.14.8.motu: Tadikakagu, e bamogu taudia, ese taunimanima lalodia e hamanokadiava; a lau ese Iehova, egu Dirava, na badinaia tarika-tarikava.
JOS.14.8.english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

JOS.19.22.motu: Edia tano hetoana danu ela, ela bona Taboro bona Sahasuma bona Bete-semese; bena hetoa na Ioridane sinavaina ai e hadoko. Hanua iboudiai na gwautatauratoi, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.22.english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
