JOS.22.32.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Fineha Eleasara bona hanua lohiadia ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia e rakatanidia Gilead tanona ai, e lou lao, Kanaan tanona ela, Israel taudia dekediai; bona idia vairadiai harina e piua.
JOS.22.32.english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

JOS.24.13.motu: Asio ruaia tanona na henimui; asio hadai hanuadia o noholai; asio hado imeadia, vine imeadia bona olive imeadia, huahuadia o ani.
JOS.24.13.english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

JOS.7.18.motu: Sabdi ena ruma taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, tatau ta ta amo; bena Akan Karami, Sabdi Sera tubuna, luda iduhuna tauna, e heduanai.
JOS.7.18.english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

JOS.22.27.motu: a toa, ai bona umui padadai, bona ai garamai bona umui garamui padadiai, ai na Iehova itomadiho-henina totona emai ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emai herohemaino bouboudia bona emai boubou haida a hahelaḡadiamu; kerukeru vanegai umui natumui ese ai natumai bae gwau henidia na garina, baeto “Umui na asi ahumui Iehova enai”.
JOS.22.27.english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in Yahweh.’

JOS.19.6.motu: Bete-lebaoto; Saruhene: hanua gwauta-toi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.6.english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

JOS.12.20.motu: Simrono-meron pavapavana, ta; Akasaf pavapavana, ta;
JOS.12.20.english: the king of Shimron Meron, one;

JOS.4.14.motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Iosua e imodaia, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai; idia ese e matauraia bada, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai, gunaguna Mose e matauraiava heḡereḡerena.
JOS.4.14.english: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

JOS.19.2.english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

JOS.15.15.motu: Una murinai ia ese Debiri taudia e tuari henidia. Debiri ladana gunana be Kiriatasefere.
JOS.15.15.english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

JOS.7.26.motu: Bena ia latanai nadi e senu, una nadi senusenua bada-hereana na mia ema bona hari dina ai. Bena Iehova ena badu ma e keru lou. Taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoamu Akoro Kourana, ema bona hari dina ai.
JOS.7.26.english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Yahweh turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

JOS.21.45.motu: Iehova ese ena gwau-hamata namodia, Israel taudia e gwaurai henidia hamata gaudia, na ta se reaia: iboudiai ia ese e hamomokanidia.
JOS.21.45.english: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

JOS.19.30.motu: bona Umaha bona Afek bona Rehob danu idia edia. Hanua iboudiai na ruahui-rua, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.30.english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

JOS.2.10.motu: Badina be ai vada a kamonai Iehova ese Davara Kakakakana na vairamui ai e hakaukaua, Aigupto tanona amo o raka lasi negana ai. Vada a kamonai danu Amoro pavapavadia raruosi, Sihon bona Og, ede o aladia mase toma, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai.
JOS.2.10.english: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

JOS.17.14.motu: Bena Iosef iduhuna taudia ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka dainai oi na tano tamona vada o henimai, ai ahumai ai bainela? Ai na hutuma, Iehova ese emai iduhu vada e hanamoa dainai.
JOS.17.14.english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”

JOS.6.21.motu: Hanua idoinai e habuaia tari; tatau bona hahine, memero bona iahu, boromakau bona mamoe bona doniki, ibouboudiai na dare matana amo e aladia mase.
JOS.6.21.english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

JOS.12.23.motu: Doro pavapavana (Doro be Nafata-doro ai), ta; Goimi pavapavana (Goimi be Gilgal ai), ta;
JOS.12.23.english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one;

JOS.13.13.motu: Ḡau tamona, Israel taudia na Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia asie luludia lasi; Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia na doini Israel taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu ema bona harihari.
JOS.13.13.english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

JOS.8.13.motu: Taunabunai iboudiai na edia gabu e abi, orea badana na hanua mirigini kahana ai, a e komu oreana na lahara kahana ai. A Iosua na koura ai e noho rani.
JOS.8.13.english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

JOS.22.10.motu: Idia na Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e kau, Kanaan tanona ai. Unuseni ai Ruben iduhuna bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia ese ihaboulaina patana bada-hereana ta e larebaia, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai.
JOS.22.10.english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

JOS.20.7.motu: Taunabunai, idia na Kede, Galilea tanona ai, Napatali ororodia ai, bona Sekem, Efraim ororodia ai, bona Kiriat-araba (ladana ta be Heberon), Iuda ororodia ai, e abidia hidi.
JOS.20.7.english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

JOS.7.20.motu: Bena Akan ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Momokani, lau na vada na kerere, Iehova, Israel Diravana, vairanai. Lau na ini na kara toma:
JOS.7.20.english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

JOS.22.25.motu: Iehova ese Ioridane sinavaina na hetoa ai vada e halaoa, ai bona umui Ruben taumui bona Gad taumui padadai; umui na asi ahumui Iehova enai.” Natumui unu bema gwau toma, bena ai natumai ese Iehova itomadiho-henina bema rakatania.
JOS.22.25.english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.

JOS.23.7.motu: Ini bese haida, doini bogaragimui ai e nohomu, ida basio hetura; edia dirava ladadia basio hato, Iadadia ai basio gwau hamata, isiaidia basio Iao heni, bona basio toma henidia diho.
JOS.23.7.english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

JOS.10.1.motu: Adoni-sedek, Ierusalem pavapavana, ese Iosua harina e kamonai, ia ese Ai vada e habuaia tari, una hanua mai pavapavana ida vada e kara henidia Ieriko mai pavapavana ida e kara henidia heḡereḡerena; e kamonai danu Gibeon taudia na Israel taudia ida vada e herohemaino bona idia ida e noho hebouva.
JOS.10.1.english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

JOS.22.5.motu: A nahuamui ba toho, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henimui haheḡanidia bona taravatudia ba badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, ena dala iboudiai ba raka bona ena haheḡani ba badinadia, bona ia enai ba tao bona ia isiaina ba lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
JOS.22.5.english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

JOS.11.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel taudia imadia ai e atodia: Israel taudia ese e hadareredia, e hahavadia ela bona Sidono badana bona Misirefoto-maimi, ma e hahavadia ela bona Mispe kourana, mairiveina kahana ai; iboudiai e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri.
JOS.11.8.english: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

JOS.3.6.motu: Iosua ese danu hahelaḡa taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Taravatu mauana bavabia isi, taunimanima vairadiai ba raka guna. Bena idia ese taravatu mauana e abia isi, taunimanima vairadiai e raka ela.
JOS.3.6.english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

JOS.22.24.motu: Lasi, ai na a larebaia, kerukeru vanegai umui natumui ese ai natumai bae gwau henidia na garina, baeto “Iehova, Israel Diravana, enai dahaka bavabia?
JOS.22.24.english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?

JOS.1.1.motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose e mase murinai, Iehova ese Iosua Nunu, Mose iduruna tauna, e hereva henia, eto,
JOS.1.1.english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

JOS.15.30.motu: bona Eltolad bona Kesili bona Horoma,

JOS.7.23.motu: Bena kalaga lalona amo e abidia lasi, Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai dekedia e laohaidia, Iehova vairanai e atodia.
JOS.7.23.english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before Yahweh.

JOS.20.6.motu: Bena hapadidi tauna na una hanua ai baine noho, ela bona hebou vairanai baine gini, hebou ese baine hahemaoro henia. Ma baine noho, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna badana baine mase; una murinai ia na ena hanua korikon bona ena ruma korikori, e heautania gabuna, ma baine lou henia diba.
JOS.20.6.english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

JOS.13.14.motu: Levi iduhuna taudia mo Mose ese tano ta se henidia, badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, vada e hereva, boubou ḡaudia lahi ai e gabudia na idia ahudia.
JOS.13.14.english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

JOS.10.3.motu: Taunabunai, Adonisedek, Ierusalem pavapavana, ese ena gwau-kau na Hohama, Heberon pavapavana, bona Pirama, Iaramutu pavapavana, bona Iafia, Lakisi pavapavana, bona Debiri, Eglon pavapavana, dekedia e siaia, eto,
JOS.10.3.english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

JOS.11.20.motu: Badina be Iehova ese lalodia e ha-aukadia, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia bena Israel ese bae habuadia tari totona; basie bogadia hisi, a bae aIadia ore, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
JOS.11.20.english: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

JOS.6.4.motu: Hahelaga taudia hahitu ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hitu bae abi, maua helagana vairanai bae raka. Dina ihahituna ai, hanua ba rakaia hegeḡe nega hahitu; hahelaga taudia danu kibi bae hiriri.
JOS.6.4.english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

JOS.8.8.motu: Hanua na bavabia negana ai, vada ba doua, Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. Vadaeni, vada name haḡanimui.
JOS.8.8.english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to Yahweh’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”

JOS.14.13.motu: Bena Iosua ese e hanamoa, Heberon tanona na Kaleb lefune e henia, ena tano korikori ai bainela.
JOS.14.13.english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

JOS.11.9.motu: Bena Iosua ese Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e kara henidia: edia hosi na aedia varovarodia e utu, bona edia kariota na lahi ai e doudia.
JOS.11.9.english: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

JOS.11.19.motu: Asi hanua ta Israel ida e herohemaino, Hivi taudia Gibeon ai e nohova mo sibodia; iboudiai na tuari ai e abidia.
JOS.11.19.english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

JOS.19.33.motu: Edia tano hetoana na Helef amo e matamaia, oak auna Saananim ai amo, bona Adaminekeb bona labnele amo, ela bona Lakumu; bena Ioridane sinavaina ai e hadoko.
JOS.19.33.english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

JOS.2.19.motu: Idia ta emu ruma iduarana amo baine raka lasi ariara ai, rarana na ia sibona kwarana ai; ai na asi emai kerere. A dika baine kau oi ida ruma lalonai e nohomu tauna ta enai, ia rarana na ai kwaramai ai.
JOS.2.19.english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

JOS.8.11.motu: Bena tuari taudia iboudiai, ia ida ela taudia, na e dae ela, hanua e raka henia kahi, Ai mirigini kahana ai e taruha. Edia taruha bona Ai hanuana padadia ai na koura dobudobuna ta.
JOS.8.11.english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.

JOS.21.22.motu: bona Kibsaim bona Bete-horono, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.22.english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.22.2.motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e haḡanilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara, lau eregu danu vada o kamonai, vada na haḡanilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara.
JOS.22.2.english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

JOS.8.2.motu: Ieriko bona Ieriko pavapavana o kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Ai hanuana bona Ai pavapavana unu ba kara henidia toma; ḡau tamona, ena kohu bona ena ubu-ubu ḡaudia bavabi emui. Emu orea ta ba siaidia hehuni, hanua murina kahana amo bae hahoadia.
JOS.8.2.english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”

JOS.6.10.motu: A Iosua ese taunimanima e haḡanidia, eto, Basio lolo, bona basio hereva-hereva; hereva ta udumui amo basine lasi, ela bona dina baine gini dae bainato “A lolo”. Bena ba lolo.
JOS.6.10.english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

JOS.7.15.motu: Bena na gwau ahu ḡaudia enai bae davaridia tauna na lahi ai bae hamasea, ena kohu idoinai danu lahi ai bae doua; badina be ia ese Iehova ena taravatu vada e tataia utu, bona hemarai karana ta vada e karaia Israel ai.
JOS.7.15.english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed Yahweh’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

JOS.19.1.motu: E duanaia oreana iharuana na Simeon iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai: edia tano na Iuda taudia edia tano bogaraginai.
JOS.19.1.english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

JOS.10.19.motu: a umui na basio halahe, inaimui do ba hahavadia, muridia amo bavala-ala henidia, edia hanua na basie heau vareai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai vada e atodia.
JOS.10.19.english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.”

JOS.15.17.motu: Bena Otoniele Kena, Kaleb natuna lahaina, ese e abia, taunabunai Kaleb ese natuna kekenina Aksa e henia, ia adavana ai e halaoa.
JOS.15.17.english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

JOS.6.11.motu: Taunabunai ia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana e siaia, hanua baine haḡeḡea nega hatamona. Bena taruha e lou lao, unuseni ai e noho rani.
JOS.6.11.english: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

JOS.19.12.motu: A Saridi amo hetoa na mairiveina dina dae kahana ai ela, ela bona Kisloto-taboro;
JOS.19.12.english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

JOS.21.29.motu: bona Iaramutu, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Enganim, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.29.english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.22.14.motu: Hanua lohiadia gwauta danu ia ida e siaidia, Israel iduhudia ta ta amo; iboudiai na edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia.
JOS.22.14.english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

JOS.12.8.motu: ororo bona koura, Araba taorana bona ororo gabaedia bona tano ḡagaedia, bona diho kahana tanodia; Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano.
JOS.12.8.english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

JOS.17.5.motu: Taunabunai, Manase iduhuna ese ahu gwauta e abidia; bona Gilead bona Basan tanodia danu, Ioridane sinavaina unukahanai;
JOS.17.5.english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

JOS.12.3.motu: Bona Araba tanona danu iena, Kineroto gohuna mairiveina kahana amo ela bona Bet-iesimoto, ela bona Araba gohuna (Tadi Gohuna), bona diho kahana tanona ela bona Pisga ororona badi-tanodia.
JOS.12.3.english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

JOS.20.1.motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto,

JOS.10.37.motu: e abia, dare amo e aladia, hanua pavapavana danu e alaia, bona hanua maraḡidia taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Eglon ai e karaia heḡereḡerena, unu ma e kara toma: e habuaia tari, bona taunimanima iboudiai e aladia ore.
JOS.10.37.english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

JOS.7.24.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel idoinai ese Akan Sera e abia, silver bona hahedoki bona gold tuana danu e abidia, bona natuna mamaruanedia bona natuna hahinedia, bona ena boromakau bona ena doniki bona ena mamoe, bona ena kalaga, bona ena kohu idoinai; ibouboudiai na Akoro kourana e laohaidia.
JOS.7.24.english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.

JOS.2.8.motu: Hasinadoa taudia do asie hekure ai, hahine na dekedia e dae kau guhi ai,
JOS.2.8.english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

JOS.22.20.motu: Akan Sera na e gwau ahu ḡaudia ai e kerere, bena badu na Israel oreana idoinai latanai e kau, ani? Davana na mase, bona dia ia sibona latanai.
JOS.22.20.english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

JOS.12.7.motu: Hanua pavapavadia una tano ai danu Iosua bona Israel taudia ese e hadareredia, Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana ai, Baal-gad amo, Lebanon kourana ai, ela bona Halak ororona, Seiri kahana ai. Bena Iosua ese edia tano e abi, Israel iduhudia e henidia, edia tano ai bae halao, iduhu ta ta ena tano ena tano ai baela;
JOS.12.7.english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

JOS.15.59.motu: bona Maarata bona Bet-anoto bona El-tekon: hanua tauratoi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.59.english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

JOS.5.12.motu: Tamo anina e ania, bena ma kerukeru mana e doko; Israel taudia na mana asie ania lou, a Kanaan tanona anina e ania una laḡani ai.
JOS.5.12.english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

JOS.20.4.motu: Hapadidi tauna na unu hanua ta baine heau henia, bena hanua ikoukouna ai baine gini, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai ia sibona sivaraina baine gwauraia hedinarai. Bena idia ese hanua lalonai bae hakaua vareai, gabu ta bae henia, unuseni ai baine noho.
JOS.20.4.english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

JOS.10.16.motu: Unu hanua pavapavadia laimaosi na e heau, Makeda kohuana ai e komu.
JOS.10.16.english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

JOS.2.3.motu: Bena Ieriko pavapavana ese ena gwau-kau e siaia, Rahaba enai, eto, Dekemu ema bona emu ruma ai e dae kau taudia ba hakaudia lasi, badina be ina tano idoinai bae hasinadoa totona vada ema.
JOS.2.3.english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

JOS.10.29.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Makeda amo ela, Libna ai e kau; bena e tuari henia.
JOS.10.29.english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

JOS.18.9.motu: Bena unu tatau ela, tano ai e loa eva-eva, sivaraina na buka ta ai e torea, kaha hitu ai; bena Iosua dekena ma e lou lao, Silo taruhana ai.
JOS.18.9.english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

JOS.11.4.motu: Iboudiai e tore isi, edia tuari taudia iboudiai ida, taunimanima hutuma bada, kone mirina na heto, mai edia hosi momo herea bona edia kariota momo herea danu.
JOS.11.4.english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

JOS.18.15.motu: Diho kahana ai, hetoa na Kiriat-iearimi badibadinai e matamaia, unu amo ela, ela bona Efron; ma ela, ela bona Nefetoa ranu gabudia.
JOS.18.15.english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

JOS.10.6.motu: Bena Gibeon taudia ese edia gwau-kau na Iosua dekena e siaia lao, Gilgal taruhana ai, eto, Imamu na emu hesiai taudia latamai amo basio abia oho; aoma haraḡa, ba hamaurimai bona ba durumui; badina be Amoro pavapavadia iboudiai ororo kahadia amo vada e hebou, vada e tuari henimai.
JOS.10.6.english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

JOS.13.33.motu: A Levi iduhuna taudia na Mose ese tano ta se henidia; Iehova, Israel Diravana, e hereva heḡeregerena, idia ahudia be ia.
JOS.13.33.english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

JOS.12.21.motu: Taanak pavapavana, ta; Megido pavapavana, ta;

JOS.22.6.motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese e hanamodia, bena e siaidia. Bena idia na edia noho gabuna ela.
JOS.22.6.english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

JOS.13.26.motu: Hesebon amo ela bona Ramata-mispe bona Betonimi danu idia edia; bona Mahanaim ela bona Debiri hetoana.
JOS.13.26.english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

JOS.24.33.motu: Eleasara Aaron danu e mase; bena Gibea ai e guria, natuna Fineha vada e henia hanuana bunai, Efraim ororodia ai.
JOS.24.33.english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

JOS.24.22.motu: Bena Iosua ese e hamaorodia, eto, Emui hereva ihahedinaraina na umui sibomui; Iehova vada o abia hidi, ia isiaina ba lao heni o tomu. Idia na e haere, eto, Ai sibomai ese vada a gwauraia hedinarai.
JOS.24.22.english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.”

JOS.15.36.motu: bona Saaraimi bona Aditaim bona Gedera bona Gederotaim: hanua gwauta-hani mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.36.english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

JOS.12.5.motu: E halohiadiava tanodia na Heremon ororona bona Saleka bona Basan tanona idoinai ela bona Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia edia tano hetoadia. Gilead tanona kahana danu iena, ela bona Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ena tano hetoana.
JOS.12.5.english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

JOS.5.2.motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Vasiga bavabi, Israel taudia ma ba peritomedia lou, nega iharuana.
JOS.5.2.english: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

JOS.10.39.motu: bena e abia, mai pavapavana bona mai ena hanua iboudiai ida. Bena e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Heberon e kara henia bona Libna mai pavapavana ida e kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Debiri mai pavapavana ida unu e karadia toma.
JOS.10.39.english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

JOS.6.14.motu: Dina iharuana ai danu hanua e rakaia hegeḡe nega hatamona; bena taruha ma e lou lao. Dina tauratoi unu e kara toma.
JOS.6.14.english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

JOS.9.8.motu: A idia ese Iosua ma e hamaoroa, eto, Ai na oiemu hesiai taudia. Iosua ese ma e nanadaidia, eto, Umui be daidia? Bona ede amo vada oma?
JOS.9.8.english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.”

JOS.19.24.motu: E duanaia oreana iha-imana na Asere iduhuna, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.19.24.english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

JOS.23.4.motu: A kamonai: dounu nonoho besedia edia tano na vada na habuadia tari besedia edia tano ida vada na henimui, Ioridane sinavaina amo eIa bona Davara Badana, lahara kahana ai.
JOS.23.4.english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

JOS.10.32.motu: Bena Iehova ese Lakisi danu Israel taudia imadia ai e atoa; dina iharuana ai e abia, e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia ore, Libna ai e karaia heḡereḡerena.
JOS.10.32.english: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

JOS.10.23.motu: Bena unu e kara toma: hari pavapava laimaosi e hakaudia lasi, Iosua dekena e laohaidia: Ierusalem pavapavana bona Heberon pavapavana bona laramutu pavapavana bona Lakisi pavapavana bona Eglon pavapavana.
JOS.10.23.english: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

JOS.17.2.motu: Manase iduhuna taudia oredia danu ahudia e abi, edia doḡoro ta ta amo: Abiesere ena, bona Helek ena, bona Asriel ena, bona Sekem ena, bona Hetere ena, bona Semida ena: Manase Iosef garana mamaruanedia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.17.2.english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

JOS.7.6.motu: Bena Iosua ese ena dabua e dare, bona tano ai e goru diho, Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai, ela bona dina e diho, ia bona Israel tau-badadia danu. Gahu e abia danu, kwaradia ai e bubu.
JOS.7.6.english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

JOS.6.23.motu: Taunabunai hari eregabe taudia gunaguna hasinadoa ela na e raka vareai, Rahaba mai tamana bona sinana bona taihuna bona varavarana iboudiai ida e hakaudia lasi; varavarana iboudiai e laohaidia, Israel taudia edia taruha murimurinai e rakatanidia.
JOS.6.23.english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

JOS.14.7.motu: Lauegu mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui negana ai, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e siaigu, Kade-baranea amo bainala, tano baina hasinadoa, eto; bena tano sivaraina na loulaia, lalogu na hadailaia heḡereḡerena.
JOS.14.7.english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

JOS.16.5.motu: Efraim taudia edia tano hetoadia, edia doḡoro ta ta amo e abidia tanodia, na iniheto. Ataroto-adara amo ela, ela bona Bete-horono atai hanuana.
JOS.16.5.english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

JOS.8.30.motu: Bena Iosua ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena, Ebal ororona ai,
JOS.8.30.english: Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

JOS.18.4.motu: Iduhu ta ta amo tatau tatoi tatoi amo bavabidia hidi; bena lau ese baina siaidia, baela, tano ai bae loa eva-eva, sivaraina bae torea, ahudia iabidia totona; bena dekegu bae lou mai.
JOS.18.4.english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

JOS.2.21.motu: Hahine na eto, Emui hereva heḡereḡerena, unu baine heto. Bena ia ese e siaidia; bona idia e raka oho murinai ia ese varo kakakakana e kwatua kau, hari gaba-mauru ai.
JOS.2.21.english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

JOS.13.11.motu: bona Gilead; bona Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia edia tano; bona Heremon ororona idoinai; bona Basan idoinai ela bona Saleka,
JOS.13.11.english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

JOS.24.26.motu: Bena Iosua ese unu hereva na Dirava ena taravatu bukana ai e tore; bena nadi badana ta e abia, oak auna henunai e haginia, Iehova ena gabu helaḡana ai.
JOS.24.26.english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

JOS.15.56.motu: bona Iesrele bona Iokodeam bona Sanoa,

JOS.5.11.motu: Lagau-hanai dinana e ore, kerukeru idia na una tano anina e ania, asie hatubua flaoana dikeadia bona e gabua uitina.
JOS.5.11.english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

JOS.21.8.motu: Ini hanua, mai edia rei gabudia ida, Israel taudia ese Levi taudia e henidia, mari amo, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
JOS.21.8.english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

JOS.13.27.motu: Koura ai, Bete-haram bona Bete-nimra bona Sukoto bona Safon na edia, bona Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ena basileia orena; hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina ela bona ranu na Kinerete gohuna amo e aru lasimu gabuna ai, Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.13.27.english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

JOS.10.31.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Libna amo ela, Lakisi ai e kau, e koua heḡeḡe bona e tuari henia.
JOS.10.31.english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

JOS.10.12.motu: Iehova ese Israel taudia imadia amo Amoro taudia e hadareredia dinana ai, Iosua ese Iehova e noia, Israel taudia vairadiai e hereva, eto,
JOS.10.12.english: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

JOS.15.10.motu: Ma Baala lahara kahana amo e heḡeḡe lao, ela bona Seiri ororona; bena learimi ororona (ladana ta be Kesalono) mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bete-semese, bena Timuna badibadina amo ela.
JOS.15.10.english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

JOS.22.1.motu: Bena Iosua ese Ruben bona Gad iduhudia taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e boiridia,
JOS.22.1.english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

JOS.24.20.motu: Iehova boma rakatania bona dirava idaudia isiaidia boma lao heni, ia ese ihanamomui baine hadokoa, ma baine hadikamui.
JOS.24.20.english: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

JOS.5.7.motu: Taunabunai idia natudia, idia ibolodia ai e halaodia taudia, na Iosua ese e peritomedia; badina be dala ai asie peritomedia.
JOS.5.7.english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

JOS.22.15.motu: Idia na Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia dekediai e kau, Gilead tanona ai; bena e hamaorodia, eto,
JOS.22.15.english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

JOS.16.6.motu: Unu amo davara kahana ela; Mikimetata na mirigini kahana ai; ma mairiveina kahana ela, ela bona Taanata-silo, ela bona lanoa mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.16.6.english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

JOS.14.3.motu: A iduhu rua bona iduhu kahana na Mose ese ahudia e henidia Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai. Levi iduhuna na ahuna se henia;
JOS.14.3.english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

JOS.15.48.motu: Ororo kahadia ai, Samiri bona latiri bona Soko,
JOS.15.48.english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

JOS.14.1.motu: Israel taudia na Kanaan tanona ai ahudia e abi herevadia bini: hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia ese tano e haria.
JOS.14.1.english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

JOS.4.24.motu: Taunabunai, tanobada taudia iboudiai bae diba Iehova imana na mai goadana; bona umui danu Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari ela bona hanaihanai.
JOS.4.24.english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”

JOS.14.4.motu: a Iosef garana na iduhu rua, Manase iduhuna bona Efraim iduhuna. Levi taudia na tano ta asie henidia, a bae noholai hanuadia mo e henidia, bona rei gabudia, edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia iubulaidia.
JOS.14.4.english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

JOS.9.5.motu: Tamaka gunadia, vada e bani ḡaudia, bona dabua gunadia, vada e hedare ḡaudia, e dokidia; adia flaoa danu vada e auka bona vada e valavala.
JOS.9.5.english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

JOS.10.21.motu: Una murinai Israel taudia iboudiai na Iosua dekena e lou lao, Makeda taruhana ai e nohova mai mainodia ida; tau ta ese malana se hamarerea, Israel taudia iherevalaidia.
JOS.10.21.english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

JOS.15.13.motu: Iosua ese Kaleb lefune ahuna e henia Iuda iduhuna taudia bogaragidiai, Iehova ese e hagania hegereḡerena. Ia ahuna na Kiriat-araba (hari Araba na Anak tamana), ladana ta be Heberon.
JOS.15.13.english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

JOS.21.35.motu: bona Dimna bona Nahalala, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.35.english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.12.13.motu: Debiri pavapavana, ta; Gedere pavapavana, ta;

JOS.24.24.motu: Hebou taudia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Iehova, eda Dirava, isiaina baia lao heni, ia erena baia kamonai.
JOS.24.24.english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

JOS.18.7.motu: A Levi taudia na asi ahudia umui padamui ai, badina be Iehova ena hahelaḡa taudia ai baela: ahudia bunai. Bona Gad iduhuna bona Ruben iduhuna bona Manase iduhuna kahana ese ahudia vada e abi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henidia gabudia.
JOS.18.7.english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

JOS.1.15.motu: ela bona Iehova ese tadikakamui edia laḡa-ani gabuna baine henidia, umui e henimui heḡereḡerena. Bena idia danu Iehova, emui Dirava, ese be henidiamu tanona bae abia, edia tano ai bae halaoa. Una negana ai, umui emui tano, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henimui tanona Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahan ai, vada ba lou henia bona ba noholaia.
JOS.1.15.english: until Yahweh has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which Yahweh your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

JOS.13.6.motu: Ororo ai e nohomu taudia iboudiai, Lebanon amo ela bona Misirefoto-maimi, Sidono taudia iboudiai, lau ese baina luludia lasi Israel taudia vairadiai. Ḡau tamona, tano na ba haria, Israel taudia ahudia ba henidia.
JOS.13.6.english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

JOS.7.17.motu: luda taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, doḡoro ta ta amo; bena Sera ena doḡoro e heduanai. Sera ena doḡoro taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, ruma ta ta amo; bena Sabdi ena ruma e heduanai.
JOS.7.17.english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

JOS.23.10.motu: Umui ta ese daha ta iluludia mai dibana; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai e tuarimu, e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
JOS.23.10.english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

JOS.21.11.motu: edia hanua ta be Kiriat-araba, Anak tamana Araba ena hanua, Iuda ororodia ai, (ladana ta be Heberon), mai ena rei gabudia ida.
JOS.21.11.english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

JOS.13.18.motu: bona lahasa, bona Kedemoto, bona Mefata;

JOS.13.25.motu: Edia tano na lasere, bona Gilead hanuadia iboudiai, bona Amono taudia edia tano kahana, ela bona Aroere, Raba mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.13.25.english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

JOS.13.2.motu: Dounu mimia tanodia bini: Filistia taudia edia tano iboudiai, bona Gesuru taudia edia tano iboudiai.
JOS.13.2.english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

JOS.8.6.motu: Bena bae havamai; una dala ai hanua amo baia veridia oho dauhai: badina be idia na baeto “Vairada ai e heaumu, vanegai e heau heḡereḡerena”. Taunabunai ai na idia vairadiai baia heau;
JOS.8.6.english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,

JOS.18.20.motu: Mairiveina kahana ai, hetoa na Ioridane sinavaina. Beniamina iduhuna taudia edia tano bunai, edia doḡoro ta ta ai. Unu hetoa Ialodiai do bae noho.
JOS.18.20.english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

JOS.19.25.motu: Edia tano bini: Helkat bona Hali bona Betene bona Akasaf
JOS.19.25.english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

JOS.21.44.motu: Bena Iehova ese laḡa-ani e henidia, edia tano kahadia iboudiai, senedia e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena. Inaidia iboudiai ta ese se laodia ahu diba, badina be Iehova ese inaidia iboudiai na idia imadia ai e atodia.
JOS.21.44.english: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.

JOS.23.5.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine doridia lao, vairamui ai baine luludia lasi; edia tano do bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
JOS.23.5.english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.

JOS.17.6.motu: badina be Manase garana hahinedia na ahudia e abi, mamaruanedia ida. A Manase iduhuna kahana ese Gilead tanona e abia.
JOS.17.6.english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

JOS.22.30.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Fineha bona hanua Iohiadia, Israel ikwaradia taudia, ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase taudia edia hereva e kamonai, bena lalodia e namo.
JOS.22.30.english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

JOS.16.9.motu: Hanua haida danu, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida, Manase taudia edia tano ai, e gwauraidia hidi Efraim taudia edia.
JOS.16.9.english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

JOS.2.20.motu: A emai ḡaukara harina na tau ta boma hamaorolaia, ai na basiama kerere, ina emai ai vada o abia gwauhamatana basia hamomokania negana ai.
JOS.2.20.english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

JOS.18.10.motu: Bena Iosua na Silo ai edia mari e kara, Iehova vairanai. Unuseni ai Iosua ese tano e haria, Israel taudia edia, iduhu ta ta ahudia e henidia.
JOS.18.10.english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

JOS.15.44.motu: bona Keila bona Aksib bona Maresa: hanua taurahani-ta, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.44.english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

JOS.9.9.motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Emu hesiai taudia na gabu daudau amo, Iehova, emui Dirava, ladana dainai vada ama. Badina be ia harina vada a kamonai, bona ena kara iboudiai Aigupto ai e karava sivaraidia;
JOS.9.9.english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

JOS.4.21.motu: Bena ia ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Kerukeru vanegai natumui bae nanadaimui, baeto “Ini nadi anidia be dahaka?”
JOS.4.21.english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

JOS.3.13.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova, tanobada idoinai lohiana, ena maua e huaiamu taudia, aedia palapaladia na Ioridane sinavaina ranuna ai bae turu dobi negana ai, Ioridane sinavaina ena aru baine doko, bona sinavai dorina amo e maimu ranudia na bae gini tao.
JOS.3.13.english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

JOS.1.11.motu: Taruha amo ba raka hanai, taunimanima ba haḡanidia, baoto “Amui dala lakwana bavabia heḡaeḡae, badina be dina toi basie ore ai na ina Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese be henimuimu tanona ai ba raka vareai, bona bavabia emui tano.”
JOS.1.11.english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.’”

JOS.15.23.motu: bona Kede bona Hasoro bona Itnan,

JOS.8.29.motu: Bena ia ese Ai pavapavana e alaia mase, au ta ai e taua dae ela bona adorahi. Dina e diho, bena Iosua ese e haḡanidia dainai haida ese mase tauna na au amo e abia dobi, hanua ikoukouna ai e atoa diho; bena nadi e senu senu kau ia latanai. Una senusenu badana na doini mia, ema bona harihari.
JOS.8.29.english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

JOS.14.2.motu: Iharina na mari amo, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, iduhu taurahani-ta bona iduhu kahana edia.
JOS.14.2.english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

JOS.2.23.motu: Bena raruosi na ororo amo e hekei, sinavai e hanaia, Iosua Nunu dekenai e kau. Bena edia laolao sivaraina idoinai e hamaorolaia.
JOS.2.23.english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

JOS.3.11.motu: A kamonai: tanobada idoinai Lohiana ena taravatu mauana ese baine gunalaimui, Ioridane sinavaina ai.
JOS.3.11.english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

JOS.9.16.motu: Dina toi vada ela, una herohemaino karana murinai, bena sivaraidia e kamonai, idia na dekedia taudia, bona badidiai e nohomu.
JOS.9.16.english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

JOS.5.13.motu: Ieriko badibadinai Iosua na e roha isi, tau ta e itaia, dare e veria lasi imana ai. Bena Iosua ese e raka henia kahi, e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ai ida, eiava inaimai?
JOS.5.13.english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

JOS.18.11.motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna oreana na Beniamina iduhuna, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: edia tano na Iuda iduhuna bona Iosef iduhuna edia tano padadiai.
JOS.18.11.english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

JOS.12.17.motu: Tapua pavapavana, ta; Hefere pavapavana, ta;

JOS.1.2.motu: Egu hesiai tauna Mose vada e mase; taunabunai, a tore isi, ina Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, oi bona ina bese idoinai, hari Israel taudia na henidiamu tanona ai ba raka vareai.
JOS.1.2.english: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

JOS.7.14.motu: Taunabunai, kerukeru daba ai baoma, iduhu ta ta amo ba raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia iduhuna na doḡoro ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia doḡorona na ruma ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia rumana be ruma taudia na ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira.
JOS.7.14.english: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects shall come near by families. The family which Yahweh selects shall come near by households. The household which Yahweh selects shall come near man by man.

JOS.13.3.motu: Sihoro, Aigupto mairiveina kahana tanona, amo mirigini kahana e laomu ela bona Ekron hetoana na Kanaan taudia edia tano e tomamu. Filistia lohiadia na laima: Gasa lohiana, Asdod lohiana, Askelono Iohiana, Gata lohiana, bona Ekron lohiana. Avim taudia edia tano danu do asio abia.
JOS.13.3.english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

JOS.17.11.motu: Isakara taudia bona Asere taudia edia tano ai ini hanua na Manase taudia edia: Bete-seana mai ena hanua maragidia ida; Ibleam mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Doro mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; En-doro mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Taanak mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Megido mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; ororo toiosi hanuadia bunu.
JOS.17.11.english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

JOS.21.18.motu: bona Anatoto bona Alamon, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.18.english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.21.17.motu: Ma Beniamina iduhuna amo e abi hanuadia be Gibeon bona Geba, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.17.english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

JOS.4.1.motu: Bese idoinai ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia vaitani, bena Iehova ese Iosua e hagania, eto,
JOS.4.1.english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

JOS.12.16.motu: Makeda pavapavana, ta; Betele pavapavana, ta;

JOS.18.28.motu: Sela; Ha-elaf; Iebusu (ladana ta be Ierusalem); Gibea; Kiriat-iearimi: hanua gwauta-hani, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida. Beniamina taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.18.28.english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

JOS.16.3.motu: Bena lahara kahana ela, ela bona laflete taudia edia tano hetoana; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Bete-horono henu hanuana hetoana; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Gesere. Unu amo e lasi, kone ai e hadoko.
JOS.16.3.english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

JOS.6.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, Ieriko hanuana na oi imamu ai vada na atoa, mai pavapavana bona mai ena tuari oreana ida.
JOS.6.2.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

JOS.15.14.motu: Bena Kaleb ese Anak garana tatoi unu amo e luludia lasi, Sesai bona Ahiman bona Talmai.
JOS.15.14.english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

JOS.13.15.motu: Mose ese Ruben iduhuna taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
JOS.13.15.english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

JOS.2.14.motu: Raruosi ese e haere henia, eto, Ai emai mauri davana na oiemu mauri. Emai ḡaukara harina basio hapiua, bena ai ese hebogahisi bona kara momokani baia hahedinarai henimu, Iehova ese ina tano baine henimai negana ai.
JOS.2.14.english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

JOS.4.22.motu: umui ese natumui ba hadibadia, baoto “Israel na ina Ioridane sinavaina amo e raka hanai, tano kaukauna ai”.
JOS.4.22.english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

JOS.10.36.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Eglon amo ela, Heberon ai e kau, e tuari henia;
JOS.10.36.english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

JOS.10.10.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hagaridia, Israel taudia vairadiai; bena Israel taudia ese hutuma bada e aladia mase Gibeon ai, bona oredia e hahavadia lao, Bete-horono e dae lao dalana ai, heaudia ai e aladia mase, ela bona Aseka bona Makeda.
JOS.10.10.english: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

JOS.15.9.motu: Una ororo dorina amo tano hetoana Ina ela, ela bona Nefetoa ranudia; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Efron ororona hanuadia; unu amo e hegeḡe lao, ela bona Baala (ia ladana ta be Kiriatiearimi).
JOS.15.9.english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

JOS.4.3.motu: ba haḡanidia, baoto “Nadi gwauta-rua Ioridane bogaraginai, hahelaḡa taudia e gini gabuna amo, bavabidia, ba huadia lao, hari hanuaboi ba taruha gabuna ai bavatodia”.
JOS.4.3.english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

JOS.19.50.motu: Iehova ena hahedua dainai idia ese ia e noilaia hanuana e henia, ladana na Timnata-sera, Efraim ororo-tanodia ai. Ia ese hanua ma e hadaia lou, bena e noholaia.
JOS.19.50.english: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

JOS.12.6.motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose bona Israel taudia ese e hadareredia; bena Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese idia raruosi edia tano e abi, Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e henidia, edia tano ai bae halaoa.
JOS.12.6.english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

JOS.8.23.motu: A Ai pavapavana na e abia mauri, Iosua dekena e hakaua lao.
JOS.8.23.english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.

JOS.19.39.motu: Napatali taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia.
JOS.19.39.english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

JOS.10.28.motu: Una dina ai Iosua ese Makeda e abia, e habuaia tari; hanua pavapavana e alaia mase, bona hanua taudia iboudiai e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Ieriko pavapavana e kara henia heḡereḡerena, Makeda pavapavana danu unu e kara henia toma.
JOS.10.28.english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

JOS.5.8.motu: Bese idoinai e peritomedia murinai, idia na edia taruha ai e nohova ela bona hisihisi vada e ore.
JOS.5.8.english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

JOS.12.22.motu: Kede pavapavana, ta; Iokoneam pavapavana (Iokoneam be Karamele ai), ta;

JOS.5.1.motu: Amoro pavapavadia iboudiai Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Iahara kahana ai, e nohova, bona Kanaan taudia edia pavapava iboudiai, kone kahana ai e nohova, na harina e kamonai, Iehova ese Ioridane sinavaina e hakororoa Israel taudia ediai ela bona idia vada e hanaia, bena kudoudia e hetaha bona laumadia e daure, Israel taudia daidiai.
JOS.5.1.english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

JOS.24.3.motu: Bena senemui Abraham na sinavai unukahana amo na abia, Kanaan tanona idoinai na hakaua hanai, natuna momo na henia; Isaak danu na henia,
JOS.24.3.english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

JOS.21.16.motu: bona Ain bona luta bona Bete-semese, mai edia rei gabudia ida. Unu iduhu ruaosi edia amo e abi hanuadia na taurahani-ta.
JOS.21.16.english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

JOS.8.18.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Io na imamu ai ba toia roro, Ai ba dudui henia; badina be oi imamu ai baina atoa kau. Taunabunai Iosua ese ena io na imana ai e toia roro, hanua e dudui henia.
JOS.8.18.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.”

JOS.4.2.motu: Iduhu gwauta-rua amo tatau ta ta amo bavabidia;
JOS.4.2.english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

JOS.4.15.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto,

JOS.10.5.motu: Bena Amoro pavapavadia laimaosi, Ierusalem pavapavana bona Heberon pavapavana bona Iaramutu pavapavana bona Lakisi pavapavana bona Eglon pavapavana, e hebou, edia tuari oreadia iboudiai e hakaudia lao, Gibeon vairanai e taruha, e tuari henia.
JOS.10.5.english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

JOS.21.40.motu: Levi taudia oredia, Merari oreana taudia, edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta-rua.
JOS.21.40.english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

JOS.5.4.motu: Iosua ese e peritomedia badina binai: Aigupto amo e raka lasi mamaruanedia iboudiai, tuari taudia iboudiai, na dala ai vada e mase, tano ḡaḡaena ai, Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai.
JOS.5.4.english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

JOS.9.1.motu: Ioridane sinavaina unukahana pavapavadia iboudiai, ororo ai bona taora ai, ela bona Davara Badana konena Lebanon kahana ai, Hiti bona Amoro bona Kanaan bona Perisi bona Hivi bona Iebusu taudia edia pavapava, ese una hari e kamonai;
JOS.9.1.english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

JOS.13.17.motu: Hesebon danu edia, mai ena taora hanuadia iboudiai; bona Dibon, bona Bamoto-baal, bona Bete-baal-meono;
JOS.13.17.english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

JOS.18.13.motu: Unu amo hetoa na diho kahana ela, Lusu (ladana ta be Betele) e lao henia, bena Lusu ororona nesena amo ela; unu amo e diho ela, ela bona Ataroto-adara, Bete-horono henu hanuana diho kahana ororona ai.
JOS.18.13.english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

JOS.4.19.motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwautana ai Israel taudia na Ioridane sinavaina amo e dae ela, Gilgal ai e taruha, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.4.19.english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

JOS.2.16.motu: E hamaorodia, eto, Ororo kahadia baola, e tahumuimu taudia bae davarimui na garina. Dina toi unuseni ai ba komu, ela bona e tahumuimu taudia bae lou mai; una murinai emui ura dalana ai ba raka.
JOS.2.16.english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

JOS.2.5.motu: bena dina e diho ai, hanua ikoukouna bae koua negana ai, idia na e raka lasi. Ede ela na asi dibagu; a idia muridia amo baola haraḡa, bona ba halasidia tao.
JOS.2.5.english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

JOS.14.14.motu: Taunabunai Heberon na Kaleb lefune, Kenisi tauna, ena tano, ema bona harihari, badina be ia ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, e badinaia tarika-tarika.
JOS.14.14.english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

JOS.10.35.motu: una dina ai e abia, e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, Lakisi ai e karaia heḡereḡerena.
JOS.10.35.english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

JOS.16.8.motu: Tapua amo lahara kahana ma ela, ela bona Kana Dokana; unu amo kone ai e hadoko. Efraim taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta amo e abi.
JOS.16.8.english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

JOS.7.10.motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, dahaka dainai ene e goru diho tomamu?
JOS.7.10.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?

JOS.14.5.motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na unu e kara toma: tano na e haria.
JOS.14.5.english: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

JOS.4.6.motu: Ina na toa ai bainela bogaragimui ai. Bena kerukeru vanegai natumui ese bae nanadaimui, baeto “Ini nadi anidia be dahaka?”
JOS.4.6.english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

JOS.15.57.motu: bona Kain bona Gibea bona Timuna: hanua gwauta mai edia hanua maragidia ida.
JOS.15.57.english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

JOS.1.17.motu: Ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Mose a kamonai heniava na heto, oi danu baia kamonai henimu; bona Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine bamomu, Mose e bamoava heḡereḡerena.
JOS.1.17.english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

JOS.22.8.motu: eto, Emui noho gabudia ba lou lao, mai kohumui logora ida: boromakau momo herea, bona silver, bona gold, bona auri labora-labora, bona auri, bona dabua momo. Ḡau tamona, tuari ai o abi kohudia na varavaramui ida ba heharilai heheni.
JOS.22.8.english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

JOS.12.1.motu: Hanua pavapavadia una tano ai, Israel taudia ese e hadareredia bona edia tano e abi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, Aranon kourana ela bona Heremon ororona bona Araba taorana idoinai mairiveina kahana ai, ladadia bini.
JOS.12.1.english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

JOS.4.18.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na Ioridane sinavaina bogaragina amo e dae; bena aedia na tano kaukauna ai e kau negana ai, Ioridane sinavaina ma e aru lou, abata ma e lasi, gunaguna heḡereḡerena.
JOS.4.18.english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

JOS.15.61.motu: Tano ḡaḡaena ai, Bet-araba bona Midin bona Sekaka,
JOS.15.61.english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

JOS.10.2.motu: Bena e gari dikadika; badina be Gibeon na hanua badana, pavapava ta ena hanua na heto; ia ese Ai e hereaiava, bona hanua taudia iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia.
JOS.10.2.english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

JOS.3.10.motu: Iosua ma eto, Ini amo vada ba diba Mauri Diravana na umui bogaragimui ai e nohomu; momokani, ia ese Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Girigasa taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Iebusu taudia na vairamui ai baine luludia lasi.
JOS.3.10.english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

JOS.24.18.motu: Iehova ese danu taunimanima iboudiai na ita vairadai e luludia lasi, Amoro taudia una tano ai e nohova ibouboudiai e luludia lasi. Taunabunai ai danu Iehova isiaina baia lao heni, badina be ia na emai Dirava.
JOS.24.18.english: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

JOS.22.11.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese harina e kamonai: haida eto, A itaia, Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia ese ihaboulaina patana ta vada e larebaia, Kanaan tanona hetoana ai. Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Israel taumui emui tano lalonai.
JOS.22.11.english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

JOS.20.9.motu: Hanua bunu idia ese e gwauraidia, Israel taudia iboudiai edia, bona noho hedoa tauna ena: hapadidi tauna na unuseni ai baine heau maun, mase tauna varavarana ese baine alaia mase na garina, ela bona hebou vairanai baine gini.
JOS.20.9.english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

JOS.21.3.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese idia ahudia amo Levi taudia edia hanua bona edia rei gabudia e henidia, Iehova ena haheḡani heḡeregerena. Gabudia bini:
JOS.21.3.english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.

JOS.13.32.motu: Taunimanima ahudia bini Mose ese e hari, Moab taoradia ai, Ioridane unukahana ai, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.13.32.english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

JOS.13.31.motu: Gilead kahana danu idia edia, bona Astaroto bona Edrei, Og ena basileia hanuadia Basan ai: unu na Makiri Manase garana e henidia, Makiri iduhuna kahana taudia ahudia, edia doḡoro ta ta ai e abi.
JOS.13.31.english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

JOS.8.1.motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Basio gari; kudoumu basine hetaha. Tuari taudia iboudiai avabidia; a tore isi, Ai hanuana baola. A itaia, lau ese Ai pavapavana bona ena orea taudia bona ena hanua bona ena tano vada na henimu; idia na oi imamu ai.
JOS.8.1.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

JOS.15.49.motu: bona Dana bona Kiriata-sana (ladana ta be Debiri),

JOS.19.10.motu: E duanaia oreana ihatoina na Sebulun iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai. Edia tano e abia ela bona Saridi.
JOS.19.10.english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

JOS.19.47.motu: A Dan taudia edia tano na edia amo e heabi oho: bena e tore isi, Leseme taudia e tuari henidia. Hanua na e abia, bona hanua taudia e aladia ore; bena edia hanua ai e halaoa, e noholaia, bona ladana e hatoa Leseme-dan, senedia e nemaia.
JOS.19.47.english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

JOS.24.19.motu: A Iosua ese hebou taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova isiaina basio lao heni diba; badina be ia na Dirava helaḡana, vageḡe Diravana; ia na emui kara dika bona emui kara havara basine gwaudia tao.
JOS.24.19.english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

JOS.24.1.motu: Iosua ese Israel iduhudia iboudiai e haboudia Sekem ai, bona edia tau-badadia bona edia hanua lohiadia bona edia hahemaoro taudia bona edia heitatao taudia e boiridia. Bena idia na Dirava vairanai e gini.
JOS.24.1.english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

JOS.1.3.motu: Aemui palapaladia bae moi tao tanodia iboudiai baina henimui, Mose na gwau henia hamata heḡereḡerena.
JOS.1.3.english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

JOS.1.14.motu: Adavamui bona natumui maraḡidia bona emui boromakau na hari Mose e henimui tanona ai bae noho, Ioridane sinavaina inikahana ai; a tuari mai dibamui taumui iboumui ai na emui tuari ḡaudia bavabi kau, tadikakamui vairadiai ba raka hanai, ba durudia,
JOS.1.14.english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

JOS.21.34.motu: Levi taudia oredia, Merari oreana taudia, ese Sebulun iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be lokoneam bona Karata, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.34.english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

JOS.24.21.motu: Hebou taudia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Lasi, ai na Iehova isiaina baia lao heni.
JOS.24.21.english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

JOS.15.53.motu: bona lanim bona Bete-tapua bona Afeka,

JOS.22.3.motu: Varavaramui asio rakatanidia dina momo Ialodiai ema bona hari ina dina ai. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena hahedua vada o badinaia.
JOS.22.3.english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.

JOS.8.15.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese e koidia, e kara vada e darere na heto, bena e heau, tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao.
JOS.8.15.english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

JOS.21.23.motu: Dan iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Elteke bona Gibeton, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.23.english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

JOS.21.24.motu: bona Aialono bona Gata-rimon, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.24.english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

JOS.4.8.motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iosua ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e karaia: nadi gwauta-rua Ioridane sinavaina bogaragina amo e abidia, Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi toadia, Iehova ese Iosua e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Bena e huadia lao, edia taruha gabuna ai e atodia diho.
JOS.4.8.english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

JOS.10.30.motu: Bena Iehova ese Libna danu, mai pavapavana ida, Israel taudia imadia ai e atodia. Bena e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Ieriko pavapavana e kara henia heḡereḡerena, Libna pavapavana danu unu e kara henia toma.
JOS.10.30.english: Yahweh delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

JOS.9.13.motu: Ini vine ranuna kopidia danu, a hahonudia negana ai idia na mamatamata; a itaia, harihari idia na vada e hedare patapata. Emai dabua bona emai tamaka danu vada e dika, dala daudau amo vada ama dainai.
JOS.9.13.english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

JOS.24.7.motu: Bena tamamui ese Iehova e tai henia negana ai, ia ese umui bona Aigupto taudia padadia e havaburaia, davara amo e habubunidia. Aigupto ede na kara henia toma na matamui ese e itaia. Murinai tano ḡaḡaena ai o nohova, nega daudau.
JOS.24.7.english: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
