JOS.6.8.motu: Iosua ese taunimanima vada e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, hahelaḡa taudia hahituosi ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hituosi e abi, Iehova vairanai; bena e raka lao, kibi e hiriri. Idia muridiai Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia.
JOS.6.8.english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.

JOS.12.9.motu: Pavapava bini: Ieriko pavapavana, ta; Ai pavapavana (Ai be Betele badibadinai), ta;

JOS.9.6.english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

JOS.23.12.motu: Badina be boma raka muri, ini bese kwabukwabudia doini bogaragimui ai e nohomu ida boma hetura, edia ulato boma adavadia, bona emui ulato boma henidia bae adavadia,
JOS.23.12.english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

JOS.19.27.motu: Una amo mairiveina kahana amo ela, ela bona Bete-dagon bona Sebulun bona Iftahele kourana; ma mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bet-emek bona Neiele; ma mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Kabulu
JOS.19.27.english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

JOS.5.6.motu: Badina be Israel taudia na laḡani hari-ahui tano ḡaḡaena ai e loaloava, ela bona bese idoinai, tuari taudia Aigupto amo e raka lasi iboudiai, na e mase ore; badina be idia na Iehova erena asie kamonai. Bena Iehova ese e gwau henidia hamata, senedia e gwau henidia hamata baine henida eto tanoml, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, na basine haheitalaidia eto.
JOS.5.6.english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

JOS.8.22.motu: Bena hari orea ta ma hanua amo e raka lasi, e tuan henidia; taunabunai Israel taudia na kahana kahana ai, idia na ihua-pada ai. Bena Israel ese e hadareredia, ta se mauri bona ta se heau.
JOS.8.22.english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

JOS.8.35.english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

JOS.16.1.motu: Iosef garana edia tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina, Ieriko badibadinai, Ieriko ranu gabudia mairiveina kahana ai, amo e matamaia; tano ḡaḡaena ela, bena ororo kahadia amo ela, Ieriko amo ela bona Betele.
JOS.16.1.english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

JOS.9.26.motu: Taunabunai ia ese Israel taudia imadia amo e hamauridia; asie aladia mase.
JOS.9.26.english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

JOS.17.1.motu: Manase iduhuna taudia ese ahudia e abi; hari Manase na Iosef natuna roboana. Makiri be Manase natuna roboana bona Gilead tamana: ia ese Gilead tanona bona Basan tanona e abi, badina be ia na tuari tauna.
JOS.17.1.english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

JOS.13.5.motu: bona Gebala taudia edia tano, bona Lebanon tanona idoinai, mairiveina kahana ai, Baal-gad amo, Heremon ororona badi-tanona ai, ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina.
JOS.13.5.english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

JOS.21.7.english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

JOS.15.35.motu: bona laramutu bona Adulama bona Soko bona Aseka,

JOS.24.25.english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

JOS.8.21.motu: Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese e itaia, e komu oreana ese hanua vada e abia, bona hanua e doua kwalahuna na e daeva, bena idia na e lou, Ai taudia e hadareredia.
JOS.8.21.english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

JOS.6.1.motu: Ieriko hanuana na e hekou ahu, Israel laudia daidiai; ta se raka lasi, bona ta se raka vareai.
JOS.6.1.english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

JOS.3.9.english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

JOS.10.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Idia garidia basio gari, badina be oi imamu ai vada na atodia; idia ta oi vairamu ai basine gini.
JOS.10.8.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

JOS.21.1.motu: Iduhu ikwaradia taudia Levi iduhuna amo na hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia dekedia ela,
JOS.21.1.english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

JOS.10.42.motu: Hanua pavapavadia iboudiai e abidia, bona edia tano danu una nega tamona ai e abidia vaitani; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na Israel edia tuari ai e tuariva.
JOS.10.42.english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

JOS.12.18.motu: Afek pavapavana, ta: Lasarono pavapavana, ta;

JOS.4.7.motu: umui na ba hadibadia, baoto “Ioridane sinavaina na Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai e kororo; Ioridane amo e huaia hanai negana ai, ranu na e kororo”. Bena ini nadi na Israel taudia edia helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, ela bona hanaihanai.
JOS.4.7.english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

JOS.10.4.motu: Dekegu aoma, ba durugu, Gibeon baita tuari henia; badina be idia na Iosua bona Israel taudia ida vada e herohemaino.
JOS.10.4.english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

JOS.1.9.motu: Vada na haḡanimu, ani, ba goada bona ba haheauka. Basio gari, daramu basine doko; badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e bamomumu, emu laolao iboudiai lalodiai.
JOS.1.9.english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

JOS.21.27.motu: Gereson oreana taudia, Levi taudia, ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Golan, Basan tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Be-estera, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua rua.
JOS.21.27.english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

JOS.6.13.motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia hahituosi ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hituosi e abi, Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai e raka, kibi e hiriri loulou. Vairadiai tuari taudia e raka; Iehova ena maua helaḡana murinai orea taudia e raka; kibi e hiriri loulou.
JOS.6.13.english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of Yahweh’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after Yahweh’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.

JOS.10.15.motu: Bena Iosua na Israel taudia iboudiai ida e lou ela, Gilgal taruhana e lou henia.
JOS.10.15.english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

JOS.12.19.motu: Madon pavapavana, ta; Hasoro pavapavana, ta;

JOS.6.6.english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”

JOS.13.30.english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

JOS.19.11.motu: Unu amo hetoana na lahara kahana ai ela, ela bona Mareala, ma ela bona Dabesete; unu amo sinavai maraḡina isena amo ela, Iokoneam mairiveina kahana ai.
JOS.19.11.english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

JOS.7.12.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia na inaidia vairadiai asi gini dibadia, bena vada e heau; badina be idia danu vada na revadia mase. Lau na basina bamomui lou, ela bona hari na gwau ahu ḡaudia na bogaragimui amo bavabidia oho, ba ha-oredia vaitani.
JOS.7.12.english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.

JOS.20.5.motu: Mase tauna varavarana ese bema ḡavaia, hapadidi tauna na basie henia; badina be ia ese dekena tauna e hapadidia, dia badu dainai se alaia mase.
JOS.20.5.english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

JOS.9.14.motu: Bena Israel taudia na edia aniani taidia taidia e ani; Iehova ena hahedua asie tahua.
JOS.9.14.english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.

JOS.3.4.motu: Uno amo emui raka dalana ba diba, badina be ina dala amo nega hata asio raka. A maua helaḡana basio raka henia kahi; umui bona ia padamui na kiubit daha rua sisivana bae mia.
JOS.3.4.english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

JOS.7.8.motu: Ḡaubada e, Israel na inaidia vairadiai vada e heau; lau na ede baina hereva toma?
JOS.7.8.english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?

JOS.22.12.motu: Israel taudia ese una hari e kamonai, bena iboudiai na Silo ai e hebou, bae tuari henidia eto.
JOS.22.12.english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

JOS.7.9.motu: Badina be Kanaan taudia bona ina tano ai e nohomu besedia iboudiai ese harina vada e kamonai, bena bae ḡeḡemai ahu, ai ladamai na tanobada ai bae kokia oho. Bena oi ladamu herea-daena na ede ba tomaia?
JOS.7.9.english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”

JOS.15.20.motu: Iuda iduhuna taudia ahudia bini, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.15.20.english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

JOS.6.27.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Iosua e bamoa; ia harina na tano idoinai e piua.
JOS.6.27.english: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

JOS.22.16.motu: Iehova ena orea idoinai ini e gwau tomamu: Ina kerere vada o havaraia anina be dahaka? Israel Diravana enai vada o kerere; hari dina ai Iehova ena amo vada o raka oho, vada o gwau edeede henia, ihaboulaina patana vada o larebaia.
JOS.22.16.english: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?

JOS.17.16.motu: Iosef iduhuna taudia ma eto, Ororo kahadia na dia heḡereḡere ai emai ai; a Kanaan taudia taora ai e nohomu na mai edia auri kariotadia; Bete-seana mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia, bona Iesrele kourana ai e nohomu taudia danu.
JOS.17.16.english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

JOS.19.16.motu: Sebulun taudia ahudia bunu, edia dogoro ta ta ai: unu hanua e abi, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.16.english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

JOS.11.13.motu: A Israel taudia na ororo komutadia doridia ai e hadai hanuadia asie doudia; tamona mo, Hasoro, Iosua ese e doua.
JOS.11.13.english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

JOS.22.17.motu: Eda kara dika Peoro ai dia bada a? Ena be Iehova ena orea latanai hisihisi e kau, to una dika amo do asita ḡoeva.
JOS.22.17.english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,

JOS.15.1.motu: Iuda iduhuna taudia na ahudia e abi, edia doḡoro ta ta ai. Edia tano na diho kahana e laomu, ela bona Edom hetoana bona Sin tano ḡagaena, diho kahana korikori ai.
JOS.15.1.english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

JOS.8.16.motu: Bena Ai taudia iboudiai e heau hebou, bae hahavadia totona; bena idia ese Iosua e havaia, hanua na e rakatania.
JOS.8.16.english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

JOS.15.46.motu: bona Ekron amo ela bona davara, Asdod kahana hanuadia iboudiai mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.46.english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

JOS.13.7.motu: Taunabunai ina tano ba haria, iduhu taurahani-ta bona Manase iduhuna kahana na ahudia ba henidia.
JOS.13.7.english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

JOS.16.4.motu: Iosef natuna, Manase bona Efraim, ese ahudia e abi.
JOS.16.4.english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

JOS.7.25.motu: Bena Iosua eto, Dahaka dainai vada o hahekwarahimai? Hari dina ai Iehova ese oi e hahekwarahimumu.
JOS.7.25.english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

JOS.12.10.motu: Ierusalem pavapavana, ta; Heberon pavapavana, ta;

JOS.8.17.motu: Ai bona Betele lalodiai tau ta dia noho; asi tauna ta Israel se havadia. I lanua na hekehona ai e rakatania, idia e havadia lao.
JOS.8.17.english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

JOS.11.18.motu: Iosua ese nega daudau unu pavapava e tuari henidia.
JOS.11.18.english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

JOS.15.34.motu: bona Sanoa bona En-ganim bona Tapua bona Enam,

JOS.19.46.motu: Meiakon; Rakon; bona lopa kahana tanodia.
JOS.19.46.english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

JOS.13.8.motu: A Manase iduhuna kahana na Ruben bona Gad iduhudia ida ahudia vada e abi guna; Mose ese e henidia, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai. Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henidia:
JOS.13.8.english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:

JOS.21.6.motu: Gereson ena orea taudia ese hanua gwauta-toi mari amo e abidia, Isakara bona Asere bona Napatali iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana edia tano lalodiai, Basan ai.
JOS.21.6.english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

JOS.10.25.motu: Iosua ma e hamaorodia, eto, Basio gari, kudoumui na basie hetaha; ba goada, ba haheauka, badina be Iehova ese inaimui iboudiai ini baine karadia toma, ba tuari henidia negadia ai.
JOS.10.25.english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

JOS.10.26.motu: Una murinai, Iosua ese laimaosi e aladia mase, au auima ai e taudia dae; e hetau dae ela bona dina e diho.
JOS.10.26.english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

JOS.10.34.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Lakisi amo ela, Eglon ai e kau; e koua heḡeḡe bona e tuari henia;
JOS.10.34.english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

JOS.1.16.motu: Bena idia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Vada o haḡanilaimai karadia iboudiai baia kara, bona ba siaimai gabudia baiala.
JOS.1.16.english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

JOS.24.6.motu: Tamamui na Aigupto amo na hakaudia lasi; bena kone ai o lasi; bena Aigupto taudia ese tamamui e ḡavadia, mai edia kariota bona mai edia hosigui taudia, ela bona Davara Kakakakana.
JOS.24.6.english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

JOS.4.9.motu: A Iosua na nadi gwauta-rua e abidia, Ioridane bogaraginai e haginidia, hahelaḡa taudia, hari taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, e gini gabuna. Idia na mimia ema bona hari dina.
JOS.4.9.english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

JOS.9.20.motu: A ini baita karadia toma: baita hamauridia, badu ita edai baine kau na garina, badina be ai ese a gwau henidia hamata.
JOS.9.20.english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

JOS.2.17.motu: Raruosi ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ai na a uramu ai na basia kerere, ina gwau-hamata emai ai vada o abia na basia hakererea.
JOS.2.17.english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

JOS.14.11.motu: Hari dina ai egu goada na doini mia, Mose ese e siaigu dinana ai heḡereḡerena; tuari ai eiava lao mai ai egu goada na heḡereḡere, unu dina ai bona hari ina dina ai danu.
JOS.14.11.english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

JOS.5.15.motu: Iehova ena tuari oreana lohiana ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Emu tamaka na aemu amo a koki oho, badina be o ginimu gabuna na tano helaḡana. Bena Iosua na unu e kara toma.
JOS.5.15.english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.

JOS.19.38.motu: Irono, Migdalele, Horeme, Bet-anata, Bete-seme. Hanua iboudiai na gwauta taurahani-ta, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.19.38.english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

JOS.6.3.motu: Hanua ba rakaia heḡeḡe, mai tuari oreana idoinai ida, nega hatamona. Dina ta ta amo unu ba kara toma, ela bona dina tauratoi bae ore.
JOS.6.3.english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

JOS.15.60.motu: Kiriata-baal danu (ia ladana ta be Kiriat-ieanmi), bona Raba: hanua rua mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.60.english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

JOS.7.3.motu: Bena idia na e dae ela, Ai hanuana e hasinadoa. Bena idia na e lou, Iosua dekenai, e hamaoroa, eto, Taunimanima iboudiai na basiela; daha rua eiava daha toi mo baela, Ai hanuana bae tuari henia. Iboudiai na basio hahekwarahidia, basio siaidia; badina be hanua maraḡina mo.
JOS.7.3.english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”

JOS.8.20.motu: Taunabunai, Ai taudia na e roha kerehai, hanua e doua kwalahuna guba ai e dae e itaia. Bena asi edia heau dalana ta; badina be tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao taudia na ma e lou, e havadia taudia ma e lou henidia.
JOS.8.20.english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.

JOS.11.17.motu: Halak ororona amo, Seiri kahana ai, ela bona Baal-gad, Lebanon kourana ai, Heremon ororona baditanona ai. Hanua pavapavadia iboudiai e hadareredia bona e aladia mase.
JOS.11.17.english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

JOS.22.19.motu: Emui tano basinema ḡoeva, boma hanai, Iehova ena tano, ena dubu e ginimu tanona, lalonai ahumui boma abi, ai bogaragimai ai. A Iehova basio gwau edeede henia, bona ai danu gwau-edeede taudia ai basio halaomai; ihaboulaina patana idauna ta, dia Iehova, eda Dirava, ena, basio larebaia.
JOS.22.19.english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.

JOS.17.7.motu: Manase taudia edia tano hetoana na Asere amo ela, ela bona Mikimetata, Sekem mairiveina kahana ai. Unu amo ia na diho kahana ela, ela bona En-tapua taudia edia tano.
JOS.17.7.english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

JOS.23.14.motu: Lau na tanobada taudia iboudiai e lao bubunimu dalana amo ba laomu. Umui iboumui ai vada o diba, lalomui ai bona laumamui ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena gwau-hamata namodia iboudiai emui ai vada e hamomokanidia, ta se reaia. Iboudiai vada e momokani, ta se moru.
JOS.23.14.english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

JOS.13.29.motu: Mose ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
JOS.13.29.english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

JOS.21.30.motu: Asere iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Misala, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Abdon, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.30.english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

JOS.2.18.motu: Taunabunai, ai na ina tano lalonai baiama negana ai, ina varo kakakakana na o tumai dobi gaba-mauruna ai ba kwatua kau. Tamamu bona sinamu bona taihumu bona tamamu ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ruma lalonai ba haboudia.
JOS.2.18.english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

JOS.8.19.motu: Bena imana e toia roro negana ai, hari e komu oreana na edia komu gabuna amo e tore isi haraḡa, e heau lao, hanua lalonai e heau vareai, vada e abia; bena maoromaoro e doua.
JOS.8.19.english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

JOS.19.35.motu: Hanua mai maḡudia bini: Sidim, Sere, Hamat, Rakata, Kinerete,
JOS.19.35.english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

JOS.22.18.motu: Matona, hari dina ai Iehova ena amo ba raka oho a? Hari dina ai umui ese Iehova o gwau edeede heniamu; kerukeru ia ese Israel besena idoinai baine badu henida.
JOS.22.18.english: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

JOS.15.40.motu: bona Kabon bona Lahamam bona Kitilisi,

JOS.13.23.motu: Ruben iduhuna taudia edia tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina isena. Ruben iduhuna taudia ahudia bunu, edia deḡoro ta ta amo bona edia hanua badadia bona maraḡidia ta ta amo e abi.
JOS.13.23.english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

JOS.9.15.motu: Bena Iosua na idia ida e herohemaino bona e gwau hamata, basine aladia mase eto. Hebou ikwarana taudia danu unu e gwau hamata toma.
JOS.9.15.english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

JOS.15.54.motu: bona Humuta bona Kiriat-araba (ladana ta be Heberon), bona Sioro: hanua taurahani-ta mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
JOS.15.54.english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

JOS.23.6.motu: Taunabunai ba haheauka, Mose ena taravatu bukana ai e tore herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia; iena amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
JOS.23.6.english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

JOS.11.6.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Idia garidia basio gari; badina be kerukeru hora inihetomana ai lau ese imamui ai baina atodia, iboudiai na bae mase ore Israel vairadiai: edia hosi aedia varovarodia ba utu, bona edia kariota na lahi ai ba doudia.
JOS.11.6.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

JOS.2.7.motu: Taunabunai e tahudia taudia ese Ioridane dalana ai e tahudia lao, ela bona turu-hanai gabudia. E tahudia ela, bena hanua ikoukouna vada e koua ahu.
JOS.2.7.english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

JOS.15.3.motu: Akrabim e dae henia tanona diho kahana amo ela, ela bona Sin; unu amo Kade-baranea diho kahana amo bona Hesron badibadina amo ela, ela bona Adara. Unu amo Karaka e lao henia,
JOS.15.3.english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

JOS.11.15.motu: Iehova ese ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Mose ese Iosua ma e hagania, bena Iosua na unu e kara toma. Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia karadia iboudiai Iosua ese e kara; ta se reaia.
JOS.11.15.english: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

JOS.7.11.motu: Israel vada e kerere, egu taravatu, na gwaurai henidia ḡauna, vada e tataia utu; vada na gwau ahu ḡaudia idia ese vada e abidia; vada e henao, vada e koikoi, unu ḡau na edia kohu lalodiai vada e hunidia.
JOS.7.11.english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.

JOS.15.2.motu: Edia tano hetoana diho kahana ai na Tadi Gohuna dokona, diho kahana e vaira henia taberona amo ela.
JOS.15.2.english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

JOS.21.28.motu: Isakara iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Kision, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Daberata, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.28.english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

JOS.16.2.motu: Betele amo ma ela, ela bona Lusu, ma unu amo ela, ela bona Ataroto: Araki taudia edia tano hetoana bunai.
JOS.16.2.english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

JOS.2.11.motu: A kamonai negana di kudoumai e hetaha, bona ta se haheauka umui daimui ai. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na guba Diravana bona tanobada Diravana.
JOS.2.11.english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

JOS.21.15.motu: bona Holon mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Debiri mai ena rei gabudia ida;
JOS.21.15.english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

JOS.21.39.motu: bona Hesebon bona lasere, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
JOS.21.39.english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

JOS.22.9.motu: Taunabunai Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana e lou, Israel taudia e rakatanidia Silo ai, Kanaan tanona ai; edia tano korikori, Gilead tanona, e lou henia, Iehova ena haheḡani Mose uduna amo e henidia dainai e abia tanona bunai.
JOS.22.9.english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

JOS.10.41.motu: Iosua ese e hadareredia, Kade-baranea amo ela bona Gasa, bona Gosen tanona idoinai ela bona Gibeon.
JOS.10.41.english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

JOS.6.16.motu: Nega ihahituna ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese kibi e hiriri negana ai, Iosua ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, A lolo, badina be Iehova ese hanua vada e henimui.
JOS.6.16.english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!

JOS.7.4.motu: Taunabunai, orea taudia bogaragidia amo daha toi sisivana e dae ela. Ai taudia ese e hadareredia, e hahavadia,
JOS.7.4.english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

JOS.15.22.motu: bona Kina bona Dimona bona Adada,

JOS.14.9.motu: Una dina ai Mose e gwau hamata, eto, Momokani, oi aemu vada e moia tao tanona na emu tano ai bainela, oiemu bona oi garamu edia, ela bona hanaihanai, badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, vada o badinaia tarika-tarika.
JOS.14.9.english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’

JOS.18.5.motu: Bae haria, ahu hitu. Iuda iduhuna na ena hetoa lalonai baine noho, diho kahana ai, bona Iosef natuna edia iduhu na edia hetoa lalodiai bae noho, mirigini kahana ai.
JOS.18.5.english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

JOS.13.1.motu: Iosua vada e buruka, ena mauri laḡanidia na momo herea. Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Oi na vada o buruka, emu mauri laḡanidia na momo herea; a tano bada-hereana na do asio abia.
JOS.13.1.english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

JOS.19.23.motu: Isakara taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia.

JOS.1.18.motu: Daika ese baine papamu ahuahu bona emu haheḡani herevadia baine dadarai, una tau bae alaia mase. Ḡau tamona, ba goada bona ba haheauka.
JOS.1.18.english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

JOS.10.13.motu: Bena dina e rahu tao, bona hua na gabuna ai e noho, ela bona Israel taudia ese inaidia amo davadia e abi. Iasara ena buka ai na ini e torea toma, ani? Dina na atai ai e rahu tao, se ḡelo, ela bona dina ta heḡereḡerena.
JOS.10.13.english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

JOS.11.16.motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese una tano idoinai e abia, ororo kahadia, bona diho kahana idoinai, bona Gosen tanona, bona koura iboudiai, bona Araba tanona, bona Israel ororodia bona kouradia:
JOS.11.16.english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

JOS.21.42.motu: Ini hanua iboudiai na mai edia rei gabudia.
JOS.21.42.english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

JOS.18.14.motu: Hetoa na diho kahana ma ela, Bete-horono diho kahana ororona lahara kahana amo ela, ela bona Kiriata-baal (ladana ta be Kiriat-iearimi) ai e hadoko. Una na Iuda iduhuna hanuana ta. Hetoa bunai, Iahara kahana ai.
JOS.18.14.english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

JOS.2.12.motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ladana ai ba gwau henigu hamata: lau ese umui na bogamui hisi heḡereḡerena umui danu tamagu ena ruma ba bogaia hisi, bona toa korikorina ba henigu,
JOS.2.12.english: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

JOS.24.29.motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Iosua Nunu, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, e mase. Ena laḡani iboudiai na sinahu-ta dikoana gwauta.
JOS.24.29.english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

JOS.4.16.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, ba haḡanidia, Ioridane sinavaina amo bae dae.
JOS.4.16.english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

JOS.3.12.motu: Taunabunai, tatau gwautararua bavabidia, ta ta iduhu ta ta amo.
JOS.3.12.english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

JOS.11.11.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai una hanua lalonai na idia ese dare amo e aladia mase, ela bona iboudiai vada e habuadia ore; ta se mauri. Bena Hasoro na lahi amo e doua.
JOS.11.11.english: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

JOS.18.19.motu: Ma unu amo Bete-hogla ororona nesena mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Tadi Gohuna mirigini kahana taberona, Ioridane sinavaina na gohu ai e aru lasi gabuna ai. Hetoa bunai, diho kahana ai.
JOS.18.19.english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

JOS.21.12.motu: Ḡau tamona, hetabira tanodia bona hanua maraḡidia na Kaleb lefune e henia, ena gabu.
JOS.21.12.english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

JOS.24.16.motu: Bena hebou taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Ai ese Iehova basia rakatania, dirava idaudia basia toma henidia diho, lasi vaitani.
JOS.24.16.english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

JOS.3.5.motu: Bena Iosua ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, Hari dina ai sibomui ba hahelaḡa, badina be kerukeru Iehova ese hoa karadia baine kara bogaragimui ai.
JOS.3.5.english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

JOS.3.14.motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese edia taruha gabuna e rakatania, Ioridane sinavaina ihanaina totona. Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese taravatu mauana e huaia lao, Israel taudia vairadiai,
JOS.3.14.english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

JOS.21.41.motu: Levi taudia edia hanua, Israel taudia edia tano lalodiai, iboudiai na hari-ahui taurahani, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
JOS.21.41.english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

JOS.10.17.motu: Bena haida ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Hari pavapava laimaosi vada e davaridia, Makeda kohuana ai e komumu.
JOS.10.17.english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

JOS.23.2.motu: Bena Iosua ese Israel besena idoinai e boiridia, edia tau-badadia bona edia hanua Iohiadia bona edia hahemaoro taudia bona edia heitatao taudia e hereva henidia, eto, Lau vada na buruka, egu maun laḡanidia na hoho.
JOS.23.2.english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

JOS.9.21.motu: Hari lohia ma eto, Baita hamauridia. Taunabunai, idia na au-siri bona ranu-utu taudia ai ela, hebou taudia iboudiai edia, hebou ikwaradia taudia edia hereva heḡereḡerena.
JOS.9.21.english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.

JOS.19.32.motu: E duanaia oreana ihatauratoina na Napatali iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.19.32.english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

JOS.6.22.motu: Iosua ese hasinadoa taudia raruosi e hamaorodia, eto, Ariara hahinena ena ruma ai ba dae kau, hahine mai varavarana iboudiai ida ba hakaudia lasi, o gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
JOS.6.22.english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”

JOS.21.20.motu: Kohat oreana taudia oredia, Levi taudia, ese Efraim iduhuna taudia edia amo edia hanua e abidia.
JOS.21.20.english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

JOS.8.33.motu: Bena Israel idoinai, Israel taudia korikori bona bogaradiai e noho hedoava taudia, Israel tau-badadia bona heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ida, taravatu mauana kahana kahana ai e gini, hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, vairadiai. Kahana na Gerisim ororona vairanai e gini, ma kahana Ebal ororona vairanai, Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, ena haheḡani gunaguna e henidia heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia ihanamodia totona.
JOS.8.33.english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.

JOS.17.8.motu: Tapua tanona na Manase taudia edia tano; a Tapua hanuana, Manase taudia edia tano hetoana ai, na Efraim taudia edia hanua.
JOS.17.8.english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

JOS.15.6.motu: ela bona Bete-hogla. Bena Bet-araba mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bohan Ruben ena nadi.
JOS.15.6.english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

JOS.13.16.motu: Edia tano na Aroere amo e matamaiamu, Aranon kourana isena ai. Koura bogaragina hanuana na idia edia, bona Medeba taorana idoinai.
JOS.13.16.english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

JOS.8.28.motu: Taunabunai Iosua na Ai hanuana e doua bona e haseriseria; unu e mia tomamu ema bona hilrihari.
JOS.8.28.english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

JOS.23.16.motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui taravatuna na boma tataia utu, dirava idaudia isiaidia boma lao heni bona boma toma henidia diho, ia ese unu baine karamui toma: Iehova ena badu emui ai baine ḡaraḡara, bena vada e henimui tanona namona amo ba boio haraḡa.
JOS.23.16.english: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

JOS.11.12.motu: Unu pavapava edia hanua iboudiai, mai pavapavadia iboudiai ida, Iosua ese e abidia, dare amo e aladia mase, e habuadia ore, Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
JOS.11.12.english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.

JOS.12.2.motu: Ta be Sihon, Amoro pavapavana: ia na Hesebon ai e nohova. E halohiaiava tanona na Aroere amo, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura bogaragina amo ela bona labok sinavaina, Amono taudia edia tano hetoana. Una na Gilead tanona kahana.
JOS.12.2.english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

JOS.22.23.motu: Eiava bema hari ihaboulaina patana a larebaia Iehova idadaraina totona, eiava latanai ḡole-oho bouboudia eiava flaoa bouboudia eiava herohemaino bouboudia baia hahelaḡadia totona, Iehova ese davana baine henimai.
JOS.22.23.english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.

JOS.18.2.motu: Israel iduhudia hitu ese ahudia do asie abi.
JOS.18.2.english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

JOS.10.7.motu: Taunabunai Iosua na Gilgal amo e dae ela, mai ena orea idoinai bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai ida.
JOS.10.7.english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

JOS.5.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Hari dina ai Aigupto ena hemarai na emui amo vada na keia oho. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoamu Gilgal, ema bona hari dina.
JOS.5.9.english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.

JOS.14.6.motu: Iuda taudia na Iosua dekena ela, Gilgal ai. Bena Kaleb lefune, Kenisi tauna, ese e hereva henia, eto, Oi dibamu Iehova ese oi herevamu bona lau herevagu na Mose, Dirava ena tau, ede e herevalai henia toma, Kadebaranea ai.
JOS.14.6.english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

JOS.6.9.motu: Tuari taudia na kibi e hiriri taudia vairadiai e raka; a orea taudia loḡora na maua helaḡana murinai e raka. Kibi na e hiriri loulou.
JOS.6.9.english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

JOS.6.24.motu: Bena hanua na lahi amo e doua, mai anina idoinai ida; a gold bona silver bona auri labora-labora gaudia bona auri gaudia e abidia, Iehova ena ruma ai e haboudia, dava-bada ḡaudia e haboudiava gabuna ai.
JOS.6.24.english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.

JOS.15.21.motu: Iuda taudia edia hanua diho kahana, Edom ena tano hetoana badinai, bini: Kabsele bona Edere bona laguru,
JOS.15.21.english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

JOS.3.1.motu: Daba matana ai, Iosua na e tore isi, Sitim e rakatania, Israel taudia iboudiai ida, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e kau. Bena maoromaoro asie hanaia; do e taruha guna.
JOS.3.1.english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

JOS.9.17.motu: Bena Israel taudia na edia laolao ela, dina ihatoina ai idia edia hanua ai e kau. Edia hanua be Gibeon bona Kefira bona Beroto bona Kiriat-iearimi.
JOS.9.17.english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

JOS.2.1.motu: Iosua Nunu ese hasinadoa taudia rarua Sitim amo e siaidia hehuni. E haduadia, eto, Aola, tano ba itaia, bona Ieriko hanuana danu. Raruosi na ela; bena ariara hahinena ta, ladana Rahaba, ena ruma ai e dae, unuseni ai e noho.
JOS.2.1.english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

JOS.19.34.motu: Bena hetoa na lahara kahana ai ela, ela bona Asnoto-taboro, ma unu amo ela bona Hukok. Sebulun na diho kahana ai, Asere na lahara kahana ai, bona Iuda na mairiveina kahana ai, Ioridane sinavaina badinai.
JOS.19.34.english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

JOS.11.23.motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese tano idoinai e abia, Iehova ese Mose e herevalai henia herevadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia. Bena Iosua ese Israel taudia e henidia, iduhu ta ta ena tano ena tano e henidia. Una negana ai tuari e doko, bona tano na e laḡa ani.
JOS.11.23.english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

JOS.10.38.motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na e lou, Debiri ela, e tuari henia;
JOS.10.38.english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

JOS.8.32.motu: Unuseni ai Mose ese ena taravatu ma e torea lou una nadi ai; Israel taudia vairadiai e torea.
JOS.8.32.english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

JOS.24.5.motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na siaidia, Aigupto na hahisia, bogaraginai na kara karadia amo; una murinai na hakaumui lasi.
JOS.24.5.english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

JOS.13.20.motu: bona Bete-peoro, bona Pisga ororona gabaena, bona Bet-iesimoto.
JOS.13.20.english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

JOS.19.17.motu: E duanaia oreana ihahanina na Isakara iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai.
JOS.19.17.english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

JOS.16.10.motu: Ḡau tamona, Kanaan taudia Gesere ai e nohova na asie luludia lasi; taunabunai Kanaan taudia na Efraim taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu bona idia isiaidia e lao henimu mai hekwarahidia ida ema bona harihari.
JOS.16.10.english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

JOS.15.7.motu: Unu amo Akoro kourana amo ela, ela bona Debiri. Bena mirigini kahana amo ela, Gilgal dalana ai. Hari Gilgal ese Adumimi e dae henia tanona e vaira henia, koura diho kahana ai. Hari tano hetoana ma ela, En-semese ranudia badibadidia amo, ela bona En-rogele.
JOS.15.7.english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

JOS.13.24.motu: Mose ese Gad iduhuna taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
JOS.13.24.english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

JOS.13.10.motu: bona Sihon, Amoro taudia edia lohia, Hesebon pavapavana, ena hanua iboudiai, ela bona Amono taudia edia tano hetoana;
JOS.13.10.english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

JOS.15.8.motu: En-rogele amo ma ela, Hinom natuna ena koura amo, ela bona Iebusu ororona (ladana ta be Ierusalem) diho kahana. Unu amo ma ela, ela bona Hinom kourana unukahana ororona dorina ai, lahara kahana ai, Refaim kourana dokona mirigini kahana ai.
JOS.15.8.english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

JOS.17.13.motu: Israel taudia na e goada e laova negana ai, idia ese Kanaan taudia e abidia, edia hesiai taudia ai e halaodia, a asie luludia lasi.
JOS.17.13.english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

JOS.19.31.motu: Asere taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maragidia.
JOS.19.31.english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

JOS.10.24.motu: Laimaosi e hakaudia lasi Iosua vairanai; bena Iosua ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia; bena ia ese tuari lohiadia, tuari ai e bamoava taudia, e hamaorodia, eto, A raka kahi mai, aemui na ini pavapava aiodia ai ba moi kau. Taunabunai, idia na e raka kahira, aedia na aiodia ai e moi kau.
JOS.10.24.english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.”

JOS.7.2.motu: Una negana ai Iosua ese tatau haida Ieriko amo e siaidia, e dae lao, hanua ladana Ai baela. Una hanua na Bet-avene badibadinai, Betele mairiveina kahana ai. E hamaorodia, eto, Aola, una tano ba hasinadoa.
JOS.7.2.english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.”

JOS.18.18.motu: Unu amo Bet-araba ororona nesena mirigini kahana amo e hanai, bena e diho ela bona Araba.
JOS.18.18.english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

JOS.23.13.motu: ba diba momokani Iehova, emui Dirava na ini bese basine luludia lasi vairamui ai; do bae noho, idoa eiava rikiriki na heheto, emui ai, eiava ikwadi ḡauna ohemui ai eiava ginigini matamui ai na heheto, ela bona ina tano namona, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona, lalona amo ba boio.
JOS.23.13.english: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.

JOS.18.3.motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese Israel taudia e gwau henidia, eto, Ela bona edena nega ai ba halahemu, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vada e henimui tanona lalonai basio raka vareai bona ahumui basio abi?
JOS.18.3.english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?

JOS.6.25.motu: A ariara hahinena Rahaba, tamana ena ruma taudia bona varavarana iboudiai ida, Iosua ese e hamauridia. Hahine na Israel ai e nohomu ema bona harihari; badina be ia ese Iosua ena hesiai taudia bae hasinadoa totona e siaidia na e rauadia.
JOS.6.25.english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

JOS.19.9.motu: Simeon taudia edia tano na Iuda taudia edia tano lalonai; badina be Iuda ahuna na bada herea. Una dainai Simeon taudia na ahudia e abi, idia edia tano lalonai.
JOS.19.9.english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

JOS.15.45.motu: Ekron danu, mai ena hanua bona ena hanua maraḡidia ida;
JOS.15.45.english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

JOS.10.9.motu: Taunabunai Iosua na hanuaboi horana idoinai Gilgal amo e raka rani, e hahoadia.
JOS.10.9.english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

JOS.9.11.motu: Bena emai tano lohiadia bona emai tano taudia iboudiai ese e haḡanimai, eto “Dala lakwana bavabia, idia dekedia baola, baoto: Ai na emui hesiai taudia, mani aita herohemaino”.
JOS.9.11.english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

JOS.24.9.motu: Bena Balak Siporo, Moab pavapavana, e tore isi, Israel e tuari henia; ia ese Balaam Beoro e boiria, baine uduguiraimui totona;
JOS.24.9.english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

JOS.24.15.motu: A Iehova isiaina ilao-henina ai boma daradara, hari ina dina ai ba haeroa, daika isiaina ba lao heni, senemui sinavai unukahana ai isiaidia e lao heni diravadia, eiava Amoro taudia edia dirava, ina o noholaiamu tanona diravadia. A lau be egu ruma taudia ida Iehova isiaina baia lao heni.
JOS.24.15.english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

JOS.15.58.motu: Halahulu danu, bona Bete-suru bona Gedoro,

JOS.21.19.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena e henidia hanuadia iboudiai a gwauta-toi.
JOS.21.19.english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

JOS.24.10.motu: a Balaam asina hakala henia, taunabunai ia ese e hanamomui; ia imana amo na hamaurimui.
JOS.24.10.english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

JOS.17.4.motu: Idia laimaosi na ela, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona lohia taudia vairadiai e gini, eto, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, varavaramai ida ahumai baine henimai eto. Bena Iehova ena haheḡani hegereḡerena, ia ese ahudia e henidia, tamadia lahaidia ida.
JOS.17.4.english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

JOS.13.12.motu: Og, Astaroto bona Edrei pavapavana, ena tano idoinai Basan ai. Hari Og be Refaim tauna; Refaim besena idoinai ia mo sibona dounu noho. Ini na Mose ese e hadareredia bena e luludia lasi.
JOS.13.12.english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

JOS.17.18.motu: a ororo kahana idoinai na emui. Ena be uda, to ba taraia, bona bavabia, ela bona ena hetoa iboudiai. Ena be Kanaan taudia na mai edia auri kariotadia bona mai goadadia, to umui ese ba luludia lasi.
JOS.17.18.english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

JOS.15.39.motu: bona Lakisi bona Boskata bona Eglon,

JOS.11.22.motu: Anakim tauna ta se mauri, Israel taudia edia tano idoinai; a Gasa ai bona Gata ai bona Asdod ai na haida dounu e mauri nohova.
JOS.11.22.english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

JOS.21.10.motu: Levi taudia hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena, Kohat oreana ai, mari ese e duanaidia guna taudia,
JOS.21.10.english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

JOS.7.21.motu: ta abi kohudia lalodiai lau na hahedoki dabuana namo-hereana ta, Sinara ḡauna, na itaia, bona silver sekeledia sinahu rua, bona gold tua ta, ena metau na sekele imahui; na hekise-hekise henidia, bena na abidia; a itaia, ḡaudia na tano ai e hepuni, egu kalaga ai; silver be henudiai.
JOS.7.21.english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”

JOS.13.4.motu: Diho kahana ai dounu mimia tanodia be Kanaan taudia edia tano idoinai; bona Meara, Sidono taudia edia tano, ela bona Afek, ela bona Amoro taudia edia tano hetoana;
JOS.13.4.english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

JOS.1.13.motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡanilaimui herevana ba laloa tao. Ia eto “Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui laḡa-ani gabuna baine henimui bona ina tano danu baine henimui e tomu”.
JOS.1.13.english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

JOS.7.22.motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese haida e siaidia; e heau lao, bena kohu na e davaria, ena kalaga ai e hepuni, hari silver danu henudiai.
JOS.7.22.english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

JOS.6.15.motu: Dina ihahituna ai, idia na daba vaburana ai e tore tore isi, hanua unu e rakaia heḡeḡe toma, nega hahitu; una dina tamona ai nega hahitu hanua e rakaia hegege.
JOS.6.15.english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

JOS.18.24.motu: Kefaramoni; Ofni; Geba: hanua gwauta-rua, mai edia hanua maragidia ida.
JOS.18.24.english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

JUD.1.20.motu: A umui, egu lalokau taumui e, emui abidadama helaḡana latanai emui mauri ba hadaia. Lauma Helaḡa ai ba ḡuriḡuri.
JUD.1.20.english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

JUD.1.15.motu: taunimanima iboudiai baine hahemaoro henidia, bona Dirava asie badinaiamu taudia baine dunidia dae, Dirava idadaraina karadia e kara daidiai bona Dirava ihadikalaina herevadia aukadia e gwaurai daidiai”.
JUD.1.15.english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

JUD.1.18.motu: Idia ese e hamaoromui, eto “Nega dokona ai ḡonaḡona taudia bae hedinarai, sibodia edia heḡahusi karadia bae kara”.
JUD.1.18.english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

JUD.1.6.motu: Aneru haida danu, edia dagi korikori asie laloa tao, bona edia gabu korikori e rakatania; bena ia ese dibura gabuna ai e atodia, mia-hanaihanai gadeadia ai e ḡuidia, unuseni ai bae noho ela bona dina badana hahemaorona negana.
JUD.1.6.english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

JUD.1.12.motu: Idia na umui ida o anibou negadia ai, emui anibou e hadikamu, e anianimu, bogadia e hakunumu, asie garimu. Idia na dagadaga asi medudia, lai ese e odadia lao odadia maimu, na heheto. Idia na au na heheto, raudia e hehuhumu, huahuadia na lasi, vada e mase vaitani, mai ramudia ida e ragadiamu.
JUD.1.12.english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

JUD.1.14.motu: Adam ena amo uru ihahituna tauna, Enok, ese idia e gwauraidia guna, eto “A itaia, Lohiabada vada ema, mai ena helaḡa taudia gerebu gerebu ida;
JUD.1.14.english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

JUD.1.24.motu: Mai siahuna ida baine gimamui bena basio keto Diravana, asi bebekabebekamui ia hairaina vairanai baine atomui mai moalemui ida Diravana,
JUD.1.24.english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

JUD.1.21.motu: Dirava ena lalokau ai ba noho. Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena hebogahisi ba laroa; ia ese mauri hanaihanai dalana ai baine hakaumui.
JUD.1.21.english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

JUD.1.17.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taudia ese e hamaorolaimuiva herevadia na ba lalo tao.
JUD.1.17.english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

JUD.1.7.motu: Sodoma bona Gomora bona dekedia hanuadia danu unuheto: heuda-hanai bona kara bodagadia e karava mai lalodia idoidiai, davadia na mia-hanaihanai lahina ai e abi, ita matada ihakanidia.
JUD.1.7.english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

JUD.1.8.motu: Ini nihi taudia ese danu tau-anidia unu e hadikadia tomamu, siahu taudia e dadaraidiamu, bona hairai anerudia e ḡonaḡonalaidiamu.
JUD.1.8.english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

JUD.1.4.motu: Badina be haida ese dekemui ai vada e rau vareai hehuni, idau nega ai davadia e gwaurai guna taudia, Dirava asie badinaiamu taudia; idia ese iena harihari-bada na lebulebu ḡauna ai e halaoamu, bona biaguda tamona, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, e ḡoreamu.
JUD.1.4.english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

JUD.1.1.motu: Lau luda, Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taugu, Iakobo tadina, e abimui hidi taumui, Tamada Dirava ese e lalokau henimuimu bona Iesu Keriso ese e gimamuimu taumui, na tore henimuimu:
JUD.1.1.english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

JUD.1.3.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, iseda hahemauri herevana baina tore henimui nato, to, kara ta dainai na tore henimuimu. Na haduamuimu, ta abia daemu herevana, helaḡa taudia e heni-dia vaitani herevana, ba gimaia goadagoada.
JUD.1.3.english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

JUD.1.9.motu: A Mikael, aneru ikwaradia, diabolo ida e hepapahuahu, Mose tau-anina e hepapahuahulaia, negana ai na se ere dika henia, a e hereva henia, eto “Lohiabada ese baine gwau henimu”.
JUD.1.9.english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

JUD.1.11.motu: Madi, ihabaidia! Kain ena dala ai vada e raka. Balaam ena kerere vada e heau henia, kohu iabina totona. Kora ena gwau-hemuri ai do bae mase.
JUD.1.11.english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

JUD.1.13.motu: Idia na davara hurehuredia na heheto, edia hemarai e hedinaraimu gwaragwara na heheto. Idia na e morumu hisiudia na heheto, mia-hanaihanai diburana ai bae bodo.
JUD.1.13.english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

JUD.1.25.motu: Dirava tamona, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai e hamauridamu Diravana: hairai bona dagi bona goada bona siahu baine abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
JUD.1.25.english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

JUD.1.19.motu: Heiri-heiri ihavaradia taudia bunu, tau-anidia e lalomu taudia, Lauma na asie abia.
JUD.1.19.english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

JUD.1.10.motu: A ini na herevalaidiamu taudia ese asi dibadia ḡaudia e ḡonaḡonalaimu, bona boroma edia diba heḡereḡeredia dibadia ḡaudia na sibodia ihadikadia ḡaudia ai e halao.
JUD.1.10.english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

JUD.1.16.motu: Idia na ḡonaḡona bona maumau taudia; edia heḡahusi karadia mo e karamu. Ududia amo heaḡi herevadia e lasimu; taḡa taudia danu e imodaidiamu, kohu iabina totona.
JUD.1.16.english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

JUD.1.2.motu: hebogahisi bona maino bona lalokau emui ai bae bada.
JUD.1.2.english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

JUD.1.23.motu: Haida lahi lalona amo ba veridia oho, ba hamauridia. Ma haida ba bogadia hisi, to mai garimui ida; tau-anina ese e hamiroamu dabuana na ba inai henia.
JUD.1.23.english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

JUD.1.22.english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

JUD.1.5.motu: Lau na uramu gunaguna o dibava ḡaudia baina hahelalolaimui une. Lohiabada ese bese ta Aigupto tanona amo e hamauridia, a gabeamo asie kamonai henia taudia na e habuadia.
JUD.1.5.english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

LAM.1.7.english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries

LAM.3.16.english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel.

LAM.4.22.motu: Siona kekenimu e, emu kara havara davana vada o abia ḡuḡuru,
LAM.4.22.english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion.

LAM.4.4.motu: Rata e topoamu merona malana na
LAM.4.4.english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst.

LAM.3.30.motu: vahana na hebota tauna baine mede henia,
LAM.3.30.english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him.

LAM.1.22.motu: Edia kara dika idoinai na oi vairamu ai baine hedinarai,
LAM.1.22.english: “Let all their wickedness come before you.

LAM.5.13.motu: Eregabe taudia na e haḡaukaradiamu, flaoa iririlaina gabuna ai;

LAM.5.2.motu: Emai tano na idau taudia vada e henidia;
LAM.5.2.english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,

LAM.5.15.motu: Moale vada e doko lalomai ai,
LAM.5.15.english: The joy of our heart has ceased.

LAM.3.64.motu: Iehova e, oi ese davadia ba henidia,
LAM.3.64.english: You will pay them back, Yahweh,

LAM.2.20.motu: Iehova e, a hageremai, a itaia,
LAM.2.20.english: “Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus!

LAM.1.14.motu: Egu kara kerere na maduna auna ai e halaoa,
LAM.1.14.english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand.

LAM.2.15.motu: Dala ai e raka hanaimu taudia iboudiai ese
LAM.2.15.english: All that pass by clap their hands at you.

LAM.3.14.english: I have become a derision to all my people,

LAM.5.20.motu: Badina be dahaka o lalomai boio hanaihanaimu;
LAM.5.20.english: Why do you forget us forever,

LAM.3.62.motu: e ala-ala henigumu taudia ududia bona edia lalo-hadai ese
LAM.3.62.english: the lips of those that rose up against me,

LAM.3.35.motu: eiava tau ta igwaurai-maorona bae laoa ahu
LAM.3.35.english: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

LAM.4.17.motu: Matamai e valahu-valahu, hekaha inarina ai,

LAM.3.11.motu: egu dala amo e hakaugu siri, e daregu patapata,
LAM.3.11.english: He has turned away my path,

LAM.4.15.motu: Taunimanima ese e boi henidia, eto,

LAM.2.2.motu: Ḡaubada ese Iakob ena noho gabudia iboudiai
LAM.2.2.english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob

LAM.3.59.motu: Iehova e, oi ese vada o itaia, e kara dika henigu;
LAM.3.59.english: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong.

LAM.3.37.motu: Daika na e haheḡani bena anina e vara,
LAM.3.37.english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass,

LAM.4.14.motu: Idia na mata-kepuludia ai ariara ai e loava,
LAM.4.14.english: They wander as blind men in the streets.

LAM.3.61.motu: Iehova e, edia heḡonaḡonalai herevadia vada o kamonai,
LAM.3.61.english: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh,

LAM.2.10.english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground.

LAM.3.33.motu: badina be taunimanima natudia tau-anidia eiava lalodia
LAM.3.33.english: For he does not afflict willingly,

LAM.2.18.english: Their heart cried to the Lord.

LAM.3.50.motu: ela bona Iehova na guba amo baine roha dobi,

LAM.4.13.motu: Ina na ena peroveta taudia edia kara dika
LAM.4.13.english: It is because of the sins of her prophets

LAM.3.17.motu: laumagu na maino ai e dabumu,
LAM.3.17.english: You have removed my soul far away from peace.

LAM.4.5.motu: Aniani manoka-manokadia e aniva taudia na
LAM.4.5.english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets.

LAM.1.11.motu: Ena taunimanima iboudiai ese adia e tahuamu,

LAM.2.7.motu: Ḡaubada ese ena ihaboulaina patana vada e uduguiraia,
LAM.2.7.english: The Lord has cast off his altar.

LAM.1.9.english: Her filthiness was in her skirts.

LAM.3.32.motu: ena be lalona baine hahisia, to baine bogaia hisi,

LAM.3.57.motu: na boi henimu negana ai o raka kahira,
LAM.3.57.english: You came near in the day that I called on you.

LAM.5.19.motu: A oi, Iehova e, o lohia hanaihanaimu;

LAM.3.24.motu: Laumagu na e tomu: Iehova na lau ahugu;
LAM.3.24.english: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul.

LAM.5.16.motu: Havava ḡauna na kwaramai amo vada e moru;
LAM.5.16.english: The crown has fallen from our head.

LAM.3.43.motu: Badu vada o rioa, vada o hahavamai,
LAM.3.43.english: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us.

LAM.3.21.motu: a ina na na laloa unemu,
LAM.3.21.english: This I recall to my mind;

LAM.3.28.motu: Maduna na pagana ai vada e atoa negana ai,
LAM.3.28.english: Let him sit alone and keep silence,

LAM.1.15.motu: Ḡaubada ese egu goada-herea taudia iboudiai na
LAM.1.15.english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me.

LAM.2.4.motu: Ena peva vada e marea, inai tauna na heto;
LAM.2.4.english: He has bent his bow like an enemy.

LAM.5.9.motu: Amai a tahumu mai garimai ida,
LAM.5.9.english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives,

LAM.5.17.motu: Ina dainai Ialomai vada e manoka-manoka,
LAM.5.17.english: For this our heart is faint.

LAM.3.26.motu: Iehova ena hahemauri baita naria, asi reḡereḡeda,
LAM.3.26.english: It is good that a man should hope

LAM.2.8.motu: Iehova ese lalona vada e ha-aukaia,
LAM.2.8.english: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion.

LAM.4.21.motu: Edom kekenimu e, Usu tanona ai o nohomu,
LAM.4.21.english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom,

LAM.2.17.motu: Iehova ese e laloa hata karana vada e karaia,
LAM.2.17.english: Yahweh has done that which he planned.

LAM.1.10.motu: Inai tauna ese vada e toi roro,
LAM.1.10.english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things;

LAM.4.20.motu: Iehova ese e horoa tauna, emai mauri laḡana, na

LAM.2.11.motu: Matagu na taitai ai vada e malaka-malaka,

LAM.3.3.motu: momokani, ia imana na lau ihadikagu totona
LAM.3.3.english: Surely he turns his hand against me

LAM.3.9.motu: e utu nadidia amo egu dala vada e koudia,
LAM.3.9.english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone.

LAM.1.5.motu: Ia inaina na ikwarana ai vada ela,
LAM.1.5.english: Her adversaries have become the head.

LAM.3.44.english: You have covered yourself with a cloud,

LAM.3.4.motu: Hidiogu bona kopigu vada e ha-oredia,
LAM.3.4.english: He has made my flesh and my skin old.

LAM.1.4.motu: Siona e lao heniamu daladia na mai hebogahisidia,

LAM.3.63.motu: Edia helai diho bona edia tore isi a itaia;
LAM.3.63.english: You see their sitting down and their rising up.

LAM.3.25.motu: E nariamu taudia na Iehova ese e hanamodiamu,
LAM.3.25.english: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him,

LAM.2.9.motu: Ena ikoukou na tano ai vada e hepuni,
LAM.2.9.english: Her gates have sunk into the ground.
