LEV.9.14.motu: Ia ese danu bogana bona bogarauna bona imana bona aena e abidia, ranu ai e huridia; bena ḡole-oho boubouna ida e haḡoledia oho, ihaboulaina patana latanai.
LEV.9.14.english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

LEV.16.4.motu: Hahedoki helaḡana, dabua aukana ḡauna, bona piribou, dabua aukana ḡauna, baine kara, bona gaba dabuana baine ḡeḡea, bona kwara ḡauna, dabua aukana ḡauna, kwarana ai baine atoa. Baine digu guna, bena baine kara, badina be unu na dabua helaḡadia.
LEV.16.4.english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

LEV.7.8.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese tau ta ena ḡole-oho boubouna baine hahelaḡaia negana ai, ia ese boubou ḡauna, e hahelaḡaia ḡauna, kopina baine abia iena.
LEV.7.8.english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

LEV.26.30.motu: Lau ese emui helaḡa gabudia ororo doridia ai na baina habuadia tari, bona emui muramura patadia baina uhedia hebubu, bona emui kaivakuku tau-anidiamasedia latadiai umui tau-animui masedia baina tahodia kau; bena laumaguese baine dadaraimui.
LEV.26.30.english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

LEV.13.36.motu: hahelaḡa tauna ese ma baine itaia. Totototo bema bada herea, ia huina vada e labora eiava lasi basine laloa; ia ese una tau eiava una hahine baine gwauraia, vada e miro.
LEV.13.36.english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

LEV.20.2.motu: Israel taudia ma ba hamaorodia, baoto: Israel tauna ta eiava noho-hedoa tauna taese natuna na ḡole-oho boubouna ai baine halaoa, dirava koikoina Molek ena, ia na momokani baine mase: hanua taudia ese nadi amo bae hodoa mase.
LEV.20.2.english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

LEV.4.2.motu: Israel taudia ba haduadia, baoto: Tau ta baine kara rea, Iehova ena taravatu ta baine tataia utu, ena boubou be iniheto.
LEV.4.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

LEV.23.37.motu: Iehova ena aria bunu; ba badinadia, dina helaḡadia bona hebou helaḡadia dinadia. Emui boubou ḡaudia na lahi ai ba gabudia: ḡole-oho bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia, boromakau bona mamoe, inuinu bouboudia danu, ta ta ena dina ena dina ai.
LEV.23.37.english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

LEV.27.20.motu: A ibodohilaina basine ura, eiava tau ta ese baine hoia, ia na basine abia lou diba.
LEV.27.20.english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

LEV.13.11.motu: una na lepra ḡouna ia kopina ai. Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gwauraia, vada e miro. Basine koua ahu lou, badina be ia na miro momokani.
LEV.13.11.english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

LEV.9.15.motu: Bena ia ese orea taudia edia boubou ḡaudia e mailaidia, kara-rea boubouna nanina e abia, orea taudia edia, e alaia mase, e haḡolea oho, kara-rea iabi-ohodia, ia sibona ena heḡereḡerena.
LEV.9.15.english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

LEV.14.23.motu: Bena dina ihataurahanina ai, ia ese baine laohaidia, hahelaḡa tauna dekenai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai, Iehova vairanai, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine haḡoevaia totona.
LEV.14.23.english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

LEV.18.17.motu: Hahine ta ida boma eno bou, ia natuna hahinena eiava tubuna kekenina ida basioma eno bou; idia na hidio tamona. Una na hemarai karana.
LEV.18.17.english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

LEV.23.21.motu: Una dina tamona ai danu taunimanima ba boiridia hebou, emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia; una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia. Ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
LEV.23.21.english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

LEV.23.42.motu: Unu dina hituosi lalodiai umui na kalaga ai ba noho; Israel taudia iboudiai kalaga bae noholai;
LEV.23.42.english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

LEV.24.22.motu: Noho-hedoa tauna bona Israel tauna korikori taravatudia na tamona: lau Iehova emui Dirava na gwaumu.
LEV.24.22.english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”

LEV.5.6.motu: bona ena kerere boubouna baine mailaia Iehova dekenai, mamoe natuna hahinena ta eiava nani natuna hahinena ta ena seri amo, ena kara-dika boubouna. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, ena dika iabi-ohona.
LEV.5.6.english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

LEV.5.16.motu: Ḡaukara helaḡadia e hakerere davana danu baine heni, bona davana korikori latanai heato-kau ḡauna danu baine atoa kau; davana bema karoaia karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ai heato-kau ḡauna unu baine atoa kau toma, hahelaḡa tauna baine henia. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, kara-dika mamoena amo; bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
LEV.5.16.english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

LEV.10.8.motu: Bena Iehova ese Aaron e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.20.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.4.17.motu: imana kwakikwakina na rara ai baine urua diho, nega hitu Iehova vairanai baine nevaria, seseahu vairanai,
LEV.4.17.english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

LEV.10.9.motu: Oi mai natumu ida hebou kalagana ai ba raka vareai negana ai na vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana basio inua, ba mase garina. Taravatu binai na umui latamui ai baine mia hanaihanai, uru iboudiai lalodiai.
LEV.10.9.english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

LEV.16.27.motu: Bena kara rea boromakauna bona kara rea nanina, raradia na herohemaino totona gabu helaḡana ai e vareailai ḡaudia, na taruha murimurinai bae laohaidia, kopidia bona hidiodia bona taḡedia na bae gabudia, lahi ese baine ḡoledia oho.
LEV.16.27.english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

LEV.7.28.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.8.24.motu: Aaron natuna danu e abidia, idiba taiadia abodia bona idiba imadia sinabadadia bona idiba aedia sinabadadia e dahulai. Bena Mose ese rara orena na ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai e nevaria heḡeḡe.
LEV.8.24.english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

LEV.19.15.motu: Basio hahemaoro koikoi: ogoḡami tauna basio bogaia hisi, bona taḡa tauna basio matauraia; kara maoromaoro ai dekemu taudia ba hahemaoro henidia.
LEV.19.15.english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

LEV.25.33.motu: A Levi tauna ta ena ruma basine hoia Iou, ia na Iubile laḡanina ai do baine abia lou. Badina be Levi taudia edia hanua rumadia na edia korikori, Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
LEV.25.33.english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

LEV.26.38.motu: Mase ese baine ḡavamui tao, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, inaimui edia tano ese baine hadonomui.
LEV.26.38.english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

LEV.13.20.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia, toutou na sisina dobu bona derana danu kurokuro, ia ese una tau baine gwauraia, vada e miro; una na lepra, iohururu gabuna amo e vara.
LEV.13.20.english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

LEV.14.51.motu: bena sida audia bona muramura avana bona dabua kakakaka bona manu maurina na manu masena rarana ai bona e arumu ranuna ai baine uru diho, bena ruma baine nevarilaia nega hitu.
LEV.14.51.english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

LEV.1.3.motu: Bema ḡole-oho boubouna na boromakau serina amo baine abia, ia eseboromakau maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine abia; baine laohaia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai baine alaia, Iehova ese baine abia dae helaorana.
LEV.1.3.english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

LEV.3.16.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai; ia na boubou anianina, ḡole-oho boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna. Digara idoinai na Iehova ena.
LEV.3.16.english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

LEV.19.9.motu: Emui uma anidia ba utu negana ai, basio utua lao ela bona emu inoḡo hetoana korikori ai; bona tano ai bae moru ḡaudia basio gogo.
LEV.19.9.english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

LEV.11.18.motu: bona kema bona boebedi bona lokoru,
LEV.11.18.english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

LEV.6.9.motu: Aaron mai natuna verina ida ini ba haḡanidia toma. Ḡole-oho boubouna taravatuna binai: boubou ḡauna na ihaboulaina patana lahina latanai baine mia rani, lahi danu baine ara rani.
LEV.6.9.english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

LEV.19.18.motu: Kara dika davana basio haloua. Emu bese taudia natudia na basio lalo-hisihisi henidia. Dekemutauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena. Lau binai Iehova.
LEV.19.18.english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

LEV.10.3.motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova na ini vada e gwau toma: Lau na baina helaḡa, bae raka henigu kahi taudia ediai; taunimanima iboudiai ese lau bae imodaigu. Bena Aaron na asi ena hereva.
LEV.10.3.english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying,

LEV.16.20.motu: Gabu helaḡana bona hebou kalagana bona ihaboulana patana daidiai herohemaino karadia baine kara murinai, ia ese nani maruanena maurina baine hakaua mai Iehova vairanai.
LEV.16.20.english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

LEV.13.28.motu: A toutou na gabuna ai mo bema mia, basinema bada, ena kurokuro eiava ena kakakaka danu bema maraḡi, una na lahi kiparana mo. Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva; badina be una na e ara gabuna kiparana mo.
LEV.13.28.english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

LEV.20.27.motu: Rohe bona mea tauna eiava hahinena na bae aladia, nadi amo bae hododia mase. Raradia na sibodia latadiai.
LEV.20.27.english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

LEV.14.30.motu: Bena ia ese hari kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua, ena moni heḡereḡerena ai e hoi, baine heni,
LEV.14.30.english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

LEV.24.12.motu: Bena e ḡuia, ela bona Iehova ena hahemaoro herevana bae diba.
LEV.24.12.english: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

LEV.26.28.motu: lau be umui emui amo baina raka oho mai badugu ida, bona emui kara dika davadia nega hahitu baina henimui, lau sibogu ese.
LEV.26.28.english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

LEV.7.29.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Iehova ena herohemaino boubouna baine mailaia tauna ese ena herahia baine mailaia Iehova ena. Herohemaino boubouna amo
LEV.7.29.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

LEV.9.18.motu: Boromakau maruanena bona mamoe maruanena danu, orea taudia edia herohemaino boubouna ḡaudia, e aladia mase. Bena Aaron natuna ese raradia e abi, tamadia e henia; bena ia ese ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai e nevaria heḡeḡe.
LEV.9.18.english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

LEV.22.27.motu: Boromakau eiava mamoe eiava nani baine vara negana ai, ia na dina hitu sinana dekenai baine noho; dina ihataurahanina ai bona dina ihataurahanina murinai ia na heḡereḡere ḡole-oho boubouna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ena.
LEV.22.27.english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

LEV.20.24.motu: A lau ese vada na gwau henimui hamata, nato, Edia tano bavabia emui; baina henimui emui tano korikori, rata bona bada ranuna e arumu tanona bunai. Lau binai Iehova emui Dirava; bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo vada na abimui hidi.
LEV.20.24.english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

LEV.14.40.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahedua, nadi mai toutoudia bae raḡadia oho, hanua murimurinai bae negedia, momoru gabuna ai.
LEV.14.40.english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

LEV.24.10.motu: Tau ta, sinana na hane Israel, tamana na Aigupto tauna, e raka lasi. Israel taudia bogaragidiai: bena ia na Israel tauna korikorina ta ida e heai. taruha lalonai.
LEV.24.10.english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

LEV.18.8.motu: Tamamu adavana ta ida basio eno bou; ia na tamamu ena.
LEV.18.8.english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

LEV.27.6.motu: Hua ta amo ela bona laḡani ima ibodohilaidia bini: bema maruane, silver sekeledia ima; bema hahine, sekele toi.
LEV.27.6.english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

LEV.18.20.motu: Dekemu tauna adavana ida basio heuda hanai; una na kara mirona.
LEV.18.20.english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

LEV.6.11.motu: Bena ena dabua aukadia baine doki oho, dabua idaudia baine hadoki; bena kahu na taruha murimurinai baine laohaia, gabu ḡoevaḡoevana ta ai baine bubua.
LEV.6.11.english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

LEV.23.30.motu: Bona tau ta una dina ai baine ḡaukara, lau ese baina hamasea, ena bese taudia bogaragidia amo.
LEV.23.30.english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

LEV.25.43.motu: Basio hahisihisia; emu Dirava garina ba gari.
LEV.25.43.english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

LEV.8.11.motu: Ihaboulaina patana mai kohuna idoinai, bona digu ranuna dihuna mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida, nanega hahitu e horodia, ihahelaḡadia totona.
LEV.8.11.english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

LEV.2.6.motu: Ba bakia sisi sisi, latanai dehoro ba seia: ia na flaoa boubouna.
LEV.2.6.english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

LEV.2.10.motu: Flaoa boubouna orena na Aaron mai natuna ida adia; Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia iboudiai ia mo helaḡa herea.
LEV.2.10.english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

LEV.7.21.motu: bona tau ta ese taunimanima edia ḡau mirona ta, eiava mauri ḡaudia mirodia ta, eiava ḡau mirona eiava bodagana ta, bema daua toho, murinai Iehova ena herohemaino bouboudia hidiodia bema ani, ia na ena bese amo bae negea daure.
LEV.7.21.english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

LEV.18.5.motu: Taunabunai, egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia; unu baine kara toma tauna be baine mauri. Lau binai Iehova.
LEV.18.5.english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.

LEV.16.31.motu: Una dina na helaḡa herea emui ai, taunabunai bavani vaga. Baine mia hanaihanai haheḡanina bunai.
LEV.16.31.english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

LEV.11.10.motu: a asi taiadia bona asi unadia ḡaudia ranu ai e maurimu bona e loamu, davara ai eiava sinavai ai, na basio ani.
LEV.11.10.english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

LEV.25.10.motu: Laḡani iha-imahuina ba hahelaḡaia, bainehelaḡa herea. Una laḡani lalonai iḡui taudia iboudiai bae ruhadia nege. Ia ladana be Iubile: ia lalonai taunimanima iboudiai edia tano korikori bona edia iduhu korikori bae lou henidia.
LEV.25.10.english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

LEV.25.19.motu: Tano ese anina baine henimui: bavaniani, ba boga kunu, ba noho namonamo.
LEV.25.19.english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

LEV.6.3.motu: eiava boio ḡauna baine davaria bena baine herevalaia koikoi eiava baine gwau hamatalaia koikoi: unu baine koikoi toma tauna
LEV.6.3.english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

LEV.4.16.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna, e horoa tauna, ese rarana baine abia, hebou kalagana lalonai baine vareailaia;
LEV.4.16.english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

LEV.13.14.motu: A hidio berona ienai bema hedinarai, ia na baine miro;
LEV.13.14.english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

LEV.22.24.motu: Ḡau ta abona nadinadina na e toto eiava e pata eiava e hedare eiava e heiva na basio mailaia Iehova ena, emui boubou ḡauna ai basio halaoa, emui tano idoinai.
LEV.22.24.english: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

LEV.25.11.motu: Laḡani iha-imahuina na emui Iubile: ia Ialonai uhe basio hado, bona sibona baine tubu ḡauna basio utua; emui vine danu rigidia basio kwamadia heini, bona huahuadia basio habou.
LEV.25.11.english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

LEV.25.9.english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

LEV.4.6.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese imana kwakikwakina na rara ai baine urua diho, nega hitu Iehova vairanai baine nevaria, gabu helaḡana seseahuna vairanai.
LEV.4.6.english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

LEV.4.7.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese danu muramura mai bonana patana, hebou kalagana lalonai e miamu ḡauna, doana na rara taina amo baine dahudia, Iehova vairanai; bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna, badinai baine bubua nege, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
LEV.4.7.english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

LEV.22.12.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna natuna hahinena ese idau iduhu tauna ta baine adavaia, ia ese aniani helaḡana, e duduia isi boubouna hidiona, na basine ania.
LEV.22.12.english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

LEV.16.3.motu: A Aaron na gabu helaḡana lalonai baine raka vareai negadia ai, ia na ini baine raka vareai toma: boromakau natuna maruanena ta baine mailaia, kara rea boubouna; bona mamoe maruanena to baine mailaia, ḡole-oho boubouna.
LEV.16.3.english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

LEV.1.15.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese manu na baine laohaia, ihaboulaina patana badibadinai aiona baine moḡea. Bena ihaboulaina patana latanai lahi ese baine ḡolea oho; a rarana be ihaboulaina patana isena ai baine seia.
LEV.1.15.english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

LEV.23.35.motu: Aria dinana gini-gunana ai, hebou helaḡana ba karaia; hau dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
LEV.23.35.english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

LEV.14.26.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese dehoro na ia imana laurina nuana ai baine seia,
LEV.14.26.english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

LEV.4.33.motu: imana na enakara-rea boubouna kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena ḡole-oho bouboudia e aladia masemu gabuna ai ena kara-rea boubouna ḡauna baine alaia mase.
LEV.4.33.english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

LEV.27.28.motu: Tau ta ese taunimanima ta eiava mauri ḡauna ta eiava tano ta Iehova baine henia vaitani, una na basine hoia diba bona basine bodohilaia diba: unuhetomadia na vada e helaḡa vaitani, Iehova ena.
LEV.27.28.english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.

LEV.13.18.motu: Tau ta kopina ai iohururu ta vada e namo
LEV.13.18.english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

LEV.15.12.motu: Gorere tauna ese baine daua toho urona na bae hamakohia, bona baine daua toho dihuna na ranu amo bae huria.
LEV.15.12.english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

LEV.11.23.motu: A mai hanidia bona mai imadia aedia ḡaudia oredia iboudiai na ba dadaraidia.
LEV.11.23.english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

LEV.26.6.motu: Lau ese maino baina henimui emui tano ai; vada ba laḡa ani, asi tauna ta ese baine hagarimui. Uda boromadia baina ha-oredia emui tano ai, bona tuari darena na basine hedinarai, emui tano idoinai.
LEV.26.6.english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

LEV.23.2.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto Iehova ena aria bini; ini aria negadia ai emui hebou helaḡadia ba kara.
LEV.23.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

LEV.16.26.motu: A hari Asasele ena nani e hakaua lao tauna ese ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu; una mirunai ia na taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai lou diba.
LEV.16.26.english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

LEV.27.24.motu: A Iubile laḡanina ai una tano biaguna korikori, senena amo e abia tauna, ese baine abia lou.
LEV.27.24.english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

LEV.23.31.motu: Ḡaukara ta basio karaia, lasi ona lasi vaitani: ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
LEV.23.31.english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

LEV.6.19.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,

LEV.16.34.motu: Baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna bunai umui emui; unuhetomana laḡani ta ta amo Israel taudia bae herohemaino bona edia dika bae hegwau tao.
LEV.16.34.english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.”

LEV.25.35.motu: Tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, asi ena heubu dalana, oi ese ba ubua, laolao tauna eiava vadivadi tauna na heto.
LEV.25.35.english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

LEV.22.18.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida bona Israel taudia iboudiai ba hamaorodia, baoto: Israel tauna ta eiava Israel taudia bogaragidiai e noho hedoamu tauna ta ese boubou ḡauna baine mailaia, gwau-hamata dainai eiava lalo-namo dainai, Iehova ena ḡole-oho ḡauna ai baine halaoa;
LEV.22.18.english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering:

LEV.7.25.motu: Badina be tau ta ese digara baine ania, taunimanima ese edia boubou ai e halaodiamu bona Iehova vairanai e haḡoledia ohomu ḡaudia ta digarana, ia na ena bese amo bae negea daure.
LEV.7.25.english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

LEV.27.15.motu: Ruma biaguna baine ura ena ruma baine bodohilaia, ia ese dava bunai baine heni mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau. Bena ruma na iena.
LEV.27.15.english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

LEV.20.17.motu: Tau ta ese taihuna ta, tamana natuna eiava sinana natuna, baine abia, ia ida bae eno bou, una na hemarai karana; edia bese bogaragidia amo bae luludia lasi. Ia ese taihuna vada e hahemaraia; ena kara dika madunana baine huaia.
LEV.20.17.english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

LEV.23.22.motu: Emui uit eiava emui bali ba utua negana ai, basio utua ela bona emu inoḡo hetoana korikori ai, bona tano ai bae moru anidia basio gogo: bae mia, oroḡami tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna ana. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
LEV.23.22.english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

LEV.24.14.motu: Heuduguirai tauna na taruha murimurinai ba hakaua lasi; bena ena heuduguirai herevadia e kamonai taudia iboudiai ese imadia na ia tubuana ai bae ato kau, murinai hebou taudia iboudiai ese nadi amo bae hodoa mase.
LEV.24.14.english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

LEV.11.40.motu: Hidiona baine ania tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho. Bona tau-anina baine huaia tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.11.40.english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

LEV.13.38.motu: Tau ta eiava hahine ta kopina ai toutou kurokurodia bae hedinarai,
LEV.13.38.english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

LEV.11.22.motu: unu na bavani: una dainai kwadi idau-idau iboudiai na bavani diba.
LEV.11.22.english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

LEV.7.14.motu: Herahia ta ta amo dikea eiava ataga eiava igabu ta ta bae dudui isi Iehova vairanai; bena hahelaḡa tauna, herohemaino boubouna rarana ihaboulaina patana ai baine nevaria tauna, baine abia iana.
LEV.7.14.english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

LEV.18.2.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
LEV.18.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

LEV.9.4.motu: bona boromakau maruanena ta bona mamoe maruanena ta bavabidia, herohemaino boubouna; iboudiai na Iehova vairanai baita aladia mase, emui boubou. Flaoa boubouna danu, dehoro ida e buloa ḡauna, bavabia. Badina be hari dina ai Iehova be hahedinarai henimuimu.
LEV.9.4.english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

LEV.25.34.motu: Bona edia gabi-ruma tanodia na haida ese basie hoi; unu tano na ediatano korikori ela bona hanaihanai.
LEV.25.34.english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

LEV.11.34.motu: Una uro anianina eiava hodu ranuna, eiava una ranu amo bae nadu anianidia na mimiro.
LEV.11.34.english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

LEV.17.16.motu: A ia na ena dabua basinema huri eiava basinema digu, ia na bema kerere.
LEV.17.16.english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

LEV.11.38.motu: a uhe ba hapariparidia murinai mase ḡauna tau-anina na idia latadiai baemoru, unu uhe bae miro.
LEV.11.38.english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

LEV.19.34.motu: noho-hedoa tauna na emui bese tauna korikori heḡereḡerena baine noho bogaragimui ai. Ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena; badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
LEV.19.34.english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

LEV.20.22.motu: Benaini: egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia, bona karadia ba kara; bena baina henimui ba noholaia tanona ese basine lorimui lasi.
LEV.20.22.english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

LEV.8.18.motu: Una murinai ia ese mamoe maruanena, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna, e hakaua lasi. Aaron mai natuna ida ese imadia na ia kwarana ai e ato kau;
LEV.8.18.english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

LEV.23.27.motu: Hua ihahituna dinana ihagwautana na herohemaino dinana: una dina ai emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia, bona ba helalo kerehai, bona ḡole-oho boubouna Iehova ba henia.
LEV.23.27.english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

LEV.7.23.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Digara basio ania, boromakau digarana eiava mamoe digarana eiava nani digarana.
LEV.7.23.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

LEV.15.21.motu: Ena mahuta patana ai baine dau kau tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.15.21.english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

LEV.17.8.motu: Ba haduadia danu, baoto: Israel tauna ta, eiava noho-hedoa tauna ta, ese ḡole-oho boubouna eiava idau boubouna ta baine alaia mase,
LEV.17.8.english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

LEV.14.28.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese dehoro taina imana ai mia baine abia, e haḡoevaiamu tauna idiba taiana abona bona idiba imana sinabadana bona idiba aena sinabadana baine dahulaidia, kara-dika boubouna rarana e dahulaidia gabudia ai.
LEV.14.28.english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

LEV.6.13.motu: Lahi na ihaboulaina patana latanai baine ara hanaihanai, basine bodo.
LEV.6.13.english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

LEV.25.12.motu: Badina be Iubile laḡanina na helaḡa emui ai: tano anina na bavania, vadaeni.
LEV.25.12.english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

LEV.15.2.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tau ta ese enobou gorerena baine davana, ia na baine miro.
LEV.15.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

LEV.6.10.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ena dabua bona ena piribou, dabua aukadia amo e kara ḡaudia, baine hadoki; bena ḡole-oho ḡauna kahuna na ihaboulaina patana latana amo baine abia oho, ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua.
LEV.6.10.english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

LEV.11.47.motu: mirodia bona ḡoevaḡoevadia ihididia bona bavani bona basio ani ḡaudia ihididia taravatudia.
LEV.11.47.english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

LEV.26.36.motu: A emui bese oredia na lalodia baina hadaradaradia, inaidia edia tano ai; au rauna lai ese e hohoamu reḡena ese baine hagaridia, bena bae heautania, dare bema heautania na heto; bena ta ese se hahavadia negana ai bae keto.
LEV.26.36.english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

LEV.9.8.motu: Taunabunai Aaron na ihaboulaina patana e raka henia kahi, boromakau natuna maruanena e alaia mase, ia sibona ena kara-rea boubouna.
LEV.9.8.english: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

LEV.1.7.motu: Bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese lahi bae haraia ihaboulaina patana latanai, bona rakuraku audia lahi ai bae ato kau.
LEV.1.7.english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

LEV.1.6.motu: Hari bae haḡolea oho ḡauna na bae kopaia, bena bae ivaia.
LEV.1.6.english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

LEV.25.17.motu: Raruosi basio hekoi heheni, a emui Dirava garina be gari, badina be lau be Iehova, emui Dirava.
LEV.25.17.english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.

LEV.5.12.motu: Ia ese hahelaḡa tauna dekena baine mailaia; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese una flaoa kahana na imana ai baine abia, helalo toana, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia ida; una na kara-dika boubouna.
LEV.5.12.english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

LEV.13.50.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia, bena ia ese hari mai gorerena ḡauna baine koua ahu ela bona dina hitu bae ore.
LEV.13.50.english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

LEV.24.7.motu: Ere ruaosi latadiai muramura mai bonana ḡoeva-daena bavatoa kau, iana flaoa ida helalo-tao toana ai baela, bona lahi boubouna ai baela, Iehova ena.
LEV.24.7.english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

LEV.14.4.motu: Bema boio, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine haḡanidia, lepra tauna ihaḡoevana totona manu ḡoevaḡoevadia rua mauridia ai bae abidia, bona sida audia taidia, bona dabua kakakakana taina, bona muramura avana.
LEV.14.4.english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

LEV.15.11.motu: Gorere tauna ese imana ranu ai basine huri, a tau ta baine daua toho, una tau ese ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.15.11.english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

LEV.23.12.motu: bena una iḡui idavena dinana ai mamoe natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana, laḡani tamona ḡauna, bavabia, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ena.
LEV.23.12.english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

LEV.22.7.motu: A dina baine diho, bena baine ḡoeva; una murinai ia ese aniani helaḡana baine ania, badina be ena heubu ḡauna bunai.
LEV.22.7.english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

LEV.16.24.motu: Bena baine digu, gabu helaḡana ta ai; una murinai ena dabua ma baine kara, baine raka lasi, ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona Israel taudia edia ḡole-oho ḡauna baine aladia mase, baine haḡole oho, ia dainai bona idia daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia.
LEV.16.24.english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

LEV.14.41.motu: Ruma laloma kahana idoinai danu bae kakasia, bona bae kakasia oho momoruna danu hanua murimurinai bae negea, miro ḡaudia e negemu gabuna ai.
LEV.14.41.english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

LEV.25.15.motu: Dekemu tauna ena tano ba hoia negana ai, ba laloa, Iubile murinai laḡani hida vada e lao bubuni; ia danu baine laloa, taboro hida do mimia.
LEV.25.15.english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

LEV.2.1.motu: Ta ese flaoa boubouna baine mailaia, Iehova ena, ia na flaoa namo-hereana baine abia, latanai dehoro baine seia, bona muramura mai bonana danu ia latanai baine atoa kau.
LEV.2.1.english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

LEV.4.10.motu: herohemaino boubouna boromakauna enai e abiamu heḡereḡerena baine abia. Hahelaḡa tauna ese ihaboulaina patana latanai baine gabua, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
LEV.4.10.english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

LEV.14.37.motu: bena gorere toana baine itaia; bema ruma habana na mai toutou gadoka-gadokadia eiava kakakakadia, bona toutou na dia haba kopina ai mo to sisina dobu,
LEV.14.37.english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

LEV.19.30.motu: Egu dina helaḡadia ba badinadia; egu gabu helaḡana ba matauraia. Lau binai Iehova.
LEV.19.30.english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

LEV.23.23.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.24.15.motu: Israel taudia ba hadibadia danu, ena Dirava baine uduguiraia tauna ese sibona ena dika madunana baine huaia.
LEV.24.15.english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

LEV.13.58.motu: A gorere toana basinema hedinarai lou, bae huria murinai, una dabua eiava una dabua varona eiava una boromakau kopina ḡauna na bae huria lou, nega iharuana, bena baine ḡoeva.
LEV.13.58.english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”
