LEV.7.10.motu: Flaoa boubouna, mai dehoro ida e buloa ḡauna, eiava flaoa kaukauna, ia danu Aaron natuna adia, unu haida heḡereḡeredia.
LEV.7.10.english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

LEV.8.30.motu: Bena Mose ese dehoro taina e abia, bona ihaboulaina patana latanai e miava rarana taina, Aaron mai dabuana ida bona Aaron natuna mai dabuadia ida e nevarilaidia: unu amo Aaron mai ena dabua ida bona Aaron natuna mai edia dabua ida e hahelaḡadia.
LEV.8.30.english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

LEV.13.27.motu: Dina ihahituna ai hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia Iou: toutou bema bada, ia ese una tau baine gwauraia, vada e miro; una na lepra.
LEV.13.27.english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

LEV.14.7.motu: Bena rara baine abia, ena lepra amo baine haḡoevaia; tauna baine nevarilaia, nega hitu; bena baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva. A manu maurina baine harohoa lasi murimuri ai.
LEV.14.7.english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

LEV.25.23.motu: Tano tabasio hoia vaitani, badina be tano na lauegu, umui ese o noholaiamu, e kara lauegu vadivadi na heto.
LEV.25.23.english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

LEV.24.16.motu: Iehova ladana baine uduguiraia tauna na baine mase; hebou taudia iboudiai ese bae hodoa mase. Ena be noho-hedoa tauna eiava Israel tauna korikori, to Lada Helaḡana bema uduguiraia, vada bae hodoa mase.
LEV.24.16.english: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

LEV.23.10.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Baina henimui tanona ai ba kau murinai, emui uma anidia ba utu negadia ai na emui iḡui roboana na hahelaḡa tauna dekena ba laohaia;
LEV.23.10.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

LEV.6.6.motu: Bena ena kara-koikoi boubouna baine mailaia Iehova enai, mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta, ena seri amo, oi ese davana ba gwauraia ḡauna, hahelaḡa tauna baine henia.
LEV.6.6.english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

LEV.18.16.motu: Ihamu ida basio eno bou; ia na tadikakamu ena.
LEV.18.16.english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

LEV.6.27.motu: Hidiona baine daua toho tauna na baine helaḡa. Rarana na dabua ta ai baine hetuturu, una dabua na gabu helaḡana ai bae huria.
LEV.6.27.english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

LEV.23.9.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.18.24.motu: Ini kara mirodia iboudiai na basio kara; badina be vairamui ai baina luludia lasi besedia be unu kara amo e hahemiromu.
LEV.18.24.english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

LEV.11.6.motu: Hea danu basio ania; badina be ana aniani e ḡauaia loumu, to imana aena palapaladia asieme parara; ia na helaḡa emui ai.
LEV.11.6.english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

LEV.10.16.motu: Bena Mose ese kara-rea boubouna nanina e tahua, to vada e heḡole oho. Bena ia ese Aaron natuna raruosi dounu mamauri, Eleasara bona Itamara, e badu henidia, eto,
LEV.10.16.english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

LEV.27.19.motu: Tano biaguna baine ura ena tano baine bodohilaia, ia ese dava baine heni mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau. Bena tano na iena.
LEV.27.19.english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

LEV.2.2.motu: Baine mailaia Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, dekediai; bena flaoa mai dehorona taina bona muramura mai bonana idoinai baine abi; bena hahelaḡa tauna ta ese ihaboulaina patana latanai baine gabu, lahi ese baine ḡole-oho. Una na helalo toana, ḡole-oho boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
LEV.2.2.english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

LEV.15.9.motu: Hosi doruna ai helai ḡauna na gorere tauna baine helai kau, una ḡau na miro.
LEV.15.9.english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

LEV.21.15.motu: unu amo natuna na basie hemarai ena bese taudia bogaragidiai; badina be lau Iehova ese vada na hahelaḡaia.
LEV.21.15.english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

LEV.22.2.motu: Aaron mai natuna ida taravadia bavatu, idia na Israel taudia edia boubou ḡaudia helaḡadia, lau dekegu ai e mailaidiamu ḡaudia, na bae matauraidia, lau ladagu helaḡana basie hahemaraia: lau binai Iehova.
LEV.22.2.english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

LEV.25.25.motu: Tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, bena ena tano kahana baine hoia, ia varavara-dosina ese una tano davana baine karaia, baine abia lou.
LEV.25.25.english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

LEV.22.3.motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto: Emui uru iboudiai lalodiai emui iduhu tauna ta ese Israel taudia edia boubou ḡaudia, e hahelaḡadiamu Iehova ena, baine raka henidia kahi mai mirona ida, una tau be lau vairagu ai bae negea daure. Lau binai Iehova.
LEV.22.3.english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

LEV.15.31.motu: Iniheto amo umui ese Israel taudia na edia miro amo ba haḡoevadia, lauegu dubu helaḡana, bogaragidiai e miamu dubuna, bae hamiroa, bena edia miro ai bae mase na garina.
LEV.15.31.english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

LEV.11.8.motu: Hidiodia basio ani, bona masedia ai basio daudia toho; idia na hehelaḡa umui emui ai.
LEV.11.8.english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

LEV.11.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e haduadia, eto,
LEV.11.1.english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

LEV.19.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.25.13.motu: Iubile laḡanina ai umui ta ta ena tano ena tano bavabi lou.
LEV.25.13.english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

LEV.4.35.motu: Bena digarana idoinai baine abia, herohemaino boubouna mamoena digarana e abiamu heḡereḡerena; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, ḡole-oho bouboudia ida, Iehova ena. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai baine herohemaino, bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
LEV.4.35.english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

LEV.18.28.motu: Bena umui ese unu ba hamiroa toma, ia ese umui danu baine lorimui lasi, e noholaia gunava taudia e loridia lasi na heto.
LEV.18.28.english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

LEV.14.19.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese kara-rea boubouna ḡauna baine alaia mase, e haḡoevaiamu tauna dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia; murinai ḡoIe-oho mamoena baine alaia mase.
LEV.14.19.english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

LEV.11.11.motu: Ba dadaraidia vaitani: hidiodia basio ani, bona masedia ai basio daudia toho; idia na hehelaḡa emui ai.
LEV.11.11.english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

LEV.22.5.motu: eiava tano ai e raumu ḡauna mirona ta baine daua toho, eiava edena miro edena miro amo vada e hahemiro tauna baine daua toho,
LEV.22.5.english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

LEV.4.32.motu: A mamoe natuna bema mailaia, ena kara-rea boubouna, ia ese mamoe natuna hahinena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia;
LEV.4.32.english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

LEV.22.11.motu: A hahelaḡa tauna ese moni amo e hoia tauna ese baine ania; bona hahelaḡa tauna ena ruma ai hesiai ai e vara tauna ese danu baine ania.
LEV.22.11.english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

LEV.11.45.motu: Badina be lau na Iehova: Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi, emui Dirava ai bainala totona. Taunabunai ba helaḡa, badina be lau na helaḡa.
LEV.11.45.english: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

LEV.25.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, Sinai ororona ai, eto,
LEV.25.1.english: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

LEV.7.16.motu: A baine mailaia ḡauna, na gwau hamata dainai baine mailaia, eiava herahia ḡauna, bae hahelaḡaia dinana ai bae ania, ma bahu dina iharuana ai bae ania.
LEV.7.16.english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

LEV.27.29.motu: Bema taunimanima ta unu bae henia vaitani toma, idia na basie bodohilaia diba: vada bae alaia mase.
LEV.27.29.english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

LEV.23.44.motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e haboudia, Iehova ena aria herevadia e hadibalaidia.
LEV.23.44.english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.

LEV.26.17.motu: Vairagu baina ha-aukaia emui ai. Inaimui ese bae hadareremui bona bae halohiamui. Ta ese basine havamui negana ai ba heau.
LEV.26.17.english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

LEV.15.14.motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, ia na kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua baine abidia, baine mailaidia Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai; unuseni ai hahelaḡa tauna baine henia.
LEV.15.14.english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

LEV.21.20.motu: eiava doru-laoho tauna, eiava tau kwadogi-herea eiava mata-gegeva tauna, eiava kopi-hemaihemai gorerena tauna, eiava kopina mai taohana tauna, eiava abona nadinadina e heala tauna.
LEV.21.20.english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

LEV.13.7.motu: Ḡau tamona, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine kahua nege, murinai una toutou ma baine bada lou, ia na hahelaḡa tauna dekena ma baine lou lao.
LEV.13.7.english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

LEV.19.31.motu: Rohe taudia bona babalau taudia na basio lao henidia; basio tahudia bona, edia kara miro ai basio miro. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
LEV.19.31.english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

LEV.11.32.motu: Bona bae mase negana ai idia ese ḡau ta latanai bae moru, una ḡau baine miro: bema au amo e karaia ḡauna ta, eiava dabua, eiava kopi, eiava puse, ranu ai do ba udaia; ia na baine miro ela bona dina baine diho, una murinai baine ḡoeva.
LEV.11.32.english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

LEV.24.21.motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna baine alaia mase tauna ese davana baine heni; a taunimanima baine alaia mase tauna na bae alaia mase.
LEV.24.21.english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

LEV.20.5.motu: lau ese vairagu baina ha-aukaia una tau enai bona ena iduhu taudia iboudiai ediai; edia bese amo baina negea daure, ia bona ia ida Molek vairani, eha lebulebu taudia iboudiai danu.
LEV.20.5.english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

LEV.8.19.motu: bena Mose ese e alaia mase, rarana na ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai e nevaria heḡeḡe.
LEV.8.19.english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

LEV.8.9.motu: Kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana danu kwarana ai e ḡeḡea, bona bagunai gold koronana helaḡana e atoa, Iehova ese Mose e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
LEV.8.9.english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

LEV.26.42.motu: lau ese egu gwau-hamata, Iakob bona Isaak bona Abraham na gwaurai henidia hamata ḡauna, baina helalolaia une, bona tano danu baina laloa.
LEV.26.42.english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

LEV.23.20.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine davedia, flaoa matamatana bouboudia ida, idoinai, hari mamoe natuna ruaosi ida, davedave boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena. Idia na Iehova ena ḡau helaḡadia, hahelaḡa tauna ana.
LEV.23.20.english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

LEV.9.19.motu: Boromakau digarana, bona mamoe digarana, bona mamoe iuna mai digarana ida, bona bogana bona bogarauna urubina, bona nadinadi, bona ase digarana, e abi;
LEV.9.19.english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

LEV.2.15.motu: Bena latadiai dehoro ba seia, bona latadiai danu muramura mai bonana bavato kau: ia danu flaoa boubouna ḡauna.
LEV.2.15.english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

LEV.13.6.motu: Ma dina ihahituna ai hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia lou: toutou bema maraḡi bona dia dobu, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva. Una na idau toto taohana. Ena dabua baine huri, bena baine ḡoeva.
LEV.13.6.english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

LEV.21.22.motu: Ena Dirava ena flaoa, helaḡa ḡauna bona helaḡa-herea ḡauna, baine ani diba;
LEV.21.22.english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

LEV.6.15.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ta ese boubou flaoana kahana mai dehorona imana ai baine abia, bona muramura mai bonana idoinai, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, helalo toana ai bainela, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
LEV.6.15.english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

LEV.25.14.motu: Dekemu tauna enai ba hoihoi, basio koia, ia danu basine koimu.
LEV.25.14.english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

LEV.11.31.motu: Tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bunu hehelaḡa umui emui ai; bona masedia ai baine daudia toho tauna baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.11.31.english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

LEV.19.32.motu: Tau burukana vairanai ba tore isi; iahu ba matauraia; emu Dirava garina ba gari. Lau binai Iehova.
LEV.19.32.english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

LEV.25.49.motu: eiava tamana lahaina ese, eiava varavarana ta ese; eiava ia sibona moni baine davaria negana ai na sibona baine hahemauri.
LEV.25.49.english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

LEV.1.2.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tau ta ese Iehova baine boua, ia na boromakau serina amo eiava mamoe serina amo ena ihaboulaina ḡauna baine abia.
LEV.1.2.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

LEV.23.26.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,

LEV.19.33.motu: Bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna na basio daḡedaḡe henia;
LEV.19.33.english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

LEV.25.16.motu: Bema laḡani momo mimia, davana na baine bada, a bema laḡani gadoi mo mimia, davana na baine maraḡi, badina e hoimu ḡauna be taboro e hoimu.
LEV.25.16.english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

LEV.23.32.motu: Ina na dina helaḡa badana, emui laḡa-ani dinana badana, bona emui helalo dinana badana: hua dinana ihataurahani-tana ai dina baine diho elabona dina ihagwautana ai dina baine diho ina dina helaḡana ba badinaia.
LEV.23.32.english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

LEV.14.46.motu: Daika ese ruma lalonai vada e raka vareai, hahelaḡa tauna ese e koua murinai, ia na baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.14.46.english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

LEV.27.33.motu: Basine itaia, namona eiava dikana; bona basine boloa: bema boloa, ḡau ruaosi bema helaḡa. Bona basine bodohilaia diba.
LEV.27.33.english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

LEV.13.45.motu: Lepra tauna na dabua hedarena baine hahedokilaia, huina baine ḡiḡia rohoroho, atai bibinana na dabua amo baine koua, baine lolo, baineto “Miro, miro”.
LEV.13.45.english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

LEV.11.44.motu: Badina be lau na Iehova, emui Dirava: taunabunai sibomui ba hahelaḡa. Ba helaḡa, badina be lau na helaḡa. Tano ai e raumu ḡauna ta ena miro ai basio miro.
LEV.11.44.english: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

LEV.4.11.motu: A boromakau kopina bona hidiona bona kwarana bona imana bona aena bona bogana bona bogarauna bona taḡena,
LEV.4.11.english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

LEV.11.27.motu: Bona imadia aedia palapaladia eme manoka to imadia aedia amo e rakamu ḡaudia danu hehelaḡa umui emui ai; masedia ai baine daudia toho tauna baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho;
LEV.11.27.english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

LEV.27.32.motu: Boromakau seridia bona mamoe seridia danu bae karoadia. Ireḡudia tauna ena itotohi henuna amo bae raka hanai; baine duahidia gwauta gwauta amo, bena ihagwautadia na bae helaḡa, Iehova ena.
LEV.27.32.english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

LEV.14.25.motu: Bena kara-dika boubouna mamoena baine alaia mase, bona rarana baine abia, e haḡoevaiamu tauna idiba taiana abona bona idiba imana sinabadana bona idiba aena sinabadana baine dahulaidia.
LEV.14.25.english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

LEV.24.11.motu: Bena hari hane Israel natuna ese Lada Helaḡana e uduguiraia, hereva metaudia e gwaurai. Bena haida ese e hakaua lao, Mose vairanai. Sinana ladana na Selomiti Dibri, Dan iduhuna hahinena.
LEV.24.11.english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

LEV.9.16.motu: Ḡole-oho boubouna danu ia ese e abia, e alaia mase, e haḡolea oho, haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
LEV.9.16.english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

LEV.14.31.motu: ta kara-rea boubouna ai bainela, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, flaoa boubouna ida; unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai, e haḡoevaiamu tauna ena.
LEV.14.31.english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

LEV.17.5.motu: A Israel taudia na edia boubou ḡaudia taruha murimurinai bae aladia mase negadia ai, idia ese Iehova dekena bae mailaidia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai, unuseni ai hahelaḡa tauna bae henia, edia herohemaino bouboudia ai bae halaodia Iehova ena.
LEV.17.5.english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

LEV.4.24.motu: imana na nani kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena ḡole-oho bouboudia Iehova vairanai e aladia masemu gabuna ai bainealaia mase: ia be kara-rea boubouna.
LEV.4.24.english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

LEV.1.16.motu: Bogarauna bona huina na baine abidia, ihaboulaina patana mairiveina kahana ai baine negedia, lahi kahuna e negeamu gabuna ai.
LEV.1.16.english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

LEV.13.35.motu: A baine ḡoeva murinai una pouka ma baine hekara lou,
LEV.13.35.english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

LEV.7.12.motu: Tau ta ese hahenamo boubouna baine mailaia, ia na ena boubou ḡauna ida se hatubua flaoana dehoro ida e bulo dikeadia, bona se hatubua flaoana atagadia, latadiai dehoro e seia ḡaudia, bona flaoa namo-hereana dehoroida e buloa bena e gabua, baine mailai.
LEV.7.12.english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

LEV.8.25.motu: Bena ia ese digarana e abia, bona iuna mai digarana ida, bona boga bona bogarau urubina, bona ase digarana, bona nadinadi ruaosi mai digaradia ida, bona aena idibana.
LEV.8.25.english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

LEV.21.24.motu: Ini hereva iboudiai Mose ese Aaron mai natuna ida bona Israel taudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
LEV.21.24.english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

LEV.7.38.motu: Iehova ese Sinai ororona ai Mose e haḡanilaia heḡereḡerena. Dinana bunai, ia ese Israel taudia e haḡanidia edia boubou ḡaudia Iehova dekenai bae mailaidia, Sinai tano-ḡaḡaena ai.
LEV.7.38.english: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.

LEV.14.39.motu: Dina ihahituna ai, hahelaḡa tauna ma bainela, baine itaia, ruma habana ai toutou vada e bada eiava.
LEV.14.39.english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

LEV.3.17.motu: Mia-hanaihanai taravatuna binai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia idoidiai lalodiai: digara bona rara basio ani.
LEV.3.17.english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

LEV.13.23.motu: A toutou na gabuna ai mo bema mia, basinema bada, una na iohururu kiparana mo; hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva.
LEV.13.23.english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

LEV.13.56.motu: A hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia, ihurina murinai gorere toana vada e heroho valahu-valahumu: ia na toutou e miamu gabuna baine darea oho, dabua amo eiava boromakau kopina amo eiava dabua varona amo;
LEV.13.56.english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

LEV.8.15.motu: bena Mose ese e alaia mase, rarana e abia, imana kwakikwakina amo ihaboulaina patana ai doa e dahulai, ihaboulaina patana e hahelaḡaia. Bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana badinai e bubua nege, unu amo e hahelaḡaia bona e haḡoevaia.
LEV.8.15.english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

LEV.16.8.motu: Bena Aaron ese mari amo baine tahudia, nani maruanena ta Iehova ena, ma ta Asasele ena.
LEV.16.8.english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

LEV.18.29.motu: Badina be unu kara mirodia bae kara taudia iboudiai na edia bese amo bae negedia daure.
LEV.18.29.english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

LEV.23.24.motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Hua ihahituna dinana gini-gunana na laḡa-ani dinanahelaḡana ta emui, helalo-tao dinana mai kibi ihiriridia, bona hebou helaḡana dinana.
LEV.23.24.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

LEV.19.19.motu: Egu taravatu ba badinadia. Emu ubu-ubu ḡaudia orea idau-idaubasio haheḡodaḡodadia. Uhe idau-idau inoḡo tamona ai basio hado. Dabua idau-idau amo e karaia hahedokina basio dokilaia.

LEV.2.14.motu: Emu uit ba karoa, herahia karoana Iehova ba henia, negana ai, uit anidia do asie auka ḡaudia bavabi, lahi latanai ba hakaukaudia, bena ba gwadadia, kopidia ba nege.
LEV.2.14.english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

LEV.25.44.motu: E noho hetabiramu besedia edia amo emui hesiai taudia bona hahinedia ba hoidia;
LEV.25.44.english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

LEV.4.29.motu: Bena imana na ena kara-rea boubouna ḡauna kwarana ai baine atoa kau; bena ḡole-oho bouboudia e aladia masemu gabuna ai baine alaia mase.
LEV.4.29.english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

LEV.16.25.motu: Kara rea boubouna digarana danu ihaboulaina patana latanai baine haḡolea oho.
LEV.16.25.english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

LEV.25.40.motu: a mai davana emu ai e ḡaukaramu tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna heḡereḡerena oi dekemuai baine noho. Ia na oi isiaimu baine lao heni ela bona Iubile laḡanina;
LEV.25.40.english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

LEV.8.31.motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron mai natuna ida e haḡanidia, eto, Hidiona na ranu ai ba nadua, hebou kalagana iduarana badinai, unuseni ai bavania, bona bosea helaḡana lalonai e miamu flaoana danu, lau na hahedua heḡereḡerena, nato “Aaron mai natuna ida bae ania”.
LEV.8.31.english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

LEV.19.20.motu: Tau ta ese hesiai kekenina ida baine eno bou, a una kekeni be mai maohenina, bona heni-tao monina dainai eiava hebogahisi dainai ena hesiai ilao-henina amo do se ruhaia nege, kara anina bae tahu henidia; to basie aladia mase, badina be hahine na do se ruhaia nege.
LEV.19.20.english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

LEV.25.45.motu: bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu taudia edia amo danu natudia emui tano ai e vara na ba hoidia diba, emui iḡui taudia ai baela.
LEV.25.45.english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

LEV.2.8.motu: Flaoa boubouna na unu ba karaia toma, bena Iehova enai ba mailaia, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine abia, ihaboulaina patana vairanai baine laohaia.
LEV.2.8.english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

LEV.4.8.motu: Bena ia ese kara-rea boubouna boromakauna digarana idoinai baine abia: boga bona bogarau urubina,
LEV.4.8.english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

LEV.15.22.motu: Ena helai ḡauna ai baine dau kau tauna danu ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.15.22.english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

LEV.13.13.motu: ia ese baine itaia namonamo; bema momokani kopina idoinai vada e daea vaitani, ia ese una tau baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva. Kopina idoinai vada e kurokuro dainai, ia na vada e ḡoeva.
LEV.13.13.english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

LEV.22.17.motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.1.9.motu: a bogarauna bona imana bona aena na ranu ai bae huridia guna. Bena idoinai be hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai, haḡole-oho ḡauna ai bainela lahi ai, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
LEV.1.9.english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

LEV.3.14.motu: Ena boubou ḡauna amo, lahi ese baine ḡole oho ḡaudia, Iehova ena, baine abi, ḡaudia bini: boga bona bogarau urubina,
LEV.3.14.english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

LEV.10.7.motu: Bona hebou kalagana iduarana amo basio raka lasi, ba mase garina; badina be Iehova ena dehoro helaḡana na latamui ai. Bena Mose ena hereva heḡereḡerena ai e karaia.
LEV.10.7.english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

LEV.1.17.motu: Hanina amo baine darea parara; basine ivaia. Hahelaḡa tauna ese rakuraku audia latadiai baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai, heḡole-oho ḡauna ai bainela lahi ai, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
LEV.1.17.english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

LEV.11.25.motu: bona tau-anidia baine abi loaloa taunana ena dabua baine huri bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.11.25.english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

LEV.16.19.motu: bona imana kwakikwakina amo baine nevarilaia nega hitu. Unuhetomana ia ese ihaboulaina patana na Israel taudia edia miro amo baine haḡoevaia bona baine hahelaḡaia.
LEV.16.19.english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

LEV.27.11.motu: A bema mauri ḡauna mirona ta, Iehova ena ihaboulaina ai asie halaoamu ḡauna, gwau-hamata tauna ese una ḡau baine laohaiaha helaḡa tauna vairanai.
LEV.27.11.english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

LEV.8.36.motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilai karadia iboudiai na Aaron mai natuna ese e karadia ḡuḡuru.
LEV.8.36.english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.

LEV.5.1.motu: Tau ta ese e itaia ḡauna eiava mai dibana ḡauna bema herevalaia diba hahemaoro gabuna ai, to basine herevalaia, ia na baine kerere.
LEV.5.1.english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

LEV.26.9.motu: Lau ese baina haḡeremui, natumui momo baina henimui, baina hahutumamui. Egu gwau-hamata emui aido baina hamomokania.
LEV.26.9.english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

LEV.23.39.motu: Benaini, hua ihahituna dinana ihagwauta-imana, uma anidia iboudiaiba haboudia murinai, Iehova ena aria ba karaia dina hitu lalodiai. Aria dinana gini-gunana na laḡa-ani helaḡa dinana, bona aria dinana ihataurahanina na laḡa-ani helaḡa dinana.
LEV.23.39.english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

LEV.13.30.motu: hahelaḡa tauna ese una pouka baine itaia: totototona bema sisina dobu, bona huina bema labora, ia ese una tau eiava una hahine baine gwauraia, vada e miro; una na pouka dikana, lepra heḡereḡerena.
LEV.13.30.english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

LEV.14.10.motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, ia ese mamoe natudia mamaruanedia rua, asi bebeka-bebekadia, bona mamoe natuna hahinena ta, laḡani tamona ḡauna asi bebeka-bebekana, baine abidia. Bona flaoa namo-hereana efa ta baine karoa, karoa gwauta; bena karoa toi baine abi, dehoro ida baine bulo. Bona dehoro kebere ta danu baine abia.
LEV.14.10.english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

LEV.6.7.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai; unu amo ena kara dika idoinai baine hegwau tao.
LEV.6.7.english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

LEV.18.1.motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,

LEV.23.8.motu: Dina hituosi lalodiai emui ḡole-oho bouboudia Iehova ba henia; bena dina ihahituna ai emui hebou helaḡana ma ba karaia lou. Una dina ai danu ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
LEV.23.8.english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

LEV.13.42.motu: A bema kwarana tubuana ai eiava ramana ai, huina vada e hehuhu gabuna ai, toutou mia-kakana ta baine hedinarai, una na lepra, boha tauna kwarana ai eiava ramana ai vada e vara.
LEV.13.42.english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

LEV.13.8.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine itaia, toutou na momokani vada e bada, ia na una tau baine gwauraia, vada e miro; ia na lepra tauna.
LEV.13.8.english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

LEV.27.30.motu: Tano anidia, nadinadi eiava huahua, bae karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta bae hahelaḡaia, Iehova ena.
LEV.27.30.english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

LEV.27.9.motu: Ḡau helaḡana bema mauri ḡauna ta, taunimanima vaia Iehova ena ihaboulaina ai e halaomu ḡaudia ta, una ḡau danu baine helaḡa, tau ta ese Iehova vada e henia dainai.
LEV.27.9.english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

LEV.15.23.motu: Ena mahuta ḡauna ta eiava ena helai ḡauna ta latadiai tau ta ese bema daua toho, una tau baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
LEV.15.23.english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

LEV.21.14.motu: vabu eiava diho hahinena eiava vada e hamiroa hahinena eiava ariara hahinena basine adavaia. Hane-ulato rami-hebou ta, ena beseamo mo, baine adavaia;
LEV.21.14.english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

LEV.26.40.motu: To bema helalo kerehai, edia kara dika bona tamadia edia kara dika, edia kara hedibaḡani egu ai bona edia raka muri karadia,
LEV.26.40.english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

LEV.14.13.motu: Hari mamoe natuna maruanena na kara-rea bouboudia ḡaudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia ḡaudia e aladiamu gabuna ai baine alaia, gabu helaḡana ai; badina be kara-dika boubouna ḡauna na hahelaḡa tauna ana, kara-rea boubouna heḡereḡerena. Ia na helaḡa herea.
LEV.14.13.english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

LEV.15.4.motu: E mahutalaia patana na miro, bona latadiai e helai kau ḡaudia iboudiai na mimiro.
LEV.15.4.english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

LEV.10.13.motu: Gabu helaḡana ai bavania; badina be ia na oi ahumu bona natumu ahudia, Iehova ena ḡole-oho boubouna amo. Unu vada e haduagu toma.
LEV.10.13.english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

LEV.26.5.motu: Uit ikwadina do basine ore ai vine huahuadia iutudia baine hematama, bona vine huahuadia iutudia do basine ore ai hadohado baine hematama. Bavaniani boga kunu, emui tano ai ba noho, asi emui kudou hetaha.
LEV.26.5.english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

LEV.11.26.motu: Imana aena palapaladia eme auka to asieme parara ḡauna, eiava ena aniani asine ḡauaia loumu ḡauna, na helaḡa umui emui ai: bona baine daua toho tauna na taubu.
LEV.11.26.english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

LEV.13.21.motu: A baine itaia, dera na se kurokuro, bona toutou na kopina ai mo bona dia kurokuro herea eiava dia kakakaka herea, hahelaḡa tauna ese una tau baine koua ahu ela bona dina hitu bae ore;
LEV.13.21.english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

LEV.11.12.motu: Ranu ai e nohomu ḡaudia asi taiadia bona asi unadia na ba dadaraidia vaitani.
LEV.11.12.english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

LEV.11.36.motu: Ḡau tamona, ranu e lohilohia gabuna eiava ranu gurina be bae ḡoeva. A mase tau-anina enai baine dau kau ḡauna na baine miro.
LEV.11.36.english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

LEV.16.2.motu: Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Kakamu Aaron, ia na dina iboudiai gabu helaḡana, seseahu lalonai, maua helaḡana ikaruhina vairanai, basine raka vareai, lasi ona lasi vaitani, baine mase garina; badina be lau na ori ai baina hedinarai, maua helaḡana ikaruhina latanai.

LUK.9.50.english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t \+w forbid|strong="G2967"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3739"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w he|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w against|strong="G2596"\+w* \+w us|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w us|strong="G3004"\+w*.”

LUK.1.74.motu: Ita inaida amo baine hamaurida eto,
LUK.1.74.english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies,

LUK.6.34.motu: Bona davana bae haloua taudia mo boma henidia torehai, emui namo be dahaka? Kara dika taudia danu bamodia e henidia torehaimu, dava iabina halaoreana.
LUK.6.34.english: \+w If|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w lend|strong="G1155"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w from|strong="G3844"\+w* \+w whom|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w hope|strong="G1679"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w receive|strong="G2983"\+w*, \+w what|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w credit|strong="G5485"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w*? \+w Even|strong="G2532"\+w* sinners \+w lend|strong="G1155"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* sinners, \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w receive|strong="G2983"\+w* \+w back|strong="G2983"\+w* \+w as|strong="G2532"\+w* much.

LUK.24.42.motu: Idia ese gwarume taina, vada e gabua ḡauna, e henia;
LUK.24.42.english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

LUK.9.57.motu: Idia dala amo e laova ai, tau ta ese e hereva henia, eto, Lau na emu laolao iboudiai lalodiai baina bamomu.
LUK.9.57.english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

LUK.13.3.motu: Na hamaoromuimu, lasi; to umui na basio helalo kerehai, iboumui ai unu ba mase toma.
LUK.13.3.english: \+w I|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w tell|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w*, \+w no|strong="G3361"\+w*, \+w but|strong="G3361"\+w* \+w unless|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w*, \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w will|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* perish \+w in|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w same|strong="G3668"\+w* \+w way|strong="G3668"\+w*.

LUK.8.30.motu: Bena Iesu ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi ladamu be daika? Ia eto, Tuari Oreana; badina be lauma dikadia hoho ese e boloava.
LUK.8.30.english: Jesus asked him, “\+w What|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w your|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w*?”

LUK.21.5.motu: Haida ese dubu Helaḡa e herevalaia, ihaheralaina nadidia nanlodia bona herahia ḡaudia helaḡadia herevadia e kara. A ia eto,
LUK.21.5.english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

LUK.22.69.motu: A harihari ela, Taunimanima Natuna na Dirava siahuna idibana kahana ai baine helai.
LUK.22.69.english: \+w From|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w now|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1537"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w Son|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w Man|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w be|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w seated|strong="G2521"\+w* \+w at|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w right|strong="G1188"\+w* \+w hand|strong="G1188"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w power|strong="G1411"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*.”

LUK.5.22.motu: A Iesu na edia lalo-hadai dibana, bena eto, Badina be dahaka lalomui ene o hadai tomamu?
LUK.5.22.english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “\+w Why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w reasoning|strong="G1260"\+w* \+w so|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w your|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w hearts|strong="G2588"\+w*?

LUK.6.39.motu: Ia ese hereva heḡereḡerena ta e henidia, eto, Mata-kepulu tauna ta ese mata-kepulu tauna ma ta baine hakaua diba eiava? Raruosi dadaira ai basie moru a?
LUK.6.39.english: He spoke a parable to them. “\+w Can|strong="G1410"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w blind|strong="G5185"\+w* \+w guide|strong="G3594"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w blind|strong="G5185"\+w*? Won’t \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w both|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w fall|strong="G1706"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w pit|strong="G2532"\+w*?

LUK.7.21.motu: Una negana ai Iesu ese hutuma e hamauridiava: gorere taudia, hisi-ani taudia, lauma dikadia ese e bolodia taudia. Bona mata-kepulu taudia hutuma danu matadia e hapapa.
LUK.7.21.english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

MAL.2.5.motu: Egu gwauhamata ienai na mauri bona maino gwauhamatana, bena unu na na henia, baine gari helaoreana. Bena e gari henigu, bona ladagu e matauraia.
MAL.2.5.english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

MAL.1.13.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Umui o tomamu “Ina daka hekwarahi”, bona o hamue henigumu. Dadidadi ḡauna eiava ae-hedairike ḡauna eiava gorere ḡauna o mailaiamu, emui boubou ḡauna ai ba halaoa o tomamu. Iehova na e tomu, Be, una na imamui amo baina abia a?
MAL.1.13.english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

MAL.2.6.motu: Hahediba herevadia momokanidia na ia uduna ai e miava, bona ia bibinana ai kerere ta se miava. Ia na lau ida a raka hebouva, maino ai bona kara maoromaoro ai, bona hutuma na ia ese kara havara amo e hakaudia siri.
MAL.2.6.english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

MAL.2.4.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Unu amo ba diba, ina haheḡani na lau ese vada na siaia vasi, egu gwauhamata Levi enai baine momokani helaoreana.
MAL.2.4.english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.4.1.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Badina be, a itaia, dina na e maimu; e siahumu amu siahuna na heto. Una dina ai hekokoroku taudia iboudiai bona kara dika taudia iboudiai na rei kakoro heḡereḡerena ai baela; hari bainema dinana ese baine aradia ore, bena idia ediai ramu ta eiava rigi ta basine mia.
MAL.4.1.english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

MAL.3.5.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Una negana ai lau na hahemaoro totona baina vasi. Lau ese babalau taudia, heuda-hanai taudia, gwauhamata koikoi taudia, ḡaukara taudia davadia ihenidia ai e koidiamu bona vabu bona ihareha e hahisidiamu taudia, bona noho-hedoa tauna e doria ohomu bona lau garigu asie garimu taudia na baina habadelaidia haraḡa.
MAL.3.5.english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.1.12.motu: A umui na O tomu Iehova ena pata vada e hamiroa bena anianina bae dadaraia negana ai, umui ese una pata na o hamiroamu.
MAL.1.12.english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

MAL.1.5.motu: Sibomui matamui amo ba itaia, bena baoto, Iehova na herea, Israel tanona murimurinai.
MAL.1.5.english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

MAL.1.14.motu: Koikoi tauna na mai ena mamoe maruanena ta ena mamoe serina ai, bena e gwau hamatalaiamu; to mai dikana ḡauna ta na e hahelaḡaiamu, Ḡaubada ena; ia na bae uduguiraia. Badina be lau na Pavapava badana, bona lau ladagu na e gari heniamu, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
MAL.1.14.english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

MAL.1.10.motu: Umui bogaragimui amo ta ese iduara bema koudia, bena lahi na egu ihaboulaina patana latanai basioma ha-araia kava, una na bema namo. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau ese asina moalelaimuimu, bona boubou ḡaudia na umui imamui amo basioa abi.
MAL.1.10.english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

MAL.2.3.motu: A itaia, lau ese natumui baina gwau henidia, bona boromakau bona mamoe taḡedia na vairamui baina dahulaidia, hari emui boubou ḡaudia taḡedia; bena lau vairagu amo baina atomui lasi murimuri ai.
MAL.2.3.english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

MAL.3.16.motu: Bena Iehova garina e gariva taudia na e hereva heheniva; Iehova ese e hakala henidia, bona edia hereva e kamonai, bena Iehova garina e gariva bona ia ladana e helalolaiava taudia ilalo-taodia bukana vada e torea ia vairanai.
MAL.3.16.english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.

MAL.2.12.motu: Ini e kara tomamu tauna iduruna lotona bema hereva eiava bema haere eiava boubou ḡauna Iehova Sabaota enai bema mailaia tauna na Iehova ese Iakob ena kalaga amo baine negea daure, una be namo.
MAL.2.12.english: Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.1.7.motu: Iniheto: aniani ḡaudia mirodia na egu ihaboulaina patana ai vada o ato. Ma o tomu, Ede a h uniroa toma? Iniheto: umui na o laloa Iehova ena pata baine hedadarai diba.
MAL.1.7.english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’

MAL.3.6.motu: Badina be lau Iehova na asina idaumu. Una dainai, Iakob garana e, umui na asio mase ore.
MAL.3.6.english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

MAL.3.12.motu: Bena bese iboudiai ese bae imodaimui; badina be moale tanona ai baola. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
MAL.3.12.english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.2.17.motu: Emui hereva amo Iehova vada o hahekwarahia ema bona vada e hesiku. Ḡau tamona, umui na o tomu, Ede a hahekwarahia toma? Iniheto: umui oto, Kara dika taudia iboudiai nanamo, Iehova vairanai, bona ia ese e moalelaidiamu. Eiava o henanadai, oto, Hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva Diravana be edeseni ai?
MAL.2.17.english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

MAL.4.6.motu: Bena ia ese tama lalodia na baine haloudia natudia ediai, bona natu lalodia na baine haloudia tamadia ediai, lau baina vasi bena tano na heuduguirai amo baina habuaia tari na garina.
MAL.4.6.english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

MAL.3.2.motu: A itaia, gwauhamata gwaukauna tauna, o moalelaiamu tauna, na e maimu. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. A ena mai dinana ai, daika baine haheauka diba? Bona baine hedinarai negana ai, daika baine gini diba?
MAL.3.2.english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

MAL.3.9.motu: Heuduguirai na latamui ai vada e kau, badina be umui na mai besemui idoinai ida ese o dadihaigumu.
MAL.3.9.english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

MAL.3.8.motu: Be, taunimanima ese Dirava bae dadihaia a? Mato, umui ese o dadihaigumu. A umui o tomamu, Ede a dadihaimu tomamu? Iniheto: emui ḡau ikaroadia ai bona emui herahia ḡaudia ihenidia ai.
MAL.3.8.english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

MAL.2.10.motu: Ita iboudai tamada na tamona, ani? Dirava tamona ese vada e karada, ani? Benaini, dahaka dainai ita na ta hekoi hehenimu, bena seneda edia gwauhamata ta hadikaiamu?
MAL.2.10.english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

MAL.2.13.motu: Ina danu o karaiamu. Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana na iruru-matamui amo o hada'ania ḡuḡurumu, mai taitaimui bona mai ḡanaḡanamui ida, badina be ia ese boubou ḡauna ihaḡerena vada e hadokoa, bona imamui amo asie abia daemu mai lalo-namona ida.
MAL.2.13.english: “This again you do: you cover Yahweh’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

MAL.1.6.motu: Mero ese tamana e matauraiamu, bona hesiai tauna ese biaguna e matauraiamu. Bena bema lau na tama, imatauraigu be edeseni ai? Eiava bema lau na biagu, igari-henigu be edeseni ai? Hahelaḡa taumui e, lau ladagu o dadaraiamu taumui e, lau, Iehova Sabaota, na hereva henimuimu. Umui na o tomu, Oi ladamu ede a dadaraia toma?
MAL.1.6.english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

MAL.3.7.motu: Senemui edia nega amo umui na egu taravatu vada o rakatanidia bona asio badinadia. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A lou henigu, bena lau ese baina lou henimui. A umui na o tomamu, Ede baia lou toma?
MAL.3.7.english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

MAL.2.16.motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na e tomu, Badina be hahekoho na na inai heniamu, bona daḡedaḡe karadia ai dabuana e hamiroamu tauna danu na inai heniamu. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. Taunabunai, sibomui ba henahua toho, bona adavamui basio hadihodia.
MAL.2.16.english: One who hates and divorces”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

MAL.3.15.motu: Ina negana amo, hekokoroku taudia na namodia baita gwaurai; kara dika taudia na e taḡamu; a dia una mo, Dirava e dibaganiamu negadia ai danu idia na e roho niaurimu.
MAL.3.15.english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

MAL.2.1.motu: Hahelaḡa taumui e, harihari ina haheḡani na umui latamui ai.
MAL.2.1.english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

MAL.2.15.motu: Dirava tamona ese mauri laumana vada e karaia bona vada e hahesiriua ita eda, ani? Bona iena ura be dahaka? Ena ura be ita ese ia bae matauraia memerodia na baita havaradia. Taunabunai, sibomui ba henahua toho, bona ta ese eregabena ai e adavaia hahinena na basine rakatania.
MAL.2.15.english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

MAL.2.8.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A umui na dala amo vada o raka siri, bona emu hahediba herevadia amo hutuma vada o hahekwakwanaidia; umui ese Levi ena gwauhamata vada o hadikaia.
MAL.2.8.english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.3.18.motu: Bena emui haero-haero ai kara namo taudia bona kara dika taudia ma ba hididia lou, Dirava isiaina e lao heniamu tauna bona isiaina se lao heniamu tauna danu ba hididia.
MAL.3.18.english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

MAL.4.4.motu: Egu hesiai tauna Mose ena taravatu ba badinaia, ena taravatu bona ena hahemaoro herevadia lau ese Horeb ai na haganilai heniava, Israel idoinai ese bae badina ḡaudia.
MAL.4.4.english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

MAL.4.2.motu: A umui, lau ladagu o gari heniamu taumui, emui ai kara maoromaoro dinana baine dae, mai hahemaurina ia hanina ai. Do ba raka lasi mai rohomui ida, boromakau natudia na edia aniani gabuna amo e roho lasimu na heto.
MAL.4.2.english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

MAL.3.11.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Kwadi baina gwaua tao, emui tano anidia basine ha-oredia totona; bona imea ai emui vine na huahua ai basie dabu.
MAL.3.11.english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.4.3.motu: Bena lau ese karana baina karaia dinana ai, kara dika taudia na ba moimoilaidia, badina be idia na kahu ai baela, aemui palapaladia henudiai. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
MAL.4.3.english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.1.4.motu: Edom bema toma “Vada e taomai tari, to vada eme heḡiḡi dobi gabudia ma baia haginidia lou”, bena Iehova Sabaota bema toma “Readia bae haginidia, to lau ese ma baina ḡiḡidia dobi, ela bona vada bae gwauraidia kara-dika tanona bona Iehova ese e badu henia hanaihanaimu besena”.
MAL.1.4.english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

MAL.1.1.motu: Maduna metauna herevana Iehova ena amo, Israel latanai, Malaki ese e gwauraia.
MAL.1.1.english: A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.

MAL.2.11.motu: Iuda vada e koikoi; bona Israel ai bona Ierusalem ai kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara; badina be Iuda ese Iehova ena gabu helaḡana, e lalokau heniamu gabuna, vada e hadikaia; bona dirava idauna natuna kekenina vada e adavaia.
MAL.2.11.english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

MAL.2.7.motu: A hahelaḡa tauna bibinana ese aonega baine gimaia, bona taunimanima ese hahediba herevadia na ia uduna amo bae tahua, una na namo; badina be ia na Iehova Sabaota ena gwaukau tauna.
MAL.2.7.english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

MAL.1.9.motu: Harihari Dirava ba noia, ia ese baine lalo namo henida bona baine bogada hisi a? Matogana, herahia ḡaudia unuhetomadia imamui amo baine abi negana ai, ia ese umui ta baine lalo namo henia a? Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
MAL.1.9.english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

MRK.5.13.motu: Bena e siaidia. Taunabunai, lauma dikadia na e lasi, boroma lalodiai e vareai; bena seri idoinai hagahaga amo e rourou hekei gohu ai, iboudiai na daha-rua sisivana; bena gohu ai e maloa bou.
MRK.5.13.english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

MRK.1.41.motu: Bena lesu ese e bogaia hisi, imana e toia roro, e daua toho; bena eto, Na uramu, vada a ḡoeva.

MRK.1.27.english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

MRK.11.12.motu: Daba ai Betania amo ma e lou, mai hitolona ida.
MRK.11.12.english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

MRK.7.36.motu: Ia ese e tamanudia, tau ta basie hadibaia, to ena hetamanu na asie kamonai, a harina e piua rohoroho.
MRK.7.36.english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

MRK.15.2.english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

MRK.14.3.english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

MRK.1.4.english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

MRK.6.5.motu: Unuseni ai kara siahudia ikaradia na asi dibana; gorere taudia ta ta mo e daudia toho, e hamauridia.
MRK.6.5.english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

MRK.7.25.english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

MRK.5.42.motu: Bena kekeni na maoromaoro e tore isi, e raka eva-eva. Ia laḡanina na gwauta-rua. Iboudiai e hoa dikadika.
MRK.5.42.english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

MRK.14.5.motu: Bema hoia, davana na dollar toi-ahui bema hanaia reana; monina bema abia, ogoḡami taudia bema henidia. Idia ese hahine e maumauraia.
MRK.14.5.english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

MRK.6.56.motu: Bona e loa henidia gabudia iboudiai, hanua maraḡidia ai bona hanua badadia ai bona uma gabudia ai, idia ese gorere taudia ariara ai bona dala ai e atodia; bena e noia, ena dabua isena ai mo bema dau kau. Bena e dau kau taudia na vada e namo.
MRK.6.56.english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

MRK.7.35.english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

MRK.5.40.motu: Idia ese e kirikirilaia. A ia ese e doridia lasi, bena kekeni tamana bona sinana bona ia mai barnona tatoiosi ida kekeni ena hekure gabuna ai e raka vareai.
MRK.5.40.english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

MRK.14.56.motu: Badina be hutuma ese e habadelaia koikoi, to edia hahebade na asie heḡereḡere.
MRK.14.56.english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

MRK.6.34.english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

MRK.15.46.english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

MRK.8.36.motu: Tau ta tanobada idoinai baine abia, to ena mauri baine reaia, dahaka namona ia enai?

MRK.6.30.english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

MRK.3.17.motu: Iakobo Sebedeo, tadina Ioane ida, e nemaidia Boanere (anina be “guba e rahurahuamu natuna”);
MRK.3.17.english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

MRK.7.24.english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

MRK.3.2.motu: Bena idia ese e itaia tao, Dina Helaḡa ai baine harnauria eiava, bena bae habadelaia eto.
MRK.3.2.english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

MRK.10.26.english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

MRK.12.34.motu: Iesu dibana ia na vada e haere mai lalo-pararana ida, bena e hamaoroa, eto, Oi bona Dirava ena basileia padamui na dia daudau. Una murinai taunimanima iboudiai na ia inanadaina garina e gariva.

MRK.2.18.english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

MRK.8.28.english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

MRK.2.15.motu: Ena ruma ai aniani gabuna ai e ege diho, bona tax gogo taudia, kara dika taudia diaḡau danu, Iesu mai ena hahediba ida e ege diho; badina be hutuma na ia murinai e rakava.

MRK.9.44.motu: Unuseni ai edia uloulo basine mase, bona lahi na basine bodo.
MRK.9.44.english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’ + 9:44 Isaiah 66:24

MRK.10.32.english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

MRK.5.7.motu: e lolo mai gao badana ida, eto, Iesu e, Dirava Herea Mikamika Natuna e, egu ai dahaka bo karamu? Dirava ladana ai na hamaoromumu, basio hahisigu.
MRK.5.7.english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

MRK.15.4.motu: Pilato ese ma e nanadaia lou, eto, Oi na to haeremu a? Oi dibamu hereva idau-idau amo e habadelaimumu.
MRK.15.4.english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

MRK.5.32.motu: A ia na e roharoha, enai e dau kau tauna e tahua.

MRK.3.34.motu: Bena e helaia heḡeḡe taudia na e haḡeredia, eto, Sinagu bona tadigu buni:
MRK.3.34.english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “\+w Behold|strong="G2396"\+w*, \+w my|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w mother|strong="G3384"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w my|strong="G3708"\+w* brothers!

MRK.9.38.motu: Ioane ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hahediba taumu e, ai na tau ta a itaia, oi ladamu ai lauma dikadia e luludia; bena a gwaua tao, badina be ia na dia ita bamoda.
MRK.9.38.english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

MRK.10.21.motu: Iesu ese e raraia, e ura henia, bena eto, O dabumu ḡauna tamona binai: emu kohu ba ha hoi, ogoḡami taudia ba harihari henidia, guba kohudia hari bavabi. Bena murigu ai bame raka.
MRK.10.21.english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “\+w One|strong="G1520"\+w* \+w thing|strong="G1520"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w lack|strong="G5302"\+w*. \+w Go|strong="G5217"\+w*, \+w sell|strong="G4453"\+w* \+w whatever|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w poor|strong="G4434"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w treasure|strong="G2344"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w heaven|strong="G3772"\+w*; \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G1204"\+w*, \+w follow|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1325"\+w*, \+w taking|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w up|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* cross.”

MRK.9.47.motu: Matamu ese baine hahekwakwanaimu, ba giboa lasi: namo Dirava ena basileia lalonai ba raka vareai mai matamu tamona, dika mai matamu rua Gehena ai bae tahomu dobi.
MRK.9.47.english: \+w If|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w eye|strong="G3788"\+w* \+w causes|strong="G4624"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w stumble|strong="G4624"\+w*, \+w throw|strong="G1544"\+w* \+w it|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w out|strong="G1544"\+w*. \+w It|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w better|strong="G2570"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w enter|strong="G1525"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*’\+w s|strong="G2192"\+w* Kingdom \+w with|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w eye|strong="G3788"\+w*, \+w rather|strong="G2228"\+w* \+w than|strong="G2228"\+w* \+w having|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w two|strong="G1417"\+w* \+w eyes|strong="G3788"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w be|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w cast|strong="G1544"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Gehenna \+w of|strong="G2316"\+w* fire,

NAM.2.2.motu: (Badina be Iehova ese Iakob siahuna e havaraia loumu,
NAM.2.2.english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.

NAM.1.5.english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

NAM.1.10.motu: Au giniginidia heromedia na heheto e aradia oremu,
NAM.1.10.english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

NAM.1.14.motu: Iehova ese oi vada e haḡanilaimu, e tomu:
NAM.1.14.english: Yahweh has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

NAM.2.1.motu: Ihamakohimu tauna ese vada e tuari henimumu,
NAM.2.1.english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

NAM.2.10.english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

NAM.3.3.motu: Hosi gui taudia e tata laomu,
NAM.3.3.english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

NAM.3.17.motu: Emu hanua lohiadia na rei kwadidia na heheto,
NAM.3.17.english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

NAM.3.13.motu: A itaia, emu tuari oreadia na hahine na heheto,
NAM.3.13.english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

NAM.1.7.english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

NAM.3.12.motu: Emu kohoro iboudiai na suke audia na heheto,
NAM.3.12.english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

NAM.3.10.motu: Ḡau tamona, vada e abia oho,
NAM.3.10.english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

NAM.2.11.motu: Leona ena guri na edeseni ai?
NAM.2.11.english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

NAM.3.8.motu: Oi ese Tebe o hereaia a?
NAM.3.8.english: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

NAM.3.5.english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

NAM.2.6.english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

NAM.2.4.motu: Kariota na ariara ai e heau lalo-dikamu,
NAM.2.4.english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

NAM.2.5.english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

NAM.3.14.motu: Ranu ba utua, ba hekou ahu negana ranuna,
NAM.3.14.english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

NAM.2.9.english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

NAM.1.1.motu: Maduna metauna Nineve latanai; Nahumu, tau Elkoso, ena mata-hanai bukana.
NAM.1.1.english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

NAM.3.4.motu: Ini na ariara hahinena ena ariara karadia momo-herea daidiai,
NAM.3.4.english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

NAM.3.18.english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

NAM.2.8.motu: Nineve na ranuna e aru ohomu gohuna na heto;
NAM.2.8.english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

NAM.1.8.english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

NAM.3.2.motu: Hekwadi varona bona ava-keikei reḡedia e daemu;
NAM.3.2.english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

NAM.3.15.motu: Unuseni ai lahi ese baine hamasemu,
NAM.3.15.english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

NAM.1.6.motu: lena badu vairanai daika baine gini?
NAM.1.6.english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

NAM.3.9.english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

NAM.2.13.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: A itaia, lau ese na tuari henimumu; emu kariota na baina doudia, kwalahu ai baela; dare ese emu leona natudia baine ha-oredia; oi damumu na tanobada amo baina negea daure, bona emu gwaukau taudia eredia na basie hekamonai lou.
NAM.2.13.english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

NAM.1.12.english: Yahweh says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

NAM.1.11.motu: Iehova ihadikana dalana e lalo hatalaia
NAM.1.11.english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

NAM.2.3.motu: Iena goada taudia edia kesi na kakakaka,
