NAM.2.3.english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

NAM.1.9.motu: Dahaka o lalo hatalaiamu, Iehova ihadikana?
NAM.1.9.english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

NAM.3.6.motu: Lau ese miro amo baina hodomu, baina dadaraimu,
NAM.3.6.english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

NAM.3.16.english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

NAM.3.11.english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

NAM.3.7.motu: Bae itamu taudia iboudiai na bae lagagalaimu, baeto,
NAM.3.7.english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

NAM.1.3.motu: Iehova ena badu na se vara haraḡamu,
NAM.1.3.english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

NAM.3.19.motu: Emu hisihisi na asi ihanamona dalana,
NAM.3.19.english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

NAM.1.15.motu: A itaia, hari namodia e mailaidiamu tauna,
NAM.1.15.english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

NAM.2.7.motu: pavapava hahinena na ena dabua vada e hahedokidia oho,
NAM.2.7.english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

NAM.3.1.english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

NAM.1.2.motu: Iehova na vaḡeḡe bona hadava Diravana,
NAM.1.2.english: Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

NAM.2.12.motu: Leona ese vamu e darea sisisisi, natuna adia,
NAM.2.12.english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.

NAM.1.4.motu: Ia ese davara e gwau heniamu, e hakororoamu,
NAM.1.4.english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

NAM.1.13.motu: Harihari iena madluna oi paḡamu ai na baina hakwaidua,
NAM.1.13.english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

NEH.7.6.motu: Basileia taudia Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e abidia mauri bona dauha e laohaidia bena edia noho-hedoa amo ma e lou mai taudia bini. Idia na Ierusalem bona Iuda e lou lao, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela.
NEH.7.6.english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

NEH.3.30.motu: Ia ohena ai, Hanania Selemia bona Hanunu, Salafa natuna ihatauratoina, ese magu kahana ta e bania. Ia ohena ai, Mesulama Berekia ese maḡu e bania, ena daiutu italaina ai.
NEH.3.30.english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

NEH.10.32.motu: Ita ta hegwauhamata hehenimu, laḡani ta ta amo ita ta ta ese sekele kaha toiosi ai ta baita heni, Dirava ena dubu ḡaukarana ena,
NEH.10.32.english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:

NEH.4.23.motu: Taunabunai, lau bona tadikakagu bona egu hesiai taudia bona kito taudia, lau murigu amo e rakava taudia, na iboumai ai emai dabua asia doki oho; ta ta ena tuari ḡauna ena tuari ḡauna na imana ai e abi hata.
NEH.4.23.english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

NEH.5.9.motu: Taunabunai lau nato, Emui kara na dia namo. Eda Dirava igari-henina dalana ai boma raka, ani, e inai henidamu besedia edia heihi-ihirai ilao-ahuna?
NEH.5.9.english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

NEH.2.15.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai koura amo ma nala, maḡu na itaia; bena na hegiro, Koura Ikoukouna amo na raka vareai, bena na lou.
NEH.2.15.english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

NEH.5.16.motu: Lau ese danu hari maḡu ḡaukarana na karaia balaheni, tano taina asina abia; bona egu hesiai taudia iboudiai na unuseni ai e hebou, ḡaukara totona.
NEH.5.16.english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

NEH.3.32.motu: Hari daiguni latana daiutuna bona Mamoe Ikoukouna padadiai gold iḡaukaralaina taudia bona hoihoi taudia ese maḡu e bania.
NEH.3.32.english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

NEH.9.38.motu: Ina idoinai dainai ita ese gwauhamata aukana ta karaiamu bona ta toreamu, bona eda lohia bona eda Levi taudia bona eda hahelaḡa taudia ese edia toa amo e hamomokaniamu.
NEH.9.38.english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

NEH.11.15.motu: Levi taudia edia amo: Semaia, (ia na Hasub natuna, Hasub na Asarikama natuna, Asarikama na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Buni natuna);
NEH.11.15.english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

NEH.9.35.motu: Edia basileia lalonai, bona emu harihari-bada, o henidia ḡauna, lalonai, bona tano badana bona namona, vairadiai o atoa ḡauna, lalonai, oi isiaimu asie lao heni; bona edia kara dika amo asie raka oho.
NEH.9.35.english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

NEH.12.26.motu: Unu na Ioiakim, Iesua Iosadak natuna, bona Nehemia, hekwara tauna, bona Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, edia nega ai.
NEH.12.26.english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

NEH.4.15.motu: Inaimai e kamonai ai na vada a diba, bona Dirava ese edia lalo-hadai vada e laoa ahu, negana ai, ai iboumai ai ese maḡu a lou henia, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara ai.
NEH.4.15.english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

NEH.7.57.motu: Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia: Sotai garana, Soferete garana, Perida garana,
NEH.7.57.english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

NEH.13.19.motu: Dina helaḡa e kahira-kahira ai, Ierusalem ikoukouna ai dina e diho negana ai, lau ese na haduadia iduara bae koudia, bona na haḡanidia basie kehodia ela bona dina helaḡa baine ore. Bena egu hesiai taudia haida na ikoukou itataodia na atodia, maduna ta dina helaḡa ai basie vareailaia helaoreana.
NEH.13.19.english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

NEH.3.19.motu: bona ia ohena ai Esere Iesua, Mispa lohiana, ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, tuari ḡaudia e haboudia rumana italaina ai, Maḡu Magevana ai.
NEH.3.19.english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

NEH.8.3.motu: Vairana na Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana e henia, bena taravatu lalona amo e duahia, daba maraḡi amo ela bona dina tubua, tatau bona hahine bona natudia badadia, ikamonaina mai dibadia memerodia, vairadiai; bona taunimanima iboudiai taiadia e kirara, taravatu bukana herevadia na e hakala henidia.
NEH.8.3.english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

NEH.11.23.motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana ese haheḡani ta e heni, idia daidiai, bona ane-abi taudia ese dina ta ta adia ahudia e abi.
NEH.11.23.english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

NEH.3.20.motu: Ia ohena ai Baruku Sabai ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, Maḡu Magevana amo ela bona hahelaḡa tauna badana Eliasibi ena ruma iduarana.
NEH.3.20.english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

NEH.2.13.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai lau na Koura Ikoukouna amo na raka lasi, ela bona Sisia Ranu Gurina bona Boromakau Tagena Ikoukouna; Ierusalem maguna heḡiḡi-dobina na itaia, bona ikoukouna danu, Iahi ese e araia oho gaudia.
NEH.2.13.english: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

NEH.12.47.motu: Bena Serubabele bona Nehemia edia nega ai Israel idoinai ese ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia ahudia na dina ta ta amo e henidia; bona Levi taudia ahudia e ato tabe; bena Levi taudia ese Aaron garana taudia ahudia ma e ato tabe.
NEH.12.47.english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.

NEH.7.29.motu: Kiriat-iearimi bona Kefira bona Beroto taudia, sinahu-hitu hari-ahui toi;
NEH.7.29.english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

NEH.6.5.motu: Dala heḡereḡerena ai Sanbalata ese nega iha-imana ena hesiai tauna na dekegu e siaia mai, imana ai na revareva ta, ikeho-hata ḡauna.
NEH.6.5.english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

NEH.7.21.motu: Atere garana (unu na Hesekia garana), taurahanita-ahui taurahani;
NEH.7.21.english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

NEH.9.14.motu: Emu dina helaḡana danu o hadibalaidia, bona haheḡani bona hahedua herevadia bona taravatu na emu hesiai tauna Mose ena amo o henidia.
NEH.9.14.english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

NEH.6.17.motu: Ina danu: unu dinadia ai luda lohiadia ese revareva momo Tobia enai e siai lao, bona Tobia ena revareva na idia ediai e kau.
NEH.6.17.english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

NEH.6.3.motu: Bena lau ese gwaukau taudia na dekedia na siaidia lao, nato, Lau na ḡaukara badana ta na karaiamu; basina vasi diba. Anina be dahaka ḡaukara na baine doko, lau ese baina rakatania bona baina vasi negana ai?
NEH.6.3.english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

NEH.7.64.motu: Idia na ladadia e tahu, lada-tore bukadia ai, to asie davaridia; una dainai hahelaḡa dagina amo e atodia siri, idia na dia ḡoḡoeva dainai.
NEH.7.64.english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

NEH.7.65.motu: Hekwara tauna ese e hamaorodia, idia na aniani helaḡa-hereana basie ania, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna ta baine tore isi, Urim bona Tumim baine nanadaidia.
NEH.7.65.english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

NEH.2.17.motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Eda hekwarahi o itaiamu, Ierusalem na e gagae, bena ena ikoukou vada e ara oho. Aoma, Ierusalem maguna baita haginia, bena eda hemarai na basine mia.
NEH.2.17.english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

NEH.4.3.motu: Tobia, tau Amono, na ia badibadinai; bena ia eto, Oibe, idia na dahaka e haginiamu; uda sisiana ta na edia nadi maḡuna latanai bema dae kau, ia ese bema hahegiḡia dobi.
NEH.4.3.english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

NEH.5.8.motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ai na emai goada heḡereḡerena ai tadikakamai Iuda taudia, idau bese ediai e hoidia taudia, na ma a hoidia lou; a umui ese tadikakamui o hoidiamu, ai ese ma baia hoidia totona. Idia na asi reḡereḡedia, bona asi edia hereva ta.
NEH.5.8.english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

NEH.8.11.motu: Taunabunai, Levi taudia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hadorodia, elo, Asi reḡereḡemui ba noho, badina be ina dina na helaḡa; lalomui be basie hisihisi.
NEH.8.11.english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

NEH.12.41.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamini, Mikaia, Elioenai. Sekaria bona Hanania danu unuseni ai, mai edia kibi;
NEH.12.41.english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

NEH.11.2.motu: Bena taunimanima ese Ierusalem inoho ura-kwalimuna taudia iboudiai e hanamodia.
NEH.11.2.english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

NEH.11.17.motu: Bona Matania, (ia na Mika natuna, Mika na Sabdi natuna, Sabdi na Asaf natuna); ia na Dirava ihanamolaina guriḡurina igwauraina imatamana tauna. Bona Bakabukia, tau iharuana tadikakana bogaragidiai, bona Abda, (ia na Samua natuna, Samua na Galala natuna, Galala na Iedutunu natuna).
NEH.11.17.english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

NEH.1.9.motu: a boma lou henigu bona egu haheḡani boma badinadia bona karadia boma kara, bena ena be emui karoho taudia be guba dokodokodia henudiai to lau ese unu amo ma baina haboudia, vada na abia hidi lau ladagu baine noho henia gabuna ai baina hakaumui vareai”.
NEH.1.9.english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

NEH.12.27.motu: Ierusalem maḡuna ihahelaḡana negana ai idia ese Levi taudia e tahudia, edia noho gabudia iboudiai lalodia amo, Ierusalem bae mailaidia totona, bena maḡu ihahelaḡana karadia bae moalelai, mai hahenamodia bona mai anedia ida, bona botabota auridia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia ida.
NEH.12.27.english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

NEH.1.5.english: and said, “I beg you, Yahweh, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

NEH.11.6.motu: Perese garana iboudiai Ierusalem ai e nohova na boga-auka tataudia sinahu-hani tauratoi-ahui taurahani.
NEH.11.6.english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

NEH.2.10.motu: A Sanbalata, tau Horono, bona Tobia, hesiai tauna, tau Amono, ina sivarai e kamonai, bena lalodia na e dika herea, ta na Israel taudia edia namo dalana itahuna vada ema dainai.
NEH.2.10.english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

NEH.10.30.motu: Ita ese natuda hahinedia na tano taudia basita henidia, eiava idia natudia hahinedia na basita abidia, natuda mamaruanedia adavadia ai basiela;
NEH.10.30.english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

NEH.6.6.motu: Lalonai ini e torea toma: Bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e herevalaiamu, bona Geseme ese danu e gwauraiamu, oi bona luda taudia emui lalo-hadai be ba daḡedaḡe, una dainai ena maḡu o haginiamu; bona oi na o uramu edia pavapava ai baola. Sivarai be unu e gwauraia tomamu.
NEH.6.6.english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

NEH.6.13.motu: Ina dainai e vatua: lau na baina gari bona ina kara baina karaia, bena baina kerere; unu amo ladagu bae hadikaia, bena bae ihi-ihiraigu.
NEH.6.13.english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

NEH.7.72.motu: Taunimanima oredia e heni ḡaudia be gold darikidia gerebu-rua bona silver minadia daha-rua, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki tauratoi-ahui hitu.
NEH.7.72.english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

NEH.6.7.motu: Bona peroveta taudia haida danu vada o haginidia Ierusalem ai, oi bae gwauraimu hedinarai, baeto, Pavapava ta na luda ai. Harihari ini hereva na hanua pavapavana bae hamaorolaia lao. Benaini, aoma, baita haeroa hebou.
NEH.6.7.english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

NEH.7.45.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia: Salumu garana, Atere garana, Talmon garana, Akubu garana, Hatita garana, Sobai garana, sinahu-ta toi-ahui taurahani.
NEH.7.45.english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

NEH.9.12.motu: Dina ai ori dubuna amo o hakaudia, bona hanuaboi ai lahi mamana amo o hakaudia, edia lao dalana o hadiaria.
NEH.9.12.english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

NEH.3.15.motu: Salumu Kolohose, Mispa tanona lohiana, ese Ranu Lohilohi Ikoukouna e bania; e haginia lou, guhiguhina e karaia, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida. Ia ese Sela gohuna maḡuna e haginia, pavapava ena uma-uma badibadinai, ela bona David ena Hanua amo e diho vadavadana.
NEH.3.15.english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

NEH.10.38.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna, Aaron garana, na Levi taudia ida bae tao hebou, Levi taudia ese karoa ihagwautadia bae abi negana ai; bena Levi taudia ese edia karoa ihagwautadia ma bae karaoadia, karoa gwauta, bena una ikaroana amo karoa ta na eda Dirava ena dubu ai bae daelaia, habou-habou daiutudia ai bae haboua.
NEH.10.38.english: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

NEH.13.5.motu: bena ia ese daiutu badana ta e lailaia Tobia ena. Una daiutu na guna idia ese boubou flaoana bona muramura mai bonana bona dubu kohudia, bona aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia, haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai Levi taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia e henidia gaudia, bona herahia, hahelaḡa taudia e henidia ḡaudia, e haboulaiva daiutuna.
NEH.13.5.english: had prepared for him a great room, where before they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.

NEH.12.43.motu: Una dina ai boubou karadia badadia e kara, bona e moale, badina be Dirava ese e hamolaedia herea; hahine mai natudia ida danu e moale. Ierusalem ena moale reḡedia na dauha amo e kamonai.
NEH.12.43.english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.

NEH.2.19.motu: A Sanbalata, tau Horono, bona Tobia, hesiai tauna, tau Amono, bona Geseme, tau Arabia, na e kamonai, bena idia ese e kirikirilaimai bona e gonagonalaimai, eto, Ina na dahaka o karamu? Hanua pavapavana o dagedaḡe heniamu a?
NEH.2.19.english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

NEH.2.3.motu: Lau ese hanua pavapavana na hamoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana baine mauri hanaihanai! Dahaka dainai senegu edia gara e miamu hanuana vada e ḡaḡae bona ikoukouna na lahi ese vada e araia oho negana ai vairagu na basina huaia?
NEH.2.3.english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

NEH.8.5.motu: Esera ese buka e kehoa taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, badina be ia na taunimanima iboudiai daediai; bena e kehoa negana ai taunimanima iboudiai na e gini tore.
NEH.8.5.english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

NEH.11.28.motu: bona Bere-sieba mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Siklag, bona Mekona mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida,
NEH.11.28.english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

NEH.13.1.motu: Una dina ai idia ese Mose ena buka e duahia, taunimanima vairadiai; lalonai e davaria, vada e torea, Amono tauna ta eiava Moab tauna ta na nega ta Dirava ena orea hebouna lalonai basine vareai;
NEH.13.1.english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

NEH.12.10.motu: Iesua na loiakim tamana, Ioiakim na Eliasibi tamana, Eliasibi na loiada tamana,
NEH.12.10.english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

NEH.5.14.motu: Ina danu: e duanaigu Iuda tanona ai e nohova taudia edia hekwara tauna ai bainala negana amo, King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ela bona laḡanina ihatoiahui-ruana, laḡani gwauta-rua, lau ese hekwara ahuna asina ania, bona tadikakagu danu asie ani.
NEH.5.14.english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

NEH.3.26.motu: bona dubu ena hesiai taudia Ofele ai e nohova ese maḡu e bania ela bona Ranu Ikoukouna mairiveina kahana ai bona una atai kohorona italaidia gabuna ai.
NEH.3.26.english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

NEH.7.46.motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia: Siha garana, Hasufa garana, Tabaoto garana,
NEH.7.46.english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

NEH.9.33.motu: Ḡau tamona, latamai ai vada e kau ḡaudia iboudiai lalodiai oi na vada o kara maoromaoro; badina be oi o kara momokani bona ai be a kara dika;
NEH.9.33.english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

NEH.6.4.motu: Nega hani hereva na unu e siaia toma, bona nega hani lau ese unu na haere henidia toma.
NEH.6.4.english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

NEH.3.31.motu: Ia ohena ai, Malkia, gold iḡaukaralaina taudia ta, ese maḡu e bania ela bona dubu ena hesiai taudia edia ruma bona hoihoi taudia edia ruma, Tuari Taudia Ihagaudia Ikoukouna italaina ai, bona daiguni latana daiutuna.
NEH.3.31.english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

NEH.6.19.motu: Bona iena kara namodia na lau vairagu ai e herevalaidia, bona lauegu hereva na ia e hamaorolaia. Bena Tobia ese revareva haida e siaidia mai, lau ihagarigu.
NEH.6.19.english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

NEH.10.34.motu: Ita ese danu hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona hanua taudia na mari amo vada ta duanaidia, boubou audia bae mailai, Dirava ena dubu lalonai, eda iduhu ta ta heḡereḡeredia ai, bae gwaurai negadia ai laḡani ta ta amo, Iehova eda Dirava ena ihaboulaina patana latanai bae ha-ara, taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena.
NEH.10.34.english: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on Yahweh our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;

NEH.12.18.motu: Bilga ena na Samua; Semaia ena na Iehonatan;
NEH.12.18.english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

NEH.5.17.motu: Ina danu: tatau sinahu-ta imahui na lauegu pata ai e anianiva, Iuda taudia bona heitatao taudia, bona e noho hetabira besedia lalodia amo dekemai ema taudia danu.
NEH.5.17.english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

NEH.13.30.motu: Taunabunai, lau ese idau bese ḡaudia iboudiai amo na haḡoevadia, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na haginidia, edia ḡaukara ta ta ai;
NEH.13.30.english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

NEH.9.22.motu: Oi ese basileia idau-idau bona bese idau-idau o henidia, bona tano daigunidia iboudiai; taunabunai idia ese Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona 0g, Basan pavapavana, edia tano e ḡaunaidia.
NEH.9.22.english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

NEH.11.7.motu: Beniamina vevena bini: Salu, Mesulama natuna, (Mesulama na Ioed natuna, loed na Pedaia natuna, Pedaia na Kolaia natuna, Kolaia na Maaseia natuna, Maaseia na Itiele natuna, Itiele na lesaia natuna).
NEH.11.7.english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

NEH.2.1.motu: King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ai, hua ladana Nisan lalonai, vine ranuna na ia vairanai e heato negana ai, lau ese vine ranuna na abia isi, hanua pavapavana na henia. A, ema bona una dina ai lalogu nega ta se hisihisi ia vairanai.
NEH.2.1.english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

NEH.7.44.motu: Ane-abi taudia: Asaf garana, sinahu-ta hari-ahui taurahani.
NEH.7.44.english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

NEH.10.29.motu: tadikakadia, edia bese lohiadia, ida e tao heboumu, gwauhamata metauna bona helaḡana lalonai e vareaimu, Dirava ena taravatu, ena hesiai tauna Mose ena amo e heni ḡauna, bae rakalaia, bona Iehova, eda Ḡaubada, ena haheḡani iboudiai bona ena hahemaoro herevadia bona ena hahedua herevadia bae badinadia, bona karadia bae kara.
NEH.10.29.english: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

NEH.6.10.motu: Semaia, Delaia Mehetabel natuna, na e hekou ahu; bena ena ruma ai na dae kau negana ai ia eto, Dirava ena dubu ai baita hedavari, gabu helaḡana ai, bona gabu helaḡana iduarana baita koudia ahu; badina be oi iala-masemu e maimu, hanuaboi baema oi iala-masemu totona.
NEH.6.10.english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

NEH.5.12.motu: Bena idia eto, Unu na baia halou henidia, bona ḡau ta ediai ma basia gwauraia; emu hereva heḡereḡerena baia karaia. Bena hahelaḡa taudia na boiridia, idia edia amo gwauhamata helaḡana na abia, edia gwauhamata heḡereḡerena ai do bae karaia.
NEH.5.12.english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.”

NEH.7.48.motu: Lebana garana, Hagaba garana, Salmai garana,
NEH.7.48.english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

NEH.9.26.motu: Ḡau tamona, idia na e gwau edeede bona e daḡedaḡe henimu, emu taravatu na muridiai e negedia, bona emu peroveta taudia ese e sisiba henidia, dekemu bae hakaudia lou totona, negadia ai, idia ese e aladia mase; idia ese danu oi ladamu iḡonaḡonalaina karadia e karava.
NEH.9.26.english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

NEH.11.4.motu: Ierusalem ai Iuda vevena bona Beniamina vevena taudia haida e nohova. Iuda vevena amo: Ataia, Usia natuna, (Usia na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Amaria natuna, Amaria na Sefatia natuna, Sefatia na Mahalalel natuna, Mahalalel na Perese garana);
NEH.11.4.english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

NEH.10.14.motu: Iduhu kwaradia: Paroso, Pahata-moab, Elam, Satu, Bani,
NEH.10.14.english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

NEH.7.28.english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

NEH.5.6.motu: Edia maumau bona unu hereva na kamonai negana ai, lau na badu dikadika.
NEH.5.6.english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

NEH.9.16.motu: A idia bona ai senemai na e hekokorokuva bona aiodia e ha-aukava bona emu haheḡani asie badinadiava;
NEH.9.16.english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

NEH.10.33.motu: flaoa helaḡana, bona flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia, e hahelaḡadia louloumu ḡaudia, bona dina helaḡadia, hua matamatadia, bona e gwaurai ariadia, bona ḡau helaḡadia, bona kara dika bouboudia Israel ena dika iabi-ohona ḡaudia, bona eda Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai, inanatalaidia.
NEH.10.33.english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

NEH.13.23.motu: Unu dinadia ai lau ese Iuda taudia haida, Asdod bona Amono bona Moab hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia, na itadia;
NEH.13.23.english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;

NEH.7.43.motu: Levi taudia: Iesua garana amo Kadmiele garana (hari Kadmiele na Hodeva garana), hitu-ahui hani.
NEH.7.43.english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

NEH.12.31.motu: Bena lau ese Iuda lohiadia na hakaudia dae maḡu latanai, bona orea badadia rua na duanaidia; bena idia na e raka hebou mai hahenamodia ida. Orea ta be idiba kahana amo e raka lao, maḡu latanai, ela bona Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna.
NEH.12.31.english: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

NEH.11.16.motu: bona Sabetai bona losabad, Levi edia lohia taudia bogaragidia amo; idia ese Dirava ena dubu murimurina kahana ḡaukaradia e biagudia.
NEH.11.16.english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

NEH.7.37.motu: Lod bona Hadidi bona Ono garadia, sinahu-hitu ruahui ta;
NEH.7.37.english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

NEH.7.42.english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

NEH.9.23.motu: Oi ese garadia o hahutumadia, guba hisiudia heḡereḡeredia, bona senedia vada o hamaorodia lalona ai bae raka vareai bona bae ḡaunaia tanona na lalonai o hakaudia vareai.
NEH.9.23.english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

NEH.13.11.motu: Taunabunai lau ese heitatao taudia na gwau henidia, nato, Dahaka dainai Dirava ena dubu vada o laloa herekwa? Bena na haboudia, bona edia ḡaukara gabudia na henidia.
NEH.13.11.english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

NEH.7.11.motu: Pahata-moab garana (unu na Iesua bona Ioab garadia), daha-rua sinahu-taurahani gwauta-taurahani;
NEH.7.11.english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

NEH.13.26.motu: Solomon, Israel pavapavana, na hahine unuhetomadia daidiai e kerere, ani? Bese momo bogaragidiai asi pavapava ta ia heḡereḡerena; ena Dirava ese e lalokau henia, bona Dirava ese Israel idoinai pavapavana ai e halaoa; ḡau tamona, idau bese hahinedia ese ia e hakaraia dika.
NEH.13.26.english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

NEH.9.34.motu: emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona emai hahelaḡa taudia bona tamamai ese taravatu asie badinadia, bona emu haheḡani bona emu sisiba, o henidia ḡaudia, na nahuadia asie toho.
NEH.9.34.english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

NEH.4.11.motu: Bona inaimai eto, Basie diba bona ḡau ta basie itaia ela bona ita na bogaragidiai baita kau; bena baita aladia mase bona ḡaukara baita hadokoa.
NEH.4.11.english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

NEH.11.27.motu: Edia noho gabudia haida danu na Hasara-sual,
NEH.11.27.english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

NEH.8.14.motu: Bena taravatu lalonai e hetore herevadia vada e davari, Iehova ese Mose ena amo vada e haheḡani, Israel taudia na kalaga ai bae noho, hua ihahituna ariana dinadia lalodiai;
NEH.8.14.english: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

NEH.7.31.english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

NEH.8.10.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Emui dala ai baola, digara bavania, vine ranuna gaihona ba inua, bona ana asie heḡaeḡaelaia tauna ahuna na ba siai henia; badina be ina dina na helaḡa, eda Ḡaubada ena. Bona lalomui basie hisihisi, badina be Iehova imoalelaina na emui goada ḡauna.
NEH.8.10.english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

NEH.13.21.motu: A lau ese na sisiba henidia, nato, Dahaka dainai maḡu vairanai o taruhamu? Una kara ba karaia lou negana ai, baina dabaimui tao. Una negana amo idia na dina helaḡa ai asiema lou.
NEH.13.21.english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

NEH.13.27.motu: Matona, ai ese umui baia kamonai henimui, bona ina kara dika-hereana baia karaia, bona eda Dirava baia kara henia koikoi, idau bese hahinedia iadavadia ai, a?
NEH.13.27.english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

NEH.7.30.motu: Rama bona Geba taudia, sinahutauratoi ruahui ta;
NEH.7.30.english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

NEH.3.13.motu: Hanunu bona Sanoa inoholaina taudia ese Koura Ikoukouna e bania. Idia ese e haginia lou, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida. Idia ese maḡu kiubit daha-ta e bania, ela bona Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna.
NEH.3.13.english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

NEH.10.10.motu: bona tadikakadia, Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanana,
NEH.10.10.english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

NEH.12.8.motu: Levi taudia: Iesua, Binui, Kadmiele, Serebia, Iuda, Matania. Hari Matania mai varavarana ida ese Dirava ihanamolaina anedia iabidia e gunalaidia.
NEH.12.8.english: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.

NEH.3.23.motu: Idia ohedia ai, Beniamina bona Hasub ese maḡu e bania, edia ruma italaina ai. Idia ohedia ai, Asaria Maaseia, Anania tubuna, ese maḡu e bania, iena ruma badibadinai.
NEH.3.23.english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

NEH.13.15.motu: Unu dinadia ai lau ese haida na itadia Iuda ai, idia ese vine huahuadia na dina helaḡa ai e moimoilai, bona uit bali senudia e mailai, doniki latadiai; bona vine ranuna bona vine huahuadia bona suke huahuadia bona kohu idau-idau iboudiai na dina helaḡa ai Ierusalem ai e vareailai. Bena aniani e hoihoilai dinana ai na sisiba henidia.
NEH.13.15.english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

NEH.4.4.motu: Emai Dirava e, a kamonai; badina be e dadaraimaimu; edia heihi-ihirai na idia sibodia kwaradia ai ba haloua. Ba negedia daure, bena iḡuidia ai bae noho tanona lalonai edia ḡau bae dadihaidia.
NEH.4.4.english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

NEH.9.32.motu: Taunabunai, emai Dirava e, Dirava badana, mai siahumu bona mai garimu Diravana, gwauhamata bona hebogahisi o badinadiamu Diravana, basio laloa hari hisihisi iboudiai Asuria pavapavadia edia nega amo ema bona ina dina ai emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona emai hahelaḡa taudia bona emai peroveta taudia bona tamamai bona emu orea taudia iboudiai latamai ai vada e kau na ḡau pipikidia.
NEH.9.32.english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

NEH.7.39.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia: ledaia garana (lesua ena iduhu), sinahu-taurahanita hitu-ahui toi;
NEH.7.39.english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

NEH.4.2.motu: Tadikakana bona Samaria tuari oreana vairadiai e hereva, eto, Ini Iuda taudia mamanodia na dahaka e karamu? Ḡau bae hamatamatadia a? Boubou karadia bae kara a? Dina tamona ai bae ha-orea a? Lahi ai e ara nadidia na momoru senusenudia amo bae kara lou a?
NEH.4.2.english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

NEH.9.13.motu: Oi na Sinai ororona dorina ai o diho, bona guba amo o hereva henidia, hahemaoro herevadia maoromaorodia bona taravatu momokanidia bona haheḡani bona hahedua herevadia namodia o henidia.
NEH.9.13.english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

NEH.6.15.motu: Taunabunai, maḡu ḡaukarana na dina imahui-rua lalodiai e ha-orea, hua ladana Elulu dinana iharuahui-imana ai e ore.
NEH.6.15.english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

NEH.9.1.motu: Una hua dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, Israel taudia na e hebou, e anivaga, puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, bona tano na kwaradia ai e ato.
NEH.9.1.english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

NEH.4.22.motu: Una negana ai, lau ese taunimanima ma na hamaorodia, nato, Taunimanima iboudiai mai edia hesiai taudia ida na Ierusalem ai bae noho rani; bena hanuaboi bae gimamai, a dina ai bae ḡaukara.
NEH.4.22.english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

NEH.7.47.motu: Kero garana, Sia garana, Padono garana,
NEH.7.47.english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

NEH.5.18.motu: E hegaeḡaelai ḡaudia, dina tamona ena, na boromakau ta bona mamoe namo-hereadia tauratoi; kokoroku danu e heḡaeḡaelai lauagu; bona dina gwauta gwauta amo kopi-pusedia mai vine-ranudia ida momo herea. Ḡau tamona, lau ese hekwara ahuna anianidia asina gwaurai; badina be hesiai ilao-henina na metau, ini taunimanima latadiai.
NEH.5.18.english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

NEH.13.17.motu: Bena Iuda lohiadia na gwau henidia, nato, Ina kara dikana umui ese o karaiamu be dahaka, dina helaḡa o hadikaiamu?
NEH.13.17.english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

NEH.11.1.motu: Bese igunalaina taudia na Ierusalem ai e nohova. Taunimanima oredia na mari e kara, bena taunimanima gwauta gwauta lalodia amo ta ta na hanua helaḡana Ierusalem ai bae hanoho, a oredia ihataurahanitadia na hanua idau-idau ai bae noho.
NEH.11.1.english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

NEH.7.19.english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

NEH.3.29.motu: Idia ohedia ai, Sadok Imere ese magu e bania, iena ruma italaina ai. Ia ohena ai, Semaia Sekania, Mairiveina Ikoukouna igimana tauna, ese maḡu e bania.
NEH.3.29.english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

NEH.7.5.motu: Bena Dirava ese lalo-hadai ta lalogu ai e havaraia, Iohia taudia bona heilatao taudia bona orea taudia na baina haboudia, edia uru ta ta ai ladadia bae tore totona. Bena e dae ema guna taudia edia uru bukana na davaria. Una buka lalonai ini e torea toma:
NEH.7.5.english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

NEH.4.10.motu: A Iuda eto, Kohu-hua taudia na edia goada e oremu, bona momoru na bada herea; ai na asia heḡereḡere maḡu baia ḡaukaralaia.
NEH.4.10.english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

NEH.11.5.motu: bona Maaseia, Baruku natuna, (Baruku na Kolohose natuna, Kolohose na Hasaia natuna, Hasaia na Adaia natuna, Adaia na Ioiaribi natuna, Ioiaribi na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Silono tauna natuna).
NEH.11.5.english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

NEH.1.2.motu: bena varavaragu ta ladana Hanani na tatau haida ida Iuda amo ema. Bena na nanadaidia, Iuda taudia dounu e nohova, heabi-oho amo e roho mauriva taudia, bona Ierusalem henanadaidia na kara.
NEH.1.2.english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

NEH.4.6.motu: Taunabunai, maḡu a haginia; maḡu idoinai a ha-ahua, tano amo ela bona harana kahana. Badina be taunimanima lalodia e urava ḡaukara.
NEH.4.6.english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

NEH.9.29.motu: Oi ese o sisiba henidia, emu taravatu enai ba haloudia totona. Ḡau tamona idia na e hekokorokuva, emu haheḡani asie badinadia, a emu hahemaoro herevadia, taunimanima na henudiai bema noho ḡaudia, na e tata utu, bona e gini muri dabudabu, aiodia e ha-auka, basie kamonai eto.
NEH.9.29.english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

NEH.7.24.english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

NEH.11.18.motu: Levi taudia iboudiai hanua helaḡana lalonai na tatau sinahu-rua taurahani-ahui hani.
NEH.11.18.english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

NEH.4.1.motu: Ai ese maḡu a haginia sivaraina na Sanbalata e kamonai negana ai ia na e badu dikadika, bena ia ese Iuda taudia e kirikirilaidia.
NEH.4.1.english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

NEH.3.17.motu: Ia murinai Levi taudia ese maḡu e bania: Rehumu Bani; bona ia ohena ai Hasabia, Keila tano kahana lohiana, ese iena kaha e bania.
NEH.3.17.english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

NEH.7.38.english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

NEH.13.8.motu: Bena na badu dikadika, bena Tobia ena ruma ḡaudia iboudiai na daiutu lalona amo na tahodia lasi.
NEH.13.8.english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.

NEH.13.12.motu: Bena Iuda idoinai ese aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia na habou-habou rumadia lalodiai e vareailaidia.
NEH.13.12.english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

NEH.2.20.motu: Bena na haere henidia, nato, Guba Diravana ese baine hanamomai, bona ai, iena hesiai taudia, baia tore isi, baia haginia; a umui na asi ahumui bona asi siahumui bona asi ilalolaimui Ierusalem ai.
NEH.2.20.english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

NEH.7.12.motu: Elam garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
NEH.7.12.english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

NEH.2.4.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ma e nanadaigu, eto, Emu noinoi be dahaka? Taunabunai, lau ese guba Diravana na ḡuria.
NEH.2.4.english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?”

NEH.12.22.motu: Levi taudia herevadia na iniheto. Eliasibi bona Ioiada bona Iohanan bona ladua edia nega ai iduhu kwaradia ladadia e tore; bona hahelaḡa taudia ladadia danu ela bona Darauese, tau Parasa, ena pavapava negana.
NEH.12.22.english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

NEH.12.32.motu: Idia muridia amo Hosaia bona Iuda lohiadia edia orea kahana e raka,
NEH.12.32.english: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,

NEH.13.14.motu: Dirava e, ba lalogu tao, ina kara dainai, bona egu kara namodia egu Dirava ena dubu bona ena ḡaukara ihanamolaidia totona vada na kara ḡaudia na basio lalodia nege.
NEH.13.14.english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

NEH.11.12.motu: Bona idia tadikakadia, dubu ḡaukaradia e karava taudia, tatau sinahu-taurahani ruahui-rua; bona Adaia, (ia na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Pelalia natuna, Pelalia na Amasi natuna, Amasi na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Pasahuru natuna, Pasahuru na Malkia natuna),
NEH.11.12.english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

NEH.2.18.motu: Na hamaorodia danu egu Dirava imana na latagu ai, namo ihavarana totona; bona hanua pavapavana ese vada e hamaorolaigu herevadia danu na hamaorolaidia. Bena idia eto, Aita tore tore isi, aita haginia. Taunabunai idia ese imadia e ha-aukadia, ḡaukara namona ikarana dainai.
NEH.2.18.english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me.

NEH.8.4.motu: Itorena tauna Esera na hereva patapatana ta, una ḡaukara dainai au amo e karaia ḡauna, latanai e gini. Ia badibadinai e gini taudia be Matitia bona Sema bona Anaia bona Uria bona Hilkia bona Maaseia, ia idibana kahana ai; bona Pedaia bona Misael bona Malkia bona Hasumu bona Hasabadana bona Sekaria bona Mesulama, ia laurina kahana ai.
NEH.8.4.english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

NEH.11.24.motu: Petahia Mesesabele, Sera Iuda vevena ta, na hanua pavapavana ena ere-gwaurai tauna, taunimanima itataodia ḡaukaradia iboudiai ai.
NEH.11.24.english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

NEH.12.45.motu: Idia bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia danu ese edia Dirava isiaina e lao heniva; bona haheḡoeva karadia e karava, David bona natuna Solomon edia haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
NEH.12.45.english: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.

NEH.3.14.motu: Malkia Rekab, Bete-hakereme tanona lohiana, ese Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna e bania; e haginia lou, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
NEH.3.14.english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

NEH.4.14.motu: Lau na roharoha, bena na tore isi, hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima oredia na hamaorodia, nato, Idia garidia basio gari. Ḡaubada ba laloa tao; ia na bada bona mai garina. Bona ba tuari, tadikakamui bona natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bona adavamui bona emui ruma daidiai.
NEH.4.14.english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

NEH.11.20.motu: Israel orena, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia oredia, na Iuda hanuadia iboudiai Ialodiai e nohova, ta ta ena tano ena tano ai.
NEH.11.20.english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

NEH.7.53.motu: Bakabuku garana, Hakufa garana, Harahuru garana,
NEH.7.53.english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

NEH.2.11.motu: Taunabunai lau na Ierusalem nala, dina toi unuseni ai na noho.
NEH.2.11.english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

NEH.8.8.motu: Bena Dirava ena taravatu bukana amo e duahia hedinarai, bona anina e gwauraia; taunabunai taunimanima lalodia na e parara.
NEH.8.8.english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

NEH.2.7.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ma na hamaoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, revareva haida boma henigu, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiadia edia, bena idia na bae gwau maoro baina raka hanai ela bona Iuda ai baina kau;
NEH.2.7.english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

NEH.12.29.motu: bona Bete-gilgal amo, bona Geba bona Asamavete kahadia amo, badina be ane-abi taudia ese edia hanua e hagini Ierusalem heḡeḡemadai ai.
NEH.12.29.english: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

NEH.9.9.motu: Oi ese senemai edia hisihisi o itaia Aigupto ai, bona edia taitai o kamonai Davara Kakakakana isena ai;
NEH.9.9.english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

NEH.7.49.motu: Hanana garana, Gidele garana, Gahara garana,
NEH.7.49.english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

NEH.3.22.motu: Ia ohena ai, hahelaḡa taudia, Taora taudia, ese maḡu e bania.
NEH.3.22.english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

NEH.2.2.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka dainai vairamu o huaiamu, a ḡau be so gorere? Ina na dia ḡau ta, to lalo hisihisina mo. Bena na gari dikadika.
NEH.2.2.english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.”

NEH.5.4.motu: Ma haida eto, Ai na moni vada a abi torehai, hanua pavapavana ena tax ihenina totona, una dainai emai uma bona emai vine imeadia vada a gwau hamatalai.
NEH.5.4.english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

NEH.7.13.english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.

NEH.9.28.motu: A lagadia e aniva murinai idia na oi vairamu ai ma e kara dika lou, bona oi ese ma o negedia daure inaidia imadia ai; taunabunai idia ese e lohiadia. Ḡau tamona, idia na ma e hegiro bona e tai henimu negana ai, oi ese guba ai ma o kamonai henidia; bona nega momo oi ese o hamauridia, emu hebogahisi heḡereḡeredia.
NEH.9.28.english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

NEH.9.7.motu: Oi na Iehova, Abram e abia hidi bona Uru, Kaldea hanuana, amo e hakaua lasi bona ladana e hatoa “Abraham” Diravana.
NEH.9.7.english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

NEH.13.7.motu: bena Ierusalem nama. Una negana ai lau ese hari kara dikana na davaria, Eliasibi ese Tobia iduruna totona vada e karaia, daiutu ta Dirava ena dubu maḡuna ikoukoudia lalodiai e heḡaeḡaelaia iena.
NEH.13.7.english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

NEH.9.10.motu: bona toa bona hoa karadia o kara, Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona ena tano taudia iboudiai ihadikadia; badina be oi vada o diba idia ese senemai e kara dagedage henidia; bona ladamu o hahoria ema bona ina dina.
NEH.9.10.english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

NEH.7.41.motu: Pasahuru garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua hari-ahui hitu;
NEH.7.41.english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

NEH.7.27.english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.

NEH.7.33.motu: Nebo hanuana ta taudia, imahui rua;
NEH.7.33.english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

NEH.3.1.motu: Bena Eliasibi, hahelaḡa tauna badana, na tadikakana hahelaḡa taudia ida e tore isi; bena idia ese Mamoe Ikoukouna e haginia. Idia ese e hahelagaia, bena iduara e atodia; e hahelaḡaia lao ela bona Sinahu Kohorona, bona unu amo ela bona Hananele Kohorona.
NEH.3.1.english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

NEH.5.10.motu: Ina danu, lau bona tadikakagu bona egu hesiai taudia ese moni bona aniani a henidia torehaimu. Ini abitorehai davadia iabidia baita hadokoa.
NEH.5.10.english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

NEH.3.12.motu: Ia ohena ai Salumu Halohese, Ierusalem tano kahana lohiana, mai natuna hahinedia ida, ese maḡu e bania.
NEH.3.12.english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

NEH.2.6.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ma e nanadaigu (ia adavana, pavapava hahinena, na ia badinai helai), eto, Baola bena edena nega ai ma ba lou mai? Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana lalona vada e heḡereḡere baine siaigu, bona lau ese negana na gwaurai henia.
NEH.2.6.english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?”

NEH.7.40.english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

NEH.12.40.motu: Bena hahenamo oreadia ruaosi na Dirava ena dubu ai e gini, bona lau danu, heitatao oreana kahana ida.
NEH.12.40.english: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;

NEH.9.25.motu: Bena hanua mai maḡudia na tuari ai e abidia, bona tano namona danu; ruma mai kohu namo-hereadia ida, bona ranu habou-habou gabudia, nadi ai e ḡei ḡaudia, bona vine imeadia bona olive imeadia bona huahua audia momo herea, iboudiai na e abidia, e ḡaunaidia. Taunabunai, e anianiva, bogadia e kunuva, bona taudia e digarava, bona emu harihari-bada e moalelaiava.
NEH.9.25.english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

NEH.12.44.motu: Una dina ai tatau haida e duanaidia, habou-habou rumadia, kohu bona herahia ḡaudia bona aniani roboadia bona karoa ihagwautadia ḡaudia e habou gabudia, itataodia; unuseni ai hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ahudia bae habou, taravatu ai e gwaurai ḡaudia, hanua hanua edia biru gabudia heḡereḡeredia; badina be Iuda taudia ese hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi oreana, dubu ḡaukarana e karaiava taudia, na e moalelaidia.
NEH.12.44.english: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.

NEH.7.56.english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

NEH.9.4.motu: Iesua, Bani, Kadmiele, Sebania, Buni, Serebia, Bani bona Kenani na Levi taudia edia vadavada ai e gini; bena idia ese Iehova, edia Dirava, e tai henia mai gao badadia ida.
NEH.9.4.english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

NEH.2.16.motu: Heitatao taudia na asi dibadia edena gabu nala bona dahaka na karaia; lau ese Iuda taudia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima oredia, ḡaukara bae karaia taudia, na do asina hamaorodia.
NEH.2.16.english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

NEH.3.25.motu: ma unu amo ela bona daiguni, Palala Usai ese Maḡu Magevana italaina ai maḡu e bania, bona pavapava ena atai rumana latanai e haginia kau kohorona, hegima taudia edia maḡu badibadinai, danu e bania. Ia ohena ai, Pedaia Paroso
NEH.3.25.english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

NEH.5.2.motu: Badina be haida eto, Ai mai natumai mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ida na huhutuma; aniani ḡaudia baia ha-abi, baia aniani, baia mauri.
NEH.5.2.english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

NEH.7.58.motu: laala garana, Darakono garana, Gidele garana,
NEH.7.58.english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

NEH.8.16.motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima na e raka lasi, ḡau e ha abi, bona edia kalaga e kara, edia ruma guhidia latadiai bona edia ruma maḡudia lalodiai, bona Dirava ena dubu maḡudia ai, bona Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana ai bona Efraim Ikoukouna ariarana ai.
NEH.8.16.english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

NEH.8.9.motu: Bena Nehemia, hekwara tauna, bona Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, bona hari Levi oreana, taunimanima e hadibadia taudia, ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Ina dina na helaḡa, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; basio helalo bona basio tai. Badina be taunimanima ese taravatu herevadia e kamonai negana ai na e tai.
NEH.8.9.english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

NEH.7.68.motu: Edia hosi na sinahu-hitu toi-ahui tauratoi; edia doniki badadia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima;
NEH.7.68.english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

NEH.3.8.motu: Idia ohedia ai Usiele Harahaia, gold iḡaukaralaina taudia ta, ese maḡu e bania; bona ia ohena ai Hanania, muramura mai bonadia ibulodia taudia ta, ese magu e bania. Idia ese Ierusalem e haginia lou ela bona Lababa-bada Maḡuna.
NEH.3.8.english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

NEH.11.25.motu: A hanua maraḡidia, mai edia biru tanodia ida, herevadia bini. Iuda taudia haida na Kiriat-araba mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Dibon mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Iekabasele mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida,
NEH.11.25.english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

NEH.4.20.motu: Edena kaha amo kibi reḡena ba kamonai, unuseni ai ba heau hegogo mai, ai dekemai ai. Eda Dirava na ita daidai baine tuari.
NEH.4.20.english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

NEH.7.2.motu: lau ese tadigu Hanani bona kohoro hekwara tauna Hanania na duanaidia, Ierusalem bae itaia tao; badina be ia ese heabidadama ai bona Dirava igari-henina ai hutuma na e hereadiava.
NEH.7.2.english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

NEH.12.13.motu: Esera ena na Mesulama; Amaria ena na Iehohanan;
NEH.12.13.english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

NEH.7.50.motu: Re-aia garana, Resini garana, Nekoda garana,
NEH.7.50.english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

NEH.8.6.motu: Bena Esera ese Iehova, Dirava badana, e hanamoa; bona taunimanima iboudiai na e haere, eto, Amen, Amen; bona imadia na e abi isi. Bena e igo diho, tano ai e goru diho, Iehova e toma henia diho.
NEH.8.6.english: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God.

NEH.9.20.motu: Emu Lauma namona o henidia, baine hadibadia, bona emu mana na ududia amo so rua; ranu danu o henidia, edia ranu-mase dainai.
NEH.9.20.english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

NEH.12.20.motu: Salai ena na Kalai; Amok ena na Ebere;
NEH.12.20.english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

NEH.12.35.motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia natudia haida mai kibidia ida. Sekaria (ia na Ionatan natuna, Ionatan na Semaia natuna, Semaia na Matania natuna, Matania na Mikaia natuna, Mikaia na Sakuru natuna, Sakuru na Asaf natuna),
NEH.12.35.english: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

NEH.7.61.motu: Ini na Tele-mela bona Tele-harasa bona Kerubu bona Adono bona Imere amo ema, a edia iduhu bona senedia ladadia ihamomokanidia asi dibadia, idia na Israel besena taudia eiava lasi:
NEH.7.61.english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

NEH.11.32.motu: bona Anatoto ai bona Nob ai bona Anania ai,

NEH.8.7.motu: Levi taudia haida danu, Iesua bona Bani bona Serebia bona Iamin bona Akubu bona Sabetai bona Hodia bona Maaseia bona Kelita bona Asaria bona Iosabad bona Hanana bona Pelaia, ese taunimanima e durudia, taravatu anina idavarina ai, taunimanima na dounu edia gabu ai nohodia ai.
NEH.8.7.english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

NEH.11.22.motu: Ierusalem ai Levi taudia itataodia tauna na Usisi, (ia na Bani natuna, Bani na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Matania natuna, Matania na Mika natuna, Mika na Asaf vevena, ane-abi taudia, ta); ia ese Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia e ita tao.
NEH.11.22.english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

NEH.3.9.motu: Idia ohedia ai Refaia Huru, Ierusalem tano kahana lohiana, ese magu e bania;
NEH.3.9.english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

NEH.11.26.motu: bona Iesua bona Molada bona Bete-pelete, lalodiai e nohova.
NEH.11.26.english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

NEH.5.1.motu: Una negana ai maumau badana e vara, hanua taudia bona adavadia ese tadikakadia Iuda taudia na e maumauraidia.
NEH.5.1.english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

NEH.1.3.motu: Bena idia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Heabi-oho amo e roho mauri bona una basileia ai dounu e nohomu taudia na e hekwarahi badamu bona e hemaraimu; Ierusalem maguna vada e heḡigi dobi, bona ikoukouna na lahi ese vada e araia oho.
NEH.1.3.english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

NEH.3.5.motu: Ma idia ohedia ai Tekoa taudia ese magu e bania, a lohiadia ese edia Ḡaubada ena ḡaukara asie goadalaia.
NEH.3.5.english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

NEH.7.70.motu: Iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni. Hekwara tauna ese gold darikidia daha-ta, nau imahui, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki sinahu-ima toi-ahui e heni.
NEH.7.70.english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

NEH.13.28.motu: Iehoiada natuna ta, hahelaḡa tauna Eliasibi tubuna, na Sanbalata, tau Horono, rava-maragina, una dainai lau ese egu amo na lulua oho.
NEH.13.28.english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.

NEH.13.24.motu: idia natudia orea kahana na Asdod gadona ai e herevava, bona Iuda gadona igwauraina asi dibadia, a bese ta ta gadodia mo.
NEH.13.24.english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

NEH.10.39.motu: Badina be Israel taudia bona Levi garana taudia ese herahia ḡaudia, aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, na habou-habou daiutudia lalodiai bae vareailai, gabu helaḡana kohudia e miamu, bona hahelaḡa taudia, dubu ḡaukaradia e karamu taudia, bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia e nohomu gabuna ai. Eda Dirava ena dubu basita laloa herekwa.
NEH.10.39.english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

NEH.13.29.motu: Egu Dirava e, ba lalodia tao, badina be idia ese hahelaḡa dagina, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia gwauhamata, na e hamiro.
NEH.13.29.english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

NEH.11.8.motu: Bona ia murinai Gabai bona Salai bona tatau sinahu-taurahanita ruahui-taurahani.
NEH.11.8.english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

NEH.13.2.motu: badina be Israel taudia asie hedavari henidia ranu bona aniani ida, a Balaam e vatua, baine uduguiraidia totona; ḡau tamona iseda Dirava ese heuduguirai na hahenamo herevana ai e halaoa.
NEH.13.2.english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

NEH.12.9.motu: Bona varavaradia Bakabukia bona Uno na ane-abi negadia ai idia italaidia ai e gini.
NEH.12.9.english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.

NEH.9.15.motu: Oi ese aniani na guba amo o henidia, edia hitolo dainai, bona ranu na nadi amo o ha-arua lasi, edia ranu-mase dainai; bona o hamaorodia, bae raka vareai, o gwau hamatalaia tanona bae abia.
NEH.9.15.english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

NEH.13.6.motu: Una kara e vara negana ai lau na dia Ierusalem ai; badina be Aratasasta, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoiahui-ruana ai lau na hanua pavapavana dekena nala. Nega taina vada ela, bena hanua pavapavana na noia baine kahugu nege;
NEH.13.6.english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,

NEH.9.8.motu: Oi ese ia lalona o dibaia, ia na mai momokanina oi vairamu ai, bona o gwau henia hamata, Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Iebusu taudia bona Girigasa taudia edia tano na ia garana ba henidia; bena emu gwauhamata vada o hamomokania, badina be oi na maoromaoro.
NEH.9.8.english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

NEH.3.7.motu: Idia ohedia ai Melatia, Gibeon tauna, bona ladono, Meronoto tauna, bona Gibeon bona Mispa taudia ese maḡu e bania; idia na Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana ena siahu henunai e nohova taudia.
NEH.3.7.english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

NEH.7.23.english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

NEH.9.17.motu: e gwau edeedeva bona hoa karadia idia bogaragidiai vada o kara na asie lalodiava; a aiodia e ha-aukadia, bona hegunalai tauna ta e duanaia, edia iḡui gabuna Aigupto ai bae lou henia eto. A oi na dika igwau-taona Diravana, mai emu harihari-bada bona mai emu hebogahisi; badu ai o halahemu, bona lalokau ai o honuhonu-daemu; bena to rakatanidia.
NEH.9.17.english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

NEH.11.13.motu: bona ia tadikakana, iduhu kwaradia, tatau sinahu-rua hari-ahui rua; bona Amasahai, (ia na Asarele natuna, Asarele na Ahasai natuna, Ahasai na Mesilemoto natuna, Mesilemoto na Imere natuna),
NEH.11.13.english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

NEH.12.24.motu: Levi Iohiadia: Hasabia, Serebia bona Iesua Kadmiele na varavaradia e gini hetalai henidia, bae heimodai bona bae hahenamo totona, David, Dirava ena tau, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai bae nari hedava hedava.
NEH.12.24.english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.

NEH.7.4.motu: Hanua na lababa bona bada, a inoholaina taudia na dia hoho, bona ruma na do asie haginidia.
NEH.7.4.english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

NEH.7.26.motu: Betelehem bona Netofa taudia, sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui taurahani;
NEH.7.26.english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

NEH.5.5.motu: Ai hidiomai na tadikakamai hidiodia heḡereḡeredia, bona ai natumai na idia natudia heḡeregeredia; ḡau tamona, natumai mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na hesiai taudia bona hahinedia ai a halaodiamu; bona natumai hahinedia haida na hesiai iḡuidia ai e nohomu; a asi emai dala una kara baia laoa ahu, badina be haida ese emai uma bona emai vine imeadia vada e abi.
NEH.5.5.english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

NEH.7.60.motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia iboudiai na sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui rua.
NEH.7.60.english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

NEH.4.18.motu: Maḡu e haginiava ai ḡaukara taudia na ta ta ena dare ena dare gabadia ai e kara; kibi ihiririna tauna na lau badibadigu ai e gini.
NEH.4.18.english: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

NEH.7.16.english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

NEH.12.46.motu: Badina be nega gunadia ai, David bona Asaf edia nega ai, ane-abi taudia na mai edia lohia ta, bona Dirava iheatolaina bona ihanamona anedia e abi.
NEH.12.46.english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

NEH.7.54.motu: Basaliti garana, Mehida garana, Harasa garana,
NEH.7.54.english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

NEH.7.3.motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ierusalem ikoukoudia basie kehodia ela bona dina na baine siahu, bona dounu igimadia e ginimu ai iduara na bae koudia bona auri amo bae ha-aukadia. Bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia bogaragidia amo hegima taudia ba duanaidia, ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai bona ta ta ena ruma ena ruma italaidia ai bae gima.
