NEH.7.3.english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

NEH.7.66.motu: Hegogo idoinai be taunimanima gerebu-hani daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui,
NEH.7.66.english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

NEH.3.28.motu: Hosi Ikoukouna atai kahana ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese maḡu e bania, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma italaidia ai.
NEH.3.28.english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

NEH.4.21.motu: Taunabunai, ai na ḡaukara a hekwarahilaia; orea kahana taudia ese io e abi hata, daba matana amo ela bona hisiu e dae ai.
NEH.4.21.english: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

NEH.5.3.motu: Ma haida eto, Emai uma bona emai vine imeadia bona emai ruma na a gwau hamatalaimu, abitorehai davadia, aniani iabina, doe dainai.
NEH.5.3.english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

NEH.2.8.motu: bona revareva ta danu, Asaf, hanua pavapavana ena uda igimana tauna, ena, bena ia ese au baine henigu, dubu kohorona ikoukoudia bona hanua maguna bona baina noholaia rumana ikaralaidia ḡaudia. Bena hanua pavapavana ese na gwaurai ḡaudia e henigu, badina be egu Dirava imana namona na latagu ai.
NEH.2.8.english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.”

NEH.6.9.motu: Badina be idia iboudiai edia ura be bae hagarimai; ini e laloa toma: Imadia na gaukara ai bae manoka, bena gaukara na basine hekara. Dirava e, harihari imagu a ha-aukadia.
NEH.6.9.english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

NEH.10.1.motu: Edia toa amo e hamomokaniamu taudia bini: Nehemia, hekwara tauna, Hakalia natuna; Sedekia,
NEH.10.1.english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

NEH.7.73.motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona orea taudia haida bona dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Israel idoinai na edia hanua lalodiai e nohova.
NEH.7.73.english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities.

NEH.8.1.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na e hegogo hebou, tau tamona na heto, Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana lalonai. Bena idia ese itorena tauna Esera e hamaoroa, Mose ena taravatu, Iehova ese Israel vada e henia ḡauna, bukana na baine mailaia.
NEH.8.1.english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

NEH.7.14.english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

NEH.8.13.motu: Dina iharuana ai, taunimanima iboudiai edia iduhu kwaradia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ida, na itorena tauna Esera dekenai e hebou, taravatu herevadia anidia bae tahu totona.
NEH.8.13.english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

NEH.8.17.motu: Hari hegogo idoinai, abi-mauri gabuna amo vada e lou taudia, ese kalaga e kara bona kalaga lalodiai e noho; badina be Iesua Nunu ena nega ema bona una dina Israel taudia na unu do asie kara toma. Bena moale na bada herea.
NEH.8.17.english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

NEH.10.31.motu: bona tano taudia ese kohu eiava aniani na dina helaḡa ai bema mailai, hoihoi totona, ita na ediai basita hoihoi, Dina Helaḡa ai eiava helaḡa dinana ta ai; bona laḡani ihahituna ai baita kau ai uma anidia bona abitorehai davadia baita gwau tora.
NEH.10.31.english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.

NEH.7.32.motu: Betele bona Ai taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui toi;
NEH.7.32.english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

NEH.13.3.motu: Taunimanima na taravatu e kamonai negana ai, idia ese bese idaudia amo e vara taudia na Israel edia amo e abidia oho.
NEH.13.3.english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

NEH.1.11.motu: Ḡaubada e, taiamu a hakala, lau emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai taudia, oi ladamu igari-henina e moalelaiamu taudia, emai ḡuriḡuri ame kamonai; bona hari dina ai emu hesiai tauna na kwalimu ba henia, bona ba bogaia hisi, ina tau vairanai.
NEH.1.11.english: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.”

NEH.13.9.motu: Na hahedua, bena daiutu e haḡoevadia. Bena lau ese Dirava ena dubu kohudia na una daiutu lalonai ma na atodia lou, bona boubou flaoana bona muramura mai bonadia danu.
NEH.13.9.english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.

NEH.9.24.motu: Taunabunai, garadia na tano ai e raka vareai, e ḡaunaia; bena oi ese tano inoholaina taudia, Kanaan taudia, na idia vairadiai o hadareredia, bona imadia ai o atodia, mai edia pavapava bona edia tano taudia ida, idia ese edia ura heḡereḡerena bae kara henidia totona.
NEH.9.24.english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

NEH.4.17.motu: maḡu e haginia taudia, muridiai e gini. Kohu-hua taudia edia maduna e haheḡereḡeredia, bena imadia kahana ta e ḡaukara, kahana ta be edia tuari ḡaudia e abi heni.
NEH.4.17.english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

NEH.3.27.motu: Ia ohena ai, Tekoa taudia ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, hari atai kohorona badana italaina ai, ela bona Ofele maḡuna.
NEH.3.27.english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

NEH.13.10.motu: Lau na davaria danu Levi taudia ahudia na asie henidia; una dainai Levi taudia bona ane-abi taudia, ḡaukara e karava taudia, na vada e heau, ta ta ena uma ena uma vada ela.
NEH.13.10.english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

NEH.3.2.motu: Ia ohedia ai Ieriko taudia ese magu e haginia; bona idia ohedia ai Sakuru Imri ese magu e haginia.
NEH.3.2.english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

NEH.7.1.motu: Maḡu vada e ahu, bona iduara vada na haginidia, bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona Levi taudia vada na duanaidia murinai,
NEH.7.1.english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

NEH.7.8.motu: Paroso garana, daha-rua sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua;
NEH.7.8.english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

NEH.11.21.motu: A dubu ena hesiai taudia na Ofele ai e nohova; bona Siha bona Gispa ese dubu ena hesiai taudia e biagudia.
NEH.11.21.english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

NEH.12.21.motu: Hilkia ena na Hasabia; Iedaia ena na Netanele.
NEH.12.21.english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

NEH.1.10.motu: Idia na oiemu hesiai taudia bona oiemu bese; oi ese emu siahu badana bona imamu goadana amo vada o hamauridia.
NEH.1.10.english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

NEH.3.16.motu: Ia murinai Nehemia Asabuku, Bete-suru tano kahana lohiana, ese magu e bania ela bona David ena gara italaina, bona taunimanima imadia amo e karaia gohuna, bona goada-dikadika taudia edia ruma.
NEH.3.16.english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

NEH.12.7.motu: Salu, Amok Hilkia, Iedaia. Unu na hahelaḡa taudia mai varavaradia ida edia lohia, Iesua ena nega ai.
NEH.12.7.english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

NEH.11.19.motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia Akubu bona Talmon mai tadikakadia ida, ikoukou e gimadiava taudia, na tatau sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua.
NEH.11.19.english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

NEH.12.36.motu: bona ia varavarana Semaia, Asarele, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanele, Iuda bona Hanani; idia ese David, Dirava ena tau, ena hatai-hatai ḡaudia e abi kau; bena itorena tauna Esera ese e gunalaidia.
NEH.12.36.english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

NEH.10.9.motu: Levi taudia: Iesua, Asania natuna; Binui, Henadad natuna ta; Kadmiele;
NEH.10.9.english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

NEH.13.4.motu: Ina kara do se vara negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna Eliasibi, e duanaia eda Dirava ena dubu daiutudia baine biagua tauna, na Tobia bamona,
NEH.13.4.english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

NEH.12.39.motu: bena Efraim Ikoukouna atai kahana amo, bona Ikoukou Gunana bona Gwarume Ikoukouna bona Hananele ena Kohoro bona Sinahu-ta Kohorona amo ala, ela bona Mamoe Ikoukouna; bena Hegima Ikoukouna ai a doko.
NEH.12.39.english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.

NEH.8.12.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai na e karoho, bae aniani, bae inuinu, bona hari ahu bae siai lao bona bae moale hisi dae na totona; badina be vada e gwaurai henidia herevadia na anidia vada e diba.
NEH.8.12.english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

NEH.10.37.motu: bona eda flaoa, e tari baroko guna ḡaudia, bona eda herahia ḡaudia, au-huahua idau-idau bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, na hahelaḡa taudia dekedia baita laohai, eda Dirava ena dubu ena habou-habou daiutudia lalodiai; bena eda tano anidia baita karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta na Levi taudia dekedia baita laohai, badina be hari Levi taudia ese karoa ihagwautadia e haboumu, eda digi hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai.
NEH.10.37.english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.

NEH.12.17.motu: Abia ena na Sikri; Miniamini ena, Moadia ena na Pilitai;
NEH.12.17.english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

NEH.13.20.motu: Bena nega ta eiava rua hoihoi taudia, kohu idau-idau e hoi taudia, na Ierusalem murimurinai e taruhava.
NEH.13.20.english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

NEH.7.9.english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

NEH.12.12.motu: Ioiakim ena nega ai hahelaḡa taudia na iduhu kwaradia: Seraia ena na Meraia; Ieremia ena na Hanania;
NEH.12.12.english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

NEH.7.34.motu: Elam ma ta garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
NEH.7.34.english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

NEH.11.31.motu: Beniamina taudia danu Geba amo ela Mikmasa ai bona Aia ai, bona Betele mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, lalodiai e nohova;
NEH.11.31.english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

NEH.7.17.motu: Asgada garana, daha-rua sinahu-toi ruahui rua;
NEH.7.17.english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

NEH.7.36.english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

NEH.9.3.motu: Bena edia gabu ai e gini tore, Iehova, edia Dirava, ena taravatu bukana lalona amo e duahia, hora toi lalodiai; ma hora toi lalodiai edia dika e gwaurai hedinarai, bona Iehova, edia Dirava, e toma henia diho.
NEH.9.3.english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

NEH.11.14.motu: bona idia tadikakadia, goada dikadika taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani; idia itataodia tauna na Sabdiele Hagedolimi.
NEH.11.14.english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

NEH.6.1.motu: Sivarai na Sanbalata bona Tobia bona Geseme tau Arabia bona inaimai oredia e hamaorodia lau ese maḡu vada na haginia bona na ha-ahua vaitani (gau tamona una negana ai ikoukou iduaradia do asina hagini);
NEH.6.1.english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

NEH.8.15.motu: bona edia hanua iboudiai lalodiai bona Ierusalem lalonai ina hereva bae hapiua bona bae gwaurai hedinarai: Ba raka lasi, ororo baola, olive audia bona uda olivedia bona keroro bona pamu audia bona rau momo audia idau-idau rigidia ba mailai, kalaga ikaradia totona, vada e torea heḡereḡerena.
NEH.8.15.english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

NEH.11.30.motu: bona Sanoa bona Adulama mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Lakisi mai ena biru tanodia ida, bona Aseka mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida. Taunabunai, idia na e taruha, Bere-sieba amo ela bona Hinom kourana.
NEH.11.30.english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

NEH.1.1.motu: Nehemia, Hakalia natuna, ena hereva bini. Laḡani iharuahuina huana ladana Kisleve lalonai, lau na hanua badana Susa ai noho;
NEH.1.1.english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah.

NEH.11.29.motu: bona En-rumon, bona Sora, bona Iaramutu,
NEH.11.29.english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

NEH.6.12.motu: Bena lalogu na e parara, vada na diba, Dirava ese se siaia a una peroveta herevana na lau ihadikagu totona e gwauraia badina be Tobia bona Sanbalata ese vada e vatua.
NEH.6.12.english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

NEH.3.3.motu: Hasena natuna verina ese Gwarume Ikoukouna e haginia; auna e atodia bona iduara e haginidia mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
NEH.3.3.english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

NEH.5.11.motu: Hari dina ai edia uma, edia vine imeadia, edia olive imeadia bona edia ruma ba henidia lou; bona karoadia sinahu ta ta amo moni eiava aniani eiava vine ranuna eiava dehoro ediai o g vaurai danu ba halou henidia.
NEH.5.11.english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

NEH.6.14.motu: Egu Dirava, ba laloa, Tobia bona Sanbalata edia kara na inihetomadia; bona peroveta hahinena Noadia bona peroveta taudia oredia, ihagarigu e uramu taudia, danu.
NEH.6.14.english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

NEH.4.9.motu: Bena ai na emai Dirava a guria, bona kito taudia a duanaidia, dina hanuaboi ilao-ahudia bae gimamai.
NEH.4.9.english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

NEH.13.16.motu: Turo taudia hanua badana ai e nohova danu, gwarume bona hoihoi ḡaudia idau-idau e vareailai, dina helaḡa ai Iuda taudia ediai bona Ierusalem lalonai e hoihoilai.
NEH.13.16.english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

NEH.13.31.motu: bona boubou au-rakurakudia dalana na lailaia, e gwaurai negadia ai, bona aniani roboadia dalana danu. Egu Dirava e, ba lalogu tao, baina namo helaoreana.
NEH.13.31.english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

NEH.5.19.motu: Egu Dirava e, ina orea dainai na kara karadia iboudiai ba lalo tao, lau ihanamogu.
NEH.5.19.english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

NEH.7.62.motu: Delaia garana, Tobia garana, Nekoda garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui rua.
NEH.7.62.english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

NEH.6.16.motu: Inaimai iboudiai na sivarai e kamonai negana ai, e noho hetabira besedia iboudiai na e gari bona e hemarai dikadika; badina be lalodia e parara ina ḡaukara na emai Dirava ena heduru dainai a ha-orea.
NEH.6.16.english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

NEH.3.24.motu: Ia ohena ai, Binui Henadad ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, Asaria ena ruma amo ela Maḡu Magevana,
NEH.3.24.english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

NEH.4.12.motu: Iuda taudia idia badibadidiai e nohova na ema, bena nega gwauta e hamaoromai, eto, Idia na edia noho gabudia iboudiai amo ihadikada totona baema.
NEH.4.12.english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

NEH.2.14.motu: Unu amo nala ela bona Ranu Lohilohi Ikoukouna bona Pavapava Gohuna, a hari latanai na ḡui ḡauna na asi ena raka-hanai gabuna.
NEH.2.14.english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

NEH.9.5.motu: Bena Levi taudia, Iesua bona Kadmiele bona Bani bona Hasabaneia bona Serebia bona Hodia bona Sebania bona Petahia, na eto, A gini tore, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba hanamoa, asi matamana bona asi dokona, ela hanaihanai. Oi ladamu herea-daena bae hanamoa; ia ese hahenamo iboudiai bona heimodai iboudiai na e hereadiamu.
NEH.9.5.english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

NEH.7.10.english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

NEH.11.10.motu: Hahelaḡa taudia edia amo: Iedaia Ioiaribi, Iakin,
NEH.11.10.english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

NEH.9.21.motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai oi ese tano gaḡaena ai o hamauridiava; ḡau ta ai asie dabuva; edia dabua asie mouka-mouka, bona aedia asie gudu.
NEH.9.21.english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

NEH.3.11.motu: Malkia Harimi bona Hasub Pahata-moab ese maḡu kahana ta e bania bona Amu Kohorona e haginia lou.
NEH.3.11.english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

NEH.12.28.motu: Bena ane-abi oreadia taudia e hebou, Ierusalem heḡeḡemadai amo, bona Netofa hanuadia amo,
NEH.12.28.english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;

NEH.7.71.motu: Bona iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni: gold darikidia gerebu-rua bona silver minadia daha-rua sinahu-rua.
NEH.7.71.english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

NEH.12.19.motu: Ioiaribi ena na Matenai; Iedaia ena na Usisi;
NEH.12.19.english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

NEH.1.8.motu: Emu hesiai tauna Mose o haḡanilaia herevana ba laloa tao; oto “Boma gwau hebeatai, lau ese baina hakarohomui rohoroho bese idau-idau bogaragidiai;
NEH.1.8.english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;

NEH.9.27.motu: Una dainai oi ese inaidia imadia ai o atodia, bena idia ese e hahisihisidia; bena edia hisihisi negana ai e tai henimu, bona oi ese guba ai o kamonai henidia; bona emu hebogahisi bada-hereadia heḡereḡeredia ai oi ese ihamauridia taudia o henidia, bena idia ese idia inaidia imadia amo e hamauridia.
NEH.9.27.english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

NEH.11.34.motu: bona Hadidi ai bona Seboimi ai bona Nebalata ai,

NEH.12.14.motu: Maluki ena na Ionatan; Sebania ena na Iosef;
NEH.12.14.english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

NEH.7.22.english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

NEH.9.37.motu: Hari pavapava, emai kara dika amo daemai ai vada o atodia taudia, ese ia anina herea-daena e abiamu; idia na mai siahudia danu, tau-animai bona emai ubu-ubu gaudia bae biagudia, edia ura heḡereḡerena ai; bona ai na vada a hekwarahi mase.
NEH.9.37.english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

NEH.10.8.motu: Maasia, Bilgai, Semaia. Hahelaga taudia bunu.
NEH.10.8.english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

NEH.3.18.motu: Ia murinai idia tadikakadia ese maḡu e bania: Bavai Henadad, Keila tano kahana lohiana;
NEH.3.18.english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

NEH.1.7.motu: Ai ese oi vada a kara havara henimu, bona haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahedua herevadia, emu hesiai tauna Mose o haḡanilaia ḡaudia, na asia badinadia.
NEH.1.7.english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

NEH.11.9.motu: Ioel Sikri ese e itadia tao, bona Iuda Hasenua na hanua itataona tauna iharuana.
NEH.11.9.english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

NEH.4.13.motu: Taunabunai, maḡu harana kwadogi-hereadia gabudia muridia kahadia ai be taunimanima na atodia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, mai edia dare io peva ida.
NEH.4.13.english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

NEH.11.3.motu: Ini na basileia lohiadia, Ierusalem ai e nohova taudia; a Iuda hanuadia ai ta ta ena tano ena tano ai e nohova, edia hanua lalodiai, Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, dubu ena hesiai taudia, bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia.
NEH.11.3.english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

NEH.13.22.motu: Bena Levi taudia na haḡanidia, idia na sibodia bae haheḡoeva, bena baema, ikoukou bae gimadia, dina helaḡa bae hahelaḡaia helaoreana. Egu Dirava e, ina danu ba laloa tao, lau ihanamogu, bona emu hebogahisi badana heḡereḡerena ai ba hamaurigu.
NEH.13.22.english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

NEH.3.10.motu: idia ohedia ai ledaia Harumafa ese maḡu e bania, ena ruma italaina ai; bona ia ohena ai Hatusu Hasabaneia ese maḡu e bania.
NEH.3.10.english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

NEH.7.55.motu: Barako garana, Sisera garana, Tema garana,
NEH.7.55.english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

NEH.10.36.motu: bona natuda mamaruanedia roboadia bona eda boromakau natudia roboadia danu eda Dirava ena dubu baita laohaidia, hahelaḡa taudia eda Dirava ena dubu ai e ḡaukaramu dekediai, taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena, bona roboa gaudia eda nani bona eda mamoe seridia amo danu;
NEH.10.36.english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

NEH.3.21.motu: Ia ohena ai Meremoto Uria, Hakoso tubuna, ese magu kahana ta e bania, Eliasibi ena ruma iduarana amo ela bona Eliasibi ena ruma dokona.
NEH.3.21.english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

NEH.2.12.motu: Bena hanuaboi ai na tore isi, lau bona tatau hida mo lau ida; tau ta asina hamaoroa Dirava ese Ierusalem ihanamona dalana na lalogu ai ede vada e havaraia toma. Egu ai na asi gui gaudia, tamona mo lau ese na guilaia.
NEH.2.12.english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

NEH.5.13.motu: Bena vairagu ramina na davedavea, nato, Ina gwauhamata basie hamomokania taudia iboudiai na Dirava ese edia ruma amo bona edia ḡaukara amo unu baine davedavedia oho toma. Taunabunai baine davedavedia oho bona baine bubudia oho. Bena hebou idoinai eto “Amen”, bona Iehova e imodaia. Bena taunimanima ese edia gwauhamata heḡereḡerena ai e kara.
NEH.5.13.english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.”

NEH.3.6.motu: Ioiada Pasea bona Mesulama Besodeia ese Ikoukou Gunana e bania; auna e atodia bona iduara e haginidia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
NEH.3.6.english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

NEH.5.7.motu: Na haeroa; bena hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia ediai gwau na atu. Na hamaorodia, nato, Umui na abitorehai davadia o abimu, ta ta tadikakana tadikakana edia amo. Bena hebou bada-hereana ta na gwauraia, idia ihahemaoro-henidia totona.
NEH.5.7.english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

NEH.11.36.motu: Levi taudia edia orea haida Iuda ai na Beniamina taudia ida e hataodia hebou.
NEH.11.36.english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

NEH.7.59.motu: Sefatia garana, Hatili garana, Pokerete-hasabaimi garana, Amon garana.
NEH.7.59.english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

NEH.11.35.motu: bona Lod ai, bona Ono, ima karakara dibaka taudia edia koura, lalonai.
NEH.11.35.english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

NEH.6.2.motu: bena Sanbalata bona Geseme ese hereva na dekegu e siaia mai, eto, Aoma, Ono taorana hanuana ta ai baita hebou. A edia lalo-hadai be bae hadikagu.
NEH.6.2.english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

NEH.10.28.motu: Bese orena, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, ikoukou igimadia taudia, ane-abi taudia, dubu ena hesiai taudia, bona tano taudia edia amo vada e raka oho Dirava ena taravatu enai vada e tao taudia, mai adavadia bona natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ida, mai aonegadia bona mai lalopararadia taudia iboudiai, ese
NEH.10.28.english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—

NEH.12.25.motu: Matania bona Bakabukia bona Obadia bona Mesulama bona Talmon bona Akubu na ikoukou igimadia taudia, ikoukou edia habou-habou rumadia e gimadia.
NEH.12.25.english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

NEH.13.13.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Selemia bona itorena tauna Sadok bona Levi tauna Pedaia na duanaidia, habou-habou ḡaudia ibalahenidia taudia ai baela; bona Hanana, Sakuru Matania natuna, na duanaia, idia idurudia tauna ai bainela; badina be idia na kara momokani taudia. Edia ḡaukara na tadikakadia adia bae henidia hagau-hagau.
NEH.13.13.english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

NEH.9.19.motu: to emu hebogahisi badana dainai tano ḡaḡaena ai to rakatanidia; ori dubuna, dala ai vada e hakaudia ḡauna, ese dina ai se rakatanidia, bona lahi mamana, edia lao dalana e hadiaria ḡauna, danu se rakatanidia hanuaboi ai.
NEH.9.19.english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

NEH.7.51.motu: Gasama garana, Usa garana, Pasea garana,
NEH.7.51.english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

NEH.12.38.motu: Hahenamo oreana iharuana na lauri kahana amo ela, bena lau na idia muridia amo na raka, orea kahana ida. Maḡu latana amo ala, Amu Kohorona atai kahana amo ela bona Lababa-bada Maḡuna;
NEH.12.38.english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,

NEH.1.6.motu: taiamu a hakala bona matamu a hapapa, lau emu hesiai tauna egu ḡuriḡuri, dina bona hanuaboi oi vairamu ai Israel besena, emu hesiai taudia, daidiai na gwauraiamu ḡauna, na ba kamonai. Israel taudia edia kara dika, ai ese oi a kara henimu gaudia, na na gwaurai hedinaraimu; oibe, lau bona tamagu ena iduhu taudia vada a kara dika.
NEH.1.6.english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

NEH.2.5.motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na hamaoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, bona lau, emu hesiai tauna, boma lalo namo henigu, boma siaigu lao Iuda, senegu edia gara e miamu hanuana bainala, baina haginia lou totona.
NEH.2.5.english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

NEH.10.35.motu: Ta gwau hamatamu, eda tano anidia roboadia bona huahua audia iboudiai anidia roboadia na laḡani ta ta amo Iehova ena dubu baita laohai;
NEH.10.35.english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to Yahweh’s house;

NEH.6.11.motu: A lau nato, Lau heḡereḡeregu tauna ta baine heau a? Lau heḡereḡeregu tauna ta na gabu helaḡana ai baine raka vareai, mauri idavarina totona, a? Lau na basina raka vareai.
NEH.6.11.english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

NEH.7.18.english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

NEH.7.7.motu: Idia na Serubabele bona Iesua bona Nehemia bona Asaria bona Raamia bona Nahamani bona Morodekai bona Bilsan bona Misperete bona Bigvai bona Nehumu bona Baanaha ida ema.
NEH.7.7.english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah.

NEH.12.15.motu: Harimi ena na Adna; Meraioto ena na Helekai;
NEH.12.15.english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

NEH.9.18.motu: Ena be idia ese auri e havevea, boromakau natuna laulauna e karaia, eto “Ina na emui dirava, Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi diravana”, bona oi ihadikamu karadia badadia e kara,
NEH.9.18.english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

NEH.9.11.motu: Oi ese davara o haparararaia idia vairadiai, bena idia na davara bogaragina amo e raka hanai, tano kaukauna ai; bona e hahavadia taudia na dobu gabudia ai o tahodia dobi, nadi ranu badadia lalodiai na heto.
NEH.9.11.english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

NEH.7.15.english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

NEH.12.16.motu: Ido ena na Sekaria; Ginetono ena na Mesulama;
NEH.12.16.english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

NEH.7.69.motu: edia kamelo na sinahu-hani toi-ahui ima; bona edia doniki na daha-tauratoi sinahu-hitu ruahui.
NEH.7.69.english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

NEH.6.8.motu: Bena hereva na ia dekena na siaia lao, nato, O gwauraimu karadia ta asia karaia; oi sibomu lalomu ai o lalo davarimu.
NEH.6.8.english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

NEH.12.23.motu: Levi garana, iduhu kwaradia, na Sisiga Bukana ai e torea ema bona Iohanan Eliasibi ena nega.
NEH.12.23.english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

NEH.12.11.motu: Ioiada na Ionatan tamana, Ionatan na ladua tamana.
NEH.12.11.english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

NEH.7.52.motu: Besai garana, Meunimi garana, Nefusesimi garana,
NEH.7.52.english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

NEH.4.16.motu: Una dina amo ela, egu hesiai taudia edia orea kahana na maḡu e ḡaukaralaia, a kahana be edia io kesi peva bona tuari dabuadia e abi hata; bona hegunalai taudia na Iuda iduhuna taudia iboudiai,
NEH.4.16.english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

NEH.2.9.motu: Bena Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiadia dekediai na kau, bona hanua pavapavana ena revareva na henidia. Hanua pavapavana ese tuari lohiadia bona hosi-gui taudia na vada e siaidia, lau ida.
NEH.2.9.english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

NEH.6.18.motu: Badina be hutuma luda ai na mai edia gwauhamata helaḡadia ienai; badina be ia na Sekania Ara rava-maraḡina, bona ia natuna Iehohanan ese Mesulama Berekia natuna hahinena vada e adavaia.
NEH.6.18.english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

NEH.7.63.motu: Hahelaga taudia edia amo danu: Hobaia garana, Hakoso garana, Barasilai garana (una tau ese Barasilai tau Gilead natuna hahinena ta e adavaia, bena idia ladadia ta e henemai).
NEH.7.63.english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

NEH.9.6.motu: Bena Esera eto, Oi na Iehova, oi mo sibomu. Oi ese guba o karaia, guba gubadia danu mai hisiudia iboudiai, bona tanobada mai latana ḡaudia iboudiai, bona davara mai lalodia gaudia iboudiai. Oi ese o hamauridia hanaihanaimu; guba hisiudia ese oi e toma henimu dihomu.
NEH.9.6.english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

NEH.11.33.motu: bona Hasoro ai bona Rama ai bona Gitaimi ai,

NEH.9.31.motu: Ḡau tamona emu hebogahisi badadia lalodiai oi ese so ha-oredia bona so rakatanidia; badina be oi na harihari-bada bona hebogahisi Diravana.
NEH.9.31.english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

NEH.4.8.motu: bena iboudiai e henega bou, idia na baema, Ierusalem bae tuari henia bona lalona bae haheḡonua.
NEH.4.8.english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

NEH.9.36.motu: A itaia, ina dina ai ai na hesiai taumai; senemai o henidia, anina bona ena herahia ḡaudia bae moalelai, tanona lalonai a itamai, ai na hesiai taumai.
NEH.9.36.english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

NEH.1.4.motu: Unu hereva na kamonai, bena na helai diho, na tai; dina haida na tailaiava bona na anivaga loulouva bona na ḡuriḡuri loulouva, guba Diravana vairanai.

NUM.31.14.english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

NUM.35.7.motu: Levi taudia ba henidia hanuadia bae hari-ahui taurahani; iboudiai na mai hetabira tanodia.

NUM.15.25.motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese Israel oreana taudia iboudiai daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia, unu amo edia dika bae hegwau tao; badina be vada e kerere; to edia boubou na Iehova vada e henia, ḡole-oho boubouna bona kara-dikaiabi-ohona boubouna, edia kerere dainai.
NUM.15.25.english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

NUM.19.17.motu: Bena taubu taudia ese hari kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna kahuna taina bae abia, sinavai ranuna ida bae buloa dihu ta ai.

NUM.34.15.motu: Hari iduhu ruaosi mai kahana ese ahudia vada e abi, Ieriko ai, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, daba e reremu kahana ai.

NUM.22.35.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Balaam e hamaoroa, eto, Idia ida baola; a lau baina hamaorolaimu herevadia mo ba gwaurai. Bena Balaam na Balak lohiadia ida ela.
NUM.22.35.english: Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.”

NUM.33.5.motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia na Ramese amo ela, bona Sukoto ai e taruha.
NUM.33.5.english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

NUM.24.16.motu: Dirava ena hereva e kamonaimu tauna,
NUM.24.16.english: he says, who hears the words of God,

NUM.25.13.motu: emai herohemaino toana be ia bona ia garana na hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, ela bona hanaihanai; badina be ena Dirava vaḡeḡena ai e vaḡeḡe, unu amo herohemaino karana vada e karaia, Israel taudia daidiai.
NUM.25.13.english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

NUM.27.1.english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

NUM.20.21.motu: Taunabunai Edom ese Israel taudia e laodia ahu, ena tano amo basie raka hanai. Bena Israel na idau dala amo ela.

NUM.26.41.motu: Beniamina natuna edia iduhu bunu: edia numera be 45,600.
NUM.26.41.english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

NUM.26.58.motu: Levi iduhudia bini: Libni bona Heberon bona Mali bona Musi bona Kora. Kohat na Amram tamana.
NUM.26.58.english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

NUM.3.16.motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese e duahidia, Iehova ese ena hereva ai e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
NUM.3.16.english: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.

NUM.29.28.motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida, ba heni hebou.
NUM.29.28.english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

NUM.23.8.motu: A Dirava ese se uduguiraiamu tauna na
NUM.23.8.english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed?

NUM.26.26.english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
