OBA.1.15.english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

OBA.1.14.english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

OBA.1.3.motu: Lalomu hekokorokuna ese vada e dibaḡanimu,
OBA.1.3.english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

OBA.1.10.motu: Tadimu Iakob o daḡedaḡe henia dainai,
OBA.1.10.english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

OBA.1.11.motu: Oi o gini edea dinana ai,
OBA.1.11.english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

PHM.1.25.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada laumamu ai baine mia.
PHM.1.25.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

PHM.1.7.motu: Una dainai, tadigu e, name moale bada bona taugu danu eme lo, emu lalokau dainai, badina be helaḡa taudia lalodia vada o hakeru.
PHM.1.7.english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

PHM.1.5.motu: badina be na kamonaimu oi ese Lohiabada Iesu o lalokau heniamu bona o abidadama heniamu, helaḡa taudia danu o lalokau henidiamu bona o abidadama henidiamu.
PHM.1.5.english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

PHM.1.22.motu: Vadivadi daiutuna ta bavabia heḡaeḡae lauegu; badina be name helaro emu ḡuriḡuri daidiai egu vasi dalana baine helailai.
PHM.1.22.english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

PHM.1.3.motu: Harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi.
PHM.1.3.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHM.1.13.motu: Bena egu ura be bama dogoa tao, sivarai namo ena iḡui ai isiaigu bema lao heni, oi ibolomu.
PHM.1.13.english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

PHM.1.10.motu: na nounumu natugu Onesimo, iḡui ai na nohomu ai tamana ai na hahelao merona, dainai.
PHM.1.10.english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

PHM.1.17.motu: Lau be oi turamu o tomamu; benaini, ia bavabia dae, lau boma abigu dae heḡereḡerena.
PHM.1.17.english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

PHM.1.21.motu: Lalogu na e tomamu ba kamonai henigu dainai na tore henimumu; dibagu na gwauraimu karadia ba hereadia.
PHM.1.21.english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

PHM.1.6.motu: Taunabunai egu ḡuriḡuri be oiemu abidadama huahuana baine dobi idia ediai, Keriso lalonai ita edai e miamu ḡaudia namodia iboudiai bae diba.
PHM.1.6.english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

PHM.1.4.motu: Na ḡuriḡurimu negadia iboudiai oi na lalomumu, bona Dirava na hanamoamu;
PHM.1.4.english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

PHM.1.23.motu: Bamogu Epafra, Keriso Iesu dainai lau ida iḡui ai a nohomu, ese e hahenamo henimumu.
PHM.1.23.english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

PHM.1.8.motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ladana ai bama haḡanimu diba, ede boma kara toma,
PHM.1.8.english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

PHM.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu dainai abi-mauri tauna, varavarada Timoteo ida, raruosi ese emai lalokau Filemona, ai ida ta ḡaukara heboumu taumu, a tore henimumu.
PHM.1.1.english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

PHM.1.14.motu: To asina uramu kara ta baina karaia, oi do so gwau maoro negana ai; egu ura be emu kara namo na dia lauegu hahedua dainai a oiemu ura dainai bema vara.
PHM.1.14.english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

PHM.1.20.motu: ḡau tamona, tadigu e, mani ba hamoalegu Lohiabada lalonai, lalogu ba hakerua Keriso lalonai.
PHM.1.20.english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

PHM.1.24.motu: Mareko bona Aristako bona Dema bona Luka, lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu, ese danu e hahenamo henimumu.
PHM.1.24.english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

PHM.1.15.motu: Badina bunai, readia, una nega sina oiemu amo e heabi oho, bavabia hanaihanai helaoreana:
PHM.1.15.english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

PHM.1.2.motu: Oi bona taihumai Apia, bona bamomai Arekipo, ia ida a tuari heboumu, bona ekalesia oreana emu ruma ai e heboumu, a tore henimuimu, a tomu:
PHM.1.2.english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

PHM.1.11.motu: Gunaguna ena hesiai ilao-henina na dika oiemu ai, a harihari ena hesiai ilao-henina na namo, oiemu ai bona lauegu ai.
PHM.1.11.english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

PHM.1.18.motu: A ia ese e hadikamu eiava emu ai e abi torehai readia: benaini, ena abi-torehai egu ai ba gwauraia.
PHM.1.18.english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

PHM.1.19.motu: Lau Paulo sibogu imagu ai na toreamu: davana idoinai do baina henimu.
PHM.1.19.english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

PHM.1.12.motu: Na siaia loumu, be vasimu, bona lalogu idoinai danu ia ida.
PHM.1.12.english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

PHM.1.16.motu: dia hesiai tauna, a hesiai e hereaiamu tauna, varavara bona lalokau, lauegu bona oiemu, tau-anina ai bona Lohiabada lalonai.
PHM.1.16.english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

PHM.1.9.motu: to lalokau dainai asina haḡanimumu, na noimumu hari. Oibe, lau Paulo, tau badana bona Keriso Iesu ena abi mauri tauna,
PHM.1.9.english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

PHP.4.9.motu: O davariva ḡaudia, o abi daeva ḡaudia, egu ai o kamonaiva o itava ḡaudia, unu mo ba kara; bena Maino Diravana ese baine bamomui.
PHP.4.9.english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

PHP.1.19.motu: Oibe, bona baina moale. Badina be lau dibagu ini amo hahemauri baina abia, emui noinoi daidiai, bona Iesu Keriso ena Lauma ena hekaha dainai.
PHP.1.19.english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

PHP.4.16.motu: Badina be Tesalonika ai na nohova ai, umui ese egu ogoḡami ikahalaina ḡaudia o siai loulouva.
PHP.4.16.english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

PHP.4.20.motu: Tamada Dirava baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen.
PHP.4.20.english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

PHP.2.8.motu: ita-itana na taunimanima na heto. Bena sibona e hahemanau, Dirava e kamonai henia ela bona mase, oibe, satauro ena mase.
PHP.2.8.english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

PHP.3.15.motu: Benaini, mai darada tauda iboudai unu baita kara toma; a umui haida lalomui bema idau, Dirava ese lalomui baine hadiaridia.
PHP.3.15.english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

PHP.1.15.motu: Momokani, haida ese Keriso na vaḡeḡe ai bona heai ai e harorolaiamu; a haida be lalo-namo ai e harorolaiamu.
PHP.1.15.english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

PHP.1.9.motu: Egu noinoi binai: emui uraheni baine vara badabada mai diarina bona mai aonegana ida;
PHP.1.9.english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

PHP.2.25.motu: Lau na tomamu tadigu Epafrodito, ḡaukara ai bona tuari ai e bamogumu tauna, o siaia egu dabu ai baine kahagu tauna, ma aina siaia vasi.
PHP.2.25.english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

PHP.2.30.motu: Badina be Keriso ena ḡaukara dainai mokona e mase; ena mauri e dadaraia, emui hebogahisi egu ai baine haḡuḡurua totona.
PHP.2.30.english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

PHP.3.13.motu: Varavaragu e, asina tomamu vada na abia; a kara tamona na goadalaiamu, murigu ḡaudia name lalo boio, vairagu ḡaudia na ḡavamu;
PHP.3.13.english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

PHP.2.15.motu: unu amo Dirava natuna ai baola, asi toutoumui, asi bebeka-bebekamui, bona asi emui kerere, uru gageva-gagevana mai gwau-edeedena bogaraginai. Idia padadiai ba hedinarai, tanobada ena diari na heto.
PHP.2.15.english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

PHP.1.3.motu: Na lalomuimu negadia iboudiai egu Dirava na hanamoamu;
PHP.1.3.english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

PHP.4.3.motu: Oi danu, o kahagumu taumu e, ene hahine ba kahadia, badina be idia na lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva, sivarai namo ena; Klemento bona lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva taudia oredia danu. Idia ladadia na mauri bukana ai vada e tore.
PHP.4.3.english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

PHP.2.3.motu: Ḡau ta basio karaia heiri-heiri dainai eiava hekokoroku dainai; a ta ta sibomui ba hahemanau, bamomui ba imodaidia.
PHP.2.3.english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

PHP.2.2.motu: umui ese egu moale boma haḡuḡurua, lalomui boma hatamona, emui ura heni boma hatamona, emui lalo-hadai boma hatamona.
PHP.2.2.english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

PHP.4.7.motu: Bena Dirava ena maino, eda diba idoinai e hereaiamu mainona, ese lalomui bona daramui baine gima, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
PHP.4.7.english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

PHP.2.1.motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ena lalo-hakeru bema mia, uraheni ena tauhalo bema mia, Lauma ena hetura-heheni bema mia, hebogahisi bona hekaha bema mia,
PHP.2.1.english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

PHP.2.23.motu: Taunabunai egu helaro be asi vanahana ia baina siaia vasi, lau ede baina heto baina diba negana ai.
PHP.2.23.english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

PHP.2.28.motu: Una dainai aina siaia vasi na tomamu. Ba itaia lou, bena ba moale; lau danu egu daradara baine maraḡi.
PHP.2.28.english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

PHP.4.17.motu: Dia herahia ḡauna asina tahuamu, a huahua hari na tahumu, ihanamolaimui ḡaudia ai baela huahuadia.
PHP.4.17.english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

PHP.2.18.motu: umui danu ba moale bona baita moale hebou.
PHP.2.18.english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

PHP.4.14.motu: Ḡau tamona, egu hisihisi lalonai o kahagumu be namo.
PHP.4.14.english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

PHP.4.4.motu: Nega idoidiai Lohiabada lalonai ba moale. Ma na gwau loumu: ba moale.
PHP.4.4.english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

PHP.1.20.motu: Egu ura bada bona egu helaro bini: ḡau ta ai basina hemarai, a nega idoidiai heḡereḡeredia harihari danu baina goada mo; bona maurigu ai eiava masegu ai lau taugu ese Iesu baine imodaia.
PHP.1.20.english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

PHP.2.10.motu: bena Iesu ladana dainai guba ḡaudia bona tanobada ḡaudia bona tanobada henuna ḡaudia iboudiai tuidia bae hadai;
PHP.2.10.english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

PHP.2.21.motu: Badina be iboudiai na sibodia edia ḡau e tahumu, a Iesu Keriso ena ḡau asie tahumu.
PHP.2.21.english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

PHP.2.27.motu: Momokani e gorerea, mokona e mase, to Dirava ese e bogaia hisi, bona dia ia mo a lau danu e bogagu hisi, egu lalo-hisihisi baine bada herea na garina.
PHP.2.27.english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

PHP.1.17.motu: Unu idia na heiri-heiri dainai e haroromu, dia lalodia amo; dibura rumana ai na nohomu ai egu hisihisi bae habadaia e tomamu.
PHP.1.17.english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

PHP.4.10.motu: Lohiabada lalonai na moale badamu, vada o lalolaigu loumu dainai. Dibagu o lalolaigu gunava, to asi emui dala ta.
PHP.4.10.english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

PHP.1.10.motu: bena ḡau namodia toadia ba diba, bona ba noho mai ḡoevamui, asi bebeka-bebekamui, ela bona Keriso ena dina.
PHP.1.10.english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

PHP.2.4.motu: Bona ta ta ena namo ena namo basio tahu, a bamomui edia namo ba tahu.
PHP.2.4.english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

PHP.2.13.motu: Badina be Dirava ese ena ura namodia iura-henidia bona ikaradia na lalomui ai e havaramu.
PHP.2.13.english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

PHP.4.22.motu: Helaḡa taudia iniseni ai, haida danu Kaisara ena ruma ai e nohomu, iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimuimu.
PHP.4.22.english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

PHP.2.22.motu: A ia toana be dibamui: mero ese tamana isiaina e lao henimu na heto, ia ese lau isiaigu vada e lao heni, sivarai namo dainai.
PHP.2.22.english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

PHP.1.26.motu: Taunabunai, Keriso Iesu lalonai emui heaḡi baine bada, badina be lau na umui dekemui ai dainai.
PHP.1.26.english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

PHP.1.22.motu: A taugu ai bama mauri noho, egu ḡaukara anina bama itaia; una dainai asi dibagu edena baina abia hidi.
PHP.1.22.english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

PHP.3.5.motu: Na vara, dina ihataurahanina ai e peritomegu. Lau na Israel besena taugu, Beniamina ena iduhu taugu. Senegu danu Heberu taudia. Taravatu ibadinana ai lau be Farisea taugu.
PHP.3.5.english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

PHP.2.9.motu: Una dainai Dirava ese e imodaia, lada ta e henia, lada iboudiai e hereadia ladana;
PHP.2.9.english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

PHP.2.26.motu: Badina be e lalomui badamu, bona lalona e hekwarahimu, ena gorere harina o kamonai dainai.
PHP.2.26.english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

PHP.1.11.motu: Kara maoromaoro huahuadia ai ba honu; idia na Iesu Keriso ena amo e maimu, Dirava iheatolaina bona ihanamona totona.
PHP.1.11.english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP.1.2.motu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi.
PHP.1.2.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHP.3.2.motu: Sisia nahuadia ba toho; dika ikarana taudia nahuadia ba toho; heiva kava taudia nahuadia ba toho.
PHP.3.2.english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

PHP.1.1.motu: Paulo bona Timoteo, ai Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taumai, ese umui Keriso Iesu ena helaḡa taumui iboumui ai Filipi ai o nohomu, bona heitatao taumui bona diakono taumui, a tore henimuimu:
PHP.1.1.english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

PHP.4.13.motu: Goada e henigumu Diravana dainai lau na ḡau iboudiai ikaradia ai na goadamu.
PHP.4.13.english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

PHP.3.14.motu: dokona na heau heniamu, davana baina abia na tomamu; una dava be Keriso Iesu lalonai Dirava ese e boirida dae.
PHP.3.14.english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

PHP.4.5.motu: Emui lalo-manau na taunimanima iboudiai bae diba. Lohiabada vada eme kahikahi.
PHP.4.5.english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

PHP.3.19.motu: Dokodia na mase; edia dirava na bogadia; edia heaḡi na edia hemarai karadia; edia helalo na tanobada ḡaudia.
PHP.3.19.english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

PHP.3.11.motu: Unu amo mase amo toreisi-louna baina ḡavaia.
PHP.3.11.english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

PHP.4.11.motu: Egu ogoḡami na asina herevalaiamu; badina be vada na manada, egu ai e miamu ḡaudia baina moalelai.
PHP.4.11.english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

PHP.2.7.motu: Ia ese sibona e hekaruhia hebubu, hesiai merona anitarana e abia, taunimanima oromana ai e vara,
PHP.2.7.english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

PHP.1.6.motu: Badina be dibagu kara namo lalomui ai e matamaia Diravana ese baine haḡuḡurua, ela bona Iesu Keriso ena dina.
PHP.1.6.english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

PHP.1.16.motu: Ini idia na uraheni dainai e haroromu; dibadia lau na sivarai namo ihamomokanina dainai na ginimu.
PHP.1.16.english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

PHP.2.14.motu: Ḡau iboudiai asi emui maumau asi emui hepapahuahu ba kara;
PHP.2.14.english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

PHP.4.12.motu: Ogoḡami dibagu; taḡa danu dibagu. Ḡabu iboudiai, ḡau iboudiai, bogakunu bona hitolo, taḡa bona ogoḡami, vada na manadalai.
PHP.4.12.english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

PHP.2.24.motu: A Lohiabada na abidadama heniamu, nega basine daudau lau danu baina vasi.
PHP.2.24.english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

PHP.4.15.motu: Filipi taumui e, umui dibamui, sivarai namo iloalaina na matamaia negana ai, Makedonia na rakatania murinai, ekalesia oreana ta ese ikahalaigu ḡaudia ihenidia bona iabidia herevadia se gwaurai, umui mo sibomui.
PHP.4.15.english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

PHP.3.17.motu: Varavaragu e, lau ba ḡavagu hebou, bona ai e haḡoimaimu taudia na ba haerodia.
PHP.3.17.english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

PHP.4.8.motu: Varavaragu e, orena binai: momokani ḡaudia iboudiai, hemataurai ḡaudia iboudiai, maoromaoro ḡaudia iboudiai, ḡoevaḡoeva ḡaudia iboudiai, lalokau ḡaudia iboudiai, haridia namodia ḡaudia iboudiai, ba haero. Ena namo taina mia ḡauna, eiava ena heimodai taina mia ḡauna, ba haeroa.
PHP.4.8.english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

PHP.3.12.motu: Lau asina tomamu vada na abia, eiava vada na ḡoeva dae. Doini na ḡavaiamu, baina abia na tomamu, Keriso Iesu ese lau e abigu na heto.
PHP.3.12.english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.18.motu: Herevana! Dibaka ai eiava momokani ai Keriso e harorolaiamu; una dainai na moalemu.
PHP.1.18.english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

PHP.4.18.motu: Lau na vada na abi vaitani; egu ḡau na momo. Badina be Epafrodito ese emui amo e mailai ḡaudia vada na abi; bonadia nanamo ḡaudia, boubou ḡaudia, Dirava ese e abi daemu mai moalena ida.
PHP.4.18.english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

PHP.3.9.motu: Bena ia lalonai bae davarigu, dia taravatu ai na kara maoromaoro dainai, to Keriso ibadinana ai na kara maoromaoro dainai; Dirava ese eda abidadama dainai e henidamu kara maoromaorona bunai.
PHP.3.9.english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

PHP.3.7.motu: A gunaguna e hanamolaigu ḡaudia iboudiai harihari Keriso dainai dikadia na gwauraimu.
PHP.3.7.english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

PHP.4.6.motu: Ḡau ta basio lalo haguhilaia; a ḡau iboudiai ḡuriḡuri ai, noinoi ai, heimodai ai, emui ura na Dirava ba hamaorolaia.
PHP.4.6.english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

PHP.3.18.motu: Badina be vada na hamaoromui gunava, bona mai taigu ida na hamaoromui loumu, haida na e raka kereremu, Keriso ena satauro e inai heniamu.
PHP.3.18.english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

PHP.3.8.motu: Oibe, ḡau iboudiai na dadaraimu, a ḡau herea-daena, Keriso egu Lohiabada baina dibaia ḡoevaḡoeva, na helaorealaiamu; ia dainai ḡau iboudiai vada na haboiodia, negenege ḡaudia ai vada na halaodia, Keriso baina abia tarika-tarika helaoreana.
PHP.3.8.english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

PHP.1.29.motu: Vada e henimui hariharina binai: dia Keriso iabiabiraina mo, a hisi ianina danu ia dainai.
PHP.1.29.english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

PHP.4.19.motu: Egu Dirava ese o dabumu ḡaudia baine henimui ḡuḡuru, ena kohu herea-daedia, Keriso Iesu lalonai baine henimui.
PHP.4.19.english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.14.motu: bona varavaragu na gwauraidiamu taudia na lau iḡuigu dainai lalodia eme goada Lohiabada lalonai, bena Dirava ena hereva e gwauraiamu mai goadadia ida, asie garimu.
PHP.1.14.english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

PHP.2.17.motu: Ena be lau raragu baine hebubu, emui abidadama karadia ihahelaḡadia, to baina moale, bona baita moale hebou;
PHP.2.17.english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

PHP.3.3.motu: Badina be peritome korikori be ita: ita, lauma ai Dirava ta toma henia dihomu, bona Keriso Iesu ta heaḡilaiamu, bona tau-anina asita abidadama heniamu, tauda.
PHP.3.3.english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

PHP.1.30.motu: Emui tuari be o itaguva na goadalaiava bona o kamonaimu doini na goadalaiamu tuarina.
PHP.1.30.english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

PHP.3.16.motu: Ḡau tamona, vada ta davari ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia ai baita raka.
PHP.3.16.english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

PHP.3.21.motu: Ia ese ini tau-anida manokadia baine hamatamata, ia tau-anina ḡoeva-daena heida-idana ai baine halao; badina be ia siahuna vada e heḡereḡere ḡau iboudiai baine hamanada.
PHP.3.21.english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

PHP.3.20.motu: A ita eda hanua konkori na guba ai; eda helaro be Ihamaurida Tauna, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, unu amo bainema.
PHP.3.20.english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

PHP.1.7.motu: Umui iboumui ai ini na lalomui tomamu na maoro, badina be lalogu ai na lalomui taomu; dibura rumana ai na nohomu ai bona sivarai namo na gwauraiamu ma na hamomokaniamu ai, umui bona lau harihari-bada tame abia hebou.
PHP.1.7.english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

PHP.1.8.motu: Dirava hari dibana, Keriso Iesu ena hebogahisi ai umui iboumui ai na ura henimui lalo-dikamu.
PHP.1.8.english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.25.motu: Una na dibagu; bena na laloamu do baina noho, umui ida baita noho hebou, emui abidadama bona emui moale ihabadana.
PHP.1.25.english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

PHP.4.2.motu: Euodia bona Sunutuke na noidiamu, lalodia bae tamona Lohiabada lalonai.
PHP.4.2.english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

PHP.2.20.motu: Badina be dekegu ai ta lasi ia heḡereḡerena; ta lasi umui baine reḡumui ia baine reḡumui heḡereḡerena.
PHP.2.20.english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

PHP.2.11.motu: bona mala iboudiai ese Keriso na “Lohiabada” bae gwauraia, Tamada Dirava iheatolaina.
PHP.2.11.english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

PHP.1.12.motu: Varavaragu e, na uramu ba diba, egu ai e vara ḡaudia na sivarai namo ihapere-rohorohona ḡaudia ai vada ela.
PHP.1.12.english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

PHP.2.12.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, nega idoidiai lau vairagu ai o kamonai henigu; harihari, lau murigu ai, emui kamonai ba habadaia, mai garimui bona mai heude-heudemui ida ihamaurimui ba tahua.
PHP.2.12.english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

PHP.1.5.motu: badina be lalomui ai o matamaia dinana ema bona hari, sivarai namo ḡaukarana ai o kahagu dainai.
PHP.1.5.english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

PHP.1.13.motu: Ḡaubada ena hegima oreana idoinai bona taunimanima iboudiai gabu idau-idau ai danu dibadia lau na Keriso dainai dibura rumana ai na nohomu;
PHP.1.13.english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

PHP.1.23.motu: Egu ura na rua; na daradaramu. Na ura badamu Keriso dekena bainala; una bema namo herea.
PHP.1.23.english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

PHP.4.21.motu: Keriso Iesu ena helaḡa taudia iboudiai ba hahenamo henidia. Varavarada dekegu ai e nohomu ese e hahenamo henimumu.
PHP.4.21.english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

PHP.1.24.motu: To umui daimui ai taugu ai baina noho baine namo.
PHP.1.24.english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

PHP.2.19.motu: Lohiabada Iesu lalonai na laloamu asi vanahana Timoteo baina siaia vasi, bena harimui baina kamonai, lalogu baine keru.
PHP.2.19.english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

PHP.1.27.motu: Ḡau tamona, Keriso ena sivarai namo ihaheḡereḡerena karadia mo ba kara; bena baina vasi itamui eiava dauhai mo harimui baina kamonai, lau baina diba umui na lalo tamona ai o gini tutuka-tutukamu, bona ura tamona ai sivarai namo ikamonai-henina o goadalaiamu.
PHP.1.27.english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

PHP.2.5.motu: Keriso Iesu lalonai e miava darana umui lalomui ai danu baine mia.
PHP.2.5.english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

PHP.1.21.motu: Badina be lauegu ai mauri be Keriso, a mase amo ḡau namo-hereana baina davaria.
PHP.1.21.english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

PHP.2.16.motu: Mauri herevana ba hahedinaraia, bena Keriso ena dina ai lau na do baina moale, bainato “Asina heau kava, asina hekwarahi kava”.
PHP.2.16.english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

PHP.3.10.motu: Bena ia bona ena toreisi-lou siahuna baina diba; bona ia e ani hisidia lau danu baina ani, ena mase dalana ai danu baina mase.
PHP.3.10.english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

PHP.1.28.motu: E inai henimuimu taudia na garidia basio gari; una na idia edia mase toana, a umui emui ai Dirava ena hahemauri toana.
PHP.1.28.english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

PHP.1.4.motu: bona umui daimui ai na noinoimu negadia iboudiai, na ḡuriḡurimu mai moalegu ida;
PHP.1.4.english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

PHP.3.6.motu: Egu goada na hahedinaraiava, ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava. Taravatu ena kara maoromaoro ibadinana ai lau na asi bebeka-bebekagu.
PHP.3.6.english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

PHP.4.23.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na laumamui ai baine mia.
PHP.4.23.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

PHP.2.6.motu: Ia hari, ena be Dirava anitarana e abia, ena be ia Dirava ida vada e heḡereḡere, to se haeroa una na baine Dogoa tao ḡauna.
PHP.2.6.english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

PHP.2.29.motu: Benaini, Lohiabada lalonai bavabia dae mai moalemui ida; bona kara unuhetomadia e karamu na taudia danu iboudiai ba matauraidia.
PHP.2.29.english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

PHP.3.1.motu: Benaini, varavaragu e, Lohiabada lalonai ba moale. Hereva tamona na torea louloumu, asina hesikumu; badina be ia ese umui baine hamaurimui.
PHP.3.1.english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

PHP.3.4.motu: Lau ese tau-anina bama abidadama henia diba; ena be tau ta ese tau-anina bema abidadama henia, to lau ese bama hereaia.
PHP.3.4.english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

PHP.4.1.motu: Taunabinai, varavaragu e, egu lalokau taumui, na ura henimuimu taumui, egu moale badina, egu dagi toana: lalokau e, Lohiabada lalonai ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
PHP.4.1.english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

PRO.2.12.english: to deliver you from the way of evil,

PRO.6.26.motu: badina be ariara hahinena na flaoa igabu ta bae davalaia,
PRO.6.26.english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread.

PRO.7.10.motu: A itaia, hahine ta ia ida e hedavarimu;
PRO.7.10.english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute,

PRO.20.26.motu: Pavapava mai aonegana ese dika taudia na e tapodia hidimu,
PRO.20.26.english: A wise king winnows out the wicked,

PRO.9.14.motu: Ena ruma iduarana ai e helaimu,
PRO.9.14.english: She sits at the door of her house,

PRO.4.11.english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom.

PRO.30.31.motu: bona kokoroku maruanena; bona nani maruanena;

PRO.31.6.motu: Kekero muramurana na mokona e masemu tauna ba henia,
PRO.31.6.english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish,

PRO.21.23.motu: Uduna bona malana e naridiamu tauna na
PRO.21.23.english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue

PRO.26.25.motu: hereva manadadia e gwauraimu negana ai basio kamonai henia,
PRO.26.25.english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him,

PRO.22.20.english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things

PRO.8.10.motu: Egu hahediba herevadia bavabi dae, a dia silver;
PRO.8.10.english: Receive my instruction rather than silver,

PRO.6.32.motu: E heuda hanaimu tauna na asi darana;
PRO.6.32.english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding.

PRO.13.10.motu: Se henahua tohomu tauna ena ḡadeḡade ese heiri-heiri e havaraiamu,

PRO.7.6.motu: Egu ruma gaba-mauruna badibadinai na gini,
PRO.7.6.english: For at the window of my house,

PRO.24.3.english: Through wisdom a house is built;

PRO.24.14.motu: Ba diba, aonega na unuheto, laumamu enai;
PRO.24.14.english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul.

PRO.11.31.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna ese davana baine abia ina tanobada ai;
PRO.11.31.english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth,

PRO.16.1.english: The plans of the heart belong to man,

PRO.30.18.motu: Ḡau toi na mai hoadia bada egu ai;
PRO.30.18.english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me,

PRO.23.20.motu: Vine ranuna e inu momomu taudia ida basio inu hebou,
PRO.23.20.english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine,

PRO.31.22.english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry.

PRO.8.14.motu: Hahealo bona aonega namodia na egu ai,
PRO.8.14.english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine.

PRO.11.23.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna ena ura na namo ai e ḡuḡurumu,
PRO.11.23.english: The desire of the righteous is only good.

PRO.1.19.motu: Daḡedaḡe amo kohu e dadimu taudia iboudiai edia dala be unu heheto;
PRO.1.19.english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain.

PRO.14.3.motu: Kavakava tauna ena hereva na ia sibona doruna ikwadilaina auna,
PRO.14.3.english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back,

PRO.24.13.motu: Natugu e, bada-ranuna bavania, badina be ia na namo;
PRO.24.13.english: My son, eat honey, for it is good,

PRO.27.26.motu: una negana ai mamoe natudia amo emu hahedoki ḡaudia bavabi,
PRO.27.26.english: The lambs are for your clothing,

PRO.4.8.motu: Ba laloa bada, bena ia ese baine heatolaimu;
PRO.4.8.english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you.

PRO.10.18.motu: Inai e huniamu tauna bibinana na e koikoimu,
PRO.10.18.english: He who hides hatred has lying lips.

PRO.14.17.motu: Badu haraḡa tauna na e kara kava kara kavamu,
PRO.14.17.english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly,

PRO.3.17.english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness.

PRO.20.25.motu: Tau ta baine hereva haraḡa, baineto “Ina na helaḡa”,
PRO.20.25.english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication,

PRO.4.2.motu: badina be hahediba herevadia namodia vada na henimui;
PRO.4.2.english: for I give you sound learning.

PRO.24.23.motu: Aonega taudia edia hereva haida bini:
PRO.24.23.english: These also are sayings of the wise:

PRO.6.15.english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly.

PRO.13.7.motu: Tau ta sibona taḡa tauna e hegwauraimu, to asi ena ḡau ta;
PRO.13.7.english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing.

PRO.26.13.motu: Lahedo tauna na e tomu “Leona ta na dala ai;
PRO.26.13.english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road!

PRO.12.3.motu: Kara dika ese tau ta se haginia tutukamu,
PRO.12.3.english: A man shall not be established by wickedness,

PRO.22.29.motu: Ena ḡaukara ikarana mai dibana tauna o itaiamu a?
PRO.22.29.english: Do you see a man skilled in his work?

PRO.23.34.motu: Oi na davara nuana ai e hekuremu tauna
PRO.23.34.english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea,

PRO.14.2.motu: Kara maoromaoro ai e rakamu tauna ese Iehova garina egarimu,
PRO.14.2.english: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh,

PRO.25.5.motu: kara dika taudia na pavapva vairana amo bavabidia oho,
PRO.25.5.english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence,

PRO.15.10.motu: Mata-hakani auka-hereana na dala e rakataniamu tauna enai;
PRO.15.10.english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way.

PRO.5.13.motu: e hadibagu taudia eredia asina kamonaiva,
PRO.5.13.english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers,

PRO.12.28.english: In the way of righteousness is life;

PRO.14.28.english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory,

PRO.11.1.motu: Metau ihahetohona e hakoikoiamu ḡauna na ḡau dika-hereana Iehova enai,
PRO.11.1.english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh,

PRO.18.1.motu: E haheidaumu tauna ese sibona ena ura e tahuamu;
PRO.18.1.english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness,

PRO.6.12.motu: Kara kava tauna, kara dika tauna,
PRO.6.12.english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity,

PRO.1.30.motu: egu hahealo herevadia ta asie abia daeva,
PRO.1.30.english: They wanted none of my counsel.

PRO.12.19.motu: Momokani bibinadia na e mia hanaihanaimu,
PRO.12.19.english: Truth’s lips will be established forever,

PRO.17.16.motu: Badina be dahaka kavakava tauna imana ai aonega ihoilaina davana baine mia,
PRO.17.16.english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom,

PRO.23.15.english: My son, if your heart is wise,

PRO.19.12.motu: Pavapava ena badu na leona e ḡoumu na heto;
PRO.19.12.english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion,

PRO.19.24.motu: Lahedo tauna ese imana na dihu ai e dau dobimu,
PRO.19.24.english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish;

PRO.1.11.motu: Idia na bema toma: Aoma, aitala,

PRO.4.6.motu: basio rakatania, bena ia ese baine narimu;
PRO.4.6.english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you.

PRO.23.1.motu: Pavapava ida bavaniani hebou negana ai,
PRO.23.1.english: When you sit to eat with a ruler,

PRO.24.16.motu: Badina be kara maoromaoro tauna na nega hitu e ketomu, ma e tore isimu;
PRO.24.16.english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again,

PRO.6.23.english: For the commandment is a lamp,

PRO.20.24.motu: Taunimanima ena raka na Iehova ese e reḡuamu;
PRO.20.24.english: A man’s steps are from Yahweh;

PRO.3.34.motu: Heihi-ihirai taudia na ia ese e ihi-ihiraidiamu;

PRO.18.8.motu: Hemaunu tauna ena hereva na aniani mai gaihodia na heheto;
PRO.18.8.english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels:

PRO.19.7.motu: Ogoḡami tauna na tadikakana iboudiai ese e inai heniamu;
PRO.19.7.english: All the relatives of the poor shun him;

PRO.26.20.motu: Asi rakuraku audia dainai lahi na e bodomu;
PRO.26.20.english: For lack of wood a fire goes out.

PRO.29.13.motu: Ogoḡami tauna bona ia e hahisiamu tauna raruosi e hevaira hehenimu,
PRO.29.13.english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common:

PRO.18.10.english: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower:

PRO.6.8.motu: to lahara negana ai ana aniani e abimu,
PRO.6.8.english: provides her bread in the summer,

PRO.20.9.english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure.

PRO.20.22.english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.”

PRO.30.11.english: There is a generation that curses their father,

PRO.30.30.motu: Ḡaudia be leona, uda ḡaudia bogaragidiai ia mo herea,
PRO.30.30.english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals,

REV.1.3.english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

REV.10.9.english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book.

REV.6.8.motu: Bena hosi mia kurona ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna ladana na Mase, bona Mase Lohiana na ia murina amo ema. Siahu na raruosi e henidia, tanobada ena inogo haniosi ai inogo ta bae biagua, dare bona doe bona dai-hanai goreredia bona tanobada ena hekori boromadia amo taunimanima bae aladia mase.
REV.6.8.english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

REV.6.11.english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

REV.15.1.english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

REV.21.14.motu: Bona maḡu badina nadidia na gwauta-rua, ohedia ai Mamoe Natuna ena aposetolo taudia gwauta-raruosi ladadia e tore.
REV.21.14.english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

REV.9.21.motu: Edia ala-ala bona edia babalau bona edia heuda-hanai bona edia henao danu asie helalolai kerehai.
REV.9.21.english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

REV.20.2.motu: Ia ese hari huala, idau negai gaigaina, ladana ta hatoamu “Diabolo” bona “Satana”, e dabaia tao, e ḡuia, laḡani daha ta iḡui ai baine noho.
REV.20.2.english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

REV.21.15.english: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

REV.22.13.motu: Lau na Alefa bona Omega, gini-gunana bona gini-gabena, matamana bona dokona.

REV.12.5.motu: Hahine na e mara, mero e abia; ia ese bese loḡora iboudiai auri itotohina amo bainereḡudia. To mero na e kitoa dae Dirava vairana bona ena terono vairanai.
REV.12.5.english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

REV.12.9.motu: Bena hari huala badana, idau negai gaigaina, ma ladana ta Satana, tanobada idoinai e koiamu ḡauna, na e doria lasi bona e tahoa dobi tanobada ai; bona ena aneru danu ia ida e tahodia dobi.
REV.12.9.english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

REV.19.9.motu: Bena aneru ese e hamaorogu, eto, A torea: “Mamoe Natuna ena headava anibouna e vavedia taudia be nanamo”. Ma eto “Ini na Dirava ena hereva momokani”.
REV.19.9.english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

REV.18.4.motu: Ma ere ta guba amo na kamonai, eto,
REV.18.4.english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

REV.18.24.english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

REV.18.18.motu: bena idouna kwalahuna e itaia negana ai e lolo, eto.
REV.18.18.english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

REV.12.1.motu: Bena hoa ḡauna badana ta guba ai e hedinarai: hahine ta, ena dabua na dina, bona hua na aena henudiai, bona hisiu gwauta-rua kwarana ai e ḡeḡea.
REV.12.1.english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

REV.7.17.motu: Badina be Mamoe Natuna ese baine reḡudia; e lohilohimu ranudia mauridia badidiai baine hakaudia; bona Dirava ese iruru-matadia iboudiai na matadia amo baine dahu oho.
REV.7.17.english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

REV.11.18.english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

REV.20.3.motu: Guri dobu-masemasena lalonai e tahoa dobi, bena guri e koua bona ikouna toana e karaia. Taunabunai, bese idau-idau basine haraiva-raivadia diba ela bona laḡani daha ta bae ore. Una murinai ma bae ruhaia nege, nega taina mo.
REV.20.3.english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

REV.1.5.motu: bona Iesu Keriso ena amo: ia na gwau maoro tauna namona, bona toreisi-lou roboana mase amo, bona tanobada pavapavadia biagudia.
REV.1.5.english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

REV.1.18.motu: mauri tauna lau; na mase, to na maurimu; baina mauri hanaihanai. Mase kina bona mase taudia edia gabu kina na imagu ai.
