REV.16.20.motu: Motumotu iboudiai e heau boio; ororo nallasihidia.
REV.16.20.english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

REV.11.4.motu: Ini na olive audia aurua bona lamepa aurua, tanobada Lohiana vairanai e ginimu.
REV.11.4.english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

REV.12.4.motu: Iuna ese guba hisiudia e daro dobi tanobada ai; hisiu toi toi amo ta ta e daro dobi. Bena hari huala na baine mara hahinena vairanai e gini, bine abia merona na ia ese baine ania eto.
REV.12.4.english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

REV.1.4.motu: Lau Ioane, ekalesia oreadia hituosi Asia ai na tore henimuimu: hariharibada bona maino bavabi, e nohomu, e nohova bona baine noho Diravana ena amo, bona ena terono vairanai e ginimu laumadia hahituosi edia amo,
REV.1.4.english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

REV.7.12.motu: eto “Amen, hahenamo bona hairai bona aonega bona heimodai bona hemataurai bona siahu bona goada na eda Dirava ese haine abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai; Amen”.
REV.7.12.english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

REV.20.5.motu: A mase taudia oredia asie mauri lou ela bona laḡani daha ta e ore. Tore-isi-lou gini gunana binai.
REV.20.5.english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

REV.14.1.motu: Bona Mamoe Natuna na itaia, Siona ororona ai e gini; bona ia ida taunimanima domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani, ia bona Tamana Iadadia baḡudia ai e torea taudia.
REV.14.1.english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

REV.22.15.motu: A murimuri ai be sisia bona babalau taudia bona heuda-hanai taudia, bona ala-ala taudia, bona kaivakuku e toma henidia dihomu taudia, bona koikoi herevadia igwauraidia e moalelaimu taudia.
REV.22.15.english: \+w Outside|strong="G1854"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w dogs|strong="G2965"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sorcerers|strong="G5333"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* sexually \+w immoral|strong="G4205"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w murderers|strong="G5406"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w idolaters|strong="G1496"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w everyone|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w loves|strong="G5368"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w practices|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w falsehood|strong="G5579"\+w*.

REV.5.10.motu: Pavapava bona hahelaḡa taudia ai o halaodia,
REV.5.10.english: and made us kings and priests to our God;

REV.22.9.motu: Bena e gwaugu tao, eto, Ene basio kara toma; lau na hesiai taugu, oi bamomu, bona varavaramu peroveta taudia bamodia, bona ina buka herevadia e badinamu taudia bamodia. Dirava hari ba toma henia diho.
REV.22.9.english: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

REV.1.9.motu: Lau kakamui Ioane, umui bamomui hisi-ani ai bona basileia ai bona haheauka ai, Iesu bagunai, motumotu ta, ladana Patamo, ai na nohova, Dirava ena hereva bona Iesu ena hereva e gwaurai hedinaraiva daidiai.
REV.1.9.english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

REV.5.9.motu: Bena ane matamatana e abia, eto,
REV.5.9.english: They sang a new song, saying,

REV.20.8.motu: Bena ia na baine lasi, tanobada daigunina haniosi ai e nohomu besedia, ladadia Gog bona Magog, tuari totona baine gogodia; ihagaudia na kone mirina na heto.
REV.20.8.english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

REV.13.18.motu: Aonegana binai: lalona e pararamu tauna ese hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna numerana baine hagaua, badina be ia na tau ta numerana. Numerana binai: 666.
REV.13.18.english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

REV.18.13.motu: muramura idauidau danu, kinamomo bona amomo bona tumiamata bona muro bona libano; vine ranuna danu, bona dehoro; flaoa bona uit; boromakau bona mamoe; hosi bonal kariota; tauunimanima tau-anidia bona laumadia.
REV.18.13.english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

REV.13.11.motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna ma ta na itaia, tano lalona amo e dae, doana na rua, man-oe natuna ta na heto, a erella na huala erena na heto.
REV.13.11.english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

REV.21.11.motu: Ia hairaina na Dirava hairaina; bona diarina na nadi hururu-hururuna, davana bada ḡauna, na heto, iaspi nadina na heto, e negari-negari.
REV.21.11.english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

REV.16.9.motu: Bena siahu badana ese taunimanima e aradia; bena idia ese hari hahehisi e biagudia Diravana ladana e uduguiraia; asie helalo kerehai bona asie heatolaia.
REV.16.9.english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

REV.22.6.motu: Aneru ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ini hereva na mamaoro-mamaoro bona momomo-kakani. Lohiabada, peroveta taudia laumadia edia Dirava, ese ena aneru vada e siaia, asi vanahana bae vara ḡaudia na ena hesiai taudia baine haheitalaidia.
REV.22.6.english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

REV.1.15.motu: Aena na auri labora-labora e kimore-kimore na heto, lahi ai e havevea negana ai. Gadona na sinavai momo reḡedia na heto.
REV.1.15.english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

REV.2.22.motu: A itaia, lau na gorere patana ai baina tahoa kau, bona ia ida e heuda hanaimu taudia basie helalo kerehai negana ai idia danu baina hahisihisidia bada.
REV.2.22.english: \+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* throw \+w her|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w commit|strong="G3431"\+w* \+w adultery|strong="G3431"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w her|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w bed|strong="G2825"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w great|strong="G3173"\+w* oppression, \+w unless|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w her|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w*.

REV.11.7.motu: Edia haroro bae haḡuḡuru, bena mauri ḡauna mai daḡedaḡena, guri dobu-hereana amo e daemu ḡauna, ese baine tuari henidia, haine hadareredia, baine aladia mase.
REV.11.7.english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

REV.17.9.motu: Aonega tauna na lalona baine parara. Hari kwara hituosi na ororo hitu; hahine na latadiai e helaimu.
REV.17.9.english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

REV.7.3.motu: eto, Tanobada bona davara bona au basio hadika, ela bona eda Dirava ena hesiai taudia bagudia ai ia toana baita karaia.
REV.7.3.english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

REV.11.12.motu: Bena gado ta guba amo e kamonai, e hereva badabada, e boiridia, eto “Ini aoma”. Bena raruosi na ori ta lalonai guba ai e dae, inaidia vairadiai.
REV.11.12.english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

REV.10.5.motu: Bena davara ai bona tanobada ai e gini aneruna na itaia, ia ese imana idibana e duduia dae guba ai,
REV.10.5.english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

REV.2.9.motu: Emu hisihisi bona emu ogoḡami na dibagu. Ḡau tamona, oi na taḡa taumu. Sibodia Iuda taudia ai e hahelaomu edia ere dika danu dibagu; idia na dia Iuda taudia a Satana ena orea taudia.
REV.2.9.english: “\+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* works, oppression, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w poverty|strong="G4432"\+w* (\+w but|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w rich|strong="G4145"\+w*), \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* blasphemy \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w say|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w Jews|strong="G2453"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3756"\+w*, \+w but|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w synagogue|strong="G4864"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w Satan|strong="G4567"\+w*.

REV.19.10.motu: Bena aena badinai na goru diho, baina toma henia diho nato, to e gwaugu tao, eto, Ene asio kara toma; lau danu hesiai taugu, oi bamomu bona varavaramu, Iesu ena hereva e badinamu taudia, bamodia danu. Dirava ba toma henia diho; badina be Iesu ena hereva na peroveta laumana.
REV.19.10.english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

REV.12.3.motu: Bena hoa ḡauna ma ta guba ai e hedinarai: huala badana kakakakana ta, kwarana na hitu, doana na gwauta, ena havava ḡaudia danu na hitu, kwarana ta ta ai.
REV.12.3.english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

REV.5.11.motu: Bena na roha lao, bona aneru hutuma gadodia na kamonai, idia ese terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia e ginidia hegeḡe, daha daha, gerebu gerebu.
REV.5.11.english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

REV.9.18.motu: Ini hahedika toiosi daidiai taunimanima tatoi tatoi amo ta ta e mase; hari lahi bona kwalahu bona teio, ududia amo e lasi gaudia, ese e aladia mase.
REV.9.18.english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

REV.11.2.motu: A Dubu Helaḡa maḡuna na basio hahetohoa, badina be bese idau-idau taudia vada e henidia, idia na hua hari-ahui rua hanua helaḡana bae moimoilaia.
REV.11.2.english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

REV.17.15.motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, o itil ranudia, ariara hahinena ese e helai heni ranudia, na tano idau-idau taudia, orea idau-idau, bese idau-idau, gado idau-idau.
REV.17.15.english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

REV.18.11.motu: Bona hanua hanua edia hoihoi taudia danu ia taina bae tai, bae tai dikadika; badina he edia hoihoi kohudia na tau ta ese basine hoi lou:
REV.18.11.english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

REV.9.7.motu: Hari kwadi ita-itadia na tuari hosidia na heheto; kwaradia na e kara gold havava ḡaudia na heheto; vairadia na taunimanima na heheto;
REV.9.7.english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

REV.22.16.motu: Lau Iesu ese egu aneru vada na siaia vasi, ekalesia oreadia herevadia vada e vasilai. Lau na David ramuna bona tuhutuhuna. Lau na hisiu bada, mai diarigu.
REV.22.16.english: \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w*, \+w Jesus|strong="G2424"\+w*, \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sent|strong="G3992"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* angel \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w testify|strong="G3140"\+w* \+w these|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w root|strong="G4491"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w offspring|strong="G1085"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w David|strong="G1138"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Bright|strong="G2986"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Morning|strong="G4407"\+w* Star.”

REV.1.12.motu: Bena na gini kerehai, e hereva henigu tauna baina itaia nato. Bena gold lamepadia auhitu na ita;
REV.1.12.english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

REV.19.11.motu: Bena guba na itaia, e parara, bona hosi kurokurona ta e hedinarai, latanai e gui tauna ladana na “Abidadama” bona “Momokani”; ia na kara maoromaoro ai e hahemaoromu bona e tuarimu.
REV.19.11.english: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

REV.10.6.motu: Noho-hanaihanai Diravana, guba mai anina idoinai bona tanobada mai anina idoinai bona davara mai anina idoinaie kara Diravana, ladana ai e gwau hamata, eto, Nega na basine halahe;
REV.10.6.english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

REV.3.8.motu: Emu kara na dibagu. A itaia, iduara ta vairamu ai vada na kehoa, tau ta basine koua diba. Dibagu danu emu goada na dia bada, to egu hereva vada o badinaia bona ladagu so ḡorea.
REV.3.8.english: “\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w* (\+w behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w set|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* open \+w door|strong="G2374"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3762"\+w* \+w can|strong="G1410"\+w* \+w shut|strong="G2808"\+w*), \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w little|strong="G3398"\+w* \+w power|strong="G1411"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w kept|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w my|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w word|strong="G3056"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* didn’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w deny|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w my|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w*.

REV.7.11.motu: Bena terono bona heitatao taudia bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi e ginidia heḡeḡe anerudia iboudiai ese terono vairanai e goru diho, Dirava e toma henia diho,
REV.7.11.english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

REV.8.3.motu: Bena aneru ta ma ema, pata helaḡana badibadinai e gini. Imana ai gold urona ta, lalonai muramura mai bonana e gabua ḡauna, e abia. Bena muramura mai bonana momo ehenia, helaḡa taudia edia ḡuriḡuri ida baine bulo, gold patana helaḡana ai, terono vairanai.
REV.8.3.english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

REV.4.1.motu: Ini ḡau muridiai na roha lao, guba ai iduara ta e hekeho na itaia, bona ere, na kamonai guna ḡauna, kibi reḡena na heto, ese e hereval henigu, eto, A dae aoma, gabeai bae vara ḡaudia baina haheitalaimu.
REV.4.1.english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

REV.11.17.motu: Lohiabada e, siahu idoidiai Diravana; o nohomu, o nohova.
REV.11.17.english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

REV.14.20.motu: Hari moimoi gabuna na hanua mulimurinai; bena e moia. Bena rara na moimoi gabuna amo e lasi, e aru ela bona maila sinahu-rua; ena dobu danu tano ela bona hosi uduna heḡereḡerena.
REV.14.20.english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

REV.9.6.motu: Unu dinadia ai, taunimanima ese mase bae tahua, to basie davaria; bae ura lalo-dika bae mase, to mase ese baine heautanidia.
REV.9.6.english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

REV.6.13.motu: Bona hisiu na guba amo e moru, lai gubana ese suke huahuadia kasiridia e hahehuhumu na heto.
REV.6.13.english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

REV.2.28.motu: Bona hisiu bada danu baina henia.
REV.2.28.english: \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w morning|strong="G4407"\+w* star.

REV.3.2.motu: Ba noga. Mia ḡaudia, be masemu ḡaudia, ba reḡu namonamo; badina be emu kara maoromaorona ta Dirava vairanai asina davaria.
REV.3.2.english: \+w Wake|strong="G1127"\+w* \+w up|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w strengthen|strong="G4741"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w remain|strong="G1096"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w were|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w about|strong="G3195"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* throw away, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w found|strong="G2147"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w yours|strong="G4771"\+w* perfected \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*.

REV.5.7.motu: Ia na ema, terono ai e helai Tauna imana idibana amo buka e abia.
REV.5.7.english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

REV.17.10.motu: Idia na pavapava hahitu danu: laima vada e keto, ta be e nohomu, a ta be do sema; bainema negama ai baine noho taina.
REV.17.10.english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

REV.15.6.motu: Bena aneru hituosi, hahehisi ḡaudia hituosi e abi anerudia, na kalaga helaḡana amo e raka lasi; dabua aukadia ḡoevaḡoevadia bona kuroka-kurokadia e hadokilai, kemedia toradia na gold.
REV.15.6.english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

REV.20.14.motu: Bena Mase bona Mase Gabuna na lahi gohuna lalonai e tahodia dobi. Ina na mase iharuana, lahi gohuna.
REV.20.14.english: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

REV.7.14.motu: Bena na haere, nato, Ḡauka e, oi dibamu. Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Ini na hisihisi badana amo vada ema, edia dabua na Mamoe Natuna rarana ai e huri, e hakurokuro.
REV.7.14.english: I told him, “My lord, you know.”

REV.18.21.motu: Bena aneru goadana ta ese nadi-huro badana ta e abia isi, davara ai e tahoa dobi, eto,
REV.18.21.english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

REV.20.13.motu: Bona davara ai e mase taudia na davara ese e henidia dae, bona Mase bona Mase Gabuna danu lalodiai e hekou taudia e henidia dae. Bena idia danu edia kara heḡereḡeredia e hahemaoro henidia.
REV.20.13.english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

REV.19.14.motu: Guba ena tuari oreadia na ia murinai ela: hosi kurokurodia ai e gui; dabua aukadia, ḡoevaḡoevadia bona kuroka-kurokadia, e hadokilai.
REV.19.14.english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

REV.5.8.motu: Buka e abia; bena mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi na Mamoe Natuna vairanai e goru diho. Idia ta ta mai edia gitara bona mai edia gold urodia: unu uro be e gabumu bena bonadia e daemu muramuradia ai e honuhonu dae, helaḡa taudia edia ḡuriḡuri bunu.
REV.5.8.english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

REV.21.20.motu: ihaimana na sadonu, ihatauratoina na sadio, ihahituna na krusolito, ihataurahanina na berulio, ihataaurahani-tana na topasio, ihagwaautana na krusoiparaso, ihagwaautatana na huakinto, ihagwauta-ruana na ametuso.
REV.21.20.english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

REV.14.12.motu: Helaḡa taudia, Dirava ena haheḡani e badinamu bona Iesu e abidadama heniamu taudia, do bae haheauka.
REV.14.12.english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

REV.9.10.motu: Iudia na doadoa iudia na heheto, mat duridia; bona edia siahu, taunimanima hua ima bae hahisidia, na iudia ai mia.
REV.9.10.english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

REV.21.6.motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Vadaeni; lau na gini-gunana bona gini-gabena, matamana bona dokona. Ranu mase tauna na e lohilohi daemu mauri-ranuna baine henia, asi davana.
REV.21.6.english: He said to me, “\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Alpha \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Omega|strong="G5598"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Beginning \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w End|strong="G5056"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w freely|strong="G1432"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w thirsty|strong="G1372"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w spring|strong="G4077"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w water|strong="G5204"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w life|strong="G2222"\+w*.

REV.22.18.motu: Ina buka ena peroveta herevadia e kamonaimu taudia iboudiai na sisiba henidiamu: tau ta ese ini hereva latadiai hereva ta baine atoa kau, Dirava ese ina buka lalonai e tore hisihisidia na ia latanai baine ato kau;
REV.22.18.english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

REV.13.2.motu: Hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna na itaia, ita-itana na taiga na heto, a aena na bea aena na heto, bona uduna na leona uduna na heto. Bena hari huala ese ena goada bona ena terono bona ena siahu na una ḡau e henia.
REV.13.2.english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

REV.21.19.motu: Hanua maḡuna badina nadidia na nadi hururu-hururudia e haheralaidia. Gini-gunana na iaspi nadina, iharuana na sapairo, ihatoina na kalakedo, ihahanina na samarago,
REV.21.19.english: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

REV.12.12.motu: Guba e! Guba ai o nohomu taumui e! Idia daidiai ba moale. Tanobada bona davara, madi ihabaimui! Badina be diabolo vada e vasi, e badu dikadikamu, badina be ia dibana ena nega eme kwadogi.
REV.12.12.english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

REV.6.10.motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Biagumai e, Helaḡa bona Momokani, edena nega ai tanobada taudia ba hahemaoro henidia, davadia ba henidia, ai raramai dainai”.
REV.6.10.english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

REV.3.5.motu: Kwalimu tauna ese dabua kurokurona baine hadokilaia; ia ladana danu mauri bukana amo basina rohoa, a Tamagu vairanai bona ena aneru vairadiai ia ladana baina gwauraia.
REV.3.5.english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w arrayed|strong="G4016"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w white|strong="G3022"\+w* \+w garments|strong="G2440"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w way|strong="G3779"\+w* blot \+w his|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w out|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w book|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w life|strong="G2222"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w confess|strong="G3670"\+w* \+w his|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Father|strong="G3962"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w his|strong="G1722"\+w* angels.

REV.4.3.motu: E helai kau tauna ita-itana na iaspi bona sadio nadidia na heheto; bona kevau ese terono e ḡeḡea dae, ita-itana na samarago nadina na heto.
REV.4.3.english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

REV.9.3.motu: Bena kwalahu amo kwadi e lasi tanobada ai; bona siahu e henidia, tanohada doadoadia siahudia na heto.
REV.9.3.english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

REV.2.1.motu: Ekalesia oreana Efeso ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Hisiu hituosi imana idibana ai e dogo taomu bona gold lamepadia auhituosi bogaradidiai e loamu tauna ena hereva bini.
REV.2.1.english: “\+w To|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Ephesus|strong="G2181"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.3.6.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai.
REV.3.6.english: \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*.

REV.18.5.motu: Badina be ena dika vada e senua ela bona guba ai,
REV.18.5.english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

REV.21.16.motu: Hanua na e hadaia kaha haniosi heḡereḡere; roha-maorona bona lababana vada heḡereḡere. Bena ena hahetoho ḡauna amo hanua e hahetohoa, maila daha-ta sinahu-ima roha-maorona bona lababana bona harana-latana vada heḡereḡere.
REV.21.16.english: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

REV.7.1.motu: Bena aneru hahani na itadia, tanobada daigunidia haniosi ai e gini, tanobada ena lai haniosi e lao ahu, lai ta basine toa tanobada ai eiava davara ai, eiava au ta basine toa henia.
REV.7.1.english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

REV.14.9.motu: Ma aneru ta, ihatoina, idia muridia amo e roho, e lolo, eto, Ta ese daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida baine toma henia diho, bona ia toana baguna ai eiava imana ai baine abia,
REV.14.9.english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

REV.12.11.motu: Idia ese Mamoe Natuna rarana dainai bona e gwaurai hedinarai herevadia daidiai vada e hadarerea; edia mauri asie lalokau henia, ela bona mase.
REV.12.11.english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

REV.21.17.motu: Maḡuna danu e hahetohoa, roha hari-ahui taurahani, taunimanima bona aneru edia hahetoho amo.
REV.21.17.english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

REV.6.9.motu: Ikouna toana iha-imana e hamotua, bena pata helaḡana henunai Dirava ena hereva dainai bona ena hereva igwauraina dainai e aladia mase taudia laumadia na itadia.
REV.6.9.english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

REV.5.2.motu: Bena aneru goadana ta na itaia, e hereva badabada, eto, Daika na heḡereḡere ina buka baine kehoa, bona ikouna toadia baine hamotu?
REV.5.2.english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

REV.7.16.motu: Idia na basie hitolo lou, basie ranu mase lou; dina eiava siahu ta ese basine raradia.
REV.7.16.english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

REV.8.2.motu: Bena Dirava vairanai e ginimu anerudia hahituosi na itadia, kibi auhitu vada e henidia.
REV.8.2.english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

REV.3.16.motu: Taunabunai, oi na maivalo dainai, dia siahu bona dia keru, lau na udugu amo baina lorimu lasi.
REV.3.16.english: \+w So|strong="G3779"\+w*, \+w because|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w lukewarm|strong="G5513"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w neither|strong="G3777"\+w* \+w hot|strong="G2200"\+w* \+w nor|strong="G3777"\+w* \+w cold|strong="G5593"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G3195"\+w* \+w vomit|strong="G1692"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w out|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w mouth|strong="G4750"\+w*.

REV.12.17.motu: Bena huala ese hahine e badu henia, ela, hahine natuna oredia eha tuari henidia, Dirava ena haheḡani herevadia bona Iesu ena hahediba herevadia e badinamu taudia bunu. Bena kone ai e gini.
REV.12.17.english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

REV.2.23.motu: Ia natuna danu baina aladia mase. Bena ekalesia oreadia iboudiai na bae diba, lau na taunimanima edia lalo-hadai hehunidia na tahumu; bona umui danu ta ta davamui baina henimui, ena kara ena kara heḡereḡeredia.
REV.2.23.english: \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1510"\+w* kill \+w her|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w children|strong="G5043"\+w* \+w with|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Death|strong="G2288"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1097"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w searches|strong="G2045"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w minds|strong="G2588"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w hearts|strong="G2588"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w each|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w one|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w according|strong="G2596"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w deeds|strong="G2041"\+w*.

REV.18.6.motu: Haida e henidia heḡereḡerena ba henia,
REV.18.6.english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

REV.18.20.motu: Guba e, ena va hu ba moalelaia;
REV.18.20.english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

REV.17.4.motu: Hahine na dabua kakakakadia bona mia-kakadia e hadokilai, gold bona nadi hururu-hururudia bona aḡeva mai hairaidia e heralai. Ia imana ai na gold keberena ta, ḡau dika-rohorohodia bona ena heudahanai amo e honu.
REV.17.4.english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

REV.4.7.motu: Mauri ḡauna gini-gunana na leona na heto; iharuana na boromakau natuna na heto; ihatoina vairana na taunimanima vairana na heto; ihahanina na ugava e rohomu na heto.
REV.4.7.english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

REV.10.11.motu: Bena e hamaorogu, ewto “Taunimanima idau-idau, bese idau-idau, gado idau-idau, pavapava idau-idau, hutuma ba haroro henidia”.
REV.10.11.english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

REV.2.3.motu: Dibagu oi na o haheaukamu, lau ladagu dainai o goadamu, lalomu na se hesikumu.
REV.2.3.english: \+w You|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w perseverance|strong="G5281"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w endured|strong="G5281"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1223"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w*’\+w s|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w sake|strong="G1223"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w grown|strong="G2872"\+w* \+w weary|strong="G2872"\+w*.

REV.12.6.motu: Bena hahine na tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao, Dirava ese e heḡaeḡaelaia gabuna ai e noho; unuseni ai dina daha-ta sinahu-rua tauratoi-ahui bae ubua.
REV.12.6.english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

REV.14.8.motu: Ma aneru ta, iharuana, ia murina amo e roho, eto, Babulono badana, hanua iboudiai na ena heuda-hanai baduna vine-ranuna e ha-inulaidia hanuana, vada e kohu, vada e kohu.
REV.14.8.english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

REV.15.2.motu: Bona davara ta na itaia, hevarivari na heto, to mai lahina. Bona da edaḡe ḡauna bona laulaunaa mai ladana mai numerana ida vada e hadareredia taudia danu na itadia, idia na una davara hevarivari na heto isena ai e gini, Dirava ena gitara imadia ai e abi.
REV.15.2.english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

REV.22.5.motu: Hanua na basine boi lou, bona lamepa bona dina diaridia na herevadia, badina be Lohiabada Dirava ese baine hadiaridia; bona bae lohia hanihanai.
REV.22.5.english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

REV.3.17.motu: Badina be oi na o tomamu “Lau na taḡa taugu, mai egu kohu momo; ḡau ta ai asina dabumu”. Madi, asi dibamu oi na dika rohoroho, ihareha, ogoḡami, mata-kepulu, asi ramimu.
REV.3.17.english: \+w Because|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w say|strong="G3004"\+w*, ‘\+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w rich|strong="G4145"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* gotten \+w riches|strong="G4147"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w need|strong="G5532"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w nothing|strong="G3762"\+w*,’ \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* don’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w wretched|strong="G5005"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3762"\+w*, \+w miserable|strong="G1652"\+w*, \+w poor|strong="G4434"\+w*, \+w blind|strong="G5185"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w naked|strong="G1131"\+w*;

REV.8.12.motu: Aneru ihahanina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena dina kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta e botaia, bena e dibura; bona hua kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta e botaia, bena e dibura; bona hisiu toi toi amo ta ta e botadia bena e dibura. Una dainai, dina kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta se diari, bona hanuaboi kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta se diari.
REV.8.12.english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

REV.8.8.motu: Aneru iharuana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena e kara ororo badana mai lahina ta davara ai e tahoa dobi na heto. Bena davara kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta rara ai ela,
REV.8.8.english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

REV.6.15.motu: Bena tanobada pavapavadia bona lohiadia, bona tuari biagudia, bona taḡa taudia, bona goada taudia, bona hesiai taudia, bona ura kwalimu taudia, iboudiai na kohua lalodiai bona ororo nadi-hagadia henudiai e komu;
REV.6.15.english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

REV.6.14.motu: Guba danu e puki, kopi mai revarevana e lokuamu na heto; ororo bona motumotu iboudiai danu gabudia amo e heraḡa oho.
REV.6.14.english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

REV.20.12.motu: Bena mase taudia kikina badana na itadia, terono vairanai gigini; bona buka vada e hekeho. Bena buka ta ma e kehoa, mauri bukana; bona mase taudia na e hahemaoro henidia, edia kara buka ai e tore heḡereḡeredia.
REV.20.12.english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

REV.14.14.motu: Bena na roha lao, ori kurokurona ta na itaia, bona ori latanai ta e helai, ita-itana taunimanima natuna ta na heto; kwarana ai na gold havava ḡauna, bona imana ai ilapa ta mai ganona.
REV.14.14.english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, + 14:14 Daniel 7:13 having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

REV.14.2.motu: Ma gado ta na kamonai, guba amo ema, sinavai momo reḡedia na heto bona guba e rahua dagumu na heto. Una gado danu e kara gitara taudia edia gitara e hataimu na heto;
REV.14.2.english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

REV.12.15.motu: Bena huala ese hahine murina amo ela, uduna amo ranu e loria lasi, sinavai na heto, aru ese baine arua isi eto.
REV.12.15.english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

REV.18.3.motu: Badina be bese iboudiai ese ena heuda-hanai baduna vine-ranuna vada e inua;
REV.18.3.english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

REV.16.10.motu: Aneru iha-imana ena kibo na daḡedaḡe ḡauna ena terono latanai e bubua; bena ena basileia e hadiburaia, bena taunimanima maladia e kori, hisihisi dainai.
REV.16.10.english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

REV.1.8.motu: Lohiabada Dirava na e tomu “Lau na Matamana bona Dokona”. Ia na e nohomu, e nohova bona do baine noho, Siahu-idoinai Diravana.
REV.1.8.english: “\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Alpha \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Omega|strong="G5598"\+w*, ” says the Lord God, “\+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w was|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2064"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Almighty|strong="G3841"\+w*.”

REV.9.19.motu: Badina be edia siahu na ududia ai bona iudia ai; iudia na gaigai na heheto, mai kwaradia, bena unu amo idia ese taunimanima e hahisidia.
REV.9.19.english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

REV.9.12.motu: Dika ta vada e ore; rua be do mimia.
REV.9.12.english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

REV.11.15.motu: Aneru ihahituna ese ena kibi e hiriria. Bena gado badadia guba ai e hereva, eto “Tanobada basileiadia na eda Lohiabada bona ena Keriso edia basileia ai vada ela. Ia na baine lohia hanaihanai”.
REV.11.15.english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

REV.9.5.motu: E haduadia danu, basie aladia mase, a hua ima bae hahisidia; una hisihisi na doadoa ena hekori hisina na heto.
REV.9.5.english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

REV.22.11.motu: Kara dika tauna do baine kara dika; lebulebu tauna do baine lebulebu; kara maoromaoro tauna do baine kara maoromaoro; helaḡa tauna do baine helaḡa.
REV.22.11.english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

REV.17.17.motu: Badina be Dirava ese e ha-uradia, ena lalo-hadai bae haḡuḡurua; bena lalodia bae tamona, edia basileia na mauri ḡauna bae henia ela bona Dirava ena hereva baine ḡuḡuru.
REV.17.17.english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

REV.20.10.motu: Bena Diabolo, e koidia tauna, na lahi bona teio gohuna lalonai e tahoa dobi, daḡedaḡe ḡauna bona peroveta koikoina e tahodia dobi guna gabuna: unuseni ai bae hisihisi boi bae hisihisi rani, ela bona hanaihanai.
REV.20.10.english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

REV.22.4.motu: bona vairana bae itaia; bona ladana na bagudia ai baine hetore.
REV.22.4.english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

REV.13.7.motu: Siahu danu e henia, helaḡa taudia baine tuari henidia, baine hadareredia, bona iduhu iboudiai boll; l taunimanima iboudiai bona gado iboudiai bon; l bese iboudiai baine lohiadia.
REV.13.7.english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

REV.13.8.motu: Bena Mamoe Natuna, e alaia mase gaun; l, ena mauri bukana ai ladadia na tanobada matamana amo asie tore taudia ibouhoudiai ese una ḡau bae toma henia diho.
REV.13.8.english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

REV.9.14.motu: Una gado ese aneru mai kibina ihatauratoina e hamaoroa, eto, Aneru hahaniosi, sinavai badana, ladana Eufrate, badibadinai vada e ḡuidia, ba ruhadia nege.
REV.9.14.english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

REV.3.15.motu: Emu kara na dibagu; oi na dia keru, dia siahu. Bona keru eiava boma siahu bema namo.
REV.3.15.english: “\+w I|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w your|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w neither|strong="G3777"\+w* \+w cold|strong="G5593"\+w* \+w nor|strong="G3777"\+w* \+w hot|strong="G2200"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w wish|strong="G3785"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w were|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w cold|strong="G5593"\+w* \+w or|strong="G2228"\+w* \+w hot|strong="G2200"\+w*.

REV.14.16.motu: Bena ori latanai e helai tauna ese ena ilapa e ḡaukaralaia, tanobada uitina e lapaia vaitani.
REV.14.16.english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

REV.11.16.motu: Bena heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi, Dirava vairanai terono ai e helaimu taudia, ese e goru diho, Dirava e toma henia diho, eto,
REV.11.16.english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

REV.18.15.motu: Unu ḡau e hoiva, edia taḡa e davariva, taudia na ena hisihisi garina bae gari, dauhai bae gini, bae tai dikadika, bae tai lulololo, baeto,
REV.18.15.english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

REV.15.4.motu: Lohiabada e, daika oi garimu basine gari?

REV.14.3.motu: idia na ane matamatana e abia, terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia vairadiai. Una ane na tau ta basine davaria diba, hari taunimanima domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani, tanobada amo e hoidia taudia, sibodia.
REV.14.3.english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

REV.18.9.motu: Bena hanua hanua pavapavadia, ia ida e heuda hanaiva bona e lebulebu hebouva taudia, ese ia idouna kwalahuna bae itaia negana ai na ia taina bae tai, bae tai lolololo.
REV.18.9.english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

REV.3.18.motu: Lau ese na haduamumu, egu ai gold ba hoia, lahi ese vada e haḡoevaia ḡauna; bena taḡa taumu ai baola. Dabua kurokurona danu ba hoia, ba dokilaia; bena hasio hemarai asi ramimu dainai. Mata muramurana danu ba hoia, matamu ba dahulai; bena ḡau ba ita.
REV.3.18.english: \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w counsel|strong="G4823"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* buy \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w gold|strong="G5553"\+w* \+w refined|strong="G4448"\+w* \+w by|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w fire|strong="G4442"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w become|strong="G4147"\+w* \+w rich|strong="G4147"\+w*; \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w white|strong="G3022"\+w* \+w garments|strong="G2440"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w clothe|strong="G4016"\+w* \+w yourself|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* shame \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w nakedness|strong="G1132"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3361"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w revealed|strong="G5319"\+w*; \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w eye|strong="G3788"\+w* \+w salve|strong="G2854"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w anoint|strong="G1472"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w eyes|strong="G3788"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* see.

REV.12.7.motu: Bena guba ai tuari e vara, Mikael mai ena aneru ida ese huala e tuari henia. Huala mai ena aneru ida e tuari,
REV.12.7.english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

REV.12.8.motu: to e darere, bena edia gabu asie davaria lou guba ai.
REV.12.8.english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

REV.6.1.motu: Bena Mamoe Natuna na itaia, ia ese ikouna toana ta e hamotua, bena mauri ḡauna ta erena na kamonai, e kara guba e rahua na heto, eto “Aoma”.
REV.6.1.english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

REV.7.4.motu: Bena toadia e kara taudia e hagaudia na kamonai: Israel besena edia iduhu iboudiai amo domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani toadia e kara:
REV.7.4.english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

REV.22.20.motu: Ini ḡau e gwaurai hedinaraimu Tauna e tomamu “Oibe, ba vasimu”. Amen: Lohiabada Iesu e, aoma.
REV.22.20.english: He who testifies these things says, “\+w Yes|strong="G3483"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w am|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w soon|strong="G5035"\+w*.”

REV.9.11.motu: Idia na mai edia pavapava, guri dobu-hereana aneruna bunai; ia ladana Heberu gadodia ai be Abadon, a Helene gadodia ai ladana na Apoluon.
REV.9.11.english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

REV.2.6.motu: A emu namo sina binai: Nikolaita taudia edia kara o inai henimu, lau ese danu na inai henimu heḡereḡerena.
REV.2.6.english: \+w But|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w hate|strong="G3404"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2041"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w Nicolaitans|strong="G3531"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w I|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w also|strong="G2504"\+w* \+w hate|strong="G3404"\+w*.

REV.2.21.motu: Lau na ena nega vada na henia, baine helalo; a ena lebulebu karadia irakatanidia se uramu.
REV.2.21.english: \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w gave|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w her|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w time|strong="G5550"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w*, \+w but|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w she|strong="G2532"\+w* refuses \+w to|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w her|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w sexual|strong="G4202"\+w* \+w immorality|strong="G4202"\+w*.

REV.2.25.motu: Ḡau tamona, vada o abia ḡauna ba kahua tao tarika-tarika ela bona lau baina vasi.
REV.2.25.english: \+w Nevertheless|strong="G4133"\+w*, \+w hold|strong="G2902"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* firmly until \+w I|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2240"\+w*.

REV.7.15.motu: Una dainai idia na Dirava ena terono vairanai gigini, bona ena Dubu Helaḡa lalonai ia isiaina e lao heni boimu e lao heni ranimu. Bona terono ai e helaimu Diravana ese edia taruha ai bainela.
REV.7.15.english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

REV.12.2.motu: E rogorogo, bena hekamonai hisina dainai e tai lolo.
REV.12.2.english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

REV.13.12.motu: Bena ia ese daḡedaḡe ḡauna gini-gunana ena siahu idoinai e ḡaukaralaia, ia vairanai, bona tanobada mai inoholaina taudia iboudiai e haduadia, daḡedaḡe ḡauna gini-gunana, hari ena mase berona e namo ḡauna, bae toma henia diho eto.
REV.13.12.english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

REV.14.11.motu: E animu hisidia kwalahuna e dae hanaihanaimu, bona dina hanuaboi laḡadia asie animu; daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida e toma henia dihomu bona ladana toana e abiamu taudia ahudia bunu.
REV.14.11.english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

REV.3.1.motu: Ekalesia oreana Sadi ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Dirava ena lauma hituosi bona hisiu hituosi e abimu tauna ena hereva bini. Emu kara na dibagu, e herevalaimumu o maurimu e tomamu, to vada o mase.
REV.3.1.english: “\+w And|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Sardis|strong="G4554"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.2.26.motu: Kwalimu tauna, egu kara baine badina ela bona dokona tauna, na siahu baina henia. Ia ese tanobada besedia baine lohiadia,
REV.2.26.english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w keeps|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w my|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w works|strong="G2041"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w end|strong="G5056"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w authority|strong="G1849"\+w* \+w over|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w nations|strong="G1484"\+w*.

REV.13.13.motu: Hoa karadia badadia danu e kara: ta be lahi guba amo e hadihoa taunimanima vairadiai.
REV.13.13.english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

REV.3.13.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai.
REV.3.13.english: \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*.

REV.6.6.motu: Bena ere ta mauri ḡaudia haniosi bogaragidia amo na kamonai, eto “Uit irau ta davana na silver monina ta, bona bali irau toi davadia na silver monina ta; bona nahuamu ba tohoa, dehoro bona vine ranuna ba hadika na garina”.
REV.6.6.english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

REV.14.19.motu: Bena hari aneru ese ena ilapa e ḡaukaralaia tanobada ai, tanobada ena vine huahuadia e utu oho; bona moimoi gabuna badana, Dirava ena badu bunai, lalonai e taho uda.
REV.14.19.english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

REV.9.17.motu: Bena egu mata-hanai ai unu hosi ini na itadia toma: e ḡui kau taudia na mai kemedia auridia, ita-itadia na lahi bona huakina bona teio na heheto; a hosi kwatadia na leona kwaradia na heheto, bona ududia amo lahi bona kwalahu bona teio e lasi.
REV.9.17.english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

REV.18.8.motu: Taunabunai ena hisihisi idau-idau dina tamona ai bae kau,
REV.18.8.english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

REV.1.19.motu: Benaini, ome ita ḡaudia ba tore: e miamu ḡaudia bona do bae vara ḡaudia bini.
REV.1.19.english: \+w Write|strong="G1125"\+w* \+w therefore|strong="G3767"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w seen|strong="G3708"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w will|strong="G3195"\+w* \+w happen|strong="G1096"\+w* \+w hereafter|strong="G3326"\+w*.

REV.14.10.motu: ia ese Dirava ena badu vine-ranuna, ena badu keherena lalonai vada e seia, ranu kavakava ida asie buloa ḡauna, baine inua; lahi bona teio amo bae hahisia danu, aneru helaḡadia bona Mamoe Natuna vairadiai.
REV.14.10.english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

REV.1.13.motu: lamepa bogaragidiai ta e gini, e kara taunimanima natuna na heto, ena dabua na lata, ela bona aena, kemena na gold torana e ḡeḡea.
REV.1.13.english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, + 1:13 Daniel 7:13 clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

REV.17.16.motu: Bona mauri ḡauna doana gwautaosi o ita ḡaudia ese ariara hahinena bae inai henia; bae havahuraia, kopi kavakava bainela, bena hidiona bae ania, lahi ai bae ḡolea oho.
REV.17.16.english: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

REV.18.12.motu: gold bona silver; nadi hururu-hururudia bona aḡeva mai hairaidia; dabua aukadia bona dahua mia-kakadia; silk dabuadia bona dahua kakakakadia; boto audia bona elefant doadia amo e kara ḡaudia; au namodia bona auri labora-labora amo e kara ḡaudia; aauri bona nadi amo e kara ḡaudia,
REV.18.12.english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

REV.13.3.motu: Bena kwarana ta na itaia, e kara vada e haberoa dikadika, mase berona na heto, to berona vada e namo.
REV.13.3.english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

REV.8.9.motu: bona davara gwarumedia toi toi amo ta ta e mase, bona lagatoi toi toi amo ta ta e mutu.
REV.8.9.english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

REV.22.17.motu: Lauma bona headava matamata hahinena e tomamu “Aoma”. E kamonaimu tauna danu baineto “Aoma”. Ranu mase tauna na bainema. Bona ranu e uramu tauna ese mauri ranuna baine inua, asi davana.
REV.22.17.english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

REV.13.10.motu: Daika baine heabi mauri, vada bae abia mauri, bona daika baine heala mase, vada bae alaia mase, dare amo. Helaḡa taudia na bae haheauka hona bae heabidadama.
REV.13.10.english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

REV.13.1.motu: Daḡedaḡe ḡauna ta na itaia, davara amo e dae, doana na gwauta, kwarana na hitu, doana doridia ai be havava ḡaudia gwauta, bona kwarana ta ta ai Dirava ihadikana herevadia e tore.
REV.13.1.english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

REV.5.12.motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Mamoe Natuna e alaia mase, ia hari namo; siahu bona taḡa bona aonega bona goada bona hemataurai bona hairai bona hahenamo baine abi”.
REV.5.12.english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

REV.16.2.motu: Aneru gini-gunana ela, ena kibo tanobada ai e bubua. Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna toana e abia bona laulauna e toma henia diho taudia ediai toto badadia mai hisidia eha dudu.
REV.16.2.english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

REV.20.7.motu: A unu laḡani daha ta bae ore; bena Satana na ena iḡui amo bae ruhaia nege.
REV.20.7.english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

REV.21.26.motu: Bese idau-idau ese hairaidia bona hematauraidia bae rakalai vareai.
REV.21.26.english: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

REV.9.16.motu: Tuari taudia mai hosidia ihagaudia na kamonai: idia na milion sinahu-rua.
REV.9.16.english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

REV.13.9.motu: Mai taiana tauna na baine kamonai.
REV.13.9.english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

REV.12.10.motu: Bena na kamonai, gado badana ta guba ai e hereva, eto, Harihari iseda Dirava ena hahemauri bona ena goada bona ena basileia, bona iena Keriso ena siahu, vada eme gini dae; badina be Dirava vairanai varavarada e habadelaidia boi e habadelaidia rani tauna na vada e tahoa dobi.
REV.12.10.english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

REV.14.13.motu: Bena gado ta na kamonai, guba amo ema, eto, Ini ba torea toma “Lohiabada enai e masemu taudia be nanamo”. Ma Lauma eto “Oibe, edia ḡaukara amo bae laḡa ani, badina be edia kara ese e ḡavadiamu”.
REV.14.13.english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’”

REV.2.18.motu: Ekalesia oreana Tuatira ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Dirava Natuna, matana na lahi hururu-hururuna na heto, aena na auri laboralabora e kimore-kimore na heto, ena hereva bini.

REV.9.8.english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

REV.7.5.english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed,

REV.17.12.motu: A doa gwauta o ita ḡaudia na pavapava gwauta, to edia basileia do asie abi. A hari mauri ḡauna ida pavapava siahuna do bae abia, hora tamona.
REV.17.12.english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

REV.2.7.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai. Kwalimu tauna na mauri auna, Dirava ena imea ai e varamu ḡauna huahuana baina henia, baine ania.

REV.21.24.motu: Bese idau-idau ese ena diari ai bae raka, bona hanua pavapavadia ese hairaidia bae rakalai vareai.
REV.21.24.english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

REV.11.1.motu: Bena siriho ta, itotohi na heto, e henigu, eto, A tore isi, Dirava ena Dubu Helaḡa bona pata helaḡana ba hahetoho, bona lalonai e toma dihomu taudia ba hagaudia.
REV.11.1.english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

REV.6.4.motu: Bena hosi kakakakana ta e lasi; e ḡui kau tauna na siahu e henia, maino tanobada amo baine abia oho, taunimanima bae heala-ala heheni helaoreana. Bena dare badana e henia.
REV.6.4.english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

REV.20.6.motu: Ina tore-isi-lou gini gunana lalonai ahuna e abiamu tauna be namo bona helaḡa; mase iharuana na asi siahuna una tau enai. Unuhetomadia na Dirava ena hahelaḡa taudia bona Keriso ena hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, bona ia ida bae ha lohia ela bona laḡani daha ta.
REV.20.6.english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

REV.14.18.motu: Ma aneru ta pata helaḡana amo e raka lasi; una aneru na mai siahuna lahi enai. Bena ia ese hari imana mai ilapana aneruna e lolo henia, eto, Emu ilapa aine ḡaukara; tanobada ena vine takodia ba utu, badina be vine huahuadia vada e maḡe.
REV.14.18.english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

REV.3.22.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai.
REV.3.22.english: \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*.”

REV.10.8.motu: Bena guba amo na kamonai gadona ma e hereva henigu, eto “Aola, davara ai bona tanobada ai e ginimu aneruna imana ai e miamu bukabukana bavabia”.
REV.10.8.english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

REV.21.2.motu: Bona hanua helaḡana, Ierusalem matamatana, na itaia, guba amo e diho, Dirava ena amo, be headavamu ulatona na heto, e haheraia adavana ena.
REV.21.2.english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

REV.4.11.english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

REV.5.4.motu: Bena na tai dikadika, badina be ta asi goadana buka bame kehoa bona lalona baine itaia.
REV.5.4.english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

REV.15.8.motu: Bena Dirava hairaina bona siahuna kwalahudia ese una dubu e hahonua; bona tau ta dubu lalonai basine raka vareai diba ela bona hahituosi ese edia hahehisi ḡaudia hituosi bae ore.
REV.15.8.english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

REV.14.7.motu: E hereva badabada, eto, Dirava garina ba gari, ia mo ba imodaia, badina be ena hahemaoro negana vada be gini daemu; guba bona tanobada bona davara bona ranu e lohilohimu gabudia e kara Diravana ba toma henia diho.
REV.14.7.english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

REV.15.5.motu: Bena na itaia, igwaurai-hedinaraina kalagana helaḡana e kehoa guba ai.
REV.15.5.english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

REV.1.16.motu: Imana idibana ai hisiu hitu e abi. Dare ta, kahana kahana mai ganodia ḡauna, uduna amo e lasi. Vairana na dina e tara na heto.
REV.1.16.english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

REV.1.17.motu: Ia na itaia, bena aena badinai na goru diho, e kara na mase na heto. A ia ese imana idibana taugu ai e dau kau, eto, Asio gari; lau na gini-gunana bona gini-gabena;
REV.1.17.english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man.

REV.22.19.motu: bona ta ese hereva ta ina peroveta bukana amo baine abia oho, Dirava ese ia ahuna mauri auna enai bona hanua helaḡana lalonai, ina buka ai haridia e tore ahudia, na iena amo baine abi oho.
REV.22.19.english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

REV.21.25.motu: Dina ai hanua ikoukouna basie kou; bona hanuaboi na lasi unuseni ai.
REV.21.25.english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

REV.13.16.motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai kikina badana, taḡa taudia bona ogoḡami taudia, ura kwalimu taudia bona e ḡuidia taudia, na toa ta e henidia, imadia idibadia ai eiava bagudia ai e kara.
REV.13.16.english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

REV.22.2.motu: hanua ariarana bogaragina amo e arua parara. Sinavai kahana kahana mauri auna e gini; huahuana na idau-idau, gwauta rua, hua ta ta mai huahuadia; bona au rauna ese bese idau-idau e hamauridiamu.
REV.22.2.english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

REV.22.1.motu: Bena aneru ese mauri ranuna sinavaina negari-negarina e haheitalaigu: ia na Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna edia terono amo e lasi,
REV.22.1.english: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

REV.22.21.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na helaḡa taumui iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
REV.22.21.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.

REV.11.13.motu: Una hora lalonai tano-laga badana ta e vara, bena hanua kahadia gwautosi amo kaha ta e kohu; bona tano-laga dainai taunimanima daha hitu e mase. Taunimanima oredia na e gari dikadika, Guba Diravana e heatolaia.
REV.11.13.english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

REV.2.13.motu: Emu noho gabuna na dibagu; Satana ena terono na eneseni ai. To oi ese lau ladagu o laloa taomu, bona o abidadama henigumu, egu hereva e gwaurai hedinaraiva mai momokanina tauna, Antipa, bogaragimui ai e alaia mase negana ai danu oi ese so ḡoregu; ena na Satana ena noho gabuna.

REV.17.13.english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

REV.11.5.motu: Ta ihadikadia urana bema ura, ududia amo lahi bema lasi, inaidia bunu bema aradia ore: taunabunai ta ihadikadia urana baine ura, ia na unu baine mase toma.
REV.11.5.english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

REV.6.16.motu: bena ororo bona hagahaga e noidia, eto, Ame karuhimai tao, terono ai e helaimu Diravana vairana amo bona Mamoe Natuna ena badu amo ba hunimai;
REV.6.16.english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

REV.21.12.motu: Ia na mai maḡuna: maḡuna danu lababana na bada bona harana na lata. Ikoukouna na gwauta-rua. Ikoukou badidiai na aneru gwauta-rarua, bona ikoukou daediai Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi ladadia e tore.
REV.21.12.english: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

REV.6.3.motu: Ikouna toana iharuana e hamotua, bena mauri ḡauna iharuana erena na kamonai, eto “Aoma”.
REV.6.3.english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

REV.7.8.english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand,

REV.13.17.motu: Taunabunai ta basine hoihoi diba, hari toa, daḡedaḡe ḡauna ladana eiava numerana, e abia tauna mo sibona.
REV.13.17.english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

REV.2.2.motu: Lau na emu ḡaukara, emu hekwarahi bona emu haheauka na dibagu. Kara dika taudia o dadaraidiamu. Sibodia aposetolo e hegwauraimu taudia, a dia aposetolo korikori, oi ese o dibadia, bena dibamu idia na koikoi taudia.
