REV.21.18.motu: Maḡu be iaspi nadina amo e larebaia, a hanua na gold herea-daena, to e negari-negari.
REV.21.18.english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

REV.6.2.motu: Bena hosi kurokurona ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna na mai ena peva. Kwarana ivavalaina ḡauna e henia, bena mai siahuna ida ela, baine kwalimu totona.
REV.6.2.english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

REV.4.4.motu: Terono ruahui-hani ese terono badana e laia heḡeḡe, bona heitatao taudia ruahuihani unu terono latadiai e helai; kwaradia na mai havava ḡaudia, gold ḡaudia.
REV.4.4.english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

REV.17.11.motu: A hari mauri ḡauna, e nohova a vada lasihia ḡauna, ia na ihataura-hanina; ḡau tamona hituosi ediai ia danu ta, bona ia danu mase gabuna bainela.
REV.17.11.english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

REV.19.18.motu: pavapava hidiodia, bona tuari biagudia hidiodia, bona goada taudia hidiodia, bona hosi hidiodia, bona hosi ai e guimu taudia hidiodia, bona taunimanima iboudiai, ura kwalimu taudia bona e ḡuidia taudia, kikina badana hidiodia, bavani.
REV.19.18.english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

REV.5.3.motu: A guba ai bona tanobada ai bona tanobada henunai ta asi goadana buka baine kehoa bona lalona baine itaia.
REV.5.3.english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

REV.16.7.motu: Bena ere ma ta pata helaḡana amo na kamonai, eto,
REV.16.7.english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

REV.7.13.motu: Bena heitatao tauna ta ese e nanadaigu, elo, Ini dabua kurokurodia e hadokilai taudia be daidia? Bona ede amo ema?
REV.7.13.english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

REV.8.10.motu: Aneru ihatoina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena hisiu badana ta guba amo e moru dobi, e hururu-hururu kede na heto, sinavai toi toi amo ta ta latadiai e moru, bona lohilohi ranudia toi toi amo ta ta latadiai e moru.
REV.8.10.english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

REV.17.8.motu: Hari mauri ḡauna o itaia be e nohova, to harihari ia na lasihia. A asi vanahana ia na guri dobu-masemasena amo do baine dae, mase gabuna bainela. Bena tanobada ai e nohomu a tanobada matamana ai ladadia na mauri bukana lalonai se tore taudia ese hari mauri ḡauna, e nohova, ma lasihia, ma bainema ḡauna, bae itaia. bona bae hoa.
REV.17.8.english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

REV.18.23.english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

REV.3.14.motu: Ekalesia oreana Laodikea ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Hereva momokani tauna, dibana tauna mai maoromaorona bona mai momokanina ida, Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia roboana, ena hereva bini.
REV.3.14.english: “\+w To|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Laodicea|strong="G2993"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.7.6.english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand,

REV.21.10.motu: Bena lauma ai e laohaigu, ororo badana ta dorina ai. Bena hanua helaḡana, Ierusalem, haheitalaigu, guba amo e diho, Dirava ena amo.
REV.21.10.english: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

REV.5.13.motu: Bena e kara ḡaudia iboudiai, guba ai bona tanobada ai bona tanobada henunai bona davara ai, bona lalodia ḡaudia iboudiai, eredia na kamonai, eto “Terono ai e helaimu Diravana bona Mamoe Natuna na hahenamo bona hemataurai bona hairai bona siahu bae abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai”.
REV.5.13.english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

REV.9.9.motu: kemedia na mai ḡaudia, auri na heto. Idia hanidiareḡedia na kariota reḡedia na heheto, hosi momo ese e verimu ḡaudia, tuari ai e heau vareaimu negadia ai.
REV.9.9.english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

REV.16.13.motu: Bena na ita, lauma dikadia tatoi, parapara na heheto, huala uduna amo bona daḡedaḡe ḡauna uduna amo bona peroveta koikoi tauna uduna amo e lasi.
REV.16.13.english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

REV.6.12.motu: Ikouna toana ihatauratoina e hamotua, bena na roha lao, tano e laḡa bada, dina danu e dibura, dabua koremana na heto, bona hua na rara na heto.
REV.6.12.english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

REV.16.14.motu: Idia na lauma dika-hereadia, hoa karadia e karamu, bona tanobada idoinai hanua hanua pavapavadia e lao henidiamu, eha gogodiamu, siahu idoinai Diravana ena dina badana tuarina dainai.
REV.16.14.english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

REV.17.5.motu: Ia baguna ai lada ta e torea, anina e hehuni ḡauna, ini e torea toma: “Babulono badana, ariara hahinedia bona tanobada ena kara mirodia idoidiai sinadia”.
REV.17.5.english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

REV.4.6.motu: Bona terono vairanai danu davara, hevarivari na heto, e mia. Bona terono lalonai bona heḡeḡenai mauri ḡaudia hani mimia, vairadia kahadia ai bona muridia kahadia ai matadia na momo.
REV.4.6.english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

REV.7.2.motu: Ma aneru ta na itaia, mairiveina kahana amo e dae kau, ikouna toana, Mauri Diravana ena, e abia kau. Bena hari mai siahudia tanobada bona davara bae hadika anerudia hahaniosi ia ese e lolo henidia,
REV.7.2.english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

REV.18.2.english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

REV.2.29.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai.
REV.2.29.english: \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*.

REV.13.5.motu: Udu ta danu una daḡedaḡe ḡauna e henia, bena ia ese Dirava ihadikana herevadia e gwaurai lalo-dika. Bolla siahu danu e henia, hua hari-ahui rua baine lohia.
REV.13.5.english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

REV.2.8.motu: Ekalesia oreana Semurana ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Ginigunana bona gini-gabena, e mase ma e mauri lou, tauna ena hereva bini.
REV.2.8.english: “\+w To|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Smyrna|strong="G4667"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.6.5.motu: Ikouna toana ihatoina e hamolua, bena mauri ḡauna ihatoina erena na kamonai, eto “Aoma”. Bena hosi korema-koremana ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna na metau ihahetohona ḡauna e abia kau imana ai.
REV.6.5.english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

REV.16.5.motu: Bena ranu ilohiadia aneruna erena na kamonai, eto,
REV.16.5.english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

REV.16.17.motu: Aneru ihahituna ena kibo na guba padanai e bubua; bena guba dubuna teronona amo ere badana ta e lasi, eto “Vada e ore”.
REV.16.17.english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

REV.3.10.motu: Egu haheauka herevana vada o badinaia dainai, tanobada idoinai baina dibaia bona tanobada taudia baina dibadia negana ai na oi baina hamaurimu.
REV.3.10.english: \+w Because|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w kept|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w my|strong="G5083"\+w* command \+w to|strong="G1909"\+w* endure, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w also|strong="G2504"\+w* \+w will|strong="G3195"\+w* \+w keep|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w hour|strong="G5610"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w testing|strong="G3985"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w whole|strong="G3650"\+w* \+w world|strong="G3625"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w test|strong="G3985"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w dwell|strong="G2730"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w earth|strong="G1093"\+w*.

REV.4.8.motu: ldia haniosi hanidia na tauratoi tauratoi amo. Murimuridia ai bona lalodia ai matadia na momo. Idia na dina hanuaboi laḡadia asie animu; e herevamu, e tomu,
REV.4.8.english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

REV.20.9.motu: Bena tanobada lababana e rakaia hanai, helaḡa taudia edia taruha bona Dirava ese e lalokau heniamu hanuana e daidia heḡeḡe; a lahi na guba amo e diho, e habuadia tari.
REV.20.9.english: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

REV.17.14.motu: Idia ese Mamoe Natuna bae tuari henia, to Mamoe Natuna na do baine kwalimu; badina be ia na lohia edia Lohia, bona pavapava edia Pavapava, bona e bamoamu taudia na ia ese e boiridia bona e abidia hidi, bona idia ese ia e abidadama heniamu.
REV.17.14.english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

REV.21.3.motu: Bena ere ta na kamonai, terono amo ema, e hereva badabada, eto, Dirava ena noho gabuna na taunimanima dekedekediai; ia na bogaragidiai baine noho. Idia na iena bese ai baela; ia ese baine hamodia, edia Dirava.
REV.21.3.english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

REV.16.16.motu: Bena lauma dikadia ese e gogodia gabu ta ai, ladana Heberu gadodiai ai be Aramagedono.
REV.16.16.english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

REV.3.7.motu: Ekalesia oreana Filadelfia ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Helaḡa bona hereva momokani tauna, David ena ki e abiamu tauna, e kehoamu bena ta basine koua, e kouamu bena ta basine kehoa, tauna ena hereva bini.
REV.3.7.english: “\+w To|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Philadelphia|strong="G5359"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.8.11.motu: Una hisiu ladana na “Idita”. Bena ranu gabudia toi toi amo ta ta e idita. Bena taunimanima hutuma e mase ranu daidiai, badina be vada e idita.
REV.8.11.english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

REV.21.22.motu: Hanua lalonai dubu ta asina itaia, badina be Lohiabada, siahu idoinai Diravana, bona Mamoe Natuna, na una hanua dubuna.
REV.21.22.english: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

REV.7.9.motu: Ini ḡau muridiai na roha lao, hutuma bada-herea na itadia, asi iduahidia, bese idau-idau bona iduhu idau-idau bona hanua idau-idau bona gado idau-idau amo, ibouboudiai na terono vairanai bona Mamoe Natuna vairanai e gini, edia dabua na kukuro-kukuro, bona imadia na mai retadia.
REV.7.9.english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

REV.21.21.motu: Ikoukou gwauta-ruaosi na ageva mai hairaidia gwauta-rua; ikoukou ta aḡeva mai hairaina ta. A hanua ariarana na gold, to e negari-negari.
REV.21.21.english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

REV.1.1.motu: Iesu Keriso ihahedinaraina herevana Dirava ese e henia, asi vanahana bae vara ḡaudia na ena hesiai taudia baine hamaorolaidia; bena ena aneru e siaia, ena hesiai tauna Ioane e haheitalaia.
REV.1.1.english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

REV.1.2.motu: Bena ia ese Dirava ena hereva bona Iesu Keriso ena hereva bona e ita ḡaudia iboudiai e gwaurai hedinarai.
REV.1.2.english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

REV.8.7.motu: Aneru gini-gunana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena medu-hetari bona lahi rara ida e hebulo na tanobada ai e diho. Bena tanobada inogodia toiosi ai inogo ta e ara ore, bona au toi toi amo ta ta e ara ore, bona rei idoinai e ara ore.
REV.8.7.english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

REV.2.12.motu: Ekalesia oreana Peregamo ai ena aneru ini ba tore henia toma: Dare kahana kahana mai ganodia e abia tauna ena hereva bini.
REV.2.12.english: “\+w To|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* angel \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w assembly|strong="G1577"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Pergamum|strong="G4010"\+w* \+w write|strong="G1125"\+w*:

REV.18.1.motu: Ini ḡau muridiai, aneru ma ta na itaia, guba amo e diho, mai siahu badana ida. Ia hairaina ese tanobada e hadiaria.
REV.18.1.english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

REV.21.27.motu: Hahedika ḡauna ta eiava lebulebu tauna eiava koikoi tauna unuseni ai basine raka vareai, a Mamoe Natuna ena mauri bukana ai ladadia e tore taudia mo.
REV.21.27.english: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

REV.9.4.motu: To e haganidia, tanobada reina bona tano ai e tubumu ḡaudia bona au basie hadika, a Dirava toana na bagudia ai asie abia taudia mo.
REV.9.4.english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

REV.13.15.motu: Bena ia na mai siahuna, una daḡedaḡe ḡauna Iaulauna baine hamauria, bena laulau na baine hereva. Mai siahuna danu una laulau ese basie toma henia diho taudia baine aladia mase.
REV.13.15.english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

REV.17.3.motu: Bena ia ese Lauma ai e laohaigu, tano ḡaḡaena ala; unuseni ai hahine ta na itaia, mauri ḡauna kakakakana ta latanai e helai kau. Una mauri ḡauna na Dirava ihadikana herevadia amo e honu; ia kwarana na hitu, bona doana na gwauta.
REV.17.3.english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

REV.12.16.motu: A tanobada ese hahine e durua, e kara uduna e haḡaia na heto, huala ese e loria lasi sinavaina ma e hadonoa.
REV.12.16.english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

REV.8.1.motu: Bena ikouna toana ihahituna e hamotua negana ai, asi reḡena ta guba ai, hora kahana sisivana.
REV.8.1.english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

REV.19.21.motu: A oredia na hosi ai e gui tauna uduna amo e lasi darena ese e aladia mase, bena manu iboudiai ese hidiodi e ani, bogadia e kunu.
REV.19.21.english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

REV.10.4.motu: E rahua vaitani, bena eredia baina tore nato, to gado ta guba amo na kamonai, eto, Guba hahitu e rahua eredia ba kou, basio tore.
REV.10.4.english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

REV.22.12.motu: Ba heita: lau na ba vasimu. Dava na imagu ai; taunimanima iboudiai edia kara heḡereḡeredia davadia baina henidia.
REV.22.12.english: “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w soon|strong="G5035"\+w*! \+w My|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w reward|strong="G3408"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* repay \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w each|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w man|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w according|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w work|strong="G2041"\+w*.

REV.21.13.motu: Laurabada kahana ai ikoukou toi, mirigini kahana ai toi, diho kahana ai toi, bona lahara kahana ai danu toi.
REV.21.13.english: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

REV.10.2.motu: Imana ai na buka maraḡina ta hekehona ai e abia. Aena idibana na davara ai e hadaia laurina be tanobada ai.
REV.10.2.english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

REV.21.23.motu: Dina bona hua danu na lasi, una hanua asie raraia; badina be Dirava hairaina ese e hadiaria, bona ena lamepa na Mamoe Natuna.
REV.21.23.english: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

REV.19.1.motu: Bena hutuma bada guba ai eredia na kamonai, eto,
REV.19.1.english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

REV.17.18.motu: Bona hari o itaia hahinena na hanua badana, hanua hanua pavapavadia e lohiadiamu hanuana.
REV.17.18.english: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

REV.6.17.motu: badina be edia badu dinana badana vada e gini dae. Daika baine gini diba?
REV.6.17.english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

REV.16.4.motu: Aneru ihatoina ena kibo na sinavai ai bona ranu lohilohi gabudia ai e bubua; bena rara ai ela.
REV.16.4.english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

REV.17.1.motu: Bena hari kiho auhituosl e abi kau anerudia ta dekegu ema, e hereva henigu, eto, Aoma, ariara hahinena badana, ranu momlo latadiai e helaimu hahinena, ihahemaoro-henina baina haheitalaimu.
REV.17.1.english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

REV.8.6.motu: Bena aneru hahituosi e heḡaegae, edia kibi bae hiriri.
REV.8.6.english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

REV.11.6.motu: Idia na mai siahudia guba bae koua, bena edia haroro dinadia lalodiai medu basine diho. Mai siahudia danu ranu na rara ai bae halaoa; bena bae ura negadia ai hisihisi idau-idau bae havara tanobada ai.
REV.11.6.english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

REV.18.10.motu: Ena hisihisi garina bae gari dainai, dauhai bae gini, baeto,
REV.18.10.english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

REV.19.20.motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna e abia mauri, bona peroveta koikoina, hoa karadia daḡedaḡe ḡauna vairanai e kara dainai daḡedaḡe ḡauna toana e abia bona laulauna e toma henia diho taudia e koidia tauna, danu e abia mauri. Idia raruosi na mauridia ai lahi gohuna, teio e aramu gabuna, lalonai e tahodia dobi.
REV.19.20.english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

REV.19.12.motu: Matana na e kara lahi hururu-hururuna na heto. Kwarana ai na havava ḡaudia momo, latadiai lada ta e torea; a e torea herevana ta asi dibana, ia mo sibona.
REV.19.12.english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

REV.8.5.motu: Bena aneru ese gold urona e abia, pata helaḡana lahina amo e hahonua; bena tanobada ai e tahoa kau. Bena ere bona guba-rahu bona kevaru bona tano-laga e vara.
REV.8.5.english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

REV.3.21.motu: Kwalimu tauna na baina abia dae, lau ida egu terono ai baia helai hebou; lau heḡereḡeregu, na kwalimu, bena Tamagu ida ena terono ai a helai hebou.
REV.3.21.english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sit|strong="G2523"\+w* \+w down|strong="G2523"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w throne|strong="G2362"\+w*, \+w as|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w also|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w overcame|strong="G3528"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sat|strong="G2523"\+w* \+w down|strong="G2523"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Father|strong="G3962"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w his|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w throne|strong="G2362"\+w*.

REV.11.19.motu: Bena Dirava ena Dubu Helaḡa guba ai na e kehoa, bona ena taravatu mauna Dubu Helaḡa lalonai na e hedinarai. Bena kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu bona tano-laga bona medu-hetari e vara badabada.
REV.11.19.english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

REV.19.16.motu: Ena dabua ai bona mamuna ai lada ta e torea: “Pavapava edia Pavapava; lohia edia Lohia”.
REV.19.16.english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

REV.1.6.motu: basileia ta ai e habouda bona Tamana Dirava ena hahelaḡa tauda ai e halaoda Tauna, enai hairai bona siahu bae mia ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
REV.1.6.english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests + 1:6 Exodus 19:6; Isaiah 61:6 to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

REV.3.19.motu: Na ura henidiamu taudia na sisiba henidiamu bona na dadabadiamu; taunabunai, lalomu ba hasiahua, ba helalo kerehai.
REV.3.19.english: \+w As|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w many|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w as|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w love|strong="G5368"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w reprove|strong="G1651"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w chasten|strong="G3811"\+w*. \+w Be|strong="G2532"\+w* zealous \+w therefore|strong="G3767"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w*.

REV.3.3.motu: O abi dae bona o kamonai ḡaudia na ba lalo tao bona ba badina; ba helalo kerehai danu. Bema basio gima, lau na henao tauna na heto baina vasi; egu vasi horana na basio diba.
REV.3.3.english: \+w Remember|strong="G3421"\+w* \+w therefore|strong="G3767"\+w* \+w how|strong="G4459"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w received|strong="G2983"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w heard|strong="G1097"\+w*. \+w Keep|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w it|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w repent|strong="G3340"\+w*. \+w If|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w therefore|strong="G3767"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* won’t \+w watch|strong="G1127"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2240"\+w* \+w as|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w a|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w thief|strong="G2812"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* won’t \+w know|strong="G1097"\+w* \+w what|strong="G4169"\+w* \+w hour|strong="G5610"\+w* \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2240"\+w* \+w upon|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*.

REV.16.11.motu: Bena Guba Diravana e uduguiraia, edia hisihisi bona edia toto daidiai; asie helalo kerehai, bona edia kara dika asie rakatani.
REV.16.11.english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

REV.8.4.motu: Bena muramura mai bonana kwalahuna, hela=a taudia edia ḡuriḡuri ida, aneru imana amo e dae, Dirava vairanai.
REV.8.4.english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

REV.18.14.motu: Laumamu ese e ura heni ḡaudioa ese vada e rakatanimu.
REV.18.14.english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

REV.19.3.english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

REV.16.12.motu: Aneru ihatauratoina ena kibo na sinavai badana, ladana Eufrate. lalonai e bubua, bena ranuna vada e kororo, mairiveina kahana hanuadia pavapavadia edia dala e lailaia.
REV.16.12.english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

REV.16.15.motu: (A itaia, henao tauna na heto ba vasimu. Hegima tauna, ena dahua e abi heḡaeḡaemu, asi ramina baine loa bena ena hemarai baine hedinarai na garina tauna, ia hari namo.)
REV.16.15.english: “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w like|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w a|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w thief|strong="G2812"\+w*. \+w Blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* watches, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w keeps|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w clothes|strong="G2440"\+w*, \+w so|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* doesn’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w walk|strong="G4043"\+w* \+w naked|strong="G1131"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w see|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* shame.”

REV.2.16.motu: A helalo kerehai. Bema lasi, baina vasi haraḡa, udugu darena amo baina tuari henidia.
REV.2.16.english: \+w Repent|strong="G3340"\+w* \+w therefore|strong="G3767"\+w*, \+w or|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w else|strong="G3361"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w quickly|strong="G5035"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w make|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w war|strong="G4170"\+w* \+w against|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w them|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w sword|strong="G4501"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w mouth|strong="G4750"\+w*.

REV.18.19.motu: Bena tano ḡahuna na kwaradia ai e taho kau, e tai, e tai lolololo, eto,
REV.18.19.english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

REV.22.14.motu: Edia dabua e huri taudia be nanamo, badina be idia ese mauri auna bae lao henia diba, bona iduara amo hanua lalonai bae raka vareai diba.
REV.22.14.english: \+w Blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w do|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G1519"\+w* commandments, \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w right|strong="G1849"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w tree|strong="G3586"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w life|strong="G2222"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w enter|strong="G1525"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w by|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w gates|strong="G4440"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w city|strong="G4172"\+w*.

REV.20.15.motu: Bena tau ta bema asi ladana mauri bukana, ia na lahi gohuna ai bema tahoa dobi.
REV.20.15.english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

REV.11.3.motu: A egu hereva igwauraina taudia raruosi na siahu baina henidia, puse dabuadia bae dokilai, bena dina; daha-ta sinahu-rua tauratoi-ahui bae haroro.
REV.11.3.english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

REV.12.13.motu: Bena huala ese e itaia, tanobada ai vada e tahoa dobi, bena ia ese mero e abia hahinena na e daḡedaḡe henia.
REV.12.13.english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

REV.19.4.motu: Bena heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi bona maurio ḡaudia haniosi e goru diho, terono ai e helaimu Diravana e toma henia diho, eto, “Amen! Aleluia!”
REV.19.4.english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

REV.4.9.motu: Bena hari mauri ḡaudia ese Mauri Hanaihanai Diravana terono ai e helaimu na e imodaiamu bona e heatolaiamu bona e hanamoamu negadia ai,
REV.4.9.english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

REV.16.1.motu: Bena ere badana ta Dubu Helaḡa lalona amo na kamonai, aneru hahituosi e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, Dirava ena badu ai e honumu kibodia auhituosi na tanobada ai ba bubu dobi.
REV.16.1.english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

REV.4.5.motu: Terono amo kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu e lasi; bona terono vairanai lamepa auhitu e ara mai hururu-hururudia, Dirava ena lauma hahituosi bunu.
REV.4.5.english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

REV.5.5.motu: Bena heitatao tauna ta ese e hereva henigu, eto, Asiotai; Iuda iduhuna ena leona, David ramuna, vada e kwalimu; ia ese buka baine kehoa bona ikouna toadia hituosi baine hamotu.
REV.5.5.english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

REV.8.13.motu: Bena ugava ta na itaia, guba padana ai e roho, bona erena na kamonai. E lolo badabada, eto, Tanobada taudia iboudiai madi O, madi O, madi O, aneru tatoiosi edia kibi, do asie hiriri ḡaudia, reḡedia daidiai.
REV.8.13.english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

REV.14.4.motu: Idia be hahine ida asie eno bou taudia; vada e helaga. Idia ese Mamoe Natuna murinai e rakamu, ena loa iboudiai. Taunimanima padadia amo e hoidia, Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna anina roboana ai baela, taudia bunu.
REV.14.4.english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

REV.12.14.motu: A ugava badana hanina ruaosi hari hahine e henia, bena ia ese huala e rohotania, tano ḡaḡaena e roho lao, ena gabu korikori ela, laḡani ta bona laḡani rua bona laḡani kahana e ubua gabuna.
REV.12.14.english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

REV.19.7.motu: Aita moale, aita hisi dae, ia mo aita heatolaia.
REV.19.7.english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

REV.16.18.motu: Bena kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu e vara; bona tano e laḡa bada, taunimanima tanobada ai e noho matama negana ai ema bona harihari tano na unu se laḡa toma.
REV.16.18.english: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

REV.2.11.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai. Kwalimu tauna na mase iharuana ese basine hadikaia.
REV.2.11.english: \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*. \+w He|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w* won’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w be|strong="G3756"\+w* harmed \+w by|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w second|strong="G1208"\+w* \+w death|strong="G2288"\+w*.

REV.4.2.motu: Lauma ese e rohegu, bena guba ai terono ta na itaia, bona ta latanai e helai kau.
REV.4.2.english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

REV.5.1.motu: Bena na itaia, terono ai e helai Tauna imana idibana ai be buka ta, lalonai bona murimuri kahana ai danu revareva e hetore; buka na e hekou kunuka-kunuka, ikouna toadia na hitu.
REV.5.1.english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

REV.9.13.motu: Aneru ihatauratoina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena gado ta na kamonai, Dirava vairanai e mia patana helagana, gold ḡauna, doana haniosi edia amo.
REV.9.13.english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

REV.19.2.motu: Badina be ena hahemaaoro na momomo-kakani bona mamaoro-mamaoro.
REV.19.2.english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

REV.14.17.motu: Bena aneru ma ta guba dubuna amo e raka lasi, ia danu imana ai na ilapa ta mai ganona.
REV.14.17.english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

REV.16.8.motu: Aneru ihahanina ena kibo na dina latanai e bubua; bena e hasiahua taunimanima baine aradia, lahi na heto.
REV.16.8.english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

REV.16.19.motu: Bena hanua badana e parara, karoa toi, bona bese idau-idau edia hanua loḡora e heḡiḡi dobi; bona Dirava ese Babulono badana e laloa, ena badu ḡaraḡarana keherenae henia, ena badu vine-ranuna baine inua ore.
REV.16.19.english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

REV.13.4.motu: Bena tanobada taudia ese huala e toma henia diho, badina be ia siahuna na hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna vada e henia; bona idia ese una daḡedaḡe ḡauna danu e toma henia diho, eto, Daika be ina ḡau idaina? Daika mai goadana baine tuari henia?
REV.13.4.english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

REV.22.3.motu: Heuduguirai basine mia; a Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna edia terono na unuseni ai. Ena hesiai taudia danu bae toma henia diho;
REV.22.3.english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

REV.9.1.motu: Aneru iha-imana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena hisiu ta na itaia, guba amo e moru tanobada ai; bena e dobu masemase gurina kina e henia.
REV.9.1.english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

REV.21.1.motu: Bena guba matamatana bona tanobada matamatana na ita; badina be guba gunana bona tanobada gunana vada e puki, davara danu lasihia.
REV.21.1.english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

REV.10.7.motu: aneru ihahituna ese ena kibi baine hiriria matama negana ai Dirava ena hereva hehunina baine momokani, peroveta taudia, iena hesiai taudia, e hamaorolaidia heḡereḡerena.
REV.10.7.english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

REV.2.17.motu: Mai taiana tauna ese Lauma ena hereva ekalesia oreadia ediai baine kamonai. Kwalimu tauna na mana, e hunia ḡauna, baina henia, baine ania; bona nadi kurokurona ta baina henia, una nadi ai lada matamatana ta e hetore, ta asi dibana herevana, iabina tauna sibona mai dibana.
REV.2.17.english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w ear|strong="G3775"\+w*, \+w let|strong="G2983"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hear|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w says|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*. \+w To|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w I|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w will|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w of|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w hidden|strong="G2928"\+w* \+w manna|strong="G3131"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w will|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w white|strong="G3022"\+w* \+w stone|strong="G5586"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w stone|strong="G5586"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w new|strong="G2537"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w written|strong="G1125"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3762"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3762"\+w* \+w knows|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w but|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w receives|strong="G2983"\+w* \+w it|strong="G2532"\+w*.

REV.17.6.motu: Hahine na na itaia, helaḡa taudia bona Iesu dainai e aladia mase taudia raradia e inu kekero. Na itaia negana ai na hoa dikadika.
REV.17.6.english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

REV.14.15.motu: Bena aneru ta Dubu Helaḡa amo e raka lasi, ori latanai e helai tauna e lolo henia, eto, Emu ilapa aine ḡaukara; a lapalapa; badina be uit iutuna negana vada eme kau, tanobada uitina vada e lo vaitani.
REV.14.15.english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

REV.17.2.motu: Hanua hanua pavapavadia na ia ida vada e heuda hanai, bona tanobada ai e nohomu taudia ese ena heuda-hanai vine-ranuna vada e inua kekero.
REV.17.2.english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

REV.18.22.motu: Gitara e hataimu bona ane e lada isimu taudia,
REV.18.22.english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

REV.11.10.motu: Bona tanobada taudia na edia mase dainai bae moale, bae his dae, bona harihari ḡaudia bae hegidu heheni; badina be unu peroveta taudioa raruosi ese tanobada taudia e hahisidiava.
REV.11.10.english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

REV.3.4.motu: A eneseni ai, Sadi ai, ta ta ese edia dabua asie hamiro; idia na dabua kurokurodia bae hadokilai, lau ida baia raka hebou, badina be idia na nanamo.

REV.5.14.english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

REV.22.10.motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Ina buka ena peroveta herevadia na basio kou ahu, badina be negana vada eme kahikahi.
REV.22.10.english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

REV.10.1.motu: Bena aneru goadana ta na itaia, guha amo e diho, ena hahedoki na ori, kwarana daenai na kevau; vairana na e kara dina na heto, bona aena na lahi hururu-hururudia na heheto.
REV.10.1.english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

REV.15.3.motu: Bena Dirava ena hesiai tauna, Mose, ena ane e abia, bona Mamoe Natuna ena ane danu. Eto,
REV.15.3.english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying,

REV.9.15.motu: Bena unu aneru hahaniosi e ruhadia: anerudia bunu vada e abidia heḡaeḡae, una hora, una dina, una hua, una laḡani, edia; taunimanima tatoi tatoi amo ta ta bae aladia mase.
REV.9.15.english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

REV.2.19.motu: Emu kara, emu lalokau emu abidadama, emu heduru bona emu haheauka na dibagu. Emu kara gabedia ese danu emu kara gunadia e hereamu.

REV.19.19.motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna bona hanua hanua pavapavadia mai edia tuari oreadia ida na itadia, e hegogo, hari hosi ai e gui tauna mai ena orea ida bae tuari henidia totona.
REV.19.19.english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

REV.21.9.motu: Bena aneru hituosi, hari kibo hituosi lalodiai hahehisi gabedia hituosi e abi anerudia, ta ema, e hereva henigu, eto, Aoma, headava matamata hahinena, Mamoe Natuna adavana, baina haheitalaimu.
REV.21.9.english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

REV.7.10.motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Hahemauri na iseda Dirava, terono ai e helaimu Diravana, bona Mamoe Natuna, ediai”.
REV.7.10.english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

REV.10.10.motu: Bena hari buka maraḡina na aneru imana amo na abia, na ania ore; bena udugu ai e gaiho, bada ranuna na heto, to na ania ore murinai bogagu na e idita.
REV.10.10.english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

REV.20.4.motu: Bena terono haida na ita, bona e helai kau taudia danu na itadia; hahemaoro siahuna na idia imadia ai vada e atoa. Bena Iesu ena hereva bona Dirava ena hereva e gwaurai hedinarai dainai kwaradia e utu oho taudia, bona daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida asie toma henidia diho bona toana bagudia ai eiava imadia ai asie abia taudia, laumadia na itadia. Idia na e mauri lou, Keriso ida eha lohia ela bona laḡani daha ta.
REV.20.4.english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

REV.22.8.motu: Lau Ioane ini ḡau na ita bona na kamonai. Na ita bona na kamonai vaitani, bena ini ḡau e haheitalaigu aneruna aena badinai na goru diho, baina toma henia diho nato.
REV.22.8.english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

REV.2.14.motu: A ḡau ta ta na lodulai henimumu. Badina be bogara-gimui ai haida ese Balaam ena hahediba herevadia e badinamu; una tau ese Balak e hadibaia, bena hekwakwanai ḡauna ta Israel taudia edia dala ai e atoa, bena idia ese kaivakuku iboulaidia vamudia e aniva, bona e heuda hanaiva.
REV.2.14.english: \+w But|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w I|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w few|strong="G3641"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w against|strong="G2596"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w because|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w there|strong="G1563"\+w* \+w some|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w hold|strong="G2902"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w teaching|strong="G1321"\+w* \+w of|strong="G5207"\+w* Balaam, \+w who|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w taught|strong="G1321"\+w* Balak \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* throw \+w a|strong="G2192"\+w* \+w stumbling|strong="G4625"\+w* \+w block|strong="G4625"\+w* \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w children|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w of|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w Israel|strong="G2474"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w eat|strong="G2068"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w sacrificed|strong="G1494"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w idols|strong="G1494"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w commit|strong="G4203"\+w* sexual \+w immorality|strong="G4203"\+w*.

REV.5.6.motu: Bena terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi padadia ai, heitatao taudia bogaragidiai, Mamoe Natuna ginina ai na itaia, e kara vada e alaia mase na heto. Doana na hitu, matana danu hilu, Dirava ena lauma hituosi, tanobada heḡeḡe-madai e siaidia lao ḡaudia, bunu.
REV.5.6.english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

REV.13.6.motu: Bena ia uduna e haḡaia, Dirava e ere dika henia, bona Dirava ladana bona ena dubu bona guba ai e nohomu taudia na e hadikadia ena hereva ai.
REV.13.6.english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

REV.11.11.motu: A dina toi mai dina kahana e ore, bena mauri laḡana Dirava ena amo na raruosi lalodiai e vareai, bena e gini tore. Bena gari bada ese e itadia taudia e butudia tao.
REV.11.11.english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

REV.19.5.english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

REV.11.9.motu: Bena dina toi mai dina kahana taunimanima idau-idau, iduhu idau-idau, gado idau-idau, bese idau-idau, taudia ese tau-anidia masedia bae itadia, a iguridia bae lao ahu.
REV.11.9.english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

REV.16.6.motu: Badina be helaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia raradia e bubu.
REV.16.6.english: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

REV.16.21.motu: Medu-hetari badadia, edia metau na pound sinahu ta mai dikooana, na guba amo e moru taunimanima latadiai. Bena taunimanima ese Dirava e uduguiraia, medu-hetari dainai, badina be ena hahehisi na bada herea.
REV.16.21.english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

REV.19.17.motu: Bena aneru ta na itaia, dina ai e gini, e lolo badabada, guba padanai e rohomu manudia e boi henidia, eto, Aoma, Dirava ena anibou badana ai ame hegogo,
REV.19.17.english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

REV.21.8.motu: A gari taudia, asie kamonai taudia, kara bodaḡa taudia, ala-ala taudia, babalau taudia, kaivakuku e toma henidia diho taudia, koikoi taudia, iboudiai ahudia na lahi bona teio gohuna: mase iharuana bunai.

REV.10.3.motu: E lolo badabada, leona e ḡoumu na heto; bena guba e rahua hahitu
REV.10.3.english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

REV.18.16.motu: Madi o, madi o, hanua badana!
REV.18.16.english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

REV.1.7.motu: A itaia, ia na ori amo be maimu; mataa iboudiai ese bae itaia; e gwadaia taudia danu bae itaia; tanobada besedia iboudiai ese ia dainai bae tai. Momokani. Amen.
REV.1.7.english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

REV.1.10.motu: Bena Lohiabada ena dina ai Lauma ese e rohegu, bena murigu ai gado badana ta, kibi reḡena na heto, na kamonai;
REV.1.10.english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

REV.2.5.motu: Vada o morutania gabuna ba laloa; ba helalo kerehai; emu kara gunadia ma ba kara. Bema lasi, lau na baina vasi, emu lamepa na gabuna amo baina abia oho, oi basio helalo kerehai negana ai.

REV.20.11.motu: Bena terono kurokurona badana ta na itaia, bona e helai kau Diravana danu. Bena tanobada bona guba na ia vairana amo e heau puki, to edia gabu ta asie davaria.
REV.20.11.english: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

REV.11.14.motu: Dika iharuana vada e ore; to ba itaia, ihatoina danu ma vada ba maimu.
REV.11.14.english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

REV.21.4.motu: Ia ese iruru-matadia iboudiai matadia amo baine dahu oho. Mase bona dara-doko bona taitai bona hisihisi bae ore; badina be ḡau gunadia vada e puki.
REV.21.4.english: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

ROM.6.4.motu: Taunabunai, bapatiso ai ita na ia ida ta mase bona ia ida e gurida; bena Keriso na mase amo Tamana hairaina ai e tore isi lou heḡereḡerena ita danu mauri matamatana lalonai baita raka.
ROM.6.4.english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

ROM.9.33.motu: buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, A itaia: Siona lalonai hetutuhi bona hekwakwanai nadina na atoamu. Mai ena abidadama tauna na basine hekwakwanlai.

ROM.8.22.motu: Taunabunai, e kara ḡaudia iboudiai na e ḡanaḡana boumu, e hisihisi boumu, hekamonai hisina na heto, ema bona harihari;
ROM.8.22.english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

ROM.8.14.motu: Badina be Dirava ena Lauma ese e hakaudiamu taudia iboudiai na Dirava natuna.
ROM.8.14.english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

ROM.1.23.motu: noho hanaihanai Diravana hairaina e rakataniava, taunimanima laulaudia, bona manu, boroma, bona e raumu ḡaudia laulaudia, e toma henidia dihova.
ROM.1.23.english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

ROM.14.3.motu: E animu tauna ese se animu tauna basine dadaraia; bona se animu tauna ese e animu tauna basine hahemaoro henia: badina be Dirava ese vada e abia dae.
ROM.14.3.english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

ROM.6.20.motu: Kara dika isiaina o lao heniva negana ai, umui na kara maoromaoro enai o heruha negeva.
ROM.6.20.english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

ROM.6.1.motu: O edeheto: kara dikadia ma baita kara loulou, harihari-bada ihabadana helaoreana a?
ROM.6.1.english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

ROM.11.17.motu: A rigi haida bema dabai kwaidu, bena oi, vara-kava olivena, gabudia ai bema hirimu kau, olive ramuna bona todena amo goada boma abia.
ROM.11.17.english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

ROM.2.1.motu: Benaini, oi haida o hahemaoro henidiamu taumu, oi na asi emu hahekora herevadia; emu hahemaoro na sibomu o hahedikalaimu, badina be oi hahemaoro taumu na unu o kara tomamu.
ROM.2.1.english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

ROM.7.2.motu: Taravatu dainai hahine ta adavana enai baine tao ena mauri dinadia idoidiai; a adavana baine mase, ia na asi taravatuna.
ROM.7.2.english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

ROM.3.7.motu: Badina be lauegu koikoi ese Dirava ena momokani bona ena hairai bema habada, dahaka dainai egu kara dika davana bema henigu?
ROM.3.7.english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

ROM.9.5.motu: Tubu tama danu idia mo edia. Idia bogaragidiai Keriso na tau-anina ai e vara: ia mo sibona herea dae, Dirava ese vada e hanamoa hanaihanai. Amen.
ROM.9.5.english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

ROM.1.8.motu: Egu hereva gini-gunana binai: egu Dirava na hanamoamu Iesu Keriso ladana ai, umui iboumui ai daimui ai; badina be emui abidadama harina e piuamu ina tanobada heḡege-madai lalonai.
ROM.1.8.english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

ROM.2.15.motu: Idia ese lalodia ai e torea tal-avatuna karadia e hahedinaraimu, bena lalodia ese taravatu e hamomokanimu; bona lalodia ese e hahemaoro henidiamu, bena e habadelaidiamu, eiava maorodia e gwauraimu.
ROM.2.15.english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

ROM.4.2.motu: Abraham na ena kara daidiai maorona bema gwauraia, ia na mai badina bema heaḡi; to dia Dirava vairanai basinema heaḡi.
ROM.4.2.english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

ROM.4.17.motu: buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Bese loḡora tamadia ai baina halaomu.
ROM.4.17.english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” + 4:17 Genesis 17:5 This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

ROM.3.5.motu: A iseda kara dika ese Dirava ena kara maoromaoro baine hahedinaraia negana ai, ede baita gwau toma? Dirava ese baine badu henida, ia na baine kerere a? Lau ese taunimanima edia hereva kava mo na gwauraiamu.
ROM.3.5.english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

ROM.13.1.motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ese lohia bae matauraidia. Badina be siahu idoinai na Dirava ena amo e maimu; bona lohia iboudiai Dirava ese vada e haginidia.
ROM.13.1.english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

ROM.5.3.motu: Dia una mo: a dikadika negadia ai ta moalemu; badina be dibada hisihisi ese haheauka e havaraiamu,
ROM.5.3.english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

ROM.1.26.motu: Una dainai Dirava ese vada e kahudia nege, heḡahusi bodagadia bae badina; edia hahine ese hahine karana korikorina vada e ha-idaua, sibodia e heḡahusi hehenimu;
ROM.1.26.english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

ROM.8.18.motu: Lau na tomamu ina nega hisihisina na ḡau pipikina, gabeamo isedai baine hedinarai hairaina baine bada herea.
ROM.8.18.english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

ROM.9.32.motu: Dahaka dainai? Badina be asi edia abidadama; taravatu karana mo e karaia. Idia na hekwakwanai nadina ai e hekwakwanai;
ROM.9.32.english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

ROM.3.12.motu: Iboudiai vada e raka oho, vada e dika bou;

ROM.4.21.motu: badina be dibana ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania.
ROM.4.21.english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

ROM.8.12.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, asi eda ima-doa tau-anina enai, bona tau-anina ena ura basita kara.
ROM.8.12.english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

ROM.7.4.motu: Unuhetomana, varavaragu e, umui danu Keriso tau-anina bagunai taravatu enai vada o mase; bena mase amo e tore isi tauna ese baine abimui, huahuada Dirava enai bae dobi helaoreana.
ROM.7.4.english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

ROM.16.21.motu: Timoteo, lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu tauna, bona varavaragu Luka bona Iason bona Sosipatro, hahaniosi ese e hanamomuimu.
ROM.16.21.english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

ROM.2.13.motu: Dirava vairanai bae maoromaoro taudia na dia taravatu e kamonaimu taudia, to taravatu e badinamu taudia hari.
ROM.2.13.english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

ROM.9.11.motu: hekapa memerodia e abi. Do asie vara negana ai, kara namo bona kara dika asie kara negana ai, Dirava ena ura e gini; dia kara ikarana dainai, a e boiboi Diravana ena heabi-hidi dainai.
ROM.9.11.english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

ROM.8.30.motu: E gvauraidia hidi taudia ia ese e boiridia; e boiridia taudia ia ese maorodia e gwaurai; maorodia e gwaurai taudia ia ese e hanamodia.
ROM.8.30.english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

ROM.10.2.motu: Lau dibagu idia ese Dirava e ura heniamu; ḡau tamona, lalodia asie pararamu.
ROM.10.2.english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

ROM.16.27.motu: Aonega Diravana tamona aita imodaia, Iesu Keriso bagunai; ia hairaina baine mia hanaihanai. Amen.

ROM.12.13.motu: Helaḡa taudia edia dabu ai ba kahadia. Heabi-dae karadia ba kara.
ROM.12.13.english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

ROM.11.18.motu: Matona, rigi korikori bogaragidiai basio heaḡi. Ba laloa, dia oi daimu ai ramu se maurimu, a ramu dainai oi o maurimu.
ROM.11.18.english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

ROM.7.12.motu: Taunabunai, taravatu na helaḡa, haheḡani danu helaḡa bona maoromaoro bona namo.
ROM.7.12.english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

ROM.1.11.motu: Badina be na ura lalo-dikamu baina itamui, bona Lauma ena harihari ḡauna baina henimui, bena ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
ROM.1.11.english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

ROM.6.22.motu: A harihari, kara dika amo vada o heruha nege, Dirava ena hesiai ai vada ola, anina emui ai be vada o helaḡa, bona dokona be mauri hanaihanai.
ROM.6.22.english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

ROM.3.3.motu: Haida be asie kamonai readia. Matona, edia kamonai na lasi dainai Dirava ena momokani danu lasi a?
ROM.3.3.english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

ROM.7.21.motu: Taunabunai, taravatu ta vada na lalo davari: kara namo baina karaia na tomu, to dika na egu ai e miamu.
ROM.7.21.english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

ROM.2.8.motu: a e heiri-heirimu bona hereva momokani e dadaraiamu bona kara gageva-gageva e badinamu taudia na badu bona hisihisi bae abi.
ROM.2.8.english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

ROM.4.8.motu: Lohiabada ese dikana se gwauraiamu tauna hari namo.
ROM.4.8.english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.” + 4:8 Psalms 32:1-2

ROM.14.4.motu: Oi be daika, tau ta ena hesiai tauna o hahemaoro heniamu? Biaguna vairanai baine gini, eiava baine keto. Ia na baine gini, badina be Lohiabada na mai siahuna baine haginia.
ROM.14.4.english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

ROM.9.31.motu: A Israel taudia na kara maoromaoro taravatuna e tahua, to asie davaria.
ROM.9.31.english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

ROM.9.2.motu: egu lalo-hisihisi na bada herea, daragu danu e dokomu dina iboudiai;
ROM.9.2.english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

ROM.7.9.motu: Gunaguna lau na taravatu murimurinai na mauriva; a haheḡani egu ai e kau, bena kara dika e vara lou, a lau na na mase.
ROM.7.9.english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

ROM.5.7.motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna dainai daika baine mase? Readia ta ta mo unu bae kara toma.
ROM.5.7.english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

ROM.16.19.motu: A umui emui haheauka harina na taunimanima iboudiai ese vada e kamonai; taunabunai, lau na umui daimui ai na moalemu. To lau na uramu umui na ḡau namodia ai ba aunega, ḡau dikadia ai ba kavakava.
ROM.16.19.english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

ROM.8.27.motu: Bona taunimanima lalodia e tahudiamu Diravana na Lauma ena ura dibana, badina be Lauma ese helaḡa taudia daidiai e noinoimu, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena.
ROM.8.27.english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

ROM.2.23.motu: Taravatu o heagilaiamu, a ḡau be taravatu itata-utuna ai Dirava o hadikaiamu a?
ROM.2.23.english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

ROM.9.21.motu: Uro ikarana tauna asi siahuna a, raro taba tamona ai uro namona bona uro dikana baine kara?
ROM.9.21.english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

ROM.10.4.motu: Badina be taravatu ihaḡuḡuruna be Keriso: bae abidadama henia taudia iboudiai maorodia bae gwaurai, ia bagunai.
ROM.10.4.english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

ROM.6.19.motu: Taunimanima edia hereva kava heḡereḡeredia ai na gwauraimu, tau-animui edia manokamanoka dainai. Badina be gunaguna taumui reḡedia ese kara dika bona lebulebu isiaidia e lao heniva heḡereḡerena, harihari taumui reḡedia ba heni, kara maoromaoro isiaina ilao-henina ai bae helaḡa.
ROM.6.19.english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

ROM.15.3.motu: Badina be Keriso danu sibona se hahemoale; Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Gwaugwau herevadia oi e gwau henilaimu na lau latagu ai vada eme kau.
ROM.15.3.english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” + 15:3 Psalms 69:9

ROM.15.18.motu: Keriso ena ḡaukara idaudia haida basina herevalai; a lau daigu ai bese idau-idau taudia vada e kamonai, bona edia kamonai amo hereva bona kara vada e vara, una mo na herevalaiamu.
ROM.15.18.english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

ROM.16.13.motu: Rufo, Lohiabada ese e abia hidi tauna, ba hanamoa; ia sinana danu, natuna ai e halaogu hahinena, ba hanamoa.
ROM.16.13.english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

ROM.11.19.motu: Readia baoto “Rigi e dabai kwaidu lau bae hirigu kau helaoreana”.
ROM.11.19.english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

ROM.1.10.motu: bona egu ḡuriḡuri ai na noinoi louloumu, Dirava baine ura nega ta baina vasi itamui.
ROM.1.10.english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

ROM.5.4.motu: bona haheauka ese manada e havaraiamu, bona manada ese helaro e havaraiamu.
ROM.5.4.english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

ROM.10.12.motu: Iuda tauna na dia idau; Helene tauna na dia idau. Badina be iboudiai edia Lohiabada na tamona; bona e hahaneamu taudia iboudiai e harihari henidiamu;
ROM.10.12.english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

ROM.11.26.motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai do bae mauri; buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto,
ROM.11.26.english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written,

ROM.14.10.motu: A oi, dahaka dainai varavaramu o hahemaoro heniamu? Dahaka dainai o dadaraiamu? Badina be ita iboudai Dirava ena hahemaoro gabuna vairanai baita gini.
ROM.14.10.english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

ROM.15.19.motu: Toa bona hoa karadia danu vada eme hedinarai, Dirava ena Lauma ena siahu dainai; taunabunai Ierusalem amo ela bona Iluriko, Keriso ena sivarai namo vada na harorolaia ḡuḡuru.
ROM.15.19.english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

ROM.15.29.motu: Lau dibagu danu, baina vasi negana ai Keriso ena hahenamo idoinai baina vasilaia.
ROM.15.29.english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

ROM.15.4.motu: E tore guna ḡaudia na ita ihadibalaida totona e tore, bena Buka Helaḡa ese haheauka bona tauhalo bae havara, ela bona helaro baita davaria.
ROM.15.4.english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

ROM.6.7.motu: Mase tauna na kara dika ena amo vada e roho mauri.
ROM.6.7.english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

ROM.7.24.motu: Lau madi, ihabaigu! Daika ese ina tau-anigu masena amo baine hamaurigu?
ROM.7.24.english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

ROM.16.3.motu: Priskila bona Akula, Keriso Iesu bagunai lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva taudia, ba hanamodia.
ROM.16.3.english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

ROM.8.31.motu: Ini ḡau ede baita herevalai toma? Dirava ese bema beiada, daika ese bema tuari henida?
ROM.8.31.english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ROM.3.9.motu: O edeheto? Ai Iuda taumai be heherea a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani. Badina be Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia vada e habadelaidia, hahebade tamona: iboudiai na mai edia kara dika.
ROM.3.9.english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

ROM.6.17.motu: Dirava baita hanamoa, badina be gunaguna umui na kara dika isiaina o lao heniva, a harihari a hadibamuiva herevana vada o kamonai henia mai daramui ida.
ROM.6.17.english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

ROM.10.6.motu: A heabidadama ena kara maoromaoro ini e gwau tomamu: “Lalomui ai basioto, Daika guba ai baine dae, Keriso baine hakaua diho
ROM.10.6.english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ + 10:6 Deuteronomy 30:12 (that is, to bring Christ down);

ROM.5.11.motu: A dia una mo: Dirava ta moalelaiamu iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso dainai; badina be ia bagunai herohemaino vada tame abia.
ROM.5.11.english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

ROM.14.1.motu: Ena abidadama e manoka-manokamu tauna na bavabia dae, to basio hepapahuahu.
ROM.14.1.english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

ROM.12.5.motu: unuhetomana, ita na hoho, a tau-anina tamona Keriso enai, reḡe idau-idau ta ḡaukara heboumu.
ROM.12.5.english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

ROM.3.18.motu: Dirava garina asie garimu, lasi vaitani.
ROM.3.18.english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.” + 3:18 Psalms 36:1

ROM.14.5.motu: Tau ta e tomamu dina ta be herea; ma tau ta e tomamu dina iboudiai be heḡereḡere. Ta ta ese lalodia bae hadai ḡoevaḡoeva.
ROM.14.5.english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

ROM.11.16.motu: Mane roboana bema helaḡa, taba idoinai bema helaḡa; bona ramu bema helaga, rigi danu bema helaḡa.
ROM.11.16.english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

ROM.14.24.english: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

ROM.1.5.motu: lena amo harihari-bada, bona aposetolo dagina, ai ese vada a abi, bena ia ladana dainai bese iboudiai baia hahelalodia kerehai, abidadama korikori bae abia;
ROM.1.5.english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

ROM.1.28.motu: Idia ese Dirava ilalo-hadailaina asie urava, taunabunai Dirava ese vada e kahudia nege, edia lalo-hadai kavakavadia bae ḡava bona kara dikadia bae kara;
ROM.1.28.english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

ROM.2.25.motu: Momokani, taravatu ba badinaia negana ai peritome ese baine hanamomu; a taravatu ba tataia utu negana ai emu peritome na asi anina.
ROM.2.25.english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

ROM.7.23.motu: a tau-anigu ai taravatu idauna na itaiamu, ia be lalogu ena taravatu e tuari heniamu, bena e ḡuigumu, kara dika taravatuna ena, tau-anigu ai e nohomu ḡauna bunai.
ROM.7.23.english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

ROM.15.16.motu: Lau be Keriso Iesu ena hesiai taugu, bese idau-idau ediai; Dirava ena sivarai namo na harorolaiamu, bena Lauma Helaḡa ena hahelaḡa dainai bese idau-idau na boubou ḡaudia namodia ai baela.
ROM.15.16.english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

ROM.14.16.motu: Oi ese namona o laloamu ḡauna dikana basie gwauraia.
ROM.14.16.english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

ROM.11.14.motu: Unu amo, readia, vaḡeḡe baina havaraia varavaragu lalodia ai; bena haida ese mauri bae davaria.
ROM.11.14.english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

ROM.15.20.motu: Egu lalo-hadai tamona binai: sivarai namo baina harorolaia, Keriso ladana do asie hatoamu gabudia ai. Asina uramu ta ena du latadiai egu ruma baina haginia.
ROM.15.20.english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

ROM.5.9.motu: Iesu rarana dainai ita na maoroda e gwauraimu, taunabunai ia ese Dirava ena badu amo baine hamaurida.
ROM.5.9.english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

ROM.9.26.motu: E gwau henidia, eto “Umui na dia lauegu bese taumui”, gabuna ai,
ROM.9.26.english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’

ROM.11.35.motu: Daika enai e abi torehai, bena davana baine henia?
ROM.11.35.english: “Or who has first given to him,

ROM.14.25.english: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

ROM.13.6.motu: Una dainai umui ese tax monidia o henidiamu; badina be idia na Dirava ena hesiai taudia, nega idoinai ina ḡaukara e karaiamu.
ROM.13.6.english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

ROM.3.20.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta basine maoro taravatu ibadinana dainai; badina be taravatu ena amo taunimanima na kara dika mai dibadia.
ROM.3.20.english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

ROM.16.18.motu: Taunimanima unuhetomadia na Keriso iseda Lohiabada isiaina asie lao henimu, a bogadia mo e lalomu; bona idia ese danu hereva manau bona ere namo amo asi dibadia taudia na e koidiamu.
ROM.16.18.english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

ROM.7.7.motu: Bena dahaka baitato? Taravatu na dika a? Lasi vaitani. Taravatu basinema hadibagu, lalogu basinema parara kara dika be dahaka. Bona taravatu basinema haduagu “Basio hekise-hekise”, lalogu na basinema parara hekise-hekise be dahaka.
ROM.7.7.english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.” + 7:7 Exodus 20:17; Deuteronomy 5:21

ROM.8.15.motu: Umui be hesiai laumana mai garina ida asio abia lou, a heabi-dae laumana vada o abia; taunabunai ta boiboimu, ta tomu “Aba e, Tamamai e!”
