ROM.8.15.english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

ROM.9.3.motu: lau na uramu dikagu bema gwauraia, Keriso ena amo bema bibigu oho, tadikakagu bona egu bese taudia daidiai.
ROM.9.3.english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

ROM.9.16.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ena ura na herevana, tau ta ena heau na herevana; Dirava ena hebogahisi mo mai badina.
ROM.9.16.english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

ROM.5.6.motu: Badina be nega korikori ai, ita ta manokava negana ai, Keriso e mase, Dirava e ihi-ihiraiava taudia daidiai.
ROM.5.6.english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

ROM.11.27.english: This is my covenant with them,

ROM.8.6.motu: Tauanina ilalona be mase; a lauma ilalona be mauri bona maino.
ROM.8.6.english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

ROM.16.25.motu: Dirava aita hanamua, ia na mai goadana baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka, egu sivarai namo bona Iesu Keriso ena haroro herevadia heḡereḡeredia. Hereva hehunidia ihahedinaraidia heḡereḡerena danu, nega gunadia amo e hehuni,

ROM.1.25.motu: Badina be Dirava ena hereva momokani na idia ese koikoi ḡauna ai e boloava, e kara ḡaudia e toma heni dihova, bona isiaidia e lao heniva, a ikaradia Diravana na e dadaraiava. Hahenamo be iena ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
ROM.1.25.english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

ROM.4.19.motu: Ena abidadama na se manokava. Ena be tau-anina e haeroava mase tauna na heto (laḡanina na sinahu-ta sisivana) bona Sara danu mase hahinena na heto,
ROM.4.19.english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

ROM.2.2.motu: Dibada danu, unu e kara tomamu taudia na Dirava ese davadia baine henidia mai maoromaorona ida.
ROM.2.2.english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

ROM.7.15.motu: Lau na karamu karadia na asi dibagu: badina be na ura henimu karadia na asina karamu, bona na inai henimu karadia na karamu.
ROM.7.15.english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

ROM.2.29.motu: a Iuda korikori na lalona ḡauna, bona peritome korikori na lalona ḡauna, dia tau-anina ai to lauma ai. Tau unuhetomana na taunimanima readia basie heatolaia, to Dirava ese baine heatolaia.
ROM.2.29.english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

ROM.1.14.motu: Lau na Helene taudia bona bese idau-idau taudia, aonega taudia bona kavakava taudia, ediai na abi torehai,
ROM.1.14.english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

ROM.11.21.motu: Badina be Dirava ese rigi korikori se bogadia hisi, bona oi danu basine bogamu hisi.
ROM.11.21.english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

ROM.8.4.motu: Taunabunai, ita, tau-anina ena kara asita karamu a lauma ena kara ta karamu tauda, edai taravatu ena kara maoromaoro baine ḡuḡuru.
ROM.8.4.english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

ROM.8.29.motu: Ia e dibadia guna taudia e gwauraidia hidi, Natuna oromana bae abia, ia tadina ai baela, ia na tau roboana ai bainela.
ROM.8.29.english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

ROM.2.7.motu: kara namodia e kara tarika-tarikamu bona hairai bona hahenamo bona basine pata maurina danu e tahumu taudia na mauri hanaihanai bae abia;
ROM.2.7.english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

ROM.16.4.motu: Idia na lau daigu ai mokona e mase. Lau ese na hanamodiamu; a dia lau mo, bese idau-idau edia ekalesia oreadia iboudiai danu.
ROM.16.4.english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

ROM.8.24.motu: Ihamaurida ḡauna be helaro. Ta laroamu ḡauna baitama itaia, una na dia helaro: daika ese e itaiamu ḡauna baine laroa?
ROM.8.24.english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

ROM.8.9.motu: Dirava ena Lauma lalomui ai bema noho, umui na tau-anina ilalona ai basioma noho, a lauma ilalona ai boma noho. A Keriso ena Lauma se abiamu tauna na dia Keriso ena.
ROM.8.9.english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

ROM.14.2.motu: Ta be mai ena abidadama, bena ḡau iboudiai e animu; ma ta lalona e manokamu, bena uma ḡaudia mo e animu.
ROM.14.2.english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

ROM.16.9.motu: bona Urebano, lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva tauna, bona Staku, egu lalokau tauna,
ROM.16.9.english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

ROM.3.13.motu: Gadodia na gara e hekehomu na heto,

ROM.9.6.motu: Basitato Dirava ena hereva na asi anina. Basitato Israel ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na Israel korikori.
ROM.9.6.english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

ROM.4.7.motu: eto, Edia kara rea e gwau taomu bona edia dika e herome ahumu taudia na nanamo;
ROM.4.7.english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven,

ROM.2.22.motu: O tomamu taunimanima basie heuda hanai, a ḡau be oi o heuda hanaimu a? Kaivakuku o ihi-ihiraidiamu, a ḡau be dubu ḡaudia o henaomu a?
ROM.2.22.english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

ROM.11.3.motu: Lohiabada e, emu peroveta taudia vada e aladia mase, emu pata helaḡadia vada e ḡiḡi rohoroho; lau mo sibogu name noho, bona lau danu e tahugumu, bae alagu mase e tomu.
ROM.11.3.english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.” + 11:3 1 Kings 19:10,14

ROM.1.2.motu: Sivarai namo bunai ia ese ena peroveta taudia ududia amo e gwauraia hamata, Buka Helaḡa lalonai:
ROM.1.2.english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

ROM.16.22.motu: Lau Teretio ese imagu amo ina revareva name torea: Lohiabada ladana ai na hanamomuimu.
ROM.16.22.english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

ROM.6.23.motu: Badina be kara dika davana be mase; a Dirava ena harihari ḡauna na mauri hanaihanai, Keriso Iesu iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
ROM.6.23.english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.5.12.motu: Taunabunai, tau ta dainai dika tanobada ai e vareai, bona dika ese mase e vareailaia; bena mase ese taunimanima iboudiai e butudia tao, badina be iboudiai na mai edia kara dika.
ROM.5.12.english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

ROM.5.17.motu: Tau tamona ena kara dika dainai mase vada e kwalimu; unuhetomana, harihari-bada bona kara maoromaoro e abimu taudia na bae kwalimu bona bae mauri, tau tamona, Iesu Keriso, dainai.
ROM.5.17.english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

ROM.5.1.motu: Taunabunai, iseda abidadama dainai ita maoroda vada e gwaurai, bena Dirava ena maino tame abia, Iesu Keriso iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
ROM.5.1.english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

ROM.2.20.motu: bona kavakava taudia o sisiba henidiamu, bona memero o hadibadiamu; badina be aonega bona hereva momokani oromadia na taravatu lalonai o davarimu.
ROM.2.20.english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

ROM.7.10.motu: Taravatu na mauri ḡauna e tomamu, a lauegu ai ia na mase ḡauna ai ela;
ROM.7.10.english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

ROM.11.7.motu: Bena edeheto? Israel ese e tahua ḡauna na do asie davaria; a abi-hidi taudia ese vada e davaria. Oredia be lalodia e ha-auka,
ROM.11.7.english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

ROM.13.5.motu: Taunabunai, ba matauraia: dia badu garina, a helalo dainai.
ROM.13.5.english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

ROM.15.32.motu: Bena Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena ai, lau baina vasi mai moalegu ida, bena baita hahealo heheni.
ROM.15.32.english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

ROM.9.23.motu: A hairai badana baine hahedinaraia, hebogahisi ḡaudia ediai: ḡaudia be ia ese e abi heḡaeḡae, hairai baine henidia eto.
ROM.9.23.english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

ROM.3.31.motu: O, abidadama dainai taravatu ta negeamu a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani. Ita ese taravatu ta haginia tutuka-tutukamu.
ROM.3.31.english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

ROM.15.2.motu: Iboudai ta ta dekeda taudia baita hamoaledia, edia namo bona edia goada ihavaradia.
ROM.15.2.english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

ROM.11.30.motu: Gunaguna umui ese Dirava o gwau edeede heniava; harihari hebogahisi vada o davaria, idia edia gwau-edeede dainai.
ROM.11.30.english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

ROM.8.11.motu: Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Laumana na lalomui ai bema noho, Keriso Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana ese umui taumui bema hamauridia, ena Lauma lalomui ai bema noho dainai.
ROM.8.11.english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

ROM.1.3.motu: ia Natuna herevana, tau-anina ai David garana amo e vara,
ROM.1.3.english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

ROM.10.1.motu: Varavaragu e, lalogu ena ura, bona egu noinoi Dirava enai danu, be Israel taudia do bae mauri.
ROM.10.1.english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

ROM.15.22.motu: Una dainai vada name helao ahu, asina vasi itamui ema bona hari.
ROM.15.22.english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

ROM.2.24.motu: Benaini, buka ai ini e torea toma, ani: Dirava ladana na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e ihiihiraiamu umui daimui ai.
ROM.2.24.english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” + 2:24 Isaiah 52:5; Ezekiel 36:22 just as it is written.

ROM.6.15.motu: Edeheto? Taravatu henunai asita nohomu a harihari-bada henunai ta nohomu dainai baita kara dika a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
ROM.6.15.english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

ROM.8.20.motu: E kara ḡaudia iboudiai na mase henunai e atodia, dia sibodia edia ura dainai, a e atodia tauna ena ura dainai;
ROM.8.20.english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

ROM.5.10.motu: Gunaguna, ta inai heniava negana ai, Dirava ida ta herohemaino ia Natuna bagunai; harihari, vada ta herohemaino vaitani negana ai, mauri baita abia iena mauri bagunai.
ROM.5.10.english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

ROM.11.10.motu: Matadia ba hakapu, bena basie ita:
ROM.11.10.english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see.

ROM.11.8.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Dirava ese lalodia e hamahuta: mai matadia, to asie ita; mai taiadia, to asie kamonai, ema bona harihari.
ROM.11.8.english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.” + 11:8 Deuteronomy 29:4; Isaiah 29:10

ROM.4.5.motu: A se ḡaukaramu to kara dika taudia na kara maoromaoro taudia ai e halaodiamu Diravana e abidadama heniamu tauna, ia be ena abidadama dainai maorona e gwauraiamu.
ROM.4.5.english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

ROM.13.10.motu: Lalokau ese dekemu tauna se hadikaiamu; taunabunai lalokau na taravatu ihaḡuḡuruna.
ROM.13.10.english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

ROM.4.16.motu: Benaini, abidadama dainai e abiamu, harihari ḡauna na heto; dia taravatu ibadinana taudia mo, a Abraham ena abidadama e tohotohoamu taudia iboudiai danu. Ia na ita iboudai tamada;
ROM.4.16.english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

ROM.11.34.motu: Daika na Lohiabada lalona dibana? Daika ese ena kara baine herevalai henia?
ROM.11.34.english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord?

ROM.13.13.motu: Eda kara nahuadia baita toho; eda raka na dina ai ta rakamu. Basita lebulebu; basita kekero; basita heuda hanai; basita mata dika; basita heai; basita vaḡeḡe.
ROM.13.13.english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

ROM.14.8.motu: Ta maurimu be Lohiabada enai ta maurimu; bona baita mase, Lohiabada enai baita mase. Taunabunai, ta maurimu eiava baita mase, ita na Lohiabada ena.
ROM.14.8.english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

ROM.14.7.motu: Asi tauna ta sibona enai e maurimu, bona asi tauna ta sibona enai e masemu.
ROM.14.7.english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

ROM.12.10.motu: Ta ta ba heura heheni, varavara na heheto; ba hemataurai heheni danu.
ROM.12.10.english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

ROM.2.18.motu: bona ena ura mai dibamu taumu, herea-dae ḡaudia toadia dibamu bona taravatu vada o diba vaitani o tomamu taumu:
ROM.2.18.english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

ROM.5.20.motu: Taravatu e gini, bena hekwakwanai vada e vara badabada. A kara dika e badamu gabudia ai, harihari-bada na e honuhonu daemu.
ROM.5.20.english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

ROM.3.22.motu: Dirava ena kara maoromaoro na Iesu Keriso e abidadama heniamu taudia iboudiai ese bae davaria. Ta dia idau;
ROM.3.22.english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

ROM.8.5.motu: Badina be tau-anina ena kara e karamu taudia ese tau-anina ena ḡau mo e lalomu, a lauma ena kara e karamu taudia ese lauma ena ḡau mo e lalomu.
ROM.8.5.english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

ROM.11.24.motu: Benaini, oi na vara-kava olivena ena amo e utumu oho, uma olivena enai e hirimu kau, idia be rigi korikori, edia olive korikorina ai basie hiri kau a? Vada bae hiri kau.
ROM.11.24.english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

ROM.16.16.motu: Ba hahenamo heheni; ba haherahu heheni. Keriso ena ekalesia oreadia iboudiai ese e hanamomuimu.
ROM.16.16.english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

ROM.2.5.motu: Emu lalo-duhu dainai badu latamu ai o habouamu; bena Dirava ena hahemaoro dinana ai una badu anina baine hedinarai.
ROM.2.5.english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

ROM.1.4.motu: a Lauma Helaḡa ese mase amo e hatorea isi negana ai e gwauraia hedinarai mai siahuna ida, ia na Dirava Natuna; eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bunai.
ROM.1.4.english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

ROM.14.14.motu: Lohiabada Iesu ese vada e hamaorogu dainai lau na dibagu ḡau ta dikana basina gwauraia. A ta ese ḡau ta dikana baine gwauraia, una ḡau na dika ienai.
ROM.14.14.english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

ROM.15.31.motu: gwau-edeede taudia Iudea ai imadia amo baine hamaurigu, bona egu ḡaukara Ierusalem ai helaḡa taudia ese bae abia dae mai lalo-namodia ida.
ROM.15.31.english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

ROM.7.5.motu: Badina be ita ese tau-anina ta badinaiava negana ai, kara dika ena laloani taravatu ena amo e varava bona tauda reḡedia lalodiai e vareaiva, bena huahuada mase enai e dobiva.
ROM.7.5.english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

ROM.2.14.motu: Bese idau-idau taudia na taravatu asi dibadia, to lalodia ai taravatu e badinamu; taravatu be asi dibadia, to sibodia edia taravatu e haginimu.
ROM.2.14.english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

ROM.10.17.motu: Taunabunai, heabidadama badina be kamonai, bona kamonai badina be Keriso ena hereva.
ROM.10.17.english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

ROM.15.21.motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto,

ROM.3.14.motu: Ududia na heuduguirai bona ere daḡedaḡe ai e honumu.
ROM.3.14.english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.” + 3:14 Psalms 10:7

ROM.3.23.motu: badina be iboudiai vada e kara dika, bona iboudiai ese Dirava hairaina vada e reaia;
ROM.3.23.english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

ROM.7.17.motu: Ḡau tamopna, kiarana na dia lau, a dika lalogu ai e nohomu hari.
ROM.7.17.english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

ROM.11.11.motu: Ma na tomamu: idia na e hekwakwanai bena vada e keto vaitani a? Lasi vaitani. A edia keto dainai bese idau-idau ese mauri vada e davaria; bena edia vaḡeḡe vada e vara.
ROM.11.11.english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

ROM.6.6.motu: Dibada ita tauda gunadia na ia ida satauro ai e mase, kara dika iha-orena; taunabunai, ita na kara dika isiaina basita lao heni lou.
ROM.6.6.english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

ROM.1.32.motu: Ena be dibadia Dirava e gwau hamata, eto, “Unu bae kara toma taudia bae mase”, to idia ese e karamu, bona e karamu taudia danu e imodaidiamu.
ROM.1.32.english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

ROM.8.37.motu: A ini ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ta kwalimu vaitani, e lalokau henidamu tauna bagunai.
ROM.8.37.english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

ROM.10.15.motu: Bona haida ese basie siaidia, haroro taudia na ede bae haroro toma? Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Ḡau namodia haridia moaledia e mailaimu taudia aedia daka namo!
ROM.10.15.english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written:

ROM.16.7.motu: Varavaragu Androniko bona Iunia danu ba hanamodia; idia be lau ida dibura rumana ai e koumai bou. Haridia na bada aposetolo taudia bogaragidiai. Idia danu Keriso ena orea lalonai e vareai guna, lau be gabe ai.
ROM.16.7.english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

ROM.10.14.motu: A asie abiabiraia taudia na ede bae hahanea toma? Bona harina asie kamonai taudia na ede bae abiabiraia toma? Bona haroro tauna bema lasi, harina na ede bae kamonai toma?
ROM.10.14.english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

ROM.3.16.motu: Hahebua-tari bona hisihisi na edia dala ai mimia,
ROM.3.16.english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

ROM.16.5.motu: Bona edia ruma ai e heboumu oreana danu ba hanamodia.
ROM.16.5.english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

ROM.12.4.motu: Ita heḡereḡereda, tau ta reḡena na momo, a edia ḡaukara na idau-idau;
ROM.12.4.english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

ROM.2.28.motu: Badina be Iuda oromana na dia Iuda korikori, bona peritome oromana na dia peritome korikori;
ROM.2.28.english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

ROM.9.13.motu: e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Iakob na lalokau heniamu; Esau na inai heniamu.
ROM.9.13.english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.” + 9:13 Malachi 1:2-3

ROM.15.26.motu: Badina be Makedonia bona Akaia taudia ese edia harihari ḡaudia vada e habou ogoḡami taudia Ierusalem ekalesiana ai edia.
ROM.15.26.english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

ROM.8.39.motu: eiava atai ḡaudia, eiava dobu ḡaudia, eiava e kara ḡaudia, ta ese Dirava ena uraheni, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ese vada e hahedinaraia ḡauna, amo basine bibida oho diba.
ROM.8.39.english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.4.23.motu: Dia ia mo sibona herevana unu se torea toma;
ROM.4.23.english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

ROM.14.6.motu: Dina e laloamu tauna na Lohiabada enai e laloamu. E anianimu tauna na Lohiabada enai e anianimu, badina be ia ese Dirava e hanamoamu; bona se anianimu tauna na Lohiabada enai se anianimu, bona ia ese danu Dirava e hanamoamu.
ROM.14.6.english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

ROM.15.33.motu: Maino Diravana ese aine bamomui. Amen.
ROM.15.33.english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

ROM.11.15.motu: Badina be inegedia ese herohemaino bema havaraia tanobada ai, iabi-loudia ese dahaka bema havaraia? Mase amo mauri baine vara.
ROM.11.15.english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

ROM.9.17.motu: Badina be buka ai Farao e hamaoroa, eto, Ina mo dainai na haginimu, egu siahu ba hahedinaraia, bona tanobada idoinai lau ladagu harina bae ha piua.
ROM.9.17.english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.” + 9:17 Exodus 9:16

ROM.5.18.motu: Bona tau tamona ena kara dika dainai hahemaoro ese iboudiai e hadikadia; unuhetomana, tau tamona ena kara maoromaoro dainai taunimanima iboudiai maorodia e gwauraunu, vada bae mauri.
ROM.5.18.english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

ROM.6.3.motu: Asi dibamui a, Keriso Iesu ladana ai e bapatisoda tauda na ena mase ai vada e bapatisoda?
ROM.6.3.english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

ROM.1.18.motu: Dirava ena badu guba amo e hedinaraimu, taunimanima edia kara gageva-gagevadia bona Dirava asie matauraiamu karadia latadiai: idia ese edia kara gagevadia daidiai hereva momokani e tao tarimu.
ROM.1.18.english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

ROM.1.16.motu: Badina be sivarai namo asina hemarailaiamu; ia na Dirava ena siahu, abidadama taudia e hamaurilaidiamu, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia.
ROM.1.16.english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

ROM.6.5.motu: Badina be ia ida tama mase bou, ia ida danu tama tore isi lou.
ROM.6.5.english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

ROM.9.29.motu: Isaia ma eto, Iehova Sabaota ese beseda kwabu-kwabudia basinema hanohodia, ita na Sodoma bona Gomora heḡereḡeredia baitama puki.

ROM.15.28.motu: Ina ḡaukara baina karaia vaitani, ina huahua baina henidia vaitani, bena baina vasi itamui, ma Spania bainala.
ROM.15.28.english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

ROM.6.21.motu: Ḡau tamona, harihari o hemarailaimu karadia o karava negana ai anidia be dahaka emui ai? Unu ḡau dokodia na mase.
ROM.6.21.english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

ROM.9.4.motu: Idia na Israel taudia: abi-hidi bona hairai bona hero-hemaino bona taravatu bona toma-diho bona gwauhamata na idia mo edia.
ROM.9.4.english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

ROM.11.33.motu: Dirava ena aonega bona ena lalo-arara na daka dobu! Ena hahemaoro na daika ese baine tahua diba? Ena dala na daika ese baine davaria diba?
ROM.11.33.english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

ROM.5.2.motu: Ia bagunai danu ita ese ta noholaiamu hariharina vada tame davaria, eda abidadama dainai; Dirava hairaina danu ta laroamu mai moaleda ida.
ROM.5.2.english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

ROM.10.5.motu: Mose ese taravatu ena kara maoromaoro e helevalaia, eto, E karanm taudia na unu Ḡau daidiai do bae mauri.
ROM.10.5.english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.” + 10:5 Leviticus 18:5

ROM.3.25.motu: Ia na Dirava ese e abia hidi, herohemaino ḡauna ai e halaoa, rarana bae abidadama henia taudia edia. Unu amo ena kara maoromaoro vada eme hedinarai, badina be kara dika gunadia vada eme hegwau tao, Dirava ena haheauka dainai.
ROM.3.25.english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

ROM.6.16.motu: Asi dibamui a, erena o kamonaimu tauna ena hesiai ai baola, o kamonai heniamu dainai? Kara dika isiaina ba lao heni, mase bavabia; eiava kamonai korikori isiaina ba lao heni, kara maoromaoro bavabia.
ROM.6.16.english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

ROM.8.1.motu: Harihari Keriso Iesu e badinaiamu taudia na dikadia basie gwaurai.
ROM.8.1.english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

ROM.2.3.motu: Bena unu e kara tomamu taudia o hahemaoro henidiamu, ma sibomu danu unu o kara tomamu; o lalomu o tomamu Dirava ena hahemaoro amo ba roho mauri a?
ROM.2.3.english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

ROM.3.21.motu: Harihari Dirava ena kara maoromaoro vada eme hedinarai, dia taravatu amo, a taravatu bona peroveta bukadia ese vada e hamomokania dalana amo;
ROM.3.21.english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

ROM.10.7.motu: eiava, Daika gabu dobuna ai baine diho, Keriso mase taudia bogaragidia amo baine hakaua dae?”
ROM.10.7.english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ + 10:7 Deuteronomy 30:13 (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

ROM.1.31.motu: asi aonegadia taudia, gwauhamata itata-utuna taudia, asi edia heuraheni taudia, asi edia hebogahisi taudia.
ROM.1.31.english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

ROM.10.11.motu: Badina be buka ai e tomamu, Ia bae abiabiraia taudia iboudiai na basie hekwakwanai.
ROM.10.11.english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.” + 10:11 Isaiah 28:16

ROM.4.4.motu: Ḡaukara tauna ese ahuna e abiamu, dia harihari ḡauna, a davana korikori.
ROM.4.4.english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

ROM.7.19.motu: Na ura heniamu karana namona na asina karaiamu, a asina ura heniamu karana dikana be na karaiamu.
ROM.7.19.english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

ROM.11.25.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu ina hereva hehunina ba diba, sibomui emui aonega ba heaḡilaia na garina. Israel taudia haida lalodia do bae duhu, ela bona bese idau-idau taudia bae didi vareai guna.
ROM.11.25.english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

ROM.9.30.motu: Bena dahaka baitato? Bese idau-idau taudia na kara maoromaoro asie tahua, to e davaria, abidadama dainai.
ROM.9.30.english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

ROM.15.15.motu: Taunabunai, mai goadagu ida na tore henimuimu, ihahelalolaimui totona, Dirava ese e henigu hariharina dainai.
ROM.15.15.english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

ROM.5.14.motu: Mase vada e kwalimuva, Adam negana ema bona Mose negana ai; ena be haida ese Adam ena kara dika asie tohotohoa, to e mase.
ROM.5.14.english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

ROM.8.10.motu: Keriso bema lalomui ai, tau-anina bema mase, kara dika dainai, a lauma bema mauri, kara maoromaoro dainai.
ROM.8.10.english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

ROM.1.7.motu: Dirava ese e ura henimuimu taumui Roma ai o nohomu, helaḡa taumui e gwauraimuimu, ba namo; Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia anlo harihari-bada bona maino bavabi.
ROM.1.7.english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ROM.15.30.motu: Varavaragu e, na noimuimu, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai bona Lauma ena uraheni bagunai, Dirava ba ḡuria goadagoada lau daigu ai, sibogu daigu ai na ḡuriḡurimu heḡereḡerena;
ROM.15.30.english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

ROM.10.19.motu: Ma na tomamu: Israel asi dibadia a? Be! Gunaguna Mose eto,
ROM.10.19.english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says,

ROM.9.27.motu: Isaia ese danu Israel e hahanea, eto, Ena be Israel garana bae hutuma, kone mirina na heto, to kwabu-kwabudia mo bae mauri;

ROM.4.9.motu: ma hahenamo na peritome taudia mo sibodia ese bae abia a? Eiava asie peritomedia taudia danu? Ita ta tomamu “Abraham ese Dirava e abidadama henia dainai maorona e gwauraia”.
ROM.4.9.english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

ROM.15.5.motu: Bena haheauka bona tauhalo Diravana ese lalomui baine hatamonadia, Keriso Iesu bagunai;
ROM.15.5.english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

ROM.7.1.motu: Varavaragu e, taravatu mai dibamui taumui, na tore henimuimu. Asi dibamui taravatu ese taunimanima e lohiadiamu edia mauri dunadia iboudiai a?
ROM.7.1.english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

ROM.15.13.motu: Helaro Diravana ese emui abidadama dainai moale bona maino idoinai baine hahonulaimui, Lauma Helaḡa siahuna amo baine habadaia.
ROM.15.13.english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

ROM.3.29.motu: Dirava na Iuda taudia mo edia Dirava a? Ia na dia bese idau-idau edia Dirava a? Lasi, ia na bese idauidau edia Dirava danu.
ROM.3.29.english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

ROM.6.11.motu: Unuhetomana, umui danu sibomui unu na ba helalolai: kara dika enai vada o mase, Dirava enai vada o mauri, Keriso Iesu iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
ROM.6.11.english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.15.9.motu: bona bese idau-idau ese danu Dirava bae imodaia, ena hebogahisi dainai; buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto,
ROM.15.9.english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written,

ROM.1.17.motu: Badina be ia lalonai Dirava ena kara maoromaoro eme hedinarai, abidadama ihabadana totona; buka ai e torea na heto, eto, Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena abidadama dainai baine mauri.
ROM.1.17.english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.” + 1:17 Habakkuk 2:4

ROM.8.19.motu: Badina be e kara ḡaudia iboudiai edia helaro be Dirava natuna bae hedinarai; una mo e nariamu.
ROM.8.19.english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

ROM.15.23.motu: A harihari lau na asi egu ḡaukara inikaha ai; bona laḡani hoho vada na ura bada baina vasi.
ROM.15.23.english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

ROM.5.21.motu: Kara dika e kwalimuva, mase e havaraiava; unuhetomana kara maoromaoro dainai harihari-bada e kwalimumu, mauri hanaihanai e havaraiamu, Iesu Keriso iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
ROM.5.21.english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

ROM.2.12.motu: Taravatu murimurinai e kara dika taudia na taravatu murimurinai davadia bae abi, a taravatu lalonai e kara dika taudia na taravatu lalonai bae hahemaoro henidia.
ROM.2.12.english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

ROM.5.8.motu: A Dirava ese ena uraheni ini e hahedinaraia toma; ita na dounu kara dikadia ta karava negadia ai Keriso na ita daidai e mase.
ROM.5.8.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

ROM.7.11.motu: badina be dika ese haheḡani amo e koigu bona e alagu mase.
ROM.7.11.english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

ROM.14.12.motu: Taunabunai, ita iboudai ta ta ena kara ena kara Dirava vairanai baita hahedinarai.
ROM.14.12.english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

ROM.1.15.motu: taunabunai lau na uramu umui Roma ai o nohomu taumui vairamui ai sivarai namo do baina harorolaia.
ROM.1.15.english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

ROM.7.13.motu: Matogana, ḡau namona na mase ḡauna ai egu ai e laomu a? Lasi vaitani. A kara dika ena dika baine hedinarai totona, ḡau namona na mase ḡauna ai egu ai e halaoa; bena haheḡani ena amo kara dika toana baine hedinarai, ia na dika vaitani.
ROM.7.13.english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

ROM.11.1.motu: Ma na tomamu: Dirava ese ena bese taudia vada e negedia a? Lasi vaitani. Lau danu tau Israel, Abraham garana, Beniamina ena iduhu taugu.
ROM.11.1.english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

ROM.12.1.motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, Dirava ena hebogahisi dainai na noimuimu, tau-animui idoidiai ia ba henia, boubou ḡaudia mauridia bona helaḡadia ai baela, Dirava ese baine moalelai: emui hesiai karana korikorina bunai.
ROM.12.1.english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

ROM.3.1.motu: Tau Iuda ena namo be dahaka? Peritome ena namo be dahaka?
ROM.3.1.english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

ROM.11.6.motu: A bema harihari-bada ese vada e abidia hidi, kara na herevana, bema lasi, harihari-bada bema asi anina.
ROM.11.6.english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

ROM.1.29.motu: ema bona dika iboudiai ese vada e hahonudia: kara gagevagageva, kara dika, mata ḡaniḡani, vaḡeḡe, hebore, roroma, hepapahuahu, dibaka, daḡedaḡe.
ROM.1.29.english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

ROM.3.4.motu: Dia unuheto. Dirava be momokani, a taunimanima iboudiai na e koikoimu; buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto,
ROM.3.4.english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written,

ROM.12.2.motu: Ina tanobada oromana na basio tohotohoa; a lalomui ba hamatamata, bae idau vaitani, bena Dirava ena ura, mai namona bona mai hairaina bona mai hereadaena ida, vada ba diba.
ROM.12.2.english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

ROM.11.20.motu: Benaini, asi edia abidadama dainai e dabai kwaidu, a oi hari emu abidadama dainai o ginimu. Asio hekokoroku: ba gari.
ROM.11.20.english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

ROM.3.8.motu: Ai na asiato “Dika baita kara, namo ihavarana helaoreana”. Haida ese e habadelaimai koikoimu, e tomamu ai na unu a gwau toma; edia koikoi davana bae abia hari namo.
ROM.3.8.english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

ROM.3.19.motu: Dibada taravatu ese e gwauraimu herevadia iboudiai ese taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia e gwaurai henidiamu, taunabunai udu ihoudiai bae hekou, bena tanobada idoinai na Dirava ese baine hahemaoro henia.
ROM.3.19.english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

ROM.3.30.motu: Benaini, Dirava na tamona; e peritomedia taudia na ia ese abidadama dainai maorodia baine gwaurai, bona asie peritomedia taudia danu abidadama dainai maorodia baine gwaurai.
ROM.3.30.english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

ROM.4.3.motu: Buka Helaḡa na dahaka e tomamu? Abraham ese Dirava e abidadama henia dainai maorona e gwauraia.
ROM.4.3.english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.” + 4:3 Genesis 15:6

ROM.5.13.motu: Badina be kara dika vada e vara guna tanobada ai, taravatu be gabeamo; asi taravatu negana ai kara dika asie hahemaoro heniava.
ROM.5.13.english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

ROM.1.30.motu: Idia na hesivarai taudia, ere dika taudia, Dirava ese e dadaraidiamu taudia, ere daḡedaḡe taudia, hekokoroku taudia, heaḡi taudia, dika ihavarana taudia, tamadia sinadia e dadaraidiamu taudia,
ROM.1.30.english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

ROM.3.6.motu: Lasi, dia unuheto. Unu bema heto, Dirava ese tanobada ede bema hahemaoro henia toma?
ROM.3.6.english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

ROM.4.13.motu: Gwauhamata na Abraham e henia, ia garana ida tanobada idounai bae abia; taravatu dainai se henia, to ena abidadama amo e varava karamaoromaorodia daidiai e henia.
ROM.4.13.english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

ROM.12.17.motu: Tau ta basio kara dika henia, iena dika davana; a taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai kara namo mo ba kara.
ROM.12.17.english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

ROM.16.8.motu: Amplia, Lohiabada bagunai na lalokau heniamu tauna,
ROM.16.8.english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

ROM.2.17.motu: Taunabinai oi, Iuda taumu o tomamu, taravatu o abidadama heniamu taumu, Dirava o heatolaiamu
ROM.2.17.english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

ROM.2.11.motu: Badina be Dirava ese taunimanima iboudiai e itadiamu, heḡereḡere mo.
ROM.2.11.english: For there is no partiality with God.

ROM.1.27.motu: tatau danu, hahine vada e rakatanidia, sibodia e heḡahusi hehenimu; bena edia kara havara davana na tau-anidia ai e abiamu.
ROM.1.27.english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

ROM.1.20.motu: tanobada matamana amo e hehuni ḡaudia, ena siahu bona ena kara, vada eme hedinarai, e kara ḡaudia ese vada e hahedinaraimu. Taunabunai, idia na asi edia hahekora herevadia.
ROM.1.20.english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

ROM.3.24.motu: to ena harihari-bada dainai maorodia e gwauraimu, Keriso Iesu ena hahemauri bagunai.
ROM.3.24.english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

ROM.9.28.motu: badina be Lohiabada ese ena hereva tanobada ai baine haḡuḡurua haraḡa mai goadana ida.
ROM.9.28.english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness,

ROM.6.14.motu: Kara dika ese basine lohiamui, badina be taravatu henunai asio nohomu, a harihari-bada henunai o nohomu.
ROM.6.14.english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

ROM.7.22.motu: Badina be lalogu ese Dirava ena taravatu e moalelaiamu;
ROM.7.22.english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

ROM.11.23.motu: A idia be edia hedadarai bae rakatania, bae hehiri kau lou; badina be Dirava na mai siahuna baine hiridia kau lou.
ROM.11.23.english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

ROM.8.3.motu: Tau-anina ena manoka dainai taravatu na asi siahuna, taunabunai Dirava ese Natu-adorana e siaia, dika tau-anina e abia, dika kwarana ai ela, tau-anina ai dika e hadarerea.
ROM.8.3.english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

ROM.4.20.motu: to Dirava ena gwauhamata e laloa taova, bona e abidadama henia tutuka-tutukava, bona e heatolaiava;
ROM.4.20.english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

ROM.11.4.motu: A Dirava ese ede e haere henia toma? Ia eto, Lauegu taunimanima na daha hitu, Baal asie toma henia dihomu.
ROM.11.4.english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.” + 11:4 1 Kings 19:18

ROM.16.1.motu: Ita taihuda Foibe e vasimu; ia na Kenkrea diakono hahinena ta.
ROM.16.1.english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

ROM.8.33.motu: Daika ese Dirava ena abihidi taudia baine habadelaidia? Bona Dirava ese maorodia e gwauraimu taudia daika ese dikadia baine gwaurai?
ROM.8.33.english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

ROM.14.18.motu: Badina be ini ḡau amo Keriso isiaina e lao henimu tauna na Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu, bona taunimanima ese e hanamoamu.
ROM.14.18.english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

ROM.15.8.motu: Na tomu Keriso na Israel edia hesiai tauna ai e halaoa, Dirava ena hereva momokani dainai, seneda e gwau henidia hamata herevadia ihamomokanidia;
ROM.15.8.english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

ROM.8.35.motu: Daika ese Keriso ena uraheni amo baine bibida oho? Nega dikadika ese a? Eiava lalo-hisihisi ese a? Eiava daḡedaḡe ese? Eiava doe ese? Eiava ogoḡami ese? Eiava mase ese? Eiava dare ese?
ROM.8.35.english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

ROM.9.12.motu: Bena ia ese Rebeka e hamaoroa, eto, Tau roboana ese tau muritai isiaina baine lao heni;
ROM.9.12.english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.” + 9:12 Genesis 25:23

ROM.1.6.motu: bona umui danu, Iesu Keriso ese e boirimuimu taumui.
ROM.1.6.english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

ROM.3.10.motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto,

ROM.3.2.motu: Diaḡau. Gini-gunana binai: Dirava ese ena hereva Iuda taudia dekediai e atova.
ROM.3.2.english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

ROM.12.21.motu: Dika ese basine hadarelemui, a emui kara namo amo dika ba hadarerea.
ROM.12.21.english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ROM.14.13.motu: Taunabunai, basita hahemaoro heheni, a laloda ini baita hadai toma: varavarada ena dala ai hekwakwanai ḡauna eiava idoa basita atoa.
ROM.14.13.english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

ROM.16.12.motu: Trufena bona Trufosa ba hanamodia; idia na Lohiabada ena orea hahinedia; Peresi, lalokau hahinena, ba hanamoa; ia na Lohiabada ena ḡaukara vada e heckwarahilaia.
ROM.16.12.english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

ROM.7.6.motu: A harihari taravatu ese vada e kahuda nege, e dogoda taova ḡauna enai vada ta mase na heto; taunabunai harihari eda hesiai ilao-henina na lauma dainai, dia nega gunadia ai e tore herevadia daidiai.
ROM.7.6.english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

ROM.4.10.motu: Edena nega ai? E peritomea murinai, eiava do se peritomea negana ai? Dia peritome lalonai, a do se peritomea negana ai, ani?
ROM.4.10.english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

ROM.13.8.motu: Tau ta enai basio ima doa. Ba heura heheni; badina be bamona e ura heniamu tauna ese taravatu idoinai vada e badinaiamu.
ROM.13.8.english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

ROM.2.26.motu: A asie peritomea tauna na taravatu baine badinaia, ia na e peritomea tauna heḡereḡerena ai bainela ani?
ROM.2.26.english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

ROM.12.16.motu: Iboumui ai lalomui bae tamona. Herea ḡaudia basio lalodia, a manau taudia ida ba noho hebou. Sibomui emui aonega basio heaḡilaia.
ROM.12.16.english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

ROM.13.9.motu: “Basio heuda hanai” bona “basio ala ala” bona “basio henao” bona “basio hekisehekise” bona taravatu oredia iboudiai na ina haheḡani tamona lalonai vada e hebou: “Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu na heto”.
ROM.13.9.english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” + 13:9 Exodus 20:13-15,17; Deuteronomy 5:17-19,21 and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” + 13:9 Leviticus 19:18

ROM.2.9.motu: Kara dika taudia ese lalo-hisihisi bona kudou-hetaha bae davari, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia;
ROM.2.9.english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

ROM.6.8.motu: Benaini, ita na Keriso ida tama mase hebou, dibada ia ida danu tama mauri hebou.
ROM.6.8.english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

ROM.9.14.motu: Dahaka baitato? Dirava mai ena kara rea a? Lasi vaitani.
ROM.9.14.english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

ROM.8.2.motu: Badina be Keriso Iesu bagunai Mauri Laumana ese kara dika taravatuna bona mase taravatuna edia amo vada e ruhagu nege.
ROM.8.2.english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

ROM.10.13.motu: bona Lohiabada ladana e hahaneamu taudia iboudiai na bae mauri.
ROM.10.13.english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.” + 10:13 Joel 2:32

ROM.14.23.motu: A daradara tauna baine aniani, sibona baine hahedika, badina be asi ena abidadama; bona abidadama ese se havara ḡaudia iboudiai na didika.
ROM.14.23.english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

ROM.16.20.motu: Asi vanahana Maino Diravana ese Satana baine moia patapata umui aemui henudiai. Iseda Lohiabada Iesu ena harihari-bada ese baine bamomui.
ROM.16.20.english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet.

ROM.9.8.motu: Anina binai: tau-anina amo e vara memerodia na dia Dirava natuna, a e gwauraidia hamata memerodia mo ia garana ai baine halaodia.
ROM.9.8.english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

ROM.16.26.motu: a harihari vada eme hedinarai; noho hanaihanai Diravana ena hahegani dainai, peroveeta taudia edia buka ese bese loḡora ibuudiai vada e hadibalaidia, edia abidadama ihavarana.

ROM.15.14.motu: Varavaragu e, lau dibagu umui na kara namo ai o honumu, diari ai o honuhonu daemu, hesisiba heheni na mai dibamui.
ROM.15.14.english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

ROM.4.11.motu: Do se peritomea negana ai ena abidadama na maoromaoro; gabeamo e peritomea, ena abidadama maoromaorona toana. Taunabunai, ia na asie peritomedia to mai edia abidadama taudia tamadia: maorodia e gwauraimu.
ROM.4.11.english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

ROM.12.14.motu: E daḡedaḡe henimuimu taudia ba hanamodia; basio uduguiraidia.
ROM.12.14.english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

ROM.14.21.motu: Vamu basita ania, vine ranuna basita inua, bona varavarada ihahekwakwanaina karana ta basita karaia, unu hari namo.
ROM.14.21.english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

ROM.9.19.motu: Readia ba hereva henigu, baoto “Be, dahaka dainai e gwaugwaumu? Daika ese ena ura e laoa ahu?”
ROM.9.19.english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

ROM.6.9.motu: Bona dibada Keriso na mase amo vada e tore isi dainai ia na basine mase lou; mase na asi siahuna ienai.
ROM.6.9.english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

ROM.8.34.motu: Keriso Iesu e mase, ma e tore isi lou; ia na Dirava idibana kahana ai e nohomu, ita daidai e noinoimu.
ROM.8.34.english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

ROM.6.2.motu: Lasi vaitani. Ita ese kara dika na vada ta masetania, be ede baita lou henia toma?
ROM.6.2.english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

ROM.14.11.motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Lohiabada eto “Egu mauri dainai tui iboudiai lau vairagu ai bae hadai, bona mala iboudiai ese Dirava bae imodaia”.

ROM.2.27.motu: Bona, asie peritomea to taravatu e badinaiamu tauna ese oi, taravatu ai o vara bona peritome o abia to taravatu o tataia utumu taumu, na baine hahemaoro henimu ani?
ROM.2.27.english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

ROM.5.19.motu: Bona tau tamona ena gwau-edeede daimai hutuma na dika taudia ai e halaodiava; unuhetomana, tau tamona ena kamonai dainai hutuma na kara maoromaoro taudia ai e halaodiamu.
ROM.5.19.english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

ROM.9.10.motu: Dia una mo. Rebeka danu, seneda Isaak adavana, e rogorogo,
ROM.9.10.english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

ROM.11.32.motu: Badina be Dirava ese ita iboudai gwau-edeede ai vada e kouda ahu, baine bogada hisi helaoreana.
ROM.11.32.english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

ROM.12.12.motu: Helaro ai ba moale. Dika negadia ai ba haheauka. Guriḡuri ba goadalaia nega idoidiai.
ROM.12.12.english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

ROM.4.6.motu: Dirava ese ena kara se laloamu to maorona e gwauraiamu tauna na David ese danu vada e hanamoa,
ROM.4.6.english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

ROM.9.25.motu: Hosea ese e torea hegereḡerena, eto,
ROM.9.25.english: As he says also in Hosea,

ROM.10.20.motu: Bona Isaia e hereva goadagoada, eto,
ROM.10.20.english: Isaiah is very bold and says,

ROM.11.36.motu: Badina be ḡau iboudiai ihavaradia ia mo; bona ḡau iboudiai badidia bona dokodia ia mo. Ia mo baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen.
ROM.11.36.english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

ROM.12.6.motu: Harihari-bada ese herahia ḡaudia vada e henida: bema peroveta, baita peroveta eda kamonai heḡereḡerena;
ROM.12.6.english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

ROM.15.6.motu: bena mai lalomui tamona bona mai eremui tamona ida Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, ba imodaia.
ROM.15.6.english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ROM.14.15.motu: Bena amu aniani ḡauna dainai varavaramu lalona e hekwakwanaimu, oi na uraheni dalana ai to rakamu. Keriso ese ia dainai e mase; oi ese amu aniani dainai basio hamasea.
ROM.14.15.english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

ROM.2.21.motu: Matona, bamomu o hadibadiamu, to sibomu to hahedibamu a? O haroromu, o tomamu taunimanima basie henao, a ḡau be oi o heuda hanaimu a?
ROM.2.21.english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

ROM.16.15.motu: Filologo, bona Iulia, bona Nerea, mai taihuna ida, bona Olumupa, bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai idia ida e nohomu, ba hanamodia.
ROM.16.15.english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

ROM.7.14.motu: Dibada taravatu be lauma ena; a lau be tau-anina ena, kara dika ese vada e hoigu, ena hesiai ai vada e halaogu.
ROM.7.14.english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

ROM.10.18.motu: A lau na tomamu idia na asie kamonai a? Lasi, e kamonai.
ROM.10.18.english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly,

ROM.7.20.motu: Taunabunai, asina ura heniamu karana na karaiamu, to ikarana na dia lau, a dika lalogu ai e nohomu hari.
ROM.7.20.english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

ROM.12.11.motu: Ḡaukara lalonai basio lahedo. Lauma na lalomui ai baine hururu. Lohiabada isiaina ba lao heni.
ROM.12.11.english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

ROM.12.15.motu: E moalemu taudia ida ba moale; e taitaimu taudia ida ba tai.
ROM.12.15.english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

ROM.6.10.motu: Badina be e mase negana ai, ia na kara dika enai e mase vaitani, a e maurimu be Dirava enai e maurimu.
ROM.6.10.english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

ROM.11.29.motu: Badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada bona ena abi-hidi na se idaumu.
ROM.11.29.english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

ROM.3.17.motu: Bona maino dalana na asi dibadia.
ROM.3.17.english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.” + 3:17 Isaiah 59:7-8

ROM.4.24.motu: a ita danu, Iesu, eda Lohiabada, mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana ta abidadama heniamu tauda, maoroda e gwaurai.
ROM.4.24.english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

ROM.11.12.motu: Ḡau tamona, idia edia keto dainai tanobada bema taḡa, bona idia edia dabu dainai bese idau-idau bema boga kunu, o edia honuhonu-dae amo dahaka namona bema vara?
ROM.11.12.english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

ROM.5.16.motu: Tau tamona ena kara dika be idau, harihari-bada be idau; badina be tau tamona dainai hahemaoro ese hahedika e gwauraia, a harihari-bada ese kara dika taudia hutuma maorodia eme gwaurai.
ROM.5.16.english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

ROM.11.28.motu: Umui daimui ai idia ese sivarai namo e inai heniamu; a Dirava ese senedia e abidia hidi dainai e ura henidiamu.
ROM.11.28.english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

ROM.13.11.motu: Nega be dibamui: mahuta amo ba noga horana vada be kaumu. Badina be ta kamonai matama negana ai eda hahemauri na dauhai, a harihari ia na vada kahikahi.
ROM.13.11.english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

ROM.4.1.motu: Seneda Abraham na ede baita herevalaia toma? Ia ese dahaka ḡau e davaria?
ROM.4.1.english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

ROM.9.15.motu: Ia ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Na bogalaidia taudia na baina bogalaidia; na bogadia hisi taudia na baina bogadia hisi.
ROM.9.15.english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.” + 9:15 Exodus 33:19

ROM.3.26.motu: Oibe, ena kara maoromaoro na ina negana ai vada eme hedinarai: sibona vada eme maoromaoro, bona Iesu e abidadama heniamu tauna maorona e gwauraiamu.
ROM.3.26.english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

ROM.8.21.motu: ena helaro be e kara ḡaudia na mase ena iḡui amo bae heruha nege, bona Dirava natuna edia ura-kwalimu herea-daena bae abia.
ROM.8.21.english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

ROM.1.24.motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ese e kahudia nege, edia heḡahusi bodagadia bae ḡava, bena sibodia bae hahedika.
ROM.1.24.english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

ROM.11.2.motu: Ena bese, e dibadia guna taudia, na Dirava ese se negedia. Buka Helaḡa ai Elia e herevalaia herevana asi dibamui a? Ia ese Israel taudia e habadelaidia Dirava vairanai, eto,
ROM.11.2.english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

ROM.16.14.motu: Asunukrito bona Flegon bona Hereme bona Patroba bona Herema, mai bamodia ida, ba hanamodia.
ROM.16.14.english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

ROM.15.1.motu: Ita goada tauda na manoka taudia edia manoka baita huahai, dia ita siboda eda moale basita tahua.
ROM.15.1.english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

ROM.1.12.motu: Bona na tomanm umui bona lau eda heabidadama dainai baita hahealo heheni.
ROM.1.12.english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

ROM.10.9.motu: udumu ai Iesu Lohiabadana ba gwaurai, bona lalomu ai bavabia dae Dirava ese mase amo e hatorea isi; bena ba mauri.
ROM.10.9.english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

ROM.5.15.motu: A kara dika na idau, harihari-bada danu idau. Badina be tau ta ena kara dika dainai hutuma e mase; a harihari, Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai, bona ena harihari-bada ese e havaraia herahiana, Iesu Keriso, dainai, hutuma eme mauri.
ROM.5.15.english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

ROM.8.17.motu: Ita na ia natuna, taunabunai ita na ia dihina danu. Ita na Dirava dihina, Keriso ida, taunabunai ia ida baita hisihisi hebou, bena ia ida hairaida baita abi hebou.
ROM.8.17.english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

ROM.15.7.motu: Taunabunai ba heabi-dae heheni, Keriso ese umui e abimui dae heḡereḡerena, Dirava iheatolaina.
ROM.15.7.english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

ROM.13.12.motu: Hanuaboi vada e ore, daba vada eme kahikahi; taunabunai dibura karadia baita nege, diari baita abia, eda kesi ai baita halaoa.
ROM.13.12.english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

ROM.2.6.motu: Ia ese taunimanima iboudiai edia kara heḡereḡerena davadia do baine henidia hagau-hagau:
ROM.2.6.english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:” + 2:6 Psalms 62:12; Proverbs 24:12

ROM.10.10.motu: Badina be lalo ena heabidadama amo kara maoromaoro e varamu, bona udu ena hegwaurai amo mauri e varamu.
ROM.10.10.english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

ROM.13.2.motu: Taunabunai, lohia e laoa ahumu tauna ese Dirava ena haheḡani e gwaua tubumu; bona e gwaua tubumu taudia ese davadia do bae abi.
ROM.13.2.english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

ROM.8.7.motu: Tau-anina ilalona ese Dirava e inai heniamu, badina be Dirava ena taravatu se badinaiamu bona ibadinana asi dibana.
ROM.8.7.english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

ROM.10.16.motu: A haida na sivarai namo asie kamonai henia. Isaia eto, Lohiabada e, daika ese emai hereva vada e abi dae?
ROM.10.16.english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?” + 10:16 Isaiah 53:1

ROM.6.12.motu: Kara dika ese tau-animui basine lohiadia; ena hekise-hekise basio kamonai henia.
ROM.6.12.english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

ROM.1.21.motu: Badina be Dirava na dibadia, to edia Dirava ai asie halaoa, asie heatolaia, bona asie hanamoa; edia lalo-hadai vada e kavakava, bona lalo-duhu ese lalodia vada e hadiburadia.
ROM.1.21.english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

ROM.16.23.motu: Gaio, lauegu badiholo tauna bona ekalesia taudia iboudiai edia badiholo tauna, ese e hanamomuimu. Erasto, hanua monina inarina tauna, bona Koato, ekalesia tauna ta, ese danu e hanamomuimu.
ROM.16.23.english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

ROM.1.22.motu: Sibodia e tomava mai aonegadia, a ḡau be kavakava taudia ai ela;
ROM.1.22.english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

ROM.7.25.motu: Dirava na imodaiamu, Iesu Keriso bagunai. Benaini, lalogu ese Dirava ena taravatu e badinaiamu; a tau-anigu ese kara dika taravatuna e badinaiamu.
ROM.7.25.english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

ROM.14.26.english: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

ROM.15.25.motu: A ina harihari lau na Ierusalem ba laomu, helaḡa taudia ikahadia totona.
ROM.15.25.english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

ROM.12.3.motu: E henigu hariharina dainai umui ta ta na haduamuimu, basio hekokoroku, a lalomui bae manau, Dirava ese heabidadama ahuna ta ta e henimui hagauhagau heḡereḡerena.
ROM.12.3.english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

ROM.14.19.motu: Benaini, maino daladia baita tahu, bona baita hahegoada heheni.
ROM.14.19.english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

ROM.8.38.motu: Badina be lau vada na diba vaitani, ḡau ta asi goadana, mase eiava mauri, eiava aneru, eiava lohia hereadia, eiava siahu ḡaudia, eiava harihari e miamu ḡaudia, eiava gabeai bae vara gaudia,
ROM.8.38.english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

ROM.9.24.motu: Gaudia be ita, e boiridia tauda, dia Iuda laumai mo, a bese idau-idau taumui danu.
ROM.9.24.english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

ROM.8.8.motu: Tau-anina ilalona ai e nohomu taudia na Dirava ihamoalena asi dibadia.
ROM.8.8.english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

ROM.14.9.motu: Ina dainai Keriso e mase bona e mauri lou, mase taudia bona mauri taudia biagudia ai bainela totona.
ROM.14.9.english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

ROM.15.17.motu: Dirava ena ḡaukara na karaiamu bona na heaḡilaiamu, Iesu Keriso bagunai.
ROM.15.17.english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

ROM.13.7.motu: Iboudiai na ena ḡau ena ḡau ba henidia: tax gogo tauna tax ba henia; heni-tao inarina tauna heni-tao ba henia; garina e garimu tauna ba gari henia; e matauraiamu tauna ba matauria.
ROM.13.7.english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

ROM.1.13.motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu ba diba, nega hoho baina vasi nato, to e laogu ahumu ema bona harihari; egu ura be huahuamui baina davaria, bese idau-idau ediai vada na abi heḡereḡerena.
ROM.1.13.english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

ROM.4.14.motu: Badina be taravatu ibadinana taudia na dihi ai bema halaodia, abidadama taudia edia abidadama bema asi anina, gwauhamata danu asi anina.
ROM.4.14.english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

ROM.3.27.motu: Bena heaḡi na edeseni? Vada eme hegwau tao. Edena taravatu bona edena kara ese e gwaua tao? Lasi. Abidadama ese e gwaua taomu.
ROM.3.27.english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

ROM.9.22.motu: Readia Dirava ena ura be ena badu bona ena siahu baine hahedinarai, bena ia ese badu ḡaudia e haheauka henidia ela bona e hebua tari.
ROM.9.22.english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

ROM.8.13.motu: Badina be tau-anina ena ura ba kara, vada ba mase; a lauma ena amo tau-anina ena kara ba hamase, ba mauri.
ROM.8.13.english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

ROM.2.4.motu: Eiava, ena harihari-bada, ena haheauka bona ena hebogahisi o dadaraimu, matona asi dibamu Dirava ena harihari-bada ese e hakaumumu helalo dalana ai a?
ROM.2.4.english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

ROM.3.28.motu: Taunabunai ita ta tomamu tau ta maorona e gwauraiamu be dia taravatu ibadinana dainai, a abidadama dainai.
ROM.3.28.english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

ROM.13.14.motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ba hadokilaia, bona tau-animui edia ura dikadia basio abi dae.
ROM.13.14.english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

ROM.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taugu, e boirigu ena aposetolo tauna ai bainala, bona e hahelagagu Dirava ena sivarai namo baina harorolaia.
ROM.1.1.english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

ROM.7.18.motu: Lau dibagu lau na asi egu namo tau-anigu ai, badina be lalogu ese kara namo e ura henimu, to ikarana asina heḡereḡere.
ROM.7.18.english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

ROM.3.15.motu: Aedia e heaumu, rara ihahebubuna totona;
ROM.3.15.english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

ROM.12.19.motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, dika basio hadavaia; badu baine mia. Badina be vada e torea, Lohiabada eto “Dava be lau imagu ai, lau ese baina karaia”.
ROM.12.19.english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” + 12:19 Deuteronomy 32:35

ROM.8.25.motu: A helaro be asita itaiamu ḡauna baita naria mai haheaukada ida.
ROM.8.25.english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

ROM.7.3.motu: Taunabunai, adavana maurina ai tau ta ma bema abia, ia na heuda-hanai hahinena; a adavana baine mase, ia na asi taravatuna, tau ta ma baine adavaia, una na dia heuda-hanai.
ROM.7.3.english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

ROM.9.1.motu: Lau na Keriso ladana ai na hereva momokanimu, asina koikoimu, Lauma Helaḡa danu dibana; lalogu na e tomamu
ROM.9.1.english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

ROM.4.18.motu: Ena helaro na e kara asi badina na heto, to abidadama dainai e helarova; taunabunai ia na bese loḡora tamadia ai ela, gwauhamata herevana heḡereḡerena eto, Garamu na unu bae hoho toma.
ROM.4.18.english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.” + 4:18 Genesis 15:5

ROM.8.23.motu: bona dia idia mo: ita danu, Lauma natuna roboadia, laloda ai ta ḡanaḡanamu, baine abida dae bona tau-anida baine hamauridia negana ta nariamu.
ROM.8.23.english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

ROM.8.16.motu: Lauma ese ita laumada ida e gwau boumu, e gwauraidamu, ita na Dirava natuna.
ROM.8.16.english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

ROM.8.28.motu: Ita dibada ḡau iboudiai e ḡaukara boumu, Dirava e ura heniamu bona Dirava ese e abidia hidi taudia ihanamodia.
ROM.8.28.english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

ROM.8.26.motu: Unuhetomana danu Lauma ese eda manoka-manoka ai e kahadamu; badina be ita na ḡuriḡuri maoromaorodia asi dibada, a Lauma ese ita daidai e ḡuriḡurimu mai ḡanaḡana badana ida.
ROM.8.26.english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

ROM.2.10.motu: a kara namo taudia ese hairai bona hemataurai bona maino bae davari, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia.
ROM.2.10.english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

ROM.11.5.motu: Benaini, harihari danu taunimanima kwabu-kwabudia mo nonoho, harihari-bada ese vada e abidia hidi.
ROM.11.5.english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

ROM.11.31.motu: Unuhetomana, idia na harihari e gwau edeedemu, a hebogahisi do bae davaria, umui emui hebogahisi dainai.
ROM.11.31.english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

ROM.16.17.motu: Varavaragu e, heai taudia bona hekwakwanai ihavaradia taudia nahuada ba toho. Hahediba herevadia vada a henimui na idia ese e tata utumu; edia amo ba raka ohu.
ROM.16.17.english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

ROM.16.11.motu: Varavaragu Herodion ba hanamoa. Narakiso ena ruma taudia ba hanamodia; idia na Lohiabada ena orea taudia.
ROM.16.11.english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

ROM.11.13.motu: Idau bese taumui, na hereva henimuimu: badina be lau na aposetolo taugu bese idau-idau emui ai; egu dagi danu na heaḡilaiamu.
ROM.11.13.english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

ROM.13.3.motu: Badina be kara namo tauna na lohia garina se garimu, a kara dika tauna hari. Oi o uramu lohia garina basio gari a? Kara namo ba kara, bena ia ese haine hanamomu;
ROM.13.3.english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

ROM.1.19.motu: Dirava herevana dibadia, badina be Dirava ese lalodia ai vada e hahedinaraia;
ROM.1.19.english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

ROM.15.27.motu: Idia na unu e kara toma mai moaledia ida; e haeroa, idia na ima-doa taudia na heheto. Badina be lauma ḡaudia vada e abi; bena tau-ani ḡaudia ma bae heni lao eto.
ROM.15.27.english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

ROM.4.22.english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.” + 4:22 Genesis 15:6

ROM.9.9.motu: Badina be gwauhamata na binai: Laḡani vairai, nega inihetomana ai, lau na bainama, bena Sara ese mero ta baine abia.
ROM.9.9.english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.” + 9:9 Genesis 18:10,14

ROM.9.20.motu: E tau e, oi be daika, Dirava ena hereva o gwau tubumu? E karaia ḡauna ese ikarana tauna baine nanadaia, baineto “Dahaka dainai ini o karagu toma”, a?
ROM.9.20.english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?” + 9:20 Isaiah 29:16; 45:9

ROM.10.21.motu: A ia ese Israel e herevalaia, eto, Dina idoinai gwau-edeede bona gwautubu besena na imagu na pala henia.
ROM.10.21.english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.” + 10:21 Isaiah 65:2
