ROM.16.2.motu: Lohiabada bagunai bavabia dae, ani, helaḡa taudia o abidia daemu na heto; bona ena ḡaukara ai ba durua. Badina be ia ese hutuma vada e durudia; bona lau danu eme durugu.
ROM.16.2.english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

ROM.2.19.motu: oi na mata-kepulu taudia o hakaudiamu, bona dibura ai e nohomu taudia edia diari ai o laomu,
ROM.2.19.english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

ROM.9.7.motu: Basitato Abraham ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na ia natuna. A buka e tomamu, Isaak ena amo oi garamu do bae vara.
ROM.9.7.english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.” + 9:7 Genesis 21:12

ROM.12.8.motu: haroro tauna baine haroro; ihenina tauna baine henia mai moalena ida; ireḡuna tauna baine hereḡu mai goadana ida; hebogahisi tauna baine hebogahisi mai lalo-namona ida.
ROM.12.8.english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

ROM.13.4.motu: ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna, taunabunai baine hanamomu. A kara dika boma kara be ia garina boma gari; badina be ia ese dare se abia kavamu. Ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna; kara dika tauna davana baine henia.
ROM.13.4.english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

ROM.16.10.motu: bona Apele, Keriso enai e gini tutukatutukamu tauna, iboudiai ba hanamodia.
ROM.16.10.english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

ROM.14.20.motu: Dirava ena ḡaukara basio hadikaia, aniani ḡauna dainai. Momokani, ḡau iboudiai na goḡoeva-gogoeva; to mai daradarana baine aniani tauna ana aniani na dika ienai.
ROM.14.20.english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

ROM.4.12.motu: Bona e peritomedia to peritome asie abidadama heniamu, edia abidadama na seneda Abraham ena abidadama, do se peritomea negana ai, e tohotohoamu taudia: ia na idia tamadia danu.
ROM.4.12.english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

ROM.2.16.motu: Egu sivarai namo hegereḡerena, dinana baine kau ai Dirava ese taunimanima edia hehuni karadia baine hahemloro henidia, Iesu Keriso bagunai.
ROM.2.16.english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

ROM.10.8.motu: Ma e tomu “Hereva na dekemu ai, udumu ai, lalomu ai”. Heabidadama herevana binai ai ese a harorolaiamu:
ROM.10.8.english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” + 10:8 Deuteronomy 30:14 that is, the word of faith which we preach:

ROM.11.22.motu: Dirava ena hebogahisi bona ena lalo-auka ba haero: e keto taudia ediai lalona e aukamu; a oi na e bogamu hisi, ena hebogahisi o badinaiamu negana ai. A basio badinaia, ia na baine utumu oho.
ROM.11.22.english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

ROM.12.18.motu: Bema mai dalana, taunimanima iboudiai ida ba noho mai mainomui ida.
ROM.12.18.english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

ROM.14.17.motu: Badina be Dirava ena basileia na dia aniani ḡauna eiava inuinu ḡauna; a kara maoromaoro bona maino bona moale, Lauma Helaḡa bagunai.
ROM.14.17.english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

ROM.7.8.motu: A taravatu ena hahedua dainai dika ese hekisehekise idau-idau lalogu ai e havara; badina be taravatu bema lasi, dika bema mase.
ROM.7.8.english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

ROM.16.6.motu: Maria danu ba hanamoa; ia na umui daimui ai vada e hekwarahi bada.
ROM.16.6.english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

ROM.4.25.motu: Ia taona e torea, iseda kara dika daidiai; ma mase amo e tore isi, maoroda baine gwaurai helaoreana.
ROM.4.25.english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

ROM.4.15.motu: Taravatu ese badu e havaraiamu; badina be taravatu bema lasi, itata-utuna danu bema lasi.
ROM.4.15.english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

ROM.15.24.motu: Taunabunai, Spania baina lao henia negana ai baina vasi; badina be na uramu egu laolao ai baina itamui, umui ida baita noho nega taina, bena dala ai ba hakaugu.
ROM.15.24.english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

ROM.16.24.motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
ROM.16.24.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

ROM.5.5.motu: Helaro danu basine doko; badina be Lauma Helaḡa vada tame abia, bena ia ese Dirava ena uraheni na laloda ai vada eme vedaia.
ROM.5.5.english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

ROM.6.18.motu: Kara dika amo e ruhamui nege; kara maoromaoro enai vada e ḡuimui kau.
ROM.6.18.english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

ROM.8.32.motu: Ia ese Natuna vara-edeana se rua, a ita iboudai daidai e kahua nege; benaini, ḡau iboudiai ia ida basine henida a?
ROM.8.32.english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

ROM.8.36.motu: Buka ai a torea heḡeregerena, eto,

ROM.10.3.motu: Badina be Dirava ena kara maoromaoro asi dibadia; sibo-lia edia kara maoromaoro e goadalaiamu, a Dirava ena kara maoromaoro asie badinaiamu.
ROM.10.3.english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

ROM.12.7.motu: bema hesiai lao-heni, hesiai baita lao heni; hahediba tauna baine hahediba;
ROM.12.7.english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

ROM.1.9.motu: Natuna ena sivarai namo isiaina laumagu ai na laohenimu Diravana na mai dibana, lauegu ḡuriḡuri na asi dokona umui daimui ai,
ROM.1.9.english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

ROM.6.13.motu: Bona taumui reḡedia na kara dika basio henia, isiaina basie lao heni; a taumui na Dirava ba henia, mase amo e roho mauri taudia na heheto, bona taumui reḡedia danu ia ba henia, kara maoromaoro ikarana ḡaudia ai baela.
ROM.6.13.english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

ROM.12.20.motu: Taunabunai, inaimu bema hitolo, ana boma henia; bema ranu mase, ranu boma henia; unu ba kara toma, e kara lahi gidadia kwarana tubuana ai ba giḡi kau na heto.

ROM.9.18.motu: Taunabunai, ena ura heḡereḡerena haida e bogadia hisi, ma haida lalodia e ha-aukadia.
ROM.9.18.english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

ROM.14.22.motu: Oi na mai emu abidadama, ani? Dirava bavabidadama henia. Sibona dikana se gwauraiamu ena kara dainai, una tau na namo.
ROM.14.22.english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

ROM.7.16.motu: A asina ura heniamu karana na karaiamu negana ai, lau ese taravatu na maorona na gwauraiamu.
ROM.7.16.english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

ROM.12.9.motu: Emui uraheni baine momokani. Dika ba lalo nege; namo enai ba tao.
ROM.12.9.english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

ROM.3.11.english: There is no one who understands.

RUT.2.17.motu: Taunabunai ia na uma ai ma e gogo ela bona ado e rahi. Bena e gwadaia, momona e negea, bali efa ta heḡereḡerena e abia.
RUT.2.17.english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

RUT.3.5.motu: Ruta eto, Emu hahedua heḡereḡerena baina karaia.
RUT.3.5.english: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”

RUT.1.16.motu: A Ruta eto, Basio haḡanigu, basioto baina rakatanimu; badina be oi baola gabuna lau danu bainala, bona oi ba noho gabuna lau danu baina noho; oiemu bese na lauegu bese ai bainela, bona oiemu Dirava na lauegu Dirava ai bainela;
RUT.1.16.english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

RUT.2.4.motu: Bena Boa na Betelehem amo ema, bali iutuna taudia e hanamodia, eto, Iehova ese baine bamomui. Idia na e haere, eto, Iehova ese baine hanamomu.
RUT.2.4.english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.”

RUT.1.1.motu: Nega ta, hahemaoro taudia ese tano e lohiaia negana ai, doe bada-hereana e vara. Una negana ai, Betelehem-iuda tauna ta mai adavana bona mai natuna mamaruanedia rarua ida edia hanua e toretania, Moab tanona ai eha noho.
RUT.1.1.english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.

RUT.4.14.motu: Bena hanua hahinedia ese Naomi e hereva henia, eto, Iehova aita hanamoa, badina be hari dina ai oi garamu vada e henimu. Ia ladana baine bada Israel ai.
RUT.4.14.english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.

RUT.4.11.motu: Bena hanua ikoukouna ai e helaiva taudia bona hanua tau-badadia eto, Ai na vada a itaia bona vada a kamonai. Iehova ese emu ruma ai be dae kaumu hahinena na Rahela bona Lea, Israel besena ihavarana hahinedia, heḡereḡeredia ai baine halaoa. Oi danu Efrata ai ba taḡa, bona Betelehem ai harimu baine namo;
RUT.4.11.english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

RUT.1.2.motu: Una tau ladana na Elimelek; adavana ladana na Naomi; natuna mamaruanedia raruosi ladadia be Malon bona Kilion. Idia na Efrata taudia, Betelehem-iuda amo; Moab tanona ai e kau, unuseni ai e nohova.
RUT.1.2.english: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.

RUT.2.6.motu: Bali iutuna taudia ireḡudia tauna ese e haere henia, eto, Una na Moab hahinena, Naomi ida Moab tanona amo ema.
RUT.2.6.english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

RUT.1.4.motu: Idia raruosi ese Moab ulatodia rarua e adavadia; ta ladana be Oropa, ma ta ladana be Ruta. Edia headava murinai idia na unuseni ai e nohova ela bona laḡani gwauta e ore.
RUT.1.4.english: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

RUT.1.19.motu: Taunabunai, raruosi e raka bou, ela bona Betelehem ai e kau. Betelehem ai e kau negana ai hanua taudia iboudiai e heau bou heau bou ema; bena hahine na eto, Ina na Naomi a?
RUT.1.19.english: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”

RUT.3.7.motu: Boa na e aniani bona e inuinu vaitani, bena mai moalena ida e hekure diho, uit senuna gwaduna ai. Bena Ruta na asi reḡereḡena ela, hetaru na aena amo e abia isi, e hekure diho.
RUT.3.7.english: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.

RUT.3.15.motu: Bena ia ese hahine na e hereva henia, eto, O dokiamu dabuana a mailaia, avabia papa. Hahine na e abia papa, bena Boa ese bali efa tauratoi e uda, e henia, baine laohaia; bena hahine na hanua e lou lao.
RUT.3.15.english: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.

RUT.4.13.motu: Taunabunai Boa ese Ruta e abia, e adavaia. Raruosi e eno bou, bona Iehova ese hahine e hanamoa; bena hahine na e rogorogo, mero ta e abia.
RUT.4.13.english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

RUT.3.8.motu: Malokihi, Boa na e noga, e hoa, e helai tore, hahine na e itaia, ia aena badinai e hekure.
RUT.3.8.english: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.

RUT.3.17.motu: Ma eto, Ia danu bali efa tauratoiosi bini e henigu, eto “Ima kavakava ai ravamu basio lou henia”.
RUT.3.17.english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”

RUT.1.21.motu: Mai ahugu nala, a Iehova ese ima kavakava vada e halougu. Dahaka dainai ladagu o hatoamu Naomi; a Iehova ese vada e hahemaoro henigu, bona Ḡaubada ese vada e hahisigu?
RUT.1.21.english: I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

RUT.2.14.motu: Aniani negana ai, Boa ese e hereva henia, eto, Ini aoma, flaoa ba bitua, vine ranuna ai ba urua diho. Hahine na bali iutuna taudia bogaragidiai e helai diho. Bena Boa ese e gabua balina taina e henia; hahine ese e abia, e ania, bogana e kunu, bahuna danu mia.
RUT.2.14.english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.”

RUT.2.11.motu: Boa ese e haere henia, eto, Harimu vada na kamonai, adavamu e mase murinai ravamu ede o karaia toma; tamamu bona sinamu bona o vara tanona o rakatanidia, ai idau taumai bogaragimai ai oma.
RUT.2.11.english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

RUT.2.3.motu: Bena ia na ela, bali iutuna taudia muridia amo e raka, bali anidia momorudia e gogova.
RUT.2.3.english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

RUT.2.23.motu: Taunabunai ia na Boa ena hesiai hahinedia ida e raka bou, momoru e gogo, ela bona bali iutuna bona uit iutuna vada e ore. Rava-bada hahinena dekenai e nohova.
RUT.2.23.english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.

RUT.1.8.motu: A Naomi ese ravana raruosi e haduadia, eto, Madi, sinamui edia ruma ba lou heni; Iehova ese baine hanamomui, umui ese mase taudia o hanamodiava bona lau vada o hanamogu heḡereḡerena;
RUT.1.8.english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

RUT.1.3.motu: Bena Elimelek, Naomi adavana, unuseni ai e mase; una hahine mai natuna raruosi ida e noho hedoava.
RUT.1.3.english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.

RUT.2.22.motu: Naomi ese ravana Ruta e hamaoroa, eto, Ravagu, namona binai, iena hesiai hahinedia ida ba raka bou, idau uma ai dika emu ai baine kau na garina.
RUT.2.22.english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”

RUT.2.1.motu: Naomi adavana varavarana ta noho, taga tauna, Elimelek ena iduhu tauna, ladana na Boa.
RUT.2.1.english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

RUT.4.7.motu: Nega gunadia ai Israel taudia edia kara na iniheto, tano e hoihoilai negadia ai: hoihoi ihamomokanina toana na tau ta ese ena tamaka ta e kokia oho, ena tano e hoia tauna e henia. Ihamomokanina toana bunai Israel ai.
RUT.4.7.english: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

RUT.2.19.motu: Ravana ese e nanadaia, eto, Edeseni ai bali anidia o gogo hari ina dina ai? Edeseni ai o ḡaukara? E hageremu tauna na Dirava ese baine hanamoa. Bena ia ese ena ḡaukara gabuna na ravana e hadibalaia, eto, Dekenai na ḡaukara tauna hari dina ai ladana be Boa.
RUT.2.19.english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.”

RUT.4.8.motu: Taunabunai hari tau ese Boa e hamaoroa, eto, Oi ese bavabia; bena ena tamaka ta e kokia oho.
RUT.4.8.english: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.

RUT.3.1.motu: Ravana Naomi ese Ruta e hereva henia, eto, Ravagu e, emu noho gabuna ta baina lailaia bena unuseni ai ba noho namonamo ani?
RUT.3.1.english: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?

RUT.2.9.motu: Bali e utuamu gabuna ba itaia tao: idia muridiai ba raka. Eregabe taudia vada na taravadia, emu ai basie dau kau. Ba ranu mase negadia ai danu hodu ba lao henidia, eregabe taudia vada e utua ranuna taina ba inua.
RUT.2.9.english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

RUT.2.13.motu: Hahine na eto, Egu lohia e, vada o lalo namo henigu; ena be lau na dia oiemu hesiai hahinedia heḡereḡeredia to oi ese taugu vada o haloa bona hereva namodia amo vada o hanamogu.
RUT.2.13.english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”

RUT.3.14.motu: Taunabunai, ia na ia aena badinai e hekure ela bona daba. Daba vaburana ai, taunimanima do basie heita heheni negana ai, ia na e tore isi. Boa ese e hahedua, eto, Tau ta basine diba hari hahine na gwada-gwada gabuna ema.
RUT.3.14.english: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”

RUT.1.13.motu: umui boma haheauka noho ela bona idia taudia bema lo a? Boma noho vado idia daidiai a? Lasi, ravagu e. Ḡau tamona, lalogu eme hisihisi umui daimui ai, badina be Iehova ese vada e murigu.
RUT.1.13.english: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for Yahweh’s hand has gone out against me.”

RUT.3.12.motu: Momokani, lau na adavamu e mase tauna varavarana; ḡau tamona, ia varavara-dosina ta do noho.
RUT.3.12.english: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.

RUT.4.12.motu: emu ruma taudia danu Perese Iuda, Tamara bogana amo e vara tauna, ena ruma taudia heḡereḡeredia ai baela, Iehova ese ina eregabe hahinena ena amo natumu baine henimu dainai.
RUT.4.12.english: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”

RUT.4.20.motu: Aminadab ese Nason e havaraia; Nason ese Salmon e havaraia;
RUT.4.20.english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,

RUT.1.12.motu: Ravagu e, a lou, emui dala ai baola; lau be vada name buruka, basina headava lou. A bama headava lou, hari ina hanuaboi bama headava, natugu mamaruanedia bama havaradia,
RUT.1.12.english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

RUT.1.22.motu: Unuhetomana Naomi na Moab tanona amo e lou, ravana Ruta, hane Moab, danu ia ida. Bali iutuna e matamaia negana ai Betelehem ai e kau.
RUT.1.22.english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

RUT.4.2.motu: Bena Boa ese hanua tau-badadia gwauta e boiridia, eto, Mani a helai diho. Bena e helai diho.
RUT.4.2.english: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.

RUT.3.4.motu: Bena baine hekure negana ai ena hekure gabuna do ba itaia, gabeai ba raka vareai, ena hetaru aena amo bavabia isi, ba hekure diho; bena ede ba kara toma ia ese baine hadibamu.
RUT.3.4.english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”

RUT.1.17.motu: oi ba mase gabuna ai lau danu baina mase, unuseni ai bae gurigu. Ḡau ta ese basine hapararada, mase mo sibona; mauri ai baina rakatanimu, Iehova ese dava badana baine henigu, ma baine hametaua danu.
RUT.1.17.english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

RUT.4.5.motu: Boa ma eto, Tano Naomi imana amo bavabia dinana ai, Ruta, hane Moab, mase tauna vabuna, danu bavabia, mase tauna dihina ihavarana totona.
RUT.4.5.english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

RUT.4.3.motu: Bena ia ese hari tau e hereva henia, eto, Naomi na Moab tanona amo vada e lou mai, bona e uramu varavarada Elimelek ena tano baine hoia e tomu.
RUT.4.3.english: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.

RUT.2.2.motu: Ruta, hane Moab, ese Naomi e hamaoroa, eto, Mani uma bainala, baine lalo namo henigu tauna murinai baina raka, bali anidia momorudia baina gogodia. Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Ravagu, vada aola.
RUT.2.2.english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.”

RUT.1.14.motu: Ma e taitai louva; bena Oropa ese ravana e hatonia, a Ruta na se rakatania.
RUT.1.14.english: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

RUT.3.10.motu: Boa eto, Natugu e, Iehova ese baine hanamomu; ina emu kara namona gini-gabena ese emu kara namona gini-gunana vada e hereaia: badina be oi na uhau, mai edia ogoḡami eiava mai edia taḡa, so sihari henidia.
RUT.3.10.english: He said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.

RUT.4.9.motu: Bena Boa ese hanua tau-badadia bona hanua taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Hari dina ai umui ese vada o itaia bona vada o kamonai lau ese Naomi ena amo Elimelek ena ḡau idoinai bona Kilion ena ḡau idoinai bona Malon ena ḡau idoinai vada na hoi;
RUT.4.9.english: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.

RUT.4.1.motu: Boa na hanua ikoukouna ela, unuseni ai e helai diho; bena hari mase tauna varavara-dosina, Boa ese e herevalaia tauna, e raka hanai. Boa ese e boi henia, eto, Turagu e, mani aoma, iniseni ai a helai. Bena hari tau ema, e helai diho.
RUT.4.1.english: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.

RUT.4.18.motu: Perese garana bini: Perese ese Hesron e havaraia;
RUT.4.18.english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,

RUT.1.6.motu: Taunabunai, ia mai ravana hahinedia raruosi ida e heḡaegae, Moab bae toretania, hahine badana ena tano bae lou henia; badina be harina ienai vada e kau Moab ai, Iehova ese ena abi-hidi taudia vada e bogadia hisi, adia vada e henidia.
RUT.1.6.english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.

RUT.3.18.motu: Ravana eto, Natugu e, ba henari ela bona ba diba ede baine kara toma: badina be hari tau na laḡana basine ania to han dina ai ina ḡau baine haḡuḡurua.
RUT.3.18.english: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”

RUT.4.16.motu: Bena Naomi ese mero karukaruna e abia, e rosia, bona e reḡua.
RUT.4.16.english: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.

RUT.4.21.motu: Salmon ese Boa e havaraia; Boa ese Obed e havaraia;
RUT.4.21.english: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,

RUT.3.2.motu: Varavarada Boa, ena hesiai hahinedia o bamodia tauna, na hari ina hanuaboi ena bali e tapoamu, ena gwada-gwada gabuna ai.
RUT.3.2.english: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.

RUT.3.9.motu: Ia eto, Oi be daika? Hahine na e haere, eto, Lau binai Ruta, emu hesiai hahinena; emu hesiai hahinena ba tarugu, badina be oi na adavagu e mase tauna varavarana.

RUT.4.15.motu: Ia ese emu mauri baine hamatamataia, bona burukamu ai baine narimu; badina be ravamu, e lalokau henimumu hahinena, tatau hahitu e hereadiamu hahinena, ia ese vada e havaraia.
RUT.4.15.english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”

RUT.3.3.motu: Taunabunai, a digu, kopimu dehoro amo ba dahua, emu dabua namona ba hahedokia, bena hari gwadagwada gabuna baola; to ienai basio hedinarai ela bona baine aniani bona baine inuinu vaitani.
RUT.3.3.english: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

RUT.1.15.motu: Naomi eto, A itaia, bamomu ese ena bese taudia bona ena dirava vada e lou henidia; ia murinai ba raka.
RUT.1.15.english: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”

RUT.2.20.motu: Bena Naomi ese ravana e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, nega idoidiai mauri taudia bona mase taudia e bogadia hisimu Diravana, ese ia baine hanamoa. Naomi ma eto, Una tau na iseda iduhu tauna, ita varavarada.
RUT.2.20.english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by Yahweh, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

RUT.1.18.motu: Rava-bada hahinena ese e itaia, Ruta na lalona vada e ha-aukaia baine bamoa; bena ia na hereva ta se gwauraia.
RUT.1.18.english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

RUT.3.16.motu: Ravana dekenai e kau negana ai, ravana ese e nanadaia, eto, Natugu e, edeheto? Bena ia ese Boa ena kara idoinai sivaraina e gwauraia.
RUT.3.16.english: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?”

RUT.3.6.motu: Taunabunai ia na hari gwada-gwada gabuna ela, ravana ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena e karaia.
RUT.3.6.english: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.

RUT.1.7.motu: Bena ena noho gabuna e rakatania, ia mai ravana raruosi ida, Iuda dalana a e raka ela.
RUT.1.7.english: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

RUT.2.5.motu: Bena Boa ese bali iutuna taudia ireḡudia tauna e nanadaia, eto, Una na daika ena hesiai hahinena?
RUT.2.5.english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

RUT.4.6.motu: Bena hari tau eto, Lau na basina abia diba, sibogu dihigu ai baina dabu na garina. Oi ese bavabia, badina be lau be basina abia diba.
RUT.4.6.english: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”

RUT.2.12.motu: Iehova ese davamu baine henimu, emu kara heḡereḡerena; Iehova, Israel taumai emai Dirava, hanina henunai o gorumu Diravana, ese davamu namona baine henimu.
RUT.2.12.english: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

RUT.2.21.motu: Ruta, hane Moab, eto, Ia danu e hamaorogu, eto “Egu eregabe taudia badibadidiai ba noho ela bona egu taboro baine ore”.
RUT.2.21.english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

RUT.4.22.motu: Obed ese Iese e havaraia; Iese ese David e havaraia.
RUT.4.22.english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

RUT.1.5.motu: Bena Malon bona Kilion raruosi e mase; sinadia na sibona e nohova, asi adavana bona asi natuna.
RUT.1.5.english: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.

RUT.2.16.motu: bona iḡui amo bali anidia haida ba buruki, tano ai ba nege, bena baine gogo; basio gwau henia.
RUT.2.16.english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”

RUT.2.10.motu: Bena hahine na tano ai e goru diho, eto, Dahaka dainai lau, idau hahinena, o lalo namo henigumu bona o haḡeregumu?
RUT.2.10.english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

RUT.1.10.motu: Bena raruosi ese e haere henia, eto, Lasi, oi baia bamomu, emu bese taudia dekedia baitala.
RUT.1.10.english: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”

RUT.2.18.motu: E laohaia, hanua ela, ravana e haheitalaia; bona bahu danu e henia.
RUT.2.18.english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.

RUT.4.10.motu: bona Ruta, hane Moab, Malon vabuna, danu vada na hoia, baina adavaia, mase tauna dihina ihavarana totona, ladana basine boio ena iduhu ai bona ena hanua ai helaoreana. Hari dina ai vada o itaia bona vada o kamonai danu.
RUT.4.10.english: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

RUT.3.13.motu: Hari hanuaboi iniseni ai ba noho. Daba ai, ia na baine ura baine adavamu, namo; a bema lasi, lau ese baina adavamu. Iehova maurina ladana ai na herevamu. A hekure diho ela bona daba.
RUT.3.13.english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as Yahweh lives. Lie down until the morning.”

RUT.4.17.motu: Bena dekena hahinedia ese mero ladana e hatoa, eto, Naomi na mai natuna, bena ladana e hatoa Obed. Ia na Iese tamana; Iese na David tamana.
RUT.4.17.english: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

RUT.2.8.motu: Bena Boa ese Ruta e hereva henia, eto, Natugu, eregu a kamonai: idau uma ai bali anidia momorudia basio gogo, ina uma basio rakatania; egu hesiai hahinedia badibadidiai ba noho.
RUT.2.8.english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

RUT.2.15.motu: Ia na e tore isi, bali anidia ma baine gogo eto. Bena Boa ese ena eregabe taudia e haduadia, eto, Iḡui padadiai danu baine gogo, basio gwaua tao;
RUT.2.15.english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.

RUT.1.11.motu: A Naomi eto, Ravagu e, a lou lao; ba bamogu anina be dahaka? Natugu haida ma baina havaradia, umui adavamui ai baela a?
RUT.1.11.english: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

RUT.1.9.motu: Iehova ese laga-ani baine henimui, adavamui matamatadia edia ruma ai. Bena e harahudia. Idia na e tai dikadika.
RUT.1.9.english: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.”

RUT.4.4.motu: Taunabunai, na lalomu, oi baina hamaoromu na tomu: ba ura oi ese ba iloia, iniseni ai e helaimu taudia vairadiai bona hanua tau-badadia vairadiai. Ba ura bavabia, vada bavabia; a basio ura vada ba hamaorogu, baina diba; badina be iabina mai siahuna tauna na oi, bona oi murimu ai lau. Hari tau eto, Baina abia.
RUT.4.4.english: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.”

RUT.2.7.motu: la ese e noigu, eto “Mani emu kara uma ai baina raka vareai, bali anidia momorudia na iutuna taudia muridiai baina gogo”. Taunabunai ia na daba ai ema, se laḡa ani ema bona harihari.
RUT.2.7.english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”

RUT.1.20.motu: Ia na e haere henidia, eto, Ladagu basio hatoa Naomi; ba hatoa Mara; badina be Ḡaubada ena kara egu ai na idita.
RUT.1.20.english: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

RUT.4.19.motu: Hesron ese Ram e havaraia; Ram ese Aminadab e havaraia;
RUT.4.19.english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,

RUT.3.11.motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, basio gari; emu noinoi heḡereḡerena do baina kara henimu, badina be egu hanua taudia iboudiai dibadia oi na kara-namo hahinena.
RUT.3.11.english: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.

SNG.3.4.english: I had scarcely passed from them,

SNG.3.2.motu: Aina tore isi, hanua ai baina loa eva-eva,
SNG.3.2.english: I will get up now, and go about the city;

SNG.3.10.motu: Aena na silver, tabekau kahana na gold;
SNG.3.10.english: He made its pillars of silver,

SNG.4.9.english: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride.

SNG.6.10.motu: Ina be daika, ita-itana na daba e reremu na heto?
SNG.6.10.english: Who is she who looks out as the morning,

SNG.6.6.english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes,

SNG.5.13.motu: Vahana na muramura avadia umadia na heheto,
SNG.5.13.english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes.

SNG.8.2.english: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother,

SNG.2.4.motu: Aria rumana ai e hakaugu lao;
SNG.2.4.english: He brought me to the banquet hall.

SNG.4.12.motu: Taihugu, adavagu, na e hekou kunuka-kunuka umana;
SNG.4.12.english: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden;

SNG.3.6.motu: Una na dahaka, tano ḡaḡaena amo e maimu,
SNG.3.6.english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke,

SNG.7.8.motu: Lau na tomu, Buatau auna baina dae,
SNG.7.8.english: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree.

SNG.2.9.motu: Egu lalokau tauna na uda nanina
SNG.2.9.english: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer.

SNG.4.5.motu: Ratamu ruaosi na uda nanidia natudia rua na heheto,
SNG.4.5.english: Your two breasts are like two fawns

SNG.4.6.english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away,

SNG.5.3.motu: A lau be dabua vada na dokia oho,
SNG.5.3.english: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on?

SNG.5.9.english: How is your beloved better than another beloved,

SNG.5.11.english: His head is like the purest gold.

SNG.1.2.english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth;

SNG.1.13.motu: Egu lalokau na muro modana ta,
SNG.1.13.english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh,

SNG.6.2.motu: Egu lalokau na ena uma vada ela,
SNG.6.2.english: My beloved has gone down to his garden,

SNG.7.11.english: Come, my beloved! Let’s go out into the field.

SNG.3.8.motu: Idia na Israel ena goada taudia,
SNG.3.8.english: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war.

SNG.8.13.motu: Imea ai o nohomu taumu e,
SNG.8.13.english: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance,

SNG.7.4.english: Your neck is like an ivory tower.

SNG.1.14.motu: Egu lalokau na kofere buredia idabubuna ta,
SNG.1.14.english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms

SNG.2.13.english: The fig tree ripens her green figs.

SNG.2.11.english: For behold, the winter is past.

SNG.5.4.motu: Egu lalokau tauna imana na iduara ikouna ai e daukau,
SNG.5.4.english: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening.

SNG.6.11.english: I went down into the nut tree grove,

SNG.1.7.motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, ba hadibagu,
SNG.1.7.english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves,

SNG.2.6.english: His left hand is under my head.

SNG.7.10.motu: Lau na egu lalokau tauna ena;

SNG.8.10.motu: Lau na maḡu, ratagu na kohoro na heto;
SNG.8.10.english: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers,

SNG.5.14.motu: Imana na gold, e hakuboroa heḡeḡe ḡauna,
SNG.5.14.english: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl.

SNG.7.1.english: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter!

SNG.4.4.motu: Aiomu na David ena kohoro na heto,
SNG.4.4.english: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory,

SNG.4.7.motu: Egu lalokau e, oi na hane namo;
SNG.4.7.english: You are all beautiful, my love.

SNG.6.1.english: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women?

SNG.2.3.english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood,

SNG.4.2.motu: Isemu na mamoe serina huidia vada e utu
SNG.4.2.english: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock,

SNG.1.12.motu: Hanua pavapavana na e ege dihova negana ai,
SNG.1.12.english: While the king sat at his table,

SNG.2.12.english: The flowers appear on the earth.

SNG.2.10.motu: Egu lalokau tauna ese e hereva henigumu,
SNG.2.10.english: My beloved spoke, and said to me,

SNG.2.5.motu: Vine huahuadia kakorodia amo ba ubugu,

SNG.1.1.english: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

SNG.4.3.motu: Udumu bibinadia na varo kakakakadia na heheto;
SNG.4.3.english: Your lips are like scarlet thread.

SNG.8.7.motu: Ranu momo ese lalokau basie habodoa diba;

SNG.4.15.motu: Hari uma na mai ranu-lohilohi gabuna,

SNG.1.6.motu: Kopigu na korema-korema dainai basio raraigu;
SNG.1.6.english: Don’t stare at me because I am dark,

SNG.3.1.motu: Hanuaboi ai, egu mahuta patana ai,

SNG.8.5.motu: Una na daika, tano ḡaḡaena amo e maimu,
SNG.8.5.english: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness,

SNG.8.3.english: His left hand would be under my head.

SNG.5.7.english: The watchmen who go about the city found me.

SNG.1.11.english: We will make you earrings of gold,

SNG.2.16.motu: Ia na egu lalokau, lau be ena lalokau;
SNG.2.16.english: My beloved is mine, and I am his.

SNG.4.8.motu: Adavagu e, Lebanon amo baita raka hebou,
SNG.4.8.english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride,

SNG.8.1.english: Oh that you were like my brother,

SNG.2.7.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,

SNG.7.7.motu: Emu lata na buatau auna na heto,
SNG.7.7.english: This, your stature, is like a palm tree,

SNG.6.8.english: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines,

SNG.1.4.motu: Murimu ai a verigu kau! Aitala haraḡa;

SNG.2.14.motu: Egu pune e, oi na nadi matudia ai;
SNG.2.14.english: My dove in the clefts of the rock,

SNG.2.17.motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, a kerehai,
SNG.2.17.english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away,

SNG.3.9.motu: King Solomon ena laolao kalagana na
SNG.3.9.english: King Solomon made himself a carriage

SNG.1.3.motu: Emu hedahu muramuradia bonadia na nanamo heherea;
SNG.1.3.english: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance.

SNG.5.1.english: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride.

SNG.7.3.motu: Ratamu ruaosi na uda nanidia natudia rua na heheto,
SNG.7.3.english: Your two breasts are like two fawns,

SNG.2.1.english: I am a rose of Sharon,

SNG.1.17.english: The beams of our house are cedars.

SNG.7.12.english: Let’s go early up to the vineyards.

SNG.7.6.english: How beautiful and how pleasant you are,

SNG.1.16.motu: Egu lalokau e, oi na raho namo taumu;
SNG.1.16.english: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant;

SNG.6.12.motu: Asi vanahana na mata hanai: lau na kariota ai,

SNG.8.6.english: Set me as a seal on your heart,

SNG.1.10.motu: Vahamu mai heraheradia ita-itadia na nanamo heherea,
SNG.1.10.english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings,

SNG.1.9.motu: Egu lalokau e, Farao ena kariota hosina ta ida
SNG.1.9.english: I have compared you, my love,

SNG.5.6.motu: Egu lalokau tauna iduarana na kehoa;

SNG.4.13.motu: Emu uma ai e varamu ḡaudia na
SNG.4.13.english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits,

SNG.6.5.motu: Asio raraigu, badina be matamu ese e hamanoka-manokagumu.
SNG.6.5.english: Turn away your eyes from me,

SNG.8.4.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,

SNG.1.8.motu: Hane namo e, bema asi dibamu,
SNG.1.8.english: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women,

SNG.3.5.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,

SNG.7.9.motu: Emu haherahu na vine ranuna namo-hereana na heto,
SNG.7.9.english: Your mouth is like the best wine,

SNG.6.13.motu: Sulama kekenina e, a lou mai, a lou mai;

SNG.5.8.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,

SNG.6.4.motu: Egu lalokau e, oi na mai hairaimu, Tirisa na heto;
SNG.6.4.english: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah,

SNG.4.1.motu: Egu lalokau e, oi na hane namo;
SNG.4.1.english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love.

SNG.5.5.english: I rose up to open for my beloved.

SNG.5.12.motu: Matana na ranu badidia ai e nohomu punedia na heheto,
SNG.5.12.english: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks,

SNG.7.2.motu: Hudomu na kehere kuboruna na heto,
SNG.7.2.english: Your body is like a round goblet,

SNG.5.15.motu: Aena na bauka-bauka, nadi kurokurona na heto;
SNG.5.15.english: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold.

SNG.7.5.motu: Kwaramu na mai hairaina, Karamele ororona na heto;
SNG.7.5.english: Your head on you is like Carmel.

SNG.8.12.english: My own vineyard is before me.

SNG.5.2.motu: Na mahuta, to lalogu be noga;
SNG.5.2.english: I was asleep, but my heart was awake.

SNG.1.15.motu: Egu lalokau e, oi na hane namo,
SNG.1.15.english: Behold, you are beautiful, my love.

SNG.8.11.motu: Solomon ena vine imeana ta be Baal-hamono ai;
SNG.8.11.english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon.

SNG.6.3.motu: Ia na egu lalokau, lau be ena lalokau;
SNG.6.3.english: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine.

SNG.3.11.motu: Siona kekenimui e, a raka lasi;
SNG.3.11.english: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon,

SNG.4.10.english: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride!

SNG.4.11.motu: Adavagu e, bada-ranuna na udumu bibinadia amo e hetuturumu,
SNG.4.11.english: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb.

SNG.4.16.english: Awake, north wind, and come, you south!

SNG.5.10.motu: Egu lalokau tauna kopina na ḡoevaḡoeva bona kakakaka,
SNG.5.10.english: My beloved is white and ruddy.

SNG.8.9.motu: Ia na bema magu, silver amo baia ha-aukaia;

SNG.3.3.english: The watchmen who go about the city found me;

SNG.6.7.motu: Vahamu ruaosi na rimono huahuana e ivaia parara na heto,
SNG.6.7.english: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

SNG.6.9.motu: Egu pune na ḡoeva-dae, ia mo sibosibona;
SNG.6.9.english: My dove, my perfect one, is unique.

TIT.1.13.motu: Una hereva na momokani. Taunabunai ba gwau henidia goadagoada, sivarai namo bae abia dae maoromaoro;
TIT.1.13.english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

TIT.3.10.motu: Heiri-heiri tauna be nega gini-gunana bona nega iharuana ba sisiba henia, murinai ba dadaraia.
TIT.3.10.english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

TIT.3.8.motu: Una na hereva momokani; bena na uramu unu hereva ba gwaurai goadagoada, bena Dirava vada e abidadama heniamu taudia na nahuadia bae toho, kara namodia bae badina. Ini ḡau be nanamo bona mai anidia, taunimanima ediai.
TIT.3.8.english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

TIT.3.5.motu: ia ese e hamaurida, dia ita eda kara maoromaoro daidiai, to iena hebogahisi dainai, vara lou ena hehuri ai bona Lauma Helaḡa ena hahematamata ai.
TIT.3.5.english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

TIT.1.9.motu: Hereva momokani baine abi tarika-tarika, vada e hadibalaia heḡereḡerena; unu amo baine heḡereḡere, hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia amo taunimanima lalodia baine hagoadadia bona hereva momokani e laoahumu taudia baine nanaudia.
TIT.1.9.english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

TIT.3.1.motu: Ba hahelalodia une, hahemaoro taudia bona siahu taudia bae kamonai henidia, bona edia haheḡani bae badina. Bae noho haḡaeḡae, kara namo iboudiai ikaradia.
TIT.3.1.english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

TIT.3.13.motu: Sena, taravatu tauna, bona Apolo, na edia laolao dalana ba lailaia, ḡau ta ai basie dabu.
TIT.3.13.english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

TIT.2.3.motu: Hahine badadia danu ba hadibadia, bae noho helaḡa taudia heḡereḡeredia, basie hahebade koikoi, vine ranuna basie inu momo, kara namo bae hahedibalai.
TIT.2.3.english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

TIT.3.11.motu: Dibamu una tau na mai ena kerere bona mai ena dika; ia sibona ese ena dika vada e hahedinaraiamu.
TIT.3.11.english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

TIT.1.12.motu: Idia sibodia edia peroveta tauna ta ini e gwau toma: Krete taudia na nega idoinai koikoi taudia, uda boromadia dikadia na heheto, boga mase taudia.
TIT.1.12.english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

TIT.1.14.motu: a Iuda taudia edia gori bona hereva momokani vada e rakatania taudia edia haheḡani basie abi dae.
TIT.1.14.english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

TIT.2.12.motu: bona vada e hadibadamu, e tomu Dirava idadaraina karadia bona tanobada ena lebulebu karadia baita rakatani, ina tanobada ai baita noho migomigo, baita kara maoromaoro, Dirava baita badinaia.
TIT.2.12.english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

TIT.3.2.motu: Tau ta dikana basie gwauraia; basie heai; bae manau; taunimanima iboudiai bae kara namo henidia.
TIT.3.2.english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

TIT.1.3.motu: ema bona ena nega korikori ai ena gwauhamata anina vada e hahedinaraia, ihamaurida Diravana ena hahedua dainai na harorolaiamu sivaraina namona lalonai.
TIT.1.3.english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

TIT.1.8.motu: A idau taudia baine abidia dae; kara namo baine ura henia; sibona baine hegwahi baine kara maoromaoro; baine helaḡa; baine boga auka.
TIT.1.8.english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

TIT.2.1.motu: A oi na hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia ba hahedibalai.
TIT.2.1.english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

TIT.3.4.motu: A Ihamaurida Diravana ena gado-namo bona ena uraheni taunimanima edai e hedinarai negana ai,
TIT.3.4.english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

TIT.2.5.motu: lalodia bae hadai maoromaoro; basie mata dika; ruma ai bae ḡaukara; bae hebogahisi; adavadia eredia bae kamonai. Unuhetomana ta ese Dirava ena hereva basine hadikaia.
TIT.2.5.english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

TIT.3.12.motu: Aretema eiava Tukiko baina siaia vasi negana ai, dekegu baoma haraḡa Nikapoli ai; badina be keru negana ai unuseni ai baina noho na tomamu.
TIT.3.12.english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

TIT.1.10.motu: Hutuma na e gwau edeedemu, e hereva kava hereva kavamu, taunimanina e koidiamu. Peritome taudia na una kara ai e hereamu.
TIT.1.10.english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

TIT.1.11.motu: Ba gwaudia tubu, ududia bae hakapu; badina be iduhu haida vada e hahekwakwanaidia, hahediba herevadia koikoidia vada e hadibalaidia, moni idavarina totona.
TIT.1.11.english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

TIT.2.10.motu: edia ḡau basie henao; kamonai karadia bae hahedinarai. Unu amo ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Ihamaurida Diravana ena hahediba herevadia anidia bae hahedinarai.
TIT.2.10.english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

TIT.2.6.motu: Eregabe taudia danu ba haduadia, bae boga auka.
TIT.2.6.english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

TIT.2.8.motu: Bena emu hereva bae maoromaoro dainai ta ese basine habadelaimu diba; bona heiri-heiri tauna baine hemarai, badina be dikada basine gwaurai diba.
TIT.2.8.english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

TIT.2.7.motu: Bona oi sibomu kara namodia ba hahedinarai, bae haḡoimu helaoreana. Emu hahediba herevadia bae maoromaoro; bona bae matau.
TIT.2.7.english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

TIT.3.9.motu: A henanadai kavakavadia iherevalaidia, bona uru ihagaudia, bona heai, bona taravatu hepapahuahudia, amo ba gini siri; badina be idia na asi anidia bona kavakava.
TIT.3.9.english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

TIT.2.4.motu: Bena idia edia amo eregabe hahinedia ese adavadia bona natudia bae lalokau henidia;
TIT.2.4.english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

TIT.2.11.motu: Badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada vada eme hedinarai, taunimanima iboudiai ihamauridia;
TIT.2.11.english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

TIT.2.13.motu: Helaro namona baita naria: Dirava badana bona Ihamaurida Tauna Iesu Keriso hairaidia ihahedinaraidia bunai.
TIT.2.13.english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

TIT.2.14.motu: Ia na sibona vada e heni, ita daidai, kara dika iboudiai edia amo baine ruhada nege, orea ta baine haḡoevaia sibona ena, kara namo baine goadalai oreana.
TIT.2.14.english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

TIT.1.7.motu: Badina be heitatao tauna na basie habadelaia diba baine namo; ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna. Ia na basine daḡedaḡe; basine badu haraḡa; kekero muramuradia basine inu momo; basine heatu; moni basine mata ḡaniḡani henia.
TIT.1.7.english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

TIT.3.14.motu: Varavarada danu ḡaukara namodia bae manadalai, dabu taudia bae hanamodia, asi huahuadia bae noho na garina.
TIT.3.14.english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

TIT.3.15.motu: Bamogu iboudiai iniseni ai ese e hahenamo henimumu. Iesu ibadinana ai e lalokau henimaimu taudia ba hahenamo henidia. Harihari-bada be umui iboumui ai emui ai baine mia.
TIT.3.15.english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith.

TIT.1.4.motu: Tito, natugu korikori eda abidadama tamona lalonai, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Keriso Iesu eda Hahemauri Tauna ena amo, bavabi.
TIT.1.4.english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

TIT.1.1.motu: Lau Paulo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna bona Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo, Dirava ena abi-hidi taudia edia abidadama idurulaina bona Dirava ibadinana herevadia momokanidia ihadibalaidia totodia e siaigu,
TIT.1.1.english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

TIT.3.3.motu: Badina be ita danu gunaguna mai eda kavakava bona mai eda gwau-edeede bona e hakauda kerere; ura dikadia bona moale idau-idau ta badinava; lalo-dika ai bona vaḡeḡe ai ta nohova; haida ese ita e inai henida, bona ita ese idia ta inai henidia.
TIT.3.3.english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

TIT.3.7.motu: Taunabunai, iena harihari-bada ese maoroda baine gwaurai, bona ia dihina ai baine halaoda, mauri hanaihanai helarona heḡereḡerena.
TIT.3.7.english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

TIT.1.5.motu: Krete ai na rakatanimu badina binai: do asie maoro ḡaudia na ba hamaoromaoro, bona heitatao taudia danu hanua hanua lalodiai ba gwauraidia hidi, egu hahedua heḡereḡerena.
TIT.1.5.english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

TIT.2.9.motu: Hesiai taudia na biagudia bae kamonai henidia, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai bae hamoaledia. Basie heiri-heiri henidia;
TIT.2.9.english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

TIT.1.6.motu: Asi edia kara dika taudia, adavadia tamodia taudia, natudia be Iesu ibadinana memerodia, asi edia lebulebu bona asi edia gwau-edeede, bavabidia hidi.
TIT.1.6.english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

TIT.1.2.motu: mauri hanaihanai bae laroa helaoreana. Seneda do asie vara negana ai, koikoi asi dibana Diravana ese una mauri hanaihanai e gwauraia hamata,
TIT.1.2.english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

TIT.1.16.motu: Idia na Dirava dibadia e tomamu, a ḡau be edia kara ese e ḡoreamu; idia na lalomase taudia, gwau-edeede taudia, kara namodia iboudiai lalodiai idia na asi goadadia.
TIT.1.16.english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

TIT.1.15.motu: Ḡau iboudiai be ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva taudia ediai. A lalo-miro taudia ediai bona asi edia kamonai taudia ediai ḡau ta dia ḡoeva; idia daradia bona lalodia na mimiro.
TIT.1.15.english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

TIT.3.6.motu: Una hahemauri na ia ese latadai vada e seia dobi, Ihamaurida Tauna Iesu Keriso bagunai.
TIT.3.6.english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

TIT.2.15.motu: Ini ḡau ba herevalai; taunimanima ba haduadia bona ba sisiba henidia mai siahumu ida. Tau ta ese basine dadaraimu.
TIT.2.15.english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

TIT.2.2.motu: Tatau badadia ba hadibadia, bae boga auka, bae matau, Ialodia bae hadai maoromaoro, kamonai ai bona lalokau ai bona haheauka ai bae gini tutukatutuka.
TIT.2.2.english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

ZEC.11.12.motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Bema lalomui baeto maoro, egu ḡaukara davana boma henigu, a bema lasi, boma rua. Bena idia ese egu ḡaukara davana e hahetohoa, silver sekeledia toi-ahui.
ZEC.11.12.english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

ZEC.9.3.motu: Turo ese ena maḡu aukana ta vada e haginia,

ZEC.4.3.motu: Ia badibadinai na olive audia rua, ta dihu idibana kahana ai, ma ta laurina kahana ai.
ZEC.4.3.english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

ZEC.14.2.motu: Badina be basileia iboudiai baina haboudia, Ierusalem bae tuari henia totona; bena hanua na bae abia, ruma kohudia na bae dadi, bona hahine na bae hadikadia; a taunimanima oredia na hanua amo basie henege daure.
ZEC.14.2.english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

ZEC.14.13.motu: Una dina ai gari bada-hereana Iehova ena amo na idia latadiai baine kau, bena ta ta ese bamona bamona imadia bae abi, bona ta ta ese imadia bae abi isi, bamodia ihadikadia totona;
ZEC.14.13.english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

ZEC.12.11.motu: Una dina ai taitai na baine bada herea Ierusalem ai, Megido taorana ai, Hadadarimon taina e taiva na heto.
ZEC.12.11.english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

ZEC.4.5.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e haere henigu, eto, Oi na asi dibamu ini na dahaka a? Lau nato, Ḡauka e, lasi.
ZEC.4.5.english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?”

ZEC.14.11.motu: Bona haida ese bae noholaia, badina be hevadari basine mia; Ierusalem taudia na bae noho namonamo, asi garidia.
ZEC.14.11.english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

ZEC.14.19.motu: Aigupto davana bona kalaga ariana ibadinana totona asie dara daemu besedia iboudiai davadia na unu bae abi toma.
ZEC.14.19.english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

ZEC.2.5.motu: Badina be lahi maḡuna heḡereḡerena ai bainala, heḡeḡemadai gabudia iboudiai, bona hairai ai bainala ia lalonai. Iehova na e herevamu.”
ZEC.2.5.english: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

ZEC.3.5.motu: Bena lau nato, Dabua ḡoevaḡoevana na kwarana bae ḡeḡelaia. Taunabunai idia ese dabua ḡoevaḡoevana na kwarana e ḡegelaia, bona hahedoki na e hahedokilaia; Iehova ena aneru na una gabu ai e gini.
ZEC.3.5.english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.”

ZEC.8.21.motu: bena hanua ta taudia ese ma hanua ta taudia dekedia baela, baeto “Ina harihari aitala, Iehova baita noia ia ese baine hahenamo henida, bona Iehova Sabaota baita tahua; lau be vada na laomu”.
ZEC.8.21.english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’

ZEC.10.7.motu: Bena Efraim na tuari tauna mai goadana heḡereḡerena ai bainela,
ZEC.10.7.english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man,

ZEC.11.4.motu: Iehova, egu Dirava, ini e gwau toma: Ialadia vada e gwaurai hata mamoedia iboudiai ireḡudia tauna ai baola.
ZEC.11.4.english: Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

ZEC.2.4.motu: e hamaoroa, eto, A heau, una eregabe tauna ba hamaoroa, baoto “Ierusalem bae noholaia, asi maḡudia hanuadia e noholaidiamu na heto, badina be taunimanima bona boromakau bae momo ia lalonai.
ZEC.2.4.english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

ZEC.6.6.motu: Kariota mai hosi koremadia na mirigini kahana tanona be lao heniamu; kurokurodia na lahara kahana be lao heniamu; bona mai toutoudia ḡaudia na diho kahana be lao heniamu.
ZEC.6.6.english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

ZEC.10.10.motu: Aigupto tanona amo baina hakaudia mai,
ZEC.10.10.english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt,

ZEC.13.9.motu: Bena unu ihatatoidia na lahi ai baina atodia,
ZEC.13.9.english: I will bring the third part into the fire,

ZEC.14.21.motu: Uro iboudiai Ierusalem ai bona Iuda ai na bae helaḡa, Iehova Sabaota enai; taunabunai edia boubou ḡaudia bae hahelaḡadia taudia iboudiai na baema diba, bae abidia, edia boubou ḡaudia hidiodia na idia lalodiai bae nadudia. Bona hoihoi tauna ta na Iehova Sabaota ena dubu ai basine noho lou una dina ai.
ZEC.14.21.english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.8.16.motu: Ba kara ḡaudia bini: Ba hereva heheni mai momokanimui ida; emui hanua ikoukoudia ai hahemaoro karadia ba kara mai momokanimui bona mai mainomui ida;
ZEC.8.16.english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

ZEC.2.1.motu: Bena na gaga isi, tau ta na itaia, mai ena hahetoho varona imana ai.
ZEC.2.1.english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

ZEC.9.7.motu: Ana rara na uduna amo baina abia oho,
ZEC.9.7.english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth,

ZEC.12.12.motu: Tano taudia na bae taitai, edia iduhu ta ta ai: David iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia; Natan iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia;
ZEC.12.12.english: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

ZEC.13.2.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Una dina ai danu kaivakuku ladadia na tano amo baina negedia daure; bena tau ta ese basine lalodia tao lou; bona peroveta taudia bona lauma mai mirona danu na tano amo baina abidia oho.
ZEC.13.2.english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

ZEC.7.12.motu: Lalodia na e ha-aukadia masemase, Iehova Sabaota ena Lauma ese peroveta taudia gunadia edia amo e siaidia taravatudia bona herevadia bae kamonai na garina. Taunabunai badu ḡaraḡara bada-herea na Iehova Sabaota ena amo e kau.
ZEC.7.12.english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.1.3.motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Lau dekegu ai ba lou mai, Iehova Sabaota e tomu, bena lau ese umui baina lou henimui. Iehova Sabaota unu e gwau tomamu:
ZEC.1.3.english: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.12.8.motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na kesi amo baine koudia heḡeḡe; una dainai manokamanoka-herea tauna idia bogaragidiai na una dina ai David ida bae heḡereḡere; bona David iduhuna na Dirava ida, Iehova ena aneru ida, bae heḡereḡere, idia ikwaradia ai.
ZEC.12.8.english: In that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like Yahweh’s angel before them.

ZEC.14.16.motu: Bena roho-mauri taudia iboudiai, unu Ierusalem vada e tuari henia besedia idau-idau iboudiai amo, na laḡani ta ta ai Ierusalem bae dara dae, Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, itomadiho-henina bona kalaga ariana ibadinana totona.
ZEC.14.16.english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

ZEC.10.1.motu: Medu na Iehova enai ba noia,
ZEC.10.1.english: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time,

ZEC.7.14.motu: bena koe-hirihiri amo na hakarohodia rohoroho, asi dibadia besedia iboudiai bogaragidiai. Taunabunai, e rakatania tanona na vada e vahu, asi lao mai tauna ta; tano namona vada e havahua vaitani.
ZEC.7.14.english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

ZEC.14.10.motu: Tano idoinai na taora ai baine hahelao, Geba amo ela bona Rimon, Ierusalem diho-kahana ai. A Ierusalem na atai ai baine mia, gabana korikorina ai, Beniamina Ikoukouna amo ela ikoukou gunana, ela bona Daiguni Ikoukouna, bona Hananele Kohorona ela bona pavapava ena vine itaolaidia gabudia.
ZEC.14.10.english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

ZEC.7.8.motu: Iehova ena hereva na Sekaria enai e kau, eto,
ZEC.7.8.english: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

ZEC.8.11.motu: A harihari lau ese ina bese kwabukwabuna basina kara henidia nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
ZEC.8.11.english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.11.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Moni mauana ai ba udaia dobi. (Una na dava herea-daena idia ese egu ḡaukara e davalaia ḡauna). Taunabunai, lau ese hari silver sekeledia toi-ahui na abidia, moni mauana ai na uda dobi, Iehova ena dubu ai.
ZEC.11.13.english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

ZEC.12.6.motu: Una dina ai, Iuda iduhudia na gida keberena au bogaragidiai na heto, eiava kede hururu-hururuna rei kakoro bogaraginai na heto; heḡeḡemadai besedia iboudiai, idiba kahana ai bona lauri kahana ai, na idia ese bae aradia ore, a Ierusalem na gabuna ai baine mia, mai inoholaina taudia ida.
ZEC.12.6.english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

ZEC.12.14.motu: bona iduhu oredia iboudiai tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia.
ZEC.12.14.english: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

ZEC.12.3.motu: Una dina ai lau ese Ierusalem na nadi metauna ta ai baina halaoa, bese iboudiai edia; bae abia isi taudia iboudiai na sibodia bae hahehisi herea. Bena tanobada basileiadia iboudiai na bae hahebou, ia ihadikana.
ZEC.12.3.english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

ZEC.1.6.motu: A egu hereva bona egu taravatu, egu hesiai peroveta taudia na haḡanilaidia gaudia, ese tamamui e lasidia tao ani? Una dainai idia na e helalo kerehai, eto, Iehova Sabaota ese e laloa hata eda dala bona eda kara heḡereḡeredia ai baine kara henida; bena unu vada e kara henida toma.
ZEC.1.6.english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers?

ZEC.8.13.motu: Iuda taumui bona Israel taumui e, umui na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai heuduguirai gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai vada ola heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese do baina hamaurimui, bena hahenamo taumui ai baola. Basio gari, a imamui ba ha-aukadia.
ZEC.8.13.english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

ZEC.8.14.motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Senemui ese e habadugu negana ai, lau na laloa hata baina kara dika henimui nato, bena asina helalo kerehai (Iehova Sabaota na e tomu),
ZEC.8.14.english: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

ZEC.3.2.motu: Bena Iehova ese Satana e hereva henia, eto, Satana e, Iehova ese aine lodu henimu! Iehova, Ierusalem e abia hidi Diravana, ese aine lodu henimu! Ina na dia lahi amo e veria lasi tutuna a?
ZEC.3.2.english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

ZEC.5.11.motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Sinara tanona; unuseni ai dubuna bae haginia; baine gini vaitani bena tohe na ilahana latanai bae laia kau.
ZEC.5.11.english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

ZEC.12.9.motu: Una dina ai danu lau ese Ierusalem e tuari heniamu basileiadia iboudiai ihabua-taridia dalana baina tahua.
ZEC.12.9.english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

ZEC.14.14.motu: Iuda ese danu Ierusalem baine tuari henia. Bena heḡeḡemadai besedia iboudiai edia taḡa na bae haboudia, gold bona silver bona dabua momo herea.
ZEC.14.14.english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

ZEC.8.3.motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Siona baina lou henia, Ierusalem bogaraginai baina noho; bena Ierusalem na bae gwauraia “Heabidadama Hanuana”, bona Iehova Sabaota ena ororo na bae gwauraia “Ororo Helaḡana”.
ZEC.8.3.english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

ZEC.10.8.english: I will signal for them and gather them,

ZEC.9.16.motu: Una dina ai Iehova, edia Dirava, ese baine hamauridia,
ZEC.9.16.english: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people;

ZEC.2.9.motu: ia eto: A itaia, lau ese imagu baina davedavea idia daediai, bena edia hesiai taudia ese bae dadidia. Bena ba diba Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu.
ZEC.2.9.english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.

ZEC.10.2.motu: Badina be e koro laulaudia helaḡadia na e hereva kava hereva kavamu,
ZEC.10.2.english: For the teraphim have spoken vanity,

ZEC.8.8.motu: bena baina hakaudia mai, Ierusalem bogaraginai baina hanohodia. Idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala, heabidadama ai bona kara maoromaoro ai.
ZEC.8.8.english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

ZEC.10.9.motu: Ena be na hakarohodia rohoroho, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai,
ZEC.10.9.english: I will sow them among the peoples.

ZEC.13.1.motu: Una dina ai ranu baine hahelohilohi dae David iduhuna bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia edia, kara dikadia bona mirodia amo bae haheḡoeva totona.
ZEC.13.1.english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

ZEC.5.8.motu: Bena ia eto, Ina na Kara Dika. Bena ma e doria dobi tohe lalonai, bona auri-metauna ikaruhina amo e karuhia ahu.
ZEC.5.8.english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

ZEC.8.23.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Unu dinadia ai tatau gwauta, gado idau-idau iboudiai besedia amo, ese Iuda tauna ta ena dabua bae dogoa tao, baeto, Mani oi ida aitala, badina be ai na vada a kamonai, Dirava na dekedekemu ai.
ZEC.8.23.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”

ZEC.4.12.motu: Nega iharuana ma na nanadaia, nato, Hari olive audia rigidia ruaosi, gold baubaudia, dehoro e seilaia ḡaudia, badibadidiai e miamu be dahaka?
ZEC.4.12.english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

ZEC.6.11.motu: Idia ediai silver bona gold bavabi, havava ḡauna ta ba karaia, bena Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, kwarana ba havavalaia.
ZEC.6.11.english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

ZEC.9.15.english: Yahweh of Armies will defend them.

ZEC.5.7.motu: Bena na itaia, auri-metauna ikaruhina na e heabi isi, bena tohe lalonai hahine ta e helaiva.
ZEC.5.7.english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

ZEC.8.12.motu: Badina be maino baine hehado; vine na baine huahua, bona tano anina baine vara, bona guba hununa baine diho; bona ini ḡau iboudiai na ina bese kwabukwabuna baina henidia, bae ḡaunaidia.
ZEC.8.12.english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

ZEC.12.13.motu: Levi iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia; Simei iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia;
ZEC.12.13.english: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

ZEC.4.13.motu: Ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Oi asi dibamu ini na dahaka a? Lau nato, Ḡauka e, lasi.
ZEC.4.13.english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?”

ZEC.2.2.motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato, Ede bo laomu? Ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Ierusalem ihahetohona totona na laomu, baina itaia ena lababa na ede badana bona ena lata na ede badana.
ZEC.2.2.english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?”

ZEC.2.13.motu: Taunimanima iboumui ai, asi reḡereḡemui ba noho, Iehova vairanai; badina be ia na vada e tore isi, ena noho gabuna helaḡana amo vada e raka lasi.
ZEC.2.13.english: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

ZEC.1.14.motu: Taunabunai, lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e hamaorogu, eto, A boi lolo, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem bona Siona daidiai lalogu na e hekwarahi badamu.
ZEC.1.14.english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

ZEC.1.16.motu: Taunabunai Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem vada name lou henia, mai hebogahisigu ida. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Egu dubu na ia lalonai bae haginia, bona hahetoho varona na Ierusalem daenai baine heveri roro.
ZEC.1.16.english: Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

ZEC.6.3.motu: ihatoina na mai hosi kurokurodia; bona kariota ihahanina na mai hosi mia-koremadia mai toutoudia.
ZEC.6.3.english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

ZEC.1.19.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, mi be dahaka? Bena ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Ini na Iuda bona Israel bona Ierusalem vada e hakaroho rohoroho doadia.
ZEC.1.19.english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?”

ZEC.14.17.motu: A tanobada iduhudia haida na Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, itomadiho-henina totona Ierusalem basiema dara dae, medu na idia latadiai basie diho.
ZEC.14.17.english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

ZEC.13.5.motu: A idia baeto, Ai na dia peroveta taudia, ai na biru taudia; badina be ina tano na emai tano korikori, tauhaumai negana amo.
ZEC.13.5.english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

ZEC.13.4.motu: Una dina ai peroveta taudia iboudiai na edia mata-hanai daidiai bae hemarai, bae peroveta negadia ai; idia na hahedoki huika-huikadia basie hahedokilai, taunimanima ikoidia totona.
