ZEC.13.4.english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

ZEC.11.7.motu: Taunabunai, lau na mamoe ihoihoilaidia taudia daidiai ialadia vada e gwaurai hata mamoedia ireḡudia tauna ai nala. Bena itotohi rua na abidia: ta ladana na hatoa Harihari-bada, ma ta ladana na hatoa Hahetamona. Bena mamoe na reḡudia.
ZEC.11.7.english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

ZEC.11.6.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Badina be ina tano inoholaina taudia basina bogadia hisi lou. A itaia, lau ese taunimanima na ta ta ireguna tauna ireḡuna tauna imadia ai, bona ta ta ena pavapava ena pavapava imadia ai, baina atodia kau; bena idia ese tanobada bae hadarerea, bona lau ese tau ta na idia imadia amo basina harohodia mauri.
ZEC.11.6.english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Yahweh; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

ZEC.14.3.motu: Bena Iehova baine raka lasi, unu basileia na baine tuari henidia, tuari dinana ai e tuarimu na heto.
ZEC.14.3.english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

ZEC.8.15.motu: unuhetomana ini dinadia ai ma vada na laloa hata, Ierusalem bona Iuda iduhuna baina kara namo henidia. Basio gari.
ZEC.8.15.english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

ZEC.4.7.motu: Ororo badana e, oi na dahaka? Serubabele vairanai oi na taora ai ba hahelao, bena ia ese atai nadina baine mailaia, bona taunimanima na bae lolo, baeto, Harihari-bada, harihari-bada ienai baine mia.
ZEC.4.7.english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

ZEC.1.9.motu: Bena lau nato, Egu lohia e, ini na dahaka? Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e hamaorogu, eto, Baina haheitalaimu, unu na dahaka.
ZEC.1.9.english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’”

ZEC.7.11.motu: A idia na asie ura bae kamonai; bena e helai muri henia bona taiadia e kodobedia, basie kamonai helaoreana.
ZEC.7.11.english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

ZEC.3.3.motu: Hari Iosua na aneru vairanai e gini, mai hahedokina miroka-mirokadia ida.
ZEC.3.3.english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

ZEC.11.14.motu: Bena egu itotohi iharuana, ladana Hahetamona, na hakwaidua, unu amo Iuda bona Israel edia hetadikaka na utua.
ZEC.11.14.english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

ZEC.13.8.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Tano idoinai lalonai
ZEC.13.8.english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says Yahweh,

ZEC.13.7.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Dare e, a noga!

ZEC.2.11.motu: Una dina ai bese momo na Iehova enai bae tao, egu bese ai baela; bena lau ese umui bogaragimui ai baina noho, bona umui na ba diba Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu vasi.
ZEC.2.11.english: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

ZEC.6.15.motu: Dauhai e nohomu taudia na baema, Iehova ena dubu ihaginina ai bae heduru; bena vada ba diba, Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu dekemu ai. Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona ba badinaia namonamo, ini ḡau do bae vara.
ZEC.6.15.english: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’”

ZEC.11.16.motu: Badina be, a itaia, lau ese mamoe ireḡudia tauna ta ina tano ai na haginiamu; ia ese be masemu taudia na se naridiamu, eiava raka-boioboio taudia na se tahudiamu, eiava mai berodia taudia na se hamauridiamu, eiava goada taudia na se ubudiamu, a ubu-ubu ḡaudia hidiodia e animu, aedia kahaudia danu e raḡadia ohomu.
ZEC.11.16.english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

ZEC.8.2.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Siona dainai lalogu na e hekwarahimu, mai lalo-hekwarahigu badana ida bona mai badu-garagaragu ida.
ZEC.8.2.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

ZEC.8.4.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Tatau burukadia bona hahine burukadia na Ierusalem hanuana ariaradia ai ma bae helai, ta ta mai edia itotohi, vada e buruka herea dainai.
ZEC.8.4.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

ZEC.1.12.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru eto, Iehova Sabaota e, Ierusalem bona Iuda hanuadia na laḡani hitu-ahui lalodiai vada o badu henidia; ma basio bogadia hisi ela bona edena nega ai?
ZEC.1.12.english: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

ZEC.11.9.motu: Taunabunai lau nato, Lau ese basina regumui. Dahaka baine mase, vada baine mase; bona dahaka bae habuaia tari, vada bae habuaia tari; bena kwabukwabudia ese bae heani heheni.
ZEC.11.9.english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

ZEC.2.3.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na itaia, ia na e raka lasi, bona aneru ma ta e raka kahi mai, ia ihedavari-henina totona,
ZEC.2.3.english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

ZEC.3.10.motu: Iehova Sabaota ma e tomu, Una dina ai umui iboumui ai ese ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ba vavedia mai, emui vine audia bona emui suke audia henudiai.
ZEC.3.10.english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

ZEC.7.10.motu: Vabu, ihareha, noho-hedoa tauna, ogoḡami tauna basio hahisidia; bona ta ese tadikakana ihadikana dalana ta basine lalo hatalaia.
ZEC.7.10.english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

ZEC.10.5.motu: Heboudia ai idia na tuari taudia mai goadadia heḡereḡeredia ai baela,
ZEC.10.5.english: They will be as mighty men,

ZEC.5.5.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna e raka kahi mai, e hereva henigu, eto, A gaga isi, e lasimu ḡauna na ba itaia.
ZEC.5.5.english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

ZEC.14.18.motu: Bona Aigupto taudia danu basiema dara dae, unuseni ai basiema hedinarai, bena Iehova ese kalaga ariana ibadinana totona asie dara daemu besedia e hahisilaidiamu gorerena na idia danu latadiai baine kau.
ZEC.14.18.english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

ZEC.1.1.motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihataurahanina ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Sekaria Berekia, Ido tubuna, dekenai e kau, eto,
ZEC.1.1.english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

ZEC.9.11.motu: Oi danu, eda herohemaino rarana dainai,

ZEC.2.6.motu: Iehova na e tomu, He, he, mirigini kahana tanona ba heautania; badina be lau ese vada na hakarohomui rohoroho, guba laidia haniosi na heheto. Iehova na e herevamu.
ZEC.2.6.english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.

ZEC.6.13.motu: Ia ese Iehova ena dubu baine haginia, bena bae matauraia, pavapava na heto; bena ena terono ai baine helai, baine lohia. Ena terono badibadinai hahelaḡa tauna ta baine gini; bena raruosi lalodia bae tamona, mai mainodia ida.
ZEC.6.13.english: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

ZEC.5.9.motu: Bena na gaga dae, hahine rarua na itadia, e maiva. Lai ese hanidia e ha-evadia; hanidia na boḡe hanidia na heheto. Bena idia ese hari tohe e abia isi, tanobada bona guba padadiai.
ZEC.5.9.english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

ZEC.4.9.motu: Serubabele imana ese ina dubu badina vada e atoa, bona ia ese baine haḡuḡurua danu. Bena vada ba diba, Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu mai dekemu ai.
ZEC.4.9.english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

ZEC.11.8.motu: Hua tamona lalonai lau ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia tatoiosi na aladia mase. A egu haheauka e ore, mamoe ediai, bona idia ese e inai henigu.
ZEC.11.8.english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

ZEC.10.3.motu: Egu badu na e ḡaraḡaramu, mamoe ireḡudia taudia latadiai;
ZEC.10.3.english: My anger is kindled against the shepherds,

ZEC.9.4.motu: To, a itaia, Ḡaubada ese ena ḡau iboudiai baine abidia oho,
ZEC.9.4.english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her,

ZEC.6.10.motu: Dauhai e hanohodia taudia bogaragidia amo, Heledai bona Tobia bona Iedaia bavabidia; idia na Babulono amo vada ema. Bena una dina tamona ai Iosia Sefania ena ruma baola.
ZEC.6.10.english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

ZEC.14.20.motu: Una dina ai hosi aiodia gabagabadia ai ina revareva bae torea: “Helaḡa, Iehova ena”. Bona Iehova ena dubu ai bae mia urodia na ihaboulaina patana vairanai e miamu naudia heḡereḡeredia ai baela.
ZEC.14.20.english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

ZEC.13.3.motu: Bema ta ma baine hedinarai, baineto ia na peroveta tauna, bena ia e havaraia tauna bona hahinena ese bae hamaoroa, baeto “Emu mauri na basine mia badina be hereva koikoidia na Iehova ladana ai o gwauraimu”; bena baine peroveta negana ai, e havaraia tauna bona hahinena ese bae gwadaia uru.
ZEC.13.3.english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

ZEC.4.14.motu: Bena ia eto, Ini na e horodia taudia raruosi tanobada idoinai Lohiana badibadinai e ginimu taudia.
ZEC.4.14.english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

ZEC.12.1.motu: Maduna metauna herevana Iehova ena amo, Israel dainai. Iehova, guba vada e idia roro bona tanobada vada e karaia bona taunimanima laumana na ia lalonai vada e havaraia Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu:
ZEC.12.1.english: A revelation of Yahweh’s word concerning Israel: Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

ZEC.1.21.motu: Bena lau nato, Ini na dahaka ikarana totona vada e maimu? Ia ese e haere, eto, Unu na Iuda e hakarohoa rohoroho doadia, bena tau ta se gaga isi; a ini na ihagaridia totona vada ema, hari Iuda tanona iḡiḡi-rohorohona totona doadia e abidia isi besedia na ini hahaniosi ese bae tahodia dobi.
ZEC.1.21.english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?”

ZEC.6.12.motu: Bena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Tau ladana Rigi a itaia; badina be ia na ena gabu ai baine tubu, bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu baine haginia.
ZEC.6.12.english: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.

ZEC.12.2.motu: A itaia, lau ese Ierusalem na hahekekero keherena ai baina halaoa, hegegemadai besedia iboudiai ediai; Iuda ihadikana ḡauna ai bainela danu, Ierusalem bae koua heḡeḡe negana ai.
ZEC.12.2.english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

ZEC.3.9.motu: Badina be, a itaia, Iosua vairanai vada na atoa nadina tamona kahana hituosi ai lau ese revarevana baina ḡasia, bona dina tamona lalonai ina tano ena kerere baina abia oho. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
ZEC.3.9.english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

ZEC.4.2.motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka o itaiamu? Lau nato, Lamepa patana ta, gold ḡauna, na itaiamu, dorina ai na dihu ta, bona ia latanai lamepa hitu, bona dorina lamepadia ta ta na mai ududia hitu.
ZEC.4.2.english: He said to me, “What do you see?”

ZEC.7.4.motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
ZEC.7.4.english: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,

ZEC.1.13.motu: Bena Iehova ese lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na hahenamo bona hahealo herevadia e gwaurai henia.
ZEC.1.13.english: Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

ZEC.6.9.motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
ZEC.6.9.english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

ZEC.11.17.motu: Egu mamoe ireḡudia tauna asi namona, madi ihabaina!
ZEC.11.17.english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

ZEC.1.17.motu: Ma ba boi lolo, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hanua badadia na noho-namo ai ma bae honu honu dae, bona Iehova ese Siona ma baine hahealo henia lou, bona Ierusalem ma baine abia hidi lou.
ZEC.1.17.english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

ZEC.11.2.motu: Beroso auna e, a tai! Badina be sida auna vada e gari;
ZEC.11.2.english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen,

ZEC.2.7.motu: He, Babulono natuna hahinena ida o nohomu taumu, a roho mauri, Siona a heau lao.
ZEC.2.7.english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

ZEC.9.8.motu: Bena egu ruma ai baina kone noho, baina gimaia,
ZEC.9.8.english: I will encamp around my house against the army,

ZEC.7.2.motu: Una negana ai Betele taudia ese Saresere bona Regeme-melek, mai edia orea taudia ida, e siaidia lao, Iehova bae noia, ena hahenamo na latadiai baine kau.
ZEC.7.2.english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,

ZEC.7.5.motu: Tano taudia iboudiai bona hahelaḡa taudia danu ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ene laḡani hitu-ahuiosi lalodiai, hua iha-imana ai bona hua ihahituna ai o taitaiva bona o anivagava negadia ai na lau daigu ai o anivagava a?
ZEC.7.5.english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

ZEC.4.11.motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato, Ini olive audia ruaosi, lamepa patana idibana kahana ai bona laurina kahana ai be dahaka?
ZEC.4.11.english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

ZEC.1.5.motu: Tamamui na edeseni ai? Bona peroveta taudia danu, idia na e mauri hanaihanaimu a?
ZEC.1.5.english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

ZEC.7.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ba hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva; ta ta tadikakana tadikakana bae kara namo henidia bona bae bogadia hisi.
ZEC.7.9.english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

ZEC.3.4.motu: Bena hari aneru ese ia vairanai ginidia taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Hari hahedoki miroka-mirokadia na iena amo ba hadokidia oho. Bena ia ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, A itaia, emu kara havara na emu amo vada na abia oho, dabua mai hairaidia na do baina hahedokilaimu.
ZEC.3.4.english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

ZEC.4.10.motu: Badina be ḡau maraḡidia dinana vada e dadaraia tauna na baine moale, bona gini-maoro varona baine itaia Serubabele imana ai.
ZEC.4.10.english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

ZEC.11.11.motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai e heutu, bona mamoe e hoihoilaidia taudia ese e itagu tao, bena lalodia vada e parara una na Iehova ena hereva.
ZEC.11.11.english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.

ZEC.9.10.motu: Kariota na Efraim amo baina negea daure,
ZEC.9.10.english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim

ZEC.9.13.motu: Badina be Iuda vada na marea, egu peva;
ZEC.9.13.english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me.

ZEC.8.18.motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
ZEC.8.18.english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

ZEC.10.4.motu: Idia bogaragidia amo daiguni nadina bainema;
ZEC.10.4.english: From him will come the cornerstone,

ZEC.6.7.motu: Hari hosi na e heau lasi negana ai, idia na e ḡava, baela, tanobada bae itaia tao eto. Bena ia eto, Aola, tanobada ba itaia tao. Taunabunai, idia na tanobada i'ita-taona ela.
ZEC.6.7.english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

ZEC.8.19.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Hua ihahanina bona iha-imana bona ihahituna bona ihagwautana anivagadia na moale bona hisi-dae negadia ai baela, Iuda taudia bogaragidiai, bona hahemoale ariadia negadia ai baela danu; taunabunai hereva momokani bona maino ba ura henidia.
ZEC.8.19.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

ZEC.14.7.motu: Bena diari na baine hesiriu hanaihanai (Iehova na mai dibana), dia dina bona dia hanuaboi; ena be dina baine diho to diari na baine mia.
ZEC.14.7.english: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

ZEC.4.1.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ma ema, e haogu, mahuta tauna bema haoa na heto.
ZEC.4.1.english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

ZEC.12.5.motu: Bena Iuda iduhudia taudia na bae hereva heheni, baeto “Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese goada e abiamu, Iehova Sabaota, edia Dirava, dainai”.
ZEC.12.5.english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Yahweh of Armies their God.’

ZEC.6.5.motu: Hari aneru ese e haere henigu, eto, Ini na tanobada idoinai Lohiana vairanai bae hedinarai guna, bena guba laina haniosi ediai baela.
ZEC.6.5.english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

ZEC.6.14.motu: Bena hari havava ḡauna na Iehova ena dubu ai baine mia, Heledai, Tobia, Iedaia bona Iosia Sefania ihahelalo-unedia totona.
ZEC.6.14.english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

ZEC.14.1.motu: A itaia, Iehova ena dina na e maimu; una dina ai emui amo e dadi oho kohudia na bogaragimui ai ma bae heharilai.
ZEC.14.1.english: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

ZEC.12.7.motu: Iehova ese kwalimu na Iuda kalagadia baine henidia guna, David iduhuna hairaina bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia hairaidia ese Iuda hairaina basie hereaia helaoreana.
ZEC.12.7.english: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

ZEC.3.1.motu: Bena ia ese hahelaḡa tauna badana Iosua e haheitalaigu, Iehova ena aneru vairanai e gini, bona Satana na ia idibana kahana ai e gini, ihabadelaina totona.
ZEC.3.1.english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

ZEC.11.3.motu: A hakala, mamoe ireḡudia taudia na e taimu!
ZEC.11.3.english: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds!

ZEC.11.10.motu: Bena egu itotohi ladana Harihari-bada na abia, na hakwaidua; unu amo egu gwauhamata, bese iboudiai na gwau hamalalai henidia ḡauna, na na utua.
ZEC.11.10.english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

ZEC.1.18.motu: Bena na gaga isi, doa hani na itadia.
ZEC.1.18.english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

ZEC.2.12.motu: Bena Iehova ese Iuda baine abia, ia ahuna ai baine halaoa, tano helaḡana lalonai; bona Ierusalem ma baine abia hidi lou.
ZEC.2.12.english: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

ZEC.6.1.motu: Bena na gaga isi lou, kariota hani na itadia, ororo rua padadia amo e maiva. Hari ororo na auri-laboralabora ororodia.
ZEC.6.1.english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

ZEC.2.8.motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau toma, ia hairaina ese e dadimui besedia dekediai e siaigu murinai, badina be umui e daumui tohomu tauna ese ia matana nadinadina e daua tohomu;
ZEC.2.8.english: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

ZEC.3.7.motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu dala ai boma raka bona egu hahedua boma badinaia, bena egu ruma do ba biagua bona egu maḡu do ba reḡudia; bona baina gwau maoro henimu, do ba raka vareai diba, iniseni ai ginidia taudia bogaragidiai.
ZEC.3.7.english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

ZEC.7.3.motu: Bona Iehova Sabaota ena dubu ai hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia na bae nanadaidia baeto, Hua iha-imana ai baina taitai bona baina anivaga, laḡani gunadia momo lalodiai vada na karaia heḡereḡerena eiava?
ZEC.7.3.english: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

ZEC.14.6.motu: Una dina ai keru eiava paraka mavamavana basie vara.
ZEC.14.6.english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

ZEC.5.10.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na na nanadaia, nato, tlari tohe na ede e laohaiamu?
ZEC.5.10.english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

ZEC.8.1.motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
ZEC.8.1.english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

ZEC.14.4.motu: Una dina ai, ia aena na Olive ororona, Ierusalem vairanai, mairiveina kahana ai e miamu ḡauna, latanai bae hahedai; bona Olive ororona baine hepola parara, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana; koura mai lababana ta baine hekara. Taunabunai Ororo kahana ta na mirigini kahana bainela, bona kahana ta na diho kahana bainela.
ZEC.14.4.english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

ZEC.9.14.motu: Bena Iehova na idia daediai baine hedinarai,
ZEC.9.14.english: Yahweh will be seen over them.

ZEC.14.9.motu: Bena Iehova ese tanobada idoinai baine pavapavaia; una dina ai Iehova na baine tamona bona ia ladana danu baine tamona.
ZEC.14.9.english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

ZEC.8.7.motu: Iehova Sabaota ma ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu bese taudia baina hamauridia, laurabada kahana tanodia amo bona lahara kahana tanodia amo;
ZEC.8.7.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

ZEC.8.17.motu: ba hahedika heheni daladia na lalomui ai basio lalo hata, bona gwauhamata koikoidia basio uralai; badina be unu ḡau iboudiai na na inai henidiamu. Iehova na e herevamu.
ZEC.8.17.english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.

ZEC.5.2.motu: Ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka o itaiamu a? Lau na haere, nato, Buka helokuna ta rohona ai na itaiamu; ena lata na kiubit ruahui bona ena lababa na hubit gwauta.
ZEC.5.2.english: He said to me, “What do you see?”

ZEC.5.3.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na heuduguirai ḡauna, tano idoinai daenai e laomu; badina be ina murinai henao taudia iboudiai na bae henege daure, ia lalonai e hedinaraimu heḡereḡerena bona ia murinai e gwau hamata koikoimu taudia iboudiai na bae henege daure, ia lalonai e hedinaraimu heḡereḡerena.
ZEC.5.3.english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

ZEC.6.4.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, Ḡauka e, ini be dahaka?
ZEC.6.4.english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

ZEC.8.22.motu: Bese momo bona basileia mai goadadia na baema, Ierusalem ai Iehova Sabaota bae tahua bona Iehova bae noia ia ese baine hahenamo henidia.
ZEC.8.22.english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”

ZEC.4.4.motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, Ḡauka e, ini na dahaka?
ZEC.4.4.english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

ZEC.14.15.motu: Bena dai-hanai gorerena ta, hari gorere heḡereḡerena na hosi bona doniki badadia bona kamelo bona doniki maraḡidia, bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia dahaka dahaka unu taruha lalodiai bae mia, latadiai baine kau.
ZEC.14.15.english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

ZEC.3.8.motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana Iosua e, harihari a kamonai, oi bona turamu hahidaosi vairamu ai helaidia, badina be idia na haridia nanamo taudia; a itaia, egu hesiai tauna, Rigi, baina mailaia.
ZEC.3.8.english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

ZEC.5.6.motu: Bena lau nato, Una na dahaka? Ia eto, Una na tohe ta e laomu. Ma eto, Ina na edia kara havara, tano idoinai lalonai.

ZEC.12.4.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai, hosi iboudiai kudoudia baina hahetahadia, bona hosi-gui taudia iboudiai na baina hakavakavadia. A Iuda iduhuna taudia na matagu baina hapapa henidia, bese idau-idau taudia edia hosi iboudiai matadia baina hakepuludia negana ai.
ZEC.12.4.english: In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

ZEC.5.1.motu: Bena na gaga isi lou, na roha lao, buka helokuna ta na itaia, e rohova.
ZEC.5.1.english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

ZEC.1.7.motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihagwauta-tana, ladana Sebata, dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Sekaria Berekia, Ido tubuna, enai e kau. Sekaria eto,
ZEC.1.7.english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

ZEC.1.4.motu: Tamamui heḡereḡeredia ai basiola. Peroveta gunadia ese idia e boi henidia, eto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dikadia amo ba raka kerehai. Iehova na e tomu, To idia na asae kamonai, egu hereva asie abia dae.
ZEC.1.4.english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says Yahweh.

ZEC.2.10.motu: Siona natuna hahinena e, ane avabia, a moale; badina be, a itaia, lau na vasimu, umui bogaragimui ai baina noho. Iehova na e herevamu.
ZEC.2.10.english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

ZEC.7.6.motu: Bona o anianimu o inuinumu negadia ai, umui sibomui daimui ai o anianimu bona o inuinumu, ani?
ZEC.7.6.english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

ZEC.1.20.motu: Bena Iehova ese auri iḡaukaralaina taudia hahani na e haheitalaigu.

ZEC.8.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Umui, ina negana ai ini hereva o hakala henimu, dubu helaḡana baine gini totona Iehova Sabaota ena dubu badina e atoa dinana amo peroveta taudia ududia amo e lasi herevadia o kamonaimu taumui e, imamui ba ha-aukadia.
ZEC.8.9.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

ZEC.8.10.motu: Badina be unu dina do asie kau ai, taunimanima ena ḡaukara na asi davana bona boromakau maruanena ena ḡaukara na asi davana, bona e raka lasi eiava e raka vareai tauna na asi ena dala ana inai tauna imana amo baine roho mauri; badina be lau ese taunimanima iboudiai na bamodia ida na haheinaidia heheni.
ZEC.8.10.english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

ZEC.7.7.motu: Ierusalem bona ena hetabira hanuadia na e noholaidiava mai namodia ida, bona diho kahana bona taora kahadia danue noholaidiava, negana ai ini hereva na Iehova ese peroveta taudia gunadia ududia amo e gwaurai, ani?
ZEC.7.7.english: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

ZEC.7.13.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau na boiboi bena idia asie kamonai heḡereḡerena ai idia e boiboi bena lau asina kamonai;
ZEC.7.13.english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;

ZEC.13.6.motu: Bena ta ese bema nanadaidia, bema toma “Ene dorumui berodia be dahaka?”, idia baeto “Ini bero na turamai edia ruma ai a davari”.
ZEC.13.6.english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

ZEC.3.6.motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Iosua e sisiba henia, eto,
ZEC.3.6.english: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

ZEC.9.17.english: For how great is his goodness,

ZEC.1.11.motu: Bena idia ese Iehova ena aneru, keroro audia bogaragidiai e giniva aneruna, e haere henia, eto, Tanobada vada a itaia tao; vada a itaia, tanobada idoinai e noho mainomu.
ZEC.1.11.english: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

ZEC.9.9.motu: Siona kekenimu e, a moale hisi dae!

ZEC.12.10.motu: Bena David iduhuna bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia latadiai hebogahisi bona noinoi laumana baina seia dobi; taunabunai vada e gwadaia uru tauna bae raraia negana ai, idia na ia taina bae tai, ta ese natuna vara edeana bema tailaia na heto, bona bae tai ḡadeḡadelaia, ta ese natuna roboana bema taitailaia na heto.
ZEC.12.10.english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

ZEC.10.12.motu: Iehova ena goada ai baina hagoadadia,
ZEC.10.12.english: I will strengthen them in Yahweh.

ZEC.5.4.motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Lau ese baina siaia lao, henao tauna ena ruma lalonai baine vareai bona lau ladagu ai e gwau hamata koikoimu tauna ena ruma lalonai danu; bena ena ruma ai baine mia ela bona baine ha-olea, au bona nadi danu baine ha-oredia.
ZEC.5.4.english: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

ZEC.8.6.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Reana ina nega ai ina bese kwabukwabuna ese una kara na bema hoalaia dainai umui na o tomamu lau ese danu baina hoalaia a! Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
ZEC.8.6.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.11.15.motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Mamoe ireḡudia tauna asi namona ena ḡaukara ḡaudia ma bavabidia lou.
ZEC.11.15.english: Yahweh said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

ZEC.1.15.motu: Bena lau ese e noho namonamomu besedia na badu henidia dikadikamu; badina be sisina mo na badu negana ai, idia ese dika ma e habadaia.
ZEC.1.15.english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

ZEC.8.5.motu: Bona una hanua ariaradia na memero bona kekeni ese bae hahonudia, ariara lalodiai bae gadara.
ZEC.8.5.english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

ZEC.7.1.motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina ai, huana ihataurahani-tana, ladana Kisleve, dinana ihahanina lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na Sekaria enai e kau.
ZEC.7.1.english: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

ZEC.9.2.english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it,

ZEC.1.2.motu: Iehova ese tamamui e badu henidia dikadika.
ZEC.1.2.english: “Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.

ZEC.10.6.english: “I will strengthen the house of Judah,

ZEC.9.5.motu: Askelono ese baine itaia, bena baine gari;
ZEC.9.5.english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear;

ZEC.1.10.motu: Taunabunai keroro audia bogaragidiai e giniva tauna na e haere, eto, Ini be Iehova ese tanobada i'itataona totona e siaidia ḡaudia.
ZEC.1.10.english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones Yahweh has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

ZEC.8.20.motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Bese idau-idau taudia do baema, hanua momo inoholaidia taudia;
ZEC.8.20.english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

ZEC.6.8.motu: Bena ia ese e boi henigu, eto, A itaia, mirigini kahana vada e lao heniamu taudia ese Laumagu vada e halagaia ani, una mirigini kahana tanona ai.
ZEC.6.8.english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

ZEC.14.5.motu: Egu ororo kourana na baine hekou ahu; badina be ororo kourana ese ia ohena ai baine hetomu kau. Bena umui na ba heau oho, Usia, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai tano laḡa o heautania na heto. Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, bainema bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai danu ia ida.
ZEC.14.5.english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

ZEC.9.6.motu: vara-hanai taudia na Asdod ai bae noho;

ZEC.14.8.motu: Una dina ai, mauri ranudia na Ierusalem lalona amo bae aru lasi, kahana na laurabada kahana davarana ai bae aru lasi, ma kahana na lahara kahana davarana ai; bae aru hanaihanai, siahu negana ai bona keru negana ai danu.
ZEC.14.8.english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

ZEC.10.11.english: He will pass through the sea of affliction,

ZEC.4.6.motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na Iehova ena hereva Serubabele enai. Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Dia goada amo eiava dia siahu amo, a Laumagu amo.
ZEC.4.6.english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

ZEC.4.8.motu: Iehova ena hereva ma ta danu egu ai e kau, eto,
ZEC.4.8.english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

ZEC.1.8.motu: Hanuaboi ai tau ta na itaia, hosi kakakakana ai e gui. Ia na koura ai e gini, keroro audia bogaragidiai; ia murinai na hosi haida, kakakakadia bona mai toutoudia bona kurokurodia.
ZEC.1.8.english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

ZEC.6.2.motu: Kariota gini-gunana mai hosi kakakakadia; iharuana na mai hosi koremadia;
ZEC.6.2.english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

ZEC.9.12.motu: Dauhai nohomui ai o helaro hanaihanaimu taumui e,
ZEC.9.12.english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope!

ZEC.11.5.motu: E hoidia taudia ese e aladia masemu, bona ta ese matadia se hakanidiamu; e hoihoilaidiamu taudia na e tomu “Iehova aita hanamoa, lau vada na taḡa”; bona ireḡudia taudia korikoridia ese asie bogadia hisimu.
ZEC.11.5.english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

ZEC.14.12.motu: Bena Ierusalem bae tuari henia besedia iboudiai na Iehova ese ina dai-hanai gorerena amo baine hahisidia: ginidia ai hidiodia bae pata, bona kwaradia ai matadia bae pata, bona ududia ai maladia bae pata.
ZEC.14.12.english: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

ZEP.1.4.motu: Lau ese imagu baina toia roro, Iuda ihadikana totona,
ZEP.1.4.english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

ZEP.3.1.motu: Gwau-edeede hanuana, vada e miro hanuana,
ZEP.3.1.english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

ZEP.2.7.motu: Kone tanona na Iuda besena kwabukwabudia ese bae ḡaunaia,
ZEP.2.7.english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.

ZEP.3.2.english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.

ZEP.3.6.motu: Bese idau-idau vada na negedia daure,
ZEP.3.6.english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

ZEP.3.18.english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

ZEP.1.9.motu: Una dina ai ruma raka-vareaina e rohoa hanaimu taudia iboudiai,
ZEP.1.9.english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

ZEP.1.12.motu: Una negana ai lau ese lamepa baina abi kau,
ZEP.1.12.english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

ZEP.3.12.motu: Badina be bogaragimu ai bese ta baina hanohoa,
ZEP.3.12.english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

ZEP.2.4.english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

ZEP.2.3.motu: Umui tano taumui mai manaumui ida,
ZEP.2.3.english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh’s anger.

ZEP.3.4.motu: Ena peroveta taudia na e gwau edeedemu,
ZEP.3.4.english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

ZEP.1.11.motu: Raro-kaka kourana inoholaina taumui e, a tai lolololo!
ZEP.1.11.english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

ZEP.1.10.motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai
ZEP.1.10.english: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

ZEP.2.2.english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

ZEP.2.13.motu: Bena ia ese imana na mirigini kahana baine toi roro henia,
ZEP.2.13.english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

ZEP.3.20.motu: Una negana ai lau ese emui gabu korikori ai baina hakaumui vareai,
ZEP.3.20.english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

ZEP.1.7.motu: Ḡaubada Iehova vairanai asi reḡereḡemui ba noho;
ZEP.1.7.english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

ZEP.2.11.english: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

ZEP.1.5.motu: ruma guhidia ai e igo dihomu guba hisiudia e toma henidia dihomu taudia,
ZEP.1.5.english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,

ZEP.3.9.motu: Oibe, una negana ai bese idau-idau gadodia baina ha-idaudia,
ZEP.3.9.english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

ZEP.3.7.motu: Lau nato “Momokani, ia ese baine gari henigu,
ZEP.3.7.english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

ZEP.2.12.english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

ZEP.2.8.english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

ZEP.3.17.motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, na bogaragimu ai,
ZEP.3.17.english: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

ZEP.2.10.motu: Ahudia unu bae heto, edia hekokoroku davana;
ZEP.2.10.english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

ZEP.3.14.motu: Siona kekenimu e, ane avabia badabada!
ZEP.3.14.english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

ZEP.1.13.motu: Edia kohu na haida ese bae dadi oho,
ZEP.1.13.english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

ZEP.2.14.motu: Nani seridia na ia bogaraginai bae hekure,
ZEP.2.14.english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

ZEP.3.8.english: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

ZEP.3.19.motu: A itaia, una negana ai e daḡedaḡe henimumu taudia iboudiai na
ZEP.3.19.english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

ZEP.1.6.motu: bona Iehova igavana amo vada e raka muri,
ZEP.1.6.english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.

ZEP.1.16.english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

ZEP.3.11.motu: Una dina ai ta ese basine hahemaraimu,
ZEP.3.11.english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

ZEP.1.15.english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

ZEP.1.3.motu: Taunimanima bona uda ḡaudia baina darodia oho,
ZEP.1.3.english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

ZEP.1.17.motu: Lau ese hisihisi baina mailaia taunimanima latadiai,
ZEP.1.17.english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

ZEP.1.14.motu: Iehova ena dina badana vada eme kahikahi,
ZEP.1.14.english: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

ZEP.3.13.english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

ZEP.3.5.motu: Ia lalonai Iehova na e kara maoromaoromu,
ZEP.3.5.english: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

ZEP.3.10.english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

ZEP.1.8.motu: Iehova ese ena boubou ḡauna baine hahelaḡaia dinana ai,
ZEP.1.8.english: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

ZEP.3.3.motu: Ena heitatao taudia ia lalonai na
ZEP.3.3.english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

ZEP.2.6.english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

ZEP.3.16.motu: Una dina ai Ierusalem bae hereva henia, baeto:
ZEP.3.16.english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

ZEP.1.1.motu: Iehova ena hereva Sefania enai e kau, Iosia Amon, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai. Hari Sefania na Kusi natuna; Kusi na Gedalia natuna, Gedalia na Amaria natuna, Amaria na Hesekia natuna.
ZEP.1.1.english: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

ZEP.1.18.motu: Edia silver eiava edia gold ese basie hamauridia diba,
ZEP.1.18.english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

ZEP.2.1.english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

ZEP.1.2.english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

ZEP.3.15.motu: Iehova ese ena hahemaoro herevadia na oi latamu amo vada e abia oho;
ZEP.3.15.english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

ZEP.2.15.english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

ZEP.2.9.motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na e tomu:
ZEP.2.9.english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

ZEP.2.5.motu: Kone taumui e, Kerete besena e,
ZEP.2.5.english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Yahweh’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.
